You will work with business and technical teams to make enterprise data discoverable, trusted, and well governed. 
 Key Responsibilities Implement and configure Informatica IDMC Cloud Data Governance and Catalog (CDGC), Axon, or Enterprise Data Catalog (EDC) for enterprise data governance. Define data governance policies, data ownership, and stewardship models, and set up governance workflows. Build and maintain end-to-end data lineage (business, technical, and column-level) across source systems, ETL pipelines, data warehouses, and BI tools. Configure and run metadata scanners and catalog resources for databases, ETL tools, cloud platforms, and reporting tools. Create and manage the business glossary, data dictionary, critical data elements (CDEs), and data domains. Link business terms to technical assets and stitch lineage across systems, including custom and manual lineage where needed. Perform impact analysis and lineage validation to support change management, audit, and regulatory needs. Define data quality rules, profiling, and scorecards using Informatica Cloud Data Quality (CDQ). Design and develop data integration mappings and taskflows using IDMC Cloud Data Integration (CDI), where required. Write and optimize SQL queries for metadata analysis and data validation. Work with data owners, stewards, architects, and ETL teams to onboard data assets into the catalog. Troubleshoot scanner, lineage, and catalog issues, and tune performance. Create governance documentation, dashboards, and training material, and drive adoption of governance practices. 
 Required Skills and Qualifications Experience: 4-7 years in data management, data governance, or data integration, with at least 2 years on Informatica IDMC or related governance tools. Hands-on experience with Informatica IDMC (CDGC, Axon, or EDC) and metadata scanners. Strong understanding of data lineage concepts, including technical, business, and column-level lineage. Good knowledge of data governance frameworks (DAMA-DMBOK), data stewardship, and data policies. Working knowledge of Informatica Data Quality, profiling, and rule creation. Good understanding of data warehousing, ETL, and data modelling concepts. Strong SQL skills for metadata analysis and validation. Excellent stakeholder management, documentation, and communication skills. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or a related field.

description:
Time and Venue:

Timing: 10.00 AM - 1.00 PM
Venue: Interview Location-Sodexo GBS
11th Floor, IT4 Building,
NESCO Center, North Wing,
Goregaon East, Mumbai, Maharashtra – 400063

1. Purpose of the Job State concisely the aim of the job. This role is the first point of contact for service requests received by the Regional Command Centre. The Helpdesk Team Member captures, validates and logs requests received by phone, email and self-service channels, applies the correct priority and SLA, and ensures complete and accurate work orders are handed over to the Scheduling team, supporting effective and compliant service delivery from India GBS, Mumbai. 2. Dimensions Point out the main figures / indicators to give some insight on the volumes managed by the position and/or the activity of the Department. Characteristics 
 Individual contributor handling inbound and outbound calls, shared mailboxes and self-service request queues, without direct people management responsibility. Creates and validates reactive work orders, escalates emergency requests and supports achievement of telephony, email and SLA / KPI targets. Operates in support of the Regional Command Centre from India GBS, Mumbai. 3. Organization chart Indicate schematically the position of the job within the organization. It is sufficient to indicate one hierarchical level above (including possible functional boss) and, if applicable, one below the position. In the horizontal direction, the other jobs reporting to the same superior should be indicated. 4. Context and main issues Describe the most difficult types of problems the jobholder has to face (internal or external to Sodexo) and/or the regulations, guidelines, practices that are to be adhered to. Capturing complete and accurate requester, location, access and fault information while handling high call and email volumes. Applying contract scope, classification, priority and SLA rules consistently across multiple client contracts. Recognizing emergency requests and following the contract-specific escalation route without delay. Managing incomplete, duplicate or out-of-scope requests while maintaining professional customer experience. Ensuring work orders handed over to the Scheduling team are complete and ready for assignment. Working within a shift-based environment and adhering to SOPs, data quality standards and the knowledge bank. Compliance with Sodexo policies, procedures, health and safety requirements, and ethical standards. 5. Main assignments Indicate the main activities / duties to be conducted in the job. Handle inbound calls using diagnostic scripting to capture caller details, building location, nature of fault and access requirements. Check for duplicates and contract scope, apply the correct classification and priority, and raise reactive work orders in the system. Manage the Helpdesk shared mailbox on an oldest-first basis, raising work orders for each request and filing completed emails. Validate self-service requests for accuracy, completeness, location, classification and priority, and correct them where required. Make outbound calls to requesters to obtain missing information requested by the Scheduling team and update work orders accordingly. Handle calls and emails from suppliers and site engineers (e.g. attendance and job status updates), updating work orders accordingly. Escalate emergencies by phone, notify the named Scheduler and on-site contacts, and follow the contract-specific escalation list. Handle out-of-hours requests in line with the contract service matrix, logging actions clearly for the day team. Log customer complaints and cancellations accurately and pass them to the relevant owner for resolution. Keep knowledge bank information up to date, including site lead and engineer details, as changes occur. Participate in call and email quality reviews, coaching and refresher training, and apply feedback. Identify opportunities for process improvement and communicate recommendations to the Helpdesk Team Lead. Perform all other duties as required. 6. Accountabilities Give the 3 to 5 key outputs of the position vis--vis the organization; they should focus on end results, not duties or activities. Accurate and complete work orders raised within agreed telephony, email and SLA targets. Timely escalation of emergency and high-priority requests through the correct contract route. Clear and complete handovers to the Scheduling team, minimizing rework and outbound follow-ups. Professional and consistent customer interactions that meet quality and compliance standards. Contribution to continuous improvement of Helpdesk processes and knowledge content. 7. Person Specification Indicate the skills, knowledge and experience that the job holder should require to conduct the role effectively Qualification: Graduate, fluent in English. Years of experience: 2-6 years. Experience in a Command Centre, Helpdesk, Contact Centre, BPO, Facilities Management or Customer Service environment. Working knowledge of ERP (e.g., Salesforce, Maximo) is desirable. Understanding reactive maintenance, priorities and SLA / KPI concepts is desirable. Strong call handling and diagnostic questioning skills. Clear and professional telephone manner, comfortable handling calls from based customers and suppliers, with familiarity with English, geography and addresses. Good MS Office skills, including Outlook and Excel. Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English. Ability to remain calm and make sound decisions under pressure. Flexible and adaptable to change, and willing to incorporate changes to duties, methods and working hours. Ability to work effectively in a rotational shift-based environment aligned to service hours, including nights, weekends and public holidays as rostered. Demonstrates Sodexo values and behaviors. Strong commitment to Zero Harm and a positive safety culture. Successful completion of pre-employment background verification is required; client-specific screening equivalent to BPSS / DBS may apply depending on the accounts supported. 8. Competencies Indicate which of the Sodexo core competencies and any professional competencies that the role requires Growth, Client & Customer Satisfaction / Quality of Services provided Communication Analysis and Decision Making Planning and organising Rigorous Management of Results Learning & Development

title: Commerce & Content Architect
description:
Role Overview 
 We are looking for the senior technical authority for Adobe Commerce and Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) solutioning in our India practice. You will design and deliver end-to-end content and commerce solutions across the whole Adobe Commerce estate, from legacy Magento to SaaS and headless storefronts. This role has three parts. First, you own presales end to end, from discovery to the oral defence of proposals. Second, you keep an active, billable presence across client engagements. Third, you spearhead Bounteous's agentic commerce offering, taking clients from a "website that sells" to a "commerce platform that agents can transact with." 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Commerce & Content Architecture Lead technical design and build scalable solution architecture for complex B2C, B2B and hybrid commerce programs. Architect across every Adobe Commerce deployment model: Magento Open Source Adobe Commerce on-premises Adobe Commerce on Cloud infrastructure (PaaS) Adobe Commerce as a Cloud Service (ACCS, SaaS) Adobe Commerce Optimizer layered over existing or third-party backends Advise clients on the trade-offs in code ownership, hosting, upgrade responsibility, extensibility and licensing. Define modernization and replatforming paths from Magento 1 and Magento 2 Enterprise/Open Source estates. This includes moving in-process PHP customizations to out-of-process extensibility with Adobe App Builder, Adobe I/O Events, webhooks and API Mesh. Define reference architectures for composable and headless commerce: Commerce Storefront powered by Edge Delivery Services Commerce drop-in components (B2C and B2B) Catalog Service, Live Search and Product Recommendations GraphQL and REST integration patterns PWA Studio and custom React/Next.js frontends where appropriate Architect content + commerce with AEM in both modes: Traditional / hybrid: AEM Sites with the Commerce Integration Framework (CIF), including running Edge Delivery and CIF pages side by side during phased migrations. Headless / modern: AEM as a Cloud Service with Content Fragments and GraphQL, Edge Delivery Services, Universal Editor and Document-based Authoring, and Product Visuals powered by AEM Assets. Design integrations with ERP, OMS, PIM, payments, tax, search, 3PL, CRM and identity systems. Validate the client's roadmap against current and expected Adobe Commerce features. Own non-functional architecture: performance and caching (Varnish, Fastly/CDN, Redis/Valkey), search (OpenSearch), message queues (RabbitMQ/AMQP), high availability, security, PCI and data-privacy compliance across regions. 
 Presales & Solutioning Lead consultative discovery and solution-definition workshops with client business and technology stakeholders. Translate business requirements into solution blueprints, integration diagrams, technical narratives and delivery plans. Build bottom-up effort estimates, assumptions, risks and dependencies, and phased roadmaps. Partner with Growth, Delivery and Client Partner teams on commercial models. Prepare compelling proposals and Statements of Work with the technical solution design, engagement and execution approach, timelines and estimates. Present and defend them orally to client executives and procurement panels. Build and run demos, proofs of concept and capability showcases, including agentic commerce prototypes. 
 Agentic Commerce Innovation Define Bounteous's agentic commerce reference architecture for Adobe clients. Make catalog, pricing, inventory, cart, checkout, order and post-purchase capabilities safely accessible to AI agents through the Adobe Commerce MCP Server, App Builder and API Mesh. Design solutions with Adobe CX Enterprise Coworker, Adobe Experience Platform Agent Orchestrator, Experience Platform Agents and Brand Concierge for conversational, grounded shopping experiences. Assess client readiness for AI discovery surfaces (including product feeds) and architect support for open agentic-commerce standards: Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP), from Google and major retailers Agentic Commerce Protocol (ACP), from OpenAI and Stripe Agent Payments Protocol (AP2) Design and build custom MCP servers, agents and skills with Anthropic's Claude (Claude Agent SDK, Claude Code, Agent Skills). Example use cases include B2B buying and reordering assistants, merchandising and catalog-enrichment agents, order-management and customer-service agents, and AI-assisted migration and code-modernization agents. Build guardrails into every agentic design: authentication and delegated authorization, spend limits, human-in-the-loop approval, fraud and agent-trust controls, auditability, observability and evaluation. Use the Adobe Commerce Developer Agent, the App Builder MCP and Claude Code to accelerate delivery, and set standards for AI-assisted code review, testing and security scanning. Turn innovations into reusable Bounteous accelerators, demos and intellectual property. 
 Delivery Leadership & Governance Provide architectural guidance to engineers through build, QA and deployment, reviewing implementation against architectural intent. Assess client environments, analyze project issues and act as the escalation point and decision-maker on critical technical issues across concurrent engagements. Establish coding standards, review mechanisms, DevOps/CI-CD practices (Cloud Manager, ECE-Tools, GitHub/GitLab) and delivery governance aligned with Adobe best practices. 
 Practice Building & Mentoring Mentor architects and senior engineers and share technical knowledge across the Adobe DX and Commerce practice. Contribute to the India practice's competency roadmap, Centre of Excellence, internal trainings, hackathons and certification programs, including Adobe and Claude certifications. Represent Bounteous in Adobe and Anthropic partner forums, client briefings and industry events. Contribute thought leadership on agentic commerce. 
 Required Qualifications Experience in commerce architecture, digital platforms or enterprise application design, including 5+ years in a Lead or Technical Architect capacity on Magento / Adobe Commerce. Extensive hands-on architecture experience across legacy Magento versions: Magento 1 (Community and Enterprise Edition) and Magento 2 / Adobe Commerce (Open Source and Commerce/Enterprise), including M1M2 and M2Cloud migrations. Deep knowledge of Adobe Commerce on Cloud infrastructure: environments, deployment, scaling, Fastly, New Relic and tuning. Working knowledge of Adobe Commerce as a Cloud Service and Adobe Commerce Optimizer. Proven experience designing headless and composable Adobe Commerce architectures. Hands-on experience integrating Adobe Commerce with AEM, in both CIF-based and headless modes. Strong experience integrating commerce platforms with enterprise systems for both B2B and B2C. Technical proficiency in PHP, JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, React, MySQL, Redis, OpenSearch/Elasticsearch, RabbitMQ and CDN/edge configuration. Demonstrated end-to-end presales track record with senior client stakeholders. Working understanding of agentic AI architectures (LLMs, tool calling, RAG, multi-agent orchestration) and the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or Engineering, or equivalent experience. 
 Preferred Qualifications Adobe Certified Master Adobe Commerce Architect (AD0-E722), plus Adobe Commerce Developer Expert certifications. Adobe Certified Master AEM Sites Architect (AD0-E117) or AEM Sites Developer Expert. Hands-on experience building with Claude / Anthropic: agents, skills and custom MCP servers. Claude is our preferred model platform. Prototype or production experience with Adobe's agentic tools (including AEM Co-worker and Adobe LLM Optimizer), UCP/ACP/AP2 or commerce MCP implementations. Familiarity with Adobe Experience Platform / Real-Time CDP, Adobe Journey Optimizer, Adobe Analytics/CJA and Adobe Target as they relate to commerce personalization. Exposure to other commerce platforms (Salesforce Commerce Cloud, commercetools, Shopify Plus) for competitive and replatforming conversations. Experience in a consultancy or agency environment serving global clients across time zones. 
 Soft Skills Executive presence and a consultative, trusted-advisor style. You can explain complex architecture to non-technical stakeholders. Strong written communication. A commercial mindset that balances scope, risk, margin and client value. Curiosity and a bias to build. You prototype new technology quickly. A collaborative leadership style across onshore and offshore teams. Ownership and accountability in fast-moving, ambiguous environments.

You will join one of our international engineering squads (Germany and India), working under the guidance of your Software Engineering Team Lead and senior engineers on your team. You will be given real, well-scoped pieces of work - not busywork - and the support to grow quickly: pairing, code review, and structured feedback are part of how the team operates day to day. This is a strong platform to learn on. Our codebase is large and touches many interconnected components, so youll build not just coding skill but the habit of thinking carefully about how a change affects the wider system - a skill that compounds over your whole career. Responsibilities Feature Implementation: Implement well-scoped features, bug fixes, and enhancements under the guidance of your Team Lead and senior engineers. Write clean, tested code across the stack - C#/.NET services, SQL Server data access, and React front-ends - following established patterns and standards. Break down assigned tasks into clear implementation steps, asking clarifying questions early rather than guessing at ambiguous requirements. Fix defects identified by QA or reported in production, learning to diagnose root causes rather than just patching symptoms. Quality & Testing: Write unit and integration tests for the code you deliver, as a core part of "done" rather than an optional extra. Participate in code reviews - both receiving feedback and, as you grow, reviewing the work of peers. Follow the team's engineering standards: layered architecture, API design conventions, and our React corporate design system. Verify your own changes thoroughly before raising them for review, including checking for obvious edge cases. Learning & Growth: Actively build your understanding of the platform's architecture, data model, and key components - asking questions and using documentation, pairing, and code reading to ramp up. Seek and act on feedback from code reviews, 1:1s, and pairing sessions - treating early mistakes as part of the learning process. Build foundational skills in requirements analysis, technical design, and estimation by working alongside more senior engineers on real tasks. Collaboration: Work closely with your Team Lead, senior engineers, QA, and Business Analysts as part of daily squad activities (stand-ups, planning, reviews). Communicate progress, blockers, and questions clearly and early - this is more valuable at this stage than trying to solve everything independently. Contribute positively to an international team culture, working comfortably with colleagues across time zones. AI-Augmented Engineering: Use AI tools in your day-to-day work - for learning, coding assistance, debugging, and documentation - under guidance from senior engineers, building good habits for using them effectively and responsibly. This is a core expectation, not a nice-to-have. title: Analytics Engineer-Senior AI / RAG Platform Engineer
description:
Job Description Experience Level: 5+ Years
Work Arrangement: Hybrid / Remote Flexible
 Executive Overview
We are looking for an experienced, hands-on Senior AI & RAG Platform Engineer with 5+ years of software engineering and applied AI experience to lead the architecture, configuration, optimisation, and production deployment of our generative AI capabilities. In this role, you will be the technical owner responsible for designing advanced Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, managing vector indexing and retrieval lifecycle, orchestrating foundation models (both open-source and proprietary), and embedding these AI services natively into our in-house custom-developed platform.
 Key Responsibilities
1. Advanced RAG Architecture & Pipeline Configuration
• End-to-End Retrieval Pipelines: Design, configure, and optimise enterprise RAG pipelines combining dense vector search, sparse keyword search (BM25), reciprocal rank fusion (RRF), and cross-encoder reranking models (Cohere Rerank, BGE).
• Document Parsing & ETL: Build robust ingestion workflows for parsing, segmenting, and embedding multi-format documents (PDFs, Markdown, relational data, APIs) with semantic chunking and hierarchy preservation.
• Vector Lifecycle & Operations: Configure and maintain production vector databases (e.g., pgvector, Qdrant, Pinecone, Milvus, Weaviate), including multi-tenant partitioning, payload indexing, and HNSW index tuning.
2. AI Model Selection, Orchestration & Agents
• Model Integration: Evaluate, select, and configure foundation models (OpenAI GPT-4o, Anthropic Claude 3.5, Llama 3.1/3.3, Mistral) based on cost, context limits, latency, and task complexity.
• Agentic Workflows & Tool Calling: Implement structured schema decoding (JSON/Pydantic), function calling, and multi-step agentic execution flows (using LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or custom workflows).
• Fine-Tuning & Serving (Optional/Targeted): Conduct parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT / LoRA / QLoRA) when necessary, and deploy open-weight models via inference servers such as vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, or Ollama.
3. Custom Platform Integration & Engineering
• API & Microservice Development: Design and expose scalable REST, gRPC, and WebSocket streaming endpoints using Python (FastAPI, asyncio) to interface between LLM workflows and our proprietary platform microservices.
• State & Memory Management: Build sliding-window conversational memory, persistent session tracking, semantic caching (Redis / GPTCache), and tenant-level access control at the retrieval boundary.
• Async & Event-Driven Processing: Integrate heavy inference and document embedding pipelines into distributed message brokers and queues (Celery, Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS).
4. LLMOps, Guardrails & Quality Assurance
• Quantitative Evaluation: Establish continuous RAG evaluation frameworks (Ragas, TruLens, DeepEval) tracking Faithfulness, Answer Relevance, Context Precision, and Hallucination rates.
• Guardrails & Security: Implement strict guardrails (NeMo Guardrails, Llama Guard), prompt-injection mitigation, PII masking, and data privacy governance.
• Observability: Track latency, token utilization, rate limits, and end-to-end trace flows using Langfuse, Arize Phoenix, LangSmith, or OpenTelemetry.
Candidate Requirements & Qualifications
Must-Have Requirements
• 5+ years of professional backend/software engineering experience, with primary expertise in Python (FastAPI, Pydantic, asyncio, multiprocessing).
• 2+ years of hands-on experience designing and operating RAG pipelines and production LLM-based solutions.
• Deep practical knowledge of AI orchestration frameworks: LlamaIndex, LangChain, LangGraph, or custom agent engines.
• Production experience with vector databases (e.g., pgvector, Qdrant, Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus).
• Strong background in microservices architecture, RESTful/gRPC design, WebSocket streaming for token generation, and distributed caching (Redis).
• Experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL) and query performance tuning.
• Proficient in Docker, container orchestration (Kubernetes), CI/CD, and major cloud ecosystems (AWS, GCP, or Azure).

Role Overview We are looking for an experienced Senior Architect – AI & Agentic Platforms to lead the architecture and development of the Agentic AI Runtime Layer for a large-scale Enterprise Platform. This is a hands-on architecture and technology leadership role requiring deep expertise in Generative AI, Agentic AI, distributed systems and enterprise platform engineering. You will build the reusable runtime that enables enterprise agents to understand business intent, plan and execute tasks, maintain context and state, invoke tools and APIs, and collaborate with specialized agents. You will also lead the architecture and engineering of an embedded intelligent enterprise agent that uses this runtime to coordinate platform capabilities and support users from insight through decision and authorized action. 
 Key Responsibilities Own the target architecture and engineering roadmap for the Agentic AI Runtime Layer and the embedded intelligent enterprise agent. Design scalable single-agent and multi-agent orchestration, including task decomposition, routing, planner and executor patterns, and agent collaboration. Build reusable services for agent registration, configuration, discovery, execution, versioning and lifecycle management. Define conversation, session, user and business context management, persistent memory, workflow state, context retrieval and token optimization. Design tool registries, tool discovery, function calling and permission-aware execution across enterprise APIs, microservices, data platforms and external systems. Establish a model abstraction layer supporting multiple providers, model routing, fallback, prompt versioning and structured outputs. Define Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), grounding and enterprise knowledge retrieval patterns with appropriate data access controls. Architect interactive, background, asynchronous and long-running workflows with human approval checkpoints and controlled execution. Build security and governance into the runtime, including tenant isolation, authentication, authorization, prompt injection protection, sensitive data controls and audit trails. Establish observability for workflow execution, model calls, tool invocation, latency, failures, token usage and operating cost. Build evaluation and regression frameworks for task completion, groundedness, tool-selection accuracy, recommendation quality and business-rule compliance. Develop reusable APIs, SDKs, reference implementations and agent development patterns for engineering teams. Evaluate agent frameworks, models and interoperability protocols; make practical build-versus-buy decisions. Lead architecture and code reviews, prototype critical components and mentor engineers across platform and agent development. BizzFree AI helps small and medium-sized businesses transform their operations through artificial intelligence, intelligent automation and digital solutions.

We work with businesses across the UK and US and are expanding our technical team in India.
 About the Role 
We are looking for an experienced and technically skilled AI Automation Engineer who can independently design, develop, integrate, test and deploy AI-powered automation systems for our international clients.
The ideal candidate must have a strong technical background, preferably a B.Tech or B.E. qualification, along with practical experience in AI development, workflow automation, API integrations and software engineering.
You will be responsible for converting business requirements into functional, reliable and scalable AI automation solutions.
This is a hands-on engineering role. We are looking for someone who can build complete automation systems rather than someone with only theoretical knowledge of AI tools.

 Design, develop and deploy AI-powered automation workflows for businesses. Build complex workflow automations using n8n, Make and Zapier. Develop AI agents using OpenAI, Claude and other large language models (LLMs). Build intelligent AI chatbots and customer support automation systems. Develop AI voice agents for inbound and outbound customer calls. Integrate AI systems with CRM platforms such as GoHighLevel, HubSpot and Salesforce. Required Technical Skills

Experience developing AI agents and intelligent conversational systems. Knowledge of prompt engineering and AI model integrations. Understanding of RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) is preferred. 2. Workflow Automation 
 Hands-on experience with n8n is highly preferred. Experience with Make (Integromat) or Zapier. Ability to build complex multi-step automation workflows. Strong understanding of workflow logic, triggers, conditions, loops and error handling. 3. Programming & Development 
 Strong knowledge of Python and/or JavaScript. Understanding of backend development and software architecture. Experience working with JSON, databases and SQL. Ability to write custom scripts and develop API integrations. Strong debugging and problem-solving capabilities. 4. API & System Integrations 
 Strong understanding of REST APIs and webhooks. Experience with API authentication, OAuth and third-party integrations. Ability to connect multiple software applications and platforms. Experience integrating CRM systems, communication platforms and business applications. 5. Cloud & Deployment 
 Knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS, Google Cloud or Azure. Experience with hosting, deployment and server management. Understanding of Docker and basic DevOps practices is an advantage. Familiarity with database management and cloud infrastructure. Additional Advantageous Skills

Ability to explain complex technical concepts in simple business language. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to understand client requirements and translate them into technical solutions. Self-motivated, organised and capable of working independently. Comfortable working in a remote, international team environment. Strong ownership, accountability and attention to detail. What We Offer

description:

Our client base is made of digital agencies that need help with solving their bandwidth problems, cutting overheads, and increasing profitability. We need diligent professionals like you to help us help them. If youre someone who dreams big and has the gumption to make them come true, E2M has a place for you. 1. Program Overview Title: AI Engineer Internship: Full-Stack AI, LLM APIs & Applied Development Duration: 6 months Location: On-Site (Ahmedabad) Type: Paid Internship Objective: Provide students with real-world experience building practical AI products, using LLM APIs, frontend, backend, databases, and automation logic, with mentorship and an opportunity to join our team full-time upon successful completion. About the Internship: As an AI Engineer Intern, youll work with our AI team to design and ship real working solutions: AI-powered micro apps, internal tools, dashboards, and client-facing AI products. This role is not about only using ChatGPT or writing prompts. Youll learn to build end-to-end solutions using AI APIs (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini), frontend and backend frameworks, databases, and AI-assisted development tools. This internship is best suited for candidates who want to become AI Engineers, not just AI users, solving real business problems for digital agencies. 2. Selection Criteria Education Background: Currently pursuing a Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or related fields. Fundamental coursework in programming, software development, or applied AI (at least one foundational course completed or in progress). Technical Skills: Programming: Basic working knowledge of Python. Backend: Basic understanding of APIs and backend development (REST APIs, server logic). Frontend: Basic knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and frontend development. Databases: Understanding of databases and CRUD operations. AI/LLM APIs: Interest in integrating LLM APIs (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, or similar) into applications. AI Tooling: Comfort using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Replit, Lovable, etc.) to build faster. Soft Skills & Mindset: Ownership mindset, not just a task-completion mindset, with eagerness to build quickly. Clear communicator who can document work and ask the right questions when blocked. Collaboration: Ability to work in fast-moving teams and follow project guidelines. Problem-Solving: Ability to search, learn, debug, and implement independently. Bonus Skills (Not Mandatory, but Nice to Have): Experience with FastAPI, Flask, or Node.js. Experience with React, Next.js, Streamlit, or similar frontend tools. Exposure to LangChain, LangGraph, RAG, embeddings, vector databases, or AI agents. Knowledge of Supabase, Firebase, PostgreSQL, or similar databases. Basic Git / GitHub knowledge and understanding of prompt engineering or structured AI outputs. Any prior project experience, even a university capstone, chatbot, dashboard, or personal AI app. 3. What Youll Work On Build AI-powered micro apps for internal teams and clients. Create custom dashboards and internal productivity tools. Develop AI-native applications using LLM APIs. Work on document automation, proposal generation, report generation, resume/JD matching, and meeting summary tools. Assist in building AI agents, RAG flows, vector search, and document-based AI assistants. Build simple full-stack AI applications across frontend, backend, APIs, databases, and AI models. Convert business requirements into working prototypes and MVPs quickly using modern AI tools. Test AI outputs, debug flows, and improve accuracy, formatting, and edge-case handling. 4. What Youll Gain Real-World AI Product Experience: Real-world experience shipping AI products and applications end-to-end. Exposure to frontend, backend, database, and AI model layers used in production environments. Hands-on use of current AI tools and frameworks in live client projects. Mentorship from Experts: Mentorship from senior AI consultants and engineers. Interns will be guided by our experienced AI team that regularly works with digital agencies. Regular check-ins, one-on-one sessions, and skill-building workshops. Practical Exposure to Digital Agency Projects: See how AI is applied in digital marketing, content workflows, client tooling, analytics, and automation. Learn how AI solutions are scoped, built, and integrated for clients across diverse industries. Excellent for anyone aiming to become an AI Engineer within a marketing or consulting environment. Career Development & Opportunities: Internship certificate plus priority consideration for full-time roles in the AI division. Outstanding interns may be offered a full-time position at the end of the internship. Networking opportunities with leaders in AI consulting, digital marketing, and tech. Workshops on resume building, interview preparation, and career growth within the tech sector. 5. Internship Structure & Responsibilities Orientation & Training (Week 1 - 2): Overview of E2M Solutions AI practice and product-building approach. Tool and framework introduction (Python, FastAPI, React / Next.js / Streamlit, Supabase, LLM APIs, AI coding tools). Best practices in project management, documentation, and shipping working prototypes. Hands-On Projects (Weeks 3 to 23): Interns are assigned to real product builds under the guidance of a project lead or mentor. Tasks may include: Building full-stack AI micro apps, dashboards, and internal tools. Integrating LLM APIs into business applications. Writing backend logic and REST APIs for data processing and AI flows. Building RAG-based assistants and document automation tools. Testing, debugging, and creating documentation and user guides. Progress Reviews (Ongoing): Weekly check-ins with mentors and monthly performance evaluations to ensure continuous learning and alignment with project goals. Regular feedback sessions on product builds and code reviews. Final Presentation & Assessment (Last Week): Interns present the AI products and solutions they helped build. Showcase both technical implementation and business impact. Feedback and assessment sessions determine potential offers for full-time roles.

title: Lead Business Analyst
description:
Lead Business AnalystRole Overview
  
  
We are looking for a
**Lead Business Analyst**
who can act as a strategic partner to business, product, sales, operations, and leadership teams by converting complex business problems and data into clear insights, actionable recommendations, and measurable business outcomes.
  
  
This role goes beyond dashboarding and reporting. The ideal candidate should possess strong business acumen, excellent numerical and mathematical abilities, and the ability to understand the financial and commercial implications of business decisions.
  
  
The candidate should be able to independently identify business opportunities, define key metrics, structure ambiguous problems, influence decision-making, and drive data-backed business improvements across functions.
  
  
We are looking for someone who combines analytical rigour with business judgment, ensuring a high degree of accuracy and precision while maintaining speed of execution. Experience in predictive analytics, forecasting, statistical modelling, and machine learning will be an important advantage.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Work closely with business, product, sales, operations, and leadership teams to understand business priorities, define problem statements, and identify high-impact analytics opportunities.
* Lead analysis of large and complex datasets to identify trends, patterns, gaps, risks, and growth opportunities.
* Demonstrate strong business acumen by understanding revenue drivers, cost structures, profitability, unit economics, and the commercial impact of business decisions.
* Apply strong mathematical and quantitative thinking to solve complex business problems, perform business modelling, and evaluate business performance.
* Own and improve key business metrics across functions by defining, tracking, and interpreting performance indicators.
* Build, maintain, and improve dashboards, reports, and data visualisations for business tracking, leadership reviews, and strategic decision-making.
* Conduct deep-dive analyses to solve complex business problems and provide clear, actionable recommendations.
* Translate business questions into analytical frameworks, hypotheses, metrics, and data-driven insights.
* Drive predictive analytics initiatives to forecast business performance, identify potential risks, anticipate customer behaviour, and uncover future growth opportunities.
* Apply statistical techniques, predictive modelling, and machine learning approaches to solve business problems and improve decision-making.
* Identify opportunities to leverage machine learning and AI-driven analytics for automation, forecasting, segmentation, and business optimisation.
* Partner with leadership and functional teams to influence decisions through structured analysis and business storytelling.
* Identify data gaps, reporting inefficiencies, and metric inconsistencies, and work with relevant teams to resolve them.
* Ensure exceptional data accuracy, consistency, quality, and reliability across dashboards, reports, and business reviews.
* Maintain a strong balance between speed and accuracy, ensuring quick turnaround times without compromising analytical quality or precision.
* Automate recurring reports and improve reporting efficiency to reduce manual effort.
* Partner with data engineering, tech, and product teams to improve data pipelines, data availability, event tracking, and reporting structures.
* Mentor or guide junior analysts where required and help improve the overall analytics maturity of the team.
* Present insights and recommendations in a clear, structured, and business-friendly manner to senior stakeholders.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* 5–8 years of experience in business analytics, data analytics, product analytics, growth analytics, or a similar role.
* Strong business acumen and the ability to connect data insights with business strategy, revenue growth, profitability, and operational efficiency.
* Excellent mathematical and quantitative aptitude, with a strong understanding of business mathematics, financial metrics, percentages, ratios, growth rates, margins, and unit economics.
* Strong hands-on experience with BI/dashboarding tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Looker, Metabase, Redash, or similar tools.
* Strong working knowledge of SQL and experience working with large and complex datasets.
* Strong working knowledge of Excel/Google Sheets, including advanced formulas, financial modelling, and data analysis.
* Experience with data analysis using Python or R.
* Understanding of predictive analytics, forecasting techniques, statistical modelling, and machine learning concepts.
* Ability to work with predictive models and translate model outputs into actionable business recommendations.
* Strong understanding of business metrics, funnel analysis, cohort analysis, customer/product performance tracking, and revenue/business performance metrics.
* Ability to independently structure ambiguous business problems and convert them into analytical solutions.
* Exceptional attention to detail, accuracy, and analytical precision.
* Ability to execute with speed and efficiency while maintaining high-quality outputs.
* Strong problem-solving, analytical thinking, and business judgment.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to work closely with senior business and leadership teams.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex data insights to non-technical stakeholders.
* High ownership and ability to operate in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in edtech, SaaS, consumer internet, marketplace, fintech, or high-growth startups.
* Experience working closely with product, sales, marketing, operations, or growth teams.
* Hands-on experience in predictive analytics, machine learning, forecasting, regression models, and statistical analysis.
* Experience in experimentation, A/B testing, business forecasting, scenario planning, and financial modelling.
* Familiarity with data warehousing concepts, data pipelines, and event tracking.
* Experience implementing ML-driven business solutions or working with data science teams.
* Prior experience mentoring analysts or leading analytics projects.

**We Are Looking For Someone Who**

* Thinks beyond dashboards and focuses on business impact.
* Has strong business acumen and understands how numbers translate into business performance.
* Has excellent mathematical and quantitative aptitude and is comfortable working with complex business calculations.
* Can independently identify the right business questions before jumping into analysis.
* Is extremely detail-oriented and values accuracy, precision, and data integrity.
* Can work at speed without compromising the quality of analysis.
* Understands predictive analytics and can use data to anticipate future business outcomes rather than only explain historical performance.
* Can identify opportunities to leverage machine learning and statistical models for better business decisions.
* Is comfortable with ambiguity and can structure problems without detailed instructions.
* Can influence decisions through data-backed insights and strong business storytelling.
* Has strong stakeholder management skills and can work with senior leaders.
* Takes ownership of data quality, reporting reliability, and insight generation.
* Can identify gaps in current reporting, metrics, and analytics processes and proactively improve them.

**Success in This Role Looks Like**

* Business and leadership teams are able to make faster, sharper, and more data-backed decisions.
* Key business metrics are clearly defined, consistently tracked, and actively improved.
* Leadership has access to accurate, reliable, and timely dashboards and insights.
* Recurring reporting is automated, and manual effort is significantly reduced.
* Predictive models and forecasting help business teams anticipate performance, risks, and growth opportunities.
* Machine learning and advanced analytics are leveraged to improve business efficiency and decision-making.
* Data gaps, metric inconsistencies, and reporting issues are proactively identified and resolved.
* Analytics moves from being report-driven to insight-driven, predictive, and business-impact focused.

**The Lead Business Analyst becomes a trusted strategic data and business partner for cross-functional teams, combining business understanding, mathematical rigour, analytical precision, and predictive intelligence to drive measurable business outcomes.**
Skills: data,metrics,machine learning,predictive analytics,analytics

title: Cloud Analytics Engineer
description:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.
  
  
Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.
  
  
Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.
  
  
**Role Description**
The Cloud Analytics Engineer will join eBay’s Data Services team within Information Technology Services and Solutions (ITSS), responsible for delivering enterprise data, analytics, and business intelligence solutions supporting eBay’s global business and corporate functions.
  
  
This hands-on role focuses on designing, developing, and operating scalable data and analytics solutions using
**Google Cloud Platform (GCP), BigQuery, and Looker**
. The engineer will work closely with business, application development, and infrastructure teams to deliver end-to-end solutions, from data ingestion and transformation to analytics and reporting.
  
  
The role also involves developing proof-of-concept solutions, contributing to product roadmaps, implementing CI/CD and DevOps automation, and supporting secure, reliable hybrid cloud operations.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Cloud Analytics Engineering: Design, develop, and optimize scalable data pipelines, data models, and analytics solutions using GCP, BigQuery, and Looker, working with structured and unstructured data.
* Architecture & Integration: Contribute to end-to-end cloud and hybrid data architectures, covering ingestion, transformation, governance, and analytics enablement.
* Business Intelligence: Build and maintain a secure, governed, high-performing enterprise BI foundation, establishing reusable solutions and consistent development standards.
* DevOps & Automation: Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and GitHub Actions. Automate deployments, platform administration, and operational processes using Python or Shell scripting.
* Security & Governance: Implement data governance, access controls, security, and compliance requirements in alignment with enterprise standards and platform capabilities.
* Operational Excellence: Deliver stable, scalable, and observable solutions, including monitoring, troubleshooting, technical specification documentation, standard operating procedures, and production support handoffs.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with business, engineering, and global application teams to translate requirements into technical solutions, resolve issues, and support the full software development lifecycle (SDLC).
* Innovation & Continuous Improvement: Develop proofs of concept, contribute to product strategy and technology roadmaps, and find opportunities to simplify processes through an automation-first approach.

**Skills & Qualifications**
**Required Experience**

* 4+ years of technology consulting or industry experience in solution architecture and development using Google Cloud Platform.
* Experience delivering at least one full lifecycle GCP implementation.
* 2+ years of hands-on SQL and Python development experience.
* 1+ year of experience leading technical workstreams involving cross-functional or geographically distributed teams.
* Strong understanding of business intelligence, data warehousing, relational databases, and data integration patterns.
* Experience developing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and GitHub Actions.
* Proficiency in Python or Shell scripting for platform automation and operational support.
* Understanding of data security, governance, compliance, and enterprise SDLC practices.

**Preferred Experience**

* Hands-on experience with Google BigQuery, Looker, and Tableau.
* Experience implementing and supporting enterprise BI platforms in hybrid cloud environments.
* Experience establishing platform standards, operational procedures, and automated monitoring.

**Professional Skills**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to understand complex technical and business processes.
* Ability to independently manage technical deliverables, coordinate across teams, and balance competing priorities.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Self-motivated, adaptable, and committed to continuous learning and process improvement in a fast-paced environment.

**Additional Details**
eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

title: Software Engineer III – Data Platform and Analytics
description:
**Summary**
Our Product Development & Operations (PDO) organization builds and runs the cloud platform that powers how P&C insurers around the world do business, with a strong focus on AI, cloud, and data platform adoption. You will join the Data Platform and Analytics team, which delivers secure, scalable data services that enable mission-critical insights for our customers. We work in an inclusive, collaborative environment using modern cloud-native technologies to solve complex data and distributed systems problems.
  
  
As a Software Engineer III, you will design and build cloud-native data and analytics services that sit at the heart of Guidewire’s platform strategy. You will use your expertise in modern Java, microservices, and frontend technologies like React or Angular to create large-scale, real-time data and analytics capabilities in the public cloud. This role is a key contributor to PDO’s priorities around operational excellence and transformative innovation, directly advancing Guidewire’s mission to combine digital, core, analytics, and AI to transform how the world’s P&C insurers do business.
  
  
**Job Description**
**What you’ll do**

* Design, develop, and operate cloud-native data platform and analytics SaaS services that are secure, scalable, and reliable, supporting PDO’s focus on operational excellence and data platform adoption.
* Build and maintain large-scale, real-time stream processing and data ingestion systems that power analytics, data science, and reporting for our customers.
* Design, implement, and run microservices-based solutions using modern Java and frameworks such as Spring Boot, applying microservices and domain-driven design patterns.
* Contribute to intuitive, performant user experiences using modern frontend technologies (React.js or Angular, HTML, CSS, JavaScript) for data and analytics workflows.
* Own CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation for your services, leveraging containers and Kubernetes to ensure fast, safe, and repeatable releases.
* Take responsibility for availability, performance, observability, and data security of your services, including triaging and resolving production issues and defects.
* Maintain secure coding practices, address application security findings, and collaborate with Security and platform teams to support strong governance and compliance goals.
* At Guidewire, we foster a culture of curiosity, innovation, and responsible use of AI—empowering our teams to continuously leverage emerging technologies and data-driven insights to enhance productivity and outcomes.

**Required**
**What you would need to succeed:**

* Demonstrated ability to embrace AI and apply it to your current role as well as data-driven insights to drive innovation, productivity, and continuous improvement.
* 6+ years of relevant software engineering experience building production-grade services or applications.
* Experience designing and developing backend services in Java, ideally with Spring Boot, and familiarity with microservices and multithreading concepts.
* Solid understanding of algorithms, data structures, and performance optimization techniques, especially in distributed or data-intensive systems.
* Strong programming skills in JavaScript and at least one modern frontend framework such as React.js or Angular, with solid knowledge of HTML and CSS.
* Working knowledge of relational databases (such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, or similar) and experience with data warehousing technologies such as Amazon Redshift or equivalent.
* Familiarity with microservices architecture patterns such as service discovery, API gateways, and domain-driven design.
* Ability to thrive in an agile, fast-paced environment, collaborating across functions and locations in a transparent, inclusive way.
* Clear, respectful communication skills and a growth mindset, with a willingness to learn new tools, domains, and ways of working.

**Preferred**

* Hands-on experience with AWS or another major public cloud provider (e.g., IAM, networking, managed databases, streaming services).
* Experience building and operating containerized services using Docker and Kubernetes; familiarity with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform.
* Exposure to building large-scale real-time data streaming or event-driven systems (e.g., Apache Kafka, Kinesis, or similar).
* Experience with observability and logging stacks such as ELK (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) or equivalent tools.
* Familiarity with CI/CD tools such as TeamCity or similar systems.
* Understanding of distributed systems principles (consistency, availability, durability, reliability, fault tolerance, consensus algorithms) and how to apply them in production systems.
* Experience with AWS RDS or other managed relational database services.

**Your Impact**
We believe in clarity and setting you up for success. In your first six months, you will take ownership of one or more data platform or analytics services, deep dive into our architecture and tooling, and deliver features that enhance real-time data processing, scalability, and user experience. You will help improve service reliability, harden security, and evolve CI/CD pipelines, directly contributing to PDO’s goals around secure, efficient, and AI-ready cloud operations and data platforms.
  
  
As your expertise grows, your work will influence how insurers unlock insights from Guidewire Data Platform and analytics products, shaping customer outcomes and contributing to Guidewire’s broader mission to transform P&C insurance with cloud, analytics, and AI.
  
  
**About Guidewire**
Guidewire is the platform P&C insurers trust to engage, innovate, and grow efficiently. We combine digital, core, analytics, and AI to deliver our platform as a cloud service. More than 540+ insurers in 40 countries, from new ventures to the largest and most complex in the world, run on Guidewire.
  
  
As a partner to our customers, we continually evolve to enable their success. We are proud of our unparalleled implementation track record with 1600+ successful projects, supported by the largest R&D team and partner ecosystem in the industry. Our Marketplace provides hundreds of applications that accelerate integration, localization, and innovation.
  
  
For more information, please visit www.guidewire.com and follow us on Twitter: @Guidewire\_PandC.
  
  
Guidewire Software, Inc. is proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We are committed to an inclusive workplace, and believe that a diversity of perspectives, abilities, and cultures is a key to our success. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, citizenship, marital status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability. All offers are contingent upon passing a criminal history and other background checks where it's applicable to the position.
  
  
Guidewire is proud to be a disability inclusive employer. We are committed to providing individualized accommodations and support to candidates for any part of our hiring process. If you think you may need disability-related accommodations, please email EmployAbility at accommodations-gw@employ-ability.org.uk, our disability partner, or schedule a call with an EmployAbility expert (calendar booking slot) for a confidential conversation.

description:

Farnell, an Avnet company, is a global high-service distributor of technology products, services and solutions for electronic system design, maintenance and repair.
  
  
**Job Summary**
Designs and prepares reports, dashboards, and summaries for statistical analysis and planning purposes. Analyzes business issues using data from internal and external sources to provide insight to decision-makers. Identifies and interprets trends and patterns.
  
  
**Principal Responsibilities**

* Collects, compiles and analyzes data from various databases and performs statistical analysis for internal customer groups.
* Develops reports and/or creates dashboards providing financial related information needed to make informed business decisions.
* Designs, creates and implements templates to collect, display and analyze data for assigned projects
* Communicates complex data in comprehensible ways. Evaluates information from multiple sources and clearly indicates quality of final analysis.
* Develops reports and other tools to deliver internal company information enabling business users to make informed decisions.
* Gathers, aggregates models, and analyzes information from multiple external sources regarding company financial performance, customer insights, competitor profiling, competitive threats, potential product or technical expansion, industry trends and other such business intelligence aspects.
* Establishes standards and procedures for a variety of processes, conducting business analysis resulting in detailed creation and maintenance of business process mapping, requirements and training materials documentation.
* May participate in or lead project teams.
* Identifies, investigates and participates in opportunities to improve processes and procedures, to include various key performance metrics.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Job Level Specifications**

* Foundational knowledge of specialized disciplines, industry practices and standards, acquired via academic instruction and/or relevant work experience of substantially the same level.
* Develops solutions to defined tasks, typical assignments and projects. May be solved by the application of specialized foundational knowledge, using existing approaches and solutions.
* Work is usually performed independently and requires the exercise of judgment and discretion. Receives initial direction although work may be reviewed for accuracy and quality.
* Collaborates with immediate management and team members within the department or function.
* Actions typically affect own work assignments and department. Erroneous decisions or failure to accomplish work may require some assistance or resources to remedy.

**Skills:**
Excel, sql basics, and any web analytics tool and Web analytics experience.
  
  
**Work Experience**

* Typically less than 2 years with bachelor's or equivalent.

**Education And Certification(s)**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience from which comparable knowledge and job skills can be obtained.

**Distinguishing Characteristics**

* Position may require the ability to travel.

The role delivers standardized data, reporting and provision of customer lists across all Marketing and eCommerce touch points. Customer data quality and integrity should be consistently adhered to, as to ensure accurate and consistent reporting and decision making.
  
  
**Additional Skills:**
Advanced Excel, Adobe Analytics reporting, PowerBI, Python is desirable but not mandatory
  
  
The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills.

**Analytics Operations Analyst**
**Enterprise Analytics (India)**
**Role Purpose**
Support the business-as-usual (BAU) delivery of Enterprise Analytics outputs through the timely execution of recurring data processing, validation, reporting, and quality assurance activities.
  
  
The role is responsible for ensuring analytics processes are completed accurately, consistently, and in accordance with established procedures and service levels. Working closely with Enterprise Analytics teams, Business Analytics Partners, and technical stakeholders, the role helps maintain the reliability and scalability of analytics operations while supporting continuous process improvement.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* BAU Analytics Processing & Delivery
* Complete recurring analytics and reporting processes on scheduled delivery cycles (e.g., monthly, quarterly, annual).
* Prepare, process, and validate datasets required for analytics production.
* Follow documented operating procedures, controls, and delivery timelines.
* Monitor process execution and promptly call out issues, delays, or exceptions, supported by clear evidence and impact assessments
* Maintain delivery trackers, status updates, and operational documentation.
* Data Validation & Quality Assurance
* Perform data quality checks and validation activities to ensure completeness and accuracy of input files, templates and outputs
* Investigate and resolve routine data issues, exceptions and processing errors.
* Compare outputs against predefined validation rules and historical trends.
* Document findings and coordinate with relevant stakeholders to address identified issues.
* Support reconciliation activities across source files, reports, systems and data outputs.
* Reporting & Output Management
* Generate and distribute standard analytics reports, dashboards, and output files.
* Verify report completeness and consistency to established quality standards before release.
* Support ongoing maintenance of reporting templates and delivery processes.
* Ensure outputs are stored and managed in accordance with governance and documentation requirements.
* Operational Support & Issue Management
* Provide operational support for Enterprise Analytics processes and tools.
* Perform initial investigation of data discrepancies, file issues, reconciliation breaks or user-reported issues.
* Bring up complex, judgement-heavy, stakeholder-sensitive, or governance-related issues with appropriate supporting information and impact assessment.
* Work with analytics, data, and technology teams to support issue resolution.
* Documentation & Process Governance
* Maintain process documentation, operating procedures, and knowledge repositories.
* Ensure alignment to established controls, compliance requirements, and audit standards.
* Support onboarding and knowledge transfer activities for new processes and team members.
* Contribute to process standardization and operational protocols.
* Continuous Improvement
* Find opportunities to improve efficiency, quality, and scalability of existing BAU processes.
* Support automation initiatives and process enhancement projects.
* Assist with testing and deployment activities when new enhancements transition into production.
* Participate in process reviews and lessons learned exercises.

**What Success Looks Like**

* BAU work are completed accurately and on schedule.
* Data quality issues are identified early and resolved promptly.
* Operational processes are delivered consistently with minimal errors and supervision
* Stakeholders receive reliable and timely analytics outputs.
* Documentation remains current and supports effective knowledge sharing.
* Continuous improvement opportunities are identified and implemented.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3–6+ years of experience in finance, analytics operations, reporting, data processing, business operations, or related functions.
* Background in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Analytics, or a related rigor.
* Strong financial and analytical competence with the ability to interpret revenue, cost, profitability, and financial reporting metrics.
* Experience conducting reconciliations, variance analysis, data validation, and root-cause investigations to ensure the accuracy of business-critical reporting and analytics solutions.
* Familiarity with profitability and performance management processes is advantageous, particularly in support of Global Client Profitability (GCP) and commercial analytics initiatives.
* Solid attention to detail and commitment to data quality.
* Ability to follow structured processes while managing multiple priorities.
* Advanced Excel skills, including Pivot Tables, Power Query, lookups, reconciliations, and data validation techniques
* Working knowledge of SQL for data extraction, validation, reconciliation and solve is preferred
* Exposure to Python, Databricks, or cloud analytics platforms is an advantage
* Strong analytical, root-cause investigation, and collaborator communication skills

**Preferred Educational Background**

* Bachelor's degree in Accountancy, Business, Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, Analytics, Information Systems, Engineering, or related disciplines.

**Why This Role Matters**
This role helps ensure Enterprise Analytics solutions operate optimally at scale by delivering accurate, timely, and consistent analytics outputs. Through strong process execution, quality control, and operational field, the role enables analytics teams and business collaborators to confidently rely on analytics products for decision making.
  
  
**How We Support Our Colleagues**
In addition to our comprehensive benefits package, we are proud to be an equal opportunity workforce. At Aon, we believe a diverse workforce is an innovative workforce. Our agile, inclusive environment allows colleagues to manage their wellbeing and work/life balance while empowering you to be your authentic self.
  
  
Furthermore, all colleagues enjoy two “Global Wellbeing Days” each year, encouraging them to take time to focus on themselves. We offer a variety of workstyle options through our Smart Working model, but we also recognize that flexibility goes beyond just the place of work... and we are all for it!
  
  
Our continuous learning culture inspires and equips colleagues to learn, share and grow, helping them achieve their fullest potential. As a result, Aon colleagues are more connected, more relevant, and more valued.
  
  
**Commitment to sustainability**
“Aon is dedicated to integrating sustainability into our core business practices. We strive to minimize our environmental impact through innovative solutions and responsible stewardship, ensuring a sustainable future for our clients and communities.”

title: Business Analyst
description:
**We’re looking for a Business Analyst**

Snabbit is India’s first Quick-Service App delivering home services in just 10 minutes through a hyperlocal network of trained and verified professionals. Backed by Elevation Capital, Nexus Venture Partners, and Lightspeed, Snabbit is redefining the home services space by combining speed, quality, and trust.

Founded by Aayush Agarwal, Snabbit is on a mission to make home services as seamless and instant as ordering groceries. We’ve already completed thousands of jobs with exceptional customer satisfaction — and we’re just getting started.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a sharp, analytical, and execution-oriented Business Analyst to help solve complex business problems and support data-driven decision-making across Snabbit.

You will work closely with cross-functional teams—including Operations, Marketing, Category, Product, Growth, and Finance—to identify opportunities, track business performance, improve processes, and drive high-impact initiatives. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working with data, finding patterns, and converting insights into measurable business outcomes.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Analyse business performance across cities, categories, and customer segments.
* Build and maintain dashboards, reports, and performance trackers for key business metrics.
* Identify trends, gaps, and opportunities through structured data analysis.
* Translate complex datasets into clear, actionable recommendations for business teams.
* Work closely with Marketing, Operations, Product, Growth, Category, and Finance teams on strategic projects.
* Track metrics such as demand, fulfillment, customer retention, service quality, productivity, and unit economics.
* Conduct root-cause analyses to understand performance deviations and operational challenges.
* Support business planning, forecasting, target setting, and performance reviews.
* Design and evaluate experiments aimed at improving customer experience, operational efficiency, and business growth.
* Automate recurring reports and improve the accuracy and efficiency of decision-making processes.
* Take end-to-end ownership of analytical projects—from defining the problem to implementing and measuring solutions.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, Business, or a related discipline.
* 4-6 years of experience in business analytics, strategy, operations, consulting, or a similar role.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with a structured approach to ambiguous problems.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.
* Working knowledge of SQL and experience analyzing large datasets.
* Familiarity with visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or Metabase.
* Strong business judgment and the ability to connect data insights with business outcomes.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and operate effectively in a fast-paced startup environment.
* High ownership, attention to detail, and a bias for action.

**Good to Have**

* Experience in a consumer internet, marketplace, hyperlocal, logistics, or high-growth startup.
* Exposure to Python or other analytical tools.
* Understanding of marketplace metrics, customer funnels, operational efficiency, and unit economics.
* Experience working directly with senior business stakeholders.

AppsForBharat (Sri Mandir App) is building beautifully crafted, AI-first consumer experiences that help millions of Indians connect with spirituality and culture. title: Merchandising Lead Analyst
description:
**Overview**
**Role Summary**
The Merchandising Lead Analyst is responsible for driving category and brand performance across wholesale marketplace channels by leveraging data, analytics, and merchandising expertise. This role partners closely with Merchandising, Planning, Marketing, Supply Chain, and Operations teams to optimize assortment decisions, improve product performance, monitor inventory health, and enhance customer shopping experience. The analyst provides actionable insights, manages reporting and business reviews, and supports strategic initiatives that drive sales, profitability, and operational excellence.
  
  
Key Responsibilities Assortment Strategy & Category Analytics
  
  

* Analyze category, brand, and item-level performance to identify assortment opportunities and risks.
* Support assortment planning decisions through sales, inventory, customer, and competitive analysis.
* Identify whitespace opportunities, emerging trends, and gaps within product categories.
* Develop recommendations for new item introductions, assortment rationalization, and lifecycle management.
* Establish performance guardrails and monitor category productivity against business objectives.

**Merchandising Performance & Business Insights**

* Monitor key business metrics including sales, units, margin, inventory productivity, sell-through, and markdown performance.
* Develop and maintain recurring dashboards, scorecards, and executive reporting.
* Conduct root-cause analysis to identify business performance drivers and opportunities.
* Translate complex data into actionable recommendations for merchants and leadership teams.
* Support weekly, monthly, and quarterly business reviews.

**Inventory & Forecasting Support**

* Partner with Planning and Inventory teams to monitor inventory health and in-stock performance.
* Identify demand trends, inventory risks, overstocks, and potential stockout situations.
* Recommend actions to optimize inventory productivity and improve sales performance.
* Support forecasting activities by providing historical and trend-based insights.

**Product Setup, Data Governance & Execution**

* Ensure product and item attributes are accurate, complete, and aligned with merchandising standards.
* Support new item setup, category maintenance, and product lifecycle processes.
* Monitor data quality and governance standards to improve reporting accuracy and operational efficiency.
* Serve as a liaison between business users and supporting teams to resolve item and catalog issues.

**Cross-Functional Partnership**

* Collaborate with Merchandising, Planning, Marketing, Supply Chain, and Operations teams to execute business priorities.
* Support cross-functional initiatives aimed at improving category performance and customer experience.
* Coordinate workstreams with offshore or shared service teams to ensure timely delivery of recurring activities.
* Assist in the development of business cases, strategic recommendations, and leadership presentations.

**Continuous Improvement & Process Optimization**

* Identify automation, reporting, and process improvement opportunities.
* Drive standardization of performance reporting and analytical processes.
* Support implementation of new tools, capabilities, and business initiatives.
* Contribute to the development of best practices in merchandising analytics and category management.

**Experience & Capability**

* 5-8 years of experience in Merchandising, Category Management, Retail Analytics, Inventory Management, or Business Operations.
* Strong understanding of retail merchandising fundamentals, including assortment planning, inventory management, pricing, promotions, and product lifecycle management.
* Proven ability to analyze large datasets and develop actionable business recommendations.
* Experience creating dashboards and reporting solutions using Power BI, Tableau, Excel, or similar tools.
* Knowledge of retail KPIs such as sales, margin, inventory turns, weeks of supply, sell-through, markdown rate, and productivity metrics.
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, and critical-thinking capabilities.
* Experience working cross-functionally with Merchandising, Planning, Marketing, and Operations teams.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Preferred Qualifications
* Experience in retail, e-commerce, merchandising, or marketplace businesses.
* Familiarity with product data governance, item setup, and catalog management processes.
* Advanced Excel, SQL, Power BI, Tableau, Alteryx, or similar analytics tools.
* Experience supporting executive business reviews and strategic planning activities. Enjoy a rewarding career at Catalyst Brands Business Services, where we offer a competitive benefits package, a vibrant work environment, and the opportunity to make a difference at one of America's most iconic retailers.

INR ₹0.00 - INR ₹0.00 /Yr.
