title: System Engineer (Cloud, Data & IoT)
description:
We are looking for a hands-on Technical System Engineer to design and build the cloud, data and IoT foundation for our real estate portfolio. You will connect smart building systems, IoT devices and business systems into a scalable data platform that powers insights on energy, occupancy, maintenance and building performance.
  
  
This is a technical role for someone who has delivered large projects end to end, combines a cloud architecture background with full-stack / back-end development, and is strong in data engineering with Databricks and Python.
  
  
As a Technical Systems Engineer in the Group Real Estate, you will be at the heart of a foundational transformation in IWMS.
  
  
This means that you will:
  
• Cloud architecture: implement and maintain secure, scalable cloud architectures for real estate and smart building solutions on GCP, Azure or AWS.
  
• Data platform: Build and operate the data lake / lakehouse (e.g. Databricks, Delta Lake) for building, IoT, IWMS and business data, including ingestion, modelling and governance.
  
• Data pipelines: Develop batch and streaming pipelines in Python / PySpark and SQL for time-series sensor data, BMS data and system integrations.
  
• IoT & smart buildings: integrate IoT device connectivity and smart building systems (BMS, energy meters, occupancy and environmental sensors) using protocols such as MQTT, BACnet and OPC UA.
  
• Back-end & full-stack development: Build APIs, microservices and, where needed, web front-ends that expose building data and insights to users and other systems (including the IWMS / Planon).
  
• Large projects: Lead the technical workstream on large, multi-site projects – from solution design and estimation through build, rollout and handover to operations.
  
• DevOps & quality: Set up CI/CD, infrastructure as code, monitoring and automated testing; ensure security, reliability and cost efficiency.
  
• Analytics & AI enablement: Enable dashboards, KPIs and advanced analytics/ML use cases such as energy optimisation, predictive maintenance and space utilisation.
  
• Follow engineering best practice specified within Ikea Digital organisation

We believe you bring:
  
• 4–7 years’ experience in software, cloud and data engineering, including large-scale projects
  
• Data platform - Databricks, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, data lake / lakehouse architecture
  
• Programming - Python, PySpark, SQL; plus a back-end language such as Java, Go or Node.js
  
• Back-end / full-stack - REST / GraphQL APIs, microservices, event-driven architecture; React / Angular / Vue
  
• Data engineering - Advanced: Batch & streaming pipelines, Kafka / Pub/Sub, time-series data, data modelling, data quality
  
• IoT & smart buildings - MQTT, IoT gateways, edge computing, BMS integration (BACnet, Modbus, OPC UA), digital twin concepts
  
• DevOps - CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, GitLab), Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform
  
• Security & governance - IAM, network security, secrets management, data governance, GDPR
  
This is our wish list!
  
  
The must-haves we see for this role are:
  
• Hands-on experience in software and data engineering, with a track record of delivering large, complex projects.
  
• Cloud architecture: background in cloud architecture on GCP and/or Azure / AWS (compute, storage, networking, security, serverless, managed data services).
  
• Software engineering: Full-stack experience with back-end focus – designing and building APIs, services and integrations.
  
• Python: Intermediate Python skills for data engineering and back-end development.
  
• Databricks: Hands-on experience with Databricks (PySpark, Delta Lake, workflows, Unity Catalog).
  
• Data background: Good data engineering experience – data lakes / lakehouses, ETL/ELT, streaming and time-series data.
  
• IoT & smart buildings: Experience with IoT platforms and smart building systems, including device data ingestion and building protocols.
  
• DevOps: Experience with CI/CD, Git, containers (Docker / Kubernetes) and infrastructure as code (e.g. Terraform).
  
  
Nice to have:
  
• Real estate / retail: Experience in real estate, facility management or retail environments with many sites.
  
• Experience integrating with IWMS / CAFM systems such as Planon.
  
• Digital twin or BIM-based platforms.
  
• Machine learning / MLOps (MLflow) for energy optimisation and predictive maintenance.
  
• Energy management, ESG and sustainability reporting.
  
• BI tools such as Power BI, Looker or Tableau.
  
  
Personal Competencies:
  
• Passion to write code and build solutions.
  
• Balancing long-term design with pragmatic delivery.
  
• Clear communicator who can explain complex technology to business stakeholders.
  
• Curious and forward-looking mindset, with a willingness to explore and learn new technologies, identify their potential, and uncover business value through AI including opportunities to develop and work with agentic AI solutions
  
• Fluent in English, written and spoken.
  
  
Education and certifications:
  
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science or equivalent experience.
  
• Cloud certifications such as Google Professional Cloud Architect, Azure Solutions Architect Expert or AWS Solutions Architect – Professional are a plus.
  
• Databricks certifications (e.g. Data Engineer Professional) are a plus.

**TOGETHER AS A TEAM**

You will work in Group Function Digital Area. The Digital Area – Group Functions is a new area built to strengthen digital partnership and delivery across all Group Functions and Global Business Operations (GBO). We develop and deliver digital capabilities across key areas like Finance, People & Culture, Procurement, Legal, Business Risk & Compliance, Communications, Real Estate, Business Steering in Ingka's global organisation.
  
  
You will be part of a team that is leading the foundational transformation in HR Tech — with a clear vision: to bring trustworthy data to business leaders so they can make informed decisions. We sit at the intersection of HR, data, and technology, and we believe that getting the foundation right is what makes everything else possible.
  
  
We are a team that believes in:
  
IKEA has long been a global leader in home furnishing. We are proud of our vision to improve the everyday life of the many people. But our industry is quickly changing, and we need to adapt to stay competitive.
  
We see so many opportunities for what we can accomplish and have the ambition to be a world-class team. At the same time, we believe that our work is not just about building models, but also about learning and having fun together.

title: Member of Technical Staff 2
description:
**Hungry, Humble, Honest, with Heart.**
**The Opportunity**
We are looking for a curious, hands-on DevSecOps Engineer who is excited about building the next generation of cloud and developer platforms through AI, automation, and engineering innovation.
  
  
This role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys asking questions such as:
  
  
“Why are we doing this manually?”
  
  
“Can we automate this?”
  
  
“Can AI help us understand or operate this system better?”
  
  
“Is there a better open-source technology or engineering approach we should explore?”
  
  
You do not need to know every technology we use. We care deeply about strong engineering fundamentals, curiosity, experimentation, and your ability to learn quickly.
  
  
You will work across cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, CI/CD, security, observability, and AI-assisted operations. You will have opportunities not only to operate platforms, but also to research new approaches, build prototypes, automate repetitive work, and turn successful ideas into production capabilities.
  
  
**About The Team**
Our team builds and operates platforms that enable engineering teams to deliver software securely, reliably, and efficiently.
  
  
We are evolving traditional DevOps toward a platform engineering and AI-assisted operations model. Our goal is to reduce repetitive operational work, improve developer experience, increase reliability and security, and use AI and automation wherever they can create meaningful engineering leverage.
  
  
We value engineers who are willing to experiment, challenge existing approaches constructively, share what they learn, and take ownership of making things better.
  
  
**Your Role**
**As a DevSecOps Engineer, You Will**

* Build, improve, and automate CI/CD workflows for application and infrastructure delivery.
* Work with cloud infrastructure and Kubernetes to deploy and operate scalable services.
* Develop automation using Python, Go, Bash, APIs, Infrastructure as Code, and AI-assisted engineering tools.
* Identify repetitive operational activities and convert them into reliable automation or self-service capabilities.
* Explore how AI, LLMs, agents, and intelligent automation can improve troubleshooting, observability, incident response, infrastructure management, and developer productivity.
* Participate in technical research and proof-of-concepts, evaluate emerging technologies and open-source projects, and present recommendations based on your findings.
* Build and maintain infrastructure using tools such as Terraform and other Infrastructure-as-Code technologies.
* Improve observability through metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, and intelligent analysis of operational data.
* Integrate security into software delivery through vulnerability scanning, dependency management, secrets management, policy enforcement, and secure engineering practices.
* Troubleshoot production and platform issues and use those experiences to identify opportunities for permanent engineering improvements.
* Contribute to platform documentation, architecture discussions, engineering standards, and reusable automation.
* Collaborate with application, security, SRE, platform, and AI/ML engineering teams.
* Continuously learn new technologies and share your experiments, findings, successes, and failures with the broader team.

**What You Will Bring**

* A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* Approximately 2–6 years of experience in DevOps, DevSecOps, SRE, Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, software engineering, or a related area.
* Good understanding of Linux, networking, cloud infrastructure, containers, and software delivery fundamentals.
* Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Experience with Kubernetes and container technologies, or a strong demonstrated interest in developing deeper expertise in this area.
* Experience with CI/CD and Infrastructure-as-Code concepts and technologies.
* Ability to write useful automation using Python, Go, Bash, or another programming/scripting language.
* Understanding of source control and modern software development practices.
* Basic understanding of application, infrastructure, container, or software supply-chain security.
* Experience working with monitoring, logging, or observability technologies.

**Work Arrangement**
Hybrid: This role operates in a hybrid capacity, blending the benefits of remote work with the advantages of in-person collaboration. In locations where our workplace policy applies (i.e. San Jose, Durham, Mexico City, Bangalore, Pune, Hoofddorp, Belgrade, Barcelona, Singapore, Sydney and Tokyo), employees are expected to work onsite a minimum of 3 days per week to foster collaboration, team alignment, and access to in-office resources. Workplace type may vary based on location and team requirements. Please speak with your recruiter for details. Additional team-specific guidance and norms will be provided by your manager.

title: Senior Systems Administrator
description:
**Who are we?**

A world where complexity is the only constant demands a new breed of company. Brave Bison is a different beast: a media, marketing and technology company purpose built for the digital era.

Our universe is made up of award-winning business arms Brave Bison, Engage, SocialChain and MTM. And we’re underpinned by leading marketing training practice, MiniMBA, as well as our very own social-first media network who deliver monthly views in the billions for some of the biggest channels in sport and entertainment across YouTube, Snap, Meta and TikTok.

We’re a global collective who live and breathe digital, working with some of the boldest brands in the world to capitalise on the complexity that defines the modern marketing landscape.

**Our mission**

New platforms, new behaviours, new audiences, new trends, new technologies, new regulations—our clients’ worlds get more complex daily. Their agency partnerships shouldn’t. It’s our job to cut through the chaos, make the complex simple and navigate a clear path to growth for them.

That’s why we make it our mission to
**capitalise on complexity**
for our clients—across consultancy, capability and execution—by crafting dynamic digital solutions that outpace tomorrow’s challenges.

**Our values**

We’re a proudly diverse business comprised of deep specialists across social media, digital marketing and technology. Although our skills, backgrounds and beliefs may differ, we are united by four core shared values:

* **Bold Curiosity.**

We run at change and challenge convention because we love to push the boundaries of what the world thinks is possible. We champion discovery, go deep into our clients’ worlds and are always hungry to learn more about them, our specialisms and each other.

* **Connected Clarity.**

We are focused in our collaboration — joining the right dots between our clients, our partners and our herd of experts to deliver agile solutions at speed and scale. We set a shared ambition from the outset, are transparent at every stage and always strive to make the complex simple.

* **Positive Encouragement.**

We want to make working with us the best part of someone’s day. We lift one other up, find the fun in the day to day and are committed to ensuring everyone belongs.

* **Constant Impact.**

We believe in outcomes over outputs. We’re goal orientated, results driven and data led. We show up with passion every day. And we’re always honing our craft.

**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced, proactive and hands-on Senior Systems Administrator to join our global IT team.

You will play a key role in managing, securing and improving our technology environment across Microsoft 365, cloud infrastructure, Windows and macOS devices, networking and security platforms.

Working closely with the IT Manager and wider IT team, you will take ownership of technical initiatives, resolve complex infrastructure issues and identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, security and automation.

As a growing business with multiple international offices, we are looking for someone who can adapt to changing priorities, work independently and take responsibility for delivering high-quality technical solutions.

Whilst this is not a people management position, you will provide technical guidance, mentoring and escalation support to other members of the IT team.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Microsoft 365, Identity and Endpoints**

* Administer and optimise Microsoft 365 and Entra ID, including licensing, access controls and Conditional Access policies.
* Manage Windows and macOS devices using Microsoft Intune and other MDM platforms, including policies, updates, patching and health monitoring.

**Infrastructure, Networking and Security**

* Administer cloud and server infrastructure (virtual machines, Active Directory, DNS and DHCP), support firewalls, VPNs and wireless, and maintain backups with regular recovery tests.
* Work closely with the Information & Cyber Security Manager to implement technical security controls, remediate vulnerabilities, support incident investigations and provide evidence for audits.
* Set up, configure and troubleshoot networking equipment such as switches, firewalls and wireless access points.

**Automation and Day-to-Day Operations**

* Share the day-to-day IT support workload with the wider team, including user queries, hardware, software and network issues, and onboarding and offboarding requests.
* Develop PowerShell scripts and use APIs and automation tools to cut manual work, including onboarding and offboarding, and recommend improvements to systems and processes.
* Act as a senior technical escalation point, finding root causes, taking incidents through to resolution and keeping documentation accurate.

**Projects and Migrations**

* Take ownership of assigned technical projects from planning to implementation, including Microsoft 365, SharePoint and Google Workspace migrations and the integration of newly acquired businesses.
* Give clear progress updates, highlighting risks, blockers and decisions needed.

**Collaboration**

* Mentor junior team members, share knowledge and work with colleagues across countries and business units.
* Take part in planned maintenance and agreed out-of-hours support.

**Essential Experience and Skills**

* At least six years of experience in systems administration, infrastructure engineering or a similar role.
* Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft 365, Entra ID and Intune, and strong Windows administration with experience supporting macOS.
* Experience with Microsoft Azure, Active Directory, DNS, DHCP and networking fundamentals.
* Practical PowerShell scripting and automation.
* Experience supporting users with day-to-day IT issues.
* Experience with endpoint security, patch management, backup and disaster recovery.
* Able to independently resolve complex technical issues and deliver technical projects.
* Strong written and spoken English.

**Desirable Experience and Skills**

* Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, Kandji, Freshservice, Microsoft Graph or REST API integrations, Meraki or Fortinet.
* Google Workspace migrations, AWS or Google Cloud Platform, and experience supporting mergers and acquisitions.
* Relevant Microsoft, networking or cloud certifications.

**Personal Attributes**

* A team player who shares knowledge, asks for help early and supports colleagues.
* Adaptable and comfortable in a fast-paced, changing environment.
* Proactive, takes ownership and makes technical recommendations.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, and able to prioritise.

title: Infrastructure Specialist-System Administration
description:
**Introduction**
A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**
As an Infrastructure Specialist in System Administration, you will provide 24/7 technical support for cloud-based solutions, ensuring seamless operations across various applications, DevOps, middleware, security, and infrastructure components. You will play a critical role in building, setting up, and maintaining cloud applications, infrastructure, and networking.
  
  
**Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include**

* Provide Technical Support: Deliver 24/7 technical support for cloud-based solutions, ensuring seamless operations across various applications, DevOps, middleware, security, and infrastructure components.
* Develop and Configure Infrastructure: Develop and configure infrastructure and configuration as code using Ansible and Terraform, and administer Dev, Test, and Production environments hosted on Windows, Linux, and Unix servers.
* Ensure System Security: Ensure systems are safe and secure against cybersecurity threats, identify and fix technical problems, and install software updates and fixes.
* Manage Cloud Applications: Manage Application ID, provide cloud elasticity by auto-scaling resources based on business requirements, and ensure DR and manual redundancy failover capabilities.
* Analyze and Resolve Issues: Identify and resolve issues involving APIs, application services, and infrastructure problems, and escalate issues to the appropriate support level when necessary.

**Preferred Education**
Master's Degree
  
  
**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**

* Cloud-Based Solution Support: Exposure to providing 24/7 technical support for cloud-based solutions, including troubleshooting and resolving issues across various applications, DevOps, middleware, security, and infrastructure components.
* Infrastructure Configuration: Experience working with infrastructure and configuration as code using Ansible and Terraform, including administering Dev, Test, and Production environments hosted on Windows, Linux, and Unix servers.
* Database Administration: Exposure to installing and configuring databases such as MYSQL, MSSQL, and PostgreSQL, including ensuring database security and performance.
* Cloud Security: Experience working with cloud security features, including load balancing and CDN options provided by multiple cloud vendors, such as Azure Load Balancer and Application Gateway.
* Logging Cluster Management: Exposure to installing and maintaining a logging cluster using Logstash, ElasticSearch, and Kibana to parse logs from applications and Docker containers.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* Familiarity with ITIL Processes: Exposure to ITIL processes and Integrated Service Level Management, including service management reports to keep clients informed.
* Knowledge of Kubernetes Nodes: Experience working with Kubernetes nodes, ICP management, and middleware components.
* Cloud Application Architecture: Exposure to cloud application architecture, including performing initial analysis on incidents and identifying potential issues.

title: Digital Solution Administration Specialist
description:
Imagine your career taking you to the depths of innovation and the heights of impact. Our people enable continuous progress. Their commitment, collective expertise, and unique capabilities are the engine room behind SBM Offshore’s True. Blue. Transition. - shaping the future of energy, and beyond.
  
  
**About Us**
SBM Offshore is a global leader in deepwater ocean infrastructure, delivering floating production solutions across the full asset lifecycle—from design and construction to installation and operation. Supported by a global team of more than 8,000 professionals, the Company operates a long-term, asset-backed business model that delivers high-availability assets and predictable cash flows. SBM Offshore combines engineering expertise, operational reliability, and selective innovation to support safe, efficient, and lower-carbon energy production, while extending its capabilities into new opportunities across the blue economy.
  
  
Purpose
  
  

* Administer and maintain digital solutions, ensuring they operate efficiently and securely. Manage system configurations, resolve technical issues, and support users in utilizing digital tools. Collaborate with teams to optimize digital solutions in alignment with business needs.

**Responsibilities**

* Administer and maintain digital solutions, ensuring their performance, availability, and security to support business operations effectively.
* Manage the configuration and deployment of digital platforms, including software applications, cloud services, and integrated systems, ensuring they meet organizational requirements.
* Monitor and troubleshoot digital systems, identifying and resolving issues promptly to minimize downtime and ensure continuous service delivery.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support the implementation and integration of digital solutions, ensuring alignment with business goals and technical requirements.
* Perform regular updates, patches, and system enhancements to keep digital solutions up-to-date, secure, and optimized for performance.
* Ensure compliance with organizational policies and industry standards, implementing necessary security measures and conducting regular audits.
* Document system configurations, procedures, and best practices, maintaining detailed records to support ongoing maintenance and future development.
* Provide technical support and expertise to end-users and internal teams, resolving complex issues and ensuring efficient use of digital solutions.
* Stay informed of emerging technologies and trends, recommending and implementing improvements to enhance the functionality and efficiency of digital systems.
* Lead or assist in digital solution projects, ensuring they are completed on time, within scope, and according to best practices.

Education
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, software engineering, or a related field is required. Certifications such as Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator, AWS Certified SysOps Administrator, or Google Cloud Certified: Professional Cloud Architect are highly recommended. Proficiency in administering and managing digital solutions, including cloud platforms, enterprise software, and digital tools, is essential. A master’s degree in a related field is preferred but not mandatory.

**Experience**

* Minimum of 5 years of experience in digital solution administration, IT systems management, or a related field, with demonstrated expertise in managing and optimizing digital environments.
* Proven experience in deploying, configuring, and maintaining digital solutions across various platforms, including cloud-based environments like AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Strong technical background with hands-on experience in system administration, including the management of servers, databases, and application environments.

Functional Competencies
  
  
Compliance
  
  
Analytics and reporting
  
  
IT Tools and application
  
  
Business Partnering
  
  
Digital savvy
  
  
Business Acumen
  
  
Delivering Tender
  
  
Management of change application
  
  
Systems and Technology
  
  
Technical Data Management
  
  
**GENERAL INFORMATION**
SBM Offshore N.V. is a listed holding company that is headquartered in Amsterdam. It holds direct and indirect interests in other companies that collectively with SBM Offshore N.V. form the SBM Offshore Group (“the Company”). For further information, please visit our website at www.sbmoffshore.com. The companies in which SBM Offshore N.V., directly and indirectly, owns investments are separate entities.
  
  
SBM Offshore is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. SBM Offshore does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.

**Benefits**

As an employee, you will have the chance to chart your own career path and take advantage of competitive compensation packages and progression opportunities based on merit.
   

  

 Join us for a rewarding career where your needs are not just met but exceeded

title: Senior Reliability Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to join our team delivering and supporting critical applications running on Azure. The ideal candidate will be an expert in Azure services, have a combination of SRE and DevOps skills including automation, monitoring, observability, CI/CD, incident management, and have a deep understanding of end to end application workflow. As a Senior Site Reliability Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the reliability and performance of our applications throughout the lifecycle.
  
  
Role, Responsibilities and Key Accountabilities:
  
  

* Investigates and resolves complex incidents escalated to the team. Runs post incident review sessions and implements fixes and improvements.
* Conduct service transition activities including establishing metrics to track performance, setting up monitoring, Runbook updates, executing Game Day/OAT, and support team training.
* Maintains services once they are live by measuring and monitoring availability, latency, and overall system health.
* Scales systems sustainably through mechanisms like automation and observability, evolving systems by advocating for changes that improve reliability and velocity.
* Maintains scalable and efficient CI/CD pipelines for application enhancement and fixes.
* Conducts regular capacity and finops review based on usage trends and growth projections.
* Develops disaster recovery (DR) plans and conducts regular DR testing to validate recovery procedures and identify areas for improvement.
* Ensures application compliance with regulatory and security requirements.
* Proactively continues to build and apply relevant domain knowledge that may relate to workflows, data pipelines, business policies, configurations, and constraints.
* Coordinates on security principal access management and triages security issues.

Qualifications and Experience:
  
  

* Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics/Electrical Engineering, or equivalent.
* 5+ years of experience working as a site reliability engineer or DevOps engineer responsible for application availability and reliability, implementing automation, and optimizing system performance.
* Extensive hands-on experience with Azure services preferably Microsoft Fabric and Purview.
* Familiarity with infrastructure-as-a-code tools such as Terraform and Azure Resource Manager.
* Scripting and automation skills using Python, PowerShell, or other languages
* Strong knowledge of ITIL framework and best practices for incident, change, configuration, and problem management.
* Have a good understanding of REST API.
* Excellent English communication skill. Must be able to work with stakeholders located globally.
* Excellent troubleshooting skills and ability to analyze complex issues.

title: Data Platforms Operations Expert
description:
Astellas is a global life sciences company committed to turning innovative science into VALUE for patients. We provide transformative therapies in disease areas that include oncology, ophthalmology, urology, immunology and women's health. Through our research and development programs, we are pioneering new healthcare solutions for diseases with high unmet medical need. Learn more at Astellas.com (https://www.astellas.com/en) .
  
  
**Are you driven to make a real difference in the lives of patients?**
We're seeking passionate individuals who thrive in dynamic environments, embrace new ideas, and aren't afraid to take intelligent risks. People who act with unwavering integrity and are deeply committed to making a tangible impact.
  
  
**Purpose And Scope**
The Data Operations Specialist is responsible for implementing practical and efficient ways to organize and process data, to enable measurement, analytics and reporting that will be used to develop actionable insight for inclusion in reports that communicate the value of Data Strategy activities. In this role, you are to build and cultivate trusted partnerships with groups from various areas of the company (within Data Strategy and outside such as with Omnichannel Strategy & Operations, Information Systems (DX), Finance, Legal, Ethics & Compliance, etc.) as well as with external vendors/suppliers. Your focus is enforcing data standards. Your pivotal responsibility lies in fostering effective collaboration, communication, and strategic alignment with the mentioned groups to propel the Data Strategy practice forward in the quality and efficiency of their analytics and reporting. This role operates within the Customer Engagement Excellence (CEE) group, which supports capabilities across VALUE Delivery, including Commercial (Sales/Marketing), Market Access and Medical Affairs, whilst prioritizing ethical decision making. During all such activities, there is a need to ensure that the integrity and independence of Medical Affairs capabilities is not compromised. You are expected to proactively communicate and consult with your Chapter and Value Team Leads as necessary to ensure that the integrity and independence of Medical Affairs is maintained at all times.
  
  
This is a global role that is also expected to build trusted partnerships with global, regional, and affiliate groups from various areas of the company (with co-colleagues within Value Delivery and outside such as Information Systems (DX), Brand teams, Procurement, HR, etc.) as well as with external vendors/suppliers. Your strategic mindset and commitment to modern data technologies will be key in shaping our data landscape.
  
  
The Chapter Member receives capability and skillset development under the guidance of the Chapter Lead, who provides coaching and mentoring within the Agile model.
  
  
**Responsibilities And Accountabilities**

* Data Sourcing & Acquisition:
* Work closely with Business to understand data needs, assess and prioritize new data use cases, and ensure Analytics Data Layer supports business reporting and measurable outcomes.
* Conduct due diligence to validate data quality, reliability, and alignment with business objectives.
* Serve as an SME for data pipeline (including ADL, Databricks, and legacy data management) and technical SME for dashboards which consume data.
* Identify and implement opportunities for efficiency gains in data workflows, processes, and systems.
* Continuously evaluate tools, technologies, and methodologies to improve data operations efficiency and scalability.
* Data Onboarding:
* Ensure data is properly formatted, validated, and transformed for marketing analytics and reporting, holding external vendors accountable for data accuracy and timeliness.
* Establish data validation frameworks to assess the completeness, timeliness, and accuracy of onboarded datasets, implementing monitoring mechanisms to detect and resolve integration issues proactively.
* Partner with IT teams to ensure smooth integration of new data sources into the organization's data infrastructure.
* Clean, standardize, and transform data to align with marketing and analytical requirements.
* Create and maintain comprehensive data dictionaries and metadata documentation.
* Data Management & Governance:
* Define, implement, and ensure adherence to data standards for structure, consistency, and interoperability across systems and teams.
* Oversee the storage, organization, and accessibility of promotional marketing data ensuring compliance with internal governance standards.
* Develop and enforce data quality standards to maintain data accuracy, consistency, and completeness.
* Partner with stakeholders to create standardized data taxonomies and classification frameworks to improve usability.
* Partner with stakeholders to transform ingested data into analytic ready formats.
* Monitor and troubleshoot data issues, implementing corrective measures when necessary, communicating data-related issues and resolutions to stakeholders.
* Provide strategic guidance on data source quality, context and usage based on business needs and analytical use cases.
* Coordinate and facilitate data source changes and communication to necessary business stakeholders.
* Assist the Data Foundation Pod in triaging new projects to determine appropriate ownership and/or engagement from the Value Teams within and outside of the Data Foundation Pod, necessary Capability teams, and potentially other Hub groups.
* Champion the adoption of Agile methodology in both project delivery and continuous integrations and continuous delivery (CI/CD) of efficient and scalable data management, reporting, and analytics solutions.
* Medical Affairs Enablement:
* Contribute to the expansion of Medical Affairs systems and solutions which may include Clinical Trial Management (CTMS), external funding and grants, Vault Medical content management system, and medical incident reporting functions.
* Ensure that data operations supporting Medical Affairs preserve the integrity and independence of the function, applying appropriate governance, access controls, and privacy safeguards when onboarding and managing medical, clinical, and R&D data sources.
* Reporting & Automation:
* Provide regular updates on data availability, integrity, and performance to key stakeholders.
* Maintain a schedule for data delivery and loading.
* Identify and implement opportunities for process automation to enhance operational efficiency.
* Stay informed on emerging industry trends and advancements in marketing data and data management, advising leadership on innovative solutions that complement and drive business growth.
* Agile:
* Utilize agile approaches, collaborate in agile ceremonies and Ways of Working to ensure effective delivery for the business
* Collaborate and foster a culture of collaboration, flexibility, and responsiveness to change, enabling the team to thrive in an agile environment

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer or Information/Data Science, Information Systems, or STEM field.
* 10+ years of relevant experience in data management, with a focus on digital marketing datasets
* Experience in sourcing, onboarding, and managing large datasets from external vendors.
* Proficiency with a coding language (e.g. SQL, Python), MS Excel and PowerPoint, ETL/data processing tools.
* Exposure to and/or good understanding of Data Warehousing/Data Lakehouse platforms and technologies (e.g., AWS S3/RedShift, SQL, etc.)
* Good understanding of data stewardship and governance concepts (e.g., data ingestion, reference data management, data transformations, data quality and observability, data archiving, etc.).
* Demonstrated ability to understand business requirements as well as underlying infrastructure applications, systems, and processes. Proven experience in process mapping, process improvement, and problem-solving skills with demonstrated ability in taking initiative to proactively evaluate existing strategies and processes and recommend best-fit solutions when appropriate.
* Deep understanding of marketing data types (campaign data, engagement metrics, media spend) and their applications.
* Familiarity with marketing tech platforms like CM360, SA360, Meta.
* Experience working with Google Analytics or Adobe Analytics.
* Familiarity with data visualization and reporting tools (e.g., Qlik, Tableau, Power BI).
* Proven ability to align data initiatives with business objectives, ensuring data-driven decision-making.
* Excellent organizational, project planning and business change management skills with a strong attention to detail and ability to effectively manage cross-functional projects.
* Strong communication, facilitation, presentation, and influencing skills to effectively interact to a diverse audience.
* Extensive computer proficiency in other Microsoft products: Excel, VBA, Macros, Access, Visio, PowerPoint, Teams, SharePoint, etc.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master’s Degree in Computer or Information/Data Science, Information Systems, or STEM field
* Understanding of Data models for platforms like CM360
* Pharmaceutical industry experience
* Experience working with Databricks
* Strong understanding of data architecture, engineering, operations, and reporting within the Life Sciences/Pharma industry across Commercial, Medical (R&D), and Finance domains.
* Familiarity with Medical Affairs data sources and systems (e.g., CTMS, Vault Medical, medical incident reporting) and with secondary data sources commonly used in Life Sciences (e.g., script level, patient longitudinal, promotional, omnichannel data).
* Experience supporting the US market (preferred but not required).

**Work Environment**
This position is based in our Global Capability Center in India. At Astellas we recognize the importance of work/life balance, and we are proud to offer a hybrid working solution allowing time to connect with colleagues at the office with the flexibility to also work from home. We believe this will optimize the most productive work environment for all employees to succeed and deliver. Hybrid work from certain locations may be permitted in accordance with Astellas’ Responsible Flexibility Guidelines.
  
  
**What Awaits You At Astellas**

title: Security Consultant
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Security Consultant**
**Job Summary:**
As an Information Security Consultant, the individual will be responsible for providing security guidance to projects and operations teams responsible for delivering, respectively maintaining, IT cloud-based solutions. The Consultant will support the entire system development lifecycle (SDLC) of business IT solutions with information security expertise and guidance. This includes performing a risk assessment of the solution and the underpinning cloud infrastructure in order to derive adequate risk treatment options, driving the security assurance activities with cloud vendors, specifying and prioritizing security requirements, directing the design of security controls, supervising the security attestation activities and effectively articulating all related findings, issues, recommendations to team members and management, assessing the security impact of change requests and providing the operations teams with related recommendations and decisions.
  
  
The successful candidate should have solid background in web services architecture and design, networking principles supporting hybrid cloud models, experience in applications development processes and methodologies (experience in agile application development and DevOps operations mode is strongly preferred), as well as oversight knowledge of infrastructure and hosting technologies leveraging virtualization and containerization. The successful candidate should have broad consulting or security assurance experience across all Information Security knowledge areas relevant to modern cloud-based architectures.
  
  
**EY Technology:**
Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently. We have 250,000 people in more than 140 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. Everything from the laptops we use, to the ability to work remotely on our mobile devices and connecting our people and our clients, to enabling hundreds of internal tools and external solutions delivered to our clients. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and is key to us being more innovative as an organization.
  
  
**EY Technology**
supports our technology needs through three business units:
  
  
**Client Technology (CT) -**
focuses on developing new technology services for our clients. It enables EY to identify new technology-based opportunities faster, and pursue those opportunities more rapidly.
  
  
**Enterprise Workplace Technology (EWT) –**
EWT supports our Core Business Services functions and will deliver fit-for-purpose technology infrastructure at the cheapest possible cost for quality services. EWT will also support our internal technology needs by focusing on a better user experience.
  
  
**Information Security (Info Sec) -**
Info Sec prevents, detects, responds and mitigates cyber-risk, protecting EY and client data, and our information management systems.
  
  
**The opportunity:**
The Security Consultant reports to Deputy CISO of Enterprise Workplace Technology in a hands-on role, focused on the secure design, architecture and development for applications, which processes sensitive data and constitutes core as well as critical business services. The Security Consultant works directly with Architects, Developers, IAM engineers, Project Managers and other resources; through collaboration and mentoring, they help teams to deliver secure business solutions.
  
  
The Security Consultant’s role is a technical position which will support the global strategies and architecture vision as it relates to the development of secure design, build, deployment and operation of business applications and related infrastructure.
  
  
**Your key responsibilities:**
This position is an individual contributor capable of supporting multiple project teams in the design, implementation and validation of security controls across applications and services (incl. underpinning infrastructure and cloud hosting platform), as well as providing the operations teams with consultancy, reviews and decisions upon deployment of changes to existent operational services. The core responsibilities are as listed in the following.
  
  

* Directing and managing solution-specific information security assurance efforts with 3rd parties and vendors, like backend reviews, controls verification and validation, etc., oriented on standards and frameworks like ISO, COBIT, NIST, TSC, etc.
* Risk assessments (threats, vulnerabilities) of cloud services and applications
* Risk assessments of cloud hosting infrastructure underpinning the services and applications
* Security assessment of architecture and networking supporting the services and applications
* Derivation of risk treatment options from risk assessments and effectively facilitating the implementation of the optimal security-usability trade-off in interactions with project teams and management
* Identifying, specifying and prioritizing security requirements in new applications and services deployment, as well as specifying and facilitating security changes in DevOps operations mode of existent applications
* Directing the design of security controls to satisfy the approved security requirements
* Supervising and managing various types of security attestation activities (scans, pentests, audits), including the definition of scope, pass criteria, contribution to test scenarios, articulating and formalizing findings and decisions
* Assessing the security posture impact of change requests and providing the operations teams with related recommendations and decisions
* Effectively communicating the findings, recommendations and decisions from all above activities, by adapting the form and depth of statements adequately to audiences and stakeholders
* Translating technical security terms and concepts into business risk terminology to facilitate making objective and security-aware risk decisions by management
* Providing knowledge sharing and technical assistance to other team members
* Acting as an agile team member according to established agile development best practices and guidelines

**Skills and attributes for success:**
The position requires knowledge of various IT system architectures and technologies like cloud, virtualization, containerization, mobile, as well as expertise and experience in security subject matter areas such as IAM, network and perimeter security, web applications security, user account management, privileged access, auditing & logging, and others as outlined in ISO 27001, OWASP, NIST and related guidelines and standards. The consultant filling the position should also have experience in conduction of 3rd party security assessments, in particular within the scope of SOC1, SOC2 reports, and in vendor risk management.
  
  
A successful candidate should have significant security working experience and knowledge in the design, implementation and operation of security controls in any two or more of the following areas:
  
  

* Agile & DevOps Methodologies – Experience as a contributing member of a balanced team within an Agile development or DevOps environment.
* Application Security - Experience with the design of security controls for multi-tier business solutions including the design of application-level access and entitlement management, data tenancy and isolation, encryption, and logging. Working familiarity with REST API and micro services architecture.
* Cloud Security –Technical understanding of virtualization, cloud infrastructure, and public cloud offerings and experience designing security configuration and controls within cloud based solutions in Microsoft Azure and Azure PAAS services
* Infrastructure Security – Experience with the integration of common infrastructure security technologies and solutions into business solution architectures including the integration of identity & access management, intrusion detection and prevention, security monitoring, and data encryption solutions.
* Identity and Access Management - Active Directory based Identity and Access Management and Authorization design experience and integration with IDaaS and Federation technologies.

**To qualify for the role you must have:**

* A BSc or MSc degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related discipline, or equivalent work experience, with preference towards advanced degrees.
* Seven or more years of experience in Information Technology disciplines. Five or more years of experience in Information Security subject matter area with demonstrated experience in the following:
* Experience providing and validating security requirements related to applications and information system design and implementation
* Experience providing and validating security requirements related to cloud services and underlying networking and architectures
* Experience conducting risk assessments, vulnerability assessments, vendor and third party risk assessments and recommending risk remediation strategies
* Experience in the use of tools and methods to identify security exposures and business risks
* Knowledge of common information security standards, such as: ISO, NIST, COBIT
* Familiarity with information system attack methods and vulnerabilities and threat modelling
* Working experience with web technologies and programming languages
* Working experience with more than one of these technologies and products - Java, .NET, NodeJS, Angular, Power Apps, Kubernetes

**Ideally, you’ll also have:**

* A vendor-neutral security certification of DoD IAT Level II-III or DoD IAM Level II-III is strongly preferred (SSCP, Security+, CEH, CISSP, CISM)
* A vendor-specific cloud security certification would be an additional asset (Microsoft AZ-500, AWS Security Specialty, …)
* Proven experience as a standing member of an agile development team (in any agile role) or as DevOps operations mode contributor would be an additional asset,
* Proven experience with either of the Adobe cloud products would be an additional assets.

**What we look for:**

* Ability to team well with others to facilitate and enhance the understanding & compliance to security policies
* Ability to work effectively with customers, management, staff members, vendors, and consultants and articulate findings and recommendations
* Strong English communication and writing skills are required
* Strong judgment and analytical ability
* Excellent interpersonal, communication, organizational, and project management skills
* Flexibility to adjust to multiple demands, shifting priorities, ambiguity, and rapid change

**What working at EY offers:**
We offer a competitive remuneration package where you’ll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

description:

title: Engineer III, Software Test
description:
**Work Schedule**
 Standard (Mon\-Fri)
   

  

**Environmental Conditions**
 Office
   

  

 Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc. is the world leader in serving science, with an annual revenue of approximately $40 billion. Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Whether our customers are accelerating life sciences research, solving sophisticated analytical challenges, growing efficiency in their laboratories, improving patient health through diagnostics or the development and manufacture of life\-changing therapies, we are here to support them. Our distributed team of more than 130,000 colleagues delivers an unrivalled combination of innovative technologies, purchasing convenience and pharmaceutical services through our industry\-leading brands, including Thermo Scientific, Applied Biosystems, Invitrogen, Fisher Scientific, Unity Lab Services, Patheon and PPD.
   

  

 For more information, please visit www.thermofisher.com.
   

  

 As a Software Developer, you will actively engage in comprehending software requirements thoroughly, ensuring end\-to\-end understanding, and delivering high quality code to fulfill these requirements. Your focus extends to optimizing system performance while prioritizing the long\-term maintainability of the codebase.
   

  

**What will you do?**
* Perform scenario\-based manual testing of software applications to identify defects and ensure adherence to quality standards.
* Analyze requirements and develop comprehensive test scenarios and test cases covering positive, negative, boundary, edge, exception, and end\-to\-end business scenarios.
* Apply strong software testing techniques Decision Table Testing, State Transition Testing, Error Guessing, and Exploratory Testing.
* Develop comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test scripts based on project requirements.
* Conduct verification and validation activities to confirm that software meets specified requirements and user expectations.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to understand system requirements, identify requirement gaps, and validate software functionality.
* Perform functional, integration, regression, system, exploratory, and end\-to\-end testing.
* Analyze test results, identify issues, and report defects in a clear and timely manner.
* Work closely with developers to troubleshoot issues, verify fixes, and ensure the integrity of the software.
* Develop and maintain automated test scripts using Playwright with Python, where applicable, to improve regression coverage and testing efficiency.
* Execute and maintain automated test scripts as part of the overall testing process.
* Perform mobile device testing across applicable devices, operating systems, screen sizes, and configurations, where required.
* Participate in sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, and retrospective meetings to provide input on testing activities and contribute to process improvement initiatives.


**Minimum Requirements or Qualifications:**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
* 6\-9 years of experience in software testing, verification, and validation.
* Strong proficiency in scenario\-based manual testing methodologies and techniques.
* Strong knowledge and hands\-on experience in test design techniques such as Boundary Value Analysis, Equivalence Partitioning, Decision Table Testing, State Transition Testing, Error Guessing, and Exploratory Testing.
* Strong ability to derive comprehensive test scenarios from requirements, business workflows, and user behavior, including positive, negative, boundary, edge, and exception scenarios.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with keen attention to detail.
* Experience in functional, integration, regression, system, exploratory, and end\-to\-end testing.
* Experience with Playwright automation using Python is an added advantage.
* Experience with Python and pytest is an added advantage.
* Experience in mobile device testing is an added advantage.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment.
* Proven ability to prioritize tasks, manage workload efficiently, and meet project deadlines.
* Knowledge of software development lifecycle (SDLC), software testing lifecycle (STLC), and Agile methodologies.
* Exposure to ISO 13485 and IEC 62304 standards for medical device development.
* ISTQB or similar certification is a plus.

**About Upstox**
At Upstox, we’re building the future of investing — simple, powerful, and for everyone. **The Role: Product Intern – Customer Experience**
You’ll join the Customer Experience Product team and work on initiatives that make every interaction with Upstox simpler, faster, and more seamless. This is a hands-on, 0→1 product role where you’ll work across customer research, product discovery, data analysis, PRDs, wireframes, experimentation, and execution. You’ll work closely with Product, Design and Engineering teams to understand customer problems, identify opportunities and translate insights into meaningful product experiences. You won’t just observe the product-building process — you’ll get the opportunity to research, create, experiment and ship.
  
  
**What You’ll Work On**
**Product & Asset Creation**

* Create clear and structured PRDs that translate customer problems into actionable product requirements.
* Design wireframes and interactive prototypes to communicate product ideas and user flows.
* Conduct user research and secondary research to understand customer needs, behaviours and pain points.
* Use Jira to track requirements, tasks and product execution.
* Build and maintain product roadmaps in collaboration with the Product team.
* Analyse user events and SQL data to identify behavioural patterns, product opportunities and areas of friction.
* Collaborate closely with Design and Engineering to take ideas from concept to execution.

**Product Skills**

* Demonstrate strong 0→1 product thinking — identify a problem, understand the user, formulate a solution and test it.
* Work on and contribute to B2C products with a strong focus on customer experience.
* Apply strong user-centric thinking when defining problems and evaluating solutions.
* Take an experimental and hypothesis-driven approach to product development.
* Use data, customer insights and experimentation to validate product decisions.
* Participate in product discovery, prioritisation and post-launch analysis.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Strong interest in Product Management and building consumer products.
* Ability to structure ambiguous problems and break them down into actionable steps.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Curiosity to understand why customers behave the way they do.
* Ability to think from the customer's perspective and identify friction in a journey.
* Comfortable working with data and analytics.
* Willingness to work closely with Product, Design and Engineering teams.
* Strong ownership and a bias for action.
* Comfortable learning new tools and concepts quickly.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with ambiguity.

**Good to Have**

* Ability to use AI to accelerate your product workflow — research, analysis, ideation, prototyping, documentation or other product work.
* Exposure to stock broking, investing or financial products.
* Familiarity with SQL, Jira, analytics tools, prototyping or wireframing tools.
* Previous experience building or contributing to B2C products through internships, projects or coursework.

**Why This Role Rocks**
You’ll be part of a fast-moving product team solving real customer problems at scale.You’ll get hands-on exposure to 0→1 product building, customer research, PRDs, wireframing, data analysis, experimentation and product execution.Most importantly, you’ll get the opportunity to work on products used by millions of customers and see your ideas move from problem → solution → product.

title: Post-Doctoral Researcher, PhD, DeepMind, 2026 Start (Fixed-Term Contract)
description:
To start the application process, you will need an updated CV or resume and a current unofficial or official transcript in English. Click on the “Apply” button on this page and provide the required materials in the appropriate sections (PDFs preferred):
  
  

* In the “Resume Section:” attach an updated CV or resume. Please ensure you include the following in it, all consolidated in a single PDF:
* Research work: Projects, Publications, Research experience and References (if any)
* Statement of purpose (no more than 500 words), detailing reasons for your interest in the Post-doctoral Researcher role.
* Please ensure you’ve listed your graduation date (in MM/YY)
* In the “Education Section:” attach a current or recent unofficial or official transcript in English. Under “Degree Status,” select “Now attending/Graduated” to upload a transcript.

If you think this role interests you, please apply to this role.
  
  
**Minimum qualifications:**

* PhD degree in a STEM field (e.g., Computer Science, Mathematics, or Statistics) or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience with one or more general purpose programming languages: Python, C/C++, or Java, etc. and training deep learning models in frameworks such as JAX, TensorFlow, or PyTorch.
* Research experience in machine learning or AI techniques (e.g., open source project(s), campus lab experience, research internship(s), or publication(s)).
* One or more scientific publication submission(s) in AI conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, CVPR, ICCV, ICLR).

**Preferred qualifications:**

* PhD and Master’s degree in a STEM field (e.g. Computer Science, Mathematics, or Statistics) or equivalent practical experience.
* Hands-on experience with one or more general purpose programming languages: Python, C/C++, or Java, etc and training deep learning models in frameworks such as JAX, TensorFlow, or PyTorch.
* Extensive research experience in machine learning or AI techniques (e.g. open source project(s), campus lab experience, research internship(s), or publication(s)).
* Ability to work and collaborate across multiple teams and work with ambiguity.
* A strong publication record in top-tier conferences/journals.

**About The Job**
The Post-doctoral Researcher role is a 12 to 24-month role designed to explore challenging problems for pushing frontiers of AI, while collaborating with DeepMind scientists and engineers. Your role will entail conducting human-computer interaction (HCI) research on how people interact with, oversee, and provide feedback to increasingly autonomous AI agents, designing and building novel interfaces and interaction techniques for human-agent collaboration, and evaluating them through rigorous user studies. Insights from your work will inform how agents learn from human feedback and remain safe and aligned with human intent, with potential application to products that might have a positive impact on billions of users.
  
  
At DeepMind, we're a team of scientists, engineers, machine learning experts and more, working together to advance the state of the art in artificial intelligence, and fulfill our mission of building AI responsibility to benefit humanity. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, and collaborate with others on critical challenges, ensuring safety and ethics are the highest priority.
  
  
In particular, our AQUA team at DeepMind India works at the frontier of AI agents, focusing on autonomous self-improvement, reinforcement learning, and the safety and alignment of agents. We build agents that continually improve themselves by learning from their own experience, interactions, and feedback, and we develop methods to ensure that increasingly capable and autonomous agents remain safe, reliable, and aligned with human intent and values. We aim to bring our research into Google's cutting-edge models and products, while also disseminating our findings through publications at top ML conferences/journals.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Work with research mentors to formulate research projects or novel applications of machine learning aligned with the team's mission. Conduct research and publish high quality work.
* Design and execute large-scale experiments, writing high-quality, reusable code, and contributing to a production-ready system using frameworks such as JAX. Learn and understand research in machine learning algorithms.
* Understand how to use research to drive design decisions. Design and conduct user studies (e.g. interviews, surveys, controlled experiments, and field deployments) to understand how people interact with, oversee, and provide feedback to AI agents.
* Prototype novel interfaces and interaction techniques that help people steer, supervise, and collaborate with increasingly autonomous agents. Develop human-centered evaluation methods and metrics for the helpfulness, trustworthiness, safety, and alignment of agents.
* Translate insights from human studies into improvements in how agents learn from human feedback and improve themselves (e.g. reward modeling, preference elicitation, and human-in-the-loop reinforcement learning).

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

title: Regional Certification Liaison 1
description:
**Career Area**
Engineering
  
  
**Job Description**
**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**
When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
  
  
**Product Compliance Engineer – Genset Compliance Management**
**Role Summary**
We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented
**Product Compliance Engineer**
to lead product safety and compliance management activities for generator set (Genset) products across countries in Rest of World (RoW - Europe, Middle-East, Africa, Asia Pacific, Australia-NZ and Latin America other than United States and Canada). This role is responsible for ensuring products meet all applicable regulatory, safety, and industry certification requirements.
  
  
The successful candidate will act as the primary interface between the engineering organization and certification agencies in respective regions that could include UL, CSA, and other recognized certification and regulatory bodies, ensuring timely certification, maintenance of approvals, and resolution of compliance-related issues. The role requires close collaboration with Engineering, Sales, Operations, Quality, and external agencies to support product development, certification, and market access objectives.
  
  
This position also requires periodic travel to test laboratories and certification facilities to witness product testing, support certification activities, and ensure compliance requirements are met. In addition, the role will be responsible for establishing and continuously improving compliance management processes and governance frameworks.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Compliance Management**

* Manage regulatory and compliance requirements for generator set products marketed in countries other than the United States and Canada.
* Knowledgeable in applicable standards, codes, and regulations relevant to gensets and associated electrical systems.
* Ensure products maintain compliance including new product development, product changes, and sustaining engineering activities.
* Monitor evolving regulatory and certification requirements and assess impact on products and business operations.

**Certification & Agency Management**

* Serve as the primary technical contact for certification agencies,

+ UL / CSA Group
+ EU Regulatory & Certification requirements covering the Machinery, EMC, RoHS & Noise Directives
+ Other certification, testing, and regulatory organizations as required

* Coordinate certification projects, audits, inspections, and follow-up activities.
* Manage certification documentation, test reports, technical files, and approval records.
* Drive timely closure of certification findings, non-conformities, and compliance gaps.

**Engineering Support**

* Provide compliance guidance to product development and engineering teams during design and development phases.
* Review product designs, drawings, specifications, and change requests for compliance impacts.
* Support root cause investigations and corrective actions related to compliance issues.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure compliance requirements are incorporated into product designs.

**Regulatory Support & Consultation**

* Respond to compliance and regulatory inquiries from:

+ Engineering teams
+ Sales and commercial teams
+ Operations and manufacturing teams
+ Quality and service organizations

* Provide technical guidance on the application of standards and certification requirements.
* Support customer and regulatory compliance documentation requests.

**Testing & Validation**

* Coordinate compliance testing activities with internal teams and external laboratories.
* Develop test plans and compliance validation strategies.
* Travel to certification laboratories and test facilities to witness testing and represent the company during certification evaluations.
* Review and approve testing documentation and certification evidence.

**Process Development & Continuous Improvement**

* Develop, implement, and maintain compliance management processes, procedures, and governance models.
* Establish compliance metrics, reporting mechanisms, and tracking tools.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to improve compliance efficiency, reduce certification lead times, and improve product readiness.
* Support compliance training and awareness programs across the organization.

**Qualifications**
**Education**

* Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering / Power Generation, Mechanical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
* Master's Degree is preferred but not required.

**Experience**

* 8+ years of experience in product compliance, certification, regulatory engineering, or related technical roles.
* Experience with generator sets, power generation equipment, industrial electrical products, or similar engineered products preferred.
* Strong experience working with certification agencies and notified bodies for EU Regulatory certification. Working knowledge on RoHS, Outdoor Noise and other related EU Directives.
* Experience managing third-party testing and certification projects.
* Experience interpreting and applying Global product safety and compliance standards.

**Technical Skills (Top Skills Required)**
**Regulatory & Compliance Expertise**

* Strong knowledge of RoW product compliance requirements for electrical and power generation equipment.
* Ability to interpret and apply regulatory requirements and industry standards.

**Certification Management**

* Experience coordinating certifications with:

+ UL / CSA Group
+ EU Notified Bodies
+ Africa & Middle-East regulatory agencies
+ Nationally Recognized Testing Laboratories (NRTLs)
+ Certification and inspection bodies

**Product Safety Standards**

* Knowledge of applicable standards and codes, including:

+ UL standards
+ CSA standards
+ Electrical safety requirements
+ Applicable NFPA and industry requirements
+ Generator set and power system compliance requirements
+ All related ISO / IEC / EN Standards

**Product Development Support**

* Design review and compliance assessment capability.
* Engineering change impact assessment from a regulatory perspective.
* Risk assessment and compliance validation planning.

**Testing & Validation**

* Product certification testing coordination.
* Test plan development and execution.
* Test witnessing and compliance verification.

**Documentation & Compliance Systems**

* Technical documentation management.
* Certification file maintenance.
* Compliance records and audit preparation.
* Process development and governance documentation.

**Project Management**

* Managing multiple certification and compliance projects simultaneously.
* Planning, tracking, and reporting compliance activities.
* Coordination of cross-functional stakeholders and external agencies.

**Soft Skills**
**Communication Skills**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to communicate complex regulatory requirements to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Strong stakeholder management capabilities.

**Relationship Management**

* Ability to build effective working relationships with certification agencies, regulatory bodies, laboratories, and internal stakeholders.
* Strong customer-focused mindset when supporting internal and external compliance inquiries.

**Analytical Thinking**

* Strong problem-solving and root-cause analysis skills.
* Ability to evaluate technical data and make sound compliance-related decisions.

**Attention to Detail**

* High level of accuracy in reviewing standards, certifications, test reports, and compliance documentation.
* Strong focus on quality and risk mitigation.

**Leadership & Influence**

* Ability to influence engineering and business teams without direct authority.
* Drive compliance requirements effectively across cross-functional organizations.

**Adaptability**

* Ability to manage changing regulatory requirements and evolving business priorities.
* Comfortable working in a dynamic product development environment.

**Collaboration**

* Strong teamwork skills with the ability to work across Engineering, Operations, Quality, Supply Chain, Service, and Sales organizations.

**Initiative & Ownership**

* Self-motivated with strong ownership of compliance deliverables.
* Ability to independently drive certification and compliance activities to successful completion.

**Travel Requirements**

* Willingness and ability to travel domestically and internationally as required.
* Travel to certification laboratories, customer locations, manufacturing sites, and testing facilities to support compliance testing, certification activities, regulatory audits, and technical reviews.
* Estimated travel: 5-10%, depending on project and certification needs.

**Success Measures**
**The Product Compliance Engineer Will Be Successful When**

* Products achieve and maintain required certifications for countries in the regions other than US and Canadian markets.
* Compliance risks are proactively identified and mitigated.
* Certification projects are completed on schedule.
* Internal compliance inquiries are addressed accurately and promptly.
* Effective compliance processes and governance mechanisms are established and sustained.
* Strong working relationships are maintained with certification agencies and regulatory stakeholders.

**Additional information**
: This job requires 5days in a week working from office.
  
  
**Posting Dates**
October 26, 2026 - October 30, 2026
  
  
Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

description:

title: Growth Content Marketer
description:
