Reo.Dev is a modern revenue stack for Developer focused companies. We help Developer Tool companies identify which Engineering Teams have an Urgent need for their product and the highest likelihood of conversion. We capture and analyze a wide array of developer activity data from Github, Docs, Docker Installs, Communities, other dev specific sources and convert them to sales signals.

**What will you be working on?**

Create content that brings people to Reo.Dev and gets them to sign up. Grow into a much bigger role over time!

Your mandate is to create a lot of content that generates eyeballs and inbound traffic for Reo.Dev: SEO and AEO content, website pages, white papers, lead magnets, and any other content or campaign that brings people back to our website.

This is a growth content role. Every piece you create needs an end goal: traffic, opt-ins and sign-ups. You'll blend creative strategy and content, SaaS content and technical content marketing, with a growth lens.

Our ICP is go-to-market folks working in DevTool and infra companies. They are technical, they are sceptical, and a lot of them spend their time on LinkedIn and Twitter. Content that works for them has to be sharp, specific and genuinely useful.

You'll work closely with our SEO & AEO Growth Lead, the broader go-to-market team and the founders, and report to the Head of Inbound Marketing. You will have a Webflow vendor, a designer, a marketing ops intern and a GTM engineer to help, but expect to be hands-on.

**What You'll Do**

1. Create SEO and AEO content: blogs, guides, comparison pages, glossaries and product pages that rank and get cited in AI answers.

2. Build lead magnets and long-form assets: white papers, reports, playbooks and templates that ICPs actually want to download.

3. Drive content on LinkedIn and Twitter, turning our data, product insights and founder ideas into posts, threads and campaigns.

4. Run email marketing: mailers, offers and sequences that turn readers into opt-ins and sign-ups.

5. Earn brand mentions across the web and LLMs, including community and Reddit-style marketing.

6. Understand DevTools, Security, AI Infra and how GTM teams at these companies work.

7. Measure what works: track traffic, opt-ins and sign-ups for every piece and campaign.

**What We're Looking For**

Sharp writing with a point of view, and work people actually read and share.

A growth mindset: you care about traffic, opt-ins and sign-ups.

Creative instincts for campaigns, hooks and ideas.

Technical curiosity and comfort writing for a technical audience.

Understanding of how content ranks on Google and gets cited by LLMs.

Comfort with Google Analytics, Search Console, Looker Studio and AI tools.

Hands-on execution: you ship fast and keep improving.

**What Will Make You Stand Out**

B2B SaaS content or marketing experience.

DevRel or technical marketing experience.

A portfolio of published work with results to show.

You have grown a LinkedIn or Twitter audience, or run newsletters with real opt-ins.

You have built white papers, lead magnets or programmatic pages.

Hands-on with WordPress or Webflow.

**Why This Role**

We have just launched a PLG product and the goal now is to grow traffic and sign-ups. Build our content engine from scratch, with unique proprietary data, wide scope and real ownership.

Location: Bengaluru, hybrid.

title: Sr. Integrated and ABM Specialist
description:
Sprinklr is the definitive, AI-native platform for Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM), empowering brands to deliver extraordinary experiences at scale — across every customer touchpoint.
  
  
By combining human instinct with the speed and efficiency of AI, Sprinklr helps brands earn trust and loyalty through personalized, seamless, and efficient customer interactions. Sprinklr’s unified platform provides powerful solutions for every customer-facing team — spanning social media management, marketing, advertising, customer feedback, and omnichannel contact center management — enabling enterprises to unify data, break down silos, and act on real-time insights.
  
  
Today, 1,900+ enterprises and 60% of the Fortune 100 rely on Sprinklr to help them deliver consistent, trusted customer experiences worldwide.
  
  
**Job Description**
**About the Role**
As an Integrated Campaign & ABM Specialist, you’ll help shape how Sprinklr engages priority audiences and enterprise accounts. You’ll turn audience insight, account intelligence, and business priorities into connected experiences that build engagement, support pipeline progression, and create opportunities for account growth. This is a hands-on role for a B2B marketer who can move confidently between strategy and execution, coordinate multiple stakeholders, and translate performance signals into clear action.
  
  
**What Success Looks Like**
Success means delivering campaigns that feel like one connected experience rather than a collection of channel activities. Your programs help account teams understand where engagement is building, which buying-group members matter, and what action to take next. You’ll be known for reliable execution, clear communication, strong partnership, and the ability to turn performance signals into better decisions.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Plan and execute integrated, multi-channel campaigns from brief and audience strategy through launch, optimization, and performance reporting.
* Build campaign journeys across email, content, webinars, virtual events, paid media, social, web, executive engagement, and sales-assisted outreach.
* Execute 1:1, 1: Few, ABM programs for priority accounts, industries, segments, and buying groups.
* Develop campaign briefs, audience definitions, messaging frameworks, content requirements, channel plans, project timelines, and stakeholder updates.
* Coordinate the creation of account- and persona-relevant assets, including landing pages, emails, sales plays, executive invitations, one-pagers, and digital experiences.
* Manage campaign operations with strong attention to quality, governance, dependencies, budgets, agencies, and launch readiness.
* Monitor engagement, buying-group coverage, conversion, pipeline progression, sourced and influenced pipeline, and account outcomes; translate findings into optimization actions.
* Identify opportunities to challenge established campaign practices, test new engagement approaches, and convert successful experiments into repeatable programs.
* Use AI thoughtfully to accelerate research, personalization, content workflows, and performance analysis while protecting quality, accuracy, customer trust, and brand standards.

**What Makes You Qualified**

* 5–7 years of experience in B2B integrated marketing, demand generation, account-based marketing, campaign management, or a related discipline; enterprise SaaS experience is strongly preferred.
* Working knowledge of 1:1, 1: Few ABM motions, buying groups, persona-led journeys, account research, and relevant account-specific experiences.
* Experience partnering with Sales and cross-functional marketing teams in a matrixed, global environment.
* Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple programs, stakeholders, deadlines, and dependencies.
* Analytical fluency across engagement, conversion, funnel, pipeline, and account-level performance metrics.
* Clear written and verbal communication, strong attention to detail, and the ability to turn complex inputs into actionable plans.
* Hands-on experience with CRM, marketing automation, campaign analytics, paid media, webinar, and project-management platforms.
* Familiarity with ABM and intent platforms such as 6sense, Demandbase, or Terminus is preferred; comparable account intelligence experience is welcome.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant work experience.

**What You’ll Help Achieve**
In your first year, you’ll help establish a dependable, insight-led campaign and ABM operating rhythm that improves account engagement, strengthens Sales partnership, and connects marketing activity to measurable business progress.
  
  

* Consistently deliver integrated campaigns and ABM plays against agreed briefs, milestones, quality standards, and business priorities.
* Improve engagement and buying-group coverage across priority audiences and accounts.
* Create a dependable operating rhythm with Sales and partner teams, including clear targeting, activation, follow-up, and feedback loops.
* Provide actionable reporting that connects campaign activity to funnel progression, pipeline, and account outcomes.
* Build reusable playbooks, templates, and learnings that improve campaign quality and scale.

**We focus on our mission**
: Sprinklr was founded in 2009 to solve a big problem: growing enterprise complexity that separated brands from their customers. Our vision was clear: to unify fragmented teams, tools and data — helping large organizations build deeper, more meaningful connections with the people they serve. Today, Sprinklr has a unified, AI-native platform for four product suites: Sprinklr Service, Sprinklr Social, Sprinklr Marketing, and Sprinklr Insights. Sprinklr is here to do three things:
  
  

* Lead a new category of enterprise software that we call Unified-CXM.
* Empower companies to deliver next generation, unified engagement journeys that reimagine the customer experience.
* Create a culture of customer obsession, with trust, teamwork, and accountability.

**We believe in our product**
: Customers who value exceptional customer experiences have what they need on our single unified platform, built with an operating system approach on a single codebase. That means that everything — and everyone — can work together to service, respond, sell, and market to customers on the channels they prefer. While Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM) as a category is just getting started, we are well on our way to creating a no-compromise, unified approach to better customer experiences for the world’s leading enterprise brands.
  
  
**We invest in our people**
: We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help each member of our team thrive. Sprinklr believes that you should be able to get the type of care you need for your personal well-being when you need it. We offer you and your family voluntary healthcare coverage in countries where applicable. We believe it is important to take time off – it is essential for your mental and physical wellbeing. We provide Sprinklrites with paid time off to recharge and spend time with loved ones. We want to grow our talent with purpose. Our open Mentoring Program is designed to create meaningful connections that support growth and amplify our focus.
  
  
To learn more about employee benefits by region, click here.
  
  
To learn more about all-things-Sprinklr, visit our candidate resource hub here.
  
  
**EEO - Our philosophy**
: Our goal is to ensure every employee feels like they belong and are operating in a collaborative environment. We fervently believe every employee matters and should be respected and heard. We believe we are stronger when we belong because collectively, we’re more innovative, creative, and successful.
  
  
Sprinklr is proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), age, physical or mental disability, citizenship, past, current, or prospective service in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.
  
  
Reasonable accommodations are available upon request during the interview process. To request an accommodation, please work directly with your recruitment coordinator or recruiter.
  
  
**Warning about Recruiting Scams:**
Please be vigilant for recruiting scams impersonating Sprinklr. Sprinklr will never ask you for money, to pay for equipment, or for unnecessary personal information during the interview process. Sprinklr will also never pay in Bitcoin or send email communications from our executives. Please review the Federal Trade Commission's advice to avoid these types of scams.
  
  
If you are contacted by someone whom you suspect may not be appropriately representing Sprinklr, please do not engage and block their email or phone number immediately.

**Requirements**

title: Senior Principal Architect, Platform & AI (Customer Engineering)
description:
**The Opportunity**

As a Senior Principal Architect in Customer Engineering at the Sr Principal Consultant level (Band E2), you will own the technical direction of FICO Customer Engineering's platform and tooling program over a three to five year horizon. Every second, banks around the world use FICO decisioning technology to decide whether a payment is fraud, whether a loan gets approved, and whether a customer gets in. Customer Engineering makes that platform simpler, safer, and faster to run at scale for the customers who depend on it. Based in Bangalore, India, you will decide what the platform is, what it is not, and how it evolves, working with senior leadership and with customer architects and security teams. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports, where you set the bar for every architect and engineer in the program and use AI as a serious engineering tool with real evaluation and safety discipline.

**What You'll Contribute**

* Define the target architecture and the path to a multi-tenant, event-driven platform, including control plane, data plane, tenancy model, and identity and access.
* Own the multi-region reliability model, including traffic routing, data synchronization, failover criteria, and the evidence that a region is safe to serve traffic.
* Set non-functional requirements for availability, latency, recovery objectives, auditability, and tenant isolation, and hold the platform to them with evidence.
* Design the AI architecture and the evaluation and safety framework for AI features, including offline evaluations, regression suites, human approval for any action that changes a customer environment, and complete audit trails.
* Build the compliance architecture, with controls and audit evidence that stand up to bank security reviews and financial-services regulators.
* Keep configuration and decision rules provably consistent across environments, and design safe, auditable self-service for customers and operations teams.
* Run the technology radar through short, time-boxed experiments on real data with explicit go or stop decisions, and write reference implementations when a pattern needs proving.
* Lead architecture governance through decision records, design reviews, and release-readiness gates, and review and unblock the hardest designs across teams.
* Partner with Product, Security, Support, SRE, and Engineering on prioritization and sequencing, explain architecture to executives in business terms, and mentor Principal Architects and senior engineers.

**What We're Seeking**

* 15+ years of experience to take full ownership of a multi-tenant, multi-region platform serving regulated customers, with financial services strongly preferred and real-time decisioning, fraud, credit risk, or payments experience a plus.
* Experience as an architect of large distributed systems in production.
* Deep AWS experience, including serverless and event-driven design, plus Kubernetes in production.
* Strong identity and security architecture skills, including OIDC and OAuth, role-based access control, secrets management, tenant isolation, and audit and compliance evidence.
* A working operational telemetry practice using metrics, logs, traces, and service level objectives to drive decisions.
* Hands-on experience shipping production systems with LLMs or agents, including evaluation, cost and latency control, tool design, failure handling, and data governance.
* Experience with predictive or ML-driven operational features such as forecasting, anomaly detection, or risk scoring, including model monitoring and retraining.
* Working knowledge of financial-services regulation and model risk management, and how to turn it into controls you can verify.
* A record of architecture decisions that held up, and the ability to write and read code so you review designs against the implementation, not the slide.

**Our Offer to You**

* An inclusive culture strongly reflecting our core values: Act Like an Owner, Delight Our Customers and Earn the Respect of Others.
* The opportunity to make an impact and develop professionally by leveraging your unique strengths and participating in valuable learning experiences.
* Highly competitive compensation, benefits and rewards programs that encourage you to bring your best every day and be recognized for doing so.
* An engaging, people-first work environment offering work/life balance, employee resource groups, and social events to promote interaction and camaraderie.

Assists the sales staff in assessing potential application of company products to meet customer needs and preparing detailed product specifications for the development and implementation of customer applications/solutions. May build POCs based on customer requirements to demonstrate feasibility of the application/solution, often requiring rapid prototyping and/or product demo for client. May provide software development and consultation to customers and/or product capability assessment and validation. Ensures that the product application/solution is functioning according to specifications. May provide follow-up support to Sales, Ops and customer personnel by disseminating technical information on specific applications/solutions
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* System design & specification: Define and specify advanced 4G/5G/NTN RAN feature behaviour and baseband requirements aligned with 3GPP TS 36 and 38-series.
* Requirements analysis & architecture: Translate system requirements into scalable RAN architectures covering DU/CU splits and interfaces.
* Performance monitoring & optimization: Monitor RAN KPIs, perform capacity planning, and optimize parameters to maximize throughput and reliability.
* Troubleshooting & root-cause analysis: Diagnose service and system failures, identify root causes, and implement corrective configuration or procedural fixes.
* Cross-functional collaboration: Coordinate with product, engineering, operations, and field teams to deliver RAN features and resolve escalations.
* Testing, validation & trials: Develop test cases, validate new RAN features in lab environments, and support field trials for software/hardware releases.
* Documentation & standards: Produce clear design docs, operational guides, and maintenance reports compliant with internal and 3GPP standards.

**Job Requirements**

* B.E./M.Tech/Ph.D. in ECE/CS with 5+ years in 3GPP L1/L2 stack development for 5G NR and NB‑IoT, including NTN extensions (Rel‑17/18/19).
* Expertise in PHY/MAC/RLC/PDCP for NR and NB‑IoT (TS 38.2xx/38.3xx, 36.2xx/36.3xx) with NTN features such as large RTT, Doppler compensation, and extended HARQ timelines.
* Strong understanding of RU–L1, L1–L2, and L2–L3 interfaces and 3GPP/O‑RAN functional splits (e.g., 7.2x, F1/E1).
* Hands‑on development of real‑time baseband/embedded stacks for NR and NB‑IoT NTN waveforms, optimized for low latency, multithreading, and memory efficiency.
* Proven experience in RAN system design, integration, testing, performance tuning, and debugging of baseband software for gNB/eNB platforms.
* Strong inclination to leverage AI tools (code assistants, log analysers) to accelerate day‑to‑day RAN development and debugging.

**Accessibility**
Mavenir is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to individuals with physical and mental disabilities. If you require any assistance, please state in your application or contact your recruiter.
  
  
Mavenir is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer and welcomes qualified applicants from around the world, regardless of their ethnicity, gender, religion, nationality, age, disability, or other legally protected status.

title: Principal Design Engineer, Design Systems
description:
**Who are we?**
Whatfix is an AI platform advancing the “userization” of enterprise applications, empowering companies to maximize the ROI of their digital investments. Technology needs adoption. It’s no different for AI. As AI reshapes roles, workflows, and human-machine interactions, it also introduces new layers of complexity and user friction. This is where Whatfix plays a pivotal role. A decade old DNA of empowering people to succeed with technology and not replacing them. We call this philosophy Userization: the belief that technology must adapt to the user, not the other way around.
  
  
At the heart of userization philosophy is ScreenSense, our proprietary AI engine, which continuously interprets both the context of what users are doing in an application or an AI tool and the intent behind their actions. By combining these signals, Whatfix delivers real-time guidance, nudges, knowledge, and automation directly in the flow of work.
  
  
**This intelligence powers our entire product suite.**

* Digital Adoption helps users get productive faster.
* Product Analytics uncovers friction and closes adoption gaps.
* Mirror allows employees to train in safe, simulated environments.

**These are ur embedded with Whatfix AI Agents which supercharge creation, insights, and user guidance.**
**Our upcoming AI-first products are already creating a buzz in the market.**

* Seek is an AI-native assistant that not only knows your business context but can also act across applications to get work done on your behalf.
* Whatfix Mirror 2.0 is the world’s only System plus Role simulation with a complete assessment to lead the Gen AI simulation category
* Together, these products reflect Whatfix’s commitment to building enterprise-ready AI teammates that maximize productivity and ROI. It gives users a unified, intelligent way to find answers across systems, apps, and knowledge silos and helps anyone looking to deliver fast and contextual answers.
* Whatfix is bridging the gap between rapid technological change and human enablement—ensuring AI is not only embedded but also usable, trusted, and outcome-driven for every employee.
* At Whatfix, we’re not just making software easier—we’re making AI work for people.
* The company has seven offices across the US, India, UK, Germany, Singapore, and Australia and a presence across 40+ countries.
* Customers: 700+ enterprise customers, including 80+ Fortune 500 companies such as Shell, Schneider Electric, and UPS Supply Chain Solutions.
* Investors: A total of ~$270 million USD has been raised as yet. Most recently Series E round of $125 Million USD led by Warburg Pincus, with participation from existing investor SoftBank Vision Fund 2. Other investors include Cisco Investments, Eight Roads Ventures (A division of Fidelity Investments), Dragoneer, Peak XV Partners, and Stellaris Venture Partners.

**Whatfix’s leadership is consistently recognized across top industry analysts and business rankings:**

* Won the 2025 AI Breakthrough Award for the Overall AI-based Analytics Solution of the Year
* Only DAP to be recognized as a “Leader” across various DAP reports for the past 5+ years by leading analyst firms like Gartner, Forrester, IDC, and Everest Group.
* With over 45% YoY sustainable annual recurring revenue (ARR) growth, Whatfix is among the “Top 50 Indian Software Companies” as per G2 Best Software Awards.
* Named a Gartner Customers’ Choice for DAP for the second year in a row (2024 and 2025)—the only vendor in the market to earn this distinction consecutively.
* We also boast a star rating of 4.6 on G2 Crowd, 4.5 on Gartner Peer Insights, and a super-high CSAT of 99.8%
* Stevie Award winner in the category (Bronze): Customer Service Department of the Year – Computer Software - 100 or More Employees.
* Winner of the ISG Paragon Innovation Award in partnership with Sophos (customer) for the EMEA region and finalist in the Transformation Award category.
* RemoteTech Breakthrough Awards winner for “Software Asset Management Solution of the Year”

**These recognitions are matched by business performance:**

* Listed on the Financial Times & Statista's High-Growth Companies Asia-Pacific 2025 list.
* Won the Silver for Stevie's Employer of the Year 2023 – Computer Software category and also recognized as Great Place to Work 2022-2023
* Only DAP to be among the top 35% companies worldwide in sustainability excellence with EcoVadis Bronze Medal

**Be one of the key Leaders in this awesome journey of building a billion-dollar company!**
**About The Role**
You'll own the architecture of the Whatfix design system and lead it through its next stage. The system serves our 16 product designers, the entire engineering organization, and the AI agents that increasingly build alongside them.
  
  
You're inheriting a rebuild that is well underway. The system's foundations and design language are in place, and its decisions are written down. You'll lead what it grows into: a component library that expands to cover patterns for AI-powered and agent-driven experiences, and the move of a live product portfolio onto the system, incrementally and without forced breaking changes. You know the difference between the right long-term architecture and what can ship today.
  
  
**You are a design engineer:**
you have worked professionally as both a designer and a front-end engineer, and design systems are the core of your practice. You work directly in the system's code and direct coding agents under written rules.
  
  
**You report to the Head of Product Research & Design and have full ownership of the system's architecture.**
You are the approver for how tokens and components look and what they mean. You partner with Platform engineering on packages, releases, and adoption.
  
  
This is a build role. It isn't a fit for a designer who specifies a system for engineers to build, or an engineer who implements designs without owning the design decisions.
  
  
**What You'll Own**
**Architecture and shipping**

* Own the token architecture: DTCG tokens in primitive, semantic, and component tiers, with modes for theme and density, kept forward-compatible with AI and agentic tooling.
* Own naming conventions, component taxonomy, and documentation standards. Keep the decisions that hold. Change the ones that don't through the system's decision process, and write down why.
* Design the migration path as carefully as the destination: versioning strategy, deprecation patterns, and incremental adoption that doesn't require product teams to stop and refactor.
* Architect shared capabilities once, in the system: internationalization, accessibility, content density, theming, and directionality.
* With Platform, own how the system ships: the build and its checks, CI, versioned packages, and releases. Review contributions from product teams.

**Components**

* Build the React components directly in the system codebase, on accessible headless primitives. Own their APIs, composition, and slots.
* Own the libraries distribution: variable-driven, 1:1 with code, and kept in sync by system tooling rather than by hand.
* Establish each component's contract: usage guidelines, do's and don'ts, required and optional attributes, edge cases, and full state coverage. Keep Storybook as the living, testable reference.
* Build accessibility into every component (keyboard, focus, screen reader, contrast) and test it with assistive technology, not only automated checks.

**Agent layer and AI patterns**

* Own the agent layer: the machine-readable rules, token and icon references, and lookup tools that let agents use the system correctly in product code and designers' prototypes.
* Build with coding agents such as Claude Code every day. Write and maintain the rules, skills, and checks that keep their output correct, review what they produce before it merges, and help designers and engineers work the same way.
* Design AI-native patterns into the component architecture: disclosure, generative content containers, confidence indicators, and agent interaction models. Treat them as Whatfix-specific design problems, not patterns borrowed from other systems.

**Adoption and measurement**

* Define success metrics beyond component coverage: adoption rates, usage patterns, and the gap between what's in the system and what ships.
* Drive adoption across designers and engineering through documentation, enablement, and direct partnership. Make the system easy to use correctly and hard to misuse.
* Represent the system to product, engineering, and executive leadership, and mentor the senior designers and engineers who contribute.

**What you bring**

* 12-14 years across product design and front-end engineering, with 5+ in design systems as the core of your practice, not a side responsibility.
* 3+ years writing production React and TypeScript (or equivalent) that other teams depend on, and a design portfolio that shows the judgment to set standards for other designers. It shows how you document what components are for and when not to use them, and how you design dense enterprise interfaces without losing usability.
* You've owned a multi-team design system end to end: tokens (global, semantic, and component tiers, multi-mode theming), build, versioned releases, and adoption. You've built or significantly rebuilt one from a broken or incomplete state and moved a live product portfolio onto it. You're fluent in the engineering around it: monorepo tooling, Node and npm, CI, git workflows, package publishing, and lint rules.
* Design-tool components (Figma today) built with variants, variables, modes, and properties that stay 1:1 with code, and experience keeping design tooling in sync with code through automation.
* Daily, hands-on use of AI coding agents (such as Claude Code or Codex) on production code, including writing the rules and context that guide them. You can show something you built this way and how you checked it.
* Deep accessibility knowledge: WCAG, ARIA patterns, and testing components with keyboards and screen readers.
* A record of leading across teams you don't manage: setting direction with engineering and product leaders, winning adoption, and mentoring senior designers and engineers.

**Nice to have**

* Experience implementing internationalization at the system level.
* Familiarity with observability or analytics tooling applied to design system adoption.
* Work at the frontier of AI-native UX: disclosure patterns, agent interfaces, and generative content states.
* Color science in design systems, such as perceptual color spaces (OKLCH) and contrast models.

**How you'll work**

* You respect what's decided. You learn why a decision was made before changing it, and when you change one, you write down why.
* You build with agents and verify. Agent output gets the same scrutiny as any contributor's: checked by the build, reviewed, and owned by you.
* You lead without managing. You set direction, explain your decisions in writing, and bring engineering, product, and design leaders along.

title: Guidewire Integration Architect
description:
**Summary**
Professional Services at Guidewire partners with P&C insurers worldwide to deliver complex cloud implementations that reduce effort, accelerate time‑to‑value, and unlock measurable business outcomes through our InsuranceSuite platform and AI‑enabled services.
  
  
We work as one global team, combining deep insurance domain expertise, modern delivery methods, and a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, and curiosity in how we serve customers.
  
  
As a Guidewire Integration Architect, you will lead end‑to‑end solution architecture across PolicyCenter, BillingCenter, and ClaimCenter for strategic customer programs, primarily on Guidewire Cloud. You will shape technical direction, mentor delivery teams, and embed automation and AI‑powered methods to cut implementation effort and time while ensuring scalable, maintainable, and upgrade‑ready solutions.
  
  
This role sits at the heart of Guidewire’s mission to transform how the world’s P&C insurers do business by making cloud and AI adoption faster, safer, and more valuable.
  
  
**Job Description**
**What you’ll do**

* Serve as the lead architect for complex InsuranceSuite implementations, defining target architectures and integration patterns across PolicyCenter, BillingCenter, ClaimCenter, and surrounding systems.
* Translate business and product requirements into cloud‑ready, scalable, and upgrade‑safe solution designs, balancing configuration, integration, and extension options on Guidewire Cloud.
* Provide design authority on programs (including SI‑led deliveries), ensuring alignment to Guidewire best practices, reference architectures, and Professional Services priorities to reduce implementation effort and time and improve delivery quality.
* Partner with customer architects, product teams, and delivery leads to embed AI‑ and automation‑enabled methods, accelerators, and repeatable offerings throughout the implementation lifecycle, improving productivity and time‑to‑value.
* Review and govern critical design decisions, code approaches, performance considerations, and data models to ensure quality, resilience, security, and operational efficiency in production.
* Mentor and coach consultants and engineers on InsuranceSuite architecture, cloud patterns, and modern engineering practices, helping build AI‑enabled delivery capability across Professional Services.
* Contribute to the evolution of standard assets, templates, and methodologies that can be reused across customers to scale services‑led innovation, support revenue growth, and improve margins.
* At Guidewire, we foster a culture of curiosity, innovation, and responsible use of AI—empowering our teams to continuously leverage emerging technologies and data‑driven insights to enhance productivity and outcomes.

**Required**
**What you’ll bring**
Demonstrated ability to embrace AI and apply it to your current role as well as data‑driven insights to drive innovation, productivity, and continuous improvement.
  
  

* Extensive hands‑on experience architecting and delivering Guidewire PolicyCenter, BillingCenter, and/or ClaimCenter solutions, ideally including cloud implementations and large‑scale transformations.
* Strong background in enterprise application architecture, integration patterns (REST APIs, messaging, batch), and secure, scalable design in a SaaS or cloud environment.
* Ability to lead technical direction on large, multi‑stakeholder programs, influencing decisions through clear reasoning, structured trade‑offs, and collaborative problem solving.
* Proficiency in core technologies used with InsuranceSuite (e.g., Java, Gosu, relational databases, integration middleware) and familiarity with modern CI/CD and DevOps practices.
* Proven track record of mentoring and upskilling engineers or consultants, with an emphasis on quality, automation, engineering excellence, and continuous improvement.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, able to convey complex technical concepts in accessible language to technical and non‑technical audiences.

**Preferred**

* 10+ years of overall software/solution architecture experience, including significant time on Guidewire implementations; prior experience in a consulting or Professional Services context is a plus.
* Experience applying AI‑ or automation‑based accelerators (e.g., code generation, intelligent testing tools, migration scripts) within delivery projects to reduce effort and improve reliability.
* Knowledge of P&C insurance domains (policy administration, billing, claims) and related industry standards or regulatory environments.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Your Impact**
We believe in clarity and setting you up for success. In your first months, you will immerse yourself in Guidewire’s architecture patterns, Professional Services delivery methodology, and AI‑enabled services strategy, then take ownership of solution architecture for one or more strategic customer programs in the region.
  
  
You will define target architectures, guide critical design decisions, and help teams adopt repeatable patterns that reduce implementation effort by up to 50% and time by 30%, directly supporting cloud adoption and measurable customer value for insurers.
  
  
As you grow in the role, your work will influence how insurers modernize their core platforms, how our partners deliver implementations, and how Guidewire advances its wider mission to transform P&C insurance through trusted cloud and AI‑powered platforms.
  
  
**What’s In It For You**
The people we employ give their all, and in return, we offer flexibility wherever we can, such as:
  
  

* Flexible work environment.
* Health and wellness benefits.
* Paid time off programs including volunteer time off.
* Market‑competitive pay and incentive programs.
* Continual development and internal career growth opportunities.

All roles at Guidewire include an in‑person interview experience, and we provide an in‑person orientation for all new hires to help you build relationships and understand how your work contributes to our customers and mission.
  
  
**About Guidewire**
Guidewire is the platform P&C insurers trust to engage, innovate, and grow efficiently. We combine digital, core, analytics, and AI to deliver our platform as a cloud service. More than 540+ insurers in 40 countries, from new ventures to the largest and most complex in the world, run on Guidewire.

We are proud of our unparalleled implementation track record with 1600+ successful projects, supported by the largest R&D team and partner ecosystem in the industry. Our Marketplace provides hundreds of applications that accelerate integration, localization, and innovation.

title: Extensions Architect
description:
**Job Description**
We are hiring an Extensions Lead with 10+ years of overall experience and an Extensions Architect with 15+ years of overall experience. Both roles require hands-on capability in AI driven delivery, Oracle Visual Builder Studio (VBS), Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), Oracle APEX, and applied AI.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Extensions Architect**
Shape Oracle Fusion extension architectures and guide AI-driven delivery.
  
  
**About Oracle Customer Success Services (CSS)**
Oracle Customer Success Services (CSS) helps customers maximize the value of their Oracle technology investments, from implementation and adoption to ongoing improvement. Bringing together Oracle product expertise, industry understanding, and delivery experience, CSS works with customers to address business priorities, strengthen technology adoption, and achieve measurable outcomes.
  
  
Within CSS, Oracle Innovation Studios brings together specialists across AI Studio, Cloud Platforms Studio, Industry Studios, Fusion Apps Studios, and Security Studio. Our teams co-innovate with customers to identify valuable use cases, validate ideas through prototypes, and deliver secure, scalable solutions. We collaborate across Studios, Product Development, sales, and delivery, combining reusable assets and practical AI capabilities to improve delivery productivity and turn business priorities into lasting customer value.
  
  
**Why join CSS?**

* Build on your expertise. Deepen your Oracle specialization while expanding your understanding of connected business processes and technologies across the Oracle ecosystem.
* Apply AI to real business needs. Develop practical knowledge of AI and automation through customer solutions and improvements to the way we design, build, and deliver.
* Connect your work to customer outcomes. Contribute across discovery, solution design, prototyping, delivery, and adoption, with opportunities shaped by your role and Studio.
* Learn through collaboration. Work with specialists, architects, engineers, and functional experts across Studios and Product Development to strengthen your solution judgment.
* Extend your impact. Create reusable assets and share knowledge through mentoring, workshops, demonstrations, technical publications, and continuous learning.

**AI Studio**
The AI Studio helps customers turn AI opportunities into working solutions using embedded AI in Oracle applications, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) AI services, and Oracle database capabilities. The team identifies valuable use cases, develops and evaluates prototypes, and supports integration, adoption, and scale. Work can include AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation, document intelligence, and intelligent automation, with attention to security, governance, and measurable business value. Join the Studio to combine Oracle expertise with practical AI engineering and help customers embed intelligence into everyday work.
  
  
**Role Overview**
As Extensions Architect, you will define end-to-end architectures for Oracle Fusion SaaS extensions, integrations, and applications with AI capabilities. You will connect customer outcomes with platform decisions, establish reusable patterns, and guide complex solutions from discovery through production. This hands-on role combines deep expertise in Oracle Visual Builder Studio, Oracle Integration Cloud, and Oracle APEX with practical AI architecture and leadership of AI-assisted engineering. Working with business and technology stakeholders, delivery teams, other Studios, and Product Development, you will define solution boundaries, nonfunctional requirements, roadmaps, and architectural tradeoffs. You will validate critical designs through prototypes and reviews, guide consistent implementation, and shape technical proposals and estimates. The role suits an experienced architect who can influence senior customer stakeholders, mentor technical leads and engineers, and balance security, operational needs, cost, and performance while demonstrating customer value and measurable delivery improvements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead architecture discovery with business and technology stakeholders to define target architectures, solution boundaries, nonfunctional requirements, delivery roadmaps, and measures of business value.
* Select Fusion configuration, Redwood and VBS extensions, APEX applications, OIC integrations, and OCI services, documenting tradeoffs in maintainability, security, cost, performance, and resilience.
* Design end-to-end application, integration, API, and data flows across Oracle Fusion ERP, SCM, HCM, and external systems using supported interfaces and patterns that accommodate SaaS updates.
* Establish repeatable AI-assisted practices across analysis, development, testing, review, documentation, and delivery automation to improve engineering consistency and productivity.
* Architect assistants, RAG solutions, and agent workflows, defining model and service selection, knowledge access, tool invocation, orchestration, evaluation, and human approval for consequential actions.
* Own cross-cutting architecture for identity, authorization, data isolation, secrets, auditability, performance, availability, disaster recovery, observability, and AI cost and latency controls to meet operational needs.
* Validate high-risk assumptions through hands-on prototypes and code reviews; lead architecture reviews and resolve complex design issues to guide implementation and production readiness.
* Create reference architectures and reusable accelerators, set engineering and AI evaluation standards, and mentor Leads and engineers to support consistent adoption across engagements.
* Shape presales solutions, estimates, assumptions, and technical proposals; present architecture and value to customer leaders, collaborate across Studios and Product Development, and contribute technical thought leadership.

**Skills - Mandatory**
**Education**

* Bachelor's or master's degree in engineering, computer science, information technology, MCA, or equivalent practical experience.

**Experience**

* 15+ years of overall IT experience, with substantial responsibility for enterprise application and integration architecture. A record of owning architecture across multiple Oracle extension projects through production delivery is required.

**Oracle Products**

* Visual Builder Studio: Deep hands-on expertise in Oracle Visual Builder Studio (VBS), Visual Builder, Redwood extensibility, Oracle JET, JavaScript or TypeScript, and extension lifecycle management. Ability to define modular UI patterns, service contracts, repositories, and CI/CD standards.
* Oracle Integration Cloud: Deep expertise in OIC architecture, adapters, orchestration, REST and SOAP APIs, asynchronous and event-based integration, bulk processing, security, monitoring, and recovery. Ability to design for idempotency, throughput, API limits, and operational support.
* Oracle APEX: Strong hands-on expertise and architectural judgment in APEX, Oracle Database, SQL, PL/SQL, ORDS, data modeling, application security, performance, and deployment. Ability to explain when APEX or VBS is appropriate and how each connects to Fusion and OCI.

**Technical Skills**

* AI driven delivery: Demonstrated leadership in applying AI assistants and agents across the software lifecycle. Ability to define context and prompt practices, automated workflows, human review, quality gates, and measurement of productivity, rework, defects, and business value.
* AI architecture and knowledge: Practical experience architecting solutions using large language models, embeddings, vector retrieval, RAG, tool use, agent orchestration, and OCI Generative AI or comparable services. Strong understanding of model evaluation, grounding, prompt injection defenses, data boundaries, human oversight, latency, and cost tradeoffs.
* Enterprise architecture and influence: Strong knowledge of Fusion extensibility and APIs, OCI architecture, SSO, OAuth, RBAC, data security, API management, and DevOps. Ability to define nonfunctional requirements, evaluate architectural tradeoffs, estimate complex work, and communicate with technical teams and senior customer stakeholders.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with Oracle Fusion AI Agent Studio, MCP, agent interoperability, Python, or agent frameworks such as LangGraph or LangChain.
* Relevant Oracle architecture or AI certifications; experience shaping service offerings, reusable intellectual property, or technical publications.

3. Reduce manual work effort through Service Now Integration Hub automation.
4. Establish and enforce integrated common processes and procedures across IT.

1. Lead the end-to-end architecture and deployment of ServiceNow modules (ITSM, ITOM, ITAM CMDB, Now Assist,Security Operation Vulnerability Response, etc.).

3. Design and maintain architectural blueprints and documentation for ServiceNow implementations.
4. Oversee integrations with third-party systems (e.g., Active Directory, Salesforce, SAP, MS Teams, Jira etc).
5. Define and enforce coding standards, data models, and development guidelines.
6. Collaborate with stakeholders to define roadmaps, upgrade strategies, and platform governance.
7. Conduct design authority reviews and approve technical solutions.
8. Provide Tier 3 support and troubleshoot complex platform issues.
9. Mentor development teams and ensure quality assurance through code reviews and testing.

1. Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, or related field.

2. Knowledge of ServiceNow upgrade cycles and release management.
3. Exposure to cloud platforms and enterprise architecture frameworks

title: Solution Architect Conversational AI
description:
**Job Title:**
Solution Architect – Conversational AI
  
  
**Location:**
Bengaluru (Hybrid)
  
  
**Experience:**
8+ Years
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-time
  
  
**Job Description**
We are a lean team of 75+ technologists with 80+ AI implementations across Conversational AI, HealthTech, IoT, ESG/Energy and Data Engineering.
  
  
We are looking for a Solution Architect to act as the design authority for enterprise customer implementations. You will translate business objectives into scalable solution designs and provide technical governance from discovery through go-live. The role is customer-facing and pragmatic, and it sits at the heart of our Conversational AI practice, where you will be the subject-matter expert for consumer-facing brands running contact center and digital engagement at scale.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Lead technical discovery and convert business outcomes into architecture, integration and non-functional requirements.
* Act as the customer-facing subject-matter expert on Conversational AI and CCaaS.
* Architect Conversational AI solutions across voice, messaging and digital channels using ElevenLabs, OpenAI and Strands.
* Design multimodal and multithreaded interaction flows that hold up on latency, concurrency and state management at production scale.
* Define solution boundaries, data flows, security patterns, environments and integration approaches.
* Define integration patterns between Java/Spring Boot backend services and Python-based AI/MLOps modules on AWS.
* Produce architecture diagrams, decision records, interface contracts and implementation guardrails.
* Review technical designs and critical changes, and identify risks before they reach testing or production.
* Create multi-option solution blueprints that detail trade-offs, implementation complexity and strategic alignment.
* Guide Customer Engineers and Product Engineers through difficult trade-offs and escalations.
* Maintain technical governance across concurrent implementations and reusable product patterns.
* Own architecture and technical approval, while delegating implementation to Customer Engineers.
* Partner with Product Engineering on reusable capabilities.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science or a related field.
* 8+ years in enterprise software delivery, including 3+ years in solution or integration architecture.
* Proven hands-on experience designing and delivering Conversational AI solutions in production.
* Strong hands-on proficiency in Java and Spring Boot.
* Strong hands-on proficiency in Python for AI and MLOps work.
* Hands-on experience architecting on AWS with DynamoDB and PostgreSQL; working familiarity with React-based frontends.
* Experience integrating LLMs (e.g., OpenAI) and Voice AI platforms (e.g., ElevenLabs) into production systems.
* Experience designing multimodal (voice, text, digital) and multithreaded/concurrent systems.
* Deep experience with APIs, event-driven integration, identity, cloud architecture, data design and production operations.
* Strong command of security patterns, environment strategy and non-functional requirements across enterprise deployments.
* Ability to lead customer workshops and explain complex decisions to executives and engineers.
* Track record of designing systems that moved successfully from discovery into production.

**Good to Have**

* Hands-on experience with consumer-facing CCaaS tools (Messaging, Digital AI and/or Voice AI).
* Experience with Strands Agents or similar agentic decision-making frameworks.
* Salesforce, Genesys Cloud or enterprise CX architecture experience.
* AI system design covering retrieval, model evaluation, guardrails, observability and human escalation.
* Experience in security-sensitive or regulated environments.

**Perks & Benefits**

* Comprehensive insurance (Life, Health, Accident)
* Flexible work model
* Accelerated learning and non-linear growth
* Flat organization structure driven by ownership and accountability
* Work with accomplished global peers from companies such as Apple, Amazon, IBM Research and Adobe
* Opportunity to work on AI/SaaS products across Conversational AI, Energy/Utilities, ESG, HealthTech, IoT, Risk/Compliance, CyberSecurity and PLM

**Key Skills**
Solution Architecture, Conversational AI, Java, Spring Boot, Python, AWS, DynamoDB, PostgreSQL, OpenAI, ElevenLabs, LLM, Voice AI, CCaaS, MLOps, Event-driven Architecture, API Integration, React, Genesys Cloud, Salesforce

Software Development – Solution Architect

B.Tech/B.E. or equivalent in Computer Science or a related field

title: I&P GN - SC&E –  Analyst - S&P - Indirect Analysis
description:
**Role Summary**
We are seeking a Senior Solution Architect to lead the design of scalable, secure, and cost-effective solutions across cloud and enterprise systems. Acting as the bridge between business objectives and engineering execution, you will translate requirements into robust architecture blueprints, define technical standards, and guide delivery teams from design through production. This role combines strategic technical leadership with hands-on depth; you will make high-impact technology decisions, champion best practices, and ensure solutions meet demanding non-functional requirements around performance, security, resilience, and cost.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Define end-to-end solution architectures that align with business goals, enterprise standards, and long-term technology strategy.
* Translate business and functional requirements into clear technical designs, high-level and low-level design documents, and architecture blueprints.
* Evaluate, recommend, and select technologies, frameworks, and platforms, including build-vs-buy and cloud-provider decisions.
* Design cloud-native, microservices, event-driven, and API-first architectures for scalability and maintainability.
* Define and govern non-functional requirements - scalability, performance, availability, security, resilience, and cost optimization.
* Lead architecture and design reviews, establish coding and design standards, and drive technical governance across teams.
* Partner with product managers, business stakeholders, security, and infrastructure teams; present architecture and trade-offs to senior leadership and clients.
* Provide hands-on technical leadership and mentorship to development teams, unblocking complex engineering challenges.
* Build proofs-of-concept and prototypes to validate architectural approaches and de-risk delivery.
* Embed security and compliance by design across the solution lifecycle.
* Champion DevOps, CI/CD, and Infrastructure-as-Code adoption to improve delivery speed and quality.
* Operate within Agile/Scrum delivery models, contributing to estimation, roadmap planning, and iterative delivery.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent hands-on experience.
* 7+ years in software engineering, including proven experience in a solution, technical, or application architect capacity.
* Demonstrated track record designing and delivering large-scale, distributed, production systems.
* Deep, hands-on expertise with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Strong command of microservices, API design, and enterprise integration patterns.
* A solid engineering foundation with hands-on coding experience in one or more major languages (e.g., Java, .NET, Python, Node.js).
* Strong understanding of application/data security, DevOps practices, and system integration.
* Demonstrated experience delivering solutions in Agile and Scrum environments.
* Excellent stakeholder communication skills, including the ability to present complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences.

**Preferred Qualifications (nice-to-have)**

* Experience in Data Engineering - designing data pipelines, data lakes/warehouses, streaming, and big-data platforms (e.g., Spark, Kafka, Snowflake, Databricks).
* Recognized architecture certifications (e.g., AWS/Azure/GCP Solutions Architect, TOGAF).
* Experience integrating enterprise platforms such as SAP, Salesforce, or similar.
* Experience with event-driven and streaming architectures at scale.
* Domain experience in analytics, data-intensive, or large enterprise product environments.
* Pre-sales or consulting exposure, including solution shaping and effort estimation.

**Technical Skills**

* Architecture: Microservices, event-driven, API-first, domain-driven design, integration patterns, EA frameworks (e.g., TOGAF)
* Cloud: AWS / Azure / GCP, serverless, containers (Kubernetes), Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, CloudFormation)
* Development: Java, .NET, Python, or Node.js; REST, GraphQL, gRPC
* Data & Messaging: SQL & NoSQL, data modelling, caching, messaging/streaming (Kafka, RabbitMQ)
* Security: IAM, OAuth 2.0 / OIDC, encryption, zero-trust and secure-by-design principles
* DevOps & Modelling: CI/CD, observability, SRE practices; UML and C4 architecture modelling

**Soft Skills**

* Technical leadership and the ability to influence without direct authority.
* Strategic thinking balanced with pragmatic, hands-on execution.
* Exceptional communication and stakeholder management across business and technology.
* Confident decision-making under ambiguity and competing constraints.
* Mentorship and a genuine commitment to growing engineering talent.
* Strong facilitation and negotiation skills across cross-functional teams.

**ThingWorx 10.x and Smart Connected Product Accelerator (SCPA)**
.
  
  
The architect will translate approved business requirements, user needs, and acceptance criteria into a
**secure, scalable, resilient, supportable, and maintainable technical solution**
. The role will provide technical direction across remote service access, endpoint automation, identity and access governance, enterprise integrations, master-data synchronization, and multiple user populations.
  
  
The ideal candidate will bring deep hands-on expertise in
**ThingWorx architecture and development**
, combined with strong knowledge of
**SCPA building blocks, IoT solution architecture, security, identity management, enterprise integration, and remote-access solutions**
.
  
  
A key objective of this role is to maximize the use of
**standard SCPA configuration and reusable building blocks**
, minimize unnecessary customization, and establish governed, upgrade-safe extension patterns where custom development is required.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Solution Architecture & Technical Leadership
  
  

* Own the end-to-end solution architecture for SmartConnect using ThingWorx 10.x and SCPA.
* Define application, data, integration, security, deployment, infrastructure, and operational architecture.
* Translate business requirements and Given/When/Then acceptance criteria into traceable technical requirements, architecture decisions, and implementation guidance.
* Evaluate requirements against SCPA capabilities and determine the appropriate configure, integrate, extend, or custom-build approach.
* Develop and maintain architecture diagrams, solution documentation, technical standards, and Architecture Decision Records (ADRs).
* Establish implementation guardrails and reusable architectural patterns for development teams.

ThingWorx & SCPA Architecture
  
  

* Design the overall ThingWorx Thing model and asset hierarchy.
* Define and govern:

+ Thing Templates
+ Thing Shapes
+ Data Shapes
+ Services
+ Events
+ Subscriptions
+ Persistence strategies
+ Mashups and application components

* Assess and leverage SCPA standard capabilities, reusable building blocks, extension points, and custom components.
* Ensure custom extensions are maintainable, testable, reusable, and designed to minimize future upgrade impact.

Remote Access & Endpoint Management
  
  

* Architect secure attended and unattended remote-access solutions for gateways and downstream endpoints.
* Define architecture for session routing, customer/user consent, endpoint availability, failure handling, auditability, clipboard access, and file transfer.
* Design secure gateway-to-endpoint communication and access patterns.
* Ensure remote-access capabilities comply with enterprise cybersecurity and least-privilege requirements.

Automation & Remote Package Execution
  
  

* Design automated file-watch ingestion and processing capabilities.
* Define targeted remote-package execution architecture, including:

+ Endpoint targeting
+ Integrity/checksum validation
+ Retry and failure-management policies
+ Execution status
+ Per-endpoint results
+ Audit records
+ Monitoring and observability

* Establish scalable automation patterns for managing distributed endpoints and connected assets.

Security, Identity & Access Governance
  
  

* Define Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and least-privilege security architecture.
* Design static and dynamic visibility groups and segmented access models.
* Architect Just-In-Time (JIT) privileged-access approval workflows, including customer-owned approval processes.
* Define identity and authorization models supporting:

+ Customers
+ Internal employees
+ External contractors
+ Business partners

* Design identity federation and authentication patterns using enterprise identity platforms.
* Ensure security controls, authorization decisions, privileged access, and user activity are appropriately auditable.

Enterprise Integration & Master Data
  
  

* Define integration architecture between ThingWorx/SmartConnect and Unity (Salesforce) for endpoint master data.
* Establish system-of-record ownership and read-only data-field principles.
* Design synchronization, reconciliation, error handling, retry, and recovery mechanisms.
* Provide visibility into synchronization status and last-successful-sync information.
* Establish standards for REST APIs, events, data contracts, and integration patterns across enterprise systems.
* Support integrations with IAM/IdP platforms, Salesforce, CMDB, SAP, logging, monitoring, and other enterprise applications.

Non-Functional Architecture
  
  
Define and govern non-functional requirements covering:
  
  

* Availability and high availability
* Performance
* Scalability
* Resiliency and recovery
* Security and privacy
* Observability and monitoring
* Auditability
* Maintainability
* Supportability
* Deployment and release management

Ensure architectural decisions support production operations, troubleshooting, future enhancements, and platform upgrades.
  
  
Architecture Governance & Delivery Support
  
  

* Lead architecture reviews, technical design reviews, threat-modeling discussions, and design-assurance activities.
* Identify architectural risks, technical dependencies, and mitigation strategies.
* Review implementation designs and code to ensure compliance with approved architectural patterns.
* Provide technical leadership and guidance to ThingWorx consultants, developers, integration engineers, and infrastructure teams.
* Partner closely with Product Management, Engineering, Cybersecurity, QA, Service Operations, Infrastructure, and enterprise integration teams.
* Communicate architectural decisions, risks, dependencies, and recommendations effectively to technical and executive stakeholders.

Migration & Coexistence
  
  

* Define the migration strategy from the existing SmartConnect implementation to the next-generation platform.
* Develop migration and coexistence architecture to minimize business and operational disruption.
* Identify opportunities to reduce technical debt during modernization.
* Define deployment, transition, rollback, and release strategies.

title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**About the role**

We're looking for an Infrastructure Engineer (SDE 3) to own the architecture and reliability of the systems Bytebeam runs in production. You will design infrastructure that is simple, maintainable, observable, and dependable under heavy load.

This is a hands-on role across platform architecture, SRE, uptime, incident response, automation, and cloud operations. You will work closely with backend and data engineers to design the infrastructure they build and operate on.

**What you'll do**

* Work on internal tooling in Go to deploy docker compose based containers to multiple vms
* Own infrastructure architecture across environments, regions, networking, deployment, observability, and reliability
* Drive SRE practices: uptime targets, alerting, incident response, postmortems, capacity planning, and operational hygiene.
* Design simple, maintainable infrastructure that engineers can understand, debug, and safely change.
* Work closely with data engineers to design reliable infrastructure for ingestion, storage, processing, and analytics workloads.
* Build and maintain infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD, containerization, service discovery, secrets, and deployment workflows.
* Improve production reliability without adding unnecessary platforms, abstractions, or operational burden.
* Make clear trade-offs across reliability, cost, security, latency, maintainability, and engineering speed.

**What we're looking for**

* Comfortable writing and reviewing automation or infrastructure tooling in Go (mandatory) and Python.
* Strong judgment around simplicity and maintainability; you avoid clever infrastructure that the team cannot operate.
* Strong production infrastructure, platform engineering, or SRE experience.
* Deep comfort with Linux, Docker, networking, observability, CI/CD, and infrastructure-as-code.
* Production experience with GCP, Azure, or AWS. All 3 or at-least 2 (Bytebeam platform is deployed on all 3 clouds)
* Good networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, TLS, load balancing, routing, firewalls, private networks, and debugging distributed systems.
* Experience designing systems with clear uptime, reliability, backup, recovery, and incident-response expectations.
* Kubernetes experience is useful to apply useful abstractions (we don't use k8s)

**Why this role**

* Own real infrastructure for connected products running in production.
* Work close to the engineers, data systems, and customer-facing workloads your decisions affect.
* Small team, high ownership, low tolerance for complexity.

**Senior SASE, Zero Trust Engineer**
**Position Purpose**
We are seeking a senior SASE security engineer to operate, evolve, and automate global secure-access capabilities while helping embed secure software-engineering and DevSecOps practices into the security platform lifecycle.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**
This role owns reliable, secure delivery of Netskope-based SASE services—including Secure Web Gateway (SWG), Zero Trust Network Access / Netskope Private Access (ZTNA/NPA), CASB, DLP, Cloud Firewall, and Private Access. The engineer will combine deep Zero Trust and networking expertise with automation, integration, and operational discipline to improve both security outcomes and user experience.
  
  
The successful candidate is equally comfortable troubleshooting production access issues, designing scalable policy and integration patterns, and building well-governed automation through code, APIs, infrastructure as code, and CI/CD.
  
  
**SASE Platform Operations**

* Operate, optimize, and continuously improve global Netskope services across SWG, ZTNA/NPA, CASB, DLP, Cloud Firewall, and Private Access.
* Design and maintain resilient, scalable access policies aligned to Zero Trust principles, least privilege, and business requirements.
* Troubleshoot complex service, connectivity, authentication, policy, and performance issues across endpoints, networks, applications, and cloud services.
* Monitor platform health, capacity, service quality, and control effectiveness; drive corrective and preventative improvements.
* Drive continuous improvement of platform performance, reliability, and user experience.
* Support service operations through proactive monitoring, root cause analysis, and problem management.

**Operation & Automation**

* Develop reusable automation modules and operational tooling using Python, PowerShell, Terraform, and platform APIs.
* Establish and apply GitHub repository strategy, governance, branch protections, pull-request workflows, and peer code-review practices.
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for tested, traceable, repeatable delivery of infrastructure, policy, configuration, and integration changes.
* Apply infrastructure-as-code practices, secure secrets management, and appropriate environment promotion controls.
* Support secure container and Kubernetes patterns where SASE services, automation workloads, or integrations require them.
* Support secure REST API integrations among Netskope and enterprise security, identity, endpoint, and monitoring platforms.

**Migration & Service Transition**

* Plan and execute migrations from legacy VPN and proxy solutions to modern secure-access services with minimal disruption.
* Define transition runbooks, validation criteria, rollback approaches, communications, and post-migration support.
* Partner with network, endpoint, cloud, identity, and application teams to resolve dependencies and accelerate adoption.

**Collaboration & Knowledge Sharing**

* Translate complex technical risks and design decisions into clear guidance for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Create and maintain architecture documentation, runbooks, coding standards, integration specifications, and knowledge articles.
* Mentor peers and contribute to a collaborative engineering culture focused on quality, learning, and continuous improvement.

**Who You Are**

* Demonstrated senior-level 7-10 years experience engineering, operating, or supporting enterprise security, network-security, SASE, or Zero Trust services.
* Hands-on experience with Netskope or a comparable secure-access platform, including multiple capabilities such as SWG, ZTNA, CASB, DLP, cloud firewall, or private access.
* Strong understanding of Zero Trust concepts and core networking protocols, including TCP/IP, DNS, TLS/SSL, and HTTP/HTTPS.
* Working knowledge of identity and access standards, including SAML, OAuth, and SCIM, and experience integrating with enterprise identity services.
* Proficiency building automation with Python and/or PowerShell, Terraform, APIs, and source-controlled workflows.
* Experience with GitHub, pull requests, code review, branch protection, CI/CD, and secure software delivery practices.
* Knowledge of SIEM and endpoint-security integrations, incident-support workflows, and operational troubleshooting.
* Ability to communicate clearly, manage competing priorities, and work effectively across security, engineering, infrastructure, and business teams.
* Netskope certifications or equivalent SASE/SSE certifications.
* Experience with SD-WAN technologies.
* Knowledge of DLP and regulatory compliance requirements.
* Experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Experience working in regulated industries such as healthcare, life sciences, or manufacturing.

title: Senior Network Engineer - Global Network
description:
**About The Role**
Rubrik is looking for a Global Network Development Engineer to design, build, and automate the network security fabric that connects our workforce, datacenters, and multi-cloud production environments. You will be a hands-on engineer on the Network Infrastructure Services team, with a focus on the Palo Alto Networks platform: Prisma Access, Strata Cloud Manager (SCM Pro), physical NGFWs, and VM-Series virtual firewalls deployed across GCP, AWS, Azure, and OCI.
  
  
You will work closely with Security, IT, Cloud Engineering, and Platform Engineering to deliver secure, scalable, and consistently managed connectivity. You are encouraged to use AI tools to speed up troubleshooting, documentation, and automation.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
Firewall and Zero Trust Security (Palo Alto Networks)
  
  

* Design, deploy, and operate Palo Alto Networks NGFWs and VM-Series virtual firewalls, including App-ID, User-ID, URL Filtering, Threat Prevention, and WildFire.
* Manage Prisma Access (remote networks, mobile users, service connections) and GlobalProtect to deliver secure remote access and zero-trust segmentation.
* Administer policy, configuration, and lifecycle through Strata Cloud Manager (SCM Pro) and, where applicable, Panorama.
* Run firewall rule reviews, policy cleanup, and software upgrade programs, and support security audits.

Multi-Cloud Network Security
  
  

* Deploy and operate firewalls and network security architectures in GCP, AWS, Azure, and OCI (e.g., centralized inspection/hub-and-spoke, transit gateways, VPC/VNet peering, load balancer-based HA).
* Build and support hybrid connectivity between datacenters, offices, and clouds (BGP, IPsec VPN, Direct Connect, ExpressRoute, Cloud Interconnect, FastConnect).
* Establish repeatable, secure-by-default reference designs for firewall deployment in each cloud.

Network Development and Automation
  
  

* Treat the network as code: build and maintain infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, including the Palo Alto Networks providers) with CI/CD, peer review, and testing.
* Develop Python tooling, APIs, and workflows (e.g., PAN-OS / SCM / Prisma Access APIs, SDKs) to remove manual toil and enforce configuration consistency.
* Automate policy change workflows, compliance checks, drift detection, and reporting.
* Use AI-assisted tools to accelerate log analysis, runbook creation, and documentation.

Core Routing, Switching, and Datacenter Networking
  
  

* Design and support routing and switching (BGP,VLANs, STP/RSTP, LACP, L2/L3 design) across offices, datacenters, and cloud edges.
* Contribute to datacenter fabric design and operations, including spine-leaf with EVPN-VXLAN (a plus).

Reliability and Operations
  
  

* Monitor health and performance using SNMP, streaming telemetry, flow data (NetFlow/sFlow), and cloud-native logging.
* Lead incident response, root-cause analysis, and postmortems; contribute to on-call rotation as part of a global team.
* Partner with teams across time zones (including the U.S. and EMEA), which may require occasional early-morning or evening collaboration, and produce clear designs, runbooks, and documentation.

**Experience You’ll Need**

* 7+ years of hands-on network engineering experience, including significant experience with network security.
* Strong, hands-on expertise with Palo Alto Networks NGFWs and VM-Series, including policy design, zone-based segmentation, NAT, and HA.
* Experience with Prisma Access and Strata Cloud Manager (SCM) or Panorama for centralized management.
* Experience operating firewalls or network security in at least two of GCP, AWS, Azure, and OCI, with the ability to ramp quickly on the rest.
* Solid routing and switching fundamentals: BGP, OSPF, VLANs, STP/RSTP, LACP, IPsec, and L2/L3 design.
* Working knowledge of cloud networking constructs (VPC/VNet, routing tables, transit/hub designs, private connectivity).
* Scripting or automation experience (Python and/or Terraform) applied to real network operations.
* Strong troubleshooting methodology across complex, multi-layer production issues.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including runbooks and incident postmortems.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Production experience with Terraform (including Palo Alto Networks providers) and Python for network automation; familiarity with Git-based CI/CD workflows.
* Experience with EVPN-VXLAN datacenter fabrics (spine-leaf, BGP EVPN, multi-tenancy).
* Experience with Ansible or other configuration management tools.
* Experience with Palo Alto Networks Cloud NGFW, Panorama, or Strata Cloud Manager API/SDK automation.
* Familiarity with SD-WAN, SASE, and ZTNA concepts and tooling.
* Experience with load balancers and application delivery (F5, AVI/NSX ALB, NGINX) or DNS/DHCP/IPAM platforms.
* Observability experience (telemetry pipelines, flow analytics, dashboards, alerting).
* Experience supporting regulated or compliance-driven environments (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP).
* Comfort using AI tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot) for network operations, documentation, and automation.

**Certifications (Preferred)**
PCNSE, PCNSA; CCNP (Enterprise/Security/Data Center) or JNCIP; cloud certifications such as AWS Advanced Networking, Azure Network Engineer Associate, Google Professional Cloud Network Engineer, or OCI Networking Professional; HashiCorp Terraform Associate.
  
  
**What Makes You Successful**

* A developer's mindset applied to networking: you automate repeatable work and version-control your changes.
* Ownership, curiosity, and rigor in design and change management.
* Ability to collaborate across global teams and time zones and to explain technical trade-offs to non-network stakeholders.

**Why Rubrik**

* Build and secure infrastructure that protects thousands of organizations from ransomware and cyber threats.
* Collaborative, engineering-first culture with access to leading tools and the flexibility to build scalable, reliable solutions the right way.
* Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits (full-time, regular employee role).
