description:
**Hungry, Humble, Honest, with Heart.**
**The Opportunity**
Are you a seasoned professional with strong hands-on expertise in virtualization, SDN, and network security, complemented by excellent consulting and communication skills? If so, you’ll thrive in our collaborative environment where you’ll lead the design and implementation of cutting-edge data center and hybrid cloud solutions, make a significant impact on our clients' success, and advance your career as part of a dynamic team at Nutanix.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Staff Consulting Architect will be a vital member of Nutanix's Professional Services team, which is dedicated to delivering innovative virtualization, software-defined networking (SDN), and network security solutions to our clients. This team operates from Bangalore or Pune and fosters a collaborative and inclusive culture that values creativity and knowledge sharing. The mission of the team is to empower organizations with next-generation data center and hybrid cloud environments that enhance performance, security, and scalability.
  
  
You will report to the Director of Professional Services, who promotes a supportive and mentoring leadership style, focusing on empowering team members to achieve their full potential and encouraging a strong sense of collaboration. The role is hybrid, requiring the employee to come into the office three days a week, fostering teamwork and facilitating knowledge exchange while allowing flexibility for remote work.
  
  
Nutanix is seeking a
**Staff Consulting Architect**
specializing in
**virtualization, software-defined networking (SDN), and network security**
to design, implement, and optimize next-generation data centre and hybrid cloud environments.
  
  
The ideal candidate will possess
**strong hands-on expertise in hypervisors (VMware / AHV)**
and a
**deep understanding of network virtualization and microsegmentation concepts.**
While certain specialized or automation-related areas can be developed through internal enablement programs, strong fundamentals in virtualization and SDN are mandatory.
  
  
**Your Role**

* Architecture & Design
* Lead the design and deployment of SDN solutions including:

+ Virtual networks, overlays (Geneve / VXLAN), logical switches and routers.
+ Network Controllers / Managers for centralized control and automation.
+ VPCs or logical segments for tenant isolation and scalability.
+ Gateways, VPNs, and BGP configurations for hybrid connectivity.

* Architect multi-tier microsegmentation strategies and enforce Zero Trust principles.
* Collaborate with enterprise network and security teams for seamless integration between virtual and physical infrastructures.
* Implementation & Delivery
* Configure SDN controllers, edge gateways, and security policies in production environments.
* Enable L2 extensions, VPN tunnels, and BGP sessions across sites or clouds.
* Implement application-centric security and isolation policies for East-West and North-South traffic control.
* Support workload and network migrations between virtualization platforms with minimal downtime.
* Integrate network visibility and flow analytics into compliance systems.
* Security & Policy Management
* Define and enforce microsegmentation and application security frameworks.
* Manage security groups, categories, or tags for dynamic policy application.
* Configure allowlist / denylist rules and quarantine mechanisms.
* Ensure compliance with enterprise standards; integrate with SIEM / Syslog for auditability.
* Platform & Virtualization Management
* Manage and optimize virtualization platforms (VMware vSphere / Nutanix AHV / equivalent).
* Administer orchestration and lifecycle management using Prism Central, vCenter, or similar tools.
* Support hybrid cloud network architectures spanning on-premises and public cloud environments.
* Collaborate with compute and storage teams to ensure end-to-end performance.
* Troubleshooting & Optimization
* Diagnose and resolve issues related to network overlays, routing, and policy enforcement.
* Utilize CLI tools, REST APIs, or automation scripts for diagnostics and configuration management.
* Perform performance tuning and maintain high availability of network services.

**What You Will Bring**
**Mandatory Skills (Must-Have)**

* 10+ years of experience in data centre virtualization and SDN solutions.
* Strong understanding of networking concepts — VLANs, routing, NAT, VPNs, BGP, firewalls, overlays (VXLAN/Geneve).
* Hands-on experience with at least one SDN platform:

+ VMware NSX / Nutanix Flow / Cisco ACI (or equivalent).

* Proven expertise in microsegmentation and Zero Trust architecture design.
* Working knowledge of any one hypervisor (VMware ESXi, Nutanix AHV, or Hyper-V).
* Experience integrating virtual and physical network infrastructures.
* Strong troubleshooting skills using CLI / API / network analysis tools.
* Excellent consulting, customer engagement, and communication skills.
* Ability to translate business requirements into scalable technical architectures.

**Trainable / Developable Skills**
*(These can be built on-the-job or via internal learning programs)*

* Automation and scripting using REST APIs, PowerShell, or Python.
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC) with Terraform or Ansible.
* Exposure to hybrid or multi-cloud networking (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Integration of flow analytics and visibility tools for monitoring and compliance.
* Performance tuning and advanced SDN optimization techniques.
* Mentoring, workshop facilitation, and leadership in technical communities.

**Soft Skills**

* Strong consulting and stakeholder management abilities.
* Excellent documentation and presentation skills.
* Team mentorship and ability to guide junior consultants.
* Structured approach to problem-solving and decision-making.

**Education & Certifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent discipline.
* Preferred Certifications (VCP-NV, VCAP-NV, CCNP Data Centre, Nutanix NCP).

**Location**

* Pune/Bangalore (Work from Office).
* Travel as required for customer assignments.

title: BMS Engineer – Building Automation & OT Networking
description:
🚀 We're Hiring: BMS Engineer – Building Automation & OT Networking

📍 Location: Bangalore

💼 Experience: 3–6 years (mandatory)

⚡ Immediate joiners only

Do you commission building management systems AND troubleshoot the IP networks they run on? We'd like to hear from you!

🏢 About the opportunity

Spydra is hiring a BMS Engineer to join its team in Bangalore. You'll work hands-on with building equipment and the IT networks behind it.

🔧 About the role

We are looking for an engineer who can commission building management systems and troubleshoot the networks they run on. You will work with facilities teams, HVAC controls vendors, and IT operations to connect building equipment, support live sites, and resolve issues across field devices, controllers, supervisory servers, and IP networks.

🔹 Key responsibilities

• Configure and commission building automation controllers and supervisory systems, including equipment graphics, alarms, trends, and schedules.

• Integrate HVAC equipment, meters, and third-party controllers using BACnet or Modbus. Verify point mappings, control sequences, and equipment behavior on site.

• Diagnose communications issues across field buses and IP networks, including problems with addressing, VLANs, routing, and firewall rules.

• Work with IT and security teams on network segmentation, remote access, certificates, and user permissions. Coordinate system upgrades, backups, and recovery testing.

• Support site acceptance testing and incident resolution. Maintain network diagrams, device inventories, point lists, and commissioning records.

✅ Required qualifications

• 3–6 years of experience in building automation / BMS (mandatory).

• Available to join immediately.

• Hands-on experience configuring, commissioning, or supporting a live BMS deployment, including field controllers and a supervisory platform.

• Practical experience with BACnet/IP and familiarity with BACnet MS/TP or Modbus.

• Working knowledge of TCP/IP, subnetting, VLANs, routing, and firewalls, with experience troubleshooting connectivity alongside IT teams.

• Ability to read HVAC control drawings, point lists, and sequences of operation. Familiarity with equipment such as air handling units, chillers, pumps, or VAV systems.

• Ability to trace a fault from the BMS dashboard through the network and controller to the field device.

⭐ Preferred qualifications

• Technical certification in a building automation or controls platform.

• Experience supporting multi-building campuses, commercial facilities, or critical infrastructure.

• Experience with supervisory server administration, backup and restore, or packet analysis tools such as Wireshark.

Send your CV to saurav@spydra.app

Subject: "BMS Engineer – Bangalore"

✔️ Total / relevant BMS experience

✔️ BMS platforms worked on (e.g., Niagara, Honeywell, Siemens, Johnson Controls, Schneider)

✔️ Protocols used (BACnet/IP, MS/TP, Modbus)

✔️ Current CTC & expected CTC

✔️ Confirmation that you can join immediately & your current location

title: Cloud Software Development Engineer
description:
**Job Details**
Job Description:
  
  
The Cloud (Network Security) Software Development Engineer will develop, integrate, and deliver open-source, high-performance network security and AI reference solutions for the Network Software Enabling team in the Enterprise/Cloud Networking segment. This role works closely with senior engineers, architects, and ecosystem partners to build reference workloads, with best known methods and configurations, optimized for Intel® Xeon® processors and accelerators across on-prem, edge, and cloud deployments.
  
  
The successful candidate will contribute to the development and optimization of security data planes and AI-enabled security workloads. These include Next-Generation Firewall, Secure Web Gateway, SD-WAN, and similar workloads, with a focus on key performance areas such as workload scale-up/load distribution, crypto processing, pattern matching, and the migration to AI-driven security functions. The role requires solid software development skills in packet processing, network security functions, performance analysis, and deployment automation.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop, integrate, and maintain features in one or more network security reference solutions.
* Implement and debug packet-processing and security components using technologies such as DPDK, VPP, Snort3, and Hyperscan.
* Enable hardware acceleration technologies (QAT, AVX-512/AMX, NIC offloads) in open-source security stacks under guidance from senior engineers.
* Support enablement and benchmarking of AI/ML models for security use cases such as malicious URL detection, phishing and fraud detection, anomaly detection, and encrypted traffic analysis.
* Run benchmarks, collect and analyze performance data, and help find bottlenecks on current and upcoming Intel® Xeon® platforms.
* Build and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) deployment and test automation using tools such as Terraform, Packer, Ansible, and containers.
* Write user guides, release notes, and deployment documentation for reference solutions.
* Take part in design and code reviews, and help with customer and partner enablement.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* 4+ years of experience in networking or systems software development.
* Solid programming skills in C and/or C++ on Linux, with Python, PowerShell or Bash for tooling.
* Working knowledge of TCP/IP networking and Linux networking internals.
* Experience with Git, CI/CD, and containers (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Good communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to share technical results clearly.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
* Familiarity with network security concepts: firewall, IPS/IDS, IPsec/TLS, or VPN.
* Exposure to AI/ML technologies and concepts, such as model training and inference, neural network architectures (CNNs, transformers), and LLMs, through coursework, projects, or professional experience.
* Familiarity with AI/ML frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, OpenVINO™, and vLLM.
* Experience with performance profiling tools such as perf, VTune, or similar.
* Hands-on experience with high-performance networking technologies such as DPDK, VPP, or kernel networking/XDP.
* Contributions to open-source networking/security projects such as DPDK, VPP, or Linux.
* Experience with hardware acceleration technologies (QAT, AVX-512/AMX, NIC offloads).
* Experience with Snort3, Hyperscan, or comparable IPS and pattern-matching engines.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work both independently and in a team.

We are seeking an experienced and technically accomplished Network Engineer with 8+ years of hands-on experience to lead the System architecture, configuration, deployment, and lifecycle maintenance of critical Railway/industrial network systems. The role demands deep technical proficiency in Layer 2 and Layer 3 (L2/L3) networking, extensive hands-on expertise with industrial-grade switches (Siemens, Moxa, Hirschmann, Phoenix Contact, Cisco), enterprise firewalls, and cyber security hardening and NMS configuration. The candidate will work closely with cross-functional engineering teams, clients, and project stakeholders to deliver high-availability, fail-safe network solutions.
  
  
**You’ll make a difference by**

* Design, configuration, staging, and commissioning of robust Layer 2 and Layer 3 industrial network architectures.
* Hands-on deployment and advanced configuration of industrial-grade managed switches, core routers, and security appliances.
* Design and implement high-availability network redundancy architectures.
* Configure and administer industrial next-generation firewalls, VPN tunnels (IPsec/OpenVPN), NAT, ACLs, and network segmentation (OT/IT boundary protection).
* Perform advanced network troubleshooting, packet-level traffic analysis (Wireshark), performance benchmarking, and root-cause analysis for complex network incidents.
* Define network security baselines, hardening guidelines, and patch management in compliance with industrial cybersecurity standards.
* Configure, integrate, and maintain Network Management Systems (NMS) for monitoring and management of network infrastructure.
* Develop dashboards, alarms, performance reports, and fault management workflows. Support SNMP, Syslog, NetFlow, and other network monitoring protocols. Troubleshoot NMS-related issues and ensure accurate network visibility and reporting
* Interface with customers, consultants, and key stakeholders (e.g., Indian Railways, Metro, RDSO,) for network design approvals.
* Prepare comprehensive technical documentation, including High-Level/Low-Level Design (HLD/LLD), network topology diagrams, IP/VLAN schemes, and validation reports.
* Mentor junior team members, conducting technical reviews and knowledge transfer sessions.
* Travel as required for on-site commissioning, customer meetings, and critical project support.

**Desired Skills:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electronics & Communication, Computer Science, Information Technology, or Electrical Engineering.
* 8+ years of proven hands-on experience in network engineering, Railway signalling, industrial networking, or critical infrastructure projects..
* Has already worked (preferably) with Train builders & interior suppliers.
* Strong technical leadership with an ownership-driven, problem-solving mindset.
* Advanced analytical and diagnostic skills for resolving high-stakes, time-critical network issues.
* Excellent client-facing, interpersonal, and stakeholder management skills.
* High proficiency in technical documentation, design presentations, and customer communication.

title: Staff Network Engineer
description:
Sandisk understands how people and businesses consume data and we relentlessly innovate to deliver solutions that enable today’s needs and tomorrow’s next big ideas. With a rich history of groundbreaking innovations in Flash and advanced memory technologies, our solutions have become the beating heart of the digital world we’re living in and that we have the power to shape.
  
  
Sandisk meets people and businesses at the intersection of their aspirations and the moment, enabling them to keep moving and pushing possibility forward. We do this through the balance of our powerhouse manufacturing capabilities and our industry-leading portfolio of products that are recognized globally for innovation, performance and quality.
  
  
Sandisk has two facilities recognized by the World Economic Forum as part of the Global Lighthouse Network for advanced 4IR innovations. These facilities were also recognized as Sustainability Lighthouses for breakthroughs in efficient operations. With our global reach, we ensure the global supply chain has access to the Flash memory it needs to keep our world moving forward.
  
  
**Description**
You will be part of our Global Network Engineering team as a Staff Network Engineer responsible for leading the design, architecture, implementation, and lifecycle management of complex global network infrastructure across corporate offices, manufacturing sites, data centers, and cloud connectivity environments. This role is expected to serve as a senior technical authority, drive standards and automation, mentor engineers, influence cross-functional technology decisions, and ensure highly available, secure, scalable, and operationally efficient network services that support business growth and manufacturing continuity.
  
  
**Essentials Duties And Responsibilities**

* Lead the architecture, design, implementation, optimization, and lifecycle management of global enterprise network infrastructure across corporate offices, manufacturing locations, data centers, cloud connectivity environments, and regional sites.
* Serve as a senior technical authority for complex LAN, WAN, SD-WAN, wireless, firewall, DDI, NAC, and network security platforms, providing technical direction for large-scale projects and critical operational issues.
* Define, document, and enforce global network standards, design patterns, configuration baselines, deployment practices, and operational runbooks to improve consistency, reliability, security, and supportability.
* Lead complex troubleshooting and root-cause analysis for high-impact network incidents involving BGP, OSPF, SD-WAN, VLANs, spanning tree, QoS, firewalls, wireless, DHCP, DNS, NAC, hardware/software failures, and application connectivity dependencies.
* Drive network automation, configuration management, source-of-truth adoption, and operational tooling using platforms such as Git, Ansible, Nautobot/NetBox, Infoblox, Splunk, SNMP, NetFlow, and related monitoring and observability solutions.
* Partner with architecture, security, cyber defense, infrastructure, application, manufacturing, and site IT teams to align network designs with business requirements, security standards, resiliency objectives, and manufacturing uptime expectations.
* Lead technical evaluations, proof-of-concepts, vendor engagements, design reviews, and technology recommendations for strategic network platforms, products, and professional services.
* Provide technical leadership for major IT projects, site transformations, network refreshes, segmentation initiatives, cloud connectivity expansion, SD-WAN migration, firewall modernization, wireless deployments, and DDI modernization efforts.
* Mentor and guide network engineers globally, review technical designs and changes, raise engineering standards, and help develop team capability through knowledge sharing and technical coaching.
* Represent Network Engineering in cross-functional forums, communicate risks and recommendations clearly to technical and leadership audiences, and influence decisions without direct authority.
* Ensure network infrastructure is effectively monitored, documented, patched, secured, and operated in alignment with service level expectations, change management practices, vulnerability management requirements, and operational excellence goals.

**Required Skills**

* 12+ years of experience designing, implementing, and operating large-scale global enterprise networks across corporate, manufacturing, data center, and cloud-connected environments.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience in network engineering and architecture.
* Expert-level knowledge of IP networking, routing, switching, TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, spanning tree, VLANs, VRRP/HSRP, LACP/LAG, QoS, multicast, NAT, ACLs, NAC, DHCP, DNS, and enterprise cabling standards.
* Strong hands-on experience with multi-vendor networking environments, including Cisco, Arista, Palo Alto, Fortinet, Aruba/Cisco wireless, Infoblox DDI, and related enterprise network platforms.
* Demonstrated ability to design and lead complex network solutions for campus, manufacturing, data center, WAN/SD-WAN, internet edge, remote access, firewall, segmentation, and cloud connectivity use cases.
* Deep experience with next-generation firewall capabilities, IPsec VPN, IDS/IPS, advanced threat protection, security policy design, vulnerability remediation, and secure network architecture principles.
* Proven experience with network automation, configuration management, version control, and infrastructure-as-code practices using Git, Ansible, Python or scripting, Nautobot/NetBox, APIs, and source-of-truth driven workflows.
* Strong operational experience with monitoring, telemetry, log analysis, troubleshooting, and observability tools such as SNMP, NetFlow, Splunk, syslog, packet captures, and performance analysis platforms.
* Ability to lead technical design reviews, develop standards, assess risks, create migration plans, define implementation strategies, and make sound trade-off decisions balancing security, resiliency, cost, and operational complexity.
* Excellent documentation skills, including architecture diagrams, low-level designs, migration plans, implementation procedures, operational runbooks, standards, and executive-ready technical summaries.
* Strong project leadership, analytical thinking, problem determination, stakeholder management, and communication skills, with the ability to influence engineers, vendors, service providers, and business stakeholders globally.
* Ability to operate independently with limited direction, lead ambiguous technical initiatives, mentor other engineers, and drive outcomes across globally distributed teams.

**Preferred Skills**

* Expert-level certifications such as CCIE, CCNP, PCNSE, or equivalent practical experience are strongly preferred.
* Advanced experience with SD-WAN architecture, network segmentation, zero-trust network access concepts, manufacturing network resiliency, and hybrid cloud connectivity.
* Strong working knowledge of Infoblox DDI, Aruba/Cisco wireless, ClearPass or similar NAC platforms, Palo Alto firewalls, Arista CloudVision, Cisco Catalyst Center/DNAC, and enterprise monitoring platforms.
* Experience supporting highly available manufacturing, R&D, or mission-critical environments where network downtime has material business impact.
* Experience leading global network transformation programs, professional services engagements, vendor evaluations, and cross-functional architecture governance.
* Familiarity with ServiceNow workflows, CMDB integrations, security compliance processes, vulnerability management, and operational metrics such as availability, incident response, and MTTR.

Additional Information
  
  
Sandisk thrives on the power and potential of diversity. As a global company, we believe the most effective way to embrace the diversity of our customers and communities is to mirror it from within. We believe the fusion of various perspectives results in the best outcomes for our employees, our company, our customers, and the world around us. We are committed to an inclusive environment where every individual can thrive through a sense of belonging, respect and contribution.
  
  
Sandisk is committed to offering opportunities to applicants with disabilities and ensuring all candidates can successfully navigate our careers website and our hiring process. Please contact us at jobs.accommodations@sandisk.com to advise us of your accommodation request. In your email, please include a description of the specific accommodation you are requesting as well as the job title and requisition number of the position for which you are applying.

title: Staff Technical Support Engineer - SASE ( NAM shift)
description:
**Our Mission**
At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
  
  
We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
  
  
****Job Summary****
**The Team**
Customer Support - Our Customer Support team is critical to our success and mission. As part of this team, you enable customer success by providing support to clients after they have purchased our products. Our dedication to our customers doesn’t stop once they sign — it evolves. As threats and technology change, we stay in step to accomplish our mission. You’ll be involved in implementing new products, transitioning from old products to new, and fixing integrations and critical issues as they are raised — in fact, you’ll seek them out to ensure our clients are safely supported. We fix and identify technical problems with a pointed focus on providing the best customer support in the industry.
  
  
****Job Summary****
You will work directly with customers to troubleshoot and resolve complex issues in Prisma SD-WAN deployments across on-prem and cloud environments. This role is focused on handling challenging post-sales problems where issues are not always straightforward and require strong analytical thinking and hands-on troubleshooting. As a Staff Technical Support Engineer, you’ll be involved in high-impact cases and work closely with Engineering and Product teams when a deeper investigation is needed. You’ll also help guide customers through best practices and design considerations based on real-world experience. This role is a good fit for someone who enjoys digging into complex networking problems, working across teams, and being part of situations where quick and thoughtful problem-solving matters.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities****
Provide post-sales technical support for Prisma SD-WAN, including configuration guidance, troubleshooting, and best practices via phone, email, and web
  
  
Own and drive complex or high-impact customer issues, including escalation scenarios, until resolution
  
  
Troubleshoot networking issues across SD-WAN environments, including routing behavior, tunnel stability, and traffic flow
  
  
Investigate issues using logs, packet captures, and system-level diagnostics
  
  
Reproduce customer issues when needed and work with Engineering to validate and escalate defects
  
  
Work with Product and Engineering teams to share customer feedback and help improve product quality
  
  
Clearly communicate technical findings and recommendations to customers
  
  
Contribute to knowledge base articles and internal documentation
  
  
Support and guide other engineers on the team when needed
  
  
Provide support that includes mandatory weekend, holiday shift work and on-call support. Support includes a blend of as-needed and rotational coverage, which is subject to change.
  
  
****Required Qualifications****
8+ years of experience in technical support, network engineering, or a related role
  
  
Solid understanding of networking concepts, including routing (BGP/OSPF) and VPN technologies (IPsec)
  
  
Experience troubleshooting real-world network issues (routing behavior, connectivity, stability, etc.)
  
  
Experience with packet captures, logs, and basic network debugging tools
  
  
Experience working in customer-facing situations, especially during critical or time-sensitive issues
  
  
Ability to explain technical issues clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
  
  
**AI Exposure & Operational Efficiency**
AI & Automation Familiarity: Experience or a strong interest in leveraging AI utilities and workflow automation platforms (such as coding assistants, low-code integration tools, or orchestration systems) to build helper scripts, streamline diagnostics, or automate repetitive support tasks.
  
  
Future-Ready Mindset: A basic conceptual understanding of AI workflows (such as LLMs or automated task flows) with an interest in identifying how these technologies can be applied to optimize customer communication or accelerate knowledge sharing (like automated KB drafting)
  
  
****Preferred Qualifications****
Experience with SD-WAN platforms (Prisma SD-WAN or similar)
  
  
Exposure to cloud networking (AWS, Azure)
  
  
Familiarity with hybrid environments (on-prem + cloud)
  
  
Basic scripting or automation experience is a plus
  
  
Experience working with cross-functional teams (Engineering/Product/Dev-Ops)
  
  
Relevant industry certifications (e.g., CCNP, CCIE, PCNSE)
  
  
****Qualifications****
**Our Commitment**
We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
  
  
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.
  
  
Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.
  
  
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
  
  
Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

title: Senior Security Operations Center Analyst
description: SOC Engineer - 3 Detection Engineering, Incident Leadership & Operational Excellence Location: Bangalore (Work From Office- 5 Days) Reports to: CISO Cashfree Payments operates mission-critical payment and API infrastructure under RBI and PCI-DSS oversight. Our environment processes high-volume financial transactions and demands high-fidelity detection, rapid response, and operational resilience. We are building an automation-driven SOC designed to scale beyond traditional monitoring models. Role Summary The SOC Engineer - 3 is a senior, hands-on technical expert pivotal in accelerating the defensive posture and operational maturity of the Cashfree Payments SOC. This role moves beyond traditional monitoring, focusing instead on Detection Engineering, Incident Response Leadership, and operational scaling within our high-volume, regulated Fintech environment. We are looking for a system-thinker and builder who can autonomously architect scalable, automation-driven security solutions. Key Responsibilities Detection and Threat Engineering ● Architect, develop, implement, and continually tune detection rules and correlation logic across SIEM and EDR platforms. ● Proactively identify and remediate detection gaps, mapping coverage to the MITRE ATT&CK framework and leveraging threat intelligence, with a special focus on cloud (AWS), containerized (Kubernetes), and payment systems. ● Implement advanced contextual alerting and enrichment strategies to drastically reduce false positive rates and combat alert fatigue. ● Conduct proactive, hypothesis-driven hunting exercises across diverse telemetry sources (cloud, network, endpoint) to uncover covert threats. Incident Response Leadership & Handling ● Function as the primary technical lead for high-severity and complex security incidents, driving effective containment, eradication, and recovery strategies. ● Execute in-depth log analysis, digital forensics triage, and timeline reconstruction to determine the root cause and scope of compromise. ● Translate findings and lessons learned from incidents into immediate, measurable improvements in detection and prevention mechanisms. ● Ensure meticulous documentation of all incidents, including technical steps, post-incident reviews, and executive summaries. SOC Operational Maturity & Automation ● Design, develop, and maintain automation playbooks using SOAR platforms to streamline repetitive tasks, triage, and incident response workflows. ● Utilize strong scripting skills (e.g. Python) to engineer custom tools and automation solutions, reducing manual effort and increasing response consistency. ● Establish and refine Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and investigation playbooks, ensuring they are current, effective, and adopted across the team. Performance & Team Enablement ● Take full ownership of critical SOC metrics, including Mean Time to Detect (MTTD), Mean Time to Respond (MTTR), and False Positive Rate. Drive measurable improvement quarter over quarter. ● Mentor and coach SOC team, elevating their investigative, analytical, and tooling skills. ● Plan and execute periodic simulation exercises (e.g., tabletop exercises, purple team engagements) to test and validate SOC readiness and playbooks. Required Qualifications and Expertise Technical Foundation ● B.Tech. in Computer Science, Electrical, or Computer Engineering or equivalent practical experience. ● 7+ years of hands-on experience in a dedicated Security Operations Center (SOC), Incident Response, or Detection Engineering role. ● Hands-on experience with AWS or major cloud environments, including cloud security solutions/services such as WAF, GuardDuty, Shield, and ransomware protection/mitigation strategies. ● Expert-level proficiency in SIEM platforms (e.g., Splunk, Elastic, Sentinel) including advanced rule creation, custom parsing, and dashboard development. ● Demonstrated strong scripting skills in Python for security automation and data manipulation. ● Excellent understanding of TCP/IP, common network protocols, and the function of security appliances (Firewalls, IDS/IPS, Proxies). Soft Skills & Leadership ● Proven ability to operate independently, set priorities, and drive complex projects from concept to completion. ● Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills for complex, multi-stage security incidents.

title: Mid - Senior SOC Analyst
description:
Wrike is the most powerful work management platform. Built for teams and organizations looking to collaborate, create, and exceed every day, Wrike brings everyone and all work into a single place to remove complexity, increase productivity, and free people up to focus on their most purposeful work.
  
  
Wrike is our people, not a place. As a distributed team, we own our growth, stay globally connected, and rely on the product we build to deliver impactful work alongside brilliant minds. You'll have real ownership over meaningful work, a global team that has your back, and the flexibility to do your best work your way. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
**Our vision:**
A world where everyone is free to focus on their most purposeful work, together.
  
  
**About the Role:**
With flexible, distributed-first ways of working, you'll have the support to do your best work, wherever you are. Wrike commits to its customers that their data is monitored around the clock. Our Security Operations Center delivers on that promise through a hybrid model with a 24/7 managed detection partner (Rapid7)—and our analysts are the core drivers who handle escalations, conduct deep-dive investigations, and execute immediate action.
  
  
As an
**L2 SOC Analyst**
, you will play a pivotal role in our security rotation: monitoring and triaging security alerts, responding to escalations from our MDR partner, investigating incidents end-to-end, and continuously maturing our detection capabilities to protect Wrike and our customers.
  
  
**Your Impact:**

* Alert Triage & Escalation: Monitor, triage, and investigate security alerts and events, including direct escalations from our 24/7 MDR partner (Rapid7).
* Incident Containment & Forensics: Assess risk and impact of potential incidents, conducting end-to-end investigations (log analysis, endpoint forensics, scoping) and taking swift remediation actions.
* On-Call Coverage: Participate in the SOC on-call rotation to guarantee round-the-clock escalation coverage.
* Detection Engineering & Tuning: Continuously refine and tune detection rules to minimize false positives and identify genuine threats faster.
* Proactive Threat Hunting: Contribute to threat hunting initiatives across endpoints, identity providers, SaaS platforms, and cloud environments.
* Process Improvement: Help document, refine, and optimize SOC playbooks, runbooks, incident reports, and operational escalation workflows.

**Your Qualifications:**

* Experience: 2–3+ years of hands-on experience in a SOC or security monitoring environment (alert triage, incident investigation, and response).
* Technical Proficiency: Hands-on experience with SIEM platforms (Rapid7 InsightIDR or similar) and EDR/antimalware tooling for endpoint investigations.
* Core Knowledge: Strong understanding of network security fundamentals, common threat vectors, and attack frameworks (MITRE ATT&CK).
* Problem-Solving & Communication: Sharp logical thinking and analytical skills paired with advanced written and verbal English communication abilities.
* Availability: Ability and willingness to participate in an on-call rotation, including occasional nights and weekends.

**Standout Qualities:**

* Hybrid Model Experience: Prior experience collaborating directly with an MDR or MSSP partner in a hybrid SOC environment.
* Extended Tooling Expertise: Hands-on familiarity with tools such as Splunk, Wazuh, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, Crowdtrike, Okta, Google Workspace, AWS, or GCP.
* Advanced Capabilities: Previous experience in active threat hunting, detection engineering, or task automation using Python/Bash.
* Industry Certifications: Relevant security certifications (e.g., Security+, CySA+, GCIH, GCDA, or vendor-specific certifications).

**Team Dynamics:**
You will join a highly collaborative, vigilant, and supportive Security Operations Center team. In this role, you will work closely with internal incident responders, cross-functional IT and infrastructure teams, and directly alongside analysts from our 24/7 MDR partner (Rapid7). The team culture values transparent communication, continuous learning, and collective ownership of security outcomes.
  
  
**Our Work Style:**
We operate in a dynamic, hybrid security model utilizing modern cloud-first security tooling.
  
  
  

* Tech Stack & Tools: Rapid7 InsightIDR, EDR/XDR platforms, Okta, Google Workspace, AWS/GCP, and custom Python/Bash automation scripts.
* Methodologies: Framework-driven incident response aligned with MITRE ATT&CK, structured playbooks, and continuous threat-hunting cycles.
* What Makes Us Different: Unlike traditional SOC environments burdened by endless repetitive alerts, our hybrid model leverages an MDR partner to offload initial noise. This allows our L2 Analysts to focus on complex investigations, high-impact threat hunting, and genuine detection engineering.

**Benefits & Perks:**

* 18 calendar days of paid vacation
* 12 days of National & Festival holidays (10 fixed, 2 flexible)
* Sick Leave Compensation (5 Paid Uncertified Sick Days)
* Menstrual Leave: Twelve (12) days per calendar year. Women employees are eligible for up to 1 day of menstrual leave per month.
* Parental Leave: 26 Weeks Maternity / 4 Week Paternity
* 2 Volunteer Days
* Group Medical Insurance (Employees + Dependents)
* Term Life Insurance (Rs 50,00,000)
* Personal Accident Insurance (Rs 50,00,000)
* Monthly Broadband / Internet Reimbursement (INR 1500)
* Hybrid Working Model + Complimentary Lunch & Snacks

Your recruitment buddy will be Nandini Singh, Recruiter.
  
  
**Who Is Wrike And Our Culture**
We’re a team of innovators and creators who solve the complex work problems of today and tomorrow.
  
  
**Hybrid work mode**
Wrike is our people, not a place. With 1,000+ employees collaborating across nearly every time zone, we support talent through 10 global hubs — Australia, Costa Rica, Cyprus, Czechia, Estonia, France, India, Ireland, Japan, and the United States — offering flexible ways of working that include remote work, hybrid environments, and co-working spaces across many locations.
  
  
While flexibility looks different across teams and regions, employees located near certain hubs — particularly in Prague (CZ), Nicosia (CY), Bangalore (IN), and Rennes (FR) — are generally expected to collaborate in person around 2–3 days per week, balancing the flexibility of distributed work with opportunities for in-person collaboration and connection.
  
  
**Our persona**
**💡 Smart:**
We love what we do, and we’re great at it because this is our domain. Our combined knowledge in this space is unmatched.
  
  
**💚 Dedicated:**
We get up every day focused on helping our customers win. We’re committed to helping our teammates win, too!
  
  
**🤗 Approachable:**
We're friendly, easy to get along with, considerate, and helpful.
  
  
**Our culture and Values**
**🤩 Customer-Focused**
**We care about our customers.**
We understand the customer journey, experience, and value derived from Wrike. Decision-making and action-taking are done with the customer in mind.
  
  
**🤝 Collaborative**
**We work as one and win together,**
each bringing unique strengths that contribute to diversity of thought for better outcomes. Leveraging our own work management platform, we foster an environment of creative collaboration and shared achievement.
  
  
**🎨 Creative**
**We strive to succeed through continuous innovation.**
It’s our pursuit of novel concepts that helped us create a market category. We continue to cultivate a workplace that fosters creative thinking as a means of transcending conventional boundaries and empowers us to break new ground to deliver extraordinary work management solutions.
  
  
**💪 Committed**
**We believe in ownership at all levels of the organization,**
by owning workflows from start to finish. Each member of our team is an integral part of this commitment, establishing work as a platform for personal growth and transformation, as well as collective success and growth.
  
  
Check out our LinkedIn Life Page, Company culture page, Instagram, Wrike Engineering Team, Medium, Meetup.com, Youtube for a feel for what life is like at Wrike.

title: Application Security Engineer
description:
**Application Security Engineer (Mobile & Web) – SDE-1**

We are looking for a hands-on
**Application Security Engineer**
with a strong software engineering mindset. You will sit close to our product and mobile engineering teams—not just flagging vulnerabilities in a spreadsheet, but diving into iOS and Android codebases, debugging issues at the source level, and helping ship secure fixes.

If you enjoy taking apart mobile apps, tracing API calls, and writing code to automate security checks, this role is built for you.

  **iOS (Swift/Objective-C)**
  and
  **Android (Kotlin/Java)**

* **API & Web AppSec:**
  Conduct security assessments on backend APIs and web services supporting our mobile clients.
* **Security Tooling & Automation:**
  Integrate and tune SAST, DAST, and SCA tools within CI/CD pipelines to catch issues early without slowing down developers.
* **Triage & Threat Modeling:**
  Validate and triage incoming bug bounty reports and penetration test findings; participate in design reviews and lightweight threat modeling for new features.

* **Experience:**
  2–3 years of hands-on experience in Application Security, Mobile Security, or Software Development with a strong focus on security.
* **Mobile Debugging Skills:**
  Practical experience debugging iOS and Android apps using tools like
  **Xcode (LLDB)**
  ,
  **Android Studio (ADB)**
  ,
  **Frida**
  ,
  **Objection**
  ,
  **JADX**
  , and
  **Burp Suite / Charles Proxy**
  .

  Comfortable reading and writing code in at least one mobile language (
  **Swift, Objective-C, Kotlin, or Java**
  ) and one scripting language (
  **Python, Go, or Bash**
  ).
* **Security Fundamentals:**
  Solid understanding of
  **OWASP MASVS/MASTG**
  (Mobile),
  **OWASP Top 10**
  (Web & API), authentication and authorization flaws, SSL pinning, local storage security (Keychain/Keystore), and reverse engineering basics.
* **Engineering Mindset:**
  You approach security like an SDE-1—focused on root causes, clean fixes, and developer empathy rather than checkbox compliance.

**Technical Environment & Tooling**

* **Mobile Platforms:**
  iOS (Swift, Objective-C), Android (Kotlin, Java)
* **Debugging & Analysis:**
  Xcode (LLDB), Android Studio (ADB), Frida, Objection, JADX, Burp Suite, Charles Proxy
* **Scripting & Automation:**
  Python, Go, Bash, CI/CD Security Scanners (SAST, DAST, SCA)
* **Security Standards:**
  OWASP MASVS / MASTG, OWASP Top 10 (Web & API)

**Nice to Have**

* Experience securing cross-platform frameworks (
  **Flutter**
  or
  **React Native**
  ).
* Familiarity with cloud fundamentals (
  **AWS / GCP**
  ) and CI/CD platforms (
  **GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins**
  ).
* Track record in bug bounty programs, CTFs, or open-source security tooling.
* Familiarity with binary analysis tools (
  **Ghidra, Hopper, or IDA**
  ).

**OT IDS / asset visibility platforms such as Claroty and Nozomi Networks,**

The role will work closely with plant/site OT teams, infrastructure and security teams, asset owners, OEMs, and third-party technology vendors to manage vulnerabilities while considering the availability, safety, and operational constraints inherent to manufacturing environments.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* OT Vulnerability Identification & Monitoring

+ Perform and support vulnerability assessment activities across OT environments using organization-provided OT security and vulnerability management tools.
+ Monitor vulnerabilities identified across OT assets such as PLCs, DCS, HMIs, engineering workstations, historians, Windows/Linux servers, network devices, and other industrial systems.
+ Review and analyze identified CVEs, security exposures, vulnerable firmware/software versions, and security misconfigurations.
+ Validate vulnerability findings against available asset, firmware, software, and exposure information.
+ Support identification and investigation of potential false positives and missing detections.
+ Maintain an accurate and actionable vulnerability backlog.

* OT IDS / Vulnerability Management Tools

+ Hands-on experience using one or more OT security platforms, preferably:

- Claroty
- Nozomi Networks

+ Use OT visibility/IDS platforms to review:

- Asset inventory and classification
- Vulnerabilities and CVEs
- Software and firmware information
- Network exposure and communications
- Risk information

+ Analyze vulnerability information produced by the organization's approved tooling and convert technical findings into actionable remediation recommendations.

* Risk-Based Vulnerability Prioritization

+ Perform risk-based prioritization rather than relying solely on CVSS severity.
+ Assess vulnerabilities considering:

- CVSS score and severity
- Exploitability
- Asset criticality
- OT/production impact
- Network exposure
- Existing compensating controls
- Threat intelligence
- Vendor/OEM guidance

+ Identify Critical and High-risk vulnerabilities requiring expedited stakeholder attention.
+ Support definition and application of vulnerability remediation priorities and timelines.
+ Prioritize vulnerabilities in a manner appropriate to OT environments where immediate patching may not always be operationally feasible.

* Threat & Vendor Advisory Monitoring

+ Monitor relevant OEM/vendor security advisories and industrial cybersecurity vulnerability notifications.
+ Correlate newly published vulnerabilities and advisories against known OT assets and exposures.
+ Assess whether vulnerable products, firmware, software, or components are present within the environment.
+ Identify potentially impacted sites/assets and communicate relevant vulnerability alerts to stakeholders.
+ Support threat-context enrichment and prioritization of vulnerabilities where appropriate.

* Vulnerability Alerts & Stakeholder Communication

+ Prepare and distribute relevant vulnerability alerts to plant/site and security stakeholders.
+ Clearly communicate:

- Affected products and assets
- Vulnerability severity
- Potential operational/security impact
- Known exposure
- Recommended actions
- Vendor/OEM recommendations where available

+ Escalate significant OT vulnerabilities through established governance channels.

* Remediation Recommendations & Coordination

+ Provide remediation recommendations based on tool findings, OEM/vendor guidance, and OT security good practices.
+ Recommend appropriate treatment options including, where relevant:

- Vendor-approved patching
- Firmware upgrades
- Configuration hardening
- Network segmentation
- Access restrictions
- Protocol/application allow-listing
- Enhanced monitoring
- Other compensating controls

+ Collaborate with OT/site teams, infrastructure teams, asset owners, OEMs, and third-party vendors to support vulnerability remediation.
+ Track vulnerabilities through remediation, mitigation, risk acceptance, or closure.
+ Validate closure of vulnerability findings based on available evidence.

* Governance & Reporting

+ Participate in regular OT vulnerability review and governance meetings with relevant stakeholders.
+ Track open vulnerabilities, remediation status, ageing, overdue actions, accepted risks, and compensating controls.
+ Prepare periodic operational and management reporting.
+ Support risk acceptance and sign-off processes for vulnerabilities that cannot be remediated within agreed timelines.
+ Support escalation of overdue or high-risk vulnerabilities.
+ Work with stakeholders to continuously improve vulnerability reporting and remediation tracking processes.

**Required Skills & Experience**
The candidate should have:
  
  

* 5–8 years of overall experience in cybersecurity, with demonstrated experience in vulnerability management and OT/ICS security.
* Practical experience working in OT / ICS / manufacturing environments.
* Hands-on experience with OT IDS / visibility tools such as Claroty and/or Nozomi Networks.
* Strong understanding of:

+ Vulnerability management lifecycle
+ CVE and CVSS
+ Risk-based vulnerability prioritization
+ Vulnerability validation and false-positive analysis
+ Threat and vendor advisory monitoring
+ Vulnerability remediation and mitigation
+ Compensating controls
+ Risk acceptance and exception management

* Understanding of common OT technologies and assets including:

+ PLC
+ DCS
+ HMI
+ SCADA
+ Engineering workstations
+ Historians
+ Industrial servers
+ Industrial network infrastructure

* Ability to coordinate effectively with plant/site OT teams, security teams, infrastructure teams, OEMs, and third-party vendors.
* Strong analytical, documentation, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.

**Preferred Knowledge**
Candidates with knowledge or working exposure to the following would be preferred:
  
  

* IEC 62443
* NIST SP 800-82
* NIST Cybersecurity Framework
* MITRE ATT&CK for ICS
* Purdue Model / industrial network segmentation
* OT asset criticality and consequence-based risk assessment
* Industrial patch and firmware management
* OT compensating controls and risk treatment strategies

**Key Competencies**
The ideal candidate should be able to:
  
  

* Analyze: Convert large volumes of OT vulnerability findings into meaningful risks.
* Prioritize: Identify what requires action first based on actual OT risk rather than CVSS alone.
* Communicate: Explain technical vulnerabilities and their business/operational implications to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Coordinate: Work across site OT teams, security, infrastructure, OEMs, and third parties.
* Govern: Drive vulnerability tracking, risk acceptance, escalation, and closure.
* Recommend: Propose practical remediation or compensating controls that consider OT safety and availability constraints.

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

description:
***Job Title:***
SAP GRC Security Analyst
  
  
**About Trellix**
Trellix is a global cybersecurity leader helping organizations build cyber resilience for the AI era. Combining AI-native security, operational threat intelligence, and automated detection and response, Trellix provides defense-grade protection at machine speed across on-premises, air-gapped, operational technology, hybrid, and cloud environments. Whether you are an industry pioneer or an emerging specialist, Trellix provides the tools and opportunities to enhance and expand your skill set. Join our mission to scale AI-driven cyber defense alongside an AI-accelerated threat landscape, and help build a safer, more resilient future. More at https://trellix.com.
  
  
***Role Overview:***
We are seeking an experienced Senior SAP Security & GRC Specialist with 6 to 8 years of hands-on expertise in SAP Security design, GRC (Governance, Risk, and Compliance) administration, and yearly audit lifecycle management. In this role, you will lead the design, implementation, and operational support of SAP authorization frameworks across S/4HANA, legacy ECC, and cloud landscapes. You will drive Segregation of Duties (SoD) risk management, oversee Emergency Access Management (EAM/Firefighter), and serve as the primary technical interface for annual internal and external IT General Controls (ITGC) and SOX audits.
  
  
**About Role:**

* Experience in Design, build, and maintaining role-based access control (RBAC) models across SAP S/4HANA, ECC 6.0, BW/4HANA and SAP Cloud platforms.
* Build and manage single, derived, composite, and structural roles following the principle of least privilege.
* Configure and troubleshoot security components, including tile catalogs, groups, spaces, pages, and OData services.
* Review security transports, execute user provisioning workflows, and assist with annual SAP license audit reviews.
* Administer and support SAP GRC Access Control modules: Access Risk Analysis (ARA), Access Request Management (ARM), Emergency Access Management (EAM), and Business Role Management (BRM).
* Conduct regular Segregation of Duties (SoD) and Sensitive Access risk evaluations; collaborate with business process owners to define and enforce mitigating controls.
* Oversee the Firefighter (EAM) framework, including controller assignment, log reviews, and emergency access monitoring.
* Maintain and customize the GRC rule set to align with changing organizational risk profiles and business requirements.
* Act as the lead technical contact for yearly internal and external audit cycles (SOX 404, ITGC, SOC 1/2).
* Coordinate evidence gathering, system walk-throughs, and sample extraction for external audit teams (e.g., Big 4).
* Track, remediate, and report on audit findings, internal control gaps, and authorization risks in a timely manner.
* Facilitate periodic User Access Reviews (UAR) and User Privilege Reviews (UPR) with management and business module leads.
* Maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs), security control documentation, and risk matrix repositories.

**About You:**

* 6–8 years of dedicated experience in SAP Security administration and SAP GRC Access Control implementation/support.
* Demonstrated experience taking primary responsibility or playing a key technical role in at least 3–4 yearly audit cycles (SOX/ITGC) with proven remediation success.
* Direct experience with SAP S/4HANA, ECC 6.0, security, and HANA DB authorization models.Deep technical command of SAP GRC Access Control (ARA, ARM, EAM, BRM).
* Solid understanding of standard SAP business cycles (Procure-to-Pay, Order-to-Cash, Record-to-Report) and associated SoD conflict matrices.
* Strong technical writing skills for audit documentation and executive risk reporting.
* Analytical problem-solving skills with meticulous attention to detail during audit defense.
* Ability to partner effectively with IT Basis, Functional Teams, Internal Audit, and Business Process Owners.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, MIS, or equivalent relevant field.

**Preferred Certifications**

* SAP Certified Technology Associate – SAP System Security / SAP GRC.
* Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA) or Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP).

***Company Benefits and Perks:***
We believe that the best solutions are developed by teams who embrace each other's unique experiences, skills, and abilities. We work hard to create a dynamic workforce where we encourage everyone to bring their authentic selves to work every day. We offer a variety of social programs, flexible work hours and family-friendly benefits to all of our employees.
  
  

* Retirement Plans

We're serious about our commitment to a workplace where everyone can thrive and contribute to our industry-leading products and customer support, which is why we prohibit discrimination and harassment based on race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation or any other legally protected status.
  
  
***Our Commitment to You:***
At Trellix, we are committed to creating a safe and trustworthy experience for our customers, employees, and candidates. Please be aware that fraudulent recruiting activity can occur through fake job postings or impersonated communications.
  
  
Trellix conducts interviews through professional channels only and does not use text messages, instant messaging, or group chats for interviews. title: Senior Information Security Assurance Analyst
description:
**Who We Are:**
Headquartered in New York City, Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. is a leading developer, publisher, and marketer of interactive entertainment for consumers around the globe. We develop and publish products principally through Rockstar Games, 2K, and Zynga. Our strategy is to create hit entertainment experiences, delivered on every platform relevant to our audience through a variety of sound business models. Our pillars - creativity, innovation, and efficiency - guide us as we strive to create the highest quality, most captivating experiences for our consumers. The Company’s common stock is publicly traded on NASDAQ under the symbol TTWO. For more corporate and product information please visit our website at http://www.take2games.com.
  
  
**The Challenge**
As Take-Two continues to operate across a complex, federated environment spanning Corporate, Rockstar, 2K, and Zynga, demonstrating that our security controls are appropriately designed, implemented, and operating effectively is increasingly important. Traditional point-in-time compliance activities are not sufficient to provide sustained confidence in our security posture.
  
  
That’s where you come in. We are seeking an experienced Senior Information Security Assurance Analyst to help mature and scale our security assurance program. In this high-impact, consultative role, you will independently lead security audits, assessments, and control reviews across our Labels; evaluate technical evidence and control effectiveness; identify systemic gaps and drive remediation; and translate security requirements and findings into practical, risk-informed guidance. You will partner closely with Security Engineering and Platform teams to improve workflows and automate evidence collection and continuous control monitoring, while serving as a trusted advisor to security, technology, engineering, and business stakeholders. You will also provide functional guidance and mentorship to other members of the team, helping establish consistent, scalable assurance practices across T2.
  
  
**What You’ll Take On**

* Independently lead label, studio, and enterprise security audits, assessments, and control reviews from planning and scoping through testing, findings, remediation, and closure.
* Evaluate control design, implementation, operating effectiveness, and technical evidence using a risk-based assurance approach.
* Identify control deficiencies and systemic weaknesses, assess business and security impact, and develop actionable remediation recommendations.
* Independently validate remediation and compensating controls before closing identified findings.
* Serve as a key operational lead for internal, external, partner, and regulatory audits and assessments, ensuring evidence is complete, relevant, and sufficient.
* Translate regulatory, contractual, and internal security requirements into practical control expectations and assurance activities.
* Maintain and continuously improve the enterprise security control framework and its alignment to standards such as NIST CSF, CIS Controls, PCI DSS, and other applicable requirements.
* Drive continuous assurance initiatives that move the organization beyond point-in-time compliance toward repeatable and ongoing control validation.
* Partner with Security Engineering and Platform teams to streamline evidence collection, reduce manual audit effort, and automate control monitoring and assurance workflows.
* Lead high-level discussions with Label and business stakeholders to communicate control deficiencies, navigate competing priorities, and drive risk-informed remediation decisions.
* Provide clear, evidence-based reporting to Information Security leadership on control effectiveness, systemic weaknesses, remediation progress, and emerging assurance risks.
* Provide subject-matter guidance, mentoring, and peer review to other GRC team members to improve the consistency and quality of assurance activities.
* Identify opportunities to standardize, automate, and continuously improve assurance methodologies, processes, and reporting across T2 and its Labels.

**What You Bring**

* Minimum of 5 years of progressive experience in Information Security Assurance, IT Audit, GRC, Security Compliance, or a related control assessment function, preferably within a large-scale, decentralized, or federated environment.
* Proven experience independently planning and executing security audits, assessments, or control reviews, including evaluating control design, implementation, operating effectiveness, and supporting evidence.
* Strong understanding of information security control frameworks and standards, including NIST CSF, CIS Controls, and relevant regulatory or contractual requirements.
* Demonstrated ability to identify control deficiencies, assess risk and business impact, develop remediation recommendations, and validate corrective actions.
* Experience translating technical security findings and control requirements into clear, actionable guidance for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Experience working with GRC, workflow, evidence management, and ticketing platforms such as ServiceNow and Jira; experience with ServiceNow GRC/AVR is a plus.
* Demonstrated ability to lead complex initiatives, manage competing priorities, and operate independently with limited managerial oversight.
* Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to challenge insufficient evidence and make defensible, risk-based judgments.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with senior security, technology, engineering, and business stakeholders.
* Proven ability to influence outcomes and drive remediation across federated teams without relying on direct authority.
* Professional information security, audit, or risk certifications (e.g., CISA, CRISC, CISSP, CISM, or ISO 27001 Lead Auditor) are highly preferred.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field; equivalent professional experience will also be considered.

**What We Offer You:**

* Great Company Culture. We pride ourselves as being one of the most creative and innovative places to work, creativity, innovation, efficiency, diversity and philanthropy are among the core tenets of our organization and are integral drivers of our continued success.
* Growth: As a global entertainment company, we pride ourselves on creating environments where employees are encouraged to be themselves, inquisitive, collaborative and to grow within and around the company.
* Work Hard, Enjoy Life. Our employees’ bond, blow-off steam, and flex some creative muscles – through corporate boot camp classes, company parties, our Office gaming spaces, game release events, monthly socials, and team challenges.
* Benefits. Benefits include, but are not limited to; Discretionary bonus, Provident fund contributions, 1+5 medical insurance + top up options and access to online Doctor consultation App, Employee assistance program, 3X CTC Life Assurance, 3X CTC Personal accident insurance, childcare services, 20 days holiday + statutory holidays,
* Perks. Gym reimbursement up to INR1150 per month ,charitable giving program, access to learning platforms, employee discount programs plus free games and events!

*Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. (“T2”) is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, which means we are committed to creating and celebrating diverse thoughts, cultures, and backgrounds throughout our organization. Employment at T2 is based on substantive ability, objective qualifications, and work ethic – not an individual’s race, creed, color, religion, sex or gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin or ancestry, alienage or citizenship status, physical or mental disability, pregnancy, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, status as a victim of domestic violence or sex offenses, reproductive health decision, or any other characteristics protected by applicable law.*

title: Information Security Engineer
description:
**Job Title**
Information Security Engineer
  
  
Summary of the Role
  
  
As a Security Software Engineer within Travel Distribution (TRD) Artificial Intelligence (AI), you’ll help secure AI-powered products throughout their lifecycle. You’ll work with Product, Engineering, Architecture, Security, and Governance teams to develop secure and reliable solutions for travel sellers.
  
  
In This Role You’ll / Your Main Responsibilities
  
  

* Contribute to AI security architecture and risk management: Apply security architecture principles to AI systems, including Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) and AI agents. You’ll identify and assess risks and help ensure solutions align with relevant enterprise security policies, governance requirements, and regulations.
* Assess and address AI-specific security risks: Carry out security assessments and threat modelling for AI use cases, addressing risks such as prompt injection, data leakage, model misuse, and insecure AI agent interactions across models, data pipelines, integrations, and monitoring.
* Integrate security into product development: Collaborate with Engineering teams to apply secure development practices, vulnerability management, security testing, and validation throughout the product lifecycle. You’ll contribute to Secure Development Lifecycle (SDL) and relevant compliance activities.
* Support governance, compliance, and operational security: Contribute to security controls and governance practices, including audit and risk-acceptance activities. You’ll help teams apply relevant security frameworks and regulatory requirements while supporting transparency, explainability, and appropriate oversight of AI systems.
* Collaborate and share security knowledge: Provide security guidance to Product, Architecture, Engineering, and Governance teams, contribute to cross-functional initiatives, and share practical security knowledge that helps teams incorporate security throughout AI development.

**About The Ideal Candidate**
You’ll be a good fit for this role if you have security engineering experience and an interest in applying security practices to AI-powered products and services.
  
  

* Experience or knowledge in security architecture, security risk management, threat modelling, vulnerability management, and secure software development practices.
* Knowledge of AI and Machine Learning (ML) technologies and associated security risks, which may include Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI agents, data pipelines, prompt injection, data leakage, or model misuse.
* Experience or knowledge related to Identity and Access Management (IAM), Application Programming Interface (API) security, or cloud security, with the ability to translate identified risks into practical security controls.
* Understanding of relevant security and compliance frameworks, such as International Organization for Standardization/International Electrotechnical Commission (ISO/IEC) 27001, National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) frameworks, Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS), or relevant AI governance and data-protection requirements.
* Effective problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to explain technical security topics clearly, collaborate across technical and business teams, share knowledge, and make practical security recommendations.

* 🤗 A caring environment – Amadeus fosters a caring environment that supports both professional growth and personal well-being.
* 💰 A complete rewards offer - Amadeus provides attractive compensation packages, including salary, bonus, caregiving and health benefits.
* 🌟 A flexible working model - Embrace our flexible working model, enabling you to excel wherever and however you work best.
* 🌈 A diverse, equitable, and inclusive community – We are committed to enabling each employee to reach their full potential by fostering a culture of belonging and fair treatment.
* 📈 A Reliable Company - Trust and reliability are fundamental to shaping our relationships with customers, partners, and employees.

Amadeus aspires to be a leader in Diversity and Inclusion in the tech industry, enabling every employee to reach their full potential by fostering a culture of belonging and fair treatment, attracting the best talent from all backgrounds, and as a role model for an inclusive employee experience.
  
  
Amadeus is an equal opportunity employer and committed to an accessible recruitment process. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, age, beliefs, disability or any other characteristics protected by law.
