title: Principal Site Reliability Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
Designs and architects infrastructure and service to ensure reliability and functionality. Forecasts demands and responds to capacity needs. Collaborates with software development teams to develop reliable and scalable infrastructures. Exercises judgment when performing data collection to maintain and optimize operations and reliability. Leverages advanced knowledge to perform incident response and/or maintenance tasks. Provides comprehensive health and performance reporting. Identifies and recommends opportunities for automation. Communicates comprehensive information about services and proactively anticipates and articulates the potential impact of changes. Provides comprehensive support for technology and documents incidents. Conducts advanced experiments with new tools and develops and maintains advanced knowledge of site reliability trends.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Mandatory**

* 5+ years of hands-on experience across software development, site reliability engineering, monitoring, and automation, with demonstrated ownership of production platforms.
* Strong programming skills in Python and experience developing backend services, REST APIs, integrations, and event-driven workflows.
* Proven experience building monitoring and observability solutions that collect and analyze alerts, metrics, logs, and service context.
* Hands-on experience integrating AI/LLM capabilities into applications for incident analysis, contextual recommendations, and operational decision support.
* Ability to develop reusable agents that combine live monitoring data, historical incidents, and previous remediation actions to recommend next steps.
* Experience implementing alert correlation, deduplication, enrichment, and prioritization to reduce noise and improve incident detection.
* Strong experience developing automated remediation workflows with approval controls, execution validation, audit trails, and recovery safeguards.
* Experience integrating monitoring platforms with incident management systems, knowledge repositories, and notification or escalation services.
* Strong understanding of distributed systems, Linux, networking, databases, and application performance, with the ability to translate failure patterns into platform capabilities.
* Experience applying software engineering practices, including automated testing, code reviews, CI/CD, version control, and secure development.
* Ability to evaluate platform reliability and AI output quality, measure operational outcomes, and improve capabilities using engineer feedback.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work with monitoring teams, service owners, and engineers to onboard services and define requirements.

**Good-to-Have**

* Experience with agentic AI frameworks, tool calling, retrieval-augmented generation, and vector databases.
* Knowledge of anomaly detection, time-series analysis, and predictive techniques for identifying recurring alarm patterns.
* Experience building centralized notification services, automated escalation calls, and incident communication workflows.
* Familiarity with OCI, Kubernetes, and Infrastructure-as-Code tools such as Terraform or Ansible.
* Experience with observability platforms such as OCI Observability, Prometheus, Grafana or equivalent tools.
* Exposure to Oracle Database and Exadata monitoring, performance diagnostics, and remediation automation.
* Experience using AI coding assistants to improve operational scripts and validate proposed changes.
* Knowledge of SLOs, error budgets, and incident metrics such as detection time, recovery time, and recurrence rate.

**Key Responsibilities**
**Capacity Ingestion and Management:**

* Designs and architects infrastructure and/or service according to terms for reliability and functionality.
* Forecasts demands for infrastructure and responds to capacity needs, ensuring systems have sufficient resources to handle current and future workloads and identifying resource gaps.
* Collaborates with the software development team to develop infrastructures, ensuring features are reliable and scalable according to deployment requirements.
* Proactively identifies opportunities for prototyping and drives prototyping initiatives (e.g., testing new applications or infrastructures, assisting in onboarding) to explore novel approaches.

**Incident and Service Lifecycle Management:**

* Exercises judgment when performing data collection, triage, technical analysis, and redirection to maintain and optimize operations and infrastructure reliability.
* Takes proactive steps to monitor services, maintain up-to-date knowledge of their performance, and document their condition.
* Leverages advanced knowledge to perform incident response, root cause analyses, and/or maintenance on assigned services (e.g., software installs, version upgrades, security updates, backup and recovery).
* Provides comprehensive health and performance reporting and takes appropriate actions based on trends in data.
* May perform provisioning to support infrastructure, applications, and services.
* May experiment with new approaches for and performs decommissioning (e.g., shutting down servers, removing data from databases) to remove objects that are no longer needed.

**Automation:**

* Identifies and recommends opportunities for automation and assesses potential benefits to enhance operational efficiency.
* Develops and implements design, automation tools, or scripts to provide solutions, gather metrics, monitor, analyze, mitigate, or remediate issues/defects within infrastructures.
* Conducts testing on moderately complex automations to ensure they perform tasks correctly and produce expected results.

**Technical Communication and Guidance:**

* Writes release notes and/or communicates comprehensive information about the scale, capacity, security, performance attributes, and requirements of services and technology with customers and immediate and related teams.
* Proactively anticipates and articulates the potential impact of infrastructure, feature, and tool changes, considering their impact across team operations.
* Serves as a resource to team members on what information to communicate and how to communicate.

**Troubleshooting and Resolution:**

* Provides comprehensive operational support for technology, serving as a key escalation point for incidents and moderately complex issues arising within Oracle services.
* Drives and actively participates in on-call shifts to address issues.
* Executes the resolution of technical issues spanning multiple services, applying advanced investigation and debugging techniques to achieve SLOs (service level objectives).
* Documents incidents according to reporting methods and performs root cause analyses, capturing essential information for analysis and future reference.
* Performs post-mortem procedures to prevent incident reoccurrence.

**Innovation and Improvement:**

* Conducts advanced experiments and evaluations of cutting-edge tools and technologies to optimize infrastructure performance and reliability, taking proactive steps to adhere to security standards.
* Identifies and seeks opportunities to execute improvements for performance bottlenecks and deployments, ensuring efficient resource usage, speed, and scalability.
* Develops and maintains advanced knowledge of site reliability trends, sharing valuable insights and information with senior team members, management, and beyond to promote innovative building, testing, deploying, and running services.
* Performs moderately complex analyses and provides clear data on production to drive business development decisions (e.g., design changes).

**Core Responsibilities**
**Planning & Execution:**

* Manages and coordinates moderately complex tasks, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure timely completion and adherence to requirements for a moderately sized project or initiative. Efficiently delegates, monitors, and prioritizes work across multiple projects, providing technical oversight and adjusting plans to address shifts in resources or timelines.

**Collaboration & Partnership:**

* Collaborates across the organization to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Leverages understanding of business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure proposed solutions meet their needs. Supports inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected.

**Problem Solving:**

* Identifies and addresses moderately complex issues by analyzing a wide range of data and/or information to identify solutions in accordance with standard practices. Proactively escalates unresolved or critical issues with a thorough assessment and suggests potential solutions. Reviews, contributes to, and documents problem solving strategies.

**Continuous Learning:**

* Pursues learning opportunities to expand knowledge and skills and/or tools in new areas and stays abreast of the latest industry trends and best practices. Proactively seeks and leverages ongoing feedback and training to improve skills. Coaches and mentors junior team members, fostering continuous learning and knowledge sharing within and across teams.

**Continuous Improvement:**

* Develops ideas, recommends updates, and/or collaborates on the implementation of process improvements to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across teams, and evaluates the impact on key stakeholders. Solicits feedback from others on ideas for alternative approaches and methods for continued improvement.

**Performance and Development:**

* Contributes to the talent development pipeline by participating in candidate interviews, assessing candidates, and providing hiring recommendations.

**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.
  
  
**Job Title**
Tech Lead, Infrastructure Engineering
  
  
**About Your Role**
As a Cloud Site Reliability Engineer (SRE), you will drive the reliability, scalability, and performance of our cloud-based platforms. You will partner with engineering, architecture, DevOps, and security teams to design and operate highly available, secure services across public cloud environments. Your work will reduce operational toil through automation and observability and will help ensure seamless service experiences for our clients and their customers.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Design, implement, and support fault-tolerant, highly available architectures across Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including redundancy, load balancing, and automated failover strategies.

title: Staff Site Reliability Engineer
description:
At SolarWinds, we’re a people-first company. Our purpose is to enrich the lives of the people we serve—including our employees, customers, shareholders, partners, and communities. Join us in our mission to help customers accelerate business transformation with simple, powerful, and secure solutions.

The ideal candidate thrives in an innovative, fast-paced environment and is collaborative, accountable, ready, and empathetic. We’re looking for individuals who believe they can accomplish more as a team and create lasting growth for themselves and others. We hire based on attitude, competency, and commitment. Solarians are ready to advance our world-class solutions in a fast-paced environment and accept the challenge to lead with purpose. If you’re looking to build your career with an exceptional team, you’ve come to the right place. Join SolarWinds and grow with us!

**Your Role**

* You will help build and evolve the shared platform capabilities that product teams depend on to ship and operate services safely at scale.
* You will work across platform, software engineering, security, and product to make reliability a first-class engineering input from design through operation. In this platform-focused role, you will shape technical direction for shared infrastructure and developer-facing capabilities, improve how services are built and run on AWS, and create the paved roads, guardrails, and self-service capabilities that make good operational behavior easier by default.
* This role is for someone who can move comfortably between architecture, automation, incident response, platform design, and technical leadership without losing sight of outcomes. You should be excited not only by solving hard problems directly, but by turning repeated operational pain into platform capabilities, standards, and automation that improve engineering effectiveness across teams.

**Your Impact**

* Lead high-complexity platform and reliability initiatives with sustained impact across multiple teams or business-critical systems, improving availability, performance, scalability, and release confidence.
* Define and operationalize reliability standards for shared platform services and critical workloads, including SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, alerting strategy, and operational readiness expectations.
* Design, build, and evolve reusable AWS and Kubernetes platform capabilities that become the preferred path for provisioning, deployment, observability, resilience, and safe service operation.
* Improve deployment safety, progressive delivery, rollback strategy, capacity planning, and operational automation in partnership with product and platform teams.
* Turn repeated operational pain and toil into durable automation, standards, and self-service capabilities that materially improve engineering productivity and consistency.
* Participate in on-call for business-critical systems, lead or support incident response when needed, and use production insights to drive systemic improvements rather than temporary fixes.
* Influence architecture and technical tradeoffs with reliability, security, and operability in mind, balancing long-term platform health with delivery speed.
* Raise the engineering bar through mentorship, design reviews, incident leadership, and strong technical judgment across the organization.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Product teams can provision, deploy, and operate services more safely with less manual effort because of the platform capabilities you help create.
* Reliability expectations are clearer, better instrumented, and more consistently applied across services.
* Repeated operational pain is converted into automation, guardrails, and standards that scale beyond a single team.
* Engineering teams trust and adopt the paved road because it improves both speed and safety.

**What Helps You Thrive**

* You have a strong platform mindset and care about building durable capabilities that improve the experience and effectiveness of internal engineering teams.
* You think in systems and can connect technical decisions to customer and business outcomes.
* You are hands-on and pragmatic, with strong engineering judgment about when to go deep, when to simplify, and how to balance reliability with delivery speed.
* You lead through influence, not title, and help other engineers make better decisions.
* You stay calm under pressure and bring clarity during incidents and ambiguous technical situations.
* You care deeply about customer experience and understand that strong reliability engineering is as much about prevention and learning as it is about response.

**Your Experience**

* Proven experience as a senior engineer in site reliability engineering, platform engineering, cloud infrastructure, or a similarly hands-on reliability-focused role, typically built over 8+ years in software or infrastructure engineering.
* Demonstrated track record of driving outcomes that improve how multiple teams build, deploy, and operate services, not just owning a single system well.
* Strong experience operating cloud-native environments on AWS, with deep familiarity in Kubernetes and infrastructure as code.
* Experience designing and improving CI/CD or GitOps-based delivery systems with a focus on reliability, safety, repeatability, and developer enablement.
* Strong experience with observability practices, production diagnostics, incident response, postmortems, and reliability mechanisms such as SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets.
* Proficiency in one or more scripting or programming languages such as Python, Go, or Bash, with a track record of building automation that meaningfully reduces operational effort.
* Comfortable using modern AI-assisted engineering tools to accelerate troubleshooting, automation, analysis, and documentation, with sound judgment to validate outputs in production environments.
* Experience with security-minded engineering practices such as secrets management, access control, encryption, and secure-by-design operational patterns.
* Experience working with ClickHouse and Kafka is a plus.
* Experience working in SaaS environments with high availability and customer-facing reliability expectations is a plus.

**Texecom is Looking for:******
**Job Title: Platform Engineer**
**Who are we?**
Texecom Ltd is a leading manufacturer and provider of professional security products, systems, and services. Our innovative solutions are designed to protect the things you care about, wherever they are. Texecom Cloud is the approved alarm signalling platform those systems depend on. When an intruder alarm
  
  
activates, our platform is what carries that signal to a monitoring centre. It is certified against EN 50136 for alarm transmission, and it also hosts the suite of subscription digital services that sit at the core of Texecom''''''''s future strategy. That gives the platform an unusual combination of constraints. It has to behave like critical infrastructure on availability and signalling integrity, and like a modern product platform on delivery pace. Both at once, on the same estate.
  
  
**What we need?**
We are recruiting a hands-on Platform Engineer to help run and develop the AWS platform on which Texecom’s cloud services are built, deployed and operated. You will join the new India-based Platform Engineering team, work alongside senior platform engineers, and take on a growing share of the platform over time. The team works as a resilient unit, so no part of the platform depends on one person.
  
  
**How can you help us?**
You will contribute to and, over time, own work of this kind:
  
  

* Multi-account AWS foundation. Work within a multi-account structure and landing zone: account setup, IAM roles and least-privilege access, with guidance from senior engineers.
* Security baseline. Help run organisation-wide security tooling (threat detection, vulnerability scanning) and turn findings into fixes.
* Data layer. Operate Aurora MySQL and DynamoDB day to day: monitoring, backups and restores, upgrades and issue investigation.
* Delivery pipelines. Build and maintain pipelines in Bitbucket Pipelines and AWS CodeBuild, and help make safe releases and rollback the default.
* Device and messaging estate. Support MQTT broker infrastructure and AWS IoT Core. Prior experience is not required.
* Observability and cost. Build and improve monitoring, alerting, logging and dashboards, and support auto-scaling and right-sizing.
* Platform tooling. Write and maintain internal tooling and automation, mainly in Python (Go is a plus).
* Golden paths, not application services. Help build the foundations and paved road that development teams deploy on. Application services are owned by the teams that build them.

**The successful candidate should have**

* At least 1 year of hands-on AWS in a live environment, with a clear account of what you personally built or ran.
* Production database exposure (must-have). You have run or looked after a database on AWS (Aurora, DynamoDB or RDS) and can describe what you did, such as upgrades, backups, restores or an incident.
* Terraform used regularly, including writing reusable modules.
* Scripting and tooling in Python, Go, PowerShell or TypeScript, building tools that other people can maintain.
* CI/CD experience: you have built or improved pipelines, not only used them.
* Production operations experience: you have been on call or handled live incidents and can describe what you did and what changed afterwards.
* Security awareness: least privilege, secret management and working in regulated or compliance-driven environments. ISO 27001, Cyber Essentials and NIST experience is useful.
* Agile delivery and familiarity with Jira and Confluence.

**Preferred (either One Is Enough, Not Mandatory)**

* Experience with blue-green or canary releases, or with changing a live database (schema migration), with a rollback plan.

**How We Work**

* Infrastructure as Code by default. Production changes go through code, with a controlled and recorded route for the rare exceptions.
* Deployment through approved pipelines, promoting through lower environments into production.
* Structured logging with correlation IDs, as a baseline across services.
* Significant design changes are written up as RFCs and reviewed by our Design Authority. Engineers write them. The aim is visible, well-reasoned decisions, not extra process.
* Engineering standards are minimum expectations, increasingly enforced through tooling.

So, if you are ready for a new challenge, a great work environment, and an opportunity to take your career to the next level, don't hesitate to apply today. We are waiting for you!

title: Senior  Platform Engineer
description:
**Company Overview**
At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.
  
  
**Department Overview**
At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future
  
  
What Unified Communications Means at Motorola Solutions
  
  
Motorola Solutions designs its UC ecosystem so that frontline workers, field technicians, office supervisors, and public safety personnel can collaborate seamlessly regardless of the device they carry or the network they connect to.
  
  
**Key Principles Include**
Any Network, Any Device: Connecting traditional two-way radios (such as MOTOTRBO or APX P25) directly to smartphones, tablets, laptops, and dedicated broadband push-to-talk (PTT) handhelds.
  
  
Instant Push-to-Talk (PTT): Expanding high-reliability, sub-second PTT audio from dedicated radio talkgroups to cellular and Wi-Fi networks.
  
  
Integration of Voice, Video, and Data: Unifying voice talkgroups with streaming video (body cameras, fixed surveillance), multimedia messaging, GPS location tracking, and telemetry.
  
  
Core Products & Services in Motorola’s UC Portfolio
  
  
WAVE PTX (Broadband Push-to-Talk)
  
  
A subscription-based carrier-independent cloud service that turns smartphones, tablets, and PCs into push-to-talk communication devices.
  
  
Allows office staff on smartphones or desktops to talk directly into frontline radio channels without needing a physical radio.
  
  
Bridges MOTOTRBO/TETRA/P25 radio systems with cellular networks.
  
  
Critical Connect
  
  
A cloud-based interoperability platform designed specifically for public safety and critical infrastructure.
  
  
Enables mutual aid and cross-agency collaboration by federating disparate communication systems (e.g., allowing police, fire, emergency medical services, and utility teams across different jurisdictions and radio frequencies to join shared talkgroups seamlessly).
  
  
Hybrid Smart Devices (e.g., MOTOTRBO Ion)
  
  
Ruggedized devices that combine the mission-critical audio and durability of a two-way radio with the multimedia and touchscreen capabilities of an Android smartphone.
  
  
Connects simultaneously to DMR radio frequencies, LTE, and Wi-Fi to keep workers connected both inside plants and out in the field.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Role Summary**
We are looking for a strong Senior Platform Engineer to design, build, and evolve the enterprise communication platform that serves as the foundation for engineering teams across the company.
  
  
Leveraging GCP, Kubernetes/GKE, Terraform, GitOps, and automation, you will build scalable, secure, reliable, and reusable platform capabilities that accelerate software delivery, simplify operations, and provide a consistent developer experience.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a hands-on platform engineer who can take ownership from design through production, solve complex technical problems, establish engineering standards, and work across teams to improve the overall platform.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, build, and operate scalable, secure, highly available, and reliable GCP platform capabilities.
* Build and evolve production Kubernetes/GKE platforms supporting business-critical workloads.
* Develop reusable platform capabilities, standards, and patterns that enable engineering teams to deploy and operate workloads consistently.
* Build and manage infrastructure using Terraform and Infrastructure as Code, with a focus on repeatability and maintainability.
* Implement and improve GitOps and CI/CD practices, using tools such as ArgoCD and other CI/CD platforms.
* Develop automation using Python, Shell, or similar technologies to reduce manual operational work.
* Design and implement GCP networking, IAM, compute, storage, load balancing, and security patterns that support application and platform workloads.
* Troubleshoot complex production issues across GCP, Kubernetes, networking, infrastructure, and platform services.
* Improve platform reliability, scalability, performance, security, and operational efficiency.
* Build platform standards and self-service capabilities that improve the developer experience and reduce operational dependencies.
* Participate in architecture and design reviews and provide technical guidance on platform engineering decisions.
* Partner closely with Application, SRE, DevOps, Security, and Architecture teams to understand requirements and deliver platform capabilities.
* Lead or participate in major incident response, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Mentor engineers and contribute to engineering standards, technical practices, and knowledge sharing.

**Must-Have Skills & Experience**

* 10+ years of experience in Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, DevOps, SRE, or a similar engineering role.
* Strong hands-on experience designing and operating GCP production environments.
* Strong production experience with Kubernetes/GKE.
* Strong experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code.
* Hands-on experience with CI/CD and GitOps-based deployment practices.
* Strong understanding of GCP and cloud fundamentals, including:
* Networking
* IAM and access control
* Compute
* Storage
* Load balancing
* Security
* Experience building and operating highly available and scalable platforms.
* Strong production troubleshooting and problem-solving skills across cloud and Kubernetes environments.
* Experience developing automation using Python, Shell, or similar scripting languages.
* Experience taking ownership of platform capabilities from design and implementation through production operations.
* Strong understanding of platform reliability, security, scalability, and operational excellence.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to influence technical decisions across teams.
* Demonstrated technical leadership and ability to mentor engineers.

GCP & Kubernetes
  
  

* Strong hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform in production.
* Strong experience operating Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) in production.
* Good understanding of GCP services and concepts relevant to platform engineering, including:
* VPC and networking
* IAM
* Compute Engine
* Cloud Storage
* Load Balancing
* Cloud DNS
* Secret Manager
* Cloud Monitoring
* Experience with Kubernetes concepts including workload management, networking, ingress, resource management, scaling, upgrades, and troubleshooting.
* Ability to understand and troubleshoot issues across the GCP → GKE → workload stack.

Infrastructure as Code & Automation
  
  

* Experience building reusable platform capabilities that can be consumed by multiple engineering teams.
* Ability to establish standardized patterns and guardrails without unnecessarily restricting development teams.
* Understanding of developer experience and the challenges application teams face when consuming cloud platforms.
* Experience improving deployment workflows, platform usability, and operational consistency.
* Exposure to self-service platform capabilities is highly valuable.
* Ability to reduce operational dependencies and enable engineering teams to become more self-sufficient.

Basic Requirements
  
  
**Preferred Skills & Experience**

* Experience operating enterprise-scale or multi-team GCP environments.
* Experience developing reusable Terraform modules, platform frameworks, or shared infrastructure capabilities.
* Advanced GKE/Kubernetes platform engineering experience.
* Experience with GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar CI/CD platforms.
* Experience with ArgoCD, FluxCD, or other GitOps technologies.
* Experience implementing platform security, governance, and compliance controls.
* Experience with GCP services such as Cloud SQL, Pub/Sub, BigQuery, Memorystore, Artifact Registry, KMS, or similar services.
* Experience with cloud migration or application modernization initiatives.
* Experience working with distributed systems, microservices, and cloud-native architectures.
* Experience working in financial services or other regulated environments.

Travel Requirements
  
  
Under 10%
  
  
Relocation Provided
  
  
None
  
  
Position Type
  
  
Experienced
  
  
Referral Payment Plan
  
  
Yes
  
  
***EEO Statement***
Motorola Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally-protected characteristic.
  
  
We are proud of our people-first and community-focused culture, empowering every Motorolan to be their most authentic self and to do their best work to deliver on the promise of a safer world. title: Platform Infrastructure / Site Reliability Engineer
description:
****Our Mission****
SPAN is enabling electrification for all ⚡
  
  
We are a mission-driven company designing, building, and deploying products that electrify the built environment, reduce carbon emissions, and slow the effects of climate change.
  
  
Decarbonization is the process to reduce or remove greenhouse gas emissions, especially carbon dioxide, from entering our atmosphere.
  
  
Electrification is the process of replacing fossil fuel appliances that run on gas or oil with all-electric upgrades for a cleaner way to power our lives.
  
  
At SPAN, we believe in:
  
  

* Enabling homes and vehicles powered by clean energy
* Making electrification upgrades possible
* Building more resilient homes with reliable backup
* Designing a flexible and distributed electrical grid

****The Role: Platform Infrastructure & Site Reliability Engineer****
We are seeking experienced engineers who are self-starters with entrepreneurial spirit to join our Platform Infrastructure & Site Reliability Engineering team. You will be instrumental in leading the design, implementation, and maintenance of our next-generation infrastructure and developer platforms, as well as ensuring the reliability and performance of production systems. This dual-focused role leverages Kubernetes, Pulumi, Istio, AWS, and related technologies to deliver robust and scalable systems in a microservices environment.
  
  
**Site Reliability Engineers**
will work closely with other teams to maintain high system availability and performance, monitor production environment, respond to incidents, and continuously improve reliability engineering practices. Note: Site Reliability Engineer work timings are from 3 PM to 12 AM IST.
  
  
If you thrive in a fast-paced setting, enjoy taking initiative, and are passionate about building innovative platform and reliability solutions, we’d love to speak with you!
  
  
****Key Areas****
**Automate & Refine**
: Automate and improve how we run things in AWS and Kubernetes, making sure our microservices and IoT systems run smoothly, securely, and cost-effectively.
  
  
**Support & Collaborate**
: Work with development teams, troubleshoot issues, and share best practices.
  
  
**Strategize & Innovate**
: Suggest new technologies, optimize pipelines, and streamline processes to enhance performance and reliability.
  
  
**Site Reliability Engineering**
: Monitor site uptime and performance, respond to incidents, root cause analysis, implement reliability improvements, and participate in on-call rotations (3 PM to 12 AM shift for SREs).
  
  
****Responsibilities****
****Platform Infrastructure (Common Responsibilities)****

* Develop and maintain infrastructure-as-code (IaC) solutions using Pulumi for provisioning and lifecycle management of cloud resources.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify and automate manual processes, improving operations and CI/CD pipelines.
* Design, build, and maintain continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines for microservices.
* Ensure best practices for testing, observability, and security are incorporated into pipeline workflows.
* Lead deployment and lifecycle management of Istio and related service mesh components.
* Architect and manage AWS services (EC2, EKS, Lambda, S3, IoT Core) for scalable solutions.
* Provide and maintain internal developer tools and frameworks that boost productivity and quality.
* Implement observability solutions (logging, monitoring, alerting) for platform components using tools like Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, or similar.
* Define SLOs/SLAs and ensure the platform meets or exceeds reliability standards.

****Site Reliability (Additional Responsibilities)****

* Monitor production systems for uptime, performance, and reliability, responding promptly to incidents.
* Troubleshoot, conduct root cause analysis, and implement resilient solutions to prevent future issues.
* Enhance reliability through automation of recovery, scaling, and maintenance tasks.
* Collaborate on capacity planning, scalability projects, and disaster recovery drills.
* Participate in on-call rotation (3 PM to 12 AM IST shift).

****About You****
****Required Qualifications****
We are seeking seasoned engineers with hands-on experience in:
  
  
**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent work experience).
* 5+ years in software engineering, DevOps, platform or site reliability engineering, with proven leadership in large-scale system design and operations.

**Technical Skills**

* Deep experience in architecture, scaling, and operating Kubernetes clusters.
* Experience with Python for tooling and IaC development.
* Expertise with CI/CD tools like Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or similar for microservices deployment.
* Proficiency with Pulumi or similar IaC tools (Terraform, AWS CloudFormation).
* Proven experience deploying and managing Istio or equivalent service mesh.
* Strong knowledge of AWS services (EC2, ECS/EKS, Lambda, S3, RDS, IoT Core) and best practices.
* Familiarity with IoT technologies and data ingestion strategies.
* Experience with developer tooling, code quality metrics, and integrated developer environments.
* For SRE: Experience in incident response, monitoring, site reliability practices, and on-call participation (including non-standard hours).

**Soft Skills & Attributes**

* Self-starter with initiative in identifying and owning solutions.
* Leadership and influence across teams.
* Collaborative communicator across diverse technical/non-technical groups.
* Analytical problem-solver for complex distributed systems.
* Adaptability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

****Life at SPAN****
Our Bengaluru team plays a pivotal role in SPAN’s continued growth and expansion. Together, we’re driving innovation, product development, and operational excellence for home energy solutions.
  
  
As part of our team in India, you’ll collaborate closely with teams in the US and worldwide, fostering innovation, learning, and growth and helping us achieve our bold mission of electrifying homes and advancing clean energy globally.
  
  
Our in-office culture encourages dynamic interactions, hands-on teamwork, and values every team member’s contributions.
  
  
Our climate-focused culture is driven by forward-thinkers, engineers, and problem-solvers who push boundaries every day.
  
  

* Do mission-driven work: Every role at SPAN directly advances clean energy adoption.
* Bring powerful ideas to life: We encourage diverse ideas and perspectives.
* Nurture an innovation-first mindset: Big thinking and bold action are valued.
* Deliver exceptional customer value through hard work and excellence.

****Benefits at SPAN India****
⚡ Generous paid leave
  
  
⚡ Comprehensive Insurance & Health Benefits
  
  
⚡ Centrally located office in Bengaluru with easy access to public transit, dining, and city amenities
  
  
Interested in joining our team? Apply today and we’ll be in touch with the next steps!

**Job Description**
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human
  
  
Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.
  
  
This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.
  
  
What You’ll Be Doing
  
  

* Design, build, and operate highly scalable, reliable, and secure infrastructure powering our production systems across AWS and GCP.
* Lead major reliability and modernization initiatives, including container platform migrations (e.g., ECS to EKS/GKE) and microservice enablement across multi-cloud environments.
* Serve as a technical authority in Kubernetes (EKS and GKE), cloud infrastructure (AWS and GCP), and modern CI/CD practices (GitOps, automation pipelines).
* Partner with development teams to architect and enable microservice-based applications, ensuring production readiness, scalability, and observability.
* Implement and manage infrastructure as code (Terraform, Ansible) to automate provisioning, scaling, and configuration management across multiple cloud providers.
* Drive improvements in observability, performance, and cost efficiency through robust monitoring, logging, and alerting systems that span AWS and GCP.
* Champion SRE best practices — defining SLOs/SLIs, conducting blameless postmortems, and continuously improving incident response.
* Lead complex technical projects from conception to completion, managing timelines, and technical dependencies across teams.
* Mentor engineers across teams, fostering a culture of reliability, automation, and continuous learning.
* Collaborate with security and compliance partners to ensure infrastructure adheres to best practices and standards (e.g., IAM Federation, Workload Identity).
* Participate in the on-call rotation, using incidents as learning opportunities to enhance systems and processes.

**What You’ll Bring To The Role**

* Strong hands-on experience architecting and operating cloud-native distributed systems (AWS and GCP).
* Deep expertise with Kubernetes (EKS and GKE) — design, provisioning, scaling, and advanced troubleshooting in production.
* Proven experience leading ECS to EKS/GKE migrations and driving microservice enablement initiatives at scale.
* Proficiency with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform (multi-provider), Ansible, or CloudFormation.
* Solid coding and scripting ability in Python, Go, or Shell, with a focus on automation, tooling, and operational excellence.
* Advanced understanding of CI/CD pipelines (ArgoCD, GitLab CI, Spinnaker), Linux systems, and networking fundamentals (Direct Connect/Interconnect, DNS, routing, load balancing).
* Experience managing databases and caching systems (e.g., RDS/Cloud SQL, Redis/Memorystore, PostgreSQL, MySQL) in cloud environments.
* Hands-on experience with observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Loki, OpenTelemetry, Google Cloud Operations) for performance and reliability insights.
* Working knowledge of container security, secrets management (HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, Google Secret Manager), and compliance in production environments.
* Strong communication and problem-solving skills, with demonstrated success leading cross-team projects and mentoring peers.

**Experience**

* 5+ years in SRE, DevOps, or Infrastructure Engineering roles.
* 3–5 years of experience with Kubernetes (EKS/GKE) and related ecosystem tools (Helm, Karpenter, etc.) in production.
* 3–5 years of experience with AWS and GCP.
* 3–5 years using Terraform to manage multi-cloud infrastructure.
* 5+ years of coding experience in Python, Go, or similar languages.
* Proven track record leading high-impact projects, specifically migration projects (ECS → EKS/GKE) and enabling microservice architectures.
* Experience implementing SLOs/SLIs, performing root cause analyses, and improving operational resilience.
* Prior work in SaaS or high-scale, cloud-native environments is a strong plus.
* Strong Linux and security fundamentals.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent hands-on experience.

Okta

**About Us**
Okta, Inc. is an identity and access management company headquartered in San Francisco. Founded in 2009 by Todd McKinnon and Frederic Kerrest, it provides the Okta Platform and Auth0 Platform so organisations can securely connect the right people to the right technologies. It is a public company listed on Nasdaq (OKTA). As of 31 January 2026, it had 6,366 employees.
  
  
Follow Okta
  
  
LinkedIn YouTube Facebook Twitter Website
  
  
Benefits & perks
  
  

* Competitive healthcare: medical, dental and vision coverage, plus early cancer detection screenings for eligible employees (2026 Total Rewards Snapshot)
* Financial benefits: spending and savings accounts, company-paid basic life and accident insurance (two times annual salary, up to $500,000), and a 401(k) plan with a dollar-for-dollar match up to $1,250 a quarter ($5,000 a year)
* Employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) to buy Okta stock at a discount, plus short-term incentives (bonus or commission) and, for most eligible employees, annual RSUs
* Flexible PTO, company-provided holidays, a recognized Wellbeing Week, sick time, and competitive leave programmes
* Parental leave of up to 18 weeks at 100% of base pay (you may take it all at once or break it up, as published in the 2026 snapshot)
* Mental health resources, a wellbeing reimbursement programme, family support programmes (including Carrot family-building benefits), and voluntary benefits
* Okta for Good / 1% Pledge: time, product and equity committed to social impact, with employee volunteering opportunities
* San Francisco HQ amenities described in an official 2025 intern guide: on-site gym, Golden Gate Café barista, free office lunches on Wednesdays and Thursdays, and a games lounge / speakeasy

Why explore a career with us
  
  

* A high-performance culture of ownership: Okta says excellence is how it operates every day: it builds for scale, acts with urgency, and gives people autonomy to own their outcomes and drive the future of identity.
* Benefits that support work and life: The official careers page and 2026 Total Rewards Snapshot describe competitive healthcare, financial benefits, flexible PTO, a recognized Wellbeing Week, and programmes for everyday wellbeing.
* Okta for Good and the 1% Pledge: Through Okta for Good and its 1% Pledge, the company says it commits time, product and equity to social impact, and gives employees a platform to volunteer and give back.
* Belonging, with ERGs to match: Okta says belonging is how it operates. Official careers copy describes Employee Resource Groups as dedicated communities for connection, mentorship and sharing backgrounds and passions across the company.
* Help define the future of identity: Okta markets itself as The World’s Identity Company™, with a vision to free everyone to safely use any technology, and invites people to help secure human and machine identities in the age of AI.

Interview process
  
  

* Apply on the official careers site: Candidates apply through Okta’s careers pages; “View open roles and See all jobs” lead to the official Okta job listings.
* CodeSignal pre-screen (technical roles): For internship and new-graduate technical roles, Okta’s official Early Careers FAQ lists a CodeSignal pre-screen as the first interview step.
* Recruiter screen: The same official FAQ lists a recruiter screen for both technical and non-technical internship and new-graduate roles.
* Technical interview, or team-member interviews: Technical early-career roles then have a technical interview. Official non-technical early-career roles have team-member interviews instead.
* Hiring manager interview: The official Early Careers FAQ ends both the technical and non-technical internship and new-graduate processes with a hiring manager interview.

title: ML Platform Lead Engineer
description:
**Corporate Overview**
The Markets and Corporate Engineering Divisions in LSEG has embarked on a Data Science and AI/ML Transformation Program. The objective is to establish a new, centralized, and secure cloud-native platform Data Science and AI/ML on AWS to support modern application and infrastructure delivery. The operating model is a federated model with Core Engineering teams based in London/Bucharest/Bangalore and Engineers embedded within each Business division to drive adoption, automation, and platform engineering standards.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* As a ML Platform Lead Engineer, you will play a key role in designing, building, automating, and supporting cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines across the Data Science and AI/ML platform.

title: Sr Production Engineer (SRE / Dev-Python)
description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.
  
  
We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.
  
  
Role
  
  
We are looking for a Senior Production Engineer to join our team. This is a Hybrid role, reporting to the Manager, Site Reliability Engineering in the Cloud Infrastructure & Operations department. Join Zscaler to be a force multiplier for the reliability of a global platform protecting over 15 million users, providing the technical vision and hands-on execution to drive an automation-first culture across the company. By maturing our observability and architectural standards, you will directly reduce our Mean Time to Mitigate (MTTM) and shape the scalability of our globally distributed, multi-cloud infrastructure.
  
  
What you’ll do (Role Expectations)
  
  

* Design and implement highly available, scalable infrastructure across AWS, Azure, GCP, and bare-metal environments
* Drive an "automation-first" culture by writing code (Python/Go) to eliminate manual toil and build self-healing systems
* Implement and maintain sophisticated observability (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry), define SLIs/SLOs, and establish error budgets
* Act as a lead Incident Commander (TDO on-call), develop response playbooks, and conduct deep-dive post-incident analyses
* Partner with Engineering and partner teams to conduct operability reviews

Who You Are (Success Profile)
  
  

* Comfortable navigating ambiguity and dynamic environments, viewing uncertainty not as a hindrance but as an opportunity to build meaningful solutions.
* Driven by a strong sense of ownership and bias for action, operating with integrity while seamlessly balancing high-level strategy with hands-on technical execution.
* Laser-focused problem solver who proactively runs toward complex engineering challenges to deliver high-impact results.
* High-trust collaborator committed to team success, actively giving and receiving transparent feedback with clarity and respect.
* Purpose-driven learner with an active growth mindset, continuously seeking feedback to grow as a teammate and engineering partner.

**What We’re Looking For (Minimum Qualifications)**

* Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain
* 3 to 5 years of experience managing reliability, scalability, and availability for large-scale production services with deep expertise in programming (e.g., Python, Go, or C/C++)
* Strong background in networking protocols, Linux/FreeBSD systems, and distributed architecture
* Experience in high-stakes incident management and participation in a 24/7 on-call rotation
* Proficiency in leveraging ITIL frameworks and incident data to drive service maturity through systematic problem management and technical operability reviews

**What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)**

* Proven ability to leverage AI technologies, workflows, and AIOps tools to drive measurable operational efficiency, including implementing machine learning models for anomaly detection and predictive capacity planning to automate incident response
* Extensive experience with public cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP), Infrastructure-as-Code (Ansible, Terraform), and chaos engineering or disaster recovery planning at scale
* Expertise in global routing (BGP), traffic tunneling (GRE, IPSec), L7 proxy architectures (HAProxy), DNS at scale, and OS networking stack internals

At Zscaler, we are committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve and the customers we work with. We foster an inclusive environment that values all backgrounds and perspectives, emphasizing collaboration and belonging. Join us in our mission to make doing business seamless and secure.
  
  
**Benefits**
Our Benefits program is one of the most important ways we support our employees. Zscaler proudly offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families throughout their life stages, including:
  
  

* Various health plans
* Time off plans for vacation and sick time
* Parental leave options
* Retirement options
* Education reimbursement
* In-office perks, and more!

Learn more about Zscaler's hybrid working model and benefits here.
  
  
By applying for this role, you adhere to applicable laws, regulations, and Zscaler policies, including those related to security and privacy standards and guidelines.
  
  
Zscaler is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals. We strive to create a workplace where employees are treated with respect and have the chance to succeed. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy or related medical conditions), age, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

Zscaler complies with all applicable federal, state, and local pay transparency rules.

title: Principal Engineer, SRE & Service Operations
description:
Founded in 2014, Circles is a global technology company reimagining the telco industry with its innovative SaaS platform, empowering telco operators worldwide to effortlessly launch innovative digital brands or refresh existing ones, accelerating their transformation into techcos.
  
  
Today, Circles partners with leading telco operators across multiple countries and continents, including KDDI Corporation, Etisalat Group (e&), AT&T, and Telkomsel, creating blueprints for future telco and digital experiences enjoyed by millions of consumers globally.
  
  
Besides its SaaS business, Circles operates three other distinct businesses:
  
  

* Circles.Life: A wholly-owned digital lifestyle telco brand based in Singapore, Circles.Life is powered by Circles’ SaaS platform and pioneering go-to-market strategies. It is the digital market leader in Singapore and has won numerous awards for marketing, customer service, and innovative product offerings beyond connectivity.
* Circles Aspire: A global provider of Communications Platform-as-a-Service (CPaaS) solutions. Its cloud-based Experience Cloud platform enables enterprises, service providers and developers to deliver and scale mobile, messaging, IoT, and connectivity services worldwide.
* Jetpac: Specializing in travel tech solutions, Jetpac provides seamless eSIM roaming for over 200 destinations and innovative travel lifestyle products, redefining connectivity for digital travelers. Jetpac was awarded Travel eSIM of the Year.

Circles is backed by renowned global investors, including Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia), Warburg Pincus, Founders Fund, and EDBI (the investment arm of the Singapore Economic Development Board), with a track record of backing industry challengers.
  
  
**Job Title:**
**Principal Engineer, SRE & Service Operations**
**About This Role**

* Design, implement, and maintain highly available, scalable, and resilient cloud infrastructure across AWS, GCP, and OCI as the primary platforms.
* Provide technical leadership and architectural expertise in Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices — covering observability, incident management, chaos engineering, and reliability frameworks.
* Lead infrastructure automation initiatives using Terraform, Ansible, and Python to drive zero-touch provisioning and configuration management across multi-cloud
* Define and enforce SLOs, SLIs, and Error Budgets across critical services, ensuring reliability targets are met without compromising velocity.
* Architect and operate Kubernetes-based workloads (EKS, GKE, OKE) with a focus on scalability, cost optimisation, and platform resilience.
* Own observability and monitoring strategy using tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, CloudWatch, and Cloud Monitoring to ensure proactive detection and resolution.
* Collaborate with development and platform teams to embed reliability, security, and performance standards into the software delivery lifecycle.
* Lead incident response, post-mortem culture, and continuous improvement initiatives to reduce MTTR and eliminate repeat failures.
* Ensure infrastructure design and operations align with regulatory, compliance, and data sovereignty requirements across cloud regions.
* Evaluate and adopt emerging cloud-native technologies across AWS, GCP, and OCI to drive innovation and operational excellence.

**What You'll Do**

* Design and architect resilient, scalable infrastructure across cloud and hybrid environments with an SRE-first mindset covering reliability, availability, and performance.
* Architect and operate Kubernetes platforms and container workloads with focus on self-healing, auto-scaling, and platform resilience.
* Develop and maintain infrastructure-as-code using Terraform, Ansible, and Helm across AWS, GCP, and OCI environments — driving zero-touch provisioning and configuration management.
* Conduct performance tuning, capacity planning, and load testing to proactively identify bottlenecks and ensure systems scale reliably under peak demand.
* Collaborate with development and platform teams to embed reliability, security, and operational standards into CI/CD pipelines and software delivery lifecycle.
* Drive chaos engineering and resilience testing initiatives to validate system behaviour under failure conditions and continuously harden the platform.
* Establish and enforce SRE best practices, runbooks, and playbooks standardising operational procedures and reducing toil through automation.

reduce toil and manual intervention wherever possibleDrive platform reliability and cost efficiency — monitor infrastructure spend, identify optimisation opportunities, and ensure platform SLAs are metInterested?If you are passionate about leveraging technology to transform regulatory compliance and meet the qualifications outlined above, we invite you to apply. title: N&T Network Designer
description:
Req ID:529773
  
  
At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, more than 80 000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.
  
  
Could you be the full-time
**N&T Network Designer**
in
**Bangalore**
we’re looking for?
  
  
**Your future role**
Take on a new challenge and apply your engineering expertise in a cutting-edge field. You’ll work alongside innovative, collaborative, and results-driven teammates.
  
  
You'll play a key role in designing and delivering N&T Backbone Transmission Network (BTN) specifications that align with the System Delivery Plan, ensuring seamless deployment and integration. Day-to-day, you’ll work closely with teams across the business (installation teams, cybersecurity teams, power experts), contribute to technical reviews, support deployment activities such as installation, testing, and commissioning, and much more.
  
  
You’ll specifically take care of BTN design specifications (Preliminary and Detailed Design), but also contribute to addressing plans and technical room surveys.
  
  
We’ll look to you for:
  
  

* Elaborating N&T BTN Design specifications in line with engineering rules and best practices
* Ensuring adherence to quality processes and promoting ethical conduct
* Minimizing deployment costs, lead times, and risks through efficient design
* Developing BTN requirements with a focus on dimensioning, especially in IP-MPLS network and cybersecurity
* Supporting functional validation and troubleshooting tasks
* Preparing and executing design reviews and managing technical gaps

**All About You**
We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:
  
  

* BE/Master’s degree in Engineering with 8+ years of experience
* Work experience in IP-MPLS solutions (experience with Nokia/Alcatel-Lucent IP-MPLS portfolio is highly preferred)
* Proven experience in LAN/WAN design and deployment of GbEthernet
* Knowledge of RFC protocols, IP routing, QoS, and cybersecurity (802.1x, Radius, Firewall)
* Familiarity with monitoring tools, traffic analysis, and general IP techniques
* Certifications such as CCNP or CCIE (or equivalent)
* Experience with fiber deployments and troubleshooting (desirable)
* Knowledge of major telco suppliers like Cisco, Nokia, Juniper, Huawei, etc.

**Things you’ll enjoy**
Join us on a life-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:
  
  

* Enjoy stability, challenges, and a long-term career free from boring daily routines
* Work with new security standards for rail signalling
* Collaborate with transverse teams and helpful colleagues
* Contribute to innovative projects
* Utilise our flexible and inclusive working environment
* Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries
* Benefit from our investment in your development, through award-winning learning
* Progress towards leadership roles or technical specialisation
* Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage (life, medical, pension)

You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!
  
  
**Important to note**
As a global business, we’re an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

title: Lead UX Designer
description:
**About The Company**
Consilio stands as the global leader in eDiscovery, document review, flexible legal talent, and legal advisory & transformation consulting services. With its Consilio Complete suite of capabilities, the company empowers multinational law firms and corporations using innovative software, cost-effective managed services, and deep legal and regulatory industry expertise .
  
  
**Job Summary**
Consilio builds eDiscovery and legal technology solutions used by legal teams at major organizations. Our users make consequential decisions inside our products — often under deadline, always under scrutiny. The work is high-stakes by nature: decisions made inside our products carry legal weight.
  
  
We're looking for a Lead UX Designer to own design for critical areas of our product suite and to serve as a steward of our design system. Two things make this role unusual. First, you'll be working out how AI shows up inside these workflows. Second, you'll be setting the standards that hold the experience together across a multi-product portfolio, and governing how those standards get used.
  
  
This is an individual contributor role. You will set direction, and you'll have real influence over what gets built.
  
  
**How This Role Operates**
You'll partner with Product and Engineering early — shaping the problem, not styling a decision that's already been made. You'll prototype fast to explore and align, and work with Engineering to keep design and code in sync.
  
  
Our internal design team is small and growing. You'll have more ownership than you'd get at a mature design org, and less existing infrastructure to lean on.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end design for one or more product areas, from problem framing through delivery and post-launch iteration
* Partner closely with Product and Engineering to shape solutions early, not just execute on requirements
* Translate in-flight product strategy into journeys, information architecture, and interaction patterns
* Define the interaction models for AI-assisted workflows: how users understand what the system did, why it did it, and how far to trust it

title: Senior/ Lead Product Designer
description:
**Design the product people use, and the AI agents that work alongside them**

ITILITE runs business travel, expense management, and payments for 500+ customers, with $50M+ in booking volume. We're building on two fronts at once.

* The first is the digital experience people use every day to book, approve, expense and manage spend. 500+ customers and 100k+ users rely on it, and there's plenty of craft left to put into it.
* The second is an AI-first layer, where a growing team of AI agents does the work for people: booking, rebooking, approvals, expense coding and reconciliation. These agents act in the real world, where mistakes cost money and people need to know when to trust the machine.

You'll design for both, and where they meet. When should an agent act, and when should it ask? How does it explain itself? Whether someone is clicking a screen or talking to an agent, it should feel like one product.

**B2B2C: business buyers, consumer-grade expectations**

We sell to businesses, but the people who feel the product are their employees, and they compare us with the best consumer apps they use. So the bar is the delight of a B2C product with the control a business needs. That's a rarer and more interesting design problem than either one alone, and it's why this work is more fun than "business software" sounds.

**Persona**

* Buyer (finance, procurement, leadership) cares about Cost, visibility, return on investment. Your design question: How do we prove value without burying them in dashboards?
* Admin (travel and finance ops) cares about Control, audit-readiness, fewer escalations. Your design question: How do we give them control without making them the bottleneck?
* Employee (the traveller, the user) cares about Speed, convenience, no friction. Your design question: How do we make the right choice the easy choice?

Cost, convenience and control pull against each other, and we don't want you to pick a winner. We want the design where all three feel the value, whether the work is done by a person or an agent.

**Your canvas**

We're in the 1-10 journey. The foundations are solid, the guardrails are sensible, and a good idea reaches production in weeks, not quarters. You won't start from a blank page, and you won't wait on a chain of approvals either. The design system works the same way. Think of it as a house that's mostly built: the foundations are poured, the walls are up, and most rooms already work well. A few rooms are still unfinished, and a few we'd happily knock through if you showed us a better way to live in them. Pick a component that's been bothering you, rethink it, and tell us where the walls should move. You won't redraw the blueprint, but you will shape it.

**What you'll own**

* **The everyday products.**
  Travel, Expense, and Cards—all three. Booking, approvals, expenses, card management, and the admin tools behind them. You'll make complex workflows feel clear and effortless, and sweat the details that make a product feel finished: empty states, errors, latency, edge cases, accessibility.
* **How people and AI agents work together.**
  You'll define when an agent acts, asks or hands back control, how it shows intent and confidence, how people review, override or undo its work, and how an admin supervises many agents at scale.
* **The machine that makes concepts.**
  A PM writes a PRD, and a workflow turns it into four or five solid concepts grounded in our design system. A designer steps in to steer the styling and make the two or three decisions that matter. We don't want our best designers hand-building prototypes or running twenty prompts. We want them to design this workflow once, so anyone on the team, PMs included, gets strong starting points in minutes. You'll own it and keep improving it.
* **The design system.**
  Improve the components and patterns that matter most, build patterns for AI states and complex workflows, and keep it coherent so AI-generated concepts meet the same bar as what we ship.
* **Decisions that move the business.**
  You'll work with Product and Engineering from problem to launch, build research into a team habit, and use funnels, session data and support conversations to find where people struggle. When a problem is hard, you'll lay out the real options, say which one will work and why, and tie it to outcomes like booking completion, policy compliance and support volume.
* **If you're coming in as Lead,**
  you'll also set the bar for craft, research and AI-assisted workflows across the team, run critiques, and grow the designers around you.

**Who we're looking for**

* **Taste you can defend.**
  You explore several directions fast and explain why one beats the others, with logic and evidence, and you understand the business well enough to connect a design choice to cost, risk or retention.
* **Craft and systems thinking.**
  Your work shows sharp interaction and visual design, and you care about design systems the way some people care about a garden: you know what to prune, what to let grow, and when to leave well alone.
* **Complex products, new interfaces.**
  You've shipped products with more than one kind of user, and you're curious about AI, agent or copilot experiences, whether you've shipped them or built side projects that show how you think.
* **AI in your own workflow, and in your team's.**
  You've turned a way of working into something other people use: a workflow, an agent, a prompt library, a template.
* **A good partner.**
  You work well with engineers and PMs, explain your reasoning, and make progress while things are still changing.
* Comfort with Figma, AI prototyping tools and a little code (React, CSS, HTML, Cursor, Claude Code) helps. None of it replaces design judgment.
* **Senior (5 to 7+ years):**
  you can own a complex product area end to end and ship it without hand-holding.
* **Lead (6 to 9+ years):**
  you've led designers or a product area, and built the workflows and standards a team runs on.

**What you get**

* **Real ownership**
  of an important part of multiple products, with a direct line to product & design leadership.
* **A rare design challenge:**
  consumer-grade experience at business scale, with AI agents in the mix.
* **Room for your craft:**
  a strong design system to improve and real customer problems to solve.
* **An AI-first way of working,**
  with the tools and space to build workflows that make the whole team better.

**This role may not be for you if**

You want a blank canvas, or a place where every change needs a long chain of approvals. You'd rather build a design system from scratch than shape a good one. You'd rather hand-build every prototype than build something the whole team can use. Or you want to work only on AI, or only on traditional screens, when this role needs both.

If you read all that and felt a little excited, we'd like to meet you.

title: Staff UX Designer
description:
**Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human**
Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.
  
  
This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

**The Overview**

At Okta, we're building a world where anyone can safely use any technology, and we're specifically focused on protecting the future of work. We bring simple and secure access to people and organizations everywhere, promising to not only protect the identities of our customers' workforce and users but to ask, “what more can we make possible?”

As a Staff Product Designer for Okta, you’ll work with a globally distributed design team to apply your craft and expertise on a range of products and services. Our culture provides the opportunity to explore the technologies we’re researching and investing in. Some of your work will be functional, practical user experience design, where you will help our design team drive cohesive user experience across Okta’s portfolio of products. Other work will be speculative, generative explorations that you carry out in collaboration and partnership across the organization to flesh out, frame, and help prioritize solutions in an ever-evolving and complex, often ambiguous, problem space.

**The Finer Print**

You will lead user experience strategy and execution for our Okta Research & Development (ORD) business unit. Specifically, ORD will solve every identity use case at work – for all types of people (employees, business partners, contractors, frontline workers), for all types of resources (SaaS, servers, privileged resources, machines, etc.), for the largest and most secure businesses in the world. As a designer, your focus will be on helping us build a secure, trusted, and unified platform with deep integrations.

**In this role, you have the opportunity to:**

* Lead a holistic, human-centered approach to design.
* Guide and oversee the UX strategy alongside cross-functional partners, collaborating to take products from concept to launch and define the long-term strategy for your product area.
* Design and facilitate co-creation design workshops with Product Management, Engineering, and Design to define opportunities within our products to solve valuable customer problems.
* Craft user-centered artifacts and end-to-end journeys to align teams contributing to Workforce Identity Management around the broader user experience.
* Collaborate with other Okta designers to ensure consistency across interface experiences across different user scenarios.
* Inspire teams to think bigger and act smaller, instilling an iterative process and fail-forward mentality to design simple and delightful user interfaces for new and existing Okta products.
* Advocate, mentor, and educate on the benefits of design thinking to product teams and new designers alike; partnering with UX team members to uphold our principles and standards.
* Mentor junior designers and contribute toward team-level and design practice and process improvements.
* Work with Design Leadership to define and drive the frameworks, contracts, and standards for others to be able to then build on top of and add value to, ensuring the quality of UX delivery.
* Find creative ways to continuously learn from customers and users; collaborating with user researchers to research and synthesize user needs to help conceive, define, test, and evolve solutions for our users across a range of mediums and experiences; Advocate for users and deliver user and customer outcomes in a dynamic work environment.
* Help product designers create success metrics to illustrate a clear understanding of how their designs impact customers.
* Present work, concepts, and new ideas to cross-functional team members, adjacent teams, and senior leadership; working to distill complex technical problems into clear, conceptual models and simple, elegant solutions.
* Keep abreast of competitor products and industry trends, including the practical application of AI in the design process; Perform competitive and comparative analysis to understand existing patterns.

**Who We Are Looking For**

* You have experience leading cross-discipline teams and exemplify leadership.
* You are passionate about solving complex problems, crafting and sharing product and design UX principles to help teams deliver cohesive user experiences.
* You are great at collaborating, sharing work early and often, and seeking constructive feedback from peers and stakeholders.
* You are a pragmatist who actively uses AI tools to improve and accelerate your day-to-day design workflow.
* Demonstrated, hands-on experience using AI-powered design tools (e.g., for ideation, asset generation, or prototyping) in your daily design activities.
* You have the heart of a teacher and can help mentor and train people. You build and share empathy with people to deeply understand them and their needs.
* You are a thought leader, undertaking explorations into new technologies and territories while also delivering practical designs.
* You see design as a partner in shaping strategic and operational product and UX outcomes; comfortable owning all stages of design for multiple teams within a given product area.
* You bring a systems-thinking lens to the conversation.
* You are passionate about supporting teams with a wide variety of experience, backgrounds, and interests.
* Your portfolio will show that you've worked on complex and/or technical projects across all aspects of the design process (conceptual design, interaction design, information architecture, and visual design).
* You are adept at working in a diverse, globally distributed team and have experience with remote collaboration tools.

**Qualifications:**

* 8+ years of relevant work experience as a Product Designer or UX Designer, with a portfolio showcasing shipped B2B or enterprise products.
* Degree in a related field or relevant work experience as a Product Designer or UX Designer.
* Proficient in Figma, Sketch, Adobe Creative Suite, and/or similar design tools.
* Possesses at least a basic understanding of HTML/CSS/JavaScript.
* Can provide a digital portfolio that showcases solid skills across a variety of projects, including work that has been seen and used successfully in actual products. (Portfolio link required when applying.)
