title: Associate Director UX/CX Designer,
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start
**Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**
Strategic Focus: 20% Strategic, 40% Managerial, 40% Tactical.
  
  
The Enterprise Digital Product Office (EDPO) at Optum is a centralized organization focused on accelerating digital transformation across the enterprise. The team partners across business, technology, and operations to design, build, and scale product-centric solutions that improve customer experiences, optimize operational workflows, and deliver measurable business outcomes. The team drives consistency in product strategy, agile delivery, and design practices, enabling teams to operate with greater speed, clarity, and impact. By aligning cross-functional stakeholders and leveraging modern technologies, including cloud platforms, data, and AI, the organization supports the development of scalable, user-centered solutions that help advance Optum's mission to build a more effective and equitable health care system.
  
  
As an Associate Director, Product Design, you will lead a team of Product Designers while owning end-to-end customer experiences, product journeys, or strategic initiatives. You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Research, Content Strategy, and Business leaders to translate product strategy into a compelling experience vision and drive delivery of high-quality, user-centered solutions.
  
  
This is a player-coach leadership role that combines people leadership, design strategy, and hands-on execution. You will guide and develop designers, influence product direction, foster a culture of design excellence, and remain actively involved in solving complex experience challenges.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Design Leadership & Delivery

+ Own the design strategy, experience vision, and execution for a broad set of features, customer journeys, products, or strategic initiatives
+ Translate business objectives, customer needs, and product strategy into clear design opportunities, experience principles, and actionable design solutions
+ Lead teams in transforming complex and ambiguous problems into simple, elegant, and innovative experiences across web, mobile, conversational, and AI-enabled channels
+ Guide designers in creating user journeys, workflows, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity experiences that bring product vision to life
+ Partner with Product, Engineering, Research, Content Strategy, Analytics, Accessibility, and Legal teams to ensure experiences are desirable, feasible, viable, and compliant
+ Provide design direction informed by user research, analytics, accessibility standards, health literacy considerations, legal requirements, technical constraints, and best practices
+ Drive quality and consistency across multiple concurrent initiatives while balancing customer needs, business priorities, and delivery timelines
+ Collaborate with Design System teams to contribute reusable components, patterns, and standards that improve scalability and efficiency across products
+ Champion accessibility, inclusive design, and health equity considerations throughout the product design process
+ Support teams in identifying opportunities that improve healthcare access, health outcomes, member engagement, and clinical quality measures such as HEDIS and STARS
+ Leverage AI-enabled tools and emerging design methodologies to accelerate workflows, improve team effectiveness, and enhance product experiences

* Design Strategy & Thought Leadership

+ Help define and evolve experience strategy across key customer journeys, products, and business initiatives
+ Lead teams in identifying emerging opportunities in healthcare, digital experiences, and AI-powered products, evaluating their applicability and business value
+ Drive design thought leadership by advocating for customer-centered design practices, innovation, and continuous improvement
+ Navigate ambiguity and help teams achieve clarity, alignment, and momentum in complex problem spaces
+ Constructively challenge assumptions and existing approaches to uncover new opportunities and improve customer experiences
+ Frame problem spaces, establish priorities, define success measures, and structure work to deliver meaningful outcomes
+ Influence stakeholders through solid storytelling, facilitation, strategic thinking, and evidence-based design recommendations
+ Foster a culture of curiosity, experimentation, and continuous learning across the design organization

* Team Leadership & Management

+ Lead, coach, and develop a team of Product Designers, creating opportunities for career growth, skill development, and increased impact
+ Foster an inclusive, collaborative, and high-performing team culture grounded in trust, accountability, creativity, and innovation
+ Establish clear expectations, performance standards, and development plans for direct reports
+ Lead design critiques, coaching sessions, workshops, and working sessions that elevate the quality of design across teams
+ Review and approve work produced by team members, partners, and agencies to ensure consistency, quality, and alignment with experience standards
+ Support resource planning and prioritize team efforts across strategic initiatives and product delivery needs
+ Build solid partnerships across Product, Engineering, Research, and Business organizations to drive alignment and successful outcomes
+ Promote employee engagement, retention, and professional development through effective coaching and people leadership
+ Serve as a trusted advisor and representative of the design organization across cross-functional teams and leadership forums

* Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any and all directives (such as, but not limited to, transfer and/or re-assignment to different work locations, change in teams and/or work shifts, policies in regard to flexibility of work benefits and/or work environment, alternative work arrangements, and other decisions that may arise due to the changing business environment). The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so

**Required Qualifications**

* 10+ years of experience designing digital products and experiences across web, mobile, and emerging digital platforms
* 2+ years of experience leading, coaching, or managing product designers and design teams
* Proven experience owning and delivering complex end-to-end customer experiences, product journeys, or strategic initiatives
* Experience partnering with Product, Engineering, Research, and Business leaders in Agile product development environments
* Demonstrated success translating product strategy and business goals into meaningful customer experiences and measurable outcomes
* Solid portfolio showcasing both strategic thinking and hands-on product design execution across complex products and services
* Deep expertise in user experience design, interaction design, information architecture, accessibility, service design, and human-centered design methodologies
* Expert proficiency with Figma, prototyping tools, and modern design workflows
* Solid communication, facilitation, storytelling, and stakeholder management skills
* Ability to lead teams through ambiguity while balancing strategic priorities and executional excellence.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience leading design teams responsible for enterprise software, healthcare products, or large-scale digital ecosystems
* Experience designing AI-powered, conversational, generative, or agentic experiences
* Experience driving adoption of design systems and reusable experience patterns
* Experience collaborating with globally distributed teams, including U.S.-based stakeholders
* Healthcare experience preferred but not required. Experience in similarly complex or regulated industries such as insurance, financial services, telecommunications, life sciences, pharmaceuticals, or enterprise software is also valued
* Experience designing accessible experiences that align with WCAG 2.1 AA requirements
* Demonstrated experience incorporating health equity, accessibility, and inclusive design principles into product development
* Experience using AI-enabled tools to improve research, ideation, design exploration, prototyping, documentation, and workflow efficiency

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone - of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income - deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

title: Brand & Content Designer
description:
**About The Role**
We are an AI-first company. We build AI for large, regulated businesses — software that reaches decisions at the point of contact, in the places work actually happens, away from a desk — and we run on AI internally too. Our market is expanding quickly and we are growing with it, which is the reason this role exists.
  
  
The Brand & Content Designer makes what this company shows the world. You work closely with the Head of Marketing, who sets the direction and owns the brand system and is hands-on in production alongside you. You will be one of the first people in this function, with the range and the visibility that comes with that.
  
  
The brief is broad and the pace is quick — several formats a week rather than one campaign a quarter — which is possible only because we work AI-first. That is a hard requirement, not a preference: if an AI creative suite is not already part of how you design, edit and produce today, this is not the right role for you. Our design language is warm minimalism: no decoration, generous whitespace, typography doing the work.
  
  
**WHAT YOU WILL DO?**

* Decks and sales collateral. Client decks, proposals, one-pagers and vertical kits, at the pace sales needs them, without the brand drifting.
* Social and campaign creative. Daily social assets, campaign visuals, account-specific landing page design, event and email creative.
* Illustration. Extend our illustration system to new scenes and verticals — vector work in Illustrator, consistent with the existing set.
* Video and motion. Short product films, customer story edits, social cutdowns, motion graphics and versioning.
* Shoot-to-edit where needed.
* AI-led production. Use image, video and generative design tools to compress production time — and know where they fail and hand work back to craft.
* Brand consistency. Apply the visual system across everything the company sends out, and catch off-brand work before a customer does.
* Templates and kits. Turn every finished asset into a reusable template, so the next version takes an hour and anyone can produce it.
* Web and light layout. Design and lay out pages in our CMS or design tool, working with the growth marketer who builds and ships them.

**EXPERIMENTAL WORK**
A standing part of this role is work nobody in our space has done yet. We protect time for it, ship it publicly, and expect some of it to fail.
  
  

* Generative film and motion at a volume a conventional team cannot reach.
* An illustration system extended by models trained on our own visual language.
* Interactive, explorable pages where the industry sends static one-pagers, and creative built for a single named account in hours rather than weeks.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR?**

* You already work AI-first. Image, video and generative design tools are part of your daily practice today — not something you have read about or mean to try. Show us what you have made with them, and tell us where they failed you.
* 3–5 years designing and producing marketing content, ideally at a startup or small in-house team where you made everything yourself.
* Strong across the Adobe toolset — Illustrator especially, plus Photoshop, InDesign and Premiere or After Effects. Figma for layout.
* Real illustration ability — not stock, not clipart. You can draw within an existing visual system and keep it coherent.
* Video editing done end to end, including motion graphics and sound. A reel matters more than a résumé here.
* Typographic discipline — our language is minimal, so spacing, hierarchy and restraint are the craft.
* Fast, organised and comfortable with volume — multiple briefs a week, versioned properly, delivered on time.
* You take direction well and improve on it. The brand system is owned by the Head of Marketing; the making sits with you.

**BONUS POINTS**

* You already build and ship what you design — no-code site builders, AI-assisted web tools, HTML and CSS
* B2B or enterprise design experience
* Presentation design at speed
* Generative visual work
* Copywriting instincts for headlines and captions.

**WHERE THIS GOES?**
You are early. The templates, illustration system and production methods you build now become what the next designers work from, and the brief widens as fast as you can take it on — toward owning the brand system, or toward leading content production. You will also learn to build and ship what you design.
  
  
Skills:- Visual Designing, Brand Design, Content Design, Graphic Designing, Illustration, Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Indesign, Adobe Premiere Pro, Adobe After Effects, Figma, Presentation / Deck Design, Sales Collateral Design, Social Media Creative, Campaign Creative, Landing Page, Web design, Video Editing, Motion graphics, Sound / Audio Editing, Typography, Visual Hierarchy, Brand Guidelines, Design Systems, Visual Systems, Templates, Creative Versioning, High-Volume Production, User Experience (UX) Design, Anthropic Claude and Social Media Marketing (SMM)

title: Mobile Engineer
description:
****Our Mission****
**SPAN is enabling electrification for all ⚡**
**We are a mission-driven company designing, building, and deploying products that electrify the built environment, reduce carbon emissions, and slow the effects of climate change.**

* Decarbonization is the process to reduce or remove greenhouse gas emissions, especially carbon dioxide, from entering our atmosphere.
* Electrification is the process of replacing fossil fuel appliances that run on gas or oil with all-electric upgrades for a cleaner way to power our lives.

**At SPAN, we believe in:**

* Enabling homes and vehicles powered by clean energy
* Making electrification upgrades possible
* Building more resilient homes with reliable backup
* Designing a flexible and distributed electrical grid

****The Role****
We are seeking an experienced Mobile Engineer at the Senior or Staff level to join to drive SPAN’s mobile solutions. Our mobile apps are the key to unlocking the potential of the SPAN panel for our users by giving them insights and never-before-available control. As a staff mobile engineer, you will evolve the mobile team’s technical culture and help build our apps into industry-leading customer experiences in millions of homes.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Guide and drive technical direction for SPAN’s mobile architecture
* Drive and support the team’s commitment to code craft, cutting edge tooling, monitoring, and TDD
* Design, implement, and test features in our React Native apps
* Work closely with product and design on SPAN’s mobile product and execution strategy
* Grow the knowledge of the team, sharing through pair programming, code review, presentations, example code, and documentation
* Partner with firmware and backend engineers to influence seamless integration with our hardware product
* Partner with QA and Platform Infrastructure to drive an efficient and robust quality system, and speedy, reliable deployments

As SPAN is a startup, this list should be considered neither exhaustive nor complete. This role will require agility and comfort to explore new areas of expertise and responsibility.
  
  
**Potential Projects**

* Lead the team to define and socialize architectural best practices in advance of a major migration
* Collaborate with other functional tech leads on scalability efforts to help us scale to millions of homes
* Collaborate with product and the rest of the mobile team to iteratively deliver value in a predictable way against multi-year projects

****About You****
**Required Qualifications**
We are seeking a seasoned frontend technical leader with the following demonstrable knowledge and experience:
  
  

* 5+ Experience in building and shipping user-facing applications used by large audiences.
* Experience in building mobile app or React web development, with a preference for ReactNative.
* Strong TypeScript experience.
* Unshakable practices around Test Driven Development
* Working closely with design on shared components and a design ecosystem
* Industry best practices around CI/CD for testing and deployments
* Feature flagging strategy and best practices for iterative development
* Outcomes-oriented communication and collaboration skills

**Bonus Qualifications**

* Experience working in the energy industry
* Experience working with IoT devices
* Experience working with gRPC and Protobuf.
* Experience maintaining Monorepo projects

team plays a pivotal role in SPAN’s continued growth and expansion. Together, we’re driving

,
**product development**
, and
**operational excellence**

This international collaboration fosters innovation, learning, and growth, while helping us achieve our bold mission of electrifying homes and advancing clean energy solutions worldwide.
  
  
Our in-office culture offers the chance for dynamic interactions and hands-on teamwork, making SPAN a truly collaborative environment where every team member’s contribution matters.
  
  
Our climate-focused culture is driven by a team of forward-thinkers, engineers, and problem-solvers who push boundaries every day.
  
  

* Do mission-driven work: Every role at SPAN directly advances clean energy adoption.
* Bring powerful ideas to life: We encourage diverse ideas and perspectives to drive stronger products.
* Nurture an innovation-first mindset: We encourage big thinking and bold action.
* Deliver exceptional customer value: We value hard work, and the ability to deliver exceptional customer value.

**Generous paid leave**

**Insurance & Health Benefits**
⚡

*be your best*

title: Azure Security Engineer
description:
**Job Summary**
The Azure Security Engineer acts as the technical subject matter expert and operational lead for cloud security services within the organization's Azure environment(s). The mission of cloud security within the Information Security team is to secure and protect organizational assets, applications, and data across the Microsoft Azure platform. The Azure Security Engineer works within a distributed team to achieve the vision of secure-by-design cloud infrastructure, following the guiding principles of Least Privilege, Zero Trust, and Defense in Depth.
  
  
The Azure Security Engineer has responsibility to support and continuously improve identity, access, and infrastructure security services throughout the organization, enabling business units and application teams to achieve their goals while maintaining a strong security posture. This role requires technical depth in Azure security combined with the ability to translate security findings into actionable outcomes for non-security stakeholders.
  
  

* Cloud Infrastructure Security – design and maintain secure Azure infrastructure including networking, compute, storage, and data protection controls.
* Identity and Access Management – govern user and application access to Azure resources through Entra ID, role-based access control (RBAC), and privileged access management (PAM).
* Security Monitoring and Compliance – establish security baselines, monitor cloud environments for threats and misconfigurations, and support compliance and audit activities.
* Stakeholder Collaboration – work with business and application teams to understand security requirements, communicate findings, and drive remediation of identified risks.

**Responsibilities**

* Act as the technical point of contact for Azure security services to troubleshoot and resolve security issues within the organization's cloud environment.
* Design and implement Azure security controls (e.g., Network Security Groups, Key Vault, Encryption etc…)
* Conduct security assessments, vulnerability scans, and configuration reviews of Azure infrastructure and cloud-based applications.
* Identify security findings and work collaboratively with application and business teams to develop, prioritize, and implement remediation strategies.
* Monitor cloud environments for security events and incidents, escalating critical issues to the security operations team.
* Develop and maintain documentation for Azure security architecture, configurations, and operational procedures.
* Participate in Azure security projects and initiatives, balancing security requirements with business and operational needs.
* Provide security training and guidance to application teams and business stakeholders on Azure best practices.
* Drive continuous improvement to cloud security processes and tools through automation, monitoring, and regular security reviews.
* Participate in security audits and access reviews to identify and mitigate potential risks.
* Collaborate with infrastructure, networking, and platform teams to embed security into cloud operations and deployments.

**Required Qualifications**

* University degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related technical discipline, or the equivalent combination of education, professional training, or work experience.
* 3-7 years of hands-on experience in cloud security, infrastructure security, or identity and access management operations.
* 2+ years of direct experience with Microsoft Azure, including identity services (Entra ID), networking, and security tools.
* Experience with Azure security frameworks and tools (Azure Policy, Network Security Groups, Azure Firewall, Defender for Cloud, Key Vault).
* Demonstrated ability to communicate security findings, risks, and remediation recommendations to non-security stakeholders and business teams.
* Experience engaging with application teams and business units to understand requirements and drive security outcomes.
* Strong technical foundation in cloud security concepts including encryption, network security, identity and access management, and threat detection.
* Experience with scripting or automation (PowerShell, Azure CLI, or similar tools).
* Strong interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills.
* Experience operating within Agile delivery methodologies as a member of a distributed team.
* Comfortable dealing with ambiguity and working through change.
* Works well on a team; supplemented by the ability to work with minimal supervision.

* Design and deliver thought leadership webinars, tech talks and blogs alongside customers and AWS.
* Identify areas for productization and feature enhancement for Quantiphi's product assets and accelerators.

**Core (all tracks)**

* Experience designing highly available, scalable, secure and fault-tolerant systems on AWS, aligned to the AWS Well-Architected Framework.

**Application Modernization**

* Experience modernizing monolithic and legacy applications (Java, .NET, mainframe) into microservices and event-driven architectures.
* Strong knowledge of containers and serverless on AWS: Amazon EKS, ECS, Fargate, Lambda, API Gateway, Step Functions, EventBridge, SQS and SNS.
* Back-end and API development experience in at least one of Java, Python, Node.js or .NET.
* Familiarity with .NET-to-Linux porting, Windows workload modernization and AWS Transform for code modernization.
* Understanding of observability, resilience and application security patterns (CloudWatch, X-Ray, OpenTelemetry).

**Data & Analytics**

* Strong experience migrating and modernizing databases and data warehouses using AWS DMS and SCT, including heterogeneous migrations.
* Good understanding of traditional platforms such as Oracle, SQL Server, Teradata and Netezza, and of moving them to Amazon Aurora, RDS, Redshift and DynamoDB.
* Experience designing modern data platforms and lakehouses on S3, AWS Glue, Amazon EMR, Athena, Lake Formation and Apache Iceberg.

* ETL/ELT experience with tools such as Glue, Informatica, Talend, SSIS or dbt, and strong SQL (queries, stored procedures, functions).
* Strong knowledge of OLTP/OLAP systems and dimensional modelling (star and snowflake schema, Kimball methodology)

**Cloud Infrastructure**

* Experience planning and executing large-scale data center and VMware migrations to AWS, including rehost and replatform with AWS Application Migration Service (MGN).
* Strong knowledge of AWS landing zones and multi-account governance: Control Tower, Organizations, IAM Identity Center and Service Control Policies.
* Networking expertise: VPC design, Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, VPN, Route 53 and hybrid connectivity.
* Experience with backup, disaster recovery and business continuity designs (AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery, AWS Backup).
* Understanding of cloud security, compliance and FinOps: Security Hub, GuardDuty, KMS, cost optimization and right-sizing.

**Good to Have**

* AWS certifications: Solutions Architect – Professional, plus a specialty or professional certification such as DevOps Engineer, Data Engineer or Advanced Networking.
* Experience bringing generative and agentic AI into modernization solutions, such as Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Q Developer and AWS Transform.

* Prior experience in a consulting firm or AWS Partner organization

**Professional Skills**

* Strong written skills for proposals, SOWs and solution documents.
* Ability to manage several concurrent pursuits under tight deadlines.
* Customer-obsessed, commercially aware, and able to balance winning the deal with delivering it profitably.

title: ML Engineer - II
description:
**Who is DexCare?**

  

DexCare optimizes time in healthcare, streamlining patient access, reducing waits, and enhancing overall experiences. Guided by our mission – Nobody waits for care – DexCare addresses tech gaps by aligning supply and demand to modernize healthcare infrastructures for an inclusive ecosystem. We are equally committed to our DEIB mission: Creating an inclusive workplace where diversity drives innovation, equity ensures fairness, and belonging strengthens collaboration, enabling everyone to thrive. 

  

 

  

**What is DexCare?**

  

DexCare, a digital care orchestration platform, streamlines care delivery logistics. It empowers healthcare systems to predict constraints and precisely schedule services, optimizecapacity, and cuts operational costs. Currently serving 57 million patients, including Kaiser Permanente and Providence, DexCare ushers in a new era of digital-care access, ensuring health systems can efficiently track and deliver every hour of capacity for consumer ease.

  
  

For more information, visit
www.dexcare.com
or follow us on
LinkedIn
. 

**About the Role**

  

DexCare is looking for a Machine Learning Engineer II to build the AI systems behind our products. Your primary focus will be Optimize AI, which ingests, structures, and governs complex healthcare scheduling rules and institutional knowledge into a single, verified source of truth. The core problem is turning large volumes of messy, inconsistent, and constantly changing operational knowledge into structured knowledge that people and AI agents can rely on to make decisions.

  
  

This is a hands-on, mid-level role. You will build, ship, and own production ML and LLM systems, working closely with product, engineering, and data teams. Our AI products share a common foundation, so you will also work across them, including Mila, our patient-facing agents, as priorities shift. You will join a well-established team early in the build-out of DexCare’s AI capabilities, with large health systems already using our products. If you enjoy taking ML systems from prototype to production and making them accurate, reliable, and fast, we’d love to hear from you.

**What You’ll Do**
  

  
* Build systems that ingest unstructured and inconsistent source material, such as policies, protocols, rules, and spreadsheets, and turn it into structured, versioned, and verified knowledge.
  
* Build extraction, normalization, and validation pipelines using LLMs and classical techniques; detect conflicts, gaps, and stale information, and route uncertain cases to human review.
  
* Build and optimize Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines that give downstream systems and agents accurate, grounded, and traceable answers with low latency.
  
* Build, ship, and maintain components of the agentic systems that act on this knowledge, including orchestration, tool calling, and state management.
  
* Build evaluation for the systems you ship: ground-truth datasets, accuracy metrics, regression tests that run before every release, LLM-as-judge and human review, and monitoring of quality in production.
  
* Diagnose and improve accuracy, latency, reliability, and cost of ML systems in production.
  
* Build components that can be reused across DexCare’s AI products, and contribute to other products as priorities shift.
  
* Follow ML lifecycle best practices: versioning of models, prompts, datasets, and knowledge; deployment; monitoring; and retraining.
  
* Handle patient and customer data in line with HIPAA and DexCare’s privacy and security standards.
  
  

  
**What You’ll Bring**
  

  
* 3-5 years of experience in machine learning or software engineering, including building and running production ML systems.
  
* Experience building systems that extract, structure, and verify knowledge from unstructured sources, such as documents, policies, or operational data, with measurable accuracy.
  
* Hands-on experience shipping LLM-based agentic systems to production, including orchestration, tool calling, and handling failures with retries and fallbacks.
  
* Experience building retrieval systems and improving their accuracy and latency.
  
* Experience evaluating ML and LLM systems: building eval datasets, defining metrics, and using the results to decide what ships.
  
* Strong Python and software engineering fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, testing, code review, and API design.
  
* Familiarity with MLOps practices and at least one major cloud platform.
  
* Clear communication and the ability to work across product, engineering, and data teams, including across time zones.
  
* Comfort working in ambiguous problem spaces where requirements and data evolve.
  
  

  
**Preferred**
  

  
* Experience with agent frameworks such as LangGraph or Google ADK.
  
* Experience with Azure / AWS and their ML and AI services.
  
* Experience with knowledge graphs, rules engines, or other structured knowledge representations.
  
* Experience with predictive ML or optimization for problems such as forecasting, scheduling, ranking, or matching.
  
* Experience with guardrails, safety classifiers, or red-teaming for LLM applications.
  
* Experience in healthcare or another regulated industry, including handling PHI under HIPAA.

  

**DexCare is an Equal Opportunity Employer**

  

 

  

DexCare is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, caste, religion, colour, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital status, pregnancy or maternity, age, disability, or any other status protected under applicable Indian law. title: Senior Data Scientist_IC3
description:

hub leverages diverse data (product telemetry, infrastructure, sales motions and much more) to generate governed analytics signals like customer health scores, product depth, and churn. * Experience building with LLMs, prompt engineering, Vector DBs, and modern GenAI frameworks (LangChain, Hugging Face, FastMCP, Pydantic).

* Outcome-driven with strong decision-making skills and the ability to prioritize multiple goals while meeting deadlines.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; exceptional attention to detail.

* Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. description:

title: Software Development Engineer 3
description:
**Job Title**
Software Development Engineer 3
  
  
**About Travel Distribution (TRD) AI**
The TRD AI organization is at the forefront of transforming Travel Distribution through Artificial Intelligence. We design and build AI-powered products and platforms that enable travel sellers to deliver smarter, faster, and more personalized services.
  
  
Our ambition is to create a scalable AI ecosystem built on reusable capabilities, robust governance, and trusted data, enabling next-generation solutions such as intelligent automation, decision support, and agentic AI-driven workflows across the travel lifecycle.

As an AI Software Engineer, you will play a key role in designing, developing, testing, and operating the next generation of AI-powered Travel Distribution products.

Working closely with Product Owners, Product Definition Analysts, Architects, and other engineers, you will transform innovative AI concepts into scalable, secure, and production-grade solutions that create measurable value for travel sellers.

title: Senior Staff Machine Learning Engineer

title: Data Engineer - EDP
description:
**Data Engineer, Enterprise Data Platform (EDP)**
**Position Summary**
The Data Engineer, Enterprise Data Platform (EDP) is a hands-on engineer responsible for building and operating the ingestion and curation layers of Bridgestone's multi-cloud Enterprise Data Platform. The EDP is a platform-as-a-service: business units build their own data products on top of it, within guardrails and governance standards this role applies and helps uphold. The platform runs on a Databricks and Unity Catalog backbone spanning AWS and Azure, delivering curated data to business units, BI and analytics teams, and conversational query experiences.
  
  
This role writes code every day. It builds pipelines to the technical standards set by the platform team, and works alongside Platform Engineering, Solution Engineers, Product Owners, and business unit engineering teams. Hands-on Databricks experience and strong data engineering fundamentals are essential.
  
  
**Job Duties**

* Builds and operates industrialized data ingestion and transformation pipelines from source systems through the silver layer of a medallion architecture, using Databricks (Spark, Unity Catalog, Workflows) as the core platform.
* Develops in Databricks as the primary environment — data modeling in Delta, job and cluster configuration, and performance and cost tuning within established platform policies.
* Builds and maintains pipelines across multiple clouds — primarily AWS (Glue, Step Functions, Redshift, Aurora, Transfer Family, S3) and Azure (Data Factory, ADLS) — and executes the migration of native cloud pipelines to Databricks as the destination technology.
* Applies the platform’s guardrails, standards, and reusable patterns in day-to-day delivery, and raises the cases where an existing standard does not fit the problem so the pattern can be improved.
* Participates in design and code reviews, incorporates feedback, and contributes reusable components back to the shared platform codebase.
* Delivers curated, well-modeled, and well-documented data to the BI and analytics teams and to conversational query experiences such as Databricks Genie Space.
* Builds and maintains the curated tables, column and table documentation, and metric definitions that Genie Spaces depend on. When a Genie answer is wrong, investigates and corrects the underlying data model rather than patching the question.
* Uses AI tooling in pipeline development, testing, and documentation within the review standards set by the team, and verifies output before it reaches production.
* Implements data quality checks, lineage capture, and access controls in line with governance and security standards.
* Writes and maintains automated tests, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure as code for the pipelines and components this role owns.
* Monitors production pipelines, responds to data incidents, performs root cause analysis, and documents RCAs and SOPs to stabilize daily operations.
* Documents pipelines, data contracts, and operational runbooks so that work is supportable by others on the team.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, information systems, or equivalent work experience.
* Minimum of 3 years in data engineering or IT development, including 2 years of cloud data engineering in a production environment.
* Hands-on Databricks experience — Spark (PySpark and SQL), Delta Lake, and Unity Catalog. Must have built and operated production pipelines in Databricks, not only used notebooks for analysis. This is the core technology of the platform.
* Strong data engineering fundamentals: data modeling, medallion architecture patterns, partitioning, incremental and CDC ingestion, idempotency, schema evolution, and backfill strategy.
* Demonstrated hands-on pipeline development — not solely support, monitoring, or coordination. This role builds.
* Production experience in at least one major cloud (AWS or Azure), including managed data services, storage, and the basics of identity and access management, with the ability to work across both.
* Strong Python and SQL.
* Experience with pipeline orchestration (Databricks Workflows, Step Functions, Azure Data Factory, or equivalent), including dependency management and scheduling.
* Working knowledge of data governance concepts — cataloging, lineage, data quality, and access control.
* Experience with Git and CI/CD (Azure DevOps or equivalent) to promote code and release packages through environments.
* Ability to perform end-to-end testing and debug issues across distributed cloud services.
* Clear written and verbal communication — able to document work, explain a technical constraint to a non-specialist, and raise blockers early rather than late.
* Practical experience with Agile delivery practices.
* Uses AI tooling as part of a normal working day rather than as an occasional experiment. Candidates will be asked to walk through their own workflow in the interview: which tools, at what points in the work, what they verify before trusting the output, and what actually got faster as a result.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Databricks certification (Data Engineer Associate or Professional) or major cloud certification.
* Hands-on exposure to Databricks Genie — curating the underlying tables, writing space instructions and sample queries, and defining metrics.
* Experience with Databricks Asset Bundles and Terraform.
* Production experience across both AWS and Azure.
* Working knowledge of ingestion from ERP and legacy sources (SAP CPI/SLT/PO, SAP BW, Teradata) into cloud or on-premises databases.
* Exposure to AWS Redshift, Aurora, Glue, Athena, Kinesis, SNS, SQS, DynamoDB, and Azure Synapse.
* Experience working in a large enterprise environment: matrixed teams, multiple business units with differing data maturity, change management, and formal release processes.

**Working Hours**

* Aligned to Bridgestone Nashville Head Office business hours, with overlap at least until 12PM Central Time Zone with rotating shifts to cover US Central time till 4PM CST.

title: BI Data Engineer
description:
****Who we are****

Born in 2014, Yoti is a digital identity and biometric technology company that makes it safer for people to prove who they are. The Yoti app was designed with privacy at its core, giving people a secure way to prove their identity and share third-party credentials with organisations and other people.

Today, we have over twenty million app downloads around the world. We’ve expanded our offering to a suite of business solutions that span identity verification, age verification and estimation, e-signing, AI anti-spoofing technologies and we continue to think of innovative new offerings. 

From day one, we’ve been working to fix an outdated identity system. This is not a journey we make on our own but with policy advisors, think tanks, researchers, academics, humanitarian bodies, our users and everyday people. We are committed to solving identity problems through grassroots research and social purpose initiatives.

****About the Team and the Work****

The BI Engineering team owns the acquisition, storage, modelling and provisioning of data that powers reporting, billing, product decisions and, increasingly, operational features consumed by systems outside BI. Our Redshift-centred warehouse handles hundreds of millions of events a day across a wide suite of products, and the roadmap for the next 18-24 months is the longest and most ambitious it has ever been. We are leveraging AI Workflows and agents across the team for ETL monitoring, query optimisation, code generation, documentation, and performance monitoring. 

You'll join at a point where the team is moving beyond "keep the pipeline running" into four parallel streams of work:

* ****Redshift Optimisation:****

  Optimising cluster and table configurations, including distribution, sort keys, and compression, to improve query performance. Analysing long-running queries and applying query-level optimisations, while leveraging data aggregation and retention strategies to improve performance, reduce storage, and manage data growth effectively.
* ****Data Aggregation & Retention:****

  Designing and building roll-up layers that preserve analytical value while enabling safe deletion of raw-level data. This includes schema design, backfills, data reconciliation, and ensuring backward compatibility for existing reports and consumers.
* ****Data provision:****

  Enabling teams to access data by creating curated, fit-for-purpose datasets and APIs for product, operations, and integrator-facing systems. These externally consumed solutions require high availability and strong data reliability.
* ****Infrastructure and Performance.****

  Strengthening pipeline monitoring through automated setup and built-in notifications, while proactively identifying query optimisation opportunities and cost-efficiency improvements. Defining solutions to manage data limitations and retention, with data volume remaining a key constraint shaping the overall roadmap.

****What will you be doing at Yoti?****

* Own Redshift performance and capacity, balancing reliability, query performance, scalability, and cost.
* Design and deliver data aggregation and retention solutions, including roll-ups, reconciliation, backfills, and safe removal of historical source data.
* Build data-provisioning solutions for product, operational, and integrator-facing consumers, ensuring reliable and accurate access to curated data.
* Build and maintain reliable ingestion and ETL/ELT pipelines, including third-party API integrations and failure handling.
* Establish data quality, reconciliation, and monitoring practices for critical data flows and reporting.
* Apply AI and automation to improve engineering workflows, monitoring, optimisation, and delivery.
* Make informed trade-offs between infrastructure improvements, feature delivery, and compliance priorities.

****Requirements / What are we looking for? (5+ years of experience required)****

****Essential - Redshift depth.****

Deep, hands-on Redshift experience is the single most important requirement. You should be able to talk credibly about:

* Distribution and sort key design, query optimisation, WLM/Auto WLM, concurrency scaling, and Short Query Acceleration.
* Vacuum, Analyse, table maintenance, and managing bloat and unsorted data at scale.
* Redshift Spectrum, external schemas, S3 integration, and cross-cluster data movement using Data Sharing, UNLOAD/COPY, and snapshots.
* Capacity planning, RA3 sizing, workload isolation, and cost optimization.

****Desirable****

* Strong SQL across Redshift and PostgreSQL, including complex queries, window functions, and query tuning.
* Strong Python skills for building ingestion, ETL/ELT, and reconciliation frameworks. Node.js or Go is a plus.
* Hands-on AWS experience across S3, MWAA/Airflow, Lambda, Glue, Athena, IAM, CloudWatch, RDS, and OpenSearch.
* Strong analytical data modelling skills, including dimensional modelling, SCDs, and scalable reporting structures.
* Experience integrating REST APIs, including authentication, pagination, retries, idempotency, and rate-limit handling.
* Experience with containerisation, orchestration, and CI/CD for data workflows.

****Interview Process****

Stage 1 - Call with a Talent acquisition Team member (30 minutes)

Stage 2 - Call with Data Engineer & Chief of Product Operations (60 minutes)

Stage 3 - Technical Evaluation 

****What’s in it for you?****

* Flexible working (Core working hours, Hybrid working)
* Performance based discretionary annual bonus
* LTIP (Long term incentive plan)
* Medical Insurance cover of INR 5 lakhs
* Life Insurance / Accidental cover
* Gratuity as per law
* PF as per law
* 18 days paid leave + 6 sick day leave (Annually)
* 10 declared holidays (Annually)
* 5 fully paid days of Selfie Time - for your own personal development, volunteering, charity events, etc
* Quarterly Team and company activities, Social clubs.
* Continuous learning opportunities (Annual Training budgets, conferences etc)

This is a great opportunity to join a company that is leading the way for innovative and responsible identity verification. We’re looking for people who can adapt to a fast-paced environment, as well as champion our brand and what we stand for. We value a positive attitude and people who have a collaborative, creative and transparent approach to solving problems.

****AI Usage during the recruitment process****

Please read our


AI Usage in Recruitment policy

to know more about how Yoti uses AI in the recruitment process and our stance on how candidates can use AI during the interview process.

****We believe in equal opportunities****

It takes a diverse community of passionate, talented and committed people to build a simpler, more secure way of proving identity. We’re an equal opportunity employer, so we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, with different outlooks and experiences. 

We are proud to be a Disability Confident employer and we’re committed to making our recruitment process as inclusive and accessible as possible. If you have a disability or long-term condition and need any adjustments or support during the application or interview process, please let us know — we’ll do everything we can to support you and to enable you to bring your best self to our hiring process.

****Pre-employment checks****

If your application is successful please be aware that as part of our pre-employment checks, we will check identity and proof of education. If you have previously been employed elsewhere, we will also carry out - Employment, Credit and  Database Checks. 

For more information about how we manage your data  please read our

title: Lead Data Engineering - Product Engineering & Delivery
description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they are doing!
  
  
*We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.*
Role Overview
  
  
Cogentiq I2C is Fractal’s agentic AI Product for invoice-to-cash, covering Collections, Cash Application, Deductions, Invoice Management and Credit Risk. It runs on a Next.js front end, a FastAPI service layer, the Cogentiq agentic runtime, and a data tier on Azure Databricks with PostgreSQL.
  
  
We are looking for a hands-on
**Data Engineering Leader**
with strong experience in building scalable, configurable, and cloud-agnostic data engineering solutions. The role requires a combination of deep technical expertise, product engineering mindset, and proven ownership of enterprise client deliveries.
  
  
A critical requirement is
**hands-on experience across at least two cloud data engineering platforms**
, with the ability to design portable PySpark-based pipelines and migrate workloads between platforms with minimal rework
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Data Engineering & Architecture: Design and develop scalable ETL/ELT pipelines, distributed data processing frameworks, Lakehouse solutions, and Medallion architectures (Bronze/Silver/Gold).
* Cloud-Agnostic Engineering: Build reusable, metadata-driven, configuration-based data pipelines that can operate across different cloud environments and processing platforms.
* Multi-Platform Portability: Architect and migrate PySpark workloads across platforms such as Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, AWS Glue/EMR, and GCP Dataproc, managing platform-specific dependencies and optimizations.
* Product Engineering: Develop reusable frameworks, connectors, orchestration capabilities, and accelerators that support multiple enterprise clients with minimal customization.
* Enterprise Integration: Design upstream and downstream integrations with SAP ECC/S/4HANA and other enterprise systems using APIs, BAPIs, IDocs, OData, CDC, and event-driven interfaces.
* Data Governance: Implement data quality, cataloging, metadata management, lineage, security, and reconciliation capabilities.
* DevOps & DataOps: Establish CI/CD, automated testing, infrastructure automation, observability, monitoring, and production support practices.
* Engineering & Delivery Leadership: Lead engineering teams, own architecture and technical decisions, drive end-to-end client delivery, and ensure engineering quality, scalability, and production readiness.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 12+ years of engineering experience, including significant hands-on Data Engineering experience and technical leadership.
* Strong hands-on expertise in Python, PySpark, Spark, SQL, distributed processing, and performance optimization.
* Hands-on experience with at least TWO data engineering platforms, such as: Azure DatabricksMicrosoft FabricAWS Glue / EMRGoogle Cloud Dataproc / Dataflow
* Demonstrated ability to migrate or adapt PySpark pipelines between platforms, understanding differences in execution environments, storage, orchestration, dependencies, and deployment.
* Experience building configurable, metadata-driven ETL/ELT frameworks, reusable components, and cloud-agnostic data pipelines.
* Strong understanding of Lakehouse architecture, Delta Lake, Medallion Architecture, data modeling, cataloging, lineage, and data quality.
* Experience with enterprise systems integration, preferably SAP (upstream ingestion and downstream write-back).
* Experience with DevOps/DataOps, CI/CD, automated testing, and production deployments.
* Proven experience in product engineering, engineering team leadership, and end-to-end enterprise client delivery.

Good-to-Have
  
  

* Experience with additional data platforms, including Snowflake, BigQuery, or Azure Synapse.
* Experience with data governance tools such as Unity Catalog, Microsoft Purview, AWS Glue Data Catalog, or Collibra.
* Experience with streaming pipelines, Kafka, CDC, and event-driven architectures.
* Exposure to ML/AI data pipelines using SageMaker, Vertex AI, or Databricks ML.
* Experience building reusable enterprise data products or accelerators for multiple clients.

Ideal Candidate
  
  
A
**hands-on engineering leader, not just a delivery manager or solution architect**
, who has built production-grade data pipelines, worked across multiple data engineering platforms, understands how to make PySpark workloads portable, and can lead both product development and complex enterprise client deliveries.
  
  
**Critical Hiring Criteria:**
Strong PySpark engineering + hands-on experience across at least two DE platforms + configurable pipeline development + engineering delivery ownership.
  
  
If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!
  
  
Not the right fit? Let us know you're interested in a future opportunity by clicking
*Introduce Yourself*
in the top-right corner of the page or create an account to set up email alerts as new job postings become available that meet your interest!

title: Tech Lead – Knowledge Graph
description:
**Location:**
Bangalore

**Work Model:**
Hybrid — 3 days in office

**About Elucidata**

Elucidata is a Tech Data-centric AI company on a mission to make life sciences AI-ready. Headquartered in San Francisco with a 120+ member team across the US and India, we’re building the future of data-centric AI for drug discovery. Our flagship AI-Agentic powered platform, Polly, helps research teams wrangle, harmonize, and analyze massive volumes of biomedical data, accelerating discoveries and making precision medicine a reality.

Recognized by Fast Company as the “Most Innovative Biotech Company of 2024,” Elucidata partners with 25+ leading organizations, including Pfizer, Novo Nordisk, Google DeepMind, Alnylam Therapeutics, and the Bill & Melinda Gates Research Institute. Backed by top VCs like Eight Roads, F-Prime, IvyCap, and Hyperplane.

With over 200 data products and AI solutions co-developed by 100+ domain experts, we’ve helped our partners achieve 4X faster R&D milestones and contribute to 16 therapies advancing toward FDA approval. At Elucidata, you’ll work at the intersection of AI, biology and impact while solving real-world challenges that accelerate the journey from data to discovery.

**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced, hands-on Tech Lead to drive the design and development of scalable data engineering systems and biomedical knowledge graph infrastructure.

In this role, you will own the technical architecture and execution of data ingestion, processing, and integration pipelines that power our AI/ML-driven solutions for biomedical research and drug discovery.

You will work closely with ML scientists, bioinformaticians, and product teams to build reliable, production-grade systems while driving engineering best practices, mentoring developers, and making critical architectural decisions.

**What You’ll Own**

* Lead the architecture, design, and development of scalable data engineering systems for ingesting, processing, harmonizing, and integrating biomedical and clinical data from diverse sources.
* Own the development and evolution of biomedical knowledge graph infrastructure, including graph data modeling, entity and relationship management, ontology integration, and efficient data retrieval.
* Design and implement robust data pipelines for processing large volumes of structured and unstructured data, including scientific literature, clinical trial records, and multi-omics datasets.
* Build and maintain production-grade backend services and APIs that enable efficient access to biomedical knowledge graphs and support downstream AI/ML applications.
* Establish engineering best practices for data quality, provenance, reliability, monitoring, testing, and performance optimization across data processing workflows.
* Drive technical execution end-to-end, make architectural decisions, conduct code reviews, mentor engineers, and collaborate closely with AI/ML scientists, bioinformaticians, and product teams.

**What Makes You a Great Fit**

* Strong hands-on experience in software and data engineering, with excellent Python programming skills and a demonstrated ability to design and build scalable, production-grade systems.
* Deep understanding of knowledge graph technologies, including graph data modeling, graph databases such as Neo4j, graph query languages, and API technologies such as GraphQL.
* Experience architecting and developing large-scale data ingestion, ETL/ELT, and processing pipelines, including workflow orchestration, distributed processing, and handling heterogeneous data sources.
* Strong proficiency with cloud infrastructure and engineering tools, particularly AWS, Docker, relational/NoSQL databases, and modern data engineering frameworks.
* Experience working with biomedical or healthcare data, including scientific literature, clinical trials, EHR/EMR data, or biological ontologies. Familiarity with clinical data standards such as OMOP CDM and clinical data transformation pipelines would be a significant advantage.
* Proven ability to independently own technical architecture, solve complex engineering problems, make sound design trade-offs, and mentor developers while maintaining high engineering standards.

**Why Join Elucidata?**

* Opportunity to shape the future of biomedical data ecosystems by building partnerships at the frontier of science and healthcare.
* Direct visibility with the CEO and leadership team.
* High-impact role — the partnerships you establish will directly translate into Elucidata’s growth and customer success.
* Work with global leaders and contribute to data-driven drug discovery.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**Company Overview**
Docusign brings agreements to life. More than 1.8 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using the Docusign AI-native IAM platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).
  
  
What you'll do
  
  
The Sr. Front End Software Engineer will own all aspects of the software development lifecycle including design, development, testing, deployment and maintenance of product features in Docusign software products. You will primarily develop customer facing experiences using React/Typescript, as well as backend API UI-facing code either in NodeJS/C#. You enjoy fast-paced entrepreneurial environments where you can solve difficult problems using current technologies and tools. You collaborate well with other team members when brainstorming, designing, and implementing new solutions. You will also help the team succeed by thinking about ways to improve processes, suggesting ways to make the team more effective, and mentoring and modeling engineering best practices.
  
  
This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the Director, Software Engineering.
  
  
**Responsibility**

* Design, develop, and maintain well crafted, responsive and modular UI, using React and Typescript
* Build and maintain microservices and micro-frontend architectures
* Ensure that UI and our entire stack enables responsive and seamless user experiences and functionality
* Work as part of a cross-functional team, proactively get alignment on designs, communicate roadblocks
* Guide and mentor other engineers through design and code reviews
* Work closely with the founders and product managers to understand the why behind each capability in the platform
* Help to drive alignment on the prioritization of engineering-driven priorities alongside product priorities
* Be a key decision-maker in selecting our forward-looking front-end architecture and technology stack

Job Designation
  
  
**Hybrid:**
Employee divides their time between in-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in-office expectation)
  
  
Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.
  
  
What you bring
  
  
**Basic**

* B.S. in Computer Science or similar field of study
* 8+ years of professional experience in fullstack software development utilizing frontend and backend technologies, like React, Typescript, or similar OOP
* Experience with modern web technologies (HTML, CSS, WebSockets, etc.)
* Experience with front-stack engineering using TypeScript, JavaScript, and modern front-end frameworks
* Experience with React
* Experience building end-user-facing product experiences
* Experience working with designers on design systems as well as authoring and maintaining shared components
* Experience working with front-end analytics and experimentation frameworks
* Experience integrating with REST APIs

**Preferred**

* Well-formed opinions based on years of experience ensuring quality through predictable, scalable, and reliable end-to-end testing
* Experience with Microsoft technology stack (Typescript)
* Experience with SQL and NoSQL solutions (e.g., Cosmos DB)
* Experience with Enterprise SaaS software products

Life at Docusign
  
  
**Working here**
Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.
  
  
We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live.
  
  
**Accommodation**
Docusign is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need such an accommodation, or a religious accommodation, during the application process, please contact us at accommodations@docusign.com.
  
  
If you experience any issues, concerns, or technical difficulties during the application process please get in touch with our Talent organization at taops@docusign.com for assistance.
  
  
**AI in Our Hiring Process**
At Docusign, we embrace technology to enhance efficiency and create a better candidate experience. We may record or transcribe interviews using enterprise AI tools to assist with meeting notes and interview documentation so our teams can stay fully engaged in the conversation. All hiring decisions remain 100% human-led. You have the right to opt out at any time by notifying your recruiter or interview team, with zero impact on your candidacy.

We are looking for passionate and technically strong Java Developers to join our engineering team at a product-based technology company. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, testing, and maintaining scalable, high-performance software applications.

You will work on building robust backend systems, developing microservices, integrating APIs, and contributing to the architecture and continuous improvement of our products. **Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend applications using Java and related technologies.

* Passion for building scalable, high-quality software products.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively within engineering teams.
* Strong communication and ownership mindset.
* Willingness to learn new technologies and adapt to evolving product requirements.

What We Offer

* Exposure to modern engineering practices and scalable architectures.
* Collaborative and technically driven work environment.

title: Senior Software Engineer [Systematic Trading Systems]
description:
**Location:**
Bengaluru

**Experience:**
6+ Years

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Work Model:**
Hybrid / As per company policy

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced
**Senior Software Engineer – Python**
to join our Front Office Technology team and contribute to the development of Mercuria's systematic trading platform.

The platform enables trading desks to develop Python-based strategies that execute orders on global exchanges through broker SDKs. This is a hands-on backend engineering role focused on building and supporting live order-routing and execution systems, ensuring high reliability, accuracy, and robust risk controls.

You will work on systems responsible for executing real trades across exchanges such as ICE, CME, and NYMEX, collaborating closely with traders and technology teams in a global production environment.

Key Responsibilities

* Design, develop, and maintain the trading execution engine, including broker connectivity, portfolio state management, risk enforcement, and order persistence.
* Integrate and work with Trading Technologies (TT) SDK for order routing, market data, execution reports, and position management.
* Manage the complete order lifecycle, including order states, partial fills, cancel/replace operations, and reconciliation.
* Build crash-safe order submission and accurate position reconstruction mechanisms.
* Implement pre-trade risk controls, including order and position limits, order-rate limiting, market-data validation, and drawdown controls.
* Develop reliable asynchronous and concurrent services to handle broker callbacks, system restarts, network disruptions, and partial failures.
* Ensure consistency and reliability of distributed systems across failures and recovery scenarios.
* Provide production support for live trading systems, troubleshoot critical incidents, and coordinate effectively with traders and global stakeholders.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* 7+ years of professional experience in Python development, preferably Python 3.11.
* Strong experience in backend engineering, distributed systems, and production-grade applications.
* Hands-on experience developing or supporting live trading systems involving order routing to exchanges or brokers.
* Strong understanding of trading and execution concepts, including order states, execution reports, cumulative and last quantities, partial fills, and cancel/replace.
* Experience with FIX protocols, broker SDKs, or native exchange APIs.
* Strong understanding of asynchronous programming, concurrency, threading, shared-state management, and long-running services.
* Experience building resilient systems that handle restarts, network disruptions, and partial failures.
* Hands-on production support experience, including troubleshooting live issues in time-sensitive environments.

Preferred Skills

* Direct experience with the Trading Technologies (TT) platform, including order gateways and risk/setup administration.
* Experience with AWS cloud services and Kubernetes/EKS.
* Knowledge of Apache Kafka or AWS MSK.
* Familiarity with futures and spread-trading mechanics.
* Understanding of networking concepts, session management, heartbeats, reconnection, message replay, and recovery.
* Familiarity with FastAPI, WebSockets, and MySQL.
* Exposure to Docker, Helm, GitLab CI/CD, Prometheus, and CloudWatch.
* Knowledge of .NET/C# and experience working with SDKs built on the .NET ecosystem.

Technology Stack

* **Languages:**
  Python 3.11, IronPython, .NET/C#
* **Frameworks:**
  FastAPI, asyncio, WebSockets, FastMCP
* **Trading & Connectivity:**
  Trading Technologies (TT) SDK, ICE, CME, NYMEX
* **Messaging:**
  Apache Kafka, AWS MSK
* **Database:**
  MySQL, Amazon RDS
* **Cloud & Infrastructure:**
  AWS, Kubernetes/EKS, ECR, ALB, Secrets Manager
* **DevOps & Monitoring:**
  Docker, Helm, GitLab CI, Prometheus, CloudWatch
* **Security:**
  OIDC/JWT, Keycloak, Azure AD, Role-Based Access Control
* **Frontend:**
  Plotly Dash

Important Information

* **Location:**
  Bengaluru
* The role operates within a global follow-the-sun production support model.
* Candidates should be comfortable supporting business-critical live trading systems and coordinating with global teams.
