title: Senior Software Engineer II
description:
**Who we are**

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

**About the role:**

Samsara Technologies India Private Limited is looking for an experienced Senior Full Stack Software Engineer to be part of our Platform & Infrastructure organization. This org is responsible for building the foundational systems that drive Samsara's products.

**This role is Hybrid - 2 days per week in the office.**

**You should apply if:**

* **You want to impact the industries that run our world:**
  The software, firmware, and hardware you build will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
* **You want to build for scale:**
  With over 2.3 million IoT devices deployed to our global customers, you will work on a range of new and mature technologies driving scalable innovation for customers across industries driving the world's physical operations.
* **You are a life-long learner:**
  We have ambitious goals. Every Samsarian has a growth mindset as we work with a wide range of technologies, challenges, and customers that push us to learn on the go.
* **You believe customers are more than a number:**
  Samsara Technologies India Private Limited engineers enjoy a rare closeness to the end user and you will have the opportunity to participate in customer interviews, collaborate with customer success and product managers, and use metrics to ensure our work is translating into better customer outcomes.
* **You are a team player:**
  Working on our Samsara Technologies India Private Limited Engineering teams requires a mix of independent effort and collaboration. Motivated by our mission, we’re all racing toward our connected operations vision, and we intend to win—together.

**In this role, you will:**

* Work with product managers, designers, staff engineers, and internal/external customers to architect, build, test, and deliver full stack features across the React and TypeScript frontend, the GraphQL layer, and Go backend services.
* Own the load time and responsiveness of high-traffic dashboard pages that show large lists and maps of assets. Measure them with real user monitoring and tracing, find where the time goes in the browser and on the server, and deliver measurable improvements.
* Improve how pages fetch and render data: sequence and batch requests, defer non-critical work, split and lazy-load code, virtualize long lists, and reduce unnecessary re-renders and main-thread work.
* Design and evolve GraphQL schemas, resolvers, and the backend services and data stores behind them, so that pages get the data they need in as few round trips as possible.
* Roll out changes safely with feature flags, staged releases, and before-and-after measurement, and partner with the Web Experience, time-series, and infrastructure teams on shared dependencies.
* Continuously evaluate and improve the performance, reliability, and user experience of our applications.
* Propose technical solutions and guide the technical direction of some of the team’s initiatives.
* Help mentor, develop, and support other engineers on the team, including backend engineers who are growing their frontend skills.
* Maintain a regular feedback loop to allow for implementation iterations and making adjustments.
* Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

**Minimum requirements for the role:**

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science/Engineering or equivalent practical experience.
* 7+ years of relevant industry experience in software development, including production experience on both frontend and backend systems.
* Proficiency in TypeScript or JavaScript and React, including state management, hooks, component design, and automated testing of UI code.
* Proficiency in at least one backend language such as Go, Java, or Kotlin, and experience building and operating APIs (GraphQL or REST) backed by relational or NoSQL data stores.
* Experience diagnosing and improving web performance using browser developer tools, a React profiler, and real user monitoring or tracing tools.
* Excellent communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills, with a demonstrated ability to manage technical discussions and mentor junior engineers.

**An ideal candidate also has:**

* Experience building data-heavy single-page applications with large tables, lists, or interactive maps (for example Mapbox or Google Maps, marker clustering, and live location updates).
* Deep knowledge of browser performance: Core Web Vitals, long tasks and the main thread, bundle size and code splitting, caching, and the cost of network request waterfalls.
* Experience with GraphQL at scale, including schema design, query batching, pagination, subscriptions or live queries, and client-side caching.
* Experience with observability tools such as Datadog RUM and APM, and with defining and tracking percentile-based performance goals.
* Expertise working with web services at massive scale deployed on hyperscalers such as AWS, GCP or Azure.
* Experience with real-time or time-series data and with caching strategies for frequently read, rarely updated data.
* Experience working within a design system and building accessible, internationalized user interfaces.
* Experience writing high-quality, performant, and maintainable code on large-scale enterprise software applications.
* Hands-on experience applying AI/ML techniques or using AI-driven tools to improve system reliability, developer productivity, or customer-facing features.

**Total Rewards**

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

**Flexible Working**

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

**Belonging at Samsara**

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

**Accommodations**

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

**Our Commitment to Authenticity**

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

**Fraudulent Employment Offers**

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

**Engineering practice:**

A new MCP tool that lets an agent read a dataset it cannot reach today, with tests and access checks.

**How We Work:**
**Our core principles:**
Interns work by the same six leadership principles as everyone at CommerceIQ:
  
  
**Ownership:**
Your feature is yours, from the ticket to production and the bugs that come after.
  
  
**Deep Dive:**
Check the data before you trust a chart, including the answers our agents give.
  
  
**GSD (Get Stuff Done):**
Ship a small version early, then improve it.
  
  
**First Principles Thinking:**
Ask why something is built the way it is, and propose a simpler way when you see one.
  
  
**Win as a Team:**
Ask for help early, and review your teammates' code.
  
  
**Hire & Develop the Best:**

title: Principal Storage Software Engineer
description:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.
  
  
****Principal Storage Software Engineer – Cloud & Distributed Storage****
**About The Role**

* We are looking for a highly experienced Storage Software Engineer with 15+ years of software engineering experience to architect, design, and build highly scalable Block, File, and Object Storage platforms and database-aware storage platforms running in Kubernetes environments.
* This role is ideal for a senior technical leader who can architect, design, code, influence, and own complex storage systems end-to-end. You will play a key role in defining the technical direction and evolution of our storage platform while driving engineering excellence and raising the technical bar across the organization.
* This is a deeply hands-on engineering role that combines strong systems programming and coding skills with storage architecture, distributed systems expertise, and technical leadership. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable defining long-term architecture, writing production-quality code, solving complex performance and reliability problems, and guiding engineers through the design and delivery of large-scale storage systems.

****What You’ll Do****

* Architect and develop highly scalable block, file, and object storage systems.
* Build database-aware storage optimized for PostgreSQL, relational databases, distributed databases, and other stateful workloads.
* Use AI coding agents to your advantage to boost productivity and lead us to the future of AI native engineering. Capable of giving the right context and detailed requirements to the Agent.
* Design storage data planes and control planes for Kubernetes environments.
* Develop Kubernetes-native storage integrations using CSI, operators, controllers, CRDs, and storage classes.
* Write production-quality systems software in C++, Go, Rust, Java.
* Design for high availability, data durability, fault tolerance, replication, recovery, snapshots, cloning, and disaster recovery.
* Optimize storage for IOPS, throughput, latency, tail latency, CPU efficiency, and network utilization.
* Debug complex problems across databases, Kubernetes, Linux, networking, and storage layers.
* Lead architecture and design reviews and establish technical direction for storage platforms.
* Mentor engineers while remaining deeply hands-on with architecture, design, coding, and troubleshooting.
* Be responsible for the outcome of the domain’s work.

****What We’re Looking For****

* Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering.
* 15-18 years of software engineering experience with strong expertise in storage, distributed systems, databases, or infrastructure software.
* Deep knowledge of storage domains: block, file, object, or database storage.
* Strong systems programming skills in C++, Go, Rust, Java.
* Strong understanding of Linux storage and I/O architecture.
* Experience building and operating distributed systems at scale.
* Strong Kubernetes and cloud-native infrastructure experience.
* Understanding of distributed systems concepts including replication, consensus, consistency, failure detection, data placement, and recovery.
* Experience with storage technologies and protocols such as NVMe, NVMe-oF, SCSI/iSCSI, UBD, S3, CSI, io\_uring, SPDK, or similar technologies.
* Ability to lead technically while remaining a hands-on engineer who designs, codes, reviews, benchmarks, and debugs production systems.

****Technical Leadership****
As a Principal Engineer, you will help define the long-term technical direction for our storage platform. You will work across storage, database, Kubernetes, networking, hardware, and infrastructure engineering teams to build reliable, high-performance storage services for business-critical workloads.
  
  
We are looking for an engineer who can operate from architecture to code to production—someone who can design the system, build critical components, analyze performance, diagnose difficult failures, and lead other engineers in delivering storage infrastructure at scale.

title: Principal Software Engineer
description:
Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 6,000 employees and 34,000 customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500. Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world. In short, we’re transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers the human connection.

Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections.

**AI at Cvent: Leading the Future**

Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation.

Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AI-powered collaboration, we’d love to meet you.

***Recruitment Scam Notice:***
*Beware of recruitment scams. Legitimate Cvent recruiting communications will come from accounts formatted as “name@cvent.com” email address. Cvent will never request payment or ask for sensitive personal or financial information through chat or social media platforms. Cvent is not responsible for losses or damages arising from communications, payments, or disclosures made to third parties impersonating Cvent.*

*If you believe a communication may be fraudulent, we strongly recommend that you don't respond and report the incident at recruitingindia@cvent.com.*

*For more information, visit Cvent’s Recruitment Fraud Notice. https://www.cvent.com/en/notice-recruitment-fraud.*

**In This Role, You Will:**

**Own the technical direction of this team**

* Define and evolve the architecture for the team's AI features — retrieval and context assembly, agent and tool-use patterns, structured generation, model and prompt lifecycle, evaluation, guardrails, cost and latency management — across its Java and Spring Boot services, event-driven integrations on AWS, GraphQL APIs, and React and Next.js front ends, consistent with the shared direction agreed across Splash.
* Make build-versus-buy and model-provider recommendations (e.g. Anthropic, OpenAI, AWS Bedrock) for the team's work with Product and the Engineering Manager, grounded in evaluation data, cost, latency, security, and vendor risk, and aligned with Splash-wide platform decisions.
* Apply and help shape Splash's responsible-AI standards in the team's work: how quality and safety are evaluated before and after release, how customer data is handled in prompts and retrieval, and what the team will and will not ship.
* Stay hands-on: prototype the hard parts, write the reference implementations and specs that others build from, and unblock the team on the most difficult technical problems.

**Shape AI architecture across Splash, with your peers**

* Work as a peer with the other Principal Engineers and Architects across Splash — in Bangalore, North America, and Spain — to set the shared AI direction, standards, and platform capabilities; contribute this team's needs and learnings, and bring the agreed direction back into the team's designs.
* Partner with those peers so that AI capabilities compose with the rest of the Splash platform rather than sitting beside it, and so that shared services, data contracts, and APIs are designed once rather than per team.
* Represent the team in Splash and Cvent-wide AI architecture, platform, and security forums; bring what the wider company learns back to the team and contribute what the team learns outward.
* Own the non-functional requirements and the long-term health of the team's systems — security, scalability, resiliency, performance, operability, and cost — and drive the architectural changes they need.

**Shape the AI-native way of working**

* Define, with the Engineering Manager, how Splash builds software with agentic coding tools and spec-driven development — what a good spec looks like, when to delegate to an agent, what must be verified by a human — and measure whether it is making the team more effective.
* Be the final technical quality gate for the team's most consequential designs and changes, and teach Lead and Senior Engineers to review AI-generated work with the same rigour.
* Keep the team's practices current as the AI development landscape changes, and share what works with the wider Splash and Cvent engineering organisations.

**Grow people**

* Grow the Lead and Senior Engineers on the team through design mentorship, direct feedback, and by creating opportunities for them to own significant technical decisions.
* Help the Engineering Manager hire and calibrate: define what good looks like at each level, interview, and help onboard new engineers to be productive quickly.

**About the role:**

Location: Bengaluru, India | Team: Splash| Reports to: Software Engineering Manager, Splash

Splash is Cvent's event marketing platform. We are standing up a new engineering team in Bengaluru with a single charter: build the AI-powered features that will define the next generation of Splash. The team works as a peer to the established Splash engineering and product teams in Bangalore, North America, and Spain, who own adjacent parts of the platform and with whom we plan, design, and ship. This is an AI-first team in two senses: we ship AI into the product, and we build software with AI — agentic coding tools, spec-driven development, and disciplined review of AI-generated output are the default way of working here, not an experiment.

We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer to be the senior technical owner for this team. You will define the architecture that the team's AI features are built on — how retrieval, agents, tool use, evaluation, and the prompt and model lifecycle fit together across Java and Spring Boot services on AWS and React and Next.js front ends — and you will make sure it holds up as the product, the models, and the tooling change underneath it. AI at Splash is larger than one team: you will work as a peer with the other Principal Engineers and Architects across Splash to shape the shared AI direction, standards, and platform capabilities, and you will own how this team's work fits into and contributes to that whole. You are a hands-on engineer with 12+ years of experience who has defined and shipped the AI architecture for a significant product area, not just contributed features to one. You influence without authority across Splash's teams in Bangalore, North America, and Spain, you partner with Product and the Engineering Manager on roadmap and build-versus-buy decisions, and you grow the Lead and Senior Engineers around you. You report to the team's Engineering Manager.

**Here's What You Need:**

**Primary Skills:**

* 12+ years of professional software engineering experience, with depth in backend and distributed systems and credibility across the full stack.
* A track record of defining the AI architecture for a significant product area and taking it to production: retrieval, agents or tool use, structured generation, evaluation frameworks, prompt and model lifecycle, cost and latency management, and the failure modes of each.
* Expert-level experience with Java and Spring Boot microservices and event-driven architectures on AWS; strong working knowledge of React or Next.js with TypeScript and of GraphQL and REST API design; experience with relational and NoSQL data stores and vector search.
* Hands-on fluency with AI-assisted and agentic software development — you use tools such as Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, or GitHub Copilot agents in your own work: writing specs an agent can execute, reviewing and correcting its output, and knowing where these tools fail. This must be lived experience, not familiarity with the concepts.
* Strong engineering judgment and a track record of owning non-functional requirements — security, scalability, resiliency, performance, cost — for production systems at scale.
* Experience shaping architecture alongside other principal engineers and architects across multiple teams, and influencing without authority in a distributed, matrixed organisation, including with Product, Design, SRE, and security partners.
* Experience mentoring and growing senior engineers and technical leads.
* Clear communication: you write architecture decisions, specs, and recommendations that people in other time zones can act on without a meeting, and you can explain technical trade-offs and risks to executives and non-technical stakeholders.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Experience building evaluation frameworks and observability for LLM features in production, and applying them to decide what ships.
* Experience with multiple model providers and with LLM orchestration frameworks and protocols (e.g. Spring AI, LangChain4j, Vercel AI SDK, Model Context Protocol), including their limitations.
* Experience with AI security and privacy concerns — prompt injection, data handling in retrieval and prompts, tenant isolation — and with responsible-AI governance in an enterprise.
* Experience in event, marketing, or martech products, or other B2B SaaS with high-volume customer-facing workflows.
* Experience forming or helping form a team from scratch and establishing its technical norms rather than inheriting an existing team.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Applied ML
description:
Dive in and do the best work of your career at DigitalOcean. Journey alongside a strong community of top talent who are relentless in their drive to build the simplest scalable cloud. If you have a growth mindset, naturally like to think big and bold, and are energized by the fast-paced environment of a true industry disruptor, you’ll find your place here. We value winning together—while learning, having fun, and making a profound difference for the dreamers and builders in the world.
  
  
**About The Role**
DigitalOcean's Agentic AI organization provides a powerful inference cloud, Managed Agents, and robust Agent Learning Services that enable customers to run AI inference confidently at scale. We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer to serve as a technical leader within our Agent Learning Services team, driving the Applied ML strategy to build a robust Continuous Learning Loop for our customers.
  
  
This is a high-impact leadership role where you will define the machine learning architectures that allow AI agents to learn from historical data, simulate synthetic data, and continuously self-improve. You will partner closely with our Infrastructure and product teams to translate complex ML concepts into scalable, production-ready continuous learning platforms.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Continuous Learning Architecture: Designing and implementing the core Applied ML pipelines for a Continuous Learning Loop, enabling AI agents to autonomously evaluate, learn, and adapt based on user interactions and synthetic data.
* Agent Optimization & Fine-Tuning: Developing the machine learning models and methodologies behind the Agent Optimizer, leveraging techniques like Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT), Reinforcement Learning from Human/AI Feedback (RLHF/RLAIF), and targeted optimization strategies to improve agent performance.
* Evaluations & Simulations: Building robust ML frameworks for Simulations and Evaluations, creating deterministic and non-deterministic scoring mechanisms, reward models, and objective metrics to benchmark agent behavior in complex multi-turn scenarios.
* Signals Processing: Architecting ML systems to extract high-quality, actionable "Signals" from noisy data, user feedback, and chat logs to feed back into the training and optimization loops.
* Model Application & Deployment: Bridging the gap between ML research and production by ensuring models are designed for efficient inference, working closely with RL Infrastructure engineers to deploy optimization algorithms at scale.
* Technical Strategy: Driving the long-term Applied ML roadmap for the Agentic AI organization, evaluating emerging research in continuous learning and agentic frameworks to keep DigitalOcean at the cutting edge.
* Cross-Functional Influence: Partnering closely with Product Managers, Data Scientists, and Infrastructure engineers to define product capabilities, experimental setups, and performance benchmarks for our agent learning services.
* Mentorship & Elevation: Mentoring senior engineers and ML practitioners, leading architectural reviews, and establishing best practices for model evaluation, ML pipeline observability, and reproducible experimentation.

**What We Expect From You**

* Extensive Experience: 10+ years of software engineering and machine learning experience, with a proven track record operating at a Staff, Principal, or Architect level designing, building, and scaling production-grade ML systems.
* Applied ML & Domain Mastery: Proven ability to decompose complex, ambiguous business goals into manageable machine learning problems that deliver strong & measurable impact. Deep expertise in Reinforcement Learning (RL), LLM fine-tuning methodologies (e.g., SFT, DPO, PPO), and continuous learning loops.
* Evaluation Frameworks & Guardrails: Deep experience building evaluation frameworks for non-deterministic AI systems, including establishing robust reward models, automated red-teaming, safety guardrails, scoring rubrics, and continuous benchmarking platforms.
* Research Contributions & Thought Leadership: Demonstrated leadership in the broader AI community through a track record of top-tier academic publications, high-impact open-source contributions, or technical patents in Applied ML and AI agent architectures.
* Cross-Functional AI Leadership: Proven expertise driving technical vision and execution across engineering, product, and infrastructure teams to build scalable, production-ready AI solutions from concept to deployment.
* This job is located in Bengaluru, India

JR: 2026-7876

You’ll be a part of a cutting-edge technology company with a high-growth trajectory, who are proud to simplify cloud and AI so builders can spend more time creating software that changes the world. As part of our team, you’ll embody our "Shark" mindset: bold, ambitious, and scrappy. You'll lead with a bias for action and take true ownership of our products, customer success, and team culture.

title: Software Engineer - Databricks
description:
For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.
  
  
**About Smartsheet**
Smartsheet helps people and teams achieve anything, from seamless work management to scalable, smart solutions. We're expanding in India and building a new engineering operation in Bangalore. We're looking for motivated engineers who enjoy learning and want to grow with us in a fast-paced environment.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Software Engineer II on our Lakehouse team, you'll build and maintain the data pipelines and platform components that power analytics and AI agents across Smartsheet. You'll work on well-defined problems with increasing independence, contribute to design discussions, and learn from senior engineers.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Build, test and maintain reliable data pipelines that ingest, process and transform data from multiple sources
* Develop and optimise Spark/SQL workloads on Databricks and Delta Lake
* Work with AWS services (S3, IAM, Glue, Lambda, EMR/Kinesis or similar) to deliver data solutions
* Help make our lakehouse AI-ready by preparing governed, well-described data and supporting Databricks Genie, ontology and agentic workloads
* Contribute to data models and help maintain data quality, governance and security standards
* Troubleshoot pipeline failures and performance issues, and help find root causes
* Add monitoring, alerting and documentation for the systems you own
* Take part in design and code reviews, and suggest improvements
* Collaborate with product engineering, analytics and AI teams to understand data needs
* Help control cloud and compute costs in the pipelines you build

**What You Bring**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field
* 3–5 years of experience in data engineering
* Hands-on experience with AWS (S3, IAM and at least a couple of services such as Glue, Lambda, EMR, Kinesis or Redshift)
* Hands-on experience with Databricks (notebooks, jobs/workflows, Delta Lake, Spark,Unity Catalog, row-level security or data governance exposure)
* Strong Python and SQL
* Experience with orchestration tools such as Airbyte, Airflow or Databricks Workflows
* Understanding of data modelling and batch processing, plus hands-on experience with streaming
* Good understanding of how AI agents use data (Genie, semantic layer/ontology, text-to-SQL) and eagerness to learn agentic patterns
* Hands-on experience with Git, CI/CD and basic observability practices
* Hands-on experience with Terraform or other Infrastructure-as-Code
* Hands-on experience with Docker and/or Kubernetes
* Good communication skills and fluency in English
* Legally eligible to work in India on an ongoing basis

**Nice to Have**

* Hands-on experience building or evaluating Genie spaces, agents, or other AI/BI solutions on Databricks
* Experience with MCP, agent frameworks or LLM evaluation
* Experience with Snowflake, GCP

**Get To Know Us**
At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You’ll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths—because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. When you’re doing work that stretches you, excites you, and connects you to something bigger, that’s magic at work. Let’s build what’s next, together.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Employer**
Smartsheet is an Equal Opportunity (EEO) employer committed to fostering an inclusive environment with the best employees. It is our policy to provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants in accordance with applicable laws in the US, UK, Australia, Germany, Costa Rica, Japan, Bulgaria, India, and Singapore. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran or disabled status, or genetic information.

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
**The Company**
PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.
  
  
We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.
  
  
We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.
  
  
Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

Meet our team

PayPal

0

title: Senior Software Engineer — Infra Agent Systems Remote India
description:
**About The Role**
Together AI runs one of the largest GPU fleets in the world. The
**Infra Agent Systems**
team builds the software systems that power and automate that infrastructure.
  
  
We develop production AI agents that diagnose hardware failures, investigate incidents, correlate signals across the fleet, and automate operational workflows. Alongside these agents, we build the platform they run on, including knowledge graphs, retrieval systems, orchestration frameworks, and developer tooling.
  
  
**You’ll Work Across Two Areas**
**Infrastructure Agent Systems**
— Build production AI agents that help operate our GPU fleet by diagnosing failures, investigating incidents, gathering evidence from live systems, and assisting with remediation. These agents are used every day by our infrastructure and datacenter teams through APIs, CLI, dashboards, and Slack.
  
  
**Core Agent Platform**
— Build the platform that powers these agents, including knowledge graphs, search and retrieval, orchestration, evaluation, and the tooling that enables agents to reason, act, and continuously improve.
  
  
We’re working on something that hasn’t really been done before: building
**knowledge graphs and self-improving AI agents**
that understand, operate, and continuously improve large-scale AI infrastructure.
  
  
This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of
**AI agents, distributed systems, infrastructure, and automation**
, solving challenging engineering problems with real production impact. There’s an enormous amount to build, learn, and shape as we define the future of autonomous infrastructure.
  
  
responsible for delivering the software but also for operating and supporting it in production.
  
  
**Why this Role**
You’ll work on two hard problems at the same time: making AI agents trustworthy enough to operate production infrastructure, and building the knowledge, retrieval, and distributed systems that make those agents effective.
  
  
You’ll have the opportunity to build foundational systems from the ground up, work on infrastructure at massive scale, and help define how self-improving AI agents operate real-world AI infrastructure.
  
  
Remote based in India
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design and build production AI agent systems that diagnose, investigate, and remediate infrastructure issues across one of the world’s largest GPU fleets.
* Build the distributed services, orchestration framework, knowledge graph, and retrieval systems that power infrastructure agents.
* Develop fleet intelligence systems that combine telemetry, infrastructure state, operational knowledge, and historical incidents to help agents make better decisions.
* Integrate with observability, incident management, ticketing, fleet inventory, source control, chat, and internal infrastructure systems through well-designed APIs.
* Own services end to end, including architecture, implementation, testing, deployment, observability, and production operations.
* Improve agent performance through evaluations, retrieval improvements, better tools, and production feedback loops.
* Turn what agents learn in production into reliable, reviewed software and automation.

**Requirements**

* 5+ years of experience building production backend systems, distributed systems, or infrastructure platforms.
* Strong systems design skills and experience owning significant systems from design through production.
* Depth in at least one of the following:

+ AI agent systems, orchestration, tool use, evaluation, or grounding
+ Knowledge graphs or graph data modeling
+ Search, retrieval, ranking, RAG, or semantic search systems

* Strong backend engineering experience, including API design, service boundaries, data modeling, and integrations across complex systems.
* Experience with Kubernetes, GitOps such as ArgoCD, infrastructure-as-code, and cloud platforms.
* Comfortable working across languages such as Go, TypeScript, Python, or Rust.

**Experience In The Following Is a Plus**

* GPU infrastructure, datacenters, bare-metal systems, hardware failure modes, BMC/IPMI, or cluster schedulers
* Graph databases
* Event-driven systems and messaging platforms such as NATS or Kafka
* Observability platforms such as Prometheus and Grafana
* Building evaluation frameworks or improving the quality and reliability of LLM-powered systems

**About Together AI**
Together AI, the AI Native Cloud, is purpose-built for AI engineers. AI application developers get high-performance inference that scales reliably, fine-tuning and reinforcement learning for creating frontier-level specialized models, and pre-training at massive scale for fully custom intelligence, all around a marketplace of leading open models that teams can run, adapt, and own. Trusted by Cursor, Decagon, ElevenLabs, Salesforce, and Zoom, Together serves 400+ trillion tokens a month.
  
  
**Application Policy**
Please read each role carefully and apply to the position best suited to you. Candidates are limited to 6 applications within a 90-day period, and applications beyond that limit will be automatically rejected. You may apply to additional roles 90 days after your last application.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity**
Together AI is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is proud to offer equal employment opportunity to everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, and more.
  
  
Please see our privacy policy at https://www.together.ai/privacy.

title: Advanced IT Developer - GitHub Platform
description:
**Department: Enterprise IT & Quality**
**Location: Global Business Services, Bangalore**
**Your impact begins here**
As Advanced IT Developer – GitHub Platform, you will keep GitHub Enterprise Cloud running securely and reliably for engineering teams across Novo Nordisk. You will build the automation, governance and self-service that let product teams move faster and deliver software with confidence. Your work will strengthen how thousands of colleagues ship code every day — turning a trusted platform into real momentum for the people who depend on our medicines.
  
  
**What You’ll Bring**
To succeed in this role, you will bring:
  
  

* A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or a related field.
* 6+ years of experience in platform engineering, DevOps engineering, software engineering or a related role.
* Hands-on GitHub Enterprise Cloud administration, including organisations, repositories, teams, permissions, policies, branch protection, integrations and security features.
* Automation and scripting skills in one or more of C#, Python, PowerShell or JavaScript.
* Experience with GitHub Actions, CI/CD automation, reusable workflows and repository templates.
* Experience managing platform configuration and infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code, preferably Pulumi.
* A solid grasp of software delivery, testing, debugging, troubleshooting and operational support.
* Familiarity with working in regulated environments, in line with QMS, O&M processes, change management and applicable SOPs.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills to engage engineering teams, security, compliance, architecture, operations and vendors.

**What You’ll Do**
You will administer the platform day to day while continuously improving how teams use it. In this role, you will:
  
  

* Configure, maintain and support GitHub Enterprise Cloud for enterprise use, managing organisations, repositories, teams, permissions, policies and integrations within the agreed governance model.
* Enable secure and compliant use of GitHub across the software development lifecycle, supporting traceability, quality, security and compliance from development through to operations.
* Build and maintain platform automation and Infrastructure as Code (preferably Pulumi) for administration, onboarding, governance and self-service, ensuring consistency and auditability.
* Troubleshoot and resolve issues across GitHub Enterprise Cloud, GitHub Actions, access management, integrations and CI/CD pipelines to keep the developer experience stable and reliable.
* Define reusable templates, blueprints, policy-as-code approaches and CI/CD patterns that help teams deliver software securely and efficiently.
* Apply Agile and DevOps practices, and work in line with Novo Nordisk QMS, O&M processes and applicable SOPs to keep changes controlled and well documented.

**Who You’ll Work With**
You will join the Data & AI Foundation (DAIF) in Bangalore, which brings together Data Engineering & Platforms, Advanced Compute & Infrastructure, AI Engineering & Platforms, and Developer Experience, Compliance & Platforms to build, operate and scale trusted data and AI capabilities. As a GBS partner, the team enables EIT GBS functions and strengthens platform ways of working through a strong India–Denmark partnership.
  
  
Your closest partners will be platform users, digital product builders and software engineering teams, alongside security, compliance, architecture, operations and other DevSecOps stakeholders. You will also work with external partners, including GitHub and relevant integration, security, automation and observability vendors, to align platform capabilities with real engineering needs. Clear communication across these teams is how priorities, requirements and dependencies get resolved at speed.
  
  
**What You Can Expect Here**
You will work in an international environment where your expertise shapes how teams across Novo Nordisk build software. The role offers room to take ownership, make decisions within your area and grow through cross-functional collaboration and platform engineering practice. You will stay close to vendor roadmaps and DevOps trends, including how AI is reshaping the modern SDLC, and put that learning into practice. You will be trusted to perform, supported to develop, and encouraged to make your voice heard.
  
  
We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

title: Senior Integration Software Engineer
description:
The Chevron Engineering and Innovation Excellence Center (ENGINE) in Bengaluru India brings together the resources and expertise of the Chevron global network with talent in India to enhance agility and technological innovation to optimize solutions for the world’s current and future energy challenges. As one of the leading energy providers worldwide, Chevron is involved in the production of crude oil and natural gas, manufacturing of transportation fuels, lubricants, petrochemicals, and additives, and the development of enabling technologies.
  
  
Chevron's vision is to be the global energy company most admired for its people, partnerships, and performance. With a clear purpose to develop affordable, reliable, ever-cleaner energy that enables human progress, we believe human ingenuity has the power to solve any challenge and overcome any obstacle. Meeting the world’s growing energy needs requires the pursuit of innovations and advancements that deliver a better future for all.
  
  
**About The Position**
The Senior Integration Software Engineer role involves designing, developing, testing, and maintaining subsurface software applications and Petrel plug-ins. The developer will collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements design, develop, and maintain Petrel plugins and workflows that support subsurface interpretation and modeling. Key skills include Petrel Development (Ocean SDK), Object Oriented Programming (C#, C++, .Net), Python, Azure, and applications integration.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain desktop and cloud-based integration solutions using modern software stacks.
* Collaborate with geoscientists and engineers to translate domain workflows into robust software applications that reduce subsurface uncertainty and cycle times.
* Build and maintain APIs and data pipelines that support seismic interpretation, geologic modeling, and reservoir characterization business capabilities.
* Integrate AI/ML models into interpretation and earth modeling workflows to enhance automation and predictive capabilities.
* Ensure software quality, usability, and performance through unit testing, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud-native deployment strategies.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies and contribute to sprint planning, retrospectives, and backlog grooming.
* Provide technical mentorship and collaborate across multi-disciplinary teams.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in geology, geophysics, computer science, or engineering (master’s degree preferred).
* At least 7 years of professional software development experience, preferably in the oil and gas industry with subsurface geology and geophysics domain knowledge.
* Proficiency in OOP including C++ and C#, Python, .Net Framework, Azure services, and DevOps.
* Proficiency in Plugin development with subsurface static/dynamic modeling applications like Petrel (Ocean SDK).
* Experience with multi-thread/parallel computing, AI/ML, HPC, Docker, and Kubernetes.
* Knowledge and working experience of software architecture & design patterns.
* Understanding authentication and cybersecurity protocols including OAuth.
* Familiarity and experience with OpenGL, Qt, and OSDU is a plus.
* Familiarity with Petrel, Techlog, Studio, and related subsurface tools is a strong plus

**Soft Skills**

* Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Excellent verbal and written communication and interpersonal skills.
* Proven ability to work independently and in a cross-functional collaborative team environment.
* Ability to adapt to new technologies and changing business requirements.
* Ability to mentor and grow others’ technical capabilities, share knowledge/experience, and collaborate with domain experts

**What We Can Offer You**
Everything we do at Chevron is guided by our values and our commitment to The Chevron Way.
  
  
Have the opportunity to take part in world-leading energy projects, advance your professional development and expand your career within an inclusive and collaborative workplace.
  
  

* Join a workplace where innovation, collaboration and safety are at the core of how we work.
* Work in thoughtfully designed environments that support focus, well-being, and innovation enhanced by digital tools that enable seamless collaboration.
* Grow through structured learning, mentorship, and opportunities to contribute to impactful projects that align with Chevron’s values and business priorities.
* Access comprehensive benefits that support your health, well-being, and work-life balance.
* Engage with emerging technologies and digital solutions that are shaping the future of energy and enterprise.

Chevron ENGINE supports global operations, supporting business requirements across the world. Accordingly, the work hours for employees will be aligned to support business requirements. The standard work week will be Monday to Friday. Working hours are 8:00am to 5:00pm or 1.30pm to 10.30pm.

To be a part of our success, click
**APPLY**
to submit your application. Chevron regrets that it is unable to sponsor employment Visas or consider individuals on time-limited Visa status for this position.

* Strong ability to work independently and meet goals/ deadlines with minimal direction/ guidance
* Being extremely curious and hungry to make an impact
* Learning quickly, enjoy and taking pride in both identifying and solving problems

**Why Proofpoint**
Protecting people is at the heart of our award-winning lineup of cybersecurity solutions, and the people who work here are the key to our success. We’re a customer-focused and driven-to-win organization with leading-edge products—and many exciting reasons to join our team. We believe in hiring the best the brightest and cultivating a culture of collaboration and appreciation. We are a diverse, multinational company with opportunities in all functions, and leaders that welcome candidates from all walks of life. Apply today and explore your future .

: The Network Infrastructure Software team develops platforms that power intent-based, automated network operations for large-scale data center networks. Our work enables engineers to express what the network should do and rely on software to safely and consistently handle how it gets done. By standardizing and automating provisioning, configuration, security, and operations, we reduce manual intervention, improve observability, and shorten MTTD and MTTR while maintaining high standards for correctness, security, and availability.

At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team.

* Partner closely with network engineering and application teams to shape the technical direction of LinkedIn’s networking platforms, applying modern networking technologies and making informed architectural trade-offs.

Preferred Qualifications:

title: Senior Data Systems Software Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
Build the next generation of Oracle Zero Data Loss Recovery Appliance (ZDLRA) software, helping fortune 500 enterprises protect and recover their business-critical Oracle databases. Work on software where data integrity, recoverability, cyber resilience, and performance at scale directly affect customers' most important operations.
  
  
Join our growing engineering team in Bengaluru and collaborate with experienced ZDLRA engineers in India and the US. You will contribute to shared product priorities, deliver new features and projects, and help evolve an enterprise data protection platform. This role offers the opportunity to help shape a new team while building deep product expertise within an established global engineering organization.
  
  
The work spans Oracle database kernel development and systems programming, primarily in C and PL/SQL on Linux. You will tackle engineering problems involving buffers and caches, memory management, storage, file systems, I/O, networking, concurrency, and distributed systems. Strong algorithms, thoughtful design, and an understanding of how these components interact will be central to delivering correct, efficient, and maintainable software.
  
  
You will participate throughout the development lifecycle: understanding problems, exploring the codebase, identifying root causes, designing solutions, implementing changes, writing tests, and validating results. The work combines new development and enhancements with complex defect resolution, including issues encountered in customer environments. As your product knowledge grows, you will take increasing technical ownership of assigned features and components, contributing to design decisions, code reviews, ongoing maintenance, and knowledge sharing.
  
  
We value engineers who investigate problems systematically, use documentation and diagnostic tools resourcefully, communicate clearly, and help colleagues succeed. You will use modern engineering tools, including LLMs and AI coding agents, to accelerate code exploration, development, and testing while applying independent judgment and rigorous validation to the resulting designs and code.
  
  
We welcome experienced developers with strong C, Linux, system programming skills and practical knowledge of database internals, storage, distributed systems, or other demanding enterprise software. Prior Oracle Database, RMAN, PL/SQL, or backup and recovery product experience is an advantage. Strong systems fundamentals, curiosity, and the ability to translate complex requirements into reliable production software are essential.
  
  
This position is based in Bengaluru, India.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Product development and technical ownership**

* Design, implement, and maintain ZDLRA features and enhancements in C and PL/SQL on Linux, contributing to Oracle database kernel and systems software development.
* Translate requirements and technical problems into clear designs, manageable tasks, and deliverable milestones. Evaluate alternatives and document trade-offs involving correctness, performance, scalability, compatibility, and maintainability.
* Apply appropriate algorithms and data structures to build efficient, reliable software. Reason about memory use, concurrency, synchronization, and behavior under demanding workloads.
* Develop and improve assigned components involving buffers, caches, storage, file systems, I/O, networking, and distributed processing, with careful attention to data integrity and recovery behavior.
* Build product expertise through code exploration, technical documentation, collaboration, and delivery of fixes and enhancements. Progress toward ownership of assigned features and projects, including subsequent development, maintenance, and defect resolution.

**Investigation, performance, and quality**

* Investigate complex defects, including issues reported from customer deployments. Reproduce failures, trace relevant code paths, establish root causes, and implement durable fixes.
* Use GDB, core dumps, logs, traces, profiling tools, and Linux utilities to gather evidence and understand software behavior across interacting components.
* Diagnose performance and scalability bottlenecks involving CPU, memory, storage, I/O, and networking. Establish useful measurements and validate the impact of changes against representative workloads.
* Design and implement tests alongside production code. Cover functional behavior, boundary conditions, regressions, concurrency, and relevant failure and recovery scenarios using the team's engineering and test frameworks.
* Use shell scripting and automation to improve diagnostic data collection, issue reproduction, testing, and other repeatable development tasks.
* Follow secure coding practices and engineering standards. Evaluate error handling, resource management, backward compatibility, and versioning implications when modifying existing code or interfaces.

**Engineering execution and collaboration**

* Take assigned work through the software development lifecycle, from analysis and design through implementation, review, testing, integration, and maintenance.
* Plan work realistically, identify dependencies, and communicate progress, design decisions, risks, and blockers. Coordinate with the engineering team to deliver agreed project milestones.
* Collaborate closely with ZDLRA engineers in India and the US and with relevant database engineering teams to resolve cross-component issues and deliver shared product objectives.
* Participate in design and code reviews, providing constructive feedback on correctness, clarity, performance, security, test coverage, and long-term maintainability.
* Write and maintain useful design notes, implementation documentation, and troubleshooting guidance. Share findings so that investigations and engineering decisions benefit the wider team.
* Use internal documentation, specifications, and existing code resourcefully to understand unfamiliar areas. Ask focused questions, seek timely feedback, and help colleagues solve technical problems.
* As product expertise grows, provide technical guidance, mentor colleagues, and contribute to improvements in the team's development practices and engineering quality.

**AI-assisted engineering**

* Use LLMs and AI coding agents to accelerate code exploration, problem analysis, implementation, test development, and documentation where they are useful.
* Critically review AI-generated suggestions and verify them against the actual codebase, requirements, and observed behavior. Validate changes through appropriate reviews and tests, and remain accountable for the correctness, security, performance, and maintainability of delivered software.

**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.
  
  
Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

title: Developer Relations Engineer
description:
**About TrueFoundry**
Every production AI system, whether it's powering customer support, writing code, analysing financial data, or diagnosing medical conditions, needs the same foundational infrastructure. A way to route between models. A way to manage tools and integrate them securely. A way to orchestrate agents and enforce governance. A unified compute layer to run it all.
  
  
We're a Series A company backed by Intel Capital and Sequoia, with companies like CVS, Mastercard, Siemens, Paytm, Synopsys and Zscaler using our platform to run production AI workloads.
  
  
As we scale, we're building out our go-to-market engine across direct sales, cloud partnerships, resellers and international markets. This means creating the right processes, systems, partnerships and operating rhythms to help our commercial teams move faster and grow efficiently.
  
  
We're looking for a
**Developer Relations Engineer**
(DevRel) who can bridge the gap between engineering and the developer community. Someone who enjoys building technical demos, writing insightful content, creating tutorials, experimenting with AI tools, and engaging with developers across platforms like GitHub, X, Reddit and Discord.
  
  
This is an opportunity to work closely with engineering, product, and marketing teams; build TrueFoundry's developer presence; influence product adoption; and help developers understand, experiment with, and build on top of our AI infrastructure.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Run experiments and benchmarks, and turn the results into reports people trust.
* Build demos, tutorials, and sample code that accompany the content.
* Write blogs for different audiences: technical deep dives, customer use cases, SEO content.
* Own content for product launches, from announcement blogs to release notes.
* Review content for technical accuracy before anything goes live.
* Learn the product deeply by using it the way a customer would.
* Turn customer questions from sales and support into content that answers them.
* Track content performance and refine what’s published based on the data.
* Bring developer feedback back to product and engineering to shape the roadmap.
* Grow our presence across GitHub, X, LinkedIn, Reddit, Discord, and developer forums.
* Track content and community performance, and refine based on the data.

**Must-haves**

* 3–6 years of experience with a software engineering background. You might be in developer relations today, or you might be an engineer who writes, speaks, or maintains open-source projects.
* A public footprint: blogs, tutorials, talks, open-source contributions, or community work. A large following isn’t required.
* Clear, engaging writing and the ability to explain complex ideas to different audiences.
* A solid grasp of software and AI concepts and the judgement to spot inaccuracies.
* Hands-on with AI assistants like Claude, ChatGPT, and Cursor.

**Good to have**

* Familiarity with the AI/ML stack (LangChain, Hugging Face, LLM APIs, vector databases).
* Experience with GitHub, Docker, Kubernetes, or cloud platforms.
* Familiarity with SEO, Webflow, and performance marketing tools.
* Experience at a B2B or developer-focused startup.
* Experience organising or contributing to developer communities (GDG, AWS Community Builders, AI meetups, or similar).

**Who Will Thrive Here**

* You’re an engineer at heart who loves teaching and sharing.
* You’re scrappy and frugal, building community without a big budget.
* You own work end-to-end, from idea to publish to measuring impact.
* You move fast without compromising accuracy.

title: Senior MIS – Sales, CRM & Reporting
description:
**Twin Health**
At Twin Health, we empower people to improve and prevent chronic metabolic diseases, like type 2 diabetes and obesity, with a new standard of care. Twin Health is the only company applying AI Digital Twin technology exclusively toward metabolic health.
  
  
We start by building a dynamic model of each person’s metabolism — drawing on thousands of data points from CGMs, smartwatches, and meal logs — that maps their personal path to better health. Guided by a dedicated clinical care team, our members have lowered their A1C below the diabetes range, achieved lasting weight loss, and reduced or even eliminated medications, all while living healthier, happier lives.
  
  
**Working here**
Our team at Twin Health is passionate, talented, and united by a shared purpose: to improve the metabolic health and happiness of our members. We believe in empowering every Twin to make a meaningful impact for our members, our clients, and each other, while enjoying a supportive, collaborative work environment.
  
  
Twin has been recognized not only for our innovation but also for our culture, including: Innovator of the Year by the Employer Health Innovation Roundtable (EHIR), selected to CB Insights’ Digital Health 150, and named one of Newsweek’s Top Most Loved Workplace® .
  
  
With more than $100 million raised in recent funding, including a $53 million Series E round in 2025 led by Maj Invest, and a $50 million investment in 2023 led by Temasek, Twin is scaling rapidly across the U.S. and globally. Backed by leading venture firms like ICONIQ Growth, Sequoia, Sofina, Temasek, and Peak XV, we are building the most impactful digital health company in the world.
  
  
Join us as we reinvent the standard of care in metabolic health.
  
  
**Role Purpose**
We are looking for an experienced and analytical professional to take ownership of Sales MIS, business reporting, lead management analytics and sales performance tracking.
  
  
The individual will be responsible for developing and maintaining comprehensive sales dashboards, analysing sales calling activities, monitoring lead allocation and conversion, identifying performance gaps, and providing meaningful business insights to the Sales Leadership team.
  
  
The role requires someone who can go beyond preparing routine MIS reports and independently interpret sales data, identify trends, recommend improvements and support management in making data-driven business decisions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Sales MIS & Business Reporting
* Own the preparation and maintenance of daily, weekly and monthly Sales MIS.
* Develop comprehensive reports covering lead generation, lead allocation, sales calls, follow-ups, meetings, conversions and revenue performance.
* Prepare individual sales executive and team-level performance reports.
* Ensure accuracy, consistency and timely circulation of MIS reports.
* Consolidate information from multiple sources into structured management reports.
* Sales Analytics & Performance Monitoring
* Analyse sales calling patterns, connect ratios, lead engagement and conversion rates.
* Monitor individual and team productivity against defined targets.
* Identify reasons for low conversions, lead drop-offs and missed follow-ups.
* Analyse sales funnel movement and identify bottlenecks.
* Provide actionable recommendations to improve sales effectiveness and productivity.
* Present periodic business insights to Sales Leadership.
* Lead Allocation & Funnel Management
* Oversee the lead allocation mechanism and ensure fair and timely distribution.
* Monitor lead ownership, follow-up status and ageing.
* Identify duplicate, unattended and inactive leads.
* Track lead movement across different sales stages.
* Establish appropriate tracking mechanisms to ensure accountability among sales executives.
* Dashboard Development & Business Intelligence
* Develop and maintain interactive dashboards using Microsoft Power BI.
* Build automated reporting mechanisms to reduce manual reporting.
* Create visual representations of sales performance, productivity, conversions and pipeline trends.
* Integrate data from CRM systems, Excel/Google Sheets and other available sources.
* Ensure dashboards provide meaningful insights for business reviews.
* Advanced Excel & Data Management
* Work extensively with Advanced Excel and Google Sheets.
* Use Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, INDEX-MATCH, SUMIFS, COUNTIFS, Power Query and other advanced functions.
* Manage large datasets and perform data cleaning, consolidation and validation.
* Identify discrepancies and maintain data integrity.
* AI & Reporting Automation
* Leverage AI tools to automate repetitive reporting and data analysis.
* Use AI-assisted tools to identify sales trends, patterns and performance gaps.
* Explore automation of daily MIS, dashboards and management reports.
* Use AI tools to generate analytical summaries and improve reporting efficiency.
* Identify opportunities to reduce manual intervention in sales data management.
* Stakeholder Coordination
* Work closely with Sales Executives, Team Leads, Sales Leadership and Marketing.
* Coordinate with the CRM/Technology team for data integration and reporting improvements.
* Highlight performance gaps and follow up with relevant stakeholders.
* Present analytical findings during periodic sales review meetings.

**Experience & Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Commerce, Statistics, Mathematics, Finance or related discipline.
* 5–8 years of experience in Sales MIS, Sales Analytics, Business Intelligence or Sales Operations.
* Strong hands-on experience in Advanced Excel and Power BI.
* Experience building interactive dashboards and automated MIS reports.
* Good understanding of sales funnels, lead management, calling metrics and conversion analysis.
* Experience working with CRM platforms such as Salesforce, HubSpot or Zoho.
* Practical exposure to AI tools such as ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot or similar tools for reporting and analytics.
* Experience with SQL or other data-querying tools will be an advantage.

We have been made aware of fraudulent interview requests being sent using the Twin Health's name. All communications will come from official Twin Health channels and a twinhealth.com email address. We will never ask you to complete a text interview or request financial details during the interview process.

title: Sales Operations Analyst - Sales Development
description:

Our products help people make powerful connections, discover exciting opportunities, build necessary skills, and gain valuable insights every day. We're also committed to providing transformational opportunities for our own employees by investing in their growth. We aspire to create a culture that's built on trust, care, inclusion, and fun – where everyone can succeed.

Join us to transform the way the world works.

**Job Description**

This role will be based in
**Bengaluru, India**

At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team.

Working closely with Sales Development leaders, and Strategy & Operations partners, you will help build analytical frameworks, develop AI-enabled workflows, support pilot programs, and measure business impact.

* Support experimentation efforts by collecting data, documenting results, maintaining testing frameworks, and tracking success metrics.
* Research emerging AI technologies, sales technology solutions, and workflow automation capabilities to support evaluation efforts.
* Document business requirements, operational processes, workflow designs, and implementation recommendations.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, Computer Science, Analytics, Operations, or related field
* 2+ years of experience in Sales Operations, Business Operations, Revenue Operations, or Sales Development
* 1+ year of experience using Excel and PowerPoint
* Experience performing data analysis using SQL or comparable analytical tools

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience supporting sales, customer success, marketing, or go-to-market organizations.
* Experience working with workflow automation, AI tools, low-code solutions, or process improvement initiatives.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Ability to translate business questions into analytical approaches and actionable insights.
* Strong attention to detail and operational execution skills.
* Demonstrated ability to learn new technologies and tools quickly.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills.
* Interest in AI, automation, and business transformation.

**Suggested Skills:**

* SQL & Data Analysis
* AI & Workflow Automation
* Experimentation Design
* Business Strategy
* Executive Communication
* Problem Solving

title: Senior Sales Executive
description:
**Company Description**
Trident Automobiles, established in 1997, began operations as a Hyundai dealer in Bengaluru and has grown into a leading multi-brand dealership representing Hyundai, Renault, Isuzu, Daimler (commercial vehicles), and JCB (construction equipment). The organization has expanded from a single showroom with about 25 team members to an employer of over 3,000 people. Guided by the motto “Drive home a relationship,” Trident focuses on long-term customer relationships and exceptional service. The company’s success is driven by its commitment to attracting and nurturing top industry talent within an empowering work environment. With more than 100,000 customers, Trident continues to prioritize customer delight and award-winning service.
  
**Role Description**
The Senior Sales Executive is a full-time, on-site role based in Bengaluru, responsible for driving vehicle sales and building strong customer relationships across Trident’s portfolio of automotive brands. Day-to-day responsibilities include engaging with walk-in and digital leads, conducting needs assessments, presenting suitable vehicle options, and organizing test drives. The role involves negotiating pricing and finance options, preparing quotations, and coordinating with finance, insurance, and registration teams to ensure smooth closure of sales. The Senior Sales Executive maintains accurate records of prospects and sales in CRM systems, follows up with customers to support repeat and referral business, and aligns with service teams to ensure a positive post-sale experience. The role also includes meeting monthly and quarterly sales targets, participating in promotional events, and sharing market insights with management to refine sales strategies.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong sales and negotiation skills, with proven experience in automotive or related retail sales.
* Customer relationship management skills, including ability to engage, build trust, and provide consultative guidance.
* Solid communication and interpersonal skills to interact effectively with diverse customers and internal teams.
* Basic business and financial acumen to explain pricing, financing, and value propositions clearly.
* Comfort with CRM tools, lead management systems, and standard office software.
* Ability to work in a target-driven environment, prioritize tasks, and manage time effectively.
* Understanding of local market trends and competitor offerings in the automotive sector is an advantage.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Commerce, Marketing, or a related field preferred; equivalent experience considered.
* Prior experience in a dealership or consumer-facing sales environment, particularly in Bengaluru or similar markets, is beneficial.

title: Inside Sales Executive – Restaurant Partnerships
description:

owners
