title: Implementation Manager
description:
**About Rocketlane**

Rocketlane is a fast-growing, innovative SaaS company making waves in customer onboarding and professional services automation.

Our mission? To empower B2B companies with a smooth, consistent, and efficient way to onboard customers and manage client projects—reducing chaos and boosting customer satisfaction across industries.

We’re a close-knit team of over 200+ passionate professionals, all focused on building a product that teams love to use. Our journey has been fueled by $45M in funding from top investors, including 8VC, Matrix Partners, and Nexus Venture Partners.tners India, and super angels like Gokul Rajaram, Girish Mathrubootham, and Clark Valberg, etc.

**What will you do? (Role Overview)**

You’ll run discovery, solution design, configuration, integrations, and go-lives with a strong consultative voice. You’ll guide customers toward best practices, manage escalations when needed, and ensure they get value—fast. This is a high-ownership role designed for our future
**AI-first Professional Services org**
, where problem-solving, adaptability, and technical depth are essential.

**What You’ll Be Responsible For**

* Own the full onboarding lifecycle for enterprise customers—from kick-off to go-live.
* Lead requirement-gathering sessions and translate business workflows into Rocketlane configurations.
* Design and guide customers on best-practice implementations, even when that means pushing back or course-correcting.
* Work with customer teams (IT, HR, Finance, PMO, Ops) to design integrations with systems like HRMS, CRM, NetSuite, and fintech platforms.
* Collaborate with internal teams (Product, Engineering, Solutions) to unblock complex implementations.
* Manage risks, escalations, and tough conversations with clarity and calm.
* Adopt and shape AI-driven workflows to automate routine tasks and improve customer value delivery.
* Serve as the customer’s trusted advisor on onboarding processes, data flows, and integration patterns.

**Must-Have Skills**

**Technical & Integration Skills**

* **Hands-on experience with REST APIs, Webhooks**
  (reading API docs, testing endpoints, and understanding auth flows).
* Experience building or supporting
  **custom integrations**
  between SaaS platforms and third-party systems.
* Strong understanding of SaaS concepts: data models, webhooks, API limits, auth, and typical enterprise integration patterns.
* Comfortable working with tools like
  **Postman, Workato, Boomi, Zapier, Make, or other iPaaS solutions**
  .

**Implementation Expertise**

* 5+ years in a
  **customer-facing role at a SaaS company**
  (Implementations / Onboarding / Technical Consulting).
* Proven ability to
  **run enterprise onboarding projects**
  end-to-end with minimal supervision.
* Skilled in conducting discovery, documenting workflows, and translating requirements into system configurations.

**AI-First Aptitude**

* Strong curiosity and a builder mindset—someone who experiments, prototypes, and learns independently.
* Comfortable using modern AI-assisted development or scripting tools (e.g.,
  **Cursor, Replit, Lovable**
  or similar) to automate tasks, validate data, test APIs, or streamline workflows.
* Driven to “own your destiny” by building small scripts, utilities, or workflows that make onboarding faster, cleaner, and more scalable.

**Consultative & Communication Skills**

* Ability to
  **be assertive**
  —advise customers on the best approach rather than simply taking requirements.
* Experience navigating escalations and difficult conversations with professionalism.
* Excellent written and verbal communication; ability to simplify technical concepts.

**Problem-Solving & Ownership**

* Strong analytical skills with a bias for action—thrives in ambiguity.
* High ownership mentality: independently unblocks, drives outcomes, and keeps projects moving.

**Good-to-Have Skills**

* Experience implementing or supporting systems like
  **Salesforce, Workday/BambooHR, NetSuite, ERP/CRM/Finance tools**
  .
* Background in Professional Services, Customer Success, or PSA tools (Rocketlane, Asana, Wrike, Jira, ClickUp, Salesforce PSA).
* Understanding of SSO/SAML, enterprise IT processes, or data migration.
* Familiarity with SQL for basic data validation.
* Project Management certifications (PMP, CSM) or equivalent mindset.
* Experience in high-growth SaaS environments.

**You should apply if you:**

* Love owning customer outcomes end-to-end.
* Are technically curious and enjoy solving integration and workflow problems.
* Thrive in customer conversations—even the tough ones.
* I want to help shape the future of an
  **AI-first Professional Services org**
  .
* Are energized by autonomy, impact, and building something that scales.

**Why join us?**

At Rocketlane, we’re all about building a great product and a great place to work. Here’s why you’ll actually look forward to Mondays:

* **Impact and ownership**
  : You won’t just be another cog in the machine; here, you’re more like a turbocharged engine part. Bring your ideas, make them happen.
* **Work with the best**
  : We’re a team of passionate, quirky, and ridiculously talented people. Come for the work, stay for the memes.
* **Celebrate wins**
  : Whether we’re hitting major milestones or celebrating new funding, we like to mix it up. From
  rap videos
  to team outings, we believe in celebrating big.
* **Learn and grow**
  : We’re all about learning—and we’re not just talking about the latest SaaS trends. You’ll grow your career, pick up new skills, and maybe even learn to love Excel (or at least tolerate it).
* **Flexibility and balance**
  : While we love collaborating in the office five days a week, we know everyone has their own rhythm. That’s why we offer flexibility around hours—so you can bring your best energy, whether you’re an early bird or a night owl. Pyjamas optional (at least outside the office).

title: AI Innovation Engineer
description:
**Vestas is the global leader in sustainable energy solutions and a driving force in the wind energy industry. Our core business encompasses the development, manufacturing, sales, installation, and servicing of wind turbines worldwide. At Vestas, we are committed to accelerating the transition to renewable energy while creating innovative solutions that deliver value to our customers and stakeholders.**
**Digital Solutions & Development > Digital Solutions > Autonomous Flows - IN**
The Autonomous Flows Advisors team sits within Vestas' Digital Development Platform and accelerates the AI and automation transformation across the business. We act as internal advisors and enablers, partnering with product teams and business areas across the value chain (R&D, commercial, manufacturing, supply chain, services and business services) to help shape the AI strategy, scope high-impact solutions, and ensure responsible, scalable AI adoption. We work closely with cyber, legal, and data governance, and collaborate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders at all levels.As an AI Innovation Lead, you will support the redesign and operationalize frontline workflows using AI and automation. Working closely with the business teams, local technology leads, and global product teams, you will help translate business priorities into measurable workflow transformations and operational prototypes. You'll be responsible for implementing the local solutions while keeping in mind potential risks and opportunities to turn your solutions into global product features. This is not a research or purely strategic role. You will be expected to get into the details, challenge assumptions, and deliver tangible innovation.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
As an AI Innovation Lead, you will play an instrumental role in our efforts to enable the Vestas AI transformation. You will be responsible for:
  
  

* Supporting the mapping and redesign of frontline workflows together with the relevant business teams - Assessing data readiness, technical feasibility, and implementation complexity for proposed automation initiatives
* Supporting the definition of success metrics and expected business outcomes for each AI initiative, in collaboration with stakeholders
* Developing local automations in collaboration with business stakeholders and subject matter experts
* Connecting automations to relevant enterprise data and systems using approved integrations and connectors
* Testing deployed prototypes with live frontline data and iteratively improving solution quality based on structured SME feedback and evaluation results
* Identifying recurring workflow patterns, reusable components, and enterprise-scaling opportunities
* Translating learnings into a structured backlog for global solutions product owners

**Qualifications**
To be successful in this role, you need to be a highly motivated, energetic, and self-driven person, who can work independently and collaboratively with a diverse set of stakeholders. We imagine that you have most of the qualifications and competences below:
  
  

* A relevant degree in a quantitative field (IT, physics, mathematics, etc.), business transformation, or similar, combining strong technical understanding and excellent communication skills - At least 3 years of relevant experience in a similar role
* Practical understanding of automation and AI use cases, limitations, and pitfalls
* Hands-on experience building AI, automation, or software solutions using modern AI development tools
* Experience with product discovery, business process redesign, automation, operational excellence, or digital transformation initiatives

**Competencies**

* Pragmatic and structured approach to problem solving, with a focus on value creation
* Excellent communication skills, both oral and written - Ability to work across complex organizations and manage conflicting stakeholder interests
* Ability to translate complex AI concepts into clear, actionable language for non-technical stakeholders
* You seek to constantly acquire new knowledge, stay up to date within AI, and challenge yourself
* Fluent spoken and written English is a prerequisite

**What We Offer**

* Purpose. An opportunity to impact climate change and the future of next generations through automation and AI.
* Steep learning curve. You will be joining a strong team of AI advisors with both broad and deep knowledge. That means that you will have somebody to learn from, just as we will invest in continuous learning, knowledge sharing, and upskilling.
* Strong relationships. We will strive to build an informal environment of mutual trust and a tightly knit team, where we can support and inspire each other to deliver great impact for Vestas.
* Opportunity to shape your role. We have been asked to scale and anchor the impact of AI and automation across Vestas. The rest is up to us.
* Healthy work life balance, with flexible working options.
* Commitment to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. Everyone can thrive and bring their unique perspectives and skills to the team.

**Additional Information**
Your primary location will be in Chennai, India
  
  
Please note: We do amend or withdraw our jobs and reserve the right to do so at any time, including prior to the advertised closing date. Please be advised to apply on or before 30th Nov 2026
  
  
Learn more about Vestas at www.vestas.com and follow us on our social media channels
  
  
**Our commitment to a fair hiring.**
At Vestas, we evaluate all candidates solely based on their professional experience, education, and relevant skills. To support a fair recruitment process, we kindly ask that you remove any photos, dates of birth or graduation, gender pronouns, marital status, or other personal information not relevant to the role before submitting your CV/resume. Your CV/resume should focus on your professional and educational background, along with the necessary contact details (email and phone number). We train our hiring teams in inclusive evaluation and regularly review process outcomes to ensure fairness.
  
  
**DEIB Statement**
At Vestas, we recognize the value of diversity, equity, and inclusion in driving innovation and success. We strongly encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply, particularly those who may hesitate due to their identity or feel they do not meet every criterion. As our CEO states, "Expertise and talent come in many forms, and a diverse workforce enhances our ability to think differently and solve the complex challenges of our industry". Your unique perspective is what will help us powering the solution for a sustainable, green energy future.
  
  
**BEWARE – RECRUITMENT FRAUD**
It has come to our attention that there are a number of fraudulent emails from people pretending to work for Vestas. Read more via this link, https://www.vestas.com/en/careers/our-recruitment-process
  
  
**About Vestas**
Vestas is the energy industry’s global partner on sustainable energy solutions. We are specialised in designing, manufacturing, installing, and servicing wind turbines, both onshore and offshore.
  
  
Across the globe, we have installed more wind power than anyone else. We consider ourselves pioneers within the industry, as we continuously aim to design new solutions and technologies to create a more sustainable future for all of us. With more than 200 GW of wind power installed worldwide and 40+ years of experience in wind energy, we have an unmatched track record demonstrating our expertise within the field.
  
  
With 39,000 employees globally, we are a diverse team united by a common goal: to power the solution – today, tomorrow, and far into the future.
  
  
Vestas promotes a diverse workforce which embraces all social identities and is free of any discrimination. We commit to create and sustain an environment that acknowledges and harvests different experiences, skills, and perspectives. We also aim to give everyone equal access to opportunity.
  
  
To learn more about our company and life at Vestas, we invite you to visit our website at www.vestas.com and follow us on our social media channels. We also encourage you to join our Talent Universe to receive notifications on new and relevant postings.

-------------------

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**Security Consultant**

**EY Technology:**

Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently. We have 250,000 people in more than 140 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. Everything from the laptops we use, to the ability to work remotely on our mobile devices and connecting our people and our clients, to enabling hundreds of internal tools and external solutions delivered to our clients. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and is key to us being more innovative as an organization.

**EY Technology** supports our technology needs through three business units:

**Client Technology (CT) -** focuses on developing new technology services for our clients. It enables EY to identify new technology-based opportunities faster and pursue those opportunities more rapidly.

**Enterprise Workplace Technology (EWT) –** EWT supports our Core Business Services functions and will deliver fit-for-purpose technology infrastructure at the cheapest possible cost for quality services. EWT will also support our internal technology needs by focusing on a better user experience.

**Information Security (Info Sec) -** Info Sec prevents, detects, responds and mitigates cyber-risk, protecting EY and client data, and our information management systems.

  

**The opportunity**

As a Security Consultant within EY’s internal Global Information Security team, the individual will be a trusted security advisor to the Client Technology Platforms Delivery organization within IT Services. The Client Technology Platforms delivery organization is responsible for end-to-end delivery of technology programs and projects supporting EY’s Client Techmology service lines including delivery of a global managed services platform, big data and analytics solutions as well as individual line of business solutions and services. This role will directly engage in delivery on programs and projects, defining security architectures, providing security guidance, identifying and prioritizing security-related requirements, promoting secure-by-default designs and facilitating delivery of information security services throughout the system development life cycle (SDLC). The role will also direct consultants in developing appropriate risk treatment and mitigation options to address security vulnerabilities to translate these vulnerabilities into business risk terminology for communication to business stake holders.

  

**Your key responsibilities**

* Define security architectures and provide pragmatic security guidance that balance business benefit and risks.
* Design and develop cloud platform-specific security policies, standards, and procedures for management group and account/subscription management and configuration (e.g. Azure Policy, Azure Security Center, AWS Config), identity management and access control, firewall management, auditing and monitoring, security incident and event management, data protection, user and administrator account management, SSO, conditional access controls and password/secrets management.
* Engage IT project teams throughout the SDLC to identify and prioritize applicable security controls and provide guidance on how to implement these controls
* Perform risk assessments of information systems and infrastructure
* Maintain and enhance the Information Security risk assessment methodology
* Define security configuration standards for platforms and technologies
* Develop appropriate risk treatment and mitigation options to address security risks identified during security review or audit
* Translate technical vulnerabilities into business risk terminology for business units and recommend corrective actions to customers and project stake-holders
* Provide knowledge sharing and technical assistance to other team members
* Act as Subject Matter Expert (SME) in responsible technologies and have deep technical understanding of responsible portfolios

  

**Skills and attributes for success**

* Experience with Cloud Identity and Access management solutions (AAD, Federation services, SAML, Ping) in implementation and operations.
* experience with Big Data and advanced analytics, AI/ML services (such as /Azure SQL/Google Cloud SQL /Azure HDInsight/Key management solutions, Storage and backup, Load balancing, Security Management, Databases and EC2 or VM machine hosting Databricks, Data Factory, Data Lake Storage/BigQuery, Azure Analysis Services, Synapse Analytics, Machine Learning, etc.)
* Experience in working with different Cloud platforms (Software as a Service (SaaS), Platform as a Service (PaaS) and Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS)) and environments (Public, Private, Hybrid) in a security role.hands-on technical experience implementing security solutions for leading Cloud service providers e.g., Amazon AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud.
* Ability to appropriately balance firm security needs with business impact & benefit
* Ability to facilitate compromise to incrementally advance security strategy and objectives
* Ability to team well with others to facilitate and enhance the understanding & compliance to security policies
* Experience facilitating meetings with multiple customers and technical staff, including building consensus and mediating compromise
* Five or more years Working experience with the architecture, design and engineering of web-based multi-tier information systems or network infrastructures
* Experience conducting risk assessments, vulnerability assessments, vendor and third party risk assessments and recommending risk remediation strategies
* Experience working with common information security standards, such as: ISO 27001/27002, NIST, PCI DSS, ITIL, COBIT

  

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Five or more years of experience in the management of a significant Information Security risk management function
* 5 or more years of experience in an Information Security or Information Technology discipline
* Experience in managing the communication of security findings and recommendations to IT project teams and management

  

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Exceptional judgment, tact, and decision-making ability
* Flexibility to adjust to multiple demands, shifting priorities, ambiguity, and rapid change
* Outstanding management, interpersonal, communication, organizational, and decision-making skills
* Strong English language skills are required

Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:

title: Engineer - Physical design
description:
**Job ID** 2026-19510 **Date posted** Oct. 27, 2026 **Location** Bengaluru, India **Category** Hardware Engineering, Design Engineering

  

Job Overview:

We are looking for a Physical Engineer specialized in building with 1–2 years of relevant experience to join our SoC implementation team. You will contribute to next-generation SoC projects, working across the synthesis-to-GDSII flow.

This role offers hands-on experience in physical implementation, timing analysis, debugging and power, performance and area (PPA) optimization. You will collaborate with design , verification, DFT and physical IP teams, using scripting and AI-assisted workflows to improve engineering efficiency.

Responsibilities:

* Complete and support RTL synthesis, floorplanning, placement, clock tree synthesis (CTS), routing, and GDSII generation with mentorship from senior engineers.

* Analyze and improve PPA through synthesis and physical implementation.

* Conduct static timing analysis with Synopsys PrimeTime, troubleshoot setup and hold violations, and assist in achieving timing closure across operating modes and corners.

* Review timing constraints, tool reports and implementation results to identify issues, investigate root causes and propose fixes.

* Assist with physical verification and final approval processes, including DRC, LVS, signal integrity, and EM/IR analysis.

* Develop Python and Tcl scripts to automate implementation tasks, analyze reports and track quality.

* Use approved AI tools and agents to assist with scripting, report analysis and debugging, while independently validating their outputs.

* Document results, communicate technical findings and collaborate with teams to resolve implementation issues.

Necessary Skills and Experience:

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Microelectronics, VLSI or a related field.

* 1–2 years of relevant experience in ASIC/SoC physical design or implementation.

* Familiarity with the RTL-to-GDSII process, encompassing synthesis, floorplanning, placement, CTS, routing, and timing closure.

* Understanding of physical designfundamentals, including utilization, congestion, clock skew, latency, buffering and cell sizing.

* Hands-on experience with PrimeTime and at least one synthesis or physical implementation tools such as Fusion Compiler, Genus or Innovus.

* Knowledge of static timing analysis, including setup/hold checks, clock definitions, timing exceptions and multi-mode, multi-corner analysis.

* Ability to read Verilog RTL and gate-level netlists and trace timing paths to investigate implementation issues.

* Practical programming skills in Python, familiarity with Tcl, and confidence working in a Linux environment.

* Strong analytical and debugging skills, clear communication and a willingness to learn and take ownership of assigned tasks.

“Preferred” Skills and Experience:

* Exposure to advanced-node, hierarchical implementation or large SoC integration.

* Familiarity with low-power concepts, UPF, multiple voltage domains, power gating and level shifters.

* Exposure to on-chip variation, timing derates, crosstalk and signal integrity.

* Basic knowledge of power distribution networks, EM/IR analysis, IO placement, and bump-planning considerations.

* Familiarity with DFT requirements and physical verification flows.

* Experience using AI coding assistants or agents for engineering automation, including effective task definition, output validation and responsible handling of proprietary build data.

description:
Chief Operating Officer (COO) – Dr. Aravind’s IVF Fertility and Pregnancy Centre

**Company:** Dr. Aravind’s IVF Fertility and Pregnancy Centre  
**Location:** Karnataka  
**Experience:** 7–15 Years in healthcare  
**Joining:** Immediate Joiners Preferred

Job Description

Dr. Aravind’s IVF Fertility and Pregnancy Centre is looking for a responsible, well-organized, and proactive Chief Operating Officer (COO) will be responsible for the overall operational management, business performance, revenue growth and administration of all IVF and fertility centres. The role requires strong leadership in managing multiple fertility centres, coordinating clinical and non-clinical departments, improving patient conversion, monitoring branch profitability and ensuring standardized operations across all locations.

The COO will work closely with the Managing Director to execute business strategies, improve fertility centre performance, ensure patient satisfaction and drive organizational growth.

Roles and Responsibilities

**IVF Centre Operations**

* Oversee day-to-day operations of all IVF, fertility and pregnancy centres.
* Ensure smooth functioning of OPD, IVF treatment coordination, counselling, nursing, laboratory, pharmacy and front-office operations.
* Ensure all centres follow company SOPs, operational policies and management instructions.
* Monitor patient flow, appointment management, waiting time and service delivery.
* Ensure operational issues are resolved promptly without affecting patient care.

**Revenue, Business & Treatment Growth**

* Achieve branch-wise monthly, quarterly and annual revenue targets.
* Monitor IVF cycle revenue, IUI procedures, consultations, scans, fertility investigations and other treatment-related revenue.
* Review enquiry-to-consultation, consultation-to-treatment and treatment conversion ratios.
* Work with Marketing and Digital Marketing teams to improve lead quality, patient footfall and consultation bookings.
* Identify revenue gaps and implement branch-wise recovery plans.
* Improve patient follow-up, counselling effectiveness and treatment initiation rates without compromising clinical decision-making.

**Centre Head & Branch Management**

* Supervise Centre Heads, Branch Managers, Regional Managers and operational teams.
* Review branch-wise performance, revenue, expenses, patient volume and manpower productivity.
* Conduct regular branch visits and operational review meetings.
* Ensure each Centre Head is accountable for revenue, operations, patient experience and staff management.
* Identify underperforming centres and implement corrective action plans with deadlines.

**Clinical & Medical Team Coordination**

* Coordinate with IVF Consultants, Fertility Specialists, Embryologists, Andrologists, Nurses and Clinical Coordinators.
* Ensure smooth coordination between consultation, investigations, treatment planning, IVF procedures and patient follow-up.
* Monitor availability of doctors, consultation schedules, OT/procedure schedules and clinical support teams.
* Address operational bottlenecks affecting patient care and treatment continuity.
* Ensure medical decisions remain under the authority of qualified treating clinicians and clinical leadership.

**Patient Experience & Couple Coordination**

* Ensure proper handling of patients and couples throughout the fertility treatment journey.
* Monitor counselling, treatment explanation, financial communication, appointment follow-up and patient support.
* Review patient complaints, feedback, service delays and patient dropouts.
* Implement measures to improve patient satisfaction, trust, continuity of treatment and referrals.
* Ensure patient privacy, dignity and confidentiality are maintained at all centres.

**HR & Manpower Management**

* Coordinate with HR for recruitment and manpower planning of doctors, nurses, embryologists, counsellors and support staff.
* Ensure adequate manpower availability in every branch.
* Monitor attendance, punctuality, discipline, employee performance and productivity.
* Review staffing shortages, employee turnover and branch-level manpower requirements.
* Ensure induction, training, performance reviews and accountability of branch staff.

**IVF Lab, Pharmacy & Inventory Control**

* Monitor IVF laboratory operational requirements and coordination with embryology leadership.
* Ensure availability of IVF medicines, injections, consumables, lab materials and medical supplies.
* Monitor branch stock, purchase requests, consumption, expiry, wastage and inventory discrepancies.
* Coordinate with Purchase, Pharmacy, Lab and Finance teams to control costs.
* Ensure critical IVF supplies are available without interruption to patient treatment.

**Finance, Cost Control & Profitability**

* Monitor centre-wise revenue, operating expenses, profitability and financial performance.
* Control unnecessary expenses, wastage, discounts and unauthorized spending.
* Review collection efficiency, outstanding payments and treatment package realization.
* Coordinate with Finance and Accounts for branch-wise financial reporting.
* Ensure centres operate within approved budgets and financial policies.

**Marketing & Lead Conversion Coordination**

* Coordinate with Marketing, Digital Marketing and Telecalling teams.
* Review branch-wise enquiries, leads, walk-ins, consultation bookings and treatment conversions.
* Monitor lead follow-up, missed calls, pending enquiries and appointment cancellations.
* Ensure marketing leads are handled promptly and converted into consultations through effective follow-up.
* Review campaign performance and provide branch-level feedback to marketing teams.

**Quality, Compliance & Facility Management**

* Ensure all centres maintain required licenses, registrations, statutory documentation and compliance standards.
* Monitor patient records, consent documentation and operational records.
* Ensure facility cleanliness, infection control, equipment maintenance and safety.
* Coordinate with Maintenance and Administration teams for infrastructure, electrical, HVAC, generator and medical equipment issues.
* Conduct regular operational inspections and compliance reviews.

**Reporting & Management Accountability**

* Submit daily, weekly and monthly operational reports to the Managing Director.
* Review centre-wise performance dashboards and business reports.
* Conduct regular meetings with Centre Heads, Regional Heads and departmental leaders.
* Ensure management instructions are implemented within the specified timelines.
* Escalate critical operational, financial, clinical-support or patient-related issues promptly.

title: Product Support Analyst I
description:
**Powering the agentic revolution in travel.** Sabre is an AI-native technology leader, backed by one of the world’s largest travel data clouds. Built on an open, modular, cloud-native architecture, Sabre serves as the backbone for both established leaders and bold, new disruptors, guiding them to the next age of travel retailing through intelligent, connected, and personalized experiences. With AI at its core and operating at unparalleled scale, Sabre transforms insights into innovation, empowering airlines, hoteliers, agencies and other partners to retail, distribute and fulfill travel worldwide.

**Level 1 Product Support Analyst**
===================================

**Job Description**

Responsible for the analysis, replication and resolution from simple to high complexity problems, follow up of incoming Cases serving as Frontline Support customers hosted in the Sabre reservations system and using our broad portfolio of Solutions.
  
Provides Technical support through different communication channels using advanced software and diagnostic tools, as well as recommends best business practices to customers on the application usability and system maintenance.
  
Acting as a liaison between different internal teams ensuring a prompt resolution is achieved while working in a high-speed multitasking environment. Shows a high sense of urgency for sensitive issues and ensures the right level of communication is maintained with internal and external teams according to the appropriate defined service level agreements. This position will support operations across multiple shifts, including weekends and holidays as required.

**Responsibilities:**

* Under direct supervision, conducts logical analysis of customer issues and drive its resolution.
* Researches and validates application to aid customers in understanding product functionality and outputs.
* Works collaboratively in a team environment with advanced support teams, account managers, implementation and development resources to meet customer expectations regarding the resolution of maintenance issues
* Communicates effectively in written and spoken English with co-workers and customers around the world.
* Strong time management and priority setting skills are required to be able to manage daily responsibilities and own technical development and growth.
* Ensures that customer needs are satisfied. Must have the ability to evaluate the impact of the issue to the customer and escalate issues. Act as the lead interface with the customer, internal or external, regarding support on our products.
* Will deliver the highest level of customer service and satisfaction while continuously demonstrating excellent teamwork, interpersonal skills, and commitment.
* Demonstrate sense of urgency for sensitive issues.

**Job Requirements**

* Graduate. Technical experience desired.
* Demonstrates good time management and priority setting skills.
* Demonstrates effective teamwork skills.
* Demonstrates ability to work under pressure and handling complexity.
* Proficient English written and oral communication skills.
* Must be organized, able to multi-task and work in all areas as needed.
* Proven Analytical and troubleshooting skills.
* Excellent customer service skills.

**Nice to have**

* Travel/Airline Industry background is desired. Experience with travel distribution/reservation systems (Sabre, Galileo, Amadeus)
* ITIL/ XML/ SQL/ API/SQL/Programming.
* Experience using Salesforce CRM tool.
* **Language** Professional fluency in written and spoken English

Please note that only candidates who meet the minimum criteria for the role will proceed in the selection process.

title: System Administration - Platform Operations
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

As a System Administrator at Kyndryl, you’ll solve complex problems and identify potential future issues across the spectrum of platforms and services. You’ll be at the forefront of new technology and modernization, working with some of our biggest clients – which means some of the biggest in the world. There’s never a typical day as a System Administrator at Kyndryl, because no two projects are alike. You’ll be managing systems data for clients and providing day-to-day solutions and security compliance. You’ll oversee a queue of assignments and work directly with technicians, prioritizing tickets to deliver the best solutions to our clients. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here. You’ll also get the chance to share your expertise by recommending modernization options, identifying new business opportunities, and cultivating relationships with other teams and stakeholders. Does the work get challenging at times? Yes! But you’ll collaborate with a diverse group of talented people and gain invaluable management and organizational skills, which will come in handy as you move forward in your career. Your future at Kyndryl Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior System Administrator to Architect. We have opportunities for Cloud Hyperscalers that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.  

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others. Required Technical and Professional Expertise • Microsoft Windows Server 2016/2019 implementation and management • VMware ESX experience • Public/private cloud management. Especially migration from onprem to cloud solution Preferred Technical and Professional Experience • Automation experience, especially IaaS (infrastructure as a code) • Vulnerability management • Microsoft Active Directory and federation services  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

Data Governance, Security and Controls

* Experience delivering analytics or automation solutions in financial services or another regulated industry.

**Job Expectations:**

**1.** Microsoft Fabric Data Engineering

* Design and build end-to-end data solutions using Microsoft Fabric, including OneLake, Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Factory pipelines, notebooks and Gen2 dataflows.
* Ingest, transform and integrate structured and semi-structured data from SQL databases, files, SharePoint, APIs and approved enterprise platforms.
* Develop reusable ETL/ELT frameworks using SQL, Python and Fabric-native capabilities.
* Implement medallion-style data layers where appropriate and optimize pipelines for reliability, performance, scalability and cost.
* Apply data quality checks, reconciliation, lineage, metadata, access controls and monitoring across data pipelines.

**2.** Data Analysis and Business Intelligence

* Partner with stakeholders to translate business questions into analytical requirements, data models, metrics and actionable insights using AI capabilities.
* Perform data profiling, exploratory analysis, trend analysis, root-cause analysis and validation using SQL, Python, Excel and Power BI.
* Design dimensional models and governed semantic models for consistent reporting and self-service analytics.
* Build and enhance Power BI reports and dashboards using Power Query, DAX, row-level security and performance optimization practices.
* Communicate findings clearly through visual storytelling, concise commentary and decision-focused recommendations.

**3.** Power Platform Development and Automation

* Design and enhance Power Apps, including Canvas and Model-Driven applications, for data capture, workflow and operational use cases.
* Build Power Automate cloud flows for approvals, notifications, data movement, exception handling and process orchestration.
* Use Dataverse, SharePoint, SQL, APIs and approved connectors to integrate applications with enterprise data and services.
* Apply environment strategy, solution packaging, deployment, permissions, connector controls and application lifecycle management standards.

**4.** Architecture, Engineering and Integration

* Translate functional requirements into technical designs, data architectures, integration patterns and scalable solution components.
* Develop maintainable code and reusable assets using version control, peer review, testing, documentation and CI/CD practices.
* Build secure integrations with REST APIs and enterprise platforms, with appropriate authentication, error handling, logging and recovery.
* Ensure solutions meet non-functional requirements for security, resilience, performance, supportability and scalability.

**5.** Delivery and Lifecycle Management

* Support the complete delivery lifecycle: discovery, requirements, design, development, testing, UAT, deployment, production support and continuous improvement.
* Prepare technical documentation, source-to-target mappings, data dictionaries, test evidence, runbooks and release records.
* Identify delivery, data, security and operational risks early; track dependencies and support timely remediation.·
* Monitor production solutions, investigate failures and data issues and implement sustainable corrective actions.

**6.** Stakeholder Collaboration and Enablement

* Work with Product Owners, business analysts, data owners, architects, engineers, QA, DevOps, Risk and control partners.
* Explain technical concepts and analytical findings to non-technical stakeholders in clear business language.
* Facilitate requirement workshops, design walkthroughs, demos and knowledge-transfer sessions. Promote governed self-service analytics, reusable patterns and responsible adoption of Microsoft Fabric and Power Platform.

title: Senior Creative (Hybrid) - Design Studios (UX/UI)
description:
Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

Design Studios (DS) is BCG’s in-house design agency, empowering the firm with exceptional creative capabilities across the globe. We are storytellers, visual strategists, and experience designers who translate complexity into clarity. We believe design is a universal language—a powerful connector between insights and action, between brands and people.

Our team is global, diverse, and driven by purpose—bringing bold ideas to life and elevating BCG’s work across industries and markets. Whether we’re crafting presentations, launching campaigns, or building immersive digital journeys, we do it with craft, curiosity, and collaboration.

What You'll Do

As a Creative Hybrid (UI/UX) in the Design Studios team, you will play a critical role in creating impactful, human-centered digital experiences across a variety of platforms and project types. Combining your strong foundation in UX, visual design, and interaction design with a sharp understanding of business and technology, you will translate complex requirements into thoughtful design solutions.

You will collaborate closely with consultants, developers, and other creatives on multidisciplinary teams. Your work will span across user experience (UX) design, and digital product/service design (prototypes, MVPs, POCs). You’ll contribute to defining design strategies and frameworks, shaping project outcomes, and ensuring a high-quality user experience throughout. As a hybrid designer, you will thrive in ambiguity, adapt quickly, and shift seamlessly between interaction flows, brand visualizations, design systems, and communication pieces.

You’ll be expected to own the end-to-end design process on projects—you’ll lead and manage communications with clients and ensure the outcomes are high quality.

**Key responsibilities include:**

* Translating business objectives and user needs into engaging and intuitive digital experiences.
* Crafting wireframes, user flows, prototypes, interaction patterns, and high-fidelity designs.
* Producing high-quality visual design assets, including illustrations, iconography, animations, and communication layouts (presentation and storytelling).
* Conducting and synthesizing user research to inform design decisions.
* Collaborating with cross-functional teams, including consultants, developers, researchers, and visual designers.
* Staying up to date with digital and design trends, proactively bringing insights into our work and methods.

What You'll Bring

* You have a bachelor's or similar degree in design or a related field (design school preferred).
* You have at least 6 years of experience in a professional services environment, design start-up, or design agency.
* You have excellent knowledge of the Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, and other common prototyping and digital design tools.
* You have an excellent grasp of Design Best Practices and an in-depth understanding of UX design principles.
* You have excellent English language skills.
* Experience working across geographies and cultures in a matrixed global organization.

Who You'll Work With

A career in design at BCG involves bringing deep strategic, user experience, and visual expertise into product development, helping to deliver breakthrough products that engage and inspire. We have extensive knowledge of design thinking and human-centered design and are fluent in the latest technological innovations.

Additional info

**You’re good at:**

* Applying human-centered design (HCD), design thinking, and UX methodologies to uncover insights and shape solutions.
* Blending UX thinking with high-end visual design — you know how to make things work and look amazing.
* Designing for multiple platforms (web, mobile, immersive environments like AR/VR), including knowledge of platform-specific constraints and opportunities.
* Balancing creative and analytical thinking—able to iterate quickly while grounding design decisions in research and business context.
* Communicating your design decisions clearly and constructively to stakeholders and team members.
* Using tools such as Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, Miro, and prototyping platforms.
* Leveraging Gen Ai tools to your day to day work to look for efficiencies throughout the work process.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience with immersive technologies (AR/VR), gamification, or spatial interaction design.
* Exposure to front-end technologies and collaboration with development teams on handoff and implementation.
* UX Gen AI Tool knowledge and capabilities

At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.

For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.

We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork.

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

* Technical Leadership: Demonstrated ability to influence technical direction, make sound engineering trade-offs, mentor engineers, and build alignment across globally distributed teams without relying on formal reporting authority.
* Communication: Strong written and verbal communication with the ability to clearly explain technical decisions, alternatives, risks, and trade-offs to engineering and non-engineering stakeholders.

title: Sales Manager(MHE Industry)
description:
**\*Job Title: Sales Manager – Industrial Equipment / Material Handling (MHE)\***

**\*\*Job Location:\*\*** Pune, Gujarat, Delhi NCR, Chennai

**\*\*Job Type:\*\*** Full-Time

**\*\*Experience:\*\*** Minimum 2+ Years

**\*\*Industry:\*\*** Industrial Equipment / Material Handling / Capital Goods

**\*About the Company\***

A growing industrial solutions company and an authorized dealer of globally recognized brands in India. The company provides material handling and intralogistics solutions to manufacturing plants, large corporates, logistics parks, warehouses, and distribution centres.

We're focuses on improving operational productivity, workplace safety, and equipment efficiency through reliable industrial equipment and customer-focused solutions.

**\*Job Summary\***

We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Sales Manager to drive business growth in the Industrial Equipment and Material Handling Equipment (MHE) segment.

The candidate will be responsible for developing new business opportunities, managing key accounts, and selling industrial equipment such as IC forklifts, electric forklifts, warehouse equipment, and other material handling solutions.

The role involves direct B2B sales, customer visits, lead generation, product presentations, commercial negotiations, and order closures.

**\*Key Responsibilities\***

**\*\*1. Sales & Business Development\*\***

- Identify and develop new business opportunities in the assigned territory.

- Generate leads and acquire new customers from manufacturing, warehousing, logistics, and industrial sectors.

- Promote and sell industrial equipment, including IC forklifts, electric forklifts, and warehouse material handling solutions.

- Conduct customer visits, understand business requirements, and recommend suitable equipment.

- Manage the complete sales cycle, from lead generation and product presentations to negotiations and order closure.

- Develop and execute sales strategies to achieve assigned revenue targets.

**\*\*2. Key Account Management\*\***

- Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and potential customers.

- Coordinate with Plant Heads, Warehouse Managers, Procurement Heads, SCM Leaders, and senior management.

- Understand customer requirements and provide suitable product solutions.

- Ensure customer satisfaction, repeat business, and long-term business relationships.

- Coordinate with internal service teams for customer support and after-sales requirements.

**\*\*3. Market Research & Competitor Analysis\*\***

- Monitor competitor activities, product offerings, and market trends.

- Identify new business opportunities and potential customers.

- Gather market information related to pricing, customer requirements, and competitor strategies.

- Share market feedback and business development insights with management.

**\*\*4. Sales Reporting & Target Achievement\*\***

- Achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets.

- Maintain accurate sales pipelines, forecasts, and customer records.

- Prepare regular MIS reports covering leads, sales opportunities, and closures.

- Update customer information and sales activities in CRM systems.

**\*Candidate Requirements\***

**\*\*Experience:\*\***

- Minimum 2+ years of experience in B2B sales of industrial equipment, capital goods, or material handling equipment.

- Experience dealing with manufacturing companies, factories, warehouses, logistics companies, and corporate clients.

- Candidates with experience in forklift sales, crane sales, compressor sales, industrial automation, or similar industrial products will be preferred.

**\*\*Skills & Competencies:\*\***

- Strong B2B sales and business development skills.

- Good understanding of industrial equipment and material handling solutions.

- Excellent communication, negotiation, and convincing skills.

- Ability to generate leads and independently close sales deals.

- Strong customer relationship and account management skills.

- Comfortable with field sales, customer visits, and territory management.

- Basic knowledge of MS Excel, CRM tools, and sales reporting.

**\*\*Education:\*\***

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field.

- MBA in Sales or Marketing will be an added advantage.

**\*Key Performance Expectations\***

- New customer acquisition and business development.

- Revenue generation and achievement of sales targets.

- Successful conversion of leads into orders.

- Development of long-term customer relationships.

- Effective territory and key account management.

Pay: ₹800,000.00 - ₹1,000,000.00 per year

* Do you have experience handling manufacturing, warehouse, or logistics clients?

title: Procurement Executive with Pharma Background
description:
**Job Title: Procurement Executive**

**Department:** Operations (Procurement)

**Location:** Chennai – Royapettah

**Employment Type:** Full-time, Work from Office, 6 days a week

**Industry:** Healthcare / Pharma

**About MrMed**

MrMed is a fast-growing digital healthcare platform committed to making specialty and life-saving medicines accessible and affordable across India. We support patients battling chronic and critical illnesses by simplifying access to high-cost therapies and providing end-to-end assistance throughout their treatment journey.

**Role Overview**

The Procurement Executive owns the availability and cost of medicines across our catalogue, from fast-moving products and refill medicines for chronic and critical-care patients to specialty and new-demand items. You will forecast demand, plan stock, negotiate with vendors and make sure the right medicines are available before patients need them. A late supply affects a patient's therapy, so this role needs someone who is analytical, proactive and comfortable negotiating. Refill medicines are the top priority within the role, with a target of 100% availability.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Demand forecasting and stock planning:** Forecast demand across the catalogue using order history, sales trends and patient refill cycles, and set and review minimum, maximum and reorder levels.
* **Stock availability ownership:** Maintain high availability of fast-moving and specialty items, with 100% availability of refill stock, and flag shortage risks early, before they become stock-outs.
* **Vendor sourcing and development:** Identify, onboard and develop authorised vendors, distributors and manufacturers, including alternate sources for continuity of supply.
* **Negotiation and cost optimization:** Negotiate price, schemes, credit terms and delivery timelines to deliver a 2–3% purchase cost saving, and run regular pricing reviews and benchmarking.
* **Purchase order management:** Raise and track purchase orders in the ERP / purchase software, follow up on deliveries, and resolve delays, short supplies and shortages quickly.
* **Vendor performance and credit notes:** Track vendor on-time-in-full (OTIF) delivery, price variance and quality of supply, maintain updated vendor records and rate comparisons, and follow up on vendor credit notes until resolved.
* **Expiry and inventory hygiene:** Monitor near-expiry and slow-moving stock, and coordinate returns or replacements with vendors.
* **Cross-team coordination:** Work with warehouse, dispatch, billing and customer support teams to keep a live view of stock, ensure accurate billing and timely order processing, and escalate critical gaps immediately.
* **Compliance:** Purchase only from licensed and authorised sources and follow applicable drug regulations and company SOPs, working with the licensed pharmacist where required.
* **Reporting:** Prepare daily stock-out and availability reports, weekly fill-rate reports and monthly cost-saving reports in Excel.
* **Process improvement:** Use data to identify procurement bottlenecks and propose process or automation improvements.

**Requirements**

* D. Pharm / B. Pharm, or a graduate with a supply-chain background
* 1–3 years in pharma or pharmacy procurement, drug distribution, hospital pharmacy purchase or supply chain
* Fluent Hindi (mandatory); good working English

**Skills (must have):**

* Vendor negotiation
* Advanced Excel (pivot tables, lookups, data analysis)
* Working knowledge of ERP / purchase software

Interested candidate please share your updated resume with hr@mrmed.in & subashini.muthukumaran@mrmed.in

**Job Title:** Logistics Field Executive

**Dept:** Operations & Credit Control Management

**Company:** Orion Express Logistics Pvt. Ltd.

**Office Location:** Bharath nagar 3/45, Mallika Nagar Rd, cantonment, Pallavaram, Tambaram, Tamil Nadu 600043

**Work Area:** Chennai, Padi, Pondicherry

**Working Days:** Monday to Saturday (Sunday Week Off)

**Working Hours:** 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM

**Monthly CTC:** Not Disclosed + Travel Allowance as per distance travelled

**Job Type:** Full-Time (Field-Based)

**Language:** English, Hindi, Marathi

**Role Overview:**

We are looking for a responsible and proactive Field Operations & Credit Control Executive to manage sales bill submissions, payment follow-ups, material handling, shipment documentation and POD collection. · Resolve billing and payment queries in coordination with the HO Credit Control Team.

· Visit Chennai Airport Cargo Terminal for material handover and shipment booking as instructed by the HO Operations Team.

· Verify inbound and outbound shipment documents and generate LRs wherever required.

· Coordinate with the Operations Team to handle material-related activities and resolve shipment issues.

**3. POD Management**

· Collect PODs from transporters for every completed trip.

· Follow up with transporters for pending PODs.

· Maintain POD records and courier collected PODs to the Head Office.

· 12th Pass or Graduate in any discipline.

· Basic knowledge of shipment documentation, LR and POD management.

· Good communication, coordination and follow-up skills.

· Willingness to travel for field-related activities.

· Ability to work independently and manage multiple responsibilities.

**Experience Required:** 8–10 Years

Job Description

Mabara Manufacturing Company is looking for a highly experienced and dedicated **Service & Customer Relationship Manager** with 8–10 years of experience in the elevator electronics industry.

The ideal candidate should possess strong technical knowledge of elevator controllers, VVVF drives, door drives, ARD systems, and elevator electronic components, along with excellent customer relationship management and problem-solving skills.

The selected candidate will be responsible for managing customer service operations, coordinating with technical teams, resolving customer complaints, and maintaining long-term business relationships with customers across India and overseas.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage and oversee customer service operations and technical support activities.
* Handle customer complaints, service requests, and technical escalations professionally.
* Coordinate with service engineers and technicians to ensure timely resolution of technical issues.
* Maintain strong relationships with existing customers, dealers, distributors, and OEM clients.

* Monitor warranty claims, product failures, service repairs, and replacement requests.
* Coordinate with production, quality control, and sales departments to resolve customer issues.
* Follow up with customers regarding pending service cases and ensure customer satisfaction.
* Maintain service reports, customer complaint records, and service performance reports.
* Manage and guide the service support team to improve response time and service quality.
* Support customers through telephone, WhatsApp and email.

Required Qualifications & Experience

* Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Electrical, Electronics, EEE, ECE, or a related discipline.
* **8–10 years of relevant experience in the elevator or elevator electronics industry.**
* Strong technical knowledge of elevator controllers, VVVF drives, ARD systems, door drives, and electronic control boards.
* Experience in customer relationship management and technical service operations.
* Proven ability to handle critical customer complaints and technical escalations.
* Experience in managing service engineers and technical support teams.
* Excellent communication, coordination, and problem-solving skills.
* Good knowledge of MS Office, email communication, and service documentation.
* Fluency in English and Tamil; Hindi proficiency will be an added advantage.

Preferred Candidate Profile

* Candidates from elevator manufacturing companies, elevator controller manufacturers, or elevator automation companies.
* Previous experience as a Service Manager, Technical Support Manager, Customer Service Manager, or Service Operations Manager.
* Strong leadership skills with the ability to handle multiple customer service cases.
* Customer-focused attitude with a commitment to timely service and long-term business relationships.

How to Apply

Interested candidates with relevant elevator electronics industry experience are invited to apply with their updated resume.

**Job Summary:**

HealthSy Pharmacy is seeking a highly professional, detail-oriented **Retail Pharmacist** to join our team. The successful candidate will be responsible for accurately dispensing prescription medications, counseling patients on proper pharmaceutical usage and potential side effects, managing store inventory efficiently, and ensuring full compliance with healthcare regulations to deliver an exceptional patient-care experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Prescription Handling & Dispensing:** Process prescriptions accurately, ensure safe dispensing of medicines, and guide customers on dosage and medication usage.
* **Patient Counseling:** Educate customers on medication usage, potential side effects, drug interactions, and appropriate therapeutic alternatives.
* **Customer Handling:** Provide exceptional service by greeting walk-in customers, addressing their healthcare inquiries, resolving grievances, and maintaining a welcoming store environment.
* **Stock Management:** Work closely with the SCM team to maintain appropriate stock levels and properly log all customer requests to support continuous stock availability.
* **Delivery Coordination:** Maintain delivery request records and follow up to ensure timely delivery of medicines.
* **Customer Support:** Handle inbound calls and customer queries related to medicines, prescriptions, and home delivery orders.
* **Customer Retention & Support:** Deliver complete customer care and support to ensure customer satisfaction and long-term retention.
* **Billing & Cash Handling:** Support counter billing and cash transactions whenever required.
* **Storage & Safety:** Ensure proper storage of medicines, including temperature-sensitive products, and maintain stock security.
* **Regulatory Compliance:** Follow applicable pharmacy regulations, licensing requirements, and HealthSy operational policies.
* **SOP & Policy Adherence:** Comply strictly with standard operating procedures (SOPs) and company policy for sheet handling, billing software usage, and transaction processing.
* **Inventory Verification & Inward Checks:** Perform thorough inward stock inspections by checking quantities, MRP, batch numbers, and expiry dates before updating stock entries in the system.

* B.Pharm / D.Pharm qualification.

title: Senior Technical Lead
description:
**Job Summary**
---------------

We build an AI-powered application security platform. It reads source code, finds security vulnerabilities, and then produces a fix that a person reviews and approves. Customers install it and run it inside their own cloud environment. The stack is Python (Langgraph, FastAPI, Pydantic V2), TypeScript, React, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes and the major cloud platforms.

**About the role**
------------------

You'll be the senior engineering owner of the backend platform, and the person everyone else learns the system from. Your job is to spread the knowledge across a team and lift engineering quality as that team grows.

The core backend service runs the analysis and remediation workflow. It's long-running and resumable, it pauses for human decisions, and it has to survive restarts without losing state.

You'll be our first engineering hire and the person who can deploy and debug the whole system. You'll also review everyone's code. Reviewing senior work and disagreeing with it is part of the job, not a rare exception.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Own the backend service: workflow logic, the API layer, and the boundaries between internal modules.
* Review all code and set the quality bar for the team.
* Take the system from single-instance to horizontally scalable without breaking correctness.
* Technically onboard every engineer who joins after you.
* Write architecture decisions alongside the team, and challenge them.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* Substantial production Python(Langgraph, FastAPI, Pydantic V2,asyncio) including async code and static typing.
* Experience with long-running, stateful or resumable workflows: state machines, checkpointing, or jobs that have to survive interruption. The framework matters far less than having solved this class of problem.
* Strong relational data modelling, plus safe schema migrations against live systems.
* You've owned a codebase other teams depended on, and you were accountable when it broke.
* You read existing systems before you change them, and you can explain someone else's design fairly even when you disagree with it.

title: Analyst 3 - Supply Chain Planning
description:
Comcast brings together the best in media and technology. We drive innovation to create the world's best entertainment and online experiences. As a Fortune 50 leader, we set the pace in a variety of innovative and fascinating businesses and create career opportunities across a wide range of locations and disciplines. We are at the forefront of change and move at an amazing pace, thanks to our remarkable people, who bring cutting\-edge products and services to life for millions of customers every day. If you share in our passion for teamwork, our vision to revolutionize industries and our goal to lead the future in media and technology, we want you to fast\-forward your career at Comcast. **Job Summary**


The Analyst will play a key role within the Supply Chain Planning team by turning data into clear insights, improving reporting accuracy, and driving automation and process improvements. This role is ideal for a candidate with hands\-on experience across demand planning, procurement, logistics, and inventory management who enjoys solving operational problems, working with large datasets, and partnering with business teams to improve visibility, efficiency, and decision\-making.**Job Description**

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1\. Supply Chain Analytics** **\& Reporting**

* Analyze supply chain planning data across demand, procurement, logistics, inventory, suppliers, and operations to identify trends, risks, exceptions, and improvement opportunities.
* Prepare accurate reports, dashboards, trackers, and business summaries that support timely planning decisions and escalation.
* Support planning activities including demand analysis, inventory positioning, supply risks, supplier commitments, and exception management.

  



**2\. Data Management \& Analysis**

* Work with large and complex datasets from multiple sources, using Excel, Power Query, and related tools.
* Clean, validate, reconcile, and organize data to improve reporting quality and reduce manual effort.

  



**3\. Process Automation \&** **Improvement**

* Identify repetitive manual activities and support automation or simplification using Microsoft 365, Power Automate, and standardized workflows.
* Document improved processes, maintain repeatable solutions, and measure the impact of automation and process changes.

  



**4\. Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Partner with internal teams, stakeholders, and suppliers to understand requirements, resolve data or process issues, and support business priorities.
* Communicate findings, risks, and recommendations clearly in a practical and business\-friendly manner.

  



**Required Qualifications \& Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or equivalent, with 6–7 years of relevant experience in supply chain planning, operations, analytics, or related functions, with hands\-on exposure to demand planning, procurement, logistics, inventory management, reporting, or process improvement.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including formulas, PivotTables, Power Query, data cleansing, validation, and analysis of large datasets.
* Experience improving reporting, workflows, or operational processes through automation, standardization, or process simplification.
* Strong analytical thinking, problem\-solving, attention to detail, communication, ownership, and ability to work independently.
**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Power BI, SQL, Power Apps, Power Automate, ERP/MRP systems, or tools used in supply chain planning and execution.
* Exposure to supplier management, manufacturing, operations analytics, or cross\-functional business process improvement.
**Technical Skill Expectations**

* Supply Chain Planning.
* Excel, Power Query, Data Analysis
* Power Automate
* Power BI

title: Hospital management system Support/ Implementation Analyst
description:
**Position Overview**

We are seeking a hands-on **HIMS Business & Implementation Analyst** to drive end-to-end implementation, workflow optimization, and ongoing client success for the **HIMS Platform**.

In this role, you will bridge the gap between clinical stakeholders and engineering teams. You will work directly with doctors, nurses, billers, and hospital administrators to translate complex operational needs into technical specifications, optimize clinical and administrative workflows, manage system rollouts, and ensure high user adoption.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Requirements Gathering & Workflow Optimization**

· Engage directly with healthcare staff (physicians, nursing, administrative, billing, and lab teams) to map clinical workflows and identify operational bottlenecks.

· Translate business and clinical requirements into technical specifications for the product and development teams.

· Propose tailored solutions using the HIMS Platform to streamline patient registration, appointment scheduling, billing, EHR management, and diagnostic machine integrations.

**2. End-to-End System Implementation**

· Lead the full system lifecycle—from pre-implementation setup and module configuration to data migration and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).

· Perform system testing, master data imports, and pre-go-live readiness checks.

· Ensure strict alignment with national/regional healthcare standards and regulations (such as HIPAA).

**3. Customer Support & SLA Management**

* Act as the escalation point for incoming customer support requests, software troubleshooting, and operational inquiries.
* Manage helpdesk ticketing operations, prioritizing incidents, conducting root cause analysis, and enforcing strict SLA resolution targets.
* Troubleshoot software bugs, database queries (SQL/MySQL), integration issues (biometric readers, lab analyzers, printers), and operational bottlenecks.
* Perform routine system health checks and coordinate regular software releases, feature updates, and patch deployments with client IT teams.

**4. Training, Change Management & Analytics**

* Design and execute tailored onboarding and training programs for both technical and non-technical healthcare personnel.
* Develop standard operating procedures (SOPs), user manuals, and standardized pre-implementation questionnaires.
* Analyze clinical, financial, and operational data to deliver actionable performance insights (e.g., patient wait times, bed utilization, support ticket trends) to hospital leadership.

**Qualifications & Education**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Healthcare Administration, Business Administration, Information Technology, Computer Science, or Bio-Medical Engineering.
* **Experience:** 3+ years of combined experience in HIS/HMS/EHR implementation, healthcare IT business analysis, and application technical support.

**Core Competencies & Technical Skills**

* **Domain & Operational Expertise:** In-depth knowledge of hospital operations (OPD, IPD, LIMS, RIS, HR/Payroll, Billing) and healthcare compliance.
* **Customer Support & Escalation Handling:** Proven track record in managing L2/L3 customer support, helpdesk ticketing tools, client SLAs, and customer retention strategies.
* **Technical & Database Proficiency:** Hands-on experience with SQL/relational databases, data migration, machine-to-software integrations, and biometric hardware setup.
* **Communication & Conflict Resolution:** High empathy and clear communication skills to effectively interface with hospital executives, doctors, and non-technical support staff under high-pressure scenarios.

**Interview Evaluation Criteria**

**Evaluation Pillar**

**Focus Areas & Key Competencies**

**1. Healthcare Operations & Workflows**

OPD/IPD flows, revenue cycle management, LIMS/RIS processes, hardware integrations, and regulatory standards.

**2. Implementation & Technical Analysis**

Requirements gathering, UAT management, SQL database queries, data migration logic, and technical gap analysis.

**3. Customer Support & SLA Operations**

Incident classification, root cause analysis, helpdesk management, SLA enforcement, and handling disgruntled clients during critical system outages.

**4. Communication & Leadership**

Executive reporting, change management, training non-technical clinical staff, and cross-functional team coordination.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: ₹400,000.00 - ₹800,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person
