title: Strategic Insights Analyst
description:
At Quantcast, we don't just build advertising technology, we revolutionize how it works. Our AI-powered Demand Side Platform (DSP) connects the world's most ambitious marketers with their ideal audiences across the open internet, delivering results that actually move the needle. Since 2006, we've been the industry's trailblazer, launching the first AI-powered measurement platform for publishers and the first AI-driven DSP. Our AI doesn't just optimize—it delivers the measurable outcomes that matter most to our clients, giving them the competitive edge they need in a crowded marketplace. Ready to join the team that's defining the future of digital advertising?

### **About the Role**

Quantcast is looking for a data-driven, commercially minded **Strategic Insights Analyst** to join our Insights team. In this role, you will work alongside some of the brightest talent in the digital advertising space, gaining direct exposure to high-stakes marketing challenges across multiple global markets and industries

You will bridge the gap between complex data analytics and client storytelling—equipping our global Sales and Account Management teams to bring deeper consultative value to every client conversation. By mining Quantcast’s proprietary first-party behavioral signals alongside syndicated third-party research, you will uncover shifting consumer journeys, identify untapped revenue opportunities, and craft compelling, pitch-ready narratives for our highest-value enterprise advertisers and agency partners worldwide.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* **1PD & Third-Party Data Fusion:** Combine Quantcast’s proprietary audience signals with syndicated market research to build holistic industry snapshots, audience personas, and competitive displacement stories across priority verticals
* **Consumer Journey & Opportunity Discovery:** Proactively identify emerging consumer behaviors, shifting path-to-conversion patterns, and seasonal/tentpole media opportunities that help clients capture incremental demand.
* **Consultative Narrative & Pitch Storytelling:** Stitch together persuasive, client-ready narratives for new business, Joint Business Plans (JBPs)—translating raw behavioral and campaign data into clear business recommendations.
* **Scalable Data Extraction & Analytics:** Expert at **SQL, Snowflake, and Python** to size generate bespoke insights and also automate repeatable insight templates for self-serve sales enablement.
* **AI-Enabled Insight Generation:** Leverage modern data infrastructure, LLMs, and internal AI workflows to accelerate research synthesis, pattern detection, and insight packaging across regional sales teams.
* **Cross-Regional Pod Collaboration:** Partner closely with Account Directors, Product Marketing, and our Measurement Science team to turn complex analytical findings into modular slides

### **Qualifications & Experience**

* **Experience:** **5+ years** of hands-on experience in data analytics, audience insights, or commercial strategy within the **advertising, ad tech, media agency, or digital publishing industry**.
* **Technical Stack:** Strong proficiency in **SQL** and **Snowflake** for large-scale data querying, paired with practical **Python** skills for data manipulation and workflow automation.
* **Data Storytelling:** Proven ability to synthesize complex, multi-source datasets (1PD, programmatic bidstream/behavioral data, and 3rd-party syndicated research) into concise, visually compelling executive slides.
* **Market Research Exposure:** Familiarity with quantitative and qualitative market research methodologies, brand/audience tracking, and syndicated tools (such as GWI, eMarketer, Comscore, or Nielsen).
* **AI & Modern Data Curiosity:** Hands-on comfort adopting evolving data tools and generative AI workflows to scale analytical output and uncover non-obvious consumer trends.
* **Commercial Mindset:** Strong understanding of digital advertising fundamentals (programmatic DSPs, upper- vs. lower-funnel KPIs, attribution, and media planning cycles) with the ability to communicate clearly with non-technical sales stakeholders.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Familiarity with BI visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker) and building self-serve data assets for commercial teams.

At Quantcast, we craft offers that reflect your unique skills, expertise, and geographic location. On top of a competitive salary, this position includes a performance bonus, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package. For more details, visit our Careers Page and see how we support our team. We are headquartered in San Francisco with offices around the world. Quantcast is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Please see the Applicant Privacy Notice for details on our applicant privacy policy. Join the team that unlocks potential.

description:
Job Description – Accounts Executive (Textile & Garment Manufacturing)

**Company:** Cottony Fashions  
**Location:** Tiruppur, Tamil Nadu  
**Department:** Accounts & Finance  
**Experience:** 2–5 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full-time  
**Reports To:** Accounts Manager / Management

Cottony Fashions is a Tiruppur-based knitted garment manufacturer and exporter with over 30 years of industry experience. We manufacture and export knitted garments for international brands and private labels, serving customers across multiple international markets.

We are looking for a detail-oriented and responsible Accounts Executive to manage daily accounting operations, financial documentation, statutory compliance and coordination with internal departments.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Day-to-Day Accounting**

* Maintain daily accounting transactions and financial records.
* Record sales, purchases, receipts, payments and journal entries.
* Maintain general ledger, cash book and bank book.
* Verify invoices, bills, vouchers and supporting documents.
* Ensure accurate and timely accounting entries in the company's accounting software.

**2. GST & Statutory Compliance**

* Prepare and verify GST-related records and documentation.
* Assist with GSTR-1, GSTR-3B and other applicable GST filings.
* Verify purchase and sales invoices and reconcile input tax credit.
* Coordinate with external auditors and tax consultants.
* Maintain TDS records, deductions and applicable statutory documentation.
* Assist with income tax and other statutory compliance requirements.

**3. Accounts Payable & Receivable**

* Manage supplier invoices and payment records.
* Track outstanding payments and prepare supplier payment schedules.
* Monitor customer outstanding balances and follow up on collections.
* Maintain vendor and customer account ledgers.
* Perform regular supplier and customer account reconciliations.

**4. Textile & Garment Costing Support**

* Maintain purchase and material cost records for yarn, fabric, trims and accessories.
* Assist in calculating garment manufacturing costs.
* Track production-related expenses and job work charges.
* Coordinate with merchandising and production departments for cost information.
* Maintain records of fabric, accessories and other material purchases.

**5. Banking & Financial Transactions**

* Handle bank reconciliations.
* Maintain cheque, NEFT, RTGS and other payment records.
* Assist with working capital and cash flow monitoring.
* Coordinate with banks for routine financial transactions.
* Maintain proper documentation for banking activities.

**6. Export Documentation & Accounting**

* Maintain export sales invoices and supporting documentation.
* Assist with export-related GST and LUT documentation.
* Coordinate with the logistics and export documentation teams.
* Maintain records of shipping bills, bills of lading and export realisation documents.
* Assist in tracking export proceeds and foreign currency receipts.

**7. Financial Reporting**

* Prepare daily, weekly and monthly accounting reports.
* Assist in preparing profit and loss statements and balance sheet schedules.
* Maintain expense reports and department-wise cost records.
* Prepare outstanding receivables and payables reports.
* Assist management with financial data and reporting requirements.

**8. Audit & Documentation**

* Maintain organised financial records and supporting documents.
* Assist in internal, statutory and tax audits.
* Verify financial transactions and identify discrepancies.
* Ensure proper documentation and approval procedures for payments and expenses.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* B.Com, M.Com or MBA in Finance.
* 2–5 years of experience in accounting and finance.
* Previous experience in textile or garment manufacturing is preferred.
* Good knowledge of GST, TDS and basic accounting principles.
* Working knowledge of Tally, ERP or accounting software.
* Good knowledge of MS Excel.
* Understanding of accounts payable, accounts receivable and bank reconciliation.
* Knowledge of export accounting and documentation is preferred.
* Strong numerical, analytical and organisational skills.

Preferred Qualities

* Experience in a garment export or textile manufacturing company.
* Understanding of manufacturing expenses and job work accounting.
* Ability to maintain accurate financial records.
* High level of integrity and confidentiality.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Ability to coordinate with multiple departments.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Accuracy of accounting entries.
* Timely completion of bank reconciliations.
* GST and statutory compliance accuracy.
* Timely supplier payment processing.
* Customer outstanding and collection tracking.
* Accuracy of financial reports.
* Timely completion of monthly accounts closure.
* Proper maintenance of financial documentation.

What We Offer

* Opportunity to work with an established garment export company.
* Exposure to textile manufacturing and export accounting.
* Opportunity to develop financial reporting and cost-control systems.
* Career growth within the accounts and finance department.

**Interested candidates can share their updated resume at:**

**Location:** Mannarai, Tiruppur.

title: Customer Support Executive (CSE)
description:
**About the Role:**

HealthSy Pharmacy is looking for a friendly, patient **Customer Support Executive** for our **Kilpauk store**. You will handle customer queries through **phone calls and chat**, making sure every customer gets accurate, timely help. This role does not involve walk-in or counter customers.

**Key Responsibilities1. Phone & Chat Support**

* Answer incoming calls and respond promptly to chat messages from customers.
* Handle queries about medicine availability, pricing, offers, store timings, and home delivery.
* Make outbound calls and send chat messages for order confirmations, delivery updates, and refill reminders.

**2. Order Management & Follow-up**

* Take orders and prescription uploads received over phone and chat, and share them with the pharmacist and billing team.
* Track orders until delivery and keep customers updated on status.
* Follow up on pending orders, failed deliveries, and prescription refills.

**3. Complaint Handling & Returns**

* Log, track, and resolve complaints (wrong item, delays, billing issues, returns) received by phone or chat.
* Escalate unresolved issues to the Store Manager.
* Explain return, refund, and exchange policies clearly.

**4. Record Keeping & Data Confidentiality**

* Record every call and chat enquiry accurately in the CRM/billing software.
* Keep all customer and prescription data strictly confidential.

**5. Sales Support & Promotions**

* Inform customers about loyalty programs, health check-ups, and other store services during calls and chats.
* Send approved offers and updates through chat.

**6. Pharmacist Coordination & Compliance**

* Pass any medicine-related or clinical questions (dosage, substitutes, side effects, interactions) to the pharmacist. Support staff must not give medical advice.

**Qualifications & Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree is preferred.
* 0 to 2 years of experience in telecalling, customer support, Freshers with strong communication skills may be considered.
* Fluent in **Tamil and English**.
* Clear, polite communication over phone and in written chat.
* Good typing speed and basic computer skills (MS Office, billing/CRM software, chat support tools).
* Patience and empathy, especially with elderly and anxious customers.
* Good problem-solving and multitasking skills.
* Should be based out of Kilpauk or willing to relocate.
* **Work timings:** 11:00 AM to 8:00 PM.
* **Note: The selected candidate will be working from the HealthSy Pharmacy Kilpauk store.**

**Compensation:**

**Salary range:** ₹[15] to ₹[20k] per month, based on experience and interview performance

**Plus:**

* PF, ESI (as applicable).

**How to apply:**

* Ensure your qualifications align with the job description before applying.
* Send your resume with a relevant subject line to **pravin.k@healthsy.in** **or** **careers@healthsypharmacy.com****.**
* Call **8925828032** directly or share your resume via WhatsApp at the same number.

Pay: ₹16,000.00 - ₹20,000.00 per month

* Provident Fund

What we’re looking for

* Comfortable communicating in **English, Tamil, and Hindi**.

title: Cluster Manager
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Position: Retail Cluster Manager – Multi-Store Operations

Department: Retail Operations

Work Location: Anna Nagar, Chennai

Store Locations: All the other stores of Chennai

Reporting To: Management / Director

Team Reporting: Branch Managers (BMs) of both stores

Job Overview

We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Retail Cluster Manager to oversee the overall operations and business performance of our company-owned and franchise retail stores in Chennai.

The candidate will be responsible for managing both Anna Nagar and Thiruvanmiyur stores, ensuring smooth day-to-day operations, achieving sales targets, maintaining inventory, supervising staff, ensuring store maintenance and delivering excellent customer experiences.

The primary work location will be Anna Nagar, with mandatory visits to the Thiruvanmiyur store at least 2–3 times a week to monitor operations and business performance.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Overall Store Operations**

- Manage and oversee the day-to-day operations of both company-owned and franchise stores.

- Ensure smooth functioning of all retail activities across both locations.

- Establish and implement standard operating procedures (SOPs) across stores.

- Monitor store discipline, operational efficiency and staff productivity.

- Ensure proper coordination between both branches and their respective teams.

**2. Sales & Business Performance**

- Drive sales growth and achieve monthly and quarterly sales targets.

- Monitor daily sales, revenue, conversion rates and store performance.

- Analyse sales reports and identify opportunities to improve business.

- Implement strategies to increase walk-ins, customer conversions and repeat purchases.

- Track individual staff performance and ensure accountability for sales targets.

- Share regular sales performance reports with management.

**3. Inventory & Stock Management**

- Monitor stock availability, inventory movement and replenishment.

- Ensure accurate stock records and conduct regular physical stock verification.

- Prevent stock shortages, excess inventory, damages and pilferage.

- Coordinate with procurement and warehouse teams for timely stock replenishment.

- Monitor inter-store stock transfers and maintain proper documentation.

**4. Customer Relationship & Service Management**

- Ensure excellent customer service and customer satisfaction across both stores.

- Handle escalated customer complaints, feedback and service-related issues.

- Ensure staff follow professional customer-handling practices.

- Monitor customer experience and implement measures to improve customer retention.

- Ensure effective handling of high-value customers and important customer interactions.

**5. Staff Management & Supervision**

- Directly supervise and manage the Branch Managers of both stores.

- Ensure proper delegation of responsibilities and accountability among store employees.

- Monitor staff attendance, punctuality, grooming, discipline and productivity.

- Identify training requirements and arrange regular staff development.

- Support recruitment, onboarding and performance evaluation of store employees.

- Conduct regular review meetings with Branch Managers.

**6. Store Maintenance & Infrastructure**

- Ensure both stores are clean, organised and maintained professionally.

- Monitor housekeeping, lighting, air conditioning, electrical systems and other facilities.

- Coordinate repairs, maintenance activities and vendor services.

- Ensure product displays, visual merchandising and store presentation standards are maintained.

- Monitor maintenance expenses and ensure cost-effective utilisation of resources.

**7. Franchise Store Coordination**

- Monitor franchise store operations and ensure adherence to company policies and brand standards.

- Coordinate with franchise management and ensure operational consistency.

- Review sales, stock, customer service and staff performance.

- Conduct periodic operational audits and identify areas requiring improvement.

- Ensure franchise stores maintain the expected brand image and service quality.

**8. Reporting & Management Coordination**

- Submit daily, weekly and monthly operational reports to management.

- Provide updates on sales, inventory, manpower, maintenance and customer issues.

- Identify operational challenges and recommend corrective actions.

- Take ownership of store-level issues and ensure timely resolution.

- Act as the primary coordination point between management and both Branch Managers.

**Work Location & Travel Requirements**

- Primary work location: Anna Nagar, Chennai.

- Responsible for overseeing all the other store of chennai.

- Mandatory visits to Thiruvanmiyur at least 2–3 times per week.

- Must be comfortable with frequent inter-store travel and hands-on operational supervision.

**Candidate Profile**

- Graduate in any discipline; preference for Business Administration or Retail Management.

- 5–8 years of experience in retail operations or multi-store management.

- Previous experience managing multiple retail outlets is highly preferred.

- Experience handling Branch Managers and retail teams.

- Strong knowledge of sales management, inventory control, customer service and store administration.

- Good leadership, communication, negotiation and problem-solving skills.

- Proficiency in MS Excel, sales reports and inventory management systems.

- Must be willing to travel between store locations regularly.

Pay: ₹300,000.00 - ₹400,000.00 per year

* Have you handled staff recruitment, training, attendance and performance reviews? Yes/No
* Are you proficient in MS Excel and retail reporting systems? Yes/No

**Employment Type:** Full-time, Permanent  
**Department:** Electrical Design

**Job Description**

We are looking for an experienced **Senior Electrical Design Engineer** to lead electrical design activities for Special Purpose Machines (**SPMs**), industrial automation equipment, and customized machinery. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in electrical schematics, control panel design, component selection, machine wiring, and coordination with **PLC**, mechanical design, and production teams.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Lead electrical design and development for SPMs, industrial automation systems, and customized machinery.
* Prepare electrical schematics, power and control circuit diagrams, panel layout drawings, and machine wiring diagrams.
* Develop electrical designs using **AutoCAD Electrical, EPLAN**, or **equivalent electrical CAD software.**
* Select and size electrical components, including **MCBs**, **MCCBs**, **contactors**, **relays**, **SMPS, VFDs, servo drives, motors**, and **safety devices.**
* Design PLC I/O interfaces, sensor connections, actuator wiring, and industrial control circuits.
* Prepare **BOMs**, **cable schedules, terminal plans**, and complete **electrical documentation**.
* Review electrical designs for safety, reliability, cost-effectiveness, and compliance with applicable standards.
* Coordinate with mechanical design, PLC programming, manufacturing, and assembly teams throughout project execution.
* Guide electrical technicians and engineers during panel building, machine wiring, testing, and commissioning.
* Troubleshoot electrical design issues and implement engineering modifications.
* Support **FAT**, **SAT**, **Machine commissioning**, and customer technical discussions when required.
* Manage multiple projects, ensure timely drawing release, and maintain design documentation.

**Preferred Technical Skills**

* Advanced proficiency in AutoCAD Electrical, EPLAN, or equivalent electrical design tools.
* Strong expertise in industrial electrical design and control panel engineering.
* In-depth knowledge of PLC systems, I/O wiring, VFDs, servo drives, sensors, motors, and industrial safety circuits.
* Experience in electrical component selection, load calculations, cable sizing, and circuit protection.
* Strong understanding of machine wiring, panel layouts, grounding, and electrical safety.
* Knowledge of BOM preparation, terminal plans, cable schedules, and engineering documentation.
* Experience in SPM design, machine automation, robotics, or customized industrial equipment.
* Familiarity with IEC standards and applicable industrial electrical safety requirements.

Preferred Candidate Profile

* B.E./B.Tech or Diploma in Electrical and Electronics Engineering (EEE) or a related discipline.
* 7–15 years of relevant experience in electrical design, control panel engineering, SPMs, or industrial automation.
* Proven experience in designing electrical systems for machines or automation projects.
* Ability to independently handle electrical design activities from concept to commissioning.
* Experience in design reviews, technical problem-solving, and cross-functional coordination.
* Strong leadership, communication, and project execution skills.

**Benefits**

* **Permanent employment.**
* **PF, ESI, and insurance as per company policy.**
* **Opportunity to work on customized machinery and industrial automation projects.**

title: Infrastructure Test Engineering Senior Analyst - Performance Engineering
description:
Are you ready to make an impact at DTCC?
  
  
Do you want to work on innovative projects, collaborate with a dynamic and supportive team, and receive investment in your professional development? At DTCC, we are at the forefront of innovation in the financial markets. We are committed to helping our employees grow and succeed. We believe that you have the skills and drive to make a real impact. We foster a thriving internal community and are committed to creating a workplace that looks like the world that we serve.
  
  
The Information Technology group delivers secure, reliable technology solutions that enable DTCC to be the trusted infrastructure of the global capital markets. The team delivers high-quality information through activities that include development of essential, building infrastructure capabilities to meet client needs and implementing data standards and governance.
  
  
**Pay And Benefits**

* Competitive compensation, including base pay and annual incentive
* Comprehensive health and life insurance and well-being benefits, based on location
* Pension / Retirement benefits
* Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.
* DTCC offers a flexible/hybrid model of 3 days onsite and 2 days remote (onsite Tuesdays, Wednesdays and a third day unique to each team or employee).

**The Impact You Will Have In This Role**
You will be the member of Enterprise Product & Platform Engineering where that will transform the way of delivering infrastructure to our business clients. A key construction of EP&PE will be the evolution of the IT Product Manager, who will partner with Engineering Domains, Business Aligned Service Delivery organization, DevSecOps Domain and our operational support teams to ensure that IT PM&D provides high quality, commercially attractive and timely solutions to support our business strategy.
  
  
The Infrastructure Test Engineering Senior Analyst is responsible for design, development, and maintenance of automated and/or manual test solutions to validate Infrastructure changes or implementations. Collect requirements and set goals and objectives for performance testing. Identify the desired performance characteristics of the system resources including response time, throughput, and resource utilization. Infrastructure Test Engineering Senior Analyst will be part of the Infrastructure testing team within EPPE to provide and support the testing of Infrastructure changes or new implementations done by various engineering teams. The infrastructure requirements will be either to address applications’ infrastructure requirements or internal environments. Identify the software agents, hardware, and network configurations for testing. Provide technical leadership to the performance engineering. Work closely with the development team during performance testing/tuning, and coordinate troubleshooting efforts. Experience with conducting root cause analysis of performance issues and bottlenecks. Evaluate, deploy, operate, and maintain performance monitoring tools. This position requires excellent verbal, written and analytical skills to be able to interact with application development teams, business analysts/SME’s, business users and project managers to understand requirements and communicate status.
  
  
**Your Responsibilities**

* Be a key technical player in contributing the architecture evolution of Infrastructure Test Automation Frameworks and related capabilities.
* Define, design, development, documentation and maintenance of tools and Automation Frameworks for current and Infrastructure Validations as part of an Agile team
* Deliver end to end performance testing for projects independently, using Agile methodologies
* Perform the Performance Engineering test activities, standard of Operation enhancements. Provide strong leadership and detailed management of change, both on software agents and hardware and demand management. Correlate application release plans with Performance Engineering testing activities, status reporting, prioritize in concert with business needs and priorities.
* Partners with project stakeholders to ensure effective planning and requirements definition.
* Active participant in all phases of the project lifecycle. Work with project stakeholders during project definition to help the team understand risks, dependencies, and opportunities; participate in requirements definition and review; lend subject matter expertise to projects.
* Creates solutions and conduct performance tests to improve availability, performance, reliability, capacity and scalability in the system or database layers.
* Understands system’s technical architecture, and able to identify the performance implications for different layers of system based on design discussions or architecture documents.
* Review design documents and code to identify potential performance bottlenecks and defects.
* Maintains credibility in communication and takes actions on assigned responsibilities.
* Provide mentoring, knowledge transfer and assist in training of junior team members.
* Build reusable components to automate repeatable, manual activities.
* Support performance, resiliency, and recovery validation activities for applications and platforms, including availability, failover, scalability, and recovery testing across cloud, container, and hybrid environments.
* Participate in resiliency test planning and execution by supporting risk-based test scenarios, recovery validation, observability-driven analysis, and RTO/RPO verification activities.
* Collaborate with engineering and operations teams to analyze performance and resiliency test results, document findings, and provide traceable test evidence for governance, audit, and operational readiness reviews.

**Talents Needed For Success**

* 2+ years of IT experience with proven expertise in performance engineering (analysis, testing, and tuning)
* Experience developing simulators in multiple languages, such as Java, PL SQL, Python for simulating performance load.
* Experience with performance diagnostics/monitoring tools such as DynaTrace or AppDynamics
* Experience with JMeter, LoadRunner or custom load generation tools
* Strong performance analysis skills, including system metrics and thread/heap dump analysis
* Broad experience with multiple middleware and data store technologies, such as message queues, relational databases, non-relational databases, caches, stream processing, batch processing
* Extensive knowledge of Linux operating system, especially process/system monitoring and performance measurement
* Experience with AWS cloud services are preferred
* In-depth experience with Java application servers is a huge plus
* Experience with JVM tuning of heap size and garbage collection is good to have
* Experience with database query optimization and analysis is a plus
* Familiarity with JMS or MQ
* Familiarity with log ingestion and analysis tools, such as Splunk
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines on Jenkins and source code control/repository is a plus
* Experience working with Agile development teams

title: Associate Director, Measurement Activation Planning and Strategy
description:
****Job Description****
**Associate Director – Integrated Measurement (MAPS)**
**Measurement, Activation, Planning & Strategy (MAPS) Product Line | DHH India Hub Delivery**
**Reports to**
Director – Customer Knowledge and Measurement, DHH India Hub Delivery
  
  
**Location**
Hyderabad, India;
  
  
international and domestic travel as required by business
  
  
**Capability scope**
Integrated measurement, measurement and planning, product build, activation enablement, and AI-enabled planning and measurement across brands and markets KPI and measurement frameworks, marketing mix modeling, multi-touch attribution, incrementality and test-and-learn, campaign and content performance, investment and ROI optimization, insight-to-planning feedback loops, and AI-enabled measurement across the One marketing framework journey
  
  
**Leadership scope**
Lead measurement science, analytics, insights, and product build teams (product owners, data scientists, AI and data engineers); partner with MAPS Customer Insight, Planning, and Activation capabilities; orchestrate pods across Brand, Commercial, Finance, Data Science/AI, Technology, Content, and Market partners
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
Lead the Integrated Measurement capability within the Measurement, Activation, Planning & Strategy (MAPS) , turning performance evidence into decisions that improve brand planning, customer activation and effectiveness, investment allocation, performance measurement and future growth across brands and markets.
  
  
**Job Description**
This role sits within the Customer Knowledge and Measurement capabilities vertical of Digital Human Health (DHH), India Hub Delivery. MAPS connects customer insight, planning, activation, and measurement to improve decision-making and business performance across brands and markets. The Associate Director, Integrated Measurement-MAPS will own the measurement backbone of MAPS, ensuring every plan has clear success metrics, every activation is measured consistently, and every insight feeds back into optimization and investment decisions.
  
  
The role brings together KPI and measurement frameworks across customer identification, marketing mix and attribution modeling, incrementality testing, campaign and content performance analytics, and investment and ROI optimization into a single, integrated view of performance. Beyond analytics, the role owns the build of scalable measurement and planning products, such as ROI simulators, budget optimizers, and performance intelligence tools, and embeds measurement into activation so that insights drive strategy and planning, targeting, omnichannel orchestration and optimization. A key mandate is to accelerate AI-enabled planning and measurement, including GenAI and agentic solutions for automated insight generation, scenario planning, and optimization, and to scale proven solutions across brands and markets.
  
  
The Associate Director will work closely with the MAPS Lead and the Customer Insight, Planning, and Activation capability leads, and partner with Brand Strategy, Customer Engagement, Finance, Data Science/AI, Commercial Technology, and market teams to close the loop between strategy and execution.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Define and lead the Integrated Measurement roadmap and India Hub delivery model within Customer Knowledge and measurement, aligned to MAPS product line priorities and to US and international brand and market needs.
* Establish a common measurement framework, including KPI hierarchy, definitions, data standards, and success criteria, that links brand strategy and planning objectives to activation and business outcomes.
* Lead advanced measurement solutions, planning and strategy, customer mapping, including marketing mix modeling, multi-touch attribution, incrementality and holdout testing, and closed-loop campaign and content measurement, with clear guidance on when to use each approach.
* Connect strategy and execution by ensuring performance insights directly inform brand planning, channel and content optimization, in-flight campaign adjustments, and resource allocation decisions.
* Activate capability to embed measurement into activation, including audience and segment targeting, next-best-action and trigger performance, omnichannel orchestration across CRM, email, web, media, and field channels, and closed-loop optimization of HCP and patient campaigns.
* Partner with Brand, Commercial, and Finance leaders to drive evidence-based investment decisions through ROI analysis, scenario planning, budget optimization, and identification of future growth opportunities.
* Run a structured test-and-learn agenda across brands and markets, capturing learnings in a reusable knowledge base that accelerates planning and activation for future campaigns.
* Accelerate AI-enabled planning and measurement by defining the AI roadmap for MAPS measurement, prioritizing use cases by business value, and applying AI/ML, GenAI, and agentic capabilities to automated performance monitoring, anomaly detection, forecasting, scenario planning, and optimization recommendations.
* Build and deploy AI solutions with Data Science/AI and Technology partners, such as conversational insight assistants, automated campaign performance readouts, AI-driven budget reallocation, and agentic planning and measurement workflows, with responsible-use guardrails, human-in-the-loop review, and value tracking.
* Scale measurement capabilities across brands and markets through reusable models, standardized dashboards, self-service tools, and playbooks that reduce cycle time and cost to serve.
* Own the product build of measurement and planning products, such as MMM and ROI simulators, budget and channel-mix optimizers, performance intelligence dashboards, and measurement data products, from discovery and MVP through release, adoption, and continuous improvement, using product management practices (vision, roadmap, backlog, user stories, and success metrics).
* Partner with Data Engineering, Commercial Technology, and AI platform teams on solution architecture, data pipelines, model operationalization (MLOps), and integration with planning and activation platforms, so that products are production-grade, reusable, and scalable across brands and markets.
* Ensure measurement rigor and trust through strong data quality, model validation, privacy and compliance controls, transparent assumptions, and consistent performance reporting across stakeholders.
* Establish governance and operating rhythms for prioritization, roadmap and backlog management, adoption, and value tracking, and report measurable business impact to MAPS and DHH leadership.
* Build and develop a high-performing team that combines measurement science, commercial understanding, consulting skills, product thinking, and stakeholder influence to deliver measurable impact.

Education Requirements
  
  
Master’s degree or equivalent experience in Statistics, Econometrics, Economics, Data Science, Decision Science, Marketing Science, Engineering, Computer Science, Business, Life Sciences, or a related discipline. Advanced degree such as MBA, MS, MPH, PharmD, or PhD preferred.
  
  
**Required Experience And Skills**

* 8+ years of experience in pharma/biotech commercial analytics, marketing science, measurement and ROI analytics, omnichannel analytics, data science, or related functions, with a strong track record in marketing and promotional measurement.
* 4+ years of people leadership experience, including coaching measurement/analytics teams and leading cross-functional pods in a global, matrixed environment.
* Deep expertise in measurement methodologies, including MMM, multi-touch attribution, incrementality/holdout testing, experimental design, causal inference, and forecasting.
* Proven experience translating measurement insights into planning, budget allocation, and optimization decisions, and influencing brand and investment choices with senior stakeholders.
* Demonstrated experience building and scaling analytics or AI products end to end, including product ownership, agile delivery, working with engineering teams, and driving user adoption and measurable value.
* Strong understanding of brand planning, customer engagement strategy, segmentation and targeting, omnichannel activation, and how measurement connects across the insight-to-plan-to-activate cycle.
* Hands-on exposure to activation, including omnichannel campaign execution, next-best-action and triggers, audience targeting, and in-flight optimization of HCP and patient engagement.
* Experience with customer and promotional data sources such as CRM activity, Rx, claims, media and spend data, web analytics, email engagement, content interaction, sales, market research, and syndicated data.
* Familiarity with modern data, analytics, and MarTech platforms such as Veeva, Salesforce, Adobe Experience Cloud, Power BI/Tableau, Databricks, AWS/GCP, Python/R, or similar platforms.
* Strong AI/ML and GenAI fluency, including practical experience with machine learning, LLMs, and agentic AI use cases, and a responsible-use mindset, with the ability to identify, build, and scale AI-enabled planning and measurement solutions that improve speed, accuracy, productivity, and decision quality.
* Ability to translate ambiguous business questions into structured solutions and communicate the so what/now what clearly through compelling data storytelling.

**Additional location(s) Compensation Information**
****Required Skills****
AI Implementation Planning, AI Implementation Planning, AI Systems, Brand Planning, Brand Strategy, Business Intelligence (BI), Coaching, Database Design, Data Engineering, Data Modeling, Data Science, Data Storytelling, Data Visualization, Forecasting Models, Growth Investing, Level Measurement Instruments, Machine Learning (ML), Marketing Science, Patient Engagement, People Management, Performance Reports, Product Management, Product Ownership, Responsible AI, Software Development {+ 3 more}

description:
**About Us**
We’re Reckitt, home to the world’s best loved and trusted hygiene and health brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose.
  
  
Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege
  
  
**About Global Business Services**
Behind our iconic power brands that touch millions of lives daily – from Dettol and Lysol to Durex and Nurofen – lies a dynamic and vital engine: Reckitt's Global Business Services (GBS).
  
  
Fuelled by a culture of positive energy and co-creativity - while learning together – One Reckitt GBS is at the forefront of our business, driving efficiency, standardisation, and innovation across our global operations. We're a fast-paced, purposeful team, constantly seeking to optimise our processes, leverage cutting-edge technology, and deliver exceptional value to every corner of Reckitt. We’re not a traditional back-office function; we’re a strategic powerhouse where diverse individuals with bright minds come together to solve complex challenges, shape future capabilities, and build a better global business that directly helps achieve Reckitt’s mission
  
  
**About The Role**
As an Senior Analyst, you will play a key role in delivering high-quality Record-to-Report (RTR) services, ensuring the accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of financial data across your assigned scope.
  
  
You will take ownership of core RTR processes including balance sheet reconciliations, period-end close, inventory accounting, fixed assets, lease accounting, consolidation and financial reporting, and statutory reporting, while supporting strong financial controls and compliance.The role also requires proactive issue resolution, stakeholder collaboration, and driving improvements in processes, automation, and data quality within a global operating model.
  
  
As a senior member of the team, you will act as a subject matter expert within your area, support junior analysts, and contribute to standardisation and transformation initiatives.
  
  
Your responsibilities
  
  

* Perform end-to-end complex RTR activities including journal postings, accruals, prepayments, and general ledger management
* Review work performed by junior RTR analysts, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and adherence to accounting policies, internal controls, and close timelines
* Own and execute period-end close activities, ensuring adherence to timelines and quality standards
* Prepare and review balance sheet reconciliations, ensuring completeness and timely resolution of reconciling items
* Ensure accuracy and integrity of financial data within ERP systems (SAP, Blackline) and reporting tools
* Support financial reporting processes, including variance analysis and management reporting
* Ensure compliance with internal controls, accounting policies (IFRS/US GAAP), and audit requirements
* Investigate and resolve complex accounting issues and escalate where necessary
* Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders (e.g., Treasury, FP&A, Tax, AP/AR) to resolve queries and improve processes
* Support internal and external audit activities by providing required documentation and explanations
* Act as a point of guidance for junior team members, supporting knowledge sharing and capability building

The experience we're looking for
  
  

* 5 years of experience in RTR, financial accounting, or shared services environment
* Professional qualification in Finance or Accounting (e.g., CA, ACCA, CPA, MBA)
* Strong experience in general ledger accounting, month-end close, and reconciliations
* Working knowledge of accounting standards (IFRS/US GAAP)
* Experience using ERP systems (e.g., SAP S/4HANA, Blackline, or similar) and financial reporting tools
* Solid understanding of internal controls, compliance, and audit processes
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a deadline-driven environment
* Effective communication and stakeholder management skills

The skills for success
  
  

* General Ledger Accounting & Financial Close
* Journal Entries, Accruals & Reconciliations
* Financial Reporting & Variance Analysis support
* ERP Systems (SAP, S/4HANA, Blackline, or similar)
* Knowledge of accounting standards (IFRS/US GAAP)
* Internal Controls, Compliance & Audit support
* Data Accuracy & Financial Integrity
* Continuous Improvement & Process Optimisation
* Stakeholder Collaboration
* Analytical Thinking & Attention to Detail

What we offer
  
  
With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way.
  
  
We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt’s potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt’s pay for performance philosophy.
  
  
Equality
  
  
We recognise that in real life, great people don’t always ‘tick all the boxes’. That’s why we hire for potential as well as experience. Even if you don’t meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you.
  
  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability or medical condition; colour, ethnicity, race, citizenship, and national origin; religion, faith; pregnancy, family status and caring responsibilities; sexual orientation; sex, gender identity, gender expression, and transgender identity; protected veteran status; size or any other basis protected by appropriate law.

* Build referral, alumni and parent channels that bring in good leads

* Own the admissions side of the CRM and keep the data and reporting clean

title: Accounts Payable Specialist
description:
**ABOUT DARWINBOX**

Darwinbox is a Hyderabad-headquartered HR technology (SaaS) company operating across eight geographies — India, Singapore, the Philippines, the UAE, the USA, Indonesia, Thailand, and Malaysia. Our Finance team runs a multi-entity, multi-currency close on NetSuite and is actively automating its Accounts Payable processes.

**ROLE SUMMARY**

The AP Executive owns day-to-day transaction processing in Accounts Payable — raising purchase orders, booking vendor invoices, preparing payments and reconciling bank accounts — and is the first point of contact for vendors and internal requestors on AP matters. We need someone who is accurate under month-end deadlines, understands GST and TDS treatment at the transaction level, and communicates clearly in writing and on calls.

**QUICK FACTS**

**Location:**
Hyderabad, India (HQ)

**Department:**
Finance & Accounts — Accounts Payable

**Reporting To:**
Head of Accounts Payable

**Experience:**
5–8 years in Accounts Payable (hands-on, end-to-end Procure-to-Pay)

**Qualification:**
B.Com / M.Com / MBA (Finance); CA Inter or CMA Inter is a plus

**Systems:**
NetSuite preferred; SAP, Oracle or equivalent acceptable

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Purchase Order Management**

* Raise purchase orders in NetSuite only against approved purchase requisitions and budget approvals, within the delegation-of-authority matrix
* Validate PO details — vendor, rates, quantity, currency, tax, payment terms and cost centre — against the approved quote or contract
* Track open POs, follow up with requestors on receipts, process approved amendments and close stale POs

**Vendor Invoice Booking**

* Verify each invoice before booking — PO or contract match, approvals, GSTIN, HSN/SAC and tax calculation, TDS section and rate, and duplicate check
* Book invoices in NetSuite with the correct GL, cost centre, tax code, TDS and currency, within the agreed turnaround time and month-end cut-off
* Process foreign-currency and import-of-services invoices, including reverse-charge GST treatment, using the correct exchange rate
* Tag prepaid items, flag uninvoiced services for month-end accruals, and follow up to clear accruals once invoices arrive
* Record vendor advances and adjust them against invoices; maintain the invoice tracker and ageing
* Work with the AP automation tools (OCR invoice capture, GL tagging, payment tracker) as they roll out — report exceptions and give feedback

**Payment Processing**

* Prepare payment runs based on due dates, agreed terms and cash availability; release only against approved, booked invoices
* Work to maker-checker: the executive prepares payment batches and an authorised approver releases them
* Update bank advices and UTRs, and send payment confirmations to vendors
* Collect the documentation required for foreign remittances (Form 15CA/15CB, invoice, agreement)
* Track MSME vendor payments against the statutory timelines (Section 43B(h)) and flag at-risk invoices in advance

**Bank Reconciliation (BRS)**

* Prepare monthly bank reconciliation statements (weekly where required) for assigned bank accounts in NetSuite
* Clear reconciling items — outstanding payments, unreflected receipts, bank charges, direct debits and timing differences — and investigate unidentified entries
* Escalate items open beyond 30 days with root cause and proposed action
* Keep bank statements and supporting evidence audit-ready; obtain reviewer sign-off every month

**Vendor Reconciliation & Communication**

* Reconcile statements for key vendors monthly and resolve differences with the vendor and the internal owner
* Respond to vendor queries on invoice status, payment dates and rejections — clearly, courteously and within agreed response times
* Coordinate with Procurement, requestors and budget owners to resolve PO–invoice mismatches and missing approvals or documents
* Support vendor onboarding and master-data changes — check PAN, GST, MSME/Udyam status and bank proof; verify bank-detail changes by call-back

**Month-End Close, Controls & Audit Support**

* Complete AP tasks per the close calendar — invoices booked, accruals and prepaids tagged, AP sub-ledger reconciled to GL
* Support GSTR-2B reconciliation by following up with vendors on missing or mismatched invoices
* Provide invoices, ledgers, vendor confirmations and bank reconciliations to statutory, internal and tax auditors
* Follow SOPs and approval limits; raise duplicate-payment risks and process gaps with the Head of AP

**MANDATORY QUALIFICATIONS**

* 5–8 years of hands-on AP experience across the full cycle — PO, invoice booking, payments and reconciliations
* Strong BRS experience across multiple bank accounts and high transaction volumes
* Working knowledge of GST (ITC, RCM, e-invoicing), TDS provisions and MSME payment rules as they apply to AP
* Hands-on ERP experience — NetSuite preferred; SAP, Oracle or equivalent acceptable
* Understanding of accrual accounting — accruals, prepaids, cut-off — and AP sub-ledger to GL reconciliation
* Excellent written and spoken English — comfortable dealing with vendors, requestors and senior finance stakeholders
* Advanced Excel (lookups, pivots, conditional sums)
* Strong attention to detail, ownership, and a track record of meeting close deadlines with low error rates

**PREFERRED BACKGROUND**

* Multi-entity and multi-currency AP experience, ideally in a SaaS or technology company
* Exposure to AP automation or OCR invoice-capture tools
* Exposure to statutory audits and internal financial controls testing
* Experience with cross-border vendors and foreign-currency payments

**HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED**

* Invoices booked accurately and within the agreed turnaround time
* Payments released on due date, with no duplicate or unapproved payments
* BRS completed within the close calendar, with no unexplained items beyond 30 days
* Vendor statement differences resolved within the month
* Vendor and requestor queries answered within agreed response times

**CORE COMPETENCIES**

**PO Management**
**Invoice Booking**
**Payment Processing**

**Bank Reconciliation (BRS)**
**Vendor Reconciliation**
**Vendor Communication**

**GST & TDS**
**NetSuite ERP**
**Advanced Excel**

**WHAT DARWINBOX OFFERS**

* Ownership of a core AP workflow in a multi-entity, multi-currency finance function
* Exposure to AP automation, with direct input into how it is built and refined
* Close working relationship with the Head of AP and Group Finance leadership
* Competitive compensation aligned to experience, and structured growth within Finance

title: Applied Scientist I, Worldwide Returns & Recommerce - Science
description:
**Description**
Welcome to the Worldwide Returns & ReCommerce team (WWR&R) at Amazon.com.
  
  
WWR&R is an agile, innovative organization dedicated to ‘making zero happen’ to benefit our customers, our company, and the environment. Our goal is to achieve the three zeroes: zero cost of returns, zero waste, and zero defects. We do this by developing products and driving truly innovative operational excellence to help customers keep what they buy, recover returned and damaged product value, keep thousands of tons of waste from landfills, and create the best customer returns experience in the world. We have an eye to the future – we create long-term value at Amazon by focusing not just on the bottom line, but on the planet. We are building the most sustainable re-use channel we can by driving multiple aspects of the Circular Economy for Amazon – Returns & ReCommerce.
  
  
Amazon WWR&R is comprised of business, product, operational, program, software engineering and data teams that manage the life of a returned or damaged product from a customer to the warehouse and on to its next best use. Our work is broad and deep: we train machine learning models to automate routing and find signals to optimize re-use; we invent new channels to give products a second life; we develop highly respected product support to help customers love what they buy; we pilot smarter product evaluations; we work from the customer backward to find ways to make the return experience remarkably delightful and easy; and we do it all while scrutinizing our business with laser focus.
  
  
You will help create everything from customer-facing and vendor-facing websites to the internal software and tools behind the reverse-logistics process. You can develop scalable, high-availability solutions to solve complex and broad business problems.
  
  
We are a group that has fun at work while driving incredible customer, business, and environmental impact. We are backed by a strong leadership group dedicated to operational excellence that empowers a reasonable work-life balance. As an established, experienced team, we offer the scope and support needed for substantial career growth.
  
  
Amazon is earth’s most customer-centric company and through WWR&R, the earth is our customer too. Come join us and innovate with the Amazon Worldwide Returns & ReCommerce team!
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Design, develop, and evaluate highly innovative models for Natural Language Programming (NLP), Large Language Model (LLM), or Large Computer Vision Models.
* Use SQL to query and analyze the data.
* Use Python, Jupyter notebook, and Pytorch to train/test/deploy ML models.
* Use machine learning and analytical techniques to create scalable solutions for business problems.
* Research and implement novel machine learning and statistical approaches.
* Mentor interns.
* Work closely with data & software engineering teams to build model implementations and integrate successful models and algorithms in production systems at very large scale.

**About The Team**
When a customer returns a package to Amazon, the request and package will be passed through our WWRR machine learning (ML) systems so that we could improve the customer experience, identify return root cause, optimize re-use, and evaluate the returned package. Our problems touch multiple modalities spanning from: textual, categorical, image, to speech data.
  
  
We operate at large scale and rely on state-of-the-art modeling techniques to power our ML models: XGBoost, BERT, Vision Transformers, Large Language Models.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
* Experience with SQL and an RDBMS (e.g., Oracle) or Data Warehouse

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience implementing algorithms using both toolkits and self-developed code
* Have publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals

Implement Event-Driven and Messaging Solutions using Azure Service Bus, Event Hub, and Azure Functions to support real-time and asynchronous integration scenarios.
  
  
Leverage Agentic AI Capabilities to design intelligent integrations using Azure AI services, Azure OpenAI, Copilot technologies, AI agents, and workflow orchestration to enhance business automation and operational efficiency.
  
  
Design AI-Enabled Integration Patterns that combine traditional integration services with generative AI, intelligent document processing, conversational workflows, and autonomous decision-making capabilities.
  
  
Establish DevOps and CI/CD Practices utilizing Azure DevOps, Git Repositories, Pipelines, Infrastructure as Code (ARM/Bicep/Terraform), automated testing, and deployment strategies.
  
  
Ensure Security, Compliance, and Operational Excellence through implementation of secure coding practices, API security, monitoring, observability, logging, vulnerability remediation, and quality gates.
  
  
Provide Technical Leadership and Mentorship to development teams through code reviews, architecture reviews, design guidance, and adoption of integration best practices.
  
  
Collaborate with Business and Technology Stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable integration solutions and drive successful project delivery.
  
  
Stay Current with Emerging Technologies in Azure Integration Services, Agentic AI, Cloud-Native Architecture, and Modern Integration Patterns, driving innovation and continuous improvement.
  
  
The experience we're looking for
  
  
11-14 years of overall IT experience with 7-10 years of hands-on experience in Azure Integration Services.
  
  
Strong expertise in Logic Apps, API Management, Azure Functions, Service Bus, Event Grid, Storage Accounts, Key Vault, and Azure Monitor.
  
  
Hands-on experience with Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, Git, and Infrastructure as Code.
  
  
Good Exposure & hands-on experience with Azure OpenAI, AI Agents, Microsoft Copilot, Agentic AI frameworks, and AI-powered automation.
  
  
Experience in enterprise integration, API-led connectivity, microservices, and event-driven architectures.
  
  
Strong communication, stakeholder management, and solution architecture skills.
  
  
The skills for success
  
  
Azure Logic Apps, API Management, Azure Functions, Service Bus, Event Hub, Event Grid, Azure OpenAI, Copilot, Agentic AI, AI Agents, Azure DevOps, Terraform, Bicep, Microservices, Event-driven Architecture, Integration Architect
  
  
What we offer
  
  
With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way. We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.
  
  
Equality

title: Architect - Infra
description:
**Overview**
 Microsoft Industry Solutions Delivery (ISD) is a global organization hosting over 6,000 strategic sellers, industry and security experts, elite engineers, world\-class data scientists and architects, consultants, and delivery specialists. Together with our partners, we help Microsoft’s most strategic customers worldwide to address their specific challenges and provide comprehensive and industry\-specific solutions that meet their unique needs. ISD is at the forefront of innovation, driving value across the entirety of the customers’ digital and AI transformation journey through repeatable and customized cutting\-edge solutions through strategic engagements with customers across the globe powered by Microsoft Cloud and AI.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Understanding Customer/Partner Technical Environment
   

  

 Gathers customer/partner insights from a broad range of stakeholders as well as the main business sponsor to shape and form both the definition and ongoing execution of projects. Identifies and evaluates industry trends (customer industry verticals, information technology \[IT] industry). Adapts business models, plans, and solutions to insights.
   

  

 Works with customer/partner stakeholders (e.g., Enterprise Architects, Security Team, Development Team, Operations Team) and business sponsor to socialize both the business solution and the project approach to determine if changes are needed to the business solution. Where the cost of change is accepted by the customer, shares this feedback with the project team and the broader account team to make the necessary adjustments using mechanisms such as updating the solution approach and projected costs in presales and change requests in delivery. Contributes to Microsoft\-centric operations and cadences to align with customer feedback.
   

  

 Uses evidence\-based approach to represent the customer/partner as a customer advocate and shares insights with Product Engineering teams and the business with a view to improving Microsoft technologies, products, services, and offerings such that they can better meet customer/partner needs across a territory.
   

  

 Architecture Design and Deployment
   

  

 Leverages a structured approach to Architecture Projects using existing methodologies (e.g., Waterfall, Agile, Iterative) that make use of existing reference architecture and established architectural styles and design patterns. Proposes and develops new solutions to scale across multiple customers/partners. Builds and maintains an architecture description document, an architecture decisions log, and a requirements/constraints traceability matrix to ensure the rationale for the business solution's Architecture is known and understood. 
   

  

 Defines and documents the architecture through an architecture description document, an architecture decisions log, and a requirements/constraints traceability matrix to communicate the value proposition of the business solution along with the project approach. Leads complex cost\-based and technology\-based discussions to explain the Architecture in terms of its build, deployment, and ongoing operational use to determine customer appetite for the business solution. Uses a business\-value approach that values return on investment (ROI) and customer costs\-savings over technical ease of execution. 
   

  

 Collaborates with the Project Manager to jointly drive project/technical governance of the design, build, and deployment into use of proof of concepts (POCs) and pilots, using enterprise architecture processes and ensuring quality control through peer review. Works with customers to understand and demonstrate business value (e.g., release of revenue, cost savings) that the business solution realize.
   

  

 Works with the business sponsor and customer/partner stakeholders (e.g., Business users, Enterprise Architects, Security Team, Operations Team) to gather and ratify requirements and constraints. Manages and resolves complex ambiguity in the requirements and constraints and documents assumptions and implications where it cannot be resolved. Maintains the requirements/constraints traceability matrix to prove that solution components have a rationale/justification for inclusion in the architecture of the business solution. Drives development and execution of test plans to prove that each requirement/constraint has been implemented as expected by the customer. Where there are defects, works in close collaboration with the Project Manager and Customer to redress or accept and document the status of the test results. 
   

  

 Collaborates with the Account Team and/or Bid Team to understand the business solution/problem. Drives agreement, based on the customer’s priorities, requirements/constraints, approach, principles, concepts, and expectations. Builds and documents a realistically costed, advanced/complex Solution Approach with traceability of requirements, constraints, decisions, and tradeoffs that balances risk, technical credibility, and technical innovation to meet customer need, predominantly based on existing solution offerings and/or reference architecture. Jointly leads the implementation in close partnership with the Project Manager. Leads oversight and governance and establishment of quality practices and standards to realize the business solution. Uses a cohesive build methodology with an agreed release schedule and timeline so the solution can be transitioned to live operations, leveraging solution expertise. Ensures communication of and adherence to the pre\-sales value proposition. Works with the Project Manager to highlight where assumptions have proven false. Uses change requests to modify the Solution/project approach when needed. As needed, collaborates with subject matter experts to receive specialized advice that can help define the Solution and project approach and increase the time to value for the customer.
   

  

 Anticipates and identifies scenarios that could slow or impede pre\-sales/delivery. Orchestrates the broader Microsoft team to address technical blockers and works with account/project team to resolve non\-technical issues. Reports significant problems to Microsoft management and resolves escalations when needed. Plans a way forward in complex and ambiguous situations with an innovative approach and durable design. Delegates and leverages specialist skills of others to drive technical alignment across internal/external teams. Coordinates disparate approaches into a single plan of action for complex scenarios.  
   

  

 Works in close collaboration with the Project Manager and Account Team to identify, categorize, and communicate business and technical risks. Defines risk mitigation activities that are foundational to the project plan. Defines risk contingency plans for invocation should the risk occur. When appropriate, oversees a broad portfolio of accounts. Manages and ensures the all\-up delivery of consulting engagements, as necessary. 
   

  

 Practice Development
   

  

 Generates new and/or improvements to existing intellectual property. Connects gaps and patterns across business and technology areas to drive changes. Identifies which ideas should be culled, with consideration for scale across customers. Drives the re\-use of intellectual property and recommends practices in both pre\-sales and delivery. Participates and contributes to internal/external communities. 
   

  

 Trusted Advisor
   

  

 Develops a network of internal/external relationships with senior\-level decision makers to build influence in addressing problems/blockers and facilitating additional views on the matter of interest. Acts as an advisor to external stakeholders. Provides direction to facilitate relationships between others. Stays up to date on Microsoft’s technologies, products, and services in order to communicate Microsoft's mission, strategy, and capabilities. When appropriate, develops a strategic relationship with key stakeholders within the customer portfolio, often as part of a steering committee, to ensure service delivery is on track and major issues are being anticipated, identified, and managed.
   

  

 Uses evidence\-based arguments that articulate complex concepts in a simple manner to respectfully challenge Microsoft and customers/partners when a decision or course of action will not produce optimal results. Leverages strategic expertise to encourage alternative approaches where applicable. Serves as the "technical conscience" to challenge the status quo and unrealistic expectations. Proactively resolves conflicts and seeks resolution to balance the overall outcome. Drives consensus where possible and leads decisions to resolve conflict when needed.
   

  

 Leads the adoption of Microsoft solutions technologies based on understanding of competitor solutions and how customer business value can be driven through Microsoft's offerings. Differentiates Microsoft's solutions in customer/partner conversations to influence the industry\-wide direction for specific architecture(s).
   

  

 Thought Leadership
   

  

 Leads virtual teams around technologies and customer/partner challenges by sharing ideas, insight, and strategic, technical input with technical teams, internal communities across the field, and the larger virtual team across Microsoft using knowledge of Microsoft architectures and their context in the competitive landscape.
   

  

 Participates in external architect community events (e.g., conferences, seminars, technical meetups, Webcasts, blogs, hackathons) and shares learnings with internal team. Acts a mentor to less experienced colleagues by educating them on technical and non\-technical concepts and sharing best practices. Demonstrates deep industry knowledge and drives recognition for Microsoft solutions through presentations and engagements with external audiences.
   

  

**Other**
 Embody our culture and values
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent work experience) relevant to Information Technology, Computer Science/Engineering.
   

  

 At least 12\-14\+ years related IT experience with Solution Architecture having experience in enterprise\-scale technical experience with cloud and hybrid infrastructures, architecture designs, database migrations, and technology management.
   

  

 Work experience should involve pre\-sales support on large deals in technical consulting, solution design of complex solutions, project envisioning, planning, development, deployment, and Team management.
   

  

 Must have a proven record of delivering business value and proven trust\-relationships with CxO, ITDM, BDM
   

  

 The job may require travel.
   

  

 Fluent English verbal and written communications skills are a must.
   

  

 Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or the recruiting process, please send a request via the Accommodation request form.Benefits/perks listed below may vary depending on the nature of your employment with Microsoft and the country where you work.
