title: Senior Consulting Manager - AOC / UOC
description:
**AVEVA is creating software trusted by over 90% of leading industrial companies.**
**The Job Summary**
We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced
**Senior Consulting Manager – AVEVA Operations Control**
to lead the design, architecture, and delivery of enterprise-scale Industrial Automation and Digital Transformation solutions using the AVEVA Operations Control portfolio. The ideal candidate will possess extensive expertise in AVEVA Operations Control, AVEVA System Platform, Historian, Operations Management Interface (OMI), Reports, and enterprise industrial system architectures, along with a strong understanding of OT-IT convergence, cloud technologies, cybersecurity, and enterprise integration.
  
  
The role is responsible for defining scalable, secure, resilient, and high-availability solution architectures while providing technical leadership throughout the entire project lifecycle—from solution consulting and architecture through engineering, deployment, testing, commissioning, and production support. The successful candidate will establish technical standards, drive architecture governance, and ensure solutions align with customer business objectives, industry best practices, and organizational quality standards.
  
  
In addition to technical leadership, this role includes people management responsibilities, providing mentorship, coaching, and career development for a team of solution architects, technical leads, and engineers. As a trusted technical advisor, the Solution Architect will collaborate closely with customers, business stakeholders, project managers, delivery teams, and cross-functional engineering groups to deliver innovative, reliable, and scalable industrial digital transformation solutions across industries including Oil & Gas, Chemicals, Manufacturing, Mining, Power, Utilities, Water, and Infrastructure. The successful candidate will foster a culture of technical excellence, continuous improvement, innovation, and collaboration while ensuring successful project delivery and customer satisfaction.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Solution Design & Architecture**

* Lead the architecture, design, and implementation of enterprise-scale Industrial Automation and Digital Transformation solutions using the AVEVA Operations Control portfolio.
* Define scalable, secure, resilient, and high-availability solution architectures that align with customer business objectives, enterprise IT standards, and OT operational requirements.
* Prepare, review, and maintain Solution Design Documents (SDD), Functional Design Specifications (FDS), Detailed Design specifications (DDS), Solution architecture, System Architecture, Factory Acceptance Test Procedure, Site Acceptance Test Procedures and deployment documentation.

* Design and govern deployment architectures for the complete AVEVA Operations Control ecosystem, including:

+ AVEVA System Platform
+ AVEVA Operations Management Interface (OMI)
+ AVEVA Historian
+ AVEVA Identity Manager
+ Galaxy Repository
+ Application Object Servers
+ Alarm Servers
+ Communication Drivers
+ License Manager
+ Microsoft SQL Server
+ IIS Web Servers

* Architect High Availability (HA), Disaster Recovery (DR), redundancy, backup, and failover strategies to ensure maximum system availability and business continuity.
* Lead infrastructure sizing, capacity planning, scalability assessments, and performance optimization for enterprise and mission-critical deployments across on-premises, virtualized, and cloud environments.
* Define enterprise system architecture, network topology, server infrastructure, cybersecurity controls, communication protocols, and integration patterns, customer standards, and AVEVA best practices.
* Design secure authentication and authorization solutions leveraging Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, HTTPS/TLS, and role-based access control (RBAC).
* Review and approve technical designs, engineering deliverables, and deployment strategies to ensure architectural consistency, maintainability, and operational excellence.
* Establish architecture standards, reusable design patterns, implementation guidelines, and technical governance processes across projects.
* Evaluate new AVEVA product capabilities and emerging technologies to continuously improve solution architecture, standardization, and delivery efficiency.
* Identify technical risks, perform architecture reviews, and define mitigation strategies to ensure successful project execution.
* Ensure all solution designs comply with AVEVA recommended practices, cybersecurity requirements, organizational governance, regulatory standards, and project-specific performance, availability, and reliability objectives.

**Essential Requirements**
**Non-Technical:**

* Excellent written, verbal, technical, and interpersonal communication skills with the ability to effectively engage with customers, executive stakeholders, project teams, and multidisciplinary engineering organizations.
* Strong leadership, mentoring, coaching, and people management skills with experience in developing high-performing technical teams.
* Proven ability to lead customer workshops, architecture reviews, technical governance meetings, and executive presentations.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and complex technical challenges.
* Experience in effort estimation, resource planning, risk management, and technical governance across multiple concurrent projects.
* Willingness and flexibility to travel for customer engagements, architecture workshops, solution reviews, commissioning support, and project delivery activities.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, Visio, and Microsoft Project.

**Technical**

* 18+ years of experience in Industrial Automation, SCADA, MES, or Digital Manufacturing, with at least 10 years in Solution Architecture or Technical Leadership roles.

- Extensive expertise in the AVEVA Operations Control portfolio, including:

* AVEVA System Platform
* AVEVA Operations Management Interface (OMI)
* AVEVA Historian
* AVEVA Identity Manager
* AVEVA Communication Drivers
* AVEVA License Manager
* Proven experience architecting and delivering enterprise-scale AVEVA Operations Control solutions for mission-critical industrial environments.
* Strong expertise in designing scalable, secure, resilient, and highly available industrial architectures for on-premises, virtualized, cloud, and hybrid environments.
* Extensive experience in enterprise architecture, infrastructure sizing, capacity planning, redundancy, disaster recovery (DR), failover strategies, and system performance optimization.
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft SQL Server, IIS, Windows Server, Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, and enterprise authentication and authorization mechanisms.
* Experience designing secure architectures utilizing HTTPS/TLS, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), and cybersecurity best practices
* Strong understanding of OT/IT convergence and enterprise integration with systems such as SAP, IBM Maximo, Microsoft applications, RESTful APIs, OPC DA/UA, MQTT, and other industrial communication protocols.
* Experience designing enterprise data architectures involving AVEVA Historian, SQL Server, reporting platforms, and analytics solutions.
* Strong understanding of cloud platforms, particularly Microsoft Azure, including Virtual Machines, networking, storage, identity management, and hybrid deployment architectures.
* Experience establishing architecture standards, engineering guidelines, reusable frameworks, and governance processes across multiple projects.
* Proven ability to perform technical reviews, solution validation, architecture governance, and design assurance throughout the project lifecycle.
* Strong knowledge of Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), Site Acceptance Testing (SAT), commissioning, production deployment, operational readiness, and support transition.
* Experience leading multidisciplinary engineering teams through the complete project lifecycle, from solution consulting and architecture to implementation, commissioning, and production support.
* Experience with AVEVA CONNECT, Industrial IoT, Digital Transformation initiatives, and cloud-based industrial solutions is desirable.
* Knowledge of enterprise integration patterns, microservices architecture, containerization, and DevOps practices is considered an advantage.
* Experience mentoring Solution Architects, Technical Leads, and Engineers while fostering technical excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement within engineering organizations.

**Services at AVEVA**
Our dynamic global team of 700+ engineers, developers, consultants, solution architects and project managers are at the forefront of delivering AVEVA cutting-edge solutions to customers. The work is complex and technical, but immensely rewarding: we empower customers to harness the full transformative potential of AVEVA’s solutions. If you’re analytical, pragmatic, and driven to make a tangible impact on the sustainability of the industrial sector, our team is the perfect place for you.
  
  
You’ll also be joining an award-winning workplace. AVEVA is Great Place to Work® Certified™ in multiple countries, reflecting the culture our people create every day. Explore our
awards and recognition
.
  
  
Find out more: https://www.aveva.com/en/about/careers/
  
  
**India Benefits include:**
Gratuity, Medical and accidental insurance, very attractive leave entitlement, emergency leave days, childcare support, maternity, paternity and adoption leaves, education assistance program, home office set up support (for hybrid roles), well-being support
  
  
It’s possible we’re hiring for this position in multiple countries, in which case the above benefits apply to the primary location. Specific benefits vary by country, but our packages are similarly comprehensive.
  
  
Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/benefits/
  
  
**Hybrid working**
We work in a hybrid way at AVEVA. Most roles are based at a local AVEVA office, with an expectation of being on-site 50% of your working hours to support collaboration and connection. Some positions are fully office-based depending on the nature of the work, and certain roles that support specific customers or markets may be remote. The working arrangement for this position will be confirmed during the hiring process.
  
  
**Hiring process**
Interested? Great! Get started by submitting your cover letter and CV through our application portal. AVEVA is committed to recruiting and retaining people with disabilities. Please let us know in advance if you need reasonable support during your application process.
  
  
Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/hiring-process
  
  
**About AVEVA**
AVEVA is a global leader in industrial software with more than 6,500 employees in over 40 countries. Our cutting-edge solutions are used by thousands of enterprises to deliver the essentials of life – such as energy, infrastructure, chemicals, and minerals – safely, efficiently, and more sustainably.
  
  
We are committed to embedding sustainability and inclusion into our operations, our culture, and our core business strategy. Learn more about how we are progressing against our ambitious 2030 targets: sustainability-report.aveva.com/
  
  
Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/

Background checks will be conducted in accordance with local laws and may, subject to those laws, include proof of educational attainment, employment history verification, proof of work authorization, criminal records, identity verification, credit check. Certain positions dealing with sensitive and/or third-party personal data may involve additional background check criteria.

We value diversity and the expertise that people from different backgrounds bring to our business. AVEVA provides reasonable accommodation to applicants with disabilities where appropriate. title: Engagement Manager (HCM Implementation, People Manager)
description:
**About Darwinbox**
Darwinboxis Asia's fastest-growing HR technology platform, designing the future of work by building the world's best HR tech, driven by a fierce focus on employee experience and customer success, and continuous, iterative innovation. We are the preferred choice of 1000+ global enterprises to manage their 4 million+ employees across 130+ countries. Darwinbox's new-age HCM suite competes with local as well as global players in the enterprise technology space (such as SAP, Oracle, and Workday). The firm has acquired notable customers ranging from large conglomerates to unicorn start-ups: Nivea, Starbucks, DLF, JSW, Adani Group, Crisil, CRED, Vedanta, Mahindra, Glenmark, Gokongwei Group, Mitra Adiperkasa, EFS Facilities Management, VNG Corporation, and many more. Our vision of building a world-class product company from Asia is backed by marquee global investors like Microsoft, Salesforce, Sequoia Capital, TCV, KKR, and Partners Group.
  
  
**What This Role Is**
Darwinbox is transforming how enterprises manage people, workflows, and employee experiences at scale. As we evolve, implementation is no longer about configuration and delivery tracking. The real challenge is helping organizations rethink how HR should operate across systems, processes, adoption, and decision-making.
  
  
This role sits at the intersection of:
  
  

* Enterprise consulting
* Product thinking
* Customer transformation
* Large-scale SaaS delivery

You will act as:
  
  

* A trusted advisor to enterprise customers
* A strategic partner to CHROs and business leaders
* The “Voice of Customer” internally across Product and Engineering
* An owner responsible for customer outcomes — not just go-live milestones

**What The Work Looks Like**

* You won’t just inherit a project plan. You’ll inherit ambiguity.
* A customer struggling to standardize processes globally.
* An implementation that technically works, but operationally doesn’t.
* A workflow designed for manual operations that now needs to scale intelligently.

Your role is to understand the business problem behind the requirement and drive the transformation end-to-end.
  
  
That means:
  
  

* Leading enterprise HCM transformation programs from discovery through adoption
* Challenging legacy processes and driving transformation conversations
* Influencing senior stakeholders with clarity and credibility
* Working closely with internal teams to shape customer outcomes
* Balancing customer expectations, scalability, product capabilities, and operational realities

Because enterprise transformation breaks when those worlds operate separately.
  
  
**Who Thrives Here**

* People who think in systems.
* People who naturally ask: “Will this scale?” / “What breaks after go-live?” / “Are we solving the actual customer problem?”
* People with consulting instincts, strong ownership mindset, and executive presence.
* People who care equally about customer outcomes, product experience, and operational excellence.

**What We Explicitly Don’t Optimize For**

* Coordination-heavy implementation profiles
* Delivery managers who only track timelines
* Requirement takers who never challenge assumptions
* Governance without ownership
* Implementation thinking without business context

**What We’re Looking For**

* 6–12 years of experience in enterprise SaaS, HCM implementation, consulting, or transformation roles
* Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills
* Consulting mindset with ability to drive transformation conversations
* Strong customer advocacy and product-oriented thinking
* Data-driven and automation-first approach to problem solving

Lastly, what we are not looking for
**,**
we’re not looking for traditional implementation managers nor project coordinators and definitely not people who measure success by whether the tracker is green.

title: Salesforce-Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Customer Tech – Salesforce Manager – Technical Lead / Architect / Project Manager**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are looking for an experienced Salesforce Manager who can lead end-to-end solution delivery across the Salesforce ecosystem. This role requires a seasoned professional with strong capabilities in Salesforce architecture, solution design, technical leadership, and project management. The ideal candidate will guide development teams, work closely with business stakeholders, and ensure scalable, secure, and high-performing Salesforce implementations across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and custom applications.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Salesforce Technical Leadership**

* Lead the technical design and architecture for Salesforce solutions including
* Apex, LWC, Visualforce, Flows, integrations, and data models.
* Define scalable architecture patterns, guardrails, coding standards, and best
* practices across Salesforce orgs.
* Perform technical design reviews, code reviews, and ensure solutions adhere to
* governor limits, security, and platform constraints.
* Evaluate and recommend Salesforce products, AppExchange tools, and
* integration frameworks.

**Delivery & Project Management**

* Own Salesforce project delivery lifecycle including requirements, solutioning,
* sprint planning, development, QA, and deployment.
* Collaborate with business SMEs, product owners, and cross-functional teams to
* translate requirements into technical solutions.
* Oversee release management, environment strategy, DevOps pipelines, and
* change management processes.
* Manage project risks, dependencies, budget, stakeholders, and release
* timelines.

**Team Leadership & Mentorship**

* Lead, mentor, and support Salesforce developers, admins, consultants, and QA engineers.
* Conduct technical capability assessments and drive continuous learning in areas like Apex, LWC, integrations, and Salesforce certifications.
* Guide junior team members on troubleshooting, performance tuning, design decisions, and platform best practices.

**Business & Stakeholder Management**

* Act as the technical liaison between business teams and the engineering team.
* Run design workshops, solution walkthroughs, and architecture discussions with customers/stakeholders.
* Support pre-sales, effort estimation, solution demonstrations, and project scoping.

**Operational Excellence**

* Ensure high-quality documentation for architecture, integrations, data flows, and technical builds.
* Drive improvement initiatives around DevOps, CI/CD, testing automation, and org optimization.
* Troubleshoot and resolve production issues, performance bottlenecks, and integration failures.
* Maintain compliance with Salesforce security, data governance, and architectural guidelines.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* 8–15 years of overall IT experience with a minimum of 5+ years leading
* Salesforce projects.

**Deep technical expertise in:**

* Apex, Triggers, SOQL/SOSL
* Lightning Web Components (LWC) & Aura
* Flows, Process Builder (retirement-ready), and declarative tools
* Salesforce APIs (REST/SOAP), Platform Events, Integration Patterns
* Data modeling, large datasets, and performance optimization
* Strong understanding of Salesforce architecture, multi-org strategy, governor
* limits, sharing/security model, and deployment processes.
* Hands-on experience with Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and
* ideally field service or CPQ.
* Strong experience with Agile/Scrum, backlog management, user stories, and sprint planning.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, documentation, and leadership skills.

**Preferred Certifications**

* Salesforce Certified Platform Developer I
* Salesforce Certified Platform Developer II
* Salesforce Certified Application Architect or System Architect (highly preferred)
* Salesforce Administrator / Advanced Administrator
* Project management certifications (PMP, CSM, SAFe) are an added advantage.

**Nice-to-Have**

* Experience with CI/CD tools (Copado, Gearset, Azure DevOps, Git).
* Experience working with integration platforms such as MuleSoft, Boomi, or Kafka.
* Experience managing multi-cloud Salesforce implementations.
* Exposure to enterprise integration patterns, security standards, SSO, OAuth, and Identity.
* Experience guiding org consolidation, technical debt remediation, and modernization initiatives.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment:**
As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
Professional Development: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture:**
In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits:**
Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply:**
If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Senior Testing Lead - Automation, Performance, Security & Functional QA
description:
**Position: Senior Testing Lead \- Automation, Performance, Security \& Functional QA**
**Location: Hyderabad ( 8 PM to 5 AM IST)**
**Work Type: Full\-Time/Onsite**
**Experience: 8\+ Years**
**PETADATA is looking for a highly experienced Senior Testing Lead with 8\+ years of experience to own the overall quality strategy, build and scale test automation, and lead functional, performance, security, API, and data\-validation testing for a data migration platform operating across cloud and on\-premise environments.**
**Roles \& Responsibilities** 
**Quality Strategy \& Leadership**
* Own and define the overall QA and testing strategy across functional, automation, performance, security, and data\-integrity testing.
* Establish quality gates, release criteria, testing standards, metrics, and reporting.
* Identify and prioritize testing efforts based on business and technical risk, especially data\-correctness risks.
* Build and manage the quality function with minimal supervision.
* Mentor developers and QA engineers and promote a quality\-first engineering culture.
* Partner closely with Engineering, DevOps, Architecture, Security, and Implementation teams.


**Test Automation**
* Design and build test automation frameworks from scratch.
* Develop automated UI, API, integration, and regression testing solutions.
* Use tools such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, and REST/API automation frameworks.
* Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines.
* Build scalable regression suites that improve release velocity and confidence.
* Use programming languages such as Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Java for automation.


**Functional \& Migration Testing**
* Own end\-to\-end functional testing across supported CRM platforms and migration scenarios.
* Test standard and custom objects, relationships, transformations, mappings, and edge cases.
* Design test scenarios based on real\-world customer data migration use cases.
* Validate migration correctness from source to destination.
* Test multi\-tenant behavior, configuration, and tenant data isolation.
* Identify defects and ensure issues are properly investigated, resolved, and prevented from recurring.


**Data Validation \& Integrity** 
  

  

* Build automated source\-to\-target data validation frameworks.
* Validate:
+ Record counts
+ Field\-level accuracy
+ Data mappings
+ Relationships and associations
+ Transformations
+ Deduplication
+ Overall data integrity

* Use SQL and programmatic validation techniques to verify migration results.
* Ensure migrated customer data remains complete, accurate, and consistent.


**Performance Testing**
* Design and execute load, stress, scalability, and performance testing.
* Test large data volumes and high numbers of concurrent migrations.
* Establish performance baselines, benchmarks, and SLAs.
* Identify performance bottlenecks and work with Engineering and Architecture teams to resolve them.
* Use tools such as k6, JMeter, Gatling, or Locust.
* Integrate appropriate performance testing into the CI/CD pipeline.


**Security Testing**
* Perform and coordinate security testing across the application and platform.
* Test tenant isolation and ensure no cross\-tenant data access is possible.
* Validate authentication and authorization controls.
* Perform input validation and abuse\-case testing.
* Integrate SAST, DAST, and vulnerability scanning into CI/CD.
* Coordinate penetration testing with internal security teams and external security vendors.
* Support security and compliance requirements such as SOC 2 and ISO 27001 through appropriate testing evidence.


**Technical Quality \& Delivery**
* Ensure software is secure, scalable, reliable, and production\-ready.
* Establish automated quality checks throughout the development lifecycle.
* Collaborate with developers to identify defects early.
* Review testing approaches and improve overall engineering quality.
* Support both cloud and on\-premise deployments.
* Help establish reliable test environments using cloud, containers, and infrastructure automation.


**Note: Should be highly self\-directed, comfortable building the QA function from the ground up, and able to work effectively with distributed engineering teams across required time zones.**
**Note: Should be able to work independently and work in USA time zones**
**Required Skills**
* 8\+ years of professional QA / Test Engineering experience.
* Strong experience leading QA strategy and quality engineering for software products.
* Strong hands\-on experience building test automation frameworks from scratch.
* Proficiency with Playwright, Cypress, and/or Selenium.
* Strong API and REST testing experience.
* Strong programming experience with Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Java.
* Hands\-on experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with functional, integration, regression, and end\-to\-end testing.
* Strong experience with performance/load testing using JMeter, k6, Gatling, Locust, or similar tools.
* Working knowledge of security testing, including OWASP, authentication, authorization, tenant isolation, SAST, DAST, and vulnerability scanning.
* Strong SQL and data\-validation experience.
* Experience validating source\-to\-target data integrity across multiple systems.
* Strong understanding of data migration, ETL, integration, or data\-intensive applications.
* Experience testing multi\-tenant SaaS applications.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Experience with on\-premise/customer\-deployed software is preferred.
* Experience with Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho, or similar CRM platforms is a plus.
* Familiarity with Docker, containers, and IaC is a plus.
* Exposure to chaos/resilience testing or contract testing is a plus.
* Experience supporting SOC 2 / ISO 27001 or other compliance audits is preferred.
* Strong problem\-solving, communication, leadership, ownership, and decision\-making skills.
* Ability to independently establish testing processes, frameworks, quality standards, and release criteria.


**Education**
**Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field is preferred.**

Based on business products, processes and system knowledge, provides basic level of thinking for exceptions and other unexpected ways users may interact with systems utilizing simple testing techniques and tools. The Agile Dev Team Member I will rarely work on more than one type of task and limited in to consistently pull the next highest priority work item.
  
  

* Demonstrates understanding to customer needs by interpreting basic process or system solutions and providing input into system design.
* Effectively writes and refines user stories, including clear and accurate acceptance criteria.
* Performs basic impact assessment relating people, processes and/or technology, and estimates user stories using relative sizing of story points.
* Partners with the Product Owner to confirm code and acceptance tests reflect the desired functionality
* Demonstrates understanding of Test-Driven Development (TDD) and Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) to build in quality.

**Agile Dev Team Member I with primarily a development discipline:**

* Demonstrates entry level developer skills with basic ability to code instructions for computer programs and limited ability to configure packaged software
* Documents and implements programs according to standards and conventions with guidance from senior team members. Performs basic quality checks of program code, related objects and documentation
* Delivers working code each sprint. Agile Dev Team Member I with primarily a testing discipline: Analyzes system and business requirements for testability.
* Identifies common errors that occur in standard application testing. Develops, documents, executes, and maintains test cases and test data.
* Reports status of test plan execution through defect logs and defect tracking system. Defines basic test plans needed to achieve appropriate level of coverage.
* Analyzes test results and assists with trouble-shooting and root cause analysis. Utilizes basic testing tools and executes basic data creation tools.
* Demonstrates ability to read automation test results. Demonstrates understanding and applies concepts of Risk Based Testing.
* Demonstrates limited ability to write test cases describing business behavior to facilitate automation.
* Supports application development, implementation, and user training activities, as required.
* Participates in key ceremonies to drive execution, improve flow and ensure transparency with guidance from a senior team member.
* Plans work via the preparation for and participation in Program Increment (PI) Planning and Sprint Planning, including the development and committing to Team PI Objectives and Sprint goals.
* Demonstrates working code to Product and Business Owners and supports the Product Owner in the execution of the iteration and PI System Demos
* Actively participates in the Sprint Retrospectives and Inspect & Adapt to timely discuss opportunities for improvement and are responsible for carrying out the execution of improvement stories.
* Participates in Daily Stands-ups to assess progress toward sprint goals and raise impediments. Participates in on-going and scheduled Backlog Refinement sessions.
* Demonstrates ongoing desire for continuous improvement and building knowledge in area of expertise.
* Actively seeks out development opportunities to develop T-shaped skills and become a cross-functional contributor.
* Practices continuous exploration, continuous integration and continuous deployment necessary for building the Continuous Delivery Pipeline and implementing DevOps.
* Offers innovative ideas within area of focus to improve processes.
* Actively participates in Agile Dev Team Member Community of Practice (CoP). Can facilitate CoP sessions with guidance from leadership and/or peers

Competitive compensation and benefits package:

**The Impact You Will Have In This Role**
Scrum Master plays a critical role within a ServiceNow delivery squad, bringing together Agile delivery leadership and techno-functional expertise. This role drives effective Scrum execution across geographically distributed teams, collaborates with business stakeholders to convert demand into clear requirements and user stories, and partners with Product, Platform, and Engineering teams to deliver predictable, high-quality outcomes while maintaining platform health and enterprise standards.
  
  
This role serves as a trusted partner to senior business stakeholders, working closely with ServiceNow Product Owners, Platform teams, and Delivery partners to ensure business demand is clearly articulated and well-prioritized. It ensures delivered outcomes drive measurable business value while maintaining the long-term health, integrity, and strategic alignment of the ServiceNow platform and enterprise standards.
  
  
**Your Primary Responsibilities**

* Agile Delivery Leadership: Facilitate Scrum ceremonies, coach Product Owners and squad members, maintain a healthy backlog, remove impediments, manage JIRA/PPM updates, and align priorities, dependencies, timelines, and delivery commitments across geographically dispersed teams.
* Business Engagement & Requirements: Serve as a primary point of contact for business stakeholders, lead discovery sessions, translate business needs into functional requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and impact assessments, and bridge communication between business, Product, Platform, and Engineering teams.
* ServiceNow Solution Alignment: Partner with Product Owners and Platform teams to refine and prioritize the backlog, evaluate solution options, and ensure delivery aligns with out-of-the-box ServiceNow capabilities, enterprise standards, security, compliance, governance, and long-term platform sustainability.
* Delivery, Release & Stakeholder Coordination: Support delivery from intake through UAT, release readiness, and deployment by coordinating resources, schedules, code movement, scope, dependencies, validation activities, risks, metrics, dashboards, and transparent stakeholder communications.
* Continuous Improvement, Governance & Controls: Document current- and future-state workflows, identify opportunities to streamline and standardize processes using ServiceNow, encourage feedback and continuous learning, strengthen intake and requirement practices, and proactively monitor and escalate risks and controls.

**Qualifications**

* Minimum of 8+ years of related experience
* Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent experience

**Talents Needed For Success**

* 8+ years of enterprise technology delivery experience in Scrum Master, business analyst, or techno-functional analyst roles, including preferably 4–5 years of hands-on ServiceNow, experience across one or more modules such as CMDB, ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, WSD, or EAM.
* Preferred experience with ServiceNow platform concepts, including CMDB/CSDM, workflows, data structures, roles, business rules, integrations, reporting, dashboards, Performance
* Analytics, platform administration, scoped applications, update sets, and upgrade or patching best practices.
* Experience operating in Agile/Scrum delivery models, including the ability to leverage JIRA for backlog management, sprint planning, user story traceability, dashboards, delivery reporting, and cross-team dependency tracking.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps automation, and offshore–onshore delivery models, with the ability to collaborate effectively across multiple time zones and global teams.
* Proven ability to engage and influence senior business stakeholders, manage competing priorities and ambiguity, and communicate complex ideas clearly and concisely.
* Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills, with experience producing high-quality business and functional requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and impact assessments.
* Capital markets, post-trade, or broader financial services domain experience is highly desirable.

**Preferred Certifications**

* Certified Scrum Master or Project Management– Preferred
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) – Plus
* Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP) or PMI-PBA – Plus

Your impact begins on day one, and your contributions will help define our future in the region
  
  
What you have
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
As a highly influential individual contributor you will take ownership of software delivery using Agile and Scaled Agile methodologies for multiple Scrum and/or Kanban teams. As a Servant-leader you will mentor, train and lead process improvements on Agile and Scaled Agile practices and ceremonies to ensure that business and engineering value is being created through predictable, continuous, high-quality releases. * Interact, communicate, and manage team and platform-level expectations with Technology and Business leaders.

* Lead multiple Agile teams within ASDD to make measurable, continuous improvement in their use of Agile ceremonies and practices.
* Facilitate and ensure optimized adherence and implementation of all Agile ceremonies and practices on a day-to-day basis.

**Required Qualifications**
Bachelor’s degree in a related discipline or equivalent work experience.
  
  

* 7+ years of current experience as a Scrum Master working with cross-functional leaders and team members.
* 10+ years of experience in the technology industry working on complex, enterprise level products.
* Hands-On experience with implementing Agile (Scrum and Kanban) and Scaled Agile.
* Current “Certified Scrum Master” (CSM) certification is required.
* Experience with a Scaled Agile framework, with an understanding of PI planning across multiple dependent teams required.
* Hands on expertise using Agile Lifecycle Management (ALM) tools in the Atlassian family i.e. JIRA, Confluence etc. is required.
* Ability to apply scrum estimation and planning techniques, including managing and tracking external dependencies.
* Proven ability to influence without direct authority.
* Previous hands-on experience in a financial services setting i.e. broker/dealer services, investor services, wealth management is a significant plus.
* Excellent interpersonal skills and ability to work with diverse personality types.
* Ability to understand and explain technical issues at a high level.
* Exceptional communication, organization, and facilitation skills.
* Ability to lead, mentor and coach cross-functional teams to reach their highest potential.
* Strong negotiation and conflict resolutions skills, collaborative approach to driving results.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail.

**Preferred Qualifications**
Current Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
  
  
▪ Hands on experience using Rally, SharePoint and Clarity.
  
  
▪ Synthesizes complex data, manages resources, and develops strategic insights
  
  
▪ Collaborates across teams, facilitates partnerships, and supports cooperative efforts
  
  
▪ Provides thought leadership in the business area and independently drives strategic initiatives
  
  
▪ Supports peers in technical areas to refine their knowledge, skills, and abilities
  
  
▪ Manages complex interactions to maintain productive professional relationships
  
  
▪ Creates processes to help others successfully manage organization-wide change
  
  
▪ Verbally articulates ideas impactfully, fostering open dialogue
  
  
▪ Inspires confidence with proven expertise, integrity, and accurate communication
  
  
▪ Sets performance-driven goals across groups and drives continuous improvement
  
  
▪ Leverages diverse expertise to develop strategies in cross-functional projects or programs
  
  
▪ Creates clear, persuasive, and professional written documents that meet business standards
  
  
What’s in it for you
  
  
At Schwab India, you’re empowered to shape your future. We support your growth through meaningful work, continuous learning, and a culture rooted in trust and collaboration – so you can build the skills to make a lasting impact. Our benefits are designed to care for your wellbeing, your family, and your long-term financial security.

title: Security Master Function Analyst - Assistant Vice President
description:
**Who We Are Looking For**
An experienced Security Master Data Analyst to support ssAlpha client implementations and middle-office onboarding. The successful candidate will combine Security Master subject matter expertise, business analysis, and project management office discipline to translate client requirements and source data into clear mapping, transformation, validation, testing, and implementation outcomes. This role requires strong analytical, organizational, and stakeholder-management skills across global business and technology teams.
  
  
**Why this role is important to us**
The team you will be joining is a part of State Street Alpha. Alpha gives asset owners and managers access to the essential financial tools they need to deliver effective investment solutions. From core custody, accounting, fund administration and shareholder recordkeeping, to complete operations solutions and servicing for alternative assets like OTC derivatives, private equity and real estate, Alpha tools help our clients make better investment choices and act on growth opportunities.
  
  
The Security Master function is critical to providing accurate, complete, and timely instrument and reference data across the implementation lifecycle. The SMF Analyst helps connect client requirements, source data, target solutions, testing, governance, and conversion execution so that downstream platforms and operational teams are prepared for go-live and transition to business as usual.
  
  
Join us if making your mark in the financial services industry from day one is a challenge you are up for.
  
  
**What You Will Be Responsible For**

* As SMF Analyst, Assistant Vice President, you will:
* Analyze client Security Master requirements, operating models, security populations, and source data structures.
* Lead requirement-gathering sessions and document business, functional, data, control, and non-functional requirements.
* Define source-to-target mapping, transformation, enrichment, defaulting, exception-handling, and validation requirements.
* Develop and review mapping specifications that describe Security Master and reference data flows from client legacy systems to target applications.
* Support end-to-end solution design and partner with Product and Technology SMEs to clarify target data models, system functionality, integrations, and operational controls.
* Analyze data quality, completeness, referential integrity, tolerances, classifications, and consistency across systems.
* Support test strategy, scenario development, data preparation, readiness assessments, reconciliation, defect analysis, and entry and exit criteria.
* Investigate data and process issues, perform root-cause analysis, coordinate remediation, and document decisions and outcomes.
* Partner with Implementation, Conversion, Product, Technology, Operations, testing teams, and clients to document requirements, test evidence, defects, resolutions, and implementation outcomes.
* Coordinate Security Master support for dry runs, dress rehearsals, cutover, go-live, and post-production stabilization, including occasional weekend or off-hours activity.
* Build and maintain integrated work plans, milestone schedules, deliverable trackers, RAID logs, decision logs, dependency registers, and action-item trackers.
* Monitor progress against milestones, identify scope or schedule variance, and drive timely escalation and recovery actions.
* Prepare status reporting covering accomplishments, upcoming activities, risks, issues, dependencies, decisions, and leadership support required.
* Facilitate working sessions, governance meetings, readiness reviews, and checkpoint calls; publish agendas, minutes, actions, owners, and due dates.
* Maintain complete, current, and audit-ready project documentation in approved repositories.
* Support scope, change, resource, and cross-workstream dependency management while reinforcing agreed governance standards.
* Serve as a client-facing Security Master contact for requirements, solutioning, issue management, readiness, and delivery activities.
* Support transition to business as usual through knowledge transfer, operating procedures, open-item tracking, and stabilization reporting.
* During normal day-to-day operations, identify unusual or potentially suspicious transaction activity and report or escalate it in accordance with corporate policy and relevant operating procedures.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**What We Value**
These skills will help you succeed in this role
  
  

* Strong knowledge of capital markets, Security Master and reference data, financial instruments, and middle-office processes; familiarity with IBOR and ABOR concepts is beneficial.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze source data, define mappings and transformations, establish validation rules, and investigate data issues.
* Strong business analysis skills, including elicitation, process analysis, requirements documentation, traceability, and stakeholder validation.
* Practical PMO capabilities, including planning, milestone tracking, RAID management, governance reporting, meeting facilitation, and documentation control.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to lead discussions and communicate complex data topics to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, organizational, and time-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, work across global teams and time zones, and meet tight deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Ability to proactively identify risks, dependencies, and delivery gaps and drive timely resolution or escalation.
* Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio, and SharePoint; experience with Microsoft Project, JIRA, Confluence, or comparable tools.
* Working understanding of databases, data warehouses, SQL, reconciliation techniques, and data quality controls.

**Education & Preferred Qualifications**

* BS/BA in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Information Systems, Data Management, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
* 7 to 10 of relevant financial services experience, preferably in Security Master, reference data, middle office, client onboarding, implementation, conversion, or business analysis.
* Experience supporting complex, cross-functional programs with formal project governance and reporting responsibilities.
* A master’s degree or relevant business analysis, project management, data management, or Agile certification is a plus, but not required.

Occasional travel for client or global team onsite engagements may be required.
  
  
**About State Street**
Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.
  
  
We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.
  
  
As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we consider all qualified applicants for all positions without regard to race, creed, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, age, disability, genetic information, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, citizenship, marital status, domestic partnership or civil union status, familial status, military and veteran status, and other characteristics protected by applicable law.

description:

Sustainability for us means operating in a manner that respects people, planet and purpose – helping us conserve precious resources, serve our patients, create value for stakeholders, give back to society, fulfil our potential and maintain our integrity and transparency

Dr Reddy’s maintains a work environment, free from discrimination and is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to employ & nurture all qualified diverse workforce without regard to race, colour religion, nationality, sex, age, disability status, genetics, sexual orientation, gender expression, citizenship or any other characteristic or classification protected by applicable law(s) of the country we operate in. We treasure every talent, and recognize merit and diversity in our organization.

**Job Description**

**Project 1- ANDA Dossier Input Documents Tracker Automation**

**Project Background:-**

Ever wondered how a medicine reaches your local pharmacy?

Behind every generic tablet is a ~5,000-page dossier submitted to the US FDA. But here's the catch: every product needs a different set of documents. A tablet needs ~200 docs. An injectable needs ~350. A modified-release product needs even more. Today, RA teams manually figure out what's needed for each product - a slow, error-prone, human-memory-driven process.

**Your Target:-**

Help us build a GenAI-powered dynamic tracker that automatically maps list of documents needed to file a generic dossier with the US FDA - and then build pipeline to auto-fetches them their approval/availability status from our internal systems (Document Management System, SAP). Your work will replace weeks of manual planning with an intelligent, self-updating tracker. This sits at the intersection of AI + enterprise systems + regulated science - a rare hands-on shot at real GenAI engineering.

**Your Activities:-**

* You will study how a US generic drug dossier (ANDA) is structured and learn the multiplicity logic behind required documents (per ingredient, per batch, per dosage form).
* You will build a GenAI curator that takes basic product inputs (name, dosage form, BoM, batch count) and auto-generates the complete document tracker
* You will connect the tracker to source systems to DocHub, QualEx, and SAP to fetch document status, versions, and effective dates.
* You will develop an triggers that detects when documents become "Effective" or when new batch records land in system, and updates the tracker in real time with alerts for overdue items.
* You will pilot the solution on few products to test the GenAI's ability to auto-generate different trackers.
* You will build a visual dashboard (Power BI / Excel) showing dossier readiness %, ownership blockers, and GenAI-flagged risks.
* You will present the final solution, architecture, and prompt library to RA leadership at the end of the internship.

**Qualifications**

B.Pharma+ MBA / M.Pharma+ MBA

title: Content Researcher and writer

Hiring: Content Researcher & Writer
  
  
About The RRR Show
  
  
The RRR Show is one of the biggest podcast channels in the Telugu digital space, with over 8 lakh digital followers and 40 million+ monthly views. We create engaging conversations, thought provoking podcasts, and relatable content that reaches millions of people.

Key Responsibilities
  
  
1. Podcast Research & Preparation
  
  
- Research podcast guests, their backgrounds, professional journeys, experiences, achievements, and viewpoints.
  
- Prepare interesting, insightful, and thought provoking questions for podcast conversations.
  
- Identify lesser known facts, interesting stories, controversies, and unique perspectives that can lead to engaging discussions.

- Create engaging community posts, polls, questions, and discussion starters.
  
- Develop topics that encourage audience participation, opinions, and conversations.
  
- Understand what interests the audience and create content that keeps the community active and engaged.
  
- Maintain a consistent pipeline of relevant community posts.

- Research subjects and develop content for our upcoming courses.
  
- Structure course modules, chapters, lessons, and learning materials.
  
- Write detailed course content, explanations, examples, exercises, and assignments.
  
- Simplify complex concepts into structured and easy to understand learning material.
  
- Research relevant case studies, practical examples, and references.
  
- Review, edit, and regularly update existing course content to maintain accuracy and quality.

- Research and develop interesting ideas for Instagram Reels and other short form videos.

title: IT Quality Systems Specialist - CAPA
description:

* Experience supporting quality management system processes within a regulated industry.
* Knowledge of ISO 13485, FDA 21 CFR Part 11, and EU Annex 11 requirements.
* Experience applying project management methodologies to drive quality or compliance initiatives.

* Experience within the medical device, life sciences, healthcare, or regulated technology industry.
