At Leanwatts, we develop and manufacture power electronic solutions for electric mobility and energy applications. Our Designed and Made in India approach focuses on reliable, high-performance products.

**What is this role about?**

Build and run the validation lab, lead the testing team, and own design verification and validation through certification. Start with portable EV chargers, on-board chargers (OBCs), and hybrid inverters, then build the test capability needed for future Leanwatts products.

**What you will do at Leanwatts**

* **Own DVP and DVT:**

  Translate product requirements, risks and applicable standards into a Design Verification Plan (DVP). Define methods, fixtures, sample sizes, hardware and firmware revisions, operating corners, acceptance limits and schedule. Keep coverage, results, deviations and retest status current through each design build.
* **Run the lab and lead the team:**

  Define bench, instrument, fixture and safety requirements; commission equipment and maintain SOPs, calibration and preventive maintenance. Own daily scheduling and test assignments, train the team, review setups before energisation, and resolve equipment or capacity bottlenecks.
* **Lead hands-on testing:**

  Cover electrical and functional performance (efficiency, power quality, modes and fault recovery), electrical safety (insulation, leakage, earthing and protection), mechanical (fitment, mounting, vibration and connector durability), thermal and environmental tests (derating, cycling, humidity and ingress), endurance and reliability, and EMI/EMC pre-compliance.
* **Make test reports usable for release:**

  Record exact sample serials, hardware and firmware, setup, instruments, conditions, raw data and pass/fail against limits. Reproduce failures with R&D, track corrective actions and verify fixes. Give R&D and Quality a clear summary of failed, untested or waived requirements before release.
* **Own external testing and certification:**

  Map applicable standards with R&D and Quality, select suitable accredited labs, and manage quotations, bookings, samples, submissions and schedules. Review agency reports for correct configuration and test scope; coordinate corrective actions, retests and closure, and retain reports and certificates by product revision.

﻿

**Must have requirements**

* **Education:**

  B.E. or B.Tech in Electrical, Electronics, Mechanical, Mechatronics, or a related engineering discipline.
* **Experience:**

  At least 5 years of hands-on product validation or test engineering on chargers, inverters, converters, or comparable power electronics.
* Experience leading testers and running lab operations, including safe test setups, equipment selection, calibration and maintenance. Able to lead electrical, mechanical, environmental and reliability tests.
* Evidence of owning a DVP, producing traceable reports, closing test failures with design teams, and coordinating external testing or certification.

title: HCP Science Content and Authority Engine Lead
description:
***Opella***
is the purest and third-largest player globally in the Over The Counter (OTC) & Vitamins, Minerals & Supplements (VMS) market. We believe in the power of self-care and the role it can play in creating a healthier society and a healthier planet. That’s why we want to make self-care as simple as it should be by being consumer-led always. Through our over 100 loved brands such as Allegra, Dulcolax and Buscopan, we deliver our mission: helping more than half a billion consumers worldwide take their health in their hands. This mission is brought to life by an 11,000-strong team, 13 best-in-class manufacturing sites, and 4 specialized science and innovation development centers. We are proudly B Corp certified in multiple markets.

We aim to be a positive force by embedding sustainability throughout our operations and culture. To succeed, we seek talented individuals who can transform our business and support our mission to become the world's best fast-moving consumer healthcare (FMCH) company in and for the world.

Find out more about our mission at
*www.opella.com*

**Purpose**

Make Opella’s science the version that gets found, trusted and cited. One owner for the content and authority strategy and for the engine that delivers it: the Content Hub builds bespoke,
**unbranded scientific assets — manuscripts, publications, symposia, toolkits; the Article Factory**
scales approved content through AI with medical writers as the expert pen. Leads Amplify in the HCP Science ambition and partners the Head of HCP Science, Categories on Simplify — so one simple reason to recommend is published at pace and shows up wherever HCPs and AI look.

**Scope**

* Content and authority strategy — what Opella publishes, where and in which channels, to win citation where HCPs and AI look; the publication and content plan per category, built from the Categories Head’s priorities.
* The engine — Content Hub and Article Factory on one production standard; writer roles, seniority and jobs-to-be-done across both modes; cost per asset and the AI-assisted share of output.
* AI-answer authority (outward AI) — Opella’s presence in LLM answers: GEO strategy, the indexed and citable corpus, and fortnightly measurement (AthenaHQ) reported category by category.
* Publications governance — chairs the scientific publication committee; runs publications and manuscripts as the service to Global Medical to ICMJE/GPP; one counting standard for the corpus.
* Competitor scientific intelligence — consolidates competitor narratives, publications and evidence positioning; supplies it to the Categories Head, who decides what it means for the category story.
* Partnership content — produces and scales the content stream for the authority partnerships the HCP Science Head owns (Mayo, Cleveland, FIP) — the third-party citation layer AI quotes.
* Guardrail and quality — machines amplify approved claims, never create; every output proof-read by a medical writer; AI-accelerated MLR without compliance exceptions.
* Global–local — supplies ready-to-adapt content to regional and local medical and MSLs under the global–local contract — governed globally, activated locally.
* Leadership — member of the HCP Science leadership team; deputy to the HCP Science Head on content and authority matters.

**Accountabilities**

* Own and deliver Opella’s share of medical AI answers: 8% → 30%, reported fortnightly, category by category.
* Deliver the content throughput that moves claims activated 20% → 80% and content cycle time from ~3 months to weeks.
* Cut global content rebuilt locally from 60% → 20% through reusable, ready-to-adapt assets.
* Grow indexed, citable publications 161 → 400 by 2030; one version of the science.
* Deliver the briefs in the priority order the Categories Headsets; hold the production standard and turnaround pace.
* Run AI-scaled production with the expert pen: no machine-created claims; every output proof-read; AI-accelerated MLR.
* Chair the scientific publication committee; run publications and manuscripts as the service to Global Medical.
* Produce and scale the content for the partnerships the HCP Science Head secures; feed citation results back into partnership choices.
* Act as production counterpart to the HCP Content Lead and the HCP Wonka design team: scientific brief in, approved content out, designed for the channels Omnichannel runs.
* Supply competitor scientific intelligence to the Categories Head on an agreed rhythm.
* Define and fill the writer jobs-to-be-done and seniority split across hub and factory; build the team on it; close the team-lead and writer vacancies.
* Deliver the AI-answer share, publication and cycle-time KPIs within the single HCP Science KPI set; share claims activation with the Categories Head.
* Always operate within compliance and rules of engagement — scientific exchange, not promotion.

**How the role is measured**

* Value creation — Authority (owned): Opella share of medical AI answers 8% → 30% (fortnightly); indexed publications 161 → 400; citation of Opella science by professionals and machines.
* Value creation — Content (owned): content cycle time ~3 months → weeks; global content rebuilt locally 60% → 20%; share of output AI-assisted via the Article Factory vs target; cost per asset.
* Value creation — Conversion (shared with the Categories Head): claims activated in market 20% → 80%; share of HCP content aligned to the validated Scientific Message Maps.
* Quality and compliance: zero machine-created claims; first-pass MLR approval rate; no compliance exceptions.
* Organisational excellence: writer and designer capability vs the skills framework; vacancies filled; GCC leverage (output per FTE).

title: Support Engineer 2
description:
**Job Description**
Serves as a point of contact for customers, fielding inquiries via phone or electronic channels. Provides technical support by troubleshooting and resolving known issues encountered with assigned Oracle product(s). Collaborates with internal teams to report and contribute to the resolution of routine design, reliability, and maintenance issues. Maintains service request and/or product documentation and begins to create Knowledge Base articles and/or troubleshooting guides for resolved issues. Consults internal teams and stakeholders on diverse customer situations and technical issues. Begins to leverage automation/tooling (e.g., A.I. Assistance) to discover root causes of common issues and identities and begins to recommend enhancements to existing support processes, workflows, guidelines, and best practices.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Support and Solution Delivery-Customer Support and Advocacy:**

* Serves as a point of contact for customers and facilitates customer relationship building, fielding inquiries via phone, electronic, or in-person means.
* Provides technical support to customers by answering technical questions, troubleshooting, and resolving known issues related to assigned Oracle product(s).

**Technical Support and Solution Delivery-Technical Problem-Solving and Resolution:**

* Leverages routine understanding of problem resolution, which may include fix delivery, and product certification to research, re-create, and test technical issues for assigned product area(s) reported by customers to identify a resolution, independently.
* Follows up with customer on service request(s) to communicate resolution and ensure all issues are resolved, escalating complex customer technical issues to appropriate technical teams for resolution, as needed.
* Collaborates with internal teams and/or more experienced peers to report design, reliability, and maintenance problems or bugs, contributing to resolution of routine issues through roll-up.

**Technical Support and Solution Delivery-Technical Support Documentation:**

* Documents activities taken on service request and/or product documentation, beginning to leverage troubleshooting guides and/or Knowledge Base articles, through resolution.
* Begins to prepare troubleshooting guides and/or create Knowledge Base articles for resolved issues.

**Technical Proficiency and Support Enhancement-Technical Support Collaboration:**

* Develops a deep understanding of assigned Oracle product ecosystem(s) and customer environment(s).
* Consults internal teams and stakeholders on diverse customer situations and technical issues.
* Participates in cross-functional training, workshops, and collaborative projects and initiatives to support business processes.

**Technical Proficiency and Support Enhancement-Technical Support Improvement:**

* Begins to leverage automation/tooling (e.g., A.I. Assistance) to discover root causes of common issues.
* Begins to identify frequently reported issues and recommend ideas that contribute to reducing repetitive issues, escalating as needed.
* Identifies and begins to recommend enhancements to existing support processes, workflows, guidelines, and best practices based on customer feedback and/or operational insights.

**Performance Monitoring and Management:**

* Monitors and executes own current support service performance metrics, independently.

**Additional Responsibilities (as Needed)**
**Vertical Lead:**

* Provides on-site and in-person technical assistance, including case consultation for complex cases, to Technical Support team.
* Proactively reviews cases, providing troubleshooting guidance and recommending next action items.
* Assesses product-related issues and assists in technical reviews of issue drafts.
* Conducts internal training and learning sessions focused on product, technical, and skills development.
* Acts as the point of contact (POC) for specific products or features, ensuring that training content is up-to-date.
* Serve as the primary contact for the vertical regarding case transfer and feature coordination with other teams or product areas.
* Participates in activities related to knowledge bases, chatbots, and user guides to deflect cases and improve support efficiency.

**Services Translation:**

* Provides translation oral and verbal services for technical and non-technical inquiries for products and services.
* Begins to understand more niche or technical terms and provide translation services for them.

**Core Responsibilities**
**Planning & Execution:**

* Tracks timelines with minimal supervision, ensuring work is completed in a timely manner and is in alignment with project requirements. Prioritizes and adjusts work as resources or timelines change, with some guidance.

**Collaboration & Partnership:**

* Collaborates within team to better understand expectations and achieve shared objectives. Leverages a foundational understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs to build partnerships with limited guidance. Actively listens and asks questions to enhance collaboration.

**Problem Solving:**

* Identifies and addresses issues, escalating problems to senior staff as needed in accordance with standard procedures. Compiles and reviews data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot standard and non-standard errors.

**Continuous Learning:**

* Seeks opportunities to gain knowledge and learn new skills and/or tools aligned with industry trends and best practices. Utilizes feedback and training to improve skills. Participates in a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing.

**Continuous Improvement:**

* Implements updates to processes, protocols, and workflows to increase efficiency and effectiveness as directed with some guidance. Contributes to ideation for future process improvements.

**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.
  
  
Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

title: Senior Technical Writer II
description:
**About Us:**
Seismic is the Go-To-Market Performance company, driving how organizations turn their strategy into revenue. Seismic brings together signals from customer conversations, buyer engagement, governed content, coaching and seller behavior to turn intelligence into winning action. Through its AI revenue execution platform, the company equips customer-facing teams with the insights, governance, and contextual guidance they need to execute with confidence and deliver measurable business outcomes. Trusted by 2,500 organizations and over 3.5 million users around the globe, Seismic is headquartered in San Diego with offices across North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific. Learn more at seismic.com.
  
  
Seismic is committed to building an inclusive workplace that ignites growth for our employees and creates a culture of belonging that allows all employees to be seen and valued for who they are. Learn more about DEI at Seismic here.
  
  
**Overview:**
Technical writers play an instrumental role at Seismic, delivering product documentation that drives product adoption, reduces Support demand, and serves as the source of truth for the AI-powered answers our customers rely on.
  
  
Our writers use DITA for authoring AI-ready product documentation, and we deliver it through an AI-powered, enterprise-class, multi-channel content delivery platform. Our documentation team sits within Product & Engineering with shared governance, tools, and processes, and our writers are embedded with product development teams in India, China, Europe, and the US.
  
  
We have had technical writers in India for three years, and we're now growing a team in our Hyderabad office. We're looking for experienced technical writers who will help us keep pace with growing demand and shape how we work.
  
  
We're implementing agentic documentation workflows to help us keep up with accelerating product innovation and focus our energy where it delivers the most value. Our writers will continue to own the quality of everything that reaches our customers, and increasingly will help shape the templates, prompts, skills, and quality criteria our AI workflows run on. If you're curious, empathetic, detail-oriented, and thrive in fast-paced environments, you sound like one of us. If you want to help redefine what a documentation professional looks like in an agentic world, this is your chance.
  
  
As a Senior Technical Writer II, you'll own documentation for one or more product areas and take an active hand in the content strategy, information architecture, and AI tooling the whole team depends on.
  
  
**Who you are:**

* BA/BS degree in English, Technical Communication/Writing, Computer Science or a related technical discipline, or relevant professional experience (required)
* 8+ years relevant experience in Scrum/Agile development environments (required)
* Experience with DITA and structured, topic-based authoring (required)
* Experience with Oxygen, Ixiasoft, Fluid Topics, Jira, or similar tools a plus
* Hands-on experience using generative AI tools (Claude or comparable) to research, draft, and edit documentation (required)
* Experience developing Claude skills (or comparable) and publishing and maintaining them in GitHub (preferred)
* Experience contributing to AI-assisted or agentic content workflows, such as prompts, templates, quality rubrics, or review checkpoints, a plus
* Experience with API documentation, information architecture, content strategy, or web technologies (HTML/CSS) a plus
* Impeccable oral and written English skills
* Flexibility to accommodate synchronous work across time zones as needed

**What you’ll be doing:**

* Deliver documentation for new product features and updates using Oxygen XML and Ixiasoft, our DITA authoring and cCMS tools
* Analyze existing documentation and update, revise, replace, and retire as needed
* Serve as documentation lead for one or more product areas: scope and plan work, track feature development in Jira, coordinate with other writers, and partner with product managers, designers, and engineers to deliver all required documentation on schedule
* Build deep knowledge of our products, technology, and customers, and relationships with the experts who inform your work
* Help establish best practices, drive quality and consistency, and build a positive team culture
* Help drive continuous improvement of our documentation using analytics and feedback from customers and internal users
* Use AI-assisted authoring tools and Claude skills in day-to-day work, and develop and iterate on skills in our shared GitHub repository
* Contribute to content strategy, information architecture, and reuse decisions, and help implement new solutions that improve how technical information is delivered to our customers
* As our agentic workflows mature, you will also:
* Review and ensure the integrity of agent-generated drafts and act as a human quality gate for your product areas
* Contribute golden examples, test cases, and feedback that improve agent output, and help identify where human judgment is essential
* Help test agentic documentation workflows: contribute to prompt libraries and the assessment criteria used to judge agent output

**What we have for you:**
At Seismic, we’re committed to providing benefits and perks for the whole self. To explore our benefits available in each country, please visit the Global Benefits page.
  
  
If you are an individual with a disability and would like to request a reasonable accommodation as part of the application or recruiting process, please click here.
  
  
Seismic is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, age, race, religion, or any other classification which is protected by applicable law.
  
  
Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.
  
  
Please be aware we have noticed an increase in hiring scams potentially targeting Seismic candidates. Read our full statement on our Careers page.

title: R&D Member of Technical Staff - II, Technical Writing
description:
**AVEVA is creating software trusted by over 90% of leading industrial companies.**
**Job Title:**
R&D Member of Technical Staff - II, Technical Writing
  
  
**Location:**
Hyderabad, India – Hybrid
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-time regular (flexible working options available)
  
  
**The job**
As part of our global technical writing group, you’ll collaborate with one or more teams of skilled software engineers from our global research & development group in writing and publishing technical documentation and associated content for our products and solutions. You’ll help us research and transform complex technical concepts, specifications, and procedures into user-oriented information for non-technical and technical audiences for developing high-quality software documentation that meets user needs.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Learn complex work from self-learning, training, and shadowing seniors
* Work under minimal supervision on advanced, unstructured, and complex work
* Improve the quality of content, adhere to the established standards and guidelines, and deliver on time
* Design, develop, review, and publish high-quality technical documentation

**Essential Requirements**

* Experience in working with products and solutions in industrial software
* Experience in working with global agile and DevOps teams
* Experience in working with Author-it Cloud and Microsoft Azure

**Desired Skills And Competencies**

* Master’s or bachelor's degree in English, Computer Science, or Engineering
* 3-5 years of experience in technical writing and documentation development
* Knowledge of software product development and cloud computing services
* Competent at concepts, processes, and tools of technical writing and information development
* Competent in using productivity tools from Microsoft and content management tools from Adobe
* Competent at DITA, structured authoring, and component content management systems
* Competent in using tools for screen capturing and recording and audio and video editing

**R&D at AVEVA**
Our global team of 2000+ developers work on an incredibly diverse portfolio of over 75 industrial automation and engineering products, which cover everything from data management to 3D design. AI and cloud are at the centre of our strategy, and we have over 150 patents to our name.
  
  
Our track record of innovation is no fluke – it’s the result of a structured and deliberate focus on learning, collaboration and inclusivity. If you want to build applications that solve big problems, join us.
  
  
Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/r-and-d-careers/
  
  
**India Benefits include:**
Gratuity, Medical and accidental insurance, very attractive leave entitlement, emergency leave days, childcare support, maternity, paternity and adoption leaves, education assistance program, home office set up support (for hybrid roles), well-being support
  
  
It’s possible we’re hiring for this position in multiple countries, in which case the above benefits apply to the primary location. Specific benefits vary by country, but our packages are similarly comprehensive.
  
  
Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/benefits/
  
  
**Hybrid working**
We work in a hybrid way at AVEVA. Most roles are based at a local AVEVA office, with an expectation of being on-site 50% of your working hours to support collaboration and connection. Some positions are fully office-based depending on the nature of the work, and certain roles that support specific customers or markets may be remote. The working arrangement for this position will be confirmed during the hiring process.
  
  
**Hiring process**
Interested? Great! Get started by submitting your cover letter and CV through our application portal. AVEVA is committed to recruiting and retaining people with disabilities. Please let us know in advance if you need reasonable support during your application process.
  
  
Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/hiring-process
  
  
**About AVEVA**
AVEVA is a global leader in industrial software with more than 6,500 employees in over 40 countries. Our cutting-edge solutions are used by thousands of enterprises to deliver the essentials of life – such as energy, infrastructure, chemicals, and minerals – safely, efficiently, and more sustainably.
  
  
We are committed to embedding sustainability and inclusion into our operations, our culture, and our core business strategy. Learn more about how we are progressing against our ambitious 2030 targets: sustainability-report.aveva.com/
  
  
Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/
  
  
AVEVA requires all successful applicants to undergo and pass a drug screening and comprehensive background check before they start employment. Background checks will be conducted in accordance with local laws and may, subject to those laws, include proof of educational attainment, employment history verification, proof of work authorization, criminal records, identity verification, credit check. Certain positions dealing with sensitive and/or third-party personal data may involve additional background check criteria.
  
  
AVEVA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to being an exemplary employer with an inclusive culture, developing a workplace environment where all our employees are treated with dignity and respect. We value diversity and the expertise that people from different backgrounds bring to our business. AVEVA provides reasonable accommodation to applicants with disabilities where appropriate. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the application and hiring process, please notify your recruiter. Determinations on requests for reasonable accommodation will be made on a case-by-case basis.

title: Adobe Content- Workfront, Genstudio-  Associate
description:
The Opportunity
  
  
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
  
  
As a Salesforce Adobe Content- Workfront, Genstudio- Senior Associate, you will leverage your consulting skills to analyze client needs, implement software solutions, and provide training and support for seamless integration and utilization of business applications. Within our Commercial & Service Excellence practice, you will play a pivotal role in helping clients optimize operational efficiency and achieve their strategic objectives. As a Senior Associate, you will focus on building meaningful client connections and learning how to manage and inspire others. You will navigate increasingly complex situations, growing your personal brand and deepening your technical skills. You are expected to anticipate the needs of your teams and clients, delivering quality solutions while embracing increased ambiguity.
  
  
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will utilize a broad range of tools and methodologies to generate new ideas and solve problems. You will interpret data to inform insights and recommendations, upholding professional and technical standards. Your ability to respond effectively to diverse perspectives and needs will be crucial in developing a deeper understanding of the business context and how it is evolving. This position offers an opportunity to enhance your strengths and address development areas, using reflection to develop self-awareness and guide others.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Analyzing client needs to implement Salesforce solutions that optimize operational efficiency
* Providing training and support for seamless integration and utilization of Salesforce applications
* Collaborating with clients to develop business models and process improvements using Salesforce tools
* Managing and inspiring teams to deliver quality work and build meaningful client relationships
* Navigating complex situations to deepen technical skills and awareness of strengths
* Utilizing analytical thinking and AI fluency to inform insights and recommendations
* Developing training materials to enhance client understanding and application of Salesforce technologies
* Implementing technology solutions that align with strategic objectives and business processes
* Integrating emerging technologies to drive innovation and improve client outcomes
* Supporting enterprise integration and systems project management for Salesforce applications

What You Must Have
  
  

* At least a Bachelor's degree
* At least 2 years of experience
* Oral and written proficiency in English required

What Sets You Apart
  
  

* Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Computer and Information Science, Management Information Systems
* Strong hands-on experience with Adobe Workfront administration and configuration.
* Proven expertise with Workfront APIs and Workfront Fusion for automation and integration use cases.
* Solid understanding of project, program, resource, and enterprise work-management concepts

description:

* Providing trusted advisory services for digital transformation, information governance, cloud migration, and content modernization programs.

* Ensuring platform reliability, scalability, security, and operational excellence.
* Driving innovation through proof-of-concepts, reference architectures, and reusable best practices.
* Supporting presales activities, solution estimation, and technical proposal development.
* Mentoring junior consultants and contributing to capability development within the practice.

**What You Need To Succeed**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* 6+ years of professional experience in Enterprise Content Management (ECM) technologies.
* Minimum 4+ years of customer-facing consulting and solution delivery experience.
* Experience in at least four full lifecycle ECM implementations from blueprinting through go-live and production stabilization.

**OpenText Expertise**

* Strong hands-on experience with:

+ OpenText Extended ECM (xECM)
+ OpenText Content Server (OTCS)
+ OTDS
+ Core Content
+ Core Archive
+ Archive Server
+ Intelligent Viewing
+ Records Management

* Proven experience with OpenText installation, configuration, upgrades, migrations, administration, patching, and troubleshooting.

**Technical Skills**

* Hands-on development experience using:

+ OScript
+ SMART UI
+ WebReports
+ REST APIs
+ Content Web Services (CWS)
+ Java and scripting languages

* Experience designing and implementing API-driven integrations with Microsoft 365, SharePoint, SAP, ERP, CRM, and cloud platforms.
* Understanding of microservices architecture, enterprise integration patterns, and modern application frameworks.

**Cloud & Container Technologies**

* Practical experience with:

+ Kubernetes
+ Docker
+ OpenShift
+ Helm
+ Containerized deployment architectures

* Understanding of cloud-native architecture, high availability, disaster recovery, scalability, and performance optimization.
* Experience with Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform is preferred.

**AI & Emerging Technologies**

* Exposure to AI-powered enterprise content management solutions.
* Working knowledge of Generative AI, Intelligent Document Processing (IDP), Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), semantic search, and knowledge discovery concepts.
* Interest in emerging technologies and continuous learning.

* Excellent verbal, written, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.

* Strong collaboration skills with cross-functional technical and business teams.

title: Technical Consultant [T500-30894]
description:
**Talent500 is hiring for one of its clients.**

**About Itineris:**

Itineris is a leading technology company that specializes in innovative SaaS solutions for water and energy utilities. Its flagship solution, UMAX, is a highly configurable Customer Information System (CIS) and CRM platform built on Microsoft Dynamics 365. UMAX enables utilities to streamline a wide range of operations – including customer service, field services, billing, asset management, and data analytics. Today, Itineris supports over 30 prominent utility providers across 7 countries and 11 U.S. states, serving more than 8 million customer accounts.

**X++ Developer – Technical Consultant**

There’s a saying at Itineris :Together goes a long way. And we live by that. Whether your job is translating our customers’ needs into the best software, selling, coding, or keeping our business running smoothly, we’re united by the same mission: growing our company and delivering innovative software that empowers energy and water utilities to engage better with their customers.

**What you will work on:**

You will work within our Project Delivery teams to implement our UMAX solution at our customers.

UMAX is the brand name of our software solution for water and energy utilities. It automates their business processes and enables them to better engage with their customers. UMAX is a cloud-based solution, built on the powerful Microsoft Dynamics 365 platform.

**Function:**

The X++ Developer - Technical Consultant will be responsible for building highly interactive, innovative applications for our UMAX solution, on a project or for Service Delivery, using the latest Microsoft technologies (X++).

The role is based in Hyderabad, India.

**As a X++ Developer - Technical Consultant, you will:**

* Develop software based on the design specifications made by the functional and technical lead.
* Develop and customize software based on Microsoft Dynamics 365 (X++).
* Act as a technical reference for consultants, project managers, sales, management and Microsoft consultants.
* Apply your expertise to deliver high quality development work, according to the Itineris standards in an efficient and effective way.
* Document your work in a structured and transparent way.

**Our ideal candidate:**

* Has knowledge of application development with minimum 3 years of development experience.
* Has proven experience as an X++ developer to develop complete custom solutions & deploy it in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations cloud.
* Has experience in OOP (required) (X++,.NET).
* Has experienced in data management and able to execute data manipulations using SQL.
* Has good oral and written communication skills in English.
* Has excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Is pragmatic thinker oriented towards finding solutions.
* Is quality driven and result oriented.
* Is a global team player with focus on collaboration.
* Is willing to continually learn and be challenged.

**Good to have skills are:**

* Experience with Power Platform (Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate, Power Portal).
* Interest in ERP or the functional domains related to the Utilities industry.
* Knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies.

**Experience, Qualifications and Certifications:**

* 4 to 6 years of experience
* Bachelor's or master's degree, preferably in computer science

**Certifications which are nice to have:**

* Finance and Operations Apps Developer Associate (MB-500)
* Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900)
* Dynamics 365 Fundamentals Finance and Operations Apps (ERP) (MB-920)
* Power Platform Fundamentals (CRM) (PL-900)
* Power Platform Developer Associate (PL-400)
* Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104)
* Azure Developer Associate (AZ-204)
* Finance and Operations Apps Solution Architect Expert (MB-700)
* Power Platform Solution Architect Expert(PL-600)ure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305)

**What we offer:**

* A fast-growing and international environment with offices in Ghent (Belgium), Atlanta (USA), London (UK), and Hyderabad (India).
* Working with future-ready water and energy companies and building valuable utility expertise.
* Internal mobility, developing your career through various educational programs and growth paths.
* An entrepreneurial mindset where you have a direct impact on our growth journey.
* An open environment where we understand the importance of taking a break to recharge and achieve the best results. We make it a priority to celebrate milestones, both big and small.
* Onboarding, learning and buddy programs to get ready for a smooth start in your new job.
* A flexible and inclusive working environment – where people can just be who they are, and where we offer flexible options for hybrid working so you can work in a way that suits you best.
* Competitive perks & benefits, because we want to help you reach your full potential, both at work and in your personal life.
* A lot of fun moments with an eye for sports, celebration and wellbeing, important for maintaining a healthy work-life balance.

title: HL7 Interface Engineer
description:
**Summary of Position**

Teladoc Health is seeking a Senior/Mid Software Engineer – Mirth / Healthcare Interoperability to join our engineering organization and build, enhance, and support healthcare integrations that enable the secure and reliable exchange of clinical and operational data.

This is a hands-on engineering role focused on Mirth Connect, HL7v2, and healthcare interoperability. The engineer will design and implement complex integration workflows, troubleshoot production interfaces, collaborate with internal teams and external healthcare partners, and contribute to the evolution of our integration platform.

The ideal candidate brings strong expertise in Mirth Connect and HL7v2, combined with solid software engineering, integration, debugging, and production support skills. Experience with FHIR, EHR/EMR integrations, and healthcare interoperability standards is highly valued.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Healthcare Integration & Engineering**

* Design, develop, configure, test, deploy, and maintain healthcare interfaces using Mirth Connect.
* Develop complex integration workflows for HL7v2 message parsing, transformation, validation, routing, and delivery.
* Develop reusable and maintainable JavaScript-based transformations and business logic within Mirth Connect.
* Integrate healthcare systems using TCP/MLLP, HTTP/HTTPS, SFTP, and other integration protocols.
* Translate business and technical requirements into robust, scalable, and production-ready integration solutions.
* Collaborate with internal engineering teams, healthcare organizations, and external vendors to design and implement interfaces.
* Contribute to the design and evolution of healthcare interoperability solutions and integration architecture.
* Identify opportunities to improve integration performance, reliability, maintainability, and operational efficiency.

**Production Support & Reliability**

* Monitor and support production healthcare interfaces and integration workflows.
* Diagnose and resolve issues involving message processing, transformation, routing, connectivity, certificates, and downstream systems.
* Troubleshoot network and protocol-level issues across MLLP, HTTP/HTTPS, and SFTP.
* Perform root-cause analysis for production incidents and implement sustainable corrective actions.
* Improve interface reliability through effective logging, monitoring, alerting, error handling, and operational automation.
* Participate in an on-call rotation supporting critical production integrations.
* Ensure integration solutions meet appropriate security, reliability, and operational standards.

**Collaboration & Technical Leadership**

* Partner with product managers, architects, engineers, analysts, and external vendors to deliver healthcare integration solutions.
* Communicate technical designs, issues, risks, and solutions clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Participate in technical design and architecture reviews.
* Conduct code and configuration reviews and promote standards for secure, scalable, and maintainable integration
* Create and maintain technical documentation, including interface specifications, mapping documents, design documents, and operational runbooks.
* Mentor engineers and serve as a technical resource for Mirth Connect, HL7v2, and healthcare interoperability.
* Contribute to engineering standards, reusable patterns, and continuous improvement across the integration platform.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years of professional software engineering and/or healthcare integration experience, including 3+ years of hands-on experience developing and supporting Mirth Connect integrations.
* Strong, practical knowledge of HL7v2, including message structure, segments, fields, components, repetitions, acknowledgments, and common message types.
* Demonstrated experience designing and implementing Mirth Connect channels, including connectors, filters, transformers, and JavaScript.
* Strong experience with TCP/MLLP, HTTP/HTTPS, and SFTP.
* Proven ability to troubleshoot connectivity, message delivery, transformation, routing, and downstream system issues in production environments.
* Working knowledge of JavaScript for Mirth transformations and integration logic.
* Understanding of SSL/TLS, certificates, keystores/trust stores, and secure endpoint configuration.
* Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases.
* Experience with software development lifecycle practices, source control, testing, deployment, and production support.
* Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering teams, business stakeholders, and external partners.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Hands-on experience with FHIR, including FHIR resources, APIs, and integration patterns.
* Experience with EHR/EMR integrations and health care information exchange.
* Experience with CCDA/C-CDA.
* Familiarity with XDS.b and XCA.
* Experience working with healthcare interoperability standards and architectures.
* Experience developing or integrating with REST APIs and web services.
* Experience with MongoDB or other NoSQL databases.
* Experience with other healthcare interface engines such as Rhapsody, Core point, Cloverleaf, or similar technologies.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Mirth Connect Certified Developer (MCCD) certification.
* Participation in Mirth Connect, healthcare interoperability, or open-source technical communities.

title: Business Intelligence Engineer I, Global Reporting & Standards (GRS)
description:
**Description**
The Global Reporting & Standards (GRS) team within the Global Reliability and Maintenance Engineering (RME) Central Team is looking for an exceptional business intelligence engineer to join us. In this role, you will work on an analytical team to bust myths, create insights, and produce recommendations to help Central RME to deliver world class service to the Amazon network. As part of the team will be involved in all phases of research, experiment, design and analysis, including defining research questions, designing experiments, identifying data requirements, and communicating insights and recommendations. You'll also be expected to continuously learn new systems, tools, and industry best practices to analyze big data and enhance our analytics. These are exciting fast-paced businesses in which we get to work on extremely interesting analytical problems, in an environment where you get to learn from other engineers and apply business intelligence to help leadership make informed decisions.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
You build mid-size to large BI solutions or components of larger solutions. Your focus is at the team level, working on a major portion of existing or new BI artifacts (e.g., contributing to the team’s datamart) or owning a difficult report or analysis.
  
  
You assume responsibility for the code, queries, reports and analyses you inherit or produce. You get your analyses and code reviewed. You test your code by validating outputs against source data, business logic, and related metrics
  
  
You have a deep understanding of data lineage of your team’s BI solutions: the technical systems by which the data is generated; how the metrics are aggregated; and how the resulting business intelligence is consumed, interpreted and acted upon by the business.
  
  
You are a passionate advocate for your customer. In addition to metrics definitions, you learn the business context and technologies behind your team’s data infrastructure. You work effectively with customers (e.g., business teams, Data Scientists, etc.) and other internal partners to ensure deliverables are aligned with expectations.
  
  
You invent, refine and develop your BI solutions to ensure they are meeting the needs of the business and team goals.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 2+ years of analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc. experience
* Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
* Experience with one or more industry analytics visualization tools (e.g. Excel, Tableau, QuickSight, MicroStrategy, PowerBI) and statistical methods (e.g. t-test, Chi-squared)
* Experience with scripting language (e.g., Python, Java, or R)

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's degree, or Advanced technical degree
* Knowledge of data modeling and data pipeline design

title: Business Intelligence Engineer, Last Mile BI
description:
**Description**
When you attract people who have the DNA of pioneers and the DNA of explorers, you build a company of like-minded people who want to invent. And that’s what they think about when they get up in the morning: how are we going to work backwards from customers and build a great service or a great product” – Jeff Bezos
  
  
Amazon.com’s success is built on a foundation of customer obsession. Every day, Amazon delivers millions of packages to customers around the world with clock-like precision. Behind every successful delivery, billions of decisions are made by systems and by people in real time. Is the customer's address accurate? Can we pinpoint it on a map? Is an unattended delivery safe? Is there an access code for the building? What are the business hours if it's a commercial address? How do we optimize a delivery associate's route across dozens of stops? The list goes on.
  
  
At the core of all of it lies quality of underlying data that can help make those decisions in time.
  
  
The person in this role will be a strong influencer who will ensure goal alignment with Technology, Operations, and Finance teams. This role will serve as the face of the LM organization to global stakeholders.
  
  
This position requires a results-oriented, high-energy, dynamic individual with both stamina and mental quickness to be able to work and thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth global organization. Excellent communication skills and executive presence to get in front of VPs and SVPs across Amazon will be imperative.
  
  
**Key Strategic Objectives**
Amazon is seeking an experienced leader to own the vision for quality improvement through global address management programs. As a Business Intelligence Engineer of Amazon Last Mile Quality team, you will be responsible for shaping the strategy and direction of customer-facing products that are core to the customer experience. As a key member of the last mile leadership team, you will continually raise the bar on both quality and performance. You will bring innovation, a strategic perspective, a passionate voice, and an ability to prioritize and execute on a fast-moving set of priorities, competitive pressures, and operational initiatives. You will partner closely with product and technology teams to define and build innovative and delightful experiences for customers. You must be highly analytical, able to work extremely effectively in a matrix organization, and have the ability to break complex problems down into steps that drive product development at Amazon Speed. You will set the tempo for defect reduction through continuous improvement and drive accountability across multiple business units in order to deliver large scale high visibility/ high impact projects. You will lead by example to be just as passionate about operational performance and predictability as you will be about all other aspects of customer experience.
  
  
**The Successful Candidate Will Be Able To**

**Location:**

**Employment Type:**
Full time, regular, hybrid work arrangement
  
  
**The job**
The Forward Deployed Solution Engineer owns a defined technical workstream within an FDE engagement. Working within agreed architecture and standards, the role applies customer domain context to configure, integrate, test, troubleshoot, validate, document, and hand over AVEVA solutions using real customer data, systems, and constraints. * Own a defined FDE technical workstream from implementation through validation and handover.
* Build, configure, integrate, test, troubleshoot, and adapt AVEVA solutions in real customer environments.
* Apply established architecture, standards, methods, and governance to deliver reliable outcomes.
* Clarify requirements, dependencies, risks, feasibility, and implementation needs for the workstream.
* Implement creative and out of the box solutioning strategies against identified product feature gaps
* Resolve non-routine technical issues across APIs, integrations, data flows, configuration, performance, security, and deployment.
* Support demonstrations, acceptance testing, performance checks, validation, and production-readiness activities.
* Create reusable configurations, connectors, templates, AI patterns, implementation notes, and troubleshooting guidance.
* Coordinate with peers and adjacent teams, guide less-experienced contributors where appropriate, and escalate material risks early.

* Typically, 5-8 years of relevant experience, or equivalent demonstrated capability in industrial technology implementation and technical project delivery.
* Hands-on capability in AVEVA solution configuration, integration, testing, troubleshooting, validation, and handover.
* Working knowledge of AVEVA products, customer domain workflows, industrial data, customer systems, APIs, cloud/edge, security, performance, and deployment constraints.

**Job Description**
**GLOBAL BANKING & MARKETS**
We make markets in and clear client transactions on major stock, options and futures exchanges worldwide. Through
  
  
our global sales force, we maintain relationships with our clients, receiving orders and distributing investment
  
  
research, trading ideas, market information and analysis
  
  
**YOUR-IMPACT**
Are you looking to for an opportunity to be part of a team that works directly with exchanges, finance teams,
  
  
technology teams, and other business partners to solve complex problems and influence change? Fees and
  
  
Commission is seeking a professional who is looking for an opportunity to develop a variety of soft and hard skills,
  
  
contribute to and influence business improvements, apply financial and risk management skills, solve complex
  
  
problems, and deliver excellent client service. You can be an innovator as a business specialist, developing and
  
  
executing solutions to increase business profitability and strengthen client relationships.
  
  
**OUR-IMPACT**
Fees & Commissions the Fees and Commissions team manages income, fee and interest charges for the client and
  
  
house businesses. The team impacts the success of millions of trades a day and uses data-based decision making to
  
  
influence strategic business decisions. Adapting to changing client and business needs and accurate management of
  
  
charges is critical to the profitability of our organization. Team responsibilities include rate maintenance, charge
  
  
validations, reconciliations, adjustments, payments, cost allocations, system developments, regulatory updates,
  
  
strategic projects, and business query support. We use data analytics and tools such as Alteryx, Tableau and SQL to
  
  
make data-driven decisions and suggestions.
  
  
**How You Will Fulfill Your Potential**

* Enhance and improve our processes and functions by developing a deeper understanding of the function and

becoming a technical expert.
  
  

* Collaborate with our technology and business partners as well as external contacts to improve strategic

process workflows.
  
  

* Provide timely client or business query support.
* Use your inquisitive mindset to identify control weaknesses and recommend robust solutions.
* Monitor Futures/listed derivative fees, commission or interest related functions for clients and house

businesses.
  
  

* Maintain accurate commission, interest, and fee rates for clients in all firm systems.
* Ensure accurate collection and payment for millions of trades a day.
* Monitor and approve functions that span the life cycle of a trade such as validations, configurations,

adjustments, reconciliations, invoices, and payments.
  
  

* Align team expectations and oversee gaps around all phases of the trade and billing life cycle.
* Act as a technical expert to enhance firm’s processes, identify control weaknesses, recommend robust

solutions, in collaboration with direct team, internal and external technology and business partners.
  
  

* Regularly assess client, business and regulatory needs and identify change required.
* Plan and execute projects to increase firm profitability and adhere to any new compliance guidance.
* Develop readiness plan and associated change management strategies for new functionality upgrades on the

back of business, regulatory or system upgrades.
  
  

* Partner with Business Intelligence team to develop capabilities for new process that would identify and mitigate risk derived from the correlation of quantitative and qualitative data.
* Define project scope and required resources; set objectives and milestones; measure outcomes and their

impact.
  
  

* Highlight project bottlenecks and propose feasible solutions.
* Collect, interpret, and condense large amount of complex data, and present meaningful actionable insights to

senior level stakeholders.
  
  

* Translate project business requirements for technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Skills And Experience We're Looking For**

* Bachelor’s degree with 4+ years of experience.
* Self-motivated and proactive team player who takes ownership and demonstrates accountability, has strong

organizational skills as well as the ability to effectively manage competing priorities.
  
  

* Proactive, enthusiastic approach with very high attention to detail
* Highly collaborative, flexible, and team-focused with ability to interact effectively with a wide range of

stakeholders.
  
  

* Translating project business requirements for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Effective problem solving and critical thinking skills along with the ability to use discretion and good judgment.
* Excellent Client Service skills with ability to communicate complex issues to individuals with varying levels of

product expertise.
  
  

* Competency with MS Suite, especially Excel and the ability to learn multiple programs quickly.
* Data ingestion, data transformation and harmonization, data processing, data provision, data modeling, and

data access.
  
  

* Financial and risk management experience including compliance risk (ex – data management, charge

accuracy), security risk (ex – client data security and confidentiality), and operational risks (ex – human error,
  
  
process flaws, data maintenance)
  
  

* End-to-end successful execution of complex projects including roadmap execution, budgeting, and resource

allocation.
  
  

* Identifying process-flow bottlenecks, providing escalation management, anticipating/making trade-offs, and

balancing business needs within pre-existing constraints.
  
  

* Collecting, interpreting, and condensing large amount of complex data, and presenting meaningful actionable

insights to senior level stakeholders.
  
  

* Managing mid to long term projects (6 months to 3+ years) including project documentation, evaluation, and

review.
  
  

* Adaptable to changing business needs.
* Ability to learn quickly with high desire for large responsibility.
* Strong organizational skills and ability to effectively manage competing priorities.

**About Goldman Sachs**
At Goldman Sachs, we commit our people, capital, and ideas to help our clients, shareholders, and the communities
  
  
we serve to grow. Founded in 1869, we are a leading global investment banking, securities, and investment
  
  
management firm. Headquartered in New York, we maintain offices around the world.
  
  
We believe who you are makes you better at what you do. We're committed to fostering and advancing diversity and
  
  
inclusion in our own workplace and beyond by ensuring every individual within our firm has a number of opportunities
  
  
to grow professionally and personally, from our training and development opportunities and firmwide networks to benefits, wellness and personal finance offerings and mindfulness programs. Learn more about our culture, benefits,
  
  
and people at GS.com/careers.
  
  
We’re committed to finding reasonable accommodations for candidates with special needs or disabilities during our
  
  
recruiting process. Learn more: https://www.goldmansachs.com/careers/footer/disability-statement.html

title: Senior Business Analyst
description:
**About the Role**

Teladoc Health is seeking a Senior Business Analyst with approximately eight years of business analysis experience to connect clinical and operational priorities with the delivery of digital healthcare platforms and integrations. You’ll work independently across Product, Clinical Operations, Clinical Informatics, Engineering, Design, Data, and QA to define requirements, evaluate workflows, and turn analysis into practical recommendations. Combining requirements expertise with data-driven decision support, you’ll help teams identify operational risks, improve

processes, and validate measurable benefits for providers and members. This is a senior individual contributor role focused on business analysis and solution validation, with no people-management or software-development responsibilities.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead requirements discovery for complex clinical platform and integration initiatives, translating business objectives into clearly defined scope and outcomes.
* Facilitate stakeholder interviews, discovery workshops, and working sessions to elicit and validate business and functional requirements.
* Document current-state and future-state workflows, identify process gaps, and recommend improvements supported by business value and operational impact.
* Translate qualitative findings and quantitative analysis into clear recommendations, outlining business value, operational and financial implications, risks, and tradeoffs for stakeholder decisions.
* Provide guidance on business analysis practices and share reusable templates, documentation standards, and lessons learned.
* Create and maintain business requirements, functional specifications, epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, and business rules.
* Partner with Product and Engineering to refine the backlog, clarify scope, and support prioritization through an Agile planning process.
* Maintain requirements traceability and identify dependencies, assumptions, open questions, and change impacts throughout delivery.
* Define KPIs, baseline measures, and reporting requirements with Data and Operations; interpret dashboard trends, investigate variances, and assess whether delivered solutions achieve intended business outcomes.
* Build collaborative relationships across clinical, business, and technical teams and facilitate alignment on requirements and priorities.
* Communicate requirements status, decision needs, scope changes, and delivery risks clearly to stakeholders and leadership.
* Analyze information from multiple operational and system sources, validate data quality, investigate workflow bottlenecks and recurring issues, and recommend evidence-based process or system improvements.
* Clarify integration requirements with architects and engineers, including data flows, field mappings, validation rules, and exception scenarios.
* Partner with QA and business stakeholders to define test scenarios, coordinate user acceptance testing, and validate solutions against agreed acceptance criteria.
* Collaborate with Product, Design, Data, Operations, and customer-facing teams to ensure end-to-end workflows address user and business needs.
* Support release readiness through workflow documentation, stakeholder walkthroughs, training inputs, and post-launch validation; capture adoption feedback and track opportunities for continuous improvement.
* Evaluate how proposed clinical platform and integration changes affect workflow efficiency, service demand, and operational capacity, partnering with Operations and Data on scenario analysis when needed.
* Partner with clinical operations and informatics to ensure requirements reflect real care-delivery workflows, patient safety considerations, data quality, and measurable outcomes.
* Partner with Security, Compliance, and Engineering to document privacy, PHI handling, access-control, auditability, and operational requirements.

The time spent on each responsibility reflects an estimate and is subject to change dependent on business needs.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**

No direct reports. This is an individual contributor position.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* Approximately 8 years of progressive business analysis experience supporting enterprise software, digital platforms, or complex systems initiatives.
* Demonstrated ability to independently lead complex business analysis assignments from discovery through implementation, working across stakeholder groups with limited direction.
* Strong facilitation, stakeholder management, negotiation, and consensus-building skills.
* Experience working within Agile/Scrum teams, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, and iterative delivery.
* Proficiency creating business requirements, functional specifications, user stories, acceptance criteria, and business rules.
* Experience mapping current-state and future-state processes and performing gap and impact analyses.
* Ability to establish clear requirements documentation and support consistent business analysis practices across teams.
* Strong organizational skills and experience using requirements and collaboration tools such as Jira and Confluence, or equivalent platforms.
* Experience partnering with QA and business users on test scenarios, user acceptance testing, defect clarification, and solution validation.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts and business tradeoffs to non-technical audiences.
* Working understanding of the software development lifecycle, system integrations, APIs, and data flows sufficient to collaborate effectively with engineering teams.
* Strong Excel skills and practical experience using SQL or comparable tools to analyze datasets, reconcile discrepancies, validate business rules, and communicate actionable findings.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Business analysis experience in healthcare, virtual care, digital health, or another regulated environment.
* Experience partnering with Clinical Operations, Clinical Informatics, Product, Security, Compliance, and Data teams to translate care-delivery needs into system and process requirements.
* Familiarity with EHR/EMR integrations, provider scheduling, clinical documentation, member workflows, HIPAA, PHI handling, and access-control requirements.
* Familiarity with healthcare interoperability concepts, including HL7 FHIR, HL7v2, SMART on FHIR, REST APIs, and clinical data exchange.
* Experience defining operational reporting, audit, monitoring, and support-readiness requirements for cloud-based, API-driven platforms.
* Experience using Tableau or a comparable visualization platform to communicate operational trends, support KPI reporting, and inform business decisions.

**What You'll Build**

You’ll develop the requirements, process models, data mappings, acceptance criteria, and decision-support insights that connect business needs with clinical technology delivery. Your work may include EHR and partner integrations, FHIR-based clinical data exchange, provider scheduling and availability, secure clinical workflows, and operational reporting. Success means requirements are clear and traceable, stakeholders understand decisions and tradeoffs, solutions meet agreed acceptance criteria, and post-launch measures demonstrate improvements in workflow efficiency, data quality, or provider and member experience

title: HR Associate — Staffing & Client Acquisition
description:
**Company description**

Firmamentum Technologies LLP builds products and services for India's hiring ecosystem — Bcommune, Bcommune Studio (our AI-native ATS) and B-Hubs. This role sits in our services vertical, which delivers recruitment, staffing, HR outsourcing and workforce consulting to client companies.

**The role**

It has two halves and you do both.
**Bring the work in:**
know our full portfolio well enough to pitch it, scope a requirement and quote it, then find companies that need it and close them.
**Deliver it:**
source, screen and close candidates against client mandates, and support the compliance side of each engagement.

We hire at 0–1 years because we would rather train the right person. We will teach you the services, the statutory framework and the commercials. We will not teach you to cold-call, follow up or own a number you bring that. If you want requirements landing in your inbox, this is the wrong role.

**Responsibilities**

* Build a target list of companies needing recruitment, staffing or HR outsourcing — startups, SMBs, mid-market, BPO, retail, manufacturing, healthcare, IT
* Run outbound outreach daily: calls, LinkedIn, email, WhatsApp and in-person visits across Hyderabad
* Pitch our services, scope the requirement, and prepare proposals, rate cards and service agreements with the founder's review
* Negotiate commercial terms: fee percentage, per-hire cost, staffing markup, replacement guarantee, payment terms
* Track and respond to staffing tenders, RFPs and vendor empanelment, including government and PSU listings
* Attend job fairs, industry meets and startup events for leads
* Keep a clean pipeline, report on it weekly, and own client accounts after signing for repeat mandates
* Convert client briefs into job descriptions with agreed profile, budget and timeline
* Source, screen, interview and shortlist candidates via portals, our Bcommune network,
  LinkedIn,
  referrals, campus and field sourcing
* Run offers, negotiation, documentation, joining and post-joining follow-up; handle replacements on contract and payroll placements
* Run bulk hiring drives end to end: walk-ins, campus drives, semi-urban and village sourcing for field roles
* Support HR outsourcing work: PF, ESI, PT, LWF, gratuity and bonus data and filing calendars; contract labour licences; policies and handbooks; onboarding and exit; attendance and leave; background verification; performance management setup; HR audits
* Support consulting work: manpower planning, org structure, salary benchmarking, employer branding, engagement programmes
* Keep every requirement and candidate in Bcommune Studio and report fill rates and turnaround times

**What we need from you**

* 0–1 years in HR, recruitment, staffing, inside sales or business development; internships count. Any graduate, Majors in HR a plus
* Fluent English, Telugu and Hindi — client and candidate calls happen in all three
* Genuine comfort with cold outreach; you will call strangers and hear no more often than yes
* Clear written English for proposals, JDs and client emails that go out under our name
* Excel or Sheets, LinkedIn and one job portal; basic grasp of PF, ESI, CTC structure, notice period and probation
* Ownership — nobody will chase you for updates; you report before being asked
* Based in Hyderabad or relocating before joining, and willing to travel locally for meetings and drives
* A plus: a consultancy or staffing internship, existing HR contacts in Hyderabad, ATS or CRM exposure, placement-cell experience, familiarity with tender portals.

**What You'll Gain**

* Fixed salary
* Ownership of the HR function from day one, not a seat inside an existing team
* Hands-on with an AI-native ATS before the market has it
* Client recruitment and internal HR in one role, which most jobs split

title: Red Team & Penetration Testing (Network)
description:
**Experience:**
6–8 Years

**Location:**
Hyderabad, India

**Role Type:**
Full-time

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Security Engineer to join our Offensive Security team. In this role, you will lead and execute penetration testing, Red Team operations, vulnerability assessments, and complex adversary simulations across enterprise environments.

You will be responsible for identifying critical security vulnerabilities, simulating real-world threat actors, evaluating security controls, and designing actionable remediation strategies. Additionally, you will architect and maintain advanced Red Team infrastructure while driving the automation of security testing workflows to enhance operational efficiency.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Red Team Operations & Adversary Simulation**

* Plan, scope, and execute end-to-end Red Team engagements simulating sophisticated real-world threat actors and attack methodologies.
* Perform comprehensive internal network penetration testing and infrastructure security evaluations.
* Execute deep reconnaissance, initial access vector identification, privilege escalation, lateral movement, and domain compromise scenarios.
* Develop and execute custom attack playbooks aligned with the MITRE ATT&CK framework.
* Evaluate the effectiveness of endpoint security controls, EDR/MDR solutions, and detection mechanisms.
* Identify detection gaps and collaborate with defensive teams to enhance detection and response capabilities.

**2. Active Directory Security Assessments**

* Conduct in-depth Active Directory (AD) penetration testing and security architecture reviews.
* Discover and exploit AD misconfigurations, complex privilege escalation vectors, and delegation flaws.
* Assess Kerberos and NTLM authentication security, leveraging attacks such as Kerberoasting, AS-REP Roasting, and NTLM relaying.
* Analyze AD Certificate Services (AD CS), Group Policy Objects (GPOs), trust relationships, and privileged account security postures.
* Map and analyze attack paths leading to domain and enterprise compromise.
* Provide hardened remediation strategies to secure enterprise Active Directory environments.

**3. Network & Infrastructure Penetration Testing**

* Conduct rigorous internal and external network infrastructure penetration tests.
* Identify and exploit vulnerabilities in core network services, operating systems, and enterprise infrastructure components.
* Evaluate firewall rulesets, network segmentation boundaries, and access control policies.
* Perform vulnerability validation and controlled exploitation utilizing advanced offensive toolsets.
* Deliver clear, highly detailed technical reports detailing methodology, proof-of-concept exploits, business impact, and mitigation steps.

**4. Red Team Infrastructure Development & Automation**

* Architect, deploy, and manage scalable Red Team infrastructure in public cloud environments, primarily AWS.
* Automate infrastructure provisioning and configuration management using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools like Terraform and Ansible.
* Deploy and maintain Command and Control (C2) frameworks, domain fronting/redirectors, payload delivery servers, and secure data exfiltration channels.
* Configure and manage modern C2 frameworks (e.g., Adaptix C2, Havoc), logging frameworks (e.g., RedELK), and customized offensive tooling.
* Develop custom exploit scripts and automation modules using Python, PowerShell, and Bash to streamline assessment workflows.
* Enforce rigorous operational security (OPSEC) practices across all offensive infrastructure operations.

**5. Security Testing & Reporting**

* Execute vulnerability assessments and penetration testing campaigns across diverse enterprise environments.
* Validate vulnerability severity and impact through controlled, documented proof-of-concept exploits.
* Author comprehensive executive and technical reports complete with risk ratings, root cause analyses, and step-by-step remediation advice.
* Partner with SOC, Incident Response, and Security Engineering teams to optimize threat detection and defensive controls (Blue/Purple Teaming).
* Conduct re-testing and provide ongoing guidance to validate successfully implemented security fixes.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Deep technical understanding of networking protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, SMB, LDAP, Kerberos, NTLM).
* Proven hands-on experience in Active Directory domain compromise and attack path analysis.
* Strong track record of conducting internal/external network penetration testing and full-scope Red Team operations.
* In-depth administration and security knowledge of Windows and Linux enterprise environments.
* Proficiency with offensive security toolsets (e.g., Nmap, Burp Suite, Nessus, BloodHound, Impacket, NetExec, Mimikatz, Wireshark).
* Hands-on operational experience with modern C2 frameworks (Cobalt Strike, Havoc, Adaptix C2, etc.).
* Experience with AWS cloud infrastructure architecture and security testing techniques.
* Practical experience with Infrastructure as Code and automation tools (Terraform, Ansible).

Crowe Capability Center – India, operating under the legal entity C3 India Delivery Centre LLP (formerly known as Crowe Horwath IT Services LLP) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Crowe LLP (U.S.A.), a public accounting, consulting and technology firm with offices around the world. Strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes, Helm charts, and designing/optimizing CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI) is essential. Proficiency in Python and scripting (Bash/PowerShell) is also a must.

Experience with configuration management (Ansible, Puppet) and DevSecOps principles is required; OpenShift is a plus.

* Participate in code reviews, architecture discussions and technical roadmap planning for platform and infrastructure.
* Drive continuous improvement of platform reliability, observability, performance, scalability and cost efficiency.

Cloud (AWS)

* Helm: Chart authoring and release management (templating, values layering, hooks)

CI/CD

Observability and operations
  
  

* Logging: Log aggregation and querying (Sumo Logic, ELK or Splunk)

Security and compliance
  
  

* Secrets management: AWS Secrets Manager, Vault or Kubernetes secrets

Fundamentals
  
  

* Linux: Strong administration skills
* Git: Branching, merge requests and tagging workflows
