title: Lead DevOps Engineer
description:
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a skilled Lead DevOps Engineer with strong hands-on experience in CI/CD pipelines, container orchestration, infrastructure automation, and cloud operations. The ideal candidate is comfortable working across the full DevOps toolchain — from source control and pipeline automation to Kubernetes, Terraform, and monitoring — and has exposure to GenAI application deployments and SAP environments.
  
  
In this high-impact role, you will spearhead multi-client V2 deployments, execute rigorous load testing for high-traffic workflows, and drive infrastructure execution for our core product ecosystem and cloud marketplace offerings, while collaborating across IST and EST time zones to support key cross-regional initiatives.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Platform Delivery & Multi-Client Operations**

* Own, automate, and manage end-to-end multi-client V2 platform deployments with minimal downtime.
* Lead infrastructure setup, CI/CD workflows, and scaling operations for our product ecosystem and cloud marketplace deployments.
* Design, execute, and analyze performance and load testing strategies to maintain platform stability during peak daily traffic.
* Provide dedicated DevOps support during EST overlapping hours to assist with continuous deployment requests and infrastructure needs across global engineering teams.

**CI/CD & Source Control**

* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, and Bitbucket Pipelines.
* Manage repositories, branching strategies, and access controls across GitHub, Bitbucket, and GitLab.
* Implement GitOps delivery workflows using ArgoCD or FluxCD.
* Integrate automated quality gates — code scanning, SAST, and dependency checks — into pipelines.

**Kubernetes & Containerization**

* Manage Kubernetes clusters (EKS, AKS, or GKE) and handle day-to-day cluster operations.
* Author and maintain Helm Charts for application packaging and multi-environment deployments.
* Build and manage Docker images; enforce container scanning and registry hygiene.

**Infrastructure as Code**

* Provision and manage cloud infrastructure using Terraform and Ansible.
* Write reusable Terraform modules and manage remote state across environments.
* Enforce infrastructure compliance using policy-as-code tools (Checkov, OPA, or Sentinel).

**Cloud & Networking**

* Manage workloads and services on AWS, Azure, or GCP including compute, storage, networking, and IAM.
* Configure VPCs, load balancers, DNS, security groups, and cloud-native managed services.

**Monitoring & Reliability**

* Implement observability using Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK, Datadog, or similar tools.
* Build dashboards, alerting rules, and SLO tracking; support incident response, root cause analysis (RCA), and system documentation.

**Security & DevSecOps**

* Manage secrets using HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, or Azure Key Vault.
* Apply DevSecOps practices — image scanning, IaC security checks, and least-privilege IAM.

**GenAI & SAP**

* Support deployment of GenAI/LLM-based applications on Kubernetes including GPU workloads.
* Assist with SAP infrastructure operations, cloud-hosted SAP environments, and system monitoring.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* CI/CD Tools: Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Bitbucket Pipelines, GitLab CI/CD.
* Source Control: Git, GitHub, Bitbucket, GitLab — branching, PRs, hooks, and access management.
* Containers & Orchestration: Kubernetes, Helm, Docker, ArgoCD / FluxCD.
* IaC: Terraform (modules, state, workspaces), Ansible (playbooks, roles, AWX).
* Cloud: AWS, Azure, or GCP — core services, IAM, networking, and cost management.
* Monitoring & Load Testing: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, Datadog, or equivalent, plus practical experience with performance/load testing tools (e.g., JMeter, k6, Locust).
* Security: Vault, Secrets Manager, Trivy, Snyk, Checkov, or similar scanning tools.
* Scripting: Bash, Python, YAML, Groovy — for automation and pipeline development.
* Core Systems & Operations: Solid understanding of Linux, networking fundamentals, system reliability, and willingness to work in overlapping IST/EST hours.

**Preferred Skills**

* Cloud Marketplaces: Hands-on experience packaging, publishing, and managing SaaS or infrastructure solutions on AWS Marketplace and Azure Marketplace.
* Certifications: CKA, AWS/Azure DevOps Engineer, Terraform Associate.
* Experience with Service Mesh (Istio, Linkerd) and API gateways (Kong, NGINX, Envoy).
* Exposure to GenAI platforms — Hugging Face, OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, or Azure OpenAI.
* Familiarity with SAP BTP, SAP S/4HANA Cloud, or SAP Basis operations.
* Knowledge of FinOps practices, chaos engineering, and progressive delivery patterns.
* Experience with Terragrunt, Pulumi, or additional IaC tooling.

**EDUCATION**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Equivalent hands-on experience will be considered in lieu of formal education.

  : Design, build, and maintain resilient cloud infrastructure solutions to support the development and deployment of scalable and reliable applications. This includes managing and optimizing cloud platforms for high availability, performance, and cost efficiency.

  : Lead reliability best practices by establishing and managing monitoring and alerting systems to proactively detect and respond to anomalies and performance issues. Develop Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and automate workflows using tools like Rundeck or Jenkins.

  : Participate in and help resolve major incidents, conduct thorough root cause analyses, and implement permanent solutions. Effectively manage incidents within the production environment using a systematic problem-solving approach.

Must possess a pragmatic and adaptable mindset, with a willingness to step outside comfort zones and acquire new skills. Ability to consider the broader system impact of your work. * Understanding of cloud security best practices, including data encryption, access controls, and identity management.

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
  
  
**Your day at NTT DATA**
The Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) is a seasoned subject matter expert, responsible for ensuring the reliability, availability, and performance of company systems and infrastructure.
  
  
This Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) works closely with development teams, operations teams, and other stakeholders to enhance system resiliency, automate processes, and improve overall system reliability.
  
  
**Key responsibilities:**

* Monitors system health, performance metrics, and alerts to identify and respond to incidents promptly and diagnoses issues, troubleshoots problems, and restores services in a timely manner.
* Implements incident response processes to minimize downtime and improve system availability.
* Designs, develops, and maintains automation tools, scripts, and processes to streamline system management tasks, deployments, and configuration changes.
* Implements infrastructure-as-code principles to ensure consistency and repeatability.
* Optimizes system resources, configurations, and processes to enhance performance, scalability, and efficiency.
* Uses monitoring tools and performance testing to identify bottlenecks and implement optimizations.
* Collaborates with teams to forecast system resource needs, plans for capacity growth, and ensures adequate scalability.
* Leads incident response efforts, coordinates with cross-functional teams, and drives the resolution of system issues.
* Performs thorough post-incident analysis to identify root causes and implements preventive measures to minimize future incidents.
* Identifies opportunities for automation and drives the implementation of self-healing, monitoring, and deployment of automation tools and frameworks.
* Continuously improves operational efficiency, system reliability, and availability through process enhancements and automation.
* Ensures consistency across environments, tracks changes, and enforces configuration standards.
* Works closely with development teams, operations teams, and other stakeholders to ensure effective collaboration, knowledge sharing, and alignment on reliability goals.
* Implements security best practices, works with security teams to assess and address vulnerabilities, and ensures compliance with security standards and regulations.
* Performs any other related task as required.

**To thrive in this role, you need to have:**

* Seasoned technical expertise in Linux/Unix systems, networking, and system administration.
* Seasoned proficiency in scripting or programming languages, such as Python, Go, Java, or Ruby.
* Seasoned knowledge of cloud platforms (such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud) and associated services.
* Seasoned proven expertise in performance monitoring, optimization, and troubleshooting using tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, or New Relic.
* Seasoned expertise in incident management, root cause analysis, and post-incident reviews
* Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills, with a keen attention to detail.
* Excellent communication, collaboration, and leadership skills.
* Seasoned ability to optimize system performance, scalability, and reliability. experience with performance monitoring and tuning tools (for example, Prometheus, Grafana, or New Relic) to identify bottlenecks, analyze performance data, and implement optimization strategies.
* Seasoned understanding of security principles, best practices, and compliance requirements. experience in designing and implementing security controls, performing security assessments, and ensuring compliance with industry standards.

**Academic qualifications and certifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Relevant certifications, such as AWS Certified DevOps Engineer - Professional, Google Cloud Professional DevOps Engineer, or Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) preferred.

**Required experience:**

* Seasoned hands-on experience in a Site Reliability Engineering role or related roles, including experience in designing and maintaining highly available and scalable systems.
* Seasoned hands-on experience with Linux/Unix systems, networking, and system administration is crucial. In-depth knowledge of cloud platforms (such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud) and associated services is essential.
* Seasoned proficiency in multiple programming languages like Python, Java, Go, or Ruby is important for developing and maintaining automation tools, frameworks, and complex system integrations. Expertise in scripting languages like Bash or PowerShell is beneficial.
* Seasoned understanding of complex infrastructure architectures, including scalable and fault-tolerant designs. experience with infrastructure-as-code tools (such as Terraform or CloudFormation) and containerization technologies (such as Docker or Kubernetes) is essential.
* Seasoned experience in designing and implementing robust automation frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment strategies. Proficiency in tools like Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, or CircleCI to build, test, and deploy applications with a focus on reliability and scalability.
* Seasoned experience in incident management, troubleshooting complex system issues, and conducting post-incident analysis. Advanced ability to lead incident response efforts, drive root cause analysis, and implement preventive measures.
* Seasoned understanding of DevOps principles, Agile methodologies, and a strong commitment to continuous improvement and learning. experience in promoting a DevOps culture and driving the adoption of best practices

**Workplace type:**
Hybrid Working
  
  
**About NTT DATA**
NTT DATA is a $30+ billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune
  
  
Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through
  
  
responsible innovation. We are one of the world’s leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with
  
  
unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and
  
  
application services. Our consulting and industry solutions help organizations and society move
  
  
confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more
  
  
than 70 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as
  
  
established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each
  
  
year in R&D.

NTT DATA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer with a global culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment. We do not discriminate based on age, race, colour, gender, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, disability, pregnancy, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected category. Join our growing global team and accelerate your career with us. Apply today.

title: DevOps Engineer – Azure & AKS
description:
**Overview**
PepsiCo is seeking a highly motivated and skilled PepsiConnect DevOps Engineer to support and enhance our cloud-native platform capabilities. This role will be responsible for managing Azure infrastructure, source code repositories, CI/CD pipelines, Kubernetes (AKS) environments, and GitOps deployments using ArgoCD. The ideal candidate will play a key role in ensuring secure, scalable, reliable, and cost-effective platform operations while enabling rapid application delivery through automation and DevOps best practices.
  
  
The position will collaborate closely with development, architecture, security, and operations teams to drive infrastructure modernization, platform standardization, operational excellence, and continuous improvement across the PepsiConnect ecosystem. This role is critical in strengthening internal DevOps capabilities and reducing reliance on external vendors while supporting business-critical digital initiatives.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design, implement, and maintain Azure cloud infrastructure to support PepsiConnect applications and services.
* Manage source code repositories, branching strategies, access controls, and release processes using Azure DevOps and Git-based platforms.
* Develop, maintain, and optimize CI/CD pipelines to enable secure and automated application deployments.
* Deploy, administer, and support Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) clusters across development, testing, and production environments.
* Implement and manage GitOps deployment practices using ArgoCD to ensure reliable and auditable releases.
* Develop Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions using Terraform, ARM, or Bicep templates to automate infrastructure provisioning.
* Monitor platform health, performance, and availability using cloud-native monitoring and logging tools.
* Troubleshoot and resolve infrastructure, deployment, and platform-related issues to ensure operational stability.
* Drive cloud governance, security compliance, vulnerability remediation, and operational best practices.
* Analyze Azure resource utilization and implement cost optimization initiatives to improve cloud efficiency.
* Collaborate with development, architecture, security, and operations teams to support application delivery and platform modernization.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, deployment standards, and operational procedures.
* Support incident management, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Promote DevOps best practices, automation, and operational excellence across the organization.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* 7+ years of experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, Infrastructure Operations, or Platform Engineering.
* 3+ years of hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure cloud services.
* 2+ years of experience managing and supporting Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
* Strong experience with Azure DevOps, Git repositories, branching strategies, and release management.
* Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines for application and infrastructure deployments.
* Hands-on experience with ArgoCD and GitOps deployment methodologies.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, ARM Templates, or Bicep).
* Strong scripting and automation skills using PowerShell, Bash, or Python.
* Experience with monitoring, logging, and observability tools.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Knowledge of cloud security, governance, and compliance best practices.
* Experience with Azure networking, Application Gateway, Key Vault, and monitoring services.
* Experience in cloud cost management and optimization.
* Familiarity with Agile, DevOps, and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices.
* Relevant Azure, Kubernetes, or DevOps certifications are a plus.

Key Competencies
  
  

* Strong ownership and accountability.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a global environment.
* Strong analytical and decision-making abilities.
* Focus on automation, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.

title: Associate Manager - Cloud and Devops Engineer
description:

This role involves building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, automating operational processes, supporting Kubernetes-based workloads, enhancing platform reliability, and driving continuous improvements across cloud and DevOps ecosystems. **Responsibilities**

* Deploy, manage, and optimize cloud infrastructure on AWS and Azure using Terraform and Infrastructure-as-Code best practices.
* Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve incidents related to cloud infrastructure and platform services.
* Design, develop, and maintain CI/CD pipelines to support application build, test, and deployment workflows.
* Manage containerized workloads using Kubernetes and related technologies such as Helm, ArgoCD, and Flux.
* Develop automation and tooling using Python, Bash, or other programming languages to improve operational efficiency.
* Configure monitoring and alerting solutions and participate in incident response and root cause analysis.
* Ensure CI/CD pipelines remain reliable, secure, and continuously optimized.
* Integrate and support Jira workflows, automation, and tooling that improve engineering productivity.
* Evaluate, onboard, and integrate third-party SaaS solutions into existing environments.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, operational runbooks, disaster recovery plans, and standard operating procedures.
* Collaborate with development, security, and infrastructure teams to implement scalable and secure platform solutions.
* Support cloud governance, compliance, and cloud security posture management initiatives.

Required Qualifications
  
  

* 2+ years of experience working with AWS and/or Azure cloud platforms.
* Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), including module development and management.
* Experience with source control platforms such as Git, GitHub, or GitLab.
* Experience creating and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or similar tools.
* Experience deploying and managing Kubernetes workloads in production environments.
* Proficiency in scripting and automation using Bash, Python, or other object-oriented programming languages.
* Solid understanding of Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) and DevOps principles.
* Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Datadog, Splunk, Prometheus, or similar platforms.
* Basic database administration and SQL query experience with PostgreSQL, MySQL, or other relational databases.

* Experience with AWS services such as EKS, ECR, IAM, and VPC.
* Knowledge of Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) practices and security best practices.

* Experience supporting highly available, enterprise-scale cloud platforms.
* Knowledge of security scanning, compliance automation, and Infrastructure Security best practices.

: Hybrid work arrangement
  
  
***At AVEVA, we’re all about limitless possibilities. Are you?***
As part of the Research and Development function, the global Cloud Operations & Infrastructure team combines software development and cloud operations to provide continuous integration and delivery of cloud-enabled products and solutions, along with continuous monitoring to ensure various cloud-specific customer requirements/SLAs are met.
  
  
As a Cloud Operations Engineer you will play a pivotal role in designing, developing, and implementing advanced cloud-based applications and services. Your work will focus on pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in cloud computing, exploring new technologies, and developing innovative solutions that align with the company’s strategic goals.
  
  
Working closely with your development and portfolio colleagues, together you will bring new solutions to the cloud following a standard framework to ensure they are operationally secure, stable and scalable.
  
  
The global, 24x7 nature of the team means there may be a requirement for occasional work outside of the standard day and to be on call as part of a shared team rota.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Work on modern approaches to software development including the ability to develop microservices and leverage serverless functions.
* Work with development teams to advise and contribute to improvements to operational stability, security, cost management and reporting requirements for our cloud solutions.
* Continually develop and improve DevOps processes, adding value through optimization, automation, and effective reporting.
* Provide timely and effective response to incidents to minimize the impact on our customers and keep colleagues updated as required.
* Oversee relevant Cloud deployments to ensure successful implementation, track and report progress, resolve or escalate release issues.
* Proactively manage cloud environments to minimize service impacting issues, including infrastructure as code, certificates, storage, health status, backup status etc.
* Ensure new services meet required operational readiness standards before being accepted into operations.
* Ensure on-going compliance to security practices and policies.
* Provide subject matter expertise to business stakeholders as required.
* Maintain clear and accurate operational documentation.
* Stay current on security industry trends, tools and best practices.

**Essential Requirements**
The following list applies to Azure and/or AWS Platforms.
  
  

* Overall 7+ years of experience in Software Development with exposure to working on Cloud environments (AWS and/or Azure)
* Strong programming skills, e.g. C#, .NET Core or Java.
* Knowledge of PowerShell or Node JS or Python scripting.
* Proficient in containerization technologies like Docker or Kubernetes.
* Knowledge of API, REST, microservices, serverless architecture.
* Knowledge of Cloud Authentication protocols such as OAuth, Identity Servers, OpenID Connect and SAML etc…
* Knowledge of Azure administration, Azure APIs, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, APIO Management, Service Bus, Event Grids, Storage Accounts and Key Vaults and tools. Or, equivalent AWS experience.
* Knowledge and experience of operational support, software development and deployment methodologies and principles.
* Strong written, verbal and presentation skills, able to convey information clearly and concisely to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Attention to detail, diligent and tenacious.
* Excellent analysis and dissemination skills.
* High degree of personal motivation and ability to self-manage.
* Maintains and develops relevant industry and technology knowledge.

**Desired Skills And Competencies**

* Certifications in Azure and/or AWS.
* Hands-on experience working within an Information Security accredited framework e.g. ISO27001, 27017/18.
* Experience working in Agile software development such as Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe).

**R&D at AVEVA**
Our global team of 2000+ developers work on an incredibly diverse portfolio of over 75 industrial automation and engineering products, which cover everything from data management to 3D design. AI and cloud are at the center of our strategy, and we have over 150 patents to our name.
  
  
Our track record of innovation is no fluke – it’s the result of a structured and deliberate focus on learning, collaboration and inclusivity. If you want to build applications that solve big problems, join us.

Job Description Summary

* Experience working within Agile software delivery teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Azure, AWS, Cloudflare, Akamai, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or Jenkins.

* Git & source control
* Datadog, New Relic, Splunk

Professional Competencies
  
  
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills; collaborative mindset; exceptional organizational abilities; proactive ownership of production systems; effective communication across technical and business stakeholders; continuous improvement mindset.
  
  
What Success Looks Like in the First 12 Months
  
  

* Establish a stable, scalable, and well-documented platform foundation.
* Improve deployment automation and release reliability.
* Strengthen monitoring, observability, and operational readiness.
* Become the technical owner for platform integrations and production operations.
* Help define and execute the technical migration strategy for Optimizely DXP.

Our IMPACT Values

* Embrace a Growth Mindset

Workplace Flexibility
  
  
This position is based in India and operates remotely while collaborating closely with global teams across India and the United States.

**The Experience**
Salesforce Technical Consultants deliver solutions that transform our customers' businesses and their customers' experiences. In the Life Sciences vertical, this role involves partnering with project teams and client stakeholders to discover, design, code, and deploy specialized Salesforce Platform and Industry solutions (including Life Sciences Cloud and Health Cloud) tailored for pharmaceutical, biotech, medtech, and healthcare organizations.
  
  
Approximately 70–75% of this role involves hands-on programming and system integration using Apex, JavaScript, Lightning Web Components (LWC), OmniStudio, and REST/SOAP APIs, while ensuring compliance with stringent regulatory standards.
  
  
The ideal technical consultant is a demonstrated practitioner and emerging thought leader who bridges deep Salesforce development capabilities with domain understanding of regulated industries. You will evaluate implementation options, build scalable architectures, guide client technical teams, proactively manage risk areas, and commit to seeing complex engineering challenges through to resolution.
  
  
**What You'll Actually Be Doing**

* Hands-on Development & Customization: Code enterprise-grade solutions using Salesforce Apex, JavaScript, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and modern web frameworks integrated with middleware and core Life Sciences backend systems.
* Domain & Regulatory Solutioning: Implement Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud, Health Cloud, and OmniStudio features that comply with strict industry regulatory and security frameworks (e.g., HIPAA, GxP, PHI).
* AI-First Workflow Execution: Champion an AI-first development workflow by leveraging advanced AI developer tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate custom Apex, LWC, and integration delivery while maintaining platform governor limits and security compliance.
* Architecture & Data Modeling: Define and build secure, scalable data models (1:M, M:M relationships), sharing rules, security models, and object structures optimized for Life Sciences and Healthcare workflows.
* Integrations & Interoperability: Build, optimize, and document API-based integrations connecting Salesforce to enterprise platforms, EHR/EMR systems, and middleware standard tools (utilizing HL7/FHIR standards where applicable).
* Technical Leadership & Workshops: Facilitate functional and technical workshops, review user stories, map end-to-end user journeys, and apply modern Apex and UI design patterns to solve complex business requirements.
* Delivery & Best Practices: Adhere to Salesforce Services development best practices, participate in DevOps/release management workflows, and drive high Customer Satisfaction (CSAT) scores.
* Travel: Travel to client sites as required by engagement scope (average of 50%, varying based on project needs).

**You're Our Person If...**

* Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent.
* 5+ years of technology development experience, with 3+ years in client-facing consulting or system implementation roles.
* Strong object-oriented programming experience (Apex, Java, C#, or Python) alongside fluent JavaScript, HTML/CSS, and web component engineering.
* Proven hands-on experience designing data models, custom logic, and platform integrations on the Salesforce ecosystem.
* Foundational domain awareness of Pharmaceuticals, Biotechnology, Medical Devices, or Healthcare Providers, including exposure to compliance constraints (HIPAA, GxP, PHI).
* Experience with API integrations (REST, SOAP, JSON, XML) and system security protocols.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze complex requirements, design adaptable technical solutions, and work independently as a self-starter.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with client facilitation experience.

**Even Better If...**

* Salesforce Product Expertise: Prior development experience with Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud, Health Cloud, OmniStudio framework, or Veeva CRM.
* Healthcare Interoperability: Experience with healthcare data standards and protocols such as HL7 and FHIR.
* Certifications: Highly beneficial to hold existing Salesforce certifications upon joining. Success in this role includes acquiring core certifications within the onboarding phase:Salesforce Certified AdministratorSalesforce Certified Platform App BuilderSalesforce Certified Platform Developer ISalesforce Certified JavaScript Developer ISalesforce Health Cloud Accredited / OmniStudio Developer (Bonus)
* DevOps & Integration Skills: Experience with CI/CD tools, version control (Git), automated testing frameworks, and middleware platforms (e.g., MuleSoft).
* AI Tooling Fluency: Practical experience using AI coding assistants to optimize daily development velocity, document custom code, and automate repetitive engineering tasks.

ATTRIBUTES
  
  

* Consultative Leader: Ability to clearly communicate the business and technical value of Salesforce platform features to both business stakeholders and client engineering teams.
* Results-Driven: Tenacious and focused on delivering high-quality, maintainable code in fast-paced environments.
* Adaptable Learner: Quick to master emerging platform updates, regulatory guidelines, and AI development techniques.
* Collaborative & Positive: Solves complex multi-system challenges with a constructive, solution-oriented mindset that motivates team members.

Unleash Your Potential
  
  
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
*be your best*
, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
*do your best*
. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.
  
  
Accommodations
  
  
If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.
  
  
Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.
  
  
Posting Statement
  
  
Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Golang & React)
description:
**About The Opportunity**

We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced
**Senior Software Engineer**
to join our team and lead the design, development, and continuous improvement of scalable, high-performance commerce applications.

In this role, you will primarily focus on backend engineering, building and maintaining the systems that support wholesale and retail operations, including purchase orders, transfer orders, inventory management, warehouse operations, vendor order processing, data processing, and internal business applications.

You will take
**end-to-end ownership**
of complex technical solutions, working across system architecture, application development, APIs, integrations, cloud infrastructure, production support, and operational reliability. You will collaborate closely with Product, Business Operations, Platform, Security, Data, and Support teams to deliver secure, scalable, and reliable solutions.

As a senior technical contributor, you will also help drive architectural decisions, establish engineering best practices, mentor other developers, and contribute to application modernization initiatives.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on engineer with
**7+ years of professional software engineering experience**
, strong expertise in
**Golang, React, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, and AWS**
, and a solid background in distributed systems, microservices, cloud-native architectures, and production reliability.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead technical discovery, architecture discussions, and solution design for complex, cross-functional engineering initiatives.
* Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable backend applications, APIs, microservices, and integrations using Golang.
* Build and enhance internal web applications using React and TypeScript.
* Develop reliable solutions supporting purchase orders, transfer orders, inventory management, warehouse operations, shipments, and vendor integrations.
* Design and implement scalable data-processing workflows, including batch processing and asynchronous, event-driven pipelines.
* Build and maintain cloud-native applications using AWS services, including ECS/EKS, Lambda, S3, RDS, SQS/SNS, and EventBridge.
* Design, optimize, and maintain relational database structures using PostgreSQL, including schema design, query optimization, partitioning, replication, and migrations.
* Define and implement application modernization strategies, including platform refactoring, schema migrations, API versioning, and backward compatibility.
* Apply distributed systems principles, microservices patterns, and domain-driven design to build reliable and extensible applications.
* Develop and optimize high-performance, low-latency applications, implementing caching, concurrency management, and rate-limiting strategies.
* Establish engineering best practices, coding standards, and scalable architectural patterns across the team.
* Translate complex technical initiatives into actionable development tasks, technical specifications, and implementation plans.
* Mentor and support other engineers through technical guidance, design reviews, code reviews, and knowledge sharing.
* Take end-to-end ownership of technical solutions, from requirements analysis and system design through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing production support.
* Build and improve observability, monitoring, alerting, distributed tracing, deployment health checks, and release validation processes.
* Troubleshoot complex production issues using application logs, metrics, distributed traces, and data analysis, performing root-cause analysis and implementing long-term solutions.
* Contribute to infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD practices using Terraform and GitHub Actions, supporting safe deployment strategies such as blue-green deployments, canary releases, feature flags, and rollback mechanisms.
* Identify and remediate application security vulnerabilities, dependency issues, authorization gaps, and CI/CD security risks.
* Participate in production support rotations and assist with time-sensitive operational escalations.
* Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to communicate architectural decisions, technical trade-offs, and implementation strategies.
* Explore and apply AI-assisted development tools to improve engineering productivity, software quality, testing, and code reviews.

**Required Qualifications**

* 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong track record of delivering production-ready applications and independently owning complex technical solutions.
* Strong hands-on experience with Golang for backend development, APIs, microservices, and system integrations.
* Solid experience with React and TypeScript for developing and maintaining internal web applications.
* Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL or similar relational databases, such as MySQL or AWS RDS/Aurora, including schema design, query optimization, partitioning, replication, and database migrations.
* Strong practical experience with AWS cloud services in production environments, including compute (ECS/EKS, Lambda), storage (S3), managed databases (RDS), messaging services (SQS/SNS, EventBridge), load balancing, and CDN.
* Solid understanding of distributed systems, microservices, event-driven architectures, domain-driven design, and cloud-native design patterns.
* Experience designing and developing RESTful APIs, service contracts, API versioning strategies, and scalable system integrations.
* Experience building batch processing workflows, asynchronous data pipelines, and event-driven applications in production environments.
* Strong understanding of application performance optimization, including caching strategies (e.g., Redis), rate limiting, and concurrency management.
* Experience implementing observability and reliability practices, including monitoring, alerting, distributed tracing, SLAs/SLOs, and disaster recovery.
* Strong production troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills, with the ability to investigate complex system issues and implement sustainable solutions.
* Solid understanding of secure software development practices, including dependency management, authentication and authorization, secrets handling, and CI/CD security hardening.
* Experience with modern CI/CD workflows, automated testing, and reliable software deployment practices.
* Proficiency with AI-powered development tools, such as GitHub Copilot or ChatGPT, and an understanding of LLM integration patterns.
* Strong experience contributing to system architecture, technical design decisions, and application modernization initiatives.
* Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers, conduct technical reviews, and promote engineering best practices.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and technical decision-making skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts and architectural trade-offs to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with Product, Business Operations, Platform, Security, Data, and Support teams.
* Ability to independently manage ambiguous technical challenges and deliver high-quality solutions in complex production environments.

**Nice To Have Skills**

* Experience developing applications supporting retail, wholesale, e-commerce, inventory management, or supply chain operations.
* Familiarity with purchase order management, transfer orders, warehouse operations, or vendor order processing.
* Experience with Terraform for infrastructure provisioning and infrastructure-as-code.
* Hands-on experience with GitHub Actions and advanced CI/CD automation.
* Experience implementing deployment strategies such as blue-green deployments, canary releases, feature flags, and automated rollbacks.
* Experience leading large-scale application modernization, legacy system refactoring, and database migration initiatives.
* Familiarity with advanced AWS architecture, high-availability systems, and disaster recovery strategies.
* Experience establishing observability standards and improving production reliability across distributed systems.
* Experience integrating AI-enabled capabilities or LLM-based solutions into software engineering workflows.
* Previous experience serving as a technical mentor or contributing to architectural standards across engineering teams.

*Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.*

title: Engineering Leader – Digital Experience & Portals
description:
**About Chubb**

Chubb is a world leader in insurance. With operations in 54 countries and territories, Chubb provides commercial and personal property and casualty insurance, personal accident and supplemental health insurance, reinsurance and life insurance to a diverse group of clients. The company is defined by its extensive product and service offerings, broad distribution capabilities, exceptional financial strength and local operations globally. Parent company Chubb Limited is listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: CB) and is a component of the S&P 500 index. Chubb employs approximately 40,000 people worldwide. Additional information can be found at: www.chubb.com.

**About Chubb India**

At Chubb India, we are on an exciting journey of digital transformation driven by a commitment to engineering excellence and analytics. We are proud to share that we have been officially certified as a Great Place to Work for the third consecutive year, a reflection of the culture at Chubb where we believe in fostering an environment where everyone can thrive, innovate, and grow.

With a team of over 2500 talented professionals, we encourage a start-up mindset that promotes collaboration, diverse perspectives, and a solution-driven attitude. We are dedicated to building expertise in engineering, analytics, and automation, empowering our teams to excel in a dynamic digital landscape.

We offer an environment where you will be part of an organization that is dedicated to solving real-world challenges in the insurance industry. Together, we will work to shape the future through innovation and continuous learning.

**Position Details**

**Job Title:**
Engineering Manager – Digital Experience & Portals

**Function / Department:**
Technology

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Location:**
Hyderabad / Bangalore

**Reports To:**
Head of Digital Engineering – NA CI

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an Engineering Manager who owns the Experience Pillar — the layer of technology that customers, agents, and partners see and touch. You will unify Chubb's portal applications across distribution, policy servicing, and digital channels, bringing consistency, speed, and AI-enhanced experiences to every interaction point. This is not a role for someone who manages backlogs from a distance. You lead from the front: you understand the frontend stack, you have opinions on API design, and you have shipped portal products that real users depend on at scale. Candidates from eCommerce, Retail, Banking, and Insurtech environments are strongly encouraged to apply.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and grow a team of engineers building digital portal applications and API-backed experience platforms serving customers, agents, and distribution partners.
* Define and own the engineering roadmap for the Experience Pillar, consolidating portal applications into a unified, scalable, and consistent architecture.
* Drive AI-native development practices across the team — AI-assisted coding, intelligent test generation, automated code review, and agentic developer workflows as standard practice.
* Architect and deliver API-first, mobile-ready portal experiences across web and partner-integrated channels.
* Establish and maintain engineering standards for frontend, BFF (Backend for Frontend), and API gateway layers.
* Partner with Product Managers, UX Designers, and Solution Architects to translate experience requirements into delivered, high-quality features.
* Own sprint quality, release velocity, and technical debt trade-offs across the pillar.
* Embed DevSecOps practices — CI/CD pipelines, security scanning, performance observability — as default engineering behaviour.
* Hire, develop, and retain engineering talent; build a high-trust, high-accountability team culture with psychological safety.
* Contribute to the Chubb India Digital engineering brand as a visible, credible technical leader.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Strong engineering background in portal and web application development — React, Angular, or equivalent modern frontend stacks, paired with strong API and microservices experience.
* Experience with API design, BFF patterns, and API gateway platforms supporting multi-channel digital experiences.
* Demonstrated AI tool adoption: you have embedded GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude, or equivalent coding assistants into team workflows — not piloted them once.
* Track record of delivering digital portal products in eCommerce, Retail, Banking, or Insurtech environments at meaningful scale.
* Cloud-native development experience (Azure or AWS); containerization, microservices, and API-first patterns.
* 3+ years of engineering leadership experience in agile, high-delivery environments; able to read code, review PRs, and engage technically.
* Insurance or financial services domain exposure is advantageous but not a gate.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent.
* 18+ years in software engineering, with at least 3 years leading engineering teams in a delivery-focused environment.
* Strong AI tooling adoption and digital product delivery track record — depth of outcome carries more weight than years alone.

**Why Join Us?**

* Be at the forefront of digital transformation in the insurance industry.
* Lead impactful initiatives that drive engineering excellence and customer outcomes.
* Work alongside experienced professionals in a collaborative, innovation-driven environment.

**Why Chubb?**

Join Chubb to be part of a leading global insurance company! Our constant focus on employee experience along with a start-up-like culture empowers you to achieve impactful results.

* Industry leader: Chubb is a world leader in the insurance industry, powered by underwriting and engineering excellence
* A Great Place to work: Chubb India has been recognized as a Great Place to Work for the years 2023-2024, 2024-2025 and 2025-2026
* Laser focus on excellence: At Chubb we pride ourselves on our culture of greatness where excellence is a mindset and a way of being. We constantly seek new and innovative ways to excel at work and deliver outstanding results
* Start-Up Culture: Embracing the spirit of a start-up, our focus on speed and agility enables us to respond swiftly to market requirements, while a culture of ownership empowers employees to drive results that matter
* Growth and success: As we continue to grow, we are steadfast in our commitment to provide our employees with the best work experience, enabling them to advance their careers in a conducive environment

**Employee Benefits**

Our company offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support our employees' health, well-being, and professional growth. Employees enjoy flexible work options, generous paid time off, and robust health coverage, including treatment for dental and vision related requirements. We invest in the future of our employees through continuous learning opportunities and career advancement programs, while fostering a supportive and inclusive work environment. Our benefits include:

* Savings and Investment plans: We provide specialized benefits like Corporate NPS (National Pension Scheme), Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP), Long-Term Incentive Plan (LTIP), Retiral Benefits and Car Lease that help employees optimally plan their finances
* Upskilling and career growth opportunities: With a focus on continuous learning, we offer customized programs that support upskilling like Education Reimbursement Programs, Certification programs and access to global learning programs.

title: iCare Connect Engineer
description:
**About The Job**
We are an innovative global healthcare company, driven by one purpose: we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives. Our team, across some 100 countries, is dedicated to transforming the practice of medicine by working to turn the impossible into the possible. We provide potentially life-changing treatment options and life-saving vaccine protection to millions of people globally, while putting sustainability and social responsibility at the center of our ambitions.
  
  
Sanofi’s Digital organization’s mission is to transform Sanofi into a data-first and AI first organization by empowering everyone with good data. Through custom developed AI products built on world class data foundations and platforms, the team builds value and a unique competitive advantage that scales across our markets, R&D and manufacturing sites. The team is located in major hubs in Paris, Lyon, Barcelona, Cambridge, Bridgewater and most recently, Toronto, with the aim of opening a new office in Hyderabad. Join a dynamic, fast paced and talented team, with world class mentorship, using AI to chase the miracle of science
  
  
**About Growing With Us**
In this role you will
  
  

* Play a critical role in managing, supporting the iCare Salesforce Health Cloud Platform.
* Accountable for delivering Digital Patient Services Products and Solutions assisting Sanofi Patient Services functions.
* Leverages specialized, functional expertise for solving complex functional problems as individual or as team member.
* Leads and executes functional and technical expertise all along the lifecycle (plan, design, build, run) of Digital Patient Services leveraging Salesforce Health Cloud and managed packages.
* Provide solution guidance for highly complex business processes, regulatory (HIPAA, Data Privacy, GxP, etc.), compliance and cybersecurity processes. S/he will leverage the Digital portfolio, catalog of services, existing platforms as well as integrate new industry standards to define and implement the Patient Services products and services.

**About You**

* Lead the design of Patient Support Services (PSS) solutions for large programs, products, and projects.
* Acts as Authority and subject matter expert owing standards and practices related to Patient Services functional expertise in Salesforce.
* Work with team and fellow Engineers to track and align on solution built as part of different streams in the Program.
* Work as part of the Agile teams on large programs, governing, shaping the delivery of projects supporting design, architecture, enhancements, with focus on optimizing business processes, finding business and technical alignments across multiple therapeutic areas where possible.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the design of Patient Support Services (PSS) solutions for large programs, products, and projects.
* Acts as Authority and subject matter expert owing standards and practices related to Patient Services functional expertise in Salesforce.
* Work with team and fellow Engineers to track and align on solution built as part of different streams in the Program.
* Work as part of the Agile teams on large programs, governing, shaping the delivery of projects supporting design, architecture, enhancements, with focus on optimizing business processes, finding business and technical alignments across multiple therapeutic areas where possible.
* Development & Customizations: Develop & review the complex solutions using Apex, LWC, Visualforce, triggers, flows & Omni Components and standard Salesforce features.
* Code reviews: Act as the health cloud expert, providing technical guidance, making technical decisions, and enforcing best practices.
* Build and maintain integrations using REST/SOAP APIs, Platform Events, Streaming APIs, and middleware (IICS, AWS API GW, etc.).
* Work with architects to define integration patterns and data flow designs.
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Work with business analysts and stakeholders to gather, refine, and translate requirements into technical solutions.
* Integration: Build and maintain integrations with third-party systems using APIs and web services.
* Quality & Performance: Conduct code reviews, unit testing, debugging, and ensure security, scalability, and data quality.
* Maintain unit test coverage (≥75%) and ensure reliable CI/CD deployments.
* Work with version control tools (Git) and DevOps platforms (Copado, Gearset, Azure DevOps, Jenkins).
* Mentorship: Guide and mentor junior developers on the team.
* System Support & Enhancements: Troubleshoot production issues, identify root causes, and implement fixes.
* Optimize performance, improve existing automations, and refactor legacy components.
* Stay updated on Salesforce releases and recommend improvements.

**Essential Skills & Qualifications**

* Salesforce Expertise: Strong knowledge of Health Cloud features, data models (patient/insurance), and core Salesforce.
* Technical Skills: Proficiency in Apex, LWC, Visualforce, Salesforce APIs, Triggers, Flow builder, OmniStudio and platform security.
* Healthcare Domain Knowledge: Understanding of provider/payer processes, US healthcare ecosystem, and compliance.
* Soft Skills: Excellent communication, problem-solving, leadership, and stakeholder management.
* Certifications: Salesforce Certified Developer I & II, Salesforce Health Cloud Certification

***Job Specific Skills, Competencies & Pruriency***

* Salesforce Technologies: Advanced
* Life Sciences/Patient Support Services expertise: Intermediate
* Application Design & Integration: Intermediate
* DevOps: Intermediate
* Compliance of computerized systems: Intermediate
* Lean & Agile practices: Intermediate
* Business Acumen: Intermediate
* Problem Solving: Intermediate

Location: Hyderabad, India (Hybrid)
  
  
Department: Product Development
  
  
Job Req ID: 1630
  
  
**About GHX**
GHX (Global Healthcare Exchange) is a leading healthcare technology company on a mission to simplify the business of healthcare and improve patient outcomes. Founded in 2000, GHX has built the GHX Global Network — the world’s largest cloud-based supply chain community connecting healthcare providers, suppliers, distributors, and partners to automate key processes, reduce costs, and increase operational efficiency. Its solutions span electronic trading, procurement automation, inventory and contract management, business intelligence, and data synchronization, helping healthcare organizations improve productivity and focus more on patient care. Over the years, GHX has enabled significant cost savings for the industry and continues to innovate with intelligent automation and AI-driven capabilities.
  
  
Website: https://www.ghx.com/
  
  
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/ghx/

GHX’s trading platform handles millions of documents to facilitate business transactions between healthcare providers, suppliers, and trading partners. The Exchange Engineering team is seeking a seasoned Senior Software Engineer to strengthen its Hyderabad team. You will design, develop, and scale the platform that supports millions of transactions, working across the stack in
**Java, Spring Boot and Angular**
, and using
**AI coding tools and agents**
as a core part of how you build and operate.
  
  
Principal Duties and Responsibilities
  
  

* Define, design, and develop components using Java, Spring Boot, Angular and AWS Cloud.
* Implement all aspects of development, including database, presentation, middle tier, and system interfaces.
* Collaborate with architects, Systems Engineering, Product Management, and other technical and non-technical stakeholders throughout the product development lifecycle.
* Formulate and communicate technical vision and strategy to business and technical stakeholders.

title: Associate Software Engineer
description:
At New Relic, we shape the future of intelligent observability, building technology that helps companies understand and optimize their complex systems. We are a collaborative, global team that values curiosity, mutual support, and solving hard technical challenges together. As we grow, we are looking for thoughtful problem-solvers ready to make a real impact.
  
  
That open, forward-thinking approach extends to how we hire. We actively work with modern AI tools every day and support candidates using them to prepare for interviews. To keep our process authentic and fair, please review our Candidate AI Interview Guide to see our general guidelines, including where AI is encouraged and what practices are prohibited before you apply.
  
  
Your opportunity
  
  
At New Relic, we provide our customers real-time insights, so they can innovate faster. Our software delivers insightful observability tools across different technologies and distributed systems, enabling software engineering teams to quickly identify, understand and tackle issues, analyze performance, and get the most out of their software and infrastructure.
  
  
If you are a curious, driven engineer eager to learn and make an impact from day one, apply now for the position of Associate Software Engineer at New Relic.
  
  
At New Relic, you will learn and contribute to our massive-scale streaming data platform that powers our industry-leading observability ingestion pipelines. Join us in our mission to revolutionize observability alongside a team of experienced engineers who are passionate about mentorship and technical growth.
  
  
What you'll do
  
  

* Build real-time data pipelines: Design and develop streaming pipelines that capture database changes (inserts, updates, deletes) from PostgreSQL and MySQL and deliver them to Apache Kafka using Apache Flink. This includes joining, filtering, and transforming the data along the way.

* Operate production systems: Deploy, monitor, and troubleshoot high-volume pipelines running on AWS, Docker, and Kubernetes. Build dashboards and alerts, and take part in an on-call rotation.
* Collaborate and learn: Join design discussions, code reviews, and agile ceremonies. Work closely with partner engineering teams to understand their data needs.
* Write and improve unit and integration tests to help maintain service reliability.
* Continuously learn from senior engineers, internal resources, and the broader engineering community.

This role requires
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or international equivalent), or equivalent practical experience
* 1 to 2 years of software engineering experience. Internships and substantial project work count.
* Strong programming fundamentals in Java, or another object-oriented language such as Kotlin, Scala, Go, or Python
* Solid grasp of data structures, algorithms, and problem solving
* Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL
* Familiarity with Git, unit testing, and the Linux command line
* Curiosity about how large-scale backend and data systems work, and eagerness to learn quickly
* Clear communication and a collaborative, ownership-driven attitude

Good to have skills
  
  

* Exposure to streaming or messaging systems such as Apache Kafka, Apache Flink, Spark Streaming, Kafka Connect, or Debezium
* Understanding of change data capture, database replication logs (WAL/binlog), or ETL pipelines
* Familiarity with serialization formats such as Protobuf, Avro, or JSON Schema
* Hands-on experience with AWS (for example S3 or IAM), Docker, or Kubernetes
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and observability (metrics, logging, alerting, dashboards)
* Open-source contributions, hackathon projects, or personal projects involving distributed systems or data processing

Bonus points if you have
  
  

* Academic projects, internships, or personal work involving backend services, data pipelines, or system-level programming.
* Familiarity with the MELT stack (Metrics, Events, Logs, Traces) or observability concepts.
* Contributions to open-source projects or a public portfolio of technical work (GitHub, etc.).
* Competitive programming background or strong algorithmic problem-solving track record.

title: Associate Director Software Engineer
description:
**Overview**
Founded in 1988, Trimont (www.trimont.com) is a specialized global commercial real estate loan services provider and partner for lenders and investors seeking the infrastructure and capabilities needed to help them scale their business and make informed, effective decisions related to the deployment, management and administration of commercial real estate secured credit. As the largest master servicer of commercial real estate loans in the United States, Trimont manages securitizations with meticulous oversight and coordination—protecting cash flows, mitigating risk, and ensuring portfolio performance.
  
  
TriVinna, a Trimont company, is rebuilding commercial real estate lending software from the ground up. For decades, CRE lenders have run trillion-dollar portfolios on fragmented legacy systems, disconnected spreadsheets, and manual re-keying of borrower financials, rent rolls, and loan events. Leveraging Trimont’s access to approximately 11% of all U.S. commercial real estate lending data and nearly four decades of servicing expertise, we are building an AI-native platform that captures loan data at the source, unifies it across the full loan lifecycle, and turns it into decisions lenders can act on.
  
  
TriVinna is an innovative firm where visionary professionals come to learn, grow, and thrive with colleagues driven by curiosity and collaboration.
  
  

* Learn: We believe ongoing learning is critical and are focused on providing a work environment where all team members can take ownership of their careers.
* Grow: We work alongside the largest institutional lenders in the world, overseeing the most significant projects in the industry. This unique opportunity allows us to broaden our skillset and develop our abilities by tackling some of the industry’s most challenging and exciting endeavors.
* Thrive: Our firm is a place where ethics and excellence meet to create an experience that matches our capabilities. There are no limits to what we as team members and as an organization, can achieve together.

*Where people, purpose, and progress come together every day.*
**Job Summary**
TriVinna is seeking a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to build and harden the multi-service .NET platform behind our commercial loan review and servicing software, the products that are replacing the legacy tools CRE lenders have relied on for decades.
  
  
We build differently. Work is scoped into small, well-defined tasks with clear time estimates, and a coding agent writes most of the code. Your job is to pair deep knowledge of the system with sharp judgment about what the agent produced, and to deliver on time. You will own each task end to end, from migration to API to UI to tests, usually in a single pull request.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**What you’ll work on**

* Backend: .NET services with EF Core on SQL Server, handlers and validators, DTOs and mapping, service-to-service clients, and background jobs.
* Authentication and authorization: SSO, session tokens, roles, permissions, grants, scopes, and organization and sub-organization data isolation.
* Frontend: React and TypeScript screens built on those APIs.
* Tests: unit tests with mocks, in-memory tests where they are enough, and real SQL Server tests where they are not.

**Examples of tasks you’d own end to end**

* Gate every action on a controller by permission code, and mask a sensitive field unless the user holds the right permission.
* Make a unique constraint work with soft-deleted rows: migration, application check, and a real-database test.
* Add cross-service validation, so one service refuses an invalid request with a clear error before writing anything.
* Strengthen sign-in and session flows against common attack patterns.
* Add server-side sort and filter to a list, with the matching UI.
* Add tests for existing handlers, including tests that run against a real SQL Server.

**Working within the system**

* Build against architecture, access-model, and product decisions owned by platform and product leadership.
* When the code shows a decision won’t work, challenge it with evidence: the call sites, the failing case, and the cost.

**Required Qualifications**

* 8-15 years of professional software engineering, including 6+ years in full-stack web development and 5+ years with .NET and C# in production.
* Real delivery experience with coding agents: you can describe where an agent went wrong and how you caught it.
* Hands-on fluency with AI coding tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or Cursor: giving them the right context, steering them through multi-step changes, and reviewing their output with the same rigor as a colleague's pull request.

**Expert (you could teach it)**

* NET Core Web API: controllers, authorization attributes and policies, middleware, and global exception handling (or another language's equivalent).
* Request-handler patterns (MediatR or similar), FluentValidation, Mapster or AutoMapper, DTO design, and API contract changes (or another language's equivalent).
* EF Core and SQL Server data behavior: migrations and snapshots, global query filters, soft deletes, filtered unique indexes, concurrency tokens, translation limits, bulk operations, transactions with retrying execution strategies, indexes, backfills, stored procedures, and row-level security.
* Role-based access: users, roles, permission codes, grants, scopes, how claims in a token gate endpoints and rows, and multi-tenant isolation.

**Strong (you do it independently)**

* xUnit-style testing: handler tests, controller and attribute tests, reflection tests, and real-database integration tests.
* OAuth 2.0, OIDC, and SAML basics: identity providers, token validation and claims, access and refresh tokens, session lifetime, and revocation.
* HTTP clients between services, service authentication, idempotency, dependency injection, configuration, logging and retry policies, and shared libraries (and when not to copy them).
* PII handling and audit logging.

**Working knowledge (you deliver, with some lookup)**

* React and TypeScript: hooks, forms, error handling, and component tests.
* Outbox and background-worker patterns.
* Azure (Entra, API Management policies), SCIM, and CI/CD for .NET services.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with full-stack ASP.NET web dev specifically.
* Experience in commercial real estate lending or servicing.
* Experience working in a codebase with several services.

**How We Work**
**With agents**

* You use a coding agent to write most of the code and tests, and you treat the output as a draft.
* You know how you would write it yourself, so you catch wrong assumptions, missed call sites, and tests that pass for the wrong reason.
* You augment and enforce architectural decision records (ADRs) and catch drift even after working features are produced.
* You give the agent the right context, review every diff, and run the change in the app.
* You never paste secrets or customer data into a tool.

**With the team**

* You read the whole picture before starting, and ask questions until you understand how the pieces fit together.
* You challenge an estimate up front, with specifics, rather than discovering the gap at the end.
* You raise a blocker or a slipping deadline the day you see it, in writing, with what is blocked, what you tried, and what you need.
* You build the unblocked part of a gated task and surface the decision that blocks the rest.
* You write pull request descriptions that a reviewer can follow.

**Why This Role**
Commercial real estate lending is one of the largest asset classes in the world, and it still runs on software built for a different era. This is a rare chance to build the products that replace it, backed by the data, client relationships, and operational expertise of the largest master servicer in the United States.
  
  

* Shape the category. Ship the loan review and servicing software that sets a new standard for CRE lenders.
* Work at the frontier. Deliver in one of the most advanced AI-assisted engineering practices in financial services.
* Own real outcomes. Take each change from database to screen, and see it in the hands of lenders.
* Work with the industry’s leaders. Your work will support some of the largest institutional lenders and investors in commercial real estate.

Trimont and TriVinna are equal opportunity employers, and we’re proud to support and celebrate diversity in the workplace. If you have a disability and need an accommodation or assistance with the application process and/or using our website, please contact us. We are proud to maintain a drug-free policy, ensuring that our community is a secure and productive space for all our team members.

Full-Time

Principal

* Set architecture standards for agent orchestration, tool/function calling, and inter-agent communication across the platform.
* Define and govern integration standards, including MCP (Model Context Protocol) and RESTful APIs, for connecting agents to internal and external enterprise systems.
* Architect scalable vector search and retrieval infrastructure to support Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) across the platform.
* AI & Agentic Systems:
* Architect and champion AI-powered applications leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) and Generative AI technologies across the platform.
* Define the technical strategy for intelligent workflows using Agentic AI frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar technologies.
* Design and guide the implementation of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions using vector databases and enterprise knowledge sources.
* Set best practices for prompt design, structured outputs, tool/function calling workflows, and AI orchestration pipelines.
* Lead the development of AI copilots, research assistants, recommendation engines, chatbots, workflow automation, and NLP-driven capabilities.
* Drive the design of multi-agent systems, agent orchestration, and autonomous workflow execution across the organization.

* Partner with upstream and downstream application teams and stakeholders to embed agentic AI capabilities across the platform's architecture, integration patterns, and data flow.
* Lead the integration of agentic AI and LLM-powered capabilities into the JAGGAER Analytics platform and related reporting experiences.
* Define the technical strategy for surfacing AI-generated insights through the Tableau Reporting Platform and other reporting services.
* Engineering Excellence & Leadership:
* Establish observability, evaluation, and performance monitoring standards to continuously improve AI system quality.
* Champion AI system performance, scalability, reliability, and security as core architectural tenets, including guardrails for safe and responsible agent behavior.
* Elevate engineering standards through rigorous architecture reviews, testing practices, and mentorship of engineers at all levels.
* Serve as a key technical voice across globally distributed Product Management, Engineering, Professional Services, and Customer Success teams, influencing roadmap and strategy.

**Position Requirements**

* 10+ years of experience in software development with deep expertise in Java and/or Python, including significant experience in technical leadership or architect roles.
* Proven track record architecting and delivering enterprise applications using Spring Boot, REST APIs, and Microservices architecture at scale.
* Strong experience building and guiding frontend applications using React.js and modern JavaScript frameworks.
* Deep understanding of software engineering principles, object-oriented design, data structures, algorithms, and enterprise architecture patterns.
* Extensive experience with Oracle and PostgreSQL databases, including advanced SQL, schema design, and performance optimization at scale.
* Demonstrated expertise in API integrations, enterprise system connectivity, and distributed application architectures.
* Hands-on experience with Generative AI concepts and a track record of integrating LLM-powered capabilities into production applications.
* Strong working knowledge of Agentic AI concepts, AI orchestration, prompt engineering, tool calling, and structured outputs.
* Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers, lead technical initiatives, and influence architectural decisions across teams.
* Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and debugging skills, with sound judgment on technical trade-offs.
* Ability to communicate clearly and persuasively in English, both verbally and in writing, including to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent; advanced degree a plus.

**Nice-to-Haves**

* Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar Agentic AI frameworks.
* Experience building AI-powered applications using Large Language Models (LLMs).
* Experience implementing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems.
* Familiarity with vector databases such as Pinecone, ChromaDB, Weaviate, or similar technologies.
* Knowledge of multi-agent systems, workflow automation, and AI evaluation techniques.
* Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) integrations.
* Experience building AI copilots, autonomous agents, deep research assistants, chatbots, workflow automation systems, or AI-powered SaaS products.
* Familiarity with AI observability, monitoring, and evaluation platforms.
* Knowledge of AWS cloud services, DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, and Kubernetes.
* Experience working with Snowflake and modern data platforms.
* Knowledge of SonarQube and application quality management practices.
* Familiarity with Data Source Manager (DSM) concepts, configuration, and integration within analytics and reporting ecosystems.
* Exposure to procurement, analytics, reporting, business intelligence, or enterprise SaaS platforms.
* Experience leading architecture reviews, technical design documents (RFCs), or engineering guilds.

Contributions to open-source projects, technical publications, or conference presentations in AI/ML or software engineering.
  
  
**What We Offer**
At JAGGAER, we are committed to supporting you and your family’s well-being. Your health is a priority, and we offer a range of programs to help you stay well and thrive. Our benefits include Health, Accidental Insurance, and Term Life.
  
  
**Why JAGGAER?:**
Shape the technical direction of an AI-native procurement platform used by organizations managing complex, global supply chains.
  
  
Work at the frontier of Agentic AI, LLMs, and enterprise-scale software architecture.
  
  
Collaborate with world-class engineering, product, and AI talent in a fast-paced, impact-driven culture.
  
  
Enjoy flexibility, purpose-driven work, and competitive compensation.
  
  
**Our Values - T.E.A.M**

Our products are built on intellectual property, but the real differentiator is the teams behind them – the way we collaborate, innovate, solve problems and deliver for customers. description:
