**The Team:**
**The Opportunity:**
**Job Description**
**What Your Impact Will Be:**
We are seeking an experienced Oracle ERP Developer who will play a critical role in the design, development, customization, and implementation of Oracle ERP systems (e.g., Oracle E-Business Suite, Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, or Oracle NetSuite) to meet organizational business requirements. This role involves working closely with business analysts, functional consultants, project managers, and stakeholders to deliver scalable, efficient, and robust ERP solutions. The developer will be responsible for creating custom solutions, integrating systems, and ensuring the ERP platform supports end-to-end business processes during implementation projects. This role requires close collaboration with onshore teams and stakeholders to ensure seamless integration and delivery of technical solutions. The candidate must be willing to work on site 4 days a week in Hyderabad, during US EST time zone.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
ERP System Development and Customization
  
  

* Design, develop, and customize Oracle ERP modules (e.g., Financials, Supply Chain, Procurement, HRMS, or Manufacturing) to align with business requirements.
* Hands-on expertise in Oracle Product Hub (PDH), Master Data Management (MDM) and SCM implementations. The ideal candidate will possess strong technical skills in Oracle Fusion applications, data conversion, integrations, extensions, and product master data governance processes.
* Develop custom forms, reports, interfaces, workflows, and extensions using Oracle tools such as PL/SQL, Oracle Forms, Oracle Reports, OAF (Oracle Application Framework), and APEX.
* Create and modify Oracle ERP APIs, web services, and integrations to support seamless data flow between Oracle ERP and third-party systems.
* Build and enhance Oracle Fusion Middleware components, including SOA, BPEL, and ADF, for Oracle Cloud ERP implementations.

ERP Implementation Support
  
  

* Collaborate with functional consultants to translate business requirements into technical specifications for ERP implementation.
* Participate in all phases of the ERP implementation lifecycle, including requirements gathering, design, development, testing, deployment, and post-go-live support.
* Configure and customize Oracle ERP modules to support business processes, ensuring alignment with organizational goals.
* Assist in data migration activities, including data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) using tools like Oracle Data Integrator (ODI) or FBDI (File-Based Data Import).

Integration and Middleware Development
  
  

* Develop and maintain integrations between Oracle ERP and external systems (e.g., CRM, HCM, or legacy applications) using Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), REST/SOAP APIs, or other middleware platforms.
* Ensure data integrity, security, and performance in all integrations and data flows.
* Troubleshoot and resolve integration issues during implementation and post-go-live phases.

Testing and Quality Assurance
  
  

* Perform unit testing, system integration testing (SIT), and support user acceptance testing (UAT) to ensure solutions meet functional and technical requirements.
* Debug and resolve issues identified during testing phases, ensuring high-quality deliverables.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, including design specifications, test scripts, and user guides.

Performance Optimization and Maintenance
  
  

* Optimize Oracle ERP applications for performance, scalability, and reliability during and after implementation.
* Monitor system performance and implement tuning strategies for database queries, reports, and workflows.
* Provide ongoing support for production issues, bug fixes, and enhancements post-implementation.

Collaboration and Stakeholder Engagement
  
  

* Work closely with cross-functional teams, including business analysts, functional consultants, DBAs, and project managers, to ensure successful ERP implementation.
* Communicate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders, providing clarity on solutions and timelines.
* Participate in project planning, status meetings, and go-live activities, ensuring timely delivery of milestones.

Compliance and Security
  
  

* Ensure all development activities adhere to organizational policies, industry standards, and regulatory requirements (e.g., SOX, GDPR).
* Implement security best practices in Oracle ERP solutions, including role-based access control (RBAC) and data encryption
* Communication  Facilitate effective communication between offshore and onshore teams, ensuring transparency and alignment on project status, risks, and issues.
* Problem Solving  Proactively identify and resolve technical and operational challenges to ensure smooth project execution.
* Stakeholder Management  Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, providing regular updates and addressing any concerns or requirements.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Education Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* Experience
* 6+ years of experience in Oracle ERP development, with at least 2 years focused on ERP implementation projects.
* Hands-on experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP.

title: Principal Software Engineer - AI
description:
**Job Description**
About the Role We are looking for a skilled Principal Software Engineer - AI to design and build Generative AI applications that solve real business problems. This is a Gen AI–first role: your primary work will be developing LLM-powered systems using frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, and Hugging Face, with RAG pipelines, vector search, and prompt engineering at the core of what you do. Our architecture separates AI services from the user-facing application. Your primary focus is owning the AI services end-to-end — from model integration and inference pipelines through to production deployment. This split lets you go deep on AI while still maintaining visibility into how your work ships to customers. You will collaborate with product managers, engineers, and business stakeholders to deliver AI features that create measurable value.
  
  
**Experiences And Skills**

* 8–12 years of professional software development experience, with at least 1–2 years focused on Generative AI or LLM application development.
* Hands-on production experience building LLM-powered applications using LangChain and/or LangGraph.
* Practical experience with Hugging Face — using pre-trained models, the Transformers library, or the Inference API.
* Working knowledge of RAG architectures, vector databases (e.g. Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector, or MongoDB Atlas Vector Search), and embedding techniques.
* Strong Python skills — writing clean, well-tested, and maintainable code, ideally with experience in FastAPI or similar API frameworks.
* Working proficiency in the MEAN stack: MongoDB, Express.js, Angular (17+), and Node.js.
* Experience designing and consuming REST APIs; familiarity with GraphQL is expected for this role.
* Comfortable using Git and working within modern CI/CD workflows.
* Clear communicator who works effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Job Responsibilities**
**Generative AI Development (Primary Focus) -**

* Design, develop, and maintain LLM-powered application features using Python and frameworks such as LangChain and LangGraph.
* Build and maintain Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines — including chunking, embedding, retrieval, and re-ranking strategies.
* Integrate Hugging Face models and APIs for text generation, classification, embeddings, and semantic understanding tasks.
* Develop and tune prompt engineering strategies, manage LLM context, and ensure reliable, production-grade outputs.
* Build agentic workflows using LangGraph — orchestrating tool use, multi-step reasoning, and stateful agent behaviour.
* Expose AI capabilities through clean Python APIs (e.g. FastAPI) that the MEAN application can consume.
* Apply responsible AI principles, ensuring solutions are fair, explainable, and aligned with organisational and regulatory standards.
* Evaluate and recommend emerging Generative AI tools, models, and frameworks that add tangible value to the product.
* Contribute to the MEAN application (MongoDB, Express.js, Angular, Node.js), with a focus on integrating AI services into the product experience.

**Engineering Excellence -**

* You will also collaborate on the user-facing application — touching Node.js APIs, MongoDB, and Angular where needed to integrate AI capabilities — but the depth of ownership sits with the Python AI services.
* Participate in code reviews to uphold quality and share knowledge across the team.
* Troubleshoot and debug issues across the stack — from LLM response quality and retrieval accuracy to API performance and UI integration.
* Contribute clear technical documentation for AI services, APIs, and integration points.
* Work within agile/scrum delivery practices, collaborating closely with product managers and fellow engineers.

title: Software Engineer Junior
description:
Role summary
  
  
The Software Engineer Junior builds and runs the data pipelines behind Goodyear Mobility Cloud (GMC). GMC collects tire pressure and vehicle telematics data from connected devices on fleets in North America and EMEA, tens of millions of messages a month. The data lands in a data lake, and data models take it through bronze, silver and gold layers for GMC alerts, internal reporting, and data science. You will learn the platform alongside the engineers who built it and take on more of its day-to-day running as you go.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Build and maintain dbt models in Snowflake across the bronze, silver and gold layers
* Add new data sources and event types end to end: Snowpipe ingestion from S3, raw tables, dbt models, tests and the Airflow DAG that runs them
* Write and maintain Airflow DAGs, with retries, timeouts and failure alerts
* Handle schema changes when a device provider adds or renames fields in its JSON payloads
* Write dbt tests and reconciliation checks that catch missing or bad data before it reaches the gold tables
* Run backfills, and trace data issues such as late payloads or stale metadata back to their cause
* Tune queries and warehouse sizing to control Snowflake cost
* Manage Snowflake objects, roles and access in Terraform
* Build and support Python APIs and reports in DataOps, GMC's internal reporting tool, which reads from Snowflake and Redshift
* Write runbooks and documentation for the pipelines you work on
* Agree with the teams that use a table what each field means and how fresh the data needs to be
* Use AI coding assistants, and review and test what they produce before it ships

**Requirements**
Mandatory
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, data science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 2 years of professional experience
* SQL beyond the basics: joins, aggregations, window functions and CTEs
* Python for scripts and small services, including packages, virtual environments and tests with pytest
* Experience with a cloud data warehouse such as Snowflake, Redshift or Databricks, from work, school or your own projects
* Data modeling basics: facts and dimensions, keys, incremental loads, and reruns that do not duplicate data
* Working knowledge of Git, pull requests and code review
* Understanding of how a data pipeline fits together, from ingestion through transformation, scheduling and testing, and how a failure in one step shows up downstream
* Comfortable at a Linux command line
* The habit of asking questions early, writing down what you learn, and keeping a distributed team informed of progress and blockers
* Experience with AI coding assistants, including reviewing and testing what they generate

Nice to have
  
  

* dbt models, tests, macros and incremental models
* Snowflake: Snowpipe, stages, roles, warehouses and the query profile
* Semi-structured data in SQL, such as JSON in Snowflake VARIANT columns
* Apache Airflow, including running dbt from Airflow
* Terraform or another infrastructure-as-code tool
* AWS: S3, IAM, Lambda and EKS
* Docker and Kubernetes
* IoT, telematics or time-series data
* Apache Superset or another BI tool
* React or TypeScript
* Apache Iceberg or data contracts
* Python tooling such as Ruff, uv and mypy or pyright

Goodyear is one of the world's largest tire companies. It employs about 63,000 people and manufactures its products in 48 facilities in 19 countries around the world. Its two Innovation Centers in Akron, Ohio, and Colmar-Berg, Luxembourg, strive to develop state-of-the-art products and services that set the technology and performance standard for the industry. For more information about Goodyear and its products, go to www.goodyear.com/corporate

title: Senior Software Engineer - Security >
description:
Role Overview
  
  
Application
  
  
**About The Company**
At Redpin we
**simplify life's most important payments.**
Buying a new property overseas can be a stressful time, especially when it comes to moving your money. Through our Currencies Direct and TorFX brands we've been helping people do just that for over 25 years. With recent investment we're now on a mission to build a new range of digital products and services that will make moving money Internationally for Real Estate purchases even easier
  
  
**We’re on a mission to become the solution for Real Estate payments everywhere**
. To do this, we are transitioning our business from a horizontal FX platform to a verticalized, embedded software company, as we look to the future and Redpin 2.0.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a
**Senior Security Engineer**
to lead and scale our
**cloud and application security practices**
. This role is critical in designing secure architectures, implementing best-in-class security controls, and proactively defending against modern threats—especially in a
**cloud-native and AI-augmented environment**
.
  
  
You will collaborate closely with Security & Compliance, DevOps, SRE, Platform, and Engineering teams to embed security across the SDLC. You'll also play a strategic role in shaping our security roadmap, ensuring alignment with regulatory requirements and evolving risks.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
**Cloud & Infrastructure Security**

* Design and enforce cloud security architecture across AWS/Azure/GCP
* Develop guardrails via Policy-as-Code (OPA, Sentinel, SCPs, etc.)
* Implement cloud posture management tools (e.g., Wiz, CrowdStrike, Prisma Cloud, CSPM)

**Application Security**

* Lead secure coding practices, code reviews, and SDLC integration (SAST, DAST, SCA)
* Threat modeling and risk assessments for new and existing applications
* Automate AppSec testing within CI/CD pipelines

**AI & Modern Threats**

* Define security strategy and guardrails for AI-based platforms and tools
* Ensure protection of AI model integrity, prompt injection risks, and data exposure
* Collaborate on ethical AI usage and compliance with AI-related standards

**Security Governance & Compliance**

* Support compliance initiatives: SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, etc.
* Develop policies, procedures, and risk controls aligned to regulatory needs
* Work with internal audit and legal to ensure ongoing compliance readiness

**Security Enablement & Monitoring**

* Build and refine security dashboards, alerts, and KPIs
* Collaborate with DevOps/SRE to ensure observability and response readiness
* Conduct security incident analysis and root cause investigations

**What You’ll Need**

* 8+ years in cybersecurity roles, with 5+ years in cloud and application security

**Strong Understanding Of**

* Cloud-native architectures (Kubernetes, containers, serverless)
* Identity and access management (IAM), secrets management
* Modern DevSecOps practices

**Experience With**

* Cloud platforms (AWS/GCP)
* Security tools: OPA, Terraform Sentinel, HashiCorp Vault, Snyk, ZAP, etc.
* IaC and CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitLab, Jenkins, GitHub Actions)
* Familiarity with AI security risks and safe deployment patterns
* Strong grasp of security frameworks and standards (NIST, CIS, OWASP, ISO)

**Bonus Points**

* Certifications: CISSP, CCSP, OSCP, GCP/AWS Security Specialist, or similar
* Experience with Policy-as-Code frameworks and security automation
* Exposure to AI/ML systems, LLMs, or model governance concepts
* Experience building security programs from scratch or scaling across orgs

We welcome people from all backgrounds who seek the opportunity to help build a future where we connect the dots for international property payments. If you have the curiosity, passion, and collaborative spirit, work with us, and let’s move the world of PropTech forward, together.
  
  
Redpin, Currencies Direct and TorFX are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, colour, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.

description:

This is for Life Correspondence team Ideal candidate will have the experience with Java as well as Quadient. Understanding of correspondence architecture, rules, and document generation tools such as ODM and Quadient/Inspire is a plus. Familiarity with OIPA and related Life platform
  
  
**Job Description Summary**
If you’re enthusiastic about delivering secure technology solutions to support a company providing extraordinary care to its customers, then Nationwide Technology is the place for you. Nationwide's industry-leading technology workforce embraces an agile work environment and a collaborative culture to deliver outstanding solutions and results. If that sounds like something you aspire to, we want to hear from you!
  
  
As a Tech Lead, you will focus on mentoring and leading others to deliver high-quality, cost-effective technology solutions by providing technical leadership, setting engineering direction and creating clear accountability for product and application health across delivery teams. You will translate business goals into technical strategy, strengthen engineering quality, manage technical debt and operational risk, and improve continuity and coordination across teams while remaining grounded in firsthand engineering practices. You’ll also guide the evaluation and practical use of emerging technologies to improve delivery effectiveness, resiliency, and long-term product sustainability.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Provides technical direction and leadership for product development and oversees architecture and design decisions to support scalability, performance and long-term product health.
* Responsible for applying secure software and systems engineering practices throughout the delivery lifecycle to ensure data and technology solutions are protected from threats and vulnerabilities.
* Mentors and trains team members on design techniques, tools, coding standards and engineering best practices.
* Provides strategic advice on using technology to achieve business and product goals and helps align product development with customer needs and desired outcomes.
* Translates product and business priorities into technical strategy, solution direction and execution guardrails for the team.
* Maintains end-to-end technical ownership for assigned products or applications and drives accountability for architecture, engineering execution, operational health and long-term sustainability.
* Applies a product mindset by aligning technical strategy, sequencing and tradeoff decisions to long-term product roadmaps, customer needs and business outcomes.
* Strengthens knowledge continuity by building institutional knowledge, promoting documentation and developing technical backup depth to reduce key-person dependency.
* Establishes accountability for application quality and technical health by driving visibility and action around code quality, testing, technical debt, vulnerabilities, currency and release readiness.
* Drives cross-collaboration and execution across multiple teams, including coordination with architects, Tech Consultants, Distinguished Engineers, product owners and the broader developer community.
* Partners with product, delivery and agile leaders to plan timelines, manage resource needs, track quarterly commitments and mitigate risks throughout the product lifecycle.
* Leads the team in implementing new features and enhancements and ensures timely delivery of high-quality software products.
* Establishes and reinforces robust software engineering practices, including code reviews, automated testing, consistent sprint execution and prompt resolution of technical issues and defects.
* Champions the use of DevSecOps practices, tooling and techniques and ensures continuous learning and improvement through ongoing training, practice and innovation.
* Establishes and reinforces engineering guardrails by ensuring design decisions, code changes, test approaches and production readiness align with security, quality, resiliency and supportability expectations.
* Evaluates and guides the practical use of emerging technologies, automation patterns and modern engineering approaches to improve delivery outcomes without weakening accountability or engineering discipline.
* Helps create clear technical ownership for applications, strengthens knowledge continuity and supports better management of technical debt, vulnerabilities, currency and release readiness, including empowered go/no-go input when appropriate.

**Qualifications & Experience**
May perform other responsibilities as assigned.
  
  
**Education**
Undergraduate studies in computer science, management information systems, mathematics, or related field are strongly preferred.
  
  
**Experience**
Eight or more years of experience in programming and systems design. Three years of experience in project management is preferred.
  
  
**Technical Skills**

* CI/CD
* Cloud Computing
* Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)
* Software Security
* Software Testing
* Systems Integration
* Technology Roadmap
* Vendor Management

**Soft Skills & Attributes**

* Persuasive communication and collaboration skills
* Analytical and problem-solving mindset
* Ability to work in agile and global environments
* Time management and prioritization

Firsthand technical leadership experience leading project teams and setting technical direction. Deep expertise in one programming language such as Java, C++, Python, JavaScript. Knowledge of software development lifecycle. Proven ability to tackle sophisticated business and development problems. Ability to thrive in a team environment. Insurance or financial services industry knowledge a plus.

title: Software Engineer, Senior B Performance Engineering
description:
**Senior Software Performance Engineer**
*6+ Years Experience | PAX India*
**About The Role**
Help scale the performance engineering discipline across Blackbaud — building the tooling, practices, and expertise that let dev and ops teams do their own performance analysis, while staying hands-on enough to solve the hardest problems yourself and mentor others.
  
  
Our core stack is Kubernetes/Azure-based microservices, though you'll occasionally support older, more monolithic systems too — the core skills (profiling, load testing, root-cause analysis) transfer directly.
  
  
This is a hands-on coding role: most of your time goes to building and maintaining our load/synthetic test tooling (including AI-assisted testing) and integrating it into our SDLC. The rest is split between observability tooling and ad hoc performance analysis, with strong ownership of latency, throughput, and resource efficiency.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
Load & Synthetic Test Tooling
  
  

* Build and maintain our synthetic/load-testing framework — test development (Playwright/Gatling), execution, and reporting.
* Apply AI capabilities to improve test development — AI-assisted authoring, scenario generation, result analysis.
* Integrate performance and synthetic tests into CI/CD pipelines so checks run continuously, not just ad hoc.

Observability & Ad Hoc Performance Analysis
  
  

* Improve observability tooling (Splunk, Grafana, Honeycomb, App Insights, AppDynamics, New Relic): dashboards, alerting, SLIs/SLOs, instrumentation.
* Run load, stress, and soak tests to catch bottlenecks before production; profile CPU, memory, GC, I/O, and network in C#/.NET and/or Java services.
* Troubleshoot production performance issues (latency regressions, resource exhaustion, throttling) and tune resource usage in Kubernetes/AKS (requests/limits, autoscaling, kubectl diagnostics).

Ongoing
  
  

* Build self-serve performance capabilities (dashboards, guardrails, docs) so teams can diagnose issues without escalating.
* Design and maintain C#/.NET and/or Java microservices with a focus on performance and scalability.
* Collaborate via Agile/GitHub workflows and mentor junior engineers on profiling and troubleshooting.

What You'll Bring
  
  

* 6+ years of software engineering experience with meaningful exposure to performance, scalability, or reliability engineering.
* Strong C#/.NET and/or Java skills, plus strong Azure experience.
* Solid grasp of how compute resources (CPU, memory, I/O, network) drive performance/scalability, including tuning in containerized environments.
* Hands-on experience with a load-testing tool (k6, JMeter, Locust, Gatling) and a browser-automation tool for synthetic/end-to-end testing (Selenium, Cypress, Playwright).
* Experience with profiling tools (dotnet-trace, PerfView, App Insights profiler) and observability/APM tooling (Splunk, Grafana, Honeycomb, AppDynamics, New Relic).
* Some experience applying AI/LLM tools to dev workflows (AI-assisted coding, test generation, analysis).
* Experience integrating tooling/tests into CI/CD (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions) and troubleshooting production performance issues.
* Working knowledge of Linux fundamentals and networking basics (DNS, TLS, routing) as they relate to performance.
* Experience with Agile/GitHub, strong documentation and communication skills, and comfort working across time zones.

You'll Thrive in This Role If You
  
  

* Are self-motivated and comfortable driving your own investigations without step-by-step direction.
* Have systemic curiosity — you want to understand how a system behaves end-to-end, and think across layers from application code down through infrastructure and database.
* Question assumptions and keep digging until you find the actual root cause, not just the first plausible explanation.

Nice to Have
  
  

* Gatling or Playwright experience specifically.
* AKS experience (cluster ops, node pools, scaling) with a performance/capacity lens.
* Front-end development experience using Angular/TypeScript.
* Database-layer performance troubleshooting (query plans, indexing, stored procedure tuning).
* Familiarity with distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry), capacity planning and cost/performance trade-off analysis.

description:

We expect to grow sizably in the coming 3-5 years, adding various dimensions to our business and multiplying and increasing the current team size multi-fold.

**About Cyber**

BDO India cyber security practice is one of the fastest growing areas of the business with significant ambition for the future through additional recruitment and acquisition. As part of our cyber team / tech risk you will be managing teams and projects delivering advisory and technical support to help our clients to improve their information / cyber security posture and respond to the dynamic nature of technology risks / cyber security threats. You will provide security domain expertise and utilise your business insight to work closely with our clients to advise, design, build and deploy pragmatic security solutions that will provide real and tangible benefits to protect their organisations. Furthermore, often carryout out IT Risk Assessments in line with industry better practices (NIST / ISF / Cloud Security / etc.), regulatory mandates (RBI / IRDAI), and various compliance standards focusing on data security, data privacy, etc.

**Role:**

Support Vulnerability Management (VM) engagements for Banking and Enterprise clients by performing vulnerability assessments, managing the vulnerability lifecycle, analyzing security findings, prioritizing remediation efforts, tracking risk treatment activities, and delivering cybersecurity assessment outcomes. Collaborate with infrastructure, application, cloud, and security teams to strengthen vulnerability management programs and improve organizational security posture.

**Experience Requirements:**

* 3 to 5 years of hands-on experience in Vulnerability Management, Security Consulting, Infrastructure Security, or Cyber Defense environments.
* Experience performing vulnerability assessments, vulnerability analysis, remediation tracking, and closure validation activities.
* Experience working with vulnerability management platforms such as Qualys VMDR, Tenable.io, Tenable.sc, or equivalent solutions.
* Experience interpreting CVE advisories, CVSS scores, vulnerability risk ratings, and vendor security bulletins.
* Experience coordinating remediation activities with infrastructure, application, cloud, database, and business stakeholders.
* Experience tracking vulnerability remediation SLAs and supporting risk-based prioritization initiatives.
* Familiarity with External Attack Surface Management (EASM) concepts and exposure monitoring activities.
* Experience working with ticketing platforms such as ServiceNow, Remedy, or equivalent ITSM solutions.
* Exposure to cloud vulnerability management within Azure, AWS, and GCP environments is preferred.
* Experience supporting vulnerability governance, exception management, risk acceptance processes, and management reporting.

**Responsibilities:**

* Support the end-to-end vulnerability lifecycle, including identification, assessment, prioritization, remediation, validation, exception management, and reporting.
* Coordinate vulnerability assessment activities across on-premises, cloud, network, and application environments.
* Monitor vulnerability scanning operations, including scan execution, scanner health, authentication, and performance.
* Analyze vulnerability findings, validate results, and perform risk-based prioritization using CVSS, threat intelligence, asset criticality, and business impact.
* Track remediation activities and collaborate with asset owners to ensure timely closure of vulnerabilities within defined SLAs.
* Manage vulnerability remediation, exception, and risk acceptance workflows through approved governance processes.
* Support remediation validation and re-scan activities to confirm effective closure of security findings.
* Analyze security advisories, vendor bulletins, and emerging threats to identify affected assets and remediation requirements.
* Review and track External Attack Surface Management (EASM) findings and coordinate remediation of identified exposures.
* Prepare vulnerability metrics, dashboards, and reports while contributing to continuous improvement of vulnerability management processes.

**Key Technical Skills:**

* Strong understanding of the vulnerability management lifecycle, including discovery, assessment, prioritization, remediation, validation, exception handling, and reporting.
* Knowledge of vulnerabilities, CVEs, CVSS scoring, exploitability assessment, patch management, and risk treatment methodologies.
* Hands-on experience with vulnerability assessment and exposure management platforms.
* Understanding of network security fundamentals including TCP/IP, DNS, firewalls, routing, switching, web technologies, and common network services.
* Familiarity with Windows, Linux, databases, Active Directory, virtualization technologies, and cloud environments.
* Understanding of cloud security vulnerabilities and misconfigurations across Azure, AWS, and GCP environments.
* Experience with ITSM platforms, ticketing workflows, asset management processes, and CMDB integrations.
* Ability to analyze technical findings, identify remediation actions, and communicate security risks to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Experience working with reporting tools, dashboards, spreadsheets, and vulnerability management metrics.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, reporting, and stakeholder communication skills.

**Certifications:**

**Preferred:**

* Qualys VMDR
* Qualys Certified Specialist
* Tenable Certified Associate
* Tenable Certified Operator
* CompTIA Security+
* SC-200

**Good to Have:**

* CEH
* Rapid7 Certified Specialist
* GSEC

title: Cyber Security / SOC /Senior Consultant Specialist
description:
Some careers shine brighter than others.
  
  
If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
  
  
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Senior Consultant Specalist
  
  
Why HSBC
  
  
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world’s most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do.
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
This role sits in Global Cybersecurity Operations (GCO) where we detect and respond to information and cybersecurity threats across HSBC’s global technology estate. As a senior member of the Monitoring and Threat Detection team you’ll triage threat detection events and help shape rapid identification and escalation of potential incidents. You’ll partner closely with Threat Detection, Incident Management and Threat Hunting teams to strengthen investigation depth and improve outcomes. The work combines hands-on investigation with continuous improvement through post-incident reviews, new detection use cases and automation opportunities. Success means faster and more consistent triage, clearer escalation and stronger detection coverage informed by real attacker behaviour. You’ll also help build capability across the team through mentoring and technical guidance.
  
  
What you'll be doing
  
  

* Oversee triage of threat detection events across HSBC’s global technology estate within an Analysis POD
* Partner with Threat Detection and Incident Management teams to support rapid identification and escalation of potential threats
* Support incident response actions by providing subject matter expertise and depth of investigation
* Participate in Purple Team and threat simulation activity to assess and validate detection capability
* Collaborate with Threat Hunters on hypothesis-driven threat hunting and advanced data analysis
* Apply structured analytical techniques to ensure consistent investigation and triage decisions
* Contribute to post-incident reviews to capture improvements and strengthen detection posture over time
* Own new SIEM detection use cases end-to-end including testing, triage documentation and training needs
* Identify automation and orchestration opportunities to reduce repetitive manual tasks across operations

What we're looking for
  
  

* Bring substantial experience investigating cyber security events using modern monitoring and detection technologies
* Demonstrate proven capability using SIEM platforms for collection and real-time analysis of security information
* Apply deep knowledge of attacker tactics, techniques and procedures to improve controls and detection outcomes, Use EDR tooling for triage, investigation and threat hunting across enterprise environments
* Interpret threat intelligence and Indicators of Attack to strengthen detection and defence against similar threats
* Work effectively with incident response tools, techniques and processes for containment, mitigation and remediation
* Use security frameworks and standards such as MITRE ATT&CK, OWASP, ISO2700x, PCI DSS, CIS and NIST to inform investigation and detection
* Apply strong knowledge of operating systems, endpoint platforms and core network protocols to support technical analysis
* Create or improve automation using SOAR platforms or equivalent demonstrable experience, Hold CEH, OSCP, EnCE, SANS GSEC, GCIH, GCIA and/or CISSP or equivalent certification or bring equivalent demonstrable experience

Strengthening Global Threat Detection
  
  
If you want your work to directly improve how a global bank detects and responds to cyber threats this role offers real scope and responsibility. You’ll operate at the heart of HSBC’s monitoring and threat detection capability with close links to incident management and threat hunting. The focus is on high-quality triage, clear escalation and continual improvement of detection coverage. Bring your expertise in investigation, SIEM and EDR and help raise capability across the team through coaching and technical direction. Apply to help protect HSBC’s technology estate and the customers and colleagues who rely on it every day.
  
  
You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

Data Engineering — Snowflake

Cloud & Platform Engineering — AWS

* Python and Snowpark for data processing, automation, APIs, reusable frameworks, testing utilities, and operational scripts.
* Advanced SQL for complex transformations, reconciliation, performance tuning, and analytical validation.
* Reusable libraries, templates, and automation patterns that improve engineering productivity.

Orchestration, DevOps & Observability
  
  

* Airflow or equivalent orchestration for dependency management, scheduling, monitoring, retries, and recovery.

* Architecture trade-off analysis across performance, scalability, maintainability, cost, security, and business value.

* UAT coordination, defect triage, and quality-risk escalation.
* GitHub branching, pull request standards, CI checks, and quality gates.

Data Governance & Controls
  
  

* PII classification, access controls, least privilege, auditability, and lineage.
* Business glossary, definitions, controls documentation, and evidence.

Cloud certifications in AWS or Snowflake, such as SnowPro Core or Advanced, are preferred. Contributions to communities of practice, domain academies, engineering forums, product mindset conversations, or reusable knowledge repositories are valued.

We are looking for a skilled Data Engineer who can design, develop and maintain scalable data pipelines and infrastructure to support data-driven applications and business operations. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in data processing, database management, ETL development and cloud-based data platforms.

You will work closely with data analysts, data scientists, backend developers and other technical teams to ensure that data is collected, processed, stored and made available efficiently and reliably.

* Design, develop and maintain scalable data pipelines and ETL/ELT workflows.
* Extract, transform and load data from multiple sources into data warehouses and storage systems.
* Develop and optimise data processing workflows using Python, SQL and relevant data engineering tools.
* Build and maintain data integration solutions for structured and unstructured datasets.
* Work with relational and non-relational databases and cloud-based data platforms.
* Develop and manage data warehouses, data lakes and data models.
* Implement data validation, monitoring and quality checks to ensure data accuracy and consistency.
* Optimise data pipelines for performance, scalability and reliability.
* Collaborate with data analysts and data scientists to provide reliable datasets for reporting and analytics.
* Monitor pipeline performance, troubleshoot failures and resolve data processing issues.
* Maintain technical documentation and follow data engineering best practices.

**Required Skills and Experience**

* 2–6 years of hands-on experience in data engineering or related roles.

title: Lead Data Engineer(Elk)
description:
**About the role**

You will lead how security and technology data reaches our Elastic SIEM, using Abstract Security as the

data pipeline layer. Data arrives through APIs, SMTP, agents (OpenTelemetry, Elastic Agent), streams

(Kafka, Kinesis) and more, and you will make sure every source lands parsed, normalised and trusted.

You will work directly with the client, source owners and OEM vendors, bring industry best practice to

each onboarding, and lead a team of data engineers.

**Key responsibilities**

• Own end-to-end data onboarding: intake, source discovery, collection, parsing, normalisation,

validation, go-live and ongoing health

• Build and operate collection, routing, filtering, enrichment and forwarding pipelines in Abstract

Security that deliver data to Elastic

• Onboard data across every collection method: REST APIs and webhooks, SMTP/email feeds,

syslog, OpenTelemetry agents and Collector, Elastic Agent/Fleet and Beats, Kafka, AWS Kinesis

(Data Streams, Firehose), S3/SQS, Azure Event Hub and file-based sources

• Cover both security tools (EDR, firewalls, proxy/SWG, email security, IdP/IAM, CASB/DLP,

vulnerability scanners) and technology sources (cloud, OS, network, databases, SaaS, custom

applications)

• Parse varied formats (syslog, CEF, LEEF, JSON, XML, CSV, key-value, multiline) and handle

timestamps, time zones and malformed events

• Normalise data to Elastic Common Schema (ECS) as the primary model, while staying fluent in

other schemas such as OCSF, Splunk CIM or Google UDM; maintain field mappings and a data

dictionary

• Tune pipelines for throughput, latency, back-pressure, batching and parse efficiency; cut noise

and volume before ingest to control cost

• Monitor data quality: parse-failure rates, missing fields, timestamp drift, ingest lag, dropped

events and volume anomalies

• Gather requirements from source owners, application teams, the SOC and detection engineers;

turn them into onboarding plans and drive them to closure

• Act as the client's point of contact for data onboarding: run working sessions, report status,

manage expectations and bring industry standards (log-source coverage, MITRE ATT&CK data-

source mapping, retention and compliance needs)

• Work closely with OEMs (Abstract Security, Elastic and security-tool vendors) to raise

reproducible cases and drive bugs and feature requests to a fix

• Lead and mentor the data engineering team; set parsing and schema standards, review

pipelines before go-live and keep runbooks current

**Must-have skills**

• 10–12 years in IT, with at least 5 years hands-on onboarding security and IT data into a SIEM or

log platform (Elastic preferred)

• Hands-on with a security data pipeline platform: Abstract Security preferred; Cribl, Logstash,

Vector, Fluent Bit/Fluentd, NiFi or Tenzir also count

• Extensive onboarding across APIs, SMTP, syslog, OpenTelemetry, Elastic Agent, Kafka and Kinesis

• Expert parsing: regex, grok, dissect, JSON/XML, multiline, timestamp and time-zone handling

• Deep ECS knowledge and practical schema adoption; working knowledge of at least one other

schema (OCSF, CIM, UDM)

• Pipeline performance tuning and troubleshooting at enterprise volumes

• Elastic data layer: ingest pipelines, index and component templates, mappings, data streams,

ILM, \_simulate

• Proven client-facing delivery and stakeholder management, with clear written and verbal

communication

• Direct experience escalating to and working with OEM vendors to get bugs fixed

• Scripting in Python or Bash; Git-based change control

• Experience leading or mentoring engineers

**Good to have**

• Elastic Certified Engineer; AWS or Azure certification

• Kafka and Kinesis administration (partitions, shards, consumer groups, lag)

• Security log semantics (Windows Security, Sysmon, EDR, firewall, IdP) and how detections use

them

• Terraform and CI/CD for pipelines as code

• Financial services or other regulated environments

• Data volume and licence-cost optimisation

**Qualifications**

* • B.E./B.Tech/MCA or equivalent in Computer Science or a related field

title: Ivalua L3 Consultant - Technical and Functional
description:
**About Proctel**

Proctel is a procurement services and solutions provider in Dubai and Hyderabad, certified to ISO 9001, ISO/IEC 27001 and ISO 18295. We help businesses improve procurement, operations and growth.

**Role overview**

We are hiring two Ivalua L3 certified consultants for a Source-to-Pay implementation that covers all licensed modules: one Technical Consultant and one Functional Consultant. Both are lead-level roles. You will review the work of L1 and L2 consultants, work closely with each other and with the client's procurement, finance and IT teams, and take the platform from design through go-live and hypercare.

**Opening 1: Ivalua L3 Technical Consultant**

* Own the technical solution architecture, data model extensions and environment set-up from development to production
* Configure modules and build scripts, rules and custom pages within Ivalua-supported extension points
* Design and build integrations with ERP, finance, HR, identity, tax and risk systems, e-signature and e-invoicing networks using APIs, files and middleware
* Set up single sign-on, role-based access, segregation of duties and audit trails
* Plan and run data migration for suppliers, contracts, catalogues, open POs and invoices, with reconciliation
* Lead performance tuning, upgrade impact analysis and L3 incident and problem management
* Write admin runbooks and train client administrators

**Opening 2: Ivalua L3 Functional Consultant**

* Run design workshops for each module, carry out fit-gap analysis and write the Functional Design Document for sign-off
* Design to-be processes, approval matrices and master data rules across supplier management, sourcing, contracts, procurement, invoicing and spend analysis
* Write configuration specifications and review the build with the technical consultant
* Write test scenarios and scripts, coordinate UAT and prioritise defects
* Validate migrated data and sign off reconciliation with data owners
* Train key users and administrators and build a super-user network
* Support go-live, hypercare and post-go-live KPI reviews

**Requirements for both openings**

* Valid Ivalua L3 certification matching the opening (technical or functional)
* 6+ years in Source-to-Pay, including 3+ years hands-on with Ivalua
* At least two full Ivalua implementations taken through go-live
* Clear written documentation and confidence leading client workshops

**Technical opening, in addition:** strong SQL and knowledge of the Ivalua data model, workflows, forms and rules; integration experience with SAP, Oracle or similar ERPs.

**Functional opening, in addition:** deep process knowledge across source-to-contract and procure-to-pay, including e-invoicing and tax requirements; experience in test design, training and change support.

**Location and joining**

Full-time, in person at our Hyderabad office (Peerzadiguda). We are looking for candidates who can join within 30 days.

**How to apply**

Apply on Indeed. In your application, state the opening you are applying for (Technical or Functional), your Ivalua certification and its validity date, and your notice period.

Proctel is an equal opportunity employer. We never charge candidates a fee at any stage of hiring.

description:
**About SkySpecs**

At SkySpecs, our mission is to simplify renewable asset management so less can do more for the planet. SkySpecs is helping to make this possible by automating the operations and maintenance of wind farms using advanced robotics paired with our custom-built asset performance management software, Horizon.

SkySpecs launched the world's first completely autonomous blade inspection product in 2016 with a custom-designed drone system. Since then, SkySpecs has inspected over 90% of the US wind turbines and expanded globally, becoming the world leader in understanding the health of turbine blades. Identifying issues with turbine blades is only the first step. In 2019, SkySpecs launched Horizon, a platform for SkySpecs to offer a multi-layered solution for customers that includes: data collection, wind turbine blade engineering expertise, and a place for all stakeholders to collaborate to manage and analyze massive amounts of data, spot trends, and create plans for high-cost repair campaigns. In 2021, SkySpecs acquired two companies specializing in wind turbine drivetrain monitoring and financial management, further expanding our asset management portfolio. Ultimately, this will help reduce the cost and risk of operations for the industry.

**What will I be getting myself into?**

SkySpecs will probably be unlike any place you've ever worked. The second you walk in the door (or log in, if you are remote), you will feel the high-energy environment filled with incredibly smart people solving hard problems. SkySpecs values collaboration, multidisciplinary problem-solving, and a mantra of ‘under-promise, over-deliver.' SkySpecs is in a critical growth phase, where there are endless opportunities to make a meaningful impact.

We are looking for a Blade Analyst to join our Inspection Analysis team. In this role, you'll have the rare opportunity to understand blades across the entire Wind Energy Industry. You'll collaborate with a team of Engineers and analysts worldwide to meet the growing demands of Inspections. title: Lead Engineer (Manager), Microsoft Power Platform
description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**

At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**Role Overview**

We are seeking an experienced Power Platform engineer to design and deliver complex enterprise solutions for clients while helping raise the technical capability of our broader Power Platform team.

This is a hands-on player coach role with significant client delivery responsibility. The Manager will remain deeply involved in solution architecture, software development, troubleshooting, implementation, technical reviews, and client discussions. This is not a primarily administrative or people management position.

The ideal candidate is a software engineer with deep Microsoft Power Platform expertise who can combine low code capabilities with custom development, enterprise architecture, and strong consulting skills.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Serve as a hands-on engineer and technical lead for complex client engagements involving Microsoft Power Platform.
* Design and build enterprise applications using Power Apps, Dataverse, Power Automate, and related Microsoft technologies.
* Develop custom solutions using C#/.NET, JavaScript or TypeScript, plugins, custom APIs, PCF components, custom connectors, Azure Functions, and other extensibility approaches.
* Design scalable Dataverse architectures, including data models, security, integrations, business logic, and performance considerations.
* Integrate Power Platform solutions with Azure, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Teams, Dynamics 365, SQL, APIs, and other enterprise systems.
* Implement strong ALM practices including source control, solution management, deployment automation, environment strategy, and CI/CD.
* Lead technical discovery sessions and translate business requirements into practical, well-designed solutions.
* Communicate architecture decisions, tradeoffs, risks, estimates, and recommendations clearly to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
* Provide technical leadership across multiple engagements and act as an escalation point for complex engineering challenges.
* Establish and promote engineering standards, reusable patterns, code quality expectations, and delivery best practices.
* Mentor engineers and technical leads and help improve engineering quality across the broader team.
* Help teams determine when Power Platform is the right solution and when custom development or other technologies are more appropriate.

**Required Qualifications**

* 8 or more years of professional software engineering, application development, solution architecture, or related technology experience.
* 4 or more years of substantial hands-on Microsoft Power Platform engineering experience.
* Strong software development experience using C#/.NET and JavaScript or TypeScript.
* Experience extending Power Platform through plugins, custom APIs, PCF components, custom connectors, Azure Functions, or similar technologies.
* Strong understanding of Dataverse architecture, security, data modeling, integration patterns, solution management, and performance.
* Experience designing and consuming REST APIs and integrating with enterprise systems.
* Experience with Azure services, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Teams, Dynamics 365, SQL, and related technologies.
* Strong experience with ALM, source control, deployment automation, managed solutions, and CI/CD.
* Strong understanding of professional software engineering practices including code review, testing, debugging, monitoring, and production support.
* Demonstrated experience leading technical delivery on complex enterprise application projects.
* Strong client facing communication, consulting, and facilitation skills.
* Ability to lead technical discussions, challenge assumptions, explain tradeoffs, and provide clear recommendations.
* Experience mentoring engineers and improving technical practices across a team.
* Experience working with global clients and distributed delivery teams, including appropriate overlap with US based stakeholders when required.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Power Platform governance, environment strategy, security standards, or Center of Excellence practices.
* Experience with Azure technologies such as Functions, Logic Apps, API Management, Service Bus, Key Vault, or Application Insights.
* Experience working in consulting or professional services environments.
* Experience supporting presales, estimation, technical proposals, demonstrations, or workshops.
* Microsoft Power Platform or Azure certifications such as PL 400, PL 600, or related credentials.

**What Success Looks Like**

Successful engineers in this role remain highly engaged in client delivery while also raising the technical capability of the broader team. They are trusted by clients, comfortable solving difficult engineering problems, able to make sound architecture decisions, and capable of guiding others through complex technical challenges.

They approach Power Platform as an enterprise application development platform and combine its native capabilities with strong software engineering practices to deliver secure, scalable, maintainable solutions.

**What It Means to Be a Consultant at Crowe**  
  
Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.

In management at Crowe, you play a pivotal role in leading teams, guiding project execution, and deepening client relationships. You are expected to contribute to account planning, identify opportunities to add value, and ensure high-quality delivery. As your responsibilities expand, you take on broader account ownership, balancing project leadership with growing involvement in client strategy and solution development.

Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.

We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.

**Our Benefits:**  
At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We value our people and offer employees a comprehensive benefits package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!  
  
**How You Can Grow:**  
We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!

**Job Description:**

**What It Means to Be a Consultant at Crowe**  
Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.

In management at Crowe, you play a pivotal role in leading teams, guiding project execution, and deepening client relationships. You are expected to contribute to account planning, identify opportunities to add value, and ensure high-quality delivery. As your responsibilities expand, you take on broader account ownership, balancing project leadership with growing involvement in client strategy and solution development.

Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.

Crowe’s Microsoft Consulting Practice is hiring an **Agentic Business Process Analyst** to help clients rethink how work gets done in the AI era. This is not a traditional business analyst role focused only on documenting requirements, writing user stories, or mapping current-state processes. This role is for someone who can diagnose business problems, understand root causes, redesign processes, and identify where AI agents, automation, data, and human judgment should come together.

The ideal candidate is deeply functional, process-oriented, and comfortable enough with technology to work side by side with engineers, architects, and client IT teams. This person should be able to bridge business and technology, helping clients move from legacy workflows to intelligent, agent-enabled processes.

This role also has an internal transformation mandate. The person will help upskill Crowe Consulting teams that may be used to traditional ERP, CRM, or business application delivery. They will help consultants develop a more modern mindset: start with problems, then processes, then technology.

**What you will do**

* Lead discovery sessions with clients to understand business goals, pain points, process breakdowns, data issues, user needs, controls, and operating constraints.
* Map end-to-end business processes, including inputs, outputs, roles, systems, decisions, handoffs, exceptions, controls, and performance measures.
* Diagnose root causes across people, process, data, and technology before recommending solutions.
* Identify opportunities for AI assistance, agentic augmentation, workflow orchestration, automation, knowledge retrieval, decision support, and process improvement.
* Partner with technical architects and engineers to translate process opportunities into solution designs, prototypes, functional specifications, user stories, and delivery roadmaps.
* Define business value measures for agentic solutions, such as time saved, cycle time reduction, first-time-right rate, SLA performance, adoption, override rate, CSAT, cost per transaction, revenue lift, and compliance improvement.
* Help clients decide where humans should stay in control, where AI should assist, and where agents can safely orchestrate or automate work.
* Support workshops, demos, process redesign sessions, executive presentations, and change management conversations.
* Create reusable playbooks, templates, process models, and training materials to help Crowe teams adopt an agentic business analysis approach.
* Coach Crowe consultants on how to move beyond legacy requirements gathering into diagnostic, value-led, AI-enabled transformation work.

**What success looks like**

* You can walk into a messy client process and make sense of it quickly.
* You can separate symptoms from root causes.
* You know when the right answer is process redesign, data cleanup, integration, training, governance, automation, or AI.
* You can help clients and internal teams understand what agents should do, what humans should do, and how to measure whether the new process is better.
* You make technical teams sharper by giving them better process context, and you make business teams more confident by helping them understand what technology can realistically do.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 6+ years as a Business Analyst, Functional Consultant, or Process Consultant.
* Strong business process mapping and redesign experience.
* Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 and/or Power Platform implementations.
* Ability to facilitate client workshops and engage executive stakeholders.
* Exposure to AI, automation, or agentic transformation initiatives.
* Experience partnering with technical teams to deliver business solutions.
* Consulting or professional services background.
* Leadership or mentoring experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Dynamics 365 Sales, Customer Service, Field Service, Customer Insights, Project Operations, Finance, or Supply Chain.
* Experience with Power Platform, Copilot Studio, process mining, business process catalogs, customer journey mapping, service design, or operating model transformation.
* Experience identifying AI use cases, automation candidates, decision support opportunities, or agentic process patterns.
* Experience in consulting or professional services.
* Exposure to responsible AI, governance, risk, compliance, controls, or regulated industry environments.

title: Customer Engagement Systems Administrator
description:
As the world’s leading provider of AI-powered solutions for social impact, Blackbaud is looking for a Customer Engagement Systems Administrator to help ensure the platforms that connect our customers and teams are secure, reliable, and ready to support meaningful engagement. You will administer key Customer Success engagement platforms, including Blackbaud’s Community platform (Vanilla), Reference Edge, and other systems across the function. Through strong platform governance, integrations, and partnership across teams, you will help create trusted systems that expand what is possible for purpose-driven people and organizations.

**What you'll do**

* Own platform administration and organization-level configuration, including security controls, access standards, governance, and user lifecycle management.
* Translate business needs from the Customer Engagement team into platform requirements and controlled, scalable solutions.
* Manage end-to-end customer relationship management integrations, including setup, authentication, permissions, data access, ongoing maintenance, and troubleshooting.
* Partner with Customer Success Operations, Information Technology, Marketing, security, and other stakeholders to establish clear ownership and deliver platform changes that support reporting, scorecards, exports, and business workflows.
* Provide actionable data insights and reporting to stakeholders, identifying trends that inform business decisions and platform improvements.
* Support users through onboarding, training, access management, documentation, frequently asked questions, and standard operating procedures that create a consistent support experience.
* Protect platform health and data by following internal security and privacy guardrails, resolving technical issues, and distinguishing system defects from business or reporting requests.

**What you'll bring**

* 3+ years of experience administering customer engagement tools, such as community or customer reference platforms, including access controls, permissions, configuration, and governance.
* Experience with business systems administration or support and ownership of software-as-a-service platforms within a controlled enterprise environment.
* Experience managing or supporting customer relationship management integrations, including integration users, permission models, data ingestion and export, and troubleshooting. Salesforce experience is preferred.
* Experience working within a shared ownership model across technology and business teams, particularly where higher-risk administrative controls require defined governance.
* Hands-on experience with customer engagement platforms; experience with Vanilla or Reference Edge is a plus.
* Experience creating and maintaining support documentation, standard operating procedures, runbooks, and structured ticket-triage processes.
* Expected working hours are 1:00 PM–10:00 PM IST, with occasional flexibility to support collaboration during U.S. East Coast business hours.

title: Senior Software Engineer – Integrations & API Connectivity
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Senior Software Engineer – Integrations & API Connectivity
  
  
**Overview**
Mastercard is a global technology company powering an inclusive, digital economy, enabling secure and seamless transactions across 210+ countries.
  
  
This role sits within Mastercard’s Open Finance Europe – Connectivity team, responsible for building and operating scalable API integrations with financial institutions across Europe.
  
  
As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be a key hands-on contributor responsible for designing, building, and operating secure, reliable backend services. You will work on complex engineering problems, contribute to system design decisions, and deliver high-quality solutions that operate at scale in production environments.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Design, develop, test, and support scalable APIs and backend services
* Contribute to system design decisions with a focus on scalability, resilience, and performance
* Deliver high-quality, production-ready code across the full software development lifecycle
* Troubleshoot and resolve production issues, ensuring system stability and reliability
* Participate in code reviews and uphold engineering best practices and standards
* Implement effective testing strategies (unit, integration, end-to-end)
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Product, Architecture, Security, and SRE
* Improve observability, automation, and operational efficiency across services

Technology Stack
  
  

* Backend: C#, .NET, Web APIs
* Cloud: Azure (App Services, KeyVault, Blob Storage), AWS (S3, Redis, Microservices)
* Data: PostgreSQL, Flyway
* Practices: CI/CD pipelines, observability, secure development
* Plus: Java / Spring Boot, AI-assisted tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot)

**What You Bring - Required**

* 3-5 years of professional software engineering experience
* Strong hands-on experience building cloud-based, distributed backend systems
* Solid expertise in API development, scalability, and production support
* Ability to solve complex technical problems with a structured, pragmatic approach
* Strong understanding of SDLC, testing practices, and secure coding principles
* Proven ability to own and deliver components/services independently
* Strong collaboration and communication skills

**Preferred**

* Experience in payments, banking, or Open Banking (PSD2) environments
* Experience working with microservices architectures
* Familiarity with observability, monitoring, and incident response practices
* Exposure to AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot)

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**This role is eligible for our hybrid work model: Two days in-office**
**Senior Software Engineer - Backend**
Our Technology team is the backbone of our company: constantly creating, testing, learning and iterating to better meet the needs of our customers. If you thrive in a fast-paced, ideas-led environment, you’re in the right place.
  
  
**Why This Job’s a Big Deal**
Join an Agile team of professionals that are instrumental in building the next generation of travel applications. We constantly explore new technologies and engineer better solutions for ever demanding business needs.
  
  
Our team of engineers, at all levels, work with the business leaders in defining the product roadmap and come up with innovative solutions to grow the future of travel. We design and develop our back end systems and REST APIs that serve hundreds of millions of searches a day, collecting and parsing data across thousands of partners to get the best deals for our customers
  
  
**In This Role You Will Get To**

* Drive mission critical projects with direct impact on the evolution of Priceline's business.
* Innovate with a cross-functional agile team that continuously experiments, iterates and delivers on new product objectives.
* Showcase fluency and development skills of Java
* Lead, mentor, and guide the team in best practices.
* Apply your programming skills towards building low latency and high throughput transactional services with continuous integration and automation testing.
* Implement SQL composition skills that collects and queries data for investigation and analysis in real time from our applications.
* The ability to quickly apply your experience to understand our codebase, systems and business requirements to effectively make changes to our applications.
* Influencer and communicator on team development efforts. Influence what the best solutions are and communicate your findings to key business stakeholders.

**Who You Are**

* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science or related field.
* 6+ years of experience in software engineering and development.
* Exceptional coding experience with Java.
* An interest in being a mentor and influencing best practices with less experienced developers.
* Strong grasp of SQL compositions skills for composing queries and analysis.
* Confident with the utilization of Spring Frameworks, Web Services and APIs.
* Experience with developing on Cloud, especially GCP.
* Experience in Microservices, Kubernetes (GKE preferable), and Dockers.
* Proven ability in Design and Architecture of complex, highly scalable and performance driven applications.
* Illustrated history of living the values necessary to Priceline: Customer, Innovation, Team, Accountability and Trust.
* The Right Results, the Right Way is not just a motto at Priceline; it’s a way of life. Unquestionable integrity and ethics is essential.

**Who We Are**
**WE ARE PRICELINE.**
Our success as one of the biggest players in online travel is all thanks to our incredible, dedicated team of talented employees. Priceliners are focused on being the best travel deal makers in the world, motivated by our passion to help everyone experience the moments that matter most in their lives. Whether it’s a dream vacation, your cousin’s graduation, or your best friend’s wedding - we make travel affordable and accessible to our customers.
  
  
Our culture is unique and inspiring (that’s what our employees tell us). We’re a grown-up, startup. We deliver the excitement of a new venture, without the struggles and chaos that can come with a business that hasn’t stabilized.
  
  
We’re on the cutting edge of innovative technologies. We keep the customer at the center of all that we do. Our ability to meet their needs relies on the strength of a workforce as diverse as the customers we serve. We bring together employees from all walks of life and we are proud to provide the kind of inclusive environment that stimulates innovation, creativity and collaboration.
  
  
Priceline is part of the Booking Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: BKNG) family of companies, a highly profitable global online travel company with a market capitalization of over $80 billion. Our sister companies include Booking.com, BookingGo, Agoda, Kayak and OpenTable.
  
  
If you want to be part of something truly special, check us out!
  
  
**Flexible work at Priceline**
Priceline is following a hybrid working model, which includes two days onsite as determined by you and your manager (ideally selecting among Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday). On the remaining days, you can choose to be remote or in the office.
  
  
**Perks & Benefits At Priceline**
Our benefits are designed to support your health, wellbeing, and life inside and outside of work. Eligible Priceliners have access to:
  
  
**Health & wellness coverage**
including medical, dental, vision, and mental health resources
  
  
**Generous time off**
including PTO, holidays, a company-wide Priceline Pause reset week, and paid volunteer days
  
  
**Work/life support**
including the ability to work up to 4 weeks per year from anywhere, parental leave, dependent care and family support resources, Summer Fridays, and office perks like stocked kitchens and catered meals (varies by location)
  
  
**Financial security programs**
such as retirement plans with company contributions, life and disability coverage, and tax-advantaged accounts
  
  
**Signature travel perks**
including employee-only discounts on hotels and flights, VIP deals, and Big Deal Bucks credits
  
  
**Additional perks & discounts**
like travel and partner discounts, tuition support, legal support, and pet benefits
  
  
**A people-first culture**
with Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), social events, recognition programs, and service awards that help you connect, grow, and celebrate together
  
  
*Specific benefits and programs vary by location.*
**Inclusion is a Big Deal!**
To be the best travel dealmakers in the world, we believe our team should reflect the broad range of customers and communities we serve. We are committed to cultivating a culture where all employees have the freedom to bring their individual perspectives, life experiences, and passion to work.
  
  
Priceline is a proud equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate the unique lenses through which our employees see the world. We’d love for you to join us and help shape what makes our team extraordinary.
  
  
**Applying for this position**
We're excited that you are interested in a career with us. For all
**current employees**
