title: Landing Page Developer
description:
**About Global University Systems (GUS)**
Global University Systems (GUS) is an international education group that empowers students to transform their lives through education. We believe education drives careers, lives, and society forward, enabling a brighter future for all. Our network of 30 institutions offers the broadest range of industry-relevant skills through inclusive, accessible, and digital-first learning. We currently educate around 122,000 students on campuses worldwide and have 20M+ unique subscribers to our courses. Our global ecosystem powers accessible digital learning and academic achievement.
  
  
**About The Role**
Landing pages are where our paid media, campaign and lifecycle traffic converts — or doesn’t. This role exists to make sure every page we put behind a campaign is fast, accurate, on-brand and built to convert. Working primarily in Landing, you will turn briefs and designs into live pages at pace, and write the HTML, CSS and JavaScript needed for everything the drag-and-drop editor cannot do on its own. You will also build the dynamic, parameter-driven pages that let us match message to audience at scale, and keep tracking, forms and lead routing working reliably behind them. The role sits within the Global Digital Operations function and supports brands and markets across the portfolio.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Build and delivery**

* Build, QA and publish landing pages in Landingi from design files, briefs and existing templates, to agreed deadlines and quality standards.
* Extend pages beyond native editor capability using custom HTML, CSS and JavaScript (bespoke components, form behaviour, interactive elements, layout fixes and third-party embeds).
* Create and maintain reusable templates, sections and component libraries so recurring campaigns can be turned around quickly and consistently.
* Build dynamic landing pages: dynamic text replacement, URL parameter handling, and keyword, audience, location or product-level variants so paid traffic lands on relevant, message-matched pages at scale.
* Ensure responsive behaviour across breakpoints and consistent rendering across browsers and devices.

**Tracking, integrations and data**

* Implement and QA tracking: Google Tag Manager containers, conversion tags, pixels, event tracking and consent-compliant deployment.
* Configure form logic, validation, thank-you journeys and lead routing into CRM and marketing automation platforms via native integrations, webhooks or APIs.
* Keep page speed, Core Web Vitals and technical SEO hygiene (metadata, canonicals, indexation rules, structured data where relevant) within agreed standards.
* Troubleshoot build, tracking and integration issues quickly when campaigns are live, and escalate clearly when a fix sits outside your control.

**Testing and optimisation**

* Build and ship A/B and multivariate tests, support the read-out, and roll winning variants into templates.
* Apply CRO and UX best practice to builds (layout, form design, copy hierarchy, CTA placement and page load) and flag friction points rather than building briefs verbatim.
* Contribute to post-campaign reviews and maintain a live backlog of optimisation opportunities.

**Governance and ways of working**

* Maintain naming conventions, versioning, documentation and an accurate inventory of live pages; archive and redirect retired pages correctly.
* Work to brand, accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA) and data protection standards across all markets served.
* Manage a multi-brand request queue: scope and estimate work, prioritise against business impact, and keep stakeholders informed on status and timelines.
* Partner with paid media, SEO, brand and content, design, CRM and web/IT colleagues to deliver joined-up campaign journeys.

**Experience & Skills**

* 2–4 years’ experience building marketing or campaign landing pages in a commercial or agency environment.
* Hands-on experience of Landingi, or a close equivalent (Unbounce, Instapage, Webflow, HubSpot CMS) with the ability and appetite to work day-to-day in Landingi.
* Solid working HTML5 and CSS3: responsive layouts, Flexbox and Grid, and confident debugging in browser developer tools.
* Practical JavaScript for front-end enhancement: DOM manipulation, event handling, form behaviour and safe use of third-party scripts and snippets.
* Experience building dynamic or personalised landing pages and parameter-driven content for paid search and paid social.
* Working knowledge of Google Tag Manager and GA4, and the ability to implement and QA your own conversion tracking.
* Demonstrable attention to detail: pixel accuracy, copy accuracy and disciplined QA across devices and browsers.
* Able to manage multiple concurrent requests, stakeholders and deadlines without losing quality.
* A clear communicator who can explain technical constraints and trade-offs to non-technical marketing colleagues.

**Desirable**

* UX experience: wireframing, usability principles, user journey mapping, or involvement in usability testing.
* CRO experience, including structured experimentation and behavioural tools such as Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity or Contentsquare.
* Experience in a multi-brand, multi-market or multi-language environment, including localisation workflows.
* Familiarity with CRM and marketing automation platforms (Salesforce, HubSpot, Dynamics) and webhook or API-based lead delivery.
* Exposure to WordPress or another CMS alongside the landing page builder.
* Comfortable working from Figma or Adobe Creative Cloud files, and able to make light design adaptations.
* Awareness of consent management platforms, GDPR and accessibility requirements.
* Experience in education or another considered-purchase, lead-generation sector.

**Other Information**
*Global University Systems equal opportunity employer. We provide equal opportunities and are committed to the principle of equality regardless of race, ancestry, place of origin, colour, ethnic origin, citizenship, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, record of offences, marital status, family status or disability.*
*The post holder may be asked to undertake different or additional duties in line with business requirements at the request of their line manager.*
*There is an expectation that all employees will maintain the values of the Group and will comply with the code of conduct as well as equality and diversity, health and safety and safeguarding policies.*

title: Early Professional, Mining Engineering
description:
**Job Description**
WSP is seeking an Assistant Engineer - Geotechnical to join the Mining Global Capability Centre in India. This early-career role will support global mining projects across rock engineering and tailings / mine-waste workstreams under the direction of experienced geotechnical, mining and tailings professionals.
  
  
The successful candidate will assist with geotechnical data review, development of geological and geotechnical models, stability and seepage analyses, numerical modelling, design documentation and preparation of technical reports. The role requires close collaboration with WSP teams in other countries and a strong commitment to technical quality, safety, learning and timely delivery.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Assist with geotechnical assessments for open-pit mines, underground mines, tailings storage facilities, water-retaining structures and other mine-waste facilities.
* Compile, validate and interpret geological, geotechnical, hydrogeological and laboratory data for use in engineering assessments.
* Support the development of geological and geotechnical models, design domains, material-property datasets and engineering assumptions.
* Undertake supervised analyses such as slope stability, seepage, deformation, stress, ground-support and earth-structure assessments using appropriate analytical and numerical methods.
* Assist in identifying credible geotechnical hazards, failure modes and design risks, and document assumptions, limitations and sensitivity checks.
* Prepare calculations, figures, technical notes, report sections, presentations, drawings and other project deliverables in accordance with agreed templates and quality requirements.
* Work with senior engineers to translate project scope and technical requirements into clear tasks, inputs, analysis steps and deliverables.
* Coordinate with multidisciplinary teams including mining, civil, water, geology, hydrogeology, environmental and CAD / digital-design specialists.
* Complete assigned work in line with project scope, schedule and budget, and communicate progress, constraints and data gaps promptly.
* Participate in technical reviews, address review comments, maintain calculation records and follow document-control and QA/QC procedures.
* Contribute to internal technical guidance, standard workflows, knowledge libraries, training sessions and continuous-improvement initiatives.
* Follow WSP requirements for health and safety, environment, quality, information security, ethical conduct and risk management.

**Technical Exposure**
**Rock Engineering and Mine Geotechnics**

* Geotechnical characterisation of rock masses and interpretation of structural-geology information.
* Open-pit slope and underground excavation stability assessments.
* Ground-support assessment, stress analysis and deformation evaluation under supervision.
* Development and checking of numerical models and sensitivity cases for mining applications.

**Tailings and Mine-Waste Geotechnics**

* Geotechnical inputs for tailings storage facilities, water-storage impoundments, waste-rock facilities and associated earthworks.
* Slope-stability and seepage assessments, material characterisation, filter compatibility and geosynthetic or ground-improvement considerations.
* Preparation of design calculations, risk inputs, technical specifications, drawings, report sections and supporting documentation.
* Exposure to recognised tailings-management frameworks and guidance such as GISTM, ICOLD and CDA, as relevant to the project and under senior direction.

**Software And Digital Skills**
Candidates are not expected to be proficient in every package at entry level. Experience through academic projects, internships or research is acceptable. The role may use:
  
  

* FLAC / FLAC3D, PLAXIS 2D / 3D or similar finite-difference / finite-element tools.
* Rocscience applications such as Slide2 / Slide3, RS2 / RS3, Dips, UnWedge or RocFall.
* GeoStudio applications such as SLOPE/W and SEEP/W.
* GIS, CAD, geological-modelling, spreadsheet and data-visualisation tools, depending on project needs.
* Microsoft 365 applications, particularly Excel, Word and PowerPoint; ability to learn collaboration and task-tracking platforms used by global teams.

**Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Mining Engineering, Geological Engineering or a closely related discipline.
* A Master’s degree in Geotechnical Engineering, Rock Engineering, Geomechanics, Mining Geotechnics or a related field is advantageous.
* Typically 0-2 years of relevant industry, internship or research experience. Strong graduate candidates with relevant academic project work may also be considered.
* Academic or practical exposure to soil mechanics, rock mechanics, engineering geology, foundation engineering, slope stability, groundwater / seepage or numerical methods.
* Good written and spoken English, with the ability to prepare clear calculations, technical notes and presentations.
* Ability to work accurately with data, follow engineering procedures and seek guidance when assumptions or inputs are uncertain.

**Key Competencies and Personal Qualities**

* Strong analytical thinking, curiosity and a practical approach to engineering problem-solving.
* Attention to detail and a disciplined approach to data, calculations, file management and checking.
* Ability to collaborate respectfully across disciplines, cultures, offices and time zones.
* Willingness to learn new software, methods, standards and project-delivery processes.
* Proactive communication of progress, risks, data gaps and support needs.
* Commitment to safety, technical integrity, sustainability, inclusion and professional development.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Delivers assigned analyses and documentation safely, accurately and on time with appropriate supervision.
* Produces traceable calculations and models with clearly documented inputs, assumptions, checks and limitations.
* Responds constructively to technical review comments and demonstrates measurable growth in engineering judgement and software capability.
* Builds trusted working relationships with GCC colleagues and WSP’s global project teams.
* Contributes to a collaborative culture through knowledge sharing, continuous learning and reliable project delivery.

**BGV:**

* Employment with WSP India is subject to the successful completion of a background verification (“BGV”) check conducted by a third-party agency appointed by WSP India.
* Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process — including documents uploaded — is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner”.

**About Us**
WSP is one of the world's leading professional services consulting firms. We are dedicated to our local communities and propelled by international brainpower. We are technical experts and strategic advisors including engineers, technicians, scientists, architects, planners, surveyors and environmental specialists, as well as other design, program and construction management professionals. We design lasting solutions in the Transportation & Infrastructure, Property & Buildings, Earth & Environment, Power & Energy, Resources and Industry sectors, as well as offering strategic advisory services. Our talented people around the globe engineer projects that will help societies grow for lifetimes to come.
  
  
With approximately
**4,000 talented people**
across 3 locations (Noida, Bengaluru & Mumbai offices) in India and more than
**73,000 globally**
, in 550
**offices across 40 countries**

title: Staff Engineer - Platform
description:
**About SolarSquare :**

At SolarSquare we are building the Home-Energy brand of future India. We help homes switch to rooftop solar and move away from traditional coal electricity. We are a full-stack D2C residential solar brand - designing, installing, maintaining (after-sales), and financing solar systems for home-owners across India.

In a few short years we have scaled to become the leading residential solar brand in India. We are obsessed with quality, customer service, and innovating to make it simple for homes to switch to solar. We are looking for leaders to join us in this mission.

**About the role :**

As a Staff Engineer on Platform, you own the developer and infrastructure platform the entire engineering org builds on - cloud-native infrastructure, CI/CD, observability, reliability, and the internal tooling that eliminates mundane, repeated work. You set the direction for how we run software at scale, and you stay hands-on doing it.

**What you'll own :**

- Design and operate a cloud-native platform (Kubernetes-based) and the paved-road tooling teams build on.

- Own CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, and developer experience - automate the mundane so engineers focus on impact.

- Drive reliability and SRE practices : observability, incident response, and root-cause fixes that stick.

- Optimize for performance, cost, and security as first-class concerns across the platform.

- Build internal developer-platform capabilities and standards that make the right way the easy way; mentor across pods.

**Tech Stack :**
We run on AWS with Kubernetes, Terraform, Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, Redis, and Kafka.

**What we're looking for :**

- 8+ years in platform, infrastructure, or SRE roles, with deep distributed-systems fundamentals.

- Expertise in cloud-native infrastructure (Kubernetes), CI/CD, and infrastructure-as-code.

- Strong observability and reliability practice across service boundaries; you measure, then improve.

- A track record building internal platforms or developer tooling that others adopt.

- Attention to performance, cost, and security as first-class concerns.

- Customer-obsessed and impact-led : you start from the customer's pain and judge yourself by the metric your work moves, not the tickets you close.

- High agency : you don't wait to be told - you spot problems, pick them up, and own the outcome through to production.

- Craft over shortcuts : you fix root causes rather than symptoms, clear tech debt as you go, and don't ship bugs.

- Bias for speed and simplicity : you build once for reuse, automate the mundane, and let AI draft the first pass so your judgment goes where it matters.

- Data-driven : you reach for evidence over assumptions and let results guide the next decision.

**Bonus points :**

- Experience with internal developer platforms (IDP), self-service infrastructure, or DevEx initiatives.

- Cost-optimization or large-scale reliability engineering experience.

- Comfort building automation and agents that remove operational toil.

**Why you'll love building here :**

- Direct ownership of high-impact initiatives with visible customer and business outcomes.

- An AI-native engineering culture with first-class tooling and internal agents.

- A high-agency, low-bureaucracy environment where you debate what's right and ship.

- A meritocracy where growth and recognition track impact, not tenure.

- Competitive compensation.

- A front-row seat to putting clean energy on millions of Indian rooftops.

title: Infrastructure Engineer I – eApps
description:
**Company Overview**
We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.
  
  
**Overview**

* Support the Enterprise Applications (E-Apps) team in operating reliable, secure, and efficient infrastructure for third-party enterprise applications across GCP and hybrid environments.
* Perform hands-on platform administration, monitoring, troubleshooting, patching, automation, and operational support under established standards and guidance from senior engineers.
* Contribute to Infrastructure as Code and automation using Terraform, Ansible, Python, Shell scripting, and PowerShell to improve consistency and reduce manual effort.
* Work with senior engineers, infrastructure teams, application stakeholders, and vendors to support deployments, project activities, incident resolution, and continuous improvement.

**Key Accountabilities**

* Platform operations: Support the health, availability, configuration, and day-to-day administration of the E-Apps infrastructure and application platforms.
* Administration and maintenance: Perform standard platform configuration, patching, upgrades, certificate updates, access changes, backup checks, and routine maintenance across Windows and Linux environments.
* Web and application platforms: Support IIS, JBoss, and Apache environments, including application hosting, configuration, service restarts, reverse proxy settings, ports, certificates, and basic Java application troubleshooting.
* Cloud and infrastructure: Support GCP resources and approved hybrid infrastructure patterns involving compute, networking, IAM, load balancing, DNS, SSL/TLS, storage, and connectivity.
* Automation: Develop and maintain Terraform configurations, Ansible playbooks, Python utilities, and Shell or PowerShell scripts for repeatable operational tasks.
* Observability and performance: Use Datadog or equivalent monitoring tools to review metrics, logs, dashboards, alerts, health checks, and basic performance indicators; escalate abnormal conditions promptly.
* Incident and ITSM support: Resolve routine incidents, document actions, participate in incident and change processes, maintain knowledge articles, and escalate complex issues with clear evidence and impact details.
* Project delivery: Support infrastructure and application activities for assigned projects, deployments, testing, environment readiness, and operational handover.
* Collaboration and knowledge sharing: Work effectively with D&T, network, OS, security, application, and vendor teams; follow standards and share operational knowledge.
* Resilience and continuous improvement: Help improve monitoring, reliability, patch compliance, recovery readiness, runbooks, and standard operating procedures for third-party enterprise applications.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Education: Full-time graduation from an accredited university in engineering, computer science, information technology, or a related discipline.
* Experience: 3–5 years of experience supporting infrastructure, middleware, or enterprise application platforms in production or business-critical environments.
* GCP and infrastructure: Working knowledge of GCP services, cloud and hybrid infrastructure concepts, load balancers, SSL/TLS certificates, DNS, networking, and access management.
* Automation and scripting: Practical experience with Terraform, Ansible, Python, Shell scripting, or PowerShell for operational support, configuration, validation, and automation.
* Middleware and platform administration: Working knowledge of IIS, JBoss, and Apache across Windows and Linux platforms, including configuration, troubleshooting, patching, service management, and application integration.
* Operating systems and databases: Familiarity with Windows Server and Linux administration, relational database concepts, and supporting applications that use Oracle, SQL Server, or MySQL.
* Monitoring and operations: Experience with Datadog or equivalent observability tools, incident handling, patching, operational documentation, and basic root-cause investigation.
* ITSM and communication: Working knowledge of incident, change, service request, escalation, and problem-management practices, with strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Core proficiency: Ability to follow standards, troubleshoot methodically, learn new technologies, and collaborate with senior engineers, stakeholders, and vendors.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Cloud breadth: Exposure to AWS or Azure administration; GCP remains the primary cloud platform for this role.
* Delivery practices: Understanding of CI/CD pipelines, source control, DevOps practices, and release or deployment automation.
* Continuous improvement: Demonstrates analytical thinking, identifies operational improvements, and uses AI capabilities where they provide business value.
* Professional behaviors: Demonstrates reliability, ownership, integrity, teamwork, learning agility, and a positive service mindset.

**SUPPORT REQUIREMENT**

* Participate in extended off-hours shift coverage, including overnight, weekend, holiday, and on-call support on a weekly rotational basis, aligned to US business-hours support needs.

**ELIGIBILITY**
Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

title: Manager - Production Support Engineer
description:
**Role Summary**

We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated
**Senior Production Support Engineer**
to ensure the stability, availability, performance, and continuous improvement of business-critical production systems. The ideal candidate will be responsible for handling production incidents, troubleshooting application and infrastructure issues, managing releases, coordinating with cross-functional teams, and driving operational excellence while meeting defined SLAs.

The role requires strong technical expertise across applications, databases, middleware, operating systems, cloud platforms, and monitoring tools, along with excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Monitor production applications and infrastructure to ensure high availability and optimal performance.
* Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve production incidents within agreed SLAs.
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for recurring issues and implement permanent fixes.
* Support Java/.NET/Web-based enterprise applications.
* Analyze application logs and identify performance bottlenecks.
* Troubleshoot issues related to APIs, middleware, web servers, and batch jobs.

* Good knowledge of Linux/Unix and Windows administration.
* Experience with Web Servers and Application Servers (Apache, Tomcat, IIS, WebLogic etc.).

* ITIL Foundation certification preferred.
* Experience in Banking, Financial Services, Capital Markets, or FinTech domain is a plus.

title: LMS - Moodle Platform Administrator
description:
**Our Vision:**

Help IIT Bombay rank among the top engineering and technology institutes worldwide by fostering strong relationships with its alumni, corporations and philanthropists.

**About us:**

The Indian Institute of Technology Bombay (IIT Bombay), established in 1958, is one of India’s premier institutions for science, engineering, and technology education and research. Recognised as an
*Institution of Eminence*
by the Ministry of Education, IIT Bombay consistently ranks among the top universities globally.

With 17 departments, 35 centres, and three schools, IIT Bombay is home to world-class faculty and over 75,000 accomplished alumni worldwide. Through the
**Educational Outreach (EO) Office**
, IIT Bombay delivers continuing and executive education for working professionals in India and abroad. EO enables learners to access IIT Bombay’s world-class faculty and research expertise through online, hybrid, and in-person programs that blend academic depth with industry relevance.

**Role Overview:**

Educational Outreach, IIT Bombay, is looking for a hands-on Moodle Platform Administrator with demonstrable experience installing, configuring, customising, maintaining and troubleshooting Moodle across on-premises and cloud environments. This role is responsible for the technical and operational management of our Moodle-based learning platform, including platform configuration, user and course administration, plugins, integrations, troubleshooting, testing and maintenance.

This is a hands-on technical role, not a content management or LMS coordination position. The successful candidate must be comfortable working directly within Moodle's administrative environment, configuring platform functionality, diagnosing issues and implementing solutions to ensure a reliable and seamless learning experience across programmes.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Moodle Platform Administration & Configuration**

* Administer, configure and maintain Moodle 4.5, managing platform settings, users, courses, categories, cohorts, enrolments, roles and permissions.
* Configure Moodle site settings, authentication, enrolment methods, access controls and administrative workflows.
* Perform Moodle installation, upgrades and patching; configure PHP settings, file permissions, cron and application services, coordinating with infrastructure teams where required.

**Course, Assessment & Learning Activity Configuration**

* Create and configure Moodle courses, course structures, learning resources, forums, SCORM packages, quizzes and assignments.
* Configure gradebooks, grading methods, activity completion, course completion, conditional access and activity restrictions.
* Manage bulk user creation, course enrolments, learner access and course backup/archival.

**Plugins, Integrations & Customisation**

* Install, evaluate, configure, troubleshoot and maintain Moodle plugins, ensuring compatibility with Moodle 4.5.
* Manage and support integrations with APIs, video platforms, virtual classrooms, proctoring and certificate systems.
* Independently customise Moodle themes, login pages, dashboards, navigation and course layouts using HTML, CSS/SCSS and basic JavaScript, ensuring responsive desktop and mobile layouts.
* Troubleshoot plugin and integration issues and maintain relevant technical documentation.

**Testing, Troubleshooting & Platform Maintenance**

* Independently diagnose and resolve Moodle issues related to configuration, access, enrolments, assessments, plugins and application functionality.
* Test configurations, plugin updates, integrations and upgrades in Stage before deployment to Production.
* Perform and verify course and full-site backup/restore, covering the database, Moodledata and code/configuration. Support disaster recovery testing and release rollback, and coordinate infrastructure issues, VAPT and security remediation with technical teams.

**Reporting & Technical Support**

* Generate Moodle reports on learner activity, participation, assessment performance and course completion.
* Support faculty, Teaching Assistants, programme teams and learners with technical LMS issues.
* Maintain documentation of configurations, changes, testing, troubleshooting, plugins and operational procedures.

**Desired Experience/Skills:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Educational Technology or a related field.
* **Minimum 5 years of relevant experience, including at least 3 years of hands-on technical Moodle administration.**
* **Practical experience administering Moodle 4.x is required; experience with Moodle 4.5 LTS is preferred.**
* Demonstrable experience with Moodle platform configuration, user and course management, roles and permissions, enrolments, plugins, integrations and troubleshooting.
* Experience with Moodle installation/configuration, SCORM, REST APIs, gradebooks, assessments, reporting and completion tracking.
* Working knowledge of Ubuntu/Linux, Nginx, PHP/PHP-FPM, PostgreSQL or MySQL, and cron/scheduled tasks, including configuration and log-based troubleshooting. Familiarity with Apache is also useful.
* Experience with Moodle backups/restores, testing, Stage-to-Production releases and troubleshooting.
* Ability to independently configure, diagnose and resolve Moodle platform issues rather than relying solely on vendor or developer support.
* Strong analytical, documentation and problem-solving skills.

Experience with Moodle 4.5 LTS, Ubuntu 24.04 LTS, AWS-hosted LMS environments, large-scale Moodle implementations, accessibility, VAPT and information-security practices will be an advantage.

**Please note:**
This is a Mumbai-based, on-campus role at IIT Bombay, Powai.
**Applicants must have demonstrable hands-on technical Moodle administration experience, including platform configuration, plugins, UI customisation, integrations and troubleshooting. Profiles primarily focused on LMS content uploads, course coordination, instructional design or learner support without hands-on Moodle platform administration will not be considered.**

**Only shortlisted candidates will be notified.**

title: HRIS Systems Administrator
description:
We are a global consultancy group, combining multi-disciplined expertise to deliver marine, engineering and technical services that drive safety and sustainability in maritime, oil & gas and renewable energy sectors. With a legacy dating back to 1856 – to the world’s first marine surveying organisation, The Salvage Association – Aqualis continues to evolve to provide the deepest pool of technical expertise across marine and energy sectors in more locations worldwide, to best support our clients and markets in keeping the world moving today, whilst managing the challenges of tomorrow.
  
  
The HR Systems Administrator is responsible for the day-to-day administration, configuration, support and continuous improvement of Aqualis' global people systems, with primary responsibility for ensuring that systems are reliable, secure, accurate and fit for purpose. This is a systems role, not an HR-generalist role. It sits within the Business Systems team and acts as the technical product owner for the People-systems estate. The role acts as a technical and functional bridge between HR, IT, payroll, vendors and other business stakeholders. It translates HR and business requirements into practical system solutions, while the HR team provides policy and process expertise where required.
  
  
**What will you be doing?**

* Administer and maintain the core HRIS and connected people systems, including system configuration, workflows, business rules, forms, notifications, templates and approval processes.
* Manage user accounts, security roles, permissions and access controls in line with data protection, least-privilege and segregation-of-duties requirements.
* Maintain system configuration across the employee lifecycle, including onboarding, employee changes, leave and absence, document management and offboarding.
* Translate business requirements into effective and scalable system solutions, challenging unnecessary customisation, complexity or duplication where appropriate.
* Investigate and resolve system issues, identifying root causes through analysis of configuration, data, logs and integration outputs.
* Monitor and support integrations between the HRIS and other platforms, including payroll, applicant tracking, identity management and reporting systems.
* Manage critical system incidents, coordinating impact assessment, escalation, workarounds, reconciliation, stakeholder communications and corrective actions.
* Maintain HR data integrity through controlled imports, bulk updates, audits, exception reporting and reconciliation, working with data owners to address issues at source.
* Create and maintain operational reports and accurate data feeds to support dashboards, analytics and business reporting, including Power BI where applicable.
* Configure, test and deploy system enhancements, coordinating releases, regression and user acceptance testing, approvals, deployment and post-release monitoring.
* Maintain accurate system documentation, including configuration records, process maps, support guidance and change logs.
* Identify opportunities to automate HR processes, reduce manual activity and rework, improve user experience and strengthen system controls.
* Support effective system adoption through user guidance, training and technical support for HR teams, managers and employees.
* Work closely with HR and IT teams while maintaining clear ownership and accountability for HR systems activities and outcomes.
* Prioritise incidents, support requests and improvement initiatives based on security, compliance, payroll and employee impact, business value, effort and dependencies.

**What are we looking for?**

* Relevant degree, professional qualification or equivalent practical experience in information systems, business systems, HR technology, data or a related discipline.
* Hands-on experience administering an HRIS or comparable enterprise business system, with responsibility beyond end-user activity.
* Practical experience configuring workflows, fields, forms, permissions, business rules or similar system components.
* Experience troubleshooting technical and data issues methodically and working with vendors or IT to reach resolution.
* Experience with data imports, validation, reconciliation and maintaining data integrity.
* Experience testing and implementing system changes, enhancements or releases using controlled change practices.
* Experience supporting users and explaining technical issues clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

**Further Information**
*This position can be based at our offices in Mumbai or Kuala Lumpur.*
*You must have the right to live and work in India or Malaysia.*
*You can learn more about our team and what we do here:*
*https://aqualis-group.com/*
*NO RECRUITMENT AGENCIES.*
**Our Recruitment AI Policy**
Our recruitment decisions are made by people. Applications are reviewed by our Talent team and hiring managers, and AI is not used to automatically score, rank or make decisions about candidates.
  
  
**Our Commitment To D&I**
At Aqualis Group, we are committed to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace where everyone feels respected, valued, and empowered to thrive, regardless of background, identity, or role. As a global company, we believe that diversity drives innovation and inclusion strengthens our teams. We support flexible working, accessible environments, and employee wellbeing. Even if your experience doesn’t match every requirement, we encourage you to apply—your unique perspective could be just what we need.

title: Strategist
description:
**What you will do**

* Unravel the digital customer journey: map how our audiences move from trigger to research, evaluation, purchase, ownership and advocacy across search, social, video, review sites, dealer and brand platforms
* Customer understanding: Using our tools, find what makes each audience distinct; layer in attitudes and listening on how they talk
* Category understanding: size search demand and map keyword intent to journey stages in SEO tools; track competitor share of voice, search visibility and content approach
* Culture understanding: spot the trends, tensions, communities and creators shaping the category using listening & research
* Persona building: turn the three lenses into named, human personas with signature traits, mindset, media habits and purchase behaviour
* Always-on listening: run listening across our brands and their competitive sets, and flag spikes, crises and opportunities the same day
* Monthly reporting: write the monthly listening and performance report covering what moved, why it moved, and what we change next month
* Platform watch: track shifts on Instagram, YouTube, X, Reddit and Snapchat and turn them into a short monthly note on what they mean for our brands
* Feed the content team: give the Social Content Strategist persona-led insight starters and journey gaps for topicals, influencer briefs and the monthly calendar
* Pitch support: deliver fast customer, category and culture reads and persona snapshots for pitches, often inside 48 hours

**What you bring**

* Hands-on experience with GWI or a comparable survey tool such as YouGov, including building audiences and reading index, penetration and sample base correctly
* Hands-on experience with at least one listening tool (Sprinklr, Brandwatch, Talkwalker or Meltwater) and native platform analytics
* Working knowledge of a search tool (Semrush, Ahrefs or Search Console) and how search intent maps to a purchase journey
* At least one persona, segmentation or customer journey map you built and can walk us through
* Comfort with Excel or Google Sheets beyond the basics: pivots, lookups, cleaning messy exports
* The ability to write a clear one-page insight summary that a client would forward to their boss
* Daily use of AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Perplexity) for research and synthesis, with the judgement to check what they produce
* Genuine curiosity about why people do what they do online

**Good to have**

* 1 to 2 years in social listening, digital insights, research or analytics
* Exposure to cultural trend frameworks
* Experience with Statista, NielsenIQ or client sales data
* Basic data visualisation in Canva, Flourish or Looker Studio
* Reading fluency in Hindi or another Indian language, to catch what English-only listening misses
* An interest in motorcycles, music or travel culture

title: Environmental Consultant
description:

The role would suit an enthusiastic individual looking to deliver environmental elements of engineering projects, within a wide range of sectors including transmission & distribution, rail, highways, energy and commercial / residential, from feasibility through to planning, including detailed design and construction.
  
  
You will have responsibility for preparing technical reports, preparing proposals, project delivery, and financial management.
  
  
You will be joining a well-respected and leading global environmental consulting team with a wide range of clients across different markets and sectors including national and local government, industrial, commercial and scientific sectors. You will be integrated into the UK EMA team and will be supported in your professional career development with opportunities for training, mentoring and chartership.

* Have strong communication skills including fluent written and verbal English with report writing skills, such as experience of Environmental Impact Assessment chapter writing

* Robust project management, time management and financial management skills.

We are technical experts and strategic advisors including engineers, technicians, scientists, architects, planners, surveyors and environmental specialists, as well as other design, program and construction management professionals. We design lasting solutions in the Transportation & Infrastructure, Property & Buildings, Earth & Environment, Power & Energy, Resources and Industry sectors, as well as offering strategic advisory services. Our talented people around the globe engineer projects that will help societies grow for lifetimes to come.
  
  
With approximately
**4,000 talented people**
across 3 locations (Noida, Bengaluru & Mumbai offices) in India and more than
**73,000 globally**
, in 550
**offices across 40 countries**
, we engineer projects that will help societies grow for lifetimes to come.
  
  
At “WSP” we draw on the diverse skills and capabilities of our employees globally to compete for the most exciting and complex projects across the world and bring the same level of expertise to our local communities. We are proud to be an international collective of innovative thinkers who work on the most complex problems. Uniﬁed under one strong brand, we use our local expertise, international reach and global scale to prepare our cities and environments for the future, connect communities and help societies thrive in built and natural ecosystems. True to our guiding principles, our business is built on four cornerstones:
**Our People, Our Clients, Our Operational Excellence and Our Expertise.**
**www.wsp.com**

* Passionate people doing purposeful and sustainable work that helps shape our communities and the future.
* A collaborative team that thrives on challenges and unconventional thinking.
* A network of experts channeling our curiosity into creating solutions for complex issues.

***Inspired by diversity, driven by inclusion, we work with passion and purpose.***

You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you.

title: Biochemist
description:
**Biochemist – AI Data Trainer**
**About The Role**
What if your expertise in protein folding, enzyme kinetics, or metabolic pathways could directly shape how the world's most advanced AI models think about science?
  
  
Alignerr partners with leading AI research labs to build and refine cutting-edge language models — and we need PhD-level Biochemists to help us get the science right. This is a fully remote, flexible contract role where your deep domain knowledge becomes the benchmark for AI accuracy.
  
  
No AI background required. Just bring your scientific rigor.
  
  

* Organization: Alignerr
* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Remote
* Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

**What You'll Do**

* Design Expert-Level Problems — Craft advanced biochemistry challenges spanning nucleic acid chemistry, proteomics, structural biology, and drug-target interactions to stress-test AI reasoning.
* Author Ground-Truth Solutions — Write rigorous, step-by-step scientific responses that serve as the gold standard for AI model training and benchmarking.
* Audit AI Outputs — Evaluate AI-generated biochemical pathways, molecular structures, and quantitative analyses for technical accuracy, logical consistency, and scientific soundness.
* Refine AI Reasoning — Identify flaws in AI thinking — such as incorrect stoichiometry, stereochemical errors, or flawed metabolic logic — and provide structured, actionable feedback to improve model performance.

**Who You Are**

* PhD-level expertise: You hold (or are in the final stages of completing) a PhD in Biochemistry, Molecular Biology, or a closely related discipline.
* Deep domain knowledge: You have strong command of at least one core area — structural biology, enzymology, cellular metabolism, bioinformatics, or molecular genetics.
* Precise communicator: You can translate highly technical biochemical concepts into clear, well-structured written explanations.
* Detail-oriented: You catch errors others miss — whether it's a miscalculated Km value or an incorrect stereocenter assignment.
* No AI experience required — we'll give you everything you need to get started.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with data annotation, quality evaluation, or scientific peer review
* Familiarity with computational tools such as PyMOL, AlphaFold, or BLAST
* Background in science writing, technical documentation, or curriculum development

**Why Join Us**

* Make a real impact — Your scientific expertise directly improves how AI reasons about life sciences, with implications for research worldwide.
* Work on the frontier — Get hands-on exposure to advanced large language models and how they're trained and evaluated.
* Total flexibility — Work on your own schedule, fully remote, with no fixed hours or location requirements.
* Autonomy — Choose your own pace and projects that align with your expertise.
* Ongoing opportunity — Strong contributors are considered for contract extensions and additional projects.

0 - 3 years’ experience

title: Power System Study Senior Expert in Renewable
description:
**ETAP empowers customers to make informed decisions throughout the life cycle of their projects with innovative software solutions for electrical systems. By applying ETAP solutions, customers experience continuous intelligence during design and engineering and into operations and maintenance using a unified electrical digital twin platform. ETAP supports customers in their digital transformation and sustainable energy transitions for a green and smart future, helping them to prioritize safety, maximize reliability, and stay resilient.**
**Our employees' passion for excellence, innovation, and customer satisfaction is our most-prized resource. If you share that passion — and want to be part of a company that leads the energy transition towards a cleaner and more resilient world for future generations — we invite you to join us!**
**ETAP is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.**
**Job Title: PSS Expert in Renewable**
**Location: India or MEA**
**Employment Type:**
Full Time
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a senior
**Power Systems & Renewable Energy Specialist**
with deep expertise in renewable grid integration, dynamic modeling, Power Plant Controllers (PPCs), inverter-based resources (IBRs), grid-code compliance, and real-time Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) validation.
  
  
The ideal candidate will bring a combination of
**power-system engineering, renewable-energy integration, control-system development, simulation, and technical project leadership**
experience. This role will work across utility-scale Solar PV, Wind, BESS, and hybrid renewable-energy projects, partnering with utilities, transmission operators, OEMs, inverter manufacturers, EPCs, and project developers
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead power-system engineering, renewable-energy integration, and grid-compliance activities for utility-scale Solar PV, Wind, BESS, and hybrid renewable-energy projects.
* Provide technical leadership for Power Plant Controller (PPC), inverter control, and plant-level active/reactive power control solutions.
* Lead grid-integration and interconnection studies, including steady-state, dynamic, transient, contingency, and system-stability analysis.
* Develop, validate, and maintain power-system models using PSS/E, PSCAD/EMTDC, and other industry-standard simulation tools.
* Develop and validate dynamic and user-defined models for renewable plants, inverters, and PPCs.
* Design and validate PPC and inverter control strategies for normal operating conditions and grid disturbances, including voltage/frequency control and fault ride-through (FRT) requirements.
* Lead HIL testing and real-time simulation using platforms such as RTDS and OPAL-RT for inverter and PPC validation.
* Assess weak-grid and low-SCR conditions, voltage stability, dynamic performance, and controller interactions.
* Lead grid-code compliance assessments and validate performance through simulation and real-time testing.
* Coordinate technical activities across OEMs, inverter manufacturers, PPC suppliers, utilities, EPC contractors, and project owners.
* Lead technical discussions with utilities and transmission-system operators on grid interconnection, stability, protection, controls, and compliance requirements.
* Define technical requirements, review engineering deliverables, and ensure technical quality throughout project execution.
* Support projects from proposal and study definition through engineering, validation, commissioning, and customer acceptance.
* Provide technical mentoring and guidance to power-system engineers and project teams.
* Contribute to research and development, new modeling methodologies, and advanced renewable-grid integration solutions.

**Essential Qualifications & Technical Skills**

* Strong experience in power-system engineering and renewable-energy grid integration.
* Advanced proficiency in PSS/E.
* Strong experience with PSCAD/EMTDC and EMT/dynamic simulation.
* Experience with MATLAB/Simulink for control-system development and analysis.
* Experience developing and validating dynamic and user-defined models.
* Strong understanding of inverter-based resources, PPCs, grid-forming/grid-following controls, and renewable plant controls.
* Experience with grid-code requirements, interconnection studies, and system stability analysis.
* Programming experience in Fortran and/or C for model development and customization.
* Experience working with utilities, transmission operators, OEMs, or renewable-energy developers.

**Preferred / Additional Skills**

* Experience with RTDS / RSCAD and/or OPAL-RT.
* Experience with PowerWorld.
* Hands-on experience with Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) testing.
* Experience with weak-grid, low-SCR, voltage stability, and controller-interaction studies.
* Experience with BESS and hybrid renewable-energy systems.
* Experience leading technical projects or multidisciplinary engineering teams.
* Strong customer-facing and stakeholder-management skills.
* Experience preparing technical proposals, scopes of work, and engineering studies.
* Experience in research, development, and implementation of advanced power-system technologies.

What You'll Bring
  
  

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to translate complex power-system challenges into practical engineering solutions.
* Strong technical communication skills and the ability to engage effectively with customers, utilities, OEMs, and engineering teams.
* Ability to lead technical projects independently while mentoring and developing other engineers.
* A collaborative, hands-on approach to solving complex renewable-energy and grid-integration challenges.

Background checks will be conducted in accordance with local laws and may, subject to those laws, include proof of educational attainment, employment history verification, proof of work authorization, criminal records, identity verification, credit check. Certain positions dealing with sensitive and/or third party personal data may involve additional background check criteria.**

title: Manager, Technical Writer
description:
The MongoDB Documentation team is a group of writers and engineers who develop and maintain the documentation for the MongoDB product family. Our goal is to help our readers, both humans and AI, successfully use MongoDB products by providing outstanding documentation. The MongoDB Documentation team is a part of the MongoDB Core Product organization and is tightly integrated with the engineering teams responsible for each product. We are hiring a Manager Technical Writer to guide the creation of world-class documentation for the MongoDB data platform.
  
  
You will use your leadership skills to manage and grow a talented team of writers, prioritize and plan documentation projects, and influence the strategic vision for the MongoDB docs. Your AI-forward mindset coupled with strong writing and technical skills will guide production of clear reference docs and tutorials on high-complexity features. Your team’s work, along with the other two MongoDB Docs teams, support AI agents, answer engines, and a large global community of new and experienced MongoDB users.
  
  
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurgaon, Bengaluru or Mumbai for our hybrid working model.
  
  
Candidate Profile
  
  
Candidates must have extensive technical writing experience and 2+ years of experience managing a team of technical writers, developer advocates, or other technical communications-focused roles. Beyond that, we are looking for someone who:
  
  

* Is passionate about developing writing expertise on a team through reviews and mentorship
* Has experience prioritizing and planning documentation projects
* Works collaboratively with other documentation leaders and writers
* Grew a technical writing team through interviewing, hiring, and onboarding talented writers
* Has hands-on experience using AI tools to accelerate documentation work
* Leverages sound editorial judgment to evaluate AI-generated content against source material for technical accuracy
* Possesses strong critical reading and writing skills
* Has experience with cloud and database technologies
* Is able to write code for technical examples in at least one programming language (e.g., C++, C#, Java, Python, JavaScript). Comfortable reading and interpreting code

Position Expectations
  
  

* Lead a technical writing team with opportunity for team growth
* Integrate with a highly collaborative, globally distributed group of documentation leaders to build a strong cross-functional documentation team
* Work cross-functionally with Engineering, Product, Design, Developer Relations, and Product Marketing to ensure the documentation meets the needs of our users
* Guide the team's adoption of AI-assisted research, writing, and review workflows, ensuring quality and technical accuracy remain high
* Foster a positive and effective team culture
* Develop the writing, testing, and technical skills of the team through coaching
* Contribute feedback to the team through copy review and planning discussions
* Collaborate with Engineering and Product on the team’s roadmap
* Interview and hire talented writers for all areas of the MongoDB Docs team
* Advocate for users in everything your team produces
* Produce technically accurate and well-written documentation when time permits

In 3 months:
  
  

* You've met with all of your team members and are starting to learn their interests, strengths, and areas for development
* You’ve become comfortable with our toolchain, AI tooling, and writing workflow
* You're getting to know our partners in Engineering and Product Management
* You’re getting comfortable with participating in intra and inter team discussions
* You've completed any required technical and leadership training required for the MongoDB Product team

In 6 months:
  
  

* You review your team’s work and are using their writing to learn more about the MongoDB data platform
* You've adapted to our style of writing and instill technical writing best practices in team members’ work
* You have worked with each team member to develop a growth plan tailored to their career goals
* You and your manager have discussed your career trajectory and growth opportunities
* You've developed a working knowledge of MongoDB's products and know who to follow up with when you need to learn more
* You've helped the team improve and establish effective, well-vetted AI-assisted workflows for drafting and review

In 12 months:
  
  

* You're actively guiding the team to produce consistently high quality documentation for enterprise architectures, entire feature sets, complex tutorials, and high level concepts
* You know how much work your team can manage and are delivering content at a healthy pace
* You provide expert copy and technical reviews for your team members
* You provide best practices and coaching on AI-assisted workflows for your team members

**About MongoDB**
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
  
  
With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
  
  
Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
  
  
To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. The Senior Manager Digital & Technology Transformation Rooms Operations, APEC plays a critical role in Marriott’s Digital and Technology Transformation, reporting to Vice President, Operations, South Asia, with a dotted line to Director of Rooms Operations, APEC, based in Mumbai, Bangalore or New Delhi.
  
  
This role will provide a bridge between current and future processes in Rooms Operations, guiding hotels on the deployment of the new systems and business processes, supporting the guest and associate journey to ensure a smooth transition and cutover. The role will conduct workshops and trainings to transitioning hotels, ensuring that property teams are fully prepared to successfully operate the new systems from Day 1.

* End-to-End Testing and Product Validation: Contribute to end-to-end business process validation testing for the discipline, collaborating with relevant stakeholders in DGE, Rooms Operations, and Loyalty Operations disciplines in APEC

+ Ability to simplify complex concepts and provide clear direction during implementation and support phases.

description:

**Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It Possible.**
**Purpose of the Role**
The Supply Planning SME will serve as the BU's dedicated testing and adoption resource for the O9 Supply Planning module. Reporting into the region SP transformation lead, this role is responsible for executing test scripts, validating data integrity, supporting training delivery, and ensuring seamless transition from testing to go-live. The SME will act as the first line of support for end users, bridging the gap between the technical implementation team and the business, and championing user confidence and adoption of the new platform.

**Modelling Constraints & Validation:**
Lead Plan Quality Validation phase for multiple business units across region.
  
  
Work with Business stakeholders to gather the manufacturing constraints and model these constraints in O9.
  
  
Work with system integration partner and perform solver execution, perform RCA , analyse KPI , perform checklist against business requirements and flag issues to partner team.
  
  
Solve Solver related problems with consideration of sustainable and standardized solution representing AMEA.
  
  
Responsible for planning functional build & implementation/Working in testing and processes validation
  
  
Document Functional requirements / participate in fit gap analyses with regional functional stream lead
  
  
**Testing & Validation**

* Execute Integration Test (iTest) and UAT test scripts end-to-end for Supply Planning processes, ensuring 100% script coverage as per the test strategy
* Validate pre-load and post-load data accuracy during User Cutover Testing (UCUT), flagging discrepancies and coordinating resolution with the data and cutover teams
* Perform security role validation — test user access, roles, and permissions ahead of each testing phase
* Log, track, and follow up on defects in qTest/Jira, ensuring timely resolution within SLA and supporting retesting of failed test cases
* Execute E2E (End-to-End) scenario testing including cross-stream scenarios with Data Science, Supply Planning, and IBP
* Support pre-test preparation including batch job readiness, test script pre-requisites documentation, and environment checks
* Participate in daily testing war rooms, morning kick-offs, and end-of-day recaps to report progress, blockers, and pass rates

* Conduct shadow testing sessions — walk end users through test scripts and o9 navigation to build familiarity and confidence
* Act as a go-to resource for end users during testing phases, providing real-time guidance on o9 processes and ways of working
* Support the BU Champion in driving change management activities, user communications, and adoption governance
* Contribute to training material review and localization for BU-specific contexts

**Go-Live & Sustainment**

* Support Parallel Run execution — assist end users in running DILO/MILO cycles using real business cases to validate outcomes
* Participate in BU Readiness Checkpoints and contribute to UAT sign-off documentation
* Provide hyper care support post go-live, acting as the first point of contact for end-user queries and issues
* Document lessons learned, process gaps, and improvement opportunities from testing phases to feed into sustainment planning
* Support the institutionalization of new ways of working and standard operating procedures in the o9 platform

**Functional Support**

* Develop working-level expertise in the o9 Supply Planning module, including Master Production Scheduling, Distribution Planning, Truck Load Build.
* Support the BU Champion in fit-gap analysis, functional requirement documentation, and process design validation
* Participate in co-location events, workshops, and cross-functional design sessions as required
* Represent BU-specific scenarios and edge cases during testing to ensure comprehensive coverage

* Solid understanding of Supply Planning processes (Master Production Scheduling, Distribution Planning, Truck Load Build.
* 3–8 years of experience in Supply Chain Planning or a related operational role
* Familiarity with planning tools/systems; exposure to advanced planning solutions (o9, Kinaxis, OMP, SAP IBP) is a necessity.
* Strong attention to detail — ability to execute test scripts methodically and identify data discrepancies
* Comfortable working with testing tools (qTest, Jira) and documenting test results and defects
* Good communication skills — ability to train and support peers in a clear, structured manner
* Collaborative mindset with ability to work in cross-functional, multi-market teams under tight timelines
* Growth mindset, quick learner, and comfortable navigating ambiguity in a fast-paced transformation environment
* Proficiency in English; additional regional language skills are a plus

Software Solutions Engineer I plays a critical role and is responsible for upgrading client applications to the latest base versions. This involves a thorough understanding of the current application landscape and the new version's features and improvements. Post-upgrade, the engineer will identify, debug, and resolve any issues that arise. This ensures that the upgraded applications function seamlessly and meet client expectations. The engineer will analyze client code to identify deviations and determine what can be upgraded directly and what requires client confirmation. The Software Solutions Engineer I will work closely with various departments, including development, quality assurance, and client support teams, to ensure a smooth upgrade process and effective issue resolution
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Meticulously analyze and assess the impact of upgrades based on release notes and code changes for new release features. This involves understanding the nuances of each release and predicting how these changes will affect the existing applications.
* Debugs custom code and base code to provide workarounds or solutions to third-party implementation teams or customers. This requires a deep understanding of the application and the ability to quickly diagnose and resolve issues.
* Leverage Duck Creek upgrade tools to generate differential analysis and produce low-impact upgrade paths for Duck Creek customers.
* Leverage AI-driven tools and processes to identify automation opportunities and reduce manual effort across product upgrade and certification activities.
* Apply strong product implementation knowledge and technical expertise to effectively support product upgrade and certification processes
* Expected to operate with minimal supervision, demonstrating strong initiative, accountability, and self-reliance in managing assigned responsibilities.
* Identify opportunities to automate processes or develop utilities that assist in faster and more effective upgrades.
* Interacts with customer counterparts to triage issues and present solutions.
* Informs the Technical Lead and Project Manager of any issues and risk that may affect overall upgrade schedules.

* Perform all other duties and activities as required.
* Act in accordance with and as a good steward of Duck Creek Technologies mission, vision, and core values:

+ Mission: To empower insurers to reimagine the future of insurance
+ Vision: To transform insurance technology, helping insurers be smarter, faster, and more efficient, and ultimately provide the best protection for people and businesses
+ Values: We Prioritize Respect, We Listen, We Care, We Add Value, and We Lead

**What You’ve Done**
Education and Work Experience:
  
  


* Bachelor’s degree, or higher educational level, or foreign equivalent, in Computer Science strongly preferred
* Minimum 2 years’ related industry experience in system development and implementation
* Demonstrated proficiency in Analysis, Development, and Triage.
* Demonstrated proficiency and implementation experience in any of the Duck Creek Billing Product
* Basic understanding of Duck Creek Billing concepts such as billing forms, billing plans, payment plans, Direct Bill, Agency Bill, EFT/payment processing, and billing transactions
* Hands-on development experience with C#, .NET, SQL Server, XML/XSLT, REST/SOAP APIs, and Duck Creek extensibility/configuration
* Experience with SQL query development, stored procedures, database troubleshooting, and performance optimization
* Has developed foundational insurance domain knowledge and can apply it to support project delivery and problem-solving.

**Skills, Knowledge, Abilities, And Behaviors**

* Knowledge of insurance products a plus
* Experience/knowledge of P&C Insurance software applications a plus
* Experience/knowledge of software development life cycle for P&C insurance software a plus

description:

We’re fully committed to supporting your growth and development from the start with extensive on-the-job training and exposure to senior leaders, as well as more traditional learning. You’ll also have the chance to give back and make a positive impact on where we live and work through volunteerism.
  
  
**Shape your Career with Citi**
We’re currently looking for a high caliber professional to join our team as
**Vice President, Wholesale Credit Risk - In-Business Quality Assurance - Hybrid**
(Internal Job Title: Quality Assurance, Monitoring & Testing Lead Analyst-
**C13**
) based in Mumbai, India. Being part of our team means that we’ll provide you with the resources to meet your unique needs, empower you to make healthy decisions and manage your financial well-being to help plan for your future.
  
  
What We Offer -
  
  

* Opportunities to grow your career locally and collaborate with colleagues across Citi's global network.
* A hybrid working model that balances in-office collaboration with remote flexibility.
* Investment in your professional development through training programmes, mentorship, and skill-building opportunities.
* Employee wellbeing support including medical coverage, mental health resources, parental leave, and family support programmes.
* Competitive retirement contributions and investment options to support your long-term financial goals.

Institutional Credit Management’s (“ICM”) objective is to provide an integrated “end-to-end” credit underwriting, identification, measurement, management, monitoring for wholesale credit businesses across the enterprise. Wholesale Credit Risk (“WCR”) In-Business Quality Assurance (QA) is an integral part of the ICM organization.
  
  
WCR In-Business QA verifies that established standards and processes are followed and consistently applied. WCR and ICM Management utilize the results of Quality Assurance Reviews (QARs) to assess the quality of the group's policies, procedures, programs, and practices as relates to the management of wholesale credit risk. The results enable management to identify risks associated with operational and control weaknesses, training needs, and process deficiencies.
  
  
The WCR Head of In-Business QA reports results of QARs providing insight and observations on deficiency and areas of improvement, engaging management of the respective In-Business Credit Risk, Independent Risk, Banking & International Credit Review, Internal Audit and Regulators.
  
  
**In this role, you’re expected to:**

* Support the Portfolio Leads of In-Business QA in implementation and ongoing delivery of a robust Quality Assurance function covering WCR Underwriting (UW) portfolios - Institutional, Commercial and Wealth
* Execute High Frequency Testing across dynamic and specialized risk areas, delivering timely assurance and insights on emerging control risks
* Provide assurance over automated and system-driven credit risk controls, identifying control gaps and enhancement opportunities
* Identify opportunities to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of control testing through innovative approaches, automation opportunities, and process improvements
* Provide effective and credible challenge during QARs to Portfolio Leads and Underwriters, as regards to credit reviews and process adherence weaknesses in such processes are identified and escalated as appropriate
* Support with the aim to ensure wholesale credit risks within Citi are effectively identified, measured, monitored, and controlled, consistent with the bank’s risk appetite and all policies and processes established within the risk governance framework
* Under the supervision of the QA Head and QA Portfolio Lead, support execution of the following:

+ Consistent and objective assessments during QARs
+ Subsequent follow-up on corrective actions that were raised during QARs
+ Assist in preparation of Quality Assurance Reports to WCR management that communicate and measure results and identify negative trends and potential solutions

* Constant interaction with the respective 1LOD functions, to ensure that quality assurance protocols are adequate for all portfolios
* Support the Head of IBQA on internal projects and initiatives
* Support ICM Voice of the Employee (VOE) initiatives

**As a successful candidate, you’d ideally have the following skills and exposure:**

* Demonstrable strong assurance experience, including 10-12 years in corporate banking, credit risk management, internal audit, loan review or quality assurance review function at an investment or large commercial bank
* Knowledge of Wholesale Credit Processes and organizational awareness, portfolios, and processes
* Understanding of policies and procedures with the ability to execute change seamlessly
* Strong grasp of the markets and lending wholesale credit risk covered process, to evaluate findings within the Quality Assurance process, determine and partner with In-Business Credit Risk for ongoing improvement, problem detection and sustainable remediation
* Strong background on core credit analysis for large corporate and finance industries to properly evaluate process and quality breaks within the quality assurance function
* Ideally, credit risk Internal Audit, control assurance, credit officer/analyst or credit risk background, with experience on day-to-day credit functions associated with analysts and risk approval
* High awareness and adherence to the control environment including Quality Assurance
* Strategic orientation to ensure the ICM organization continues to be positioned as a thoughtful and proactive partner on driving best practices to support safety and soundness within ICM and Citi
* Assists colleagues in identifying stretch opportunities to elevate individual and team performance
* Proven culture carrier

Competencies:
  
  

* Highly Effective interpersonal skills, with the ability to build relationships and exert influence with and without direct authority with Senior Levels of Management
* Strong organizational skills with ability to manage priorities effectively
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and concisely to audiences of varying levels of seniority
* Advanced Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, and PowerPoint) skills

Qualifications:
  
  

* BA/BSc or higher degree in Business (MBA)/ or equivalent or any other related subject

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a family of more than 230,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.
