title: Business Data Specialist - Product/Material
description:
At Dow, we believe in putting people first and we’re passionate about delivering integrity, respect and safety to our customers, our employees and the planet.
  
  
Our people are at the heart of our solutions. They reflect the communities we live in and the world where we do business. Their diversity is our strength. We’re a community of relentless problem solvers that offers the daily opportunity to contribute with your perspective, transform industries and shape the future. Our purpose is simple - to deliver a sustainable future for the world through science and collaboration. If you’re looking for a challenge and meaningful role, you’re in the right place.
  
  
**About You And This Role**
**Dow**
has an exciting opportunity of a
**Business Data Specialist - Product/Material**
in the Enterprise Data & Artificial Intelligence (ED&AI) – Data Foundation team. This role is located in
**Navi Mumbai**
.
  
  
In this role you will support the creation, maintenance, and quality of critical enterprise product and material master data that enables business operations and analytics. This role applies to foundational knowledge of business processes, data standards, and information systems to ensure data is accurate, timely, and aligned with enterprise policies and standards.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Using an in-depth understanding of business operational needs to oversee the creation and maintenance of product and materials.
* Working with the businesses to improve data maintenance processes.
* Run the business support for master data request process for create, change, discontinue, and reactivate requests
* Ensuring material data meets quality standards established with the business.
* Helps manage data quality audits and cycle time metrics.
* Works within clearly defined standard operating procedures and adheres to quality guidelines for the business.
* Creating work process documents for the business in accordance with Dow company standards, ensuring that the needs of the business and its customers are met.
* Investigate and resolve routine data issues, escalating complex cases when appropriate.
* Serving as a focal point for business’s data trouble shooting issues
* Monitor assigned workloads and service requests to meet established service levels and business expectations.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in information systems, Business, Data Science, or related field.
* 3-5 years of experience in Material Management.
* SAP ECC
* ServiceNow
* Product/Material master data management
* Effective communication and collaboration skills.

**Skills:**

* PMR (Product/Material Request)
* MDG (Master Data Governance)
* Experience with using PowerBI
* Excellent Microsoft Office skills
* Demonstrate strong written and verbal communication skills
* Demonstrate strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and ability to collaborate effectively.

**Additional Notes:**

* This position does not offer relocation assistance.
* The ability to accommodate a flexible schedule aligned with international time zones is essential

**Benefits – What Dow Offers You**
We invest in you.
  
  
Dow invests in total rewards programs to help you manage all aspects of you: your pay, your health, your life, your future, and your career. You bring your background, talent, and perspective to work every day. Dow rewards that commitment by investing in your total wellbeing.
  
  
Here are just a few highlights of what you would be offered as a Dow employee:
  
  

* Equitable and market-competitive base pay and bonus opportunity across our global markets, along with locally relevant incentives.
* Benefits and programs to support your physical, mental, financial, and social well-being, to help you get the care you need...when you need it.
* Competitive retirement program that may include company-provided benefits, savings opportunities, financial planning, and educational resources to help you achieve your long term financial-goals.

+ Employee stock purchase programs (availability varies depending on location).

* Student Debt Retirement Savings Match Program (U.S. only).

+ Dow will take the value of monthly student debt payments and apply them as if they are contributions to the Employees’ Savings Plan (401(k)), helping employees reach the Company match.

* Robust medical and life insurance packages that offer a variety of coverage options to meet your individual needs. Travel insurance is also available in certain countries/locations.
* Opportunities to learn and grow through training and mentoring, work experiences, community involvement and team building.
* Workplace culture empowering role-based flexibility to maximize personal productivity and balance personal needs.
* Competitive yearly vacation allowance.
* Paid time off for new parents (birthing and non-birthing, including adoptive and foster parents).
* Paid time off to care for family members who are sick or injured.
* Paid time off to support volunteering and Employee Resource Group’s (ERG) participation.
* Wellbeing Portal for all Dow employees, our one-stop shop to promote wellbeing, empowering employees to take ownership of their entire wellbeing journey.
* On-site fitness facilities to help stay healthy and active (availability varies depending on location).
* Employee discounts for online shopping, cinema tickets, gym memberships and more.

+ Transportation allowance (availability varies depending on location)
+ Meal subsidiaries/vouchers (availability varies depending on location)
+ Carbon-neutral transportation incentives e.g. bike to work (availability varies depending on location)

Join our team, we can make a difference together.
  
  
**About Dow Chemical International Pvt Ltd**
Dow Chemical International Private Limited (Dow India) aims to be the most innovative, sustainable, inclusive customer-centric materials science company. The company is committed to delivering the right solutions to its customers’ challenges. With broadest technology sets spanning performance materials, industrial intermediates, and plastics Dow India delivers differentiated science-based products and solutions in high-growth segments, such as packaging, infrastructure, automobile, and consumer care.
  
  
A Great Place to Work® Certified company with approximately over 1000 employees, its operations comprise of manufacturing sites, innovation center, established centers of excellence, and commercial office. As a responsible corporate, the company supports its Corporate Social Responsibility (program) with technology expertise and employee volunteerism. Dow India works with non-profit partners towards the empowerment of differently abled, women, and children in communities where it operates. title: Performance Marketing - Founder's Office
description:
**About the Job:**

The Choosy Investor simplifies real estate investing in India, focusing entirely on consumer interests in the real estate sector. Through syndicate investing, the company negotiates bulk discounts for buyers by aggregating multiple interested investors. They work only with trustworthy, legally vetted properties and provide seamless site visit coordination, complete with premium customer support. Offering zero brokerage services, The Choosy Investor guides clients through the entire home-buying process, including legal procedures and home loan assistance, ensuring an optimized and hassle-free investment experience.

**Role Description:**

This is an Onsite role for a Performance Marketing Expert. The role involves developing and executing digital marketing campaigns, optimizing marketing strategies for social media and other online platforms, and analyzing campaign performance to meet organizational goals. Responsibilities also include collaborating with the sales team to drive revenue growth and contributing to strategy discussions for market positioning.

**Multi-Channel Paid Acquisition:**

Scaling high-performance campaigns across Meta (Advantage+), Google (Search, PMax, Display), and LinkedIn.Native & Content Discovery: Leveraging Taboola and Outbrain to drive top-of-funnel awareness and mid-funnel intent via discovery-based placements.

**Full-Lifecycle Email Marketing:**

Building and managing automated email drip campaigns to nurture cold leads into site visits and bookings.

**Advanced Tracking & Attribution:**

Implementing server-side tracking, CAPI, and multi-touch attribution to accurately map the real estate buyer's journey.

**Funnel Optimization:**

Engineering high-converting landing pages and lead-capture flows with constant A/B testing.

**Marketing Automation:**

Seamlessly connecting lead flows to CRMs and triggering instant multi-channel nurture sequences (Email, WhatsApp, SMS).

**Tech Stack:**

**AI tools:**

Should be able to use AI tools to increase daily work efficiency.

**Ad Platforms:**

Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager.

**Native & Discovery:**

Taboola, Outbrain, or Microsoft Audience Network.

**Email & Automation:**

Mailchimp, ActiveCampaign, Klaviyo, or Brevo (formerly Sendinblue).

**Analytics & Ops:**

Google Analytics 4 (GA4), GTM (Server-Side), Looker Studio/Tableau.

**CRM & Leads:**

Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho, or industry-specific CRM platforms.

**Workflow Automation:**

n8n, Zapier, or Make.com.

**Landing Pages:**

Unbounce, Instapage, or Leadpages.

**What we're looking for:**

**Performance Marketing Expertise:**
0–5 years of experience in performance marketing, digital advertising, or lead generation. Freshers with a strong understanding of digital marketing fundamentals and a willingness to learn are also welcome.

**Native Advertising Knowledge:**
Basic to advanced understanding of native advertising platforms such as Taboola or Outbrain. Experience in running native ad campaigns and generating quality leads will be an added advantage.

**Email Marketing & Lead Nurturing:**
Understanding of email marketing, audience segmentation, and lead nurturing strategies to engage prospects throughout a longer sales cycle.

**Data-Driven Approach:**
Ability to analyse campaign performance and optimise key metrics such as Cost Per Lead (CPL), lead quality, conversion rates, and Return on Ad Spend (ROAS).

**Tracking & Analytics:**
Familiarity with tracking pixels, UTM parameters, Google Analytics, and campaign tracking tools. Knowledge of API-based integrations and data tracking will be an added advantage.

**Nice to have:**

* Knowledge of WhatsApp Business API for automated lead qualification and follow-ups.
* Exposure to PropTech, real estate marketing, or high-ticket lead generation.
* Basic knowledge of HTML/CSS for email and landing page customisation.
* Hands-on experience with Meta Ads, Google Ads, or other digital advertising platforms.
* Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and a willingness to experiment with new marketing strategies.

This is a high-ownership opportunity for someone who is eager to learn, take initiative, and contribute to building effective performance marketing strategies. You will have the opportunity to work with experienced professionals, explore new marketing channels, and grow your expertise while driving meaningful business results.

Intellect Design Arena

About Intellect Design Arena

Intellect Design Arena is a global leader in Financial Technology, revolutionizing the future of banking through AI-first platforms and solutions. We empower global financial institutions to transform their operations and deliver cutting-edge digital experiences.

**Role Overview**

Banking is being rewritten by AI, and we need a dynamic Digital Product Marketing Manager to write the story. Sitting at the intersection of strategy, product expertise, and compelling content creation, you will make Intellect the first name CIOs and CTOs think of when they think of AI-first banking.

You will own our content engine—translating complex product capabilities into sharp, high-impact stories, thought leadership, and digital commentary that senior banking decision-makers can't stop arguing with or forwarding.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Own the Narrative:**
  Position Intellect authentically as an "AI-first banking technology company" by turning products, platforms, and customer outcomes into narratives banking leaders care about.
* **Drive Strategic Industry Commentary:**
  Track banking, AI, enterprise tech, and regulations like a hawk to publish sharp, opinionated commentary on what shifts mean for banks.
* **End-to-End Content Creation:**
  Research, draft, edit, and ship high-value content across formats, including LinkedIn posts, blogs, white papers, case studies, video scripts, and executive interviews.
* **Build & Engage Senior Audience:**
  Grow and engage a following of senior decision-makers (CIOs, CTOs, IT leaders) by using performance data to continuously refine content strategy.
* **Integrate Organic & Paid Performance:**
  Collaborate with performance marketing to deploy content through targeted organic and paid digital levers for maximum visibility and demand generation.
* **Deep Product & SME Engagement:**
  Partner closely with product specialists and SMEs to connect complex technical capabilities directly to business outcomes on a CIO’s desk.
* **AI-Powered Workflow:**
  Leverage modern AI tools for research, ideation, drafting, repurposing, and optimization, while maintaining rigorous editorial judgment.

Qualifications & Skill Set

* **Education:**
  MBA from a Tier 1 or Tier 2 business school (Marketing specialized preferred) or a Postgraduate qualification in Digital Marketing from a reputed institution.
* **Experience:**
  Around 4–5 years of experience in B2B tech marketing, SaaS product marketing, or content/thought leadership roles.
* **Industry Domain:**
  Solid understanding of financial technology (FinTech), banking software, enterprise software, or the ability to grasp complex tech domains quickly.
* **Content Expertise:**
  Proven track record in B2B storytelling, executive thought leadership, case study development, white papers, and social media engagement (especially LinkedIn).
* **Modern Marketing Stack:**
  Fluency with AI marketing tools, social listening, SEO, web analytics, and marketing automation platforms.
* **Mindset:**
  Proactive ownership, strong editorial judgment, strategist's vision, researcher's curiosity, and a bias toward shipping impact over fluff.

title: Technical Marketing Engineer - 8 to 15 yrs
description:
**Meet the Team**
Cisco is an authority in Data Center and AI networking innovation, building cutting-edge solutions that enable businesses to harness artificial intelligence and advanced data center networking technologies. We seek an experienced Technical Marketing Engineer (TME) specializing on NX-OS architectures include AI networking solutions to join our dynamic team. Here, you will have the opportunity to work on developing the Nexus 9000 line of data center switches and their associated software that features application awareness, to make the network infrastructure flexible and agile for dynamic response to application needs, virtual machine workload mobility and cloud extension.
  
  
You will work with a diverse group of problem solvers and creative thinkers focusing on the Nexus 9000, NXOS, Nexus Dashboard and network fabric for Artificial Intelligence (AI) applications. The role requires a high level of initiative, energy and rapid thinking.
  
  
**Your Impact**
As a NX-OS Networking Technical Marketing Engineer, you will bridge the gap between our engineering, sales, and marketing teams. You will play a pivotal role in driving product adoption by demonstrating technical expertise, creating impactful marketing collateral, and engaging with customers to showcase the value of our Nexus offering for all Data Center Architectures include AI networking solutions. This hands-on role requires a good degree technical proficiency, marketing strategy, and customer interaction.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
This multifaceted role offers an opportunity to influence product direction while working closely with strategic customers and partners on next-generation data center solutions.
  
  
**Technical Expertise And Enablement**

* Act as a technical expert for NX-OS architectures include NDFC, Nexus Dashboard networking products and solutions.
* Collaborate with major customers and Sales teams to understand and fulfill their Data Center Network Fabric requirements.
* Partner with engineering and product management to define and refine product requirements and solutions.
* Develop and execute the technical strategy for NX-OS include Nexus Dashboard, focusing on AI-driven automation and AIOps.
* Provide technical training, demonstrations, and support to internal teams, partners, and customers.
* Represent the team & lead technical Deceptive sessions at large Cisco and Industry events

**Marketing And Content Creation**

* undefined
* Develop technical marketing collateral, including white papers, solution briefs, case studies, technical presentations, and videos.
* Write and present thought leadership content, such as blog posts, webinars, and conference presentations.
* Collaborate with the product and marketing teams to define messaging and positioning for DC networking solutions.

**Customer Engagement**

* Work closely with customers to understand their use cases, gather feedback, and demonstrate product capabilities.
* Partner with the sales team to support pre-sales efforts, including delivering proof-of-concept (POC) demonstrations and addressing technical queries.

**Solution Development**

* Develop and showcase real-world use cases and demos to highlight DC networking capabilities.
* Partner with the engineering team to provide feedback for continuous product improvement.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Electrical Engineering, or related field with 10-12 years of experience in technical marketing, product Engineering, pre-sales engineering, or a related technical role.
* Expertise in DC networking technologies like VxLAN, cloud, virtualization and knowledge of routing protocols such as BGP, OSPF, ISIS, including high-performance computing (HPC), RDMA, Ethernet etc
* Experience in working with various software defined network controllers, ansible and other automation technologies.
* Strong understanding of networking concepts, protocols, and hardware (e.g., switches, NICs, DPUs).
* Ability to tackle sophisticated problems creatively. Good verbal and writing skills. Able to create white papers for publishing on Cisco’s website. Must be a great teammate and work well in small and large group environments. Comfortable presenting to customers and Cisco employees.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: Senior Business Development Manager – Sustainability & Environmental Solutions
description:

We are looking for an experienced and commercially driven
**Senior Business Development Manager – Sustainability & Environmental Solutions**
to build and expand our sustainability and environmental services business across the UAE and wider GCC region.

The ideal candidate should have a strong technical background in environmental engineering or sustainability, combined with proven business development capabilities.

* **International Partnerships:**
  Experience developing international technology or strategic partnerships will be an advantage.
* **Education:**
  B.Tech / M.Tech in Environmental Engineering or Environmental Science.
* **Location:**
  India.
* **Travel:**
  Must be comfortable travelling to the UAE and other GCC countries as required.

Proposed Operating Model

**India – Primary Operations**

**The candidate will be primarily based in India and responsible for:**

* Market research and business planning.
* Identifying international technology partners.
* Approaching prospective clients and generating leads.
* Developing technical and commercial proposals.
* Conducting online client meetings and follow-ups.
* Managing the sales pipeline.

* Meeting government, corporate and industrial clients.
* Visiting oil and gas companies and EPC contractors.
* Developing strategic business partnerships.
* Attending relevant industry events and networking opportunities.

  Weekly.

  Weekly.

  Monthly.

Travel frequency can be increased based on business requirements and the availability of significant opportunities.

Preference should be given to candidates who:

* Have previously worked in UAE or GCC markets.
* Have established contacts in environmental consultancy, oil and gas, EPC or industrial sectors.
* Can independently approach senior corporate executives and decision-makers.
* Have experience identifying and developing international technology partnerships.
* Are comfortable with international business travel.
* Can independently prepare technical and commercial proposals.

Additional Strategic Responsibility – International Technology Partnerships

**at least 5–10 established international sustainability and environmental technology companies**
interested in entering the Middle East market through a regional business partner.

Potential technology and business segments include:

* Methane detection and monitoring.
* ESG and carbon accounting software.
* Energy efficiency technologies.

* Waste management and recycling technologies.

The objective is to establish strategic partnerships that can create opportunities in consultancy, regional distribution, technology implementation and recurring service contracts.

The success of this role will be measured primarily by the candidate's ability to:

* Build a strong UAE/GCC business pipeline.
* Generate qualified business opportunities.
* Acquire new corporate and industrial clients.
* Establish strategic international partnerships.
* Convert opportunities into signed projects and revenue.

title: Pre Sales Coordinator
description:
Role Purpose
  
  
The Pre Sales Coordinator ensures smooth execution of all post order win activities, bridging Business Development (BD), Legal, and Operations teams. The role focuses on accurate documentation, timely coordination, and compliance with internal processes to support successful project closures.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Documentation & Compliance
  
  

* Maintain Adhvanik Central for project activity tracking.
* Prepare and upload proposals, EPC, O&M, and Admin Purchase Orders.
* Collect client documents for KYC post-project win.
* Ensure NDAs, EPC agreement, O&M agreement, PPA agreement, Vendor registration forms are executed correctly from commercial perspectives.
* Ensuring proper onboarding of clients on Adhvanik Central platform co-ordination
* Follow-up with Design team for final drawings and client approvals for the same
* Schedule internal and external kickoff meetings with the internal team and client team.
* Liaise with BD, Operations and Legal teams for EPC agreement, PPA agreement and NDA and approvals.
* Liaison accounts team to raise PI and sharing with client
* Check client Purchase Order to ensure alignment with proposal
* Ensure complete handover of customer order details to the project team.

Key Performance Indicators
  
  

* % Completion Sales Related Project activity tasks within timelines
* % of Error free task completions
* % of Error free data provided for legal agreements
* Turnaround time for providing data and resolving legal agreement queries

Detailed Competency Attributes for Pre-Sales Coordinator
  
  

* Skills

Communication Skills: Ability to clearly articulate information, both verbally and in writing in ENGLISH, to internal teams and clients. This includes active listening, persuasive presentations, and effective follow-ups.
  
  
Coordination & Collaboration: Skilled at working across Business Development, Legal, Accounts and Operations teams to ensure smooth execution of post order win sales activities.
  
  
Documentation & Compliance: Proficient in preparing, reviewing, and maintaining accurate documentation (proposals, agreements, trackers) and ensuring compliance with internal processes.
  
  
Time Management: Prioritizing and completing tasks within deadlines, managing multiple responsibilities simultaneously.
  
  
Technical Proficiency: Familiarity with CRM systems, Adhvanik Central, and standard office software (Word, Excel, Teams, etc.).
  
  

* Knowledge

Process Knowledge: Deep understanding of sales workflows, documentation standards, and compliance requirements.
  
  
Product & Service Knowledge: Awareness of the company’s offerings, industry trends, and client requirements to tailor solutions effectively.
  
  
Legal & Commercial Understanding: Basic knowledge of legal agreements (NDAs, EPC, O&M, PPA) and commercial terms relevant to project execution.
  
  

* Traits

Attention to Detail: Ensures accuracy in documentation, data entry, and compliance checks.
  
  
Proactive & Resourceful: Takes initiative to resolve issues, escalate challenges, and seek help when needed.
  
  
Persistence: Follows up diligently with internal teams and clients to ensure timely completion of tasks.
  
  
Adaptability: Comfortable managing changing priorities and working in a dynamic environment.
  
  

* Motives

Commitment to Excellence: Driven to maintain high standards in documentation, compliance, and coordination.
  
  
Customer-Centric Mindset: Motivated by the desire to support successful project closures and client satisfaction.
  
  
Continuous Improvement: Seeks feedback and opportunities to enhance processes and personal performance.
  
  

* Self-Image

Trusted Coordinator: Sees themselves as a reliable bridge between teams, ensuring seamless pre-sales execution.
  
  
Quality Champion: Takes pride in delivering error-free work and upholding compliance standards.
  
  
Valued Team Player: Views their role as integral to the success of both the sales process and the broader organization.

title: Business Development Executive
description:
Ungrammary is an award-winning UX/UI design studio based in Mumbai. Leading brands trust us, including Adobe, Kotak Mahindra Bank, Adani Capital, AU Small Finance Bank, VMware and Fossil. Our work spans fintech, SaaS, healthcare, retail and consumer products, and is used by millions of people.

Clutch ranks us among the Top 20 UX agencies globally and the Top 5 in India. Our work has won the iF Design Award 2024, the International Design Award (IDA) and the DNA Paris Design Award.

We're a founder-led team of strategists, designers and growth-driven minds, and we're looking for a Business Development Executive to help us scale.

**The role**

We're hiring a Business Development Executive to grow Ungrammary's business with mid-size and enterprise clients in the design and tech space. You'll own the full sales cycle, from generating leads to pitching and closing high-value deals.

This is a services sales role. You won't be selling a product with a fixed price and feature list. You'll be selling our team's thinking, craft and track record, where every engagement is shaped around a client's problem. That takes confident, clear communication with decision-makers, and pitches built with empathy for what the client actually needs.

The role is hybrid and based in Mumbai, working closely with the founders, design and marketing.

**What you'll do**

* Generate leads through outreach, referrals, LinkedIn, events and digital platforms, as well as your own network.
* Identify companies that need UX/UI, product design, design systems or digital transformation work, especially in fintech, SaaS, healthcare and enterprise.
* Run discovery calls to understand a prospect's business problem, timelines and budget.
* Work with the founders and design leads to shape tailored pitches, proposals, scopes of work and estimates.
* Present Ungrammary's work to decision-makers, handle objections and close deals with mid-size and enterprise clients.
* Build long-term relationships with clients and grow existing accounts through follow-on work.
* Manage multiple leads, proposals and follow-ups at the same time.
* Track lead movement in the CRM and keep detailed records of calls, conversations and proposals.
* Report on pipeline, conversions and revenue, and contribute to monthly sales goals and growth metrics.
* Coordinate with marketing, design and leadership to refine outreach and sales strategy.
* Stay current on industry trends, competitors and new opportunities in UX/UI and product design.
* Represent Ungrammary at client meetings, industry events and networking sessions in Mumbai.

**What we're looking for**

* 2+ years of experience in business development, B2B sales or client servicing.
* A graduate degree, plus either an MBA or prior sales experience.
* Experience selling services, such as agency, consulting or IT services work. Product-only sales experience (SaaS licences, hardware, consumer products) is not a fit for this role.
* Excellent spoken and written English, with strong storytelling and presentation skills.
* Confidence in leading conversations with founders and senior decision-makers.
* Ability to understand a client's problem and turn it into a clear, persuasive pitch.
* Strong Excel skills and comfort with CRM tools, sales trackers and data reporting.
* A proactive, target-driven and collaborative way of working, with minimal handholding.
* Genuine interest in design, technology and building long-term client relationships.
* Based in Mumbai and able to meet clients in person.

**Bonus points**

* Agency background, especially in a design, tech, digital or creative agency.
* An MBA from a premier institute.
* Experience selling design, UX or digital product services.
* An existing network among startups, fintech companies or enterprise teams in Mumbai.
* Experience with CRM tools such as HubSpot or Zoho.
* Comfort using AI tools for research, outreach and proposal drafting.

**Working model and compensation**

* **Location:**
  Mumbai.
* **Working model:**
  Hybrid — a mix of remote work and in-person days, with no fixed schedule. Office and client days vary week to week, based on client meetings and team needs.
* **Compensation:**
  Fixed pay plus performance-based incentives on the business you bring in.

**Why join us**

* Sell work you can be proud of, for brands used by millions.
* Work directly with the founders and shape how Ungrammary grows.
* High ownership and autonomy, with a direct line between your effort and the company's growth

title: Remote Sales Representative 2 - Virtual Engagement Solutions
description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.
  
  
**A Day in the Life**
Virtual Engagement Solutions (VES) is focused on expanding customer reach, increasing engagement with existing and prospective accounts, and driving commercial growth through remote customer interactions. VES partners with sales leaders across multiple Medtronic Operating Units to identify opportunities, support market development initiatives, and improve access to Medtronic therapies through a scalable virtual engagement model.
  
  
This position is based in Mumbai and follows a Flexible Hybrid work style. Occasional travel of approximately 5-10% may be required for team meetings, training, customer engagement activities, or collaboration with field sales teams.
  
  
The Remote Sales Representative 2 supports revenue growth by engaging customers remotely, identifying and qualifying sales opportunities, and collaborating closely with field sales representatives. This role serves as a key customer contact, providing product education, managing sales leads, supporting territory planning activities, and helping maintain strong customer relationships within assigned accounts and geographies.
  
  
**Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:**

* Generate, qualify, and close sales opportunities within assigned customer accounts and territories.
* Engage customers remotely to promote Medtronic products and support patient retention initiatives.
* Collaborate with field sales representatives to coordinate account activities and customer follow-up.
* Identify new business opportunities and route appropriate leads to internal stakeholders.
* Provide product education and support customer awareness of Medtronic therapies and solutions.
* Coordinate product demonstrations and customer interactions with field sales teams.
* Analyse customer and sales data to support territory planning and account growth strategies.
* Resolve customer inquiries and escalate issues as needed to ensure a positive customer experience.

**Required Knowledge and Experience:**

* High School Diploma (or equivalent) AND 6+ years experience
* OR Associate’s Degree AND 4+ years experience\*
* OR Bachelor’s Degree AND 2+ years experience\*

**Preferred:**

* Experience supporting customer accounts within the healthcare, medical device, or medical technology industry.
* Experience working in partnership with field-based sales representatives.
* Knowledge of cardiovascular or neuroscience product portfolios.
* Bachelor’s degree in biomedical engineering or related technical healthcare discipline.
* Experience delivering product education, customer presentations, or virtual product demonstrations.

**Physical Job Requirements**
The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position.
  
  
‌
  
  
‌
  
  
**Recruitment Fraud Alert**
We are aware of phishing scams targeting job seekers. Please keep the following in mind:
  
  
Apply only through official Medtronic channels. All legitimate Medtronic recruiting communications come from approved Medtronic platforms and official @medtronic.com email addresses.
  
  
Medtronic will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information (such as bank account or Social Security details) during early stages of the hiring process. Any such requests are not legitimate.
  
  
If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Medtronic, do not respond, click links, or open attachments.
  
  
If you have any questions, concerns regarding the authenticity of a communication alleged to have been made by or on behalf of Medtronic, please contact us immediately at AskHR@medtronic.com.
  
  
**Benefits & Compensation**
**Medtronic offers a competitive Salary and flexible Benefits Package**
A commitment to our employees lives at the core of our values. We recognize their contributions. They share in the success they help to create. We offer a wide range of benefits, resources, and competitive compensation plans designed to support you at every career and life stage.

title: Business Development Executive
description:
Aqdas Business Solutions Pvt. Ltd. is looking for a proactive, commercially driven and results-oriented Business Development Executive to identify new business opportunities, acquire clients, develop markets and generate revenue.

The candidate will be responsible for developing business across services such as business consulting, management solutions, branding, creative design, digital marketing, website development, business software, technology and process automation.

This is a hands-on, target-driven B2B sales role for someone who can independently identify prospects, initiate contact, conduct meetings, present suitable solutions, negotiate and convert opportunities into paid engagements; not merely generate leads or arrange meetings.

Key skills required:

The candidate should have practical knowledge of:

● B2B sales, business development, market research, prospect identification and lead qualification

● Cold calling, personalised email outreach, LinkedIn prospecting and field sales

● Business networking, referral generation and partnership development

● Understanding client requirements, consultative selling, service presentations and commercial proposals

● Negotiation, objection handling, deal closure, revenue targets and payment coordination

● Sales pipeline management, CRM, structured follow-ups and profitability awareness

● Professional written and verbal communication; digital and AI-assisted research tools

Key responsibilities:

1. Independently identify potential clients and new business opportunities across industries and approved markets.

2. Generate leads through cold calling, emails, networking, digital platforms, referrals, exhibitions and physical visits; approach business owners and decision-makers.

3. Conduct online and in-person meetings, understand business challenges and recommend relevant services and solutions.

4. Qualify prospects based on requirements, budget, urgency, decision-making authority and commercial feasibility; discuss indicative pricing before preparing proposals.

5. Coordinate and prepare service proposals, scopes of work, presentations and quotations within approved frameworks; present proposals, address concerns, negotiate and close standard engagements.

6. Manage incoming enquiries, follow up consistently and reconnect with dormant prospects and previously unsuccessful opportunities. 2

7. Develop referral networks and channel partnerships; identify repeat business, cross-selling and expansion opportunities.

8. Coordinate client confirmations, commercial documentation, advance payments and subsequent payment follow-ups; hand over confirmed engagements with documented commitments.

9. Maintain prospect databases, sales pipelines, communication records, activity reports and revenue forecasts; monitor competitor offerings, pricing and customer feedback.

10. Achieve assigned client acquisition, sales, revenue and collection targets while ensuring profitability and adherence to approved commercial policies.

Candidate profile:

The ideal candidate should be:

● Proactive, self-motivated, commercially driven and capable of independently generating and converting business opportunities

● Confident approaching unfamiliar businesses and senior decision-makers; comfortable with cold calling, field visits and networking

● Able to understand business problems and recommend suitable solutions

● Skilled in persuasion, negotiation and objection handling; persistent and resilient

● Disciplined in follow-ups, documentation and reporting; fluent in English and Hindi, with Marathi advantageous

● Professional, ethical, dependable and accountable for outcomes

● Adaptable to a growing, multi-service business environment and willing to travel for client visits

Preference will be given to candidates with experience in:

● B2B sales with proven independent prospecting, client acquisition, negotiation and deal closure against measurable revenue and collection targets

● Business consulting, digital marketing, branding, website development, IT, SaaS or professional services

● Selling to SMEs, business owners and corporate decision-makers through field-based and digital business development

● Domestic and international client acquisition

Selection process:

Shortlisted candidates may be required to complete a practical sales assignment and participate in a simulated client meeting or sales presentation. 3

Final selection will be based on:

● Relevant experience and previous sales performance

● Practical knowledge and client acquisition capabilities

● Communication clarity, negotiation and deal-closing capabilities

● Role suitability

● Assignment performance

● Salary fitment

● Availability/notice period

title: Systems Engineer, APAC Controls Deployment and Service Team
description:
**Description**
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
  
  
The Data Center Capacity Delivery Asia-Pacific Controls Deployment and Service (DCCD APAC CDS) team delivers and services the control systems which monitor and ensure the health of our data centers. APAC CDS’ mission is to safely provide our customers with the unmatched reliability, security, and performance that AWS is known for. APAC CDS covers six disciplines of deployments, projects, service, colo, on-call support, and management.
  
  
As Amazonians, we work in a competitive environment. Our customers are always beautifully, wonderfully dissatisfied. Being successful in our roles is not just about doing our jobs well, but also evolving and innovating. Change is the only constant, and applies to our customers, our roles, our team organization, our tools, and our mechanisms.
  
  
To be successful in this team, you will also have:
  
  
Ability to thrive at the pace and scale of Amazon
  
  
Ability to work independently and manage multiple competing priorities
  
  
Ability and willingness to collaborate with peers around the globe, which may involve some participation in meetings at odd hours
  
  
Ability and willingness to travel domestically or globally as and when needed
  
  
Are you experienced in building and managing Windows systems, with a passion for maintaining highly-available IT infrastructure and services at a massive scale? The Controls Fleet team is responsible for supporting some of Amazon's most critical infrastructure services. As part of Amazon Web Services (AWS), we power the infrastructure behind the world's premier e-commerce and cloud computing environments. To meet the growing demand for AWS services worldwide, we seek exceptionally motivated individuals driven by learning and innovation. We are looking for a passionate and motivated Windows Engineer to join our team of Systems Engineers.
  
  
By joining us, you'll become part of a world-class team in a dynamic environment with the entrepreneurial spirit of a start-up. This is an opportunity to operate and engineer systems on a massive scale, gaining world-class experience in managing and supporting critical infrastructure. You'll work alongside passionate individuals dedicated to deploying and supporting essential IT infrastructure that powers AWS.
  
  
The ideal candidate will be innovative, possess excellent problem-solving and analytical skills, and thrive in a fast-paced environment. They should have a keen attention to detail and the ability to solve problems at their root. The Controls Fleet Operations team services customers globally, requiring the ability to manage multiple tasks and adapt to different challenges.
  
  
In addition, the ideal candidate should have an expert understanding of Windows tools such as Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, Hyper-V, Windows Failover Clustering, and System Center Configuration Manager (SCCM). Proficiency in PowerShell and windows automation are essential. This role demands a solid foundation in networking principles and hands-on experience with hardware troubleshooting and system building.
  
  
**Following Technical Skills Are Required**

* Cross-platform Expertise (Windows/Linux): Proficient in managing mostly Windows but Linux environments as well. For Windows skills, this includes experience with Active Directory/LDAP, Group Policy, and system administration. Skilled in PowerShell or Python scripting, with the ability to implement cross-platform security measures and manage core network services like DNS and DHCP.
* Enterprise-scale Automation: Experienced in developing and implementing large-scale automation solutions using Python, PowerShell, and configuration management tools. Capable of creating efficient global deployment scripts, integrating automated testing, and utilizing version control systems to maintain and optimize infrastructure as code.
* Network Redundancy and Optimization: Adept at configuring layer two network setups for maximum reliability and performance. This includes implementing NIC teaming, load balancing, and failover clustering. Skilled in network administration of larger layer two networks with layer three switch and routing concepts.

**Other Relevant Skills**

* High-availability Configurations: Skilled in designing and maintaining high-availability systems through clustering services, load balancer setups, and redundancy planning. Experienced in conducting failover testing, implementing robust disaster recovery procedures, and setting up continuous system health monitoring to ensure maximum uptime.
* AWS Cloud Integration: Well-versed in AWS services and their implementation in enterprise environments. Able to manage cloud resources effectively, optimize costs, and integrate AWS automation tools. Experienced in implementing cloud security best practices and designing hybrid cloud configurations that leverage AWS Systems Manager, EC2, and S3.
* Storage Solutions and RAID Management: Experienced in designing and managing enterprise storage solutions, including RAID array configuration and optimization. Proficient in implementing backup and recovery solutions, planning for data redundancy, and managing storage capacity. Capable of setting up monitoring tools and implementing disaster recovery procedures.

If you are passionate about technology, excited by the prospect of working in a dynamic, fast-paced environment, and driven to solve complex problems, we would love to hear from you.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Innovation and Problem Solving: Utilize creativity and analytical skills to solve complex problems and implement innovative solutions.
* Adaptability: Quickly adjust to changing priorities and manage multiple tasks efficiently.
* Large-Scale Windows Server Environments: Design, build, and support extensive Windows server environments.
* Enterprise Tooling: Implement and manage enterprise-scale tooling, such as SCCM, for a large Windows fleet.
* Automation and Scripting: Develop and implement best practices for automating tasks and scripting in large server environments. Proficiency in PowerShell is essential.
* Hardware Troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve hardware issues, with hands-on experience in system building.
* Networking and Windows Administration: Strong understanding of networking principles and expert-level Windows administration.
* Global Deployment: Create scripts and automation tasks applicable to a global server fleet.
* On call: Participate in a 24x7 on call rotation that supports global customers
* Documentation: processes, maintain run-books, and contribute to continuous improvements of Amazon Control Systems support practices. Enhance knowledge sharing and drive process enhancements.

A day in the life
  
  
Your day begins with a review of outstanding actions and site conditions alongside the Facility Manager, setting the work plan for your team. From there, you move into the data center environment—performing hands-on maintenance, supervising corrective work, and responding to emergent situations where your technical judgment guides risk mitigation. You may serve as the Incident Commander during event response, coordinate with partner teams on complex problems, and identify opportunities to improve processes that keep our infrastructure reliable.
  
  
**About The Team**
About AWS
  
  
Diverse Experiences
  
  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS?
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

description:
**Project Executive/Lean Consultant – Pharma**
==============================================

**Location:** Mumbai

**Experience:** 6–8 Years

**Employment Type:** Full-time

We are looking for hands-on Lean Consultants with experience in pharmaceutical manufacturing to drive Operational Excellence initiatives at client sites. The role involves working closely with plant teams to implement lean practices, improve operational efficiency and deliver measurable improvements across manufacturing and QC operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Site assessment and planning support:** Help run the opening site assessment (Gemba walks, process mapping, time and motion studies, and data collection) and turn its findings into your delivery plan with the programme manager.
* **Embed the tiered management system:** Set up and facilitate daily, weekly and monthly performance meetings. Build visual boards, define and track KPIs, and coach supervisors and managers until they run the meetings themselves.
* **Kaizen events:** Collect baseline data, design and facilitate Kaizen events (three heavily supported events per site), and follow up until the result is verified and sustained.
* **Problem solving:** Lead and coach structured problem solving on issues raised through the tiers (for example, A3, 5 Whys, fishbone, PDCA). Make sure actions close and gain hold.
* **Changeover and OEE:** Run quick changeover (SMED) studies and simple OEE loss analysis on equipment and process lines. Implement practical improvements; full TPM is not in scope.
* **Lean Lab:** Apply Lean in QC and analytical labs: map sample and test flow, reduce test turnaround time and workload, and run 5S to create flow.
* **Basic scheduling:** Support simple batch-size and campaign-frequency improvements where they release capacity.
* **Training delivery:** Deliver the programme's standard training modules (Yellow Belt and Green Belt level) and support trainees through their projects.
* **Benefits and reporting:** Quantify and record benefits from each improvement against an agreed baseline, and feed the programme manager's benefit tracking, site governance and progress reports.
* **Work to the standard:** Follow the programme's playbooks and delivery standard, and build site capability rather than doing the work for the site, so it can sustain the system after the programme ends.

**Educational Qualification**

* Engineering degree (chemical, mechanical, industrial or production) or B.Pharm / M.Pharm / M.Sc. in a relevant science.
* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt, or equivalent formal Lean training with completed projects.

Lean and CI tools (applied, not only trained)

* Tiered management and visual management: meeting structure, KPI boards, escalation, and action tracking.
* Structured problem solving: A3, 5 Whys, fishbone, PDCA.
* Kaizen events: data collection, design and facilitation, with a measured result.
* SMED / quick changeover and basic OEE loss analysis.
* 5S, process mapping and value stream mapping.
* Time and motion study and work sampling.

**Experience**

* At least 6 to 8 years of total work experience.
* At least 2 years in pharma finished-dose manufacturing or operations (oral solid dose or sterile injectables), with working knowledge of GMP and data-integrity expectations.

title: Account Executive / Senior Account Executive - Karta AI
description:
**Account Executive / Senior Account Executive**

Enterprise Sales | BFSI & FinTech | Mumbai

**Location:** Mumbai, Maharashtra

**Function:** Enterprise Sales

**Reports to:** CRO / Founders

**Employment:** Full-time

  

**About Karta AI**

Karta AI is an AI-led enterprise technology platform focused on helping financial institutions and businesses transform customer operations through intelligent automation, AI-driven workflows and enterprise-grade AI capabilities. We work with organisations across banking, financial services, insurance, NBFCs, fintech and the broader financial technology ecosystem to address complex business challenges, improve operational efficiency, enhance customer experience and accelerate digital transformation.

**The Role**

The Account Executive / Senior Account Executive will identify, develop and close enterprise opportunities across the BFSI and FinTech ecosystem in Mumbai and surrounding markets. The role owns the sales journey end to end, from account research and prospecting through discovery, solution alignment, demonstrations, proof of concept, commercial negotiation and closure. Success requires business acumen, technology curiosity, executive presence and disciplined sales execution.

**What You'll Own**

**1. Enterprise business development**

Identify, qualify and acquire new enterprise customers across banks, NBFCs, insurance companies, fintechs, payment companies and other financial institutions.

Build and execute account plans for named strategic accounts; map buying centres, influencers and decision-makers.

Create pipeline through targeted outbound prospecting, referrals, networking, industry events and partner-led opportunities.

Identify whitespace and expansion opportunities within existing customer relationships.

**2. Consultative and solution selling**

Lead structured discovery to understand business objectives, operational bottlenecks, customer-experience gaps and technology priorities.

Be comfortable discussing APIs, integrations, LLMs, AI agents, workflows and automation at a business level.

Ask insightful questions, distinguish symptoms from root causes and uncover both stated and unstated customer needs.

Translate business challenges into relevant Karta AI use cases, solution propositions and measurable outcomes.

Build value-led business cases around revenue growth, productivity, cost optimisation, process efficiency, risk reduction and customer experience.

Position Karta AI as a strategic business solution; avoid feature-led, price-led or transactional selling.

**3. Solution presentations and stakeholder engagement**

Partner with presales, solution engineering and product teams to shape customer-specific demonstrations, workshops and proposals.

Explain AI, automation and enterprise technology concepts in clear, business-oriented language.

Engage and build consensus across business, IT, operations, risk, compliance, procurement and finance stakeholders.

Coordinate proof-of-concept engagements with agreed objectives, success measures, owners and timelines.

**4. Opportunity and commercial management**

Own the complete sales cycle, including qualification, solution alignment, proposals, RFP/RFI responses, negotiation and closure.

Develop compelling proposals, presentations, commercial constructs and ROI-led business cases.

Manage objections, procurement processes and multi-stakeholder decision paths with confidence and integrity.

Maintain accurate CRM records, opportunity stages, next steps, sales forecasts and pipeline reviews.

Ensure a structured handover to customer success and delivery teams after closure.

**5. Customer relationships and account growth**

Build trusted, long-term relationships through preparation, responsiveness, credibility and consistent follow-through.

Maintain a strong understanding of customer priorities, organisational changes and emerging opportunities.

Drive account penetration, cross-sell and expansion by continually connecting platform capabilities to customer outcomes.

Represent Karta AI with professionalism and sound judgement in every customer interaction.

**Experience & Qualifications**

**Account Executive**

Typically 4–6 years of experience in B2B enterprise technology sales.

Exposure to SaaS, AI, cloud, enterprise software, fintech or digital-transformation solutions.

Experience generating pipeline, qualifying opportunities, presenting solutions and contributing to deal closures.

Comfort engaging mid-level and senior business stakeholders; BFSI or FinTech exposure is preferred.

**Senior Account Executive**

Typically 7–10 years of experience in enterprise technology sales.

Demonstrated record of acquiring enterprise customers and closing mid-to-large-value opportunities.

Ability to independently develop strategic accounts and manage complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.

Strong BFSI, NBFC, banking, insurance, fintech or payments ecosystem exposure is highly desirable.

Experience selling AI, SaaS, automation, enterprise platforms or digital-transformation solutions is an advantage.

  

**Education:** Master's degree in Business, Commerce or a related discipline. An MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification is preferred, but not mandatory. Relevant experience, commercial capability and demonstrated sales outcomes will carry greater weight than academic credentials alone.

  

**What We Expect from the Candidate**

Think like a business consultant and execute with the urgency and ownership of a sales professional.

Prepare thoroughly, listen carefully and bring a point of view to every customer conversation.

Understand the customer's business before recommending a technology solution.

Challenge conventional thinking constructively and help customers see where AI can create tangible value.

Communicate with maturity, professionalism and integrity—internally and externally.

Own your pipeline, commitments, learning curve and revenue outcomes.

  

**Why Karta AI**

Be part of a growing AI-led enterprise technology business and its market-building journey.

Engage with leading banks, NBFCs, fintechs, financial institutions and adjacent industry segments.

Build expertise in emerging AI and enterprise transformation opportunities.

Own meaningful customer relationships and revenue mandates in an entrepreneurial, high-accountability environment.

Grow with the organization as it expands across markets.

**Sell outcomes. Build trust. Accelerate AI-led transformation.**

If you are passionate about enterprise technology and believe in consultative selling, we would like to hear from you.

title: Executive/ Manager - Product Development & Commercialisation
description:
**Organisation:** GCV Life Pvt. Ltd. (GCViDEAL)**Job Title:** Executive/ Manager - Product Development & Commercialisation

**Job type:** On site

**Location:** Chakala, Mumbai

**About the Role**

Responsible for managing and coordinating the end-to-end product development, formulation development, manufacturing, quality, regulatory and supply-chain activities for nutraceutical, pharmaceutical, personal care and allied product categories.

The role involves translating client requirements and market opportunities into commercially viable products through coordination with contract manufacturers, ingredient suppliers, packaging vendors, internal business development teams and quality/regulatory functions.

**Key Responsibilities**A. Product Development & NPD

· Manage the product development lifecycle from initial concept and client requirement assessment to formulation finalisation, sampling, validation and commercial manufacturing.

· Evaluate new product opportunities based on market trends, consumer requirements, ingredient innovations and commercial feasibility.

· Coordinate with contract manufacturers and technical teams for new product development across nutraceutical, functional food, pharmaceutical and personal care categories.

· Drive formulation development, optimisation and improvement in terms of ingredient selection, active concentrations, excipient systems, flavour profiles, stability and product performance.

· Evaluate innovative delivery formats, including gummies, powders, sachets, tablets, capsules, liquids, RTDs and other functional formats.

· Coordinate prototype development, sample evaluation, sensory assessment and subsequent formulation modifications.

· Prepare and manage New Product Development (NPD/NPDP) documentation and development timelines.

· Coordinate technical feasibility assessments for new ingredients, formulations, processing technologies and product formats.

B. Contract Manufacturing, Technical Coordination and Scale up

· Identify, evaluate and coordinate with third-party manufacturing partners based on technical capabilities, product requirements, quality standards, certifications and commercial feasibility.

· Conduct manufacturing facility visits and technical assessments to evaluate production capabilities, infrastructure, processes and quality systems.

· Coordinate product development and commercial manufacturing activities with external manufacturing partners.

· Review manufacturing feasibility, process limitations, production capacities, minimum order quantities and lead times.

· Monitor manufacturing progress, identify bottlenecks and coordinate corrective actions to ensure timely execution.

· Establish manufacturing timelines and align internal and external stakeholders on development, procurement, production and dispatch schedules.

· Coordinate with manufacturing partners for process improvements, production optimisation and resolution of technical issues.

C. Quality Assurance & Quality Control Coordination

· Coordinate manufacturer QA/QC teams to establish and maintain product quality standards.

· Review product specifications, Certificates of Analysis (COAs), raw material documentation and finished product quality parameters.

· Establish and coordinate quality checkpoints across product development, sampling, manufacturing and finished goods evaluation.

· Coordinate product testing, analytical evaluation, stability studies and quality investigations.

· Review product samples for sensory attributes, physical characteristics and compliance with agreed specifications.

· Identify quality deviations and coordinate corrective and preventive actions with manufacturing partners.

· Ensure alignment between approved product specifications, manufacturing requirements and final commercial batches.

· Support quality documentation and product release-related activities.

D. Regulatory Affairs & Compliance

· Coordinate regulatory requirements for product development, manufacturing and commercialisation.

· Support FSSAI compliance, including product documentation, ingredient permissibility, product categorisation and labelling requirements.

· Review product labels, ingredient declarations, nutritional information, claims and regulatory artwork.

· Coordinate with regulatory teams and manufacturing partners for required licences, certifications, declarations and technical documentation.

· Support preparation and review of Free Sale Certificates, product descriptions, technical dossiers and other export-related documentation.

· Coordinate regulatory feasibility assessments for domestic and international product opportunities.

· Ensure product development and commercialisation activities remain aligned with applicable regulatory requirements.

E. Product Costing & Commercial Feasibility

· Coordinate product costing exercises for new and existing products.

· Evaluate ingredient costs, excipient systems, manufacturing charges, packaging costs and other associated expenses.

· Work with manufacturers and suppliers to obtain commercial quotations and develop product cost sheets.

· Identify opportunities for formulation optimisation, alternative ingredient sourcing and manufacturing efficiencies to improve product economics.

· Evaluate MOQ, batch sizes, production yields and manufacturing feasibility against commercial requirements.

· Support business development teams with technical and commercial inputs during client discussions and product proposals.

· Assess product feasibility from both technical and commercial perspectives before proceeding with development or commercial production.

F. Product Portfolio & Market Research

· Conduct market research to identify emerging nutraceutical ingredients, product formats, consumer trends and innovation opportunities.

· Evaluate new ingredients and technologies for potential inclusion in the company's product portfolio.

· Analyse competitor products, market positioning, formulation approaches and potential differentiation opportunities.

· Identify opportunities for portfolio expansion through innovative formulations, ingredient combinations and delivery formats.

· Coordinate technical evaluation and commercial feasibility of new product concepts.

title: Lead Sales Representative
description:
As a Sr Sales Representative here at Honeywell, you will play a crucial role in driving revenue growth and meeting sales targets for our Honeywell LifeScience’s business unit. Your responsibilities will include managing, developing, and executing sales strategies, and building strong relationships with customers. Your expertise in sales, leadership, and strategic thinking will directly impact the company's sales performance and contribute to its overall business success. You will report directly to our Sales Manager and you’ll work out of our Mumbai location on a Hybrid work schedule. In this role, you will impact the company by driving revenue growth and contributing to the company's financial success. Your ability to build strong relationships with customers and meet sales targets will position Honeywell as a trusted partner and drive the company's growth and competitiveness in the market.

  

**Qualifications and Skills:**

* **Experience** : 10+ years of B2B Application field sales experience, with a strong background in account management within the software or technology sector and knowledge of life science vertical.
* **Track Record** : Proven success in meeting and exceeding sales targets, with a history of managing complex, multi-year enterprise deals.
* **Account Management Expertise** : Strong experience managing large, enterprise-level accounts, with a focus on both client retention and growth.
* **Relationship Building** : Excellent interpersonal skills, with the ability to develop and maintain relationships at all organizational levels.
* **Solution Selling** : Experience in consultative sales, with the ability to align software solutions with client business objectives.
* **Negotiation Skills** : Demonstrated strength in contract negotiation and deal closure, with experience managing high-stakes, complex deals.
* **CRM Proficiency** : Expert-level proficiency with CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics) to track account performance and manage sales pipelines.
* **Communication Skills** : Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present to executive audiences.
* **Strategic Thinking** : Ability to craft and execute long-term strategies for account growth and customer success.
* **Team Leadership** : Experience mentoring and guiding junior sales staff.

**WE VALUE:**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field. MBA or Advance degrees are preferred.
* Familiarity with industry-specific software solutions (e.g., SaaS, Business Applications, ERP, Cloud Technologies, etc)
* Establish network within the relevant industry sectors (Life Sciences, Pharmaceuticals, Medical Devices, F&B, CPG, Food Manufacturing, Logistics/distributions, Specialty Chemical, Process Solutions)
* Passion for sales and achieving results
* Strategic thinking and problem-solving abilities
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team
* Strong business acumen and understanding of market dynamics
* Continuous learning and adaptability

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Account Management** : Serve as the primary point of contact for key B2B clients, managing relationships to ensure satisfaction and long-term partnership.
* **Revenue Growth & Retention** : Drive revenue growth through cross-selling and up-selling within existing accounts while maintaining high retention rates.
* **Strategic Account Planning** : Develop and execute comprehensive account plans, identifying key opportunities and aligning company solutions with client business goals.
* **Client Relationship Building** : Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with senior-level stakeholders and decision-makers in client organizations.
* **Customer Success Advocacy** : Collaborate with internal teams, including customer success and product development, to ensure clients receive optimal value from our software solutions.
* **Solution Selling** : Present tailored solutions to meet client needs, positioning the company as a trusted partner in achieving their business objectives.
* **Contract Renewals & Negotiations** : Lead contract renewal discussions, ensuring favorable terms for both the company and the client while maximizing revenue.
* **New Business Development** : Identify and pursue new business opportunities within the existing client base, including expanding into new departments or regions.
* **Client Engagement** : Regularly engage with clients through face-to-face meetings, virtual consultations, and product demonstrations to keep them informed of new product features, upgrades, and industry trends.
* **Problem Resolution** : Act as a liaison between clients and internal teams to address and resolve any issues, ensuring a seamless customer experience.
* **Market & Industry Knowledge** : Stay updated on industry trends, competitor products, and market dynamics to provide valuable insights and strategic advice to clients.
* **Sales Reporting & Forecasting** : Provide regular updates on account performance, sales forecasts, and pipeline management to senior leadership.

  
Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

description:
**Company Description**

Why work for Accor?  
We are far more than a worldwide leader. We welcome you as you are and you can find a job and brand that matches your personality. We support you to grow and learn every day, making sure that work brings purpose to your life, so that during your journey with us, you can continue to explore Accor’s limitless possibilities.

 **Job Description**

**Main Purpose of the Job**

Optimise Hotel occupancy, average rate and yield, successfully converting all

reservation enquiries into materialised bookings and taking responsibility to attain the

highest possible occupancy and average rate.

**Key Duties**

* Reporting to Reservation Manager of the hotel, in her absence to the Guest Service Manager.
* Promptly answer all requests for reservations and record them accurately
* Constant upkeep of Opera Reservations system through updating of rates systems, validity dates, mail messages, availability control
* Check no shows from previous day and give details to Guest Service Manager for processing and follow up
* Ensure all reservations loaded into the PMS system are up to date
* Closely scrutinise reservations relating to regular clients to ensure all information is correct resulting in minimal check in time
* Monitor occupancy for upcoming weeks, when stop sell is necessary input date into PMS and advise Guest Service, Telephones and ARS allotment holders
* Create group masters and update group information as it is received eg. Rooming list, arrival, meals, follow up on information if not received. Liaise with other departments to ensure group requirements and special requests are actioned
* Reconfirm all arrivals 1 day prior to arrival and ensure all relevant information is available to Front Desk by the evening prior to arrival
* Ensure an accurate and complete guest history exists for all return guests and that details of arrivals etc are communicated to Management.
* Regularly check guest history records and advise Guest Service Manager should a tidy up need to be actioned
* Regularly monitor occupancy, judge busy periods and request assistance as required
* Closely monitor allotments and ensure all are being utilised and not oversold. Provide allotment statistics and ensure accurate handling / correspondence
* Have sound knowledge of Accor specified yield management practises and attend / contribute to monthly business strategy meetings
* Assist in preparation and checking of rate manual, ensure rates and rates schedule in computer system are correct.
* Communication with DOS and sales department to forward all possible leads and feedback from inbound and corporate markets
* Communication between Guest Service and Reservations Office open and reciprocal
* Ensure completion of daily duties, eg. Correspondence, filing, reports, etc. Adherence to Emergency Communication procedures ensuring that
* Clear past reservations monthly and file in file boxes for storage

* Any other duties assigned by your Manager.
* Drive “Reservations” through effective training and mentoring of the fellow team members.

**Financial/Asset Responsibilities/Duties**

* Facilitate the smooth running of the department through adequate supply of materials and equipment.
* Adhere to the department budget through the Purchase Order System and inventory controls.
* Pro-actively control costs by being aware of forecasted business and targeted profitability, whilst maintaining standards.
* Utilise internet and email in conjunction with Accor Internet and Email policy.

**Customers Responsibilities/Duties**

* Ensure that the Department establishes and maintains an ongoing quality improvement programme through use of Reservation and hotel guest questionnaires and take action on any feedback.
* Deliver and achieve a level of service quality that consistently meets and preferably exceeds the expectations of guests.
* Attend to operational problems and needs promptly including customer complaints, enquiries and requests, take a positive problem solving approach.
* Ensure that customer safety and security is maintained to high levels at all times.
* Ensure every member of the team is able to promote Hotel facilities service and is aware of special company/Hotel promotions.

Health & Safety Responsibilities/ Duties

* Establish and maintain safe working conditions and practices following Accor Health, Safety and Environmental policies.
* Ensure all practicable steps are taken to maintain a safe work environment following Accor Health, Safety and Environmental policies.

* Ensure all staff within the department are fully conversant with departmental fire and evacuation procedures.
* Ensure all hazard are recorded and reported to the Management and that they are investigated appropriately with controls identified and reviewed.
* Implement Accor policy on prevention of Harassment/ Bullying in the Workplace according to guidelines.
* Ensure all protective clothing and equipment is provided to employees where necessary, maintained and they are train its use.

* Ensure all workplace accidents and incidents are reported accurately and promptly on the prescribed form, with appropriate investigation and corrective action taken.
* All serious harm accidents are reported to management immediately and within 7 days in writing.
* All new and transferring staff have training and ongoing supervision to ensure they have the knowledge and skills to perform work tasks in a safe manner.
* Rehabilitation support and assistance is provided to injured workers following Accor guidelines.
* Review and develop health and safety policy objectives and plans at least annually.
* Be proactive in keeping departmental health and safety records and information up to date.
* Ensue site visitor / contractor entry procedures are applied.

**Occupational Health & Safety**

***Employee Responsibility***

All employees are responsible for complying with the relevant OHS&E legislation and policies.

This will include in particular:

* Taking care of themselves and others.
* Co-operating with Accor Hotel instructions including Safe Work Method Statements, Safety and other Procedures and Training.

* Reporting all hazardous situations.
* Following all reasonable instructions from a manager

description:
