JOB DESCRIPTION

Executive Assistant to Managing Director & CEO

POSITION TITLE Executive Assistant to MD & CEO

LOCATION Mumbai — Andheri East

EMPLOYMENT TYPE Full-Time, Work from Office

REPORTS TO Managing Director (MD) & Chief Executive Officer (CEO) Level: Executive Office / Management Support

**1. ROLE PURPOSE**

The Executive Assistant to the MD & CEO will provide high-level executive, organisational and coordination support to the senior leadership of the Group. This role goes beyond traditional administrative support. The EA will act as a key coordination point between the MD/CEO and internal teams, ensuring that priorities are organised, decisions are followed through, information reaches leadership on time, meetings result in action, and critical matters do not fall through the cracks. The successful candidate must be highly organised, proactive, commercially aware, discreet and comfortable working in a fast-paced, multi-business environment.

**2. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

A. Executive & Calendar Management • Manage and coordinate the MD and CEO's calendars, meetings, appointments and business commitments. • Prioritise meetings based on urgency and business importance. • Coordinate internal and external meetings with employees, vendors, consultants, partners, investors and other stakeholders. • Prepare the MD/CEO ahead of important meetings with relevant documents, background information and pending matters. • Coordinate travel arrangements, itineraries and associated schedules when required.

B. Meeting Management & Follow-Through • Prepare agendas and supporting information for key management meetings. • Attend selected leadership and business meetings and record clear minutes, decisions and action points. • Maintain an Action Tracker covering commitments, owners, deadlines and status. • Follow up with department heads and team members on behalf of the MD/CEO. • Escalate delays, unresolved matters and critical dependencies before they become problems. • Ensure decisions taken by the MD/CEO are communicated accurately and followed through to completion.

C. Executive Office Coordination • Act as a central coordination point between the MD/CEO and different departments and businesses. • Help leadership maintain visibility across key priorities, projects and deadlines. • Coordinate information required from Finance, Operations, HR, Marketing, Sales, Manufacturing, E-commerce and other functions. • Maintain a structured view of what is pending, who owns it, when it is due and where leadership intervention is required. • Support coordination across multiple Group companies and brands as required. Ariiston Clothing India Private Limited • Confidential — Internal Use

D. MIS, Reporting & Decision Support • Collect and consolidate reports, MIS and business updates required by the MD/CEO. • Ensure information submitted to leadership is complete, organised and presented clearly. • Prepare concise executive summaries rather than simply forwarding large volumes of information. • Assist in preparing presentations, reports, briefing notes and management documents. • Track key business milestones, commitments and leadership priorities. • Highlight exceptions, delays and areas requiring immediate attention.

E. Communication & Stakeholder Management • Draft and coordinate professional emails, letters, messages and internal communications on behalf of the MD/CEO when required. • Liaise professionally with senior employees, customers, suppliers, consultants, investors and other stakeholders. • Manage sensitive communication with appropriate discretion and judgement. • Ensure important communications requiring MD/CEO attention are identified and prioritised.

F. Project & Priority Tracking • Support the MD/CEO in tracking strategic and operational initiatives across the Group. • Maintain trackers for key projects, deadlines and deliverables. • Coordinate with responsible team members to obtain timely updates. • Identify dependencies and potential delays. • Follow up persistently but professionally until agreed actions are completed. The EA is not expected to perform the department head's job, but is expected to ensure that agreed commitments are properly tracked and brought back to leadership where required.

G. Confidential & Sensitive Matters • Handle confidential business, employee, financial and strategic information with absolute discretion. • Maintain organised records of important documents and executive correspondence. • Exercise sound judgement regarding what information can be shared and with whom. • Support the MD/CEO with sensitive assignments when required.

**3. KEY EXPECTATIONS**

* Be proactive rather than reactive. • Anticipate what the MD/CEO will require before being repeatedly asked. • Follow through until matters are genuinely closed. • Be comfortable following up with senior managers and department heads. • Separate urgent matters from routine matters. • Communicate clearly, professionally and confidently. • Maintain accuracy even when managing multiple priorities. • Understand the broader business context behind tasks rather than simply executing instructions. • Protect the MD/CEO's time and help leadership remain focused on the highest-value priorities. • Maintain strict confidentiality and professional boundaries.

**4. CANDIDATE PROFILE**

Experience Ariiston Clothing India Private Limited • 4–8 years of relevant experience in an Executive Assistant, Executive Office, Founder's Office, CEO Office or senior management support role. • Experience supporting a CEO, MD, Founder, Director or other senior executive preferred. • Experience in a fast-paced, multi-business, manufacturing, retail, consumer, e-commerce or entrepreneurial environment would be advantageous. Skills • Excellent written and verbal English communication. • Strong Microsoft Excel, Word and PowerPoint skills. • Strong calendar, meeting and time-management capability. • Good analytical and reporting ability. • Ability to create and maintain professional trackers and MIS. • Strong attention to detail. • Excellent follow-up and coordination skills. • Ability to handle confidential information. • Comfortable interacting with senior management and external stakeholders. • Ability to work independently with limited supervision.

**5. PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES**

* Highly organised and structured • Proactive and solution-oriented • Mature and dependable • Assertive without being disrespectful • Detail-oriented • Calm under pressure • Persistent with follow-ups • Commercially aware • Comfortable with changing priorities • Trustworthy and discreet • Able to work closely with strong senior personalities

**6. KEY SUCCESS MEASURES**

* Effective management of MD/CEO priorities and schedules. • Timely closure of leadership action items. • Quality and accuracy of meeting minutes, trackers and reports. • Reduction in missed deadlines and unresolved follow-ups. • Timely availability of information required for management decisions. • Effectiveness of coordination between leadership and department heads. • Quality and professionalism of executive communication. • Confidentiality, reliability and trust. • Ability to progressively reduce the administrative and coordination burden on the MD and CEO.

**7. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

Ariiston Clothing India Private Limited • Within the first three to six months, the EA should develop a strong understanding of the Group's businesses, key people, priorities and operating rhythm. The MD and CEO should be able to rely on the EA to know: • What needs attention. • What is pending. • Who is responsible. • What deadline has been committed. • What has been completed. • What is delayed. • And what requires leadership intervention. The objective of the role is ultimately to create greater structure, visibility and execution discipline around the Office of the MD & CEO, allowing senior leadership to spend more time on business growth, strategy, decision-making and organisational leadership.

title: Director - Advisor Relations, APJ
description:
**Director - Advisor Relations, APJ**

### **Leading at Cognizant**

This is a leadership role at Cognizant. We believe how you lead is as important as what you deliver. Cognizant leaders drive our business strategy, inspire teams around our future, live our leadership behaviors, uphold our Values, and nurture a culture where everyone can thrive.

At Cognizant, leadership transcends titles and is reflected in everyday actions and decisions. We empower leaders at every level to act with purpose, build trust, strengthen inclusion, and deliver meaningful business outcomes.

### **About the role**

As Director - Advisor Relations, APJ, you will lead a unified advisor relations program across Asia Pacific and Japan to strengthen Cognizant’s market position and strategic relationships with leading sourcing advisors, consultancies, and third-party influencer firms. You will influence pipeline growth, support regional business priorities, and represent Cognizant’s strategic voice across the advisor ecosystem.

You will collaborate closely with regional leadership, sales, marketing, business development, and functional teams to strengthen market awareness, shape advisor perceptions, accelerate deal cycles, and create measurable business impact.

### **In this role, you will:**

* Define and execute the APJ advisor engagement strategy, aligned with Cognizant’s growth priorities and global market positioning.
* Build and manage senior relationships with leading sourcing advisors, consultancies, and influencer firms across APJ.
* Lead proactive advisor engagement for strategic pursuits and renewals, using influencer relationships to shape market perceptions and accelerate deal cycles.
* Advise senior regional leaders on market trends, competitive intelligence, advisor perspectives, go-to-market strategy, and solution roadmaps.
* Oversee advisor briefings, inquiries, engagement programs, and events, ensuring disciplined execution and strong stakeholder participation.
* Increase Cognizant’s inclusion and consideration in advisor-generated deal pipelines and strategic opportunities.
* Track and report key performance indicators, including pipeline influence, business impact, engagement outcomes, and return on investment.
* Partner with sales, marketing, business development, and regional teams to align advisor relations activity with measurable commercial outcomes.
* Consistently demonstrate the Cognizant Way to Lead through Personal Leadership, Organizational Leadership, and Business Leadership.

### **What you need to have to be considered**

* Proven experience leading an advisor relations or advisor engagement program across APJ within a Tier 1 technology or services organization.
* Deep, established relationships with leading sourcing advisory firms, consultancies, and relevant influencer organizations in the region.
* A demonstrated record of influencing enterprise deals, supporting pipeline growth, and delivering measurable business results.
* Strong commercial orientation, including experience supporting large-deal pursuits, renewals, and complex sales cycles.
* Ability to advise senior leaders using market insights, competitive intelligence, and external influencer perspectives.
* Experience operating successfully in a complex, global, and matrixed organization with multiple regional and functional stakeholders.
* Excellent executive communication, relationship management, strategic thinking, and stakeholder-influence skills.
* Embodiment of the Cognizant Way to Lead: Leading Self, Leading Others, and Leading the Business.
* Commitment to Cognizant’s Values: Work as One, Dare to Innovate, Raise the Bar, Do the Right Thing, and Own It.

### **These will help you succeed**

* Experience representing a technology or professional services organization with analysts, advisors, or third-party market influencers.
* Knowledge of the APJ technology services market, regional buying dynamics, and the advisor-led sourcing ecosystem.
* Ability to translate external market intelligence into practical go-to-market actions, pursuit strategies, and leadership recommendations.
* A data-driven approach to measuring engagement effectiveness, pipeline contribution, and return on investment.

### **Work model**

The work arrangement and primary location for this role will be confirmed based on business requirements and the country of hire. The working arrangement may change based on business, client, and project requirements. Cognizant will provide clear expectations throughout the recruitment process.

### **Location : Anywhere in India**

description:
**Company Description**
WNS, part of Capgemini, is an Agentic AI-powered leader in intelligent operations and transformation, serving more than 700 clients across 10 industries, including Banking and Financial Services, Healthcare, Insurance, Shipping and Logistics, and Travel and Hospitality. We bring together deep domain excellence – WNS’ core differentiator – with AI-powered platforms and analytics to help businesses innovate, scale, adapt and build resilience in a world defined by disruption.Our purpose is clear: to enable lasting business value by designing intelligent, human-led solutions that deliver sustainable outcomes and a differentiated impact. With three global headquarters across four continents, operations in 13 countries, 65 delivery centers and more than 66,000 employees, WNS combines scale, expertise and execution to create meaningful, measurable impact.
  
  
**Job Description**
Job Summary
  
  
The AR – Cash Application Senior/Lead Associate is responsible for end to end cash application activities, ensuring accurate and timely posting of customer receipts in SAP and HighRadius. This role requires strong analytical skills to resolve unapplied and unidentified cash, adherence to tight SLAs, and the ability to actively drive process improvements. The role involves working in US shifts/night shifts and supporting month end close activities.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Post all cash receipts including ACH, Checks, Wire Transfers, and Credit Cards accurately and timely in SAP and HighRadius Cash Application.
* Download, review, and reconcile daily bank statements from online banking portals for cash posting.
* Ensure 100% lockbox payments are applied by end of day in line with SLA requirements
* Process cash-related journal entries, adjustments, write-offs, and refunds as per approved policies.
* Perform extensive research and analysis to resolve unapplied and unidentified cash receipts.
* Handle monthly application and reconciliation of unapplied and unidentified cash balances.
* Collaborate with AR, Collections, Billing, and Treasury teams to resolve complex cash issues.
* Maintain comprehensive documentation of cash application processes, SOPs, and guidelines.
* Ensure compliance with internal controls, SOX requirements, and audit standards.
* Support month end close activities related to cash posting and reconciliations.
* Act as a Senior/Lead associate, mentoring and supporting junior team members.
* Participate in team meetings and contribute to knowledge sharing.
* Actively identify and propose process improvement ideas, focusing on automation, efficiency, accuracy, and turnaround time.
* Support system enhancements, transitions, and UAT activities related to cash application tools.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* Strong experience in AR Cash Application.
* Hands on working knowledge of SAP and High Radius Cash App.
* In depth understanding of US payment methods: ACH, Checks, Wire Transfers, and Credit Cards.
* Strong problem solving and analytical skills.
* Ability to perform effectively under pressure in a fast paced environment.
* High learning agility and adaptability.
* Effective communication and stakeholder management skills.

**Educational Qualification**

* Bachelor’s degree in commerce, Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field (mandatory).

**Work Requirements**

* US shifts / Night shifts – mandatory
* Flexibility to support peak volumes and month end close
* 2-3 years of experience in cash application/Accounts receivable

**Qualifications**
Bachelor’s degree
  
  
**Additional Information**

* Night shifts – mandatory
* Strong experience in AR Cash Application.
* Hands on working knowledge of SAP and High Radius Cash App.

description:
**Description**
Tech Lead – IAM (Identity and Access Management)
  
  
Exp- 10 to 15 Years

**Requirements**
We are seeking a skilled and experienced Tech Lead to guide a team in designing, implementing, and supporting modern Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions. The ideal candidate will bring deep technical expertise in authentication and authorization frameworks and play a pivotal role in securing our systems through robust IAM strategies. The role requires hands-on experience with Duende IdentityServer (v6 and v4), cloud identity platforms, and strong collaboration with cross-functional global teams, particularly with senior architects and engineering stakeholders in the US.
  
  
Required Skills and Experience:
  
  
8+ years of overall software development experience with at least 4+ years in IAM.
  
  
Expertise in Duende IdentityServer (v6/v4) or any other IDM server, GoF design patterns, OIDC/OAuth2, .NET Core, and modern authentication protocols. Python is a plus
  
  
Hands-on experience with OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SAML, JWT, and related standards.
  
  
Experience with cloud-native IAM services (Azure AD, Okta, AWS Cognito, etc.).
  
  
Solid understanding of CI/CD, DevOps, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) as it applies to IAM.
  
  
Familiarity with serverless architecture design and implementation.
  
  
Knowledge of directory services (LDAP, Active Directory) and federation protocols.
  
  
Proficient in scripting (PowerShell, Python, or Bash) to automate IAM workflows.
  
  
Experience with tools like Keycloak, ForgeRock, or Ping Identity is a plus.
  
  
Excellent communication and presentation skills; ability to negotiate and align technical approaches with client architects.
  
  
Strong documentation and system design skills using tools like Visio, Draw.io, or Lucidchart.
  
  
Preferred Qualifications:
  
  
Certifications such as Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate, Okta Certified Professional, or CISSP.
  
  
Experience in regulated industries (Healthcare, Finance, etc.) is a plus.
  
  
Prior experience working with distributed global teams and agile methodologies.
  
  
Job responsibilities
  
  
Key Responsibilities:
  
  
Lead and mentor a technical team responsible for IAM implementation and support activities.
  
  
Work closely with Architect to Design, and develop scalable IAM solutions using Duende IdentityServer v6/v4.
  
  
Implement secure authentication and authorization protocols including OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, and SAML.
  
  
Configure and manage Single Sign-On (SSO) and Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) across multiple applications and identity providers.
  
  
Define and enforce Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and Attribute-Based Access Control (ABAC) frameworks.
  
  
Automate identity lifecycle processes using tools such as Azure AD Connect, Okta Workflows, or similar.
  
  
Ensure systems adhere to GDPR, SOC 2, HIPAA, and other relevant compliance and security standards.
  
  
Troubleshoot and resolve complex authentication and access issues in collaboration with support teams.
  
  
Maintain and evolve cloud-native IAM solutions across AWS.
  
  
Collaborate with enterprise Architecture, Security, and DevOps teams to align IAM solutions with organizational security strategy.
  
  
Drive documentation and knowledge sharing around identity governance, policies, and architecture.
  
  
Excellend communicaiton skills to present and defend architectural decisions to client stakeholders, demonstrating both technical depth and business understanding.
  
  
What we offer
  
  
**Exciting Projects:**
We focus on industries like High-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.
  
  
**Collaborative Environment:**
You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!
  
  
**Work-Life Balance:**
GlobalLogic prioritizes work-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
Our dedicated Learning & Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.
  
  
**Excellent Benefits:**
We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.
  
  
**Fun Perks:**
We want you to love where you work, which is why we host sports events, cultural activities, offer food on subsidies rates, Corporate parties. Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!

GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward-thinking companies. Manager - Civil - Hydro PSP Project

**Qualification:**
Graduation/Equivalent - Civil

6 to 10 Years

**Location:**
Pune Division

**Role Overview**

The Manager - Civil (Hydro PSP Project) will be responsible for managing all development-stage activities across Pumped Storage Project (PSP) sites in Maharashtra, from initial site investigations and surveys through regulatory approvals and project planning, up to the commencement of construction.

The role requires strong expertise in site investigation management, geotechnical studies, regulatory coordination, and project development planning. Proficiency in Marathi is essential for effective engagement with state government departments, regulatory authorities, and local stakeholders across Maharashtra.

Key Sector Exposure Hydro & Pumped Storage

* End-to-end management of hydropower or PSP project development activities prior to construction.
* Site survey and investigation management, including topographical, geomapping, GIS, aerial, and geophysical surveys.
* Geotechnical drilling programs and in-situ field testing such as SPT, PLT, vane shear, permeability testing, and RQD assessment.
* Management of permitting and approval processes for surveys, drilling, and investigation activities.
* Preparation of project development plans and pre-construction readiness documentation.
* Coordination with Maharashtra State Government departments, Revenue authorities, Forest Department, MPCB, District Administration, and other regulatory agencies.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Plan, mobilize, and manage site survey activities, including topographical surveys, geo-mapping, GIS-based terrain analysis, aerial/drone surveys, and hydrological data collection across PSP project locations in Maharashtra.
* Lead and supervise geotechnical investigation programs, including borehole drilling, core logging, test pitting, geophysical surveys, and sub-surface data collection. Monitor drilling contractors and ensure quality control of bore logs and sample handling procedures.
* Coordinate and oversee in-situ testing programs such as SPT, PLT, plate load tests, and field permeability tests. Review findings and support the preparation of Geotechnical Investigation Reports in coordination with designated geologists.
* Prepare and manage the Project Development Plan covering all pre-construction milestones, including site layout planning, approach roads, construction infrastructure requirements, utility assessments, regulatory submission schedules, and FID readiness activities.
* Obtain necessary permissions, approvals, and NOCs for survey, investigation, and drilling activities, including land access approvals, forest entry permits, tree-cutting permissions, and Water Resources Department clearances.
* Liaise with the Maharashtra Revenue Department, District Collector offices, Sub-Divisional Officers, Forest Department, Maharashtra Pollution Control Board (MPCB), MSEDCL, GSDA, Gram Panchayats, and other relevant authorities to ensure compliance and timely approvals.
* Draft, translate, and respond to official correspondence in Marathi and represent the organization in government meetings, compliance reviews, inspections, and stakeholder interactions.

Built on a foundation of quality, innovation, customer-centricity, and timely delivery, Krisala is rapidly expanding across Pune and the rest of Maharashtra with a vision to redefine urban living through landmark projects.

Join Us in Building the Future of Real Estate

At Krisala Developers, we foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous growth, empowering our people to create meaningful impact while building rewarding careers.

**Job Title – General Manager – Billing**

**Location – Pune**

**Job Description**
–

We are looking for a seasoned and commercially astute leader to head the Billing function at Krisala Developers. The incumbent will be responsible for driving end-to-end project billing operations across multiple residential, commercial, and township developments, ensuring accuracy, commercial discipline, contractual compliance, and effective cost management.

The role will involve strategic oversight of project billing, quantity surveying, contractor and vendor bill certification, commercial evaluations, cost monitoring, and project-wise financial controls. Working closely with senior leadership and cross-functional teams, the incumbent will drive process standardization, strengthen billing governance, identify cost optimization opportunities, and build a high-performing billing team capable of supporting the organization's expanding project portfolio.

**Roles & Responsibilities**
–

* Lead and oversee the centralized Billing function across multiple real estate development projects, ensuring consistency, accuracy, and timely execution of billing operations.
* Drive end-to-end verification, scrutiny, certification, and processing of contractor and subcontractor Running Account (RA) bills, final bills, and vendor invoices.
* Oversee quantity surveying, measurement verification, BOQ validation, and reconciliation of executed quantities against approved drawings, work orders, contracts, and actual site progress.
* Review contractual provisions, rate analysis, extra items, deviations, variation claims, escalation claims, and change orders to ensure commercial accuracy and safeguard organizational interests.
* Monitor project-wise billing, committed costs, actual expenditure, and budget utilization, identifying cost variations and potential financial exposures.
* Ensure accurate reconciliation of contractor accounts, including advances, recoveries, retention money, mobilization advances, material adjustments, and statutory deductions.
* Establish robust billing processes, standard operating procedures, internal controls, and approval mechanisms to strengthen governance and minimize billing discrepancies.
* Collaborate with Project Execution, Contracts, Planning, Procurement, Finance, and Accounts teams to ensure seamless coordination and timely resolution of commercial and billing-related matters.
* Drive project-wise MIS, budget-versus-actual analysis, cost variance reports, outstanding bill statements, and management dashboards for effective decision-making.
* Ensure adherence to contractual obligations, applicable statutory requirements, and internal financial controls in coordination with relevant stakeholders.
* Identify opportunities for cost optimization, process automation, improved billing turnaround time, and operational efficiencies across projects.
* Lead, mentor, and develop the billing team, establishing clear performance metrics, accountability, and a strong culture of commercial discipline.

**Must-Have Skills**
–

* Strong expertise in Real Estate Project Billing, Quantity Surveying, and Commercial Operations.
* Extensive experience in contractor RA bills, final bills, BOQ preparation, quantity surveying, measurement verification, and bill certification.
* Strong understanding of civil construction activities, structural works, finishing works, MEP services, and associated project execution processes.
* Expertise in contract interpretation, rate analysis, extra item evaluation, deviation management, and reconciliation.
* Strong understanding of project cost monitoring, budget control, and billing-related financial processes.
* Knowledge of GST, TDS, labour cess, retention, advances, and other statutory and contractual deductions applicable to construction billing.
* Experience in managing billing operations across multiple projects with large-scale construction activities.
* Strong leadership, team management, analytical, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience with SAP or ERP-based billing and project management systems

**Preferred Skills –**

* Prior experience with reputed Real Estate Developers, Infrastructure Companies, or Construction Organizations.
* Experience handling high-rise residential projects, commercial developments, and large-scale township projects.
* Exposure to Mivan/Aluform construction, RCC structures, finishing packages, and MEP billing.
* Working knowledge of SAP or other ERP-based billing and project management systems.
* Experience in implementing billing SOPs, internal controls, and process automation.
* Ability to drive billing efficiency, cost optimization, and commercial discipline across multiple project sites.

**Educational Background**
–

* B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering.
* Postgraduate qualification in Construction Management, Quantity Surveying, Project Management, or a related discipline will be an added advantage.
* Graduation/Postgraduation from an AICTE-approved and/or UGC-recognized institution.

**Why Join Krisala Developers?**

* Opportunity to work with one of Pune’s fastest-growing real estate developers.
* Collaborative and growth-oriented work culture.
* Group Health Insurance Coverage.
* Group Term Life Insurance.
* Personal Accident Insurance Coverage.
* Provident Fund & Statutory Benefits.
* Leadership exposure and career advancement opportunities.
* Opportunity to contribute to landmark residential, commercial, and township developments.

Interested?

If you're looking to be part of a growth-driven organization that values innovation, ownership, and excellence, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Sr. Consultant - Infrastructure Engineering
description:
**What You'll Do**
We are seeking a highly experienced Virtual Devices / Virtual Workspace Engineer to own the architecture, engineering, modernization, and technical evolution of enterprise virtual desktop platforms.
  
  
This is a deeply technical, hands-on engineering role focused on Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD), Windows 365 Cloud PC, Citrix, image engineering, automation, performance, and cloud infrastructure.
  
  
The role will be responsible for designing and engineering secure, scalable, highly available virtual desktop solutions across cloud and on-premises environments. The individual will act as a technical authority for Virtual Devices, driving architecture decisions, engineering standards, automation, performance optimization, resilience, and platform modernization.
  
  
This role requires strong expertise across the complete virtual desktop technology stack, including compute, storage, networking, identity, profiles, images, applications, security, monitoring, automation, capacity, and disaster recovery
  
  
Windows 365 Cloud PC & Azure Virtual Desktop Engineering
  
  

* Own the engineering, configuration and continuous improvement of Windows 365 Enterprise / Cloud PC as a strategic enterprise virtual device platform.
* Design and manage Cloud PC provisioning policies, device images, user assignments, sizing, connectivity, configuration and lifecycle management.
* Engineer Cloud PC solutions for different workforce personas and use cases, including standard knowledge workers, developers, contractors, privileged users, offshore/BOT scenarios and other specialized workloads.
* Evaluate and implement appropriate Cloud PC configurations and SKUs based on CPU, memory, storage, application workload and user-experience requirements.
* Engineer Cloud PC connectivity models and troubleshoot complex issues involving Microsoft Entra ID, Intune, Conditional Access, Zscaler, enterprise networking, DNS, authentication and application dependencies.
* Develop solutions for non-standard Cloud PC use cases, including shared/process-account requirements, application-specific workloads and scenarios where the standard user-based implementation does not meet business requirements. These types of BOT and process-account CPC exceptions have already been part of your Devices work.
* Engineer and support migration patterns for workloads moving from Citrix VDI to Windows 365 Cloud PC, including application validation, user-data/profile considerations, network dependencies, authentication and cutover.
* Evaluate capabilities such as Windows 365 Frontline/Flex or equivalent consumption models where they provide a better solution for temporary, shift-based or non-persistent workforce requirements.
* Design technical controls and monitoring for Cloud PC availability, connectivity, provisioning failures, login experience, application health and end-user performance.
* Use endpoint and service telemetry to identify whether an issue sits with the Cloud PC, Windows OS, Intune, Entra ID, network, security layer or application rather than treating Cloud PC as an isolated service.
* Engineer Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) where workload or architectural requirements make AVD more appropriate than Windows 365.
* Design AVD environments covering host pools, session hosts, application groups, images, profiles, scaling, application delivery and user access.
* Provide technical comparison and recommendations across Citrix, Windows 365 and AVD, selecting platforms on workload requirements rather than vendor preference.
* Maintain awareness of Microsoft's virtual desktop roadmap and bring relevant capabilities into the enterprise technology roadmap through structured evaluation and proof-of-concepts.

Intune, Autopilot & Modern Device Management
  
  

* Serve as a senior technical engineer for Microsoft Intune-based Windows device management, across both physical Windows endpoints and Windows 365 Cloud PCs.
* Design and engineer configuration profiles, compliance policies, security baselines, endpoint security policies, application deployments, device configuration and update policies.
* Own engineering around Windows Autopilot and next-generation Autopilot/Windows device provisioning capabilities, including zero-touch provisioning and device lifecycle modernization.
* Engineer and troubleshoot the complete provisioning journey from hardware/device registration → Entra identity → Autopilot → Intune enrollment → policy/application deployment → security compliance → user readiness.
* Troubleshoot complex issues involving Intune, Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access and device identity, including situations where Intune and Entra report different compliance states.
* Correlate device identity and state across Intune managed-device records, Entra device objects, Autopilot records and Windows device registration.
* Understand Intune processing across the MDM channel, Intune Management Extension, application deployment, compliance evaluation and configuration policies.
* Engineer Windows update and servicing approaches using Windows Autopatch, Windows Update for Business and Intune, with controlled rollout rings and remediation strategies.
* Design and maintain device security capabilities including BitLocker, Defender, Windows security baselines, certificate deployment and endpoint security configuration.
* Develop technical monitoring and remediation for provisioning, compliance, application deployment and configuration failures rather than relying on user-reported incidents

Identity, Security & Device Trust
  
  

* Engineer device identity and access integration across Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Intune, Windows 365, AVD and Citrix.
* Understand and troubleshoot Entra Join, Hybrid Entra Join, device registration, Primary Refresh Tokens, authentication and device trust.
* Partner with Security teams to design Conditional Access policies that use device compliance, identity, authentication strength and device state appropriately.
* Engineer endpoint security controls using Intune, Microsoft Defender, BitLocker, Windows security baselines and related enterprise security tooling.
* Understand how security technologies such as Zscaler, endpoint security agents, network controls and authentication platforms interact with physical devices, Cloud PCs and virtual desktops.
* Lead technical response and remediation for critical security vulnerabilities impacting the Devices and virtual workspace technology stack.

**Who You Are**
Required Technical Experience
  
  

* Extensive hands-on engineering experience in enterprise Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI), Desktop-as-a-Service (DaaS), or virtual workspace environments.
* Deep technical expertise in Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) architecture, deployment, administration, troubleshooting, and optimization.
* Strong hands-on experience with Windows 365 Enterprise / Cloud PC architecture and management.
* Strong enterprise experience with at least one major traditional VDI platform such as:

+ Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops
+ VMware Horizon

* Deep understanding of FSLogix, profile architecture, profile containers, storage design, troubleshooting, and performance optimization.
* Strong experience with Windows 10/11 enterprise desktop engineering within virtualized environments.
* Proven experience with golden images, image lifecycle management, application packaging/layering, and automated image deployment.
* Strong knowledge of Azure compute, storage and networking relevant to virtual desktop architecture.
* Strong understanding of Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Group Policy, Conditional Access, MFA, RBAC, and identity integration.
* Hands-on experience designing and optimizing Azure networking, DNS, routing, NSGs, private connectivity, and hybrid connectivity supporting VDI.
* Strong understanding of VDI capacity planning including CPU/memory sizing, IOPS, storage latency, network performance, concurrency, session density, and user workload profiling.
* Advanced PowerShell scripting and automation capabilities.
* Strong technical troubleshooting skills across the entire virtual desktop stack.

Highly Desirable Technical Experience
  
  

* Nerdio Manager for Enterprise or comparable AVD orchestration/management tooling.
* Terraform and/or Azure Bicep for Infrastructure as Code.
* Experience implementing automated infrastructure and image deployment pipelines.
* Experience engineering GPU-enabled virtual desktops for graphics-intensive, engineering, analytics, or compute-intensive workloads.
* Experience with Azure Files, Azure NetApp Files and enterprise storage architectures for virtual desktop workloads.
* Experience with Microsoft Intune management of Windows 365 and virtual Windows endpoints.
* Experience with Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights or equivalent enterprise monitoring/DEX solutions.
* Strong understanding of FinOps and Azure cost optimization for virtual desktop environments.
* Experience designing multi-region VDI architecture, resilience, disaster recovery, and business continuity.
* Understanding of zero-trust architecture as applied to virtual desktops and remote access.

title: Data Platform Engineer
description:
At Johnson Controls, you will help build and operate the data platform behind Open Blue, our smart-building platform. In this role, you will build the streaming and lakehouse pipelines that deliver trusted building and energy data to the applications our customers rely on.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are looking for a Data Platform Engineer with 3+ years of experience to build, deploy, and maintain pipelines on the OpenBlue Data Platform (OBDP). You will work with Kafka, Flink, Spark, Apache Iceberg, and Snowflake alongside senior engineers, and help run them on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) with CI/CD and infrastructure as code. This is a hands-on role where you will own well-scoped features end to end, from code to production, and take on more design ownership over time.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Build and maintain Kafka and Flink streaming jobs for ingestion and transformation.
* Develop and maintain Spark jobs for data processing tasks.
* Write unit and integration tests and contribute to CI pipelines.
* Fix production defects and support SIT, UAT, and deployments.
* Deploy and operate data services and jobs on AKS using Helm and Kubernetes operators.
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure as code.
* Set up monitoring, alerting, and dashboards for pipelines and services (Datadog, Azure Monitor, Prometheus, Grafana).
* Support routine database and lakehouse operations, including Iceberg table maintenance and PostgreSQL backups and tuning.

**How You Will Do It**

* Own the outcome with accountability by delivering well-tested features and following through on commitments.
* Stay close to work by understanding how the data you build is used downstream.
* Look for root causes, improve continuously, and raise issues with candor.
* Work as one team by partnering with engineers, QA, and product, sharing context, and asking for help early.
* Use clear documentation and disciplined engineering practices to support consistency and handoffs.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* 3+ years of experience in software or data engineering.
* Hands-on experience with at least two of Kafka, Flink, Spark, Iceberg, or Snowflake, with working knowledge of or eagerness to learn the rest.
* Proficiency in Java, Scala, or Python, and solid SQL skills.
* Understanding of distributed systems basics such as partitioning, fault tolerance, and idempotency.
* Experience with Git, code review, and agile/Jira workflows.
* Hands-on AI-assisted development with Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar, with a critical eye for generated code.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines in a cloud environment.
* Exposure to Trino, PostgreSQL, or TimescaleDB.
* Experience with React and TypeScript.
* Azure experience.
* Production experience with AKS, Helm, or Kubernetes operators for Flink, Spark, or Kafka.
* Experience with time-series or IoT data.
* Experience with Terraform or Bicep and GitOps tools (Flux or Argo CD).
* Azure networking and security basics, including VNets, private endpoints, Key Vault, and Entra ID.

title: Senior Specialist Planning
description:
**Life tastes better with ice cream**
With 19.000 expert ice cream colleagues and iconic brands like Wall’s, Cornetto and Ben & Jerry’s, loved in 76 countries, we are the world’s largest Ice Cream company leading the industry.
  
  
We create iconic ice cream brands that are part of everyday life, bringing moments of joy to millions of people around the world. Everybody loves ice cream. And as the world’s biggest pure‑play ice cream company, we have the scale and ambition to make a real difference.
  
  
**What Truly Sets Us Apart Is How We Work.**
We move fast and keep things simple. We turn ideas into action, trust people to take ownership, and work as one team to win together with integrity. Our culture is high‑performance, collaborative and focused on getting things done.
  
  
We’re curious and ready for what’s next. We embrace digital, use data to make better decisions, and keep learning, including how AI can help us work smarter and serve consumers better.
  
  
**Role Purpose**
Responsible for ensuring product availability and service excellence through effective supply planning, inventory management, risk mitigation, and cross-functional collaboration.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Identify and manage supply risks, driving mitigation actions with Supply Units and relevant stakeholders.
* Monitor inventory levels, forecast performance, and stock projections to ensure target service levels.
* Manage supply shortages, out-of-stock situations, and customer escalations with end-to-end ownership.
* Coordinate distribution planning between warehouses and secondary distribution centers.
* Oversee local repacking schedules and execution with warehouse teams.
* Support product transitions including listings, de-listings, and flow-through activities.
* Assess incremental stock requests and provide timely feasibility feedback.
* Manage obsolete inventory, write-offs, disposals, and stock health reporting.
* Maintain master data, purchase order corrections, and invoice-related updates.
* Generate and analyze supply chain reports, service metrics, and inventory performance dashboards.
* Collaborate with Supply, Logistics, Warehousing, and Commercial teams to optimize service and operational efficiency.

**Requirements**

* Experience in Supply Planning, Inventory Management, or Customer Supply Chain.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
* Proficiency in SAP/ERP systems and advanced Excel.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

**Why join us?**
This is a place for people who are passionate about ice cream and are growth obsessed - both for the business and for themselves. People who act like an owner and drive our business end-to-end. People who are driven by success to deliver more than we ever thought we could!
  
  
You’ll thrive here if you value an inclusive culture, with low ego and hierarchy - and if you’re excited to continuously learn and challenge how we work, using digital, data, and new thinking to push us forward.
  
  

* Roles with real accountability and visible impact
* Free to move fast, experiment and challenge how things are done
* Continuous learning and development as the business grows
* Reward linked to performance and contribution.

Your career here is shaped by what you deliver, as you work across functions and markets and grow with the business.

title: Security Consultant II
description:
**About Gruve**
 Gruve is an innovative software services startup dedicated to transforming enterprises to AI powerhouses. We specialize in cybersecurity, customer experience, cloud infrastructure, and advanced technologies such as Large Language Models (LLMs). Our mission is to assist our customers in their business strategies utilizing their data to make more intelligent decisions. As a well\-funded early\-stage startup, Gruve offers a dynamic environment with strong customer and partner networks.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 Security Consultant owning VAPT and Red Teaming engagements across infrastructure, network, web, mobile, API, thick\-client, cloud and AI/LLM environments. The role involves identifying and exploiting security weaknesses, simulating real\-world adversary techniques, developing proof\-of\-concept exploits, documenting findings and providing clear remediation guidance to technical and business stakeholders. The consultant will also support purple\-team activities, mentor junior resources and contribute to offensive security capability development.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Perform Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing across infrastructure, network, web, mobile (Android/iOS), API, thick\-client and cloud environments (AWS/Azure/GCP).
* Identify, validate and document vulnerabilities using manual testing techniques and automated security tools; develop PoCs to demonstrate exploitability.
* Conduct database security testing and configuration reviews across MySQL, Oracle and NoSQL platforms.
* Plan, execute and document Red Team engagements simulating real\-world threat actor TTPs mapped to MITRE ATT\&CK.
* Execute attack chains covering initial access, lateral movement, privilege escalation and data exfiltration.
* Conduct Active Directory exploitation, phishing/social\-engineering campaigns and endpoint security bypass exercises.
* Use and adapt adversary\-emulation tools and frameworks such as Cobalt Strike, Metasploit and Caldera.
* Collaborate with Blue Teams during purple\-team exercises to validate and improve detection and response capabilities.
* Perform security testing of AI/ML and LLM\-based applications, including prompt injection, jailbreak, model extraction and adversarial\-input testing.

title: Principal Firmware Engineer, High-Speed Ethernet
description:
**Description**
**Invent the future with us.**
Ampere is a semiconductor design company for a new era, leading the future of computing with an innovative approach to CPU design focused on high-performance, energy efficient AIcompute.
  
  
As a pioneer in the new frontier of energy efficient high-performance computing, Ampere is part of the Softbank Group of companies driving sustainable computing for AI, Cloud, and edge applications.
  
  
Join us at Ampere and work alongside a passionate and growing team - we’d love to have you apply!
  
  
**About the role:**
We are seeking a hands-on
**Principal Firmware Engineer**
to lead the architecture, design, development, integration, and validation of low-level firmware for high-speed Ethernet solutions, including
**Gigabit MAC/PCS/PHY-adjacent interfaces, PTP/gPTP timing, TSN features, DMA, QoS, and platform drivers**
.
  
  
This role requires a technically strong engineer who can operate at both system and register level: define firmware architecture, develop production-quality drivers, diagnose hardware/software issues on silicon, guide firmware engineers, and collaborate closely with RTL, verification, silicon validation, applications, and customers.
  
  
The successful candidate will own critical aspects of the Ethernet firmware stack from boot-time initialization through high-throughput data-path operation, time synchronization, traffic scheduling, error handling, diagnostics, and performance characterization.
  
  
**What you’ll achieve:**
**Technical Architecture and Ownership**

* Define firmware architecture for high-speed Ethernet subsystems supporting high speed gigabit Ethernet modes.
* Lead design of low-level drivers for Ethernet MAC, DMA, PCS, SerDes/PHY control interfaces, MDIO, interrupt controllers, clock/reset, and associated IP blocks.
* Define scalable driver state machines for initialization, configuration, link management, normal operation, diagnostics, fault recovery, and reset handling.
* Establish firmware interfaces and configuration models for Ethernet QoS, PTP, TSN, packet classification, DMA queues, and traffic scheduling.
* Identify hardware/software integration risks early and influence hardware architecture, register design, diagnostics, and verification requirements.
* Design firmware for high-throughput and low-latency operation for Gigabit Ethernet.
* Analyze and optimize CPU utilization, DMA bandwidth, memory bandwidth, interrupt load, cache behavior, and buffer utilization.
* Drive root-cause analysis for packet loss, descriptor corruption, DMA stalls, RX starvation, TX underflow, FIFO overflow, bus errors, and performance regressions.
* Ensure correct cache-coherency and memory-ordering behavior on Arm-based SoCs with coherent or non-coherent DMA.

**PTP / gPTP / Time Synchronization**

* Develop and integrate firmware support for hardware timestamping and IEEE 1588 PTP / IEEE 802.1AS gPTP.
* Configure and manage PTP clocks, timestamp units, clock adjustment, rollover handling, and TX/RX timestamp correlation.
* Support synchronization applications requiring deterministic timing and bounded timestamp latency.
* Develop diagnostics and performance characterization for time synchronization accuracy, offset, drift, jitter, timestamp loss, and synchronization recovery.
* Collaborate with system/software teams on PTP stack integration and time-domain requirements.

**TSN and Ethernet QoS**

* Lead firmware enablement for relevant TSN and QoS capabilities
* Define queue allocation, scheduling, buffer, and congestion-management policies for mixed traffic environments.
* Develop traffic test scenarios to validate latency, jitter, throughput, packet loss, fairness, and isolation under congested conditions.

**Bring-Up, Debug, and Validation**

* Lead pre-silicon and post-silicon firmware bring-up for Ethernet subsystems.
* Debug complex hardware/firmware interactions
* Develop fault-injection and negative-test scenarios
* Drive technical resolution of customer and field escalations.

**Leadership and Collaboration**

* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to firmware engineers.
* Lead architecture reviews, code reviews, debug reviews, and design-for-testability discussions.
* Establish reusable driver frameworks, coding patterns, debug utilities, and test infrastructure.
* Work closely with RTL, design verification, validation, software, systems, security, safety, product, and customer engineering teams.
* Guide junior and senior engineers toward independent ownership of firmware subsystems.
* Communicate technical risks, design choices, trade-offs, and milestones clearly to engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.

**About you:**

* Bachelor's degree with 8 years or Master’s degree with 6 years of experience in embedded firmware, device-driver, networking, or semiconductor software development experience
* Proven hands-on experience developing low-level drivers for Ethernet MAC, DMA, PHY/PCS control, networking accelerators, or comparable high-performance peripheral IP.
* Strong understanding of Ethernet fundamentals including Ethernet frame format; MAC and PHY operation; VLAN / IEEE 802.1Q; QoS / 802.1p; link negotiation and management; MDIO/MDC; flow control; multicast and filtering.
* Strong experience with DMA architectures
* Strong understanding of embedded C/C++ and low-level programming concepts:
* Strong Arm SoC knowledge of Cortex-A, Cortex-R, Cortex-M;
* Experience with IEEE 1588 PTP, gPTP, hardware timestamping, or time synchronization systems.
* Demonstrated ability to debug difficult system issues using hardware and software observability tools.
* Ability to lead technical design and influence teams across firmware, RTL, verification, and validation.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with 25GbE, 10GbE, 40GbE, 50GbE, or other high-speed Ethernet MAC/PCS/SerDes-based systems.
* Experience with TSN features including IEEE 802.1Qav, 802.1Qbv, 802.1Qbu, 802.1Qci, IEEE 802.3br, and IEEE 802.1AS.
* Experience with Ethernet MACsec / IEEE 802.1AE, MKA, replay protection, secure association management, or secure networking.
* Experience with high-speed packet test equipment, traffic generators, packet analyzers, and performance benchmarking.
* Experience with FPGA prototyping, emulation, pre-silicon firmware development, or post-silicon validation.

**What we’ll offer:**
At Ampere we believe in taking care of our employees and providing a competitive total rewards package that includes base pay, cash long-term incentive, and comprehensive benefits.
  
  
Benefits highlights include:
  
  

* Premium medical, dental, vision insurance, parental benefits includingcrechereimbursement, as well as a retirement plan,so thatyou can feel secure in your health,financial futureand child care during work.
* Generous paid time off policy so that you can embrace a healthy work-life balance
* Fully catered lunch in our office along with a variety of healthy snacks, energizing coffee or tea, and refreshing drinks to keep you fueled and focused throughout the day.

And thereismuch more than compensation and benefits. At Ampere, we foster an inclusive culture that empowers our employees to do more and grow more. We are excited to share more about our career opportunities with you through the interview process.
  
  
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
  
  
Ampere is an inclusive and equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, religion, age, veteran and/or military status, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, physical or mental disability, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law.

title: Senior Analyst / Tech Lead – Detection Engineering & Cloud SecOps
description:
***Senior Analyst / Tech Lead – Detection Engineering & Cloud SecOps***

**Experience :**
5–8 years

**Primary skills :**
Detection Engineering, SIEM & SOAR Engineering, Cloud Security Operations

Also valued

AWS CloudTrail/GuardDuty, Microsoft Defender for Cloud/Entra ID, GCP Security Command Center, MITRE ATT&CK mapping

**About Searce**

Searce is an AI outcome engineering company and a modern technology consultancy that helps enterprises futurify their business with AI, cloud and data. Founded in 2004, we are 1,300+ Searcians across 12 countries, with deep business process expertise, a Google Cloud Global MSP status and compliance credentials including PCI DSS and ISO 27001. We solve with our proprietary evlos™ problem-solving methodology: no bureaucratic fluff, working prototypes fast, and production scale that holds.

**About ATRE**

ATRE (AI Trust & Resilience Engineering) builds and runs security operations for enterprise customers across cloud and AI workloads. We treat detection as engineering: rules are tested, tuned and measured like production code. Our teams work closely with customers to reduce risk and noise at the same time.

**Role overview**

You will be the senior hands-on engineer for detection and response in Pune. You will own detection content, SIEM and SOAR health, and high-severity investigations, and set the technical standard for the SOC analysts around you.

What you'll do

* **Detection Engineering:**
  Design, write, test and tune correlation rules and behavioral detections in the SIEM, cutting false positives and alert noise each quarter.
* **SIEM & SOAR Engineering:**
  Own log ingestion, parsing and health for Sentinel, Chronicle or Splunk, and build SOAR playbooks in Cortex XSOAR or Tines to cut MTTR.
* **Cloud Security Operations:**
  Monitor AWS, Azure and GCP through CloudTrail, GuardDuty, Defender for Cloud and Security Command Center, with detections on IAM anomalies and misconfigurations.
* **Advanced Triage & Incident Response:**
  Lead deep-dive investigations of high-severity alerts across logs, endpoints and networks, driving each one from root cause to remediation within SLA.
* **Technical Leadership:**
  Mentor SOC analysts on KQL, SPL and YARA-L, threat hunting and investigation tradecraft, and set detection coverage standards mapped to MITRE ATT&CK.

What you bring

* 5–8 years of direct hands-on experience in a SOC, detection engineering, incident response or SecOps engineering role.
* Advanced proficiency writing complex queries and rules in an enterprise SIEM such as Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, Google SecOps/Chronicle, Elastic or QRadar, using KQL, SPL or YARA-L.
* Proven experience building automated response workflows in a SOAR tool such as Cortex XSOAR, Splunk SOAR, Tines or Sentinel Automation.
* Scripting skills in Python, PowerShell or Bash to integrate security APIs.
* Strong operational command of EDR/XDR platforms, Windows and Linux internals, network protocols and attacker techniques.

Good to have

* Hands-on experience securing and monitoring AWS, Azure or GCP, working with native telemetry such as AWS CloudTrail/GuardDuty, Microsoft Defender for Cloud/Entra ID or GCP Security Command Center. This is a high-priority skill for this role.

**Why Searce**

You will work with a solver mindset in an AI-native practice, where AI outcome engineering is how we deliver. We invest in learning and growth, and you will have room to build and lead. Our culture is blameless and solver-minded, guided by our HAPPIER values, so we fix systems, not people.

title: Security Analyst II
description:

*****This role operates in a hybrid structure with on-site presence four days a week, specifically Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, based in Pune, India.*****

* Lead customer consultations on security incidents via video, phone, chat, and ticket; deliver expert analysis and actionable recommendations.

**Required Skills**

* Solid understanding of cloud security across Azure, AWS, and VMware including identity, networking, and workload protection.
* Forensic analysis skills including host triage, log analysis, and malware identification.
* Proficient in scripting (Python, PowerShell, KQL) for analysis, automation, and detection development.

* Working knowledge of vulnerability management, control validation, and security policy frameworks.
* Demonstrated mentoring and training ability.
* Strong customer consultation and advisory skills; comfortable leading engagements via video, phone, chat, and ticket in English.
* Ability to analyze complex attack chains and communicate findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.

**Education And/Or Experience**

* Required certifications within 12 months: AZ-500, SC-200, SC-300, SC-401.

* Demonstrated commitment to ongoing professional development and continuing education.

As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. #VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture
  
  
**About This Role**
We are seeking an experienced Senior Windows & Endpoint Security Engineer to manage enterprise-scale Windows Server environments across on-premises and Microsoft Azure platforms. The role focuses on secure and highly available Windows workloads, Active Directory services, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint (MDE), security compliance and L3 technical support. The position is based in Pune and sits within Data Center Operations.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Administer Windows Server 2016, 2019 and 2022 environments at enterprise scale, covering build, hardening, patching, upgrades, performance, capacity and decommissioning
* Act as an L3 escalation point for complex Windows Server incidents and technical problems.
* Manage Microsoft Defender for Endpoint onboarding and server health, including antivirus policies, exclusions and agent lifecycle management.
* Collaborate with SOC and Cyber Security teams and support security audits and compliance reporting
* Drive Windows security baselines, patch compliance, vulnerability remediation and security posture improvements.
* Design, administer and optimise Active Directory Domain Services, including GPO structures, OU design, delegated administration, Domain Controllers, replication, FSMO roles and recovery scenarios
* Support Active Directory security hardening, logging and privileged access monitoring
* Administer Windows Server workloads hosted on Microsoft Azure IaaS, including virtual machines, availability sets/zones, scaling strategies, monitoring agents and security integrations. [
* Support hybrid identity scenarios and on-premises-to-Azure migration and post-migration optimisation
* Troubleshoot Azure networking, VM health, extensions and performance issues, while using automation and operational standards to reduce recurring problems

**Who You Are**
You bring 6–8+ years of experience working with Windows Server and Active Directory environments.

title: Head of Information Security
description:
Leapswitch Networks (CloudPe)
  
  

* Contract consultants also considered

We run data centres, a public cloud and VPS and hosting services for thousands of businesses. Attackers now use AI to find and exploit weaknesses at machine speed, so we need a security leader who defends at the same speed. You will own security across our whole platform, with direct access to the founders and real authority to change how we work.
  
  
What you will do
  
  

* See us as an automated attacker does: continuous attack-surface monitoring, and actively exploited vulnerabilities patched or mitigated in hours, not weeks.
* Build zero-trust access with phishing-resistant MFA, short-lived credentials and just-in-time admin access for people, services and AI agents.
* Run detection engineering, threat hunting and an AI-assisted SOC; lead incident response, including CERT-In reporting.
* Validate continuously with red-team and purple-team exercises, automated testing and a disclosure programme.
* Secure our own AI agents and LLM automation against prompt injection, excessive agency and credential leakage.
* Own supply-chain and vendor risk, backups and ransomware resilience, fraud and abuse, and ISO 27001 readiness.
* Build and lead a small security team.

What you bring
  
  

* 10+ years in infrastructure or security, 4+ leading security at a hosting, cloud, data centre or telecom company.
* An offensive mindset: you have run or led penetration tests or red-team work against infrastructure.
* A clear view of how attackers use AI, and real use of AI in your own security work, including where it fails.
* Hands-on depth in Linux hardening, SSH and key management, firewalls, network ACLs, and KVM, OpenStack, VMware or Virtuozzo security.
* Real incidents led end to end, from first hour to root cause.
* Knowledge of CERT-In directions and the DPDP Act; clear writing for engineers and leadership.

Nice to have
  
  
1 OSCP or OSEP, GIAC, CISSP or CCSP; ISO 27001 or SOC 2 audit experience.
  
  
2 LLM red-teaming, MITRE ATLAS, detection-as-code, eBPF runtime security.
  
  
3 Published research, CVEs or open-source security tools.
  
  
How to apply
  
  
Apply with your CV and a short note in the Application Form on a security problem you fixed in an infrastructure environment: what you found, what you changed, and the result. Tell us one way you use AI in that work.

* Good knowledge of Windows administration; basic networking knowledge (TCP/IP) is a plus.
* Knowledge of identity & access management lifecycle processes (request, approval, provisioning, review, revocation) is an advantage.
* Structured, service-oriented way of working with strong communication and problem-solving skills.
* Very good German and good English skills, both written and spoken.

Technical Environment

You will review proposed and existing architectures, identify security design gaps and recommend appropriate controls to embed security at the design stage. The role requires strong knowledge of security architecture, perimeter and network security, information security risk assessment and recognised security frameworks, combined with the ability to engage effectively with technical architects, local markets and Group stakeholders.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Review and provide feedback on CCP, Tufin and demand requests in line with assigned responsibilities

* Collaborate with teams across different verticals, local markets and Group functions to ensure appropriate security requirements are incorporated into new solutions
* Apply knowledge of firewalls, routing, VPNs, proxies, IP networks and zoning concepts when assessing designs
* Maintain relevant SOPs and operational documentation
* Contribute to knowledge transfer and knowledge-acquisition sessions for team members
* Identify opportunities to improve or automate Secure by Design processes and support business cases for additional or expanded services
* Communicate recommendations clearly and help stakeholders resolve complex security and risk-management challenges

**Who You Are**

* You bring approximately 8–12 years of IT experience, with relevant experience in areas such as perimeter security, firewall technologies, VPN, proxy, network engineering or network management
* You have practical knowledge of information security, security architecture and risk-assessment methodologies

* You have good knowledge of cloud, data centre and application security, including cloud environments such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform and Oracle Cloud

* You have experience assessing technical designs and providing security architecture guidance to technical teams
* You understand relevant security principles and technologies, including PKI, SSL, IKEv1/IKEv2, sandboxing and advanced persistent threats
* You are familiar with recognised frameworks or standards such as TOGAF, SABSA, Zachman, ISO 27001, NIST, SANS, CIS, NIST SP 800-53, NIST SP 800-37 and COBIT 5
* You understand OWASP Security by Design principles and have awareness of data privacy, information protection and GDPR
* You can structure complex problems, assess alternatives and communicate practical security recommendations to technical and business stakeholders
* You have strong written and verbal communication skills
* Previous telecommunications industry experience would be beneficial
* Relevant certifications such as CCNA, CISM, CISSP, ISO 27001, ISO 31000/31001, CASP+, or certification in an architecture framework would be beneficial

* Collaboration with technical architects, business teams, Vodafone local markets and Group stakeholders

title: Senior SDET (Python, Playwright, pytest)
description:
**Senior SDET (Python, Playwright, pytest)**

**THE ROLE**

Own test automation and quality for Securly Flex, a market-leading EdTech product. Securly Flex is the #1 flexible scheduling software for K-12 schools. It builds time into the school day for intervention and enrichment, and serves as the scheduling engine behind schools' MTSS and RTI programs. Its Autoassign feature uses thousands of data points each night to build the next day's flex period rosters, so students are assigned where they're needed most based on teacher priorities and student needs.

This is a senior engineering role, not a QA role. You will own and scale our Python-based test platform (pytest and Playwright for Python), write the framework code yourself, and define what "ready to release" means for Flex. You'll use AI coding tools such as Cursor, Claude Code and Copilot as an everyday part of how you build and scale coverage.

**Location:**
Pune, India (Hybrid – 2–3 days onsite)

**Experience:**
6–12 years

**Reports to:**
Director of Quality Engineering

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* **Own and evolve the framework.**
  Extend and improve the Flex automation framework in Python (pytest and Playwright): fixtures, reusable libraries, test data utilities, parallel execution (pytest-xdist), and reporting that the whole team builds on.
* **Test complex scheduling logic.**
  Automate placement logic, capacity limits, sign-up cutoffs, permissions, and concurrent registrations, at both the API and UI layers.
* **Gate every release.**
  Set the CI/CD quality bar and enforce it in the pipeline, so regressions don't reach production.
* **Lead with AI-assisted engineering.**
  Use Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot and Playwright MCP to generate scenarios, build faster, and triage failures, and help the team adopt them well.
* **Set performance baselines.**
  Measure peak-load moments, such as thousands of students signing up in the same minute, and define what counts as a performance regression.
* **Cover web, mobile, and integrations.**
  Own end-to-end coverage across student, teacher, and admin workflows, the mobile app, SIS roster imports and attendance exports, single sign-on, and notifications.

  — strong, production experience writing automation in Python with pytest and Playwright. You understand fixtures and their scopes, test isolation, and modern Playwright practices (role-based locators, auto-waiting assertions, tracing). Strong TypeScript or Java Playwright engineers who are ready to work in Python will also be considered.
* **Test framework architecture**
  — you've designed automation frameworks that other engineers extend. You build the platform, not just the scripts.
* **API and business-rule automation**
  — REST and contract testing, plus testing business rules (placement, capacity, eligibility, state transitions), not just UI flows.

  — you've defined what blocks a release, not just written the tests that check it.

  — clean, production-quality Python written from scratch, including data structures and logic. You catch edge cases and API contract details, and your test code is held to the same standard as product code.

  — Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, with 6–12 years of hands-on SDET / test automation experience.

**Strongly Preferred**

* **AI coding tools**
  — hands-on use of Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, or Playwright MCP to build tests, generate scenarios, or triage failures.
* **Performance and concurrency testing**
  — k6, JMeter, Gatling, or Locust, including burst traffic and race conditions.
* **Security and access-control testing**
