title: Senior Analytics Engineer, FinOps Reporting
description:
**Location:**
Anywhere in India (Hybrid or Home based)
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
Bentley Systems is seeking a Senior Power BI Data Modeler to own the reporting and semantic layer supporting the company’s Cloud and AI technology spend. In this role, you will develop and maintain certified datasets, establish appropriate access controls, and deliver executive, team-level, and self-service reporting through Power BI using data from Databricks and BigQuery.
  
  
This position is responsible for the quality and ongoing management of these data products, including how they are modeled, governed, secured, and maintained. Success in this role requires ensuring that technology cost data is accurate, current, appropriately permissioned, and accessible to the teams responsible for managing it.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain certified shared datasets and semantic models supporting Cloud and AI technology spend.
* Create dimensional data models, star schemas, DAX measures, and incremental refresh processes using Power BI and the Databricks data catalog.
* Own the access model for technology spend data, ensuring that teams can securely access the information applicable to their areas.
* Configure and maintain access controls, including role-based access control, row-level security, object-level security, and sensitivity labels.
* Ensure reporting solutions comply with applicable security and data governance standards.
* Automate governance, security, deployment, and maintenance activities through APIs, scripts, and notebooks.
* Perform data validation, reconciliation, and tie-out exercises to support the testing of new and existing project financial data models and enhancements.
* Establish and monitor data refresh service-level expectations, failure alerts, and controls that allow issues to be identified and addressed promptly.
* Build and maintain executive, team-level, and self-service reports covering cost allocation, budget-to-actual variance, commitment coverage, and unit economics.
* Partner with engineering, product, finance, and other stakeholders to ensure that financial data models accurately reflect business requirements.
* Help engineering and product teams understand, interpret, and use their technology cost data effectively.
* Drive adoption of certified datasets and self-service reporting capabilities across participating teams.
* Apply Git-based development and deployment practices to semantic models and reporting solutions.
* Maintain clear documentation for datasets, calculations, access controls, and reporting processes.
* This is a full-time position. Travel requirements and typical working hours will be based on the role’s assigned location.
* Requires sitting or standing at will while performing work on a computer.

**Qualifications**

* 7 to 8 years of relevant experience in business intelligence, analytics engineering, data modeling, data warehousing, or a related discipline.
* At least two years of experience owning shared or certified datasets and data products, rather than focusing exclusively on individual report development.
* Advanced experience with Power BI semantic modeling, including star schemas, DAX, incremental refresh, and row-level security.
* Strong SQL skills and experience working with Databricks SQL and Delta Lake.
* Strong understanding of dimensional modeling and data warehousing principles.
* Experience designing star schemas and enterprise-level reporting models.
* Experience working with large-scale datasets and complex reporting environments.
* Experience implementing access and data security controls, such as role-based access control, row-level security, object-level security, and sensitivity labels.
* Experience using Git-based version control and deployment practices.
* Experience validating and reconciling financial or operational data across source systems, models, and reports.
* Working knowledge of financial and cost-allocation concepts, or the ability to develop that knowledge quickly, including the differences between amortized and billed costs.
* Ability to take ownership of data quality, refresh reliability, access governance, and the ongoing maintenance of data products.
* Ability to communicate complex data and financial concepts to engineering, product, finance, and executive stakeholders.
* Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate, or successful completion of the PL-300 certification exam.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working with cloud and technology billing data from platforms such as Azure Cost Management, Google Cloud Billing, or AWS.
* Experience analyzing or reporting on AI-related technology costs, including services such as Claude or Microsoft Copilot.
* Experience developing cost-allocation models for multi-tenant products, platforms, or environments.
* Experience supporting FinOps, technology business management, cloud cost optimization, or related financial management practices.
* FinOps Certified Practitioner credential, or willingness to earn the certification within the first year of employment with company sponsorship.

This is a Hybrid role.
  
  
**What We Offer**

* Step into a collaborative work environment where ideas flourish, and teamwork propels us forward towards shared success.
* An attractive salary and benefits package.
* Bentley Impact Day: take a day off from work to volunteer with an organization of your choice.
* Celebrate milestone achievements and moments that matter through our colleague recognition award programs and our Bentley Achievers platform.
* A commitment to inclusion, belonging and colleague wellbeing through global initiatives and resource groups.
* Be part of a company committed to making a real difference by advancing the world’s infrastructure for better quality of life, where your contributions help build a more sustainable, connected, and resilient world. Discover our latest user success stories for an insight into our global impact.

**Who We Are**
Bentley Systems (Nasdaq: BSY) is the infrastructure engineering software company. We provide innovative software to advance the world’s infrastructure – sustaining both the global economy and environment. Our industry-leading software solutions are used by professionals, and organizations of every size, for the design, construction, and operations of roads and bridges, rail and transit, water and wastewater, public works and utilities, buildings and campuses, mining, and industrial facilities. Our offerings, powered by the iTwin Platform for infrastructure digital twins, include MicroStation and Bentley Open applications for modeling and simulation, Seequent’s software for geoprofessionals, and Bentley Infrastructure Cloud encompassing ProjectWise for project delivery, SYNCHRO for construction management, and AssetWise for asset operations. Bentley Systems’ 5,200 colleagues generate annual revenues of more than $1 billion in 194 countries.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Employer**
Bentley is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and considers for employment all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, gender/gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, marital status, religion/belief, national origin, caste, age, or any other characteristic protected by local law or unrelated to job qualifications.

title: Credit Manager
description:
The Credit Manager is responsible for the delivery of high quality, ongoing operation of the credit and collections processes, applied to customers in a range of geographic territories. This role will be responsible for proposing changes and improvements to the existing Credit Risk & Collection Strategy and rolling out processes and procedures which are aligned to the existing S&N Control framework.
  
  
The Credit Manager will work with a cross-functional stakeholder base (Finance, Commercial & Legal) to improve process and resolve issues to ensuring that the target Day-Sales-Outstanding is met.
  
  
The role will design appropriate governance structures to minimize bad debt exposure to S&N over the credit management process (including monitoring & management of credit limit balances, blocked order releases and annual credit limit re-approvals) and the Collection Strategy in conjunction with Collections Team Lead (including AR monitoring, collections, dispute management, bad debt provision calculation and AR write-off).
  
  
The role holder will own the identification and implementation of Continuous Improvement in the operational processes and performance. This will include monitoring and optimization of activities currently performed, review and approval of all relevant Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), mentoring and training GBS team members, and identification and migration of further activities as appropriate.
  
  
The role holder works in close unison with commercial team and finance business partner. Where appropriate the Credit Manager will visit select customers in person to negotiate payment plans and improvement in debt.
  
  
Responsibilities:
  
  

* Devise and manage operation of the Credit Management and Collections Strategy
* Close cooperation with commercial teams and key distributor customers
* Working with Collections Team Leads and Finance Operation Controller/Business Partner to set up and monitor monthly collections targets in line with a standard framework
* Operation and maintenance of Global Credit Management timetable of activities – including execution of key financial controls
* Minimize DSO, Aging and write off of debt
* Liaise with management in other functions (Sales, Customer Service, Order management) to improve the end-to-end process and unblock / resolve long running disputes and identify their root causes
* Manage customer credit limits in accordance with the Business Unit Strategy, ensuring sign off in alignment with Delegated Authority Matrix (DAM). Proactively monitor customer credit limit headroom to minimize blocked orders.
* Set the Business Unit rules and monitor compliance for the approval or Order Releases in accordance with the S&N Delegation of Authority Matrix. Embed rules within the system workflows, if not possible, design a compliant and efficient manual workflow approval process.
* Ensure appropriate governance structures are in place for disputed customer balances which lead to alternative payment arrangements (e.g. Payment plans), transfer of aged debt into the legal process, write-offs of debt.
* Ensure appropriate reporting is in place for teams to proactively monitor credit worthiness (AR ageing, credit limit headroom) and determine actions where there are changes in status that may impact DSO
* Review and approve SOPs
* Mentor and train Credit & Collections staff on market specifics and the localized collections strategy
* Creating procedures and policies that ensure timely payments while maintaining a high level of customer retention
* Act as an escalation point for commercial, Customer Service and OTC teams
* Site visits / face-to-face contact with key customers

Requirements:
  
  

* A minimum of 5 years' experience in Credit Management and Collections.
* Demonstrates experience in analyzing financial data, drawing sound conclusions and developing proposals/solutions.
* Must have strong credit control experience.

title: Senior AI Product Engineer
description:
**Role purpose:**

We are looking for a
**hands-on Senior AI Product Engineer**
to design, build, test and deploy enterprise AI applications and reusable agentic capabilities.

This is a role for a
**builder**
. The successful candidate will be expected to personally prototype, code, integrate, test, troubleshoot and improve AI solutions, working side-by-side with product, data, engineering and business teams.

The environment is fast-moving and priorities will evolve as AI technology, business requirements and our own capabilities mature. The role therefore requires someone who learns quickly and takes responsibility for turning ideas into working solutions.

**What the role will do -**

**Build AI products**

* Personally design and develop AI agents, agentic applications and reusable AI components.
* Build using platforms such as Microsoft Foundry, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Microsoft 365 agents and Snowflake Cortex.
* Develop prompts, orchestration logic, APIs, tools and application integrations.
* Build multi-agent workflows that combine specialist capabilities and governed enterprise data.
* Create human-in-the-loop and approval patterns for AI-driven business actions.
* Rapidly prototype ideas, put working solutions in front of users and iterate based on feedback.

**Move AI from insight to action**

* Build capabilities that allow AI to trigger or support real business actions rather than simply provide answers.
* Integrate AI products with Microsoft Teams, Dynamics 365 (including Sales) and other enterprise systems.
* Develop scheduled and automated AI workflows.
* Work directly with commercial and operational users to understand how AI can improve real workflows.
* Challenge requirements where a simpler, faster or more scalable technical approach exists.

**Industrialise what works**

* Take successful prototypes and make them robust enough for enterprise use.
* Personally develop automated tests and evaluation frameworks for agents, prompts and generated outputs.
* Implement logging, monitoring, error handling and observability.
* Apply strong source-control, testing, CI/CD and release-management practices.
* Troubleshoot production issues and continuously improve performance, reliability and cost.

**Create reusable capability**

* Identify engineering patterns that can be reused across multiple AI products.
* Build common agent tools, integrations and components rather than repeatedly solving the same problem.
* Document solutions well enough that other engineers can understand, support and extend them.
* Actively share engineering practices and help raise hands-on AI capability across the team.

**Work collaboratively**

* Work closely with AI product owners and business users to turn imperfect requirements into working solutions.
* Partner with Data Engineering to consume trusted, production-ready data products.
* Work alongside semantic/data-product engineers to translate business definitions into effective AI capabilities.
* Partner with Security and Responsible AI colleagues to solve control requirements without unnecessarily slowing delivery.
* Participate actively in design reviews, testing, user sessions and problem-solving rather than handing work between teams.

**What we're looking for -**

**Essential:**

* Strong, recent hands-on software engineering experience using
  **Python, TypeScript/JavaScript or both**
  .
* Demonstrable experience personally building applications using GenAI/LLMs.
* Experience building APIs, integrations and tool/function-calling patterns.
* Experience with agentic and/or multi-agent application patterns.
* Experience with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), grounding and context management over enterprise data.
* Strong understanding of Git, automated testing and CI/CD.
* Experience deploying and supporting cloud applications.
* Practical understanding of AI security and responsible AI risks, such as prompt injection, data leakage and access control.
* Ability to troubleshoot across application, AI, integration and data layers.
* Comfortable working iteratively where requirements and technology may change rapidly.
* Strong collaborator who can explain technical decisions to non-technical colleagues.

**Highly desirable:**

* Microsoft Foundry (formerly Azure AI Foundry)
* Microsoft Copilot Studio
* Microsoft 365 agents
* Snowflake Cortex Agents
* Microsoft Graph
* Dynamics 365 / Dataverse
* Microsoft Teams application development
* AI evaluation and observability frameworks
* Model Context Protocol (MCP) and agent-to-agent integration patterns

**The person we want:**

We are
**not**
looking for someone who primarily creates architecture diagrams, writes technical strategies or manages other engineers to do the work.

We want someone who:

* Builds things
* Is comfortable getting into the code and solving problems
* Experiments quickly but understands what production quality requires
* Doesn't wait for perfectly defined requirements before making progress
* Challenges assumptions constructively
* Works collaboratively rather than protecting technical territory
* Takes ownership from problem through working solution
* Is comfortable saying, "I don't know yet, let me test it"
* Has the confidence to drive change rather than wait for someone else to do it

**What success looks like:**

After 6–12 months:

* New AI ideas move from concept to a working prototype in weeks rather than months.
* Successful prototypes reach production rather than remaining demos.
* Reusable components shorten subsequent AI development.
* Agent testing and evaluation are increasingly automated.
* AI capabilities reliably connect insight to real business actions.
* The team has measurably increased its hands-on agentic engineering capability.

title: Senior Machine Learning Researcher
description:
Arkose Labs is on a mission to create an online environment where all consumers are protected from spam and abuse. As a Fast Company 2025 Best Workplace for Innovators, we provide a proactive fraud deterrence platform, Arkose Titan, designed to neutralize modern attacks powered by Agentic AI and LLMs. By combining proprietary intelligence with dynamic friction, we undermine attacker ROI to protect global giants like Microsoft, Meta, and Roblox. Headquartered in San Mateo, CA, we maintain a global presence across APAC, Central and South America, and EMEA.
  
  
**Position Overview**
As a Sr. Machine Learning Researcher specializing in security, you will apply your expertise in machine learning and cybersecurity to develop innovative solutions to detect, prevent, and respond to security threats and fraud. You will conduct independent research, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and stay abreast of the latest advancements in the field.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and implement ML and deep learning models to detect and mitigate security threats.
* Developing new product features using statistical/machine learning-based algorithms to identify bot and fraud traffic
* Conduct data cleaning, preprocessing, and exploratory data analysis. Apply statistical methods to analyze security-related data.
* Stay updated with the latest research and advancements in ML and cybersecurity. Publish research findings in reputable journals and conferences.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand project requirements and contribute to the development of solutions.
* Collaborate with security analysts, software engineers, and other stakeholders to integrate ML solutions into security products.
* Communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders effectively.

**Must Have**

* Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field.
* Proficiency in ML algorithms, neural networks, and model development.
* Experience with ML frameworks and libraries (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn).
* Strong coding skills in Python, R, and familiarity with languages such as C++, Java, or Scala.
* Ability to perform data cleaning, preprocessing, and exploratory data analysis.
* Strong understanding of statistical methods and their applications.
* Familiarity with cybersecurity concepts, threat models, and common attack vectors.
* Experience with security tools and technologies (e.g., intrusion detection systems, firewalls, malware analysis tools).
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to identify and mitigate security threats using ML techniques.
* Understanding of network security, bot security, application security, and incident response.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with bot detection, device fingerprinting, behavioral biometrics, or real-time risk scoring.
* Experience with low-latency, high-throughput ML serving infrastructure.
* Familiarity with current ML research relevant to fraud/security (e.g., following or contributing to arXiv publications in adversarial ML, anomaly detection, or graph learning).
* Experience scaling researcher productivity using Agentic AI.

title: AI Platform Lead
description:
The AI Platform Lead leads the development and evolution of Sensata's enterprise AI platform, delivering the shared services, tools, and infrastructure that enable scalable, secure, and reusable AI solutions. This role bridges AI architecture and solution delivery by providing the platform capabilities, governance controls, and engineering foundations that accelerate AI adoption across the enterprise.
  
  
**General Responsibilities**

* Leads the design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance of complex software. Writes code, builds reusable modules, and converts business and technical requirements into sound designs.
* Selects methods, technologies, interfaces, and design patterns for ambiguous assignments, ensuring solutions meet architecture, scalability, security, and industry standards.
* Leads code, design, and release reviews; refactors legacy code, integrates components, resolves defects, and improves application performance.
* Builds automated tests for reliability and regression coverage and advances reusable patterns, development standards, build automation, and continuous delivery.
* Leads major projects or workstreams by estimating effort, managing risks and dependencies, coordinating milestones, and partnering across functions on features and troubleshooting.
* Documents key processes and technical decisions, mentors engineers, evaluates new technologies, and supports quality, security, and industry compliance.

**Experience / Qualifications**

* Relevant work experience or knowledge of the role
* Must be a team player able to work in a fast-paced environment with demonstrated ability to handle multiple competing tasks and demands
* Strong communication skills; oral, written and presentation
* Strong organization, planning and time management skills to achieve results
* Strong personal and professional ethical values and integrity
* Takes ownership of meeting goals and standards
* Proficient in Microsoft Office programs (Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, and Excel)
* Strong interpersonal & collaboration skills to work effectively with all levels of the organization including suppliers and/or external customers

**Additional Responsibilities**
:
  
  

* Own, build, and run Sensata's enterprise AI platform on Azure, including Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, the LLM gateway, telemetry, and shared developer tools. Implement the reference architecture defined by the Principal AI Architect.
* Stand up and manage Dev/Test/Prod environments, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure-as-code so AI solutions are built, tested, and released the same way every time.
* Own production readiness and operations for AI solutions, including release management, monitoring, incident response, and scaling priority use cases from pilot to production.
* Put MLOps/LLMOps practices in place for model deployment, evaluation, versioning, and performance monitoring.
* Put platform security, identity and access controls, and responsible AI guardrails in place. Partner with IT on the underlying cloud, network, and identity foundations.
* Build reusable components, templates, APIs, and automation so AI engineers and data scientists can deliver faster and more consistently.
* Provide visibility into platform usage, performance, reliability, and cost. Drive optimization and own the platform roadmap.
* Lead and develop platform engineers, set engineering standards, and coordinate delivery across global teams.

**Additional Qualifications**
:
  
  

* 8+ years of experience in software engineering, platform engineering, cloud infrastructure, or enterprise technology roles.
* Professional proficiency in spoken and written English
* Experience building and supporting enterprise platforms, shared services, or developer enablement capabilities at scale.
* Strong knowledge of cloud platforms, APIs, platform architecture, system integration, and modern software development practices.
* Experience supporting AI, machine learning, generative AI, or advanced analytics solutions in enterprise environments.
* Knowledge of platform governance, security controls, identity and access management, monitoring, and operational excellence.
* Experience developing scalable services, automation frameworks, and reusable technical capabilities.
* Proven ability to lead complex technical initiatives and influence cross-functional teams without direct authority.
* Strong understanding of AI platform operations, usage monitoring, cost management, and performance optimization.
* Experience with Azure, AI platform technologies, MLOps, or cloud-native architectures preferred.
* Advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field preferred.

Smarter
**Together**

* Collaborating at Sensata means working with some of the world’s most talented people in an enriching environment that is constantly pushing towards the next best thing
* Employees work across functions, countries and cultures gaining new perspectives through mutual respect and open communication
* As OneSensata, we are working together to make things work together

title: Principal Platform Architect -Agentic AI
description:
Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!
  
  
**Job Details**
**About The Role**
We're looking for a Leena AI Architect to own the technical architecture, governance, and scaling strategy for our Leena AI deployment — the agentic AI platform powering "AI Colleagues" across HR, IT, and other Enterprise Applications. Where the Platform Engineer builds and operates individual workflows and connectors, the Architect sets the design standards, security model, and integration strategy the whole program runs on, and is accountable for how the platform scales across business units, geographies, and systems of record.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Platform & Solution Architecture
  
  

* Own the end-to-end architecture across Leena's core components — Orchestrator, Workbench, Context Graph & Memory, Knowledge Studio, AOP Studio, and Workflow Studio — ensuring they're configured and extended consistently across the organization.
* Define the reference architecture for how new AI Colleagues are scoped, built, and promoted through staging to production, aligned to Leena's SCOPE → BUILD → VALIDATE → OPERATE lifecycle.
* Set standards for Agent Operating Protocols (AOPs) and tool design so automations are consistent, auditable, and reusable across HR/IT domains rather than built ad hoc per team.

Integration & MCP Strategy
  
  

* Define the integration architecture connecting Leena AI to our systems of record (Workday, ServiceNow, Microsoft 365, etc.) and own the decision framework for native connector vs. REST API vs. MCP-based integration.
* Set enterprise standards for MCP usage — when to expose internal capabilities via Leena's own MCP server/A2A interface versus consuming external MCP servers via the Custom MCP or Pipedream MCP connectors — and review all new custom MCP server connections for security and design fit.
* Architect how Leena AI agents integrate with our own internal agents/tools exposed via MCP, keeping a single source of truth for what capabilities exist across the enterprise agent ecosystem.

Governance, Security & Compliance
  
  

* Design and own the platform's permissions and role-based access control model — at the Colleague, AOP, and tool level — ensuring AI Colleagues only see and do what their role allows across every connected system.
* Partner with InfoSec/compliance on data residency, credential management, OAuth client governance, audit logging, and prompt-injection/security review for all new integrations.
* Define observability and governance standards: what gets logged, what gets reviewed, and how incidents involving agent actions are escalated and resolved.

Technical Leadership
  
  

* Act as the primary technical authority and escalation point for Platform Engineers, Workflow builders, and implementation teams; review designs before they go to production.
* Mentor Platform Engineers on MCP integration patterns, AOP/workflow design, and troubleshooting.
* Own the technical relationship with Leena AI's solutions/support team — roadmap input, beta features, architecture reviews, incident escalation.

Roadmap & Scaling
  
  

* Build the multi-year roadmap for expanding AI Colleague coverage across business functions and geographies, including model configuration choices (e.g., WorkLM vs. other supported LLMs) where relevant to performance, cost, or compliance.
* Define success metrics and capacity/performance benchmarks for the platform as usage scales (ticket deflection, resolution accuracy, latency, cost per resolution).
* Evaluate new Leena AI platform capabilities (e.g., new connectors, Capability Discovery, Guardrails) and decide what gets adopted and how.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 8+ years in enterprise architecture, integration architecture, or solution architecture roles, including at least 2+ years working with agentic AI/conversational AI platforms (Leena AI, Moveworks, Microsoft Copilot Studio, or similar).
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Strong understanding of enterprise integration patterns: REST/SOAP APIs, OAuth 2.0, SSO/SAML, and the Model Context Protocol (client-server architecture, tool discovery, transport mechanisms).
* Experience designing role-based access control and security models for systems with broad access across HRMS/ITSM/ERP/CRM.
* Hands-on familiarity with at least 2–3 of: Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, ServiceNow, Microsoft 365/SharePoint.
* Experience setting technical standards and leading through influence across engineering, security, and business stakeholders — this is an architecture and governance role, not solely a hands-on build role.
* Strong communication skills; comfortable presenting architecture decisions to CXO-level and compliance stakeholders.

**Nice to Have**

* Direct experience with Leena AI's Orchestrator, AOP Studio, or Workflow Studio.
* Experience building or governing an organization's own MCP server(s) for internal agent ecosystems.
* Background in LLM Ops/model evaluation (benchmarking models for enterprise workflow reliability).
* Experience in regulated industries with compliance-heavy automation requirements.

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, systems engineering, information technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience required. Master’s degree in computer science, software engineering, systems engineering, information technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience preferred. 8+ years of experience in software engineering, systems engineering, solution architecture, or a related field required. Certification in solution architecture, cloud architecture, enterprise architecture, or equivalent preferred.

title: DE&A - Snowflake Architect
description:
**Job Description**
As a Snowflake Data Architect, you will be responsible for providing advisory and thought leadership on migration to Snowflake or implementing data solutions using Snowflake Cloud services including integration with existing data and analytics platforms and tools. You will contribute in pre-sales and design, implement scalable data architectures, and information solutions covering data security, data privacy, data governance, metadata management, multi-tenancy and mixed workload management, and provide delivery oversight. You will also guide clients on adopting the latest Snowflake platform capabilities, including the open lakehouse (Apache Iceberg v3), adaptive compute, streaming and Openflow ingestion, Horizon governance and security, and AI-ready and agentic workloads on Cortex, CoWork and CoCo.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Snowflake Architect at Zensar participates in end to end cycle from opportunity identification to its closure and takes up complete ownerships of project execution and provide valuable expertise in the project. You will do this by:
  
  

* Responding to client RFI, RFP documents with proper solution design including cost estimates
* Understanding customer requirements and create technical proposition
* Contributing to SoWs, technical project roadmaps, etc required for successful execution of projects leveraging Technical Scoping & Solutioning approach
* Advising clients on adopting the latest Snowflake platform capabilities (Iceberg v3 and Horizon Catalog, Adaptive Compute, Openflow and Datastream, dbt Projects, Cortex AI) and translating them into modernization roadmaps and business cases
* Architecting governed, AI-ready data platforms: secure agent and user access, semantic layers, AI cost governance and FinOps controls
* Leading migrations to Snowflake and accelerating them with AI-assisted tooling such as Snowflake AIM (SnowConvert AI, Snowpark Migration Accelerator)
* Managing and owning all aspects of technical development and delivery
* Understanding requirements and writing technical documents
* Ensuring code review and developing best practices
* Planning end to end technical scope of the project and customer engagement area including planning sprint and delivery
* Estimating effort, identifying risk and providing technical support whenever needed
* Demonstrating the ability to multitask and re prioritizing responsibility based on dynamic requirements
* Leading and mentoring teams as needed

**Qualifications**
12-15 Years of Data and Analytics experience with minimum 5+ years in Snowflake Cloud Data warehousing
  
  

* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Extensive experience in Snowflake – Virtual warehouse (Compute), Data modeling & storage including LDM/PDM design, data loading/unloading and data sharing, SnowSQL / Snowflake CLI as well as Snowflake Internals and integrations, SnowPipe implementation, S3 Internal data copy/movement, Snowflake security including readers and consumers accounts.
* Hands-on with the current Snowflake data engineering stack: Adaptive Compute and Gen2 warehouses, Dynamic Tables, Snowpipe Streaming (Kafka connector, elastic channels), Datastream (streaming), Openflow connectors and pipelines-as-code, dbt Projects on Snowflake, hybrid tables and Snowflake Postgres, with sound judgement on GA versus preview features
* Open lakehouse architecture on Snowflake: Apache Iceberg v3 (Snowflake-managed and externally managed tables, Horizon Catalog and Iceberg REST, vended credentials for external engines such as Spark and Trino), zero-copy integrations (for example SAP, Salesforce) and secure data sharing / Marketplace
* Data governance and security on Snowflake Horizon: Horizon Context, lineage and metadata connectors (including OpenLineage), masking and row access policies, Snowflake-provided tags, Trust Center, and governance for AI agents (agent identity, AI guardrails, multi-party approval)
* Cortex AI and agentic solutions: AI functions (AI\_COMPLETE, AI\_EXTRACT, AI\_PARSE\_DOCUMENT), Cortex Search and Analyst with semantic views, Snowflake CoWork (formerly Snowflake Intelligence), CoCo (formerly Cortex Code), Cortex AI Gateway and the Snowflake-managed MCP server
* Cost and performance governance (FinOps): budgets, resource monitors, per-user AI quotas, cost attribution on shared compute, query and warehouse optimisation
* Advance SQL knowledge and hands on experience on complex queries writing using with Analytical functions, Troubleshooting, problem solving and performance tuning of SQL queries accessing data warehouse as well as Strong knowledge on stored procedures
* 6+ Years of experience in Informatica 10.x & above with all modules including ETL design & development and troubleshooting / debugging, Repository Manager, Strong experience in Informatica Mapping Designer (Mapping & Mapplets creations using all Transformations) and Workflow Designer (Session & Task implementation and Job scheduling)
* Minimum 2 data lake & EDW implementations using Azure/AWS/GCP Cloud Data native services along with Snowflake cloud data warehouse.
* Design and build production data pipelines from ingestion to consumption within a big data architecture, using Java, Python, Scala and Snowpark.
* Good experience in Requirements Analysis and Solution Architecture Design, Data modelling, ETL, data integration and data migration design
* Well versed with Waterfall, Agile, Scrum and similar project delivery methodologies.
* Experienced in internal as well as external stakeholder management
* Experience in MDM / DQM / Data Governance technologies like Collibra, Atacama, Alation, Reltio, as well as Snowflake Horizon, will be added advantage.
* SnowPro Core / SnowPro Advanced (Architect, Data Engineer) certification will be added advantage.

**About Us**
At Zensar, we’re
*“experience-led everything”*

Part of the $4.8 billion RPG Group, we’re a community of 10,000+ innovators across 30+ global locations, including Milpitas, Seattle, Princeton, Cape Town, London, Zurich, Singapore, and Mexico City. Explore Life at Zensar and join us to Grow. Own. Achieve. Learn. to be the best version of yourself.
  
  
We believe the best work happens when individuality is celebrated, growth is encouraged, and well-being is prioritized. title: Lead Architect/Senior Associate Director
description:
Some careers shine brighter than others.
  
  
If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
  
  
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Sr. Associate Director, Solution Architecture
  
  
Ready to set the architecture direction for HSBC’s CTO Platforms domain?
  
  
Why HSBC
  
  
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world’s most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do.
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
Join CTO Platforms to shape the architectural direction for a value stream or domain within a large regulated bank. This role sets target and transition architectures and keeps delivery aligned to reference architectures, standards and guardrails. You’ll represent architecture in governance and Design Authority forums, presenting options and trade-offs and helping decisions land clearly. The role also focuses on cross-programme dependencies and early risk identification so delivery stays coherent across teams. You’ll influence strategic initiatives including Compass and the AI/GenAI agenda by promoting shared platforms and governed capabilities. Success looks like simpler, reusable and well-controlled technology outcomes that engineering teams can deliver with clarity and pace.
  
  
What you'll be doing
  
  

* Set architectural direction for an assigned value stream or domain aligned to target architecture, reference architectures, standards and guardrails
* Produce and maintain target and transition architectures with clear sequencing, dependencies, decision points and interim guardrails
* Represent architecture in governance and Design Authority forums, presenting options, trade-offs, recommendations and exception impacts
* Identify and manage cross-programme architectural dependencies, risks and constraints and escalate early to support timely decisions
* Embed alignment to Group architecture strategy and standards including Build vs Buy, reuse, simplification and control-by-design
* Shape architectural direction for strategic R&C initiatives including Compass and the AI/GenAI agenda to converge on shared platforms and governed capabilities
* Translate architectural direction into solution designs with engineering teams using patterns, non-functional requirements and guardrails to maintain delivery alignment
* Strengthen solution architecture capability across engineering through coaching, quality reviews and communities of practice

What we're looking for
  
  

* Bring extensive experience as a solution, domain or enterprise architect in a large complex and regulated organisation
* Demonstrate defining target-state architectures and translating them into transition states, roadmaps and decision frameworks
* Show strong experience reviewing solution designs and articulating options, trade-offs and recommendations based on evidence and standards
* Apply broad understanding of modern application, integration, data and cloud architectures including APIs, event-driven patterns, microservices, CI/CD and operational non-functional requirements
* Embed security, resilience, privacy, records management and auditability requirements into designs and delivery workflows
* Apply Build vs Buy, reuse, simplification and technology rationalisation including assessing Low-Code/No-Code and third-party options
* Use working knowledge of AI and GenAI architecture including responsible adoption, platform integration, data and knowledge foundations, governance, monitoring and evidence
* Operate effectively in senior governance forums and across geographically distributed teams with clear stakeholder management and influencing
* Communicate complex technology choices clearly through concise architecture artefacts for business and technology audiences

Building coherent platforms at scale
  
  
If you want to shape how platforms evolve across a complex environment this role offers the scope to make a visible difference. You’ll help teams converge on shared architectures that are easier to deliver, operate and govern. You’ll bring clarity to decisions that cut across programmes and turn architectural intent into practical delivery guardrails. If this aligns with the work you want to do next we’d welcome your application.
  
  
You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.
  
  
www.hsbc.com/careers
  
  
HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.”
  
  
Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

title: Specialist - Integration (AEM-IS)
description:
**Job Summary**
We are seeking a seasoned SAP Integration Specialist with deep expertise in SAP Cloud Platform Integration (CPI), SAP Integration Suite, SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP), and Advanced Event Mesh. In this role, you’ll design, develop, and maintain scalable integration solutions that bridge cloud and on-premise applications across global enterprise environments. You will also be instrumental in mentoring junior developers and driving best practices for integration design, security, and performance.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Key Responsibilities**

* Architect and lead the design of scalable, secure, and high-performance integration solutions using SAP BTP Integration Suite, CPI, and Solace PubSub+.
* Define integration strategies and roadmaps aligned with enterprise architecture and digital transformation goals.
* Lead the migration of legacy interfaces from SAP PI/PO to SAP Integration Suite, ensuring minimal disruption and optimal performance.
* Govern and optimize the use of SAP BTP services including API Management, Event Mesh, Open Connectors, and CPI-DS.
* Oversee the configuration and administration of Solace messaging infrastructure, including advanced topic routing and durable subscriptions.
* Champion API-first design principles, ensuring robust, reusable, and secure APIs using REST/SOAP standards.
* Collaborate with enterprise architects, business stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to define integration requirements and governance models.
* Mentor and guide junior developers, conduct code reviews, and lead knowledge-sharing initiatives.
* Establish best practices for monitoring, logging, and troubleshooting using tools like SAP Solution Manager, ElasticSearch, and Splunk.
* Drive continuous improvement through Agile methodologies, DevOps practices, and innovation initiatives.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
* 10+ years of experience Integration with 6+ years in SAP integration, including SAP PI/PO, SAP CPI, and SAP BTP.
* Proven experience in leading large-scale integration projects across cloud and on-premise systems.
* Deep technical expertise in ABAP, IDOCs, BAPI, RFC, and ALE.
* Strong command of Solace CLI, Solace APIs, and Solace Cloud Console.
* AI-augmented development experience
* Proficiency in Java, Groovy, Python, and integration-specific scripting.
* In-depth understanding of security protocols (OAuth, SAML, SSL) and API lifecycle management.
* Experience with SAP S/4HANA, SAP Fiori, and hybrid integration scenarios.
* Exposure to AI tools/technology would be nice to have.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* SAP certifications in Integration Suite, BTP, or Cloud Platform Integration.
* Good understanding of API Management tools like IBM API Connect, Apigee etc.
* Experience with DevOps tools (Git, Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes) and CI/CD pipelines.
* Familiarity with event-driven architectures, microservices, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Exposure to SAP Open Connectors, Graph API, and CAPM.
* Strong background in Agile delivery and tools like JIRA and Confluence.

**Technical Skills**

* Integration Tools: SAP CPI, SAP PI/PO, SAP BTP, API Management, Event Mesh, Cloud Connector
* Languages: Java, ABAP, Groovy, Python, JavaScript, XML/XSLT
* Protocols: REST, SOAP, IDOC, OData, RFC, BAPI, SFTP, HTTP
* Platforms: SAP S/4HANA, ECC, Fiori, HANA
* Tools: Eclipse, NetWeaver Studio, Postman, SoapUI, GitHub
* Cloud & DevOps: Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, Git, CI/CD

**Soft Skills**

* Strategic mindset with strong leadership and mentoring capabilities.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Analytical thinker with a passion for innovation and continuous improvement.
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, global, and collaborative environment.

**About Medline India**
Medline India was setup in 2010 in Pune, primarily as an offshore Development centre and to augment resources for Medline Industries LP headquartered in Chicago, USA. We are a 1500+ strong and growing team of technology, finance & and business support professionals who support our businesses worldwide towards a mission to make healthcare run better. We are proud to be certified as a ‘Great Place to Work’ by the Great Place to Work Institute® (India) for the duration May 2023 – May 2024.
  
  
We are an organization with a conducive work environment, ample opportunities to learn, contribute and grow with a highly empowered & engaged team. At present, Medline Industries, LP holds the esteemed position as the #1 market leader, delivering an extensive portfolio of over 550,000 medical products and clinical solutions. title: GMS-Senior-OT VM
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Job Description: Senior OT Vulnerability Management Analyst / Consultant**
**Experience**
: 5–8 Years
  
  
**Domain**
: Operational Technology (OT) / Industrial Cybersecurity
  
  
**Specialization**
: OT Vulnerability Management
  
  
**Role Level:**
Senior1,2 /Senior 3
  
  
**Role Summary**
We are looking for an experienced
**OT Vulnerability Management professional**
with 5–8 years of cybersecurity experience and strong exposure to industrial/OT environments.
  
  
The candidate will be responsible for supporting the end-to-end OT vulnerability management lifecycle, including
**OT asset and vulnerability monitoring, vulnerability identification and validation, risk-based prioritization, threat advisory monitoring, stakeholder notification, remediation coordination, governance, and reporting.**
The role requires hands-on experience working with
**OT IDS / asset visibility platforms such as Claroty and Nozomi Networks,**
along with a good understanding of industrial environments including ICS, PLCs, DCS, HMIs, engineering workstations, historians, and associated network infrastructure.
  
  
The role will work closely with plant/site OT teams, infrastructure and security teams, asset owners, OEMs, and third-party technology vendors to manage vulnerabilities while considering the availability, safety, and operational constraints inherent to manufacturing environments.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* OT Vulnerability Identification & Monitoring

+ Perform and support vulnerability assessment activities across OT environments using organization-provided OT security and vulnerability management tools.
+ Monitor vulnerabilities identified across OT assets such as PLCs, DCS, HMIs, engineering workstations, historians, Windows/Linux servers, network devices, and other industrial systems.
+ Review and analyze identified CVEs, security exposures, vulnerable firmware/software versions, and security misconfigurations.
+ Validate vulnerability findings against available asset, firmware, software, and exposure information.
+ Support identification and investigation of potential false positives and missing detections.
+ Maintain an accurate and actionable vulnerability backlog.

* OT IDS / Vulnerability Management Tools

+ Hands-on experience using one or more OT security platforms, preferably:

- Claroty
- Nozomi Networks

+ Use OT visibility/IDS platforms to review:

- Asset inventory and classification
- Vulnerabilities and CVEs
- Software and firmware information
- Network exposure and communications
- Risk information

+ Analyze vulnerability information produced by the organization's approved tooling and convert technical findings into actionable remediation recommendations.

* Risk-Based Vulnerability Prioritization

+ Perform risk-based prioritization rather than relying solely on CVSS severity.
+ Assess vulnerabilities considering:

- CVSS score and severity
- Exploitability
- Asset criticality
- OT/production impact
- Network exposure
- Existing compensating controls
- Threat intelligence
- Vendor/OEM guidance

+ Identify Critical and High-risk vulnerabilities requiring expedited stakeholder attention.
+ Support definition and application of vulnerability remediation priorities and timelines.
+ Prioritize vulnerabilities in a manner appropriate to OT environments where immediate patching may not always be operationally feasible.

* Threat & Vendor Advisory Monitoring

+ Monitor relevant OEM/vendor security advisories and industrial cybersecurity vulnerability notifications.
+ Correlate newly published vulnerabilities and advisories against known OT assets and exposures.
+ Assess whether vulnerable products, firmware, software, or components are present within the environment.
+ Identify potentially impacted sites/assets and communicate relevant vulnerability alerts to stakeholders.
+ Support threat-context enrichment and prioritization of vulnerabilities where appropriate.

* Vulnerability Alerts & Stakeholder Communication

+ Prepare and distribute relevant vulnerability alerts to plant/site and security stakeholders.
+ Clearly communicate:

- Affected products and assets
- Vulnerability severity
- Potential operational/security impact
- Known exposure
- Recommended actions
- Vendor/OEM recommendations where available

+ Escalate significant OT vulnerabilities through established governance channels.

* Remediation Recommendations & Coordination

+ Provide remediation recommendations based on tool findings, OEM/vendor guidance, and OT security good practices.
+ Recommend appropriate treatment options including, where relevant:

- Vendor-approved patching
- Firmware upgrades
- Configuration hardening
- Network segmentation
- Access restrictions
- Protocol/application allow-listing
- Enhanced monitoring
- Other compensating controls

+ Collaborate with OT/site teams, infrastructure teams, asset owners, OEMs, and third-party vendors to support vulnerability remediation.
+ Track vulnerabilities through remediation, mitigation, risk acceptance, or closure.
+ Validate closure of vulnerability findings based on available evidence.

* Governance & Reporting

+ Participate in regular OT vulnerability review and governance meetings with relevant stakeholders.
+ Track open vulnerabilities, remediation status, ageing, overdue actions, accepted risks, and compensating controls.
+ Prepare periodic operational and management reporting.
+ Support risk acceptance and sign-off processes for vulnerabilities that cannot be remediated within agreed timelines.
+ Support escalation of overdue or high-risk vulnerabilities.
+ Work with stakeholders to continuously improve vulnerability reporting and remediation tracking processes.

**Required Skills & Experience**
The candidate should have:
  
  

* 5–8 years of overall experience in cybersecurity, with demonstrated experience in vulnerability management and OT/ICS security.
* Practical experience working in OT / ICS / manufacturing environments.
* Hands-on experience with OT IDS / visibility tools such as Claroty and/or Nozomi Networks.
* Strong understanding of:

+ Vulnerability management lifecycle
+ CVE and CVSS
+ Risk-based vulnerability prioritization
+ Vulnerability validation and false-positive analysis
+ Threat and vendor advisory monitoring
+ Vulnerability remediation and mitigation
+ Compensating controls
+ Risk acceptance and exception management

* Understanding of common OT technologies and assets including:

+ PLC
+ DCS
+ HMI
+ SCADA
+ Engineering workstations
+ Historians
+ Industrial servers
+ Industrial network infrastructure

* Ability to coordinate effectively with plant/site OT teams, security teams, infrastructure teams, OEMs, and third-party vendors.
* Strong analytical, documentation, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.

**Preferred Knowledge**
Candidates with knowledge or working exposure to the following would be preferred:
  
  

* IEC 62443
* NIST SP 800-82
* NIST Cybersecurity Framework
* MITRE ATT&CK for ICS
* Purdue Model / industrial network segmentation
* OT asset criticality and consequence-based risk assessment
* Industrial patch and firmware management
* OT compensating controls and risk treatment strategies

**Key Competencies**
The ideal candidate should be able to:
  
  

* Analyze: Convert large volumes of OT vulnerability findings into meaningful risks.
* Prioritize: Identify what requires action first based on actual OT risk rather than CVSS alone.
* Communicate: Explain technical vulnerabilities and their business/operational implications to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Coordinate: Work across site OT teams, security, infrastructure, OEMs, and third parties.
* Govern: Drive vulnerability tracking, risk acceptance, escalation, and closure.
* Recommend: Propose practical remediation or compensating controls that consider OT safety and availability constraints.

Dynasty Developers Pvt Ltd is a real estate development company focused on creating high-quality residential and commercial projects. The organization emphasizes thoughtful design, reliable construction standards, and customer-centered service to deliver long-term value to property buyers and investors. Team members collaborate across functions to bring projects from concept to completion while maintaining transparency and professionalism. The company offers opportunities for growth, learning, and meaningful contribution within the dynamic real estate market of the Pune region.

**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Business Development Manager role based in the Pune Division. The Business Development Manager will identify and pursue new business opportunities, including partnerships, corporate clients, and channel relationships to drive sales and project occupancy. Daily activities include researching market trends, generating and qualifying leads, conducting client meetings and presentations, and negotiating deals in alignment with company objectives. The role involves close coordination with sales, marketing, and project teams to develop proposals, respond to inquiries, and ensure a smooth client experience from initial contact through closure. The Business Development Manager will also maintain a robust sales pipeline, prepare regular performance reports, and represent the company at events, industry forums, and client engagements.

**Qualifications**

* Strong business development, sales, and relationship management capabilities, with a track record of achieving or exceeding revenue targets.
* Ability to conduct market research, analyze customer needs, and translate insights into actionable business strategies.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, with the ability to build trust and influence diverse stakeholders.
* Solid organizational and time management skills, including managing a pipeline, prioritizing opportunities, and meeting deadlines.
* Comfort working on-site in the Pune Division, collaborating with cross-functional teams and engaging directly with clients.
* Proficiency with standard productivity and CRM tools to manage leads, track activities, and generate reports.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Real Estate, or a related field; relevant experience in real estate or property development is an advantage.
* Self-motivated, proactive, and adaptable, with a commitment to ethical, inclusive, and customer-focused business practices.

title: Senior Sales Reporting Analyst
description:
**Practice/Department:**
Enterprise Technology & Operations
  
  
**Position Title:**
Senior Sales Reporting Analyst
  
  
**Position Location:**
Remote
  
  
**Reports to:**
Senior Director, Data Analytics
  
  
**FLSAStatus**
Exempt
  
  
**SOC Occupational Code**
13-1111
  
  
**EEO-1 Job Category**
2
  
  
**Job Summary**
The Senior Sales Reporting Analyst role will assist with development and support reporting, analytics, and insights for the Sales organization. This role will partner closely with Sales leadership, Revenue Operations, Finance, and Data & Analytics to translate business needs into accurate, scalable, and actionable reporting solutions.
  
  
The role will have a strong focus on Salesforce reporting and analytics, while also supporting enterprise sales reporting across other data sources. The Senior Sales Reporting Analyst will support reporting across pipeline, bookings, invoiced performance, forecasting, customer performance, and other key sales metrics while helping ensure consistency in data, definitions, and reporting across platforms.
  
  
The ideal candidate has strong experience with Salesforce reporting and sales analytics, a solid understanding of B2B sales processes, and the ability to translate business questions into clear, scalable reporting and insights.
  
  
**Essential Functions**

* Design, build, and maintain sales reports, dashboards, and analytics for Sales, Revenue Operations, Finance, and executive leadership
* Develop and maintain Salesforce reports and dashboards supporting pipeline, opportunity management, forecasting, sales activity, and performance reporting
* Partner with business stakeholders to gather reporting requirements and translate them into scalable reporting and analytics solutions
* Support Quote-to-Cash reporting and analytics, including pipeline, bookings, backlog, invoiced revenue and gross profit, forecasting, win/loss, and sales performance metrics
* Analyze sales performance across key dimensions including AE, Sales Director, region, practice, customer, product, manufacturer/OEM, and opportunity
* Identify trends, risks, exceptions, and opportunities within sales data and help translate findings into actionable business insights
* Ensure data accuracy and consistency by validating Salesforce data, business definitions, hierarchies, and downstream reporting
* Support the definition and governance of key Sales KPIs, business rules, hierarchies, and reporting definitions
* Maintain and document report logic, filters, calculations, data sources, and metric definitions to support governance and self-service reporting
* Troubleshoot reporting issues, including data quality, permissions, hierarchy, and visibility challenges
* Support Salesforce releases, enhancements, and process changes by assessing and validating reporting impacts
* Collaborate with Data Engineering and BI teams to align Salesforce reporting with enterprise data models, the data warehouse, Power BI, and other downstream analytics
* Help drive adoption of standardized enterprise reporting and reduce reliance on manual or duplicative reporting

**Required Skills/Abilities/Competencies**

* Strong hands-on experience with Salesforce reporting and dashboards, including standard, custom, summary, matrix, and joined reports
* Solid understanding of the Salesforce data model, including objects such as Opportunities, Accounts, Leads, Contacts, and Activities
* Strong experience with sales metrics, pipeline management, forecasting, bookings, and performance reporting
* Experience translating business requirements into reporting, dashboards, and actionable analytics
* Experience working with BI and visualization platforms; Power BI experience strongly preferred
* Ability to work with complex filters, business rules, hierarchies, row-level visibility, and sharing/security models
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to data accuracy and detail
* Ability to identify trends and exceptions within data and communicate their business impact
* Ability to clearly communicate insights to technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Working knowledge of enterprise data warehouses and dimensional data models preferred
* SQL experience preferred

**Education And Experience**

* 4–7 years of experience in Salesforce reporting, sales analytics, business intelligence, Revenue Operations analytics, or a related field
* Hands-on experience supporting Sales or Revenue teams in a B2B environment
* Experience working across Salesforce and enterprise BI/data platforms strongly preferred
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Analytics, Data Science, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
* Salesforce certifications (e.g., Salesforce Administrator, Advanced Administrator, or Reporting & Dashboard Specialist) are a plus
* Power BI or related analytics certifications are a plus

**Core Skills & Attributes**

* Strong business acumen with the ability to connect sales data and metrics to business outcomes
* Analytical mindset with the ability to move beyond producing reports to identifying insights, trends, risks, and opportunities
* Detail-oriented with a strong focus on data accuracy and consistency
* Strong stakeholder-management skills with the ability to work directly with Sales and business leadership
* Collaborative mindset with experience working cross-functionally across Sales, Revenue Operations, Finance, Data Engineering, BI, and enterprise applications teams
* Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, evolving environment
* Strong documentation and organizational skills
* Proactive, curious, and continuously looking for opportunities to improve and standardize reporting and insights

**Physical Requirements**

* Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
* Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at times.

description:

**Mission**

Leverage AI-assisted engineering tools and practices to improve productivity, code quality, and delivery effectiveness.

* Strong expertise in React, TypeScript, JavaScript, component-based architecture, and modern frontend engineering practices.
* Experience building scalable, responsive, and high-performing web applications with a strong focus on usability, accessibility, and user experience.

title: Specialist Software Engineer ( AI Architect , Developement )
description:
At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.
  
  
Senior Technical AI Architect & Builder (SPARK)
  
  
So, what’s the role all about?
  
  
NiCE is building SPARK, a new internal incubation team that turns great ideas from across CX International into working AI solutions, and then into enterprise-grade tools that roll out to colleagues around the world. We are looking for the senior technical voice and hands-on builder at its core.
  
  
As Senior Technical AI Architect & Builder, you will set the technical direction for SPARK and build alongside the team. You will advise on the tech stack, choose the patterns and tools we standardise on, and write the code for flagship prototypes yourself. You will also advise business and technology leaders on what is feasible, what is wise, and what to build next.
  
  
This is a consultative and autonomous role. You are comfortable owning ambiguous problems end to end, making sound technical decisions with minimal supervision, and explaining your reasoning to engineers and executives alike. You will be the senior technical lead for the SPARK AI Architects & Builders.
  
  
How will you make an impact?
  
  
You will own the technical architecture of SPARK and the quality of what it ships, from the first prototype to the enterprise-grade tool, working hands-on with the Technical AI Architect & Builder, the Business Analyst, and NiCE’s platform, security, and architecture teams.
  
  
Set Technical Direction
  
  

* Recommend and own the SPARK tech stack: models and providers, agent and orchestration frameworks, retrieval and vector storage, integration patterns, and developer tooling
* Make build-versus-buy and platform-versus-custom decisions, and record them in clear architecture decision records
* Define reference architectures and reusable patterns so every new idea starts from a paved path instead of a blank page
* Track the fast-moving AI landscape and bring forward the models, tools, and protocols worth adopting
* Ensure build allows tools to be migrated easily.
* Always ensure cost optimization is included into the design.

Build Hands-On
  
  

* Design and build agentic AI solutions, including tool use, multi-step reasoning, memory, multi-agent coordination, and human-in-the-loop controls
* Build RAG pipelines and integrations with enterprise systems such as Salesforce, ServiceNow, Workday, and Microsoft 365, using APIs and MCP
* Ensure solution design incorporates NiCE guidelines on Ethics, Risk, compliance
* Review data and infrastructure readiness of the solutions
* Write clean, tested, documented code that others can pick up and extend
* Turn ideas into working prototypes quickly, and into demonstrable value for the business teams who proposed them

Take Prototypes to Enterprise Grade
  
  

* Define what enterprise-grade means for SPARK: security, access control, privacy, reliability, scalability, observability, and cost
* Harden prototypes for global rollout, including CI/CD, automated tests, evaluation pipelines, monitoring, and rollback
* Establish LLM evaluation practices: test sets, regression tests, hallucination checks, and quality dashboards
* Work with Security, Legal, and Architecture teams to embed responsible AI and data protection requirements into every design

Advise and Lead
  
  

* Act as trusted technical adviser to business teams, the Project Manager, and senior leaders on feasibility, trade-offs, effort, and risk
* Review designs and code, mentor the Technical AI Architect & Builder, and raise the engineering bar across the team
* Work with minimal supervision, flag risks early, and make good decisions when requirements are still moving
* Collaborate with NiCE’s internal/ external AI platform and architecture teams so SPARK solutions fit the wider enterprise AI strategy

Have you got what it takes?
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (Master’s preferred), or equivalent experience
* 10+ years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years designing and delivering LLM-powered or agentic AI systems in production
* Expert, hands-on skills in Python and/or TypeScript; you are still a developer who writes code every week
* Deep experience with agent and orchestration frameworks (such as LangGraph, LangChain, AutoGen, or equivalent), tool-integration protocols such as MCP, and RAG architectures with vector databases
* Strong working knowledge of LLM providers and APIs (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Gemini, and open-source models), including prompt design, structured outputs, and evaluation
* Experience with at least one major cloud AI ecosystem (Azure, AWS, or GCP) and with REST API, event-driven, and microservice design
* Strong grasp of security, privacy, and responsible AI practices for enterprise systems
* Proven ability to work independently, advise stakeholders, and own technical decisions in ambiguous situations
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex AI concepts to executives and non-technical colleagues
* Fluency in English

You will have an advantage if you also have:
  
  

* Experience in an AI centre of excellence, innovation lab, or internal incubator
* Experience with Cognigy, NiCE CXone, or other CCaaS and conversational AI platforms, including voice AI
* Experience integrating with enterprise systems such as Salesforce, ServiceNow, Workday, Atlassian, and Microsoft 365
* Experience with LLMOps: evaluation frameworks, observability (OpenTelemetry), prompt registries, and cost governance
* Experience fine-tuning or evaluating open-source models
* Experience with workflow applications such as N8N or similar
* Have developed market ready software applications
* Fluency in foreign language; German would be a plus, for close collaboration with Forward Deployment Cognigy team in Germany.

What’s in it for you?
  
  
SPARK is a chance to be a founding member of a brand-new team, and to shape how NiCE turns AI ideas into everyday tools used by colleagues around the world.
  
  
Join an ever-growing, market-disrupting, global company where the teams, comprised of the best of the best, work in a fast-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! As the market leader, every day at NiCE is a chance to learn and grow, and there are endless internal career opportunities across multiple roles, disciplines, domains, and locations. If you are passionate about AI, innovative at heart, and excited to constantly raise the bar on what intelligent technology can do, you may just be our next NiCEr!
  
  
Enjoy NiCE-FLEX!
  
  
At NiCE, we work according to the NiCE-FLEX hybrid model, which enables maximum flexibility: 2 days working from the office and 3 days of remote work, each week. Naturally, office days focus on face-to-face meetings, where teamwork and collaborative thinking generate innovation, new ideas, and a vibrant, interactive atmosphere.
  
  
**Requisition ID:**
11874
  
  
**Reporting into:**
VP , Business Operations , Sales Ops
  
  
**Role Type**
: Individual Contributor
  
  
**About NiCE**
*NICE Ltd. (NASDAQ: NICE) software products are used by 25,000+ global businesses, including 85 of the Fortune 100 corporations, to deliver extraordinary customer experiences, fight financial crime and ensure public safety. Every day, NiCE software manages more than 120 million customer interactions and monitors 3+ billion financial transactions.*
*Known as an innovation powerhouse that excels in AI, cloud and digital, NiCE is consistently recognized as the market leader in its domains, with over 8,500 employees across 30+ countries.*
*NiCE is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, neurotype, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other category protected by law.*
