**Samisha Holidays LLP**
| 📍 [City, India] | 🏢 [On-site / Hybrid / Remote] | 💼 Full-time

**Help us build the digital home of a growing travel brand ✈️**

Samisha Holidays LLP is a travel company and Destination Management Company (DMC). We plan domestic and international holidays: tour packages, custom itineraries, and MAP, AP and CP meal plans. Our website brings in many of our customers, so we're hiring a hands-on
**Web Developer**
to own it from start to finish.

You'll move our site to a modern stack (Astro + Sanity, with React components), keep our search rankings safe through the move, and set up the tracking, forms and integrations that turn visitors into bookings. If you like shipping real work and seeing what it does for a business, read on.

🔧 What you'll do

* Build and maintain our website with React and Astro, using a headless CMS (Sanity).
* Plan and carry out the move off WordPress, keeping SEO intact: 301 redirects, canonicals, sitemaps, and no lasting drop in rankings.
* Model content for tour packages, destinations and itineraries, and set up editor roles so our team can update the site on their own.
* Look after technical SEO: schema.org markup, meta tags, heading structure and Core Web Vitals.
* Set up GA4 events and conversions, Google Tag Manager and Search Console, so we know which pages bring in enquiries.
* Build enquiry and booking forms on serverless functions, with spam protection.
* Manage DNS, email authentication (SPF, DKIM), HTTPS and security headers.
* Deploy through Git to Cloudflare Pages, Vercel or Netlify.
* Explain technical choices in plain English to the business owner, and train staff on the CMS.

✅ What we're looking for

* **About 3 years**
  building production websites, with at least one live site you can show and walk us through.
* Strong
  **HTML, CSS and modern JavaScript/TypeScript**
  , and semantic, accessible markup.
* Strong
  **React.js**
  on production projects (components, hooks, state management). Next.js or a similar framework is a plus.
* Hands-on work with at least one
  **CMS**
  (WordPress, Strapi, Contentful, Storyblok, Drupal or similar), including content modelling and editor roles.
* Working
  **WordPress**
  knowledge: themes, plugins, exporting content, and basic hardening.
* **Technical SEO**
  : headings, meta tags, schema.org, sitemaps, canonicals, 301 redirects, Core Web Vitals.
* At least one
  **website migration or replatform**
  done without a lasting ranking drop.
* **GA4, Google Tag Manager and Search Console.**
* **Serverless functions**
  (Cloudflare Workers, Vercel or Netlify functions) and form handling with spam protection.
* **DNS basics**
  : A/CNAME, MX, SPF, DKIM, and HTTPS/security headers.
* A
  **Git**
  workflow and deploys through Cloudflare Pages, Vercel or Netlify.
* **Clear written English**
  , and the patience to explain technical choices to non-technical colleagues.

💡
*You don't need Astro or Sanity experience. Astro runs React components, and you'll learn both on the job.*

⭐ Nice to have

* Any exposure to Astro, Sanity or GROQ
* WhatsApp Business / Cloud API, click-to-WhatsApp ads, or Meta Pixel setup
* Google Business Profile management and local SEO
* PDF generation from structured data (we'd use it for trip brochures)
* Payment gateway integration (Razorpay, Stripe, PayU)
* Building login-protected portals or B2B dashboards for travel agents and partners
* Experience in travel, hospitality or e-commerce
* Basic Google Sheets automation with Apps Script for lead tracking

🌍 Why Samisha Holidays?

* **Real ownership.**
  You'll lead the website, not work on one small piece of it.
* **Visible impact.**
  Your work shows up straight away in enquiries and bookings.
* **Room to grow.**
  After the site, there's portals, automation, WhatsApp and payments to build.
* **A modern stack**
  in a small team where decisions get made quickly.
* [Add compensation range / benefits / travel perks here]

📩 How to apply

Click
**Apply**
, or message us with:

1. Your CV
2. **A link to a live site you built**
   , with 2–3 lines on your role in it
3. *(Optional)*
   A short note about a migration you handled and how you protected its SEO

**Samisha Holidays LLP is an equal opportunity employer.**
We welcome applicants from all backgrounds.

#hiring #webdeveloper #reactjs #frontenddeveloper #technicalSEO #wordpress #headlessCMS #astro #sanity #javascript #typescript #travelindustry #jobsinindia #SamishaHolidays

**Before you post, fill in these three things:**

* **Location and workplace type**
  (on-site, hybrid or remote)
* **Salary range.**
  Posts that show pay usually get more, and better-matched, applicants.
* **The migration line.**
  I wrote that you're moving from WordPress to Astro + Sanity, because the JD points that way. If that's wrong, change or remove it.

Once you send me the location, workplace type and job type, I can also set this up as a LinkedIn job listing for you to review before it goes live.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Frontend focus
  
  
**Title:**
Senior Software Engineer – Fullstack AI (Frontend Focus)
  
  
**Location:**
Pune (M.H)
  
  
**Experience:**
4+ years in software engineering, including 1+ year building AI-powered user experiences in production
  
  
**About The Role**
You'll own the experience layer of Clearwater's AI-enabled security products. This is a hands-on role: you'll build fast, accessible interfaces for agent-driven workflows and write the backend glue they need. You'll work with design, product, and backend engineers from concept to production.
  
  
What you'll do
  
  

* Build production web applications with React and TypeScript, with strong performance, accessibility, and testing
* Design AI-native interfaces: streaming responses, tool-call and agent-step visibility, approval and human-in-the-loop controls, citations, and graceful failure states
* Build and maintain a shared component library and design system
* Write the backend-for-frontend layer in Python or Node: APIs, auth, session handling, and streaming endpoints (SSE/WebSockets)
* Instrument user-facing AI features with analytics, tracing, and feedback capture to improve quality
* Use AI coding tools and agents to speed up UI development, testing, and review, and help the team do the same
* Review code, set frontend standards, and mentor engineers

Must have
  
  

* 4+ years of professional software engineering with a frontend-leaning full-stack record
* Strong JavaScript/TypeScript and React (Next.js or similar), with solid HTML/CSS and browser fundamentals
* 1+ year building UI for LLM or agent features that reached production (streaming, chat or workflow UIs, state handling)
* Working backend ability in Python or Node, including REST/GraphQL APIs and a relational database
* Frontend testing and quality practice: unit, integration, end-to-end, and performance and accessibility checks
* Working knowledge of Docker, CI/CD, and one major cloud

Nice to have
  
  

* Experience building dashboards or analyst-style tools for security, healthcare, or compliance-driven products
* Familiarity with agent protocols and tooling such as MCP, and with how agents call tools
* Data visualization experience for complex, high-volume data
* Experience with design systems and Storybook
* Open-source contributions or public UI projects

First 12 months
  
  

* Ship production features end to end with high quality and accessibility
* Deliver an agent-driven workflow UI that users adopt, with measurable task-completion or time-saved gains
* Establish the team's patterns for AI interface states, human approval steps, and frontend evals

Why join
  
  
You'll have high ownership at an early-stage engineering site, direct exposure to leadership, and the chance to shape how security teams interact with AI agents.

Working knowledge of JavaScript, HTML, and CSS, including DOM manipulation, form validation, and working with API responses. description:

This role goes well beyond routine Salesforce administration. You will act as Business Applications Analyst, User Support Lead and Technology Coordinator for multiple business teams — understanding how they work, where they lose time, and translating that into practical Salesforce solutions.

You will own the full lifecycle of a business-system requirement: gathering needs, designing the solution, configuring and developing it, testing, deploying, training users and improving it over time. In short, you are the bridge between the business and the technology.

* Run day-to-day administration: users, roles, profiles, permission sets, sharing settings and field-level security

* Strong Salesforce platform, development and integration skills
* Excellent communication — able to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
* Analytical mindset with a focus on root-cause analysis
* User-centric approach and genuine empathy for end users
* Detail-oriented, comfortable juggling multiple priorities and stakeholders
* Strong documentation and knowledge-transfer habits

* A values-driven organisation with genuine work-life balance
* A dynamic business that adapts to what the work actually needs
* Real exposure to business insight, and ownership of outcomes
* A culture that rewards accountability and entrepreneurial spirit

* Location: Pune
* Work Mode: Onsite

title: Software Engineer
description:
RAGNITIONAI is building Intell Terminal—a high-signal market, policy, and exposure intelligence terminal designed for large enterprises and mid-market manufacturers. Instead of drowning leaders in generic news, we help teams track shifts that directly affect operations, costs, and commercial decisions.
  
​
  
The Role
**(Paid Internship)**
We are looking for a hands-on, self-driven engineering builder to join us for a 3-to-6-month structured internship/fellowship with strong potential to convert into a full-time or deeper product role as we grow. This is not a routine ticket-taking internship—you will work directly with the founder to build, iterate, and ship core product components from early stage to live usage.
  
​
  
What You Will Build
  
1.​Web interfaces, dashboards, and clean structured views for displaying signals, alerts, and company exposure profiles.
  
​2.Data ingestion pipelines, API integrations, and automated workflows that pull, clean, and organize multi-source information.
  
​3.Practical tooling, prompt/scoring workflows, and internal scripts that speed up research, tagging, and verification.
  
4.​Fast prototypes and production iterations based on real user and pilot feedback.
  
  
​What We Look For
  
1.​Strong fundamentals in software development (e.g., modern frontend/full-stack web or Python/backend/automation workflows—adapt to your exact stack).
  
​2.Comfort working in a fast-moving, zero-bureaucracy early-stage environment where priorities evolve quickly.
  
​3.Ownership mindset: you take a rough problem statement, figure out how to build it cleanly, and ship without needing micromanagement.
  
4.​Bonus if you have built side projects, shipped MVPs, or worked with data pipelines, scraping/APIs, or LLM-assisted workflows.
  
​
  
What You Get
  
​1.Direct ownership of core product modules rather than isolated side tasks.
  
​2.Close working relationship with the founder and exposure to how an early B2B intelligence product is shaped around real enterprise needs.
  
​3.Conversion potential: Clear path to transition into a longer-term or full-time role as milestones and funding progress.
  
​4.Paid internship: Stipend / milestone-based compensation will be discussed and decided during the interview, with work format aligned to current team needs.
  
  
​To Apply
  
Send your resume/profile along with 1–2 links to things you have actually built (GitHub, live project, demo, or short write-up) and a few lines on a tough technical problem you solved recently. You can also send your resume and project links directly to careers@ragnitionai.com

title: GIS Developer
description:
**Company Overview**
At Bridgenext, we engineer Growth Operating Systems. Most enterprises have spent millions on their revenue stack and still aren't seeing the growth they expected.They have tools that function, but no system that wins. We help growth-hungry companies close that gap by turning fragmented platforms, siloed teams, and disconnected data into one integrated Growth OS. More than a technology company or marketing agency, we're a global digital consultancy with experts in engineering, data, AI, creative and more.
  
  
Our teams are made up of experts who believe in engineering impact, starting with putting people at the center of everything we do. Every team member directly shapes our work, culture, and values. Nothing matters more to us than a kind, respectful, fulfilling environment that supports everyone. Our flexible, inclusive culture gives you the autonomy, resources, and opportunities to thrive.
  
  
**Position Description**
Bridgenext is seeking an experienced GIS Developer to design, develop, test, maintain, and enhance geospatial applications and data-management solutions supporting timberland, agriculture, natural resources, and broader land-management operations.
  
  
The role requires strong GIS development, spatial-data management, system-integration, automation, and modern web-development capabilities. The GIS Developer will build scalable solutions using the Esri ArcGIS platform, Python, SQL, Microsoft Azure services, and contemporary web technologies to support informed operational and investment decisions.
  
  
The successful candidate will collaborate with GIS Analysts, Business Analysts, land managers, forestry and agriculture professionals, Product Owners, and technology teams to translate complex geospatial requirements into secure, reliable, and user-focused solutions.
  
  
**Responsibilities Include But Are Not Limited To**

* Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain GIS web applications, geospatial services, and supporting data solutions.
* Build and support integrations between ArcGIS platforms and enterprise systems, including land-information management, forest operations, reporting, and environmental or safety platforms.
* Develop and maintain ArcGIS geoprocessing tools, Python/ArcPy automation, scheduled workflows, REST APIs, and reusable services for spatial processing and resource-management activities.
* Create, publish, administer, and optimize ArcGIS map services, feature services, geoprocessing services, image services, mobile data services, and offline map packages.
* Develop interactive mapping and responsive GIS applications using JavaScript/TypeScript, React, and the ArcGIS Maps SDK for JavaScript, with appropriate authentication, authorization, and role-based access controls.
* Support backend and full-stack development for GIS applications using modern APIs, web technologies, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Manage and maintain enterprise geospatial datasets, parcel information, forest inventory, farmland and timberland boundaries, resource data, and related business attributes.
* Support spatial editing workflows for harvesting, regeneration, dispositions, casualty loss, exclusion areas, acreage tracking, leases, inspections, and field operations.
* Develop or support growth-and-yield modeling, forest-inventory analysis, spatial joins, overlays, and other geospatial analytics used in harvest planning and investment decisions.
* Ensure spatial-data integrity and consistency across ArcGIS, enterprise geodatabases, integrated applications, and downstream reporting platforms through validation, verification, and reconciliation controls.
* Write and optimize spatial SQL queries for Microsoft SQL Server and Azure SQL Managed Instance, including enterprise geodatabase administration, spatial indexing, reporting, migration, and domain management.
* Develop and support big-data geospatial workflows using Databricks, PySpark, GeoPandas, Databricks Mosaic, ADLS Gen2, Delta Lake, and Parquet where applicable.
* Develop solutions for mobile and offline field-data collection using ArcGIS Field Maps, Survey123, Collector, and custom field applications.
* Support Azure Active Directory group synchronization, Single Sign-On, least-privilege access, ArcGIS Portal group governance, and periodic access reviews.
* Participate in solution design, sprint planning, story refinement, estimation, testing, user acceptance, release activities, peer reviews, and continuous-improvement initiatives.
* Troubleshoot and resolve production issues involving spatial data, map and feature services, application integrations, performance, valuations, reporting, and field workflows.
* Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines and cloud-based deployments using GitHub, Jenkins, Azure DevOps or Harness, Artifactory, and related DevSecOps practices.

**Must Have Skills**

* Bachelor's degree in GIS, Geography, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 5+ years of professional experience in GIS application development and geospatial technologies.
* Strong hands-on experience with ArcGIS Enterprise, ArcGIS Server, ArcGIS Portal, ArcGIS Online, ArcGIS Pro, and enterprise ArcGIS administration concepts.
* Proficiency in Python and ArcPy for geoprocessing, spatial automation, data migration, and administrative workflows.
* Strong SQL and database-development experience, including spatial data types, enterprise geodatabases/SDE, spatial indexing, and query optimization.
* Experience developing web applications using JavaScript or TypeScript, React, and the ArcGIS Maps SDK for JavaScript.
* Knowledge of ArcGIS REST APIs, RESTful service design, system integrations, and secure API consumption.
* Experience creating and supporting map, feature, geoprocessing, image, and mobile/offline GIS services.
* Experience with Databricks, PySpark, GeoPandas, Databricks Mosaic, Delta Lake, ADLS Gen2, Parquet, and large-scale spatial analytics.
* Experience with Microsoft Azure services and cloud-based GIS or application environments.
* Working knowledge of Azure Active Directory, SSO, role-based access, and enterprise security controls.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, spatial-data validation, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to collaborate with business stakeholders and translate functional geospatial requirements into technical solutions.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience in forestry, timberland, agriculture, natural resources, real assets, or land-management domains.
* Experience with timber harvest applications, forest inventory, growth-and-yield modeling, parcel management, farmland operations, or environmental and safety systems.
* Hands-on experience with ArcGIS Field Maps, Survey123, Collector, mobile field solutions, and offline GIS workflows.
* Exposure to Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, enterprise data lakes, data governance, and spatially enabled reporting solutions.
* Knowledge of .NET/C#, Java, FastAPI, React Native, Flutter, or other technologies used to integrate GIS with enterprise and mobile applications.
* Experience with DevOps and CI/CD tools such as GitHub, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, Harness, JFrog Artifactory, Jira, and Confluence.
* Familiarity with ArcMap/Citrix legacy environments and modernization or migration to ArcGIS Pro and ArcGIS Enterprise.

**Professional Skills**

* Strong written, verbal, and presentation communication skills, with the ability to explain technical GIS concepts to business and operational stakeholders.
* Collaborative team player who can work effectively with GIS Analysts, Business Analysts, land managers, field teams, and cross-functional technology squads.
* High standards of professionalism, ownership, documentation, code quality, and production support.
* Self-sufficient and organized, with the ability to prioritize concurrent development, support, and data-quality activities.
* Flexible and improvement-oriented, with sound judgment and a practical approach to solving complex spatial and integration problems.

Bridgenext is an Equal Opportunity Employer

follow version control and code review practices.• Test, debug and support deployments to customer labs; maintain build and release documentation.• Mentor interns or junior developers and contribute to technical planning (for senior candidates).Required Skills• Unity 3D and C# – strong proficiency, with at least one shipped or deployed 3D application.• VR development – OpenXR, XR Interaction Toolkit or Meta XR SDK, with deployment to standalone headsets.• 3D mathematics – vectors, matrices, quaternions and coordinate transformations.• Physics and collisions in Unity – rigidbodies, colliders, joints, raycasting, constraints.• Real-time performance optimization and profiling (Unity Profiler, Frame Debugger, memory analysis).• Good software design – reusable components, separation of simulation logic from presentation, state machines, event-driven patterns.• Proficiency with Git and collaborative development workflows.• Strong debugging and problem-solving skills.Preferred Skills (Good to Have)• Kinematics, robotics or mechanism simulation (forward / inverse kinematics, motion planning, joint limits).• Experience building engineering, industrial, medical or education-focused simulators or serious games.• CAD formats and pipelines (STEP / FBX / OBJ), Blender or similar 3D tools, Unity shaders / URP.• Industrial automation concepts (PLC, sensors, drives, CNC) or willingness to learn them.• REST APIs, JSON, and connecting Unity to web backends, databases or LMS platforms.• ROS / ROS 2, digital twin concepts or external simulation tools.• Networking / multiplayer in Unity, hand tracking or mixed-reality features.• AR (AR Foundation) and cross-platform builds (Windows, Android).• Comfort using AI tools (ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot or similar) to speed up development and debugging, with the judgement to verify the output.QualificationBE / BTech or ME / MTech in Computer Science, IT, Robotics, Mechatronics, Mechanical, Electronics or a related discipline. Candidates with a strong project portfolio and equivalent practical experience are also encouraged to apply.What We Look For• Strong engineering fundamentals and curiosity about how machines and systems work.• Ownership – you can take a feature from idea to deployment.• Ability to learn new domains quickly (manufacturing, automation, education technology).• Clear communication and a good fit in a cross-functional product team.What You Will Gain• Work on real products used in engineering colleges and training centres across India.• Exposure to CNC, robotics, industrial automation, IoT and immersive technology under one roof.• High ownership and direct impact on product direction.• Growth path toward technical lead for the XR / simulation team.How to ApplySend your updated resume, a portfolio or demo videos of Unity / VR projects (build links, APKs or recorded walkthroughs) and your GitHub profile (if available) to mktg@cadmech.co.in with the subject line “Application – Unity & VR Developer – Cadmech”.Selection process: resume screening, technical interview, short practical assignment (shared with shortlisted candidates), HR discussion.

title: Lead, Software Engineer (Agentic workflows/APIs)
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Lead, Software Engineer (Agentic workflows/APIs)
  
  
**Overview**
Mastercard is seeking a highly skilled and passionate Tech Lead to drive the next generation of platform modernization, API transformation, cloud-native engineering, agentic workflow solutions, and AI-enabled product capabilities.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a hands-on technical leader who can architect and deliver scalable enterprise systems while mentoring engineering teams, influencing technical strategy, and driving innovation across multiple initiatives.
  
  
This role requires deep expertise in distributed systems, APIs, cloud technologies, AI-powered engineering, data platforms, and software delivery at scale. The successful candidate will play a critical role in shaping the future of Mastercard's intelligent platforms by combining strong technical leadership with exceptional execution capabilities.
  
  
Role & Responsibilities
  
  
Technical Leadership
  
  

* Lead end-to-end delivery of complex engineering initiatives.
* Define technical architecture, engineering patterns, solution roadmaps, and development standards.
* Drive technical design reviews, architecture discussions, and engineering best practices.
* Guide teams in building scalable, secure, resilient, and maintainable platforms.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend strategic adoption opportunities.
* Influence technical roadmaps and long-term platform strategy.

Software Engineering
  
  

* Design and develop enterprise-grade backend services, APIs, and distributed systems using Java and Spring Boot.
* Build scalable, high-availability microservices and cloud-native applications.
* Design and implement secure, high-performance RESTful APIs and integrations.
* Ensure software quality through code reviews, automated testing, and engineering governance.
* Drive modernization, automation, and platform engineering initiatives.

Agentic Workflows & AI Enablement
  
  

* Design and implement agent-driven workflows and intelligent automation solutions.
* Integrate AI powered capabilities into engineering and operational processes.
* Collaborate with business and engineering stakeholders to identify AI-enabled use cases.
* Establish best practices for responsible AI adoption within software delivery lifecycles.
* Drive adoption of AI-assisted development practices to improve engineering productivity and quality.

Cloud, Platform & Data Engineering
  
  

* Design, develop, and deploy solutions on AWS.
* Build reusable frameworks, platforms, and engineering accelerators.
* Enable Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automation-first engineering practices.
* Design and support scalable ETL, analytics, and data processing solutions.
* Build event-driven and data-intensive applications using modern architecture patterns.
* Partner with DevOps teams to improve deployment reliability, scalability, and operational maturity.

Operational Excellence
  
  

* Champion observability, monitoring, alerting, reliability, and performance engineering practices.
* Lead incident management, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis activities.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on availability, performance, resiliency, and security.
* Ensure compliance with Mastercard engineering, risk, and security standards.

Team Leadership
  
  

* Mentor and coach software engineers and senior engineers.
* Support hiring, onboarding, and technical skill development.
* Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, ownership, and continuous learning.
* Collaborate effectively across Product, Architecture, Security, Operations, and Engineering teams.
* Develop future technical leaders and promote engineering excellence.

**Required Qualifications**
Education
  
  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.

**Experience**

* 8+ years of software engineering experience.
* Proven track record delivering enterprise-scale software solutions.
* Experience leading cross-functional engineering initiatives.
* Experience building cloud-native and distributed systems at scale.
* Strong experience mentoring engineers and driving engineering excellence.

Technical Skills
  
  
Category Technologies / Expertise
  
  
Programming Languages Java (8+), Python
  
  
Backend Engineering Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Microservices, REST APIs, OpenAPI/Swagger, API Lifecycle Management, Distributed Systems
  
  
Architecture & Design System Design, Object-Oriented Design, Design Patterns, Domain Driven Design (DDD), Event-Driven Architecture, CQRS, Event Sourcing, Hexagonal/Clean Architecture
  
  
Cloud Technologies AWS EC2, ECS, EKS, Lambda, S3, API Gateway, IAM, SNS, SQS, RDS
  
  
Databases Oracle, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, NoSQL Databases
  
  
Event Streaming & Messaging Kafka, Axon Framework, Event Streaming Platforms
  
  
DevOps & Platform Engineering Git, GitHub, Jenkins, Maven, Gradle, CI/CD Pipelines, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), Platform Engineering
  
  
Monitoring & Observability Splunk, Dynatrace, OpenTelemetry, Distributed Tracing, Application Monitoring, Logging & Alerting
  
  
Security OAuth2, JWT, Secure API Development, Secure SDLC, Authentication & Authorization, Encryption Standards, Secure Coding Practices
  
  
AI & Agentic Engineering GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot, Agentic
  
  
Engineering Practices
  
  
**The Ideal Candidate Demonstrates**

* Strong object-oriented design and architecture skills.
* Expertise in scalable system design and distributed architecture.
* Experience with design patterns and modern engineering practices.
* Expertise in unit, integration, performance, and automated testing.
* Strong knowledge of CI/CD, DevOps, and automation-first development.
* Experience working in Agile product development environments.
* Strong focus on reliability, observability, security, and performance optimization.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience building AI-powered or agentic applications.
* Familiarity with LLM platforms, GenAI, MCP, Copilot, or related technologies.
* Experience with event-streaming platforms such as Kafka.
* Experience with AWS services including Lambda, ECS/EKS, API Gateway, S3, CloudWatch, and IAM.
* Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform.
* Experience with observability platforms such as Splunk and Dynatrace.
* Experience with Databricks, Snowflake, or modern analytics platforms.
* Experience building enterprise API products and developer ecosystems.
* Experience leading cloud transformation and modernization programs.
* Payments, fintech, or financial services industry experience.

Success Measures
  
  
**The Successful Candidate Will**

* Deliver scalable and secure platform solutions aligned with business objectives.
* Accelerate adoption of agentic and AI-enabled engineering capabilities.
* Improve engineering productivity, quality, operational excellence, and platform reliability.
* Mentor engineers and grow overall team capability.
* Drive technical innovation while maintaining strong delivery execution.
* Influence architecture and technology strategy across the organization.
* Champion engineering excellence and modern software development practices.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

description:
**About Us**

THG is an international technology company and leading online retailer, home to premium brands such as lookfantastic, Myprotein, and ESPA; all of which are powered by our industry-leading and award-winning technology platform, THG Ingenuity.

**Tech at THG**

Technology is the driving force behind THG, and it starts with our people. We are ambitious with our goals and challenge conventional thinking. THG Technology is different because we support every single person to make massive impact and drive their own work. Our people are always learning, and we work every day to ensure our technology, from our software platforms, to our hosting services, to our M.L capability and beyond, is world class. This enables us to keep powering THG and our partners on a global scale.

**What will I be doing?**

You would be working on a specific product that makes up our end-to-end eCommerce platform. This platform drives multibillion £ in sales globally for THG’s own brands as well as our partner brands. The elements of the platform you could be working on could be Order Processing, Fraud Detection, ECRM, Product Information Management (PIM) as well as others. As part of the engineering team you would be designing, developing, maintaining, testing and deploying the elements of that platform.

The team you would be working on would be split between India and THG’s base in the UK so you would need to be confident in communicating clearly with colleagues in the UK and able to contribute to team discussions.

**What skills and experience would I need?**

**Technical:**

* Strong knowledge of Java.
* Demonstrable knowledge of relational (SQL) and/or NoSQL databases
* Experience designing and building REST based APIs.
* Experience integrating with internal and third-party services.
* A strong understanding of software development best practices
* Knowledge of DevOps (Kubernetes, Docker, etc.)
* Understanding of CI/CD principles and experience using a deployment tool, e.g., Jenkins.
* Able to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
* A strong user focused mindset towards building the best product for the end customer.
* Experience writing testable and maintainable code.

**Non-technical:**

* Communication – Abie to clearly communicate with both tech & non-tech stakeholders.
* Best Practices – Adoption of best practices in coding, architecture and design patterns.
* Ownership – Take lead in owning a problem domain from requirements through to deployment.
* Team player – Be able to collaborate and work effectively with the team and stakeholders.

**What's in it for me?**

You would get the chance to advance your career with one of the fastest growing eCommerce businesses globally. The environment at THG is one that breeds innovation and likes to push the boundaries. If you’re the kind of person that likes to do the same then THG will challenge you and give you the platform to push yourself which will in turn help you to accelerate your career.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Pattern is a leading eCommerce data and growth company headquartered in the Silicon Slopes tech hub in Lehi, Utah, with global offices in Europe, China, Australia, the Middle East, and Canada. Named to the Inc. 500 list of the fastest-growing companies in the US, Pattern has made its mark in the industry. Some of the biggest consumer brands - including Skullcandy, Nestle, Clorox, Kong, Panasonic, Tumi, and PopSockets - trust Pattern with their business, and Pattern has recruited talent from Amazon, eBay, Adobe, PepsiCo, Apple, Google, and Oracle.
  
  
Pattern values data and the engineering required to take full advantage of it. As a Senior Software Engineer on the AI Platforms team, you will build the systems that turn Pattern's data into automated, accountable action for our brand partners.
  
  
**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**
  
  

* Platform services: design, build and run the backend services that receive events, track cases, decide whether an agent should run, and resume work when a person responds.
* Correctness: own the platform's correctness guarantees:

+ idempotency;
+ deduplication of repeated signals;
+ locking against concurrent runs;
+ recovery from crashed or stuck runs;
+ a complete audit trail of what each agent did.

* Agents: build and evolve agents that follow business SOPs. Decide which steps belong in deterministic code, which need the model's judgement, and which must stay with a person.
* Tools: build MCP tool servers that give agents safe, well-described access to internal data and services, with clear input and output schemas.
* Human-in-the-loop: integrate approval flows: request approvals, verify signed callbacks, handle partial approval, rejection and expiry, and make sure only approved work is executed.
* Evaluations: write evals for agents and tools (golden datasets, regression suites, trace review) and use them as the gate for shipping prompt, model and tool changes.
* Observability and cost: instrument services and agents with tracing, metrics and logs. Track model cost per case, and keep agents from running when nothing has changed.
* Safety: apply guardrails, including:

+ treating external content as untrusted input;
+ keeping money and policy rules in code, not in prompts;
+ never automating systems Pattern policy forbids.

* Cross-team work: make changes across service boundaries with the teams that own sensors, task management, approvals and the Pi web app, including in a second language (Python or Ruby on Rails) when the work requires it.
* Requirements: translate business requirements (SOPs, approval rules, escalation paths) into clear designs, tickets and runnable systems.
* Production support: support production, including on-call triage when an automation misbehaves.
* Leadership (Senior): mentor other engineers, review their designs and code, and help set engineering standards for AI work on the team.

**What We Expect**
**Senior Software Engineer (5-7 years)**

* 3+ years of production experience in your primary backend language.
* Designs new components end to end, such as the case-tracking service, and takes ambiguous problems to a clear design.
* Owns a production service, including being on call.
* Has shipped and measured an LLM-powered feature they owned.
* Mentors engineers and reviews designs and code.

**Required Qualifications**
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* 5-7 years of professional software engineering experience, mostly on backend systems.
* Primary skill set (one of the following):

+ TypeScript and Python , with production experience in TypeScript (3+ years) and solid working experience in Python; or
+ TypeScript and Ruby on Rails , with production experience in either (3+ years) and solid working experience in the other.

You should be comfortable reading and making changes in the language you use less.
  
  

* Experience designing APIs and webhooks, including authentication and signature verification.
* Has shipped at least one LLM-powered feature in production: tool or function calling, structured outputs, and a way to measure whether it works.
* Comfort with AWS (ECS or containers, S3, IAM at minimum) and with Docker.
* Production ownership,monitoring, alerting, incident response and root-cause analysis.
* Excellent engineering practice: version control, code review, automated testing, and small, reviewable changes.
* Strong written and spoken communication, including turning ambiguous business processes into clear technical designs.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with PostgreSQL in production: data modelling, transactions, indexing, and concurrency control (row locking, optimistic versioning, unique constraints).
* Experience with background jobs and queues (for example BullMQ, Sidekiq, Celery, SQS or Kafka), including retries, idempotency and dead-letter handling.
* Experience building agents or agent platforms: multi-step workflows, human approval steps, memory or state across runs.
* Experience building or consuming MCP servers, or similar tool-integration layers.
* Experience with LLM evaluation and observability tools such as Opik, Langfuse, LangSmith, Braintrust or Promptfoo.
* Familiarity with agent frameworks and SDKs (for example the Vercel AI SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK or LangGraph), and with LLM gateways or routers.
* Experience with durable workflow or event-driven patterns: transactional outbox, leases, Temporal, Step Functions or event sourcing.
* Experience with OpenTelemetry tracing.
* eCommerce or marketplace domain experience (Amazon, Walmart, Shopify or similar).
* Experience working productively with AI coding agents (for example Claude Code) on a large existing codebase.

**Your first 90 days**
  
  

* Days 1-30:

+ Learn the platform end to end: follow one automation from sensor detection to approved, completed work.
+ Ship small fixes in the agents platform and a tool server.
+ Be able to explain how a repeat signal is prevented from creating duplicate work.

* Days 31-60:

+ Own a component, such as part of the case-tracking service, an approval integration or a set of MCP tools.
+ Add an evaluation suite that catches a real regression.
+ Close one reliability gap, for example concurrent events or stuck runs.

* Days 61-90:

+ Lead the delivery of a new automation use case across sensors, agent, tools and approvals (Software Engineer II: own a major part of it).
+ Ship it with the evaluations, monitoring, shadow-mode run and rollback plan that make it safe to leave running.

**Our core values**

* Data Fanatics: Our edge is always found in the data
* Partner Obsessed: We are obsessed with partner success
* Team of Doers: We have a bias for action
* Game Changers: We encourage innovation

**Why Pattern?**

* The company is a rocket ship experiencing phenomenal growth
* We have tailwinds and a long runway; we're barely scratching the surface
* We have big opportunities that will get you energized and excited
* Great benefits including time off, insurance, competitive pay

**Five values**
guide how we build for clients and how we work with each other:
**Outcomes, Quality, Accountability, Communication and Care.**

* We take software to production.
* We check our work before anyone else has to.
* We stand by our commitments.
* We keep people informed in plain language.
* We treat a problem as ours to solve.

We hire curious people who own the outcome.
Meet the team that leads thinkbridge.

**About Role:**

We are looking for a hands-on Tech Lead with 7+ years of experience to own engineering execution and delivery of the integrations, data pipelines and internal platforms that connect
**think**
bridge. The role is accountable for driving all assigned feedback to verified closure through parallel execution, effective delegation and strong technical oversight. Success is measured by completed outcomes, engineering quality and a zero-backlog operating model, rather than prioritization exercises or time estimates.

The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in SQL, programming (C#/Python/Java/Node.js), ETL/ELT pipelines, and SaaS API integrations, along with hands-on experience delivering production-ready solutions using AI tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or Codex.

**What You'll Do**

**As part of the job**

* Ensure engineers work only within the corresponding assigned scope; route new work through dedicated AI tool before execution.
* Ownership of every assignment: Take end-to-end accountability for all assigned feedback, from understanding and solutioning through implementation, validation and closure.
* Parallel delivery: Do not independently prioritize, defer or queue assigned feedback. Decompose work into independently executable tasks, distribute them across engineers and use AI agents where appropriate to drive concurrent delivery.
* Zero backlog: Maintain a target of zero unstarted or unattended assigned feedback. Actively drive all open items to closure and resolve dependencies and blockers without allowing work to accumulate.

description:
**Who We Are**
VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.

#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture
  
  
**About This Role**
We are seeking a Data Analyst – Information Provisioning to support Business Intelligence capabilities by developing and maintaining the BI application layer. * Support business users in system usage and data interpretation
* Participate in projects and service processes, including demand fulfilment and operational support

**Who You Are**

* Experienced in Business Intelligence and Data Warehouse development
* Strong expertise in SQL, including advanced scripting (Teradata, Oracle, PostgreSQL or similar)

* Familiar with Unix/Linux environments and basic shell scripting
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex data
* Effective communicator, able to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
* Collaborative and able to work across teams and manage stakeholder expectations
* Comfortable working under pressure and meeting tight deadlines
* Experience in telecom environments is beneficial

You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
  
  
**What's In It For You**

* Opportunity to work on large-scale data platforms and complex BI systems
* Exposure to global stakeholders and cross-functional collaboration
* Involvement in end-to-end data lifecycle, from ingestion to reporting
* Continuous learning in data engineering, optimisation, and analytics practices
* A collaborative environment focused on innovation and improvement

**What Skills You Will Learn**

* Advanced data modelling and data warehouse design techniques
* Performance tuning and optimisation of large-scale data systems
* End-to-end BI application layer development and support
* Stakeholder management and business requirement translation
* Use of modern data tools, scheduling systems, and cloud-based platforms

title: SQL Developer-Pune -4+ yrs
description:
**SQL Server Developer – Transactional (OLTP) Databases, Healthcare SaaS**

**Experience:**
4–6 years

**Location:**
Pune (Hybrid - three days TTW from office)

**Work Hours:**
General shift initially; US-hours shift (6:00 PM–03:00 AM IST) after 6 months

**Environment:**
Microsoft SQL Server, live transactional healthcare SaaS

**Notice Period:**
Earlier joining preferred

**Role Overview**

We are hiring a strong T-SQL developer for our healthcare SaaS platform. In the first phase you will write, refactor and maintain database logic for critical business workflows. Over the first 6–12 months, with structured mentoring, you will grow into production troubleshooting and performance tuning, and from there into production SQL support.

This is not a BI/ETL/DW role and not an SSIS package-development role.

**Key Responsibilities**

**SQL Development (primary focus)**

* Write, debug and maintain T-SQL stored procedures, functions and views for critical business workflows.
* Deliver new database logic and enhancements with the engineering team.
* Refactor existing procedures for better performance and maintainability.
* Test database changes and release them through the team’s change process.
* Perform controlled, documented production data fixes.
* Investigate slow procedures using execution plans, with guidance from senior engineers.

**Growth Path: Performance Tuning & Production Support (from about month 6, with mentoring)**

* Shadow, then handle, live production issues (blocking, deadlocks, high CPU, slow queries) as US-hours support is phased in.
* Use Query Store to find top resource-consuming queries, detect plan regressions and force plans.
* Use DMVs to analyze waits, blocking, query stats, index usage and memory/CPU pressure. Examples:
  sys.dm
  \_exec\_requests,
  sys.dm
  \_os\_wait\_stats,
  sys.dm
  \_exec\_query\_stats.
* Read execution plans, fix parameter sniffing, and improve indexing and statistics.
* Document root causes and prevention steps for each incident.

**Requirements**

* 4–6 years of hands-on T-SQL experience on transactional (OLTP) application databases.
* Strong T-SQL skills: stored procedures, transactions, error handling, CTEs, temp tables and window functions; set-based logic in preference to cursors. You must be able to write new logic, not just review it.
* Solid indexing fundamentals (clustered, non-clustered, covering indexes) and the ability to read a basic execution plan (scan vs seek, key lookup).
* Has optimized at least one slow query or procedure and can explain what they found and what they changed.
* Working understanding of transactions and locking basics (isolation levels, blocking).
* Clear written and spoken English.
* Eagerness to learn production troubleshooting and willingness to move to US-hours support after the ramp-up period.

**Preferred**

* Hands-on Query Store or DMV experience.
* sp\_WhoIsActive / Extended Events.
* AWS RDS for SQL Server.
* ADO.NET
  application stacks.
* Healthcare or SaaS domain.
* Database source control (Git, DACPAC).

title: Senior Software Engineer - (DevOps / SRE)
description:
**Senior Software Engineer (DevOps / SRE)**
Rapid7's InsightVM and Exposure Command help thousands of organizations find and fix vulnerabilities at global scale, handling massive and spiky data volumes triggered by events like Patch Tuesday. Join our Pune engineering team to build, scale, and operate these mission-critical cloud services across multiple AWS regions while driving 24/7 operational ownership and proactive, AI-driven reliability.
  
  
**About The Team**
Our Pune engineering team partners closely with global engineering, security, and product teams to ensure our flagship vulnerability and exposure management platforms remain resilient, secure, and highly available for thousands of enterprise customers worldwide.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Senior Software Engineer (DevOps / SRE), your primary responsibility will be to own production reliability, observability, infrastructure as code, and incident response across multi-region AWS environments while supporting our transition to 24/7 follow-the-sun operations. Specifically, your focus will be to:
  
  

* Deploy, scale, and tune Java/Spring Boot microservices on Kubernetes (Amazon EKS) across multiple AWS regions, supporting a rotational schedule of two weeks remote US night shifts (10:00 PM to 6:00 AM IST, eligible for shift allowance) alternating with in-office day shifts.
* Manage cloud infrastructure including RDS, ElastiCache, OpenSearch, SQS, S3, and Lambda using Terraform, identifying and resolving configuration drift to maintain environment consistency.
* Own and evolve CI/CD and GitOps release pipelines built on Jenkins, GitHub Actions, container buildpacks, ECR, and ArgoCD.
* Define service-level objectives (SLOs) and error budgets for critical services, building Grafana dashboards, alerts as code, and synthetic uptime checks to detect issues proactively.
* Participate in PagerDuty on-call rotations, lead root-cause analyses and postmortems, and automate recurring fixes to steadily reduce mean time to recovery (MTTR).
* Plan capacity and optimize infrastructure costs for high-volume traffic surges such as Patch Tuesday by right-sizing pods and databases.
* Monitor asynchronous event communication, queue backlogs, and dead-letter queues (DLQs) across AWS SQS to ensure smooth data flow during peak loads.
* Harden platform security by rapidly rolling out critical CVE fixes across the fleet and leveraging AI coding and operations assistants for code review, root-cause analysis, and safe production diagnostics.

**The Skills And Qualities You'll Bring Include**

* Bring 5 to 8 years of hands-on experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), or platform engineering supporting enterprise-scale distributed systems.
* Demonstrate deep production expertise with Kubernetes (Amazon EKS preferred), including running stateful services, alongside core AWS infrastructure (RDS MySQL/Postgres, ElastiCache/Redis, OpenSearch, SQS/SNS, S3, Lambda, and IAM).
* Architect and maintain multi-region, multi-account Terraform setups in production with strong drift management practices.
* Build and operate automated CI/CD and GitOps workflows using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, and ArgoCD, paired with observability tooling such as Grafana and Prometheus-style metrics.
* Leverage AI engineering and operations assistants (such as Claude Code) in daily troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and infrastructure workflows.
* Debug JVM and Spring Boot microservices in production (analyzing thread and heap dumps and tuning memory) alongside strong scripting proficiency in Python, Go, or Bash.
* Take clear personal ownership of service reliability and incident outcomes, driving root-cause analyses and establishing clear operational expectations across teams.
* Break down complex, ambiguous platform challenges into sequenced, time-bound milestones while weighing architectural trade-offs with minimal direction.
* Embrace evolving operational models and rapidly adopt new AI tooling and workflows, maintaining focus and momentum through platform transitions.
* Build strong working relationships across global engineering, security, and product teams to deliver lasting reliability improvements and communicate technical decisions clearly.
* Embody our core values to foster a culture of excellence that drives meaningful impact and collective success.

We know that the best ideas and solutions come from multi-dimensional teams. That’s because these teams reflect a variety of backgrounds and professional experiences. If you are excited about this role and feel your experience can make an impact, please don’t be shy - apply today.
  
  
**About Rapid7**
At Rapid7, our vision is to create a secure digital world for our customers, our industry, and our communities. We do this by harnessing our collective expertise and passion to challenge what’s possible and drive extraordinary impact. We’re building a dynamic and collaborative workplace where new ideas are welcome.
  
  
Protecting 11,500+ customers against bad actors and threats means we’re continuing to push the envelope just like we’ ve been doing for the past 20 years. If you ’re ready to solve some of the toughest challenges in cybersecurity, we’re ready to help you take command of your career. Join us.

 As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next\-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient.  \#VOIS \#BeUnrivalled \#CreateTheFuture

The role focuses primarily on Google Cloud Platform, cloud automation, infrastructure as code and the transformation of legacy IT environments into cloud\-ready and cloud\-native solutions.

title: Senior Platform Engineer, Network Infrastructure
description:
Cloud Foundations Reliability (CFR) is part of NVIDIA’s Global Network Infrastructure (GNI) organization. We deploy, integrate, and operate the Kubernetes-based platform and shared services used to provision, monitor, and operate NVIDIA’s global network across data centers, colocation facilities, and cloud environments. The team owns the architecture and lifecycle of this platform, including cluster provisioning and upgrades, GitOps delivery, observability, capacity, and service enablement. We build software and automation to standardize how network platforms and services are deployed, scaled, and managed across environments.
  
  
We are looking for a hands-on senior engineer to own the lifecycle and automation of the Kubernetes platform supporting GNI network systems. You will also provide production support for network services running on the platform, partnering with their engineering owners when issues or changes cross the platform boundary. You will take complex problems from design through production and remain accountable for the outcome. You will bring deep Kubernetes expertise and help establish consistent engineering practices across the US and Bangalore teams. This is a senior individual contributor role with end-to-end ownership and production responsibility.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Design, build, and operate the Kubernetes platform that powers GNI network automation, telemetry, and operations across data center, colocation, and cloud environments.
* Own the lifecycle management for GNI Kubernetes environments, including cluster onboarding, upgrades, capacity, availability, and recovery.
* Develop production-quality software and automation for cluster provisioning, validation, upgrades, remediation, and safe multi-cluster delivery through GitOps.
* Provide production support for network services hosted on the platform, working with Network Automation and service teams that retain ownership of application architecture, code, and features.
* Diagnose complex Kubernetes platform and hosted-service failures involving control-plane health, cluster networking, storage, scheduling, workload placement, and multi-cluster dependencies. Drive issues from initial signal through verified resolution.
* Define production-readiness and observability standards for the platform and hosted network services, including health signals, capacity, alerts, runbooks, and recovery.
* Participate in CFR’s production on-call rotation, including scheduled after-hours and weekend coverage. Lead incident response and recovery, then drive corrective actions to completion.

**What We Need To See**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 8+ years of experience building or operating production Kubernetes platforms, network infrastructure, or distributed systems.
* Deep experience with Kubernetes at scale, including cluster lifecycle, upgrades, networking, storage, and recovery.
* Proficiency in at least one general-purpose programming language, such as Go or Python.
* Experience with GitOps, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, and automated production delivery.
* Experience deploying and supporting network automation or telemetry services on Kubernetes.
* Experience with production on-call, incident response, root-cause analysis, and driving corrective actions to completion.

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Strong knowledge of IP routing, data center fabrics, and cloud networking is a great plus.
* Experience designing and operating large, multi-region Kubernetes fleets, including fleet-wide upgrades and recovery.
* Hands-on experience with Cluster API (CAPI) and Metal3 for bare-metal provisioning, cluster lifecycle, machine remediation, and upgrades.
* Experience building Kubernetes controllers or operators in Go using custom resources and reconciliation patterns. Experience designing or operating network automation and telemetry services on Kubernetes at global scale.
* Contributions to Cluster API, Metal3, or other open-source Kubernetes infrastructure projects.

NVIDIA’s deep learning platforms have made major impact to various fields is broadly used across leading academic institutions, start-ups, and industry, including the world’s largest Internet companies. We need passionate, hard-working and creative people to help us take on more of these unique opportunities in deep learning cloud solutions. NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hard-working people in the world working for us. Are you creative and autonomous? Do you love a challenge? If so, we want to hear from you.

title: HR Data & Reporting Specialist
description:
**Life tastes better with ice cream**
With 19.000 expert ice cream colleagues and iconic brands like Wall’s, Cornetto and Ben & Jerry’s, loved in 76 countries, we are the world’s largest Ice Cream company leading the industry.
  
  
We create iconic ice cream brands that are part of everyday life, bringing moments of joy to millions of people around the world. Everybody loves ice cream. And as the world’s biggest pure‑play ice cream company, we have the scale and ambition to make a real difference.
  
  
**What Truly Sets Us Apart Is How We Work.**
We move fast and keep things simple. We turn ideas into action, trust people to take ownership, and work as one team to win together with integrity. Our culture is high‑performance, collaborative and focused on getting things done.
  
  
We’re curious and ready for what’s next. We embrace digital, use data to make better decisions, and keep learning, including how AI can help us work smarter and serve consumers better.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The Workday Data & Reporting Analyst will provide hands-on Workday data, reporting and operational support during the separation of The Magnum Ice Cream Company from Unilever and the subsequent transition and stabilization period.
  
  
This is an individual contributor role and will focus on HR data quality, Workday reporting, EIBs, Supervisory Organizations and operational support, ensuring accurate, reliable and timely HR data across the organization.
  
  
The role will independently investigate and resolve complex data and reporting issues, manage ServiceNow tickets, and coordinate with AMS and third-party Workday partners to ensure issues are effectively resolved.
  
  
This role will suit someone who combines strong Workday data and reporting expertise with a hands-on operational mindset and an interest in using automation, AI and emerging Workday capabilities to improve how HR services are delivered.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Workday Data & Data Quality
  
  

* Maintain high-quality Workday Core HCM data, ensuring accuracy, completeness and consistency.
* Perform data validation, reconciliation and quality checks to proactively identify and resolve issues.
* Create, execute and validate Workday EIBs and mass data changes, with appropriate pre-load and post-load controls.
* Create and maintain Supervisory Organizations and validate related organizational data.
* Investigate complex data discrepancies, identify root causes and drive corrective actions through to resolution.
* Develop data-quality controls and identify opportunities to prevent recurring issues.
* Ensure HR data changes comply with agreed data governance, approval and documentation standards.

Reporting & Analytics
  
  

* Create and maintain Workday Advanced Reports, dashboards and recurring or ad hoc reporting solutions.
* Translate business requirements into effective reporting solutions.
* Analyze HR data to identify trends, exceptions and data-quality issues.
* Support stakeholders in understanding and effectively using HR data.
* Troubleshoot and resolve reporting issues.
* Identify opportunities to standardize, automate and simplify reporting and data processes.

ServiceNow & Operational Support
  
  

* Manage Workday data and reporting tickets through ServiceNow (SNOW) from triage through resolution and closure.
* Provide hands-on investigation and data correction rather than acting solely as an escalation point.
* Manage priorities and ticket workloads in line with agreed service levels.
* Identify recurring ticket themes and recommend permanent fixes, controls or knowledge articles.
* Collaborate with HR Operations, Payroll, Finance and Technology teams to resolve cross-functional issues.

AMS & Third-Party Coordination
  
  

* Coordinate with AMS and third-party Workday support partners to resolve data and reporting issues.
* Ensure requirements and expected outcomes are clearly defined when work is assigned to external partners.
* Monitor ticket progress, SLAs, escalations and quality of resolution.
* Review and challenge proposed solutions where needed to ensure the underlying issue is resolved.
* Support effective knowledge transfer from external partners to the internal team.
* Identify opportunities to improve the support model and reduce recurring issues or unnecessary external dependency.

Knowledge & Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Maintain SOPs, knowledge articles, process documentation and user guidance.
* Provide practical guidance on Workday reporting, EIBs, mass data changes and organizational data.
* Use data-quality findings and recurring ticket themes to identify opportunities for continuous improvement and automation.
* Act as a Workday data and reporting subject-matter expert within a globally distributed team.
* Coach team members and transfer knowledge to strengthen internal Workday data and reporting capability.
* Explore opportunities to use AI, automation and emerging Workday capabilities to improve data management, reporting and operational support.

Experience & Technical Expertise
  
  
**Essential**

* 5+ years of hands-on experience in Workday, HRIS, HR data, reporting or a related field.
* Strong knowledge of Workday Core HCM data and HR organizational structures.
* Strong experience with Workday EIBs, mass data changes, data validation and reconciliation.
* Experience creating and maintaining Supervisory Organizations.
* Strong Workday reporting capability, including building and maintaining Advanced Reports.
* Strong understanding of HR data quality, controls and governance.
* Experience working within an operational support environment and managing incidents or service requests through ServiceNow (SNOW) or a comparable platform.
* Experience working with AMS and/or third-party Workday support providers.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with excellent attention to data accuracy.
* Ability to independently manage complex activities, ticket workloads and competing priorities.
* Strong stakeholder-management and communication skills.
* A hands-on mindset and willingness to investigate and resolve issues directly.
* Professional fluency in English.

Highly Desirable
  
  

* Experience coordinating or managing an AMS / third-party Workday support model, including tickets, SLAs and escalations.
* Experience in a global Workday production-support environment.
* Experience with Workday Prism Analytics.
* Experience with Power BI, Tableau or similar analytics tools.
* Experience supporting major HR transformation, separation, migration or stabilization activities.

Nice to Have
  
  

* Knowledge or experience with Workday Extend.
* Knowledge of AI agents, agentic AI or AI-enabled HR solutions, particularly their application to HR data, reporting or service delivery.
* Experience with VNDLY or Workday Adaptive
* Awareness of broader Workday capabilities, including integrations and security dependencies.

**Why join us?**
This is a place for people who are passionate about ice cream and are growth obsessed - both for the business and for themselves. People who act like an owner and drive our business end-to-end. People who are driven by success to deliver more than we ever thought we could!
  
  
You’ll thrive here if you value an inclusive culture, with low ego and hierarchy - and if you’re excited to continuously learn and challenge how we work, using digital, data, and new thinking to push us forward.
  
  

* Roles with real accountability and visible impact
* Free to move fast, experiment and challenge how things are done
* Continuous learning and development as the business grows
* Reward linked to performance and contribution.

Your career here is shaped by what you deliver, as you work across functions and markets and grow with the business.
  
  
**Ready to build the future of Ice Cream?**
If this sounds like the place where you'd thrive, we'd love to hear from you. Apply online and share your CV. We'll review your application and be in touch with the next steps.
  
  
If you are an individual with a disability and require assistance at any time during our recruitment process, please let your Talent Acquisition Partner know.
  
  
**Additional Information**
The Magnum Ice Cream Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We embrace diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work regardless of age, disability, gender identity, race, religion, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic.

title: Supplier Quality Engineer
description:
Shape Supplier Excellence as a Supplier Quality Engineer

  

Are you ready to take the next step in your quality career? Join us as a **Supplier Quality Engineer** and play a key role in ensuring supplier and manufacturing quality across complex project deliveries. You will work closely with suppliers, procurement, engineering, assurance, and project teams to drive quality performance, resolve challenges, and continuously improve supplier capability. This is an opportunity to influence supplier readiness, strengthen quality standards, and contribute to successful project execution in a multicultural and international environment.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

* Collaborate with procurement during supplier selection and qualification, providing input on quality risks, capabilities, and technical compliance.
* Lead supplier qualification processes, including audits, documentation reviews, and first article inspections, ensuring readiness for project deliveries.
* Act as the primary supplier quality contact for assigned category(ies)/projects, managing supplier delivery performance.
* Coordinate with Procurement to embed quality expectations in supplier agreements and onboarding processes.
* Drive timely resolution of supplier quality issues through root cause analysis (RCA) and corrective/preventive actions (CAPA).
* Conduct supplier visits, process audits, and Gemba walks to verify compliance and enable proactive risk mitigation and explore development opportunities.
* Lead and track supplier claim management activities by initiating claims, validating cost of poor quality (COPQ), and supporting claim recovery with Procurement.
* Support supplier coaching on quality tools and practices to foster self-inspection, problem-solving, and capability growth.
* Contribute to supplier scorecards and performance reviews with data-driven insights for continuous improvement and escalation when needed.
* Support sales project cases and new development projects.
Coordinate with sourcing and Category for footprint changes.  

  

**Knowledge & Skills:**

* Good knowledge of supplier quality processes (APQP, Audits, NCR/CAPA, qualification) Familiarity with manufacturing processes (e.g., casting, machining, welding, fabrication and surface preparation)
* Competence in quality tools and techniques (8D, FMEA, Control Plan, SPC, root cause analysis)
* Understanding of ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001 and related QHSE standards Proficiency in interpreting technical drawings and quality specifications
* Ability to collaborate across functions (Procurement, Assurance, Engineering, Projects) and with suppliers Strong communication, problem-solving, and follow-through skills
Certification in Lean Six Sigma is a plus Go along with company HSE procedures and practices  

**Experience & Education:**

* Technical degree in Mechanical, Industrial, or Manufacturing Engineering (or equivalent technical field)
* At least 04 years of experience in supplier quality, manufacturing, or industrial quality assurance roles Experience in capital projects or low-volume/high-complexity production environments preferred
* Hands-on experience with supplier audits, inspections, and qualification activities
* Exposure to project-based procurement, customer-facing quality, or field quality is a plus Experience in multi-cultural and multi-national environment is plus.
* This position requires domestic/international travel (60% -70%) and depuations.
Good communication in English and fluent in local language.  

  

**To succeed in this role**
---------------------------

Success in this role requires strong expertise in supplier quality management, supplier qualification, auditing, and quality improvement methodologies. You combine technical understanding of manufacturing processes with the ability to identify risks, solve quality issues, and build effective relationships with suppliers and cross-functional stakeholders. You are comfortable working independently, managing multiple priorities, and driving continuous improvement in complex project and production environments.

We also expect you to align with Valmet’s Leadership Principles—practical behaviors that guide how we lead, collaborate, and succeed together:

* Take accountability – Act with ownership, set clear expectations, and follow through
* Lead with courage – Champion change, try bold ideas, and learn quickly
* Build on trust – Listen to understand, be open, and create psychological safety
Collaborate for growth – Work across boundaries, value diverse perspectives, and focus on customer value  

  

**We offer**
------------

You will join a quality-focused environment where supplier performance, product quality, and continuous improvement are central priorities. The team works closely with Procurement, Engineering, Assurance, Projects, and suppliers to ensure supplier readiness, compliance, and high-quality project deliveries. Through supplier audits, qualification activities, performance reviews, and problem-solving initiatives, the team drives measurable improvements across the supply chain. You will also have opportunities to collaborate with colleagues and suppliers across multiple countries and cultures while supporting complex projects and supplier development activities.

Valmet offers an inspiring and challenging position with opportunities to contribute to meaningful business outcomes. You will work in an international and collaborative environment that values innovation, learning, and professional growth. We value our employees and provide modern work tools, learning opportunities, and a workplace that supports continuous development.

  

**When everything works together**
----------------------------------

*Valmet is where the best talent from a wide variety of backgrounds comes together. We work together with our customers throughout the entire lifecycle, delivering cutting-edge technologies and services as well as mission-critical automation and flow control solutions. Backed by more than 225 years of industrial experience and a global team of over 19,000 professionals close to customers, we are uniquely positioned to transform industries toward a regenerative tomorrow. At Valmet, diversity of thought drives innovation. We are committed to a respectful and inclusive environment, where people can be themselves and are supported to contribute at their best. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and make hiring decisions based on skills, experience, and potential, never on personal characteristics such as gender, gender identity, age, ethnicity, nationality, disability, neurodiversity, religion, sexual orientation, or political views. Join the team – and lead the way with us!*

description:
**Job Description: Principal Engineer, Data Platform (Databricks)**

**About the Role**

We are building our next-generation data platform on Databricks. The Principal Engineer sets the technical direction for how the bank ingests, models, governs and serves data. This is a hands-on role: you will design the detailed lakehouse implementation, set engineering standards for SQL and pipelines, lead the migration from legacy platforms, and mentor engineers across several teams. You will work within the target-state architecture owned by the Solution Architect.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Lakehouse design:** Own the detailed design of the Databricks lakehouse: ingestion, bronze/silver/gold layers, Delta Lake design, Unity Catalog setup, and workspace and cluster configuration.
* **Migration:** Lead the hands-on migration of legacy Hadoop/Hive/Spark and warehouse workloads to Databricks, including re-platforming HQL and SQL, validating data parity, and safe cutover.
* **Engineering standards:** Set standards for SQL, PySpark and Delta Live Tables/Lakeflow pipelines, covering code review, testing, CI/CD and observability.
* **Performance and cost:** Tune performance and cost: partitioning, liquid clustering/Z-ordering, file compaction, join and shuffle tuning, Photon, cluster right-sizing and DBU spend governance.
* **Data modeling:** Design canonical, auditable entity models (applications, accounts, customers, transactions) across source systems.
* **Security and compliance:** Implement PII protection, encryption and tokenization, row/column-level security, lineage, retention and audit readiness with Security, Risk, Compliance and Data Governance.
* **Design reviews:** Lead technical design reviews, write architecture decision records, and resolve cross-team technical trade-offs.
* **Mentoring:** Mentor senior and mid-level engineers and raise engineering quality across the data organization.
* **Data products:** Work with Analytics, Data Science/ML, Risk, Fraud and Finance to turn business needs into reliable, documented data products.
* **Evaluation:** Evaluate new Databricks capabilities and tools and recommend adoption where there is clear value.

**Must-Have Skills**

* **Experience:** 12+ years in data or software engineering, with at least 5 years in a technical lead, staff or principal role.
* **SQL:** Expert-level SQL: complex analytical queries, window functions, CTEs, query plan analysis and tuning on very large datasets (billions of rows).
* **Spark and big data:** Deep experience with Apache Spark (PySpark and/or Scala) and the ecosystem: Hadoop, Hive, Kafka, Parquet/ORC/Delta.
* **Databricks in production:** Hands-on production use of Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Workflows/Jobs, Databricks SQL, and cluster and cost management.
* **Pipelines:** Proven design and operation of large-scale batch and streaming pipelines, including Structured Streaming, Delta Live Tables and Kafka, on a major cloud.
* **Migration:** Experience migrating on-premises or EMR-based Hadoop/Hive platforms to Databricks.
* **Performance and cost:** Proven Spark and Databricks performance tuning and cost optimization, including cluster policies.
* **Data modeling:** Dimensional, entity-centric, Data Vault or medallion modeling, including slowly changing dimensions, incremental/CDC loads and soft deletes.
* **Orchestration and CI/CD:** Airflow, Databricks Workflows or Oozie; Git, Terraform or Databricks Asset Bundles, and automated testing and data quality checks.
* **Data security:** Implementation of PII protection: encryption, tokenization, and row/column-level security.
* **Leadership and communication:** Mentoring engineers, and explaining technical trade-offs clearly to engineers and executives.

* Data modeling for Marketing (campaign, attribution, funnel) and Collections (delinquency, contact, payments)
* Observability and monitoring frameworks for data pipelines
