description:
Senior Network Engineer
  
  
Role Summary
  
The Senior Network Engineer is the senior technical authority within the Network Operations teams, providing technical leadership, operational expertise and service ownership across one or more network services.
  
The role combines advanced technical capability with operational leadership to ensure the delivery of secure, stable and resilient customer services. Beyond incident resolution, the Senior Network Engineer drives continual service improvement, mentors engineers, supports customer engagements and works closely with engineering, architecture and service management teams to strengthen the operational capability and resilience of the services they support.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
**The Senior Network Engineer is expected to:**  

* Lead the investigation and resolution of complex operational incidents and technical escalations.
* Provide technical leadership and guidance to engineers across the operations team.
* Take ownership of service outcomes, ensuring customer impact is minimised and operational risks are managed effectively.
* Make sound technical and operational decisions during live service events.
* Drive continual service improvement through process optimisation, automation and operational innovation.
* Produce and maintain operational documentation, procedures and knowledge articles.
* Mentor colleagues, share knowledge and help develop the capability of the wider team.
* Build effective relationships with customers, engineering teams, service management and third-party vendors.
* Support the introduction of new technologies, services and operational capabilities.
* Promote a culture of ownership, collaboration, professionalism and continuous improvement.

Required Technical Skills / Experience
  
The Senior Network Engineer should possess strong technical knowledge and practical experience in several of the following areas:
  

* (5+ years experience) Enterprise networking, including routing, switching, TCP/IP, DNS and VPN technologies.
* (5+ years experience) Network security technologies, including firewalls, secure access solutions and network segmentation.
* (2+ years experience) Public cloud networking and connectivity across one or more hyperscale cloud providers.
* (5+ years experience) Troubleshooting and root cause analysis of complex network and security incidents.

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
**Function**

Engineering

**Our Company**
===============

We’re Hitachi Vantara, the data foundation trusted by the world’s innovators. Our resilient, high-performance data infrastructure means that customers – from banks to theme parks – can focus on achieving the incredible with data.

If you’ve seen the Las Vegas Sphere, you’ve seen just one example of how we empower businesses to automate, optimize, innovate – and wow their customers. Right now, we’re laying the foundation for our next wave of growth. We’re looking for people who love being part of a diverse, global team – and who get excited about making a real-world impact with data.

**Job description**
===================

**About the Role**
==================

We are looking for an experienced and hands-on Product Designer to join our Product Design team at Hitachi Vantara.

In this role, you will contribute to designing intuitive, consistent, and effective experiences for complex enterprise products, particularly in the areas of digital infrastructure, data management, and emerging AI-driven capabilities.

You will work closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and fellow Designers to transform business requirements and user needs into meaningful product experiences.

We are looking for someone who can work independently, take ownership of complex design challenges, and balance user needs, business objectives, and technical feasibility.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Lead end-to-end Product Design activities, from discovery and problem definition through ideation, prototyping, validation, and delivery.

* Translate complex business and technical requirements into clear user flows, interaction models, wireframes, and high-fidelity designs.

* Collaborate closely with Product Management and Engineering to define solutions that balance user needs, business priorities, and technical constraints.

* Plan and conduct user research, usability testing, and design validation activities to inform decisions.

* Identify opportunities to simplify complex workflows and improve the usability, consistency, and accessibility of our products.

* Contribute to the evolution and adoption of design systems, patterns, and shared UX standards.

* Present and communicate design decisions clearly, using evidence and rationale to build alignment with stakeholders.

* Take ownership of assigned design initiatives, managing priorities and dependencies with limited supervision.

* Support other Designers through design reviews, constructive feedback, and knowledge sharing.

* Explore emerging technologies and AI-assisted experiences where they can provide meaningful value to users.

  

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Typically 10+ years of professional experience in Product Design, UX Design, Interaction Design, or a related field, or equivalent demonstrated expertise.

* Strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end design thinking, problem-solving, and delivered product experiences.

* Advanced proficiency with Figma and modern design and prototyping tools.

* Solid understanding of user-centered design, interaction design, information architecture, usability, and accessibility.

* Experience designing complex digital products, preferably enterprise or B2B software.

* Ability to independently manage design assignments and collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary teams.

* Strong analytical, communication, and presentation skills.

* Experience working with design systems and translating design specifications into implementation-ready deliverables.

  

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Experience with enterprise infrastructure, data management, cloud platforms, or technical products.

* Familiarity with AI-driven user experiences, automation, and data visualization.

* Experience collaborating with distributed, international Product and Engineering teams.

* Experience mentoring or supporting the development of other Designers.

**About us**
============

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
**Key Responsibilities**

**Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) & Experimentation**

* Own conversion rates across the ResearchAyu website, core funnels, and campaign landing pages to maximize lead generation.
* Design, launch, and iterate on fast-paced A/B and multivariate tests using user behavior data, heatmaps, and analytics.
* Partner closely with growth and marketing teams to align design decisions with key performance metrics (Conversion Rate, CTR, Lead Quality, and Bounce Rate).

**User Journey Mapping & Behavioral UX**

* Map end-to-end customer journeys to identify drop-off points, cognitive load, and usability bottlenecks.
* Apply principles of user psychology, persuasion, and cognitive behavior to design frictionless forms, clear value propositions, and intuitive user flows.
* Conduct competitor benchmarking, usability testing, and user research to uncover new opportunities for funnel improvement.

**UI Design & Creative Execution**

* Translate business and campaign requirements into wireframes, user flows, interactive prototypes, and high-fidelity responsive designs in Figma.
* Build and maintain scalable design systems, reusable components, Auto Layout structures, and brand guidelines to ensure consistency across desktop and mobile.
* Create high-converting visual assets for landing pages and digital campaigns-including static banners, UI graphics, micro-interactions, and lightweight motion creatives.

**Hands-On Frontend Implementation**

* Bridge the gap between design and engineering by building, editing, and deploying responsive web pages and landing page variations directly in code (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, or modern no-code/low-code builders).
* Ensure pixel-perfect execution, fast page load speeds, accessibility compliance, and cross-browser/device responsiveness without waiting on heavy engineering cycles.

**What We’re Looking For**

**Experience:** 2–4 years of hands-on experience in UI/UX Design, Product Design, or Growth Design, ideally within high-growth B2C, D2C, SaaS, or lead-generation environments.

**Behavioral & CRO Mindset:** Proven track record of improving conversion rates and reducing drop-offs. You start every project by understanding user intent and psychological triggers before drawing a single wireframe.

**Design Mastery:** Expert-level proficiency in **Figma** (components, variants, Auto Layout, interactive prototyping) and working knowledge of creative tools (Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects, or Canva) for campaign visuals.

**Frontend Execution Skills:** Strong hands-on proficiency in **HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript** (experience with frameworks like React/Next.js, Tailwind CSS, or platforms like Webflow/WordPress/Framer is a strong advantage). You can take a concept from Figma straight to a live, testable page.

**Data-Driven & Agile:** Comfortable interpreting analytics tools (e.g., GA4, Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity) to validate hypotheses and ship rapid iterations in a fast-paced environment.

**Portfolio:** A strong portfolio showcasing real-world web/landing page projects, clearly explaining the problem, behavioral rationale, UX decisions, and measurable conversion impact.

**Core Skills Summary**

Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) • User Psychology & Behavior • User Journey Mapping • A/B Testing & Funnel Analytics • Figma (Prototyping & Design Systems) • Responsive UI/UX Design • HTML / CSS / JavaScript • Landing Page Optimization

HVK Architecture & Interiors is hiring an in-house performance marketer to grow qualified enquiries for our luxury residential interior design and turnkey projects. You will work closely with the marketing and pre-sales teams. You will own the performance system: campaign goals, lead-quality feedback, tracking, creative coordination, competitor research, and nurturing from first enquiry to booked consultation.

Role targets and measures

* **Monthly lead volume:**
  Build toward
  **200–300 leads per month**
  from Meta and Google, within the approved media budget.
* **Appointment booking:**
  Achieve a
  **10% lead-to-booked-appointment rate**
  , equivalent to
  **20–30 bookings from 200–300 leads**
  .
* **Qualified meetings:**
  Track bookings, attendance, and qualification separately. Work with pre-sales to improve attendance and qualification against the first-month baseline.
* **Sales contribution:**
  At an indicative
  **10% close rate from qualified attended meetings**
  , 20–30 meetings could support
  **2–3 project wins**

* **Lead quality:**
  Define and report qualified leads against HVK’s audience:
  **HNI and UHNI prospects across Delhi NCR**
  with a relevant residential or select commercial project and a credible project timeline.
* **Efficiency and attribution:**
  Report cost per lead, cost per qualified lead, cost per booked and attended meeting, and campaign contribution to won projects. Establish current baselines in the first 30 days and agree channel-level cost targets with management.
* **Data and feedback:**
  Ensure every paid lead is traceable to its source and campaign, with duplicates and disqualification reasons classified. Review lead feedback with pre-sales every week.

What you will own

* Plan, launch, and optimise Meta Ads and Google Ads across TOFU, MOFU, and BOFU stages, including prospecting, retargeting, search-intent, and conversion campaigns.
* Own campaign briefs, budget recommendations, priorities, reporting, and optimisation. Maintain clear ownership of HVK’s goals and lead-quality definitions.
* Run a
  **weekly creative brainstorming session**
  with the marketing team. Maintain a rolling creative test calendar and bring at least
  **4 fresh concepts or angles to testing each month**
  , coordinating copy, landing pages, project stories, and required assets.
* Partner with pre-sales to review lead quality, contactability, appointment outcomes, and reasons prospects do not progress. Make sure follow-up and feedback are recorded consistently.
* Build and maintain CRM stages, lead-nurture sequences, and automation for new enquiries, missed calls, unbooked prospects, and longer-consideration leads.
* Review public-facing campaigns and positioning from
  **5–8 relevant luxury interior design and real estate firms each month**
  . Bring at least
  **3 actionable campaign or creative recommendations**
  into the monthly review.
* Monitor tracking and reporting across ad platforms, website forms, CRM, and analytics. Where technically available, connect qualified-lead and won-project outcomes back to campaign reporting.
* Provide a concise weekly performance update and a monthly funnel review covering spend, volume, quality, appointments, attendance, and sales contribution.

First 90-day outcomes

* **By day 30:**
  Audit the existing Meta and Google setup, tracking, CRM handoff, creative pipeline, and recent lead outcomes. Document the baseline and a prioritised plan.
* **By day 60:**
  Implement agreed fixes, establish the weekly lead-feedback loop, launch a structured creative and funnel-testing plan, and activate the first nurture automations.
* **By day 90:**
  Deliver the agreed run-rate toward
  **200–300 monthly leads**
  and a
  **10% lead-to-booked-appointment rate**
  , subject to approved budget. Report lead quality and cost against agreed baselines.

Experience and skills

* At least
  **3 years**
  of hands-on performance marketing experience across Meta Ads and Google Ads.
* Experience running campaigns for
  **luxury interior design or real estate**
  , with a practical understanding of the
  **Delhi NCR audience and market**
  .
* Experience with full-funnel campaigns, retargeting, conversion tracking, landing-page feedback, CRM workflows, and marketing automation.
* Comfortable analysing campaign and CRM data, explaining performance clearly, and acting on feedback from sales and pre-sales teams.
* Working knowledge of GA4, Google Tag Manager, and a CRM or automation platform such as HubSpot, Zoho, or an equivalent system.

Working arrangement

This is a full-time, hybrid position with a five-day working week. The role requires regular coordination with HVK’s Delhi NCR marketing and pre-sales teams.

How to apply

Please share your CV and a short note (hvkstudio1@gmail.com) describing your experience in luxury interiors, real estate, and the Delhi NCR market. Include campaign examples with monthly spend, lead volume, qualified-meeting results, and outcomes wherever available.

title: IN26318 Business Services Manager (Locally Recruited)
description:
**Description**
CIMMYT is a cutting edge, non-profit, international organization dedicated to solving tomorrow's problems today. It is entrusted with fostering improved quantity, quality, and dependability of production systems and basic cereals such as maize, wheat, triticale, sorghum, millets, and associated crops through applied agricultural science, particularly in the Global South, through building strong partnerships. This combination enhances the livelihood trajectories and resilience of millions of resource-poor farmers, while working towards a more productive, inclusive, and resilient agrifood system within planetary boundaries.
  
  
For more information, visit cimmyt.org.
  
  
We are looking for a driven, service-oriented professional to join us as Business Services Manager –India — someone who thrives in complex environments, is comfortable working across multiple entities, and takes genuine pride in making operations run smoothly.
  
  
This role sits at the intersection of two distinct but connected organizations — CIMMYT India and BISA India — operating under a shared services model. Each has its own structures, priorities, and operational footprint, and the BSD Manager will need to understand both well. BISA operates a network of research stations across India, each with its own inventory, warehousing, and field operations requirements. CIMMYT India, while structured differently, has its own operational needs that this role will equally support. Managing both entities means navigating real complexity — different governance lines, different operational rhythms — and doing so with confidence and clarity.
  
  
The position is based in India with frequent travel to BISA research stations and CIMMYT operational locations.
  
  
The role will be based in New Delhi, India.
  
  
**Requirements**
**Key Responsibilities**
**General Business Services Management**

* Lead and coordinate business services operations across both CIMMYT India and BISA India, keeping everything aligned with institutional policies and compliance standards.
* Ensure operational services are delivered efficiently across field stations, offices, warehouses, and research operations.
* Build processes that are structured, scalable, and consistent with CIMMYT’s internal control frameworks and regional direction.
* Work closely with the RBSM – Asia on operational planning, escalation, and decision support — keeping them well-informed with timely updates and field observations.
* Spot operational bottlenecks early and put practical solutions in place to improve efficiency, compliance, and service quality.
* Track and maintain performance indicators across inventory, warehousing, procurement, logistics, facilities, and admin services.

**Inventory, Warehouse, and Field Operations**
This is a significant part of the role. BISA’s research stations carry diverse and operationally critical inventory, and effective management of these assets is essential to the success of research programmes.
  
  

* Oversee inventory and warehouse management across BISA stations and CIMMYT locations in India.
* Maintain strong controls over seed inventory, agrochemicals and fertilizers, fuel and consumables, and harvested produce and agricultural by-products.
* Ensure warehouses are well-organised, with clear zoning, storage standards, stock movement controls, and regular physical verification.
* Keep inventory traceable through proper documentation, batch tracking, and reconciliation processes.
* Support the rollout and ongoing use of Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365) inventory and warehouse modules, working under the direction of the RBSM Asia.
* Manage inter-station inventory movements and ensure documentation and reconciliation are in order.

**Procurement, Logistics, and Operational Coordination**

* Work with Procurement teams to ensure timely sourcing and movement of operational and agricultural materials.
* Keep procurement, receiving, inventory, and field usage processes well-aligned and free of gaps.
* Monitor operational readiness through the lens of crop seasonality, field station needs, warehouse capacities, and research timelines.
* Coordinate logistics for field operations, input storage and movement, and operational supplies.
* Provide regular operational data, reports, and field updates to the RBSM Asia for regional oversight and management review.

Fleet, Travel, and Facilities Management
  
  
With operations spread across multiple research stations and offices, managing fleet, travel, and facilities (Guest houses) is a meaningful part of keeping CIMMYT and BISA running effectively in India.
  
  

* Oversee the management of the institutional vehicle fleet across BISA stations and CIMMYT India locations — covering scheduling, maintenance, insurance, road worth in compliance, and safe usage policies.
* Maintain accurate fleet records including logbooks, benefit vehicle assignation and maintenance, service histories, fuel consumption tracking, and driver assignment registers.
* Ensure fleet utilisation is optimised and costs are managed within approved budgets, with regular reporting to the RBSM Asia.
* Coordinate institutional travel arrangements for staff across CIMMYT India and BISA, including ground transportation, inter-station travel, and support for international visitors and mission travel.
* Ensure travel processes comply with CIMMYT/BISA travel policies, authorisation procedures, and safety protocols — particularly for field and remote-location travel.
* Manage facilities across BISA research stations and CIMMYT India offices, including office space, staff accommodation, utilities, use of office guest houses, and common infrastructure.
* Coordinate preventive and corrective maintenance of buildings, equipment, and station infrastructure, ensuring a safe and functional working environment.
* Oversee lease and service agreements for facilities, working with relevant teams on renewals, compliance, and vendor performance.
* Ensure facilities meet required health, safety, and environmental standards, and that any risks are identified and addressed promptly.
* Support planning for station expansions, relocations, or facility upgrades as and when required.

**Governance, Compliance, and Internal Controls**

* Ensure day-to-day operations comply with CIMMYT/BISA policies, internal controls, and administrative procedures.
* Strengthen governance across warehouse management, inventory controls, documentation and traceability, segregation of duties, and operational approvals.
* Ensure Occupational Health and Safety (OHS) standards are met for the storage and handling of agrochemicals and other operational materials.
* Keep records, inventory data, and supporting documentation audit-ready at all times.
* Flag significant compliance or control risks to the RBSM Asia promptly for institutional review and follow-up.

**Business Continuity and Risk Management**

* Maintain operational continuity through disruptions — whether from extreme weather,agricultural emergencies, supply chain issues, or infrastructure challenges.
* Monitor and manage operational risks tied to agro-climatic conditions, seasonal cycles, supply disruptions, and storage vulnerabilities.
* Coordinate station-level mitigation measures and escalate major risks through the RBSM Asia.
* Support preparedness and contingency planning across stations.

**Team Leadership and Coordination**

* Supervise and support Operations Associates and operational staff at BISA stations.
* Provide operational guidance to Procurement Analysts assigned to India operations, where applicable.
* Build capability within field-based teams through mentorship, hands-on oversight, and training.
* Foster a culture of operational discipline, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Ensure station teams consistently follow approved operational processes, inventory controls, and system requirements.

**Qualifications And Experience**

* Master’s degree in business administration, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Operations Management, Hospitality Management, Agricultural Business Management, or a related discipline.
* At least 12 - 15 years of progressively responsible experience in operations, business services, warehouse management, procurement, logistics, or related support functions.
* Proven experience managing multi-location operations, ideally in agricultural, research,development, or international organisation settings.
* Hands-on knowledge of inventory and warehouse management, procurement and logisticscoordination, internal controls, and operational governance.
* Familiarity with ERP systems, with preference for Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365).
* Practical understanding of agricultural operations and seasonality, agrochemical handlingand storage, seed systems, and farm operations.
* Experience managing fleet operations, institutional travel coordination, and facilities orestate management across multiple locations.
* Experience in international organisations, the CGIAR system, NGOs, or researchinstitutions is a strong advantage.
* Willingness and ability to travel frequently to field stations and operational locations withinIndia.
* Strong coordination, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
* Excellent written and spoken English. Working knowledge of Hindi is an advantage.

**Benefits**
The position is for an initial fixed-term contract of 12 months, after which further employment is subject to performance and the continued availability of funds. CIMMYT offers an attractive remuneration package, with a range of benefits including health insurance.
  
  
Candidates must Apply Online for
**IN26318 Business Services Manager - India.**
Applications must include a CV with contact details (telephone and email address) of 3 work-related references along with the confirmation that Recruitment team can contact them) and a cover letter. Incomplete applications will not be taken into consideration.
  
  
This position is recruited locally. Applicants must have the legal right to work in the duty station country at the time of application. CIMMYT does not provide visa sponsorship or work permit support for locally recruited staff roles.
  
  
**Please note that only short-listed candidates will be contacted.**
**CIMMYT is an equal opportunity employer. It fosters a multicultural work environment that values gender equality, teamwork, and respect for diversity. Women are encouraged to apply.**

title: Structural Design Engineer
description:
Role Summary

Own the end-to-end structural, mechanical, and site-engineering design of solar platform systems — floating while ensuring designs account for site hydrology, flood risk, and water-body conditions relevant to floating installations.

**Key Responsibilities**

Structural & Mechanical Design

* Lead structural design of floating platform systems: float modules, walkways, and module mounting structures (MMS).
* Design pile foundations and anchoring systems for floating structures, based on soil, bathymetric, and site parameters.
* Prepare design basis reports for floating structures, foundations, and equipment platforms.
* Evaluate and select float construction materials (Ferro-cement, HDPE, or hybrid), weighing buoyancy, durability, and cost.
* Perform structural analysis and modelling using STAAD.Pro, SolidWorks, and AutoCAD.
* Prepare GA, fabrication, and assembly drawings for module mount structures, walkways, lightning arrestor systems, and safety rails.
* Build 3D models and renders of solar plants (SolidWorks/SketchUp), including shadow analysis and walk-throughs.
* Review and approve fabrication and installation drawings; prepare installation manuals for site/construction teams.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* B.Tech/B.E. in Mechanical, Civil, or Structural Engineering (a PhD or advanced qualification in Water Resources/Hydraulics is a strong plus for the hydrology-facing aspects of this role).
* 10+ years of experience in structural/mechanical design of solar structures (floating and/or ground-mounted).
* Direct experience with floating solar or marine floating structures strongly preferred; Ferro-cement float system experience preferred (HDPE experience acceptable with a learning curve).
* Strong command of STAAD.Pro, SolidWorks, and AutoCAD; SketchUp a plus.

B2C Recruitment / Career Services

2–5 Years

Faridabad / Delhi-NCR

Full-Time

**About the Role**

We are looking for a dynamic and target-oriented
**B2C Recruitment & Career Services Executive**
who can manage and grow our candidate-focused recruitment business.

The role will involve
**candidate acquisition, career counselling, recruitment services, sales conversion and relationship management**
. The person will interact directly with job seekers, understand their career requirements, explain relevant recruitment and career services, convert qualified leads into paid customers, and support them through the recruitment journey.

This is a
**combination of Recruitment + B2C Sales + Career Counselling + Customer Relationship Management**
.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Candidate Acquisition & Engagement**

* Connect with job seekers through leads, databases, references, digital platforms and other channels.
* Understand candidates' experience, skills, career aspirations and job preferences.
* Build and maintain a strong pipeline of active job seekers.
* Regularly follow up with candidates and keep them engaged throughout the recruitment process.

**2. B2C Sales & Business Development**

* Explain and sell relevant recruitment and career services to candidates.
* Convert enquiries/leads into registrations and paid services.
* Understand candidate requirements and recommend appropriate services such as:
* Candidate Registration
* CV/Resume Development
* Interview Preparation
* Skill/Job-oriented Training
* Career Counselling
* Job Placement / Recruitment Services
* Handle candidate objections related to pricing, service value, timelines and outcomes.
* Follow up effectively to achieve monthly sales and revenue targets.
* Maintain high conversion rates from leads to paid customers.

**3. Career Counselling**

* Counsel candidates regarding suitable career opportunities based on their experience, skills and aspirations.
* Explain job opportunities, recruitment processes, interview requirements and career paths.
* Build trust and establish long-term relationships with candidates.
* Provide professional and transparent information about the services being offered.

**4. Recruitment & Placement Coordination**

* Understand client requirements and identify suitable candidates from the B2C candidate pool.
* Screen candidates based on job descriptions and client requirements.
* Coordinate interviews between candidates and employers.
* Track candidate progress from registration/service enrolment through interview and joining.
* Coordinate with the internal recruitment team to maximize placement opportunities.
* Maintain accurate candidate and placement records.

**5. Customer Relationship Management**

* Act as the primary point of contact for candidates.
* Ensure a positive candidate experience throughout the recruitment journey.
* Resolve candidate queries and coordinate with internal teams for timely resolution.
* Maintain regular communication and follow-ups.
* Generate repeat business and referrals from satisfied candidates.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 2–5 years of experience in
  **B2C Sales, Recruitment, Career Counselling, Placement Consultancy, EdTech, Training, Education Counselling, Inside Sales or similar customer-facing roles**
  .
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Excellent convincing, counselling and negotiation abilities.
* Strong sales orientation and ability to work with targets.
* Comfortable making a high volume of calls and conducting regular follow-ups.
* Ability to understand customer/candidate needs and recommend appropriate services.
* Good understanding of recruitment and job placement processes.
* Strong objection-handling and closing skills.
* Comfortable discussing fees and converting prospects into paying customers.
* Good knowledge of MS Excel/Google Sheets and CRM systems.

description:
**Job Description**
**YOUR TEAM**
Our Sustainable Water Management team works across a spectrum of services covering water quality and catchment management water resources and security, hydrology and hydraulics, geomorphology, hydroecology and hydrogeology. We provide high quality technical services and advice to high-profile customers in the UK and overseas, including government departments and agencies, the water industry, and industrial sectors, including power, transport, nuclear, mining, commercial and oil and gas.
  
  
We offer a dynamic, but supportive environment for a motivated and talented individual to fulfil their potential. We recognise that our people are central to our success as a business. As a consequence, we are committed to a providing a comprehensive framework for the professional development of our staff, including:
  
  

* Access to extensive internal and external training opportunities;
* A mentoring programme; and
* Support for gaining chartership through professional institutions.

**Responsibilities**
YOUR NEW ROLE, WHAT’S INVOLVED?
  
  
We are seeking senior professionals to join our rapidly expanding team of Water Quality and Catchment Management specialists so that we can continue to deliver sustainable solutions to the water sector and environmental regulators in the UK and help protect the water environment.
  
  
With a background in earth sciences and working knowledge of water quality and geochemistry / environmental chemistry you should be aware of the UK situation with regard to:
  
  

* How river, lake and TraCs water quality is protected through the WFD and other regulatory tools;
* Be aware / have working knowledge of water quality modelling tools (SAGIS, SIMCAT, InfoWorks, ICM etc.).
* Experience on national level infrastructure projects, particularly for National Highways. Experience of HEWRAT or drainage would be advantageous.
* Experience of EIA scoping, reviews and assessments for water/hydrology chapters.
* Experience of water quality permitting and completion or review of H1 and RQP assessments.
* Demonstrate understanding of how to conceptualise a water quality problem and knowledge of the available datasets which can be used in problem solving.

Prior work experience, either postdoctoral or in consultancy or working in the water sector (regulator or industry) would be desirable.
  
  
You should have an interest in problem solving through interrogation of time series and spatial datasets, good conceptualisation skills and understand the important of source pathway receptor models and be able to clearly communicate ideas either through your writing or visualisations. An awareness of how groundwater and surface water interact would also be useful.
  
  
Awareness of sampling network design, liaising with UK teams on risk assessment before field work, and data collation and interpretation (for river and / or groundwater sampling and monitoring) would also be beneficial and some knowledge of catchment management / agri-environment schemes.
  
  
The role will include the following:
  
  

* Water quality data analysis, conceptualisation and visualisation and clear communication;
* Carrying out desk-based investigations / interpretation of datasets.
* Helping to design field monitoring campaigns including traditional and non-traditional approaches;
* Delivery of technical reports and presentations to clients; and
* Winning new work and writing proposals for new projects.
* Project and task management.
* Being a key member of our water quality team in Sustainable Water Management;

You will be based in our India office (Bengaluru or Mumbai as per your choice), but will work collaboratively with teams across WSP’s global business and mainly with our UK based teams. So, being able to work effectively as part of a diverse team, as well as individually for discrete tasks, is very important to us.
  
  
**Qualifications**
WE’D LOVE TO HEAR FROM YOU IF YOU HAVE
  
  

* Degree-level qualifications in a relevant subject (e.g. geography, geology, geochemistry, earth/environmental science, civil engineering or similar);
* A higher degree in a relevant discipline (e.g. river or lake water quality, water chemistry, hydrogeochemistry, water management, environmental science, or similar), is desirable, but not essential;
* You should have excellent analytical skills, and be able to apply them to analysing problems and finding solutions to novel challenges;
* Experience in use of MS Office tools (Word, Teams, Excel, Access, Powerpoint) and use of GIS packages, such as ArcGIS or QGIS;
* You will collaborate effectively as part of a team and be able to work independently with some steer;
* You will demonstrate excellent communication skills, being able to write clearly and / or communicate ideas through visualisations.

title: Travel Consultant
description:
**Company Description**
Makeyourtrippossible is a Delhi-based travel company led by a team of experienced and passionate travelers. The company specializes in budget-friendly trip packages across India, offering first-class lodging and convenient travel options. Through its website, makeyourtrippossible provides a wide range of holiday packages and destination blogs to help clients plan their ideal trips. The team is dedicated to sharing accurate travel information and respecting clients’ time by delivering efficient, reliable service.
  
**Role Description**
The Travel Consultant is a full-time hybrid role based in Delhi, with some flexibility for work from home. In this role, the consultant will advise clients on travel options, create customized itineraries, and manage end-to-end travel arrangements within India. Day-to-day responsibilities include handling inquiries, preparing quotations, booking transportation and accommodation, and managing reservations and changes. The consultant will maintain accurate client records, coordinate with vendors and partners, and ensure timely communication and high-quality customer service. The role also involves staying updated on destinations, offers, and travel trends to provide informed recommendations and enhance the client experience.
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong skills in Travel Consulting and Travel Management.
* Candidates should possess proven experience in Travel Arrangements and Reservations.
* Candidates should possess excellent Customer Service skills, with a client-focused mindset.
* Candidates should possess good communication and interpersonal skills, both written and verbal.
* Candidates should possess organizational abilities, attention to detail, and the capacity to manage multiple bookings.
* Candidates should possess basic computer literacy and familiarity with booking tools or travel platforms.
* Prior experience in the travel or hospitality industry and knowledge of Indian destinations are beneficial.
* A relevant diploma or degree in Travel, Tourism, Hospitality, or a related field is an advantage.

Highway’ team in Mumbai/Noida/Bengaluru to work alongside our UK discipline.

Mandatory Skills

title: Software Development Engineer III
description:
**About GoKwik**
GoKwik is India’s leading D2C Commerce Growth Platform, helping 15,000+ brands acquire, convert, engage, and retain shoppers. Powered by a network of 200M+ shoppers, 500M+ checkouts, and 1.5B+ customer conversations, we’re building the operating system for commerce growth.
  
  
Why This Role Matters
  
  
We are looking for a Software Development Engineer III to build and scale the core backend platform that powers merchant onboarding, storefronts, inventory management, and integrations with eCommerce platforms such as Shopify and WooCommerce.
  
  
The role involves designing reliable, scalable backend services, making architectural decisions, and improving the performance and operational efficiency of production systems. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, and Infrastructure teams to build reusable platform capabilities, reduce manual interventions, and support the growing needs of merchants. You will also contribute to technical direction, engineering standards, and the development of other engineers on the team.
  
  
What You’ll Own
  
  

* Backend Platform Development: Design, develop, and maintain core backend services and reusable platform capabilities for merchant onboarding, storefronts, inventory management, and external integrations.
* System Design and Architecture: Own low-level and high-level designs for shared services. Make decisions around APIs, data models, failure handling, performance, scalability, and maintainability, and document design decisions clearly.
* Distributed Systems and Kafka: Design and operate event-driven systems using Kafka, including topic and partition strategies, consumer groups, message ordering, idempotency, retries, dead-letter queues, consumer lag monitoring, and schema evolution.
* System Performance and Optimisation: Improve SQL query performance, caching, queuing, and service efficiency. Investigate production bottlenecks and implement solutions that address root causes.
* Platform Integrations and Data Synchronisation: Build reliable, bi-directional integrations with eCommerce platforms and external systems. Use patterns such as outbox, change data capture (CDC), reconciliation jobs, and backfills while accounting for third-party API rate limits.
* Scalability and Multi-Tenant Architecture: Design systems that support multiple merchants reliably, including data partitioning and sharding, workload isolation, backpressure management, and appropriate consistency models.
* Production Reliability and Observability: Own production reliability through on-call support, incident response, root-cause analysis, postmortems, and service-level objectives (SLOs). Use observability and application performance monitoring tools, including SigNoz, to identify and resolve issues.
* Infrastructure and Cost Optimisation: Identify opportunities to reduce infrastructure costs, manual support work, and recurring merchant-specific fixes without compromising system reliability or delivery speed.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with Product, Frontend, Infrastructure, and Engineering teams to plan delivery, communicate technical decisions and risks, review designs, and manage production priorities.
* Technical Leadership: Lead design reviews, establish engineering standards, review critical changes, and mentor SDE I and SDE II engineers. Contribute to technical direction across teams and promote clear documentation and execution practices.
* AI Systems and Engineering Tools: Apply AI-assisted development tools where appropriate and demonstrate an understanding of AI system design, including LLM inference, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vector search, agents, and guardrails.

Who You Are
  
  

* Have 6+ years of software engineering experience in a product or platform company, with hands-on ownership of production backend systems.
* Have strong low-level and high-level system design skills and can evaluate trade-offs, justify architectural decisions, and take accountability for outcomes.
* Have extensive hands-on experience with Kafka in production, including partitioning, ordering guarantees, consumer groups, rebalancing, delivery semantics, idempotency, dead-letter queues, lag monitoring, and failure recovery.
* Have experience designing and scaling high-throughput systems, with measurable examples of improvements in throughput, latency, data volume, or system capacity.
* Possess strong distributed systems fundamentals, including consistency and availability trade-offs, sharding, rate limiting, backpressure, and graceful degradation.
* Have a solid understanding of SQL databases, data modelling, transactions, indexing, query optimisation, caching, and queuing systems.
* Have practical experience with production ownership, on-call responsibilities, incident management, reliability targets, root-cause analysis, and permanent corrective actions.
* Have experience with application performance monitoring and observability tools, preferably including open-source solutions such as SigNoz.
* Have demonstrated the ability to optimise database queries and infrastructure costs.
* Can communicate technical designs, document services, manage technical stakeholders, and explain complex engineering decisions clearly.
* Are proficient in Node.js or Golang and their associated frameworks, or have strong experience in one of these languages with the ability to contribute to the team’s technology stack.
* Demonstrate strong ownership, data-driven decision-making, and a proactive approach to identifying and resolving problems.
* Have experience mentoring engineers and contributing to technical standards and engineering practices.

Why GoKwik
  
  
At GoKwik, you will work on core commerce technology that supports a growing ecosystem of D2C brands. You will have the opportunity to solve complex backend and distributed systems challenges, shape platform architecture, improve production reliability, and influence engineering practices across teams. The role combines hands-on development with technical leadership and offers the opportunity to build scalable, reliable systems that support the next phase of commerce growth.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer Intern
description:
**Forward Deployed Engineer Intern— Evaluations (Product + Engineering)**

**Website:**

voicearena.com

**Location:**

Gurugram,

**About us**

Voice Arena builds evaluations, models and datasets for voice AI. Our mission is to make machines talk like humans, and to measure honestly how close they are. We evaluate speech recognition, speech generation, speaker diarization and conversational agents across languages and real-world conditions.

Our research and engineering team develops evaluation methods, publishes research and builds datasets where gaps in human data hold AI back.

**About the role**

This is an
**Evaluations PM + Engineer**

role. You will own how we measure the quality of our speech, voice, and image data, and of our customers' models: ASR, TTS, speech-to-speech (S2S), and voice agents. You will define what "good" means for each dataset and model, build and run the evaluations yourself, and turn the results into clear decisions for the product, research, and business teams.

You don't hand evaluations off. You plan them, run them end to end, and own the outcome.

**What you'll do**

**Evaluation product ownership**

* Own the evaluation roadmap across ASR, TTS, S2S, and voice-agent models.
* Work with research, product, and business teams to understand use cases and define what quality means for each one.
* Turn quality goals into clear evaluation plans: test sets, metrics, pass/fail thresholds, and timelines.
* Prioritise which models, languages, and use cases to evaluate first, based on impact.
* Share results through clear reports and dashboards, and make go/no-go recommendations on model releases.
* Track model quality over time and flag regressions early.
* **Hands-on evaluation (done by you)**
* Run end-to-end evaluations of ASR, TTS, S2S, and voice-agent models yourself.
* Set up and run open-source and in-house models locally and on cloud GPUs for inference.
* Integrate and run models from different vendors and customers through their APIs (batch and streaming), and compare them fairly.
* Manage cloud GPU instances (GCP/AWS/Azure) to run large-scale evaluation and inference jobs efficiently.
* Build and curate evaluation datasets, including multilingual, Indian-language, noisy, and real-world audio.
* Design and run human evaluations: listening tests, rating guidelines, annotator training, and agreement checks.
* Write reproducible evaluation pipelines in Python and automate recurring benchmarks.
* Analyse errors to find failure patterns and feed them back to the research and data teams.
* Benchmark in-house models against third-party and open-source models.

**What we're looking for**

**Skills**

* Hands-on evaluation of ASR, TTS, S2S, or voice/LLM agent models.
* Strong Python, with Pandas/NumPy, Hugging Face, and audio libraries (librosa, torchaudio).
* Running ML model inference (PyTorch / Hugging Face) on GPUs.
* Working with third-party model APIs (REST, WebSocket/streaming).
* Cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, or Azure), including GPU instances.
* Evaluation metrics, test-set design, and statistical significance.
* Designing human evaluation studies and rating guidelines.
* Clear written and verbal communication, and explaining results to technical and non-technical people.
* Strong ownership, and the ability to work independently in a fast-moving team.

**Nice to have**

* Experience fine-tuning speech models (ASR, TTS, or S2S).
* Experience with Indian languages, code-mixed, or low-resource speech data.
* Familiarity with Whisper, NeMo, pyannote, ESPnet, or commercial speech APIs.
* Experience evaluating LLMs or voice agents (ASR → LLM → TTS pipelines).
* Experience building evaluation dashboards or automated regression testing.

**Why join us**

* Own how quality is defined and measured for speech AI used at scale.
* Work closely with research and product, and directly shape which models ship.
* High ownership and real impact from day one.

title: Evidence Lead, AI Access Initiative (EAII Advisors)
description: About The AI Access Initiative (2AI)We're at an inflection point in artificial intelligence - presenting both tremendous potential opportunity and risk for people in developing countries. AI capabilities are improving on a timescale measured in months, while development systems often move on timescales measured in decades. Much of the technology needed for positive impact exists today, but few organizations exist to bridge research, deployment, and scaled implementation: we must act now to ensure AI's benefits reach people in poverty in LMICs.Incubated at Evidence Action, we're scaling The AI Access Initiative, an organization focused on scaling AI-enabled 'big bets' to benefit tens or hundreds of millions of people in poverty in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs). We operate at the intersection of global development actors, top AI labs, and leading researchers to drive meaningful access to AI's benefits for the 3.5 billion people living in poverty globally. We create "public good," open-sourced playbooks, toolkits, and insights that define how to design and launch tractable and impactful AI-enabled programs. Given the scale of opportunity, we expect our portfolio to expand substantially, but to start, we're scaling two programs focused on AI in Agriculture and AI in Health.Agriculture: We have an ambitious goal to reach 100M+ farmers with AI-enabled weather forecasts, expand forecast R&D to generate novel forecasts, and build public and private sector (WhatsApp, telcos) delivery channels to deliver new, LLM-generated voice and image content that maximizes behavior change. Health: Here, our initial goal is to scale AI-enabled clinical decision support to 20M+ people via telemedicine platforms, dramatically improving diagnosis and health outcomes at a national level. We are also planning to explore and test novel interventions for low-resource settings, including direct-to-consumer (DTC) health interventions. We are led by former Evidence Action CEO Kanika Bahl, a founding member of Anthropic's Long-Term Benefit Trust, and advised by Nobel Laureate Michael Kremer; Dario Amodei, CEO of Anthropic; and Kent Walker, President, Global Affairs for Alphabet and Google. This work builds on Evidence Action's track record reaching 530M+ people with cost-effective, evidence-based programs across 9 countries in Africa and Asia, with a focus on last-mile delivery.About 2AI India And EAII AdvisorsEAII Advisors, Evidence Action's technical partner in India, supports state governments in delivering evidence-based public health programs. Operating across 10 states, EAII Advisors provides technical assistance to ministries of health, education, water, and women and child development, reducing health burdens in impoverished communities and improving the long-term wellbeing of children and families.2AI India is being incubated as a project within EAII Advisors, with plans to spin off into an independent entity at the end of this year. We are hiring a founding team: the first hires will shape the culture, establish the operating model, and own early wins before the organization scales.Roles And ResponsibilitiesThe Evidence Lead is 2AI India's primary engine for measuring whether our programs work and why. This is not a traditional monitoring and evaluation (M&E) role. The focus is generating insights that change program design in real time. Data collection for government reporting is a real but secondary function, roughly 20% of the role. The Evidence Lead is also expected to be actively applying AI and machine learning (ML) tools to evaluation.Evidence Generation and Program MeasurementMeasures the effectiveness of new programs and ideas, from early concept tests through scaled delivery, and defines what "working" means for each before it launchesIdentifies the right data sources for evaluation, including administrative data, program data, partner data, and primary collection, and making the tradeoffs between rigor, cost, and speed explicitDesigns and runs cost-effectiveness models, making the assumptions behind each result legible to the people making the callBuilds the measurement and feedback loops into program design from the start rather than retrofitting them after launchOwns the data collection and reporting obligations that come with government partnerships, roughly 20% of the role,Thought Partnership to ProgramsServes as a thought partner to the programs team on program design, ensuring programs are built to be measurable and monitoring and evaluation efforts measure what really matters. Translates findings into recommendations that program leads can act on, and is explicit about the confidence behind each oneAI and ML Applied to EvaluationApplies AI and ML tools directly to evaluation and data analysis work, and keeps that practice current as the tools changeBuilds the data and modeling infrastructure that lets a small team run rapid and purpose-built analysisExternal RepresentationPresents 2AI's evidence and data externally, with findings tailored to the needs of specific audiences: funders, partners, government counterparts, and the research communityTeam building and enablementFosters a strong, values-aligned culture as a leader across the organizationWillingness to roll-up sleeves and pitch in to the organization building activities required of a founding teamOvertime, hires and enables a team of strong monitoring, learning, and evaluation professionals committed to objectively assessing our programs and fostering their improvementDisclaimer: The duties and responsibilities described are not a comprehensive list and additional tasks may be assigned to the employee from time to time.RequirementsEssentials:Relevant professional background: 7-9 years of experience in M&E, impact evaluation, or applied research in global health or international developmentRigorous evidence environment: has worked in an organization where methodological standards were high and contested, such as academic research, a think tank, or an equivalent research labApplied AI and ML fluency: is already using AI and ML tools in evaluation and data analysis work todayCost-effectiveness modelling: experience building and updating cost-effectiveness analyses, and can explain the assumptions driving a result to a non-technical decision-makerAnalytical structuring: structures ambiguous problems, thinks analytically, and solves quantitative problems without waiting for a fully specified briefProgram collaboration instincts: experience working in close proximity to programs; can understand how program needs and constraints differ from research needs, and adjusts the evidence agenda accordinglyClear communication: shows clarity of thought, writes compellingly, and translates technical information into common language for varied audiencesExternal credibility: can present to funders, government counterparts, and technical peers and hold up under questioningExperience navigating Indian government data systems and state-level reporting requirementsComfort with ambiguity: a track record of doing well in early-stage, resource-constrained environments where the path is not defined and you build it as you goInitiative and bias to action: takes ownership of unassigned problems and moves without being askedWhat Success Looks LikeIn the First 6 Months:You have a working measurement approach with key indicators for the agriculture program, agreed with the Program Director, that specifies what evidence would change the program's directionYou have built or adapted a cost-effectiveness model for at least one priority intervention, and leadership understands and trusts its assumptionsYou have mapped the available data landscape in India, including what government and partner systems can and cannot tell usCompensation : Competitive and commensurate with the individual's credentials, experience, and previous pay scale.BenefitsEAII provides a comprehensive benefits package for employees. Benefits include:Comprehensive health insurance with IPD and OPD provisionsLife and Accidental insurancePF, ESIC and Gratuity as per statutory requirementsGenerous leaveMental and physical wellbeing benefitsLearning & Development benefitsAvenues for engagement and recognitionNote: This role will be open for applications until October 30,2026 . Please apply at your earliest convenience. We may close this search earlier than the specified date if we find the right fit. Due to the volume of applications received, we will only be able to contact shortlisted candidates.

title: Health Policy & Management
description:
**Health Policy & Management — AI Data Trainer**
**About The Role**
Your public health expertise is more valuable than ever — and not just in clinics or government offices. At Alignerr, we partner with the world's leading AI research labs to build smarter, safer AI models. We're looking for Masters in Public Health (MPH) graduates to help ensure that AI systems provide accurate, evidence-based health information grounded in scientific consensus and ethical guidelines.
  
  
This is a fully remote, flexible contract role where your domain knowledge directly shapes how millions of people will interact with AI on critical health topics.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Design Complex Health Scenarios — Develop advanced public health challenges covering disease outbreak simulations, health equity assessments, and statistical interpretation of clinical trial data
* Author Ground-Truth Solutions — Write rigorous, step-by-step responses that synthesize peer-reviewed research, epidemiological data, and authoritative guidelines from sources like the CDC and WHO
* Audit AI Outputs — Evaluate AI-generated health advice and policy recommendations for factual accuracy, potential bias, and adherence to ethical standards — flagging misinformation and logical gaps
* Refine AI Reasoning — Provide structured feedback that helps models distinguish correlation from causation, communicate health risks clearly, and adapt messaging to diverse populations

**Who You Are**

* Holds a Masters in Public Health (MPH), MSPH, or closely related graduate degree
* Strong foundational knowledge in at least two of: Epidemiology, Biostatistics, Environmental Health, or Health Policy
* Able to translate complex health data into clear, culturally sensitive, and actionable written content
* Detail-oriented when working with statistical significance, data citations, and intervention logic
* No prior AI experience required — we'll get you up to speed

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with data annotation, quality evaluation, or research review workflows
* Proficiency with data analysis tools such as R, SAS, or Stata
* Background in health communication, clinical research coordination, or public health surveillance

**Why Join Us**

* Work on high-impact AI projects with leading research labs and teams
* Fully remote and asynchronous — work on your own schedule, 10–40 hours/week
* Freelance flexibility: high autonomy, global reach, and meaningful variety in your work
* Directly contribute to making AI safer and more accurate on topics that affect public health worldwide
* Strong potential for ongoing contract renewals as new projects launch

title: Ecommerce Manager
description:
**Job Title: E\-Commerce \& Marketplace Growth Manager** 




  





 We are looking for a highly driven and commercially minded
 **E\-Commerce \& Marketplace Growth Manager** 
 to take ownership of our online sales channels and drive growth across marketplaces, our website, and other digital commerce platforms.
 



  





 This is not a purely operational role. We are looking for someone who can think like a business owner—someone who can identify opportunities, improve sales, optimise profitability, study competitors, develop new product ideas, and build new revenue channels.
 



  





 The ideal candidate will manage and grow our presence across platforms such as
 **Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, our own website, and other relevant marketplaces and aggregator portals** 
 .
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Marketplace Management \& Growth** 



* Manage and grow sales across Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra and other relevant e\-commerce and aggregator platforms.
* Create, optimise and manage product listings, including titles, descriptions, keywords, images and product information.
* Monitor product performance and identify opportunities to improve sales and visibility.
* Plan and execute pricing, discounts, offers, bundles and promotional campaigns.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure inventory availability and minimise stock\-outs.
* Monitor product ratings, reviews, returns and customer feedback.
* Identify underperforming SKUs and develop strategies to improve or discontinue them.
* Identify high\-performing products and opportunities to scale them.



  





**2\. Website Sales \& Digital Commerce Growth** 



* Drive sales and growth through the company website.
* Identify opportunities to improve website conversion rates and customer experience.
* Create product bundles, combo offers, trial packs, family packs, premium packs and other initiatives to increase average order value.
* Develop cross\-selling and upselling opportunities across the product portfolio.
* Work with internal and external teams to improve product pages, offers and customer journeys.
* Develop strategies to increase repeat purchases and customer retention.



  





**3\. Customer Feedback, Testimonials \& Retention** 



* Develop and manage a structured process for collecting customer feedback.
* Conduct customer calls to understand product experience and satisfaction.
* Identify satisfied customers and collect written and video testimonials.
* Build a strong repository of customer reviews, testimonials and user\-generated content for use across digital platforms.
* Follow up with customers to encourage repeat purchases and referrals.
* Analyse customer complaints and feedback to identify opportunities for product and service improvement.

* Continuously monitor competitors, their products, pricing, offers and promotions.
* Conduct regular market research to identify trending products and emerging opportunities.
* Identify products that competitors are selling successfully and evaluate whether they can be developed, manufactured or sourced in\-house.
* Work with internal teams to identify opportunities for competitive pricing while maintaining healthy margins.

**5\. New Product \& Revenue Opportunities** 



* Identify new product categories and opportunities that can generate additional revenue.
* Research products currently performing well in the market and assess their commercial potential.
* Identify opportunities to manufacture, source or develop products at competitive pricing.
* Work with internal teams to develop new SKUs, variants, sizes, bundles and product extensions.
* Explore high\-margin complementary products and add\-on opportunities.
* Present commercially viable new product and revenue ideas to management on a regular basis.

* Develop strategies to increase direct\-to\-consumer sales and reduce dependency on any single marketplace.

* Track daily, weekly and monthly sales performance across all channels.
* Monitor profitability at a product and channel level.
* Analyse the impact of discounts, commissions, returns and promotional campaigns on margins.
* Identify opportunities to reduce costs and improve profitability.
* Prepare regular MIS and growth reports for management.
* Take ownership of assigned revenue and growth targets.
