* Proven experience in managing e\-commerce marketplaces such as Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra or similar platforms.
* Strong understanding of online product listings, pricing, promotions and marketplace operations.
* Commercial mindset with the ability to identify new sales and revenue opportunities.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to understand product profitability, margins and pricing.
* Experience with website sales and D2C e\-commerce will be an advantage.
* Comfortable speaking with customers and conducting feedback or testimonial calls.
* Ability to conduct competitor and market research.
* Highly proactive, organised and result\-oriented.
* Strong communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of business outcomes.



  





**Preferred Profile** 




 We would prefer someone who:
 


* Has hands\-on experience managing multiple e\-commerce platforms.
* Understands both
 **sales growth and profitability** 
 .
* Can independently identify problems and propose solutions.
* Is comfortable working in a fast\-paced and entrepreneurial environment.
* Has a strong interest in consumer products, digital commerce and new product development.
* Thinks beyond day\-to\-day operations and actively looks for new business opportunities.

title: Professional Services Solution Consultant
description:
**WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands.**
**We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.**
**We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.**
**Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow.**
**For more information, visit WPP.com.**
Role summary:
  
  
The Solution Consultant is a trusted advisor and hands-on solution partner within Professional Services. The role combines solution consulting, business and product analysis, technical understanding, stakeholder management, project management, and disciplined delivery thinking.
  
  
Working across agency and client teams, Product, Engineering, Growth, Enablement, Training, Support and delivery colleagues, the consultant discovers needs, shapes requirements, designs and demonstrates solutions, supports scoping and implementation, and feeds learning back into reusable patterns and product improvements.
  
  
Success means clients and WPP teams understand what is possible, requirements are clear before delivery starts, proven capabilities are configured appropriately, hand-offs are clean, and repeatable solutions can be deployed with less friction and faster time to value.
  
  
Key responsibilities:
  
  
Discovery & requirements:
  
  

* Lead structured discovery with agency, client and internal stakeholders to understand objectives, users, workflows, data, constraints and expected outcomes.
* Analyse current-state processes, usage and needs, separating problems to solve from requested features.
* Translate needs into clear requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, solution specifications and, where required, scope inputs for statements of work.
* Identify dependencies, assumptions, risks and gaps early, and ensure the right Product, Engineering, Enterprise Solutions or Professional Services owners are engaged.

Solution design & consulting:
  
  

* Map business needs to proven, ready-to-deploy WPP Open capabilities and recommend an appropriate foundation or configured solution.
* Design and present solution options that explain the value, trade-offs, dependencies and delivery implications in language suited to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Create and deliver demonstrations that show how selected WPP Open capabilities address the defined use case.
* Support business-case and value-realisation thinking by linking the proposed solution to measurable client or operational outcomes.

Technical & platform expertise:
  
  

* Build and maintain strong knowledge of WPP Open architecture, capabilities, agents, configuration options, data and integration touchpoints.
* Stay current on platform releases, capabilities and deployment guidance, and distinguish proven, scalable capabilities from functionality still in development or testing.

Delivery partnership & quality:
  
  

* Partner with Project Managers, Product Analysts, Deployment Specialists, Configuration Admins and implementation teams from scope through go-live and handover.
* Ensure solution intent, requirements and acceptance criteria remain traceable through configuration, testing and delivery.
* Support UAT, solution validation and issue resolution, escalating material scope, quality or dependency risks through the appropriate delivery route.
* Contribute to clear handovers into Enablement, Training or Support where those teams own the next stage of adoption.

Project management & delivery coordination:
  
  

* Develop and maintain clear delivery plans that define milestones, dependencies, ownership, decision points and critical path activities for assigned engagements.
* Coordinate day-to-day project activity across stakeholders, ensuring actions are tracked, blockers are surfaced early and progress remains visible to the right delivery and leadership audiences.
* Maintain disciplined RAID management, including proactive identification of risks, assumptions, issues and dependencies, with clear mitigation plans and escalation routes.
* Support governance routines such as status reporting, checkpoint reviews, decision logs and delivery readiness assessments, ensuring stakeholders have confidence in progress and next steps.
* Balance speed, scope and quality by making delivery trade-offs explicit, aligning expectations early and ensuring changes are assessed for impact before commitments are made.
* Drive clean closure by confirming acceptance criteria, documenting outcomes, capturing lessons learned and ensuring handover routes are agreed before the engagement is considered complete.

Scale, product feedback & continuous improvement:
  
  

* Convert lessons from engagements into reusable solution patterns, templates, playbooks and configuration standards.
* Provide structured feedback to Product and Engineering on recurring client needs, friction, feature gaps and opportunities for improvement.
* Help standardise intake and scoping so requests arrive with the information needed to route and estimate work accurately.
* Use delivery and usage evidence to identify opportunities to improve solution quality, reduce avoidable effort and accelerate time to value.

Stakeholder relationships:
  
  

* Act as a credible, pragmatic bridge between business, product and technology stakeholders.
* Build trust through transparent recommendations, clear documentation, realistic commitments and proactive communication.
* Work collaboratively across WPP, maintaining client-team ownership of client relationships while providing the expertise needed to make good solution decisions.

Skills & experience:
  
  

* 5+ years of experience in solutions consulting, business analysis, product analysis, implementation consulting or a comparable role, ideally within marketing technology or professional services.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capability, with experience turning ambiguous business needs into structured, actionable requirements and solution options.
* Excellent written, verbal, presentation and facilitation skills, including the ability to translate between technical and non-technical audiences.
* Experience working across product, engineering, delivery and commercial stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.
* Working knowledge of Agile delivery and backlog practices, including user stories, acceptance criteria and prioritisation.
* Ability to manage and coordinate the intake of features and change requests, clarifying need, priority, impact and ownership so requests can be translated into actionable outcomes.
* Understanding of digital marketing technology and related cloud, data, integration and workflow concepts.
* Experience with platform implementation, configuration, adoption or service design is advantageous.
* Experience with WPP Open, agent deployment, API integration, data modelling, Jira/Confluence or process-mapping tools
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, make sound trade-offs and maintain high-quality documentation and stakeholder communication.

Working principles:
  
  

* Client value first: recommend capability because it improves an outcome, not simply because it exists.
* Deliver what is available: favour proven, ready-to-deploy capabilities and be explicit about anything that is not yet scaled.
* Enable the enablers: design solutions and handovers so administrators, champions and enablement teams can sustain adoption.
* Client teams stay in control: provide expertise behind the scenes while respecting ownership of client conversations and ongoing relationships.

The person:
  
  
You are curious, structured and commercially aware, with enough technical depth to be credible with engineers and enough empathy and communication skill to make complexity understandable. You are comfortable challenging unclear requirements, bringing the right people together and turning a good bespoke answer into a better repeatable pattern. Above all, you focus on outcomes: dependable delivery that builds trust, scalable ways of working and faster realisation of value from WPP Open.
  
  
**Who you are:**
**You're open
*:***
we are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.
  
  
**You're optimistic
*:***
we approach all that we do with confidence: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.
  
  
**You're extraordinary:**
We are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day.
  
  
**What we'll give you:**
**Passionate, inspired people**
– we champion a culture of people that do extraordinary work
  
  
**Scale and opportunity**
– we offer the opportunity to create, influence and deliver projects at a scale that is unparalleled in the industry.
  
  
**Challenging and stimulating work**
– unique work and the opportunity to join a group of creative problem solvers.
  
  
**We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.**
**WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.**
**Please read our Privacy Notice (https://www.wpp.com/en/careers/wpp-privacy-policy-for-recruitment) for more information on how we process the information you provide.**

title: Business Performance Analyst
description:
**Business Performance Analyst (AI Training)**
**About The Role**
What if your business expertise and leadership skills could directly shape how AI understands commerce, finance, strategy, and operations? We're looking for experienced Business Performance Analysts to lead and mentor a team of analysts creating high-quality, business-focused content that trains the next generation of AI models.
  
  
This is a fully remote, flexible contract role ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of people management, analytical rigour, and subject matter expertise. No prior AI experience required — your business background is what matters.
  
  

* Organization: Alignerr
* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Remote
* Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

**What You'll Do**

* Lead and mentor a team of Business Analysts and Content Specialists producing business-domain content for AI training
* Allocate tasks, manage workflows, and ensure timely delivery of high-quality outputs
* Conduct quality assurance reviews and continuously refine team processes for greater efficiency
* Provide constructive performance feedback, hands-on coaching, and ongoing team development
* Serve as the primary point of contact for project stakeholders, delivering regular progress updates
* Guide the creation of case studies, business scenarios, and structured analytical content across domains including finance, policy, e-commerce, and operations

**Who You Are**

* Experienced team leader with a strong track record of managing and developing analysts or specialists
* Deep practitioner in business analysis, consulting, or a related domain — you know your subject inside out
* Sharp analytical thinker who can evaluate the quality, logic, and accuracy of business content
* Clear, confident communicator who can translate complex ideas into structured, actionable feedback
* Self-directed and organised — you manage priorities well and deliver without hand-holding
* Creative and lateral thinker who can approach business problems from multiple angles
* No prior AI or tech experience required

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, Economics, Statistics, or a related field — or equivalent professional experience
* 2+ years of direct team management experience
* 3–6 years of experience in business analysis, management consulting, content strategy, or domain-focused project work
* Strong research, analytical, and critical evaluation skills
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills

**Nice to Have**

* Master's degree or MBA in a relevant business or quantitative discipline
* Experience with data annotation, content evaluation, or quality assurance systems
* Background in case study writing, academic content, or structured business research
* Familiarity with AI tools or large language model workflows as an end user

**Why Join Us**

* Work on cutting-edge AI projects alongside leading research labs
* Fully remote and flexible — work when and where it suits you
* Freelance autonomy with the structure of meaningful, leadership-level work
* Gain rare, hands-on exposure to how advanced AI models are trained and evaluated
* Contribute to work that shapes how AI reasons about business, finance, and strategy at scale
* Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch

title: Civil Engineer Consultant
description:
**ERM**
is the world’s largest specialist sustainability consultancy, with over 50 years of experience helping organisations navigate complex environmental, social, and governance challenges. We bring together a global community of experts to deliver meaningful impact for our clients and the planet.
  
  
Our
**Consulting Delivery Hub**
(CDH) in India is a critical part of ERM’s global consulting model enabling scalable, high-quality delivery across regions and service lines. CDH teams work in close partnership with regional consultants to support global client projects, providing specialist expertise, driving consistency, and enhancing delivery efficiency across our most important programmes.
  
  
As part of the Consulting Delivery Hub, you will collaborate with colleagues worldwide, contribute to complex sustainability projects, and play a key role in shaping the future of global consulting delivery.
  
  
**Why this role matters?**
As an Consultant, Engineering, you will support ERM’s global consulting delivery by developing engineering designs for civil remediation projects. You will work within the engineering team and partner with regional project teams to produce practical, safe, and technically sound project deliverables. This role helps strengthen delivery quality, consistency, and scalability across ERM’s remediation portfolio.
  
  
**What your impact is?**

* Deliver accurate engineering calculations, drawings, specifications, cost estimates, and technical reports that support civil remediation projects.
* Provide responsive construction-phase and field support that helps projects meet safety, quality, schedule, budget, and scope expectations.
* Support effective operation and troubleshooting of groundwater remediation, soil vapor extraction, sub-slab depressurization, and other remediation systems.
* Collaborate effectively with global project teams and external stakeholders while managing multiple concurrent assignments.

**What you’ll bring:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Civil, Environmental, or Geotechnical Engineering with a minimum 3.0 GPA.
* 2 - 4 years of relevant engineering, environmental consulting, design, and construction experience.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.
* Experience using AutoCAD to prepare or support engineering design deliverables.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, organization, and analytical skills, with the ability to record detailed technical data and contribute to technical reports.
* Ability to manage multiple assignments concurrently, maintain flexibility, and deliver work within established quality, budget, schedule, and scope expectations.
* Ability to work independently with appropriate guidance and contribute effectively as part of a multidisciplinary team.
* Detail-oriented approach, mechanical aptitude, and hands-on troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.

**Preferred:**

* Engineer-in-Training certification.
* Environmental fieldwork experience.
* Experience with AutoCAD Civil 3D and ArcGIS.
* Experience recording technical field data and preparing technical reports.
* Exposure to global delivery, shared-service, or cross-regional project environments.

**Key responsibilities:**

* Assist with engineering design for civil remediation projects by evaluating data, performing calculations, conducting research, estimating quantities and costs, preparing design drawings, and developing technical specifications, contract documents, and design reports.
* Support the construction phase of remediation projects through quality control and quality assurance review, and off-site technical support.
* Conduct periodic remote monitoring, operation, maintenance, and troubleshooting for groundwater remediation, soil vapor extraction, sub-slab depressurization, and other remediation systems.
* Compile, validate, and evaluate technical data and assist with preparation of reports, memoranda, calculations, tables, figures, and other project deliverables.
* Prepare environmental compliance plans, permits, and reports addressing air quality, hazardous waste, spill prevention, stormwater, erosion and sediment control, groundwater, and wastewater.
* Communicate professionally with project team members, subcontractors, regulatory representatives, tenants, and clients during design, construction, and field activities.
* Assist project teams in maintaining compliance with applicable federal, state, and local environmental regulations and project-specific requirements.
* Complete assigned work in accordance with ERM quality procedures and project-specific expectations for scope, budget, and schedule.

description:

**The opportunity**
: Senior Consultant-AMI-Business Consulting Risk-CNS - Risk - Process & Controls - New Delhi
  
  
**AMI :**
The Advanced Manufacturing, Mobility & Infrastructure (AMI) Industry Market contains the following industries: Aerospace and Defence, Chemicals, Infrastructure, Industrial Products, Automotive, and Transportation that includes Mobility-as-a-Service. We help our clients to address the rapidly changing needs of our business world on not only how goods and services are bought and sold, but also on how they are designed and created. AMI builds and shares resources across sectors facing common challenges and aims to drive more effective cross-sector collaboration while enabling greater resource-pooling and developing more cohesive market responses. AMI also presents an opportunity to connect regional sector communities with a more robust, global priority sector infrastructure.
  
  
**CNS - Risk - Process & Controls :**
EY Consulting is building a better working world by transforming businesses through the power of people, technology and innovation. Our client-centric approach focuses on driving long-term value for our clients by solving their most strategic problems. EY Consulting is made up of three sub-service lines: Business Consulting (including Performance Improvement and Risk Consulting), Technology Consulting and People Advisory Services.
  
  
We help our clients in identifying and managing the interplay between upside and downside risk in order to make the long-term decisions to prevent risk and impact on their organization's ability to meet its future business strategy and objectives. The 3 key fields of play are :
  
  
Enterprise Risk - helps clients identify and address key risk areas, while building the agility to respond quickly. The areas of focus include Enterprise risk and resilience, Internal audit, Compliance and Internal controls
  
  
Technology Risk - helps clients to achieve sustainable growth by supporting their efforts to protect their business performance and by providing trusted communications on internal control and regulatory compliance to investors, management, regulators, customers and other stakeholders. EY teams accomplish this by assessing the technology risks that are introduced to businesses.
  
  
Financial Services Risk - helps clients in the financial sector to identify, manage and monitor the risks in their business. It is done through a transformative and agile approach including process and procedures, risk, data modeling and analytics, reporting to stakeholders and third parties, business requirements (for software selection and IT implementation), analysis of assets and liabilities, and capital and liquidity management.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Excellence**

* Lead and execute internal audit, risk advisory, and process review engagements across business functions to evaluate the effectiveness of governance, risk management, and internal control frameworks. Perform risk assessments, develop audit plans and testing strategies, identify control gaps, and provide practical recommendations to improve operational efficiency and regulatory compliance. Conduct walkthroughs, interviews, data analysis, and control testing to evaluate key business processes, including procurement, sales, inventory management, finance, and information technology controls. Prepare high-quality audit workpapers, observations, reports, and executive presentations, clearly communicating risks, root causes, business impacts, and actionable recommendations. Manage client relationships and coordinate with process owners, senior management, and cross-functional teams to discuss findings, track remediation plans, and drive timely closure of audit issues. Mentor and supervise junior team members, review their work, support business development initiatives, and contribute to the enhancement of audit methodologies, tools, and industry best practices.

**Skills And Attributes**
**To qualify for the role you must have**
**Qualification**

* Chartered Accountant

**Experience**

* Internal Audit

**What We Look For**
People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.
  
  
**What We Offer**
Fuelled by the brilliance of our people, EY has emerged as the strongest brand and the most attractive employer in our field, with market-leading growth over competitors. Our people work side-by-side with market-leading entrepreneurs, game-changers, disruptors, and visionaries. As an organization, we are investing more time, technology, and money than ever before in skills and learning for our people. At EY, you will have a personalized Career Journey and also the chance to tap into the resources of our career frameworks to better know about your roles, skills, and opportunities.
  
  
EY is equally committed to being an inclusive employer, and we strive to achieve the right balance for our people—enabling us to deliver excellent client service while allowing our people to build their careers as well as focus on their wellbeing.

title: Program Operations (Senior Associate)
description:
If you like being the person students turn to, and the person who makes sure their program actually works, read on. You’ll own the student experience for Kraftshala’s live programs: answering questions, fixing problems, keeping trainers and mentors in sync, and getting every learner to the finish line.

Delhi, on-site | 0 to 3 years | ₹6 to ₹8 LPA

You’d fit well if you’ve worked in EdTech ops, student success, customer success, or any role with lots of people and lots of deadlines.

**The short version**

**Who we’re looking for:**
Someone who thrives in fast-paced environments, enjoys solving operational problems, communicates clearly under pressure, and genuinely cares about creating exceptional student experiences. If you naturally take ownership, bring structure to chaos, and enjoy making systems work better every day, you’ll fit right in here.

**What this role is about:**
You’ll manage learning programs end-to-end - ensuring students stay on track, stakeholders stay aligned, and execution happens smoothly across multiple moving parts. The role combines program management, operations, stakeholder coordination, student support, and process improvement.

**Why you should apply:**
This is a strong fit for someone with 0-3 years of experience who wants rapid ownership, steep learning, and exposure to real operational complexity early in their career. You’ll work in a fast-moving, high-trust environment where strong execution, responsiveness, initiative, and problem-solving are deeply valued.

**About us:**
Kraftshala is India’s largest skilling institution in terms of marketing placements, with a 94% placement rate, and we are gunning to become the world’s largest career launchpad, across domains.

We’re backed by a number of eminent investors including ex-unicorn startup founders and CXOs of global giants like RedBus, NoBroker, Nestlé, and Performics.

**The detailed version**

As a Program Operations (Senior Associate) at Kraftshala, you’ll coordinate live sessions, manage stakeholders, improve processes, and ensure our programs run smoothly at scale. You will own operational execution across multiple moving parts. This role requires someone who can combine strong operational thinking with empathy, responsiveness, attention to detail, and excellent execution discipline.

Specific responsibilities will include:

**Program Management & Student Operations**

* Taking charge of the entire learning journey for assigned student cohorts and ensuring smooth end-to-end program delivery.
  *Metric to Measure: % of students achieving key learning milestones; cohort completion metrics*
* Being the first point of contact for students, solving queries promptly, empathetically, and with strong ownership.
  *Metric to Measure: Average response/resolution time; student satisfaction scores*
* Coordinating and executing live sessions, schedules, assessments, and operational workflows seamlessly across batches.
  *Metric to Measure: % of sessions conducted without operational issues or reschedules*
* Managing student escalations effectively and ensuring timely closure while maintaining a strong student experience.
  *Metric to Measure: Escalation turnaround time; escalation satisfaction scores*
* Tracking student engagement, participation, and progress using internal systems and operational dashboards.
  *Metric to Measure: % of students receiving timely nudges/support; engagement metrics*

**Stakeholder Management & Cross-functional Coordination**

* Liaising with trainers, mentors, evaluators, operations teams, and internal stakeholders to ensure aligned execution.
  *Metric to Measure: Timeliness and quality of stakeholder coordination; stakeholder feedback*
* Managing communication across multiple stakeholders while ensuring clarity, responsiveness, and follow-through.
  *Metric to Measure: Task completion timelines; communication effectiveness*

**Process Improvement & Operational Excellence**

* Identifying inefficiencies in workflows and proactively improving operational systems and processes.
  *Metric to Measure: Number of process improvements implemented; measurable impact on delivery quality*
* Leveraging tools and automation platforms (Notion, Google Sheets, Zapier, etc.) to streamline workflows and reduce manual effort.
  *Metric to Measure: Reduction in manual interventions; automation coverage across workflows*

**Monthly Outcomes**

**Month 1:**
Learn the ropes - understand our program delivery workflows, student journey, systems, tools, communication practices, and operational processes while shadowing ongoing cohorts.

**Month 2-3:**
Take ownership of one or more student cohorts end-to-end, independently manage student communication and operational workflows, and identify at least one meaningful process improvement opportunity.

**Month 4:**
Own multiple cohorts independently, handle stakeholder coordination smoothly, drive operational execution with minimal supervision, and consistently hit key program delivery metrics.

**Top Grading**

* **Ownership & Accountability:**
  An A-Player takes complete ownership of outcomes, follows through consistently, and proactively solves problems before they escalate, whereas a B-Player requires reminders and reacts only after issues surface.
* **Operational Excellence:**
  An A-Player brings structure to complexity, manages multiple moving parts effectively, and executes reliably under pressure, whereas a B-Player struggles with prioritization and consistency.
* **Student Obsession:**
  An A-Player genuinely cares about student experience and looks for ways to improve it proactively, whereas a B-Player focuses only on task completion.
* **Process Thinking:**
  An A-Player continuously improves systems and workflows to make operations more scalable and efficient, whereas a B-Player sticks to existing processes without questioning or optimizing them.
* **Attention to Detail:**
  An A-Player catches small issues early and maintains high execution accuracy, whereas a B-Player misses details that create operational friction or delays.
* **Communication & Coordination:**
  An A-Player communicates clearly, promptly, and with context across stakeholders, whereas a B-Player’s communication is inconsistent, delayed, or incomplete.
* **Learning Agility:**
  An A-Player adapts quickly, absorbs feedback well, and improves continuously, whereas a B-Player struggles with change or repeated feedback.

**Must Haves**

* 0-3 years of experience in operations, program management, customer success, student operations, stakeholder management, or coordination-heavy roles
  *(We are not too fussed about the number of years. Experience is simply a proxy for capability, which is what we really care for)*
* Strong execution discipline and the ability to manage work independently in fast-paced environments
* Experience handling multiple stakeholders, timelines, and operational workflows simultaneously
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Comfort with ambiguity, problem-solving, and operational firefighting when needed

title: Professional Services Solution Consultant
description:
**WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands.**
**We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.**
**We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.**
**Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow.**
**For more information, visit WPP.com.**
Role summary:
  
  
The Solution Consultant is a trusted advisor and hands-on solution partner within Professional Services. The role combines solution consulting, business and product analysis, technical understanding, stakeholder management, project management, and disciplined delivery thinking.
  
  
Working across agency and client teams, Product, Engineering, Growth, Enablement, Training, Support and delivery colleagues, the consultant discovers needs, shapes requirements, designs and demonstrates solutions, supports scoping and implementation, and feeds learning back into reusable patterns and product improvements.
  
  
Success means clients and WPP teams understand what is possible, requirements are clear before delivery starts, proven capabilities are configured appropriately, hand-offs are clean, and repeatable solutions can be deployed with less friction and faster time to value.
  
  
Key responsibilities:
  
  
Discovery & requirements:
  
  

* Lead structured discovery with agency, client and internal stakeholders to understand objectives, users, workflows, data, constraints and expected outcomes.
* Analyse current-state processes, usage and needs, separating problems to solve from requested features.
* Translate needs into clear requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, solution specifications and, where required, scope inputs for statements of work.
* Identify dependencies, assumptions, risks and gaps early, and ensure the right Product, Engineering, Enterprise Solutions or Professional Services owners are engaged.

Solution design & consulting:
  
  

* Map business needs to proven, ready-to-deploy WPP Open capabilities and recommend an appropriate foundation or configured solution.
* Design and present solution options that explain the value, trade-offs, dependencies and delivery implications in language suited to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Create and deliver demonstrations that show how selected WPP Open capabilities address the defined use case.
* Support business-case and value-realisation thinking by linking the proposed solution to measurable client or operational outcomes.

Technical & platform expertise:
  
  

* Build and maintain strong knowledge of WPP Open architecture, capabilities, agents, configuration options, data and integration touchpoints.
* Stay current on platform releases, capabilities and deployment guidance, and distinguish proven, scalable capabilities from functionality still in development or testing.

Delivery partnership & quality:
  
  

* Partner with Project Managers, Product Analysts, Deployment Specialists, Configuration Admins and implementation teams from scope through go-live and handover.
* Ensure solution intent, requirements and acceptance criteria remain traceable through configuration, testing and delivery.
* Support UAT, solution validation and issue resolution, escalating material scope, quality or dependency risks through the appropriate delivery route.
* Contribute to clear handovers into Enablement, Training or Support where those teams own the next stage of adoption.

Project management & delivery coordination:
  
  

* Develop and maintain clear delivery plans that define milestones, dependencies, ownership, decision points and critical path activities for assigned engagements.
* Coordinate day-to-day project activity across stakeholders, ensuring actions are tracked, blockers are surfaced early and progress remains visible to the right delivery and leadership audiences.
* Maintain disciplined RAID management, including proactive identification of risks, assumptions, issues and dependencies, with clear mitigation plans and escalation routes.
* Support governance routines such as status reporting, checkpoint reviews, decision logs and delivery readiness assessments, ensuring stakeholders have confidence in progress and next steps.
* Balance speed, scope and quality by making delivery trade-offs explicit, aligning expectations early and ensuring changes are assessed for impact before commitments are made.
* Drive clean closure by confirming acceptance criteria, documenting outcomes, capturing lessons learned and ensuring handover routes are agreed before the engagement is considered complete.

Scale, product feedback & continuous improvement:
  
  

* Convert lessons from engagements into reusable solution patterns, templates, playbooks and configuration standards.
* Provide structured feedback to Product and Engineering on recurring client needs, friction, feature gaps and opportunities for improvement.
* Help standardise intake and scoping so requests arrive with the information needed to route and estimate work accurately.
* Use delivery and usage evidence to identify opportunities to improve solution quality, reduce avoidable effort and accelerate time to value.

Stakeholder relationships:
  
  

* Act as a credible, pragmatic bridge between business, product and technology stakeholders.
* Build trust through transparent recommendations, clear documentation, realistic commitments and proactive communication.
* Work collaboratively across WPP, maintaining client-team ownership of client relationships while providing the expertise needed to make good solution decisions.

Skills & experience:
  
  

* 5+ years of experience in solutions consulting, business analysis, product analysis, implementation consulting or a comparable role, ideally within marketing technology or professional services.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capability, with experience turning ambiguous business needs into structured, actionable requirements and solution options.
* Excellent written, verbal, presentation and facilitation skills, including the ability to translate between technical and non-technical audiences.
* Experience working across product, engineering, delivery and commercial stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.
* Working knowledge of Agile delivery and backlog practices, including user stories, acceptance criteria and prioritisation.
* Ability to manage and coordinate the intake of features and change requests, clarifying need, priority, impact and ownership so requests can be translated into actionable outcomes.
* Understanding of digital marketing technology and related cloud, data, integration and workflow concepts.
* Experience with platform implementation, configuration, adoption or service design is advantageous.
* Experience with WPP Open, agent deployment, API integration, data modelling, Jira/Confluence or process-mapping tools
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, make sound trade-offs and maintain high-quality documentation and stakeholder communication.

Working principles:
  
  

* Client value first: recommend capability because it improves an outcome, not simply because it exists.
* Deliver what is available: favour proven, ready-to-deploy capabilities and be explicit about anything that is not yet scaled.
* Enable the enablers: design solutions and handovers so administrators, champions and enablement teams can sustain adoption.
* Client teams stay in control: provide expertise behind the scenes while respecting ownership of client conversations and ongoing relationships.

The person:
  
  
You are curious, structured and commercially aware, with enough technical depth to be credible with engineers and enough empathy and communication skill to make complexity understandable. You are comfortable challenging unclear requirements, bringing the right people together and turning a good bespoke answer into a better repeatable pattern. Above all, you focus on outcomes: dependable delivery that builds trust, scalable ways of working and faster realisation of value from WPP Open.
  
  
**Who you are:**
**You're open
*:***
we are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.
  
  
**You're optimistic
*:***
we approach all that we do with confidence: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.
  
  
**You're extraordinary:**
We are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day.
  
  
**What we'll give you:**
**Passionate, inspired people**
– we champion a culture of people that do extraordinary work
  
  
**Scale and opportunity**
– we offer the opportunity to create, influence and deliver projects at a scale that is unparalleled in the industry.
  
  
**Challenging and stimulating work**
– unique work and the opportunity to join a group of creative problem solvers.
  
  
**We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.**
**WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.**
**Please read our Privacy Notice (https://www.wpp.com/en/careers/wpp-privacy-policy-for-recruitment) for more information on how we process the information you provide.**

title: Senior Associate - Content - Across TMT, Financials, Healthcare, Oil & Gas
description:
GLG Content and Events delivers market-moving insights by leveraging the perspectives of senior industry professionals across global markets. Through thousands of live and virtual conversations each year, GLG equips the world’s leading financial institutions with timely, differentiated intelligence required to make informed investment decisions.
  
  
The Content Growth Team (CGT) in Gurugram is a strategically important group responsible for expanding GLG’s Library of expert interview transcripts. These conversations provide institutional investors across Public Equity, Private Equity, Credit, and Venture, with deep, actionable perspectives on companies, sectors, supply chains, and macro/industry trends.
  
  
We are seeking a
**Senior Associate, Expert Content**
with strong capital markets intuition to research, curate, design, and conduct expert interviews that directly support investor decision-making. This role is ideal for individuals with experience in financial research or market analysis who enjoy breaking down complex industries and translating expert perspectives into investor-relevant insights.
  
  
The ideal candidate has sharp research instincts, an understanding of how investors evaluate sectors and companies, and an ability to guide expert conversations toward what matters for fundamentals, competitive dynamics, and forward-looking risk/reward.
  
  
**Specific Responsibilities Include (but Are Not Limited To)**

* Contribute to editorial development and theme selection for capital markets–relevant conversations.
* Identify, research, and analyze company, sector, and macro trends that influence investor positioning and market sentiment.
* Use strong editorial judgment to select high-value topics and experts who can speak credibly to business models, competitive landscapes, and industry inflection points.
* Apply a capital-markets lens to all interviews; prioritizing insights on fundamentals, earnings drivers, supply and demand dynamics, margin pressures, cost structures, regulatory changes, and competitive strategy.
* Independently structure and conduct 45–60 minute expert interviews, guiding the conversation toward high-value insights while asking thoughtful follow-up questions.
* Execute GLG’s investor-focused content strategy, ensuring all content meets GLG’s high editorial, quality, and compliance standards.
* Manage multiple content projects simultaneously with high workflow discipline, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and exceptional attention to detail.
* Demonstrate digital awareness and adaptability in using AI-driven tools to enhance research depth, accuracy, and insight generation
* Coordinate speaker honoraria and maintain strong professional relationships with senior experts.

**An Ideal Candidate Will Have The Following Attributes**

* 2–5 years of experience in equity research, credit research, financial journalism, consulting research, business research, or industry roles involving analysis of markets, companies, or business models.
* Strong understanding of capital markets, including how investors think about revenue drivers, margin trends, guidance, catalysts, competitive positioning, valuation factors, and risk frameworks.
* Demonstrated ability to quickly build knowledge across unfamiliar sectors and extract what is material for investor decision-making.
* Skilled at crafting and leading detailed, dynamic expert interviews with senior executives, operators, regulators, and specialists.
* Ability to work across the desired shift timings: 11:00 AM – 8:00 PM or 1:00 PM – 10:00 PM
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to synthesize complex themes clearly and professionally.
* Digitally aware, comfortable adopting AI-led productivity tools and new workflows.
* Exceptional project discipline and ability to manage a high volume of conversations and deadlines without compromising quality.
* A collaborative, positive, and proactive mindset, with a desire to contribute to a high-performing, insight-driven team.

**About GLG / Gerson Lehrman Group**
GLG is the world’s leading platform for trusted human expertise. We connect global decision-makers—from hedge fund managers and private equity partners to strategy leaders at Fortune 500s—with the specific, authoritative voices required to answer their most critical questions.
  
  
At GLG, you are an extension of our clients' core teams. You will work at the intersection of industries and global markets, navigating high-stakes challenges across the full spectrum of their strategic initiatives. Operating within the industry’s most trusted research environment, you’ll help our clients capture the nuanced perspectives that drive smarter, faster business outcomes.
  
  
We are a global team of pragmatic problem-solvers who mirror the intensity of the markets we serve. If you are driven by intellectual curiosity and a bias toward action, join us in reinventing the industry we invented.

title: IAM Sales Engineer
description:
**Experience: 5+ years**

**Location: Delhi-NCR/Mumbai**

**The Opportunity**

We are seeking a dynamic, technical, and customer-focused Sales Engineer to be a key driver of our growth in the Indian market. You will be the technical champion for OpenIAM’s solutions, partnering closely with our sales team & partners to understand complex customer requirements, architect compelling solutions, and demonstrate tangible business value. This role is critical in bridging the gap between technical capabilities and business outcomes for our prospects and customers.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Technical Pre-Sales**
  : Partner with Account Executives to lead the technical sales cycle from discovery and requirement analysis to proof-of-concept (POC), solution design, and technical closure.
* Solution Demonstration & Storytelling: Deliver compelling, customized demonstrations of the OpenIAM platform that address specific customer pain points, use cases, and security/compliance requirements (e.g., IGA, SSO, MFA, IGA, PIM/PAM)
* **Architecture & Scoping:**
  Develop technical proposals, architecture diagrams, and solution design documents. Accurately scope POC and implementation requirements.
* **Proof-of-Concept (POC) Execution:**
  Plan, manage, and execute successful POCs/Pilots onsite or remotely, effectively handling technical objections and proving OpenIAM's value.
* **RFPs and Tenders:**
  Should have an experience in answering the RFPs/Tenders, attending pre-bid meetings and play a consultant’s part while the customers are in the process of creating an RFP.
* **Trusted Technical Advisor:**
  Build credibility and trusted relationships with technical and security stakeholders (CISOs, IT Architects, Infrastructure Heads, DevOps teams) across mid-market and large enterprises.
* **Market & Competitive Intelligence:**
  Maintain deep knowledge of the IAM/IGA landscape, competitor solutions, and industry trends in the Indian market. Effectively articulate OpenIAM’s differentiation.
* **Collaboration:**
  Work closely with Product Management, Engineering, and Professional Services teams to relay customer feedback and ensure smooth handover post-sale.
* **Content & Enablement:**
  Contribute to the development of technical sales collateral, presentations, and best practice guides tailored for the regional audience.

**Qualifications & Experience**

**Required:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* 5+ years of experience in a pre-sales/sales engineering role, preferably within the cybersecurity, identity management, enterprise software, or cloud services domain.
* Strong understanding of Identity & Access Management concepts: IGA, SSO, MFA, LDAP, RBAC/ABAC, Directory Services, Provisioning, and Identity Federation (SAML, OIDC, OAuth).
* Solid technical foundation in: Linux/Unix, Windows Server, Networking, Databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle), Web/Application Servers, and Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Excellent presentation, whiteboarding, and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Proven ability to run successful POCs, handle technical objections, and create winning proposals.
* Self-motivated, proactive, and able to work autonomously in a fast-paced, remote/hybrid environment.
* Willingness and ability to travel within India (approximately 30-40%).

**Highly Desirable:**

* Direct experience with OpenIAM, or competitors
* Knowledge of IT security frameworks, compliance regulations, and audit processes relevant to India.
* Scripting/programming skills (Java, Python, PowerShell, Bash).
* Experience with DevOps, CI/CD, and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) in the context of IAM.
* Relevant certifications (CISSP, Security+, vendor-specific IAM certifications).

**What We Offer**

* Competitive salary and attractive performance-based variable compensation (commission/bonus).
* Opportunity to be a key player in a high-growth, global cybersecurity company.
* Work with cutting-edge technology in the critical IAM space.
* Flexible remote/hybrid work model.
* Comprehensive benefits package.
* Continuous learning and professional development opportunities.

**Role Overview**
Drive high-value B2B revenue acquisition, enterprise account expansion, and commercial contract closures for security guarding and manpower outsourcing services across corporate, industrial, commercial, residential, and institutional sectors. This senior individual-contributor or team-lead role focuses on winning large multi-site mandates, managing complex tender/RFP bids, negotiating statutory-compliant pricing structures, and partnering with operations and compliance teams for smooth deployment.

Key Responsibilities

* **Enterprise Client Acquisition & Strategic Hunting:**
  Source and close major B2B accounts across IT parks, manufacturing plants, warehouses, hospitals, logistics hubs, retail chains, and large residential townships. Leverage existing networks, executive referrals, and structured field outreach to build a high-value pipeline.
* **Site Audits & Commercial Costing:**
  Lead detailed site risk and manpower requirement assessments. Structure comprehensive commercial proposals and cost sheets covering minimum wages, statutory compliances (PF, ESIC, bonus, gratuity, LWF), uniform/gear costs, and agency margins while protecting gross profitability.
* **Tendering, RFPs & Contract Negotiation:**
  Manage end-to-end commercial bids, RFQs, and institutional/government tenders (including GeM where applicable). Negotiate pricing, payment terms, SLAs, and annual/multi-year service agreements with Admin Heads, Facility Heads, Procurement, and CSOs.
* **Deployment Handover & Key Account Retention:**

description:
We're hiring: Business Development (Architect & Designer Segment)
  
  
Executive / Sr. Executive /Territory Manager
  
  
Sketch Lighting | Bespoke, design-led lighting
  
Location: Delhi NCR | Office: Okhla Industrial Area, Phase 1
  
  
About us
  
Sketch Lighting develops bespoke lighting for architects, interior designers and design studios. Our projects are custom, so our business grows through trust and relationships, not cold calling or discounts.
  
  
About the role
  
You will be given a defined list of architect and interior design firms in Delhi NCR. Your job is to build real relationships with them and turn those relationships into lighting projects for us.
  
  
How the role works
  
1. Research each firm and approach it in a personalised way
  
2. Meet the team and build rapport
  
3. Earn the chance to deliver an Art of Light session, our lighting learning session for the firm's designers
  
4. After the session, stay connected with every participant and follow up for the next session
  
5. Ask about early-stage projects and help the firm shape its lighting design
  
6. Take each enquiry through to quotation and order, with our design team and lighting engineer supporting you on technical questions
  
7. When the relationship is ready, bring our founder in to meet the firm's principals
  
  
Your week
  
- Monday: in office, for planning, calls, LinkedIn outreach and tracker updates
  
- Tuesday to Saturday: meetings at architect and designer offices and project sites
  
- Every activity is logged in our Growth tracker, and you get a written weekly review with clear next steps
  
  
Earnings
  
Fixed salary plus performance incentive. The incentive is linked to the sessions you deliver and the orders you win. The first few months are about building relationships, so we are looking for people who will put in the daily effort that makes this work.
  
  
You must have
  
- Prior sales or business development experience with architects, interior designers or consultants, for a premium building material, furniture, décor, lighting or design-led product
  
- Based in Delhi NCR, comfortable travelling across it daily and working from our Okhla office on Mondays
  
- Ability to speak confidently to design teams and explain design value
  
- Discipline to follow up consistently and record your work honestly
  
  
This role is not for
  
- Telecalling or retail selling
  
- Candidates with no experience of selling to architects or interior designers
  
  
How to apply
  
Email your CV to hr@sketchlighting.com
  
Subject line: Application - Business Development - Your Name
  
  
In the email, please tell us in 3 to 4 lines:
  
1. Which premium product you have sold to architects or interior designers
  
2. Your total relevant experience in years
  
3. Your current location in Delhi NCR and your notice period
  
  
Only candidates meeting the must-have criteria will be contacted. Shortlisted candidates go through a phone conversation, a written and practical task, and a final interview.

We are looking for a passionate, driven and market-oriented sales professional to join
**Crax**
and drive business growth across the General Trade channel.

**Key Responsibilities:**

🔹 Achieve sales targets and drive primary & secondary sales across the assigned territory.

🔹 Strengthen distributor network and drive distribution expansion across retail, wholesale and rural markets.

🔹 Drive numeric distribution, outlet coverage, productivity and sales growth.

🔹 Manage distributors, super-stockists, sub-distributors and sales teams to ensure effective market execution.

🔹 Ensure product availability, stock management, visibility and merchandising at retail outlets.

🔹 Execute beat plans, promotional schemes, new product launches and sales initiatives.

🔹 Monitor market performance, competitor activities and sales productivity.

🔹 Drive sales team performance, coaching and effective utilization of sales automation tools.

**Candidate Profile:**

✔️ Minimum 3 years of experience in FMCG sales, preferably in the snacks/food industry.

✔️ Strong experience in General Trade, distributor management and territory sales.

✔️ Good understanding of retail distribution, market expansion and sales execution.

✔️ Post Graduate preferred.

✔️ Strong execution, communication, relationship management and result-orientation skills.

**About the organization:**

DFM Foods Limited is a listed company started in the year 1984, in the brand name Crax. Pioneer in the Indian snack foods market, DFM Foods introduced CRAX Corn Rings in 1984.Today, with sales across North, West and Central India, DFM Foods is a public company listed on the BSE Limited & National Stock Exchange of India Limited.

DFM Foods Ltd. is a lead player in the business of manufacturing packaged snacks. In fact, we pioneered the entry of packaged snacks in the Indian market with the introduction of CRAX Corn Rings, our flagship product that has been a household name since its launch in 1984.

Over the past 40 years, we have been spreading happiness in people’s lives through singular, high-quality snacks. Starting with CRAX Corn Rings, we have expanded our portfolio to more than 15 products, such as corn rings, corn puffs, wheat puffs, and crispy sticks, under the brand names CRAX, CURLS, NATKHAT, and FRITTS. In the “namkeen” segment, we offer a range of 12 distinct product variants that include Bhujiyas, Daals, Mixtures, and Nut-Mixes.

DFM Foods enjoys strong brand awareness with CRAX and NATKHAT among the most recognized names in the industry. As a result of our commitment to product innovation and diversification, focus on quality, bold strategies, and sound logistics for PAN India distribution, the company has been growing at a robust pace over the last 10 years.On 09 September 2019, Advent International, one of the largest and most experienced global private equity investors entered into a Share Purchase Agreement to acquire a majority interest in DFM Foods from the erstwhile promoters and other major shareholders.

title: Tele caller
description:
**Company Description**
Goolshan Logistics Private Limited operates GLwarehousez, a B2B marketplace connecting warehouse, godown, and industrial land owners with verified occupiers. Owners can list commercial spaces for free, while tenants benefit from a zero-brokerage model. The platform charges a success fee of 30% of one month’s rent only when a deal closes through its team, aligning incentives with successful transactions. GLwarehousez focuses on transparent, cost-effective space discovery, offering a streamlined experience for businesses seeking industrial and storage facilities.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Tele Caller role based in Delhi, India. * Reliable, self-motivated, and comfortable working in a target-driven environment with a collaborative team.

* Ability to work on-site in Gurgaon and travel locally for client meetings as required.

title: Account Executive (B2B SaaS – Supply Chain & Warehouse Intelligence)
description:
Job Title: Account Executive (B2B SaaS – Supply Chain & Warehouse Intelligence)
  
  
Openings: 2 Positions
  
  

* Role 1: ERP-led Manufacturers, FMCG & Food Brands
* Role 2: D2C & Quick Commerce Brands, Importers & Distributors

Compensation: ₹12 LPA Fixed + Uncapped Incentives @ 3% of collected/closed ACV (~₹1.62 Lakhs/quarter at target)
  
  
Employment Type: Full-Time
  
  
Reporting To: Sales Lead – Revenue & Partnerships
  
  
**About The Company**
A fast-growing B2B SaaS company building an AI-powered Warehouse Operations & Supply Chain Intelligence Platform. Built on top of modern WMS, TMS, and ERP integrations, the platform helps manufacturers, distributors, FMCG/food brands, and D2C/quick-commerce businesses move from manual warehouse execution to real-time inventory visibility, automated forecasting, and AI-driven replenishment.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are hiring 2 full-cycle Account Executives to own the end-to-end mid-market sales cycle—from discovery and product demos to commercial closure—across dedicated industry verticals. Working closely with an aligned SDR, you will drive mid-market closures (~₹6 Lakhs average ACV) with uncapped earning potential at 3% of closed/collected ACV.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Full-Cycle Sales Ownership: Run the complete sales process from initial discovery and tailored product demonstrations through proposal negotiation and contract closure.
* Pipeline & Activity Execution: Manage 40–50 active evaluations and conduct 40–50 new product demos per month across your assigned industry segment.
* Quota & Revenue Delivery: Consistently deliver 3–4 customer closures per month (8–10% demo-to-close conversion benchmark), contributing ~₹18 Lakhs/month in new booked ACV.
* SDR & GTM Collaboration: Partner daily with your dedicated SDR on outbound/inbound account qualification and SQL handoffs, while collaborating closely with Founders and GTM leadership.
* Forecasting & Operational Rigor: Maintain disciplined CRM hygiene, accurate pipeline tracking, and timely weekly reporting.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* Proven full-cycle B2B SaaS closing experience (mid-market ACV range ₹4L–₹12L+), ideally selling into Manufacturing, Supply Chain/Logistics, FMCG, Retail/D2C, or ERP-driven businesses.
* Strong consultative discovery skills—able to uncover warehouse bottlenecks, stockout/spoilage pain points, and ERP/WMS workflow gaps.
* Track record of running high-velocity demo pipelines and closing deals independently.
* High-ownership, builder mindset comfortable operating in a fast-paced, target-driven startup environment.

Compensation & Growth
  
  

* Fixed CTC: ₹12,00,000 per annum
* Variable / Incentives: Uncapped @ 3% of collected/closed ACV (~₹1.62 Lakhs/quarter at target run-rate)
* Support Structure: Dedicated SDR alignment + founder-led product & GTM support

title: Mobile Connectivity Support Specialist
description:
**Mobile Connectivity Support Specialist |**

Remote within India | India working hours

Can you guide someone through a mobile device that won’t get online, isolate the cause, and confirm they can get back to work?

UpStar is hiring a specialist to support consultants at a US-based Global Management Consulting firm. Your primary responsibility is troubleshooting mobile connectivity devices, including portable hotspots, by phone or video. Wi-Fi and router support is secondary. General desktop or service-desk experience alone does not meet the specialist requirement.

**What you’ll do**

* Guide nontechnical users through
  ***mobile device setup, activation and troubleshooting.***
  Isolate device, SIM/eSIM, carrier and signal issues from Wi-Fi, router, VPN or application problems.
* Support
  ***NETGEAR mobile connectivity devices.***
  Confirm that users are back online and can complete the task they were trying to do.
* Use
  ***ServiceNow***
  to triage incidents, document what you checked and route or escalate issues with a clear handoff. Update device records where authorized.
* Reproduce issues on sample devices where practical, coordinate vendor replacements and support rollouts into new markets.

**What you’ll bring**

* At least five years of relevant IT, network or connectivity support experience, including hands-on troubleshooting of mobile connectivity devices for users in a work setting.
* Hands-on Wi-Fi and router troubleshooting.
* Recent hands-on ServiceNow incident experience. Experience with another ticketing tool does not replace this requirement.
* Clear spoken communication with nontechnical users and availability during India working hours.
* Experience with NETGEAR Nighthawk or Peplink BR1 is a strong plus, not a requirement.

**How to apply**

Email your CV to career@upstars.ai with the subject
**Mobile Connectivity Support Specialist**
Include your city, notice period or earliest start date, phone or WhatsApp number with country code. The target start is January 2027.

***Briefly describe one workplace mobile-device connectivity issue you personally handled: the device or model, what broke, what you checked or changed, and what the user confirmed. In one more sentence, tell us when you last used ServiceNow and what ticket action you personally handled.***

title: Solutions Consultant - Data Security and DSPM
description:
**About DataSurity and SARC**

DataSurity is an AI-led platform that helps Indian organisations comply with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and the DPDP Rules, 2025. It covers the full compliance journey in one place.

* **Data Discovery and Classification.**
  Finds personal data in databases, file shares, cloud drives, mailboxes and laptops.
* **Data Mapping and RoPA.**
  Records what the organisation does with personal data, in which systems and with which third parties.
* **Consent and Cookie Management.**
  Notices and consent on websites, apps and forms, in 22 Indian languages, with proof.
* **Data Principal Rights.**
  A privacy portal where people raise requests, and a workflow that answers them on time.
* **Retention and Erasure.**
  Stops the use of data and deletes it in connected systems when the law requires it.
* **Gap Assessment, Third-Party Risk and Breach Response.**
  Tests the organisation against the Act, tracks vendors and manages personal data breaches.

DataSurity is built by SARC, a 40-year-old advisory firm with 100+ partners, 500+ professionals and offices in India, the UK, the UAE, Singapore and the USA. Clients get the platform together with SARC's privacy consultants, technology lawyers and security engineers. The platform is already in use at clients in financial services, healthcare, manufacturing and hospitality.

SARC Global is a multidisciplinary advisory firm with 40+ years of experience, 100+ partners, 500+ professionals, and a presence across India, UK, USA, Singapore, and UAE. We are building a dedicated cybersecurity practice from the ground up, backed by strategic technology partnerships and deep BFSI client relationships, to become India’s most trusted cyber risk advisory firm. Our operating model is built right from risk to resilience, starting from consulting and audits to solutioning and managed services.

**About the role**

You will be the technical face of DataSurity in front of clients. You will present the platform, run live demos and show CISOs, DPOs and CIOs how it solves their DPDP problems.

You will work closely with the CEO, the sales team, SARC's privacy consultants and the product team. The role suits someone who has sold data security products at a reputed OEM and now wants to shape a young product in a new market.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Demos and client meetings**

* Present DataSurity and run live demos for CISOs, DPOs, CIOs, and legal and compliance heads.
* Shape each demo around the client's industry, systems and DPDP gaps.
* Keep the demo environment, demo data and demo scripts ready at all times.

**Solution scoping**

* Run discovery calls to understand the client's systems, data stores and current privacy setup.
* Collect sizing details for the commercial proposal, such as number of systems, data volumes and number of customers.
* Recommend the right modules, the deployment option and the integrations the client will need.

**Proofs of concept**

* Plan and run proofs of concept and pilots. Connect the client's data sources, run scans and walk the client through the findings.
* Agree the success criteria with the client before the start, and close each proof of concept with a short report.

**Proposals and tenders**

* Write the technical part of proposals, RFP responses and tender compliance sheets, including those for banks and PSUs.
* Answer the security and architecture questions raised by the client's IT and information security teams.

**Partners and events**

* Train and support MSSP and consulting partners who take DataSurity to their own clients.
* Present DataSurity at industry events, roundtables and webinars.

**Product feedback and handover**

* Bring client questions, objections and competitor insights back to the product team.
* Hand over every won deal to the onboarding team with clear notes on scope and commitments.

**Experience and Skills**

* 8 to 12 years of total experience, with at least 5 years in presales or solution engineering for enterprise data security or cybersecurity products.
* Hands-on experience with Data Seurity Posture Management, data discovery and classification, or DLP products from a reputed OEM.
* Has personally run product demos and proofs of concept for large enterprises.
* Good understanding of where enterprise data sits: databases, file servers, cloud storage, mailboxes, SaaS applications and laptops.
* Experience with Indian BFSI or PSU clients, and comfort presenting to CISO and CIO level leaders.
* Experience writing technical responses to RFPs and tenders.
* Working knowledge of the DPDP Act and Rules or of GDPR, and the drive to go deep into DPDP quickly.
* Clear spoken and written communication in English and Hindi. Can explain a technical point simply to a legal or business audience.
* Willing to travel to client sites and events across India.

**Qualifications**

* Experience with privacy GRC platforms or DSPM platforms
* Certifications such as DCPP, CIPP/E, CIPM, CISSP or CISA.
* Familiarity with ISO 27001 and ISO 27701.
* Experience with PSU tenders, including GeM.
* Experience working with MSSPs, system integrators or channel partners.
* Regular use of AI tools in daily work.

The role involves a combination of research, presentation preparation, client communication, sales coordination and documentation. The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills, attention to detail and an interest in B2B sales, e-commerce and digital business solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Pre-Sales Research & Audit**

* Conduct preliminary audits and research on prospective clients' e-commerce businesses, marketplace presence and digital performance.
* Analyse client requirements and identify potential business opportunities.
* Gather relevant information, competitor insights and business data to support sales discussions.
* Assist in preparing pre-sales audit reports and recommendations.
* Coordinate with internal teams to collect relevant data, insights and service-related information.

**2. Sales Support & Presentation Development**

* Prepare sales decks, company presentations, proposals and client-specific pitch documents.
* Customise presentations based on client requirements and business objectives.
* Assist in developing service presentations for marketplace management, Amazon Advertising, digital marketing, e-commerce operations and Enlytical.ai.
* Organise relevant case studies, company credentials, service details and supporting documents.
* Ensure presentations and proposals are accurate, structured and professionally formatted.

**3. Client Pitching & Sales Coordination**

* Participate in client meetings and business presentations alongside the sales team.
* Assist in pitching NuvoRetail's services, technology solutions and business offerings to prospective B2B clients.
* Understand client requirements and help communicate relevant solutions.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders to address client queries and gather required information.
* Manage follow-ups, meeting schedules and communication with prospective clients.

**4. Sales Documentation & Client Onboarding**

* Assist in preparing client contracts, agreements, proposals, Statements of Work (SOWs) and other sales-related documentation.
* Coordinate with relevant internal stakeholders for contract review, approvals and execution.
* Maintain proper records of client documentation and agreements.
* Coordinate with internal teams to facilitate a smooth client onboarding process after deal closure.
* Ensure timely sharing of required information and documents between the sales team and execution teams.

**5. Sales Operations & Reporting**

* Maintain and update lead details, client information, sales activities and opportunity status in the CRM.
* Track client interactions, meeting schedules, follow-ups and sales pipeline updates.
* Maintain sales trackers, documentation and reports using Microsoft Excel.
* Coordinate with internal teams through Microsoft Teams for sales-related updates and requirements.
* Ensure accuracy and organisation of sales records and documentation.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Marketing, Commerce or a related field.
* 1–2 years of experience in pre-sales, sales support, business development, client coordination or a related role.
* Freshers with strong communication, analytical and presentation skills are welcome.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Good knowledge of Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel.
* Ability to create structured presentations, sales decks and business documents.
* Strong research, analytical and documentation skills.
* Attention to detail and ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
* Comfortable participating in client meetings and professional business discussions.
* Familiarity with CRM tools and Microsoft Teams.

**Tools & Platforms**

* **BEGIN CRM:**
  Lead management, client records and sales pipeline tracking.
* **Microsoft Excel:**
  Data management, tracking, reporting and analysis.
* **Microsoft PowerPoint:**
  Sales presentations, proposals and pitch decks.
* **Microsoft Teams:**
  Internal coordination, communication and meetings.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

* Candidates with exposure to B2B sales, pre-sales, SaaS, e-commerce, digital marketing or consulting environments will be preferred.
* Basic understanding of e-commerce marketplaces such as Amazon and Flipkart is an advantage.
* Experience in preparing business presentations, proposals or client-facing documents will be beneficial.
* Candidates with strong coordination, research and organisational abilities.
* Someone who is comfortable working with multiple internal stakeholders and interacting with external clients.

**What We Are Looking For**

An enthusiastic and organised individual who can support the sales team across pre-sales activities, client presentations, documentation and onboarding. The candidate should be comfortable working with data, preparing professional business presentations, communicating with clients and ensuring smooth coordination throughout the sales process.
