title: Business Consultant
description:
**Job Description**

**Business Consultant – SME Advisory & Business Transformation**

**Location:**
Gurugram/ Delhi NCR, India

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Work Mode:**
On-site / Hybrid

**Reporting To:**
Consulting Director / Founder

**About the Role**

**We are looking for an experienced Business Consultant**
to join our consulting team and work directly with our external clients across different industries.

The Business Consultant will be responsible for understanding clients' business challenges, conducting business assessments, identifying gaps and opportunities, developing strategic recommendations, and supporting clients with the implementation of business improvement initiatives.

The consultant will work with
**small and mid-sized businesses**
and provide advisory across key business functions, including
**Sales & Marketing, Human Resources, Operations, and Finance**
.

The ideal candidate should have strong commercial understanding, consulting experience, analytical skills, and the ability to interact confidently with business owners, founders, CEOs, and senior management.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Client Business Assessment & Advisory**

• Work directly with business owners, founders, CEOs, and senior management of client companies.

• Understand clients' business objectives, challenges, operational structure, and growth plans.

• Conduct business health checks, audits, and diagnostic assessments.

• Identify business gaps, inefficiencies, risks, and growth opportunities.

• Analyse business performance and provide practical, data-driven recommendations.

• Develop business improvement plans and strategic roadmaps for clients.

• Present findings and recommendations to clients in a clear and professional manner.

**2. Sales & Marketing Consulting**

• Review clients' sales and marketing strategies and processes.

• Analyse lead generation, conversion, sales pipelines, customer acquisition, and retention.

• Assess sales team structure, performance, targets, and KPIs.

• Review marketing activities, customer acquisition costs, and marketing ROI.

• Identify opportunities for revenue growth and improved sales performance.

• Recommend improvements to sales processes, customer journeys, pricing, positioning, and go-to-market strategies.

• Support clients in implementing sales and marketing improvements.

**3. HR & People Consulting**

• Assess clients' organisational structures and workforce requirements.

• Review recruitment, onboarding, performance management, employee engagement, and retention processes.

• Review HR policies, processes, systems, and compliance practices.

• Develop organisational structures, roles, responsibilities, and accountability frameworks.

• Develop KPI and performance management systems.

• Identify people-related gaps and recommend practical solutions.

• Advise business owners on team structure, productivity, employee performance, and organisational effectiveness.

**4. Operations Consulting**

• Conduct operational assessments for client businesses.

• Review workflows, processes, SOPs, systems, and team responsibilities.

• Identify bottlenecks, inefficiencies, duplication, and operational risks.

• Develop and improve SOPs and operational processes.

• Recommend automation, technology, and process optimisation opportunities.

• Establish operational KPIs and reporting systems.

• Support clients in implementing operational improvements.

• Monitor implementation and measure business impact.

**5. Financial & Commercial Consulting**

• Review clients' financial and commercial performance.

• Analyse revenue, costs, margins, profitability, and key financial indicators.

• Identify cost optimisation and efficiency opportunities.

• Review pricing and commercial models.

• Support clients with budgeting and business planning.

• Analyse profitability by product, service, client, or business unit.

• Work with clients' finance teams/accountants to identify financial and commercial improvement opportunities.

**6. Business Strategy & Growth Consulting**

• Develop growth strategies based on client objectives and market opportunities.

• Conduct SWOT and business performance assessments.

• Identify new revenue opportunities.

• Support market expansion and business diversification initiatives.

• Develop short-, medium-, and long-term business plans.

• Assist clients in defining strategic priorities and measurable objectives.

• Track progress against agreed business goals.

**7. KPI & Performance Management**

• Develop company-wide and departmental KPIs for clients.

• Establish performance measurement frameworks.

• Create management dashboards and reporting structures.

• Conduct monthly or quarterly business performance reviews.

• Identify performance gaps and recommend corrective actions.

• Track client performance against agreed targets.

• Prepare management reports and present key findings to clients.

**8. Implementation & Change Management**

• Convert consulting recommendations into practical implementation plans.

• Work alongside client teams to implement agreed initiatives.

• Establish timelines, milestones, owners, and measurable outcomes.

• Conduct regular client review meetings.

• Monitor implementation progress.

• Identify challenges and recommend corrective actions.

• Measure and report the impact of consulting interventions.

**9. Client Relationship Management**

• Build trusted and professional relationships with client stakeholders.

• Act as a strategic business advisor to client leadership teams.

• Understand client expectations and maintain clear communication.

• Manage multiple client engagements simultaneously.

• Conduct regular client meetings and business reviews.

• Prepare professional presentations, reports, and recommendations.

• Identify additional opportunities where the consulting team can support the client.

**Required Experience**

•
**5+ years of experience**
in business consulting, management consulting, business advisory, strategy, operations, business transformation, or a senior cross-functional business role.

• Experience working with
**external clients**
is highly desirable.

• Experience consulting with SMEs, startups, or mid-sized businesses is preferred.

• Demonstrated exposure to multiple business functions, including:

o Sales & Marketing

o HR

o Operations

o Finance

• Experience interacting with founders, CEOs, directors, and senior management.

• Strong experience in business analysis, process improvement, strategic planning, and KPI development.

**Educational Qualifications**

**Key Skills**

• Management Consulting

• Business Advisory

• Business Strategy

• Client Management

• Commercial Acumen

• Financial Analysis

• Sales & Marketing

• HR & Organisation Development

• Operations Management

• Process Improvement

• KPI & Performance Management

• Business Analytics

• Project Management

• Change Management

• Strategic Planning

• Presentation & Communication

**Candidate Profile**

• Comfortable working directly with business owners and senior executives.

• Able to understand different industries and business models quickly.

• Commercially minded and focused on measurable outcomes.

• Comfortable working across multiple client engagements.

title: SAP FI-AR Consultant/ Product Owner
description:
At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today’s risks into tomorrow’s opportunities. We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are—with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. Moody’s is transforming how the world sees risk. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we’re advancing AI to move from insight to action—enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence.
  
  
If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity.
  
  
**Skills And Competencies**

* 5+ years of relevant AR and collections systems experience, including expert, hands-on knowledge of SAP S/4HANA Accounts Receivable: customer/business-partner master data, payment terms, reconciliation accounts, open items, dunning, credit management, disputes, collections, and cash application
* Deep understanding of customer invoices, debit and credit memos, incoming receipts, unapplied/on-account cash, overpayments, partial payments, residual items, payment differences and tolerances, refunds, write-offs, reversals, and clearing. Ability to explain and validate related debits and credits and impacts on customer balances, bank-clearing accounts, and the General Ledger
* Strong functional knowledge of electronic bank statements, automatic matching of incoming payments to open AR, posting and clearing rules, and exception investigation and reprocessing and Proven product ownership experience spanning product vision, roadmaps, product backlogs, prioritization, epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria. Strong business analysis and functional design skills, including preparing BRDs and FDDs and securing documented business approvals
* End-to-end Order-to-Cash understanding, from customer and contract/order data through billing, AR, collections, payments, refunds, reconciliation, and month-end close. Strong knowledge of AR aging, collections follow-up, disputes, allowances and bad debt, and AR subledger-to-General Ledger reconciliation
* Strong leadership through influence: independently facilitate decisions, challenge assumptions, resolve conflicting priorities, translate complex business needs into practical solutions, and drive cross-functional commitments to closure. Communicate progress, delays, and escalations clearly to business and technology stakeholders.
* Understanding of integrations between SAP S/4HANA AR, Sales and Distribution (SD), Financial Accounting/General Ledger (FI/GL), billing, banking interfaces, CRM platforms such as Salesforce, and middleware; ability to diagnose issues across process and system boundaries
* Demonstrated delivery experience across Agile/Scrum, Waterfall, and hybrid approaches, with disciplined adherence to the SDLC, testing, approvals, change management, and release controls. Working knowledge of SOX controls, audit support, and financial data integrity. Proficiency with Jira for backlog, ticket, SLA, dependency, and delivery tracking, and familiarity with service-management, documentation, collaboration, and process-mapping tools such as ServiceNow, Confluence, SharePoint, Teams, and Visio
* Proven ability to balance project delivery and BAU support, manage ticket aging and service commitments, investigate recurring issues, and maintain complete documentation, knowledge transfer, and operational coverage

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience
* Product Owner certification (CSPO or SAFe PO/PM) or SAP S/4HANA Finance certification is preferred

**Responsibilities**

* Serve as the functional lead and product owner for SAP S/4HANA Accounts Receivable, Cash Application, and Collections, driving requirements, design, delivery, and business-as-usual support across the Order-to-Cash lifecycle
* Maintain the product roadmap and backlog; drive prioritization with Finance process leads and the Technology Services Group, balancing business value, operational urgency, control requirements, dependencies, effort, and capacity; document agreed scope, sequencing, delivery commitments, and escalation decisions
* Gather and document business needs through Business Requirements Documents, Functional Design Documents, process flows, epics, user stories, and testable acceptance criteria; maintain traceability through development, testing, and release; obtain documented business approvals and coordinate required technical reviews
* Facilitate workshops with Finance, Collections, Cash Application, Sales Operations, Treasury, Tax, and the Technology Services Group to define current- and target-state processes, requirements, dependencies, and acceptance criteria; apply end-to-end Order-to-Cash understanding to assess impacts across adjacent domains
* Partner with the SAP Center of Excellence, solution architects, and delivery teams on functional designs for customer master data, invoicing, debit and credit memos, cash application, refunds, adjustments, reversals, clearing, disputes, dunning, collector worklists, and collections strategies and Independently investigate complex SAP AR and Cash Application issues across configuration, master data, accounting entries, and integrations; identify root causes and coordinate sustainable solutions with business and technology teams
* Lead functional delivery using Agile/Scrum, Waterfall, or hybrid approaches; lead System Integration Testing and User Acceptance Testing; validate end-to-end processing and accounting outcomes; coordinate defect triage; and oversee cutover, hypercare, and transition to ongoing support
* Ensure projects, enhancements, and production changes follow the Software Development Life Cycle, including required documentation, approvals, testing evidence, change controls, and support handover; support SOX control design, audit readiness, and financial data integrity
* Own oversight of in-scope Jira tickets from intake through validated closure; drive SLA adherence, intervene before breaches, and escalate at-risk or overdue items with business impact and a recovery plan. Maintain proactive communication with Finance process leads, the Business Systems Team, and the Technology Services Group on completed deliverables, milestones, risks, dependencies, delays, and decisions required; identify opportunities to apply automation and AI responsibly to collections and delivery workflows

**About The Team**
The Business Systems Team supports systems and processes across Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, and General Ledger. This role serves specifically as the hands-on functional lead and product owner for SAP S/4HANA Accounts Receivable, Cash Application, and Collections, partnering with Finance process leads and the Technology Services Group to lead requirements and functional design, drive prioritization and delivery, strengthen controls, and maintain project, enhancement, and business-as-usual support coverage. The team collaborates with adjacent process owners on cross-domain dependencies and integration impacts.
**This is a one-year contract position based in India**
, with the potential to transition to a permanent role; the role requires flexibility to work business hours aligned with either EMEA or the United States based on business needs.
  
  
Moody’s is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender expression, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by law.
  
  
Candidates for Moody's Corporation may be asked to disclose securities holdings pursuant to Moody’s Policy for Securities Trading and the requirements of the position. Employment is contingent upon compliance with the Policy, including remediation of positions in those holdings as necessary.

title: Growth Manager

title: Business Head, D2C
description:
**Job Purpose:**

Lead the strategic direction and growth of the Direct-to-Consumer (D2C) business segment, driving revenue, customer acquisition, and service. Develop and execute innovative business strategies to create exceptional user experiences and cultivate strong relationships with upscale merchants, ensuring market leadership in the hospitality service app industry.

**Key Responsibilities:**

•Develop and execute the overall D2C business strategy, aligning with the company's vision and goals.

•Lead cross-functional teams to drive product innovation, feature development, market expansion, and product support.

•Identify and pursue strategic opportunities for revenue growth; including new market segments, product offerings, and initiatives to establish partnerships and alliances that enhance the D2C ecosystem.

•Own product level profitability by ensuring optimal allocation of budgets and monitoring various costs (CAC, development costs, infrastructure costs, support costs, people costs, etc.)

•Negotiate and finalize agreements with key stakeholders like merchants, technology partners, and institutions while ensuring mutually beneficial partnerships.

•Oversee customer acquisition initiatives by leveraging digital marketing, user behavior & user growth strategies; oversee customer retention programs to minimize churn rate & maximize lifetime value.

•Lead merchant onboarding efforts, ensuring a diverse and curated selection of upscale merchants on the platform by providing support and guidance to optimize the merchant’s presence and offerings.

•Liaison with the technical program management team in prioritizing various feature enhancement and maintenance support.

•Ensure adequate support is extended for timely resolution of merchant and consumer queries & issues

•Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the success of D2C business initiatives and present periodic business reports to TLC leadership and other stakeholders.

**Key Performance Indicators:**

**Strategic:**
Reposition TLC DigiTech’s value proposition both internally and externally in line with organization’s strategic objectives

**Primary:**

1.Revenue from D2C offerings

2.Direct costs as a percentage of revenue – Apportioned employee costs, technology costs, customer service costs, admin costs

3.CAC – Cost of acquiring a new customer

4.Contribution Margin 1 (CM1)

Difference of total revenue and variable costs directly associated and apportioned with delivering services (employee cost, customer service cost, infrastructure cost)

5.Contribution Margin 2 (CM2)

Difference of CM1 and apportioned service delivery fixed costs (payment gateway expense) & marketing costs (CAC)

6.Growth in total number of user signups

7.Growth in total number of merchants onboarded

**Secondary:**

1.Number of new cities/districts where Kitty Party launched/operations set-up

2.Number of new products/experiences added in the Kitty Party portfolio

title: Product Development Manager, Rugs and Home Textiles
description:
**ABOUT QUINCE**
Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.
  
  
What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.
  
  
**OUR CULTURE**
Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.
  
  

* We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
* Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
* Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.
  
  
**Product Development Manager, Rugs and Home Textile**
Quince is a US-based, hyper-growth tech retail start-up experiencing 100%+ YoY growth and serving millions of users each month. Backed by over USD 500 million in funding, we continue to scale rapidly. At Quince, we didn’t just build a $2B+ retail brand—we completely rewrote the playbook on cross-border e-commerce.
  
  
We are seeking a
**Product Development Manager, Rugs and Home Textile**
to join our growing team at Quince. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring products are launched in a timely manner while achieving the highest quality standards.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Own and actively manage day-to-day product development timelines across new products, color and size extensions, vendor transitions, and refreshes, tracking milestones and escalating risks early.
* Serve as the central point of coordination across Merchandising, Sourcing, Fit, Technical Development, Materials, QA, Creative, and Vendors to ensure alignment on development status and dependencies.
* Ensure all required product documentation is accurate, complete, and ready prior to vendor handoff, including technical specifications, build documentation, testing requirements, and fit inputs.
* Coordinate and track all sample requests, shipments, reviews, fit requests, and revisions to drive efficiency and maintain momentum toward target timelines.
* Facilitate timely product reviews and approvals by Merchandising, Fit, and Technical teams; track testing requests and results to ensure quality outcomes are clearly communicated.
* Run in-person country development trips with Global Merchants, Global Fit, and Local PD teams to accelerate decision-making and strengthen vendor execution.
* Partner with Sourcing to support timely staging of materials and finished-goods production; coordinate delivery of photo samples to Creative to ensure marketing and launch readiness.
* Maintain clean, accurate, real-time data across all product development systems and tracking tools to ensure transparency and support fast execution.

**Qualifications required:**

* 10+ years in product development or factory-facing roles
* Deep functional category expertise, including product and material standards
* Extensive experience working directly with factories and sample rooms
* Comfortable operating independently and navigating ambiguity Highly organized, detail-oriented and analytical with focus on execution, problem-solving, improving processes and quality enhancement
* Clear communicator across language, cultural, and functional boundaries
* Proven track record of progressing within an organization and demonstrating continuous growth in roles and responsibilities
* Continuous learner and highly curious; always open to considering new perspectives; proactive when changing course and facing added challenges
* Excellent written and verbal communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills
* Motivated by working in a fast-paced collaborative environment, where flexibility to stretch into or out of functional comfort zones is crucial for team success
* Bachelor’s Degree, preferred

**WHY QUINCE?**
Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.
  
  
**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY**
Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.
  
  
Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis.
  
  
Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.
  
  
*Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds*
At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official Quince email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. Interviews are conducted via phone, in person, or through the approved platforms Google Meets or Zoom—never via messaging apps or other calling services. Offers are merit-based, communicated verbally, and followed up in writing. If personal information is requested to initiate the hiring process, rest assured it will be through secure and protected means.

**About The Function**
The Product Management function at MakeMyTrip sits at the core of how we build, scale and reimagine travel. By bringing together technology, data, design and business insight, it creates seamless experiences for millions of travellers across discovery, personalisation, payments and loyalty.
  
  
Our PM teams act as mini-CEOs: they shape strategy, turn insights into impact, and push the boundaries of travel tech to make MMT a truly product-first organisation.
  
  
Within this, Connect helps Hotels and Alternative Accommodation partners grow by solving challenges across the pre- and post-booking journey. The team drives partner visibility, conversions and pricing competitiveness through innovative tools and propositions. It also builds the partner lifecycle workflows behind them, from onboarding and commercial setup to approvals, which strengthen MMT's partner ecosystem and fuel scalable, sustainable growth.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Product Manager at Connect (RL3 / RL4), you will own a defined product area for Hotels and Alternative Accommodation partners. You will be responsible for its outcomes from discovery to launch and beyond. The role covers two connected areas:
  
  

* Partner growth products that improve pricing competitiveness, visibility, inventory management and conversions across the consumer and host journey.
* Partner lifecycle workflows that let sales, supply, finance and support teams onboard, set up and manage partners efficiently.

This role needs a strong product mindset, the ability to turn insights into scalable product strategies, and close collaboration with business, tech, design and analytics teams. You will be expected to understand partner and internal-user needs deeply, prioritise with clear trade-offs, and deliver measurable improvements in partner success and business growth for MakeMyTrip.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Own the product roadmap for a defined area within Connect, and set clear goals, priorities and success metrics that tie to business outcomes.
* Conceptualise and build new products and features that are accurate, scalable and impactful, and that address key partner and customer needs in pricing, visibility, inventory and conversions.
* Improve partner lifecycle workflows such as onboarding, commercial setup, approvals and deactivation, so that internal teams work faster and with less manual effort. This includes:

oConfiguring and automating workflows and approval processes, and writing clear specs for custom builds and integrations with telephony, e-sign and finance systems.
  
  
oKeeping partner data clean, and building reports and dashboards that match the BI team's numbers.
  
  
oManaging user access, running UAT and releases, and fixing recurring issues at the root, supported by release notes and SOPs.
  
  

* Turn requests from supply, sales, finance and operations into clear PRDs, user stories and acceptance criteria. Prioritise them and explain what is deferred and why.
* Work closely with technology, design, QA, supply, finance and customer support teams to plan releases, run UAT and ensure smooth launches.
* Own and track product KPIs such as adoption, conversion, turnaround time (TAT) and manual effort. Analyse performance continuously and iterate after launch.
* Build strong product insight through regular partner and user conversations, market research and competitive benchmarking.
* Create a seamless, differentiated experience for both consumers and hosts across the Connect ecosystem.
* Bring a passion for data and problem-solving, and simplify complex experiences into intuitive, high-impact solutions.

**Qualification & Experience**

* Management graduate from a reputed institute with 0–2 years of experience in a consumer-facing, technology-enabled business or product environment.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving and stakeholder management skills.
* Proven ability to thrive in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.

**Good To Have**

* Experience with Salesforce or a similar CRM platform, ideally on sales, supply or partner workflows.
* Experience in travel, hospitality, e-commerce, fintech or a B2B marketplace.

**Key Success Factors For The Role**

* Customer centricity: A deep passion for understanding and improving the experience of partners, travellers and internal users.
* Ownership & execution: The ability to turn ideas into impactful products through structured execution and cross-functional collaboration.
* Strategic thinking: The ability to build a long-term product vision for your area that is aligned with business goals.
* Analytical rigour: A data-driven approach to problem-solving, from setting success metrics to measuring results after launch.
* Innovation & agility: Eagerness to experiment, learn quickly and adapt solutions to changing market needs.
* Communication & influence: A strong ability to explain product decisions and bring business and tech teams around shared outcomes.

title: Product Manager
description:
**Description**
What is Articore
  
  
Articore owns and operates leading global online artist-driven two-sided direct-to-garment marketplaces including Redbubble.com and TeePublic.com.
  
  
The Group's community of passionate creatives sell uncommon designs on high-quality, everyday products such as apparel, stationery, housewares, bags and wall art. Through the Redbubble and TeePublic marketplaces, independent artists are able to profit from their creativity and reach a new universe of adoring fans. For the artists' customers, it's the ultimate in self-expression: a simple but meaningful way to show the world who they are and what they care about.
  
  
The Role
  
  
You are the Product Manager for the Redbubble native app. Every part of it is yours: each screen and view, the user flows, checkout, and the eventing and data behind them.
  
  
Your job is to make the app work, keep it working, and build on it so that it earns more revenue. That means looking after what is live today and shipping the next improvements on top of it.
  
  
You will report to the Product Director and work closely with the engineers on the app, who are based in India, and with Product, Design and Analytics counterparts in the USA and Australia. The app sits alongside the Redbubble website, so you also work with the teams who own the web experience.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
**Own the App**

* Own the whole app experience: every view, the user flows, checkout and account.
* Keep the app healthy, with issues triaged, prioritised and fixed.
* Own the eventing and data, so that we can see how customers use every part of the app.

**Grow Revenue**

* Own the revenue the app contributes, from first install to repeat purchase.
* Improve conversion through the app and checkout, and bring customers back to it.
* Build new capabilities on top of the app and measure what each one adds.

**Roadmap and Delivery**

* Set the roadmap and prioritise app work, and write specifications the engineering team can build from.
* Keep the app consistent with the Redbubble website, and make any differences deliberate.
* Work with engineers to ship in small, measurable steps.

**Ship, Measure, Decide**

* Instrument before you launch, and run experiments rather than a roadmap of features.
* Use Amplitude and our data foundations to reach your own conclusions.
* Use AI tooling across discovery, analysis, prototyping and specification.

**Partner Across Regions**

* Work closely with the engineers on the app, with Product, Design and Analytics counterparts in the USA and Australia, and with the teams who own the web experience. We aim to decrease the amount of cross-hour meetings by having designated async communication leads and ways of working.
* Communicate in writing, clearly and often, to people who are rarely awake at the same time as you.

**Requirements**

* App Experience: You have managed a native app before, ideally one that moved from a website to an app, or an app that sits alongside a website and an ecommerce business.
* Product Experience: 4+ years in product management in ecommerce, with a track record you can point to in numbers rather than launches.
* Mobile Product Fluency: You understand how native apps are built, released and measured, and what separates a good app experience from a mobile website in an app wrapper.
* Commercial Instinct: You are fluent in conversion, checkout, retention and lifetime value, and you can show how a roadmap becomes revenue.
* Delivery Discipline: You write specifications people can build from, you hold a clear definition of ready, and you care about what was tested before it went live.
* Data Fluency: You run your own analysis. You are comfortable in an analytics tool, you know what a valid test looks like, and you are hard to fool with a promising-looking chart.
* AI-Native Working: You already use AI tooling to work faster and better, and you have opinions about where it helps and where it doesn't.
* Willingness to Push Back: You can tell an engineer, a stakeholder or a senior leader that something isn't worth building, and hold that position with evidence.
* Written Clarity: Most of your influence happens asynchronously, in writing, read by people you rarely share a working hour with.

Work Environment
  
  

* India-based alongside the engineers on the app.
* Regular collaboration across the USA and Australia, with early or late calls balanced deliberately throughout the week.

**Benefits**

* High Trust Culture: Thrive in an environment built on mutual respect where your voice matters.
* Flexible Work Arrangements: The opportunity to balance your work and personal life with flexible schedules.
* Global Opportunities: Be part of a global organisation that offers diverse and enriching experiences.

title: Product Manager (Hotels)
description:
Role: Product Manager
  
  
Location: Gurgaon
  
  
**About The Function**
The Domestic Hotels Product Team strives to delivering unparalleled experiences for customers seeking hotel accommodations. Our efforts are led by a profound understanding of customer challenges, extensive data analysis, and identification of root causes. From architecting powerful backend systems to creating intuitive, delightful user journeys, the function is shaping the future of Hotels making every booking effortless, personalized, and unforgettable.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Product Manager, the responsibility will be to lead high-impact initiatives in a fast-paced, innovation-driven environment. The role entails full ownership of the product lifecycle from concept and strategy to launch and ongoing enhancement while working closely with cross-functional teams to drive measurable improvements. This position offers the opportunity to collaborate with leading industry professionals and influence the creation of exceptional, customer-first experiences in the Hotels space. .
  
  
What will you be doing
  
  

* Define and drive the product vision and strategy for Domestic Hotels, aligning initiatives with growth, revenue, and customer experience goals.
* Lead the end-to-end product lifecycle — from strategy and roadmap to feature launches and post-launch optimization.
* Own and optimize scalable product systems to improve funnel efficiency, conversion, retention, and the post-sales consumer experience.
* Design seamless, high-impact experiences for consumers and accommodation partners across frontend and backend platforms.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams — Revenue, Category, Supply, Design, and Technology — to deliver cohesive, high-impact product solutions.
* Leverage data, insights, and experimentation to solve core user and business problems at scale.
* Drive product adoption and engagement by applying deep empathy for customers and partners and iterating on the product experience.
* Lead product releases in collaboration with Engineering, Design, and QA to ensure quality and timely delivery.
* Define, track, and optimize key product KPIs across acquisition, conversion, retention, and revenue to maximize business impact.
* Continuously analyze market trends, customer feedback, and post-launch performance to refine the product roadmap and drive growth.

Qualification & Experience
  
  

* Engineering & Management graduates from reputed institutes with 3 to 4 years of experience in product management roles for consumer-facing, technology-enabled businesses.
* Experience managing the complete product lifecycle using agile methodologies including requirement definition, prioritization, user experience design and metric tracking.
* Experience working with complex datasets using analytical tools and techniques. Proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint and SQL is expected.
* Prior experience with product analytics tools such as Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, Amplitude or Mixpanel will be an added advantage.
* Experience in travel, mobility, e-commerce or marketplace businesses.
* Exposure to ML or GenAI-powered customer experiences.
* Experience with personalization, recommendation systems or conversational interfaces.
* Experience working with large-scale consumer products serving millions of users.

Key Success Factors for the Role
  
  

* A passion for solving complex customer problems through technology, data and innovation.
* Strong product thinking with the ability to translate ambiguous business challenges into structured product solutions.
* Deep curiosity about emerging ML and GenAI capabilities and their application in creating superior customer experiences.
* Strong analytical mindset with the ability to work with large datasets and make data-driven decisions.
* Good understanding of technology systems and how technical decisions influence product outcomes and scalability.
* Ability to influence and collaborate effectively across business, engineering, design, analytics and leadership teams.
* High ownership mindset with the ability to independently drive initiatives from ideation to execution.

title: AI Transformation Lead
description:
Lead Incedo's AI transformation by converting strategy into scaled adoption, AI-native delivery and measurable business value. The role will connect client and enterprise priorities with Generative AI, Agentic AI, engineering transformation, reusable platforms and organization-wide change.

This is a business and technology transformation role, not a pure AI research, data science or program-management position.

Key Accountabilities

1. Transformation Strategy & Portfolio

* Define and execute a prioritized AI transformation roadmap across strategic accounts, delivery
* Build a value-led portfolio and move initiatives from opportunity identification through production, adoption and benefits realization.
* Create repeatable transformation playbooks and scale successful patterns across Incedo.

2. AI-Native Delivery & Engineering

* Accelerate AI-PDLC/AIDLC adoption and redesign workflows around Human + Agent ways of working.
* Establish AI-native POD patterns across requirements, architecture, development, testing, documentation and operations in key accounts and programs
* Demonstrate measurable improvement in productivity, cycle time, quality and delivery predictability.

3. Client Transformation & Growth

* Partner with Business Unit, Account and Delivery leaders to identify high-value client opportunities.
* Lead executive discovery workshops and shape AI roadmaps, business cases, proposals and lighthouse programs.
* Convert successful client implementations into differentiated offerings and reusable transformation plays.

4. Platforms, Agents & Reusable IP

* Drive adoption of Incedo AI platforms and accelerators, including brAInSpark and DataXel.
* Identify reusable agents, engineering patterns and accelerators; connect field needs to platform roadmaps.
* Ensure successful proofs of concept are industrialized rather than remaining isolated pilots.

5. Talent, Change & Governance

* Build a network of AI champions and embed AI capability through live delivery application, not training completion alone.
* Partner with HR and capability teams to evolve AI-native roles, skills, learning pathways and recognition mechanisms.
* Establish portfolio governance, Responsible AI controls and executive reporting across adoption, risk and value.

Candidate Profile

**Experience**

* Director: typically 14-18 years of experience.
* Track record leading enterprise, portfolio or multi-account transformation from strategy through adoption and measurable value.
* Experience in technology services, consulting, digital engineering or a CTO / AI Transformation Office.

**Leadership**

* Executive presence with strong client advisory and stakeholder influence.
* Ability to lead across organizational boundaries and operate effectively in ambiguity.
* Strong commercial orientation, structured thinking and transformation storytelling.

**AI & Engineering Fluency**

* Generative AI, LLMs and Agentic AI.
* RAG, enterprise knowledge systems and AI evaluation.
* AI-assisted engineering and modern SDLC/DevSecOps.
* Cloud, data platforms, security and Responsible AI.

**Transformation Capabilities**

* Operating-model and workflow redesign.
* Business case development and value realization.
* Organization-wide change, adoption and capability building.
* Portfolio governance, KPI design and executive reporting.

title: Senior Director, Engineering (Customer Experience)
description:
**About Birdeye Inc.**
Birdeye builds AI coworkers for multi-location brands. Jay for marketing, Myna for operations, and Robin for customer experience orchestrate AI agents to win AI visibility, book appointments, and drive consistent CX at every location. They run on BirdAI, the Agent OS built on 13 years of multi-location data infrastructure and 3,000+ integrations. BirdAI consolidates every signal, reasons with industry, brand and location context, and acts autonomously or with a human in the loop.
  
  
Birdeye is trusted by the world's largest multi-location brands across healthcare, dental, restaurants, financial services, auto, retail, and property management. G2 ranks Birdeye #1 in Enterprise Multi-Location Marketing Platforms and named it to the 2026 Best Agentic AI Products list. Learn more at birdeye.com.
  
  
**About Robin**
Robin is Birdeye’s AI coworker designed to help businesses manage customer experience, customer interactions, feedback, and reputation at scale. Built for multi-location brands, Robin leverages AI to automate workflows, analyze customer insights, and enable businesses to deliver smarter, more efficient customer experiences.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a Senior Director of Engineering – Robin (Full Stack) to lead the engineering vision, architecture, and development of AI-native products and platforms. This role requires a strong technology leader with deep hands-on engineering experience across full-stack development, AI-driven product engineering, scalable distributed systems, and modern agentic architectures.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Lead engineering strategy, architecture, and execution for Robin’s AI-powered customer experience platform.
* Build and scale AI-native applications using modern full-stack technologies, including Java, Python, React, and cloud-native architectures.
* Drive the development of intelligent AI agents, agentic workflows, LLM-powered applications, and autonomous systems.
* Architect scalable, distributed, high-performance systems capable of handling large volumes of customer interactions and data.
* Drive innovation in conversational AI, multi-agent systems, orchestration frameworks, RAG, and LLM integrations.
* Partner closely with Product, AI/ML, Design, and Platform teams to deliver next-generation AI experiences.
* Establish engineering excellence around system reliability, performance, scalability, security, and observability.
* Build a culture of AI-native development, leveraging coding agents, developer copilots, and autonomous engineering workflows.
* Lead, mentor, and grow high-performing engineering teams while fostering innovation and strong technical ownership.
* Drive rapid experimentation, prototyping, and productionization of AI-powered capabilities

**What We’re Looking For**

* 12–18+ years of overall software engineering experience, with significant experience leading large engineering organizations.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field from a Tier-1 college like IIT/NIT/BITS etc.
* Strong hands-on background in full-stack development with technologies such as Java, React, Python, and modern backend frameworks.
* Experience building AI-native products, LLM-powered applications, AI agents, and agentic systems, with experience building and scaling Customer Experience products like Surveys, Insights, Ticketing, Competitors, etc.
* Deep understanding of system design, microservices, distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, and scalable architecture.
* Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks, RAG pipelines, vector databases, prompt engineering, and model integration.
* Strong experience in SaaS product engineering, ideally with high-scale, multi-tenant platforms.
* Proven ability to lead engineering teams through complex product development and large-scale technical transformation.
* Experience with AI coding tools and modern engineering productivity platforms.
* Strong product mindset, strategic thinking, and ability to translate business needs into technical vision and execution.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience building AI agents, copilots, autonomous workflows, or conversational AI platforms.
* Background in customer experience (CX), SaaS, CRM, reputation management, or multi-location business platforms.
* Experience in AI-first or AI-native engineering organizations.
* Strong technical leadership, balancing architectural depth with organisational scale.

This is an opportunity to shape the future of AI-native customer experience by building Robin into an intelligent AI coworker that transforms how businesses manage customer interactions, insights, and operations at scale.

Maintain a healthy candidate pipeline for current and upcoming requirements.

Achieve assigned monthly hiring targets and ensure timely closure of vacancies.

Take complete ownership of assigned positions and drive them until successful joining.

Maintain daily recruitment trackers, candidate databases, and hiring reports.

Monitor recruitment performance through sourcing, interview, selection, offer, and joining conversion metrics.

Coordinate employee documentation and background verification.

Maintain recruitment and employee-related records.

Assist the HR team with other HR activities whenever required.

Recruitment Targets & Performance Expectations

This is a strictly target-based in-house recruitment position.

The candidate will be assigned monthly hiring targets based on organizational requirements.

Responsible for achieving monthly recruitment closures and ensuring candidates successfully join the organization.

Maintain consistent sourcing, screening, and interview pipelines.

Ensure regular follow-ups with candidates and hiring managers.

Minimize candidate dropouts and offer-to-joining gaps.

Share daily and weekly recruitment progress reports.

Demonstrate accountability for assigned vacancies and monthly hiring outcomes.

Graduate in any discipline; MBA/PGDM in HR will be an added advantage.

1–3 years of experience in Talent Acquisition or Recruitment.

Experience in both IT and Non-IT recruitment is preferred.

Exposure to domestic and international recruitment will be an added advantage.

Hands-on experience with Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed, and other recruitment platforms.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Strong interpersonal, negotiation, and candidate management skills.

Positive attitude with a strong "I Can Do" mindset.

Self-driven, proactive, and capable of taking ownership of assigned hiring requirements.

Comfortable working with monthly hiring targets and performance expectations.

Ability to manage multiple open positions simultaneously.

Immediate joiners who can start at the earliest.

Delhi-based candidates preferred.

Candidates with excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

Individuals who take ownership rather than waiting for instructions.

People who are proactive, energetic, target-driven, and enthusiastic about recruitment.

Candidates comfortable with in-house hiring for both domestic and international positions.

Opportunity to earn additional incentives based on recruitment performance and achievement of hiring targets.

description:
Pets are family. Yet pet healthcare remains reactive, fragmented and difficult to navigate.

At Pawbud Health, we are building an AI-native preventive healthcare platform combining AI-powered health assessments, at-home diagnostics, veterinary care and insurance. Our long-term ambition is to build the health intelligence infrastructure for pets.

We're building the future of pet healthcare. Now, we need someone who can make people fall in love with it.

**About the role**

We're looking for a creative thinker, storyteller and hands-on marketer who can turn Pawbud into one of India's most loved and memorable consumer brands.

You'll work directly with the founder, shape our brand's personality and build our marketing engine from scratch.

Think bold ideas, unconventional campaigns, meaningful storytelling and a healthy obsession with consumer psychology.

**What you'll own**

* **Brand Building:**
  Define how Pawbud looks, sounds, feels and lives in the minds of pet parents.
* **Creative Campaigns:**
  Build memorable, conversation-starting campaigns that people genuinely want to share.
* **Content & Social Media:**
  Develop a distinctive brand voice and build an engaged community of pet parents.
* **Influencer & Community Marketing:**
  Build relationships with creators, communities and brand advocates.
* **PR & Communications:**
  Make Pawbud a recognised voice in pet healthcare.
* **Marketing Strategy:**
  Turn brand awareness into measurable consumer demand and organic customer acquisition.

* 5–8 years of experience in consumer marketing, brand building or D2C businesses.
* You've helped build or scale a consumer brand, preferably from its early stages.
* You have exceptional creative instincts and know what makes people stop scrolling.
* You understand both storytelling and numbers.
* You're resourceful and can create disproportionate impact with limited budgets.
* You're a pet parent who genuinely understands the emotional bond people share with their pets.

What success looks like

* **First 30 days:**
  Define Pawbud's brand positioning, personality and marketing roadmap.
* **First 90 days:**
  Establish a repeatable content engine, creator network and launch distinctive brand campaigns.
* **First 6 months:**
  Demonstrate measurable growth in organic acquisition, branded searches, engagement and consumer demand.

* Build a brand from zero, not inherit someone else's playbook.
* Work directly with an experienced founder.
* Enjoy creative freedom, real ownership.
* Highly competitive salary and
  **meaningful ESOPs**
  .

title: Asst. Manager - Performance Marketing (AI & Marketing Technology)
company: GUS Global Services India Pvt. Ltd.
description:
Role snapshot

Role

Assistant Manager – AI & Marketing Technology

Team - Performance Marketing

Location - Delhi, India (on-site)

Experience 3+years

Education - Bachelor's in a technical field (B.Tech/B.E., BCA, B.Sc. CS/IT)

Core stack - Python · SQL · Google Ads Scripts · Ads/GA4 APIs · LLM APIs · n8n/Make

The role in brief

We want a builder, not a campaign manager. You will turn our performance marketing team's manual work into scripts, pipelines and AI-powered workflows that run on their own.

You'll sit inside Performance Marketing, work across Google Ads, Meta Ads, GA4 and our CRM, and own the automation layer that sits on top of them. Success is measured in hours saved, faster decisions and cleaner data — not slide decks.

What you'll do

**1. Automate campaign operations**

* Write and maintain Google Ads Scripts for bid, budget, pacing and status checks.
* Automate search-term mining: keyword discovery, n-gram analysis and negative-keyword recommendations.
* Build monitoring for Google Ads and Meta Ads: budget pacing, overspend, disapprovals, broken URLs and tracking failures.
* Audit the team's weekly workload and convert the most repetitive tasks into automation.

**2. Own reporting and insights**

* Pull Google Ads, Meta Ads, GA4 and CRM data into one reliable source of truth.
* Ship automated dashboards and daily performance summaries (Looker Studio or similar).
* Use LLMs to turn raw numbers into plain-language insights and optimisation recommendations.
* Set up anomaly alerts for drops in performance, cost spikes and lead-quality issues, routed to Slack, email or WhatsApp.

**3. Build AI workflows and agents**

* Design scalable workflows with Python, SQL, APIs and n8n, Make or Zapier.
* Apply LLM APIs for analysis, ad-copy variants, search-term classification and lead scoring support.
* Prototype AI agents that monitor accounts and propose actions for human approval.
* Write prompts, evaluation checks and guardrails so AI output is accurate and on-brand.

**4. Strengthen tracking and data**

* Maintain conversion tracking across Google Tag Manager, GA4, Google Ads and Meta (Pixel and Conversions API).
* Support offline conversion imports from CRM so platforms optimise for qualified leads and enrolments, not just form fills.
* Build and maintain data pipelines into a warehouse such as BigQuery.
* Diagnose tracking gaps and campaign issues with data, not guesswork.

Must-have skills

* 3+ years in performance marketing, marketing automation, martech or a similar technical role.
* Hands-on Google Ads Scripts (JavaScript) experience automating live accounts.
* Python for data work and automation: pandas, requests, scheduling, error handling.
* SQL: joins, window functions and aggregations on relational data or a warehouse.
* Working with REST APIs: authentication (OAuth), pagination, rate limits and JSON.
* Practical use of LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Gemini) inside real workflows, including

prompt design.

* At least one automation platform: n8n, Make or Zapier.
* Solid grasp of paid-media fundamentals: match types, bidding strategies, CPC, CPL, CPA, ROAS and attribution.
* Ability to build, test, debug and document workflows independently.

Good to have

* Google Ads API and Meta Marketing API, used directly rather than through connectors.
* GA4 BigQuery export and Google Cloud basics (Cloud Functions, Cloud Scheduler, Apps Script).
* Server-side tagging, Meta Conversions API and Google Enhanced Conversions.
* Offline conversion tracking and CRM integration (LeadSquared or Salesforce).
* Building AI agents and tool-calling workflows; familiarity with frameworks such as LangChain or MCP.
* Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and vector databases for internal knowledge tools.
* Statistical basics for marketing: A/B testing, significance, simple forecasting and anomaly detection.
* Git, version control and basic code review habits.
* Experience in education or lead-generation marketing, where lead quality matters as much as volume.
* Awareness of data privacy and consent requirements, including India's DPDP Act 2023.

Tech stack you'll work with

**Key Tools & Technologies:**

* **Ads:**
  Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads
* **Analytics:**
  GA4, Google Tag Manager
* **Coding:**
  Python, SQL, BigQuery
* **Automation:**
  n8n, Make, Zapier
* **AI:**
  OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, AI Agents
* **Reporting:**
  Power BI, Looker Studio, Excel
* **CRM:**
  LeadSquared, Salesforce

* **Days 1–30:**
  Understand workflows and automate daily performance reports.
* **Days 31–60:**
  Automate Google Ads monitoring and keyword analysis.
* **Days 61–90:**
  Implement performance alerts and AI-based anomaly detection.

**Who We're Looking For:**

* Strong coding and automation mindset.
* Understanding of performance marketing.
* Ability to build and improve AI-powered workflows.
* Bachelor's degree in a technical field (B.Tech/B.E., BCA, B.Sc. CS/IT).

**Assessment:**
Candidates should share 1–3 examples of their work, such as scripts, GitHub projects, automation workflows or dashboards. Shortlisted candidates will complete a practical assignment.

**About The Role**
We are looking for an Experiential Marketer to own the strategy, project management, and execution of our highest‑impact, marketer-targeted trade shows and surrounding experiences. This role will lead integrated event marketing campaigns, from pre‑event promotion through onsite execution and post‑event follow‑up, across multiple personas and target audiences.
  
  
You’ll partner closely with sales, product marketing, field marketing, and the core events team to turn trade shows, sponsored events, and executive dinners into a high-performing pipeline and brand channel.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Tier 1-3 trade show strategy & project management
* Own end‑to‑end planning and execution for Tier 1-3 trade shows and activations, including on‑site presence, in‑booth experiences, speaking sessions, and meeting programs.
* Build clear event briefs with objectives, target audiences, key messages, offers, and KPIs for each major show.
* Develop and manage detailed project plans, timelines, and run‑of‑show documents; keep cross‑functional stakeholders aligned and accountable.
* Own end-to-end logistics on booth experience, signage, shipping, vendors, and onsite staffing, ensuring everything ladders up to the event strategy.
* Own post‑event recaps, performance reporting, and optimization recommendations.
* Integrated event marketing for trade shows
* Develop multi‑channel event marketing plans for priority trade shows: organic social, email, web, paid amplification (where relevant), and partner co‑marketing.
* Lead sales enablement for each program: talk tracks, 1‑pagers, decks, and meeting briefs tailored to each audience.
* Collaborate with demand gen to build audience segmentation, nurtures, and cadences before and after events. Create copy for emails, landing pages, and other marketing collateral as needed.
* Coordinate content with product marketing and brand/creative, ensuring consistent messaging and positioning across all touchpoints.
* Track and report on registrations, meetings, lead quality, pipeline, and influenced revenue from event marketing activities.
* Sponsored events, partner programs & hosted dinners
* Plan and execute sponsored events, partner activations, and wraparound experiences (dinners, happy hours, small-format networking events) tied to Tier 1 and Tier 2 shows.
* Work with partners to define shared goals, messaging, and promotion plans, ensuring brand alignment and a strong attendee value proposition.
* Own guest list strategy, invitations, confirmations, and on‑site experience for hosted dinners and VIP experiences.
* Ensure all sponsored and hosted programs have clear measurement plans and post‑event follow‑up workflows.
* Audience & persona strategy
* Build and refine persona‑based event strategies across key segments (e.g., demand gen, field marketers, marketing ops, event planners, executives, etc.).
* Tailor event narratives, offers, and calls‑to‑action for different buyer stages and segments (prospects, customers, partners).
* Partner with analytics and marketing ops to understand audience performance by persona, industry, segment, and region, and use those insights to inform the event roadmap.
* Partner with sales and customer teams to bring the right mix of accounts and personas into each program.
* Collaboration, budget & operations
* Serve as the central point of contact for assigned trade shows and activations, driving alignment across marketing, sales, and events.
* Manage budgets for your programs, including tracking spend and reconciling invoices in partnership with finance and procurement.
* Use project management tools to keep work streams organized, transparent, and on schedule.
* Continuously test and scale new event formats, offers, and engagement tactics to improve ROI.

**Here's What You Need**

* 7+ years of B2B event marketing, field marketing, and trade show experience, ideally in SaaS or technology.
* Experience planning for the marketer target audience preferred
* Proven track record owning Tier 1 trade shows or large‑scale activations end‑to‑end (strategy, campaigns, onsite execution, and follow‑up).
* Hands‑on experience building integrated event marketing campaigns (email, social, web, sales plays, and partner marketing).
* Strong project management skills; comfortable leading complex programs with multiple stakeholders and tight deadlines.
* Proven ability to utilize AI to increase efficiencies, improve attendee experience, and optimize event marketing performance
* Experience planning and executing sponsored events, dinners, and small-format experiences alongside major conferences or trade shows.

title: Senior Devops Engineer
description:
For over four decades, PAR Technology Corporation (NYSE: PAR) has been a leader in restaurant technology, empowering brands worldwide to create lasting connections with their guests. Our innovative solutions and commitment to excellence provide comprehensive software and hardware that enable seamless experiences and drive growth for over 100,000 restaurants in more than 110 countries. Embracing our "Better Together" ethos, we offer Unified Customer Experience solutions, combining point-of-sale, digital ordering, loyalty and back-office software solutions as well as industry-leading hardware and drive-thru offerings. To learn more, visit partech.com or connect with us on LinkedIn, X (formerly Twitter), Facebook, and Instagram.
  
  
We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to embed security into every stage of how PAR builds, ships, and operates software. You will sit at the intersection of platform engineering and security, owning the tooling, automation, and guardrails that let dozens of product teams move fast without compromising the trust of the brands and guests who rely on us. This is a hands-on senior role: you will design secure CI/CD and cloud infrastructure, hunt down risk before it reaches production, and raise the security bar for the entire engineering organization.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Design, build, and operate secure CI/CD pipelines with integrated SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets scanning, and container image scanning — making the secure path the easy path for product teams.
* Harden and automate cloud infrastructure (AWS and/or Azure) using infrastructure-as-code, with security policies enforced as code through tools such as OPA, Sentinel, or native policy engines.
* Own container and orchestration security across Docker and Kubernetes: image provenance, runtime protection, network policies, and admission controls.
* Implement and tune cloud security posture management, vulnerability management, and threat detection; drive findings to remediation with engineering teams.
* Build and maintain secrets management, identity, and least-privilege access patterns (IAM, workload identity, service mesh mTLS).
* Lead threat modeling and secure design reviews for new services and architectures; partner with product engineering early rather than auditing late.
* Respond to and run post-incident analysis for security events; improve detection, alerting, and runbooks after every incident.
* Design and manage cloud networking: VPC/VNet architecture, subnetting, routing, NAT, VPC peering and transit gateways, private endpoints/PrivateLink, and hybrid connectivity (site-to-site VPN, Direct Connect/ExpressRoute).
* Operate edge and traffic-layer security: load balancers (ALB/NLB, NGINX, HAProxy), API gateways, WAF, DDoS protection, CDN configuration, DNS management, and TLS certificate lifecycle/PKI automation.
* Implement GitOps-based delivery (ArgoCD or Flux) with Helm/Kustomize, and progressive delivery patterns such as blue-green and canary releases with automated rollback.
* Build and run the observability stack — metrics, logging, tracing, and alerting (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/OpenSearch, Datadog, or equivalents) — with SLOs and actionable, low-noise alerts.
* Manage artifact repositories and software supply chain: image registries, SBOM generation, artifact signing and provenance (Sigstore/Cosign, SLSA).
* Drive capacity, autoscaling, and cost optimization across compute, storage, and network layers without compromising the security posture.
* Champion compliance-relevant engineering controls (e.g., PCI DSS, SOC 2) and automate evidence collection wherever possible.
* Mentor engineers across teams on secure coding and operational security practices; act as a force multiplier, not a gatekeeper.

**Unleash your Potential**

* 6–10 years of experience across DevOps, platform, or security engineering, with at least 3 years focused on DevSecOps or application/cloud security in production environments.
* Deep hands-on experience with CI/CD platforms (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Azure DevOps) and embedding security tooling into them.
* Strong cloud engineering skills on AWS and/or Azure, including IAM, networking, encryption, and logging/monitoring services.
* Production experience with Kubernetes and containers, including securing clusters and workloads at scale.
* Proficiency with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar) and at least one scripting/programming language (Python, Go, or Bash).
* Solid networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, routing and switching concepts, firewalls, security groups/NACLs, network segmentation, and troubleshooting with tools like tcpdump, dig, and Wireshark.
* Hands-on cloud networking experience: VPC/VNet design, load balancing, ingress controllers, service mesh (Istio/Linkerd), private connectivity, and zero-trust network patterns.
* Experience running observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Datadog, or similar) and using it to drive reliability and security outcomes.
* Working knowledge of application security: OWASP Top 10, dependency and supply-chain risk, secrets hygiene, and secure SDLC practices.
* Experience with security scanning and monitoring tooling (e.g., Snyk, Trivy, SonarQube, Wiz, Prisma Cloud, Falco, or equivalents).
* Clear, pragmatic communication — able to explain risk and trade-offs to both engineers and leadership, and to influence without authority.

**Nice to Have**

* Security certifications such as CISSP, CKS, OSCP, AWS/Azure security specialty, or GIAC; networking certifications such as CCNA or AWS Advanced Networking.
* Experience with multi-region, high-availability architectures, disaster recovery, and chaos engineering practices.
* Experience in payments, fintech, retail, or other PCI DSS-regulated environments.
* Exposure to zero-trust architectures, SIEM/SOAR platforms, or building internal security platforms and paved-road tooling.
* Contributions to open-source security tooling or active participation in the security community.

**Interview Process**
Interview #1: Phone Screen with Talent Acquisition Team

title: Staff Site Reliability Engineer
description:
**About The Role**
We're looking for a Staff Site Reliability Engineer who is equally at home writing production software and running the infrastructure it lives on — and who wants to take ownership of one of the hardest, highest-leverage problems on our platform: intelligently managing a large fleet of GPU-backed models.
  
  
We run nearly 30 models across heterogeneous hardware, and keeping that fleet fast, reliable, and cost-effective is a serious engineering challenge. You'll build the GPU management and scheduling platform that sits at the center of it — collecting utilization and load metrics, interpreting what they actually mean, and using them to make real-time decisions about admission control and scaling. The goal: route and schedule inference calls so we use our capacity efficiently without exceeding it, and scale model replicas up and down automatically as demand shifts.
  
  
This is a senior role for someone with a decade in the field who can move fluidly between systems engineering and software development, and who is excited to own a complex, evolving system end to end.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  

* Design and build our GPU management and scheduling platform — the system that decides when, where, and how inference calls run across a fleet of ~30 models on heterogeneous hardware
* Build the metrics pipeline that collects GPU load and utilization data, and the logic that turns those signals into decisions
* Implement admission control to protect capacity — deciding when to accept, queue, or shed inference requests so we operate within fleet limits
* Build autoscaling that adjusts the number of model replicas in response to real-time demand and utilization
* Develop cloud orchestration systems and operators in Python and Go to manage the model fleet
* Architect and operate scalable, fault-tolerant, secure production systems on AWS, GCP, or Azure
* Design and build infrastructure automation and deployment pipelines (Terraform, CI/CD) as first-class software
* Stand up and maintain monitoring, logging, and alerting that keep the platform reliable and performant
* Develop and enforce security and compliance policies appropriate to a healthcare AI platform
* Partner with engineers and research scientists to diagnose and resolve complex infrastructure, deployment, and operational issues
* Mentor engineers and raise the technical bar across the team

*We value in-person teamwork and believe the best ideas happen together. Our team is expected to be in the office five days a week in Gurugram. This role will also require engaging with a US based team requiring some flexibility for overlapping hours with California.*
What You Bring
  
  
*Must-Have*

* 10+ years of professional experience across site reliability / DevOps engineering and software engineering
* Computer Science Degree Required from a top CS program.
* Strong software engineering fundamentals — you build orchestration and scheduling systems in Python and/or Go, not just configure off-the-shelf tools
* Experience designing systems that make decisions from operational metrics — collecting signals, interpreting them, and driving control loops such as autoscaling, load shedding, or admission control
* Deep experience with infrastructure automation and CI/CD (Terraform, GitLab CI/CD, or similar)
* Hands-on production experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
* Strong knowledge of containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)
* Experience with monitoring and logging stacks (ELK, Grafana, Datadog, or similar)
* Familiarity with secrets management and security tooling (HashiCorp Vault, AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault)
* Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills

*Nice-to-Have*

* Experience managing GPU fleets or scheduling workloads across heterogeneous accelerators
* Familiarity with ML inference serving and model deployment (e.g. Triton, KServe, Ray Serve, or similar)
* Experience with Kubernetes autoscaling internals (HPA/VPA, custom metrics, custom controllers)
* Experience implementing HIPAA and SOC 2 compliance
* Experience operating in an HPC environment
* Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field

Join our team at Hippocratic AI and help shape the future of clinically safe, production-grade AI systems.
  
  
**Why Join Hippocratic AI**
**Reinvent healthcare with AI that puts safety first.**
We’re building the world’s first healthcare‑only, safety‑focused LLM — a breakthrough platform designed to transform patient outcomes at a global scale. This is category creation.
  
  
**Work with the people shaping the future.**
Hippocratic AI was co‑founded by CEO Munjal Shah and a team of physicians, hospital leaders, AI pioneers, and researchers from institutions like El Camino Health, Johns Hopkins, Washington University in St. Louis, Stanford, Google, Meta, Microsoft, and NVIDIA.
  
  
**Backed by the world’s leading healthcare and AI investors.**
We recently raised a $126M Series C at a $3.5B valuation, led by Avenir Growth, bringing total funding to $404M with participation from CapitalG, General Catalyst, a16z, Kleiner Perkins, Premji Invest, UHS, Cincinnati Children’s, WellSpan Health, John Doerr, Rick Klausner, and others.
  
  
**Build alongside the best in healthcare and AI.**
Join experts who’ve spent their careers improving care, advancing science, and building world‑changing technologies — ensuring our platform is powerful, trusted, and truly transformative.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity**
Hippocratic AI is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are committed to building a team that reflects the patients we serve. We actively encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds. If you require accommodations during the hiring process, please contact people@hippocraticai.com.
  
  
***Please be aware of recruitment scams impersonating Hippocratic AI. All recruiting communication will come from @***
***hippocraticai.com***
***email addresses. We will never request payment or sensitive personal information during the hiring process.***
