title: Site Reliability Engineer – Personal
description:
**Job Description**

* Accountabilities and Responsibilities

Personal AI Product – Bespoke SRE Accountabilities
  
  
 Engineer, operate and continuously improve the approved Personal AI toolset, covering Copilot for personal
  
  
productivity, Claude Desktop, Claude Code and Google Gemini, including enterprise configuration, client
  
  
operation and approved integrations within the team’s remit.
  
  
 Define and monitor service health indicators and service level objectives with the Senior Product Manager
  
  
Personal AI, using available telemetry and colleague feedback to identify availability, performance and user-
  
  
experience issues. Distinguish internally controlled components from supplier-managed services and escalate
  
  
dependencies appropriately.
  
  
 Investigate and resolve incidents and recurring problems across the Personal AI toolset, coordinating with
  
  
service support, endpoint, identity, network and security teams and technology vendors. Maintain runbooks,
  
  
known-error records and recovery procedures, and translate post-incident learning into reliability
  
  
improvements.
  
  
 Automate repeatable administration, configuration validation, provisioning and operational checks through
  
  
approved scripts, APIs and tooling, reducing manual effort and maintaining auditable configuration baselines.
  
  
 Work with endpoint and identity teams to support controlled deployment, updates, authentication, access
  
  
and licence lifecycle management. Test changes and vendor releases for compatibility, security and colleague
  
  
impact, with documented rollback or recovery arrangements where supported.
  
  
 Implement approved security, privacy and responsible AI controls with the relevant specialists, including data
  
  
handling, permissions and integration boundaries. For Claude Code and other tools capable of taking actions,
  
  
apply approved restrictions on execution, credentials and access to repositories and enterprise resources.
  
  
 Contribute to ongoing market scanning of new and emerging personal AI tools and vendor capabilities. Assess
  
  
technical fit, enterprise manageability, reliability, integration requirements, risks and indicative operating
  
  
costs, presenting evidence-based recommendations to the Senior Product Manager Personal AI.
  
  
 Run technical discovery with colleagues and partner teams to understand productivity needs, test
  
  
assumptions and assess feasibility. Translate findings into options, technical requirements and prioritised
  
  
engineering backlog items for product review.
  
  
**Job Description**
 Document pilot findings and recommend whether to progress, iterate or stop. Prepare successful capabilities
  
  
for production through operational readiness checks, monitoring, support ownership, documentation and
  
  
knowledge transfer; remove pilot access and resources when no longer required.
  
  
 Monitor available usage, licence utilisation and consumption data to identify waste, capacity constraints and
  
  
improvement opportunities. Provide technical evidence to support product investment and licence decisions
  
  
without compromising colleague privacy.
  
  
 Partner with adoption and support teams to create technical guidance and troubleshooting material, and use
  
  
colleague feedback to improve service quality. Provide engineering estimates, risks and dependencies to the
  
  
Senior Product Manager Personal AI, who retains ownership of product priorities and roadmap decisions.
  
  
Programming/Software Development (SFIA Level 3, PROG)
  
  

* Designs, codes, verifies, tests, documents, amends and refactors moderately complex programmes/scripts.
* Applies agreed standards, tools and security measures to achieve a well- engineered result.
* Monitors and reports on progress.
* Identifies issues related to software development activities.
* Proposes practical solutions to resolve issues.
* Collaborates in reviews of work with others as appropriate.
* Builds and maintains automation, tooling and scripts used to improve reliability, deployment and operational

workflows.
  
  

* Reviews and improves code or automation created by self and peers.

Systems and Software Lifecycle Engineering (SFIA Level 4, SLEN)
  
  

* Elicits requirements for systems and software lifecycle working practices and automation.
* Prepares design options for the working environment of methods, procedures, techniques, tools and people.
* Selects systems and software lifecycle working practices for software components and micro-services.
* Deploys automation to achieve well-engineered and secure outcomes.
* Improves lifecycle practices by embedding reliability, operability and automation early in delivery.
* Supports CI/CD and operational automation to deliver secure and well-engineered systems.

Configuration Management (SFIA Level 3, CFMG)
  
  

* Applies tools, techniques and processes to track, log and correct information related to configuration items.
* Verifies and approves changes to protect assets and components from unauthorised change, diversion and

inappropriate use.
  
  

* Supports user compliance with identification standards for object types, environments, processes, lifecycles,

documentation, versions, formats, baselines, releases and templates.
  
  

* Performs audits to check the accuracy of the information and undertakes any necessary corrective action

under direction.
  
  

* Improves configuration consistency, traceability and auditability through automation and tooling.
* Identifies configuration related reliability risks and supports corrective actions.

Requirements Definition and Management (SFIA Level 4, REQM)
  
  

* Defines and manages scoping, requirements definition and prioritisation activities for initiatives of medium

size and complexity.
  
  

* Contributes to selecting the requirements approach.
* Facilitates input from stakeholders, provides constructive challenge and enables effective prioritisation of

requirements.
  
  

* Establishes requirements baselines or backlogs, obtains appropriate agreement to requirements and ensures

traceability to source.
  
  

* Defines and prioritises requirements related to reliability, resilience, operability and risk.
* Provides constructive challenge to requirements that introduce reliability or operational risk.

**Job Description**
Release Management (SFIA Level 4, RELM)
  
  

* Plans and schedules releases in line with business requirements and objectives.
* Coordinates release activities across multiple teams and stakeholders.
* Manages the release lifecycle, ensuring timely and quality deliverables.
* Ensures releases meet defined quality, security and compliance standards.
* Communicates release plans, progress and outcomes to stakeholders.
* Conducts post-release reviews and identifies areas for improvement.
* Leads release readiness from a reliability and operational risk perspective.
* Ensures releases meet agreed quality, resilience, security and compliance expectations.

Testing (SFIA Level 3, TEST)
  
  

* Designs test cases and test scripts under own direction, mapping back to pre- determined criteria, recording

and reporting test outcomes.
  
  

* Participates in requirement, design and specification reviews, and uses this information to design test plans

and test conditions.
  
  

* Applies agreed standards to specify and perform manual and automated testing.
* Automates testing tasks and builds test coverage through existing or new infrastructure.
* Analyses and reports on test activities, results, issues and risks.
* Supports testing strategies that validate reliability, recovery and failure scenarios.
* Uses test outcomes and incidents to drive reliability improvements.

System Integration and Build (SFIA Level 3, SINT)
  
  

* Defines the modules and components and dependencies needed for an integration build and produces a

build definition.
  
  

* Accepts completed modules and components, checking that they meet defined criteria.
* Produces builds from system components for loading onto target environments.
* Configures the hardware, software and infrastructure environment as required by the system being

integrated.
  
  

* Produces integration test specifications, conducts tests and records and reports on outcomes.
* Diagnoses faults and documents the results of tests.
* Produces system integration reports.
* Supports integration and build activities with a focus on reliability, recoverability and operational readiness.
* Diagnoses and resolves complex integration issues that impact system stability.

Personal Capability Building
  
  

* Develop own capabilities by participating in assessment and development planning activities as well as formal

and informal training, coaching and practical application.
  
  

* Gain or maintain external professional accreditation, where relevant, to improve performance and fulfil

personal potential.
  
  

* Maintain an understanding of relevant technology, external regulation, and industry best practices through

ongoing education, attending conferences, and reading specialist media.
  
  

* Champions blameless learning and continuous reliability improvement
* Contributes to professions and communities of practice by sharing knowledge, adopting agreed standards,

and supporting consistency of ways of working across teams
  
  
Behavioural Competencies
  
  
Ensures Accountability
  
  
**Job Description**
Holds self and others accountable to meet commitments. For example, accepts responsibility for own work, both
  
  
successes and failures. Handles fair share and does not make excuses for problems. Usually meets commitments
  
  
to others.
  
  
Manages Complexity
  
  
Makes sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.
  
  
For example, looks at complex issues from multiple angles; explores issues to uncover underlying issues and root
  
  
causes; sees the main consequences and implications of different options.
  
  
Effective Decisions
  
  
Makes good and timely decisions that keep the organisation moving forward. For example, knows when to act
  
  
independently and when to escalate issues. Integrates various inputs, decision criteria, and trade-offs to make
  
  
effective decisions. Typically makes good independent decisions.
  
  
Takes Action
  
  
Takes on new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm. For
  
  
example, takes timely action on important or difficult issues. Identifies and pursues new opportunities that
  
  
benefit the organisation.
  
  
Collaborates
  
  
Builds partnerships and works collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives. For example, readily involves
  
  
others to accomplish goals; stays in touch and shares information; discourages "us versus them" thinking; shows
  
  
appreciation for others' ideas and input. Acts as a senior individual contributor, mentoring less experienced
  
  
engineers and sharing reliability expertise. Influences practices through example, review and collaboration rather
  
  
than formal authority
  
  
Customer Centric
  
  
Builds strong customer relationships and delivers customer-centric solutions. For example, keeps in contact with
  
  
customers to ensure problems are resolved, or to improve customer service. Studies customer feedback and
  
  
emerging customer needs and uses these to determine some creative new ideas.
  
  
Optimises Work Processes
  
  
Knows the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement.
  
  
For example, uses metrics and benchmarks to monitor accuracy and quality. Takes steps to make methods
  
  
productive and efficient. Promptly and effectively addresses process breakdowns.
  
  
Plans and Aligns
  
  
Plans and prioritises work to meet commitments aligned with organisational goals. For example, outlines clear
  
  
plans that put actions in a logical sequence; conveys some time frames. Aligns own work with relevant
  
  
workgroups. Takes some steps to reduce bottlenecks and speed up the work.
  
  
Self-Development
  
  
Actively seeks new ways to grow and be challenged using both formal and informal development channels. For
  
  
example, creates a development plan that states clear goals and the tactics to achieve them. Gathers information
  
  
on where to focus. Makes efforts to apply new skills on the job.
  
  

* Experience and Qualifications

The role holder is expected to have the following experience and qualifications:
  
  

* Significant professional experience (typically 5–8 years) in Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, software

engineering, or production operations within complex, live environments.
  
  

* Proven ability to design, build, and operate reliable, scalable systems, balancing availability, performance,

and security.
  
  

* Strong hands‑on experience with automation, scripting, and tooling to reduce toil and improve system

reliability.
  
  

* Experience designing and maintaining monitoring, alerting, incident response, and on‑call practices.

**Job Description**

* Leads investigation and resolution of complex incidents, including root cause analysis and post‑incident

improvements.
  
  

* Applies systems and software lifecycle practices, including CI/CD, testing, release, configuration, and

integration.
  
  

* Owns or leads medium‑to‑complex reliability initiatives, including requirements definition, planning, and

delivery.
  
  

* Operates with a high degree of autonomy and provides technical guidance and mentoring to less experienced

SREs.
  
  

* Experience working in governed or regulated environments, with awareness of risk, resilience, and customer

impact.
  
  

* Hands-on experience administering or supporting enterprise AI productivity tools, ideally including one or

more of Copilot for personal productivity, Claude Desktop, Claude Code and Google Gemini, with the ability
  
  
to develop expertise across the Personal AI portfolio.
  
  

* Experience supporting SaaS services and desktop clients, including enterprise configuration, identity and

access dependencies, endpoint deployment, approved integrations and vendor escalation.
  
  

* Ability to assess emerging AI capabilities and run structured technical discovery, proofs of concept and pilots,

using clear success criteria and evidence to inform recommendations and production readiness.
  
  

* Practical understanding of enterprise AI risks and controls, including sensitive data handling, permissions,

unreliable outputs and security boundaries for AI tools that can execute actions; able to work with security,
  
  
privacy and responsible AI specialists.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* A degree or equivalent qualification in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering,

or Information Technology
  
  
or
  
  

* Demonstrable equivalent professional experience supported by continuous learning and development.

**Certifications:**

* Associate or professional‑level cloud, DevOps, or SRE‑related certifications are desirable but not mandatory.

Professional and Leadership Expectations
  
  
 Operates as a trusted senior engineer, providing technical leadership and assurance for complex cloud
  
  
solutions within a defined domain.
  
  
 Demonstrates strong professional judgement in addressing ambiguity, managing risk, and making decisions
  
  
that protect service reliability and security.
  
  
 Influences and improves engineering practices through mentoring, design reviews, and contribution to
  
  
shared standards and patterns.
  
  
 Takes accountability for technical outcomes beyond immediate tasks, considering longer-term sustainability
  
  
and operational impact.
  
  
 Models professional behaviours, collaboration and integrity, and actively supports the development of
  
  
engineering capability across teams.
  
  

* Treating Customers Fairly

You should be able to demonstrate that you pay due regard to customers and treat them fairly by:
  
  

* Making the fair treatment of customers central to all organisational changes, procedural changes and policy

decisions that you make, approve or oversee.
  
  

* Always demonstrating fair customer treatment to other employees – leading by example.
* Rewarding the fair treatment of customers by other employees.
* Being able to explain the impact that your role and actions have on the fair treatment of customers.
* Being able to explain the potential implications for customers who are not treated fairly by you or others.

**Job Description**

* Always seeking to be competent to do your job e.g. by completing all compulsory regulatory training on time

to ensure that you have all the necessary knowledge and skills.
  
  

* Always seeking to help those people who work for you to be competent to do their jobs e.g. by ensuring that

they complete all compulsory regulatory training on time.
  
  

* Conduct Principles
* You must act with integrity.
* You must act with due skill and diligence.
* You must be open and cooperative with the FCA, the PRA and other regulators.
* You must pay due regard to the interests of customers and treat them fairly.
* You must observe proper standards of market conduct.
* You must take reasonable steps to ensure that the business of the firm for which you are responsible is

controlled effectively.
  
  

* You must take reasonable steps to ensure the business of the firm for which you are responsible complies

with the relevant requirements and standards of the regulatory system.
  
  

* You must take reasonable steps to ensure that any delegation of your responsibilities is to an appropriate

person and that you must oversee the discharge of the delegated responsibility effectively.
  
  

* You must disclose appropriately any information of which the PRA and FCA would reasonably expect notice.
* You must act to deliver good outcomes for retail customers.
* Fitness and Propriety

You must take reasonable steps to ensure the areas you are accountable for are managed with appropriate due skill,
  
  
care and diligence to comply with PRA and FCA requirements. Failure to do so could result in fines and suspensions by
  
  
the regulators and consequently could also impact on the role holder’s ability to continue to perform in role.

title: User Experience Researcher
description:
**Role:**
UX Researcher

**Function:**
UX Research / Product Research

**Location:**
Delhi (Onsite)

**Type:**
Full-time

**Industry:**
Broadcast Media, Online Media, Media Production

**About Company**

One of India's largest private FM radio networks, reaching 40 million+ listeners weekly. The company broadcasts across 49 cities, 1,000+ towns, and 50,000 villages.

Owned by Reliance Broadcast Network Limited, it is the only private FM station broadcasting from Jammu & Kashmir. The company also has an international presence in Singapore and Bhutan.

Its digital platform, extends the brand with curated music, news, and lifestyle content. Teams work at the intersection of legacy radio and a fast-growing digital product.

**Position Overview**

This role sits at the heart of the company's digital product team, driving research across the full lifecycle of the FM app — from 0→1 concept validation through post-launch iteration. The researcher will translate user needs, behaviours, and content consumption patterns into clear, actionable insights that directly shape product and design decisions. This is an independent contributor role requiring the ability to identify the right research questions, not just answer them.

**Role & Responsibilities**

* Plan and execute end-to-end UX research using methods such as user interviews, usability testing, contextual inquiry, surveys, concept testing, diary studies, and competitor research.
* Lead 0→1 discovery research to validate product concepts and experiences before development begins.
* Conduct independent user interviews and synthesise qualitative findings into clear themes, insights, and prioritised recommendations for Product and Design teams.
* Combine qualitative research with behavioural and product data (GA4, Mixpanel, Amplitude, Firebase, Hotjar/FullStory or similar) to surface patterns and opportunities.
* Evaluate existing app experiences, identify friction points, and run pre- and post-launch usability studies for upcoming releases.
* Partner with Product, Design, Engineering, and Business stakeholders to ensure research insights are embedded in product decisions.
* Build and maintain an insights repository and longitudinal understanding of user behaviour to support ongoing product strategy.

**Must Have Criteria**

* 3–5 years of hands-on UX Research or Product Research experience on consumer digital products.
* Demonstrated ability to independently plan and conduct user interviews, usability studies, and qualitative research end-to-end.
* Hands-on experience leading at least one 0→1 product research initiative (discovery through concept validation).
* Proficiency with at least one analytics or behavioural research tool — GA4, Mixpanel, Amplitude, Firebase, Hotjar, or FullStory.
* Proven ability to translate research findings into specific, actionable product and design recommendations.
* Strong command of research methodology selection — knowing when to use qualitative vs. quantitative approaches.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in media, entertainment, OTT, audio streaming, or high-engagement consumer app verticals.
* Exposure to content consumption research or audience behaviour studies.
* Experience working in a fast-scaling digital product environment with evolving requirements.
* Familiarity with maintaining a structured research repository or insights management system.

**What We Offer**

* Direct impact on a digital product used by millions of listeners across India.
* Opportunity to shape the company's app from early-stage research through to post-launch iteration.
* Cross-functional collaboration with Product, Design, Engineering, and Business leadership.
* A creative, media-first work culture at the intersection of legacy broadcasting and digital innovation.
* Onsite role based out of Delhi.

**About This Role**

We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

* Develop and collect metrics to drive continuous improvement of existing products
* Deliver high quality features which can be tested and adheres to reporting standards
* As needed, lead small development teams to bring a project to market
* Mentor other engineering teammates to help elevate their experience and knowledge

**What We Look For{{{{~}}}}**

* At least 7 years of full-stack software engineering experience
* Experience bringing new ideas and building consensus on the path forward
* Experience with building and serving REST APIs using Go (preferably) and Java Python or a similar language.
* Experience working in a distributed, cloud-based architecture, with either design patterns like transactional outboxes, or queuing tools like RabbitMQ, SQS, Kafka
* Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

**Preferred Knowledge and Skills{{{{~}}}}**

* Experience with SQL based RDMS through an ORM tool
* Comfortable using observability platforms like Prometheus, or vendor solutions like NewRelic or Datadog to instrument your code for production monitoring and alerting.
* DevOps experience with CI/CD pipelines
* Familiarity with containerized micro-service architecture deployed with Kubernetes on AWS
* Demonstrated history of delivering commercial APIs and web applications
* A clear record of getting products to market and prioritizing solutions and improvements based on stakeholder/customer feedback.

**About You{{{{~}}}}**

* You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
* You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
* You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
* You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
* You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
* You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

**Sezzle’s Technology Stack{{{{~}}}}**

* Languages{{{{~}}}} Golang, Typescript, Python
* Frontend{{{{~}}}} Typescript - React and React Native
* Backend{{{{~}}}} Golang
* Database{{{{~}}}} MySQL, Postgres, Elasticsearch
* DevOps & Cloud{{{{~}}}} AWS, Kubernetes
* Version Control{{{{~}}}} Git
* CI/CD{{{{~}}}} Gitlab
* Testing{{{{~}}}} Developer-driven, focus on automated unit, integration, and end-to-end tests
* Sezzle is focused on using open source, and we build what we can before buying!

**What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome?**
At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

About Team
  
  
The IT SaaS Engineering Team is the backbone of MongoDB's go-to-market operations. We build and run the Salesforce platform — with the automation, security, and governance that Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Security, and Compliance rely on daily to manage customer relationships and drive business growth.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We're hiring a Technical Staff Engineer - Salesforce to own the architecture, design, and evolution of our CRM platform. This role combines deep technical leadership, hands-on solution design, and a modern engineering mindset that embraces AI-powered development responsibly. As a senior individual contributor, this person sets technical direction and raises the engineering bar through architecture, design, and mentorship.
  
  
What You'll do
  
  

* Lead architecture, design, and development of scalable Salesforce solutions — custom applications, automations, and integrations
* Translate business requirements into secure, maintainable, technical solutions aligned with long-term platform strategy
* Partner with business stakeholders, product teams, and engineering to refine requirements and deliver high-quality solutions
* Oversee integrations between Salesforce and other enterprise platforms, ensuring reliable data flow and sound system design
* Drive platform optimization across performance, scalability, usability, and governance
* Establish and enforce engineering standards for coding, testing, documentation, CI/CD, and release management
* Troubleshoot complex production issues and drive long-term, scalable resolutions
* Identify tech debt and drive modernization efforts across the Salesforce ecosystem
* Leverage AI-powered engineering tools (Apex Guru, GitHub Copilot, Salesforce Agentforce Vibes, Claude Code) to improve productivity and code quality — with strong judgment on security, privacy, and accuracy.

**Responsibilities**

* Provide technical leadership through architecture reviews, design reviews, code reviews, and engineering best practices
* Act as a subject matter expert on Salesforce development, platform capabilities, automation, integrations, and scalable CRM solution design
* Lead technical design sessions and identify gaps between current-state and future-state solutions
* Evaluate emerging technologies, frameworks, and engineering practices, and drive proof-of-concepts where appropriate
* Mentor engineers across the team and foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, continuous learning, and engineering excellence
* Support team growth by coaching, developing talent, and helping build a high-performing engineering organization
* Influence business and technical stakeholders through strong communication, sound judgment, and effective problem-solving
* Operate effectively in a fast-changing environment by managing priorities, driving accountability, and ensuring high-quality execution

**Minimum Requirements**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field
* 9+ years of Salesforce engineering or technical leadership experience within global SaaS organizations
* 2+ years directly managing engineering teams — hiring, performance management, and career development
* Strong hands-on experience with Sales Cloud (opportunity/lead management, forecasting, territory/assignment rules) and Experience Cloud (portal architecture, sharing sets, guest user security, community licensing) required.
* Strong hands-on experience with Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, integrations, and platform customization
* Strong understanding of Salesforce architecture, governor limits, design patterns, and scalable solution design
* Experience with DevOps, CI/CD, release management, and Agile/Scrum delivery
* Salesforce certified Application Architect and System Architect certifications strongly preferred

Success Measures
  
  

* In 3 months, you will: Develop a strong understanding of MongoDB’s Salesforce ecosystem, business processes, and technical landscape. Build trusted relationships with key stakeholders and engineering partners
* In 6 months, you will: Lead the technical design and successful delivery of critical Salesforce initiatives. Establish yourself as a trusted technical leader within the Sales Apps team
* In 12 months, you will: Be the go-to technical leader for Salesforce architecture, complex solution design, and platform strategy. Elevate team quality through strong technical leadership, mentoring, and scalable engineering practices

**About MongoDB**
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
  
  
With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
  
  
Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
  
  
To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!
  
  
MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.
  
  
MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

**About Us**
MongoDB, Inc. provides an intelligent data platform for modern applications. It was founded in 2007 (originally as 10gen) by Dwight Merriman, Eliot Horowitz and Kevin Ryan. It has US headquarters in New York City and international headquarters in Dublin, and is listed on Nasdaq (MDB). The company says it has 5,600+ employees around the globe and 70,000+ customers.
  
  
Follow MongoDB
  
  
LinkedIn Instagram YouTube Facebook Twitter Website
  
  
Benefits & perks
  
  

* Formal wellness program MongoDB Bloom, covering physical, emotional, financial, and family & community well-being, with monthly educational sessions.
* Flexible PTO (official benefits blog; no fixed global day count is published there).
* New parents receive up to 20 weeks of fully paid parental leave, plus an additional four weeks of fully paid flexible work arrangements to return; eligibility varies by location and tenure.
* Parenting workshops and Cleo, which provides fully personalized counseling on the journey to parenthood.
* 15 days of subsidized backup care per year for employees in the U.S., Canada, and some countries in Europe.
* Global fertility and adoption assistance with Carrot: MongoDB reimburses 90% of covered costs, up to a $50,000 USD lifetime maximum for U.S. employees and the equivalent of $20,000 USD lifetime maximum for non-U.S. employees (the amount varies by country).
* Regional Employee Assistance Programs (EAPs) with a 24/7 hotline and three free sessions with local mental health counselors.
* Spring Health mental health service in the U.S. for employees and their family members.
* Headspace offered free to global employees and their family members.
* A global Mental Health First Aiders team of MongoDB employees trained to spot signs that someone needs emotional support and to direct them to resources.
* Wellness events and programs, including virtual yoga and bootcamp classes, meditation and mindfulness sessions, nutrition sessions, fitness challenges, and global wellness workshops.
* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision health care packages.
* Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP).
* Company coverage of transactional fees when employees donate to charities through Bright Funds.
* Enhanced Gender Affirmation services for U.S. employees (MongoDB says it is among the 7% of Cigna's client companies offering expanded services; official examples include health-plan coverage for medically necessary treatments such as hormone therapy and gender-affirming surgery).
* Global mobility across 40+ offices, including internal transfers and relocation depending on the role.
* Role-dependent working models: In-Office (typically 3-5 days a week), Flexible (typically 1-2 days a week in office), fully remote, and customer-facing remote, agreed with managers.
* Employee resource groups including Config.MDB (neurodivergent employees and employees with disabilities), MDBWomen, Queer Collective, Queeries, MDBWomen in Sales, and MongoDB Veterans.

Why explore a career with us
  
  
Unleash the power of software and data: MongoDB's official mission is to unleash the power of software and data, enabling teams to build for what's next. The company says it provides an intelligent data platform for modern, real-time, hybrid, multi-cloud applications and has 70,000+ customers.
  
  
Live a published set of values: MongoDB's official values are Think Big, Go Far; Build Together; Embrace the Power of Differences; Make it Matter; Own What You Do; and Be Intellectually Honest. The company also publishes a Leadership Commitment that all employees are expected to live.
  
  
Choose a working model that fits the role: Official careers pages describe role-dependent ways of working, agreed with managers: In-Office (typically 3-5 days a week at a dedicated desk), Flexible (typically 1-2 days a week at a shared desk, with the rest remote), fully remote, and customer-facing remote roles. MongoDB also notes global mobility across 40+ offices, with internal transfers and relocation depending on the role.
  
  
Benefits built around four well-being pillars: Official benefits sit under physical, emotional, financial, and family & community well-being, supported by the formal wellness program MongoDB Bloom. Published examples include flexible PTO, up to 20 weeks of fully paid parental leave plus four weeks of paid flexible return (eligibility varies by location and tenure), and a global Carrot fertility and adoption benefit.
  
  
Inclusion, employee groups, and recognized leadership: Official employee resource groups include Config.MDB, MDBWomen, Queer Collective, Queeries, MDBWomen in Sales, and MongoDB Veterans. In 2025 MongoDB was named a Glassdoor Best-Led Company, a list of 50 companies with more than 1,000 employees that Glassdoor says is based on employee feedback rather than self-nomination.
  
  
Interview process
  
  
Step 1 - Recruiter conversation: Candidates share their career ambitions and learn more about MongoDB in a recruiter conversation. The official Engineering careers page says this is not a rigid process and can vary by role or region.
  
  
Step 2 - Initial technical interview: An initial technical interview is used to assess the candidate's technical acumen.
  
  
Step 3 - Technical assessments: Candidates meet peers through assessments related to system design and coding.
  
  
Step 4 - Director/VP interview: A Director or VP interview is used to find out more about the bigger picture.
  
  
Step 5 - Job offer: If an offer is extended and accepted, MongoDB begins the onboarding process.

description:

We are a network and digital integrator that understands the entire value chain of the digital world, freeing our customers to focus on the strategic initiatives that shape their business.
  
  
Every day, you will collaborate with a team dedicated to providing consistent, sustainable global solutions, no matter where our customers operate. With over 30,000 employees across Asia, the Americas, Africa, and Europe, we offer a dynamic environment to develop and perfect your skills in a field filled with exciting challenges and opportunities.
  
  
**About The Role**
Advance the development and enhancement of innovative software solutions that optimize and scale network infrastructure aligned with Orange's strategic goals, while coordinating effectively across teams and maintaining a focus on reliability and quality.
  
  

* Develop, test, and maintain applications, tools, and features specifically for Network Planning.
* Coordinate with product owners and stakeholders to clarify requirements and convert them into practical technical solutions.
* Contribute to software design ensuring solutions are reliable, maintainable, and suitable for purpose.
* Work in teamwork with engineers and cross-functional teams to deliver project goals efficiently.
* Investigate and resolve software issues assisting continuous improvement of existing systems.
* Participate in code reviews and adhere to established coding standards and development practices.
* Create and maintain clear technical documentation for developed software and tools.
* Stay current with relevant technologies and communicate best practices and knowledge within the team.
* Work with minimal supervision to achieve agreed deliverables, seeking guidance from experienced staff as appropriate.
* Supports Network Planning initiatives that enhance the efficiency and scalability of Orange's network infrastructure.
* Builds software tools aligned with Orange Business and Orange Wholesale strategic goals to facilitate business growth.
* Coordinates closely with stakeholders to ensure software systems remain reliable and adaptable to changing network demands.
* Engages in continuous professional development and technical contribution with opportunities for progression into advanced technical roles based on demonstrated expertise.
* Facilitates knowledge transfer and supports innovation within the technical community.

**About You**
You possess solid experience in software development, with a focus on writing secure, maintainable, and scalable code. Your expertise with Python and Pandas enables you to efficiently process and evaluate data, supported by methodical and troubleshooting skills that facilitate practical solutions. You have proficiency in API design, unit testing, Git, CI/CD, SQL databases, and Linux systems, and you follow technical designs and architectural guidance confidently. Educational background includes a bachelor's degree in computer science or related fields, with relevant certifications and 3+ years of hands-on software engineering experience. You communicate technical concepts clearly and approach methodical thinking with structure and flexibility, contributing effectively to team goals.
  
  
**Your professional skills:**

* Exhibit solid experience in software development by producing secure, clean, maintainable, and scalable code.
* Demonstrate strong knowledge of Python and utilize Pandas for effective data processing, manipulation, and evaluation.
* Apply methodical and troubleshooting skills to interpret data, diagnose issues, and deliver practical technical solutions.
* Develop and integrate APIs, working knowledge in HTTP communication, RESTful API standards, and ORM frameworks.
* Implement unit testing following testing standards and use relevant tools to ensure code quality.
* Utilize Git for source control and apply CI/CD and DevOps practices to streamline development processes.
* Execute database operations using SQL with experience in industry-standard databases like MySQL, MariaDB, or Microsoft SQL Server.
* Operate confidently within Linux-based environments and follow technical and architectural guidelines from experienced engineers.
* Understand web technologies including PHP, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS to assist full-stack development as needed.
* Possess foundational knowledge of computer networking and experience with cloud platforms, containerization tools such as Docker, and preferably Kubernetes.

**Your soft skills:**

* Communic ate technical concepts clearly to diverse audiences, including non-technical stakeholders.
* Approach methodical thinking with a structured and critical thinking mindset.
* Manage time effectively to consistently deliver work according to agreed schedules.
* Adapt to new technologies and evolving project needs with a willingness to learn and grow.
* Coordinate proactively with team members to contribute positively toward mutual goals.

title: Sitecore Developer
description:
**Location: Gurugram (Onsite)**
**About The Job**
Are you passionate about building modern digital experiences and solving complex technical challenges? Do you enjoy working with Sitecore, .NET and web technologies while continuously looking for better ways to build and improve? In that case, we might have the right opportunity for you!
  
  
In Website Technology, we are responsible for developing and evolving Saxo’s global websites and the technology that enables our digital content and customer experiences.
  
  
As our new Senior Sitecore Developer, you will play an important role in developing and maintaining our Sitecore platform and building scalable, reliable and high-performing web solutions. You will work hands-on with Sitecore and .NET while contributing to technical design, integrations, performance and continuous improvements across our website ecosystem.
  
  
You will collaborate closely with developers, Product Owners, UX, content and other technology teams, taking solutions from requirements and technical design through development, testing and deployment.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design, develop and maintain scalable solutions using Sitecore, .NET and C#.
* Develop reusable Sitecore components, templates, pipelines and integrations.
* Design and integrate APIs and services connecting Sitecore with other platforms.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex application, CMS, integration and performance issues.
* Write clean, maintainable and testable code, supported by appropriate unit and automated tests.
* Contribute to UAT preparation and execution, helping define meaningful test scenarios and ensuring solutions meet the intended business requirements.
* Use AI-assisted development tools effectively and responsibly to improve coding efficiency, accelerate problem-solving and enhance code quality, while maintaining strong engineering judgement and ownership of the final solution.
* Participate in code reviews and contribute to technical standards and development best practices.
* Collaborate with Product Owners, UX, QA and other developers to turn business requirements into effective technical solutions.
* Contribute to improvements in website performance, accessibility, SEO, resilience and the overall customer experience.
* Mentor and support other developers and share technical knowledge across the team.

**Your profile**
As a person, you are curious, collaborative and comfortable taking ownership of technical solutions. You enjoy solving complex problems and are not afraid to challenge existing solutions when you see an opportunity to make them simpler, more scalable or more reliable.
  
  
You are comfortable working in a cross-functional environment and can communicate technical topics clearly with both technical and non-technical colleagues. You are interested in understanding the business need behind a requirement rather than focusing only on its implementation.
  
  
You have solid hands-on software development experience and strong knowledge within some of the following areas:
  
  

* Sitecore CMS development, preferably Sitecore 9 or 10
* C# and .NET
* Sitecore architecture, templates, components and pipelines
* Solr, search and Sitecore indexing
* REST APIs and system integrations
* Git and CI/CD development practices
* Unit testing and automated testing
* UAT preparation, test scenarios and validation of business requirements
* Modern, scalable and high-performing web architectures
* Effective use of AI-assisted development tools to improve developer productivity and software quality

It will be an advantage if you have knowledge or hands-on experience within some of the following areas:
  
  

* Umbraco CMS
* React and TypeScript
* Kubernetes or Azure
* Kafka or event-driven architecture
* Web accessibility and WCAG
* Technical SEO and Core Web Vitals
* Large, multilingual or multi-market websites

Sitecore or Microsoft certifications are an advantage, but practical experience, technical curiosity and the ability to build robust solutions are equally important.
  
  
**We get curious people invested in the world**
When you work at Saxo, you become a Saxonian and part of a purpose-driven organisation, where good ideas are always taken seriously, and where you can make a true impact. We are invested in your development, and you can expect a robust career from day one when you join Saxo – no matter which role you take on.
  
  
You will join 2,500 other ambitious colleagues across 11 countries and become part of an international organisation. Working in Saxo, you will get to meet colleagues from many different cultures and backgrounds, and you should know that we value diversity and inclusion and see it as a genuine source of strength to drive growth, foster innovation and position us for long-term success.
  
  
We encourage an open feedback culture and supportive team environments enabling employees to grow and fulfil their career aspirations.
  
  
When you bring passion, curiosity, drive and team spirit, your learning journey will be dynamic and your career opportunities in Saxo will be immense.
  
  
At Saxo we don’t just offer a job – we offer an opportunity to invest in your future!

title: Senior Software Engineer (PAM)
description:
Bitwarden is the trusted identity security leader for millions of users worldwide, empowering enterprises, developers, and individuals to securely manage and share sensitive information anywhere. Bitwarden makes it easy for all users to extend robust security across their devices with password management, secrets management, and passwordless and passkey innovations. The company is headquartered in Santa Barbara, California. Learn more at bitwarden.com.
  
  
As a Senior Software Engineer on Bitwarden’s Privileged Access Management (PAM) team, you will lead the design and development of our next-generation privileged access platform. You'll own critical gateway services, terminal access protocols, and auditing/enforcement at the intersection of security, scalability, and user experience.
  
  
In alignment with our modern
**True Ownership**
model, our engineers are "T-shaped" professionals who own their services end-to-end—from initial design and secure development to automated testing, deployment, and operational health in production. This role offers unique opportunities to build secure-by-default patterns and make significant contributions to our open-source security ecosystem.
  
  
**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* End-to-End Delivery: Support Bitwarden goals by designing, developing, testing, deploying, and operating secure, performant gateway controls, audited terminal logins, and session recording mechanics for our PAM product line.
* Decoupled Architecture: Maintain strict service boundaries and design resilient APIs that allow the PAM platform to operate as an independent, decoupled tenant on our core platform infrastructure.
* Upstream Collaboration: Partner closely in a co-located, cross-functional "Embedded Trio" (Product, Design, and Engineering) to rapidly design and validate technical solutions prior to code implementation.
* Automated Quality: Eliminate manual testing barriers by building and maintaining robust automated test suites, integration harnesses, and CI/CD pipelines for your team's services.
* Operational Stewardship: Own the operational health, performance, and reliability telemetry of your services in production, proactively participating in sustainable on-call rotations and postmortem analyses.
* Documentation: Build and maintain high-quality internal architecture specifications, API contracts, and external open-source developer documentation.

**WHAT YOU BRING TO BITWARDEN**

* Overall Experience: 4+ years as a Software Engineer with team lead experience paired with AI assisted development practices, including experience leading a team's technical direction, mentoring senior engineers and being accountable for outcomes you did not implement yourself.
* Quality: Experience with JEST or any other unit testing framework. Set the bar in pull request review and own the team's conventions for testing, error handling, API design, and secure coding, keeping automated suites, integration harnesses, and CI/CD pipelines strong enough that manual testing is never the safety net. Maintain the architecture specifications, API contracts, and open source developer documentation that go with them.
* Technical Stack:Strong proficiency and experience in AI-Led Development in C# / .NET, Rust, or TypeScript.
* Security Domain Expertise: Practical experience designing or implementing secure gateway architectures, reverse proxies, and session proxying (SSH, RDP, or HTTPS).
* Identity & Auditing: Understanding of Identity and Access Management, key-rotation protocols, and real-time audit logging systems.
* T-Shaped Engineering Mindset: Practical experience with containerized environments (Docker/Kubernetes), automated test frameworks (unit, integration, and end-to-end), and SRE/observability tools (APM, alerting, and telemetry dashboards).
* Secure Coding: Familiarity with zero-trust and zero-knowledge security architectures, encryption standards and threat-modeling methodologies.
* Collaborative Spirit: A highly collaborative and adaptable mindset, excited to work in rapid, outcome-driven feedback loops.
* Open Source Passion: Excitement and enthusiasm for open source, developer advocacy, and building a more secure internet.
* Problem-Solving: Excellent problem-solving skills—valuing written, clear documentation and using data to make technical decisions.

**Why Join Us**
This is an opportunity to play a foundational role in shaping our India Engineering COE from the ground up. Our user community loves us and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone from our friends and family to the world’s largest organizations.
  
  
Become an expert. You’ll get immersed in the prominent technology markets of security and open source software. You'll work alongside talented global teams, solve meaningful engineering challenges, influence how we scale our engineering organization & contribute to products used by customers around the world.
  
  
If you're passionate about building exceptional teams, enabling engineering excellence, and making a lasting impact within a fast-growing engineering company, we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Employer**
We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone can do their best work. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and make employment decisions based on skills, experience, qualifications, and business needs.

title: Architect/ Senior Architect-Backend
description:

Simpplr is the AI-powered intranet for unifying the digital workplace. It brings people, trusted knowledge, apps, and agents into a coherent digital experience. Powered by a proprietary EX Knowledge Graph, Simpplr synthesizes signals and context across connected systems to deliver personalized information and actions. The platform serves as a digital hub supporting communications, engagement, employee services, and work. With low-code extensibility and enterprise-grade security and governance, Simpplr enables confident operation at scale. More than 1,000 organizations — including AAA, the NHS, Penske, and Moderna — trust Simpplr to keep their workforce informed, aligned, and productive. Learn more at simpplr.com.
  
  
**Architect /Sr Architect**
**Location-**
**Gurgaon**
**The Opportunity**
Simpplr is looking for a
**Backend Architect**
to design and build scalable systems that power our next generation of intelligent, AI-enabled products.
  
  
In this role, you will be responsible for architecting
**AI platforms and backend systems**
, working across microservices, APIs, cloud infrastructure, data models and graph databases. You will partner closely with engineering, product and AI teams to build reliable systems that can represent complex relationships between people, content, entities and enterprise data.
  
  
This is a
**hands-on architecture role**
for someone who has strong backend engineering fundamentals and has
**practical experience designing or building Knowledge Graphs using graph databases such as Neo4j**
.
  
  
You will design systems that connect four perspectives of an enterprise:
  
  

* Company Graph: People, teams, roles, permissions, applications, and organizational relationships.
* Knowledge Graph: The entities, concepts, facts, and relationships found in enterprise content.
* Business Event Graph: Actions, state changes, and events over time.
* Telemetry Graph: How agents, workflows, tools, and services execute and perform.

These graphs share identities and provide context for enterprise search, RAG, and intelligent agents. This role calls for someone who can move from business questions to sound data models, APIs, and production systems—and who enjoys building and reviewing the implementation.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Define the architecture and technical direction.
* Design scalable and highly available backend architectures, microservices and distributed systems.
* Design Knowledge Graph data models, entity relationships, ontologies and graph schemas.
* Design APIs and services that enable applications to consume and interact with data.
* Work on entity modeling, relationship modeling, entity resolution and graph traversal.
* Design data ingestion and transformation pipelines to build and continuously update the Knowledge Graph from multiple enterprise data sources.
* Define approaches for graph data quality, consistency, scalability and performance optimization.
* Architect integrations across enterprise systems, APIs and data platforms.
* Design and review HLD/LLD, system architecture, API contracts and technical specifications.
* Work with AWS services and cloud-native technologies to build scalable and resilient platforms.
* Collaborate with AI/ML and product teams to make Knowledge Graph capabilities consumable by search, RAG and intelligent/AI-powered applications.
* Provide technical leadership through architecture reviews, design discussions and mentoring of senior engineers.
* Identify technical risks, scalability bottlenecks and architectural improvements across the platform.

**What We're Looking For**

* 12+ years of experience in backend engineering and software architecture, with significant experience designing large-scale distributed systems.
* Strong hands-on experience with Java, Python, Go or similar backend technologies.
* Proven experience designing microservices, distributed systems and API-driven architectures.
* Strong experience with AWS and cloud-native architecture.
* Hands-on experience with Knowledge Graphs and graph databases, preferably Neo4j.
* Experience designing data ingestion pipelines that transform structured/unstructured enterprise data into graph models.
* Strong understanding of relational , NoSQL databases, data modeling and distributed data systems.
* Experience designing highly scalable and fault-tolerant backend platforms.
* Strong understanding of REST APIs, event-driven architecture, messaging and asynchronous processing.
* Experience with system design, architecture patterns, scalability, performance and reliability.
* Ability to translate complex business and data requirements into scalable technical architecture.
* Deep hands-on experience with AWS, including designing secure, highly available, and cost-conscious production systems.

**Good to Have**

* Experience building systems for enterprise search, semantic search, RAG or AI-powered applications.
* Understanding of ontologies, taxonomy, entity resolution and semantic relationships.
* Experience integrating Knowledge Graphs with LLM/RAG or Agentic AI systems.
* Experience with technologies such as Kafka, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, Spark or similar data platforms.
* Experience with Kubernetes and containerized workloads.
* Exposure to data governance, security, tenant isolation and enterprise SaaS architecture.
* Experience working in a B2B SaaS / enterprise product environment.
* DevOps skills: Kubernetes, containers, CI/CD, infrastructure as code such as Terraform or CloudFormation, monitoring, logging, and production troubleshooting.

**Your Voice, Unfiltered**
We value the real you. To ensure a fair and authentic experience for everyone, we ask that you do not use AI tools (such as real-time answer generators, transcription apps, or note-taking bots) during your interview
  
  
Our process is designed to hear your unique story, thought process, and lived experience in real-time. Use of unauthorized AI tools may result in disqualification, as we want to ensure every candidate is evaluated on their own individual merits. We’re excited to meet the person behind the resume!
  
  
If you need assistive technology or AI tools for accessibility (e.g., live captioning), please notify your recruiter in advance. We are committed to providing an inclusive interview experience.
  
  
**Simpplr’s Hub-Hybrid-Remote Model**
**At Simpplr we believe that when work is good, life is better and that belief guides all we do. Including how we approach our flexible work model. Simpplr operates with a Hub-Hybrid-Remote model. This model is role-based with exceptions and provides employees with the flexibility that many have told us they want.**

* Hub - 100% work from Simpplr office. Role requires Simpplifier to be in the office full-time.
* Hybrid - Hybrid work from home and office. Role dictates the ability to work from home, plus benefit from in-person collaboration on a regular basis.
* Remote - 100% remote. Role can be done anywhere within your country of hire, as long as the requirements of the role are met.

title: Backend Engineer Manager (Gurugram based)
description:
**About Agoda**

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

**Get to Know our Team:**

In Agoda’s Back End Engineering department, we build the scalable, fault-tolerant systems and APIs that host our core business logic. Our systems cover all major areas of our business: inventory and pricing, product information, customer data, communications, partner data, booking systems, payments, and more. These mission-critical systems change frequently with dozens of releases per day, so we must employ state-of-the-art CI/CD and testing techniques in order to make sure everything works without any downtime. We also ensure that our systems are self-healing, responding gracefully to extreme loads or unexpected input. In order to accomplish this, we use state-of-the-art languages like Scala and Go, data technologies like Kafka and Aerospike, and agile development practices. Most importantly though, we hire great people from all around the world and empower them to be successful. Whether it’s building new projects like Flights and Packages or reimagining our existing business, you’ll make a big impact as part of the Back End Engineering team.

**The Opportunity:**

The Engineering Manager role at Agoda is one of the most significant and challenging roles at the company. The right candidate is both extremely hands on – technically excellent, with solid engineering principles – and exhibits strong leadership and people development skills. We are looking for world class development managers to lead one or more of our engineering teams.

**In this Role, you'll get to:**

* Be hands on - its one of the job’s fundamental task, and most of our development managers are writing and reviewing code, giving expert level coaching and guidance to their engineers.
* It's important to have a love of engineering and a passion for building things elegantly and at scale. Staying in touch with where the industry is going is crucial, and it’s important to have strong opinions about how systems should be architected, engineered, and maintained.
* Do full stack engineering: you should have solid experience in all parts of the technology stack: infrastructure, client side, back end, performance, data, and others.
* Developing people - Despite our investment and belief in technology, people are still our greatest asset. The right candidate will have a keen interest in developing people: inspiring those around them so they can achieve their potential. Being able to bring A-players such as yourself from outside and integrating them into the business will also be important.

**What you'll Need to Succeed:**

* Extremely proficient in at least 1 programming language (Java, Scala, C#)
* Strong experience in systems architecture – particularly in complex, scalable and fault tolerant distributed systems
* Demonstrable experience as a system owner with operational responsibility
* Proficient in lower level engineering (Garbage collection, context switching, threading)
* DevOps culture – Agility. Leanness. Automation. CI/CD
* Good understanding of application security
* Passionate about technology and the Internet
* Must have worked in a successful agile development team
* Must have run engineering teams before with 5+ direct reports
* Able to operate with autonomously: making decisions, setting KPIs, with a strong sense of ownership
* Practices data driven decision making

**It's Great if you have:**

* Proficiency in more than one programming language

**This position is based in Gurugram, India. Relocation package will be provided.**

title: Management Associate – HR & Communications
description:
**About Hillwoods Group of Institutions**

Hillwoods Group of Institutions is an established educational group operating schools and higher education institutions across Delhi-NCR and Gujarat. The Group is committed to delivering quality education through academic excellence, holistic student development, innovation and progressive educational practices.

With a focus on institutional growth, professional management and continuous improvement, Hillwoods is strengthening its organisational capabilities through strategic initiatives, technology integration, human resource development and operational excellence.

As part of its next phase of growth, the Group is expanding its professional management team to strengthen institutional performance, develop scalable management systems and drive new educational initiatives.

Hillwoods offers professionals an opportunity to work in a dynamic, collaborative and growth-oriented environment, contribute meaningfully to institutional development and be part of shaping the future of education.

**About the opportunity**

Hillwoods Group of Institutions is building a consistent Group HR and internal communications function. We seek a dependable, people-oriented professional who can help formalise recruitment, employee administration and communication across schools and higher education institutions.

**Role purpose**

Coordinate the employee lifecycle and internal communication processes, supporting the GMO in building professional, accessible and reliable people systems. The role involves working closely with institutional heads, academic interviewers and management to attract suitable staff, support induction and maintain consistent employee records and communication.

**Key responsibilities**

**Recruitment & selection coordination**

·       Work with institutional heads to identify approved staffing requirements and prepare role descriptions and recruitment advertisements.

·       Source candidates, screen applications against agreed criteria, arrange interviews and coordinate assessments, reference checks and candidate follow-ups.

·       Maintain recruitment pipelines and vacancy trackers; support selection documentation and offer/joining coordination with authorised management.

**Onboarding, service records & HR administration**

·       Coordinate joining formalities, document verification, induction schedules and new-staff orientation across institutions.

·       Maintain accurate and appropriately restricted employee service records, appointment documentation, attendance and leave inputs, and probation-review schedules.

·       Coordinate with institutional administration and Finance on authorised payroll inputs, employee changes and exit formalities.

**Staff development & performance processes**

·       Coordinate teacher and staff training schedules, participation records and feedback, working with Principals and qualified academic leaders on professional development.

·       Support probation reviews, appraisal administration, employee feedback and approved performance-improvement processes.

·       Identify recurring staffing or onboarding gaps and recommend practical process improvements.

**Internal communications & leadership induction**

·       Maintain an up-to-date organisational directory, reporting contacts, escalation channels and approved internal communication formats.

·       Draft and coordinate approved circulars, leadership announcements, induction packs, meeting communications and policy updates.

·       Support consistent communication between management and institutions; ensure new leaders understand reporting relationships and official channels.

**Employee relations & organisational support**

·       Coordinate grievance intake, acknowledgement and confidential routing through authorised channels, maintaining appropriate records and discretion.

·       Support employee engagement, staff feedback and organisational development initiatives.

·       Maintain HR dashboards and provide management with clear updates on vacancies, joining, retention, training and pending people processes.

**Qualifications & experience**

·       Graduate degree in HR, management, psychology, business administration or a related field; MBA/PGDM in HR or management preferred.

·        Minimum 3 years in recruitment, HR operations, people administration or internal communications; strong fresh graduates with relevant internships may be considered.

·       Experience recruiting teaching and non-teaching staff or working in educational institutions is advantageous.

**Key skills & attributes**

·       Excellent written English and professional communication; ability to prepare accurate correspondence and structured records.

·       Strong interpersonal skills, judgement, confidentiality and sensitivity when handling employee information.

·       Proficiency in spreadsheets, documentation, recruitment tools and digital collaboration; ability to organise and follow through independently.

**What the role offers**

An opportunity to help establish a professional HR and internal communications function from the ground up, with exposure to recruitment, institutional leadership and organisational development.

•    
**End-to-End Cognitive Architecture Design:**
Architect unified, full-stack target states spanning enterprise data ingestion (Snowflake, Databricks), medallion-layered data products, domain intelligence layers, semantic ontologies, temporal knowledge graphs, and governed multi-agent orchestration that executes deterministic business workflows.

•    
**Full-Stack Product & Experience Architecture:**
Define frontend architecture standards (Angular, React/Next.js, micro-frontends, design systems, SSR/SSG, accessibility to WCAG 2.2, Core Web Vitals performance budgets) and backend service architecture (NestJS, FastAPI, Java/Spring Boot, Go) using domain-driven design, event-driven, and CQRS patterns.

•    
**API & Enterprise Integration Architecture:**
Establish API-first strategy and contracts (REST/OpenAPI 3.1, GraphQL Federation, gRPC, AsyncAPI, webhooks), API gateway and management patterns (Kong, Apigee, AWS API Gateway, Azure API Management), and integration with core systems of record (SAP, Salesforce, ServiceNow, Workday, Oracle) via iPaaS (MuleSoft, Boomi, Workato) or event-driven connectors.

•    
**Real-Time & Event Streaming Architecture:**
Design low-latency, event-driven backbones using Apache Kafka/Confluent, Amazon Kinesis/MSK, Apache Pulsar, Apache Flink, and Spark Structured Streaming; CDC with Debezium; and streaming delivery into Snowflake (Snowpipe Streaming) and Databricks — plus real-time agent and UI experiences over WebSockets and Server-Sent Events.

•    
**Ontology & Knowledge Graph Strategy:**
Define rigorous methodologies for identifying, curating, governing, and continuously enriching business concepts, entities, and semantic relationships so the knowledge graph acts as a living, hallucination-resistant foundation for AI agents.

•    
**Multi-Agent Orchestration & Governance:**
Design deterministic, human-in-the-loop agentic systems using modern frameworks, Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Agent2Agent (A2A) boundaries, enforcing strict tenancy, RBAC/ABAC, prompt governance, evaluation gates, and end-to-end auditability.

•    
**Executive Outcome Baselining:**
Partner directly with client business and technology stakeholders to define and baseline objective, quantifiable KPIs (operational efficiency, EBITDA impact, cycle-time reduction, cost-to-serve) that anchor follow-on outcome-based delivery phases.

•    
**Execution Roadmapping & Risk Governance:**
Translate strategic blueprints into phased, dependency-mapped execution roadmaps and actionable work orders — explicitly documenting open architectural decisions (ADRs), technical trade-offs, and assumptions without premature lock-in.

•    
**Thought Leadership & Practice Building:**
Shape R Systems reference architectures, accelerators, and reusable assets; support pre-sales solutioning and proposals; and represent R Systems in client executive briefings and industry forums.

Core Blueprinting Deliverables

In advisory and discovery phases, you will own the authoring, executive validation, and formal sign-off of the following foundational artifacts:

1.    
**Enterprise AI Solution Strategy:**
A comprehensive strategic framework defining guiding architectural principles, Digital Brain sequencing, and alignment with business objectives.

2.    
**Target-State Architecture Blueprint:**
Detailed technical documentation covering full-stack component boundaries (UI, API, services, streaming, data, AI), data flows, security/tenancy models, and enterprise system integration patterns.

3.    
**Domain Intelligence, Ontology & Knowledge Graph Blueprint:**
Technical and governance specifications for entity extraction, semantic modeling, progressive graph enrichment, and continuous knowledge lifecycle management.

4.    
**Integration & Event Architecture Specification:**
API catalog and contracts, event taxonomy and schemas, streaming topologies, and system-of-record integration patterns.

5.    
**Baselined Business Outcomes Charter:**
A codified, measurable set of target KPIs and baseline metrics governing downstream outcome-based delivery accountability.

6.    
**Phased Implementation Roadmap:**
Sequenced milestones, critical-path dependencies, and target release gates (e.g., Alpha, Beta, and Production launch readiness).

7.    
**Follow-On Delivery Execution Plan:**
Complete technical scope, workstreams, deliverables, and dependency matrices enabling client authorization of subsequent implementation phases.

Engagement Scope Boundaries (Advisory vs. Execution Phase)

•     Building or operating production Snowflake/Databricks data pipelines or ingesting live production datasets.

•     Authoring full-scale production ontologies or deploying production agent/graph clusters.

•     Provisioning live client beta/production environments, mobilizing full delivery squads, or managing end-user training, cutover, and hypercare.
