Required Technical Depth & Architecture Stack

The ideal candidate combines C-suite architectural vision with genuine, hands-on full-stack engineering fluency — capable of reviewing code, validating reference implementations, and guiding engineering teams across every layer of the modern AI stack. Deep expertise in the core client stack is expected; breadth across the alternatives listed demonstrates the range we need.

Frontend Frameworks & Experience Engineering

•    
**Core:**
Angular (standalone components, signals, RxJS, NgRx), TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS (custom design tokens).

•    
**Breadth:**
React, Next.js (App Router, SSR/RSC), Vue/Nuxt; micro-frontends (Module Federation); component libraries and design systems (Storybook); WCAG 2.2 accessibility; Core Web Vitals performance engineering.

•    
**Data & Graph Visualization:**
ECharts (analytics/result studios), AntV G6 / d3-force / Cytoscape.js (interactive knowledge graph exploration), and streaming conversational/agent UX (token streaming, tool-call traces, human-approval flows).

Backend Services, APIs & Integration

•    
**Services:**
NestJS (Node.js/Express), Python (FastAPI, Uvicorn, Celery), Java/Spring Boot, and Go; microservices, domain-driven design, event sourcing, CQRS, saga/outbox patterns.

•    
**API Design:**
REST/OpenAPI 3.1, GraphQL (Apollo Federation), gRPC/Protobuf, AsyncAPI, webhooks; versioning, idempotency, rate limiting, and contract testing (Pact).

•    
**API Management & Integration:**
Kong, Apigee, AWS API Gateway, Azure API Management; API gateway/proxy routing with injected user context; iPaaS (MuleSoft, Boomi, Workato); SAP, Salesforce, ServiceNow, Workday, and Oracle integration patterns.

•    
**Identity & Auth:**
OAuth 2.1/OIDC, SAML SSO (Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, Amazon Cognito), JWT, magic links/OTPs via Amazon SES, Redis session revocation, fine-grained authorization (OPA, Cedar, OpenFGA).

Real-Time Streaming & Event-Driven Architecture

•    
**Streaming Platforms:**
Apache Kafka / Confluent (Kafka Connect, Schema Registry, ksqlDB), Amazon MSK and Kinesis, Apache Pulsar, Azure Event Hubs, Google Pub/Sub.

•    
**Stream Processing:**
Apache Flink, Spark Structured Streaming, Kafka Streams; exactly-once semantics, windowing, late-arriving data, and back-pressure.

•    
**CDC & Eventing:**
Debezium, AWS DMS, EventBridge, SNS/SQS; Snowpipe Streaming and Databricks streaming tables; WebSockets/SSE for live UIs and agent event streams.

Agentic AI, Orchestration & NLP Pipelines

•    
**Core Agentic Frameworks:**
PydanticAI (multi-agent planner, analyst, insights, and governed action patterns), LangGraph, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers with signed scope headers for governed data access.

•    
**Breadth:**
LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen/AG2, Microsoft Semantic Kernel, OpenAI Agents SDK, Google ADK, Amazon Bedrock Agents/AgentCore; Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol for cross-agent interoperability.

•    
**Agent Design Patterns:**
planner/executor and supervisor hierarchies, tool use, reflection, short- and long-term agent memory, durable workflows (Temporal), deterministic guard paths, and human-in-the-loop approval checkpoints.

•    
**Evaluation & LLMOps:**
offline/online evals and regression gates (Ragas, DeepEval, promptfoo), tracing (LangSmith, Langfuse, Arize Phoenix), red-teaming, and prompt/version registries.

•    
**Knowledge Curation & Parsing:**
Graphiti (temporal knowledge graphs), Argilla, distilabel; tree-sitter, spaCy, and GLiNER for localized Named Entity Recognition (NER); document parsing (Unstructured, Docling, Amazon Textract).

AI Models & Enterprise Gateway Governance

•    
**Models:**
Multi-model orchestration via Amazon Bedrock (Anthropic Claude, Amazon Nova, Titan v2 embeddings), Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI/Gemini, and open-weight models (Llama, Mistral) served via vLLM or SageMaker; local embeddings (FastEmbed / BGE); speech services (Amazon Transcribe, Polly).

•    
**AI Gateway:**
Centralized policy enforcement, token quotas/budgets, fallback and cost/latency-aware routing, prompt registries, semantic caching, metering, and Bedrock Guardrails (LiteLLM, Portkey, Kong AI Gateway or equivalent).

•    
**Model Adaptation:**
Retrieval-augmented generation, fine-tuning (LoRA/PEFT), structured outputs, and prompt caching for cost/performance optimization.

•

OWL 2, RDF/RDFS, SHACL, SKOS, SPARQL; ontology engineering tools (Protégé, TopBraid); triple stores (Stardog, GraphDB, Amazon Neptune).

•    
**Property Graphs:**
Neo4j (Cypher, APOC, Graph Data Science, multi-tenant semantic modeling, audit metadata); Amazon Neptune; graph data modeling and query optimization.

•

•    
**GraphRAG:**
Graph-grounded retrieval (Microsoft GraphRAG, LightRAG, Neo4j GraphRAG) combined with hybrid search to minimize hallucinations and provide explainable, cited answers.

Search, Vector & Enterprise Data Persistence

•

Elasticsearch/OpenSearch (BM25 + vector hybrid retrieval, re-ranking, hash-chained AI audit trails, activity telemetry).

•    
**Vector Stores:**
pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, or native Snowflake/Databricks vector search.

•    
**Operational Stores:**
Redis (state/session management, job queues), PostgreSQL (Amazon RDS/Aurora), and NoSQL (DynamoDB, MongoDB).

•

Snowflake (Cortex AI, Horizon governance, Dynamic Tables, Snowpipe Streaming) and Databricks (Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Mosaic AI); medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) lakehouse design; Apache Iceberg; record-level enterprise connector integration patterns.

Cloud Infrastructure, Security & Observability

•

AWS CDK (TypeScript) provisioning ECS Fargate, EKS, EC2, Lambda, RDS, ElastiCache, EFS, ALB, S3 + CloudFront, Route 53, Cloud Map, and KMS/Secrets Manager; Terraform; working fluency in Azure and GCP equivalents.

•

Zero-trust design, fine-grained RBAC/ABAC, hash-chained audit logs, nginx-unprivileged hardening, secrets management, and OWASP Top 10 for Web, API, and LLM Applications.

•

•

NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, and emerging U.S. state AI regulations; model risk management for regulated industries.

•

12+ years of progressive technical leadership in Enterprise Architecture, Solution Architecture, or Principal Full-Stack Engineering, with a proven track record delivering production AI, data platforms, and knowledge-centric systems for U.S. enterprises.

•    
**Full-Stack Depth:**
Has personally designed and shipped production systems across frontend (Angular and/or React), backend (Python and TypeScript/Node.js, plus Java or Go), API/integration, and real-time streaming layers — not only drawn them.

•    
**Agentic AI in Production:**
Has taken at least one multi-agent or LLM-powered system from pilot to governed production, including evaluation, guardrails, observability, and cost controls.

•    
**First-Principles Problem Solver:**
Ability to dissect ambiguous, complex enterprise challenges — bridging legacy infrastructure constraints with cutting-edge agentic patterns without over-engineering.

•    
**Ontology & Knowledge Systems Mastery:**
Deep theoretical and practical command of semantic modeling, taxonomy/ontology design, entity resolution, and graph-grounded RAG (GraphRAG) to minimize LLM hallucinations.

•    
**Snowflake, Databricks & Enterprise Data Fluency:**
Strong architectural grasp of the lakehouse and medallion architecture as the enterprise ingestion, governance, and analytical backbone feeding downstream intelligence layers.

•    
**Executive Gravitas & Technical Writing:**
Exceptional ability to command executive rooms, facilitate stakeholder alignment on measurable business outcomes, and author crisp, self-contained architectural blueprints that engineering teams can execute without ambiguity.

•    
**Domain Experience:**
Consulting or forward-deployed delivery in BFSI, healthcare/life sciences, manufacturing, retail/CPG, or telecom.

•    
**Industry Presence:**
Open-source contributions, patents, publications, or conference talks on agentic AI, knowledge graphs, or large-scale platforms.

Relevant Certifications (Highly Valued)

Current certifications in the following areas are a strong plus and will be weighted in evaluation:

•    
**Cloud Architecture:**
AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional; Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert; Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect.

•    
**Generative & Agentic AI:**
AWS Certified Generative AI Developer – Professional or AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer – Associate; Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate; Google Cloud Professional Machine Learning Engineer; Databricks Certified Generative AI Engineer Associate.

•    
**Data Platforms:**
SnowPro Advanced: Architect; Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional.

•    
**Knowledge Graph:**
Neo4j Certified Professional / Neo4j Graph Data Science Certification.

•    
**Enterprise Architecture:**
TOGAF Enterprise Architecture Practitioner; AWS/Azure Well-Architected expertise.

•    
**Platform & Security:**
Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) or Application Developer (CKAD); Confluent Certified Developer/Administrator for Apache Kafka; CISSP or CCSP; ISO/IEC 42001 Lead Implementer (AI management systems).

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
**About Us:**

Deep22 is a venture-backed, New York-based AI startup building the next generation of video technology for sports and media. Our platform uses AI to help rights holders, broadcasters, and content teams identify, create, and distribute the moments that matter instantly and at scale.

We are passionate about the intersection of sports, media, and technology, and are looking for an exceptional Full Stack Engineer to join our growing engineering team and help bring our vision to life.

**Job Description:**

We are looking for a Full Stack Engineer with 2–3 years of experience building and maintaining production software systems.

You will work across our frontend and backend applications and help develop products that process and deliver video at scale. This is a hands-on engineering role where you will work closely with our Lead Software Engineer and founding team, take ownership of meaningful product features, and contribute across the development lifecycle, from implementation and testing through deployment and production support.

This role is particularly well suited to someone who enjoys solving challenging engineering problems, wants significant ownership early in their career, and is excited by the opportunity to build at the intersection of AI, video, and sports.

**What You’ll Do:**

* Design, build, and maintain frontend and backend components of our web application using React, TypeScript/JavaScript, Node.js, and Python.
* Own product features from implementation through deployment, monitoring, and iteration.
* Build and maintain APIs and services supporting video processing, content management, user workflows, and data handling.
* Integrate AI and machine learning services into production product workflows.
* Help build reliable, high-performance video ingestion, processing, streaming, and encoding workflows.
* Work with real-time and high-throughput systems that process live and recorded video.
* Build and maintain cloud infrastructure and services on GCP.
* Monitor production systems, investigate issues, and troubleshoot problems across the stack.
* Optimize application performance, reliability, and scalability as usage grows.
* Contribute to CI/CD, testing, observability, and engineering best practices.
* Collaborate closely with engineers, founders, and product stakeholders to translate product requirements into reliable software.
* Take real ownership of what you build and proactively identify opportunities to improve our product and engineering systems.

**What We’re Looking For:**

* 2–3 years of professional software engineering experience building and maintaining production systems.
* Strong fundamentals in TypeScript/JavaScript, Node.js, and React.
* Experience building both frontend and backend applications in a production environment.
* Experience with cloud infrastructure and services, ideally Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or an equivalent platform such as AWS or Azure.
* Strong understanding of APIs, databases, authentication, and modern web application architecture.
* Experience deploying, monitoring, and debugging production software.
* Solid debugging instincts and the ability to reason through production issues under pressure.
* Comfort working in a small, fast-moving team where you are expected to take meaningful ownership of what you build.
* Familiarity with Python and an interest in working with AI/ML-powered applications.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Strong communication skills and a willingness to learn quickly.
* An interest in sports, media, AI, or video technology.

**Nice to Have:**

* Experience with FFmpeg or other video/media processing tools.
* Experience with real-time or high-throughput data pipelines.
* Familiarity with video streaming protocols such as RTMP, SRT, HLS, or DASH.
* Experience with Docker and containerized applications.
* Experience with serverless or microservices architectures.
* Familiarity with authentication and authorization systems such as OAuth, JWT, or SSO.
* Experience integrating AI/ML models or APIs into production applications.
* Familiarity with computer vision, multimodal AI, or video understanding systems.
* Experience working at an early-stage startup.

**What We Offer:**

* The opportunity to build cutting-edge AI and video products used in professional sports and media.
* Meaningful ownership of production systems and product features from day one.
* The chance to work closely with an experienced founding and engineering team in an early-stage startup environment.
* Significant learning opportunities across full-stack development, cloud infrastructure, AI, and video technology.
* Potential for rapid career growth as the company and engineering team scale.
* Competitive salary and equity.
* Opportunity for domestic and international travel.

* CDC & Eventing: Debezium, AWS DMS, EventBridge, SNS/SQS; Snowpipe Streaming and Databricks streaming tables; WebSockets/SSE for live UIs and agent event streams.

Agentic AI, Orchestration & NLP Pipelines
  
  

* Core Agentic Frameworks: PydanticAI (multi-agent planner, analyst, insights, and governed action patterns), LangGraph, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers with signed scope headers for governed data access.
* Breadth: LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen/AG2, Microsoft Semantic Kernel, OpenAI Agents SDK, Google ADK, Amazon Bedrock Agents/AgentCore; Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol for cross-agent interoperability.
* Agent Design Patterns: planner/executor and supervisor hierarchies, tool use, reflection, short- and long-term agent memory, durable workflows (Temporal), deterministic guard paths, and human-in-the-loop approval checkpoints.
* Evaluation & LLMOps: offline/online evals and regression gates (Ragas, DeepEval, promptfoo), tracing (LangSmith, Langfuse, Arize Phoenix), red-teaming, and prompt/version registries.
* Knowledge Curation & Parsing: Graphiti (temporal knowledge graphs), Argilla, distilabel; tree-sitter, spaCy, and GLiNER for localized Named Entity Recognition (NER); document parsing (Unstructured, Docling, Amazon Textract).

AI Models & Enterprise Gateway Governance
  
  

* Models: Multi-model orchestration via Amazon Bedrock (Anthropic Claude, Amazon Nova, Titan v2 embeddings), Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI/Gemini, and open-weight models (Llama, Mistral) served via vLLM or SageMaker; local embeddings (FastEmbed / BGE); speech services (Amazon Transcribe, Polly).
* AI Gateway: Centralized policy enforcement, token quotas/budgets, fallback and cost/latency-aware routing, prompt registries, semantic caching, metering, and Bedrock Guardrails (LiteLLM, Portkey, Kong AI Gateway or equivalent).
* Model Adaptation: Retrieval-augmented generation, fine-tuning (LoRA/PEFT), structured outputs, and prompt caching for cost/performance optimization.

Ontology, Semantic & Knowledge Graph Architecture
  
  

* Semantic Web Standards: OWL 2, RDF/RDFS, SHACL, SKOS, SPARQL; ontology engineering tools (Protégé, TopBraid); triple stores (Stardog, GraphDB, Amazon Neptune).
* Property Graphs: Neo4j (Cypher, APOC, Graph Data Science, multi-tenant semantic modeling, audit metadata); Amazon Neptune; graph data modeling and query optimization.
* Semantic Architecture: Business glossaries, taxonomies, and domain ontologies; upper/industry ontologies (FIBO, schema.org, HL7 FHIR); entity resolution and master data; semantic layers (dbt Semantic Layer, Snowflake semantic views, Cube, AtScale); ontology-driven application patterns (e.g., Palantir Foundry-style object models).
* GraphRAG: Graph-grounded retrieval (Microsoft GraphRAG, LightRAG, Neo4j GraphRAG) combined with hybrid search to minimize hallucinations and provide explainable, cited answers.

Search, Vector & Enterprise Data Persistence
  
  

* Search & Audit: Elasticsearch/OpenSearch (BM25 + vector hybrid retrieval, re-ranking, hash-chained AI audit trails, activity telemetry).
* Vector Stores: pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, or native Snowflake/Databricks vector search.
* Operational Stores: Redis (state/session management, job queues), PostgreSQL (Amazon RDS/Aurora), and NoSQL (DynamoDB, MongoDB).
* Enterprise Data Platforms: Snowflake (Cortex AI, Horizon governance, Dynamic Tables, Snowpipe Streaming) and Databricks (Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Mosaic AI); medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) lakehouse design; Apache Iceberg; record-level enterprise connector integration patterns.

Cloud Infrastructure, Security & Observability
  
  

* AWS & IaC: AWS CDK (TypeScript) provisioning ECS Fargate, EKS, EC2, Lambda, RDS, ElastiCache, EFS, ALB, S3 + CloudFront, Route 53, Cloud Map, and KMS/Secrets Manager; Terraform; working fluency in Azure and GCP equivalents.
* Security: Zero-trust design, fine-grained RBAC/ABAC, hash-chained audit logs, nginx-unprivileged hardening, secrets management, and OWASP Top 10 for Web, API, and LLM Applications.
* Observability & DevSecOps: OpenTelemetry (OTLP) tracing (Jaeger, CloudWatch, AWS X-Ray, Datadog, Grafana), SLOs/error budgets, and automated CI/CD security scanning (GitHub Actions, Docker, Trivy, gitleaks, SAST/DAST, SBOM).
* Responsible AI & Compliance: NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, and emerging U.S. state AI regulations; model risk management for regulated industries.

**Qualifications & CompetenciesMust-Have**

* Experience: 12+ years of progressive technical leadership in Enterprise Architecture, Solution Architecture, or Principal Full-Stack Engineering, with a proven track record delivering production AI, data platforms, and knowledge-centric systems for U.S. enterprises.
* Full-Stack Depth: Has personally designed and shipped production systems across frontend (Angular and/or React), backend (Python and TypeScript/Node.js, plus Java or Go), API/integration, and real-time streaming layers — not only drawn them.
* Agentic AI in Production: Has taken at least one multi-agent or LLM-powered system from pilot to governed production, including evaluation, guardrails, observability, and cost controls.
* First-Principles Problem Solver: Ability to dissect ambiguous, complex enterprise challenges — bridging legacy infrastructure constraints with cutting-edge agentic patterns without over-engineering.
* Ontology & Knowledge Systems Mastery: Deep theoretical and practical command of semantic modeling, taxonomy/ontology design, entity resolution, and graph-grounded RAG (GraphRAG) to minimize LLM hallucinations.
* Snowflake, Databricks & Enterprise Data Fluency: Strong architectural grasp of the lakehouse and medallion architecture as the enterprise ingestion, governance, and analytical backbone feeding downstream intelligence layers.
* Executive Gravitas & Technical Writing: Exceptional ability to command executive rooms, facilitate stakeholder alignment on measurable business outcomes, and author crisp, self-contained architectural blueprints that engineering teams can execute without ambiguity.

Nice-to-Have
  
  

* Domain Experience: Consulting or forward-deployed delivery in BFSI, healthcare/life sciences, manufacturing, retail/CPG, or telecom.
* Industry Presence: Open-source contributions, patents, publications, or conference talks on agentic AI, knowledge graphs, or large-scale platforms.

Relevant Certifications (Highly Valued)
  
  
Current certifications in the following areas are a strong plus and will be weighted in evaluation:
  
  

* Cloud Architecture: AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional; Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert; Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect.
* Generative & Agentic AI: AWS Certified Generative AI Developer – Professional or AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer – Associate; Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate; Google Cloud Professional Machine Learning Engineer; Databricks Certified Generative AI Engineer Associate.
* Data Platforms: SnowPro Advanced: Architect; Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional.
* Knowledge Graph: Neo4j Certified Professional / Neo4j Graph Data Science Certification.
* Enterprise Architecture: TOGAF Enterprise Architecture Practitioner; AWS/Azure Well-Architected expertise.
* Platform & Security: Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) or Application Developer (CKAD); Confluent Certified Developer/Administrator for Apache Kafka; CISSP or CCSP; ISO/IEC 42001 Lead Implementer (AI management systems).

title: Analyst - Control Management (RCSA Control Testing)
description:
**Job Description**
**B30 Analyst, Issue and RCSA Control Testing**
International Risk and Controls sits within International Card Services (ICS), which supports Consumer and Commercial customers across 28 international markets and plays an important role in American Express’ global growth strategy.
  
  
**Purpose of the Role**
The role will support the First Line Risk & Control framework by delivering independent, risk-based testing of controls linked to Issues and RCSA. The Analyst will assess whether controls are appropriately designed, implemented and operating effectively, producing clear and evidence-based conclusions to support issue closure and strengthen the ICS control environment.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Execute end-to-end testing of controls linked to Issues and RCSA, assessing control design and operating effectiveness through process walkthroughs, evidence review, sampling and clear, evidence-based conclusions.
* Assess whether remediation plans, issue descriptions and linked controls are appropriately aligned, identifying gaps that may affect testing readiness or prevent the sustainable closure of an Issue.
* Develop clear and complete testing workpapers covering scope, testing procedures, sample selection, evidence assessed, exceptions identified and conclusions that can be independently reviewed and re-performed.
* Apply professional judgement and appropriate challenge when evidence is incomplete, inconsistent or does not support the expected control outcome, escalating significant concerns to the Manager and relevant stakeholders.
* Record accurate and timely testing results in ServiceNow, clearly communicating control deficiencies, evidence gaps and required corrective actions to support effective remediation and issue closure.
* Maintain accurate testing plans and trackers, coordinate evidence requests with LECM, market teams and control owners, and identify closure dates or testing deliverables that may be at risk.
* Perform quality reviews of completed testing against the CoE’s quality standards, documenting findings and supporting improvements to testing methods, workpaper quality and consistency across the team.
* Use Excel, Power BI, AI and automation tools to support sample selection, evidence analysis and test-of-design activities, improving the coverage, quality and efficiency of assurance delivery.

**Key Skills And Attributes**

* Demonstrates strong analytical skills and professional judgement, with the ability to assess control design, evaluate evidence and identify whether corrective actions address the underlying risk and root cause.
* Applies a disciplined and detail-oriented approach to testing, producing clear, accurate and reproducible workpapers that meet internal quality standards and can withstand independent review.
* Communicates clearly and professionally with control owners and stakeholders across multiple markets, providing constructive challenge and following through on evidence requests, testing exceptions and agreed actions.
* Demonstrates curiosity, integrity and independence when evaluating control performance, with a willingness to adopt AI, automation and data analytics tools to improve testing effectiveness and efficiency.

**Qualifications**

* Minimum of two years’ experience in control testing, internal audit, operational risk, issue validation or compliance testing within financial services, a consulting firm or a comparable regulated environment.
* Hands-on experience in test of design (ToD) and test of operating effectiveness (ToE), including process walkthroughs, sample selection, evidence assessment, exception documentation and preparation of testing conclusions.
* Working knowledge of risk and control principles, with the ability to interpret control descriptions, identify design gaps and produce clear documentation that supports independent review.
* Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, business, risk management or a related discipline.
* Experience using governance, risk and compliance platforms such as Archer or ServiceNow, together with familiarity with RCSA, issue-management and corrective-action processes.

**Department:** Housekeeping  
**Position:** Housekeeping Staff

**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Experience:** 0–3 Years (Freshers can also apply)

Job Summary

We are looking for dedicated, hardworking, and responsible Housekeeping Staff to maintain cleanliness, hygiene, and a safe environment across hospital premises. The candidate will be responsible for ensuring that patient areas, OPD, wards, cabins, washrooms, and common areas are clean, sanitized, and well-maintained as per hospital hygiene standards.

Key Responsibilities

* Maintain cleanliness and hygiene in hospital premises, including wards, OPD, ICUs, cabins, corridors, and waiting areas.
* Clean and sanitize floors, furniture, doors, windows, washrooms, and other assigned areas.
* Ensure proper cleaning and disinfection of patient care areas as per hospital protocols.
* Collect, segregate, and dispose of biomedical waste according to hospital waste management guidelines.
* Ensure adequate availability of cleaning materials and housekeeping supplies.
* Maintain washroom cleanliness and replenish toiletries whenever required.
* Follow infection control protocols and use appropriate PPE while performing cleaning duties.
* Report maintenance issues, damages, or hygiene-related concerns to the supervisor.
* Handle cleaning equipment and chemicals safely.
* Perform assigned duties as per the housekeeping schedule and supervisor's instructions.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Minimum 10th pass preferred.
* Previous housekeeping experience in a hospital or healthcare facility will be an advantage.
* Knowledge of basic cleaning and sanitation procedures.
* Understanding of hospital hygiene and infection control practices is preferred.
* Ability to work in rotational shifts.
* Good discipline, punctuality, and teamwork.
* Hardworking, sincere, and responsible attitude.

* Salary: As per experience and company standards.
* Accommodation: As per company policy.
* Training and guidance will be provided.

Interested candidates can directly visit **Axten Hospitals, East of Kailash, New Delhi**, for a walk-in interview.

description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Retail Sales & Operations Executive

Location: Gurugram

Department: Sales & Operations

Experience: 1–4 Years

Reporting To: Management / Store Manager

About MOLOG

MOLOG is a Gurgaon-based creative strategy firm, founded in 2017. We work on government, infrastructure

and large-scale programme engagements across Bharat, the kind of work that ends up in front of the public, not

in a drawer.

Our goal for 2030 is simple to say and hard to do: a listed company, a multinational, and one of the best

organisations in the world to work for. The people who join now are the ones who will build that, and grow with

it.

That means you will not spend your first year watching. You will own real work early, sit close to the people

who lead the firm, and see what you do make a visible difference.

Role Overview

MOLOG is looking for proactive and customer-oriented Retail Sales & Operations Executives to manage its

expanding retail store operations. The role involves engaging with walk-in customers, understanding their

requirements, pitching relevant offerings, driving sales conversions, managing customer enquiries, and ensuring

smooth day-to-day store functioning. The ideal candidate should possess strong communication, interpersonal,

and sales skills, along with the ability to independently manage customer relationships, lead follow-ups, and

store operations.

Key Responsibilities

1. Sales & Customer Engagement

* Attend to walk-in customers, understand their requirements, and recommend suitable products or

services.

* Actively pitch offerings, handle customer queries, and drive sales conversions.

* Identify sales opportunities and work towards achieving assigned targets.

* Build and maintain strong customer relationships through effective engagement.

2. Customer Relationship Management

* Handle incoming calls, customer enquiries, and appointment scheduling.

* Maintain customer databases and ensure timely follow-ups with prospective clients.

* Address customer concerns and ensure a positive overall experience.

* Build long-term customer relationships through effective communication and engagement.

3. Retail & Store Operations

* Oversee day-to-day store activities and ensure smooth operational functioning.

* Maintain store presentation, organisation, and overall customer readiness.

* Coordinate billing, payments, inventory tracking, and other store-related activities.

* Ensure adherence to store processes, operational guidelines, and service standards.

4. Lead Management & Follow-ups

* Generate, track, and manage customer leads through walk-ins, calls, and other channels.

* Follow up with prospective customers to drive conversions.

* Maintain records of enquiries, sales, customer interactions, and follow-up status.

* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure timely resolution of customer requirements.

5. Reporting & Process Management

* Maintain daily sales reports, customer records, and operational trackers.

* Monitor sales performance, customer footfall, and conversion rates.

* Support management in implementing sales strategies and improving store operations.

* Identify operational gaps and suggest improvements wherever required.

Required Qualifications & Skills

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Commerce, or a related field.

* 1–4 years of relevant experience in retail sales, customer relationship management, or business

development.

* Prior experience in real estate, BPO/call centres, retail, or customer-facing sales roles.

* Strong communication, interpersonal, and customer-handling skills.

* Ability to pitch offerings, negotiate, and convert enquiries into sales.

* Basic understanding of billing, payment handling, and store operations.

* Proficiency in MS Excel, Google Sheets, and basic reporting.

* Strong organisational, multitasking, and problem-solving abilities.

* Fluency in English and Hindi.

Preferred Experience

* Prior experience in telesales, inbound/outbound calling, or call centre operations.

* Experience in real estate sales, property consulting, or customer relationship management.

* Experience in retail stores, showrooms, or customer-facing business environments.

* Exposure to sales targets, lead management, and customer conversion processes

title: IAM Sales Engineer
description:
**Experience:** 5+ years

**Location:** Delhi-NCR/Mumbai)  
**Department:** Sales - APAC Region  
**Reports to:** Country Manager, India

**The Opportunity**

We are seeking a dynamic, technical, and customer-focused Sales Engineer to be a key driver of our growth in the Indian market. You will be the technical champion for OpenIAM’s solutions, partnering closely with our sales team & partners to understand complex customer requirements, architect compelling solutions, and demonstrate tangible business value. This role is critical in bridging the gap between technical capabilities and business outcomes for our prospects and customers.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Technical Pre-Sales:** Partner with Account Executives to lead the technical sales cycle from discovery and requirement analysis to proof-of-concept (POC), solution design, and technical closure.
* **Solution Demonstration & Storytelling:** Deliver compelling, customized demonstrations of the OpenIAM platform that address specific customer pain points, use cases, and security/compliance requirements (e.g., IGA, SSO, MFA, IGA, PIM/PAM)
* **Architecture & Scoping:** Develop technical proposals, architecture diagrams, and solution design documents. Accurately scope POC and implementation requirements.
* **Proof-of-Concept (POC) Execution:** Plan, manage, and execute successful POCs/Pilots onsite or remotely, effectively handling technical objections and proving OpenIAM's value.
* **RFPs and Tenders:** Should have an experience in answering the RFPs/Tenders, attending pre-bid meetings and play a consultant’s part while the customers are in the process of creating an RFP.
* **Trusted Technical Advisor:** Build credibility and trusted relationships with technical and security stakeholders (CISOs, IT Architects, Infrastructure Heads, DevOps teams) across mid-market and large enterprises.
* **Market & Competitive Intelligence:** Maintain deep knowledge of the IAM/IGA landscape, competitor solutions, and industry trends in the Indian market. Effectively articulate OpenIAM’s differentiation.
* **Collaboration:** Work closely with Product Management, Engineering, and Professional Services teams to relay customer feedback and ensure smooth handover post-sale.
* **Content & Enablement:** Contribute to the development of technical sales collateral, presentations, and best practice guides tailored for the regional audience.

**Qualifications & Experience**

**Required:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* **5+ years of experience in a pre-sales/sales engineering role,** preferably within the cybersecurity, identity management, enterprise software, or cloud services domain.
* **Strong understanding of Identity & Access Management concepts:** IGA, SSO, MFA, LDAP, RBAC/ABAC, Directory Services, Provisioning, and Identity Federation (SAML, OIDC, OAuth).
* Solid technical foundation in: Linux/Unix, Windows Server, Networking, Databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle), Web/Application Servers, and Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Excellent presentation, whiteboarding, and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Proven ability to run successful POCs, handle technical objections, and create winning proposals.
* Self-motivated, proactive, and able to work autonomously in a fast-paced, remote/hybrid environment.
* Willingness and ability to travel within India (approximately 30-40%).

**Highly Desirable:**

* Direct experience with OpenIAM, or competitors
* Knowledge of IT security frameworks, compliance regulations, and audit processes relevant to India.
* Scripting/programming skills (Java, Python, PowerShell, Bash).
* Experience with DevOps, CI/CD, and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) in the context of IAM.
* Relevant certifications (CISSP, Security+, vendor-specific IAM certifications).

**What We Offer**

* Competitive salary and attractive performance-based variable compensation (commission/bonus).
* Opportunity to be a key player in a high-growth, global cybersecurity company.
* Work with cutting-edge technology in the critical IAM space.
* Flexible remote/hybrid work model.
* Comprehensive benefits package.
* Continuous learning and professional development opportunities.

description:
**Job Description – B2B Sales Executive / B2B Business Development Manager**

**Company:** MusafirBaba Travels Pvt. Ltd.  
**Department:** Sales & Business Development  
**Location:** Najafgarh, New Delhi  
**Job Type:** Full-time | Work from Office  
**Experience:** 2–5 Years (Relevant B2B Sales Experience)

**About MusafirBaba**

MusafirBaba is an emerging travel and tourism company focused on building a strong nationwide travel network through strategic business partnerships, technology and innovative travel solutions.

Our services include domestic and international tour packages, tourist visas, flight bookings, hotel reservations, train and bus bookings, car rentals and other travel-related services.

We are expanding our B2B business vertical and looking for ambitious sales professionals who can help us build a strong network of travel agents, travel agencies, tour operators and business partners across India.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a **hardcore B2B Sales & Business Development professional** who can independently identify, approach, acquire and develop new business partners for MusafirBaba.

The primary responsibility will be to expand our B2B network by connecting with travel agencies, independent travel agents, tour operators and other potential business partners, converting them into active clients and generating recurring business.

We value actual sales experience, client acquisition capabilities and revenue generation more than the number of years spent working in the travel industry.

**This is a hunting-oriented sales role, not a travel operations, ticketing or customer support position.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. B2B Client Acquisition & Network Expansion**

* Identify and approach potential B2B clients, including travel agencies, independent travel agents, tour operators, travel consultants and other travel-related businesses.
* Proactively acquire new business partners through cold calling, WhatsApp, email, LinkedIn and other outreach channels.
* Introduce MusafirBaba's B2B services, commercial offerings and partnership opportunities to prospective clients.
* Convert prospects into registered and active B2B business partners.
* Build and expand a nationwide network of travel industry partners.
* Develop and maintain a strong pipeline of prospective business accounts.

**2. Sales & Business Generation**

* Generate business through domestic and international tour packages, tourist visas, car rentals and other travel-related services.
* Understand the requirements of B2B partners and offer suitable products and competitive commercial proposals.
* Negotiate pricing, commissions, margins and business terms to successfully close deals.
* Drive repeat business from onboarded partners through regular engagement and relationship development.
* Identify cross-selling and upselling opportunities across MusafirBaba's service portfolio.
* Achieve monthly partner acquisition, sales revenue and business development targets.

**3. Relationship & Account Development**

* Establish and maintain long-term business relationships with travel agents and B2B partners.
* Understand partner expectations, business requirements and market demands.
* Ensure newly acquired partners become active and consistent revenue-generating accounts.
* Reactivate dormant accounts and increase business volume from existing partners.
* Maintain regular communication and follow-ups to strengthen business relationships.

**4. Lead Generation & Market Research**

* Research and identify potential travel agencies, tour operators and business opportunities across different regions.
* Generate qualified B2B leads independently rather than relying entirely on company-provided leads.
* Monitor competitor offerings, market pricing and industry developments.
* Explore new geographical markets and opportunities for expanding MusafirBaba's B2B presence.
* Maintain proper records of prospects, communications, follow-ups, conversions and revenue generated.

**Candidate Requirements**

* 2–5 years of relevant experience in B2B sales, business development or client acquisition.
* Demonstrated experience in independently acquiring new clients and generating business.
* Strong cold calling, lead generation, negotiation and deal-closing capabilities.
* Excellent communication, presentation and relationship-building skills.
* Ability to independently develop a sales pipeline and convert prospects into paying business partners.
* Comfortable working with monthly sales targets and performance-based KPIs.
* Working knowledge of MS Excel, Google Sheets, CRM tools and professional email/WhatsApp communication.

**Industry Preference**

Candidates with experience in the travel and tourism industry will be preferred, particularly those who have worked with:

* Travel agencies and tour operators.
* B2B travel companies and travel aggregators.
* Domestic and international tour package companies.
* Tourist visa and visa assistance companies.
* Car rental and ground transportation companies.

**Additional preference will be given to candidates who have experience selling or acquiring B2B business for domestic/international tour packages, tourist visa services and car rental services.**

Candidates with an existing network of travel agents, agencies and tour operators will have an added advantage.

**Who Should Apply?**

We are specifically looking for:

* Sales professionals who have personally acquired new B2B clients and generated revenue.
* Candidates with a proven record of converting cold prospects into long-term business accounts.
* Travel industry professionals who understand how to sell tour packages, visas and car rental services to other travel businesses.
* Individuals who can independently approach decision-makers, pitch services, negotiate commercial terms and close business.
* Self-driven professionals who enjoy hunting for new opportunities and building business networks.

**Who Should NOT Apply?**

This position is not suitable for candidates whose experience is primarily limited to:

* Flight or hotel ticketing and reservations.
* Travel operations and backend coordination.
* Itinerary preparation and holiday package operations without sales responsibilities.
* Customer support and enquiry handling.
* Processing visa applications without business development or sales experience.

**General experience in a travel company will not be considered a substitute for actual B2B sales and client acquisition experience.**

Performance Evaluation – Key KPIs

The candidate's performance will be evaluated on:

* Number of new B2B prospects independently identified and approached.
* Number of qualified business leads generated.
* Number of new B2B partners successfully acquired.
* Number of acquired partners generating actual business.
* Monthly revenue and gross margin generated through B2B sales.
* Repeat business and partner activation rate.
* Consistency in follow-ups, pipeline development and target achievement.

**Our Expectations**

We are not looking for someone who simply maintains relationships with existing clients or waits for enquiries to arrive.

We want someone who can identify opportunities, initiate conversations, pitch confidently, negotiate effectively, close deals and continuously expand MusafirBaba's business network.

**Your ability to acquire clients and generate business will matter more than your designation, years of general industry experience or operational knowledge.**

If you are a result-oriented sales professional who knows how to build business relationships and turn them into revenue, we would like to hear from you.

The role will focus on acquiring new brand partners, identifying sponsorship opportunities and building customised partnership proposals for companies looking to engage with India's startup and business ecosystem.

The ideal candidate should have a strong background in B2B sales and business development, with experience selling sponsorships, event partnerships, advertising solutions or other high-value B2B offerings. They should be comfortable pitching to marketing heads, founders, CXOs and senior decision-makers, and have the ability to take ownership of the complete sales cycle.

**Experience:** 4–6 years of experience in B2B sales, business development or sponsorship sales, preferably across events, media, publishing, experiential marketing agencies, advertising agencies or consulting firms. Front-end experience of selling to startups, technology companies and/or BFSI companies is mandatory.

### **Why This Role Is Unique**

**Impact:** Inc42's platforms collectively reach more than 300 Mn people online and have brought together over 50,000 attendees and 1,000 speakers. You will be responsible for building commercial partnerships across some of India's most influential startup and business events.

**Inc42 Network:** Engage directly with founders, CXOs, marketing leaders, investors and decision-makers across startups, enterprises,and consulting firms.

**Own a Revenue Vertical:** Drive sponsorship and partnership revenue across Inc42's flagship events, conferences, communities and proprietary IPs. Take ownership of pipeline creation, client acquisition, deal closure, receivables and account growth.

**Build Strategic Partnerships:** Work with brands to create meaningful associations with Inc42's platforms through sponsorships, event integrations, customised experiences and long-term partnerships.

### **About Inc42 Media**

Inc42 is India's #1 startup media and intelligence platform, informing, educating and empowering startup founders, business leaders and decision-makers through journalism, market intelligence, industry-leading events, executive communities and learning platforms.

Since launching in January 2015, Inc42 has grown into an authoritative voice on India's startup economy. Our reporting has been followed and cited by leading global publications, including The Wall Street Journal, Bloomberg, Reuters and TechCrunch.

Today, Inc42 tracks over 50,000 startups and delivers market intelligence through in-depth research reports, while bringing together the startup ecosystem through some of India's most influential conferences, executive communities and leadership experiences.

Over the years, Inc42 has built several business platforms and communities, including Inc42 Plus, Griffin Club and D2CX, creating opportunities for founders, operators, investors and business leaders to connect and engage.

### **What You'll Do**

**1. Business Development & Sponsorship Sales**

* **New Business Development:** Identify and acquire new sponsors and brand partners across startups, technology companies, BFSI, large enterprises and consumer brands.
* **Sponsorship Sales:** Drive revenue by selling sponsorship opportunities, event integrations, brand partnerships and customised association packages across Inc42's conferences and events including the D2C & Retail Summit and AI Summit, among others.
* **Pipeline Ownership:** Build and maintain a strong pipeline of prospective sponsors through market research, outbound prospecting, networking, referrals and industry connections.
* **Revenue Targets:** Own monthly and quarterly sales targets and drive revenue across assigned events, communities and IPs.
* **Consultative Selling:** Understand client marketing objectives and identify relevant opportunities for brands to engage with Inc42's audience through sponsorships, partnerships and event-led experiences.
* **Deal Closure:** Manage the complete sales cycle, including prospecting, pitching, proposal development, negotiations, closure and receivables.
* **Conceptualising Partnerships:** Work with internal teams to develop customised sponsorship ideas and brand integrations beyond standard event sponsorship packages.

**2. Account Management & Partnerships**

* **Client Relationships:** Build and maintain relationships with marketing heads, brand managers, founders, CXOs and other key decision-makers.
* **Account Growth:** Identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities across Inc42's events, communities and other IPs to increase revenue from existing clients.
* **Partnership Delivery:** Coordinate with event, marketing, content, production and operations teams to ensure that sponsorship commitments and brand deliverables are executed as agreed.
* **Long-term Partnerships:** Build a strong portfolio of recurring clients and strategic brand partnerships across multiple Inc42 properties.
* **Client Feedback:** Gather feedback from partners, identify opportunities to improve sponsorship offerings and build case studies and testimonials.

**3. Sales Strategy & Market Development**

* **Market Research:** Track industry trends, competitor events, sponsorship opportunities and brand marketing spends to identify potential revenue opportunities.
* **Partnership Strategy:** Identify brands and categories that align with Inc42's events, communities and audience, and develop relevant partnership propositions.
* **Competitive Benchmarking:** Monitor competing conferences, media platforms and event properties to understand sponsorship models, pricing and market positioning.
* **New Revenue Streams:** Identify opportunities to build new partnerships and monetisation avenues across Inc42's existing and upcoming IPs.
* **Pipeline Analysis:** Maintain accurate sales forecasts, pipeline reports and revenue tracking. Share client insights and market feedback with internal teams to improve offerings and commercial strategy.

### **Who We Are Looking For**

* **Experience:** 4–6 years of experience in B2B sales, business development or sponsorship sales, preferably in events, media, publishing, experiential marketing, advertising agencies or consulting.
* **Industry Exposure:** Prior front-end sales experience with startups, technology companies and/or BFSI clients is mandatory.
* **Sponsorship & Partnership Sales:** Experience in selling event sponsorships, brand partnerships, conference integrations, media properties or other B2B solutions will be preferred.
* **New Business Acquisition:** A proven track record of generating new business, building a pipeline and achieving revenue targets.
* **Consultative Selling:** Ability to understand brand objectives and develop customised sponsorship and partnership proposals.
* **Relationship Management:** Comfortable engaging with founders, CXOs, marketing heads, brand managers and senior business stakeholders.
* **Commercial Acumen:** Strong negotiation, presentation and deal-closing skills, with the ability to manage revenue targets and account growth.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced startup environment and manage multiple sales opportunities independently.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering or an equivalent discipline.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, organisational skills and attention to detail.
* Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and at least one CRM tool, with the ability to maintain accurate pipeline and sales records.

BraynupAI is an AI-first tech startup based in Noida that prepares students and working professionals for the jobs of tomorrow. Every programme has AI built into every topic, not added as an afterthought. Our flagship programmes are:

- Network among colleges, students or working professionals

- Experience running counselling over video calls

title: IP Admin Senior Analyst
description:
We are looking for someone to join our IP Admin Team at Noida. This position exists to process correspondences issued by United States Patent & Trademark office (PTO or USPTO), patent offices worldwide and the filing documents submitted in PTO during the patent & trademarks life cycle. The main purpose of the role is to review, docket, de-docket information received from PTOs, law firms, agents, and clients into Intellectual property management system (IPMS) and routing the said information to the appropriate attorneys or paralegals for action.
  
  
This is an exciting opportunity to work in the IP field where-in, self-improvement initiatives to drive client delight, building capability are added learnings.
  
  
We are the largest Intellectual Property Administrative service provider.
  
  
**Experience, Education, Skills, And Accomplishments**

* B.Sc. / M.Sc. B.Com, BBA, BCA, BA, MBA graduates with minimum 50% aggregate
* Freshers from 2025-2026 Batch
* Experienced candidates should have a minimum of 18 months of work experience in Backend Operations
* Confident and proactive team player, with good interpersonal skills
* Ability to work independently and efficiently with minimum / no supervision.

**It would be great if you also had . . .**

* IP Knowledge with experience to work on different IPMS' is added advantage and preferable.
* Good written & verbal communication skills
* Basic MS office: Proficiency in Microsoft office suite programs, including Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.
* Strong analytical skills to comprehensively evaluate the data.

**What will you be doing in this role?**

* Docketing: calendaring the statutory & non-statutory deadlines in Intellectual Property Management System (IPMS) along with relevant documents to preserve IP rights.
* De-docketing: perform or close the calendared events in IPMS once the requisite action is completed or cancelled, respectively.
* Prioritize daily docketing/de-docketing requests and other allocated tasks as agreed with client to complete in each day to keep IPMS current and correct.
* Review patent & trademarks prosecution related documents (US & Non-US) received via mail or shared site and update / create the records in IPMS as per the standard operating procedures (SOPs).
* Create and update patent & trademarks records in IPMS along with family linking of direct and subject matter related (SMR) applications.
* Effective communication with Attorneys, Paralegals, Law firms, foreign agents, and other stake holders to seek instructions and clarification on certain tasks.
* Maintain the data integrity of IPMS and proactively monitoring the docket to ensure that all PTO & client deadlines are met.
* Facilitate timely filing of all patent and trademarks application & office action response through order letters and other required instructions.
* Facilitate accurate and timely payment of all PTO fees including the maintenance fees, coordinate with client for payment instructions and coordinate with annuity service providers or law firms.
* Abreast of changes in PTO guidelines and procedures and extend support to team with process related inputs.
* Training: Providing OJT’s to new joiners, conducting refresher trainings.
* Audits: Ability to perform internal and PTO Audits is preferred
* Quality Check: Should be able perform docketing Quality audits
* 1st level query resolution

**About The Team**
The team consists of 10-15 members and is reporting to the Manager Operations.
  
  
Core process related responsibilities: IP docketing is the process of tracking deadlines related to the prosecution of patents, trademarks, and copyrights before their respective governing offices. This includes interacting with clients including external vendors - Law firms, Annuity service providers etc., Quality Auditors, IP Operations function heads, Continuous Improvement team.
  
  
**Hours of Work**

* You will be working for works 40 hours/week (8 hrs a day; 5 days a week); you are entitled to get Overtime if you work beyond your working hours.
* This is a permanent job role.

At Clarivate, we are committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all qualified persons with respect to hiring, compensation, promotion, training, and other terms, conditions, and privileges of employment. We comply with applicable laws and regulations governing non-discrimination in all locations.

title: Senior IT Specialist
description:
Job Req Number: 92432
  
  
Time Type: Full Time
  
  
Job Description: Database Infrastructure Engineer
  
  
Industry
  
  
  

* Industrial Technology and Automation: Logistics & Supply Chain

Employment Type
  
  
  

* Full-time

Are you ready to develop your career in a rapidly growing and successful global company acting in a fast-paced role? If you are someone looking for a position that challenges and inspire you in a successful international company, DSV is your place.
  
  
The DSV group, headquartered in Denmark, is one of the biggest transports and logistics companies in the world, with more than 75,000 dedicated employees, operating in more than 90 countries.
  
  
You will join a global and determined group driven forward by the desire to grow and will be part of a dynamic group, which is characterized by high level professionalization and constant improvement.
  
  
Who do we look for?
  
  
Roles & Responsibilities:
  
  
As a Database Infrastructure Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining the architecture of our database systems. You will work closely with other IT professionals and departments to ensure our database infrastructure is robust, scalable, and aligned with business needs. Additionally, you will participate in guard duty rotations to ensure 24/7 support and monitoring of our database systems.
  
  
  

* Infrastructure Design: Develop and implement database infrastructure strategies that support business goals and ensure high availability, scalability, and performance.
* Architecture Development: Design and architect database solutions, including data modeling, schema design, and integration with other systems.
* Technology Evaluation: Evaluate and recommend new database technologies and tools to enhance our infrastructure.
* Automation: Implement automation for database deployment, management, and monitoring using tools like Ansible to improve efficiency and reduce manual intervention.
* Virtualization: Utilize virtualization technologies such as VMware, OpenShift, and Kubernetes to manage and deploy containerized database applications.
* Vulnerability Management: Identify and address database vulnerabilities, ensuring timely application of patches and updates to maintain security and compliance.
* Security: Ensure database security by designing and implementing robust security measures, including access controls and encryption.
* Disaster Recovery: Develop and maintain disaster recovery plans to ensure data integrity and availability in case of failures.
* Collaboration: Work with development and operations teams to support database-related projects and initiatives.
* Documentation: Create and maintain detailed documentation of database architecture, configurations, and procedures.
* Guard Duty: Participate in guard duty rotations to provide 24/7 support and monitoring of database systems.

Qualifications:
  
  
  

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Experience: Minimum of 5 years of experience in database infrastructure engineering and architecture.
* Technical Skills: Proficiency in database management systems (e.g., SQL Server, Oracle, DB2, MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB), data modeling, infrastructure automation tools (e.g., Ansible), and virtualization technologies (e.g., VMware, OpenShift, Kubernetes) Strong architecture skills are essential.
* Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to design and implement complex database solutions.
* Communication: Excellent communication and teamwork skills.
* Certifications: Relevant certifications (e.g., Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect, Oracle Certified Master, AWS Certified Solutions Architect) are a plus.

Location: Noida (India)
  
  
We offer you:
  
  
The opportunity to expand your experience in a truly international, world-class company whose philosophy is that your everyday work should be both varied and full of professional challenges, with wide opportunities for constant professional and personal development.
  
  
Additionally, we offer the following:
  
  
  

* Medical Insurance including family and Parents up to 10 Lakh INR per year
* 2.5 days earned leave per month which is 30 days in a calendar year & 10 days Sick Leave in a year
* Parking for 4-wheeler or 2-wheeler vehicle
* Personal Mobile and Internet expenses reimbursed per calendar month subject to maximum cap.

**DSV – Global Transport and Logistics**
DSV is a dynamic workplace that fosters inclusivity and diversity. We conduct our business with integrity, respecting different cultures and the dignity and rights of individuals. When you join DSV, you are working for one of the very best performing companies in the transport and logistics industry. You’ll join a talented team of approximately 75,000 employees in over 80 countries, working passionately to deliver great customer experiences and high-quality services. DSV aspires to lead the way towards a more sustainable future for our industry and are committed to trading on nature’s terms.
  
  
We promote collaboration and transparency and strive to attract, motivate and retain talented people in a culture of respect. If you are driven, talented and wish to be part of a progressive and versatile organisation, we’ll support you and your need to achieve your potential and forward your career.
  
  
Visit dsv.com and follow us on LinkedIn, Facebook and Twitter.

title: Cloud and Observability Engineer (Remote Role, 6pm - 3am)

title: Third-Party Risk & Vendor Security Manager
description:

Operationalize and manage our client's third-party cyber-risk process across the complete supplier lifecycle. The role ensures that suppliers are categorized, assessed, monitored and, where necessary, remediated from planning and selection through contracting, onboarding, reassessment, renewal, offboarding and termination.

Key accountabilities

* **Supplier lifecycle assurance**
* Coordinate security due diligence before supplier engagement.
* Categorize suppliers and services according to criticality, data exposure, system access and business impact.
* Conduct pre-onboarding, post-onboarding, periodic reassessment, renewal and material-change assessments.
* Validate offboarding controls, including access revocation, asset return and secure erasure of our client's data.
* Maintain complete assessment records and evidence throughout the lifecycle.
* **Risk assessment and remediation**
* Issue and evaluate security questionnaires and supporting evidence.
* Review ISO 27001 certificates, SOC reports, penetration-test evidence, business continuity documentation and relevant control attestations.
* Determine inherent and residual cyber risk using the approved methodology.
* Document findings, recommend treatment actions and track remediation to closure.
* Escalate overdue, high or critical risks and support formal risk-acceptance decisions.
* **Governance and stakeholder coordination**
* Maintain the vendor inventory, ownership records, risk register and assessment repository.
* Coordinate with Procurement, Legal, Privacy, Enterprise Architecture, business owners and suppliers.
* Support security, privacy, audit, contractual and regulatory requirements in the sourcing process.
* Prepare management reporting on assessment status, risk trends, overdue actions and exceptions.
* Contribute to continuous improvement and automation of the TPRM framework and tooling.
* **Continuous monitoring and incidents**
* Support ongoing monitoring of critical and high-risk suppliers.
* Trigger reassessments following material service, ownership, control or threat changes.
* Coordinate supplier-related incident follow-up, corrective actions and evidence collection.
* Consider fourth-party dependencies, concentration risk and business continuity in assessments.

Expected deliverables

* Completed supplier categorization and assessment records.
* Clear vendor risk reports with ratings, findings and treatment recommendations.
* Up-to-date evidence repository, vendor inventory and risk register.
* Remediation tracker with owners, target dates, escalation and closure evidence.
* Lifecycle controls for onboarding, reassessment, renewal and offboarding.
* Management dashboards and periodic reporting on supplier cyber risk.

Required technical skills

* Third-party risk management and supplier security due diligence.
* Information-security risk assessment and residual-risk evaluation.
* Ability to review ISO 27001, SOC 1/SOC 2, penetration-test and continuity evidence.
* Knowledge of security questionnaires, control frameworks and evidence-based assurance.
* Understanding of cloud, SaaS, privacy, identity, access, encryption, logging and incident-notification risks.
* Issue management, remediation tracking, exception handling and risk acceptance.
* Working knowledge of ISO 27001, NIST CSF and relevant supply-chain and regulatory expectations.

Preferred technical skills

* Experience with TPRM, GRC or ServiceNow-based workflow platforms.
* External security-rating and continuous-monitoring services.
* Contract security clauses and collaboration with Procurement, Legal and Privacy.
* Data analysis, dashboards and workflow automation.
* Familiarity with AI-enabled suppliers and AI-related third-party risks.
* Awareness of OT supplier risk in manufacturing environments.

Behavioural competencies

* Persistent and disciplined in follow-up without damaging supplier relationships.
* Strong stakeholder management and ability to influence without direct authority.
* Clear written communication and defensible documentation.
* Analytical, detail-oriented and consistent in applying risk criteria.
* Commercially aware and able to distinguish material risk from administrative gaps.
* Confident in difficult conversations, negotiation and escalation.
* Able to manage a portfolio of concurrent assessments and deadlines.

Certification expectations

* **Required**
  : CISA or CRISC (At least one. Best aligned to assurance, control assessment and risk management.)
* **Strongly preferred**
  : CISM (Supports broader information-security governance and stakeholder management.)
* **Strongly preferred**
  : CTPRP (Directly relevant to third-party risk management practice.)
* **Strongly preferred**
  : ISO 27001 Lead Auditor (Supports evidence review, control testing and supplier assurance.)
* **Added value**
  : CISSP or CDPSE (Useful for technically complex or privacy-intensive supplier assessments.)

Experience profile

* Approximately 5+ years in cyber risk, audit, GRC, supplier assurance or information security.
* Demonstrated experience conducting and documenting vendor security assessments.
* Experience coordinating remediation with vendors and internal stakeholders.
* Experience working with Procurement, Legal, Privacy, Architecture and business owners.
* Strong evidence of managing risk registers, assessment evidence and reporting.

Success indicators

title: Intermediate Auditor
description:
At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today’s risks into tomorrow’s opportunities. We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are—with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. Moody’s is transforming how the world sees risk. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we’re advancing AI to move from insight to action—enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence.
  
  
If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity.
  
  
**Skills And Competencies**

* Minimum 2 years of experience in IT audit, IT risk, controls, cybersecurity, or related areas
* Knowledge of IT general controls (ITGCs), application controls, Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), access management, and data security concepts
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to assess risks, evaluate controls, and identify opportunities to improve processes and audit effectiveness
* Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate with stakeholders and present audit observations clearly and professionally
* Intermediate data analysis capabilities using Excel or equivalent tools, including pivot tables, lookups, reconciliations, and large dataset analysis
* Familiarity with audit, risk, and control frameworks such as COSO, COBIT, NIST, ISO, or SOC reporting, as well as emerging technologies, automation, AI tools, or cloud-based environments is preferred

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field
* Professional certifications such as CISA, CISSP, CIA, or progress toward obtaining one are preferred

**Responsibilities**

* Support the execution of technology-focused audits by assessing risks, evaluating control design and effectiveness, and contributing to audit planning activities

* Partner with audit team members and business stakeholders to gather information, understand processes, and support audit objectives throughout the audit lifecycle

The Internal Audit team provides independent assurance and advisory services that help strengthen risk management, governance, and control processes across Moody’s. Working closely with business and technology stakeholders, the team evaluates key risks, assesses the effectiveness of controls, and identifies opportunities to enhance operational efficiency and resilience. Team members are encouraged to bring curiosity, critical thinking, and innovative approaches to audit execution while gaining broad exposure to Moody’s businesses, technologies, and strategic initiatives

title: Head – Group Management Office
description:
**About Hillwoods Group of Institutions**

Hillwoods Group of Institutions is an established educational group operating schools and higher education institutions across Delhi-NCR and Gujarat. The Group is committed to delivering quality education through academic excellence, holistic student development, innovation and progressive educational practices.

With a focus on institutional growth, professional management and continuous improvement, Hillwoods is strengthening its organisational capabilities through strategic initiatives, technology integration, human resource development and operational excellence.

As part of its next phase of growth, the Group is expanding its professional management team to strengthen institutional performance, develop scalable management systems and drive new educational initiatives.

Hillwoods offers professionals an opportunity to work in a dynamic, collaborative and growth-oriented environment, contribute meaningfully to institutional development and be part of shaping the future of education.

**About the opportunity**

Hillwoods Group of Institutions is establishing a professional Group Management Office (GMO) to support

its schools and higher education institutions. We seek an experienced education-management leader who

can build a central management function, strengthen institutional systems and guide a small, capable

team.

**Role purpose**

Lead the establishment and functioning of the GMO, translating management priorities into coordinated

action across institutions. The role combines institutional administration, educational performance

oversight, people leadership, operational coordination and organisational development. It requires a

hands-on systems builder, not simply a senior administrator or a reporting specialist.

**Key responsibilities**

**Establish and lead the GMO**

* Design a practical operating model, standard reporting formats, management review cycles,

communication protocols and action-tracking systems.

* Recruit, develop and supervise the Management Associates; allocate assignments, review quality and

coach them in analytical thinking, professional communication and execution.

* Assess existing institutional processes, identify gaps and implement proportionate SOPs that reduce

duplication and administrative burden.

**Institutional performance & academic administration**

* Work with Principals, College Heads and designated academic specialists to establish a common

framework for academic administration, student outcomes, faculty development and institutional

improvement.

* Coordinate periodic academic reviews, classroom-observation programmes and independent quality

assessments; ensure approved corrective actions are implemented and reviewed.

* Analyse institution-wise performance and identify risks, recurring deficiencies and priorities requiring

management intervention.

**Campus operations and organisational coordination**

* Coordinate Campus Operations Heads and monitor service standards, procurement, vendor

performance, facilities, transport, security and maintenance.

* Establish clear interfaces between academic leadership, campus operations, finance and Group

management; resolve coordination bottlenecks and escalate issues requiring decisions.

* Conduct institutional visits, review operational evidence and support corrective action at

geographically dispersed campuses.

**People management, admissions & growth**

* Guide the development of central HR processes, recruitment, induction, performance review and
* internal communication in coordination with institutional leaders. Monitor admissions, enrolment and retention trends with designated admissions owners; supportevidence-led improvement initiatives.
* Coordinate strategic projects, expansion studies, partnerships and institutional development plans; work with Finance on feasibility and budget implications.

**Management reporting & decision support**

* Prepare concise, evidence-based management reviews, highlighting risks, options, dependencies and

recommendations.

* Maintain a prioritised portfolio of management assignments, with clear ownership, timelines and

follow-through.

* Collaborate with the Group Financial Controller on budget and expenditure reviews and ensure

operational plans reflect approved financial constraints.

**Qualifications & experience**

* Postgraduate qualification in management, education, educational leadership or a related discipline preferred; equivalent demonstrated leadership experience is valued.
* Typically 10–15 years of relevant experience, with meaningful responsibility for institutional management, school-group operations, cluster management or educational administration.
* Demonstrated experience designing or implementing management systems, leading teams and working with Principals or institutional heads; multi-campus exposure strongly preferred.
* Experience as a Principal is relevant where accompanied by substantial cross-functional or multi- institution management responsibility.

**Key skills & attributes**

* Strong understanding of school operations, academic administration and educational quality processes.
* People leadership, structured problem-solving, change management, financial literacy and strong written and verbal communication.
* Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution, maintain confidentiality and handle senior stakeholders constructively.

**What the role offers**

A founding leadership opportunity to establish a Group-wide management function, shape a small team

and work directly with the Director – Group Management on institutional improvement and growth.
