Over the past two decades, Bain has formalized industry and capability areas, internally known as "Practices", integral to how Bain wins and delivers results to its clients. Practice is considered a business unit of Bain. The primary role of Practice is to drive growth for Bain in a particular industry or capability, together with offices, and boosting Bain's expertise and commercial excellence.
  
  
The APAC Applied Tech & AI Practice is Bain's regional practice supporting affiliates and case teams across the region on selling and serving of work involving tech and AI strategy and transformation, domain-specific solutions/builds, and tech and AI foundations. It draws capabilities across Product Management and Innovation, Data Science and Machine Learning Engineering, Application Engineering, Design and Research, Architecture, Process Excellence and Tech Delivery to customize the right solution for clients. We partner closely with global leadership, industry practices, other capability practices, and Bain's technology ecosystem (cloud solution providers, AI providers, systems integrators) to keep the region's offering current and commercially competitive.
  
  
This role will sit at the center of the day-to-day running of the practice owing the strategy, planning, and operations backbone and supporting the Practice Director on commercial, content, and senior stakeholder relationships.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
**Strategy and Planning**

* Regional practice plan and budget: Support the RCL and Practice Director in developing the regional practice plan and budget; coordinate with global team to ensure consistency of elements and approach
* Regional practice priorities and KPI tracking: Support the RCL and Practice Director in defining the Applied Tech & AI priorities and goals. Track progress monthly and proactively flag trends and risks
* Regional meetings: Own regional meeting planning including agenda and facilitators, working closely with RCL as well as other industry and capability practices to incorporate the best results stories and expertise from Applied Tech & AI
* Leadership reporting: Prepare and coordinate ongoing reporting into leadership forums on the progress and performance of the Applied Tech & AI Practice
* Practice team management: Coach and mentor team members; support knowledge team in receiving opportunities to build skills in content development. Help KM team decide what content to codify to meet commercial needs of the region (along with solution teams)

**Affiliate Management and Staffing**

* Affiliate engagement through regional calls, training/information sharing: Work with the RCL and Practice Director to set agendas for regional calls and trainings and coordinate with facilitators on specific topics
* Affiliate career development, HLAs and ratings: Provide input to RCL and Practice Director on affiliate contributions tracked during the HLA process; gather and coordinate input from solution teams
* Quarterback alignment and enablement: Support alignment of Applied Tech & AI quarterbacks to Bain priority accounts. Ensure quarterback assignments reflect in affiliate HLAs. Plan and run training on effective quarterback role
* Staffing and expert deployment in region; utilization management: Support RCL and Practice Director as needed on coordinating with offices on affiliate staffing, making suggestions to manage utilization and skill development for individuals

**Solution Deployment & Commercialization**

* Regional go-to-market strategy including win/loss learning & feedback: Support RCL / Practice Director on debrief calls with pitch teams and case teams; ask probing questions based on client context; develop an informed perspective on insights and patterns; feed learnings back to Solution teams and to affiliates for improved go-to-market
* Interlock execution in region with interlock champions: Measure interlock progress, including content creation and commercialization; support interlock content creation as needed, in coordination with the industry and other capability practices
* Manage and run quarterly business review (QBR) process with APAC regional managing director, Applied Tech & AI RCL, Industry RPLs and Interlock Leaders to ensure progress of interlocks and resolve roadblocks
* Direct proposal support: Work with interlock leaders, quarterbacks, and industry practices to prioritize must-wins in the region; Provide direct solution support on occasional opportunities where appropriate
* Central orchestrator of Bain Solution SKU in region, aligned with global standards, across Bain ecosystem: Provide in-region support for Solution ecosystems and deployment
* Client and case-team advisory and support: Support case teams with commercial requests in region, providing more detailed recommendations to rapid response requests

**Marketing and Brand Building**

* Regional external meetings/forums: Work with hosts and content facilitators to prepare for events, with limited RCL / Practice Director support; pre-wire calls, dry runs on content and discussions
* Regional marketing collateral: Create videos, blogs, briefs and other sales collateral with the Marketing team, specific to the region and to meet regional commercial goals; track ROI/impact

**About You**
**Education & Experience**

* 5–8 years' professional services + undergrad
* 4–5 years' experience with MBA/Master's

**Required Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities**

* Analytical and problem-solving skills and expertise to push insights to conclusive recommendations
* Able to effectively drive pieces of work end-to-end with limited direction
* Able to prioritize, or work with supervisor to proactively prioritize when there are competing pieces of work
* Perform complex, accurate analysis independently; clearly communicate insights and implications of work
* Proficient Excel and PowerPoint based analysis and reporting; as well as comfort building and using dashboards and other reporting tools
* Continuously learn from one experience to another and make thoughtful recommendations on improvements
* Put together first draft of an executive summary or storyline; structure and design impactful slides and updates for senior audiences
* Steer and direct highly effective meetings; participate in meetings with more senior stakeholders and appropriately share opinions
* Able to understand clients’ core business needs and provide initial views/suggestions on the best of Bain’s solutions and capabilities to solve those needs
* Track record of inspiring, motivating and apprenticing junior team members

**Additional Requirements**

* Comfort operating in a fast-changing technology and AI space, and willing to learn and experiment with technology and new tools
* Flexibility with hours needed to work with global team
* In-office requirements as per local office and PPK guidelines
* Language requirements: Fluent English spoken and written

title: Managing Consultant, Socioeconomic
description:
**ERM**
is the world’s largest specialist sustainability consultancy, with over 50 years of experience helping organizations navigate complex environmental, social, and governance challenges. We bring together a global community of experts to deliver meaningful impact for our clients and the planet.
  
  
Our
**Consulting Delivery Hub**
(CDH) in India is a critical part of ERM’s global consulting model enabling scalable, high-quality delivery across regions and service lines. CDH teams work in close partnership with regional consultants to support global client projects, providing specialist expertise, driving consistency, and enhancing delivery efficiency across our most important programmes.
  
  
As part of the Consulting Delivery Hub, you will collaborate with colleagues worldwide, contribute to complex sustainability projects, and play a key role in shaping the future of global consulting delivery.
  
  
**Why this role matters?**
As a
**Socioeconomic Managing Consultant**
, you will support ERM's global Capital Project Delivery (CPD) work by leading discrete socio-economic workstreams and producing high-quality analysis, impact assessment and social value inputs to major infrastructure, energy, mining and transition projects. You will work within the Social Sustainability sub‑team, partnering with regional consultants across NA region, including Impact Assessment, Stakeholder Engagement, Sustainable Finance, Human Rights and Political Risk leads to deliver defensible socio-economic baselines, impact assessments and mitigation frameworks that de-risk projects and maximise positive community outcomes. This role is critical to scaling ERM's socio-economic delivery capacity, supporting CPD projects to secure consents, achieve social licence to operate, and meet growing lender, regulator and community expectations for robust socio-economic evidence
  
  
**What your impact is?**

* Support socio-economic baselines and impact assessment chapters.
* Lead economic appraisal, quantification of jobs and GVA effects, and social value analysis to strengthen client business cases, funding bids and consent applications.
* Manage discrete workstreams and small project teams (1–2 people), coordinating CDH and regional inputs to deliver on time, on budget and to quality.
* Act as a trusted day-to-day point of contact for clients on socio-economic workstreams, presenting findings clearly and responding to client and regulator queries
* Contribute socio-economic evidence across CPD sectors.
* Support bids, proposals and thought leadership.

**What will you bring?**

* Bachelor’s degree in economics, human geography, sociology, planning, public policy, development studies or a closely related social science discipline; a Master's is desirable.
* 6-10 years' relevant experience in consulting with a demonstrable track record of delivering socio-economic analysis, impact assessment or economic appraisal outputs.
* Proven ability to independently draft socio-economic baseline and impact assessment chapters for EIA/ESIA, or comparable economic appraisal / business case outputs.
* Sound working knowledge of UK/Irish EIA and consenting regimes (e.g. DCO, Section 36, TCPA, Planning (Wales) Act) and/or international frameworks such as the IFC Performance Standards and Equator Principles.
* Strong quantitative and qualitative research skills, including confident use of Census, ONS/NRS/NISRA/CSO, Nomis, BRES, ASHE and IMD datasets, and application of HM Treasury Green Book principles to economic.
* Experience managing discrete workstreams or small teams, including planning, budgeting, quality review and client liaison.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex socio-economic evidence into clear outputs for regulators, clients and communities.
* Strong commercial awareness and ability to work efficiently within scope, budget and time constraints.
* Have mandatory working exposure to NA region.

**Required Qualifications, Skills & Competencies**

* B.A. and/or M.A. in economics, geography, social science (with training in quantitative methods) or MBA (applied to social sustainability issues), ideally with good knowledge of development economics.
* Experience delivering socio-economic chapters for permitting or comparable major infrastructure consenting regimes, or ESIA socio-economics chapters aligned with IFC PS/Equator Principles.
* Exposure to Social Impact Assessment, social value, community benefits, just transition or deliberative engagement approaches.
* Experience working in a global delivery, shared service or hub environment across time zones.
* Excellent use of excel and AI-enabled tools. Ideally familiar with GIS to support socio-economic analysis and reporting.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the preparation of socio-economic baselines drawing on Census, labour market, deprivation, housing, health, tourism and industry datasets at national, regional, local and neighbourhood scales.
* Identify and assess likely significant socio-economic effects (employment, GVA, population and demographic change, housing, community infrastructure, tourism and recreation, sociocultural effects, sense of place) across construction, operation and decommissioning phases.
* Apply and, where appropriate, refine assessment methodologies covering sensitivity/magnitude, mitigation hierarchy, cumulative effects and distributional impacts.
* Draft scoping reports, EIA/ESIA socio-economic chapters, standalone Socio-economic Statements (SES), technical notes, and inputs to ESMPs, Livelihood Restoration Frameworks and community benefit strategies.
* Deliver quantitative economic modelling of direct, indirect and induced jobs and GVA, and qualitative assessment of wider socio-economic, sociocultural and tourism effects.
* Support stakeholder mapping and engagement and integrate stakeholder feedback into socio-economic scoping and assessment.
* Manage discrete workstreams end-to-end — including scoping, planning, delivery, quality review and client communication — and coordinate CDH inputs with regional teams.
* Contribute to bids, proposals and internal capability building, including standardising templates, tools and methodologies.
* Maintain current knowledge of UK, Irish and international socio-economic policy and guidance (e.g. ISEP SIA guidance, IFC PS, HM Treasury Green Book, Well-being of Future Generations (Wales) Act, NPF4).
* Adhere to ERM's Health & Safety, ethics and quality management systems in all project work.

Each of the pillars plays a vital role in managing Risk and supports the business in anticipating and addressing risks, issues, and challenge. **Risk Engagement Strategy**
and
**AI Strategy for Risk**
. Data/Analytics, Technology, and governance teams, supporting process automation and Gen AI adoption, and tracking milestones, risks, and value realization through dashboards and executive-ready reporting.

* Minimum 3 to 5 years of progressive project management experience, preferably within financial services, risk management, or a regulated environment. title: Clinical Affairs Manager
description:
**Company Description**
It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at
**Intuitive**
. As a global leader in
**robotic-assisted surgery**
and
**minimally invasive care**
, our technologies—like the
**da Vinci surgical system**
and
**Ion**
—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.
  
  
We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.
  
  
The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.
  
  
If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help
**transform the future of healthcare**
, you’ll find your purpose here.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Primary Function:**
This position reports to the India Country lead, Clinical Affairs, Intuitive Surgical India Pvt. Ltd.
  
  
The position requires a candidate with extensive experience supporting evidence generation strategy and execution of clinical studies. The Clinical Study Manager-4 (CSM IV) role will develop and execute strategies for clinical and outcomes research studies to support post market and pre-market evidence initiatives.
  
  
As a member of the Clinical Affairs team, this role will be responsible for working with key stakeholders to design and develop clinical protocols and execute clinical studies (pre-market or post-market studies), with minimal supervision. The candidate will be required to work closely with in-house or vendor’s/CRO’s clinical research associates (CRAs), clinical trial assistants (CTAs) and data management for the conduct and execution of the study, as well as with biostatisticians to review and interpret results of clinical studies, develop clinical study reports or support the development of clinical publications. During trial execution, the CSM will drive the progress of the trial during site selection, site start-up and through enrollment and follow-up. The CSM will clearly provide guidance to the monitors about monitoring needs, and oversee compliance work on the study. The CSM will also take a leadership role in external communication with investigators and study teams.
  
  
**Roles And Responsibilities**

* Responsible for leading assigned clinical research activities
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders, investigators and KOLs to develop and review study design and concepts, prepare protocol and study outlines and subsequently driving identified initiatives
* Responsible for the planning and execution of the clinical studies including site selection, analysis of potential patient recruitment and projections, creation of study related documents (protocols, case report forms, Informed consents, Clinical trial agreements, study reports), organizing IRB/EC submissions with follow-thorough to ensure successful progress
* Responsible for independently conducting clinical studies on schedule and within budget while ensuring high quality and compliance
* Liaise with external vendors and sites to negotiate contracts and budgets in collaboration with the legal team and management
* Responsible for supervising day to day operation of vendors/CROs
* Track study progress and provide regular status reports
* Work closely with in-house or vendor Biostatisticians on data analysis, interpretation and synthesis, to develop clinical study reports and /or support development of scientific publications
* Organize and lead study meetings and other study activities as assigned
* Mentor junior in-house or vendor clinical study manager(s); provide guidance to CRAs and CTAs on monitoring and other study needs
* Follow Intuitive’s processes (e.g., SOPs) and regulatory requirements (e.g., GCP and Indian rules and regulations relevant to conduct of clinical studies) and proactively manage studies, following such guidelines and requirements
* Conduct literature searches and familiarize with literature to stay informed and abreast of relevant scientific/clinical knowledge and/or to determine evidence gaps
* Review and revise Clinical Operations Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to assist Clinical Affairs leadership with continuous process improvement initiatives
* Work with clinical investigators to prepare manuscripts, abstracts, slide presentations, and poster presentations for scientific meetings and publications in collaboration with management
* Support regulatory submissions and conduct of pre-market clinical studies

**Qualifications**
**Skills/Job Requirements:**

* Previous experience implementing, supporting and managing medical device or pharmaceutical products’ clinical studies
* Experience working with cross-functional functions and surgeons/physicians, while conceiving and planning clinical studies
* Significant knowledge of clinical studies’ design
* Strong experience in protocol, ICF and development of other study related documents, writing clinical section(s) for regulatory submission
* Strong experience in conducting literature searches, reviews and appraisal of the scientific data
* Excellent ability to interact with surgeons and other professionals inside and outside the company
* Knowledge of Good Clinical Practice ICH/GCP and other applicable regulations, fundamental understanding of clinical research and monitoring requirements
* Experience negotiating clinical research contracts and budgets
* Must be able to work effectively with cross-functional teams
* Must be able to travel 30-40% on average
* Must be able to manage multiple projects and/or balance competing priorities
* Strong communication, presentation and interpersonal skills with high attention to detail and organization
* Ability to learn quickly, adapt to shifting requirements, and self-educate on different surgical specialties as applicable to clinical projects (“Self-starter attitude”)
* Ability to lead project team consisting in-house or vendor CRAs and CTAs and support management with relevant study updates
* Exhibits strong work ethics to help meet aggressive timelines or multiple projects when necessary, with a problem-solving mindset

**Required Education And Training**

* MBBS, M.D. with a minimum of 7 years of experience in clinical research
* PhD with a minimum of 10 years of experience in clinical research
* Bachelor’s degree in a scientific/bioengineering field with/without relevant clinical research diploma with a minimum of 15 years of experience in clinical research

**Working Conditions**
(As applicable - Any physical requirements for the job. If not applicable, state “none”)
  
  

* None

**Preferred Skills and Experience**
(As applicable - Specific skills, knowledge, and experience that are not required to perform the job, but are desirable to have)
  
  

* Experience in clinical studies for medical devices preferred
* Experience with primary sponsors of clinical studies & CROs preferred over experience exclusively with CROs
* Understanding of design of clinical studies, statistics, statistical methods, and manuscript writing is strongly preferred

Additional Information

We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees, and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type, without regard to race, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, color, age, religion, protected veteran or disability status, genetic information or any other status protected under federal, state, or local applicable laws.

title: Regional Director, Forward Deployed Engineering (Singapore)
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.
  
  
SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.
  
  
****About The Role****
We're building a Forward Deployed Engineering team to close the gap between the value our enterprise customers expect from Cursor and the value they're actually getting. FDEs don't advise, they embed directly with customer engineering teams, build production-grade Cursor workflows, and transfer the habits and culture that compound long after the engagement ends. The measure of success is what's different at day 30, not what got shipped.
  
  
We're looking for a Regional Director, Forward Deployed Engineering to lead and help scale this team. You'll manage a growing team of FDEs working across our most strategic enterprise accounts, own what makes a world-class FDE engagement, and stay close enough to the work to escalate, coach, and course-correct in real time. You will serve as the primary point of contact for customers, owning both project delivery and the day-to-day relationship, while also identifying and scoping new opportunities. You'll also build our partner FDE track — training and enabling GSI and consulting partners who extend this motion at scale.
  
  
This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who combines deep technical credibility, strong people management, and the judgment to keep engagements scoped tight, delivered fast, and worth repeating. This role will be based in all 3 cities: Bengaluru, Mumbai and New Delhi.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  

* Sell

+ Own the full arc from technical discovery to executive close — partnering with Sales and Account teams to qualify opportunities, leading architecture reviews, surfacing integration complexity and infrastructure constraints, and scoping engagements with enough precision to de-risk delivery before a line of code is written
+ Build and present proposals that translate ambiguous customer problems into concrete, time-boxed deliverables with clear ROI
+ Sell the vision and the plan to C-suite stakeholders who need to believe in both the outcome and the team delivering it
+ Drive deal strategy on strategic accounts; your technical credibility is a direct lever on close rates for six- and seven-figure engagements

**Deliver**

* Serve as executive technical sponsor on your region's highest-priority engagements and manage stakeholder relationships from IC engineers to C-suite

* Identify and escalate product gaps, integration friction, and recurring customer pain back to Product and Engineering with enough specificity to drive roadmap decisions
* Manage active engagements: escalate on complex builds, coach FDEs on scoping and delivery decisions, and step in directly on accounts where the stakes are highest
* Build reusable playbooks that make the broader FDE org more capable over time

**Manage People**

* Lead, develop, and scale a team of 6–8 Forward Deployed Engineers working strategic FDE projects
* Hire top-tier FDE talent; set clear expectations, technical performance standards, and career growth paths for a team where "excellent" means actually shipping in production
* Coach FDEs through the hardest problems in the field — scoping under deal pressure, building alongside senior technical stakeholders, and knowing when to protect scope vs. when to flex
* Build and scale the partner FDE track — train, enable, and hold the quality bar for GSI and consulting partners who carry the FDE motion forward at volume

* You have 8+ years of experience leading technical teams that build and ship in production — Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Engineering, or a similar function where writing and reviewing code is part of the job
* You have experience with software development and coding in Python, Javascript/Typescript
* You’ve built and owned AI-native workflows in production, not just prototypes, and have debugged real-world model failures
* You can diagnose a complex enterprise engineering environment quickly, identify the highest-leverage intervention, and scope a meaningful engagement
* You've built and scaled IC-level technical teams and know what excellence looks like in the field: sharp scoping, clean delivery, and knowledge that stays at the customer long after the engagement closes

title: Campus Partnership Manager
description:
**Job Description: Campus Partnership Manager**

**Location:**
Bangalore / Delhi

**Experience:**
3–5 years

**Educational Qualification:**
B.Tech/B.E., M.Sc., or MBA

**Reports**
to Associate Program Head

**Hybrid**
with regular travel

**About the Role**

As a Campus Partnership Manager, you will build and nurture long-term relationships with engineering colleges where Avanti alumni are studying. You will work closely with college administration, Student Counsellors, alumni, and internal teams to establish and strengthen college chapters and ensure effective implementation of campus initiatives.

This is
**not a conventional B2B sales or business development role**
focused on closing deals or meeting acquisition targets. It is a relationship-driven role that requires consistent engagement, trust-building, and long-term collaboration with educational institutions.

Your goal will be to onboard colleges from Avanti's ecosystem, formalise partnerships through MoUs, strengthen college chapters, and support FLGI students in developing the skills, professional networks, and placement readiness needed to secure quality jobs and high-paying career opportunities.

**What You Will Actually Do**

**1. Build Long-Term College Relationships**

* Onboard engineering colleges where Avanti alumni are currently studying, leveraging the existing alumni presence to establish institutional partnerships.
* Build and maintain relationships with college administration, faculty, and other relevant stakeholders.
* Work towards signing Memorandums of Understanding (MoUs) with colleges to formalise partnerships and establish long-term collaboration.
* Maintain regular communication and follow-ups to build trust and ensure sustained institutional support.
* Strengthen partnerships through consistent engagement and collaboration to support Avanti alumni and FLGI students on campus.

**2. Establish and Strengthen College Chapters**

* Work closely with Student Counsellors (College POC’s) to establish and strengthen Avanti chapters across partner engineering colleges.
* Support Student Counsellors in planning and implementing regular chapter activities and student engagement initiatives.
* Ensure college chapters remain active, student-focused, and aligned with Avanti's objectives.
* Encourage alumni participation through mentoring, peer learning, career guidance, and professional networking.
* Address challenges affecting chapter continuity, student participation, and program implementation in collaboration with Student Counsellors and college administration.

**3. Drive Career Readiness for FLGI Students**

* Work closely with Student Counsellors to ensure FLGI students receive structured career-readiness support.
* Facilitate access to alumni mentors, industry professionals, internships, projects, and placement opportunities.
* Support initiatives related to CV building, LinkedIn profiles, professional communication, interview preparation, and job-search strategies.
* Help students understand industry expectations and prepare for competitive, high-paying job opportunities.
* Collaborate with college placement cells and alumni to strengthen students' transition into employment.

**4. Lead and Support Student Counsellors**

* Supervise and support Student Counsellors responsible for student engagement and program implementation across partner colleges.
* Set clear expectations, review performance, and conduct regular check-ins to address challenges.
* Guide counsellors in stakeholder management, student outreach, chapter activities, and placement-readiness initiatives.
* Ensure college-wise plans, student follow-ups, and program activities are completed on time.
* Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

**5. Monitor Progress and Strengthen Implementation**

* Develop college-wise action plans and track partnership progress, chapter activities, and student participation.
* Conduct regular college visits to strengthen relationships and understand on-ground challenges.
* Use dashboards and trackers to monitor program implementation and student outcomes.
* Identify gaps and coordinate with college stakeholders, Student Counsellors, alumni, and internal teams to resolve them.
* Document learning and share effective practices across partner colleges.

**What We Are Looking For**

* **Educational qualification:**
  B.Tech/B.E., M.Sc., or MBA, with a compulsory STEM background.
* **Experience:**
  3–5 years in program management, institutional relationship management, campus engagement, education, or a related field.
* Experience engaging with engineering colleges, universities, faculty, placement cells, or institutional leadership.
* Strong relationship-building skills and the ability to build trust through consistent engagement.
* Experience coordinating teams, managing stakeholders, and driving activities to completion.
* A student-first mindset and an understanding of the challenges faced by first-generation learners and students from underserved backgrounds.
* Strong planning, communication, problem-solving, and execution skills.
* Comfort with data tracking, dashboards, reporting, and monitoring outcomes.
* Willingness to travel to partner colleges as required.

**What Probably Won't Work**

* Someone who views college partnerships primarily as sales targets, one-time transactions, or signed agreements.
* Someone who expects relationships to develop quickly without consistent follow-ups and trust-building.
* Someone who is comfortable with planning but struggles with on-ground execution.
* Someone who is unwilling to collaborate closely with Student Counsellors, alumni, students, and college administration.
* Someone who measures success only by the number of colleges onboarded rather than the quality and continuity of engagement.
* Someone who focuses on activities completed without tracking whether students are becoming more career-ready.

**What's Hard About This Job**

* **Building trust takes time:**
  College administration has competing priorities, and meaningful collaboration requires patience, credibility, and regular engagement.
* **Every college is different:**
  Institutional structures, student needs, and levels of support vary across campuses.
* **Partnerships need ongoing ownership:**
  Onboarding a college is only the beginning. Keeping chapters active and stakeholders engaged requires sustained effort.
* **Student outcomes require coordination:**
  Improving placement readiness depends on collaboration among students, alumni, Student Counsellors, college placement cells, and industry mentors.
* **Progress may not be immediate:**
  Mentorship, professional development, and placement readiness require consistent interventions before measurable outcomes emerge.
* **You must balance strategy with execution:**
  The role involves building institutional relationships while also supporting counsellors, visiting campuses, tracking activities, and resolving day-to-day challenges.

**Why This Role Matters**

For many Avanti alumni and FLGI students, access to a good engineering college is only the first step. They also need guidance, professional networks, mentorship, and opportunities to compete for quality jobs.

Strong college partnerships help bridge the gap between entering college and becoming placement-ready.

As Campus Partnership Manager, you will help create an ecosystem where:

* Colleges actively support student development and career readiness.
* Alumni contribute through mentorship, guidance, and professional connections.
* College chapters become active communities of learning and opportunity.
* Student Counsellors deliver effective, coordinated support.
* FLGI students gain the skills, confidence, networks, and exposure needed to pursue meaningful careers and high-paying jobs.

This is a diverse, dynamic, and evolving role with no fixed playbook. Every college, stakeholder, and student community comes with different needs and challenges. While there are clear goals and responsibilities, the approach to achieving them may change depending on the situation.

Final Note:

The Campus Partnership Manager will build and strengthen long-term partnerships with engineering colleges, establish active college chapters, and support FLGI students in developing career readiness through mentorship, professional networks, and placement-focused initiatives. The role involves leading Student Counsellors, managing institutional stakeholders, and tracking implementation and student outcomes, with a strong focus on sustained engagement, on-ground execution, and meaningful impact rather than conventional sales or one-time partnerships.

title: Training Coordinator
description:
**Training Coordinator – Institute for Medical Practice (iMEP)**

Institute for Medical Practice (iMEP)

Nipro India Healthcare R&D Skill Development Center

Location : Delhi / Gurgaon

Travel: Willingness to travel to partner hospitals and healthcare institutions is required.

**Role Purpose**

To coordinate and manage the delivery of clinical education and capability-building programmes conducted by iMEP at partner institutions and through the iMEP Mobile Medical Education Initiative (iMEP on the Move).

The Training Coordinator will manage programme planning, institutional liaison, faculty coordination, logistics, learner engagement, documentation, feedback and impact assessment. The role will support high-quality clinical and technical training for doctors, nurses, dialysis technicians and other healthcare professionals (HCPs).

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Institutional Training Coordination**

\* Coordinate with hospital training coordinators, nursing heads, nephrologists, department representatives and other stakeholders.

\* Gather training requirements and participant nominations from hospital departments.

\* Prepare monthly training calendars with hospital stakeholders and the iMEP team.

\* Schedule sessions around faculty availability, participant convenience and hospital operations.

\* Confirm training dates, venues, timings and participant lists; share invitations, reminders, joining instructions and learning materials.

\* Arrange training rooms, audio-visual facilities, equipment and other required resources.

\* Coordinate participant registration, attendance and completion records.

\* Maintain regular communication with institutional stakeholders and resolve coordination issues promptly.

**2. Training Programme Planning and Delivery**

\* Coordinate the end-to-end execution of clinical, technical and behavioural training programmes.

\* Prepare session plans, checklists and responsibility trackers.

\* Coordinate with internal and external faculty, clinical experts and product specialists.

\* Ensure presentations, training manuals, assessment forms and other learning resources are available on time.

\* Coordinate practical demonstrations and hands-on training using simulators, phantoms, arm models and relevant medical equipment.

\* Support programmes on topics such as dialysis fundamentals, AVF/AVG, CVC management, RO water treatment, vascular access, dialysis equipment and patient communication.

\* Coordinate soft-skills programmes on empathy, communication, patient engagement, time management and stress management.

\* Manage on-site arrangements and support faculty throughout each programme.

\* Coordinate session closure, including assessments, feedback and documentation.

**3. iMEP on the Move**

\* Plan and coordinate mobile medical education programmes at identified hospitals and healthcare institutions.

\* Confirm training requirements, locations, participant groups and schedules with host institutions.

\* Prepare deployment schedules and coordinate bus movement, travel, parking and site readiness.

\* Arrange transport and availability of training equipment, medical devices, simulators, phantoms and learning materials.

\* Check that the mobile training facility is ready before each deployment, including equipment, power supply, connectivity and cleanliness.

\* Coordinate faculty, trainers and support staff, and organise registration, training batches, session flow and hands-on learning activities.

\* Support appropriate use and upkeep of training equipment and learning resources.

\* Maintain records of deployments, institutions visited, sessions conducted, HCPs trained and programme feedback.

\* Liaise with relevant internal teams on vehicle maintenance, servicing, insurance, permits and other operational requirements.

**4. Faculty and Stakeholder Coordination**

\* Maintain an up-to-date database of internal and external faculty, clinical experts and trainers.

\* Share session objectives, participant profiles and programme details with trainers.

\* Coordinate with Nipro sales, product, technical and clinical teams to arrange subject-specific training support.

\* Facilitate communication among hospital stakeholders, iMEP and Nipro teams.

\* Follow up on faculty and institutional requirements to ensure timely closure.

**5. Learning Assessment, Feedback and Documentation**

\* Coordinate QR-based attendance and participant registration.

\* Administer pre- and post-training assessments to measure knowledge improvement.

\* Collect participant and faculty feedback after each session.

\* Consolidate assessment results, attendance records and satisfaction scores.

\* Maintain institution-wise and programme-wise training databases.

\* Prepare session completion reports and monthly training dashboards.

\* Track programmes conducted, participants trained, training hours and learning outcomes.

\* Maintain records of certificates, training materials, photographs and other programme documentation.

\* Highlight operational challenges, feedback trends and opportunities to improve future programmes.

**Qualifications and Attributes**

\* Graduate in Science or an allied health discipline.

\* Good communication skills in English and Hindi.

\* Willingness to travel to hospitals and other training locations.

\* A proactive, energetic and results-oriented approach.

\* Strong administrative, planning and coordination skills.

\* Able to manage multiple activities, follow up on details and work effectively with diverse stakeholders.

\* Comfortable supporting both classroom-based and hands-on training programmes.

Remuneration will be competitive and commensurate with the candidate’s qualifications, skills and relevant experience.

**How to Apply**

Please send your updated CV to
**jobs@nipromedindia.com**
with the subject line: Application – Training Coordinator, iMEP.

NIPRO Corporation - Global is a leading international healthcare company headquartered in Osaka, Japan, serving healthcare professionals, pharmaceutical companies, and patients worldwide. For over seven decades, NIPRO has focused on developing, manufacturing, and delivering high-quality medical devices, medicines, and pharmaceutical packaging. The company is driven by an entrepreneurial spirit and a commitment to continuous growth and innovation. NIPRO’s mission is to create value-added products and technologies that improve patient outcomes and advance healthcare globally. With over 38,000 colleagues, NIPRO strives to help people everywhere lead longer, better lives.

Our

title: Project Engineer - Busbar Trunking
description:
Lauritz Knudsen Electrical and Automation (A unit of Schneider Electric India Pvt. Ltd.) is a pioneering Electrical and Automation brand with a rich legacy of over 70 years in India. We offer a comprehensive portfolio of low-voltage switchgear, medium-voltage switchgear, busbar trunking, automation solutions, software, and services catering to diverse segments, including homes, agriculture, buildings, infrastructure, and industry.
  
  
We have an exciting opportunity for an experienced
**Project Execution Engineer (PE)**
to join the Busbar Trunking team. Based in
**Delhi,**
this role will report into Head – Busbar Trunking System.
  
  
The
**Project Execution Engineer**
will be responsible for the end-to-end (E2E) execution, coordination, and completion of Busbar Trunking Systems (Busduct) projects. Operating within the
**Execution Vertical**
, this role bridges engineering design and onsite execution, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest quality and safety standards.
  
  
The engineer will act as a primary interface between clients, consultants, installation service providers (ISPs), electrical contractors (ECs), and internal project management teams. The role is critical in driving
**project ownership**
,
**risk mitigation**
, and
**operational excellence**
, whilst building strong client relationships and ensuring repeat business.
  
  
**Key responsibilities will include:**

* Project Execution & Site Management

* Installation Supervision: Conduct pre-inspection and mid-installation checks to ensure compliance with approved layout drawings, technical standards, and manufacturer guidelines.

* Cross-Functional Alignment: Coordinate closely with clients, main contractors, MEP consultants, and internal execution teams to ensure execution timelines and project budgets are strictly met.
* Meetings & Representation: Attend regular site progress and project coordination meetings, serving as the technical and execution subject matter expert for the busbar trunking package.
* Partner & Resource Management

* Project Controls & Documentation

* Projections & Forecasts: Provide timely projections, resource forecasts, and progress updates to the internal Project Management (PM) team.

* Drive project closure activities:

+ Final documentation handover
+ Customer acceptance
+ Secondary Responsibilities (Tendering Support)

+ Ensure documentation approval and control (storage and sharing) across various project stages
+ Continuous Improvement

* Identify process inefficiencies
* Support implementation of best practises on:

+ Order execution
+ Co-ordination
+ Lead time reduction

* Support development of standard project execution methodologies

**Required skills**
:
  
  

* Diploma / bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering (or related field) from an accredited university)
* 5–8 years of direct hands-on experience design, routing, installation, and testing of low-voltage (LV) or medium-voltage (MV) Busbar Trunking Systems
* Active experience in project execution or site engineering will be preferred
* Proficiency in AutoCAD or related CAD tools, including use of Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word)
* Excellent stakeholder management, and communication skills
* Strong analytical, problem-solving and troubleshooting skills
* Able to manage multiple projects and deadlines
* Ability to read and understand project execution workflows, SLD, GA drawings, technical specifications
* Ability to work in fast-paced, high-pressure project environments

description:

Job Description – Interior Design Site Supervisor
  
  
Job Title: Interior Site Supervisor / Interior Site EngineerIndustry: Interior Design / Architecture / Construction / Real EstateDepartment: Interior Projects & Site ExecutionEmployment Type: Full-TimeExperience Required: 2–5 Years (Preferred)Job Location: As per Company RequirementSalary: As per Experience & Industry Standards
  
Job Summary
  
We are looking for an experienced, technically skilled, and detail-oriented Interior Design Site Supervisor to manage and supervise day-to-day interior execution activities at residential and commercial project sites.
  
The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of interior finishing work, modular furniture, carpentry, false ceilings, electrical coordination, painting, flooring, and site measurements.
  
The candidate will be responsible for ensuring that interior projects are executed according to approved design drawings, quality standards, budgets, and project timelines.
  
Key Roles & Responsibilities
  
1. Interior Site Execution & Supervision
  
- Supervise daily interior design and fit-out activities.- Monitor carpentry, modular furniture, false ceilings, partitions, flooring, painting, polishing, and finishing work.- Ensure work is executed according to approved interior design drawings and specifications.- Coordinate with carpenters, electricians, plumbers, painters, and other contractors.- Monitor daily site progress and workmanship quality.
  
2. Drawing Interpretation & Site Measurements
  
- Read and understand AutoCAD drawings, layouts, elevations, and working drawings.- Verify site measurements before execution.- Coordinate with interior designers and architects for technical clarifications.- Ensure accurate implementation of approved designs.- Identify and report site discrepancies or execution challenges.
  
3. Contractor & Labour Management
  
- Supervise contractors, vendors, subcontractors, and site workers.- Allocate daily work activities and monitor completion.- Ensure proper coordination between different interior trades.- Maintain labour attendance and work progress records.- Resolve day-to-day site execution issues.
  
4. Material Management & Coordination
  
- Monitor the availability and utilization of interior materials.- Coordinate requirements for plywood, laminates, MDF, veneers, hardware, tiles, paints, and accessories.- Follow up with purchase teams and vendors for timely material delivery.- Check materials against approved specifications.- Control material wastage and maintain site inventory records.
  
5. Quality Control & Finishing Inspection
  
- Inspect carpentry, modular installations, false ceilings, flooring, and finishing work.- Ensure workmanship meets approved quality standards.- Identify defects and coordinate rectification.- Verify measurements, alignments, levels, and finishing details.- Prepare snag lists and monitor closure before project handover.
  
6. Project Planning & Timeline Management
  
- Prepare daily work plans and execution schedules.- Monitor project milestones and completion deadlines.- Coordinate with project managers and interior designers.- Identify potential delays and recommend corrective actions.- Ensure timely completion of assigned interior projects.
  
7. Client & Designer Coordination
  
- Coordinate with clients regarding site progress and approved requirements.- Communicate execution issues to designers and project managers.- Facilitate site inspections and progress reviews.- Ensure execution remains aligned with approved client expectations.- Obtain necessary approvals through authorized project personnel before implementing changes.
  
8. Site Safety & Maintenance
  
- Ensure safe working practices at project sites.- Monitor proper use of safety equipment and PPE.- Maintain site cleanliness and material organization.- Coordinate safe execution of electrical, ceiling, and installation work.- Report safety hazards and unsafe conditions.
  
9. Site Reporting & Documentation
  
- Prepare Daily Progress Reports (DPR).- Maintain site measurement records, material registers, and work completion reports.- Track contractor activities and pending work.- Submit daily and weekly updates to management.- Coordinate project completion documentation and handover.
  
Educational Qualifications
  
- Diploma / Degree in Interior Design, Civil Engineering, Architecture, or a related discipline preferred.- ITI qualification with relevant interior site execution experience may also be considered.- 2–5 years of experience in interior fit-out, residential interiors, commercial interiors, or turnkey interior projects.- Practical knowledge of site supervision and interior finishing work is essential.
  
Required Skills
  
- Interior site supervision and execution.- AutoCAD drawing interpretation.- Site measurements and layout understanding.- Carpentry and modular furniture installation.- False ceiling and gypsum work.- Flooring, painting, polishing, and finishing.- Plywood, MDF, laminates, and hardware knowledge.- Electrical and plumbing coordination.- Vendor, contractor, and labour management.- Material planning and inventory control.- Quality inspection and snag list preparation.- Project scheduling and reporting.- MS Excel and basic computer knowledge.- Strong communication and problem-solving skills.
  
Preferred Candidate Profile
  
We are seeking a responsible, proactive, and technically sound Interior Site Supervisor who can independently handle day-to-day site execution and coordinate multiple contractors.
  
The candidate should have hands-on experience in residential interiors, modular kitchens, wardrobes, furniture installations, commercial fit-outs, and finishing works.
  
Candidates with experience in turnkey interior projects, luxury residences, offices, showrooms, and retail interiors will be preferred.
  
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
  
- On-time project execution and completion.- Quality of interior finishing and workmanship.- Accuracy of site measurements and installations.- Effective contractor and labour coordination.- Material utilization and wastage control.- Timely identification and resolution of site issues.- Reduction in rework and execution defects.- Site safety and cleanliness.- Client satisfaction and successful project handover.

title: Program Associate - Founder office
description:
**About Masters’ Union**

Founded in 2020, Masters’ Union is a new-age, industry-led university focused on business, technology, engineering, and entrepreneurship. Built around learning by doing, the institution combines academics with real-world projects, startup building, and global exposure, with the ambition of becoming one of the world’s top business schools and multidisciplinary universities over the next two decades.

Today, Masters’ Union has nearly 3,500 students across undergraduate, postgraduate, and executive programmes, with almost half being experienced professionals. Spread across nearly 5 lakh square feet in Gurugram and Manesar, the institution houses the PwC Center for Generative AI, a Bloomberg Lab, a maker space, AI and robotics infrastructure, advanced bioengineering workshops, and startup incubation spaces.

The institution is chaired by Manoj Kohli, former CEO of Bharti Airtel and former Country Head of SoftBankIndia. Its leadership ecosystem includes Vivek Gambhir, Pankaj Bansal, Sanjiv Bikhchandani, Amitabh Kant, and 30+ other founders, CEOs, investors, and policymakers who contribute to teaching and institution building.

Masters’ Union’s flagship postgraduate program has recorded strong placement outcomes, with graduates placed at firms such as Bain & Company, Boston Consulting Group, Google, and Microsoft. The institution has also built a strong student startup ecosystem, with students pitching on Shark Tank India and raising external funding for their ventures.

**About the Role**

This role demands for a structured and execution-focused professional to drive new initiatives, special projects, operational processes, and cross-functional reviews. The role will take ideas from an initial brief through planning and launch, build clear processes to improve day-to-day operations, and ensure teams deliver on agreed actions and timelines.

**Specifically, the role will involve**

• Taking new ideas from brief to launch by defining scope, plans, owners, timelines, and budgets.

• Managing special projects and student programs end to end, ensuring clear execution plans and timely delivery.

• Tracking outcomes and share concise updates on progress, results, and learnings.

• Designing, documenting, and maintaining SOPs, workflows, and trackers for student-facing and internal operations.

• Identifying recurring operational issues, investigate root causes, and implement fixes to prevent them from recurring.

• Running regular reviews with departments to track progress against agreed commitments, deliverables, and timelines.

• Following up on action items, owners, and deadlines to ensure timely closure.

• Flagging risks and escalate blockers early, along with a clear recommendation or proposed way forward.

• Initiatives and student programmes launch on schedule and deliver their stated outcomes.

• Processing and tracking to improve clarity, consistency, and operational efficiency.

• Reviewing actions that are closed on time, with risks and blockers raised early and accompanied by practical solutions.

**Ideal Candidate will have**

• 1–3 years of experience in program management, operations, consulting, strategy, a Chief of Staff role, or a similar function.

• Strong candidates with relevant internships and demonstrated project ownership will also be considered.

• A structured thinker who can turn an ambiguous problem or loosely defined brief into a clear, actionable plan.

• Excellent written English and clear, confident communication with senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders.

• Strong ownership, attention to detail, follow-through, and the ability to manage multiple priorities.

title: Associate Project Manager
description:
**About Coding Ninjas**

Coding Ninjas is one of India's leading online coding EdTech companies, founded in 2016. The company was founded by Ankush Singla, Kannu Mittal, and Dhawal Parate, with IIT and Stanford backgrounds and experience at leading organizations such as Amazon, Facebook, Cars24, and other startups.

With a vision to become India's leading coding education platform for college students and young professionals, Coding Ninjas focuses on delivering high-quality programming education and enabling learners to achieve their career goals.

The company serves thousands of learners annually and continues to expand its presence in India and international markets.

**Why Are We Here?**

The Student Experience team at Coding Ninjas is responsible for ensuring that every learner has a smooth, engaging, and outcome-oriented learning journey.

We are looking for an
**Associate Project Manager (APM)**
who can lead a team of Relationship Managers, drive operational excellence, and ensure a consistently high-quality learner experience.

The APM will be responsible for managing the end-to-end student experience for assigned programs, leading the Relationship Manager team, coordinating with cross-functional stakeholders, and ensuring the achievement of key operational and business objectives.

**Job Description**

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Team Management & Leadership**

* Lead, mentor, and manage a team of Relationship Managers to ensure effective student relationship management.
* Define team priorities, allocate learner portfolios, and monitor individual and team performance.
* Conduct regular one-on-ones, performance reviews, coaching sessions, and team meetings.
* Identify performance gaps and create structured improvement plans for team members.
* Build a culture of accountability, ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

**2. Student Experience & Satisfaction**

* Own the overall learner experience across assigned programs, ensuring smooth onboarding and learning progression.
* Monitor student satisfaction and proactively identify potential dissatisfaction or disengagement.
* Drive initiatives to improve student NPS, feedback scores, and overall learner satisfaction.
* Review recurring learner concerns and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Ensure Relationship Managers maintain regular and meaningful communication with learners.

**3. Retention & Student Engagement**

* Own student retention targets and proactively identify learners at risk of dropping out.
* Monitor learner engagement, attendance, course progress, module completion, and inactivity trends.
* Develop and execute engagement strategies to improve course completion and reduce dropouts.
* Ensure timely interventions for students with low participation, missed classes, poor performance, or negative feedback.
* Drive initiatives that motivate learners to complete their learning journey within defined timelines.

**4. Escalation & Stakeholder Management**

* Act as the escalation point for complex student concerns and ensure timely resolution.
* Coordinate with internal teams, including Academics, Tech Support, Sales, Placement, Finance, and Operations.
* Identify recurring operational issues and work with relevant stakeholders to establish long-term solutions.
* Ensure adherence to defined escalation processes, response timelines, and service-level agreements (SLAs).
* Review critical learner cases and ensure appropriate follow-ups until closure.

**5. NPS & Feedback Management**

* Own NPS performance across assigned programs and drive improvements across student feedback cycles.
* Monitor NPS trends, identify detractors, and ensure timely intervention and resolution.
* Review feedback received by Relationship Managers and ensure appropriate action plans are implemented.
* Conduct root cause analysis for recurring negative feedback and escalations.
* Drive initiatives to improve learner satisfaction and reduce repeated detractor instances.

**6. Referrals & Student Advocacy**

* Drive referral generation through the identification of satisfied and engaged learners.
* Guide Relationship Managers in identifying referral opportunities and converting them into successful referrals.
* Build student advocacy through positive learning experiences, engagement initiatives, and community building.
* Monitor referral performance and ensure achievement of defined team targets.

**7. Process Excellence & Project Management**

* Take ownership of student experience projects and operational initiatives from planning to execution.
* Define project timelines, milestones, responsibilities, and success metrics.
* Maintain and review performance dashboards, trackers, and operational reports.
* Track key metrics such as NPS, retention, referrals, module completion, ticket resolution, learner engagement, and RM productivity.
* Analyse performance trends and identify opportunities for process improvement.
* Establish and improve standard operating procedures (SOPs) to enhance operational efficiency and consistency.
* Leverage data to make informed decisions, improve team productivity, and enhance the overall learner experience.
* Ensure accurate documentation and reporting of student concerns, interventions, and resolutions.

**Required Candidate Profile**

**Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in any discipline.
* 3–6 years of experience in customer experience, operations, relationship management, project management, or student experience roles.
* Prior experience in managing a team, preferably in EdTech, customer success, or service operations.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong leadership, coaching, and team management capabilities.
* Advanced Excel and Google Sheets skills, including VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, data analysis, and reporting.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with a data-driven approach.
* Ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, escalations, and operational challenges effectively.
* Strong customer-centric mindset with a focus on learner satisfaction and retention.

**Key Competencies**

* People Management & Leadership
* Project & Program Management
* Student Experience & Customer Success
* NPS & Retention Management
* Escalation & Conflict Resolution
* Cross-functional Stakeholder Management
* Data Analysis & Performance Monitoring
* Process Improvement & Operational Excellence
* Referral Generation & Student Advocacy

**Success Metrics (KPIs)**

The performance of the Associate Project Manager will be evaluated on:

1. **Student NPS:**
   Achieving defined program-level NPS targets and reducing repeated detractors.
2. **Student Retention:**
   Maintaining targeted retention levels through proactive learner interventions.
3. **Learner Progression:**
   Improving module completion, class attendance, and learning engagement.
4. **Team Productivity:**
   Ensuring Relationship Managers achieve their defined productivity and performance targets.
5. **Escalation Management:**
   Ensuring timely resolution of student concerns and adherence to SLAs.
6. **Referral Generation:**
   Achieving defined referral targets through student advocacy.
7. **Project Execution:**
   Delivering assigned projects and operational initiatives within defined timelines and success metrics.
8. **Process Excellence:**
   Ensuring consistent execution of SOPs, accurate reporting, and operational discipline.

**The ideal candidate should be a strong people leader and project owner with a customer-first mindset, capable of driving measurable improvements in student experience while ensuring team performance, cross-functional alignment, and operational efficiency.**

**Job Description**

About the Role

We are seeking an accomplished
**Senior Project Manager – Safety**
with 10-15 years of experience in Health, Safety, Environment (HSE) and Occupational Safety Management within large-scale construction, infrastructure, industrial, commercial, and real estate projects. The role will be responsible for leading project safety strategy, ensuring regulatory compliance, fostering a strong safety culture, and driving best-in-class safety performance across multiple project sites.

Key Responsibilities

Safety Leadership & Strategy

* Develop and implement project-specific Health, Safety, and Environmental (HSE) management plans.
* Lead the overall safety function across assigned projects and ensure alignment with organizational safety objectives.
* Drive a proactive safety culture through leadership engagement, awareness programs, and behavioral safety initiatives.
* Establish safety performance targets and monitor achievement through regular reviews.

Regulatory Compliance & Governance

* Ensure compliance with applicable local safety regulations, statutory requirements, and client-specific HSE standards.
* Monitor compliance with OSHA principles, ISO 45001 standards, and construction safety best practices.
* Conduct regular safety audits, inspections, and compliance assessments across project sites.
* Liaise with government authorities, clients, consultants, and contractors on safety-related matters.

Risk Assessment & Incident Management

* Lead hazard identification, risk assessment, and mitigation planning for all project activities.
* Review Job Safety Analysis (JSA), Method Statements, Permit-to-Work systems, and emergency response plans.
* Investigate incidents, near misses, and accidents, conducting root cause analysis and implementing corrective actions.
* Monitor leading and lagging safety indicators to identify improvement opportunities.

Site Safety Management

* Oversee contractor safety performance and ensure compliance with site safety requirements.
* Monitor high-risk activities including work at height, lifting operations, confined space entry, excavation, and hot works.
* Conduct safety walks, inspections, and leadership site visits.
* Ensure appropriate use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) and implementation of safe work practices.

Training & Capability Development

* Develop and deliver safety training, induction programs, toolbox talks, and awareness campaigns.
* Mentor project safety teams and build organizational HSE capabilities.
* Promote behavioral-based safety programs and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Qualifications**

Qualifications

* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Environmental Science, Occupational Health & Safety, or related discipline.
* Diploma/Advanced Diploma in Industrial Safety, Occupational Health & Safety, or equivalent.
* Professional certifications such as
  **NEBOSH IGC**
  ,
  **NEBOSH Construction Certificate**
  ,
  **ISO 45001 Lead Auditor**
  ,
  **IOSH Managing Safely**
  , or equivalent are highly desirable.
* Additional certifications in First Aid, Fire Safety, Incident Investigation, or Risk Management will be an advantage.

Experience Requirements

* 10-15 years of experience in HSE management within construction, infrastructure, industrial, data center, commercial, healthcare, or mixed-use developments.
* Experience leading safety teams on large-scale projects.
* Strong understanding of contractor management, safety compliance, and risk control measures.
* Experience working in PMC, EPC, consultancy, or construction organizations.

**Additional Information**

MBA or Chartered Accountant with overall experience in Finance, Accounting, Taxation and Audit

title: Assistant Manager – PMO
description:
**Company Description**
ib vogt is firmly committed to supporting the decarbonisation of the global electricity sector. The company focuses on the global development of turnkey PV plants and battery storage projects as well as the expansion of its IPP portfolio. In these areas, the company performs all integral services of the value chain from development, financing, and EPC, to O&M and asset management.
  
  
Headquartered in Berlin, Germany, ib vogt has established various offices across Europe, Asia Pacific, the Americas, and Africa as part of its presence in over 35 countries. The company works together with numerous partners globally, augmenting its in-house team of over 900 staff. ib vogt has built or has in construction more than 4.7 GW of PV power plants globally with a project pipeline of more than 55 GWp.
  
  
ib vogt India, subsidiary of ib vogt GmbH, headquartered at Gurgaon, Haryana and regional presence at Jaipur, Pune, Ahmedabad, Vadodara, and Bangalore. With 140+ staff in India and seamless support from Berlin, it provides turnkey solutions for solar, wind and hybrid projects across India. It has already developed and delivered more than 1.15 GWp of Solar projects and has a pipeline of more than 2 GWp.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Role & Responsibilities: -**
The PMO will support the planning, execution, and monitoring of solar energy projects. The role involves coordinating activities across different departments, ensuring that project timelines are adhered to, and providing administrative and logistical support. The Project Coordinator will also be responsible for tracking progress, preparing reports, and helping maintain the quality and efficiency of project delivery.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Prepare detailed project plans, timelines, and milestones.
* Coordinate communication between various teams including customer, contractors, and stakeholders to ensure seamless project execution.
* Track and update project progress using project management tools and software.
* Prepare regular status reports and presentations for internal teams and management.
* Schedule and organize meetings, including preparing meeting agendas and taking minutes.
* Manage project documentation, ensuring that all records are accurate, complete, and up to date.
* Assist in identifying project risks and issues and facilitate the resolution process.
* Coordinate logistics for the delivery of materials and equipment to project sites.
* Monitor project budgets and ensure expenditures are aligned with financial goals.
* Support procurement activities, including managing supplier relationships and ensuring timely deliveries.
* Ensure all project activities comply with regulatory requirements and company policies.
* Collaborate with the project team to ensure project objectives are met on time and within scope.
* Handle project-related tasks and administrative duties as needed.

**Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications & Skills:**
**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in electrical/ electronics engineering

**Experience**

* 7 - 9 years of experience in project coordination, preferably in solar or renewable energy

**Technical Skills**

* Proficiency in project management software (e.g., MS Project, Primavera).
* Strong organizational and multitasking skills with a keen eye for detail.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

**Preferred Skills**

* Knowledge of solar project development and construction processes.
* Experience in project budgeting and financial tracking.
* Familiarity with regulatory and compliance standards in the solar industry.

Additional Information
  
  
**We Offer You**

* Interesting and challenging tasks
* A truly international working environment with colleagues from all over the world
* An open-minded, friendly and highly motivated team.
* Great opportunities for professional and personal development
* competitive remuneration (based on experience)

*We know that no candidate ticks every box. If this role excites you and you believe you can make an impact, we'd love to hear from you.*
*At ib vogt, we are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace where everyone can thrive. We believe that embracing diverse perspectives drives innovation and helps us better serve the global communities we operate in. As an equal opportunity employer, we provide employment opportunities without regard to age, ethnicity, religion or belief, gender identity, sex, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy or maternity, marriage and civil partnership, or any other protected status.*
*We strive to create an accessible recruitment process for all candidates and are happy to discuss reasonable accommodations to support your application. As a global company, we acknowledge that accessibility provisions may vary by location depending on local infrastructure and legal requirements. If you have a disability or require any adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know - we will do our best to support you.*

description:
About Spectal

We’re a youth experiential agency connecting brands with culture through experiential marketing, brand solutions and live entertainment. From campaigns for Heineken, Kingfisher, Hero MotoCorp, Bingo! and Myntra to live experiences with Amit Trivedi, Sunidhi Chauhan and DIVINE, we bring ideas to life where young audiences gather at college fests across India and festivals like Sunburn, Comic Con and Zomaland.
*We’ve worked with brands including Heineken, Kingfisher, Hero MotoCorp, Bingo! and Myntra, and artists like Amit Trivedi, Sunidhi Chauhan and DIVINE.*

*Myntra’s 34-city Glamfest Tour and 50 campus activations for Nestlé’s Nescafé and KitKat.*

* Manage client relationships for select accounts, understanding briefs, staying aligned with brand objectives and ensuring the work delivers against them.

* Contribute to ideas and concepts, bringing an understanding of the brand, its audience and cultural trends.

Shape the creative direction of a growing agency, work closely with clients and the founder, and build a team that brings ideas to life for leading brands.
