title: Site In Charge
description:
**About Hygenco:**

Hygenco aims to be a global leader in deploying Green Hydrogen- and Green Ammonia-powered

industry solutions. We develop and deploy scaled-up, commercially attractive Green Hydrogen

and Green Ammonia production assets. We combine our in-house expertise in renewable power,

process industry, gases, and project financing with the latest innovation and know-how from our

network of global OEMs and EPC firms. Hygenco is founded by industry professionals bringing in

combined 30+ years of experience in Construction, Renewables, Operations & Maintenance, Investment Banking, and Private Equity.

1.
**Role Summary**

· We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Site Incharge to lead and manage the overall site execution activities for a Hydrogen Generation Plant at locations in PAN India.

· The Site Incharge will be responsible for overall coordination and supervision of multidisciplinary site activities covering Civil, Structural, Mechanical, Piping, Electrical, Instrumentation, Utilities, Equipment Erection, Pre-Commissioning and Commissioning support.

· The candidate will act as the key site representative and coordinate with the Project Management Team, Engineering Consultants, EPC contractors, subcontractors, vendors and client representatives to ensure safe, timely and quality execution of the project.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

· Overall Site Management – Take responsibility for day-to-day site execution and administration; plan, coordinate and monitor construction and erection activities; ensure availability and proper utilisation of manpower, materials, tools and equipment; coordinate multidisciplinary teams; and ensure smooth execution through mechanical completion and handover.

· Civil & Structural Works – Supervise foundations, buildings, roads, drainage, trenches, paving and structural works; coordinate equipment foundation requirements; review IFC drawings; monitor excavation, PCC, RCC, reinforcement, shuttering, grouting and structural steel; and ensure proper survey, levels and alignment.

· Mechanical, Piping & Equipment Erection – Supervise erection and installation of plant equipment and mechanical systems including electrolyser, hydrogen compressor, gas purification/drying systems, water treatment systems, storage facilities and associated equipment, as applicable; monitor piping fabrication, erection, welding, testing and reinstatement; coordinate OEM/vendor representatives.

· Electrical & Instrumentation Coordination – Coordinate electrical equipment, cabling, panels, earthing, lighting, instrumentation, control panels, field instruments, junction boxes and control systems; ensure proper mechanical-electrical-C&I interfaces; and support testing and commissioning.

· Planning & Progress Monitoring – Monitor daily/weekly progress against the approved schedule; prepare progress reports; identify delays and bottlenecks; coordinate recovery plans; monitor contractor productivity and manpower; and participate in coordination meetings.

· Contractor & Vendor Management – Coordinate EPC contractors, subcontractors and manpower agencies; monitor performance against scope, schedule, quality and safety; ensure timely availability of drawings/materials/resources; and coordinate vendor/OEM site visits and commissioning.

· Quality Assurance & Quality Control – Ensure execution as per approved drawings, specifications, method statements and ITPs; coordinate inspections/testing; monitor material inspection and documentation; manage NCRs and punch points; and ensure test reports and checklists are maintained.

· HSE / Safety Management – Ensure compliance with HSE requirements and statutory safety regulations; implement PTW, JSA, HIRA and toolbox talks; monitor high-risk activities; coordinate HSE inspections/audits; and maintain PPE, barricading, housekeeping and emergency preparedness.

· Pre-Commissioning & Commissioning Support – Coordinate mechanical completion and handover; close construction punch points; coordinate flushing, pressure/leak testing and equipment checks; support OEM/commissioning teams during start-up; coordinate trial runs and performance testing; and ensure final punch-point closure.

· Documentation & Reporting – Maintain drawings, inspection reports, test certificates, progress reports, material records, RFIs, technical queries, deviations, site instructions and as-built information.

**3. Required Qualifications**

· B.Tech / B.E. in Mechanical Engineering or Civil Engineering from a recognised university/institute.

· 8–10 years of relevant experience in EPC, construction or project execution.

· Experience in Hydrogen, Oil & Gas, Petrochemical, Chemical, Power, Process Plant or similar industrial projects will be preferred.

· Experience in multidisciplinary plant construction and commissioning will be an advantage.

**4. Required Skills & Competencies**

· Strong site execution and project coordination skills.

· Good knowledge of multidisciplinary EPC project execution.

· Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, layouts, P&IDs and construction drawings.

· Strong contractor and manpower management skills.

· Good knowledge of construction methodologies and site safety practices.

· Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities.

· Good communication and coordination skills.

· Ability to manage multiple activities and priorities at a project site.

· Proficiency in MS Office, Excel and project reporting tools.

· Knowledge of MS Project/Primavera will be an advantage.

**5. Preferred Experience**

· Hydrogen Generation / Green Hydrogen Projects

· Electrolyser installation and commissioning

· Hydrogen compression and storage systems

· Water treatment / DM / RO systems

· Process plant construction

· Mechanical equipment erection

· Piping fabrication and erection

· Civil and structural works

· Electrical & Instrumentation installation

· Pre-commissioning and commissioning activities

· EPC/LSTK project execution

**6. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

· Safe and timely completion of site activities.

· Achievement of project milestones as per approved schedule.

· Quality compliance and reduction of rework/NCRs.

· Effective contractor and manpower utilisation.

· Timely closure of punch points and site issues.

· Successful mechanical completion and commissioning support.

· Compliance with project HSE requirements.

· Accurate and timely site progress reporting.

**7. Reporting**

· Reports To: Project Manager / Project Head

· Location: Any Location in India for Project Site work.

· Nature of Role: Full-Time, Site-Based

· Travel: As required for project execution, vendor coordination and inspections.

description:
**About The Role**
Gartner Consulting partners with clients to solve their most critical business and technology challenges through collaborative problem solving, and increasingly delivers production-grade solutions alongside its advisory work. We are looking for a hands-on Power Platform & Copilot Solutions Architect to own the architecture and delivery of Microsoft Power Platform and Copilot solutions – both internal assets used by Gartner consulting associates and client-facing solutions deployed in client environments.
  
  
This is an all-rounder role: you will articulate solution value to clients, design and build the architecture yourself, lead delivery in client engagements, and guide Power Platform engineers to deliver. You will enhance existing Gartner solutions and build new ones.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
**Client Engagement & Solutioning**

* Work with clients and Gartner consultants to understand business problems and translate them into clear, practical solution designs.
* Communicate solution value to business and technical stakeholders; support pre-sales through demos, solution approaches, effort estimates and proposal inputs.
* Lead discovery workshops and convert outcomes into requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria.

**Architecture & Hands-on Build**

* Architect and build solutions using Model-driven and Canvas Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, SharePoint and Power BI.
* Design and build Copilot Studio agents (generative orchestration, topics, tools, knowledge/RAG, autonomous triggers, multi-agent patterns) and Microsoft 365 Copilot declarative agents.
* Deliver integrations using REST/OData APIs, custom and HTTP connectors with Microsoft Entra ID authentication, and Azure services; extend with JavaScript and C# plugins where needed.
* Understand, maintain and evolve existing Gartner assets, and create reusable components and patterns across engagements.

**Delivery Leadership**

* Lead the end-to-end delivery lifecycle in client engagements – planning, estimation, sprint delivery, testing/UAT, deployment, hypercare and handover.
* Guide, review and mentor Power Platform engineers; set design and development standards and conduct solution reviews.
* Manage scope, risks and dependencies; provide clear status updates to engagement leaders and client stakeholders.

**Governance, ALM & Platform Administration**

* Administer and govern Power Platform via the Power Platform Admin Center – environment strategy, Managed Environments, DLP policies, security roles, capacity and licensing.
* Own ALM: managed/unmanaged solutions, connection references, environment variables and Power Platform Pipelines/Azure DevOps across DEV, QA and Production.
* Set up monitoring and adoption tracking using Copilot Studio analytics, Azure Application Insights, and Copilot Studio Kit; embed security and responsible AI practices.

**What You Will Need**
**Must Have**

* 5–7 years of overall experience, with hands-on Microsoft Power Platform delivery.
* Strong expertise in Power Apps (Model-driven and Canvas), Power Automate, Dataverse (data modelling, security, business rules) and Power BI.
* Hands-on Copilot Studio experience, including generative AI concepts such as LLMs, RAG, prompt engineering, knowledge sources and agent evaluation/testing.
* Experience with Power Platform administration, governance, environment management and ALM/deployment pipelines.
* Integration experience with REST APIs, custom connectors, Microsoft Entra ID (app registrations, authentication) and Azure services.
* Experience leading small delivery teams and owning end-to-end delivery of client or enterprise projects.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to bridge business and technology and explain solutions simply to senior audiences.

**Good to Have**

* Microsoft certifications such as PL-600, PL-400 or PL-200; Azure AI certifications are a plus.
* Experience with Azure OpenAI / Azure AI Foundry, Microsoft Fabric or Databricks.
* Pro-code skills in JavaScript, C# (.NET) or TypeScript for Dataverse plugins and client-side extensions.
* Prior consulting or professional services experience, or exposure to AI strategy and governance solutions.

**Who are we?**
At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.
  
  
Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.
  
  
Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.
  
  
**What makes Gartner a great place to work?**
Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.
  
  
We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.
  
  
Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.

**About The Role**
As an Controls Analyst – Financial Controls Analytics, you will support the design and delivery of data analytics solutions across BT’s Financial reporting risk and controls framework. You will work with large and complex enterprise datasets to develop, validate and visualize analytics that help identify risk indicators, control exceptions and process improvement opportunities.
  
  
The role requires strong hands-on analytical capabilities and the ability to translate audit and business requirements into scalable analytical solutions using technologies such as SQL, Python, Power BI, ETL tools and modern data platforms including Databricks and Snowflake. You will also have opportunities to contribute to technology-enabled Internal Audit transformation, including automation, Continuous Controls Monitoring (CCM), and AI/GenAI-enabled analytics.
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing (Role Accountabilities)**

* Perform data extraction, transformation, profiling and analysis using SQL, Python and ETL tools/techniques.
* Develop and execute audit analytics, exception testing and risk-based analytical procedures across enterprise processes.
* Build interactive dashboards and reporting solutions using Power BI to communicate analytical findings, exceptions and risk insights.
* Work with large and complex datasets across modern data platforms such as Databricks and/or Snowflake.
* Perform data quality checks, reconciliations and validation to ensure the completeness and accuracy of analytical outputs.
* Translate audit, risk and business requirements into analytical logic, data requirements and test scenarios.
* Collaborate with Internal Controls, business, technology and data teams to understand processes, identify relevant data sources and deliver analytics.
* Document data logic, transformation steps, assumptions and analytical procedures to support repeatability and auditability.
* Support technology-enabled Internal Audit transformation initiatives, including analytics, automation and Continuous Controls Monitoring.
* Identify opportunities to leverage AI/GenAI and Large Language Models (LLMs) within analytics, audit and risk management use cases.

**What You’ll Need To Succeed (Skills & Experience)**

* Strong hands-on experience with SQL, including complex queries, joins, aggregations, data profiling and analytical logic.
* Strong hands-on experience with Python for data analysis, transformation, statistical modelling, automation and development of scalable analytical solutions.
* Strong understanding of ETL concepts, data transformation and working with data from multiple source systems.
* Hands-on experience developing dashboards and analytical reporting solutions using Power BI.
* Experience working with data warehousing and modern data platforms such as Databricks and/or Snowflake.
* Strong data analysis, reconciliation and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work effectively with large and complex datasets.
* Ability to understand business, audit and risk requirements and translate them into structured analytical tests and actionable outputs.
* Strong communication and documentation skills, with the ability to explain analytical approaches and findings to business and audit stakeholders.
* Exposure to AI/GenAI solutions and Large Language Models (LLMs) and their application across analytics, audit and risk management.
* Ability to work collaboratively across multidisciplinary teams and manage assigned analytical deliverables.
* Understand common business and technology processes such as Procure-to-Pay (P2P/PTP), Order-to-Cash (O2C/OTC), Travel & Expense (T&E), ITGC and SOX controls.
* Have an understanding of risks, controls, KRIs and exception-based audit testing.
* Have exposure to enterprise systems and datasets such as SAP, Oracle, Workday, expense platforms, GRC tools or other ERP environments.
* Have experience or exposure to Internal Audit transformation initiatives involving analytics, automation or technology-enabled auditing.
* We are looking for a hands-on analytics professional who combines strong technical capabilities with an understanding of risk, controls and Assurance. You should be comfortable working with complex enterprise datasets, developing analytical solutions independently and translating technical findings into meaningful risk and business insights.
* You should bring a problem-solving mindset, strong attention to data quality and the ability to collaborate effectively with audit, business, data and technology stakeholders.

BT Group is the UK’s leading communications group and the holding company behind some of the country’s most recognised brands – including BT, EE, Openreach and Plusnet. Our purpose is as simple as it is ambitious: we connect for good. Our customers include consumers, small, medium and large businesses, public sector organisations and other communications providers.
  
  
BT Group’s role is about setting direction, unlocking value and creating the conditions for our brands and businesses to thrive.
  
  
Having come through the most capital-intensive phase of our fibre investment, our focus now is on what comes next – simplifying how we operate, using technology and AI to work smarter, and organising ourselves to serve customers better and grow sustainably. Group teams shape strategy, policy, brand, capital allocation and transformation, helping the whole organisation perform at its best.
  
  
We have a singular culture that unites all our people: we are customer-first challengers, who are committed, clear and connected. These behaviours unite us as one team to deliver for our colleagues, our customers, our stakeholders and the country. Joining BT Group means working at the heart of a business that matters to the UK, with the opportunity to shape decisions, influence outcomes and help set the future course of one of the country’s most important companies.

title: Assistant Consultant- Ecology
description:
**Job Description**
WSP is seeking
**Assistant Consultants**
to join our large and growing technical support team in India (Noida/Bengaluru/Mumbai), working closely with our UK-wide national Ecology team.
  
  
The successful candidate will support data delivery and GIS-based outputs that underpin ecological assessments and reporting. You will play a key role in ensuring high-quality, efficient, and client-focused project delivery by handling, analysing, and visualising ecological data collected across UK projects.
  
  
The role is primarily focused on
**data handling, GIS analysis, and technical support**
, contributing to a wide range of environmental and multidisciplinary projects across commercial and scientific sectors.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Data Management & Analysis
* Handling, sorting, validation, and preparation of ecological datasets
* Managing, interpreting, and manipulating large and complex data sets
* Ensuring data quality control, validation, and adherence to QA/QC processes
* Supporting structured data storage, metadata standards, and version control
* GIS & Spatial Deliverables
* Preparation of ecological cartography (e.g., habitat maps, species distribution plans) to recognised standards
* Performing spatial analysis, including calculation of habitat losses and gains
* Supporting Biodiversity Net Gain (BNG) analysis and preparation of associated digital inputs
* Developing GIS templates and data capture tools for use in field data collection platforms
* Generating high-quality figures and mapping outputs for reports, publications, and consultations
* Technical Support to Ecology Projects
* Preparing supporting information for European Protected Species licensing and assessments
* Assisting in preparation of habitat mitigation and compensation design plans
* Supporting HRA/EIA deliverables through data and mapping inputs
* Interpreting ecological survey data and translating it into usable outputs
* Data & Systems Management
* Purchasing and maintaining datasets (e.g., OS Mapping and third-party datasets) in compliance with licensing agreements
* Ensuring adherence to data security, licensing, and compliance requirements
* Collaboration & Continuous Improvement
* Working collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams across ecology, planning, and EIA
* Actively promoting knowledge sharing and development of best practices
* Supporting internal stakeholders and building strong working relationships across WSP
* Contributing to process improvements and efficiency enhancements

* Exposure to UK ecology standards and international best practices
* Strong focus on learning, development, and career progression
* Collaborative and inclusive team environment

**4,000 talented people**
across 3 locations (Noida, Bengaluru & Mumbai offices) in India and more than
**73,000 globally**

title: Manager, GTM Operations
description:
**About The Job**
The database market is massive (the IDC estimates it to be $140B+ by 2027!) and MongoDB is at the head of its disruption. The MongoDB community is transforming industries and empowering developers to build amazing apps that people use every day. We are the leading modern data platform and the first database provider to IPO in over 20 years. Join our team and be at the forefront of innovation and creativity.
  
  
Our Strategy and Planning team, part of our broader Sales Operations team, strives to help our Sales organization go faster and grow faster. This function acts as business partners to our Senior Sales Leaders. You have an opportunity to embed yourself as the “COO” of the India Enterprise business, and your responsibilities will range across a variety of strategic initiatives including analyzing inefficient business rules, piloting new sales roles, optimizing for obstacles in the sales process, and analyzing sales data to come up with meaningful business insights. You will also get involved in regional & Global initiatives to benefit the wider business.
  
  
We are seeking a Manager of Sales Strategy & Planning to run our India region. This role will contain a direct report and will shape how our future organization becomes more productive, scalable, and AI-enabled.
  
  
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
As the India Strategy and Planning Manager, you will:
  
  

* Help drive the analytical rhythm of our business including quarterly business reviews, org deep dives
* Organize and execute on the strategy of our India GTM team - building the next wave of MongoDB customers
* Partner with Senior Sales leadership to drive market + segment specific analyses to uncover insight and provide recommendations
* Conceptualize and pilot new programs to test the effectiveness of various sales roles / comp plans
* Participate in quarterly and annual business planning for the Sales teams

The Ideal Candidate
  
  

* Education: Bachelor’s Degree with a quantitative focus (Economics, Finance, Computer Science, Mathematics, etc.)
* Experience: 5+ years of work experience in either Sales Strategy / Consulting / Sales Operations / Analytics
* Management: Experience managing a team or supervising a direct report
* Technical Aptitude: Strong proficiency in SQL, AI tooling, and data visualization
* Analytical Mindset: Proven experience working with large datasets to conduct analysis, identify data trends or issues, and quantify business impact.
* Problem Solving: A proactive approach to navigating ambiguity, with the ability to help distill high-level business needs into structured, actionable tools.
* Communication: Ability to communicate technical findings clearly and efficiently to non-technical, cross-functional partners.

**About MongoDB**
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
  
  
With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
  
  
Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
  
  
To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

title: Senior Analyst-Data Analytics
description:
**Job Description**
The UMGEA – Global Analytics team is seeking an Analyst for the Field Analytics team. The Analyst will support the build and rollout of scalable merchant intelligence capabilities that help identify actionable opportunities, enable retention and growth initiatives, and inform Client Management and Marketing treatments across GMNS.
  
  
This role will support work across merchant triggers, retention analytics, trigger arbitration, treatment playbooks, and predictive insights. The Analyst will help translate analytical opportunities into clear business actions, supporting the transition of insights and pilots into governed, production-ready capabilities through platforms. The role requires strong analytical problem-solving, attention to detail, execution discipline, and the ability to turn complex data into practical recommendations that can be activated by field, Client Management, and Marketing partners.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Provide analytic and execution support for merchant retention, trigger arbitration, treatment playbooks, and predictive insights that enable GMNS growth initiatives and CLM priorities.
* Analyze merchant performance, spend, engagement, coverage, and behavioral trends to identify early indicators of decline, retention risk, and growth opportunities and support field activation decisions.
* Support the development and scaling of merchant trigger capabilities, including deterministic and predictive triggers that help enable timely, insight-led interventions.
* Help translate analytical pilots and proof-of-concepts into governed, production-ready capabilities through enterprise platforms such as TargetIQ .
* Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to understand business questions, define analytical requirements, and deliver timely, high-quality insights.
* Translate complex data into clear, concise findings, treatment recommendations, and business actions that can be understood and acted upon by partners.
* Support automation and standardization of recurring analytics processes to improve efficiency, reduce operational risk, and increase speed to market.

**Qualifications**

* 2-4 years of relevant experience in analytical domain.
* Intellectual curiosity, attention to detail ability to learn quickly and drive results.
* Ability to drive insights from data, manage multiple projects and drive results in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong collaboration skills with ability to build relationships and challenge the status quo.
* Excellent business writing and presentation skills with the ability to communicate effectively, build relationships and influence at all levels.
* Technical Skills: Familiarity with Google Big Query, SQL, Python, Lumi, PySpark and Tableau.
* Experience in dispute analytics, risk operations, or merchant business preferred.
* Experience in Machine Learning/ Cloud / Gen AI is a plus.

**Academic Background**

* Bachelors in Statistics/Mathematics/Economics/ Engineering/Data Science with relevant experience.
* Post Graduation in Statistics/Mathematics/ Economics/Engineering/Management is a plus.

title: Svcs Business Analyst
description:
**Business Analyst – (Client Engagement Services)**
**What makes Gartner a GREAT fit for you?**
When you join Gartner, you’ll be part of a fast-growing team that helps the world become smarter and more connected. We’re the leader in our industry, achieving double-digit growth by helping clients make the right decisions with business and technology insights they can’t find anywhere else. Our associates enjoy a collaborative work environment, exceptional training and career development — as well as unlimited growth potential. If you like working with a generous, supportive, high-performing team, Gartner is where you want to be.
  
  
**About this role:**
The Global S&O arm of Gartner is currently seeking talented people to join its Client Engagement Service (CES) team in India. As a member of this team you will drive client engagement and service productivity programs across Gartner. You will work towards driving integrated approach across Gartner’s key functions – Business units under Global Service & Delivery (GS&D), Sales, BTI and Products and their leaders with the central goal of improving client retention through high value engagement mechanisms. You will also get an opportunity to work on some of the high impacting strategic projects to drive key organizational goals, operational & economic productivity of the overall operations and service associates.
  
  
**What you’ll do:**
This stint involves driving some of the high business impacting strategic initiatives which aim to drive key business priorities of CES with an ultimate focus towards client engagement and retention. You will drive efficiency and productivity across the client value chain through key functions of the services operations team – Client insights, Service Advisors and Events CoE. The ultimate goal will be to drive client engagement and retention by actively working with the Service Delivery Teams across geographies. You will also help in crafting high impact outreach campaigns, content review, Mission critical priority (MCP)/ Client Initiative (CI) led value delivery campaigns, securing valuable client feedback through surveys and come up with insights and recommendations for course correction.
  
  
**Core Operations:**
▪ Drive client retention and engagement by collaborating with and empowering Global service delivery groups across client retention life cycle
  
  
▪ Own and accountable for a large portfolio of clients across various key initiatives of Service Operations function. Partner and enable services teams on this portfolio to drive seamless value delivery to clients.
  
  
▪ Partner with services teams to identify clients’ C level priorities by analyzing multiple data sources and synthesizing them to identify the most impactful client priorities
  
  
▪ Drive Events CoE to increase client registrations, engagement and other operational metrics leading to higher client retention for the organization
  
  
▪ Conceptualize, design and implement initiatives that have a direct impact on KPIs
  
  
▪ Work on content review for client marketing campaigns, developing valuable suggestions for client marketing assets
  
  
▪ Drive operational excellence – incremental improvement of overall operational engine – reduced process steps and complexity by developing intuitive and simpler process design/interfaces and automate it.
  
  
▪ Implement best practices/tested solutions across Service Delivery Associates to maximize effectiveness of key levers
  
  
▪ Analyzing lagging/leading business KPIs across all stages of the client value chain in order to generate actionable insights, develop implementation plans and ensure execution of all changes
  
  
▪ Continuously improve quality of processes & deliverables by establishing a regular process check and measurement mechanism.
  
  
**Iterate and Evolve to increase Business Impact**
▪ Push self to innovate on productivity and efficiency drivers. Implement those innovation end to end based on ROI impact and measure the success.
  
  
▪ Build and drive stakeholders to implement strategic initiatives to drive R&P and client engagement – process improvement ideas, A/B testing and leveraging various sources of information to make it useful for continuous improvement
  
  
▪ Work on process analytics to analyze client responses, coming up with actionable insights to improve process governance
  
  
▪ Drive structured problem solving on various projects as needed. Provide guidance on data driven hypothesis testing and scale up approaches. Influence decision making on next big bet.
  
  
▪ Discover innovative levers/best practices (escp. Focusing on right MCPs/KIs of client) within Gartner or outside aiming to boost effectiveness of outreaches – higher R&Ps, usage, retention
  
  
▪ Continue to evolve on funneling approach of outreach mechanism by leveraging client’s footprints and persona
  
  
▪ Provide active support as and when needed during development and execution of strategic initiatives within GS&O, GS&D and across Sales, R&A and Product; lead some of these projects independently.
  
  
**Continuous Process Optimization**
▪ Identify process improvement opportunities and apply LEAN principles to boost efficiency and productivity of processes & people
  
  
▪ Keeping in mind ‘One Gartner’ approach to serve clients, integrate and standardize all possible elements of the process. Also, aim for economy of scale by integrating all process touch points (Sales, onboarding, servicing, client surveys) of client’s journey in order to map the client behavior better to deliver client value.
  
  
▪ Conduct time & motion diagnostics to explore opportunities of process redesign. Establish process excellence to operate in a Lean way including maximization of automation for all tasks and process
  
  
▪ Continue to re-engineer and optimize the instrumentation (dashboards, reports, tools) designed to measure and alert SDAs/Leadership on lagging/leading KPIs
  
  
**Collaboration and Stakeholder Management**
▪ Own stakeholder management, relationship building with team members and with cross-functional units. Ensure right communication and positioning of the vision and priorities to team members.
  
  
▪ Communicating and presenting analytical insights to internal stakeholders and to senior management
  
  
▪ Partnering with internal stakeholders to learn, ideate, and recommend automation alternatives to service delivery associates’ manual work streams
  
  
▪ Delivering strong support to the stakeholders with a no-limits mindset to do everything to increase retention
  
  
▪ Drive problem solving via story boarding and driving discussions in various forums
  
  
▪ Actively Improve collaboration and close-coordination with global teams across time-zones
  
  
**What you’ll need:**

* MBA with 0-4 years of work experience
* Strong leadership skills to build capability within the team and collaborate with other team leads to ensure the larger goals are met
* Good command of knowledge related to Information technology, product development and its application to business
* Knowledge/experience on analytical problem solving, analytical tools
* Exposure and understanding of lean six sigma, lean diagnostics, T&M and other process improvement techniques would be a big plus

**Who you are:**

* Developing professionals with strong business acumen, problem solving leadership (qualitative & quantitative).
* High on champion mindset and a quick learner
* Strong orientation towards operational and business excellence
* Strong communication and collaboration skills
* Innovative mindset and inclination to solve business problems
* Analytical thinker with experience deriving business insights from data analytics
* Detail-oriented with high personal standard for quality
* Comfortable in working with cross-functional teams
* Skillful in managing expectations of varying stakeholders (internal & external)

**What we offer:**
In addition to an outstanding work environment with rapid advancement potential, Gartner associates enjoy exceptional compensation and benefits, including:
  
  

* Competitive base salary
* Flexible work environment
* A great work culture

**About Gartner:**
Gartner, Inc. (NYSE: IT) is the world’s leading information technology research and advisory company. We deliver the technology-related insight necessary for our clients to make the right decisions, every day. We work with every client to research, analyze and interpret the business of IT within the context of their individual role. Founded in 1979, Gartner is headquartered in Stamford, Connecticut, U.S.A. Visit gartner.com to discover more.
  
  
**Who are we?**
At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.
  
  
Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.
  
  
Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.
  
  
**What makes Gartner a great place to work?**
Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.
  
  
We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.
  
  
Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.
  
  
We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.
  
  
**Gartner is the world authority on AI**
At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.
  
  
It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.
  
  
**What do we offer?**
Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.
  
  
In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.
  
  
Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

title: Senior Analyst - FOPS Performance and Analytics
description:
Achieving our goals starts with supporting yours. Grow your career, access top-tier health and wellness benefits, build lasting connections with your team and our customers, and travel the world using our extensive route network.
  
  
Come join us to create what’s next. Let’s define tomorrow, together.
  
  
**Description**
Get ready for a career at the leading edge of the airline industry! Our Flight Operations team works hard to connect people and unite the world safely, reliably and efficiently every single day. From industry leadership and pioneering technologies to next-level training, our Flight Ops team hires, trains, qualifies and supports the best pilots in the industry. The moments we share in the air and on the ground with our customers and our colleagues make United a special place to work and a great way to fly, together.
  
  
**Job Overview And Responsibilities**
The Flight Operations Performance & Analytics team delivers reporting, advanced analytics and decision-support solutions across key operational areas. The team's goal is to improve reliability and efficiency within United's pilot operation. Areas of focus include delays and cancellations, reserve staffing, training scheduling, irregular operations and other operational priorities.
  
  
The team improves visibility into operational issues and supports effective resource allocation through scalable reporting, analysis and analytical tools. Its work helps reduce costs associated with delays and cancellations, suboptimal reserve staffing, unbalanced flying levels and inefficient trip builds, while supporting long-term staffing and training-event planning. The team also develops KPIs, dashboards, automation and analytical solutions for leaders across Flight Operations.
  
  
The Senior Analyst will deliver advanced analytics and data-driven solutions that help Flight Operations leaders improve operational performance, reliability and efficiency. The role will translate complex operational problems into actionable insights, identify root causes and opportunities, and develop scalable analytics, dashboards, automation and AI-enabled solutions to support business decisions.
  
  

* Partner with Flight Operations leaders to translate business challenges into analytical solutions and actionable insights.
* Perform advanced analysis and root-cause diagnostics across areas such as delays and cancellations, open time, reserve staffing, sick leave, training and crew operations.
* Design and develop KPIs, dashboards, analytical tools and decision-support solutions for Flight Operations leadership and business teams.
* Identify opportunities to automate and streamline recurring reporting and analytical processes.
* Analyze large operational datasets using SQL, Python and visualization tools to identify trends, risks and improvement opportunities.
* Evaluate new processes, tools and operational initiatives to determine whether they are delivering intended business outcomes.
* Develop recommendations that improve operational reliability, resource utilization and cost efficiency.
* Build high-quality presentations and analytical outputs for Flight Operations leadership, eTeam, front-line management and business teams across the organization.
* Apply approved AI and automation capabilities to accelerate analysis, improve productivity and develop scalable analytical solutions.
* Independently structure ambiguous business problems and drive analytical work from problem definition through recommendation.

**This position is offered on local terms and conditions. Expatriate assignments and sponsorship for employment visas, even on a time-limited visa status, will not be awarded. This position is for United Airlines Business Services Pvt. Ltd., a wholly owned subsidiary of United Airlines Inc.**
**Qualifications**
**What's needed to succeed (Minimum Qualifications):**

* Bachelor's degree in Operations Research, Computer Science, Statistics, Logistics/Transportation, Industrial Engineering, Engineering or another quantitative field such as mathematics, statistics or economics.
* 4+ years of experience in business intelligence, data analytics, data science and/or data engineering.
* Strong understanding of data structures, data relationships and data modeling.
* Familiarity with the data ecosystem, including acquisition, engineering, storage, management, analysis, visualization and deployment.
* Advanced proficiency in Excel and data analysis/modeling.
* Proven ability to work with large and complex datasets.
* Proficiency in writing complex queries and procedures using SQL, with experience in Python or another analytical programming language.
* Experience developing dashboards and analytical solutions using visualization platforms such as Power BI, Tableau or Spotfire.
* Ability to understand business needs and design data and technology solutions that connect business processes with quantifiable outcomes.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate complex analytical findings into clear recommendations for business and operational stakeholders.
* Hands-on experience applying approved AI tools to improve analytical, automation or business workflows.
* Must be legally authorized to work in India for any employer without sponsorship.
* Must be fluent in English, written and spoken.
* Successful completion of an interview is required to meet job qualifications.
* Reliable, punctual attendance is an essential function of the position.

**What will help you propel from the pack (Preferred Qualifications):**

* Master's degree in a quantitative, analytical or business discipline.
* Airline experience or knowledge of airline operations, ideally pilot flight operations.
* Exposure to statistical and advanced analytical methods.
* Exposure to workflow automation or agentic AI platforms such as Power Automate or Copilot Studio.
* Adaptability in a changing business environment.
* Ability to build and maintain positive relationships with stakeholders.
* Passion for the airline industry and its complexity and challenges.
* Supportive team player motivated to make a difference.

title: Business Analyst & PM Coordinator
description:
Atomic Computing is an AWS Partner that helps SaaS and SMB companies cut cloud costs, improve security, stay compliant and scale faster. We work with clients across North America, Europe, the Middle East and India, and we're growing our delivery team in Delhi NCR.

We're looking for a Business Analyst & PM Coordinator: someone who sits between our clients and our engineers, turns messy conversations into clear requirements, and keeps projects moving. It's a client-facing role, part technical, part commercial.

**What you'll do**

* Run discovery and requirements workshops with clients, and write clear PRDs, user stories and acceptance criteria
* Coordinate delivery: plans, owners, timelines, status reports and follow-ups, so nothing falls through the cracks
* Present to clients, confidently and clearly, in calls, demos and steering meetings
* Spot gaps, risks and contradictions early, and raise them before they become problems
* Manage change requests: assess the impact on scope, timeline and cost, and help clients decide
* Build strong relationships with clients and with our engineering, cloud and security teams

**What we're looking for**

* Excellent spoken and written English, and you enjoy presenting
* Experience as a Business Analyst, Project/Product Manager or similar, ideally on software, cloud or SaaS projects
* A sense of urgency: you follow up today, not next week, and you own outcomes
* Accuracy and attention to detail
* Enough technical understanding to talk to engineers (APIs, cloud, data); you don't need to code
* Based in Delhi NCR and able to meet clients and the team in person when needed
* Certification (CBAP, CCBA, ECBA, PMI-PBA, PMP, CAPM, CSPO/PSPO, CSM/PSM) is a big plus

**What we offer**

* ₹62,000 – ₹77,000 per month on a contract basis, full-time hours
* Work with international clients on cloud, AI and security projects
* A small, fast-moving team where your work is visible

**How to apply**

Apply here on LinkedIn. Please make sure your profile shows your location and a profile photo. Shortlisted applicants get a short form, a quiz, and a practical 48-hour client brief that ends in a 5-minute Loom presentation, before the final interview.

title: Business Analyst - Knowledge Management
description:
**ERM**
is the world’s largest specialist sustainability consultancy, with over 50 years of experience helping organisations navigate complex environmental, social, and governance challenges. We bring together a global community of experts to deliver meaningful impact for our clients and the planet.
  
  
The
**Global Delivery Centre**
(GDC) in Gurugram is ERM’s global operating backbone. It delivers business enablement services in Finance, HR, IT, and Commercial Operations to ensure ERM’s global business runs seamlessly, efficiently, and consistently.
  
  
At the GDC, you will:
  
  

* Be part of a hub that ensures ERM’s business continuity worldwide.
* Collaborate with colleagues across geographies to support global operations.
* Drive consistency, compliance, and efficiency in core functions.
* Work with digital, automation, and AI-enabled tools to optimise how ERM operates.
* Work in shifts where required, depending on the role. As processes mature and automation increases, reliance on shifts will reduce.

**Why this role matters?**
As a Business Analyst (Knowledge Management), you will support ERM’s global delivery by supporting the HR Transformation and Process Improvement projects. You will work within People Services Team (GDC), partnering with various stakeholders to achieve desired results. This role is critical to project delivery, efficiency and GCC’s scalability.
  
  
**What will your impact be?**
You will play a key role in strengthening HR knowledge management and enabling a seamless digital employee experience across the GDC. You will ensure HR content, policies, processes, and self-service journeys are accurate, accessible, and continuously improved, while supporting the transition of HR activities into the GDC through structured planning, documentation, knowledge transfer, and hyper-care. Working closely with HR SMEs, process owners, technology teams, and stakeholders, you will bring structure to requirements and backlog management, drive Agile delivery, and identify opportunities to simplify processes, improve self-service adoption, and create a consistent, scalable HR experience.
  
  
**Key responsibilities:**
**Knowledge Management & Content Curation**

* Own and curate HR portal content across Help, Minerva, Workday Help, and other digital channels, ensuring an accurate, consistent, and user-friendly employee experience.
* Develop, maintain, and continuously improve customer journeys, knowledge articles, FAQs, and self-service content.
* Maintain front-end/portal content and coordinate with relevant stakeholders to ensure content is clear, current, and aligned with business requirements.
* Publish and maintain policies, handbooks, SOPs, and process documentation, ensuring appropriate version control and alignment with local process owners.
* Establish and maintain content governance, including content reviews, ownership, version control, and periodic refresh cycles.

**Self-Service & Digital Adoption**

* Support the rollout and adoption of HR self-service capabilities, including Workday Help and other digital HR solutions.
* Develop and maintain communication and knowledge content to support new feature releases, process changes, and system enhancements.
* Partner with HR SMEs and technology teams to translate complex processes into simple, employee-friendly self-service experiences.
* Monitor user feedback and identify opportunities to improve content, navigation, and self-service adoption.

**Transition Planning & Execution**

* Partner with SMEs to identify, define, and document activities required for the transition of HR processes into the GDC.
* Translate transition requirements into structured RBD backlog items, including activities, dependencies, ownership, timelines, and deliverables.
* Develop and maintain transition documentation, including SOPs, process maps, knowledge articles, issue logs, and transition plans.
* Support transition readiness, knowledge transfer, and hyper-care activities to ensure smooth integration and operational stabilization.
* Identify knowledge gaps, process risks, and dependencies and proactively work with stakeholders to address them.

**Agile & Backlog Management**

* Work within an Agile delivery framework to manage, prioritize, and continuously refine the RBD backlog.
* Convert business and transition requirements into clear user stories, tasks, acceptance criteria, and actionable deliverables.
* Track backlog progress, dependencies, risks, and impediments to support timely delivery.
* Actively participate in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Collaborate with SMEs, HR stakeholders, technology teams, and GDC teams to ensure alignment and timely resolution of delivery challenges.

**What you’ll bring:**

* Experience in Business Analysis, Knowledge Management, HR Operations, or Process Improvement.
* Strong understanding of BPM, process mapping, and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Knowledge of Lean Six Sigma principles; certification is an advantage.
* Proven ability to gather requirements and develop SOPs, process maps, user stories, and knowledge content.
* Experience working with global teams and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience with Workday, HR portals, knowledge management, or digital self-service platforms.
* Ability to manage priorities, track deliverables, and work effectively in an Agile environment.

**Preferred:**

* Experience in HR Shared Services, GCC, or global HR transformation environments.
* Exposure to BPM, Lean Six Sigma, Agile, or continuous improvement methodologies.
* Familiarity with Workday, HR knowledge management, digital self-service, or workflow platforms.
* Experience leveraging automation, Co-pilot, or AI-enabled tools to improve processes and employee experience.
* Relevant certifications such as Business Analysis, Agile/Scrum, or Project Management.

title: Supply Planner
description:
SUNPAN is a fast-growing global furniture brand that specializes in the design of high quality, trend-forward furnishings for commercial and residential spaces. We collaborate with established designers and suppliers from around the globe to source the finest materials and inspired styles. As a trade-only company, we are a trusted source for interior designers seeking timeless pieces that elevate any space. Our curated assortment spans dining and bar to living, bedroom, outdoor, and accents.
  
  
Proudly certified as a Great Place to Work for five consecutive years, SUNPAN fosters a creative and supportive environment. We welcome talented individuals to explore rewarding career opportunities across our diverse teams.
  
  
**Job Summary**
As a Supply Planner, you will work closely with the Merchandising and Purchasing team to monitor and control inventory levels, as well as analyze current inventory levels, production speed, and sales forecasts to determine product fulfillment needs that meet customer demand.
  
  
The Supply Planner will find ways to improve inventory management while planning, forecasting, researching, and identifying opportunities for growth. This is an excellent opportunity for an enthusiastic individual who possesses strong analytical skills and a passion for supply chain management.
  
  
This role requires regular interaction with the Toronto team, including attendance at scheduled meetings during overlapping business hours, typically in the afternoon/evening IST several times per week.
  
  
**About The Role**

* Inventory Planning: Assist in developing and executing inventory planning strategies to maintain optimal stock levels, considering factors such as sales forecasts, lead times, and seasonality.
* Demand Forecasting: Collaborate with the sales and marketing teams to analyze market trends, historical data, and customer demand patterns to create accurate demand forecasts for home furnishing products.
* Order Management: Monitor and manage purchase orders, ensuring timely placement, delivery, and availability of inventory while maintaining appropriate inventory turns.
* Supplier Coordination: Liaise with suppliers to confirm order details, track shipments, and resolve any supply-related issues, ensuring on-time delivery and resolving discrepancies.
* Inventory Analysis: Conduct regular inventory analysis, including reviewing stock levels, identifying slow-moving or obsolete items, and proposing action plans for inventory optimization.
* Reporting and Documentation: Generate reports on key performance indicators (KPIs), inventory metrics, and supply chain performance, providing insights and recommendations for improvement.
* Collaboration and Communication: Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including procurement, logistics, sales, and customer service, to ensure alignment and efficient supply chain operations.
* Process Improvement: Identify opportunities for process enhancements and actively contribute to the continuous improvement of supply chain processes and system.
* Attend evening calls once or twice per week to collaborate with North American stakeholders and ensure effective cross‑time‑zone communication.
* Conduct occasional factory visits to support operational oversight, relationship management.

**Let's Talk About You**

* Post-secondary diploma or degree in Finance, Accounting, Supply Chain Management, Inventory Management, Economics or equivalent
* 2+ years of progressive Supply Planner or related experience
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret data and make informed decisions.
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Proficient in Microsoft Excel and other relevant software applications for data analysis and reporting.
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with internal teams and external suppliers.
* Knowledge of supply chain concepts, inventory management, and demand forecasting is a plus.
* A self-motivated and proactive mindset, with the ability to work both independently and as part of a team.
* Knowledge of SAP is an asset

title: (Associate) Director, Evidence, AI Access Initiative (EAII Advisors
description: About The AI Access Initiative (2AI)We're at an inflection point in artificial intelligence - presenting both tremendous potential opportunity and risk for people in developing countries. AI capabilities are improving on a timescale measured in months, while development systems often move on timescales measured in decades. Much of the technology needed for positive impact exists today, but few organizations exist to bridge research, deployment, and scaled implementation: we must act now to ensure AI's benefits reach people in poverty in LMICs.Incubated at Evidence Action, we're scaling The AI Access Initiative, an organization focused on scaling AI-enabled 'big bets' to benefit tens or hundreds of millions of people in poverty in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs). We operate at the intersection of global development actors, top AI labs, and leading researchers to drive meaningful access to AI's benefits for the 3.5 billion people living in poverty globally. We create "public good," open-sourced playbooks, toolkits, and insights that define how to design and launch tractable and impactful AI-enabled programs. Given the scale of opportunity, we expect our portfolio to expand substantially, but to start, we're scaling two programs focused on AI in Agriculture and AI in Health.Agriculture: We have an ambitious goal to reach 100M+ farmers with AI-enabled weather forecasts, expand forecast R&D to generate novel forecasts, and build public and private sector (WhatsApp, telcos) delivery channels to deliver new, LLM-generated voice and image content that maximizes behavior change. Health: Here, our initial goal is to scale AI-enabled clinical decision support to 20M+ people via telemedicine platforms, dramatically improving diagnosis and health outcomes at a national level. We are also planning to explore and test novel interventions for low-resource settings, including direct-to-consumer (DTC) health interventions. We are led by former Evidence Action CEO Kanika Bahl, a founding member of Anthropic's Long-Term Benefit Trust, and advised by Nobel Laureate Michael Kremer; Dario Amodei, CEO of Anthropic; and Kent Walker, President, Global Affairs for Alphabet and Google. This work builds on Evidence Action's track record reaching 530M+ people with cost-effective, evidence-based programs across 9 countries in Africa and Asia, with a focus on last-mile delivery.About 2AI India And EAII AdvisorsEAII Advisors, Evidence Action's technical partner in India, supports state governments in delivering evidence-based public health programs. Operating across 10 states, EAII Advisors provides technical assistance to ministries of health, education, water, and women and child development, reducing health burdens in impoverished communities and improving the long-term wellbeing of children and families.2AI India is being incubated as a project within EAII Advisors, with plans to spin off into an independent entity at the end of this year. We are hiring a founding team: the first hires will shape the culture, establish the operating model, and own early wins before the organization scales.Roles And ResponsibilitiesThis role reports to the Global Monitoring, Learning, and Evaluation Director. The Associate Director / Director, Evidence is 2AI India's primary engine for measuring whether our programs work and why. This is not a traditional monitoring and evaluation (M&E) role. The focus is generating insights that change program design in real time. Data collection for government reporting is a real but secondary function, roughly 20% of the role. The Evidence Lead is also expected to be actively applying AI and machine learning (ML) tools to evaluation.Evidence Generation and Program MeasurementMeasures the effectiveness of new programs and ideas, from early concept tests through scaled delivery, and defines what "working" means for each before it launchesIdentifies the right data sources for evaluation, including administrative data, program data, partner data, and primary collection, and making the tradeoffs between rigor, cost, and speed explicitDesigns and runs cost-effectiveness models, making the assumptions behind each result legible to the people making the callBuilds the measurement and feedback loops into program design from the start rather than retrofitting them after launchOwns the data collection and reporting obligations that come with government partnerships, roughly 20% of the role,Thought Partnership to ProgramsServes as a thought partner to the programs team on program design, ensuring programs are built to be measurable and monitoring and evaluation efforts measure what really matters. Translates findings into recommendations that program leads can act on, and is explicit about the confidence behind each oneExternal RepresentationPresents 2AI's evidence and data externally, with findings tailored to the needs of specific audiences: funders, partners, government counterparts, and the research communityTeam building and enablementFosters a strong, values-aligned culture as a leader across the organizationWillingness to roll-up sleeves and pitch in to the organization building activities required of a founding teamOvertime, hires and enables a team of strong monitoring, learning, and evaluation professionals committed to objectively assessing our programs and fostering their improvementAI and ML Applied to EvaluationApplies AI and ML tools directly to evaluation and data analysis work, and keeps that practice current as the tools changeBuilds the data and modeling infrastructure that lets a small team run rapid and purpose-built analysisDisclaimer: The duties and responsibilities described are not a comprehensive list and additional tasks may be assigned to the employee from time to time.We are still actively scoping our roles and structure, reflecting the dynamism of this fast-growing phase of the organization — both the fun and the realities that come with rapid growth. 2AI is open to candidates across the Associate Director-level, and for the right candidate, the Director level. Title, scope, and compensation will be assessed candidly with each candidate throughout the process based on their experience and fit.RequirementsEssentials:Relevant professional background: 7-9 years of experience in M&E, impact evaluation, or applied research in global health or international developmentRigorous evidence environment: has worked in an organization where methodological standards were high and contested, such as academic research, a think tank, or an equivalent research labCost-effectiveness modelling: experience building and updating cost-effectiveness analyses, and can explain the assumptions driving a result to a non-technical decision-makerAnalytical structuring: structures ambiguous problems, thinks analytically, and solves quantitative problems without waiting for a fully specified briefProgram collaboration instincts: experience working in close proximity to programs; can understand how program needs and constraints differ from research needs, and adjusts the evidence agenda accordinglyClear communication: shows clarity of thought, writes compellingly, and translates technical information into common language for varied audiencesExternal credibility: can present to funders, government counterparts, and technical peers and hold up under questioningExperience navigating Indian government data systems and state-level reporting requirementsComfort with ambiguity: a track record of doing well in early-stage, resource-constrained environments where the path is not defined and you build it as you goInitiative and bias to action: takes ownership of unassigned problems and moves without being askedApplied AI and ML fluency: using AI and ML tools in evaluation and data analysis work today is nice to have but not mandatoryWhat Success Looks LikeIn the First 6 Months:You have a working measurement approach with key indicators for the agriculture program, agreed with the Program Director, that specifies what evidence would change the program's directionYou have built or adapted a cost-effectiveness model for at least one priority intervention, and leadership understands and trusts its assumptionsYou have mapped the available data landscape in India, including what government and partner systems can and cannot tell usCompensation : Competitive and commensurate with the individual's credentials, experience, and previous pay scale.BenefitsEAII provides a comprehensive benefits package for employees. title: Senior Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A)
description:

title: Commercial Pricing Analyst
description:
**Commercial Pricing Analyst**

As a Commercial Pricing Analyst at TMS Global, part of DS Smith, you'll play a key role in supporting profitable growth across a diverse international customer portfolio. Working with stakeholders across EMEA, APAC, LATAM and North America, you'll transform complex commercial data into actionable insights, influence pricing strategy and support critical decision-making that drives business performance and long-term customer value.

Working closely with Sales, Procurement and Commercial Finance teams, you'll develop benchmarking models and provide commercial analysis to support contract renewals, RFP activity, raw material indexation and strategic pricing decisions across our global business.
**This role is offered on an initial 12 month contract.**

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Commercial Strategy & Planning**

* Analyse customer and supplier pricing data to provide actionable insights and support informed commercial decision making.
* Ensure pricing decisions align with margin objectives, customer agreements and overall commercial strategy.
* Monitor raw material indices and market trends, providing insight and recommendations on potential pricing impacts.
* Identify opportunities to improve pricing performance, operational efficiency and commercial effectiveness.

**Process & Systems Optimisation**

* Drive automation initiatives and process improvements to enhance efficiency, accuracy and scalability across commercial operations.
* Manage the implementation of contract events within internal systems, including contract anniversaries and raw material index (RMI) adjustments.
* Develop, enhance and maintain pricing models, ensuring effective deployment and adoption across the business.

**Internal Support & Governance**

* Partner with implementation and account teams on contract execution, onboarding and pricing-related issue resolution.
* Provide data management, pricing administration and commercial policy support to sales and finance teams.
* Equip Operations and Shared Service teams with tools and guidance to ensure accurate product pricing.
* Ensure adherence to internal controls and commercial governance processes, reporting any identified risks to senior management.

**About You**

This role would suit someone who thrives in a fast-paced, matrix environment and enjoys collaborating across teams and geographies. You’ll bring strong analytical capability, attention to detail, and a proactive, solutions-focused mindset.

**The ideal candidate will have experience in the following areas:**

* Fluency in English, written and spoken is a standard requirement.
* A background in the Packaging industry, with Print experience is essential.
* Proven experience within pricing and commercial analytics
* Strong experience developing and maintaining pricing models and analytical tools.
* Strong understanding of commercial pricing methodologies, supply chain dynamics and operational delivery.
* Excellent stakeholder management skills, with experience partnering across commercial, finance and operational teams.
* Advanced Excel skills, including modelling and data analysis.
* Experience using Power BI or similar visualisation tools would be advantageous.

If this role sounds like an exciting opportunity and you believe you have the skills and experience to succeed, we'd love to hear from you.

*“To achieve our aim of being among the most successful, sustainable and responsible companies in the world, we aim to build a diverse, motivated, and engaged workforce. Our goal is to create a culture of inclusion where everyone is treated fairly, differences are valued, and everyone has an equal opportunity to succeed.*

*Our people come from diverse backgrounds, bring different perspectives, ideas and experiences to generate unique solutions focused on present and future sustainability challenges. We welcome all candidates to apply, even those not meeting all criteria.”*
