title: Lead - Site Sales
description:
**Responsibilities**

* Site Sales and Revenue Generation
* Achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets for the assigned real estate project.
* Manage the end-to-end sales process from initial inquiry to booking closure.
* Engage with prospective customers visiting the project site or sales experience centre.
* Understand customer requirements, budgets, preferences, and investment objectives.
* Recommend suitable units based on customer requirements and available inventory.
* Present project features, amenities, location advantages, specifications, and value propositions.
* Negotiate commercial terms within approved pricing and discount guidelines.
* Drive unit bookings, booking value, revenue generation, and inventory movement.
* Identify and prioritize high-potential prospects to improve conversion rates.
* Develop action plans for slow-moving units and priority inventory.
* Lead Management and Conversion
* Manage leads received through digital campaigns, channel partners, walk-ins, referrals, corporate outreach, and other sources.
* Contact leads within the prescribed turnaround time.
* Qualify prospects based on budget, location, unit preference, purchase timeline, and funding requirements.
* Maintain regular follow-ups with prospective customers through telephone, email, messaging platforms, and meetings.
* Update lead status, follow-up remarks, and customer interactions in the CRM system.
* Schedule project presentations, virtual discussions, and physical site visits.
* Maintain an active sales funnel and ensure timely movement of leads across different sales stages.
* Re-engage inactive and previously contacted leads through structured follow-up campaigns.
* Ensure accurate classification of leads as qualified, unqualified, follow-up, negotiation, booked, lost, or deferred.
* Record reasons for lost or dropped leads to support conversion improvement.
* Customer Presentation and Site Visits
* Conduct professional project presentations for prospective customers and their families.
* Explain unit layouts, floor plans, specifications, amenities, construction status, and possession timelines.
* Arrange and conduct project tours, sample flat visits, and experience centre walkthroughs.
* Explain available inventory, price options, payment plans, and applicable commercial charges.
* Address customer queries related to the project, developer, approvals, construction progress, and buying process.
* Ensure the project site, sample apartment, sales lounge, and customer presentation areas are prepared for scheduled visits.
* Provide customers with approved brochures, cost sheets, layout plans, and project-related documents.
* Ensure that only approved and updated project information is shared with customers.
* Pricing, Inventory and Commercial Management
* Maintain a detailed understanding of unit-wise inventory, availability, pricing, and payment plans.
* Prepare accurate cost sheets based on unit selection and approved pricing.
* Explain the complete price structure, including base value, floor-rise charges, preferential location charges, parking, amenities, taxes, and other applicable charges.
* Obtain necessary approvals for discounts, offers, waivers, or commercial exceptions.
* Ensure that commercial commitments made to customers are properly approved and documented.
* Track booked, available, blocked, cancelled, and priority inventory.
* Coordinate with Sales Planning and Finance teams for inventory and pricing updates.
* Promote priority and slow-moving inventory based on business requirements.
* Maintain confidentiality of pricing strategies, customer information, and commercial approvals.
* Negotiation and Sales Closure
* Handle customer objections related to pricing, location, configuration, competition, possession timelines, and payment terms.
* Develop appropriate negotiation strategies based on customer profile and business requirements.
* Communicate the project’s value proposition and differentiators effectively.
* Facilitate discussions between customers and senior sales leadership where required.
* Obtain necessary internal approval for negotiated commercial terms.
* Encourage customers to complete booking formalities within agreed timelines.
* Ensure that the booking amount and required documents are collected accurately.
* Minimize booking cancellations through clear communication and transparent selling.
* Booking and Documentation Coordination
* Assist customers in completing booking application forms and related documentation.
* Verify customer details, unit information, commercial terms, payment plan, and booking value before submission.
* Coordinate with CRM, Finance, Legal, Sales Operations, and Collections teams for booking processing.
* Ensure timely collection of booking amounts and required KYC documents.
* Facilitate customer handover from the Sales team to the CRM or Customer Experience team.
* Maintain records of booking forms, cost sheets, approval notes, payment details, and customer communications.
* Support the resolution of discrepancies related to pricing, inventory, booking terms, or customer documentation.
* Ensure customer commitments are properly captured and communicated to relevant stakeholders.
* Channel Partner Coordination
* Build and maintain relationships with authorized channel partners and brokers.
* Conduct project briefings, presentations, and site familiarization sessions for channel partners.
* Share approved project updates, inventory information, campaign details, and sales collateral.
* Support channel partners in arranging customer meetings and site visits.
* Track channel partner leads, visits, conversions, and booking performance.
* Ensure channel partner leads are registered and managed according to company policy.
* Coordinate with the Channel Sales team to resolve lead ownership or attribution issues.
* Support channel partner activation initiatives to improve project sales.
* Customer Relationship Management
* Deliver a professional and customer-focused experience during every interaction.
* Build trust through accurate, transparent, and timely communication.
* Maintain regular contact with customers until the booking is completed and formally handed over.
* Address customer concerns in coordination with relevant internal departments.
* Avoid making unauthorized commitments regarding pricing, possession, specifications, or modifications.
* Encourage customer referrals and repeat business opportunities.
* Capture customer feedback and share relevant insights with management.
* Ensure customer data is handled securely and confidentially.
* Market Intelligence and Competitor Analysis
* Monitor competing projects, pricing, offers, configurations, amenities, and sales strategies.
* Conduct periodic competitor site visits and market surveys.
* Track customer preferences, buying behavior, and common objections.
* Provide management with market intelligence and competitor updates.
* Identify emerging customer segments and potential sales opportunities.
* Recommend changes in sales pitch, campaigns, pricing communication, or inventory positioning based on market feedback.
* Maintain updated competitor comparison reports.
* MIS and Sales Reporting
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly sales reports.
* Maintain accurate records of leads, follow-ups, site visits, negotiations, bookings, and lost opportunities.
* Track source-wise lead quality and conversion performance.
* Report sales funnel movement and expected closures to management.
* Prepare sales forecasts and booking projections.
* Update CRM records and sales trackers within prescribed timelines.
* Participate in sales review meetings and present pipeline status.
* Maintain accurate data for management dashboards and performance reviews.
* Cross-Functional Coordination
* Coordinate with Marketing for campaign leads, promotional activities, and customer events.
* Work with CRM and Customer Experience teams for booking handover and customer communication.
* Coordinate with Finance and Collections teams for payment confirmation and commercial clarification.
* Work with Legal teams for agreement-related customer queries.
* Coordinate with Project and Construction teams for verified project progress updates.
* Work with Design and Sales Planning teams for unit plans, layout details, and inventory information.
* Collaborate with Facility, Security, and Administration teams to ensure smooth customer visits.
* Escalate critical customer issues to the appropriate authority for timely resolution.
* Process Compliance and Governance
* Follow approved sales processes, pricing guidelines, and delegation of authority.
* Ensure all discounts, waivers, and special commercial terms are formally approved.
* Comply with applicable real estate regulations and internal policies.
* Maintain complete documentation for bookings and commercial approvals.
* Ensure accuracy and transparency in all customer communications.
* Support internal audits and provide required sales records.
* Follow data privacy, customer confidentiality, and ethical selling practices.
* Ensure that project information is communicated strictly through approved sales materials.

**Qualifications**
Educational Qualification
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Commerce, Real Estate, or a related discipline.
* MBA or postgraduate qualification in Sales and Marketing is preferred.
* Certification in real estate sales, customer relationship management, or negotiation would be an advantage.

**Experience**

* 10 to 15 years of relevant experience in real estate sales, site sales, direct sales, or project sales.
* Experience in residential, commercial, plotted development, retail, or luxury real estate sales.
* Prior experience with a reputed real estate developer or property advisory organization is preferred.
* Proven experience in managing customer meetings, project presentations, site visits, negotiations, and booking closures.
* Experience in handling premium or high-value real estate customers would be an advantage.
* Working knowledge of CRM systems, sales MIS, inventory management, and booking documentation.
* Experience in coordinating with channel partners and internal support teams.
* Prior experience in independently managing a project sales pipeline or mentoring junior sales executives is preferred.

* **Hands-on incident response and SIEM log integration experience.**

* Working knowledge of Saudi NCA ECC and CCC controls.
* Terraform and policy-as-code experience.

  Works alongside the GCP Infrastructure Architect, GCP Network Architect, GCP Cloud Engineers and Client's cybersecurity and SOC teams.

  Part of the 24×7 rota for security escalations and SOC alerts; covers Saudi business hours, Sunday to Thursday.
* **Client approval:**
  profile reviewed and approved by Client, with a background check completed before onboarding.

  Full-time, dedicated to the Client account for the duration of the engagement.

* Zero major security or compliance findings in NCA ECC/CCC reviews and audits.
* 100% of SOC alerts acknowledged within 30 minutes.
* Vulnerabilities remediated within SLA for each severity.
* 100% of in-scope log sources flowing to the SIEM; quarterly posture report delivered on time.

title: Product Marketing & UI Designer
description:
**Urgently Required:**

**Reports to: Head of Product**

**Function: Product**

Product Marketing & UI Designer

We're looking for a Product Marketing & UI Designer who can own both the story and the screen for our products. This person will craft positioning, messaging, and go-to-market narratives while also designing the interfaces customers actually use moving fluidly between writing a launch brief and shaping a user flow. AI tools are a core part of how this role works day to day: used to prototype interfaces quickly and to speed up research, drafting, and content work. Just as important is communication range, this person needs to flex tone, depth, and format for very different audiences, from an engineering handoff or a leadership review internally, to customers, partners, and external channels.

Key Responsibilities

• Positioning, Messaging & Go-to-Market

◦ Own positioning, messaging, and value propositions for products/features, and keep them consistent across every customer-facing surface.

◦ Plan and execute go-to-market launches in partnership with Product,Engineering,

Marketing, timelines, launch assets, and success metrics.

◦ Build sales enablement material (battle cards, pitch decks, FAQs, one-pagers) and brief internal stakeholders on new launches.

◦ Own external communication for launches — website copy, blogs, email campaigns, social messaging.

◦ Run competitive and market research to sharpen positioning, and feed customer/market insight back into the product roadmap.

• UI Design & Prototyping

◦ Own UI design for web and app products from wireframes and low-fidelity concepts through to final, developer-ready screens.

◦ Use AI-assisted design and prototyping tools to rapidly generate concepts, explore variations, and validate ideas before committing to high fidelity design.

◦ Build and maintain a consistent design system/component library across the product portfolio.

◦ Run and incorporate usability feedback, iterating designs based on user testing and analytics.

• Cross-Functional Communication

◦ Adapt communication for the audience in the room — crisp executive summaries for leadership, detailed specs and redlines for engineering, accessible messaging for external customers and partners.

◦ Use AI tools to move faster across both design prototyping and content/copy drafting, without compromising quality or brand consistency.

◦ Present design and messaging decisions clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, internal and external.

Requirements

• 3–6 years of experience spanning product marketing and/or UI design, ideally in B2B or B2B2C SaaS/tech (a strong background in one with working proficiency in the other is fine).

• Hands-on experience with AI tools for prototyping (e.g., AI-assisted design/mockup tools) and for accelerating research, drafting, or content work.

• Proven ability to adapt communication style, tone, and depth for different stakeholders — technical teams and leadership internally; customers, partners, and press externally.

• Strong portfolio or work samples showing both shipped UI work and marketing/launch content.

• Proficiency with a design tool such as Figma (or equivalent), and strong written communication skills.

• Comfortable owning a narrative or a screen end-to-end, from a one-line summary to a full launch deck or a polished interface.

Nice to Have

• Experience designing for multilingual or multi-market audiences.

• Basic understanding of front-end constraints (HTML/CSS) to design realistically for implementation.

• Prior experience in a category-defining or fast-scaling product environment.

* Strong understanding of ETL processes and technologies
* Experience with a variety of data sources, including relational databases, flat files, and web APIs

* Excellent problem-solving and debugging skills
* Strong communication and teamwork skills
* Solid understanding of software development life cycle models as well as expert knowledge of both Agile and traditional project management principles and practices and the ability to blend them together in the right proportions to fit a project and business environment
* Technical background, with understanding or hands-on experience in enterprise solutions for different industries
* High-level knowledge of BI architecture or data warehousing
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Effectively managing multiple deliverables, clients and projects in a fast-paced environment
* Proficiency in Azure services, including compute, storage, networking, and identity and access management (IAM).

* Strong knowledge of Azure networking services, including virtual networks, VPN gateways, ExpressRoute, Azure Firewall, and Azure Load Balancer.
* Knowledge of security best practices and compliance standards related to cloud environments.
* Solid understanding of cloud architecture patterns, scalability, high availability, and disaster recovery.

Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**What It Means to Be a Consultant at Crowe**  
Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.

In management at Crowe, you play a pivotal role in leading teams, guiding project execution, and deepening client relationships. You are expected to contribute to account planning, identify opportunities to add value, and ensure high-quality delivery. As your responsibilities expand, you take on broader account ownership, balancing project leadership with growing involvement in client strategy and solution development.

Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.

Crowe’s Microsoft Consulting Practice is hiring an **Agentic Business Process Analyst** to help clients rethink how work gets done in the AI era. This is not a traditional business analyst role focused only on documenting requirements, writing user stories, or mapping current-state processes. This role is for someone who can diagnose business problems, understand root causes, redesign processes, and identify where AI agents, automation, data, and human judgment should come together.

The ideal candidate is deeply functional, process-oriented, and comfortable enough with technology to work side by side with engineers, architects, and client IT teams. This person should be able to bridge business and technology, helping clients move from legacy workflows to intelligent, agent-enabled processes.

This role also has an internal transformation mandate. The person will help upskill Crowe Consulting teams that may be used to traditional ERP, CRM, or business application delivery. They will help consultants develop a more modern mindset: start with problems, then processes, then technology.

**What you will do**

* Lead discovery sessions with clients to understand business goals, pain points, process breakdowns, data issues, user needs, controls, and operating constraints.
* Map end-to-end business processes, including inputs, outputs, roles, systems, decisions, handoffs, exceptions, controls, and performance measures.
* Diagnose root causes across people, process, data, and technology before recommending solutions.
* Identify opportunities for AI assistance, agentic augmentation, workflow orchestration, automation, knowledge retrieval, decision support, and process improvement.
* Partner with technical architects and engineers to translate process opportunities into solution designs, prototypes, functional specifications, user stories, and delivery roadmaps.
* Define business value measures for agentic solutions, such as time saved, cycle time reduction, first-time-right rate, SLA performance, adoption, override rate, CSAT, cost per transaction, revenue lift, and compliance improvement.

* Support workshops, demos, process redesign sessions, executive presentations, and change management conversations.

title: Track Manager (Support & Operations)
description:
Track Manager (Support & Operations)

Gautam Buddha Nagar, Uttar Pradesh

**Job Summary**
---------------

**Applied AI Technologist**

*(AI Experience Technologist)*

**About the role**
==================

We're looking for an Applied AI Technologist who can turn a customer's business problem into a working, production-ready AI solution. You'll work at the point where customer conversations and hands-on building meet. You'll understand what the customer needs, picture the end state, build it quickly with AI-assisted development, and make sure it holds up in a real enterprise environment.

This is a builder role for someone with sound engineering judgment. Vibe coding lets you move fast, and your fundamentals decide what is good enough to ship.

Experience : 3 to 10 years

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Key responsibilities**
========================

**Customer and requirements**
-----------------------------

* Work directly with customers to understand their business problems, clarify vague requirements, and turn them into clear solution outcomes.
* Picture the end state for customers and end users, and show it early with prototypes, mockups and demos.
* Get up to speed quickly on new domains and customer contexts, and know when to bring in specialists.
* Explain solutions, trade-offs and risks clearly to both business and technical stakeholders.

**Building with AI**
--------------------

* Design and build solutions quickly with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot).
* Guide LLMs precisely, with structured prompting, context engineering and step-by-step iteration, so the output is accurate and consistent.
* Build LLM-powered applications, including agentic workflows, RAG pipelines and tool or function-calling integrations where relevant.
* Design user experiences that are intuitive, useful and fit how end users actually work.

**Engineering quality and production readiness**
------------------------------------------------

* Review, test, debug and harden AI-generated code. Understand what the AI produced before shipping it, and reject what doesn't meet the bar.
* Take solutions from prototype to production: deployment, integration with customer systems (APIs, identity, data sources) and maintainable handover.
* Design evaluations, test cases and guardrails to measure and improve LLM output quality, reliability and safety.
* Apply security, data-privacy and responsible-AI practices in every solution, especially when handling customer data.

**Skill Requirements**
----------------------

**Required skills and experience**
==================================

* **Programming:** Strong hands-on experience in Python and/or front-end (React, JavaScript/TypeScript) or back-end development, with solid software engineering fundamentals: code structure, testing, debugging, version control and basic architecture.
* **AI-assisted development:** Expert in vibe-coding workflows. Can break problems into steps, steer AI agents effectively, and review output critically.
* **Prompting and LLM steering:** Deep expertise in prompt design, including system prompts, few-shot examples, reasoning techniques, structured outputs, tool use and context management.
* **LLM evaluation:** Experience defining success criteria, building test sets and evaluating model output systematically.
* **Deployment and integration:** Working knowledge of at least one cloud platform (Azure, AWS or GCP), APIs, containers or serverless, and CI/CD basics.
* **Security and responsible AI:** Understanding of data privacy, PII handling, access control, prompt-injection risks and enterprise compliance.
* **Communication:** Excellent written and spoken English. Can explain complex ideas clearly and concisely, and present with confidence to customers.
* **Mindset:** Learns fast, takes ownership of outcomes, and knows what AI should and shouldn't be used to build.

**Nice to have**
================

* Experience with agentic frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, MCP) or enterprise AI platforms (Azure AI Foundry, Copilot Studio, AWS Bedrock, Vertex AI).
* Experience in a customer-facing, consulting or pre-sales role.
* A background in UX, design thinking or product management.
* A portfolio of AI solutions, demos or open-source work that you've built and deployed.

**Other Requirements**
----------------------

**Selection process**
=====================

* **Screening conversation:** background, communication and customer orientation.

* **Live build exercise (90–120 minutes):** Candidates get a deliberately vague customer brief. They are expected to:

* + ask questions to clarify the requirement
  + build a working solution using AI tools of their choice
  + walk through what they built and what they would fix, secure or test before production.

* **Customer-scenario discussion:** role-play presenting the solution to a business stakeholder.

title: IT Network Administrator (Contractual)
description:
**Job Description:**

**IT Network Administrator**

**Position Summary:**

The IT Network Administrator is responsible for overseeing and managing the organization's IT network environment, including hardware and software. The role also includes incident and change management and supporting employee on- and off-boarding processes.

To succeed in this position, candidates should have at least two years of experience in network administration or a similar role. Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, are essential. Technical expertise in network management, system security, and a variety of operating systems is required. Problem-solving abilities and customer service skills are also important for this role, and relevant certifications will be considered advantageous.

**Position: IT Network Administrator**

**Responsibilities:**

* Ensure network availability and quality, performing repair actions in collaboration with local teams.
* Configure, change, update network and firewall devices, policies and rules.
* Monitor network and associated systems to maintain optimal performance.
* Analyze, troubleshoot, and resolve problems.
* Conduct daily performance analysis and troubleshoot root causes of issues.
* Maintain up-to-date documentation to ensure accuracy and compliance.
* Monitor and enforce the company's information security policy and compliance with the regulation.
* Manage secure configurations and changes for networks, firewalls, hardware, systems, and mobile devices.
* Identify appropriate technologies, equipment, and software for building networks.
* Managing and maintaining our IT network in Logistics, including routers, switches, firewalls, and wireless networks.
* Recommending and contributing changes in network security.
* Coordinating and scheduling downtime for maintenance, patching and upgrades of network devices and systems.
* Perform Incident management – troubleshoot and resolve incidents.
* Perform Change management – plan and implement changes.
* Manage and handle logistics for IT equipment.
* Support the IT aspects of employee on- and off-boarding processes.
* Follow up on ticket requests and escalate as needed.

**Requirements:**

* 2 years of experience as Network Administrator or similar position.
* Fluent in English, both written and verbal.
* Excellent communication and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent customer service skills.
* Ability to work well in a team and under tight deadlines.
* Experience with OSI Model
* Experience with network protocols: OSPF, RSVP/LDP, TCP/IP, RIP, VLANs, Port-security
* Experience with routing, switching, firewalling, and related network protocols (ICMP, ARP, Port-security, etc.).
* Experience with managing switches and routers, firewalls, cloud network.
* Experience with AD, DNS, ADFS, DHCP, NPS, CA.

**Preferred Requirements:**

* Experience with Atlassian products (Jira Service Management).
* Virtualization certificates.
* Windows Server certificates.
* Network infrastructure certificates.
* ITIL certificates.
* Other IT related certificates.

* Excellent spoken and written English and Hindi, with proficiency in a local language where relevant.
* Strong persuasion, negotiation, and objection-handling skills. A warm, patient, and professional manner with clients and candidates.

**Preferred Qualities**

title: Institutional Fixed Income Sales
description:
**Company Description**
Sovereign Global Markets Private Limited is a wealth management and financial services firm focused on guiding clients to financial success with integrity, trust, and transparency. The organization offers specialized solutions across multiple verticals, including debt capital markets, institutional and retail fixed income, corporate treasury, family office management, and third‑party products. It complements these services with equity research, online bond platform provider solutions, high‑frequency trading, and proprietary trading strategies. Sovereign Global partners with a diverse client base, including HNIs, UHNIs, family offices, corporate treasuries, financial advisors, and debt market participants. The firm’s client‑centric approach emphasizes innovation, market insights, and tailored strategies that evolve with the financial needs of individuals and institutions.
  
**Role Description**
The Institutional Fixed Income Sales role is a full-time, on-site position based in the Greater Kolkata Area. The individual in this role will engage institutional clients such as banks, mutual funds, insurance companies, and corporate treasuries to originate and grow fixed-income business across products like G-Secs, SDLs, NCDs, and other debt instruments. Responsibilities include building and maintaining client relationships, understanding client portfolio objectives, presenting investment ideas, and executing client orders in coordination with the trading desk. The role involves regular market monitoring, preparing sales pitches and product notes, and providing timely updates on yields, spreads, credit developments, and macroeconomic trends. The Institutional Fixed Income Sales professional will work closely with internal teams in trading, research, and risk to ensure effective deal execution, compliance with regulations, and high-quality client service.
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Institutional Sales skills, with experience engaging and growing relationships with institutional investors.
* Candidates should possess solid Finance and Fixed-Income Investing skills, with working knowledge of debt products, yield curves, credit risk, and market dynamics.
* Candidates should possess Trading and Sales skills, including understanding of execution processes, pricing, and negotiation in fixed-income markets.
* Relevant academic background such as a bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business, or a related field; advanced certifications (e.g., CFA, NISM debt market modules) are an advantage.
* Strong analytical, quantitative, and presentation skills, along with proficiency in MS Excel and financial market tools.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work collaboratively with trading, research, and compliance teams.
* Prior experience in institutional fixed-income sales, debt capital markets, or treasury roles will be highly beneficial.

title: Area Sales Manager- Raipur
description:
**Empowering careers at ARJO**
**At Arjo, we know what moves us. We go above and beyond for people facing mobility challenges. We take every opportunity to work and grow as one team and take pride in sharing our knowledge and experience. Does that sound like something that moves you too?**
**This could be your opportunity to begin a challenging and rewarding career in a healthcare company that empowers movement for people with mobility challenges.**
**Job Description About Arjo**
Arjo provides medical equipment and solutions for hospitals and elderly care markets, including pressure area care, patient handling, and diagnostic equipment. We are a market leader in medical equipment rentals and capital equipment sales, operating under ISO 13485 certified Quality Management System.
  
  
**Employer Arjo (ArjoHuntleigh Healthcare India Pvt Ltd)**
ArjoHuntleigh Healthcare India Pvt Ltd, a 100% subsidiary of Arjo AB Sweden is operating in India for the last 25 years and employing over 200 people in 39 cities. The company deals with products in Pressure Injury Prevention, Venous Thromboembolism (VTE) Prevention, Medical Beds and Patient Handling; in addition to holding a significant presence in the Diagnostics segment with products like Patient Monitors, Fetal Monitors and Dopplers. The company has pioneered the concept of rental sales in Corporate Hospitals of India with the products that it offers. The company commands a leadership position in the product segments that it operates in and enjoys the trust of Doctors and Nurses in over 1000+ major hospitals in India.
  
  
**Department : Sales**
**Role Purpose**
Drive sales of medical equipment and rental solutions to large corporate hospitals, ensuring revenue growth, customer satisfaction, and compliance with regulatory and quality standards .
  
  
**Role Overview**
Drive revenue growth by managing and expanding sales of medical equipment, rentals, and consumables across assigned hospital accounts. Build strong relationships with key stakeholders, lead product adoption through clinical engagement, and collaborate cross-functionally to deliver high-quality, compliant healthcare solutions while identifying new business opportunities
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Sales Achievement & Market Expansion
* Achieve annual sales targets and manage Accounts Receivable for the assigned territory.
* Identify new customers, develop high‑growth markets, and expand territory presence.
* Upsell and cross‑sell to existing customers, including rentals and consumables.
* Launch new products and drive their adoption in key hospitals.
* Key Account & Stakeholder Management
* Develop and execute account strategies for key hospitals.
* Build strong networks with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) — doctors, nurses, biomedical staff, and hospital executives (COO, CFO, CEO, CNO).
* Maintain strong relationships with C‑suite and other key decision‑makers.
* Collaborate with hospital project consultants on new projects.
* Customer Engagement & Product Support
* Lead effective product demonstrations and engage stakeholders to create awareness of how Arjo solutions address critical healthcare needs.
* Work closely with the clinical team on product trials, evaluations, and successful adoption.
* Grow and maintain long‑term customer relationships.
* Market Intelligence & Risk Management
* Monitor competitor activity and develop appropriate mitigation strategies with manager.
* Capture customer feedback, escalate quality‑related issues promptly, and support risk management documentation for equipment deployment.
* Cross‑Functional Collaboration
* Collaborate with internal teams — Clinical, Marketing, Service, and Finance — to align on market strategies and ensure smooth execution.
* Support sustainability initiatives aligned with Arjo’s corporate responsibility goals.

**Experience**
: Average of 3-5 years of experience in Medical Equipment Sales/ Medical Devices Sales/Specialty Pharmaceutical product sales / Hospital Sales .
  
  
**Qualifications**
**:**
Science/ Engineering Graduate / Non-Science Graduates holding a Full Time MBA.
  
  
**CTC Offered:**
As per market standards
  
  
**About Arjo**
**At Arjo, we believe that empowering movement within healthcare environments is essential to quality care. Our products and solutions are designed to promote a safe and dignified experience through patient handling, medical beds, personal hygiene, disinfection, diagnostics, and the prevention of pressure injuries and venous thromboembolism. With over 6500 people worldwide and 65 years caring for patients and healthcare professionals, we are committed to driving healthier outcomes for people facing mobility challenges.**
**For more information about Arjo visit**
**www.arjo.com**

title: Vibration Analyst
description:
**Company Description**
PAIAS Reliability Services Private Limited specializes in advanced condition monitoring solutions for industrial plants, including vibration analysis, ultrasound analysis, thermography, oil analysis, ultra-precision geometric measurements, and shaft alignment. The company also delivers artificial intelligence–driven tools for plant performance optimization and Asset Performance Management (APM). In addition, PAIAS focuses on sustainability by offering safe and environmentally responsible chemicals that help remove scales, corrosion, humus, and bacteria in plant operations. Applicants can expect to work with cutting-edge technologies that support plant reliability, efficiency, and sustainable practices. The organization values technical excellence, innovation, and long-term partnerships with industrial clients.
  
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time hybrid role for a Vibration Analyst based in the Kolkata metropolitan area, with a mix of on-site work at client plants and some work-from-home flexibility. The Vibration Analyst will perform routine and advanced vibration measurements on rotating and static equipment, analyze collected data, and identify potential faults or failure modes. The role includes preparing diagnostic reports, recommending corrective actions, and collaborating with maintenance and operations teams to improve equipment reliability. The analyst will support broader condition monitoring activities, such as integrating vibration findings with other technologies (e.g., ultrasound, thermography, oil analysis) and contributing to AI-driven plant performance solutions. Day-to-day work also involves maintaining monitoring databases, supporting troubleshooting during equipment issues, and adhering to safety and quality standards during field visits.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong skills in Vibration Analysis and Condition Monitoring for rotating and static equipment.
* Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills and Troubleshooting abilities to interpret data and recommend practical solutions.
* Candidates should possess skills in Oil Analysis and familiarity with other condition monitoring techniques as an added advantage.
* Relevant engineering or technical diploma/degree (Mechanical, Electrical, Instrumentation, or related field) is preferred.
* Experience in industrial plant environments such as power, steel, cement, refinery, or process industries is beneficial.
* Proficiency with vibration analysis software and data collection tools, and basic understanding of reliability-centered maintenance concepts.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to prepare clear reports and interact with client teams.
* Willingness to travel within the Kolkata region and occasionally to other sites, while following all safety guidelines.

title: Electrical SME - Retrofit & Remote IFM Support
description:
Job description:
  
  
Job Description

**Role**
- Electrical SME – Retrofit & Remote IFM Support

**Location**
- Wipro Kolkata / Bangalore

**Experience**
: 15+ years in industrial electrical maintenance role preferably with electrical OEMs or solution providers, or IT & ITES facilities

Work arrangement: Provide remote technical support across multiple sites, visit sites as required, and participate in the COE roster for scheduled technical support and emergency on-call coverage.

**Role Purpose**

We are seeking an experienced Electrical Subject Matter Expert within Wipro Central Engineering – Facility Management to handle design, detailing , prepare retrofit BOQs ,cost estimates, support IFM maintenance teams remotely, and lead practical fault diagnosis and emergency technical support, including through Teams / video calls where approved by the company.

͏

**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide remote preventive and corrective maintenance support to IFM teams for HT and LT electrical distribution systems, panels, transformers, switchgear, DG electrical interfaces, motors, drives, PLCs, SCADA, other control systems, lighting and earthing.
* Lead structured troubleshooting by telephone and company-approved Teams / video calls, using drawings, alarms, fault histories and readings safely obtained by qualified site personnel.
* Review drawings, load requirements and vendor quotations; support technical evaluation, shutdown planning, execution, testing, commissioning and handover.
* Prepare itemised BOQs, technical scopes, specifications, and budgetary and detailed cost estimates for electrical retrofits, replacements and upgrades, clearly stating quantities, assumptions and exclusions.
* Participate in the COE roster to support critical breakdowns and power failures; coordinate with site teams, OEMs and service partners to ensure safe recovery, timely escalation and documented handover of open issues.
* Conduct root-cause analysis, track corrective actions, maintain support records and coach site teams to reduce repeat failures.
* Coordinate electrical compliance activities with IFM site teams, safety teams, authorised inspectors and service partners, including applicable statutory inspections, testing, documentation, tracking of renewals and closure of audit observations.
* Enforce site safety requirements, permit-to-work procedures, verified isolation and lockout/tagout controls. Remote guidance must not replace checks by qualified on-site personnel or authorise unsafe live work; stop and escalate when remote diagnosis is insufficient or safety controls are inadequate.

͏

**Candidate Profile**

* B.E./B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering or Electrical & Electronics Engineering, or an equivalent recognised qualification with substantial relevant experience.
* 15+ years of relevant experience in industrial electrical maintenance, roles with electrical OEMs or solution providers, or IT & ITES facilities, with hands-on expertise in HT and LT distribution systems, breakdown troubleshooting and retrofit delivery.
* Preference will be given to candidates with industrial electrical experience or experience with electrical OEMs or electrical solution providers.
* Proven ability to independently prepare BOQs, cost estimates and technical specifications, and to evaluate vendor proposals.
* Strong ability to interpret single-line diagrams, control schematics and test reports, supported by practical fault-finding expertise.
* Hands-on experience with PLCs, SCADA and other control systems, including maintenance, fault diagnosis and troubleshooting.
* Experience in guiding teams across multiple sites remotely, coordinating emergency support and communicating clearly with technicians, facility managers and OEMs.
* Sound safety judgement, disciplined documentation, and relevant licences or authorisations where required for the assigned duties.
* Knowledge of electrical substations and their operation and maintenance will be an added advantage.

**Essential:**
A practical, hands-on electrical specialist—not solely a design reviewer—who can independently estimate retrofit works and guide qualified site technicians through remote troubleshooting, while recognising when on-site intervention is required.

͏ ͏

Of yourself, your career, and your skills. We want to see the constant evolution of our business and our industry. It has always been in our DNA - as the world around us changes, so do we. Join a business powered by purpose and a place that empowers you to design your own reinvention. Come to Wipro. Realize your ambitions.

title: MDR Analyst - L1
description:
**Summary**
Data has never been more valuable and vulnerable. As cybercriminals become more sophisticated and regulations more strict, organizations struggle to answer one key question: “Is my data safe?"
  
  
At Varonis, we see the world of cybersecurity differently. Instead of chasing threats, we believe the most practical approach is protecting data from the inside out. We’ve built the industry’s first fully autonomous Data Security Platform to help our customers dramatically reduce risk with minimal human effort.
  
  
At Varonis, we move fast. We’re an ultra-collaborative company with brilliant people who care deeply about the details. Together, we’re solving interesting and complex puzzles to keep the world’s data safe.
  
  
**Position Overview:**
Varonis MDR team is at the forefront of worldwide data detection and response services. We lead and redefine how data should be monitored, and protected and how data breach incidents should be handled. It’s a 24/7 global security service assisting customers to investigate and respond to security incidents.
  
  
We are seeking a driven MDR Security Analyst to join the forefront of our data security mission, monitoring, triaging, investigating, and escalating incidents where data is at risk, and ensuring we meet operational SLAs. Data is the #1 target of attackers, and Varonis’ Managed Data Detection and Response (MDDR) customers entrust our team with the security of their data. They will develop a deep understanding of the Varonis platform and related technologies. This role demands knowledge of security ecosystems (ex. SIEM, SOAR, ITSM, EDR, IPS/IDS, Active Directory, DNS, IAM/PAM, etc.) and enterprise security operations.
  
  
**Location & Working Model:**
This is a fully remote position based in India. The role follows standard daytime business hours. As part of Varonis' global 24/7 MDDR service, analysts collaborate with teams across multiple regions and time zones to provide continuous customer coverage.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**:**

* Monitor and respond to detections within the Varonis platform.
* Conduct thorough triage of Varonis detections through critical analysis and investigative methodologies.
* Validate findings and coordinate investigative and response efforts with customers and internal teams.
* Document and communicate investigative findings effectively, including tracking in CRM and related systems.
* Assist in the development, documentation, analysis, testing, and modification of Varonis’ threat detection systems, playbooks, and runbooks.

**Requirements**
**:**

* 0-3 years of experience in cybersecurity
* Degree or certification(s) in cybersecurity and/or proven ability to execute across cyber security operations disciplines, including monitoring, detection, investigation, and incident response.
* Proven success in contributing to a team-oriented environment.
* Strong analytical and creative problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication skills in English (written and oral) and interpersonal skills (colleagues and customers).
* Attention to detail and the capability to deliver outcomes autonomously.
* Knowledge of common security technologies and tools including network-based (firewall and IDS), host-based (EDR and AV), data-based (DLP and DSPM), and identity-based (PAM and IAM), gained through experience or study.
* Knowledge of operational information security disciplines including alert monitoring, threat detection, incident response, security infrastructure management, and system and architecture hardening, gained through experience or study.
* Demonstrated ability to learn new skills and technologies swiftly.
* Proficiency in critical thinking and problem-solving for complex issues.

We invite you to check out our Instagram Page to gain further insight into the Varonis culture!

Varonis is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other legally protected characteristics.
  
  
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

description:

title: IT Administrator
description:
**Job Description – IT Administrator**

**Location:**
Metropolitan (Near Bypass Dhaba), Kolkata

**Work Location:**
Primarily Metropolitan, with weekly visits to Bantala Warehouse

**Experience:**
5–8 Years

**CTC:**
Up to 4.5 - 5 LPA

**Department:**
Information Technology

**About the Role**

We are looking for a hands-on and technically sound IT Administrator to independently manage day-to-day IT infrastructure, Microsoft 365 administration, networking, end-user support and IT operations across our office and warehouse locations.

The candidate must have practical experience in
**Microsoft 365 Admin Centre, network troubleshooting, Outlook email account creation and configuration, and hands-on troubleshooting of barcode scanners and barcode printers.**

The ideal candidate should be comfortable handling IT operations independently, resolving technical issues and coordinating with external vendors whenever required.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Microsoft 365 Administration & End-User Support**

* Hands-on experience with the Microsoft 365 Admin Centre and its core administrative functionalities.
* Create, configure and manage employee email IDs through the Microsoft 365 Admin Console.
* Manage user accounts, licences, password resets and access permissions.
* Configure and troubleshoot Outlook email accounts, including profile setup, email synchronisation and connectivity issues.
* Provide support for Microsoft Office 365 applications such as Outlook, Excel, Word and Teams.
* Manage user onboarding and offboarding, including email access creation, modification and deactivation.
* Troubleshoot desktop, laptop, operating system and software-related issues.

**2. Networking & Connectivity (Critical)**

* Hands-on knowledge of LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, routers, switches and network infrastructure.
* Configure and troubleshoot IP addresses, DNS, DHCP and network connectivity issues.
* Diagnose internet connectivity, network sharing and printer connectivity problems.
* Manage network printers and ensure seamless connectivity across office and warehouse locations.
* Coordinate with Internet Service Providers and networking vendors whenever required.
* Ensure stable and secure network connectivity across operational areas.

**3. Barcode Scanner & Printer Support (Critical)**

* Hands-on experience in installation, configuration and troubleshooting of barcode scanners and barcode printers.
* Troubleshoot barcode printing issues, scanner connectivity, driver installation and configuration.
* Configure barcode printers, including label size, alignment, print settings and connectivity.
* Support USB and network-connected barcode devices.
* Coordinate with vendors for hardware repairs, replacements and technical support.
* Ensure uninterrupted barcode scanning and printing operations at the warehouse.

**4. Hardware & IT Asset Management**

* Manage desktops, laptops, monitors, printers, scanners, routers, switches and other IT peripherals.
* Perform hardware diagnosis, component replacement, system upgrades and basic repairs.
* Maintain IT asset records, allocation, movement and return documentation.
* Monitor IT inventory and coordinate procurement, quotations and vendor requirements.
* Maintain AMC, warranty and service records.

**5. CCTV, EPABX & Infrastructure Support**

* Monitor and troubleshoot CCTV systems and coordinate with vendors for installation and repairs.
* Provide basic support for EPABX/intercom systems.
* Coordinate installation and maintenance of IT and communication infrastructure.
* Ensure minimum downtime of critical IT infrastructure.

**6. Server, ERP & IT Operations Support**

* Provide basic server maintenance and monitoring support.
* Assist in troubleshooting application, server and connectivity-related issues.
* Provide basic IT support for ERP and business applications.
* Coordinate with external IT partners for advanced technical issues.
* Maintain IT documentation, system records, backup practices and security procedures.

**7. Vendor & Procurement Management**

* Coordinate with IT hardware, networking, software, printer, barcode and CCTV vendors.
* Raise and track service requests to ensure timely resolution.
* Assist in IT procurement, quotation comparison and purchase coordination.
* Follow up on AMC, repairs, replacements and warranty-related matters.

**Required Technical Skills**

* **Microsoft 365 Admin Centre:**
  User creation, email ID creation, licence allocation, password reset and access management.
* **Outlook Administration:**
  Email configuration, profile setup and troubleshooting.
* **Networking:**
  LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, routers, switches, IP configuration, DNS and DHCP.
* **Barcode Devices:**
  Hands-on installation and troubleshooting of barcode scanners and barcode printers.
* **Printer Support:**
  Installation, driver configuration, connectivity and troubleshooting.
* **Hardware Support:**
  Desktop, laptop and peripheral troubleshooting.
* **Operating Systems:**
  Windows OS; Linux knowledge will be an advantage.
* **IT Infrastructure:**
  CCTV, EPABX, IT asset management and basic server support.

**Preferred Exposure**

* Experience in manufacturing, warehouse, retail, apparel or FMCG environments.
* Experience supporting warehouse barcode scanning and label printing operations.
* Multi-location IT infrastructure management.
* IT procurement and vendor coordination.

**Candidate Profile**

* Graduate / Diploma in IT, Computer Science or relevant technical qualification.
* 5–8 years of relevant experience in IT Support / IT Administration / System Administration.
* Must have practical working knowledge of Microsoft 365 Admin Centre and networking.
* Must have hands-on experience with barcode scanners and barcode printers.
* Should be comfortable creating and managing Outlook email accounts.
* Should be capable of independently managing day-to-day IT operations with limited supervision.
* Must be comfortable travelling to Bantala Leather Complex once a week.

**Key Competencies**

**Technical:**
Microsoft 365 Administration | Outlook | Email Management | Networking | LAN/WAN | DNS/DHCP | Barcode Scanners | Barcode Printers | Hardware Troubleshooting | CCTV | IT Asset Management.

**Behavioural:**
Ownership | Problem Solving | Responsiveness | Vendor Coordination | Attention to Detail | Independent Working.

As a Service Engineer, you will be responsible for ensuring effective installation, commissioning, maintenance and technical support of BPL's medical equipment portfolio across North Karnataka. You will play a key role in ensuring equipment reliability, customer satisfaction and seamless service delivery across the assigned territory.

Your Responsibilities

* **Installation & Commissioning:**
  Carry out installation, commissioning and site acceptance of BPL's medical equipment across Imaging, Critical Care, Cardiology and other healthcare product segments.
* **Preventive & Breakdown Maintenance:**
  Perform scheduled preventive maintenance and attend to equipment breakdowns, ensuring timely resolution and minimum equipment downtime.
* **Technical Support:**
  Provide prompt on-site and remote technical assistance to customers, ensuring adherence to defined service response and resolution timelines.
* **Customer Relationship Management:**
  Build and maintain strong relationships with hospitals, healthcare professionals and biomedical engineering teams to ensure a high level of customer satisfaction.
* **User Training & Demonstrations:**
  Conduct equipment demonstrations, user training and technical guidance for hospital staff and biomedical engineers.
* **Service Documentation:**
  Maintain accurate service reports, installation records, maintenance logs and other relevant service documentation.
* **Spare Parts Management:**
  Ensure effective spare parts planning, availability and utilization to support timely service delivery.
* **AMC/CMC Support:**
  Support Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) and Comprehensive Maintenance Contract (CMC) activities, including scheduled visits and customer coordination.
* **Internal Coordination:**
  Work closely with internal service, sales and technical teams to ensure efficient service operations and timely resolution of customer issues across the assigned region.

Key Skills & Competencies

Biomedical Equipment Servicing | Technical Troubleshooting | Preventive Maintenance | Installation & Commissioning | Customer Relationship Management | Field Service Operations | Spare Parts Management | Healthcare Technology

description:

Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.

title: Technical Service Manager
description:
Castrol is one of the world’s leading lubricant brands, serving customers and consumers in the automotive, marine, industrial and energy sectors. Castrol brands are recognised globally for their premium quality and high performance, shaped by the company’s commitment to innovation and cutting-edge technology. With products sold in more than 150 countries, Castrol has helped keep things moving on roads and racetracks, air, sea, and space for over 125 years.
  
  
Whether you're just starting out or ready for your next big move, you're in the right place to explore an exciting career with Castrol.
  
  
**Job Description**
About the Team
  
  
The Technical Services & Engineering team partners with the Sales organization to drive sustainable business growth by providing technical expertise, application support, and value-based solutions for industrial customers. The team supports customers across key industrial segments including steel, automotive, bearing manufacturing, metalworking, and general engineering industries, working closely with Sales, Marketing, Product Management, Supply Chain, and customer operations teams to deliver measurable business value and operational excellence.
  
  
Key Tasks
  
  

* Provide technical expertise and field-based engineering support to customers and the Sales team across industrial lubricant and metalworking fluid applications.
* Evaluate customer manufacturing processes, identify performance improvement opportunities, and develop value-based solutions that support new business acquisition and retention.
* Conduct product trials, technical assessments, and competitive benchmarking activities to support successful product conversions and competitive displacement opportunities.
* Develop technical business cases, value-selling proposals, and quantify cost-saving recommendations for customers.
* Perform root cause analysis and troubleshooting for lubrication and metalworking fluid-related challenges, ensuring timely resolution and customer satisfaction.
* Create and document customer success stories, case studies, and technical value demonstrations to support business growth initiatives.
* Deliver technical training programs and knowledge-sharing sessions for customers, distributors, and internal stakeholders.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support product implementation, application optimization, and continuous improvement initiatives across the region.

**Experience Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, Production Engineering, Metallurgy, Chemical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
* Proven experience in industrial lubricants, greases, high-performance lubricants, metalworking fluids, or technical services within the manufacturing or industrial sector.
* Strong knowledge of industrial lubricant technologies, including hydraulic oils, gear oils, greases, rust preventives, specialty lubricants, soluble oils, and neat cutting oils.
* Experience supporting industrial applications such as steel plants, rolling mills, TMT manufacturing, bearing manufacturing, automotive components, metal cutting, metal forming, or general engineering operations.
* Ability to conduct technical assessments, troubleshoot application issues, and perform root cause analysis in customer environments.
* Experience supporting product trials, implementations, and technical customer engagements.
* Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence both technical and commercial audiences.
* Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned region to support customers and business growth objectives.

title: Controllership Transformation - Core - Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY GDS FAAS (Controllership Transformation) - Senior position**
**The opportunity**
Financial Accounting Advisory Services (FAAS) professionals provide advisory services including Accounting and regulatory support for accounting change and special matters; accounting processes and controls support.
  
  
Within EY FAAS practice, the Finance Transformation Experts team build and develop client relationship with our regional stakeholders. We are part of an integrated global network of professionals who develop, design and optimise client service business processes for efficiency and high performance. We leverage and improve various frameworks, methodologies, solutions specific to our offerings and articulate presentations that communicate proposals, strategies, plans and outcomes.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Delivery and Subject Matter Expertise -**

* Drive transformation initiatives across Record-to-Report (R2R) processes by leveraging deep techno-functional expertise. Lead end-to-end process improvements and strategic interventions, beyond system implementation, acting as a transformation lead (not PMO).
* Own and lead transformation across key R2R process areas, including:

+ Revenue Recognition
+ Accruals
+ Intercompany Reconciliation
+ Manual Journal Entries and Automation
+ Asset Accounting
+ Chart of Accounts & Accounting Master Data
+ Account Reconciliation (e.g., Cash & Bank, Sales)
+ Subledger Accounting
+ Consolidation
+ Financial Statement Preparation and Filing
+ Notes and Disclosures
+ Cost Accounting & Inventory
+ Profitability Analysis

* Provide subject matter expertise and lead delivery teams in R2R transformation and implementation programs, ensuring alignment with business objectives and regulatory requirements.
* Support the design and integration of ERP platforms with AI-based solutions, including defining and implementing AI use cases within R2R processes (especially within SAP-based environments).
* Drive consolidation process design and execution, including:

+ Defining consolidation data structures
+ Managing mapping between operational COA and Group COA / FS items
+ Ensuring effective use of tools such as SAP Group Reporting, SAP BPC, Oracle FCCS

* Lead the workstreams or delivery teams within large transformation programs, ensuring timely delivery, quality outcomes, and stakeholder alignment.
* Define and implement AI-driven solutions and automation opportunities in R2R processes, evaluating available tools and driving their practical application in enterprise environments.
* Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.

**Business Development & Solution Development -**

* Lead pursuit teams to understand client problem statements & formulate that in solutions
* Lead developing client specific solutions for the engagement team
* Lead proposal development or lead proposal teams
* Lead collaboration with market teams to develop relationship and drive business growth for EY
* Collaborate cross service lines to ensure smooth execution of the project.
* Lead development of internal capability development and lead training sessions to coach internal teams to develop capability
* Lead operational initiatives within the practice areas.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**Subject Matter and Technical Skills -**

* Deep knowledge in Record to report, invoice to pay and Order to cash areas
* Certification and/or sound experience based knowledge in ERPs like SAP S/4 HANA FI/CO/COPA, SAP Central Finance, Oracle Fusion Finance, Oracle Netsuite
* Certification and/or sound experience based knowledge in digital finance solutions like Blackline, Trintech, High Radius, Different RPA solutions
* Knowledge about AI/ML/Gen-AI & Analytics solution in finance space particularly in Record to Report areas.
* Knowledge of consolidation, reporting, inter-company and ERP data structures
* Have experience in current state analysis (As is), future state analysis (To be), process optimization, data optimization, data analytics, data management

**Business Skills And Knowledge –**

* Strong business development skills
* Very strong solution conceptualization/ideation skill
* Strong solution/product build skills
* Strong project management skills

**Human Skills –**

* Excellent written & oral communication & articulation
* Flexible work attitude
* Proven ability to lead diverse team over multiple geographies
* Strong collaboration skills
* Ability to comprehend complexity quickly & apply solutions
* Comfort in dealing with ambiguity
* Strong entrepreneurial skills in terms of ownership of problem & solutions
* Strong problem solving skills
* Ability to perform effectively under pressure and deliver results
* Willingness to travel for short or long duration at short notice

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* CA, MBA (Finance) with Commerce Background, CWA, CMA, CFA, M.Com
* 2-4 Years of relevant consulting experience in record to report transformation (not Industry user experience)
* Experience of working with international clients preferred
* Experience with previous multinational consulting firms or Big4 firms

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Principal Forward Deployed Product Manager
description:
**Overview**
**Working at Atlassian**
Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.
  
  
Atlassian is helping the world's largest enterprises
**turn their AI experiments into real business value.**
Most have run the pilots and proofs of concept; few have converted them into durable outcomes that change how work actually gets done. Our Forward Deployed team embeds with customer executives, engineers, and frontline teams to close that gap, co-designing and shipping agent-first ways of working that deliver measurable business outcomes.
  
  
As a Principal Forward Deployed Product Manager, you are the person who makes that transformation real. You sit inside our most strategic customers,
**turn an ambiguous "we want to be AI-first" ambition into a concrete operating model and a portfolio of production agents,**
and own the journey from the first executive conversation to live systems to measurable business impact. You pair with Forward Deployed Engineers who build alongside you, and you carry what you learn in the field straight back into Atlassian's product.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Three parts to this role:**

* Transformation leader — trusted advisor to executive leadership re-architecting how their organization works. You turn AI ambition into new ways of working that stick, reshaping how people and functions across the organization operate.
* Product leader — work backwards from the customer: outcome and metric first, then experiment, iterate, and prioritize relentlessly to get there; own it end to end, first conversation to production.
* AI Builder/Architect — go deep on the technical craft: agentic architectures, evaluation suites, reliable non-deterministic systems, pairing with FDEs to ship production solutions.

**In this role, you will:**

* Own the outcome end to end. You carry the result from the first executive conversation to a live system in production — the plan, the build, the adoption, and the business impact are all yours.
* Turn ambiguous ambition into a plan. Run executive discovery that sizes the opportunity and the value at stake, then prioritizes use cases by business value and feasibility before anyone writes a line of code.
* Drive systemic behavior change. Partner with leaders on the cultural and ways-of-working shift that turns new agentic systems into how the organization's people and functions actually operate.

* Turn findings into a plan. Score and prioritize use cases by business value and technical feasibility, then translate that into a clear plan for where to start and how to sequence the work

* Prove and grow the value. Establish baselines and track outcome metrics (cycle time, throughput, quality, cost per outcome), then expand from the first win into durable transformation and the platform consumption that follows.

* Deep fluency in how agentic AI is architected, secured, and deployed in the enterprise, with the credibility to drive technical design decisions alongside customer engineering leaders.
* Operating model & workflow transformation track record: Demonstrated success not just redesigning workflows but getting organizations to adopt them — shifting roles, behaviors, and culture so new ways of working stick, not just launch.
* Demonstrated success in redesigning workflows for agent-first or AI-enabled teams, moving beyond tool rollouts into systemic behavior change.
* Executive stakeholder mastery: Proven ability to influence and partner with senior leaders while maintaining deep technical credibility with senior engineers and architects.
* Exceptional systems thinking & codification skills: Demonstrated ability to turn bespoke, high-touch client solutions into scalable frameworks, playbooks, and "train-the-trainer" enablement programs.
* Strong product and analytical sense: Ability to define business cases, track outcome metrics (cycle time, throughput, cost-per-outcome), and connect customer value directly to commercial consumption.

description:

title: Financial Crime Compliance Analyst - Kolkata
description:
**Job Description:**

**About AML RightSource:**

We are AML RightSource, the leading technology-enabled managed services firm focused on fighting financial crime for our clients and the world. Headquartered in Cleveland, Ohio, and operating across the globe, we are a trusted partner to our financial institution, FinTech, money service business, and corporate clients.

Using a blend of highly trained anti-financial crime professionals, cutting-edge technology tools, and industry-leading consultants, we help clients with their AML/BSA, transaction monitoring, client onboarding (KYC), enhanced due diligence (EDD), and risk management needs.

We support clients in meeting day-to-day compliance tasks, urgent projects, and strategic changes. Globally, our staff of more than 4,000 highly trained analysts and subject matter experts is the industry's largest group of full-time compliance professionals. Together with our clients, we are Reimagining Compliance.

**Location:**
Kolkata

**Title:**
Associate Analyst/Senior Analyst

**About The Position:**

A Financial Crime Compliance Analyst works with our clients (banks and non-bank financial institutions) to provide advice and counsel in order to help them fight financial crime and mitigate financial crime risks. The purpose of this role is to detect and investigate unusual financial activity by performing both quality control work related to the work of our Associate Analysts and performing his/her own detailed monitoring of account activity and ensuring compliance with regulatory policies, operational policies, and/or reviewing client files for the purpose of performing Know your Customer (KYC) Procedures. In short, you are on the front-line of making decisions as to how to keep clients compliant with applicable law and regulations.

You research and analyze various sources of data and provide written summaries of recommendations and conclusions as it relates to the identification of suspicious or unusual financial activity and/or reviewing client files for the purpose of performing Know your Customer (KYC) Procedures.

You may perform quality control activities, supervisory responsibility on occasion and be responsible for ad hoc communication with client. You will need to exercise discretion and judgment in the work, and you must be able to work efficiently and independently in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Identify data anomalies and red flags for money laundering, terrorist financing, fraud, sanctions violations, and escalate for second level review.
* Verify the identity of clients to understand the nature and purpose of their relationship with the financial institution for the purposes of performing Know your Customer (KYC) Procedures, escalating where appropriate for second level review· Ability to perform quality control work as needed.
* Assist with advanced tasks including communication with clients, analyzing production data and creating client specific aids and training.
* Independently assist analyst with workflow items and administrative tasks as they arise.
* Submit written work product for review by AMLRS and client-led quality control teams, make the requested adjustments as necessary, and apply the feedback going forward.
* Adhere to all designated timeframes and procedure to ensure on time and accurate completion of work.
* Work and contribute in a team-oriented and collaborative environment.
* Adhere to and comply with all applicable, federal and state laws, regulations and guidance, including those related to Anti-Money, as well as adhering to company policies and procedures and client requirements.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s Degree with 2+ years of relevant AML/BSA/KYC/TM/Crypto/CDD/EDD experience.
* Strong communication skills and ability to produce narrative and written summaries clearly synthesizing recommendations and conclusions.
* Strong analytical, problem solving and organizational skills.
* Proficient in Microsoft Excel, Microsoft PowerPoint & Microsoft Word, with ability to learn new technologies quickly.
* Ability to multi-task, work independently and as part of a team, establishing cooperative and collaborative working relationships.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

Professional Certification

* Strong knowledge of banking industry and related regulations and laws.
* Strong entrepreneurial spirit, highly collaborative, able to express ideas readily, manage change fluidly, able to influence and identify opportunities for improvement.

**Work Shift:**

* Rotational Work shift with cab facilities both sides.

AML RightSource is committed to fostering a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

**Recruitment Scam Alerts**

**We’re aware of an increase in recruitment scams where individuals falsely claim to represent AML RightSource. These scammers may ask for money or personal information by offering fake job opportunities through e-mail, text message or social media. Please verify the source of any job-related communications carefully. All official AML RightSource communications are conducted through "@amlrightsource.com" email addresses. If you encounter suspicious messages, do not respond.**

As an Application Developer specializing in SAP ABAP HANA, you will design, develop, and support application solutions with a focus on the HANA version of Advanced Business Application Programming (ABAP). You will work on designing, developing, and re-engineering highly complex application components, integrating software packages, programs, and reusable objects residing on multiple platforms.
