* Develop Application Solutions: Design, develop, and support application solutions with a focus on HANA version of ABAP, ensuring high-quality and efficient solutions that meet business requirements.
* Integrate Software Packages: Integrate software packages, programs, and reusable objects residing on multiple platforms, utilizing knowledge of SAP HANA Technical Concept and Architecture.
* Re-engineer Application Components: Re-engineer highly complex application components to optimize performance and efficiency, applying Code Performance Rules and Guidelines for SAP HANA.
* Utilize Development Tools: Leverage ABAP Development Tools (ADT) and HANA Studio for data modeling and development, ensuring effective use of tools and technologies.
* Ensure Data Services: Develop and implement ABAP Core Data Services, Database Procedures, and Text Search, ensuring seamless data integration and management.

**Preferred Education**
Master's Degree
  
  
**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**

* Exposure to SAP ABAP HANA: Experience working with HANA version of Advanced Business Application Programming (ABAP), including designing, developing, and supporting application solutions.
* Knowledge of SAP HANA Technical Concept and Architecture: Familiarity with SAP HANA Technical Concept and Architecture, including data modeling using HANA Studio and integration of software packages, programs, and reusable objects.
* Proficiency in ABAP Development Tools: Experience working with ABAP Development Tools (ADT) and Code Performance Rules and Guidelines for SAP HANA.
* Understanding of Data Modeling and Integration: Exposure to data modeling using HANA Studio and integration of data services, including ABAP Core Data Services, Database Procedures, and Text Search.
* Familiarity with HANA Live Models Consumption: Basic understanding of HANA Live models consumption and ALV on HANA.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* Working Knowledge of ADBC: Experience with ADBC, including its application in SAP HANA environments, would be beneficial for this role.
* Familiarity with Native SQL: Exposure to Native SQL, including its use in SAP HANA, would be advantageous in designing and developing application solutions.
* Understanding of HANA Text Search: Basic understanding of HANA Text Search, including its integration with ABAP Core Data Services, would be valuable in this position.

* Competitive compensation, performance incentives, and comprehensive health/wellness benefits.

**Job overview**

We are looking for an experienced, commercially-oriented Finance Manager for our luxury pre-opening resort in Dasada, Gujarat. You will oversee all financial operations, ensuring strong financial discipline, cost control, statutory compliance, and profitability while maintaining our guest service standards.

**Key Responsibilities**

**· Financial planning & budgeting:**

prepare annual budgets, financial forecasts, and cash flow projections with the GM and corporate team. track performance against budgets, analyze variances, and evaluate the feasibility of new investments.

**· Accounting & financial reporting:**

oversee daily accounting operations, general ledger maintenance, and monthly/annual closing. prepare balance sheets, P&L, and cash flow statements in line with company policies.

**· Revenue audit & controls:**

audit daily revenues across rooms, F&B, wellness, and activities. reconcile PMS, POS, and accounting system data while monitoring key metrics like ADR, RevPAR, and occupancy.

**· Cost control & profitability:**

track operating expenses across departments, focusing on F&B costs, payroll, utilities, and procurement. implement cost-saving measures without sacrificing luxury standards.

**· Payables & receivables:**

manage vendor payments, supplier credit terms, corporate billing, and collections. oversee employee advances and operational imprests.

**· Cash flow & treasury:**

monitor daily cash/bank balances, handle short-term liquidity needs, supervise petty cash, and manage cash handling procedures.

**· Inventory & stores control:**

oversee physical stock counts, track inventory movements, and manage stock variances across F&B, housekeeping, and engineering stores.

**· Statutory compliance & taxation:**

ensure timely calculation, filing, and payment for GST, TDS, income tax, and other statutory requirements. coordinate with auditors and external tax consultants.

**· Internal controls & risk management:**

maintain robust internal controls, manage audit points, address revenue leakages, and safeguard company assets.

**· Fixed assets & capex:**

maintain the fixed asset register, track depreciation, monitor capex against approved budgets, and conduct periodic physical asset verifications.

**· Payroll & employee costs:**

verify monthly payroll processing with HR, manage employee reimbursements, and monitor overall manpower costs.

**· Procurement & vendor management:**

review purchase orders, ensure proper segregation of duties, and negotiate vendor terms using cost analysis.

**· Financial systems & reporting:**

oversee accounting software, PMS, and POS integrations to automate reporting, ensure data integrity, and create operational dashboards.

**· Business partnering:**

advise the GM and department heads on financial performance, cost optimization, and margin improvements aligned with our sustainability and luxury goals.

**· Team leadership:**
lead, mentor, and train the resort finance team to deliver accurate, timely output and maintain compliance.

**Candidate Profile**

· Bachelor's degree in commerce, accounting, finance, or a related field.

· Minimum 6 years of experience in finance and accounts, ideally in hospitality or resort operations.

The candidate should have proven ability to develop and manage Channel Partner networks, generate qualified leads, build strong customer relationships, and drive prospects through the complete sales cycle. Strong understanding of real estate sales processes with a target-oriented approach and focus on revenue generation, customer acquisition, and business growth. Excellent communication and client service skills are a must. • Drive end-to-end real estate sales, including lead generation, prospect qualification, customer engagement, site visits, follow-ups, negotiations, booking, and closure.

• Identify, onboard, and develop new Channel Partners (CPs) while maintaining productive relationships with existing CPs to generate regular sales leads and business opportunities.

• Generate and manage leads through Channel Partners, direct enquiries, referrals, digital leads, and market outreach, ensuring effective follow-up and conversion.

• Manage customer relationships throughout the sales journey, addressing queries, coordinating with internal teams, and ensuring timely communication and a positive customer experience.

• Work experience with Real Estate Developer/ Real Estate Consultancy/Franchise or with Real Estate Portals, would be preferred.

**Skills: -**

• Must have excellent communication skills, the ability to multi-task and exceptional phone manners.

• Should be well versed with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Power Point)

• Must have excellent Interpersonal Skills

• Excellent fluency over spoken and written English, Hindi & Gujarati

• Should have knowledge of preparing proposals for clients & good presentation skills

**Other Abilities & Requirements:**

Candidates must have a fair idea of the geography of Ahmedabad city

Salary up to 7.20 LPA based on experience and current salary.

title: Field Sales Executive
description:
**Company Description**
NutrivoPets is a growing pet nutrition company dedicated to providing high-quality, scientifically formulated food and supplements for companion animals. The organization focuses on improving pet health and well-being through balanced, nutritious products tailored to different breeds and life stages. NutrivoPets works closely with veterinarians, pet retailers, and caregivers to promote responsible pet care and informed product choices. The company values customer education, ethical business practices, and building long-term relationships within the pet care community.
  
**Role Description**
The Field Sales Executive role at NutrivoPets is a full-time, on-site position based in Ahmedabad. The person in this role will visit pet stores, veterinary clinics, distributors, and other retail partners to promote NutrivoPets products and expand market presence. Daily activities include meeting with prospective and existing customers, demonstrating product benefits, negotiating orders, and ensuring product visibility through merchandising and in-store promotions. The Field Sales Executive will monitor local market trends, gather customer feedback, and report sales performance to the sales leadership team. This role also involves coordinating with internal teams for timely deliveries, after-sales support, and participation in local events, campaigns, and brand-building initiatives.
  
**Qualifications**

* Proven experience in field sales, preferably in FMCG, pet care, or healthcare products, with strong customer relationship-building abilities.
* Basic knowledge of sales processes, including lead generation, pipeline management, and negotiation, with the ability to meet and exceed targets.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to present product information clearly and professionally to diverse customer groups.
* Comfort with frequent local travel in and around Ahmedabad, including visiting multiple customer locations daily.
* Ability to work independently, manage time effectively, and maintain accurate records of visits, orders, and customer interactions.
* Proficiency with smartphones and basic digital tools (email, spreadsheets, CRM or sales reporting apps) for tracking and reporting activities.
* High level of integrity, accountability, and customer-centric mindset, with a genuine interest in pets and pet wellness considered an advantage.
* Minimum of a high school diploma; a bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field is beneficial but not mandatory.

title: Visa Counselor
description:
**Visa Counsellor**
– Student Visas (Counselling + File Processing)

**Location:**
Bodakdev, Ahmedabad

**No of Openings:**
2

UpSkill Overseas is hiring two Visa Counsellors. Together they take a student from first enquiry to visa approval: counsel the student, then build and file the application.

**About UpSkill Overseas**

We are an Ahmedabad-based overseas education and student visa consultancy. We help students study in the UK, USA, Australia, Ireland and more, and handle admissions, student visas, visitor visas, SOP and resume support, and IELTS, PTE, GRE and SAT coaching under one roof.

**What you will do – Counselling**

•        Counsel students and parents on country, course, university and intake based on profile, budget and test scores

•        Convert enquiries from walk-ins, calls, WhatsApp and ads into enrolled students, with consistent follow-up

•        Explain visa rules, financial documents, timelines and costs clearly and honestly

•        Log every lead and conversation in our CRM (Zoho)

What you will do – Processing

•        Prepare and check university applications, student visa files and visitor visa files: checklists, financials, sponsorship, SOPs and forms

•        Fill and submit visa forms (DS-160, UKVI, ImmiAccount, Irish AVATS) and book biometrics and appointments

•        Track offers and next steps such as I-20, CAS and CoE through university and partner portals

•        Run mock visa interviews and support refusal cases and re-applications with senior team members

•        Keep up with visa rule changes across all our destinations

**Who we are looking for**

•        2–4 years in student visa counselling and/or processing

•        Hands-on visa experience with at least two of: UK, USA, Australia, Ireland

•        Fluent in English, Gujarati and Hindi

•        Sharp eye for documents; one wrong form can cost a student their intake

•        Comfortable working with monthly enrolment targets

•        Graduate in any discipline

**Good to have:**
Zoho CRM experience, US F-1 interview preparation, working knowledge of IELTS or PTE

**What we offer**

•        Competitive salary, plus an incentive on every successful visa closure

•        Student and visitor visa work across the UK, USA, Australia and Ireland

•        Training on our processes for every destination

•        Office: Shilp Aaron, Sindhu Bhavan Marg, Bodakdev, Ahmedabad

•        Working days: Monday to Saturday, 10:00 am – 7:00 pm

**How to apply:**
Apply with Easy Apply and mention the countries you have processed visa files for and whether your strength is counselling, processing or both.

title: Civil Draftsman
description:
**Company Description**
Sheild Engineers is an innovative consultancy and construction service provider specializing in structural and infrastructure engineering. The company offers integrated planning, detailed design, construction, and project management for residential, commercial, and industrial buildings, as well as bridges, transportation infrastructure, and electrical management services. With a focus on optimized, state-of-the-art design solutions, Sheild Engineers combines technical expertise, research, and creative approaches to deliver projects that meet evolving client and industry needs. By managing the full project lifecycle from blueprint to delivery, the firm provides a smooth, efficient client experience and supports a sustainable future in the built environment.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Civil Draftsman role based in Ahmedabad. The Civil Draftsman will prepare detailed technical and engineering drawings for structural and infrastructure projects, translating design concepts into accurate, buildable plans. Daily responsibilities include creating and updating CAD drawings, collaborating with civil engineers and project managers, ensuring drawings comply with relevant codes and standards, and maintaining organized documentation of design revisions. The role also involves coordinating with the design team to resolve drawing-related issues, supporting quantity estimation where needed, and contributing to quality control of drafting outputs.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong skills in Civil Engineering Drafting and Civil Engineering Design for buildings, bridges, and infrastructure projects.
* Proficiency in Technical Drawing and Engineering Drawings, with the ability to interpret and produce detailed plans and sections.
* Hands-on experience with Computer-Aided Design (CAD) tools (e.g., AutoCAD or similar) for 2D and basic 3D drafting.
* Diploma or degree in Civil Engineering or a related discipline from a recognized institution.
* Understanding of relevant building codes, standards, and construction practices.
* Strong attention to detail, accuracy in measurements, and ability to work to deadlines.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills for working with multidisciplinary project teams.
* Prior experience as a Civil Draftsman or in a similar drafting role within engineering or construction is preferred.

title: CCTV Operator

description:
**Who We Are**
VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
  
  
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
  
  
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  
  
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture
  
  
**About This Role**
We are seeking a
**Fraud Control Analyst**
to identify, investigate and prevent activities that could result in financial loss or a poor customer experience. Based in
**India or the EU**
and reporting to a Team Leader within Security Operations, you will monitor customer activity, analyse suspected fraud cases and take timely decisions to prevent fraudulent activity.
  
  
This opportunity is suited to candidates with
**3–5 years of experience in analytics, banking, telecommunications, fraud control, revenue assurance or customer support**
, particularly where data analysis has been an important part of the role. The position operates in a
**24/7 environment**
.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Monitor customer accounts, services and transactions to identify potentially fraudulent or suspicious activity, including roaming, domestic, artificially inflated traffic and first-party fraud
* Conduct detailed investigations of identified fraud-risk cases and use available evidence to confirm or rule out fraudulent activity
* Monitor accounts with unusually high local or international voice, messaging or data usage and take appropriate preventive action in line with established procedures
* Identify emerging fraud patterns and recommend effective approaches for fraud prevention, detection and resolution
* Manage internal fraud-related requests and complaints received through phone and email while maintaining high customer service standards
* Make timely, evidence-based decisions to prevent fraudulent activity, including independently resolving complex cases within established processes
* Maintain accurate case handling and meet agreed productivity, quality, service-level and process-compliance requirements
* Contribute to performance reporting, including key performance indicators and service delivery standards
* Collaborate professionally with colleagues, Team Leaders and other stakeholders, and recommend opportunities to improve fraud-control processes
* Comply with applicable internal regulations, departmental procedures and the Code of Conduct

Success in the role will be measured primarily through the
**speed and effectiveness of fraud prevention, accuracy of decisions and adherence to required processes**
.
  
  
**Who You Are**

* You are a graduate from a recognised university with 3–5 years of relevant experience in analytics, banking, telecommunications, fraud control, revenue assurance or a customer support role involving data analysis
* You have strong analytical skills and knowledge of telecommunications or banking fraud-control practices, with the judgement to investigate complex information and make appropriate decisions
* You are comfortable using Microsoft Office and multiple systems or applications to analyse information and manage cases
* You have strong written and verbal English communication skills at approximately C1/C2 proficiency and can manage customer and internal interactions professionally, including challenging situations
* You are organised, customer-focused and results-oriented, can prioritise competing activities, proactively manage your performance and are willing to work in a 24/7 operational environment

**Not a perfect fit?**
Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
  
  
**What's In It For You**

* Opportunity to build practical expertise in telecommunications fraud detection and prevention
* Exposure to customer and transaction monitoring across domestic and international telecommunications services
* Experience investigating complex fraud-risk cases where decisions directly contribute to reducing financial loss and protecting customer experience
* Opportunity to work collaboratively within Security Operations and contribute recommendations that improve fraud-control processes and service delivery
* A role offering meaningful decision-making responsibility and exposure to evolving fraud behaviours and prevention approaches

**What Skills You Will Learn**

* Advanced fraud-risk analysis and investigation techniques within a telecommunications environment
* Identification and interpretation of emerging fraud behaviours and suspicious usage patterns
* Evidence-based decision-making for fraud prevention and loss mitigation
* Monitoring and interpretation of operational performance measures, including quality, service standards and fraud-prevention effectiveness
* Cross-functional communication, customer issue resolution and continuous process improvement

**VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment**
Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio-economic background.
  
  
**Join Us**
At Vodafone, we’re not just shaping the future of connectivity for our customers – we’re shaping the future for everyone who joins our team. When you work with us, you’re part of a global mission to connect people, solve complex challenges, and create a sustainable and more inclusive world. If you want to grow your career whilst finding the perfect balance between work and life, Vodafone offers the opportunities to help you belong and make a real impact.

.

* Relevant experience in Electrical design in a consultancy organisation for Water Sector.
* Conversant in Electrical design software – Dialux, ETAP.
* Computer literacy in MS office-an understanding of AUTOCAD is essential.
* Ability to work in on one's own with lead office as part of integrated team
* Very good written and oral communication skills
* Self-motivated with keen interest to learn new skills and add value to the team/organization

At Mott MacDonald, we support our staff to create work-life balance which works for them and welcome candidates looking for career flexibility. We are open to discussing flexible working at interview stage.
  
  
**Our benefits package is designed to enhance your experience:**

* Group term life insurance, and Group medical insurance coverage
* Career mobility options
* Short and Long-term global employment opportunities
* Global collaboration and knowledge sharing

title: Amazon Ads Specialist
description:
We are looking for an Ecommerce Marketplace Specialist to drive the growth and performance of our brands across leading online marketplaces such as Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, AJIO, Nykaa Fashion, and quick-commerce platforms.

  

The role will be responsible for managing end-to-end marketplace operations, improving product visibility and conversion, optimizing advertising campaigns, executing promotional initiatives, and generating actionable insights to maximize sales, profitability, and customer experience.

  

**Tasks**

  

Manage end-to-end operations across ecommerce marketplaces, ensuring seamless execution and business growth.

  

Conduct regular catalogue audits to maintain listing accuracy, content quality, pricing consistency, and inventory availability.

  

Monitor marketplace performance and prepare daily, weekly, and monthly reports with actionable business insights.

  

Plan, execute, and optimize marketplace advertising campaigns while managing budgets to maximize ROAS and profitability.

  

Identify opportunities to improve sales, traffic, conversion rates, product visibility, and overall marketplace performance.

  

Monitor key marketplace KPIs including sales, revenue, traffic, conversion rate, ACOS/TACOS, ROAS, returns, ratings, reviews, and inventory health.

  

Execute promotional campaigns, deals, offers, and seasonal marketplace events.

  

Ensure timely execution of new product launches, catalogue updates, pricing changes, promotions, and marketplace initiatives.

  

Work closely with Supply Chain, Creative, Catalog, Customer Experience, and Performance Marketing teams to execute business priorities.

  

Monitor inventory levels and coordinate with relevant teams to minimize stock-outs and ensure marketplace availability.

  

Track competitor pricing, promotions, assortment, visibility, and marketplace activities to identify growth opportunities.

  

Ensure compliance with marketplace policies and maintain strong seller performance standards.

  

Identify operational gaps and implement process improvements to improve efficiency and marketplace performance.

  

Use data and marketplace analytics to develop recommendations and drive continuous business growth.

  

**Requirements**

  

Strong understanding of ecommerce marketplace operations and business management.

  

Hands-on experience with platforms such as Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, AJIO, Nykaa Fashion, and/or quick-commerce marketplaces.

  

Strong understanding of marketplace advertising, including Sponsored Ads, campaign optimization, ACOS, TACOS, ROAS, and budget management.

  

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to convert data into actionable business insights.

  

Good understanding of ecommerce metrics including GMV, revenue, traffic, conversion, ASP, returns, ratings, inventory health, and profitability.

  

Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills and comfort working with large datasets.

  

Excellent cross-functional coordination and stakeholder management skills.

  

Strong attention to detail and ownership of business outcomes.

  

Ability to work in a fast-paced, target-driven environment.

description:

Join Oracle in supporting mission-critical database, application and middleware environments. The role works across infrastructure, database, middleware and application teams to maintain service availability, improve performance and support cloud migration and operational automation.

We are seeking an Oracle Apps DBA & Fusion Middleware Administrator to manage, maintain and troubleshoot Oracle Applications, Database and Fusion Middleware environments. You will support production operations, upgrades, high availability, disaster recovery and cloud infrastructure.
  
  
Candidates should bring strong expertise in either Oracle Apps DBA or Fusion Middleware administration, supported by good working knowledge of the other.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage reliable production environments: Administer Oracle Database, Oracle Applications 11i/R12 and Fusion Middleware products, including WebLogic, SOA and OBIEE, across standalone, clustered and multi-node environments.

* Maintain availability and disaster readiness: Support RAC, Active Data Guard, physical and snapshot standby databases, switchover, failover and disaster recovery synchronization using RSYNC across data centers.
* Administer middleware services and deployments: Configure JDBC connection pools, data sources, JMS resources and one-way/two-way SSL. Deploy and migrate WAR, EJB and EAR applications using WebLogic Console, deployment utilities and WLST.

* Automate operational activities: Use Python and shell scripting to standardize server and service management, reduce manual effort and prevent recurring incidents.
* Support cloud environments and migrations: Provision and maintain cloud infrastructure and migrate on-premises Oracle environments to OCI, applying sound networking, security, resilience and connectivity practices.
* Coordinate effective service delivery: Work independently with customers and cross-functional teams, manage operational risks and changes, follow applicable compliance requirements and provide proactive technical recommendations.

**Responsibilities**
**Qualifications & Skills**
**Mandatory**

* Meet one of the following education and experience pathways:

+ 11 years of experience implementing or supporting IT solutions, IT operations or related work; or
+ A bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, with 7 years of relevant experience; or
+ A master’s degree in a related field, with 5 years of relevant experience.

* Demonstrate hands-on Oracle Applications, Database and/or Fusion Middleware administration experience, with strong expertise in Apps DBA or Fusion Middleware and working knowledge of the other.
* Experience installing, configuring, administering and supporting Oracle infrastructure in production environments.
* Knowledge of Oracle Applications 11i/R12 administration, cloning, refreshes, patching and multi-node maintenance.
* Experience with WebLogic architecture, vertical and horizontal clustering, load balancing, high availability, patching and troubleshooting.
* Experience supporting Oracle Database high availability and disaster recovery technologies, including RAC and Data Guard.
* Hands-on knowledge of JDBC, JMS, application deployment, SSL configuration and WLST.
* Strong Linux/Unix administration, Python and shell scripting skills.
* Experience with cloud infrastructure, OCI provisioning and migration of on-premises Oracle environments to OCI.
* Ability to troubleshoot across infrastructure, database, middleware and application layers and support services within agreed SLAs.
* Strong communication, coordination, organizational and customer-facing skills, with attention to detail and the ability to work independently.
* Willingness to work 24×7 shifts and weekends as required.

**Good-to-Have**

* OCI certification, Oracle Product Certifications or other relevant technical certifications.
* Knowledge of Identity Management and Oracle Access Manager.
* Experience provisioning or maintaining environments on Azure, AWS or Google Cloud.
* Working knowledge of Docker and container orchestration technologies.
* Project management certification, including Certified Associate in Project Management.
* Experience contributing to solution architecture, project delivery or cross-functional programs.

**Self-Assessment Questions**

* Can I independently administer and troubleshoot either Oracle Apps DBA or Fusion Middleware environments, while demonstrating practical working knowledge of the other?
* Can I explain a production patching, cloning or upgrade activity I completed, including validation, rollback planning and downtime management?
* Have I supported RAC, Data Guard or middleware clustering, and can I describe my role in a failover, switchover or disaster recovery exercise?
* Can I demonstrate how I diagnosed a complex production issue or used Python, shell scripting or WLST to reduce recurring incidents and manual effort?
* Do I meet an education and experience pathway, have relevant OCI provisioning or migration experience, and feel comfortable supporting customer environments through shifts and weekend work?

title: GIS Consultant
description:

* Practical experience using ArcGIS Pro for data management, analysis and map production.

Desirable

The position is responsible for managing end-to-end tendering activities for domestic coal procurement, movement, and supply operations. title: QA Executive, Subject Matter Expert
description:
Role at a glance

PharmaSynapse is hiring one Junior Executive in Quality Assurance to work as the shop floor subject matter expert for our QA and AI engineering team.

* **Role:**
  Junior Executive, QA (Subject Matter Expert)
* **Experience:**
  3 to 5 years in QA at GMP plants on oral solids (tablets and capsules) and injectables, at least 2 of them on the shop floor
* **Education:**
  B.Pharm or M.Pharm (M.Sc considered with strong IPQA experience)
* **Location:**
  On site at our office in Gota, Ahmedabad. Ahmedabad local candidates only
* **Working hours:**
  Monday to Friday, 10 am to 7 pm
* **Reports to:**
  Kinjal Patel, Co-founder and CEO
* **Type:**
  Full time

About the role

PharmaSynapse builds AI software that prepares GMP documents for pharma plants. You will join Kinjal Patel, our Co-founder and CEO with 12 years in pharma QA, as the second QA expert on the team and work every day with our AI engineers. Your floor knowledge decides whether what we build holds up inside a real plant.

What you will do

Your main job is to help Kinjal and our AI engineers build and test the software, and these five kinds of work fill most of your week.

* Create realistic dummy documents for testing, such as master formulas, BMRs, BPRs, equipment lists, in-process limits and process validation sampling plans, for oral solids and injectables, with no real company data.
* Test the software by running each flow end to end as a production or QA user would, from preparing a document through review and approval, and log every gap with clear steps to repeat it.
* Check each document the software produces against shop floor practice and GMP, and mark every error with the correct entry beside it.
* Suggest changes to steps, screens and terms so the software matches how production and QA actually work on the floor.
* Brainstorm with Kinjal and the engineers on new features, and explain how a batch runs from dispensing to packing to teammates who have never worked in a plant.

What you must bring

We screen for floor experience first, because a documentation-only background cannot tell our engineers how a batch really behaves.

* B.Pharm or M.Pharm, with at least 3 years in QA at GMP plants making oral solids and injectables, approved by USFDA, EU, MHRA, WHO or PIC/S.
* Shop floor experience on both oral solid (tablet and capsule) and injectable lines is a must, with at least 2 years as IPQA doing line clearance, in-process checks, sampling and AQL inspection on running batches.
* On injectables, hands-on floor exposure to aseptic area behaviour, media fill, environmental monitoring and 100% visual inspection.
* Hands-on work with executed BMRs and BPRs, covering real-time entries, GDP corrections, reconciliation and review before batch release.
* Time on process validation batches, executing the sampling plan (blend uniformity, stratified sampling, hold time studies) and compiling the PV data.
* Floor-level QMS work, such as raising deviations and incidents, handling change controls and following CAPA through to closure.
* Working knowledge of 21 CFR 211, 21 CFR Part 11, EU GMP Chapter 4, Annex 1, Annex 11, Annex 15, WHO TRS and ALCOA+.
* Excellent spoken and written English, strong enough to explain a floor step clearly to engineers outside pharma, lead a brainstorming discussion and write test findings anyone on the team can follow.
* Fluent Gujarati or Hindi and comfort with Excel.

Good to have

* Floor time on other dosage forms, such as oral liquids, ophthalmics, or creams and ointments.
* Exposure to MFC and MPC preparation, finished product specifications, APQR compilation or CPV trending.
* Use of plant software such as an eQMS, LIMS, eBMR or SAP, or a part in a computer system validation exercise.
* Curiosity about AI tools, shown by something you have already tried, such as checking a document with ChatGPT or building an Excel template your team still uses.

What you get

* An on-site role at our Gota office in Ahmedabad, Monday to Friday from 10 am to 7 pm, with no rotating night shifts.
* Daily work with a QA founder and an AI architect, each with 12 years in their field.
* A clear path to Product Specialist and then Domain Lead as the product grows.
* Pay that respects your floor experience, discussed openly in the first call.

How to apply

* Email your CV to
  **p.kinjal@pharmasynapse.ai**
  with the subject line "Junior QA Executive, SME". In the same email, describe in five or six lines one line clearance you refused to sign and what you found on the line. We read that answer before we open the CV, so make it specific. We consider applications only from candidates who already live in Ahmedabad.

description:
**Department:**
Engineering and Product Development

**About Othrys Aviation:**

Othrys Aviation is an aircraft manufacturing company focused on designing and developing safe, reliable, and high-performance aviation solutions. We bring together engineering, manufacturing, testing, and innovation to build aircraft that meet stringent operational and regulatory standards.

**About the Role:**

We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented
**Aerospace Engineer**
to contribute to the design, development, analysis, testing, and certification of aircraft and related systems.

The role requires strong engineering fundamentals, practical problem-solving skills, and the ability to collaborate with multidisciplinary teams across design, manufacturing, quality, testing, supply chain, and regulatory compliance.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Support the conceptual, preliminary, and detailed design of aircraft, airframes, components, and aerospace systems.
* Perform engineering calculations and analyses related to aerodynamics, aircraft structures, loads, stability, performance, weight, and material selection.
* Develop and review 3D models, engineering drawings, assemblies, specifications, and bills of materials.
* Conduct or support structural, stress, fatigue, vibration, thermal, CFD, and finite element analyses, depending on project requirements.

* Support certification activities and coordinate the preparation of technical evidence for regulatory reviews.
* Collaborate with suppliers and vendors to evaluate aerospace components, materials, technical specifications, and manufacturing capabilities.
* Identify opportunities to improve aircraft performance, safety, reliability, manufacturability, weight, cost, and operational efficiency.
* Maintain accurate configuration control and documentation throughout the product development lifecycle.
* Stay updated on developments in aerospace technology, aircraft manufacturing, materials, propulsion, and regulatory requirements.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Aeronautical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 3–7 years of relevant experience in aerospace engineering, aircraft design, aviation manufacturing, defence, UAVs, or a related engineering environment.

  .

* Familiarity with aircraft development, testing, verification, validation, and configuration-management processes.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and root-cause-analysis skills.
* Good technical documentation and communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary, safety-critical engineering environment.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Master’s degree in Aerospace, Aeronautical, Mechanical, or a related engineering discipline.
* Experience in one or more of the following areas:
* Aircraft structural design and stress analysis
* Aerodynamics and computational fluid dynamics
* Flight mechanics, stability, and control
* Propulsion-system integration
* Avionics or aircraft-system integration
* Composite-material design and manufacturing
* Aircraft performance and weight estimation
* Ground testing or flight testing
* Airworthiness and certification
* Knowledge of aviation standards and regulatory frameworks issued by
  **DGCA, FAA, EASA, or equivalent authorities**
  .
* Familiarity with aerospace quality and development standards such as
  **AS9100, DO-160, ARP4754A, or other applicable standards**
  .
* Experience working with prototype aircraft, unmanned aerial vehicles, light aircraft, or new aircraft-development programmes.
* Exposure to Product Lifecycle Management and configuration-control systems.

**What We Offer:**

* Opportunity to contribute directly to aircraft development and manufacturing.
* Exposure to the complete aircraft-development lifecycle—from design and prototyping to testing and certification.
* Collaboration with multidisciplinary engineering and manufacturing teams.
* A technically challenging environment that encourages innovation, ownership, and continuous learning.
* Competitive compensation based on experience and technical expertise.

We are inviting applications for the role of
**Analyst**
,
**Sustainability – ESG Process Pod**
**Location:**
Ahmedabad, Gujarat.
  
  
This role supports the setup of the ESG Process Pod by helping setup, operationalize and scale sustainability and responsible sourcing activities through structured demand intake, prioritization support, data gathering, validation, reporting assistance, supplier engagement, and process tracking. We are looking for a sustainability-minded analyst with strong business understanding, good analytical skills, and the ability to translate global and zonal ESG requirements into practical execution priorities. The role will initially focus on global priority items and the first critical tasks required to establish a scalable ESG execution capability.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Intake of global and zonal sustainability requests and helping structure them into clear, actionable work items
* Assist with prioritization of ESG operational requests using agreed criteria such as strategic alignment, business value, operational scalability, standardization potential, feasibility, capacity, timing, and regulatory or reporting urgency
* Sustainability related data gathering, validation, evidence tracking, supplier follow-up, and reporting support
* Support CDP, CSRD readiness, internal ESG reporting, KPI tie-outs, and quarterly sustainability update templates by collecting inputs, validating completeness, and tracking open actions
* Sustainability mailbox management, Third-Party Risk related task support, request tracking, status reporting, and follow-up documentation
* Maintain trackers, dashboards, and status updates that provide visibility on request pipeline, execution progress, bottlenecks, risks, and resource needs
* Work with Sustainability, Procurement, GBS, zones, and data teams to clarify requirements, align priorities, escalate blockers, and ensure final business or SME sign-off remains with the appropriate owners

**Desired Candidate**

* 1+ years of experience or degree related to Sustainability, ESG, Procurement, Supply Chain, Business Operations, Reporting, Risk, Compliance, or related analytical roles
* Strong business understanding and ability to connect operational tasks to broader sustainability, procurement, reporting, and compliance priorities.
* Ability to identify dependencies, assess priority, and translate business needs into concrete execution steps.
* Strong analytical skills with proficiency in MS Excel and PowerPoint; experience with Power BI, Monday.com, Aravo, SAP, Ariba, or ESG reporting tools is an added advantage.
* Self-motivated with strong ownership, accountability, attention to detail, and ability to progress work independently while escalating risks or blockers early.
* Good communication skills, with the ability to summarize status, decisions, trade-offs, and risks clearly for both operational teams and leadership stakeholders.
* Comfortable working in a fast-moving setup phase, balancing hands-on execution with process building, standardization, and continuous improvement.

Location(s)

description:
**Department:**
Marketing and Leasing

**Location:**
GIFT City, Gandhinagar, Gujarat

**Reports to:**
[Head of Leasing / Director]

**Employment type:**
Full-time

**Experience required:**
Minimum 5 years

**Role Overview**

We are seeking an experienced marketing professional to drive the leasing of our office, commercial, co-working, and managed office space portfolio in GIFT City. The successful candidate will develop and execute marketing and business development strategies that attract financial services firms, Big 4 and other professional services firms, IT/ITeS companies, global capability centres, and retail and commercial tenants to the International Financial Services Centre (IFSC) and the wider GIFT City ecosystem

.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Plan and execute marketing strategies to generate leasing enquiries and achieve occupancy and revenue targets for office, commercial, co-working, and managed office spaces.
* Lead the marketing and leasing of co-working and managed office offerings, including packaging, pricing inputs, and tenant onboarding for flexible space requirements.
* Target and engage Big 4 firms and other professional services firms, along with financial institutions, global capability centres, and corporate occupiers, to build and convert a strong tenant pipeline.
* Build and maintain a strong pipeline of prospective tenants, tracking leads from first enquiry to lease closure.
* Coordinate with tenant representation brokers and consultants such as JLL, Knight Frank, CBRE, and Colliers, and manage channel partner relationships.
* Liaise with prospective tenants on space requirements, site visits, commercial terms, and onboarding formalities.
* Prepare marketing collateral, including brochures, presentations, leasing proposals, floor plans, and digital content.
* Plan and manage events, roadshows, investor and tenant meets, and participation in industry forums.
* Oversee digital marketing, branding, website content, and social media presence for the property portfolio.
* Conduct market research on GIFT City and Ahmedabad–Gandhinagar commercial real estate, including competitor supply, rental benchmarks, and absorption trends.
* Work with legal, finance, and property management teams to ensure smooth lease execution and tenant handover.
* Maintain accurate leasing MIS and report regularly on pipeline, conversions, and campaign performance.
* Travel as required to meet prospective tenants, brokers, and partners, and to attend roadshows and industry events.



**Qualifications and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Real Estate, or a related field; an MBA is preferred.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in marketing, leasing, or business development for commercial real estate, with a demonstrable track record of leasing office and commercial space.
* Experience in leasing co-working and managed office space (flexible workspace) is strongly preferred.
* Prior experience with a leading real estate consultancy or developer (for example JLL, Knight Frank, CBRE, Colliers, Cushman & Wakefield, or a comparable Grade A developer) is strongly preferred.
* Proven record of closing leases and meeting or exceeding leasing targets.
* Established network among corporate occupiers, real estate heads, and brokers, including Big 4 and other professional services firms, preferably in Gujarat or western India.
* Willingness to travel frequently within India for client meetings, roadshows, and events.

**Skills and Competencies**

* Strong understanding of commercial lease structures, rental negotiation, and Grade A office market dynamics.
* Working knowledge of GIFT City, SEZ, and IFSC regulatory and incentive frameworks is an advantage.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
* Proficiency in CRM tools, MS Office, and digital marketing platforms.
* Strong analytical ability and attention to detail.
* Fluency in English and Hindi; Gujarati is an advantage.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Area leased (sq. ft.) and rental value achieved against target
* Lead-to-closure conversion ratio
* Pipeline quality and size
* Time to lease closure
* Marketing spend efficiency and enquiry generation

title: Sales Executive
description:
**Coimbatore (in office) · Full-time · 1–5 years' experience · ₹25,000–30,000 per month**

About us

LocoTrails is a fully bespoke, experiential travel company. We don't sell packages. We start with who you are: what you love, what you're curious about, the feeling you're chasing. Then we design the trip around that.

We plan 400–500 custom trips a year across 60+ destinations, with a team of 20 in Coimbatore. Most of our clients have come through word of mouth, and we're now growing fast. 10% of our net margins go towards funding holidays for underprivileged children.

The role

You'll be the first voice people hear when they reach out to us. Enquiries come in from everywhere: Instagram, WhatsApp, our website, ads and referrals. You'll be the one who picks up, makes them feel welcome, understands what they're looking for, and moves the right ones forward to our travel advisors.

You'll be on calls through the day. If you love talking to people and get excited about travel, this is a job where both of those count.

What you'll do

* Respond quickly to every new enquiry, whether it comes by phone, WhatsApp, Instagram DM, website form, ad or referral
* Have the first conversation with every lead, and keep it warm, curious and unhurried. Find out who's travelling, when, what they're hoping for and roughly what they're looking to spend
* Qualify enquiries: spot the ones that fit how we work, and politely close the ones that don't
* Hand qualified leads over to our travel advisors with clear notes, so the client never has to repeat themselves
* Follow up consistently with leads who've gone quiet
* Log every conversation in our system, including the lead source, its stage and the next step
* Explain how we work, what clients can expect and what happens next
* Tell the team about patterns you notice: what people ask for, which channels the best leads come from, and why some don't go ahead

What we're looking for

* 1–3 years in a customer-facing role that's mostly on the phone, such as inbound sales, customer support, client relations, a call centre or hospitality
* Excellent spoken English and Tamil. Hindi or another language is a plus
* A warm, confident phone manner. You can build rapport with a stranger in the first two minutes
* You're a genuine listener who asks the next question rather than reading from a script
* You're at ease speaking with senior professionals, business owners and well-travelled families
* You're organised and never let a lead slip, and your WhatsApp and written replies are quick and clear
* You're comfortable with WhatsApp Business, Google Sheets and CRM tools

We're deliberately hiring someone early in their career who wants to grow with a young team. We're not looking for 10+ years of experience.

Bonus points

* You love to travel. You've planned your own trips, and friends come to you for recommendations
* You've worked in travel, hospitality or premium services before

Why join us

* A young, fast-growing team where your work is seen and you'll have room to grow
* A ₹10,000 yearly learning budget to spend on anything you like
* ₹5 lakh health insurance
* A team activity every month and a team holiday every 3–6 months
* 3% of net profits shared with the team

Details

* **Location:**
  In office, Coimbatore
* **Salary:**
  ₹25,000–30,000 per month
* **Working days and hours:**
  Monday to Saturday 9 AM to 6 PM
* 2 Paid leaves a month

title: Lead Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Core Responsibilities**

* **Infrastructure Technical Leadership:**
  Define and enforce technical standards across Windows/M365/Azure environments so issues are prevented, not just fixed.
* **Customer Baselines & Hardening:**
  Build repeatable baseline requirements (identity, endpoint, email, logging, monitoring) and drive adoption across customers.
* **Telemetry, Logging & Integrations:**
  Ensure security operations have the right data—improve log collection, forwarding, reliability, and integration patterns that support detection/IR.
* **Automation & Reliability:**
  Reduce operational load through automation (PowerShell required; Python a plus), standard checks, and repeatable remediation workflows.
* **L3 Escalation:**
  Act as L3 for infrastructure and security-adjacent incidents (identity issues, email compromise support, endpoint instability, connectivity/logging gaps).
* **Tooling Strategy + Modernization:**
  Research and recommend infrastructure/security-adjacent improvements tied to measurable outcomes (stability, visibility, reduced manual work).
* **POC Leadership (Internal + Customer):**
  Lead infra-side POCs end-to-end—test plans, success criteria, operational fit, documentation, and rollout readiness (runbooks, training, support model).
* **Customer-Facing Technical Support:**
  Join technical sales and customer calls to validate designs, explain implementation approach, and guide rollout planning.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:**
  Partner with the Lead Security Engineer to ensure infrastructure decisions enable better detection and response (not blind spots).

**Required Qualifications**

* **Experience:**
  **10+ years**
  hands-on systems/infrastructure engineering (managed services experience strongly preferred).
* **Windows & Identity Depth:**
  Strong Windows Server/AD/GPO/DNS fundamentals plus troubleshooting at scale; strong Microsoft 365/Entra ID administration and identity troubleshooting.
* **Cloud/Modern Ops Capability:**
  Practical experience with Azure and modern endpoint/security operations requirements (logging, monitoring, baselines).
* **Automation Requirement:**
  Strong PowerShell and the ability to deliver
  **basic scripting/automation for enrichment, validation, and remediation acceleration**
  (Python optional but valued).
* **Operational Discipline:**
  Able to turn fixes into standards/runbooks; strong documentation habits and repeatable rollout thinking.
* **Communication:**
  Excellent written/spoken English for customer-facing technical discussions and U.S. stakeholder collaboration.
* **Ownership & Judgment:**
  Calm under pressure; makes clear recommendations and drives work through implementation.

**Tools & Platforms (partial)**

* **Infrastructure & Networking:**
  Palo Alto Firewalls, Cisco Meraki (Switches/APs), Datto RMM
* **Security & Identity (integration awareness required):**
  CrowdStrike (EDR/XDR), FortiMail, DNSFilter
* **Data Protection:**
  Rubrik (On-Prem & SaaS)
* **Service Management:**
  Zoho Desk

**What Success Looks Like**

* **Fewer Repeat Issues:**
  Recurring incidents drop due to baselines, hardening, and automation.
* **Better SOC Visibility:**
  Logging/telemetry completeness improves; fewer investigation blockers caused by missing data.
* **Faster Resolution:**
  L3 escalations resolve more quickly because standards and remediation patterns are consistent.
* **Tech Stack Progress:**
  POCs produce clear go/no-go decisions and smooth rollouts with documented support models and runbooks.
* **Customer Confidence:**
  Strong technical leadership on calls; customers see stable environments and clear guidance.

**Help Us Grow Our Dream Team — Join Us, Refer a Friend, and Earn a Referral Bonus!**
**Job Summary**

* We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Healthcare RCM Supervisor, Accounts Receivable, to oversee our accounts receivable department. The ideal candidate will possess strong leadership skills, a comprehensive understanding of healthcare revenue cycle management, and a proven track record of optimizing accounts receivable processes. The Supervisor will be responsible for managing a team of AR specialists, ensuring timely and accurate billing, claims processing, payment posting, and denial management.

**Essential Functions And Tasks**

* Lead and manage a team of accounts receivable specialists, providing guidance, support, and coaching to ensure high performance and productivity.
* Develop and implement strategies to optimize the accounts receivable process, reduce aging of accounts, and improve cash flow.
* Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and metrics related to accounts receivable, such as days in accounts receivable (AR days), denial rates, and cash collection ratios, and take proactive measures to address any deviations from targets.
* Oversee the billing and claims processing functions, ensuring that claims are submitted accurately and timely, and that any issues or errors are promptly addressed and resolved.
* Manage payment posting activities, reconciling payments received with billed charges, and identifying and addressing any discrepancies or variances.
* Coordinate denial management efforts, analyzing denial trends, implementing corrective actions, and appealing denials as necessary to maximize revenue recovery.
* Collaborate with other departments, such as coding, billing, and compliance, to ensure alignment and consistency in revenue cycle processes and workflows.
* Stay informed about changes and updates in healthcare regulations, payer policies, and industry trends related to accounts receivable management, and implement necessary changes to ensure compliance and optimization.
* Conduct regular team meetings and performance reviews, providing feedback, recognition, and development opportunities to team members.
* Foster a positive and collaborative work environment, promoting teamwork, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Serve as a point of contact for escalated issues and inquiries from internal stakeholders, external partners, and patients related to accounts receivable matters.
* Keep accurate records of accounts receivable activities, performance metrics, and outcomes, and generate reports as needed to track progress and measure success.

**Education And Experience Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in any related field.
* Minimum of 6 years of experience in healthcare revenue cycle management, with a focus on accounts receivable.

**Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities**

* Previous leadership experience, preferably in a healthcare setting.
* In-depth knowledge of medical billing processes, reimbursement methodologies, and regulatory requirements.
* Strong understanding of healthcare payer policies and claims adjudication processes.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively lead and motivate a team.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a focus on driving results and achieving objectives.
* Proficiency in healthcare revenue cycle management software and systems.
* Certified Professional Coder (CPC) or Certified Revenue Cycle Representative (CRCR) certification is a plus.
* Willingness to stay updated on industry trends and best practices through continuing education and professional development opportunities.

FACE Prep is one of India’s largest placement-focused skill development companies, specializing in job preparation for the tech sector. Since 2008, the organization has supported millions of students in launching their careers through structured training and guidance. FACE Prep offers a range of programs, including masterclasses, self-paced preparation modules, workshops, and bootcamps that build job-ready skills. Its alumni work across leading global technology companies such as Google, Microsoft, Meta, Adobe, PayPal, Amazon, and major IT services firms, demonstrating the impact and reach of its training ecosystem.

**Role Description**

The Admission Counsellor will support prospective learners through the entire admissions journey, from initial inquiry to enrollment in FACE Prep programs. This full-time, on-site role is based in Coimbatore and involves guiding students and families by explaining program offerings, eligibility, curriculum, and outcomes. * Candidates should possess strong Communication and Interpersonal Communication skills to engage effectively with students, families, and internal teams.
* Candidates should possess Customer Service skills to respond to inquiries promptly, handle concerns professionally, and provide a positive admissions experience.
* Candidates should possess Sales skills to convert leads into enrollments through ethical, consultative counseling and clear explanation of program value.
* Candidates should possess an understanding of Education-related processes, particularly in career preparation, training programs, or higher education counseling.

* Ability to work on-site in Coimbatore, manage multiple inquiries, use CRM or admissions software, and meet enrollment targets in a structured environment.
* Fluency in English and local languages, strong listening skills, and a learner-centric mindset to support diverse backgrounds and aspirations.

title: Admissions Lead
description:

The Admissions Lead will oversee student recruiting campaigns, conduct information sessions, and follow up with prospective learners to improve conversion rates. Daily tasks include maintaining accurate applicant records, preparing reports on admissions performance, ensuring a positive experience for applicants and families, and collaborating with marketing and academic departments to align outreach with program objectives.

Admission Sales Lead

Admissions / Student Recruitment

Higher Education / Education / EdTech

5–8 Years

Coimbatore (Onsite)

* Manage the complete admissions sales cycle, including lead qualification, counselling, follow-ups, application conversion, and enrolment.
* Develop effective sales strategies to improve lead-to-admission conversion rates.
* Handle prospective student enquiries through inbound and outbound calls, emails, and other communication channels.

* Maintain accurate records of student interactions, follow-ups, and enrolment status.

• Assist with configuring and testing single sign-on (SSO) and multi-factor authentication (MFA) for applications, guided by senior engineers.
  
  
• Handle access requests and approvals, and support periodic access reviews by gathering, reconciling and documenting the results.
  
  
• Work with directory services such as Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID to manage users, groups and roles under the principle of least privilege.
  
  
• Support privileged access tasks, such as onboarding privileged accounts and checking vault and session records.
  
  
• Troubleshoot access issues, including login failures, MFA problems and account lockouts, and keep tickets complete and up to date.
  
  
• Prepare documentation, runbooks and access reports that serve as audit and compliance evidence.
  
  
• Learn how automation and AI-assisted tools are used to speed up identity governance and access reviews.
  
  
𝗥𝗲𝗾𝘂𝗶𝗿𝗲𝗱 𝗦𝗸𝗶𝗹𝗹𝘀 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗤𝘂𝗮𝗹𝗶𝗳𝗶𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝘀
  
  
• Completed or pursuing a B.E., B.Tech, B.Sc, M.Sc or equivalent degree, 2026 or 2027 pass-out. Cyber Security specialization preferred.
  
  
• Understanding of IAM fundamentals: authentication vs authorization, SSO, MFA, role-based access control (RBAC), least privilege and the identity lifecycle.
  
  
• Working knowledge of Windows, Linux and networking fundamentals, and familiarity with Active Directory or LDAP.
  
  
• Basic understanding of authentication standards such as SAML, OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect.
  
  
• Demonstrated hands-on practice in cyber security and identity through labs, a home lab (for example an Active Directory or Keycloak setup, or a free Microsoft Entra ID or Okta tenant), or projects.
  
  
• Hands-on exposure to an identity platform such as Okta, Microsoft Entra ID or Active Directory.
  
  
• Entry-level certifications or courses, such as Microsoft SC-900, CompTIA Security+ or the Google Cybersecurity Certificate.
  
  
• Basic scripting in Python or PowerShell.
  
  
• Analytical mindset, curiosity and clear written communication.
  
  
• Excellent communication and presentation skills, both written and verbal.
  
  
• Able to work full-time on-site for the full 3-month internship.
  
  
𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗬𝗼𝘂 𝗪𝗶𝗹𝗹 𝗚𝗮𝗶𝗻

• Exposure to enterprise identity practices such as SSO, MFA, lifecycle automation, access governance and privileged access management.
  
  
• A certificate of internship on completion.
  
  
• Strong performers may be considered for full-time opportunities, subject to performance and open roles.

Moving Tech Innovations is a SaaS/MaaS mobility platform that connects drivers and riders through simple, people-first technology. Its family of apps includes Namma Yatri (Karnataka & Tamil Nadu), Yatri Sathi (West Bengal), Odisha Yatri (Odisha), Kerala Savari (Kerala) and MeghGo (Meghalaya). Together we are changing urban mobility across India with utility-based pricing and a zero-commission model.

The platform is built on open networks like ONDC and works through partnerships across Samaaj (society), Sarkar (government) and Bazaar (business) to make mobility accessible to everyone. It is now growing beyond autos into a full multi-modal network of buses, metro, autos and cabs, so commuters get one seamless, affordable and connected way to travel.

With 2 lakh+ daily rides and growing interest from around the world, Namma Yatri is redefining community-driven mobility, one ride at a time.

Moving Tech is also the technology partner for Bharat Taxi, which aims to be the Amul for Mobility. Bharat Taxi is a people-first, cooperative-based taxi initiative backed by the Ministry of Cooperation, Government of India. It brings drivers together on a common platform where they earn fairly while giving riders safe, affordable and dignified travel built on trust and transparency.

● Solve operational bottlenecks with speed and ownership

**What We’re Looking For**

● Strong problem solving and structured thinking

● 4–6 years of experience in growth, operations, product, program management or consulting

● Comfort with data - dashboards, metrics, decision-making from numbers

● Experience in product, program management, consulting, account management

● Experience working with tech and engineering teams

title: India Collections / Recovery Manager
description:
We are looking for an experienced and commercially driven India Collections / Operations Manager to lead the establishment, expansion and growth of our India Collections business.

The ideal candidate should have a strong background in business development, sales, marketing and collections management, preferably within a debt collection agency, bank, NBFC, telecom company or financial services organisation.

The primary responsibility of this role will be to identify and secure new collection business opportunities by leveraging established industry networks and relationships with banks, NBFCs, telecom companies, fintechs and other financial institutions.

In addition to business development, the candidate will be responsible for building, managing and scaling the India Collections operations, covering both telecalling and field collection capabilities.

This role requires a combination of strong industry connections, business acquisition capabilities, collections expertise and operational leadership.

Key Responsibilities

1. Business Development, Sales & Client Acquisition

• Identify, develop and secure new collection business opportunities from banks, NBFCs, telecom companies, fintechs and other financial institutions.

• Leverage existing industry networks and professional relationships to generate qualified business leads.

• Establish relationships with key decision-makers, including collection heads, recovery managers, procurement teams and senior management.

• Develop and execute business development and marketing strategies to expand the company's collections portfolio.

• Present the company's services, prepare business proposals and participate in client meetings and commercial negotiations.

• Convert prospective clients into long-term business relationships and contribute directly to revenue growth.

• Identify opportunities to expand existing client relationships and introduce additional collection services.

2. Collections Operations Management

• Establish and manage end-to-end collections operations covering telecalling and field collections.

• Develop collection strategies, workflows, operational processes, performance metrics and quality standards.

• Recruit, train and manage telecalling teams, collection agents, team leaders and field executives.

• Build and manage a scalable network of field collection resources across multiple geographies.

• Drive collection performance and ensure achievement of client and business targets.

• Monitor portfolio performance, recovery rates, productivity and operational efficiency.

• Implement best practices and continuous process improvements across collection activities.

3. Client & Stakeholder Management

• Develop and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective clients.

• Ensure high service delivery standards and client satisfaction.

• Understand client requirements and develop suitable collection strategies.

• Coordinate with internal management and operational teams to ensure effective service delivery.

• Participate in client reviews, business discussions and performance meetings.

4. Process, Technology & Compliance

• Implement effective collection systems, reporting frameworks and operational controls.

• Work with technology and management teams to identify automation opportunities and improve operational efficiency.

• Ensure adherence to applicable regulatory guidelines, client requirements, company policies and ethical collection practices.

• Monitor operational risks and maintain appropriate quality and compliance standards.

Requirements & Qualifications

• 5–10 years of relevant experience in collections, business development, sales, marketing or financial services.

• Proven experience in acquiring new clients or generating business within the collections or financial services industry.

• Strong professional network and established relationships with banks, NBFCs, telecom companies, fintechs or collection agencies.

• Experience in debt collection, recovery services, outsourcing or BPO environments will be highly preferred.

• Understanding of retail lending, unsecured lending, vehicle finance, credit cards and other collection portfolios.

• Experience in establishing, managing or scaling collection teams and operational processes.

• Strong business development, negotiation, presentation and relationship management skills.

• Excellent leadership, communication and stakeholder management abilities.

• Ability to independently identify business opportunities and convert them into commercial engagements.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

• Acquisition of new collection clients and business contracts.

• Value of new business generated and revenue growth.

• Development of strategic relationships with banks, NBFCs and other financial institutions.

• Achievement of collection and recovery targets.

• Operational productivity and team performance.

• Client satisfaction and service delivery standards.

• Effective establishment and expansion of collections operations.

About the Opportunity

This is a key leadership opportunity for an ambitious professional who can combine industry relationships, business development capabilities and collections expertise to establish and grow Charter's India Collections business.

The successful candidate will have significant responsibility for developing new client relationships, securing business opportunities, building operational capabilities and driving the long-term growth of the collections division.

How to Apply

Interested candidates may send their updated CV to:

careers@chartermerc.com.au

About Charter

Charter is a financial services company based in Kochi, India, providing solutions to clients across Australia, the United Kingdom, New Zealand, India and the United States. We are committed to delivering exceptional client service while fostering a positive, collaborative and growth-oriented workplace for our employees.

title: Senior Visa Case Officer
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Senior Visa Case Officer – Australian Migration**

**Company**
: YESTE Migration & Education Consulting International Company

**Job Location**
: Kochi, Kerala

**Salary**
: ₹35,000 – ₹55,000 per month

**Experience**
: 3–6 Years

About the Role

**YESTE**
is looking for an experienced Senior Visa Case Officer to manage end-to-end Australian visa application processes, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely processing. The ideal candidate should have strong technical knowledge of Australian immigration procedures, visa subclasses, documentation requirements, and application assessment.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Manage end-to-end Australian visa application processes, from initial profile assessment to application lodgement and post-lodgement follow-ups.

2. Assess client eligibility and identify suitable Australian visa pathways.

3. Handle visa applications across the following subclasses:

Skilled Migration

\* Subclass 189 – Skilled Independent Visa

\* Subclass 190 – Skilled Nominated Visa

\* Subclass 491 – Skilled Work Regional (Provisional) Visa

\* Subclass 191 – Permanent Residence (Skilled Regional) Visa

Employer-Sponsored Migration

\* Subclass 482 – Skills in Demand Visa

\* Subclass 186 – Employer Nomination Scheme Visa

\* Subclass 494 – Skilled Employer Sponsored Regional (Provisional) Visa

Partner & Family Migration

\* Subclass 309/100 – Partner Visa

\* Subclass 820/801 – Partner Visa

\* Subclass 300 – Prospective Marriage Visa

Temporary & Other Visa Categories

\* Subclass 600 – Visitor Visa

\* Subclass 500 – Student Visa

\* Subclass 485 – Temporary Graduate Visa

\* Subclass 408 – Temporary Activity Visa

4. Prepare, review, and verify visa applications and supporting documentation in accordance with Australian immigration requirements.

5. Coordinate skills assessments through relevant assessing authorities, including ACS, Engineers Australia, VETASSESS, and ANMAC.

6. Handle Expression of Interest (EOI), SkillSelect, state nomination, and employer sponsorship processes.

7. Monitor changes in Australian immigration policies, visa requirements, and Department of Home Affairs procedures.

8. Identify documentation gaps, eligibility concerns, and potential compliance risks.

9. Liaise with clients, migration consultants, employers, and relevant stakeholders throughout the application process.

10. Monitor application progress, manage deadlines, and coordinate responses to requests from the Department of Home Affairs.

11. Maintain accurate case records and ensure proper documentation through CRM or case management systems.

12. Conduct quality checks and provide technical guidance and mentoring to junior case officers.

**Skills & Qualifications**

\* Bachelor’s degree in any discipline; relevant migration or immigration qualifications are an advantage.

\* 3–6 years of hands-on experience in Australian visa processing or migration case management.

\* Strong working knowledge of Australian visa subclasses, particularly 189, 190, 491, 482, and 186.

\* Practical experience in skilled migration, employer-sponsored migration, and visa documentation.

\* Knowledge of Australian immigration legislation, DHA procedures, and compliance requirements.

\* Strong analytical, documentation, communication, and case-management skills.

\* Ability to independently manage multiple cases and meet application deadlines.

\* High attention to detail, confidentiality, and professional ethics.

**Key Performance Expectations**

\* Accuracy and quality of visa applications.

\* Timely case processing and application lodgement.

\* Compliance with Australian immigration requirements.

\* Effective client coordination and case management.

\* Technical knowledge and continuous learning.

\* Mentoring and supporting junior team members.

**What We Offer**

\* Competitive salary: ₹35,000 – ₹55,000 per month.

\* Opportunity to work with an international migration and education consulting organisation.

\* Professional growth and exposure to Australian migration operations.

\* Collaborative and performance-driven work environment.

Build your career with YESTE – Delivering Excellence in International Migration Services.

title: Customer Support Executive (Malayalam Speaking)
description:
ELLOMIND | Kochi, Kerala | Full-time | On-site

**About the role**

ELLOMIND offers online therapy with Malayalam-speaking psychologists. We are looking for a kind and organised person to be the first point of contact for our clients. You will talk to people who are looking for mental health support, help them book sessions, and make sure nothing is missed.

**What you will do every day**

* Reply to client messages and calls on WhatsApp and phone, in Malayalam and English
* Understand what the client needs and help them book a session with the right psychologist
* Talk to new enquiries, answer their doubts and help them take the first step to book
* Follow up with people who enquired but have not booked
* Reschedule or cancel sessions when a client or psychologist asks
* Send session reminders and check that both the client and psychologist are ready
* Follow up on pending payments after sessions
* Check in with clients after their session and note any feedback or concerns
* Update every enquiry, booking and follow-up in the CRM
* Share a short daily update on enquiries, bookings, reschedules and pending follow-ups

**Also part of the job**

* Keep all client information private
* Work closely with the psychologists and the operations team
* Tell your manager straight away about urgent issues or unhappy clients
* Suggest ways to make the client experience better
* Help with other support and coordination work when the team needs it

**What we are looking for**

* Fluent Malayalam and good English, spoken and written
* Experience in customer support, or in client or patient coordination at a hospital, clinic or similar service
* Hands-on experience with a CRM or similar tools for tracking leads and follow-ups
* A knack for sales: you can understand what a person needs, build trust and help them decide, without being pushy
* Patient, polite and calm with people who may be going through a hard time
* Organised, reliable and good at follow-up
* Comfortable with WhatsApp, Google Sheets and basic computer work

**Good to have**

* A degree in psychology
* Experience in sales or tele-calling in healthcare, wellness or education

**How to apply**

Apply through LinkedIn or send your resume to team@ellomind.com.
