title: Business Analyst
description:
**Job Title: Business Analyst**

**Location: Kochi, India (Hybrid)**

**Permanent - Full Time**

**About Us**

Cyncly is a global technology powerhouse with 2,400+ employees and 70,000+ customers across 100+ countries. Cyncly transforms the way customizable products and spaces are imagined, designed, sold, managed and made. Our end-to-end software solutions connect professional designers, retailers and manufacturers to the world's largest repository of product content. Today, our business spans across the Kitchen & Bath, Furniture, Window, Glass & Door, and Flooring industries with operations in North & South America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Africa.

Cyncly brings over 30 years of experience to deliver more value for our customers through an expanded portfolio of end-to-end solutions. Our global presence allows us to provide world-class support and sales with a local touch, providing the best possible customer experience.

Cyncly is now embarking on an exciting journey as we continue to expand through strong organic growth and complementary acquisitions, backed by leading growth private equity firms specializing in technology.

***Availability between 7:00 PM to 4:00 PM IST is required to support collaboration with our global teams.***

**About the Role**

We are hiring a Business Analyst in Kochi to turn the needs of window, door and glass manufacturers into clear, buildable requirements for the Soft Tech product in Cyncly's Windows, Doors & Glass (WDG) business unit. You will work in an async-first, distributed Agile team spanning New Zealand and India, and act as the bridge between product stakeholders and the engineering team.

**Key Position Responsibilities Include:**

* The analyst owns the path from a customer or product need to a requirement the engineering team can estimate, build and test.
* Elicit and document requirements for WDG workflows such as quoting and estimating, order entry, bills of materials, cut lists, production scheduling and glass optimization.
* Write user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows and business rules in the backlog, in a form developers and QA can use without a follow-up call.
* Work with the New Zealand Product Manager and Product Owner to refine and prioritize the backlog and bring back clear scope and trade-offs.
* Participate in backlog refinement, sprint planning and other Agile ceremonies, and run requirement walkthroughs with developers and QA across both locations, closing open questions within the working day where possible.
* Support QA by reviewing test cases, preparing UAT scenarios and checking that delivered features match the agreed behavior.
* Analyze customer-reported issues and change requests, and separate defects, gaps and genuine enhancements.
* Document how existing V6 functionality and integrations behave, including REST API and JSON payload interactions, so that behavior is captured accurately.
* Prepare release notes for delivered features and changes.
* Keep requirement documents, decision logs and domain glossaries current so knowledge does not sit with one person.
* Help new India team members, including freshers, learn the WDG domain and the product.

**Required Experience and Qualifications:**

* Candidates need 4–6 years of business analysis in enterprise or manufacturing software, with a track record of writing requirements that developers could build from directly.
* Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, business or a related field.
* Strong requirements practice user stories, acceptance criteria, use cases, process modelling (UML/BPMN) and traceability.
* Good understanding of Agile/Scrum and the software development lifecycle.
* Hands-on experience with Azure DevOps for backlog management.
* Ability to work through a large legacy application, read its behavior and business rules, and document them accurately.
* Working knowledge of SQL to inspect data and validate behavior.
* Understanding of REST APIs, integrations and JSON payloads.
* Comfort with an async-first way of working across a ~6.5-hour time gap with New Zealand: written clarity, concise updates and well-prepared handovers.
* Excellent written and spoken English, as most stakeholder communication is with New Zealand colleagues.
* Ability to challenge unclear scope politely, propose practical solutions and escalate risks early.

**Good to Have:**

* Experience in the fenestration or building-products industry is the strongest differentiator, though we will consider strong analysts from adjacent manufacturing domains.
* Exposure to window, door, glass, aluminum, uPVC or timber fabrication, including how products are configured, priced, cut and assembled.
* Understanding of the value chain from manufacturer to dealer, installer and builder, and of quote-to-order-to-production flows.
* Familiarity with configurators, estimating or CPQ tools, optimization (cutting, nesting) or shop-floor and ERP integrations.
* Experience working with distributed teams in New Zealand, Australia, the UK or the US.
* Experience in software product companies or enterprise application development.
* Certification such as CBAP, PMI-PBA or CSPO is a plus, not a requirement.

**Working for Us**

At Cyncly, we call our team OneCyncly, a reflection of how we work together as one, united by our purpose: powering businesses that bring spaces to life. Our strength comes from our diversity of experiences, perspectives, and skills - and we thrive when we work together with openness, trust, and respect.

Here, you’ll join a group of colleagues who take ownership, solve problems, and focus on making an impact. We embrace curiosity, welcome new ideas, and see mistakes as opportunities to learn. You’ll have the freedom to work flexibly and autonomously, supported by teammates and leaders who are committed to your growth.

We celebrate the different ways people contribute and encourage everyone - from every background - to bring their authentic self to work. Because when we collaborate, challenge each other, and share what we know, we build something better together.

If you want to work in a place where your ideas matter, your growth is valued, and your work shapes the spaces people live, work, and play in - Come join us.

**About The Role**
We are looking for an Senior Analytics Engineer to build and maintain the data pipelines, metrics, dashboards, and reports that measure the impact of our DevSecOps transformation program on the developer community.

You will deliver rapid reporting prototypes, develop maintained reporting solutions, and serve as the curator of our metric definitions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

Convert CSV and JSON extracts into usable reporting, validate initial findings, and refine requirements with stakeholders. Develop prototypes into maintained solutions where needed.
* Discover and understand data sources. Identify the systems, APIs, tables, and extracts needed to answer reporting questions. Understand how source data is generated, what it represents, and the limitations that affect its use.
* Build and coordinate data pipelines. Use Python, SQL, and appropriate platform capabilities to extract, transform, and load reporting data. Partner with Databricks and other data engineering teams when they own upstream pipelines, and help resolve data access, integration, and refresh issues.

* Evaluate AI adoption and outcomes. Report on access, engagement, and usage of AI development tools. Use appropriate baseline, trend, and group comparisons to assess relationships between adoption and development outcomes.
* Own and curate metric definitions. Maintain a shared metric dictionary covering each measure’s purpose, calculation, data sources, reporting population, time periods, exclusions, assumptions, and limitations. Coordinate agreement on definitions and manage changes to preserve consistency.
* Explain and interpret the metrics. Serve as the point of reference for what each metric means, how it is calculated, and how it should be used. Investigate questions about reported figures and explain findings clearly to technical and business audiences.
* Maintain reporting reliability. Validate accuracy, completeness, and freshness; investigate discrepancies; troubleshoot failed pipelines and report refreshes; maintain appropriate access controls; and document how reported measures trace back to their sources.

**Required Skills And Experience**

* Power BI: Practical experience building and maintaining dashboards, reports, and data models, including DAX, Power Query, scheduled refreshes, and row level security.
* SQL: Strong ability to write, troubleshoot, and optimize queries involving complex joins, aggregations, window functions, and time based calculations.
* Databricks: Experience querying and preparing data, working with Unity Catalog catalogs, schemas, tables, and views, and collaborating with teams responsible for data access and pipelines.
* Python: Practical experience extracting, cleaning, transforming, and validating data, integrating with APIs, and automating recurring data processes.
* Data integration and modeling: Experience building or maintaining ETL/ELT processes, combining data from multiple systems, and working with API authentication, CSV files, and JSON data.
* Excel: Proficiency in importing and transforming extracts, preparing and reconciling data, and building prototype analyses and reports using Power Query, formulas, and pivot tables.
* Software development lifecycle: Intermediate understanding of Git version control, commits, branching, pull requests, merge requests, code review, testing, CI/CD pipelines, and production deployments. Ability to connect these workflows to the data used to measure them.
* Analytical judgment: Ability to define meaningful measures, validate assumptions, distinguish activity and adoption from outcomes, and explain what the available evidence supports.
* Responsiveness and ownership: Ability to work with incomplete or evolving requirements, deliver useful initial analyses quickly, apply appropriate validation, and carry reporting work through delivery and ongoing maintenance.
* Communication and collaboration: Ability to translate stakeholder questions into data requirements, coordinate across teams, document definitions and decisions, and explain calculations and findings clearly.

* Experience measuring developer productivity, DevSecOps transformation, software delivery performance, or technology adoption.
* Experience working with Excel, CSV, and other supplemental reporting inputs stored in SharePoint.
* Experience using AI coding assistants such as Codex to accelerate data manipulation, Python and SQL development, analysis, and reporting automation, with the ability to review and validate generated code and outputs.

Stakeholders receive timely, useful reporting supported by dependable data processes and clearly defined metrics. Emerging questions can be answered quickly through validated prototypes, and recurring needs become maintained reporting solutions. Reported figures can be traced to their sources, definitions are consistently understood, and insights help teams make informed decisions about the DevSecOps transformation program.

title: Senior Business Analyst (Accounting and Compliance Domain)
description:
**About Opalus and OPAL**

Opalus Enterprise Systems Private Limited is building OPAL, an AI-powered business operating platform for small and medium-sized businesses. OPAL places accounting at its core and connects finance, banking, customers, people, recruitment, projects, documents, workflow and reporting in one secure operating environment. A permissioned AI layer across the connected business record helps users understand their information, prepare work and take controlled action, with approvals and audit trails throughout.

A high-fidelity working prototype is complete. We are now building the production platform for an initial Australian release, and establishing our software development office and multidisciplinary product team in Kochi, Kerala.

**The opportunity**

This is not a general business analysis role, and it is worth being direct about that before you read further.

OPAL is an accounting product. Every feature in it, whether that is an invoice, a bank reconciliation, a payroll run or an AI-generated suggestion, ends its life as entries in a general ledger that has to balance, keep its history and stand up to an audit. This role owns the accounting meaning of the product: what each business event does to the ledger, which accounts it touches, when it posts, what it must never be allowed to do, and how we prove afterwards that it was right.

We are looking for someone whose accounting is genuinely solid, not someone who has worked near accountants. If you can take a trial balance that does not balance and work out why, read a set of financial statements and tell us what the ledger must have done to produce them, and explain without hesitating when a correction should be a reversal and when it should be an adjustment, this role will suit you.

You will also need to understand what OPAL is trying to be and help bring it into existence. The product is being built from the accounting core outwards, and the person in this role has a real say in how it behaves.

**What you will do**

* Define the accounting behaviour of each module: the journal that each business event produces, the accounts it touches, its timing, and its effect on the subledgers and the general ledger.
* Specify the rules that the posting path must enforce before anything reaches the ledger: balanced entries, valid accounts, open periods, correct tax treatment, complete source references, and what happens to anything that fails those rules.
* Set out how posted records are corrected, when a reversal is the right instrument and when an adjustment is, and what evidence each one must leave behind.
* Specify the chart of accounts: account types and roles, linked and system accounts, protected accounts, and how the structure supports reporting and consolidation.
* Define reconciliation between the subledgers and the general ledger for receivables, payables, bank and tax, including the control accounts that must always agree.
* Translate Australian tax obligations into product behaviour: GST on sales and purchases, tax codes and rates, cash and accruals bases, activity statement preparation, PAYG and superannuation.
* Define period control: financial year, opening balances, lock dates and year-end, and where each of those must be enforced rather than merely displayed.
* Write the financial reporting requirements: profit and loss, balance sheet, trial balance, ledger detail, ageing and tax reports, each with drill-down to the source transaction.
* Define audit trail, approval, control and segregation-of-duties requirements, and the evidence each produces.
* Specify migration and opening balances from incumbent SME accounting products, so that a client's books carry across and reconcile.
* Turn all of the above into precise, testable specifications with acceptance criteria that an engineer can build from and a tester can prove.
* Support test design, user acceptance testing, defect triage and release validation, including judging whether a defect is an accounting error or a cosmetic one.
* Work directly with product, engineering, quality assurance and the architecture team, and carry an idea from a conversation through specification to a working feature.

**What you bring**

**Accounting depth**

* A professional accounting qualification such as CA, CMA, ACCA or CPA, or a degree in accounting or commerce with equivalent practical depth.
* Confident command of double-entry accounting: journals, the general ledger, the chart of accounts, the trial balance, and how the financial statements derive from them.
* Practical understanding of the subledgers and how they reconcile to the general ledger: receivables, payables, bank and tax, and the control accounts that tie them together.
* Understanding of the accruals and cash bases, accruals and prepayments, period close, opening balances and year-end.
* Understanding of why posted accounting records must be immutable, and how corrections are made properly rather than by editing history.

**Product and systems**

* At least six years in business analysis for accounting systems, ERP, payroll, banking or fintech, or equivalent time as a practising accountant working closely on system implementations.
* Hands-on experience with SME accounting platforms such as Xero, MYOB, QuickBooks Online or Reckon, and a considered view of what they do well and where they fall short.
* Experience specifying how transactions post, not only how screens look.
* Experience with bank feeds, statement import, matching and reconciliation.
* Experience defining requirements for application programming interfaces, data flows and third-party integrations.
* The ability to write a specification precise enough to be testable, covering business rules, exceptions, controls and acceptance criteria.

**Tax**

* Working knowledge of a goods and services tax or value added tax regime, including tax codes, when tax is recognised, and the difference between calculating tax on a transaction and reporting it for a period.
* Australian GST, activity statement, PAYG and superannuation knowledge, or demonstrable ability to learn a new jurisdiction quickly and accurately.

**Ways of working**

* In-depth experience working day to day with a product team, backend and frontend engineers, QA engineers and a solution architect, from the design stage of a product through build, testing and release. This role sits inside the delivery team rather than handing specifications across to it.
* Experience holding traceability from a requirement through to its implementation, its test coverage and its verification, so that what was asked for can be shown to be what was built and proved.
* Experience of agile delivery, sprint ceremonies and working to a release cadence.
* Experience preparing business requirement documents (BRD) and functional specification documents (FSD), breaking them into epics and user stories with acceptance criteria under Agile Scrum, and working from interface designs in Figma.
* Strong written English and the ability to document and facilitate with finance, compliance, product and engineering stakeholders.
* Eligible to work in India.
* Based in Kochi, or willing to relocate to Kochi.
* Available for occasional overlap with Australian business hours.
* Available for occasional extended hours during key delivery periods such as user acceptance testing, major releases or compliance milestones.

**Desirable**

* Direct experience of the Australian SME accounting or payroll ecosystem.
* Payroll domain experience: calculations, employee records, statutory reporting, and posting payroll results to the ledger.
* Multi-entity accounting, intercompany transactions and consolidation.
* Fixed assets and depreciation, multi-currency, or inventory costing.
* Process modelling using BPMN or a comparable technique.
* Experience on a software product rather than only on client implementations.

**How we will assess**

* Our assessment is practical, so that the conversation is about your reasoning rather than your CV.
* A short written exercise on journals and ledger behaviour.
* A discussion of a realistic accounting scenario, where we are interested in how you arrive at the answer.
* A conversation about how you would specify one OPAL feature from business event through to posted entry and report.

**Location requirement**

title: Application Security Engineer
description:
We are looking for a hands-on Senior Application Security Engineer to build and lead security testing at Mozilor. You will test our web application, APIs, the cookie banner script that runs on customers' websites, our WordPress plugins and mobile SDKs, find weaknesses before attackers do, and work with developers to fix them.

This is a new, two-person team. You will be its senior member: you decide how we test, automate what can be automated, and mentor a colleague who is growing into security.

You will also be the main point of contact for security practices across Mozilor: incident coordination, vulnerability tracking, risk assessments, and support for ISO 27001, SOC 2 and customer security reviews. The role is technical first. Expect roughly 80% hands-on testing and automation and 20% security practices and compliance support.

You will report to the Head of Engineering.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Plan and carry out security testing of our web application, APIs, the customer-facing banner script, WordPress plugins and mobile SDKs, with a focus on login, user permissions and separation of customer data.
* Assess and protect the code we deliver to customers' websites, including how it is built, published and served, so that it cannot be tampered with.
* Build and maintain automated security checks in our build and release pipeline, and tune them so developers get useful results rather than noise.
* Write clear, reproducible findings with realistic severity and a concrete fix, pair with developers on remediation, and verify that fixes work.
* Run lightweight threat reviews of new features with the product teams, and turn them into test cases.
* Scope and coordinate the annual external penetration test, triage any third-party reports, and verify the findings.
* Mentor the second team member and help build a security mindset across the development teams.
* Act as the point of contact for security practices across Mozilor: coordinate security incidents, track vulnerabilities to closure, run periodic risk assessments, and report key security risks to leadership.
* Support ISO 27001, SOC 2 and customer or vendor security reviews with technical evidence and answers, working with Engineering, Operations and external partners.

**Requirements:**

* 3+ years in security, with meaningful hands-on experience personally testing web applications and APIs, not only managing or auditing.
* Strong grasp of web and API security: authentication and session handling, access control and authorisation flaws, server-side request forgery, injection, and business-logic abuse. Familiar with OWASP Top 10, ASVS and the Web Security Testing Guide.
* Solid understanding of client-side and JavaScript security: DOM-based attacks, content security policy, subresource integrity, and the risks of scripts embedded on third-party sites.
* Working knowledge of software supply-chain security: dependency scanning, build-pipeline trust, secrets handling and artifact integrity.
* Can write code. Comfortable scripting in Python or JavaScript, building small tools, and integrating security scanners into CI.
* Clear written communication. Reports that a developer can reproduce and fix, and summaries a non-technical manager can act on.
* Collaborative working style. Pairs with engineers rather than handing over reports, and prioritises by real risk.
* Integrity. Handles customer data and unfixed weaknesses carefully, and has only tested systems with proper authorisation.
* Familiar with ISO 27001 and SOC 2 controls, and comfortable answering customer security questionnaires.

**Good to Have:**

* Public evidence of skill: bug bounty findings, published write-ups, open-source tools, conference or meetup talks, or recorded CVEs.
* Hands-on certifications, or equivalent demonstrable skill (preferred, not required): OSWE, Burp Suite Certified Practitioner (BSCP), CREST CCT APP or OSCP.
* Experience testing mobile apps (OWASP MASVS) or WordPress plugins.
* Basic familiarity with cloud services.
* AWS Certified Security – Specialty.
* Experience setting up a security practice or tooling from scratch.
* Awareness of privacy regulations such as GDPR.

+ Security posture evaluations across SCADA, DCS, PLC, HMI, and ICS environments

* Perform OT-focused vulnerability assessments and exposure analysis in coordination with engineering and operations teams.
* Implement and operationalize OT monitoring solutions including:

+ Dragos Platform
+ Nozomi Networks Guardian / Vantage

* Design and validate OT detection and response capabilities, leveraging network traffic analysis, anomaly detection, and threat intelligence.
* Conduct industrial threat modeling and risk quantification aligned to operational impact, safety, and business continuity considerations.
* Develop OT cybersecurity roadmaps and transformation programs, aligned with frameworks such as:

+ IEC 62443
+ NIST SP 800-82
+ NCA (KSA) / regional regulatory frameworks

* Support implementation of:

+ OT network segmentation (zones & conduits)
+ Secure remote access for vendors and operators
+ OT-specific incident response and crisis management playbooks

**Sector-Specific Advisory**

* Apply deep understanding of industrial processes and control systems across:

+ Energy and Power Generation
+ Oil & Gas (Upstream, Midstream, Downstream)
+ Utilities (Water, Electricity Distribution, Smart Grids)
+ Smart Cities and Critical Infrastructure ecosystems

* Align OT security recommendations with operational priorities such as safety, availability, reliability, and regulatory compliance.
* Bridge the gap between engineering, operations, and IT/security teams, ensuring practical and implementable solutions.

**Stakeholder Engagement & Advisory**

* Act as a trusted advisor to CISOs, Plant Managers, OT Engineers, and Executive Leadership.
* Translate complex technical issues into business, safety, and operational risk impacts.
* Deliver executive-level briefings and technical deep-dives, tailored to diverse stakeholder groups.
* Facilitate workshops, tabletop exercises, and scenario-based discussions for OT cyber resilience.

**Practice & Capability Development**

* Contribute to the growth of the OT Cybersecurity practice, including:

+ Development of methodologies, playbooks, and accelerators
+ Standardization of OT assessment frameworks and delivery artifacts

* Support business development activities, including:

+ RFP/RFI responses
+ Client presentations and solution articulation
+ Thought leadership in OT cybersecurity and industrial resilience

* Stay current with:

+ Emerging OT threats and attack campaigns
+ ICS vulnerabilities and adversary tactics
+ Evolving regulatory requirements across the MENA region

**People Leadership & Team Development**

* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of OT security consultants and specialists.
* Build cross-functional capability across OT, IT, and cyber domains.
* Drive a culture of technical excellence, safety awareness, and delivery quality.
* Provide structured feedback, coaching, and career development aligned to firm objectives.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong understanding of OT/ICS cybersecurity principles, including security challenges unique to industrial environments.
* Hands-on experience with OT security platforms, especially:

+ Dragos
+ Nozomi Networks

* Deep knowledge of:

+ Industrial communication protocols (Modbus, DNP3, OPC-UA, PROFINET, IEC 61850)
+ OT asset visibility, anomaly detection, and network monitoring
+ Experience in installation, commissioning, FAT, and SAT of ICS systems like DCS, PLC, SCADA, and Network Devices in ICS Security related Projects.

* Proven capability in conducting OT risk assessments, including:

+ Threat modeling
+ Risk quantification
+ Control gap analysis

* Strong understanding of industrial processes and operational workflows across Energy, Oil & Gas, Utilities, or Smart City environments.
* Familiarity with IT/OT convergence risks, segmentation strategies, and secure architecture design.
* Ability to communicate complex technical findings in a clear, business-impact context.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience in managing large, multi-stream client engagements.

**To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Cyber Security, Engineering (Electrical/Instrumentation/Industrial), Information Technology, or related discipline.
* 10–15 years of experience, with at least 5–7 years in OT/ICS cybersecurity.
* Proven hands-on experience with:

+ OT security assessments and architecture reviews
+ Deployment or use of Dragos and/or Nozomi platforms
+ OT risk and maturity assessments

* Experience working with clients in Energy, Oil & Gas, Utilities, or Smart Infrastructure sectors.
* Strong consulting, stakeholder management, and communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple engagements and deliver high-quality outcomes.
* Willingness to travel across the MENA region, as required.

**Ideally, You’ll Also Have**

* Certifications such as:

+ GICSP (Global Industrial Cyber Security Professional)
+ ISA/IEC 62443 certifications
+ SANS ICS (GRID, ICS410, ICS515)
+ CISSP / CISM (added advantage)

* Experience in:

+ OT incident response and forensic investigations
+ Industrial SOC / OT SOC design and implementation
+ Smart City cybersecurity architecture
+ Integration of OT with enterprise security tools (SIEM, SOAR, XDR)

* Exposure to leading OT vendors such as:

+ Claroty, Dragos, Nozomi, Tenable.ot, Forescout etc.

**What We Look For**
We seek individuals who:
  
  

* Have a growth mindset and bring a strong blend of OT domain knowledge and cybersecurity expertise
* Can operate effectively across engineering, operations, and cybersecurity stakeholders
* Demonstrate client-centricity, problem-solving, and solution-driven thinking
* Are passionate about securing critical infrastructure and industrial ecosystems
* Contribute to practice growth, innovation, and team development
* The ability to balance deep technical expertise with business acumen
* A collaborative approach to problem-solving and innovation
* A commitment to quality, integrity, and continuous improvement

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 10+ years in integration architecture with 4+ years hands-on on Boomi AtomSphere.
* Proven delivery of complex, multi-system integrations in retail domain.
* Deep knowledge of integration patterns (EIP), API lifecycle, microservices, and event-driven design.

* Create canonical data models and mapping standards; drive reuse via common connectors, templates, and accelerators.

title: TC-CS-IAM-ISAM-GIG
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**GIG- ISAM**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**Role Summary**
As part of our EY-cyber security team, you shall Engage in Identity & Access Management projects in the capacity of execution of deliverables. An important part of your role will be to actively establish, maintain and strengthen internal and external relationships. You’ll also identify potential business opportunities for EY within existing engagements and escalate these as appropriate.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We’re looking for Security Consultant in the cyber security team to work on various Identity and Access Management projects for our customers across the globe. Also, the professional shall need to report any identified risks within engagements and share any issues and updates with senior members of the team.
  
  
In line with EY’s commitment to quality, you’ll confirm that work is of the highest quality as per EY’s quality standards and is reviewed by the next-level reviewer. As an influential member of the team, you’ll help to create a positive learning culture, coach and counsel junior team members and help them to develop.
  
  
As a member of the Identity and Access Management (IAM) team this position will contribute towards execution of an IAM roadmap that meets security requirements, including but not limited to security for customer applications using policy driven security, SSO, authentication and authorization, user provisioning/de-provisioning, and federation focusing on multiple protocols (SAML2.0, OpenID, OAuth2.0, WS-FED).
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Engage and contribute to the Identity & Access Management projects
* Work effectively as a team member, sharing responsibility, providing support, maintaining communication and updating senior team members on progress
* Execute the engagement requirements, along with review of work by junior team members
* Help prepare reports and schedules that will be delivered to clients and other interested parties
* Develop and maintain productive working relationships with client personnel
* Build strong internal relationships within EY Consulting Services and with other services across the organization
* Help senior team members in performance reviews and contribute to performance feedback for staff/junior level team members
* Contribute to people related initiatives including recruiting and retaining IAM professionals
* Maintain an educational program to continually develop personal skills
* Understand and follow workplace policies and procedures
* Manage the performance management for the direct reportees, as per the organization policies
* Foster teamwork and lead by example
* Training and mentoring of project resources
* Participating in the organization-wide people initiatives

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong understanding of Identity Access Management solutions.
* Strong experience in designing and implementing Customer Identity and Access Management (CIAM) solutions, including customer registration, profile management, and self-service account capabilities.
* Knowledge of CIAM best practices, including customer lifecycle management, identity federation, consent management, privacy compliance, and secure customer onboarding.
* Hands-on experience on IBM Security Access Manager or IBM Security Verify Access end-to-end implementation involving requirement gathering, designing, implementation, customization and testing.
* Implementation experience in Web Module, Federation Module and Advance Access control module of IBAM/ISVA
* Hands-on experience with IBM ISAM WebSEAL administration, including configuration and management of various junction types, reverse proxy services.
* Experience implementing Single Sign on, Multi Factor Authentication, adaptive authentication, and customer/partner identity solutions using ISAM/ISVA.
* Working experience in application integration with header-based, SAML2.0, OIDC, OAuth2.0, WS-Fed protocols.
* Experience in implementing social login and third-party Identity Provider (IdP) integrations using ISAM/ISVA for secure authentication and federation use cases.
* Ability to design and customize authentication policies, access controls, identity workflows, and customer-facing access experiences.
* Experience in developing and integrating REST APIs, web services, and identity-related connectors to enable seamless customer and application integrations
* Ability to develop and maintain ISAM custom JavaScript mapping rules, API protection policies, and federation configurations.
* Proficiency in Java, JavaScript, and scripting technologies used for IAM customizations and automation.
* Experienced in diagnosing and resolving complex authentication, authorization, and federation issues.
* Experience in supporting platform administration activities, including upgrades, deployments, patching, and environment maintenance.
* Strong knowledge of certificate administration in ISAM, including troubleshooting SSL/TLS, signer, personal, and key database certificate-related issues.
* Understanding of IAM governance, configuration management, operational controls, and industry best practices.
* Willingness to work in a client-focused environment with flexibility to support evolving business and operational requirements.
* Should have knowledge of different integration and architecture in customer’s IAM environment such as Load Balancer, network components
* Understanding of latest technology such as Zero trust framework, Fine-grained authorization, Password less authentication, CIAM
* Ability to develop documentation such as business requirement document, high and low level design document, training and user procedures document.
* Should be flexible to work on new technologies in IAM domain.
* Should have had direct client experience, including working with client teams in an on-site or offshore mode.
* Need to liaise with Business stakeholders and seek requirement clarification. Should be able to map business requirements to technical specifications.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* B. Tech./ B.E. with sound technical skills
* Strong command on verbal and written English language.
* Relevant experience in IBM Security Access Manager or IBM Security Verify Access.
* Strong interpersonal and presentation skills.
* 5 – 9 Years’ Work Experience

**Certification:**

* Desirable to have certifications in security domain, such as CISSP and CISA or any IAM product specific certifications
* Desirable to have certifications in IBM Security Access Manager or IBM Security Verify Access

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment**
: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development**
: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture**
: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits**
: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply:**
If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

title: SDET Trainer
description:
**Company Description**
Aspire Info is a skill development and technology services initiative dedicated to empowering individuals, supporting organizations, and connecting businesses with suitable technical talent. The company focuses on bridging the gap between academic learning and industry needs through practical, job-oriented training and real-world technology solutions. Its services include corporate and academic training in full stack development and programming, website and software development, and coordinated trainer deployment for organizations and institutions. Aspire Info also supports internship and skill development programs, helping learners build relevant competencies for today’s technology-driven workplace. The organization is committed to making technical learning more practical, technology more accessible, and talent connections more effective.
  
**Role Description**
The SDET Trainer role at Aspire Info is a full-time, on-site position based in Kerala, India. The trainer will design and deliver structured training programs on Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) concepts, including programming fundamentals, test automation, and software quality practices. Day-to-day responsibilities include preparing curriculum and training materials, conducting classroom and lab sessions, guiding learners through hands-on coding and testing exercises, and assessing learner performance through assignments, projects, and evaluations. The trainer will collaborate with internal teams to align content with industry standards, update training modules based on current tools and frameworks, and provide mentorship to learners on career readiness and practical application of skills. The role also involves maintaining training documentation, collecting feedback, and continuously improving the learning experience.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong foundation in Computer Science concepts, including data structures, algorithms, and software engineering principles.
* Proficiency in Programming and Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), with hands-on experience in at least one modern programming language (e.g., Java, C#, Python).
* Experience in Software Development and Back-End Web Development, including APIs, databases, and application architecture.
* Practical experience in SDET-related areas such as test automation frameworks, unit and integration testing, CI/CD, and version control tools.
* Prior experience as a technical trainer, educator, or mentor, with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly and guide learners through practical exercises.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage diverse learner groups in an inclusive, gender-neutral, and non-discriminatory manner.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent industry experience.
* Familiarity with industry-standard tools and technologies used in modern software development and testing (e.g., Selenium, REST APIs, Git, build tools) is an advantage.

description:
Location: Kochi

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1759380

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**Title – ServiceNow Architect**

**EY Technology:**

Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently. We have 400,000+ people in more than 170 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. Everything from the laptops we use, to the ability to work remotely on our mobile devices and connecting our people and our clients, to enabling hundreds of internal tools and external solutions delivered to our clients. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and is key to us being more innovative as an organization.

  

**The opportunity**

EY Technology is expanding the team which manages and maintains our growing internal ServiceNow platforms. This is an opportunity in a fast-paced environment working and consulting on technical projects, architecture and best practices with our world class developers, support and platform engineering staff. As a ServiceNow Architect you will become one of the go-to staff who provide strategic direction, ensures project implementation and leverages a deep understanding of the platform to ensure critical business needs are met. The goals of the ServiceNow architect are to evaluate and manage migration of new products, Support all new demands in ServiceNow across instances, Align right product in the right instance, adoption of new features including upgrades and patches. Also, answers to technical queries, provide technical guidance and act as a central resource for all things ServiceNow. This position requires you to challenge yourself to create and innovate while ensuring current and future continuity and extensibility of the platform.

  

**Your key responsibilities**

In this key role you will be responsible for working with multiple teams and internal clients to assist with the following duties:

* Acting as a technical Point of Contact for all areas of the platform
* Evaluate and manage migration of new products to ServiceNow
* Supports all new demand onboarding across products
* Instance alignment
* Adoption of new features from ServiceNow
* AI Adoption with ServiceNow
* Upgrades and security patches
* Providing Guidance on best practices
* Consulting/Advising on Solutions and providing strategic solutions
* Attempting to minimize customization
* Advising where a requirement is not feasible or advisable and highlighting risks.
* Assisting with road map development and prototyping
* Assisting with Incident resolution when needed
* Mentoring of other team members
* Ability to see (big picture) impacts of configurations or customizations beyond the current scope of work
* Ability to learn emerging or currently not in use features the tool very quickly

  

**Skills and attributes for success**

The skills you bring to our growing team will be instrumental in the success of future projects and the transformation of our platform into a more user centric experience while ensuring current and future continuity and extensibility. Your expertise will bring knowledge which can be shared with fellow staff members to present them with educational opportunities to enrich their career growth while teaching best practices. A candidate must be able to quickly adapt and learn our environment and constraints to add value to our team.

  

**To qualify for the role you must have**

* At least 6 years of design, development & administration experience of the ServiceNow platform
* Extensive experience with SOAP and REST integrations and associated security protocols
* Experience configuring, deploying and supporting HRSD, ITBM, ITOM and ITSM applications
* Experience configuring, deploying and supporting Now Assist functionalities of ServiceNow
* Experience configuring, deploying and supporting Discovery and Service Mapping
* Understand Infrastructure (equipment, OIDs, PowerShell, SSH Commands)
* Proven track record of technical leadership roles delivering complex requirements using creative and innovative methods
* Proven track record of building relationships with multiple diverse stakeholder groups to complete complex initiatives
* ServiceNow Certified Application Developer
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator
* Exceptional communication skills which allow effective communication with all ranks of stakeholders who may be technical or non-technical stakeholders
* Ability to drive initiatives with minimal supervision

  

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* ITIL v3 or v4 Foundations Certification
* Experience with Agile Development Methodology
* Orchestration experience
* Schedule Flexibility (we have global stakeholders)

  

**What we look for**

Our team values self-starters who demonstrate leadership skills and value the contributions of individual team members and leverage their strengths. Demonstrated technical leadership coupled with the ability to see the big picture to avoid causing technical debt or cross platform issues is a necessity. Having a ‘can do’ attitude and being able to work with and mesh well with multiple people from diverse backgrounds and negotiating diverse personalities while effectively communicating is key to this position.

**What working at EY offers**

We offer a competitive remuneration package where you’ll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

  

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

  

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

description:
**Telesales Executive** is typically responsible for the **entire sales cycle over the phone and Email**—from pitching to closing the deal.

**Responsibilities include:**

**1. Outbound Sales & Pitching**

* **Calling Leads & Databases:** Making a high volume of daily outbound calls to warm leads (collected by field teams/marketing) and cold prospect lists.
* **Delivering Sales Pitches:** Presenting products, services, or packages persuasively, tailoring the pitch to match the customer's specific pain points.
* **Cross-Selling & Upselling:** Suggesting upgrades, add-ons, or higher-tier plans to both new prospects and existing customers to maximize order value.

**2. Negotiation & Closing Deals**

* **Handling Objections:** Overcoming price concerns, competitor comparisons, and hesitation using structured rebuttal techniques.
* **Sharing Quotes & Proposals:** Sending product brochures, pricing sheets, or payment links via email or WhatsApp immediately after a call.
* **Closing Sales:** Converting interested prospects into paying customers directly over the phone and meeting daily, weekly, or monthly revenue targets.

**3. Follow-Up & Pipeline Management**

* **Systematic Follow-Ups:** Maintaining a disciplined callback schedule for undecided prospects, missed calls, and pending payment confirmations.
* **Lead Nurturing:** Keeping warm prospects engaged over days or weeks until they are ready to make a purchase decision.

**4. CRM Updating & Reporting**

* **Logging Call Data:** Recording call outcomes, customer feedback, and next follow-up dates accurately in the CRM or sales tracker.
* **Target & KPI Tracking:** Tracking personal conversion rates (calls-to-leads, leads-to-sales) and submitting daily/weekly performance reports to the Team Leader or Sales Manager.

**5. Post-Sale Handover & Coordination**

* **Order Processing:** Collecting necessary customer details/documents and coordinating with the operations, billing, or delivery team to ensure smooth fulfilment.
* **Customer Retention:** Checking in with recently closed customers to ensure satisfaction and gather referrals.

**Key Requirements & Qualifications (Optional Checklist)**

**Education:** Bachelor’s degree or a related field.

**Experience:** 1–3 years of experience in an accounting or bookkeeping role (fresh graduates with strong internship experience can also apply).

**Technical Skills:** Proficiency in MS Excel, Tally, QuickBooks, etc. and experience with accounting software.

title: Staff, Design Technology
description:
**Ready to be a Titan?**

ServiceTitan strives to be the best place our Titans have ever worked, so they can do the best work they’ve ever done. The Experience Design (XD) team solves real world problems in the home services industry. We are passionate about bringing innovative and delightful solutions to traditional problems and workflows. The work is complex: software with depth, consequence, and real stakes for the tens of thousands of tradespeople who depend on it every day.

We’re looking for a Staff Design Technology with 8+ years of experience who brings a strong combination of design craft, technical expertise, and systems thinking. In this role, you will help shape and evolve our design system, bridging the gap between design and engineering to create scalable, consistent, and high-quality user experiences.

You will work closely with designers, engineers, and other stakeholders to solve complex design system challenges, explore new ideas, and improve the way our teams design and build products. We are looking for someone who is passionate about design systems, enjoys working hands-on with Figma and React, and is motivated to improve the system through better tooling, processes, and documentation.

This role is based in Bengaluru, India, and sits within ServiceTitan's growing global team, working in close partnership with our XD organization headquartered in the US.

**What you’ll do**

  

* Drive the evolution of our design system by solving complex design and technical challenges, ensuring consistency, scalability, and quality across our products.
* Collaborate with designers and engineers to ideate, prototype, and iterate on solutions that improve the design-to-development workflow.
* Translate design system concepts into reusable, scalable components using Figma and React.
* Establish and improve design token structures, naming conventions, and code conventions to support consistency across design and engineering.
* Identify, investigate, and resolve design and code inconsistencies, bugs, and system-level issues.
* Develop and maintain UX documentation, component guidelines, and usage patterns to support adoption and consistency across teams.
* Explore opportunities to improve the design system through custom Figma plugins, tooling, automation, and streamlined processes.
* Collaborate with design system stakeholders to understand their needs, gather feedback, and prioritize improvements.
* Champion consistency and quality across desktop, tablet, and mobile experiences.
* Define and track success metrics to evaluate the effectiveness, adoption, and impact of design system components, tools, and processes.
* Work effectively across teams, bringing stakeholders together to align on design system direction and implementation.

**What you'll bring**

  

* 8+ years of experience in design technology, design systems, product design, front-end development, or a related field.
* Strong visual UI design skills and a keen eye for detail, quality, and consistency.
* Proven experience contributing to and evolving design systems, including building reusable components and scalable design patterns.
* Experience working closely with Engineering teams and a strong understanding of how design decisions translate into code.
* Proficiency in Figma, including the ability to quickly prototype and create components.
* Hands-on experience with React and the ability to iterate on code solutions.
* Strong understanding of design tokens, component architecture, naming conventions, and code conventions.
* Ability to identify and solve complex design system problems involving design, code, and user experience.
* Experience designing and building consistent experiences across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with designers, engineers, and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Experience creating and maintaining UX documentation and component guidelines.
* Ability to work quickly, navigate ambiguity, and balance quality with execution.
* Interest in measuring the success and impact of design system initiatives through relevant metrics.
* A collaborative mindset, with the ability to contribute to ideation, share feedback, and continuously improve the system.

**Good to Have**

  

* Experience creating custom Figma plugins to improve design workflows and system efficiency.
* Experience developing tools, automation, or processes that improve design-to-development collaboration.
* Experience creating customizable and flexible user experiences that accommodate different user needs and workflows.
* Experience contributing to design system adoption and governance across multiple product teams.
* Experience working with component libraries, design system documentation platforms, or front-end tooling.
* A portfolio or examples demonstrating contributions to design systems, UI components, or design technology initiatives.

‌

**Be Human With Us:**

Being human isn’t about checking every box on a list. It’s about the experiences we have, people we meet, and the perspectives we share. So, if you have the skills but are hesitant to apply because of your background, apply anyway. We need amazing people like you to help us challenge the conventional and think differently about the problems that we’re solving. We’re in this together. Come be human, with us.
  
  
**Use of AI Technology:**

We use technology, including automated and AI-assisted tools, to support certain aspects of our recruitment process. These tools are designed to improve efficiency and enhance the candidate experience. AI tools are not used to make hiring decisions; all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams.

At ServiceTitan, we celebrate individuality and uniqueness. We believe that the convergence of fresh perspectives and experiences from all walks of life is what makes our product and culture so great. We do not discriminate against employees based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity or expression, age, disability, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws.

description:

#### **Life at EvoluteIQ:**

We at EvoluteIQ believe in the power of transformation. We are committed to building a industry-leading technology that will revolutionize the way enterprises conduct business.

To make that happen, we need people who are generous, genuine, self-driven and collaborative. People who not only want to be a part of a fast-growing and radical thinking company, but who are kind and care—about each other. We at EvoluteIQ thrive in the company of each other and make each other a better version of ourselves every day.

**Could that be you?**

#### **The EIQ Mission:**

Our culture is who we are, and it defines us. We are nimble, fast, dedicated, humble and bold. We see opportunities everywhere around us to make a **“dent in the universe”.** Our core fabric is Innovation! And this is not just a word, but the way of life within EvoluteIQ.

Changing the way business is done, reimagining the future of work, and enabling people to improve their quality of work every day, is a daunting task. That is what we all strive every day at EvoluteIQ. To enable everyone to automate complicated processes with their instinct and knowledge.

We make building of automation simple for everyone, so that it is not mystery for a few.

**Would you like to be part of this journey?**

We are looking for a **Senior Hybrid Designer (UX + UI)** who is equally comfortable with UX (understanding users, shaping flows, solving problems) and UI (creating clean, polished, consistent screens). You will design AI-powered product experiences from the first idea to the final build, and you will work directly with clients to understand their needs and turn them into clear, usable solutions.

This role suits someone who enjoys owning their work end to end, can explain design decisions in plain language, and is curious about how people work with AI. You will work closely with product managers, engineers, and business teams, and you will help raise the quality of design across the team.

#### **What you'll do at EvoluteIQ:**

* **Own the full design process:** take features from research and problem framing through wireframes, prototypes, and final UI ready for development.
* **Design for AI:** create experiences where users work alongside AI (for example, agents, assistants, and automated workflows), making AI behavior clear, trustworthy, and easy to control.
* **Work with clients:** join client workshops and discovery sessions, understand their business goals and users, and present design ideas and recommendations with confidence.
* **Understand users:** plan and run user interviews, usability tests, and quick reviews, and turn what you learn into clear design decisions.
* **Build clean UI:** produce high-quality visual designs that follow and extend our design system, with attention to layout, typography, spacing, and accessibility.
* **Contribute to the design system:** add and improve components, patterns, and guidelines so the team can design faster and more consistently.
* **Partner with engineering:** share clear specs and handoffs, answer questions during build, and review what gets built to make sure it matches the design.
* **Prototype and test ideas quickly:** use interactive prototypes (and AI design tools where useful) to explore options and get early feedback.
* **Communicate clearly:** present work to stakeholders, explain the reasoning behind decisions, and handle feedback openly.
* **Support the team:** give helpful design reviews, guide junior designers, and share what you learn.

#### **What will you bring to the team?**

* **Experience:** at least 5 years as a product, UX, or UI designer working on digital products (web apps, SaaS, or enterprise software).
* **AI product experience:** has designed for at least one AI-native or AI-powered product, such as chat or agent interfaces, AI assistants, or smart automation.
* **Client consulting:** has worked directly with clients or external stakeholders, including running workshops, gathering requirements, and presenting work.
* **Strong UX skills:** user research, user flows, information architecture, wireframing, and usability testing.
* **Strong UI skills:** visual design, layout, typography, colour, and building responsive designs for desktop and mobile.

description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

##### **About Tracxn**

Tracxn is a B2B data company. For 13 years, we have helped investors and companies find and track private companies. Our customers include venture capital (VC) funds, private equity (PE) firms, investment banks, accelerators, incubators and large companies across India, Asia-Pacific, Europe and the Middle East.

##### **About the role**

We are looking for a hands-on sales leader who can build and lead a sales team while continuing to own individual sales targets. You will set the team’s sales plan, guide day-to-day execution and ensure that the team meets its targets. This is a Sales head role: you will lead the team, work on the sales strategy and also handle your own customer conversations, demos and deal closures.

##### **What you’ll actually do**

* Own an individual sales target and manage your own customers from first outreach to closure and account growth.
* Set the sales plan for the team, including target segments, customer cohorts, outreach priorities and execution approach.
* Lead, guide and review the sales team to ensure that individual and team targets are met.
* Take sales calls and product demos yourself, understand customer requirements and move opportunities towards closure.
* Help team members improve their outreach, pitches, demos, follow-ups and deal-closing approach.
* Identify and contact senior decision-makers such as partners, managing directors and heads of research.
* Review the sales pipeline and forecasts regularly, identify gaps and take action to improve conversions.
* Work with Product and leadership teams to share customer feedback and improve the sales approach.

##### **What we are looking for**

* 2-4 years of work experience, with meaningful prior experience in sales.
* An undergraduate or MBA degree from a top-tier institution with a strong academic track record.
* Evidence of taking ownership beyond individual sales execution, such as guiding colleagues, leading a small team or driving a sales initiative.
* Ability to handle individual sales work while also planning and leading the work of a team.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently in situations where there is no fixed playbook.
* A clear focus on targets, follow-through and getting things done.
* Clear and confident communication, including the ability to engage senior decision-makers.
* Prior experience selling to VCs, PEs, investment banks, M&A or acquisition-focused firms is an added advantage.

##### **What we are not looking for**

* People who want to move into team management without continuing to own individual sales work.
* People who can manage their own pipeline but are not interested in taking responsibility for the team’s overall performance.
* People who need step-by-step instructions to get work done.
* People who see sales as a short-term role before moving to something else.

**Location**: Bengaluru

Pre-Sales Executive – Interior Design

**Company:** Studio Elan  
**Industry:** Interior Design & Turnkey Execution  
**Location:** Bengaluru

Job Purpose

Studio Elan is looking for a proactive and well-spoken **Pre-Sales Executive** to manage prospective client enquiries, understand their initial interior design requirements, qualify leads, and schedule consultations with the Design/Architect team.

The candidate will serve as the first point of contact for prospective clients and ensure a professional, seamless client experience from the initial enquiry to the first design consultation.

Key Responsibilities1. Lead Management & Client Communication

* Respond promptly to incoming enquiries from website, social media, referrals, advertisements, and other channels.
* Contact prospective clients and introduce Studio Elan's interior design and turnkey execution services.
* Maintain professional communication with clients through calls, WhatsApp, email, and other communication channels.
* Follow up with enquiries systematically to ensure no potential lead is missed.

2. Client Requirement Understanding

* Conduct initial discussions with prospective clients to understand their interior requirements.
* Gather preliminary information regarding:
* Property type (Apartment, Villa, Independent House, Commercial Space, etc.)
* Property location
* Property size and configuration
* Possession status
* Interior requirements and scope of work
* Design preferences and lifestyle requirements
* Estimated budget
* Expected project timeline
* Identify the client's expectations, priorities, and seriousness of enquiry before scheduling a consultation.

3. Meeting Fixing & Consultation Coordination

* Schedule appointments between prospective clients and the Studio Elan Design/Architect team.
* Coordinate client meetings for requirement discussions, design understanding, project feasibility and initial consultation.
* Ensure the designer/architect receives the necessary preliminary information before the meeting.
* Confirm appointments with clients and send meeting reminders.
* Coordinate physical meetings, site visits, office consultations or virtual meetings as required.
* Ensure meetings are scheduled efficiently based on client availability and the design team's calendar.

4. Client & Design Team Coordination

* Act as a bridge between prospective clients and the design team.
* Ensure that the client's initial requirements are clearly communicated to the assigned designer or architect.
* Coordinate follow-ups after meetings to understand client feedback and next steps.
* Assist in scheduling subsequent meetings, site visits, design presentations and discussions.
* Maintain clear communication between the client, pre-sales team and design team throughout the initial sales process.

5. Lead Follow-Up & Conversion Support

* Follow up with clients after consultations to understand their interest and decision-making status.
* Coordinate with the design team regarding proposals, quotations, presentations and project discussions.
* Maintain regular follow-up with prospective clients until the lead is converted, lost or placed on hold.
* Identify potential opportunities for conversion and escalate high-value or urgent prospects to the management team.
* Support the sales team in moving qualified leads towards project closure.

6. CRM & Reporting

* Maintain accurate records of all enquiries, calls, conversations, requirements and meeting schedules.
* Update lead status regularly in CRM or the company's lead management system.
* Maintain a record of scheduled meetings, completed consultations, follow-ups and conversion status.
* Prepare periodic reports on enquiry pipeline, meetings scheduled, client feedback and lead conversion.

Candidate Profile

* Graduate in any discipline; candidates from Interior Design, Architecture, Sales, Marketing or Hospitality backgrounds will be preferred.
* Experience in pre-sales, client coordination, telecalling, sales or customer relationship management is preferred.
* Excellent communication skills in English and Hindi; Kannada will be an added advantage.
* Pleasant personality, professional presentation and confidence in interacting with premium clients.
* Strong follow-up, coordination and organisational skills.
* Basic understanding of residential interiors, interior design processes, materials and turnkey projects will be an advantage.
* Familiarity with CRM tools, MS Excel, Google Sheets and WhatsApp Business.
* Ability to understand client requirements and communicate them clearly to the design team.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Number of enquiries contacted within the defined response time.
* Number of qualified leads generated.
* Number of client meetings successfully scheduled.
* Meeting attendance and confirmation rate.
* Quality and completeness of client requirement information collected.
* Follow-up consistency and lead pipeline management.
* Conversion of enquiries into design consultations and prospective projects.
* Accuracy of CRM records and reporting.

Desired Attributes

* Client-focused and service-oriented approach.
* Professional and confident communication.
* Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills.
* Proactive attitude and ownership of leads.
* Excellent coordination and follow-up discipline.
* Ability to understand client expectations and build trust.
* Interest in premium residential interiors and luxury design.

Role Objective

The primary objective of this role is to ensure that every prospective Studio Elan client receives a professional first interaction, their requirements are understood accurately, and a meaningful consultation is arranged with the appropriate designer or architect—thereby improving lead quality, client experience and project conversion.

title: Tele Calling Executive
description:
**ABOUT TROVE**

Joining Immediate Preferred Trove Innovations (India) Pvt. Ltd. is one of India’s fastest growing premium tile brand, headquartered in Bangalore. With a strong digital and retail presence, we receive a high volume of inbound enquiries every day through platforms like IndiaMart, Instagram, Meta Ads, and our website. We are looking for a sharp, energetic Lead Conversion Specialist who can take ownership of every enquiry that comes in and convert it into a confirmed showroom visit — and ultimately, an order.

**ROLE OVERVIEW**

As a Lead Conversion Specialist at Trove, your one job is to make sure no lead goes cold. You will call, follow up, and engage every inbound enquiry from across our digital channels, understand what the client is looking for, and get them into one of our Experience Centres. You will assign leads to the right showroom, keep the tracking sheet fully updated, and own the conversion pipeline from first contact to confirmed visit. Your performance is measured by one thing: how many enquiries become orders.

**WHAT YOU WILL OWN**

**1. Lead Calling & First Response**

* Call every inbound lead promptly — from IndiaMart, Instagram, Meta Ads, Google Ads, and the Trove website — within the target response time. Speed of first contact is everything.
* Introduce Trove confidently, understand the client’s requirement (tile type, space, budget, timeline), and qualify the lead during the first call.
* Communicate fluently in English, Hindi, and Kannada — switch seamlessly based on the client’s comfort.

**2. Follow-Up & Nurturing**

* Own structured follow-up for every lead — call, WhatsApp, or message based on client preference — until the visit is confirmed or the lead is closed.
* Never let a warm lead go cold due to lack of follow-up. Maintain a follow-up cadence and document every interaction.
* Handle client queries about products, showroom location, timings, and design support — give clear, helpful answers that build confidence in Trove.

**3. Showroom Assignment & Coordination**

* Assign each qualified lead to the most appropriate Trove Experience Centre based on the client’s location and requirement.
* Coordinate with the showroom team to ensure the client is expected, welcomed, and attended to on arrival.
* Confirm appointments with the client and the showroom — no dropped handoffs, no missed visits.

**4. Lead Tracking & Sheet Management**

* Update all lead activity in Trove's internal software and CRM — every call, follow-up, status change, and outcome must be logged in the system in real time, not just the sheet
* Update the lead tracking sheet in real time — source, contact details, follow-up status, showroom assigned, visit date, and outcome Maintain clean, accurate data with no gaps or stale entries — the sheet is the single source of truth for the lead pipeline.
* Generate a daily summary of lead status, conversions, and pending follow-ups for review by the manager.

**5. Conversion & Order Follow-Through**

* Track every lead post-visit — follow up with the showroom and the client to understand if an order was placed or if further support is needed.
* Re-engage leads that visited but did not convert — understand objections and find ways to bring them back.
* Own your conversion number: enquiry to visit, visit to order. That is your metric.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

* 0–2 years of experience in tele-sales, inside sales, customer service, or lead management — freshers with strong communication skills are welcome.
* Fluent in English, Hindi, and Kannada — all three are mandatory. You must be able to switch naturally based on the client.
* Confident, warm, and persuasive on the phone — able to build rapport quickly and handle objections without sounding pushy.
* Highly organised — able to manage a large pipeline of leads simultaneously without letting any slip.
* Proficient in MS Excel, CRM or Google Sheets for lead tracking and reporting.
* Self-driven and target-oriented — motivated by conversion numbers, not just call volumes.
* Familiarity with CRM tools or lead management platforms is an advantage.

**ABOUT THE INCENTIVE**

Your fixed salary is the base. On top of that, you earn a performance-linked incentive for every enquiry that converts into a confirmed order through your follow-up. The more leads you convert, the more you earn — there is no cap. High performers consistently earn significantly above their fixed salary.
