**Job Description:**

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a Senior Oracle EBS Sales & Service Functional Support Analyst to join Terex's TMS (Terex Management System) Level 2 support organization. This role is the primary escalation point for Oracle EBS Sales and Service incidents across Terex's global, multi-org manufacturing and distribution environment. You will resolve functional issues, reduce ticket backlog, drive continuous improvements and ensure commercial and service teams across our business segments — including Genie, Materials Processing, and Environmental Solutions — can operate without disruption.

**Key Responsibilities**

Incident Management & Resolution (Sales & Service)

* Provide day-to-day level 2 support of Oracle EBS Sales and Service modules and related applications for Terex users globally.

* Log, categorize, prioritize, and resolve incidents and service requests in line with defined SLAs and operational procedures.

* Execute routine, playbook-driven activities that contribute to system stability and operational continuity.

* Troubleshoot and resolve complex sales and service issues that may span Oracle EBS modules, middleware and other applications.

* Communicate clearly with end users and stakeholders, providing timely updates, setting expectations, and confirming resolution prior to ticket closure.

Manage escalations and escalate effectively when needed.  



Terex Sales & Service Process Support

* Ensure that monthly, quarterly and yearly inventory close proceed without IT impact.

* Support Oracle EBS Order Management for internal and external orders entered directly or through interfaces with other order management platforms such eCommerce.

* Support standard ship confirm for machine orders.

* Support Oracle Warehouse Management System for aftermarket orders.

* Support Oracle Installed Base and interfaces to warranty systems.

Act as an escalation point for complex issues, coordinating thorough troubleshooting and restoration of service.  



Continuous Improvement, Monitoring & Enablement

* Identify recurring incidents and contribute to problem management by capturing symptoms, workarounds, and supporting root cause investigations.

Look for opportunities to streamline or automate existing functionality and processes.  



Collaboration & Communication

* Partner with the Technical team on defects and enhancements, providing functional specifications, test scenarios, and validation of fixes.

* Partner with other tracks (Finance, Sales & Service, Supply Chain and Engineering & Manufacturing) as necessary for support and enhancements.

* Create and maintain knowledge articles, troubleshooting guides, and standard operating procedures to improve first-contact resolution.

* Support change implementation activities (communication, requirements, UAT support, validation and hypercare) and ensure end user and support team readiness for new or changed functionality and processes.

* Support Oracle EBS projects and activities outside of Enterprise Support when requested.

Ensure accurate ticket documentation, categorization, and reporting inputs to support service performance, auditability, and continuous improvement.  



**Education**

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Business, Information Technology, or a related discipline.  



**Experience & Skills**

* At least 8 years of hands-on functional implementation or support experience with Oracle EBS R12.2+ Sales & Service modules (Order Management, Shipping Execution, Inventory, Pricing/Advanced Pricing, Customer Data).

* Strong understanding of order-to-cash and fulfilment process flows (order entry, order holds, pick/pack/ship, invoicing interfaces, returns/RMA) in a manufacturing/aftermarket context.

* Experience supporting multi-org, multi-currency, multi-site Oracle EBS configurations supporting global order fulfilment, intercompany and inter-org manufacturing flows, inter-org transfers, and aftermarket distribution flows.

* Proven track record in SLA-driven production support with ServiceNow (or equivalent ITSM tool).

* Ability to write and interpret SQL queries for data analysis and troubleshooting across Sales, Shipping, Inventory and Service tables.

* Solid root cause analysis and problem management skills.

Strong communication skills; ability to interface with business users across Asia Pacific, EMEAR and North America time zones.  



**Preferred**

* Working knowledge of other Oracle EBS modules and Oracle CX.

* Experience of Configurator and ShipConsole.

* Familiarity with Dataload, More4Apps and API Wizard.

* Experience mentoring junior analysts and delivering user training.

* Knowledge of RPA/Gen AI tools for support automation.

ITIL certification (or strong ITIL-aligned operational experience).

description:
Blackstone is the world’s largest alternative asset manager. Blackstone seeks to deliver compelling returns for institutional and individual investors by strengthening the companies in which the firm invests. **Firm Overview**

Blackstone is the world’s largest alternative asset manager. Blackstone seeks to deliver compelling returns for institutional and individual investors by strengthening the companies in which the firm invests. Blackstone’s over $1.3 trillion in assets under management include global investment strategies focused on real estate, private equity, credit, infrastructure, life sciences, growth equity, secondaries and hedge funds. Further information is available at www.blackstone.com. Follow @blackstone on LinkedIn, X (Twitter), and Instagram.

**Business Unit**

BXTI

**Business Description**

Blackstone Technology & Innovations (BXTi) is the technology team at the core of each of Blackstone’s businesses and new growth initiatives. Serving both internal and external clients, we work to build the next generation of systems that manage risk, create efficiency and improve transparency within the firm and across our broad community of investors and portfolio companies.

BXTi is nimble and entrepreneurial – our open, iterative design processes and rapid pace of development mean that everyone on the team has the opportunity to make an impact from day one. We are problem solvers who can take projects from idea to implementation. We believe in active mentoring and developing excellence. We collaborate to find the best answers for our customers and for Blackstone. We are critical to the firm maintaining its competitive edge.

**Job Title**

Senior Vice President, Identity Platform – Team Lead & Architect

**Job Description**

The SVP, Identity Platform – Team Lead & Architect is accountable for the strategy, architecture and delivery of the firm’s enterprise identity and access management (IAM) platforms. This leader owns identity as a core, firm wide capability—enabling secure access for employees, customers, applications, APIs and emerging AI systems—while balancing security, developer experience, regulatory requirements, and business velocity.

This role combines leadership, deep technical architecture and hands-on platform stewardship. The SVP will lead a high performing identity engineering team, set long term architectural direction and partner closely with Cybersecurity, Cloud & Platform Engineering, Application Engineering, Data and Legal/Compliance.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategy & Platform Ownership**

* Define and own the enterprise identity vision, roadmap and reference architecture across workforce, application, customer and machine identities.
* Establish identity as a productized platform, with clear service offerings, SLAs, APIs, and self‑service capabilities.
* Drive modernization toward cloud‑native, zero‑trust, API‑first and policy‑driven identity architectures.
* Ensure identity strategy supports AI platforms, automation and machine‑to‑machine access at scale.

**Architecture & Technical Leadership**

* Serve as the lead **architect** for identity, authentication, authorization and access policy across the firm.
* Design and implement:

  + Authentication
  + Authorization (RBAC, ABAC, policy engines)
  + Token services, federation and identity brokering
  + Secrets, credentials and machine identities
* Define organizational standards for using OIDC, OAuth2, SAML, SCIM, and emerging identity patterns.
* Ensure architectures meet availability, resiliency, performance, integration and auditability requirements at enterprise scale.

**Engineering & Delivery Leadership**

* Lead and grow a world‑class identity engineering organization (product managers, engineers, operators).
* Oversee delivery of critical identity services used by hundreds of applications and platforms.
* Partner with platform and application teams to embed identity correctly, not bolt it on.

**Security, Risk & Compliance**

* Partner with Cybersecurity to ensure identity controls align with zero‑trust, least privilege, and defense‑in‑depth principles.
* Ensure compliance with relevant regulatory, privacy, and audit requirements.
* Lead incident response and post‑incident improvements for identity‑related events.
* Continuously evaluate vendor and open‑source solutions for risk, scalability, and strategic fit.

**Executive Stakeholder Engagement**

* Act as the firm’s senior identity authority with executives, auditors, and regulators.
* Translate complex technical concepts into clear business and risk narratives.
* Influence roadmaps across technology and business functions to ensure identity is foundational, not reactive.

**Required Qualifications**

**Experience**

* 15+ years in identity, security, or platform engineering, with significant experience operating at enterprise scale.
* Proven experience leading large, business-critical platforms used across a broad range of application portfolios.
* Prior experience at Director / VP / SVP level or equivalent senior leadership role.

**Technical Depth**

* Deep, hands‑on expertise in:

  + Enterprise IAM and identity platforms
  + OIDC, OAuth2, SAML, SCIM
  + Authorization models (RBAC, ABAC, policy engines)
  + Cloud identity patterns (AWS, Azure, hybrid)
* Strong understanding of distributed systems, high‑availability platforms, and secure API design.
* Experience integrating identity into developer platforms, CI/CD pipelines, and AI systems.

**Leadership & Communication**

* Demonstrated experience leading senior engineers and architects while remaining technically credible.
* Exceptional communication skills and effectiveness in influencing C-suite executives and senior business leaders.
* Strong product mindset—balancing security, usability, and speed.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience modernizing or replacing legacy identity platforms.
* Background in financial services, regulated environments, or large global enterprises.
* Familiarity with policy‑as‑code, infrastructure‑as‑code, and platform product management models.
* Experience supporting external partners, portfolio companies, or multi‑tenant ecosystems.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Identity is viewed as a strategic enabler, not a bottleneck.
* Applications and platforms adopt identity consistently and correctly by default.
* Security posture improves while developer and user friction decreases.
* The identity platform scales confidently to support new businesses, AI workloads, and regulatory demands.

* Closely manages profitability by minimizing profit leaks and maximizing gross profit.

title: Senior Sales Manager - Banks & NBFCs
description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

‍

##### **About Tracxn**

Tracxn is a leading market intelligence platform for private company data, serving Financial Institutions, Venture Capitalists, Private Equity Firms, Investment Banks, and Corporates. With a strong global footprint, Tracxn tracks over millions of companies across various sectors to provide deep insights and help clients make data-driven decisions.

##### **About the Role**

Tracxn is looking for experienced sales professionals with hands-on experience selling to Indian **banks and NBFCs**. In this role, you will head Tracxn’s GTM team for banks and NBFCs and own the sales target for this segment. Your focus will be on finding the right customers, reaching senior decision-makers, running product demos, managing follow-ups and closing deals. You will lead from the front: setting the GTM approach for the segment while personally driving key customer conversations.

##### **Key Responsibilities**

* Head the **GTM team for banks and NBFCs** and own the sales target for this segment.

* Build and run the GTM plan for the segment, including target account lists, outreach plans and sales priorities.

* Identify and reach out to decision-makers such as **business**, **credit**, **product** and **procurement heads** and **CXOs** in **banks and NBFCs**.

* Map the organizational structure and decision-making hierarchy within each target bank or NBFC, and engage the right stakeholders at each stage of the sale.

* Run customer conversations, **sales calls** and **product demos** yourself.

* **Meet leads in-person** at banks and NBFCs to take sales conversations forward and build lasting relationships.

* Understand how each bank or NBFC finds, evaluates and tracks companies across sales, credit and product functions, and explain how Tracxn can help.

* Follow up consistently, discuss pricing and commercial terms, and take opportunities through to closure, including navigating procurement and approval processes.

* Guide and support team members on outreach, account strategy and deal closures.

‍

##### **What We're Looking For**

* **7+ years** of relevant sales experience

* Direct, **hands-on** experience selling **data or IT products** to Indian banks and NBFCs is **mandatory**.

* Good knowledge of the organizational and decision-making hierarchy in banks and NBFCs, including how buying decisions move across business, credit, product, technology and procurement teams.

* Experience engaging sales heads, credit heads, product teams and CXOs in banks and NBFCs.

* A track record of closing deals with banks and NBFCs, including navigating long sales cycles and multi-stakeholder approvals.

* Ability to set the GTM direction for a segment while independently managing outreach, customer conversations, demos, follow-ups and deal closures.

* **Willingness to travel** and meet leads in person at banks and NBFCs.

* A strong focus on sales targets, consistent follow-through and customer ownership.

* Clear and confident communication, including the ability to engage senior and CXO-level decision-makers.

‍

##### **What we are not looking for?**

* Candidates without direct experience selling to Indian banks or NBFCs.

* Candidates whose experience is limited to selling non-data or non-IT products to this segment.

* Candidates looking for a purely strategic or team-management role without hands-on sales execution.

* Candidates who are not open to occasional travel and in-person meetings with leads and customers.

‍

**Role:** Senior Sales Manager

**Industry Type:** B2B SaaS

**Department:** Sales & Business Development

**Employment Type:** Full Time, Permanent

To know more about us, visit our website: www.tracxn.com

title: Sales Executive
description:
At Marzi, a Sales Executive is not just a salesperson. They are the bridge between a customer's interests, aspirations and meaningful experiences. You will own the complete customer journey — from the first conversation to understanding customer needs, building trust, recommending the right events and converting interest into paid bookings through thoughtful, personalized interactions.

**Your mission: Turn conversations into connections, connections into bookings, and customers into repeat customers.**

Key Responsibilities:-

* Customer Discovery & Rapport Building: Build genuine relationships with customers (50+ TG), understand their lifestyle, interests, preferences, motivations and expectations through meaningful conversations.
* Need Generation: Go beyond responding to enquiries. Identify latent needs, create interest and help customers discover experiences they may not have considered.
* Personalized Recommendations: Recommend the right events and experiences based on individual customer preferences, ensuring relevance and value rather than pushing bookings.
* Conversion & Revenue Ownership: Own the complete sales funnel, proactively convert enquiries into paid bookings and consistently achieve individual revenue and booking targets.
* Follow-up & Relationship Management: Maintain structured, personalised follow-ups, address concerns, build confidence and close bookings without making customers feel pressured.
* Customer Retention: Build long-term relationships, encourage repeat participation, generate referrals and create a strong customer experience beyond the first booking.
* Ownership & Execution: Maintain CRM hygiene, track every opportunity, monitor conversion performance, identify gaps and continuously improve individual results.

We are looking for people who demonstrate:

* Exceptional communication: Fluent, articulate, confident and engaging conversational skills.
* Customer empathy: Ability to understand, listen patiently and connect naturally with the 50+ audience.
* Rapport-building mastery: Ability to establish trust and make customers feel heard, valued and comfortable.
* Consultative selling: Strong ability to identify needs, generate interest and recommend the right experience instead of aggressively selling.
* Conversion mindset: Natural ability to influence decisions, handle objections and confidently ask for bookings without creating pressure.
* Persistence with professionalism: Disciplined follow-ups without irritating, overwhelming or misleading customers.
* High ownership and accountability: Takes complete responsibility for targets, pipeline, follow-ups and outcomes. No excuses, no blame-shifting.
* Results orientation: Strong personal drive to achieve and exceed monthly booking and revenue targets.

What Success Looks Like

* Consistently achieving and exceeding monthly paid-booking targets.
* Strong lead-to-paid-booking conversion.
* High-quality customer interactions and customer satisfaction.
* Increasing repeat bookings and customer referrals.
* Zero leakage of qualified leads due to poor follow-up or lack of ownership.

Pay: ₹400,000.00 - ₹550,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Application Question(s):

* How Fluent is your English?
* How Many years of experience do you have?

Work Location: In person

* Understanding of service fees, margins, payment terms and commercial commitments.

* Comfort working closely with a Founder in an early-stage business.
* Willingness to attend client meetings and relevant business events.

Experience in corporate hotel sales, serviced apartments, accommodation, relocation, corporate travel, facilities services or adjacent B2B services is preferred.

* Qualified meetings and opportunities created.
* Progression through proposals, procurement and commercial discussions.
* New corporate accounts generating paid business.

title: Business Development Executive (BDE)
description:
At Marzi, a Business Development Executive is not just a salesperson. They are the bridge between a customer's interests, aspirations and meaningful experiences. You will own the complete customer journey — from the first conversation to understanding customer needs, building trust, recommending the right events and converting interest into paid bookings through thoughtful, personalized interactions

.**Your mission: Turn conversations into connections, connections into bookings, and customers into repeat customers.**

Key Responsibilities:-

* Customer Discovery & Rapport Building: Build genuine relationships with customers (50+ TG), understand their lifestyle, interests, preferences, motivations and expectations through meaningful conversations.

* Conversion mindset: Natural ability to influence decisions, handle objections and confidently ask for bookings without creating pressure.

* Knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes.
* Experience with Kafka, RabbitMQ, or other messaging platforms.
* Understanding of Redis, Elasticsearch, or distributed caching.
* Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
* Knowledge of system design, design patterns, and distributed systems.
* Experience working on SaaS platforms or enterprise-grade software products.

* Ability to design scalable and high-performance applications.
* Strong understanding of system design, distributed systems, and database optimization.

* Experience working in a product-based company or SaaS environment.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Passion for building scalable, high-quality software products.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively within engineering teams.
* Strong communication and ownership mindset.
* Willingness to learn new technologies and adapt to evolving product requirements.

What We Offer

* Opportunity to work on innovative technology products.
* Exposure to modern engineering practices and scalable architectures.
* Collaborative and technically driven work environment.
* Opportunities for continuous learning and career growth.
* Opportunity to contribute to product architecture and engineering decisions.

**We are looking for engineers who are passionate about building products, solving complex technical challenges, and creating technology that delivers real business value.**

**About The Role**
As an
**Account Executive - Portfolio Sales**

**Portfolio Systems Engineers, Specialist Technical Teams, Customer Success, Channels & Partner Account Managers, and Global Business Operations**

* Outcome-Driven Closer: A seasoned sales professional who excels in managing medium-to-long sales cycles (3-12+ months) and closing multi-solution deals ranging from $50K to multi-million-dollar commitments.

* Deep technical skill across Cisco or competitive enterprise networking portfolios (Switching, Routing, Wireless, SD-WAN, Enterprise Security/Firewalls).

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

title: Associate Manager, GBS CPM
description:
**Job Description**
**Job Summary**
CIB
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Credit & Portfolio Management (CPM) is part of the Group Corporate & Institution Banking Function. Credit & Portfolio Management is responsible for:
  
  

* Actively managing the Bank’s credit portfolio to maximize risk-adjusted returns for sustainable Group ROTE outcomes through better origination discipline, portfolio optimization, modelling, early identification and action of stressed assets and distribution.
* Driving balance sheet optimization and resilience through improving the inter-operability of key subsidiaries, reducing Cost of Funds (CoF) and improving quality and resilience of liabilities by monetizing illiquid CIB loans to create medium term secured and contingent funding options that could even be used to raise funds in stress.

**Various Sub-units Underneath CPM Are Listed Below**
**Distribution:**
CPM Distribution is part of Credit & Portfolio Management. CPM Distribution co-ordinates loan sales in the secondary market to generate liquidity, obtain RWA relief, and offload risk at minimum cost under the guidance of the Origination and Distribution Policy. To facilitate loan sales and other CPM Distribution initiatives, GBS CPM Team extracts the data on all transferable loans from multiple sources and compiles them in the Loan Database.
  
  
Distribution also runs various programs that help in the bank offloading RWA. The team functionally supports these various programs.
  
  
**Analytics and liquidity**
In addition, we do CPM Analytics activities which involve RWA Variance analysis, Account Plan Tracking, CPM MI packs and OBL MI packs. The activities include the production and distribution of RWA Variance reports for CB and CIB, analyzing RWA movements and engaging with GAM’s directly on the reason for the Variance.
  
  
**SAG Reporting**
Monthly, Quarterly, Semi-Annual, and Annual performance of Regulatory and non-Regulatory reports.
  
  
Reaching out to in country RM to get clarity / Status of their clients.
  
  
Reaching out the Account manager and Account owners for Clarity on SAG accounts.
  
  
Helping the in-country team to keep track of various access and Client related information for SAG clients in System such as RV2.
  
  
**Financial Resources Management:**
To manage and execute Standard Chartered Bank’s (“SCB”) strategy for Financial Resource Management (“FRM”) in the business, across Corporate and Institutional Banking (“CIB”) and Wealth and Retail Banking (WRB). The role envisages driving financial resource optimisation for capital and liquidity for the designated balance sheet across CIB and WRB as well as the Group, with a view to achieve increased return on tangible equity (“RoTE”) and Economic Value Added (EVA) for the Bank.
  
  
International Balance Sheet Management (IBSM) function helps cross border deal booking to ensure Balance sheet optimization.
  
  
High-Priced Liabilities (HPL) and OPAC review for Liability optimization.
  
  
**Transaction Banking:**
CPM function to work on Trade optimization activities that largely include: RWA/Return Management, Trade Portfolio Management, Suboptimal Management
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategy**

* Support the delivery of strategic CPM reporting and analytics through accurate and timely management of OPAC and FTP reporting processes.
* Contribute to continuous process improvement by identifying opportunities for automation, data optimization, and reporting enhancements across CPM reporting activities.
* Support implementation and assessment of Model X enhancements by evaluating business impacts and providing analytical insights to stakeholders.

**Business**

* Help the team to pursue the strategic intent and agenda for CPM
* Enhance stakeholder experience by ensuring timely, accurate, and reliable delivery of management information, trackers, dashboards, and analytical reports.

**Processes**
**CEO CIB Office**
**Credit & Portfolio Management (CPM)
  
  

* Role requires to provide daily, real-time monitoring and governance of the end-to-end data process flow across interconnected system chain and perform ongoing validation checks, identifying anomalies at an early stage, coordinating investigations with relevant stakeholders, and ensuring timely resolution of data quality issues before they impact critical business processes.
* In addition, the resource would establish robust controls, monitoring routines, and escalation protocols to reduce the risk of future operational incidents report for both CIB and CB and analysing the reason for the RWA, FTP, OPAC and any other balance sheet related risk metric movement
* The role would provide a single point of accountability for cross-functional coordination, helping to bridge existing gaps between data producers and data consumers while improving transparency across the operating model. Development and maintenance of various CPM MI Dashboard like CPM MI, CG Simulation etc.

Candidate-in-role is expected to strengthen governance, accelerate issue resolution, review modelling and reporting outputs, and support the scalability of future business and regulatory initiatives.
  
  

* The role requires to design, establish, and maintain the end-to-end data linkage between the Bank’s Trade processing systems and Model X (SCB’s internal model to track Operational liabilities), ensuring that Small & Medium Enterprise activity is correctly identified, mapped, and incorporated into the modelling process.

title: Assistant Manager - Asset Management Performance Attribution Reporting
description:
**Position Overview**

The Validator acts as the independent quality, control, and risk assurance layer within the Asset Management Reporting lifecycle. The role ensures that all reports produced are technically accurate, conceptually sound, methodologically consistent, and compliant with internal standards, client requirements, and regulatory expectations before final release. The Validator is accountable for challenging outputs, validating assumptions, and preventing incorrect or misleading information from reaching clients or regulators.

**Job Responsibilities**

* **Direct Responsibilities:**
* Perform independent validation of reports produced by Processors, focusing on accuracy, completeness, consistency, and appropriateness.
* Review calculations, methodologies, disclosures, narratives, and trends across reporting periods.
* Execute second-level controls and formally evidence validation and sign-off.
* Ensure outputs align with documented procedures, regulatory guidance, and client expectations.
* **Contributing Responsibilities:**
* Challenge unusual movements, overrides, or explanations and ensure they are supported by facts and documentation.
* Identify systemic issues, recurring errors, or control weaknesses and escalate with root-cause analysis.
* Support internal audits, external audits, and regulatory reviews with clear explanations and evidence.
* Provide feedback and guidance to Processors to improve overall quality maturity.
* Contribute to strengthening control frameworks and standardization.

**Required Education, Skills and Experience (must have)**

* **Education:**
  Post Graduate degree in Finance.
* **Technical Skills:**
* Strong conceptual understanding of Asset Management Reporting (performance, holdings, regulatory disclosures).
* Ability to interpret and validate complex data flows across investment, accounting, pricing, and reference data domains.
* Solid knowledge of control frameworks, audit expectations, and risk management principles.
* Data validation and reconciliation techniques.
* Advanced Excel; familiarity with reporting platforms and databases.
* Understanding of asset management products and reporting methodologies.
* **Behavioral Skills:**
* Rigorous professional judgment and the ability to constructively challenge perspectives.
* Strong attention to detail combined with a big-picture understanding of reporting impact.
* Clear and structured written and verbal communication.
* Strong ownership mindset and accountability for quality and risk prevention.
* Ability to work under pressure during peak reporting cycles without compromising standards.
* Analytical thinking and risk awareness.

**Preferred Education, Skills and Experience (nice to have)**

* **Technical Knowledge:**
* Strong understanding of performance measurement and attribution methodologies (arithmetic and geometric approaches).
* Knowledge of key attribution models (e.g., Brinson-Fachler / Brinson-Hood-Beebower) including allocation, selection, and interaction effects.
* Familiarity with portfolio return calculations, benchmark comparison, and relative performance analysis.
* Ability to link performance drivers to investment decisions, market movements, and portfolio positioning.
* Experience working with holdings, transactions, benchmark data, pricing, and FX data.
* Understanding of multi-asset and multi-currency portfolios, including the impact of currency and derivative exposures.
* Familiarity with performance attribution tools/platforms and reporting systems.
* **Professional Experience:**
* Prior experience in Performance Attribution, Performance Measurement, or Investment Reporting roles is preferred.
* Equivalent professional experience in Asset Management Operations or Financial Reporting.

description:

You will bridge the gap between complex data analytics and client storytelling—equipping our global Sales and Account Management teams to bring deeper consultative value to every client conversation. title: SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) & Datasphere Platform and Operations Engineer
description:
**SAP Analytics Cloud & Datasphere Platform and Ops Engineer**

**Location: Chennai (Hybrid – 3 Days Office)**

This role leads the end-to-end integration architecture, security, performance, and reliability of live and acquired data flows between SAP S/4HANA, Datasphere, SAC, and external sources. The engineer defines standards, automates deployment and monitoring, and partners with security, network, and analytics teams to deliver trusted, governed, and performant data for reporting, planning, and advanced analytics.

**Main duties and responsibilities**

**The role will be responsible for the following activities:**

* Platform ownership: Lead the build and run of SAP Datasphere and SAC connectivity, data integration pipelines, and modelling standards.
* Architecture and design: Define integration patterns (live, federated, acquired), connectivity topologies (Cloud Connector, SDI/SDQ), and performance optimization (pushdown, caching).
* Security and compliance: Govern SSO/SAML, trusted connections, roles/authorizations, and data protection aligned to enterprise policies.
* Reliability and operations: Implement end-to-end monitoring, alerting, SLAs, runbooks, and incident/problem management for connectors, agents, and data pipelines.
* Collaboration and leadership: Partner with SAP functional teams, data/analytics, network/security, and business stakeholders; mentor engineers and enforce standards.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams, contributing to the solution design and integration of SAC and Datasphere in end-to-end business processes.

**Essential requirements**

* Degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics or a comparable degree.
* Overall, 8-10 years of experience and at least 2-3 years’ experience working on SAP SAC / Datasphere solutions as a platform engineer / platform owner or relevant role.
* Proven experience designing and implementing solutions utilizing SAC for planning,forecasting, and KPI reporting, as well as integrating with SAP Datasphere and upstream processes.
* Platform engineering and modelling: Lead Datasphere space/design modelling (semantic, fact/dimension, associations, hierarchies, measures) with strong performance optimization, cost control, and pipeline orchestration (federation, query pushdown).
* SAC solutions and usability: Deliver high-quality SAC stories, input templates, Analytics Designer apps, and guided workflows, emphasizing usability, governance, and performance; manage live/import models and secure refresh scheduling.
* Enterprise connectivity and security: Own live/acquired connectivity across S/4HANA, Datasphere, and non-SAP sources using Cloud Connector, Destination service, OData/JDBC, SDI/SDQ, remote tables; enforce SSO/SAML, trusted connections, RBAC, and compliance.
* Operations, monitoring, and resilience: Establish observability (health checks, alerts), error handling, auto-recovery, and SLA-driven operations; optimize performance via partitioning, caching, and connectivity tuning.
* Governance and quality assurance: Define standards, naming conventions, data lineage, Data products and catalogue/metadata; drive testing (strategy, UAT, performance), defect management, and produce architecture/design documentation, runbooks, and user guides.
* DevOps and lifecycle management: Manage environment promotion (dev/test/prod), transport/deployment tooling, dependencies, and release readiness; oversee incident, problem, and change management.
* Stakeholder engagement and troubleshooting: Translate senior stakeholder requirements, prioritize value, and drive adoption; perform root-cause analysis across network/security/SAP basis/Datasphere/SAC with strong communication and diagnostic skills.
* SAP Coordination: Manage SAP OSS notes, service requests, and vendor engagements; evaluate and roll out feature packs and roadmap items.
* FinOps and cost optimization: Implement cloud cost governance for Datasphere and SAC, including usage analytics, right‑sizing, tagging/chargeback, budget forecasting, and cost guardrails; drive performance-to-cost optimization.
* License management and entitlement governance: Administer SAC license allocations (BI, Planning) and Datasphere capacity; monitor active vs dormant users, reclaim and reassign entitlements, ensure compliance with contract terms, and report license utilization and optimization opportunities to leadership.
* Excellent communication skills and ability to work in an Agile environment.

* Stakeholder Engagement: Communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and executives in a clear and concise manner. Act as a trusted advisor to the business on automation strategy and best practices.

* Provide architecture direction across multiple strategic engagements, workstreams, regions, or accounts, raising consistency, quality, and reuse without direct people-management accountability.
* Govern architecture quality, scalability, maintainability, security, interoperability, production readiness, and alignment to measurable customer outcomes.
* Define and govern repeatable validation approaches for complex operational scenarios, including KPI validation, day-in-the-life workflows, edge cases, acceptance criteria, and value realization.
* Shape architecture principles and governance for AI and advanced analytics, ensuring safe, scalable, grounded, and value-led adoption.
* Synthesize recurring customer requirements, architecture constraints, product gaps, and emerging industry needs into evidence-based Product, Portfolio, R&D, and FDE leadership recommendations.
* Convert strategic engagement learning into reusable reference architectures, Industry Accelerators, functional models, governance methods, and productization opportunities.
* Coach and develop senior Solution Architects and technical contributors, strengthening architecture capability and professional standards across the FDE community.
* Influence portfolio direction and policy discussions while escalating final investment, organizational, and enterprise-policy decisions to the appropriate leadership owners.

**Essential Skills:**

* Typically 12-16 years of relevant experience, or equivalent demonstrated capability in enterprise architecture, industrial transformation, strategic solution delivery, or related disciplines.
* Senior-principal individual contributor and recognized authority in enterprise-scale industrial solution architecture.
* Deep expertise in industrial operating models, workflows, transformation priorities, and one or more strategic industries.
* Proven ability to resolve unprecedented, highly ambiguous, and multidimensional architecture challenges.
* Enterprise architecture capability across AVEVA products, industrial data, OT/IT systems, cloud, integrations, security, AI, and complementary technologies.
* Strong KPI and value-realization expertise, including baselines, measurable outcomes, value hypotheses, and impact assessment.
* Executive advisory and influencing capability with senior customer, operational, architecture, Product, Portfolio, R&D, and FDE stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to set architecture principles, governance, standards, reference patterns, and reusable accelerator models across customers or regions.
* Broad AVEVA portfolio knowledge and the judgment to identify capability gaps, reuse opportunities, product implications, and strategic trade-offs.
* Define and Design AI Agents, Skills corresponding to domain skills
* Strong understanding of industrial data and integration ecosystems, including SCADA, historians, MES, EAM/CMMS, ERP, cloud, edge, security, and interoperability.
* Proven ability to coach senior architects and raise architecture quality through influence rather than direct people-management authority.
* Evidence of shaping Product, Portfolio, R&D, or FDE priorities through synthesized customer and industry insight.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Enterprise and portfolio-level FDE architecture standards, governance, reusable models, and accelerator patterns are adopted across strategic engagements.
* Senior customer and internal stakeholders receive credible architecture guidance on transformation pathways, operating-model implications, trade-offs, and long-term solution direction.

title: IT&D Manager, Solution Architect
description:
We are Reckitt
  
  
Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose. Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.
  
  
Information Technology & Digital
  
  
In IT and D, you'll be a force for good, whether you're championing cyber security, defining how we harness the power of technology to improve our business, or working with data to guide the innovation of consumer loved products.
  
  
Working globally across functions, you'll own your projects and process from start to finish, with the influence and visibility to achieve what needs to be done. And if you're willing to bring your ideas to the table, you'll get the support and investment to make them happen.
  
  
Your potential will never be wasted. You'll get the space and support to take your development to the next level. Every day, there will be opportunities to learn from peers and leaders through working on exciting, varied projects with real impact. And because our work spans so many different businesses, from Research and Product Development to Sales, you'll keep learning exciting new approaches.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a Manager, Solution Architect, who will play a key role in the delivery and operating of the Architecture Community of Practice and our modern Architecture Ways of Working, establishing a true “Architecture as a Strategy” culture and mindset. They will drive change activity across the enterprise’s technology and process landscape and will proactively lead the alignment to Reckitt’s Architecture Principles and Standards.
  
  
Your responsibilities
  
  

* The role will act as a key transformation agent for Reckitt. She/he will be a driving force embedding our operating model, and empowering IT&D teams with the tools, artefacts, support network and ways of working to minimise unnecessary architecture handoffs.
* Creating solution designs that will meet business requirements, integrating the chosen technology solution into Reckitt’s landscape. Guide and define how non-functional requirements should be met. Driving the use and adoption of Reckitt platform services and correct use patterns (data, integrations etc).
* Partner with Infrastructure Architects where hosting or integration is required to Cloud, Datacentre or local sites is required, ensuring compliant and secure solutions.
* Responsible the quality of solution designs and associated output. Responsible to ensure adherence to best practices, technical standards. Provide solution architecture assurance during delivery.
* Create and updates TAS documents & provide support through Technical Review Board (TRB) process.
* Review and input into RFPs providing and assessing on technical requirements and questions. Conduct vendor and solution searches for input into RFP or roadmap.
* Provide technical advisory services to capability and IMEX teams, assisting them to align to patterns, standards and other associated reference architecture.
* Identifying enhancements and updating Architecture Reference document (Patterns, Standards and Decision Trees) as required.
* Collaborate with project teams, ensuring strategic alignment and adherence to Reckitt’s architecture principles and standards.
* Partner with platform teams and associated Enterprise Architects to ensure that patterns and roadmap architecture is embedded into approach and designs.

The experience we're looking for
  
  

* Experience as Solution Architect and subject matter expert within a Technology or Business domain.
* Strong knowledge of the technologies and architectures associated with digital transformation.
* Pragmatic approach with good understanding of how to manage constraints and conflicting priorities.
* She/he should be highly motivated with excellent analysis, execution, and communication skills, who can collaborate with technical and business stakeholders.
* A strong influencer, communicator and storyteller, with the ability to make complex technical information simple and accessible for non-technical audiences
* Understanding of architectural approaches, models and frameworks, such as TOGAF, with proven track record of producing enterprise level technology artefacts to support business and technology design decisions.
* Strong Technology expertise in Core IT domains or relevant Functional domains.
* Experience in the creation, management and driving the adoption of reference architecture.

The skills for success
  
  
Product Development, system development, Project Management, Programme Management, Design Thinking, Process Automisation, IT Service Management, Innovation Processes, Innovation, User Experience Design, Change Analyst, Change Management, Digital Transformation, Value Analysis, Change Management, Adoption, Technology Adoption Lifecycle, Stakeholder Relationship Management, Vendor Management, Outstanding Communication, stakeholder engagement, Digital Strategy, Product Solution Architecture, Cyber Security Strategy, Cyber Security, Data Privacy, Portfolio Management, Data Governance, Product Compliance, Media Analytics, advertising, Consumer Engagement, Market Value, Market Chain, Data Driven Practices, Advanced Analytics, Data Analytics, Governance.
  
  
What we offer
  
  
With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way. We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.
  
  
Equality
  
  
We recognise that in real life, great people don't always 'tick all the boxes'. That's why we hire for potential as well as experience. Even if you don't meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability or medical condition; colour, ethnicity, race, citizenship, and national origin; religion, faith; pregnancy, family status and caring responsibilities; sexual orientation; sex, gender identity, gender expression, and transgender identity; protected veteran status; size or any other basis protected by appropriate law.

title: Director - Enterprise Architecture
description:
**The Opportunity**
The Director Enterprise Architecture is responsible for the Asia architecture direction and roadmap, with emphasis on cloud-native platforms, microservices, APIs, event-driven architecture, DevSecOps and pragmatic modernization of mainframe and legacy estates. Guided by our purpose – always with you building a more confident future – and our New Frontier strategy focused on stronger growth, attractive returns and all-weather performance, this is an exciting opportunity which includes Architecture ownership, decision rights, roadmaps and priorities are understood across the assigned scope.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Architecture strategy & modernization. Set the Asia architecture direction and roadmap, with emphasis on cloud-native platforms, microservices, APIs, event-driven architecture, DevSecOps and pragmatic modernization of mainframe and legacy estates.
* Solution & platform leadership. Guide architecture decisions across major customer, distribution and servicing platforms, including Genesys Cloud CX, NICE CXone, Salesforce, mainframe ecosystems and regional integration services.
* Governance & assurance. Own design quality, operational readiness and AARB/GARB preparation, including pre-review, decision-ready submissions, presentation, risk and exception management, and closure of governance actions.
* People & capability leadership. Build, coach and retain a high-performing architecture team through clear accountabilities, performance management, career development, succession planning, reusable patterns and communities of practice.
* Delivery & stakeholder alignment. Partner with Product and Engineering leaders to maintain the architecture runway, remove cross-team barriers and communicate technology choices, risks, cost and business implications to senior management.
* Security, resilience & responsible AI. Ensure architectures meet expectations for identity, privacy, security, availability, observability, disaster recovery, supportability, cost and responsible use of AI.

**Required Qualification**

* Architecture leadership. Typically 10+ years of technology experience, including 5+ years leading people, architecture teams or complex technical programs across multiple applications and platforms.
* Modern architecture. Strong experience with cloud-native solutions, microservices, event-driven systems, APIs, containers/Kubernetes, managed cloud services, DevSecOps, CI/CD, infrastructure as code and observability.
* Integration & legacy modernization. Experience integrating SaaS and digital platforms with mainframe or other systems of record through APIs, events, middleware, batch/MFT and data-integration patterns.
* Insurance / BFSI. Demonstrated domain expertise in insurance or broader BFSI, with an understanding of regulated customer journeys, policy administration, distribution, contact-centre operations, data protection, resilience and auditability.
* Leadership & influence. Proven people leadership and strong communication, consultation, presentation and stakeholder-management skills in distributed onshore and offshore environments.
* Mandatory. Microsoft Certified: Agentic AI Business Solutions Architect Expert, Exam AB-100. The credential should be active at appointment or completed within an agreed onboarding period.
* Valued. GitHub Copilot Certification, Exam GH-300; Microsoft Azure Solutions Architect Expert; or additional Microsoft credentials in Azure AI, Microsoft Foundry, AI engineering, MLOps, GenAIOps, responsible AI or AI security.

**Preferred Experience**

* Identity architecture. IAM and CIAM capabilities such as Microsoft Entra ID, Ping Identity, SSO/federation, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SAML, MFA, RBAC/ABAC, PAM, identity lifecycle governance and workload identity.
* Asia and Japan. Experience leading architecture across Japan and other Asia markets; business-level Japanese and English communication is strongly preferred for Japan-facing responsibilities, with additional Asia language capability advantageous.
* Enterprise leadership. Experience with SAFe, platform rationalization, vendor/SaaS due diligence, FinOps, technology risk, resilience engineering, contact-centre AI and AI-assisted software delivery.

title: Lead Architect/Senior Associate Director
description:
Some careers shine brighter than others.
  
  
If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
  
  
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Sr. Associate Director, Solution Architecture
  
  
Ready to set the architecture direction for HSBC’s CTO Platforms domain?
  
  
Why HSBC
  
  
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world’s most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do.
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
Join CTO Platforms to shape the architectural direction for a value stream or domain within a large regulated bank. This role sets target and transition architectures and keeps delivery aligned to reference architectures, standards and guardrails. You’ll represent architecture in governance and Design Authority forums, presenting options and trade-offs and helping decisions land clearly. The role also focuses on cross-programme dependencies and early risk identification so delivery stays coherent across teams. You’ll influence strategic initiatives including Compass and the AI/GenAI agenda by promoting shared platforms and governed capabilities. Success looks like simpler, reusable and well-controlled technology outcomes that engineering teams can deliver with clarity and pace.
  
  
What you'll be doing
  
  

* Set architectural direction for an assigned value stream or domain aligned to target architecture, reference architectures, standards and guardrails
* Produce and maintain target and transition architectures with clear sequencing, dependencies, decision points and interim guardrails
* Represent architecture in governance and Design Authority forums, presenting options, trade-offs, recommendations and exception impacts
* Identify and manage cross-programme architectural dependencies, risks and constraints and escalate early to support timely decisions
* Embed alignment to Group architecture strategy and standards including Build vs Buy, reuse, simplification and control-by-design
* Shape architectural direction for strategic R&C initiatives including Compass and the AI/GenAI agenda to converge on shared platforms and governed capabilities
* Translate architectural direction into solution designs with engineering teams using patterns, non-functional requirements and guardrails to maintain delivery alignment
* Strengthen solution architecture capability across engineering through coaching, quality reviews and communities of practice

What we're looking for
  
  

* Bring extensive experience as a solution, domain or enterprise architect in a large complex and regulated organisation
* Demonstrate defining target-state architectures and translating them into transition states, roadmaps and decision frameworks
* Show strong experience reviewing solution designs and articulating options, trade-offs and recommendations based on evidence and standards
* Apply broad understanding of modern application, integration, data and cloud architectures including APIs, event-driven patterns, microservices, CI/CD and operational non-functional requirements
* Embed security, resilience, privacy, records management and auditability requirements into designs and delivery workflows
* Apply Build vs Buy, reuse, simplification and technology rationalisation including assessing Low-Code/No-Code and third-party options
* Use working knowledge of AI and GenAI architecture including responsible adoption, platform integration, data and knowledge foundations, governance, monitoring and evidence
* Operate effectively in senior governance forums and across geographically distributed teams with clear stakeholder management and influencing
* Communicate complex technology choices clearly through concise architecture artefacts for business and technology audiences

Building coherent platforms at scale
  
  
If you want to shape how platforms evolve across a complex environment this role offers the scope to make a visible difference. You’ll help teams converge on shared architectures that are easier to deliver, operate and govern. You’ll bring clarity to decisions that cut across programmes and turn architectural intent into practical delivery guardrails. If this aligns with the work you want to do next we’d welcome your application.
  
  
You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.
  
  
www.hsbc.com/careers
  
  
HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.”

title: Enterprise Architect - Citrix Job
description:
YASH Technologies is a leading technology integrator specializing in helping clients reimagine operating models, enhance competitiveness, optimize costs, foster exceptional stakeholder experiences, and drive business transformation.
  
  
At YASH, we’re a cluster of the brightest stars working with cutting-edge technologies. Our purpose is anchored in a single truth – bringing real positive changes in an increasingly virtual world and it drives us beyond generational gaps and disruptions of the future.
  
  
**We are looking forward to hire Citrix Professionals in the following areas :**
Citrix Product Owner
  
  
**Job Description**
**Job Summary**
The Citrix Product Owner is a position within the Charles River Laboratories Global Technology organization responsible for owning, governing, and continuously improving the enterprise Citrix service across virtual applications, virtual desktops, and secure remote access.
  
  
This role blends product ownership accountability with service management and project/program execution, ensuring Citrix capabilities are well-defined, prioritized, reliable, secure, and aligned with business requirements. The role serves as the central point of coordination between Citrix engineering and support teams, infrastructure, application owners, security, compliance, vendors, and business stakeholders.
  
  
The scope covers Citrix services supporting global business operations across data centers, branch offices, and public cloud environments. The Product Owner is accountable for service outcomes, roadmap, and priorities, with technical implementation and daily administration delivered through engineering and support teams.
  
  
**Duties And Responsibilities**

* Serve as the leader for the global Citrix service, accountable for its vision, business value, service performance, and continuous improvement.
* Define, maintain, and evolve the Citrix strategy and multi-year roadmap, balancing business requirements, user experience, security, cost, and technical feasibility.
* Act as the voice of the customer, translating business and application requirements into clear, prioritized capabilities for virtual application delivery, virtual desktops, and secure access.
* Own and actively manage the Citrix backlog, including service enhancements, recurring incident remediation, platform upgrades, automation, capacity improvements, and technical debt.
* Define the Citrix service catalog, supported use cases, service boundaries, ownership model, and support responsibilities across internal teams and external providers.
* Partner with Citrix architects, engineers, and application owners to establish platform standards, validate solution designs, and ensure applications are suitable for delivery through the Citrix environment.
* Govern the lifecycle of applicable Citrix components, including Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops, Citrix DaaS, Workspace, StoreFront, Delivery Controllers, Cloud Connectors, Virtual Delivery Agents, provisioning services, and NetScaler Gateway.
* Coordinate dependencies across compute, virtualization, storage, networking, identity, DNS, certificates, databases, endpoint devices, and public cloud services.
* Establish and review service-level objectives and SLAs for availability, support responsiveness, application access, session reliability, and user experience.
* Measure and report on service health, including login duration, application launch success, connection failures, session responsiveness, capacity utilization, incident trends, and user satisfaction.

**About the Role**

We are a stealth-mode managed services organization delivering enterprise-grade infrastructure services to SMB and large enterprise customers. We are looking for an experienced
**Windows Architect – Datacenter Infrastructure**
to design, standardize, secure, and operate large-scale Windows environments across multiple datacenter locations.

This role requires deep hands-on expertise in Windows Server, Active Directory, Hyper-V virtualization, security hardening, and enterprise infrastructure operations, along with strong architectural and leadership capabilities.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Windows Infrastructure Architecture and Design**

* Architect scalable, secure, and highly available Windows Server platforms for datacenter environments
* Design and standardize solutions for Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, IIS, File and Print services, and Microsoft System Center components
* Define architecture standards, naming conventions, build documents, and configuration baselines

**Active Directory Architecture and Governance**

* Design and manage multi-domain, multi-site Active Directory forests
* Govern FSMO roles, schema updates, trust relationships, replication topology, and domain security
* Define and enforce OU design, GPO strategy, delegation models, and domain-wide policies
* Ensure Active Directory security, monitoring, compliance, and disaster recovery readiness

**Virtualization and Cluster Management (Hyper-V)**

* Architect and manage Hyper-V clusters, high availability, and resource pools
* Oversee VM lifecycle management including provisioning, scaling, upgrades, and optimization
* Lead Hyper-V migrations, platform upgrades, replication strategies, and storage integrations (iSCSI / FC)
* Ensure resilient configurations for NIC teaming, NLB, and cluster networking

**Security, Patch, and Compliance Management**

* Define and enforce Windows server hardening standards and secure configuration baselines
* Govern OS patching and vulnerability remediation using WSUS, SCCM, BigFix, or similar tools
* Manage enterprise endpoint protection and ensure continuous threat monitoring

**Monitoring, Capacity Planning, and Performance Engineering**

* Architect monitoring and alerting frameworks using SCOM, Nagios, Zabbix, ManageEngine, or similar tools
* Drive capacity planning, forecasting, and performance tuning for Windows and AD infrastructure
* Produce regular health checks, performance reports, and growth projections

**Incident, Problem, and Change Management**

* Lead resolution of critical P1 and P2 Windows and Active Directory incidents
* Perform root cause analysis and drive long-term stability improvements
* Govern change management processes including planning, approvals, implementation, and documentation

**Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity**

* Design and maintain disaster recovery strategies for Active Directory, Hyper-V, File Services, and core Windows platforms
* Conduct regular DR drills, backup validation, and recovery testing to ensure readiness

**Collaboration, Projects, and Technical Leadership**

* Lead large-scale infrastructure deployments, migrations, transformations, and datacenter transitions
* Collaborate with Network, Security, Cloud, Storage, and Application teams to deliver integrated solutions
* Mentor Windows engineers and establish best practices across teams

**Cross-Platform and Cloud Exposure**

* Exposure to Azure or GCP cloud environments and hybrid identity solutions (Azure AD Connect)
* Experience working with remote datacenter operations and integrated network and storage platforms

**Required Experience and Skills**

* 12–16+ years of enterprise experience in Windows Server and Active Directory administration
* Strong hands-on and architectural experience in datacenter environments
* Deep expertise in Windows Server 2012/2016/2019/2022, Active Directory, GPO, DNS, DHCP, Hyper-V, clustering
* Strong understanding of ITIL-based service operations

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field
* Certifications preferred: MCSE, MCSA, Azure Administrator or Architect, ITIL

**Preferred Skills**

* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills in large-scale distributed environments
* Experience with automation and scripting using PowerShell
* Excellent documentation, communication, and stakeholder coordination skills

**Why Join Us**

* Work on complex, enterprise-scale datacenter environments
* High-ownership role within a growing managed services organization
* Opportunity to influence infrastructure standards and architecture decisions
* Competitive compensation aligned with experience and impact

title: Principal Consultant
description:
**What will you be responsible for?**
As a Route/Switch Implementation Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, deploying, and modernizing enterprise network infrastructure across a large-scale, highly available environment. You will lead the implementation of routing, switching, and SD-WAN solutions that support critical business, clinical, and technology operations.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities Include**

* Building and deploying network infrastructure for new enterprise locations and business initiatives.
* Migrating legacy environments to modern routing, switching, and SD-WAN architectures and standards.
* Supporting network integration activities related to mergers, acquisitions, and organizational expansion.
* Implementing connectivity for applications, vendors, clinical systems, cloud services, and other technology platforms.
* Configuring, validating, and optimizing enterprise routing and switching environments.
* Leading network deployment activities from planning through implementation, testing, documentation, and operational handoff.
* Troubleshooting complex routing, switching, SD-WAN, application connectivity, and network performance issues.
* Performing root-cause analysis using packet captures, protocol analysis, network telemetry, and troubleshooting tools.
* Collaborating with network security, infrastructure, application, and architecture teams to deliver resilient and scalable solutions.
* Creating and maintaining implementation plans, network diagrams, configuration standards, operating procedures, and technical documentation.
* Ensuring compliance with change management, operational governance, and enterprise architecture standards.
* Supporting operational readiness activities and successful transition of deployed solutions to support teams.

**How would your day look like?**
A typical day will involve planning and executing infrastructure deployments while partnering with multiple stakeholders to ensure reliable and secure network connectivity across the enterprise.
  
  
**You Will**

* Participate in project planning, design reviews, and implementation readiness activities for network deployments and modernization initiatives.
* Configure and deploy enterprise routing, switching, SD-WAN, and data center networking solutions.
* Collaborate with application teams, vendors, security engineers, architects, and infrastructure teams to enable business and clinical connectivity requirements.
* Implement routing protocols, VLANs, switching policies, and network segmentation solutions.
* Validate network changes through testing, failover verification, performance analysis, and connectivity assessments.
* Troubleshoot routing, switching, SD-WAN, and application communication issues across complex enterprise environments.
* Analyze traffic flows, asymmetric routing conditions, and network performance challenges to identify and resolve root causes.
* Develop implementation plans, maintenance procedures, change records, and technical documentation.
* Execute scheduled production changes and network migrations following established change-management processes.
* Conduct post-implementation reviews and provide knowledge transfer to operational support teams.

**Who are we looking for?**
We are seeking mid-to-senior-level, hands-on implementation engineers with strong experience deploying and troubleshooting enterprise routing, switching, and SD-WAN technologies. This role is best suited for individuals with proven implementation expertise rather than experience that is primarily focused on architecture, monitoring, ticket escalation, or operational support.
  
  
**Required Qualifications**

* 8-12+ years of hands-on enterprise network engineering experience, with demonstrated ownership of large-scale implementation, migration, modernization, and integration projects in complex, 24x7 enterprise environments.
* 5+ years of hands-on network engineering experience supporting large, complex, 24x7 enterprise environments.
* Experience leading end-to-end network deployment projects, including:

+ Greenfield site implementations
+ Legacy-site modernization and technology refresh initiatives
+ Mergers and acquisitions integrations
+ Application, vendor, and business connectivity deployments

* Strong troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills involving:

+ Routing and switching technologies
+ Application connectivity issues
+ Network performance optimization
+ Traffic flow and asymmetric routing analysis
+ Packet capture and protocol analysis

* Experience working within structured change-management and documentation processes.
* Ability to create implementation plans, network diagrams, configuration documentation, operating procedures, and operational handoff materials.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills with the ability to work effectively across technical and business teams.

**Technical Expertise Required**
Expert hands-on experience with Cisco enterprise routing and switching platforms, including:
  
  

* Cisco IOS
* Cisco IOS-XE
* Cisco NX-OS
* Cisco Catalyst
* Cisco Nexus

**Strong Knowledge Of Enterprise Networking Technologies, Including**

* Border Gateway Protocol (BGP)
* Enhanced Interior Gateway Routing Protocol (EIGRP)
* Open Shortest Path First (OSPF)
* Virtual LANs (VLANs) and trunking
* Spanning Tree Protocol (STP)
* Multilayer switching
* Virtual Extensible LAN (VXLAN)

**Hands-on Implementation Experience With Several Of The Following**

* Cisco Application Centric Infrastructure (ACI)
* Cisco DNA Center / Catalyst Center
* Aruba EdgeConnect SD-WAN
* VMware NSX
* Cisco Nexus 9000 Series
* Cisco Nexus 7000 Series
* Cisco Nexus 5000 Series
* Cisco Nexus 2000 Series

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting healthcare organizations or similarly complex, highly regulated enterprise environments.
* Experience implementing large-scale data center, campus, branch, and SD-WAN transformation initiatives.
* Demonstrated ability to work directly with customers, vendors, architects, security teams, application owners, and infrastructure teams to deliver successful network deployments.
