title: Senior Hardware System Architect |10-15 | Hyderabad
description:
We are looking for a senior system architect who owns complete electronic system architecture studies,

covering both hardware and software. You will translate customer and programme requirements into

validated architectures spanning RF, communication, digital, DSP, control and power subsystems, and

hand them over to our board, FPGA and embedded teams with clear, traceable specifications. You will

be accountable for architecture decisions, the quantitative evidence behind them, and their performance

once built.

Key Responsibilities

• Own end-to-end electronic system architecture studies for communication, defence and high-

performance computing systems, from requirements capture through to architecture baseline and

handover.

• Define functional, logical and physical architectures, HW/SW partitioning, interface definitions and

interface control documents, using model-based systems engineering (SysML) with requirements

traceability.

• Build and run system-level models in MathWorks (MATLAB/Simulink) and VisualSim to analyse

RF link budgets, noise and linearity, DSP algorithm performance, control loop behaviour, latency,

throughput and power.

• Evaluate architecture options against quantified criteria (performance, size, weight, power, cost,

reliability, thermal, manufacturability) and document trade-off decisions and their rationale.

• Define FPGA and SoC architectures and partitioning, and assess implementation feasibility with

Xilinx (AMD) Vivado, covering resource utilisation, timing closure risk and IP selection.

• Specify the RF, digital, embedded and power subsystems for the board-level design teams, and

review schematics and layouts for conformance to the architecture.

• Define embedded and system software architecture, including device drivers, middleware and real-

time behaviour, and review C/C++ implementations against timing and resource budgets.

• Plan verification and validation end to end, including test-bench and hardware-in-the-loop

strategies, bring-up plans and acceptance criteria.

• Lead architecture and design reviews, technical risk assessments and mitigation plans, and

communicate trade-offs clearly to customers and programme leadership.

• Prepare technical proposals, feasibility studies and solution presentations for defence,

communication and computing customers.

• Mentor design and systems engineers and set architecture standards, modelling practices and

reuse guidelines across projects.

Required Qualifications and Skills

• B.E./B.Tech in Electronics & Communication, Electrical, or a related engineering discipline. A

Master's degree or equivalent in RF, communications, signal processing or systems engineering is

preferred.

• 10 years or more of experience in electronic systems engineering, including at least 5 years

leading system or hardware architecture for RF, communication, digital or power systems that

have progressed to production or flight/field deployment.

• Demonstrated ownership of complete system architectures spanning hardware and software, with

documented trade-off analyses and quantified performance evidence.

• Strong RF system knowledge: transceiver architectures, link budgets, noise figure and linearity

budgets, mmWave and 5G concepts, antennas, filters and amplifiers at system level.

• Strong DSP and communications knowledge: modulation and demodulation, filtering, FFT-based

processing, synchronisation, channel coding, and performance analysis.

• Digital and high-speed interface knowledge: FPGA and SoC architecture, and protocols such as

PCIe, DDR, JESD204, Ethernet and VMEbus.

• Control and power system knowledge: control loop design and stability, SMPS and power

architecture, power sequencing, and power budgeting and thermal considerations.

• Hands-on proficiency with MathWorks MATLAB and Simulink for system modelling and simulation.

• Working proficiency with VisualSim for architecture modelling and performance analysis.

• Working proficiency with Xilinx (AMD) Vivado Design Suite for FPGA architecture feasibility,

implementation and timing analysis.

• Programming skills in C, C++ and Python, including scripting for model automation and data

analysis.

• Practical SysML modelling experience (SysML v1 or v2) and model-based systems engineering

practice.

• Software environments: Linux, real-time operating systems, version control (Git) and requirements

or issue tracking (e.g., Jira).

• Working familiarity with EDA tools such as Cadence Allegro or OrCAD, sufficient to review board

designs against the architecture.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present architecture trade-offs to

both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience on defence, aerospace or communication programmes, including exposure to MIL-

STD-461 (EMI/EMC) and MIL-STD-810 (environmental) requirements.

• Experience with software-defined radio, radar, electronic warfare, satellite or wireless

communication systems.

• Certification in systems engineering (e.g., INCOSE CSEP) or formal MBSE training.

• Familiarity with thermal modelling, RF calibration or power optimisation for energy-efficient

designs.

• Exposure to Agile methods in hardware and systems development.

• Experience with Dassault Systèmes or Cadence model-based design and simulation ecosystems.

title: Senior Principal - Platform Architect WiFi
description:
Business Introduction
  
  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
  
  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
  
  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The Platform Architect owns the technical design of GSK's enterprise wireless platform, defining the reference architectures, patterns and standards that make solutions secure, scalable and consistent, and guiding engineering teams in applying them. The role provides design assurance across the platform's services, architects for reliability and resilience rather than treating them as later additions, and designs AI into the platform through reference patterns for AI-assisted delivery and intelligent operations.
  
  
The role sets standards and assures designs; it does not build. Engineering delivery sits with the platform engineering teams, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, domain target architecture and the architecture team sit with the Platform Architecture Director, and enterprise-level standards sit with Enterprise Architecture. Solution designs for major cross-domain initiatives sit with the Solution Architect in Enterprise Architecture.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Define reference architectures, patterns and standards for the platform, aligned to DPTF strategy and to enterprise architecture.
* Design AI into the platform, producing reference patterns for AI-assisted delivery and for intelligent, self-healing operations.
* Architect for reliability and resilience by design, so that platform SLOs and error budgets are achievable rather than aspirational.
* Provide design assurance and technical guidance to engineering teams, reviewing designs against the standards before build rather than after.
* Ensure platform solutions are secure and compliant, including GxP requirements where the platform supports regulated activity.
* Evaluate and introduce new technologies, measuring the result against architecture OKRs rather than adopting on vendor claim.
* Set architecture standards that supplier and managed-service solutions must meet, and assure their designs to the same bar as internal work.
* Partner with Enterprise Architecture and Information Security on standards, roadmaps and exceptions.
* Increase pattern reuse across the platform, tracking where teams have adopted a pattern and where they have diverged and why.
* Reduce rework by intervening early in design, and evidence the reduction rather than asserting it.
* Advise the Product Owner and Platform Manager on the architectural consequence of roadmap choices, including technical debt being accepted.
* Hold the boundaries with the Platform Architecture Director on domain target architecture, the Solution Architect on cross-domain initiative designs, and the engineering teams on build.

**Education & Professional Qualifications**

* Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e.g., Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems).
* Architecture certifications desirable (e.g., TOGAF, or recognised cloud or network architecture certification relevant to the platform).

**Area of Specialisation**

* Platform architecture in the relevant domain, covering reference architecture, patterns, standards and design assurance.
* Security and resilience by design, including AI reference patterns and GxP considerations where applicable.

**Why is this level of Education Required?**

* Deep architecture credentials are needed because the role sets the standards that engineering teams and suppliers must build to, and those standards have to withstand security, compliance and reliability challenge.

**Experience Required**

* Overall, 15 years and typically 6-8 years in technology architecture or senior engineering, including at least three years producing reference architectures or standards others build to.
* Deep hands-on depth in the relevant platform domain, whether cloud, network or digital workplace.
* Experience running design assurance or architecture review, including declining designs that did not meet the standard.
* Track record of architecting for reliability and resilience, working to SLOs and error budgets.
* Experience designing secure and compliant solutions, ideally including GxP or another regulated context.
* Experience setting architecture standards that supplier or managed-service solutions had to meet.
* Awareness of AI reference patterns for assisted delivery and intelligent operations.
* Extensive experience designing enterprise wireless services across complex campus environments.
* Deep knowledge of radio frequency design, capacity, roaming, guest access and wireless security.
* Evidence of defining wireless architectures that improved coverage, user experience, resilience or operational efficiency.

**Desirable Requirements**

* Advanced wireless certification, such as Certified Wireless Network Expert.
* Experience with Cisco Catalyst, Meraki or Juniper Mist wireless platforms.
* Experience supporting location services, Internet of Things or operational technology wireless use cases.

**Other Job-Related Skills/Background**

* Ability to influence engineering teams without line authority, so that patterns are adopted rather than circumvented.
* Judgement about when to grant an architectural exception and when to hold the standard.
* Clear design documentation, since patterns are only reusable if others can follow them.
* Comfort challenging vendor claims and evaluating technology on measured outcome.
* Pragmatism about technical debt, making the cost visible rather than blocking delivery outright.
* Collaborative habit with Enterprise Architecture and Security, whose standards constrain the platform.

**Skills**
Automation Technology, Cisco IP, Cloud Based Services, Computer Programming, Configuration Management (CM), Design Assurance, GxPs, IP Address Management (IPAM), Juniper MX, Load Balancers, Network Design, Operational Technology (OT), Packet Switching, RF Design, Security Engineering, Software-Defined Networking Wide Area Network (SD-WAN), System Monitors, Wireless Architecture, Wireless System Design, Zero Trust Architecture
  
  
**Why GSK?**
**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**
GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

**Job Description – AI/ML Lead Engineer**

**Location:**
Hyderabad

**Experience:**
6–12 Years

**Organization:**
ValueMomentum – Advanced Analytics Technology Solution Center

About ValueMomentum

ValueMomentum's Advanced Analytics Technology Solution Center focuses on strengthening AI, Machine Learning, and Enterprise Analytics capabilities within the Property & Casualty (P&C) Insurance domain.

The team develops innovative AI-driven solutions across Underwriting, Claims, Distribution, and Enterprise IT, combining Machine Learning, Generative AI, Knowledge Engineering, and Cloud technologies to solve complex business challenges.

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced
**AI/ML Lead Engineer**
with strong expertise in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Generative AI, and Data Engineering to design, develop, and deploy scalable, production-ready AI solutions.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience building end-to-end AI/ML applications, developing LLM-based solutions, implementing RAG architectures, and operationalizing ML models using cloud platforms and MLOps practices.

The role requires strong engineering fundamentals, system design capabilities, and the ability to translate business requirements into reliable enterprise AI solutions.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Machine Learning Engineering**

* Design, develop, train, and optimize ML models for business use cases such as fraud detection, risk scoring, claims prediction, and document classification.
* Implement feature engineering, model evaluation, and optimization techniques.
* Work with supervised and unsupervised learning, NLP, and deep learning models.
* Ensure model accuracy, scalability, reliability, and performance in production environments.

**2. Generative AI & LLM Engineering**

* Develop production-grade Generative AI applications using Large Language Models (LLMs).
* Build Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines using embeddings, vector databases, and semantic search.
* Implement Agentic AI solutions using frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, or AutoGen.
* Develop prompt engineering and context engineering strategies.
* Implement GenAI evaluation and monitoring using RAGAS, LangSmith, MLflow, or equivalent tools.

**3. Data Engineering & AI Pipelines**

* Design and develop scalable data ingestion and ETL/ELT pipelines using Python, PySpark, Apache Spark, Databricks, and Delta Lake.
* Build data processing and feature engineering workflows to support ML and GenAI applications.
* Implement data quality, validation, and data lineage frameworks.
* Work with structured and unstructured data sources.

**4. Cloud & MLOps**

* Deploy and operationalize AI/ML applications on cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Databricks.
* Implement MLOps/LLMOps pipelines for model training, deployment, monitoring, versioning, and retraining.
* Work with MLflow, Unity Catalog, Feature Store, Model Registry, and Databricks Workflows.
* Containerize applications using Docker and deploy using Kubernetes where required.
* Develop CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or Databricks Asset Bundles.
* Monitor model performance, data drift, latency, and system reliability.

**5. Solution Architecture & Technical Leadership**

* Design end-to-end AI/ML architectures covering data ingestion, model development, deployment, and monitoring.
* Identify appropriate solutions using ML models, business rules, knowledge graphs, and human-in-the-loop approaches.
* Lead technical implementation and ensure production readiness of AI solutions.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams, business stakeholders, and clients.
* Mentor engineers and contribute to reusable frameworks, technical documentation, and best practices.

Mandatory Technical Skills

* Strong programming experience in
  **Python**
  .
* Hands-on experience in
  **Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning**
  .
* Strong experience in
  **Generative AI, LLMs, Prompt Engineering, and RAG**
  .
* Experience with
  **Agentic AI frameworks**
  such as LangGraph, CrewAI, or AutoGen.
* Strong knowledge of
  **Data Engineering, PySpark, Apache Spark, and SQL**
  .
* Experience with
  **Databricks, Delta Lake, and Lakehouse architecture**
  .
* Hands-on experience with
  **MLOps, MLflow, model deployment, and monitoring**
  .
* Experience working with at least one cloud platform:
  **Azure, AWS, or Databricks**
  .
* Experience building and consuming REST APIs.
* Strong understanding of software engineering practices, Git, CI/CD, and application deployment.

Preferred Skills

* Experience in the Property & Casualty (P&C) Insurance domain, particularly Claims, Underwriting, or Distribution.
* Knowledge of Knowledge Graphs, Ontologies, Taxonomy Management, and Neo4j.
* Experience with Databricks Unity Catalog, Feature Store, Model Serving, and Lakehouse Monitoring.
* Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, and Infrastructure as Code.
* Knowledge of Responsible AI, model explainability, bias detection, and GenAI guardrails.
* Exposure to Model Context Protocol (MCP).

Experience & Education

* 8–11 years of relevant experience in AI/ML Engineering, Applied AI, or Enterprise AI solution development.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Mathematics, Statistics, or an equivalent discipline.
* AI/ML certification or specialization in cloud-native AI architectures is preferred.

Key Expectations

* Ability to design and deliver end-to-end AI/ML solutions from development to production.
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, and system-design skills.
* Ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to take ownership of technical delivery and mentor team members.

**Role overview**

You'll train our vision foundation models end to end: infrastructure, experiment design, pre-training, SFT and RL post-training. Your calls on architecture, data and scale shape every model we ship.

**What the Role Involves**

Typical project: find a capability gap, test a fix with small ablations, scale it into a multi-node pre-training run, then post-train and evaluate.

* **Training infra:**
  Scale and harden distributed training on multi-node GPU clusters.
* **Experiments:**
  Design ablations on architectures, data mixtures and hyperparameters; turn results into decisions.
* **Pre-training:**
  Run large-scale vision and vision-language pre-training; debug loss spikes and throughput drops.
* **SFT:**
  Build fine-tuning recipes and data mixtures.
* **RL post-training:**
  Build RLHF, DPO and GRPO-style pipelines and reward models.
* **Performance:**
  Tune parallelism, precision, memory and data loading so GPUs never wait.

**What We're Looking For**

Someone who values research and engineering equally. Someone who hates seeing great ideas sit on a research shelf, and want every innovation to create real value in the product. The goal: be the best at balancing the two.

* B.Tech (minimum) in CS, EE or a related field
* 3+ years training deep learning models, including large models or large datasets
* First-principles intuition for why models train well or fail
* Expert in Python and PyTorch
* Know modern vision architectures and pre-training: ViT, MAE, DINO, CLIP
* Hands-on distributed training with DDP, FSDP, DeepSpeed or Megatron
* Solid ML systems knowledge: GPUs, memory, collective communication, parallelism strategies
* Strong CS fundamentals and Linux debugging skills
* Comfortable with early-stage pace

**Technology Stack**

Experience with most of these: PyTorch, FSDP, DeepSpeed, Megatron-LM, Hugging Face, Weights & Biases, TensorBoard, Hydra, WebDataset, Slurm, Kubernetes, Docker, NCCL, PyTorch Profiler, Nsight Systems, Git, AWS / GCP.

Nice to have

* Pre-trained foundation models at scale (billions of parameters, hundreds of GPUs)
* RL post-training for large models: reward models, DPO, PPO, GRPO
* Vision-language, diffusion or video models
* CUDA, Triton, FlashAttention, NCCL tuning
* BF16 / FP8 training
* torch.compile or XLA
* InfiniBand / RoCE and parallel file systems

**Good to Have**

* Built a transformer or training loop from scratch
* Published papers, benchmark reports or technical blog posts
* Released open-source models or datasets, or contributed to training frameworks
* Top finishes in ML competitions (Kaggle, CVPR challenges)
* Worked with 3D, robotics or embodied-AI data

title: Applied ML Engineer – Vision
description:
**About us**

We're a company building vision foundation models from scratch. We own the full stack: data, training infrastructure, pre-training, post-training and deployment.

We sit at the intersection of research and engineering. Ideas don't stop at a paper or a notebook: they get built, scaled and shipped.

We're a small team. Engineers own problems end to end and have real influence on what we build.

**Role overview**

You'll take our foundation models from checkpoint to production: data pipelines, inference optimisation, custom fine-tuning, evaluation and real-world readiness. You'll decide when a model is ready to ship.

**What the Role Involves**

Typical project: find where a model fails on real-world images, fix it with better data and fine-tuning, prove the fix on a benchmark, then hit a latency and cost target in production.

* **Data pipelines:**
  Collect, filter, dedupe, label and curate image and video data at billion-sample scale.
* **Inference:**
  Cut latency and cost with quantisation, distillation, batching and compilers.
* **Serving:**
  Deploy on cloud GPUs and edge devices with batching, caching and autoscaling.
* **Fine-tuning:**
  Adapt our models to customer tasks (detection, segmentation, VQA, retrieval) with full fine-tuning and LoRA.
* **Evals:**
  Build public and internal benchmarks; track metrics and failure modes.
* **Real-world readiness:**
  Stress-test for robustness, distribution shift, edge cases and bias; feed findings back to pre-training.

**What We're Looking For**

You value research and engineering equally. You hate seeing great ideas sit on a research shelf, and you want every innovation to create real value in the product. Your goal: be the best at balancing the two.

* B.Tech (minimum) in CS, EE or a related field
* 3+ years building and shipping ML systems, focused on computer vision
* First-principles intuition for why models fail, beyond calling library APIs
* Strong Python and PyTorch, with solid engineering practice (tests, code review, CI)
* Fine-tuned pre-trained vision models (ViT, CLIP, DINO, SAM, detectors) on custom data
* Large-scale data processing with Spark, Ray or similar
* Production inference optimisation: quantisation, batching, profiling, ONNX / TensorRT export
* Solid ML systems knowledge: GPU compute vs memory limits, FP16 / BF16 / INT8 trade-offs
* Strong CS fundamentals: algorithms, concurrency, distributed systems, Linux
* Comfortable with early-stage pace

**Technology Stack**

Experience with most of these: PyTorch, Hugging Face, Weights & Biases, MLflow, Ray, Spark, WebDataset, Parquet, ONNX Runtime, TensorRT, Triton Inference Server, vLLM, Docker, Kubernetes, Airflow, CVAT / Label Studio, FiftyOne, Prometheus / Grafana, Git, AWS / GCP.

**Good to Have**

* Built foundation-model datasets: web-scale crawling, dedup, CLIP filtering, captioning, synthetic data
* Vision-language models and multimodal evals
* Custom CUDA or Triton kernels
* Serving large multimodal models: KV cache, continuous batching, speculative decoding
* Edge deployment: Jetson, Core ML, TFLite
* Video or 3D vision

**Added Advantage**

* Built APIs or SDKs for ML models
* Managed annotation tooling or labelling vendors at scale
* Domain experience: manufacturing, retail, healthcare, autonomous driving or satellite imagery
* Top finishes in ML competitions
* Shipped an ML product at an early-stage startup
* Published work or open-source contributions

title: Senior Sales Manager/ closing manager
description:
The Senior Closing Manager is responsible for converting qualified walk-ins, Channel Partner (CP)-sourced clients, and direct HNWI inquiries into closed bookings across both One-Time Payment (OTP) and Regular Construction-Linked Plan (CLP) landowner inventories. This role owns the final-mile pitch, cost-sheet negotiation, legal/allotment reassurance, and booking token collection.

• High-Ticket Deal Closure: To close deals ranging from ₹2.34 Cr to ₹5.5+ Cr.

• Dual-Track Inventory Pitching:

o Convert cash-ready investors, rich IT leaders, and Section 54 capital-gains buyers onto Landowner OTP tracks within strict 15-day to 30 days payment realization timelines.

o Pivot home-loan and end-user families onto Regular CLP / 25:75 / 20:80 tracks on upper-floor stacks without diluting OTP pricing integrity.

• Pipeline & CRM Discipline: Maintain daily site-visit logs, follow-up, token-to-Agreement conversion tracking, and weekly inventory status reports for the Partners.

Required Qualifications, Experience & Compensation Structure

• Proven Track Record: Verifiable history of closing ₹40 Cr to ₹80+ Cr in annual sales volume (or 15–25+ luxury units per year).

About FundingPe
  
  
FundingPe helps Indian founders, startups and established businesses become investor-ready through professional business plans, pitch decks, financial projections and business documentation.
  
  
With the founder's permission, FundingPe facilitates introductions to investors and lenders whose investment or lending mandates match the business requirements.
  
  
FundingPe believes in transparent business practices, ethical selling, clear commercial terms and building long-term trust with entrepreneurs.
  
  
Funding is not guaranteed. Investment and lending decisions are independently made by investors and lenders.
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
We are looking for energetic, target-driven and experienced Business Development Managers to join our field sales team across Delhi NCR and Hyderabad.
  
  
The selected candidates will be responsible for identifying potential business clients, meeting entrepreneurs and company decision-makers, generating qualified leads, presenting FundingPe's services and converting prospects into verified paying customers.
  
  
This is a field-based sales role requiring daily market visits, networking, relationship building and consistent business development.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
- Conduct daily field visits to meet business owners, founders, entrepreneurs and directors.
  
- Generate new business opportunities through market research, networking, referrals and direct visits.
  
- Identify businesses requiring funding-readiness and business documentation services.
  
- Present FundingPe's service offerings, pricing, deliverables and terms professionally.
  
- Convert qualified prospects into verified paying customers.
  
- Maintain a consistent sales pipeline and conduct regular follow-ups.
  
- Record all leads, meetings, follow-ups and sales in the official CRM.
  
- Submit daily sales and field activity reports.
  
- Coordinate with internal documentation and onboarding teams.
  
- Follow ethical sales practices and never promise guaranteed funding or investment outcomes.
  
  
Target Customer Segments
  
  
Candidates will engage with:
  
  
- Manufacturing companies and industrial businesses.
  
- Distributors, wholesalers, traders and exporters.
  
- Retail businesses and restaurant chains.
  
- Healthcare businesses, clinics and diagnostic laboratories.
  
- Educational institutions and service businesses.
  
- Startups, technology companies and D2C brands.
  
- E-commerce and logistics companies.
  
- Textile and automobile component manufacturers.
  
- Solar and renewable energy businesses.
  
- Contractors and professional service firms.
  
- Early-stage entrepreneurs and business founders.
  
  
Required Skills & Qualifications
  
  
- 2–8 years of experience in target-based field sales or financial product sales.
  
- Experience in Banking, NBFCs, Loans, Credit Cards, Insurance or B2B Sales is preferred.
  
- Proven experience in achieving monthly sales targets.
  
- Strong communication, negotiation and presentation skills.
  
- Ability to independently generate leads and acquire new customers.
  
- Confidence in interacting with business owners and senior decision-makers.
  
- Willingness to travel locally and conduct daily field visits.
  
- Self-motivated, disciplined and result-oriented.
  
- Immediate availability to join.
  
  
Salary & Performance Incentives
  
  
Monthly Salary Package: ₹40,000 – ₹50,000
  
  
Performance-based incentives:
  
  
- 5–9 verified paid founders per month: ₹20,000 incentive.
  
- 10 or more verified paid founders per month: ₹40,000 incentive.
  
  
Monthly Sales Targets
  
  
- First 3 months (Probation): 5 verified paid founders per month.
  
- After confirmation: 10 verified paid founders per month.
  
  
A verified paid founder is counted only after the agreement is signed, payment is received and settled, and customer onboarding is completed.
  
  
Additional Benefits:
  
  
- Field travel reimbursement during probation: ₹3/km by bike and ₹2/km by scooty.
  
- Post-probation travel allowance: ₹3,000 per month.
  
- Performance-based salary hikes and career progression.
  
- Training and certification programme.
  
- Eligible candidates who complete the 7-day training, achieve certification and join receive a training completion bonus equal to 7 days of their monthly salary package.
  
  
The salary package includes base wages and target-linked salary. The exact split and applicable payment terms will be specified in the written offer letter.
  
  
Training & Joining Process
  
  
- 7-day online training programme starting 1 December 2026.
  
- Training certification through attendance, written assessment, role-play and practice lead generation.
  
- Minimum written assessment score: 80%.
  
- Minimum role-play score: 7/10.
  
- Joining formalities for shortlisted and certified candidates: 7 December 2026.
  
  
Career Growth Opportunities
  
  
Business Development Manager → Senior Business Development Manager → Team Leader → Assistant Sales Manager → Sales Manager → City Business Head → Regional Business Head.
  
  
Career progression and salary revisions are performance-based and subject to company policies.
  
  
Who Should Apply?
  
  
This opportunity is ideal for experienced field sales professionals from banking, NBFCs, financial services, insurance, loan sales and B2B business development backgrounds who are confident in meeting business owners and achieving monthly acquisition targets.
  
  
Please do not apply if you:

- Are unable to conduct daily field visits.
  
- Cannot join immediately.
  
- Are unwilling to work with monthly sales targets.

Important Recruitment Notice
  
  
FundingPe does not charge candidates any recruitment, registration, training, ID card or placement fees.
  
  
All official customer payments must be made through the company's authorised payment channels. Candidates must follow ethical sales practices and must never guarantee funding or investment outcomes.

title: Sales Specialist - Hybrid Cloud Solutions
description:

at HPE is about building the future. We are redefining what’s next and combining our legacy of innovation with a bold new goal to accelerate everything we do. Together with our partners, we deliver global, commercial, public sector & small/medium business customers throughout 11 geographies. We’re transforming businesses. Join us redefine what’s next for you.
  
  
**Job Family Definition**
Sales Specialists & Consultants are product, services, software or solution specialists that are responsible for leading pursuit in their assigned focus areas. Collaborates with and supports Account Managers and provides specialist expertise within the sales team. Drives proactive campaigns to build the pipeline, uses specialized knowledge and skills to prospect, qualify, negotiate and close opportunities. May have named accounts allocated, cover a designated geography, or may be allocated to one high-potential, competitive attack account.
  
  
**Management Level Definition**
Applies developed subject matter knowledge to solve common and complex business issues and recommends appropriate alternatives. Works on problems of diverse complexity and scope. May act as a team or project leader providing direction to team activities and facilitates information validation and team decision making process. Exercises independent judgment to identify and select a solution. Ability to handle most unique situations. May seek advice in order to make decisions on complex business issues.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
***Responsibilities:***

* Drive direct sales of HPE Hybrid Cloud solutions, identifying new business opportunities and expanding existing customer relationships across assigned accounts.
* Develop and execute sales strategies to position HPE GreenLake solutions, Hybrid Cloud offerings, and consumption-based IT services to enterprise customers.
* Identify, qualify, and develop opportunities for HPE GreenLake, Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure, Private Cloud, and Storage as a Service (STaaS) solutions.
* Build and manage a strong sales pipeline for Hybrid Cloud and as-a-Service offerings, ensuring alignment with Account Managers and business objectives.
* Work closely with Account Managers to identify customer requirements, develop account-specific sales strategies, and drive revenue growth through specialized Hybrid Cloud solutions.
* Engage directly with customers, including CXOs, IT leaders, infrastructure heads, and decision-makers, to understand their business challenges and present relevant Hybrid Cloud solutions.
* Drive consultative selling by understanding customers' existing IT infrastructure, cloud adoption strategies, data management requirements, and infrastructure modernization initiatives.
* Position HPE GreenLake's consumption-based model and flexible IT solutions as alternatives to traditional infrastructure procurement and ownership models.
* Drive sales of Storage as a Service, Hybrid Cloud Storage, data management, and infrastructure modernization solutions, aligning offerings with customer requirements.
* Identify opportunities for cloud transformation, workload modernization, hybrid IT infrastructure, and migration from traditional on-premises environments to hybrid cloud models.
* Develop customer-specific proposals, solution value propositions, commercial models, and business cases in collaboration with technical specialists and solution architects.
* Lead customer discussions, negotiations, commercial presentations, and deal closures for Hybrid Cloud and GreenLake opportunities.
* Collaborate with Presales, Solution Architects, Product Teams, and delivery teams to develop comprehensive solutions that address customer business and technical requirements.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with customers, channel partners, and strategic technology partners to accelerate Hybrid Cloud business growth.
* Analyze competitor offerings across Hybrid Cloud, cloud infrastructure, storage, and as-a-Service solutions to strengthen HPE's competitive positioning.
* Drive strategic account penetration by identifying cross-selling and upselling opportunities across HPE's Hybrid Cloud and GreenLake portfolio.
* Support Account Managers in developing pursuit strategies, forecasting opportunities, managing deal progression, and achieving assigned sales quotas.
* Maintain accurate opportunity management, sales forecasting, and pipeline updates through CRM tools such as Salesforce/Siebel.
* Stay updated on emerging Hybrid Cloud technologies, cloud consumption models, infrastructure-as-a-Service, Storage as a Service, and industry trends to strengthen customer engagement and sales effectiveness.

**What You Need To Bring**
***Education and Experience Required:***

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Information Technology, or a related discipline preferred.
* Typically 5–8 years of experience in enterprise technology sales, preferably in Hybrid Cloud, Cloud Infrastructure, Storage, or IT Infrastructure solutions.
* Proven experience in direct sales, consultative selling, account management, and business development within enterprise or commercial accounts.
* Demonstrated success in achieving sales quotas, developing new business opportunities, and closing complex technology deals.
* Experience selling HPE GreenLake, Hybrid Cloud solutions, Storage as a Service, Infrastructure as a Service, or similar consumption-based IT solutions is preferred.
* Strong understanding of enterprise customer environments, IT infrastructure, and cloud transformation requirements.

**Knowledge And Skills**

* Strong understanding of Hybrid Cloud architecture, including private cloud, public cloud, and hybrid IT environments.
* Good knowledge of HPE GreenLake offerings, consumption-based IT models, and as-a-Service business models.
* Understanding of Storage as a Service (STaaS), enterprise storage solutions, data management, and storage modernization.
* Knowledge of Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure, compute, storage, networking, virtualization, and cloud management solutions.
* Ability to position and sell infrastructure solutions based on customer business requirements, operational efficiency, scalability, and cost optimization.
* Strong direct sales and consultative selling capabilities, with the ability to independently identify, qualify, develop, and close sales opportunities.
* Ability to work closely with Account Managers to drive account penetration, pipeline development, customer engagement, and revenue growth.
* Understanding of enterprise cloud adoption strategies, workload migration, infrastructure modernization, and IT transformation initiatives.
* Ability to articulate the business value of HPE GreenLake and Hybrid Cloud solutions against traditional CAPEX-based infrastructure models.
* Strong commercial acumen, including deal structuring, pricing discussions, contract negotiations, and closing strategies.
* Ability to engage with senior customer stakeholders, including CXOs, CIOs, CTOs, and IT infrastructure decision-makers.
* Strong understanding of competitive offerings from major Hybrid Cloud, storage, and infrastructure providers.
* Experience working with channel partners, strategic alliances, and technology partners to drive sales opportunities.
* Excellent communication, presentation, stakeholder management, and negotiation skills.
* Strong pipeline management, sales forecasting, opportunity tracking, and CRM management skills.
* Ability to translate complex technical solutions into measurable business outcomes and customer value.

We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.

title: Area Sales Manager
description:
**About Boki**

Boki is a financial automation software company built for manufacturers. Its platform automates supplier invoice processing, approval workflows and GST reconciliation, helping finance teams identify and recover lost input tax credit. It integrates with accounting systems such as Tally, QuickBooks, Xero and NetSuite. Boki focuses on promoter-run manufacturing groups with ₹50–500 Cr in annual turnover.

**About the Role**

Boki is hiring an Area Sales Manager to join its founding field sales team in Hyderabad. You'll sell directly to promoters and business owners of manufacturing groups across the city's industrial belts. Working with a pre-built list of 321 prospects while sourcing additional opportunities independently, you'll build relationships, secure read-only access to their Tally systems and demonstrate the GST input tax credit they could recover. You'll own the entire sales process, from prospecting and negotiations to closing and payment collection.

**What You'll Do**

* Work through a list of 321 promoter-run manufacturing groups across Hyderabad's industrial areas, including Jeedimetla, Balanagar, Patancheru, Nacharam, Kattedan and Medchal.
* Source new meetings independently through field visits, industrial estate associations and networking.
* Build relationships with promoters and business owners to secure read-only access to their Tally systems.
* Present the amount of GST input tax credit businesses are losing and the potential exposure under the Section 16(4) deadline.
* Negotiate and close contracts at ₹9,000 per entity per month.
* Own payment collection after closing deals.
* Retain and grow existing accounts, with additional commission on year-two revenue.
* Document meeting insights and successful sales approaches to help build the team's sales playbook.
* Work towards the day-90 targets of 10 Tally authorisations and 2 signed contracts.

**Who We're Looking For**

* 3–6 years of B2B field sales experience selling directly to business owners, preferably without relying on inbound leads or scripted sales processes.
* Experience in MSME lending, industrial consumables, factory sales, dealer or distribution sales is relevant.
* Proven ability to independently source, close and collect payment on deals.
* Comfortable conducting field visits across Hyderabad's industrial estates, including travelling by two-wheeler.
* Strong relationship-building, negotiation and communication skills.
* Self-driven and comfortable generating meetings without depending on an SDR, CRM or marketing budget.
* Able to engage directly with promoters and communicate commercial value confidently.

**Why Join Boki?**

* Be one of the first two field sales hires and help build the sales playbook.
* Work closely with the founder, who will join your first 20 customer meetings.
* Get access to a pre-built prospect list and an onboarding lead who can install the product within the same week.
* Uncapped commission: 15% of first-year contract value and 5% of year-two value on retained or grown accounts.
* Benefits include a MacBook Air, travel reimbursement on actuals, and health and accident cover.

**Compensation:**
₹8–14 LPA fixed, plus uncapped commission

Hybrid

Role Overview

We are looking for a highly motivated and results-driven Senior Business Development Executive (Sr. BDE) with 4–6 years of experience in inside sales and outbound business development, specifically targeting the North American market.

The ideal candidate should have strong English communication skills, hands-on experience in cold calling, lead generation, prospect research, and appointment setting. Experience working with IT services companies and selling technology services is highly preferred.

5. Qualify prospects and convert meetings into Sales Qualified Leads (SQLs) or identified business opportunities.
6. Develop compelling cold-calling pitches, LinkedIn messages, and personalized email campaigns.
7. Execute outbound campaigns using LinkedIn, email, WhatsApp, and other relevant social channels.
8. Research target accounts, identify key stakeholders, and independently build prospect databases using LinkedIn, D&B, and AI-driven research tools.

Mandatory Skills & Qualifications

**Summary**
**Position Summary**
Artificial Intelligence & Engineering
  
  
AI & Engineering leverages  cutting-edge  engineering capabilities to help build, deploy, and  operate  integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These insights are powered by engineering for business advantage, helping transform mission-critical operations.
  
  
Join our AI & Engineering team to help transform technology platforms,  driving  innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients' achievements.  You’ll  work alongside talented  professionals  reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that could be critical to businesses.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
Level: Software Engineer II
  
  
As a Software Engineer II at Deloitte Consulting, you will deliver high-quality engineering solutions that support enterprise applications and client transformation initiatives. In this role, you will contribute across backend and front-end development, apply modern engineering practices, and help deliver secure, scalable, and maintainable technology solutions. You will also support continuous improvement through automation, innovation, and strong execution within project timelines.
  
  
Work you'll do
  
  
As a Software Engineer II on the Engineering as a Service team, you will be responsible for …
  
  

* Designing, developing, and maintaining backend services and application programming interfaces using Java, Spring, Spring Boot, and microservices architecture
* Building and enhancing React applications using TypeScript, modern JavaScript, and integration with RESTful or GraphQL services
* Evaluating solution options, identifying risks, and contributing to secure, scalable, and maintainable design decisions
* Performing testing, debugging, defect management, documentation, and production issue resolution across the software development lifecycle
* Supporting process improvements, automation, delivery metric tracking, knowledge sharing, and development of tools or accelerators that improve project outcomes

The T eam
  
  
Engineering as a Service provides complete design, implementation, and technology operations, leveraging our core engineering expertise . We transform engineering teams, modernize technology, and deliver complex programs with a product engineering approach. Our flexible delivery models—traditional teams, pools, or pods—are tailored to each client’s needs, offering engineering-led advisory, implementation, and operational capabilities to accelerate innovation.
  
  
Education: BE/ B.Tech /M.C.A./ M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from accredited university
  
  
Location: Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Chennai, Pune
  
  
Shift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM or 2 PM to 11 PM IST
  
  
**Qualifications**
Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:
  
  

* Core JAVA & Backend engineering :
* 4-7 years of strong hands-on experience in JAVA( 8 +) with solid grounding in Object-Oriented design principles and clean coding practices including identifying design flaws in existing codebases and refactoring towards maintainable designs
* Well versed with core Java concepts including Exception Handling, Collections Framework, Concurrency (threads), Streams, Lambdas etc.
* Ability to design and implement efficient, Secure , and maintainable backend code, evaluate multiple solution approaches, and justify design decisions considering performance and security trade-offs
* Spring & Enterprise Frameworks:
* Strong understanding of microservices architecture , with the ability able to design high-level service boundaries, ensure effective inter-service communication and manage data consistency
* Hands-on experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs using Spring Boot, applying API design best practices and integrating with external services, data sources and databases
* Solid expertise in Spring framework/Spring Boot design principles including core annotations, dependency injection, bean lifecycle, transaction management, and database access patterns.
* Experience implementing security and cloud-native patterns using Spring Security and Spring Cloud ( e.g. authentication/ authorization, configuration and resiliency)
* Strong understanding of data persistence , including RDBMS & SQL (or NOSQL), normalization , complex query troubleshooting and ORM/ JPA (e.g., Hibernate) for performant and transactional data access.
* Proven ability in testing, trouble shooting and debugging , including writing JUnit tests, identifying performance bottlenecks, and resolving production issues with minimal handholding
* React
* 4 - 7 years of hands-on experience in React :
* Strong hands-on experience building scalable and production-grade React applications using TypeScript and modern JavaScript (ES6+).
* Strong understanding of React fundamentals, including JSX, component lifecycle, hooks, rendering behaviour , and component composition
* Experience implementing state management and data-fetching patterns, using Context API and modern state libraries ( e.g. , Redux Toolkit/ Zustand / Recoil ) based on application complexity.
* Strong UI engineering fundamentals including HTML/ CSS, responsive design, accessibility considerations and cross-browser compatibility
* Hands-on experience integrating React applications with backend services via RESTful APIs ( GraphQL where applicable ) , including contract-driven integration ( OpenAPI /Swagger), pagination, error handling
* Experience implementing authentication and authorization flows in the UI using OAuth2/OIDC and JWT, including route protection, secure token handling , and role-based UI behavior.
* Strong testing and debugging skills with unit/component testing (Jest, React Testing Library) and end-to-end testing (Cypress/Playwright), ensuring stability and maintainability.
* Experience with React performance optimization, including code splitting, lazy loading, memoization strategies, and efficient rendering of large data sets
* Familiarity with React build tooling, including modern bundlers (Webpack/Vite), environment configuration, and deployment optimization.
* Soft Skills
* Strong communication skills with the ability to articulate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Proven experience working directly with clients and business stakeholders to clarify requirements, manage expectations, and reduce ambiguity.
* Ability to ask the right questions, challenge assumptions constructively, and drive clarity in complex or evolving problem spaces.
* Strong collaboration mindset; able to work effectively with cross-functional teams including product managers, designers, QA, and platform teams.
* Ownership-driven approach with the ability to independently drive tasks to completion with minimal handholding

**Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**

* Certification (JAVA):
* Oracle Certified Associate (Java 8 or above)
* Oracle Certified Professional (preferred but not mandatory)
* Agile Development and Collaboration
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum or SAFe environments with iterative delivery and continuous feedback.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with product, QA, and platform teams to deliver high-quality features incrementally.
* Comfortable participating in sprint planning, estimations, reviews, and retrospectives with a delivery-oriented mindset
* Awareness of any of the industry domains

Our Data & Analytics Operations team is building a Digital Workforce: AI agents, which we call digital workers, that carry out complete business processes end to end, such as researching public records, reviewing documents, verifying businesses and assembling case evidence. Digital workers run on a shared enterprise platform with people in the loop, so experts set the rules, handle exceptions and focus on the decisions that need human judgment. Digital workers are already handling production volume, and we are scaling quickly.

  

**About the Role**

  

We are looking for a hands-on Senior Engineering Manager to lead the team that designs, builds and runs our digital workers. You will lead a team of AI engineers, set the engineering standards for how we build, test and operate AI agents, and make sure every digital worker is accurate, secure and delivering measurable business results.

  

You will partner closely with product, operations, data and technology leaders across the globe, and you will play a central role in growing a world-class AI engineering capability in Hyderabad.

**Key Responsibilities**
  

  
* Lead, hire, coach and grow a team of AI engineers and senior AI engineers, building technical leaders who own their digital workers end to end.
  
* Own engineering delivery of digital workers for operations use cases including business research, data quality, risk and compliance, and fraud investigation, from concept through production.
  
* Apply and evolve platform patterns for orchestration, agent skills, reusable tools, retrieval, reasoning and human-in-the-loop review.
  
* Set shared standards for agent development, prompt and context engineering, tool calling and reuse, and run an engineering community of practice across product areas.
  
* Design and run evaluation frameworks that measure accuracy, agreement with expert reviewers, confidence thresholds and exception rates.
  
* Own release management, monitoring, observability, incident response and ongoing production support (LLMOps) for digital workers.
  
* Integrate digital workers with enterprise data pipelines and systems of record while protecting data quality, lineage and controls.
  
* Partner with security, legal and compliance teams to embed guardrails, auditability and responsible-AI practices.
  
* Assess and size new use cases, translate business needs into engineering plans and contribute to the multi-quarter roadmap.
  
* Report progress, risks and business outcomes such as throughput, accuracy, cycle time and cost to serve to senior leadership.
  

  
**Key Skills**
  

  
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field.
  
* 10+ years in software, data or AI/ML engineering, including 4+ years leading engineering teams with direct reports.
  
* 3+ years building and shipping generative AI or LLM-based applications to production.
  
* Strong hands-on Python and API development skills.
  
* Practical experience with agentic frameworks and SDKs (for example LangChain, LangGraph, OpenAI, Vertex AI or Amazon Bedrock), tool calling, RAG, embeddings and vector search.
  
* Experience designing evaluation and quality frameworks for AI systems, including human review and hallucination controls.

**Senior HR Technology Integration, AI & Automation Engineer**
**Position Summary**
We are seeking experienced technology professionals to design, build, and scale
**integration, AI, and intelligent automation capabilities**
across the HR technology ecosystem.
  
  
This role is designed for professionals with deep expertise in
**one or more**
of the following areas:
**HR/HCM integrations, enterprise integration and iPaaS, Oracle AI, generative AI, agentic AI, or intelligent automation**
.
  
  
Candidates are
**not expected to have expertise across every technology or discipline listed below**
. We are looking for individuals who bring strong engineering depth in one or more areas, combined with the ability to design secure, scalable, and reusable solutions across a complex enterprise HR technology landscape.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**HR & Enterprise Integration Engineering**

* Design, develop, deploy, monitor, and support inbound and outbound integrations across HR and enterprise platforms.
* Develop Oracle HCM integrations using Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), REST/SOAP APIs, HCM Extracts, HDL/HSDL, file-based integrations, middleware, and event-driven integration patterns.
* Design and implement enterprise integrations using iPaaS platforms such as Workato, Boomi, MuleSoft, or similar technologies.
* Integrate Oracle HCM and other HR platforms with Payroll, Finance, Benefits, Identity and Access Management, Service Management, enterprise data platforms, and third-party providers.
* Design integration solutions that are scalable, reusable, secure, observable, and resilient, with appropriate monitoring, error handling, recovery, and support capabilities.
* Develop reusable APIs, integration patterns, services, and frameworks to simplify connectivity across the HR technology ecosystem.
* Partner with HR product teams, enterprise architecture, security, data, and application teams to define integration standards and solution architecture.

**Enterprise AI & Intelligent Automation**

* Design and implement enterprise AI solutions including copilots, intelligent agents, Model Context protocol(MCP) ,RAG solutions, AI-enabled workflows, and multi-system orchestration.
* Build agentic AI and automation solutions that connect HR applications, enterprise data, knowledge sources, APIs, and workflow platforms.
* Develop reusable AI and automation capabilities that can be leveraged across multiple HR functions and employee experiences.
* Leverage platforms such as Oracle, ServiceNow, Moveworks, GCP Enterprise AI, and enterprise data platforms to deliver HR AI and automation use cases.
* Evaluate, configure, and deploy Oracle embedded AI and automation capabilities within Oracle Fusion HCM.
* Partner with HR teams to identify and prioritize AI and automation opportunities that improve employee experience, HR productivity, operational efficiency, and service delivery.
* Integrate Oracle AI capabilities with enterprise AI, data, integration, and workflow platforms where appropriate.
* Design workflow automation, RPA, and intelligent orchestration solutions to reduce manual effort and streamline end-to-end HR processes.
* Establish reusable engineering patterns, controls, and governance for the secure and responsible use of AI and automation.
* Support experimentation and rapid prototyping while ensuring successful solutions can transition into secure, supportable, production-grade capabilities.

**Candidate Profile**
We are looking for candidates with strong experience in
**one or more**
of the following technology areas:
  
  

* Oracle HCM Integration: Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), HCM Extracts, HDL/HSDL, REST/SOAP APIs, and Oracle HCM integration patterns.
* Enterprise Integration & iPaaS: Workato, Boomi, MuleSoft, or comparable enterprise integration platforms; API-led and event-driven integration architectures.
* Generative & Agentic AI: LLM-based applications, RAG architectures, copilots, intelligent agents, AI orchestration, and enterprise AI integration patterns.
* Oracle AI: Oracle Fusion HCM embedded AI, automation, and emerging Oracle AI capabilities.
* Enterprise AI Platforms: GCP Enterprise AI, Moveworks, or similar enterprise AI and employee-experience platforms.
* Intelligent Automation: Workflow automation, RPA, low-code/no-code automation, process orchestration, and AI-enabled workflows.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience designing integrations or automation solutions across HR, Payroll, Finance, Benefits, Identity, ITSM, or enterprise data platforms.
* Understanding of enterprise integration patterns, API architecture, security, data protection, and cloud-based architectures.
* Experience translating complex business processes into scalable technical solutions.
* Ability to work across HR, IT, Security, Data, and Enterprise Architecture teams.
* Experience taking solutions from proof of concept through production deployment and operational support.
* Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to evaluate emerging technologies and apply them to practical business use cases.

**Candidates are not required to have experience across all technologies listed above. Deep expertise in one or more integration, AI, or automation domains, together with the ability and interest to work across adjacent technologies, is highly valued.**

title: ORDER FULFILLMENT EXECUTIVE
description:
Job Description: Order Fulfiilment Executive

**Department:** Supply Chain / Order Management **Reports To:** Manager – Supply Chain / Operations **Location:** [Location] **Employment Type:** Full-time

Role Summary

The Order Fulfilment Executive is responsible for processing customer Purchase Orders (POs) from receipt to dispatch. The role covers PO verification, stock checking and stock records, placing orders with OEMs, following up on delivery and material documents, maintaining complete records of all OEM orders and company Purchase Orders, and maintaining an accurate PO backlog so that pending materials are identified and dispatched at the earliest.

Key Responsibilities

1. Purchase Order Processing

Receive customer POs and verify them against the quotation or agreed terms, including part numbers, descriptions, quantities, prices, taxes, delivery dates and payment terms.

Identify discrepancies or missing information in the PO and resolve them with the customer or the sales team before processing.

Register each PO in the system and issue an order acknowledgement or confirmation where required.

2. Stock Checking and Inventory Control

Check available stock against each PO and confirm which items can be supplied from inventory.

Allocate stock to confirmed orders and coordinate with the stores or warehouse team for picking and packing.

Maintain accurate stock records, update movements on time, and reconcile system stock with physical stock.

Monitor stock levels and inform the management of shortages, slow-moving items and reorder requirements.

3. Procurement firom OEMs

Place purchase orders with OEMs or suppliers against customer POs for items not available in stock.

Confirm price, quantity, lead time and delivery schedule with the OEM before placing the order.

Obtain written order acknowledgements and confirmed delivery dates from OEMs.

4. OEM Order and Purchase Order Records

Maintain a complete and up-to-date record of every purchase order placed by the company on OEMs and suppliers, linked to the customer PO it was raised against.

For each order, record the PO number and date, OEM name, part numbers, descriptions, quantities, agreed prices, taxes, payment terms, lead time and committed delivery date.

Update each record as the order progresses: order acknowledgement, revisions or amendments, partial shipments, quantities received, delays and final closure.

Keep copies of all related correspondence and documents with the order record, including quotations, acknowledgements, amendments, invoices, COC and other certificates.

Maintain a master register of customer POs and OEM orders in the ERP or in Excel so that any order can be traced from customer PO to OEM order to dispatch.

Verify OEM invoices and received quantities against the order record and report any mismatch to the Accounts team and the OEM.

Reconcile the OEM order register with the PO backlog at least once a week, and ensure that every open customer PO has a corresponding OEM order or stock allocation.

Provide order data, order status and OEM-wise delivery performance to the management when required.

5. Delivery Follow-up

Follow up regularly with OEMs and suppliers on production status, shipment and delivery dates.

Escalate delays to the OEM and to internal management, and propose alternatives where required.

Keep the sales team and customers informed about delivery status and any change in schedule.

Coordinate with logistics and transporters for inbound and outbound movement of material.

6. Material Documentation

Obtain and verify the required documents from OEMs, including Certificate of Conformance (COC), test certificates, invoices, packing lists, delivery challans and warranty or origin certificates, as applicable.

Check that the documents match the PO, and that the material received matches the documents.

Share the required documents with customers along with the dispatch and maintain a document record for each order.

7. PO Backlog Management

Maintain a PO backlog report showing, for each open PO: the item, quantity ordered, quantity supplied, pending quantity, OEM, expected delivery date and current status.

Review the backlog daily and prioritise orders by delivery commitment and customer urgency.

Report backlog status to the management on a weekly basis, with reasons for delays and the action being taken.

Arrange dispatch of pending material as soon as it is available and close the PO in the system.

8. Dispatch and Order Closure

Coordinate packing, invoicing and dispatch of material along with the required documents.

Share dispatch details, such as invoice, transporter name and tracking number, with the customer.

Confirm delivery and close the order after receipt of material.

Qualifiications and Experience

Graduate in any discipline. A degree or diploma in engineering, commerce or supply chain is preferred.

1–3 years of experience in order processing, order management, procurement, or materials coordination. Experience in an industrial or technical products environment is preferred.

Experience of working with OEMs and handling material documents such as COC is an advantage.

**Skills Required**

Good working knowledge of MS Excel and ERP or inventory management software.

Understanding of purchase orders, invoices, delivery challans and dispatch documentation.

Clear written and verbal communication in English; knowledge of Hindi and Telugu is an advantage.

Strong attention to detail and accuracy in checking orders and documents.

Ability to follow up consistently, manage several orders at once and meet deadlines.

**Performance Measures**

Accuracy of PO verification and order entry.

Accuracy of stock records.

On-time delivery against the committed date.

Reduction in the value and age of pending POs.

Completeness of material documents at the time of dispatch.

Timeliness and accuracy of the backlog report and of OEM order and PO records.

Interfaces

**Internal:** Sales, Stores and Warehouse, Accounts, Logistics, Management.

**External:** Customers, OEMs and suppliers, Transporters.

**About us:**

Hm Industrial products and services9 part of Hima Group) was started in 1998 and is an established channel partner and solution provider for reputed global companies including pall corporation, kelvion Heat exchangers, Delta PD pumps, American Air filtration and others. We serve the oil and gas refinery, power, Mining and related industrial sectors with high-quality process solutions and after sales support. With a strong presence across south India and expanding footprint, we focus on delivering reliable, value-added solutions that help customers improve reliability, efficiency and uptime.

description:
**Services Specialist, Data Preparation & Reporting**

Are you a detail-oriented, analytical minded individual who enjoys talking to stakeholders to understand their requirements and analyze the data to provide meaningful insight? At Deloitte Global Talent under Global Talent Operations in USI , we provide reporting and data advisory services to the Talent network across the globe.

As a Senior Data Analyst, you will support a portfolio of Global Talent data, survey, reporting and analytics initiatives. This role combines project management coordination with hands-on data collection, quality assurance, analysis, dashboard development, survey administration and recurring reporting. You will translate complex stakeholder requirements and distributed data submissions into reliable insights, accessible reporting products and well-managed delivery processes.

You will prepare scheduled and ad-hoc reports and contribute to implementation and process-improvement initiatives aligned with the organizational roadmap. The role offers broad exposure to global stakeholders and opportunities for professional growth.

**Work you'll do**

As a Services Specialist, Data Preparation & Reporting on the Talent Data Solutions team, you will be responsible for:

* Partner with project leads and stakeholders to translate information needs into data-collection and reporting approaches, delivery expectations, and project plans.
* Coordinate workstreams from launch through closeout, including outreach, mailbox and query management, progress tracking, follow-ups, issue escalation, and status reporting.
* Design standardized templates, guidance, and repeatable processes; review, clean, reconcile, validate, and document data submissions before analysis or reporting.
* Analyze quantitative and qualitative data, define metrics, investigate discrepancies, and translate findings into stakeholder insights and trends.
* Create and maintain Power BI or Tableau dashboards and Qualtrics surveys; deliver scheduled and ad-hoc reports, presentations, and process-improvement recommendations.
* Collaborate with data owners, reporting consumers, and technology partners; draft project communications; and identify opportunities to automate recurring activities.

**The team**

The role sits in the Talent Data Solutions team within Global Talent Operations in USI. Our team culture is collaborative and encourages team members to take initiative and seek on-the-job learning opportunities. Our professionals are committed to excellence and to enhancing the trust of the entire Talent network. Quality is our top priority, and by focusing on exceptional client service, we continue to raise the bar on quality and deliver greater value to our clients.

**Location: Hyderabad**

**Shift Timings: 2 PM to 11 PM IST**

**Qualifications**

Required:

* 18-24 months of experience as an Analyst, or experience as a first-year Senior Analyst, supporting data, reporting, survey, or analytics projects with multiple stakeholders and deadlines.
* Experience using Microsoft Excel to clean, organize, validate, and analyze structured data.
* Experience developing dashboards or reporting solutions in Microsoft Power BI.
* Experience building and administering surveys in Qualtrics or a comparable enterprise survey platform, including Microsoft Forms.
* Experience defining and calculating metrics, investigating data-quality issues, and preparing findings for non-technical audiences.
* Experience using Microsoft PowerPoint, Word, Teams, and generative artificial intelligence (AI) tools to develop project deliverables, presentations, and communications.
* Experience managing data or reporting project tasks, collaborating with internal and external stakeholders, assessing and routing queries through escalation channels, and applying quality assurance, risk, privacy, and data-protection guidelines.

Preferred:

* 2-3 years of business-analysis experience, including gathering requirements and translating them into solution documentation.
* Experience developing dashboards or reporting solutions in Tableau.
* Experience applying statistical analysis techniques, including regression, correlation, and factor analysis.
* Experience with Talent, workforce, employee-experience, or learning data and reporting.
* Experience documenting data visualizations, survey design, data governance, or privacy practices; or administering report or dashboard access and role-based security requirements.
* Experience improving or automating recurring workflows using Power Query, Visual Basic for Applications (VBA), or Python.

**Our purpose**

  
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.

**Professional development**

  
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. title: Software Engineer Junior
description:
Role summary

The Software Engineer Junior builds and runs the data pipelines behind Goodyear Mobility Cloud (GMC). GMC collects tire pressure and vehicle telematics data from connected devices on fleets in North America and EMEA, tens of millions of messages a month. The data lands in a data lake, and data models take it through bronze, silver and gold layers for GMC alerts, internal reporting, and data science. You will learn the platform alongside the engineers who built it and take on more of its day-to-day running as you go.

Responsibilities

* Build and maintain dbt models in Snowflake across the bronze, silver and gold layers
* Add new data sources and event types end to end: Snowpipe ingestion from S3, raw tables, dbt models, tests and the Airflow DAG that runs them
* Write and maintain Airflow DAGs, with retries, timeouts and failure alerts
* Handle schema changes when a device provider adds or renames fields in its JSON payloads
* Write dbt tests and reconciliation checks that catch missing or bad data before it reaches the gold tables
* Run backfills, and trace data issues such as late payloads or stale metadata back to their cause
* Tune queries and warehouse sizing to control Snowflake cost
* Manage Snowflake objects, roles and access in Terraform
* Build and support Python APIs and reports in DataOps, GMC's internal reporting tool, which reads from Snowflake and Redshift
* Write runbooks and documentation for the pipelines you work on
* Agree with the teams that use a table what each field means and how fresh the data needs to be
* Use AI coding assistants, and review and test what they produce before it ships

Requirements

Mandatory

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, data science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 2 years of professional experience
* SQL beyond the basics: joins, aggregations, window functions and CTEs
* Python for scripts and small services, including packages, virtual environments and tests with pytest
* Experience with a cloud data warehouse such as Snowflake, Redshift or Databricks, from work, school or your own projects
* Data modeling basics: facts and dimensions, keys, incremental loads, and reruns that do not duplicate data
* Working knowledge of Git, pull requests and code review
* Understanding of how a data pipeline fits together, from ingestion through transformation, scheduling and testing, and how a failure in one step shows up downstream
* Comfortable at a Linux command line
* The habit of asking questions early, writing down what you learn, and keeping a distributed team informed of progress and blockers
* Experience with AI coding assistants, including reviewing and testing what they generate

Nice to have

* dbt models, tests, macros and incremental models
* Snowflake: Snowpipe, stages, roles, warehouses and the query profile
* Semi-structured data in SQL, such as JSON in Snowflake VARIANT columns
* Apache Airflow, including running dbt from Airflow
* Terraform or another infrastructure-as-code tool
* AWS: S3, IAM, Lambda and EKS
* Docker and Kubernetes
* IoT, telematics or time-series data
* Apache Superset or another BI tool
* React or TypeScript
* Apache Iceberg or data contracts
* Python tooling such as Ruff, uv and mypy or pyright

Goodyear is one of the world's largest tire companies. It employs about 63,000 people and manufactures its products in 48 facilities in 19 countries around the world. Its two Innovation Centers in Akron, Ohio, and Colmar-Berg, Luxembourg, strive to develop state-of-the-art products and services that set the technology and performance standard for the industry.
