Senior Management / Executives
  
  
HR and Training Teams

Contractors and Subcontractors
  
  
Equipment and System Vendors/OEMs
  
  
Regulatory Authorities and Government Bodies
  
  
Clients and End Users
  
  
Consultants and Advisory Teams
  
  
Local Utility Providers
  
  
Environmental and Safety Regulatory Bodies
  
  
Legal Advisors (for compliance and contracts)
  
  
Testing and Certification Agencies
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Educational Qualification:**
Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Instrumentation & Control Engineering, or a related field.
  
  
Master’s degree (optional, but preferred) in a relevant field such as Electrical Engineering, Automation, or Control Systems Engineering.
  
  
Relevant certifications in I&C systems, control systems, automation technologies, or project management (e.g., PMP, Six Sigma, or similar) would be advantageous.

* Proficient in Python and build systems (CMake) for automation, model generation, and validation.
* Hands-on experience with software development practices and tools such as Agile, DevOps, Git, Jenkins/GitHub Actions, and code-quality tooling.
* Demonstrated technical leadership, including mentoring engineers, leading cross-functional initiatives, and influencing architecture decisions.
* Excellent debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills across hardware/software boundaries.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, including presenting technical strategy to stakeholders and management.
* Ability to work across a geographically dispersed team and deal with ambiguity in a fast-paced environment.Strong debugging, analytical, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative environment
* Strong verbal and written communication skills

**What you'll walk into:**
You won't be starting from zero. You'll be owning live problems:
  
  

* Getting ready to open: figure out how we open and maintain accounts, process trades, and hold client cash and securities on day one. Build that for ACCC rather than copying a manual process from another firm.
* Working with partner brokers: define how a partner firm and ACCC split the work on accounts, trades, and holding client assets, so it still works as volume grows.
* After the trade: settlement in Canada (through CDS), trades that fail to settle, and corporate actions such as dividends and splits. Automate the routine cases and keep a clear list of exceptions, instead of running the book in spreadsheets.
* Registered accounts and tax: TFSA, RRSP, RESP, and similar accounts. Cover who can open them, contribution rules, what a security cost, tax withheld on dividends and other income, and the reports clients and partners need.
* The day after launch: written steps for daily work, checks that our records match the custodian and the market, contacts at vendors and custodians, and a plan if a system or vendor fails. Have these ready before real client volume shows up.
* Building Canada: clear handoffs between product, engineering, and operations teams.

**What you’ll own:**

* Account lifecycle & client/introducing-broker servicing (onboarding handoffs, KYC/AML ops interfaces, maintenance, transfers)
* Trade lifecycle (capture, affirmation, clearing, settlement, fails, breaks)
* Custody & asset servicing (segregation, security movements, corporate actions, cash)
* Books & records, reconciliations, exception management, and operational controls
* Registered accounts & tax ops: TFSA, RRSP, RESP and related wrappers; tax lots / cost basis; withholding; local reporting partners need to stay compliant
* Day-2 production ops: runbooks, escalations, vendor/custody interfaces, BCP/DR operational playbooks

**How you’ll work:**

* **Translate Canadian reality into runnable process**
  — CIRO-aligned dealer/clearing/custody expectations, introducing–carrying dynamics, custody controls, and operational risk into SOPs, RACI, controls, and exception paths Product and Engineering can build against
* **Automation-first by default**
  — redesign high-volume / high-risk / high-friction work for straight-through processing, rules, exception queues, and measurable SLAs, instead of spreadsheet heroics
* **AI-first operating lens**
  — Prototype and productize AI-assisted ops (exception triage, recon investigation, SOP Q&A, control-testing support, runbook copilots) with human oversight where risk or regulation requires it
* **Go-live and beyond**
  — Readiness for ACCC launch and early production; continuous improvement after go-live
* **Raise the bar without managing a team**
  — Coach partners through expertise, crisp documentation, and decision logs; leave systems others can run

**How we'll measure success:**

* Launch readiness gates met with documented controls, SOPs, RACI, and runbooks Product / Eng / Ops can execute against
* STP, exception, and reconciliation aging targets defined and trending the right way post go-live
* Registered-account and tax workflows ready when partners launch, rather than added later
* Specs and decision logs that remove re-discovery for Product and Engineering
* Systems and playbooks others can run after you, so knowledge sticks in the org and not only in one person's head

**Who you are (Must-haves):**

* 10+ years deep, hands-on Canadian brokerage operations experience at a CIRO dealer, carrying broker, custodian, clearing firm, or brokerage ops function in Canada
* Fluent in the plumbing: clearing / settlement, custody, CDS / CDSX (or equivalent), fails, corp actions, tax, cash / securities ops, account servicing, introducing / carrying arrangements
* Demonstrated depth in at least two of: clearing / settlement; custody & asset servicing; books & records / reconciliations; registered accounts & tax
* Regulatory-literate (CIRO / provincial securities / CSA context). You design operable controls, and you are not the UDP or compliance sign-off owner
* Builder: you've redesigned and shipped process + tooling changes that stuck, not only run BAU
* Practical with automation and AI (workflow automation, rules engines, RPA, or AI-assisted ops). You know where AI helps and where controls must stay deterministic
* Exceptional written communication: SOPs, RACI, decision logs, and requirements that cross-functional teams can ship against

**Who you might be (Nice-to-haves):**

* Greenfield Canadian dealer / clearing / custody stand-up
* API-first or broker-as-a-service / correspondent platforms
* US and Canada dual-entity operations
* Deep CDS / CDSX or Canadian market-infrastructure experience
* Registered-account or Canadian tax-ops stand-up (TFSA, RRSP, RESP, tax lots, withholding, reporting)
* AI-native ops workflow: recurring use of tools like Cursor, Claude, ChatGPT, or custom agents for SOP drafting, exception synthesis, and prototyping

title: PhD Position in Computational Fluid Mechanics and AI/ML-Driven Fluid Mechanics
description:
**PhD opportunity| Fluid mechanics | Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham Coimbatore**

I am inviting applications for full-time/part-time PhD positions under my supervision at
**Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham, Coimbatore**
, in cutting-edge areas of Fluid Mechanics.

**Research Focus Areas:**

**a) Hydrodynamics, Collective Motion and Transport of Marine Microswimmers**

How do ocean waves, currents, and biological responses influence marine microorganism dynamics and transport? What drives collective motion, self-organization, and preferential accumulation of microswimmers? How can AI/ML techniques, including Deep Learning, PINNs, and Reinforcement Learning, be used to model, predict, and control microswimmer dynamics?

**b) Bacterial Motility, Chemotaxis and Collective Dynamics**

How do bacteria sense, navigate, and adapt to complex physical and chemical environments? What mechanisms govern bacterial transport, collective behaviour, aggregation, and pattern formation? How can AI/ML techniques, including Deep Learning, Reinforcement Learning, Inverse Reinforcement Learning, and physics-informed machine learning, uncover bacterial decision-making strategies and predict bacterial dynamics?

**c) Hydrodynamics and Environmental Transport of Marine Microplastics**

How do particle shape, size, inertia, and buoyancy influence microplastic transport in marine environments? What drives microplastic dispersion, sorting, accumulation, and interactions with marine microorganisms? How can AI/ML techniques, including Deep Learning, Neural Operators, PINNs, and hybrid CFD–ML frameworks, predict microplastic transport and environmental fate?

**The research combines mathematical modelling, computational fluid dynamics (CFD), nonlinear dynamical systems, stochastic modelling, and emerging AI/ML-based computational methods.**

**Candidates interested in fundamental theoretical and computational research, AI/ML-driven research, or an integration of both are equally encouraged to apply. Prior knowledge of AI/ML is not mandatory.**

**Eligibility:**
B.E/B.Tech/M.E/MTech in Data science/Artificial Intelligence/Mechanical / Civil / Aerospace Engineering or any allied branches, MSc in Mathematics / Physics

**Fellowship:**
₹30,000/month (up to 4 years, Extendable based on performances)

**How to Apply:**

Interested candidates may apply here:
**https://aoap.amrita.edu/phd-26/index/**

Candidates are requested to mention my name in the place for choice of supervisor.

Interested candidates may also send your CV to: 
**ak\_banerjee@cb.amrita.edu**

**Personal website:**
**https://sites.google.com/view/ayankumarbanerjee**

**Note: Potential candidate may register for PhD in any suitable department and still work under a faculty member from another department—for example, Physics students can register in Physics department, work under my guidance, and earn their PhD in Physics.**

**About the supervisor:**
*Dr. Ayan K. Banerjee is an Assistant Professor at the School of Artificial Intelligence, Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India. He earned his Ph.D. from IIT Bombay, M.Tech from IIT Delhi, and B.E. from IIEST Shibpur (formerly BESU Shibpur). He has also pursued postdoctoral research at the University of Pittsburgh, USA (2022–23), and Tel Aviv University, Israel (2020–21).*

title: Sales And Marketing Representative
description:
Company Description

**Matsui Technologies India Limited (MTIL)**
provides comprehensive plastic processing solutions, including mold temperature controllers, dryers, chillers, dehumidifiers, granulators, blenders, dosing units, metal separators, and centralized conveying and recycling systems. Serving a wide range of sectors—such as automotive, packaging, household, healthcare, food, electrical and electronics, and automation across more than 29 countries—MTIL supports over 600 customers with strong manufacturing capabilities based out of our Greater Noida plant. The organization is TÜV Certified for ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015, and ISO 45001:2018, and holds CE certification for international business. MTIL is part of Matsui Mfg. Co. Ltd., headquartered in Osaka, Japan, offering the backing of a global group company.

Role Description

This is a full-time, field-based (home-office) Sales and Marketing Representative role based in Hyderabad, covering the Telangana and Andhra Pradesh region and reporting to our South Regional Office (Chennai / Bangalore). The representative will identify and pursue new business opportunities, manage existing customer accounts, and promote MTIL’s plastic processing auxiliary equipment across relevant manufacturing segments. Daily responsibilities include conducting client visits, product presentations, and demonstrations; responding to customer inquiries; preparing quotations; and supporting negotiations to close sales. The role also involves implementing regional marketing initiatives, participating in trade shows and industry events, gathering market intelligence, coordinating with technical and service teams to ensure customer satisfaction, and maintaining accurate sales and activity reports.

Qualifications

 \* Strong B2B Sales & Marketing skills for generating leads, building pipelines, and achieving revenue targets.

 \* Excellent communication, negotiation, and customer service skills to engage decision-makers and build long-term client relationships.

 \* Experience in industrial equipment, plastic processing machinery/auxiliaries, or related manufacturing sectors is preferred.

 \* Ability to work independently in a field-sales setup across Telangana and Andhra Pradesh, with readiness to travel within the region (and occasionally to Chennai, Bangalore, or Greater Noida) as needed.

 \* Fluency in Telugu, English, and Hindi, along with a valid two-wheeler/four-wheeler driving license for local industrial visits.

 \* Proficiency in CRM tools and MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) for quotations, reporting, and customer presentations.

 \* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in engineering (Mechanical/Plastics/Manufacturing), business, marketing, or a related field, or equivalent practical B2B sales experience.

* Experience of working with SHG enterprises, FPOs, social enterprises or SRLM/NRLM marketing initiatives is preferred.

**Skills and Competencies**

* Strong brand-building skills: positioning, brand architecture, visual identity, packaging and storytelling.

* Working knowledge of food labelling, FSSAI, quality standards and export documentation (IEC, APEDA).

* Ability to negotiate with B2B vendors, institutional buyers, marketing/; sales market places/ platforms and retail partner chains and to structure commercial arrangements.

* Good understanding of digital marketing, e-commerce, ONDC and social commerce.

* Excellent written and oral communication and presentation skills in English; proficiency in Marathi strongly preferred.

* Ability to manage agencies and vendors for design, packaging and market research.

**About the Project:**

Maharashtra has one of India’s largest Self-Help Group networks, with over 65 lakh SHG women in the programme’s target areas. Mobilisation is largely in place; the challenge now is to raise women’s incomes by improving access to productive assets and markets and strengthening their bargaining power.

Swayamshree 2.0 is Reliance Foundation and Gates Foundation’s response to this challenge in the country. The initiative is being implemented by PCI India in Maharashtra in partnership with the Maharashtra State Rural Livelihoods Mission (MSRLM–UMED). Over three years, the programme aims to help 12 lakh SHG women move toward and beyond the ₹1 lakh annual income benchmark.

The programme works within MSRLM’s existing systems, alongside its community cadres, strengthening priority value chains—including spices, pulses, fruits and community food enterprises—incubating model enterprises, Producer Groups and FPOs, building the UMED brand and market channels, and progressively handing ownership to MSRLM and community institutions.

**About the Role:**

Women's enterprises in Maharashtra produce good products that too often sell in small volumes, at low prices, with inconsistent packaging. As Manager – Branding and Marketing , you will lead brand development for the UMED umbrella brand and its sub-brands, set packaging and quality standards, and build B2B, B2G, B2C and export channels that bring repeat orders to women-led enterprises.

This role suits a marketer who has built or managed food and consumer brands, understands institutional and B2B sales, and wants to apply that commercial discipline to community enterprises.

**Key Responsibilites:**

**Brand Architecture & Product Readiness**

* Lead development of the UMED umbrella brand and category-specific sub-brands, in close coordination with MSRLM.

* Develop common packaging, labelling and quality standards, and support SKU rationalisation and category management.

* Support enterprises with product development, packaging, certification and market positioning; leverage ODOP/GI and IPR opportunities for product differentiation.

* Strengthen white-labelling and private-label opportunities for women-led processing units.

**B2B & Export Market Linkages**

* Develop and manage relationships with anchor buyers, processors and FMCG companies: buyer segmentation, sampling, vendor empanelment and rate contracts.

* Organise and lead district and state-level Buyer–Seller Meets, reverse BSMs and product showcases.

* Assess export readiness of commercially mature enterprises and facilitate compliance, FIEO membership, global B2B meets and trade fairs.

**B2G & B2C Channels**

* Facilitate GeM and tender empanelment and procurement linkages with government canteens, hospitals, hostels, schools, Anganwadis and other public institutions.

* Reposition UMED Mart as an omnichannel platform: merchandising, POS and inventory digitisation and demand analytics.

* Build and manage e-commerce, ONDC, organised retail and exhibition channels such as Saras Mela.

**Market Intelligence & Capacity Building**

* Set up buyer CRM, demand forecasting and price-realisation tracking with the MIS Officer.

* Train MSRLM staff, District Coordinators and community cadres on marketing, pricing, negotiation and buyer management.

* Document market-linkage models and results for replication and reporting.

Direct impact on how Mise is seen by the hotel industry, working alongside the founders and an advisory board from hospitality.

description:

**How We Work**

Energy Exemplar is growing fast around 30% year on year and, that growth is driven by how we work. We trust our team to deliver great results from wherever they work best, whether that’s at home, in the office, or on the move.

We’re a global team that values ownership, integrity, and innovation. You’ll be supported to balance work and life in a way that works for you, and empowered to take initiative, solve problems, and make an impact, regardless of your background, location, or role.

Our four core values, Customer Success, One Global Team, Integrity & Ownership, and Innovation Excellence aren’t just words. They show up in how we collaborate, how we solve, and how we grow together.

**About The Opportunity**

We are looking for a
**Senior UX Designer**
with strong craft, solid research practice, and real experience building AI-powered products.
**UX research**
is a core part of this role. You will plan and run studies with domain experts, turning what you learn into clear design decisions. You will also shape how energy analysts, grid planners, and market traders use our simulation and data tools, working closely with product managers, engineers, and domain experts.

**UX Research**

Research is a key output of this role, not just a supporting task. You will lead the research program for your product areas, working closely with product and engineering teams.

**Research Methods**

* In-depth interviews and contextual inquiry: one-on-one sessions with energy modelers, traders, grid operators, and regulators to understand their goals, workflows, and pain points.
* Moderated usability testing: task-based sessions on prototypes or live builds to find friction points, comprehension gaps, and usability issues.
* Surveys and concept testing: structured questionnaires to check assumptions and measure satisfaction (CSAT, SUS, NPS) before committing to a full design.
* Card sorting and tree testing:

  validate

   the information architecture and navigation of complex platforms like PLEXOS Cloud.
* Heuristic evaluation: structured reviews against Nielsen's 10 heuristics and WCAG 2.1 to find issues without needing participant sessions.
* Pendo analytics: use real product usage data to spot adoption gaps, drop-off points, and friction areas, then connect those findings with qualitative research.

**Research Activities**

* Plan and

  facilitate:

   

  write

   research plans and discussion guides, recruit participants from Energy Exemplar's customer base, and run sessions with energy domain experts.
* Synthesize:

  use

   affinity mapping and thematic analysis to turn raw data into clear insights, separating symptoms from root causes.
* Share findings:

  write

   concise reports with clear recommendations and present them in team reviews and stakeholder meetings.

**Research Planning**

* Keep a rolling quarterly research plan that is aligned to the product roadmap, with studies prioritized by impact and risk.
* Balance discovery research and evaluative research: know when a full study is needed versus a quick concept test

  . 


  Manage time constraints and 

  select the

   

  appropriate

   

  research

  method.

**What You Will Do**

* Own end-to-end UX across PLEXOS Cloud, PLEXOS Desktop, Aurora, Adapt2, and PLEXOS Intelligence, from discovery through to delivery and iteration.
* Apply UX heuristics in a practical way: reduce cognitive load in dashboards, simulation builders, and data visualizations.
* Design AI-native experiences: conversational interfaces, copilot features, intelligent recommendations, and human-in-the-loop workflows.
* Use vibe-coding in your day-to-day work: tools like Figma Make, Claude, GitHub Copilot, and

  VSCode

   with 

  Opencode

   to prototype fast and make UX changes directly in dev environments.
* Maintain the design system: keep

  component

   libraries, interaction patterns, and design tokens consistent across products in Figma.
* Turn complex data into clear visuals: design charts, scenario comparison views, time-series dashboards, and simulation result displays.
* Work cross-functionally: collaborate with engineering, data science, product, and customer success to ship designs that are practical, tested, and aligned to business goals.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5-8 years of UX design experience with a portfolio that shows research, information architecture, interaction design, and visual design. Expert in Figma.
* Strong knowledge of UX heuristics and design principles, with the ability to apply them to real design decisions and reviews.
* Hands-on experience with AI design and coding tools: Figma Make, Claude, GitHub Copilot,

  VSCode

   with 

  Opencode

  , or similar.
* Experience designing complex data visualizations for expert B2B users: dashboards, time-series charts, and scenario comparison tools.
* Has designed AI-native features such as copilots, intelligent automation, generative UI, or recommendation systems.
* Design systems experience:

  component

   libraries, design tokens, variants, auto-layout, and engineering handoff in Figma.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Background designing cloud-native SaaS platforms for technical users or domain experts.
* Front-end literacy: comfortable reading and writing HTML, CSS, and JavaScript alongside engineers.
* Nice to have:


   s

  ome familiarity with energy market concepts such as electricity dispatch, capacity planning, grid topology, or commodity trading.

**What We Offer**

* Meaningful work: your designs will shape how energy markets are planned around the world, supporting the move to clean energy.
* AI-forward culture:


  PLEXOS Intelligence is a core 

  investment

  and you will be working on the front line of AI product development.
* Global team: colleagues across the US, Europe, Australia, and Asia in a fast-growing and collaborative environment.
* Learning and growth: domain training via Energy Exemplar's Xpert platform, conference attendance, and mentorship from product and engineering leaders.

title: Senior Customer Enablement Analyst
description:
At SiteMinder, we believe our success comes from our people. We build diverse, inclusive teams where different voices, backgrounds and perspectives are valued. Our differences drive innovation for our customers, and our people bring the ideas, expertise and energy that help us keep moving forward. We’re better together.
  
  
**What We Do...**
Right now, somewhere in the world, a hotel is taking a booking or increasing their revenue through technology you could help build. SiteMinder is the world’s leading hotel commerce platform. For more than 20 years, we’ve helped hotels attract guests, maximise revenue, forecast demand and perform at their best. Today, our platform supports 56,000+ hotels in 150+ countries, connects to 3,000+ partners and powers more than 140m reservations and AU$85 billion+ in hotel revenue each year.
  
  
That’s the kind of impact your work can have here. You’ll solve meaningful challenges with AI, simplify complexity and build solutions that help hotels perform. Supported by clear purpose, a strong platform and teams who care about what they’re building, you’ll have the opportunity to shape the future of an industry that never stands still.
  
  
**About The Senior Customer Enablement Analyst Role...**
The Senior Customer Enablement Analyst helps customer-facing teams identify, evaluate and deliver AI and technology solutions that support SiteMinder’s customer lifecycle, from onboarding through adoption, support, success management, renewal and expansion. The role acts as a catalyst ,and tech SME and delivery partner. It takes problems and opportunities raised by customer team leaders, explores solutions, and moves agreed initiatives from discovery through testing, launch and adoption. It then tracks operational outcomes.
  
  
The role is system-agnostic and outcome-focused. It works across the customer technology stack, including Intercom, and reviews and recommends workflow and configuration changes so that tools support how customer teams work. Customer Technology owns the technology roadmap and platform decisions. Process Excellence owns process design and improvement. This role makes sure customer-team needs are understood, solutions are grounded in real workflows, and changes are usable and adopted..
  
  
**What You Will Do...**

* Act as the primary engagement partner for Customer teams, shaping initiatives across Onboarding, Support, and Customer Success and ensuring they align to broader transformation priorities.
* Within Data and Business Systems ensure Customer teams requirements are reflected in tooling roadmaps, platform designs and delivery sequencing.
* Intake and prioritisation: capture problems and opportunities from Support, Onboarding and Success leaders, and help prioritise them with the Customer Technology Director.
* Solution exploration: research AI and technology options, run vendor demos and proofs of concept, and compare options against the need.
* Project delivery: manage initiatives from discovery through testing, launch and adoption, tracking timelines, risks and dependencies.
* Vendor liaison: act as the day-to-day contact for external partners on requirements, delivery and performance.
* Platform workflows: review and recommend configuration changes to customer-support platform workflows,
* Understand and improve customer workflows: Document processes, roles, handoffs and pain points; facilitate discovery; and help teams address process, data, training or technology issues.
* Shape and coordinate delivery: Turn business needs into clear requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria. Coordinate business-side work through design, testing, launch and hypercare, while tracking scope, risks, dependencies and decisions.
* Enable adoption: Support communications, training and rollout planning; gather feedback; resolve adoption barriers; and keep process and user guidance current.
* Support AI, data and automation opportunities: Help define use cases, expected benefits, data needs, human review and success measures. Support pilots and follow SiteMinder’s AI, privacy, security and data governance requirements.
* Measure outcomes: Agree measures with business and technology owners and report on adoption, customer impact and operational results.

**What You Have...**

* Extensive experience in business analysis, customer operations, enablement, service improvement, transformation or a related field.
* Ability to analyse customer-facing workflows and produce clear process maps, requirements or delivery documentation.
* Experience supporting cross-functional work through testing, rollout, training and continuous improvement.
* Familiarity with onboarding, support, customer success, case handling or customer communications; B2B SaaS experience is an advantage.
* Strong facilitation, communication and stakeholder-management skills; able to manage ambiguity and competing priorities.
* Practical understanding of data, automation and AI, including privacy, quality, human oversight and controls.

**Our Perks & Benefits…**

* Flexibility to work in a Hybrid model (3 days in-office)
* Annual and Sick Leaves
* Paid Birthday, Study and Volunteering Leaves every year
* Medical Insurance Cover
* Employee Referral Bonus
* Tenure Bonus
* Team Events & Celebrations

Think this role sounds like you? If so, we’d love to hear from you. Please send us your resume and our Talent Acquisition team will be in touch.
  
  
When you apply, feel free to share your pronouns and let us know if you need any adjustments during the interview process, we’re here to support you. We also warmly encourage applications from people from underrepresented backgrounds.

title: Technical Project Manager
description:
**Job Description – Technical Project Manager**

**Position:**
Technical Project Manager (TPM)

**Experience:**
6–10 Years

**Location:**
Pune

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Department:**
Project Delivery & Technology

**Reporting To:**
Head of Project Management / Delivery Head

**About Asmadiya Technologies**

Asmadiya Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is a growing IT services and technology solutions company specializing in
**Artificial Intelligence (AI), Agentic AI, Cloud Computing, Enterprise Application Development, DevOps, Digital Transformation, and Data Analytics**
.

We work with enterprise clients across BFSI, manufacturing, logistics, and other industries to deliver scalable, secure, and innovative technology solutions.

We are looking for a highly motivated and technically strong
**Technical Project Manager**
who can lead complex software development projects, manage cross-functional engineering teams, engage with customers, and ensure successful project delivery.

**Role Overview**

The Technical Project Manager will be responsible for end-to-end management and delivery of enterprise technology projects.

The ideal candidate should combine
**strong technical expertise, hands-on software engineering understanding, project management capabilities, and excellent client communication skills**
.

This is not a purely coordination-focused project management role. The candidate must understand software architecture, participate in technical discussions, challenge engineering decisions when required, identify delivery risks proactively, and support teams in resolving complex technical problems.

The TPM will also be responsible for ensuring project profitability, delivery quality, resource utilization, and customer satisfaction.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. End-to-End Project Management**

* Manage multiple software development projects from initiation through production deployment and support.
* Define project scope, objectives, milestones, deliverables, timelines, and resource requirements.
* Develop detailed project plans, sprint plans, resource allocation plans, and delivery schedules.
* Own project execution and ensure delivery within agreed timelines, scope, budget, and quality standards.
* Establish and monitor project KPIs, delivery metrics, and performance dashboards.
* Manage project dependencies, risks, issues, change requests, and escalations.
* Ensure appropriate documentation, governance, and reporting throughout the project lifecycle.

**2. Technical Leadership & Architecture Understanding**

* Demonstrate strong understanding of modern software development architectures and engineering practices.
* Participate in technical discussions involving solution design, system architecture, APIs, databases, cloud infrastructure, and integrations.
* Collaborate with Solution Architects, Technical Leads, Developers, QA Engineers, DevOps Engineers, and AI Engineers.
* Review technical approaches, identify potential challenges, and suggest practical solutions.
* Ensure adherence to coding standards, architecture guidelines, security practices, and performance requirements.
* Understand production issues and coordinate root cause analysis and resolution.
* Support teams in resolving technical blockers and complex delivery challenges.
* Encourage engineering best practices, automation, reusable components, and continuous improvement.

**3. Agile Delivery & Scrum Management**

* Lead Agile/Scrum ceremonies including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Work closely with Product Owners and Business Analysts to prioritize requirements and maintain a healthy product backlog.
* Define sprint goals and ensure effective estimation and capacity planning.
* Monitor sprint velocity, burndown charts, cycle time, and delivery predictability.
* Manage release planning and coordinate deployments across development, testing, staging, and production environments.
* Support Agile, Waterfall, and Hybrid delivery models depending on client requirements.

**4. Client & Stakeholder Management**

* Act as the primary point of contact for project delivery and technical coordination.
* Conduct regular client meetings, steering committee discussions, and delivery reviews.
* Understand business requirements and translate them into executable delivery plans.
* Provide transparent status reports covering progress, milestones, risks, dependencies, and action items.
* Manage client expectations and proactively address delivery concerns.
* Build strong relationships with customer stakeholders and identify opportunities for account expansion.
* Coordinate with pre-sales and business development teams for technical proposals, estimates, and new project opportunities.

**5. Team Leadership & Resource Management**

* Lead cross-functional engineering teams across frontend, backend, cloud, DevOps, testing, and AI/ML.
* Assign responsibilities and ensure accountability for deliverables.
* Mentor Technical Leads, Developers, and other team members.
* Conduct regular performance discussions and provide constructive feedback.
* Identify skill gaps and coordinate technical training and capability development.
* Manage resource utilization, project allocation, and capacity planning.
* Foster a collaborative, high-performance, ownership-driven engineering culture.

**6. Quality, Security & Delivery Governance**

* Ensure comprehensive testing, code review, quality assurance, and release readiness.
* Implement structured delivery governance, including RAID logs, change management, and escalation mechanisms.
* Coordinate CI/CD pipelines, deployment strategies, and release management activities.
* Ensure compliance with project-specific information security and data protection requirements.
* Work with DevOps and infrastructure teams to maintain application reliability, performance, and scalability.
* Implement corrective and preventive actions based on delivery audits and lessons learned.

**7. Project Commercials & Financial Management**

* Manage effort estimation, project budgets, resource costs, and delivery profitability.
* Monitor planned versus actual efforts and identify cost or schedule deviations.
* Track resource utilization, project margins, and budget consumption.
* Manage change requests and assess their commercial impact.
* Support billing milestones, timesheet compliance, and client acceptance of deliverables.
* Identify opportunities to improve delivery efficiency and reduce project costs without compromising quality.

**Required Technical Skills**

**Area**

**Expected Knowledge**

Programming

Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, Python, or .NET

Frontend

Angular, React, Next.js

Backend

Spring Boot, Node.js, NestJS, REST APIs, Microservices

Databases

PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle, SQL Server, NoSQL

Cloud

AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud

DevOps

CI/CD, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Docker, Kubernetes

Architecture

Microservices, API integration, distributed systems, scalability

AI Technologies

Basic understanding of GenAI, LLMs, RAG, and Agentic AI

Project Tools

Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, MS Project

Delivery Methods

Agile, Scrum, Kanban, Waterfall, Hybrid

Quality & Security

SonarQube, automated testing, OWASP, secure SDLC

**Note:**
The candidate is not expected to be an expert in every technology listed but must possess strong technical foundations.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* **6–10 years of overall IT experience**
  , including at least 3 years in technical project management or technical delivery leadership.
* Prior hands-on experience as a Software Developer, Technical Lead, or Solution Engineer is strongly preferred.
* Proven experience delivering enterprise-grade web applications, APIs, cloud solutions, or digital transformation projects.
* Experience managing cross-functional teams of approximately 8–20 members.
* Strong understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
* Demonstrated experience with effort estimation, project scheduling, risk management, and stakeholder communication.
* Experience managing multiple projects simultaneously.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, leadership, and negotiation skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* PMP, PMI-ACP, Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), or equivalent certification.
* AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud certification.
* Experience delivering AI/ML, GenAI, Agentic AI, or intelligent automation projects.
* Exposure to enterprise security, compliance, and regulatory requirements.
* Experience in fixed-price, time-and-material, and managed-services engagement models.
* Experience working with international clients across the US, UK, Europe, or Middle East.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

**KPI**

**Expected Performance**

Project Schedule Adherence ≥ 95%

Sprint Commitment Achievement ≥ 90%

Project Budget Variance Within ± 5%

Project Gross Margin Meet approved project targets

Resource Utilization Meet delivery utilization targets

Client Satisfaction ≥ 4.8/5

Critical Risk Management 100% tracked with mitigation plans

Delivery Documentation 100% compliance with PMO standards

Production Quality Meet agreed defect and SLA targets

Project Reporting 100% on-time reporting

**What We Expect From You**

We are looking for a Technical Project Manager who:

* Takes complete ownership of project outcomes rather than only tracking tasks.
* Understands technology deeply enough to challenge assumptions and support engineering decisions.
* Can independently manage clients and engineering teams.
* Identifies potential risks before they become critical delivery issues.
* Balances technical quality, speed, customer satisfaction, and project profitability.
* Demonstrates an execution-focused, solution-oriented mindset.
* Is comfortable working in a growing, fast-paced technology organization.

**Why Join Asmadiya?**

* Work on emerging technologies including Agentic AI, Generative AI, and Cloud-Native Applications.
* Lead enterprise digital transformation initiatives and complex engineering projects.
* Collaborate directly with technical leadership and business stakeholders.
* Opportunity to influence engineering practices, delivery governance, and organizational growth.

* Excellent organizational skills and a structured approach to managing project timelines and documentation.
* Strong problem-solving abilities and a customer-oriented mindset.

Qualifications

title: Project Manager - Logistics Division
description:
**Job Description**

**General Project Manager – Logistics Division**

**Company:**
Bharat Maritime Pvt. Ltd. (BMPL).

**Experience:**
15 years or more.

**Qualification:**
B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical, Electrical, Automotive, or a related engineering discipline. Project management certifications or relevant postgraduate qualifications will be an advantage.

**Preferred Industry Background:**
Indian Railways, Metro Railways, Rolling Stock, Railway Electrification, Heavy Engineering related to Railways.

**Job Purpose**

NL is seeking an experienced General Manager (Projects) for its’ Logistics Division to lead the planning, estimation, coordination, and execution of complex engineering Projects involving construction and operation of elevated freight corridors based on latest technologies.

***The ideal candidate will have substantial experience with Indian Railways and/or Metro Railways***
, coupled with understanding of Sea Port Logistics. A strong understanding of Railway technical systems and operations, and proven expertise in project estimation, costing, budgeting, and execution. This shall be a techno-commercial role.

As NL’s Logistics expands, the candidate will contribute to developing project execution capabilities, establishing effective project management processes, and coordinating multidisciplinary engineering teams to deliver projects within defined timelines, budgets, and quality standards.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Project Planning and Execution**

* Lead end-to-end project planning, scheduling, resource allocation, execution, monitoring, and delivery.
* Develop project schedules, milestones, budgets, and execution plans.
* Coordinate with engineering, procurement, production, quality, testing, and commissioning teams.
* Monitor project progress, resolve execution challenges, and implement corrective actions to ensure timely delivery.

**2. Technical and Operational Expertise**

* Apply a thorough understanding of Indian Railways and Metro Railway networks, operating procedures, technical systems, and engineering standards.
* Evaluate technical specifications, engineering drawings, equipment requirements, and project feasibility.
* Leverage railway operations and systems experience to support the development and implementation of e-fleet solutions.
* Co-ordinate with mechanical, electrical, electronics, and other engineering teams, as relevant to Project requirements.

**3. Estimation, Costing and Commercial Management**

* Prepare and review project cost estimates, BOQs, cost sheets, budgets, and technical-commercial proposals.
* Evaluate material, equipment, manpower, manufacturing, installation, testing, and commissioning costs.
* Support tender preparation, bid evaluation, vendor negotiations, and commercial assessments.
* Track actual project costs against approved budgets and identify opportunities for cost optimisation.

**4. Stakeholder and Team Management**

* Lead cross-functional teams and establish clear project responsibilities and deliverables.
* Coordinate with customers, railway authorities, consultants, vendors, contractors, and other stakeholders, as applicable.
* Conduct project review meetings and provide progress, cost, risk, and performance reports to senior management.
* Identify project risks and implement mitigation plans to maintain quality, safety, cost, and schedule objectives.

**7. Quality, Safety and Compliance**

* Ensure adherence to applicable engineering specifications, quality standards, contractual requirements, and safety procedures.
* Coordinate inspection, testing, commissioning, documentation, and project handover activities.
* Ensure compliance with relevant railway, electrical, and other regulatory requirements applicable to individual projects.

**Experience and Competencies**

* Minimum 15+ years of relevant experience in project management, railway operations, technical engineering, estimation, costing, related projects.
* Prior experience with Indian Railways, Metro Railways, rolling stock, railway electrification, or railway engineering organisations is preferred.
* Strong knowledge of railway network operations, technical systems, engineering specifications, and operational requirements.
* Proven experience in project estimation, budgeting, cost control, tendering, and project execution.
* Ability to interpret engineering drawings, technical specifications, BOQs, and contractual documents.
* Experience in multidisciplinary team coordination, vendor management, and stakeholder engagement.
* Strong planning, analytical, commercial, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, MS Project, and other project planning tools.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

A technically strong and commercially oriented professional with experience in Indian Railways or Metro Railways who can transition railway domain knowledge into the execution of complex engineering projects. Candidates with exposure to rolling stock, electrification, heavy engineering will be preferred.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Achievement of project milestones and delivery schedules.
* Accuracy of estimates and adherence to approved project budgets.
* Effective resource utilisation and cost optimisation.
* Quality of project execution and compliance with applicable standards.
* Effective management of project risks and stakeholder expectations.
* Successful integration, testing, commissioning, and handover of project deliverables

description:

title: Program Manager
description:
**Role:**
Program Manager

**Work Mode:**
Hybrid (3 days in office, rest remote)

**Job Location:**
Pune or Gurgaon

**Program Manager, Enterprise Delivery (US Clients):-**

We are hiring a Program Manager with 10+ years of experience delivering projects for US-based enterprise clients, based in Pune or Gurgaon, working in the office three days a week.

**About the role:-**

You will own end-to-end delivery of complex projects for US-based enterprise clients, working from India with cross-functional teams across engineering, design, QA and client-side stakeholders. This is a senior, hands-on role: you set the plan, run the cadence, keep the client informed with crisp communication, and make sure work ships fast and at high quality.

We are looking for someone who has done this for many years, can speak credibly with enterprise executives, and brings a point of view on how delivery should run.

**What you will do:-**

* Own delivery of enterprise client projects from kickoff to closure, accountable for scope, schedule, quality and client satisfaction.
* Build clear, realistic project plans: work breakdown, milestones, dependencies, resourcing and risk, kept current as the work moves.
* Run weekly and daily delivery rhythms with cross-functional teams, removing blockers and keeping the work moving at velocity.
* Produce crisp status reports for US clients and internal leadership: progress, risks, decisions needed and next steps, with no surprises.
* Spot risks early and escalate them promptly, with a clear recommendation and a fallback, to the right level on both the client and internal side.
* Hold the quality bar: define acceptance criteria with the team, track defects and rework, and make sure releases meet client expectations.
* Manage scope and change control, keeping commercial and delivery stakeholders aligned.
* Work across time zones, with regular overlap with US client teams.
* Share your point of view on delivery practices, templates and lessons learned to raise the standard for the wider team.

**What you bring:-**

* 10+ years of project or program management experience, with a substantial part of it delivering projects for US-based enterprise clients.
* A track record of running complex, multi-team projects to on-time, on-quality delivery.
* Crisp written and verbal communication, comfortable presenting to senior client stakeholders.
* Thought leadership: a clear view on how to run delivery well, and the ability to coach others on it.
* Strong skill in building clear project plans and keeping them accurate, using tools such as Jira, MS Project, Smartsheet or similar.
* Proven ability to work with cross-functional teams (engineering, design, QA, business) without direct authority.
* Disciplined status reporting and a calm, structured approach to escalation.
* A bias for velocity without giving up quality.
* Working hours that allow overlap with US time zones.

**Location and working model:-**

* Location: Pune or Gurgaon, India.
* Working model: in the office three days a week, the rest remote.
* Working hours with regular overlap with US client time zones.

title: Construction Manager
description:
**About The Role**
We are looking for an experienced Construction Manager to oversee the successful delivery of our construction projects, ensuring they are completed on time, within budget and to the highest quality and safety standards. In this role, you will take ownership of the construction process, from initial mobilisation through to final handover, coordinating with contractors, consultants and internal stakeholders to ensure smooth execution. You will play a key role in managing project timelines, budgets, quality and risks, while ensuring that all construction activities align with business objectives, technical requirements and regulatory standards.
  
  
Main Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead and oversee the end-to-end construction process, from initial mobilization through to project completion and handover, ensuring delivery on time, within budget and in line with approved designs and specifications.
* Act as the main point of contact between the company, project management consultants, contractors and other stakeholders, ensuring effective coordination and alignment on project objectives.
* Review and monitor construction schedules, ensuring key milestones are achieved and proactively addressing delays, risks and operational challenges.
* Ensure all construction activities meet the required quality standards, approved specifications, applicable building regulations and industry best practices.
* Oversee project budgets and expenditure, managing variations, change orders and contractor claims to maintain cost control and financial accountability.
* Provide regular updates to senior management on project progress, key milestones, financial performance, potential risks and recommended corrective actions.
* Ensure compliance with Health, Safety and Environment (HSE) requirements, promoting safe working practices across all contractors and project stakeholders.
* Collaborate with Legal, Procurement and other internal teams to ensure contractual compliance, effective vendor management and timely resolution of disputes or commercial issues.
* Identify opportunities to improve construction processes, project delivery efficiency and overall quality.

What You Bring
  
  

* Proven experience in construction management, with a strong track record of delivering complex construction projects from planning through to completion.
* A degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture or a related field.
* Strong knowledge of construction methodologies, project planning, quality standards and applicable building regulations.
* Experience managing contractors, consultants and external stakeholders across multiple stages of construction projects.
* Solid understanding of project budgeting, cost control, contract administration and change management.
* Ability to interpret architectural and engineering drawings, technical specifications and construction documentation.
* Familiarity with project management tools and construction scheduling software, such as Primavera P6, Microsoft Project or similar platforms.
* Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills, with the ability to anticipate challenges and drive practical solutions.
* Excellent communication, negotiation and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to work effectively with senior management.
* A proactive, hands-on approach, with strong ownership, attention to detail and a focus on delivering results.

**About Us**
ARRISE sets the benchmark for service delivery and excellence in the iGaming industry. Playing a key role in the success of its clients, which include Pragmatic Play, a brand relied upon by the world’s biggest online casinos for its cutting-edge products, ARRISE helps to deliver exceptional gaming experiences to millions of players worldwide.
  
  
Our global team of over 13,000 talented and driven professionals are shaping the future of iGaming. Headquartered in Gibraltar, we have offices spanning Canada, India, the Isle of Man, Latvia, Malta, Romania, Serbia, Bulgaria, and the UAE, and more exciting destinations on the horizon.
  
  
At ARRISE, we take pride in creating growth opportunities at all levels, constantly investing in our people while welcoming new colleagues and forging strategic partnerships that open new opportunities for success.
  
  
To achieve this, we bet on ourselves. We know that success is a collective effort, and our team is driven by ambition, collaboration, and a shared commitment to grow and succeed — while embracing every step of the journey.
  
  
Be part of the future of iGaming with 13,000 ARRISERS! See a job that excites you? Apply now, and our friendly recruitment team will connect with you soon. Your journey starts here.

title: Change Management / Consultant Specialist
description:
Some careers shine brighter than others.
  
  
If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
  
  
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Consultant Specialist
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**
Why HSBC
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
HSBC is establishing a Value Stream Optimisation (VSO) capability to operationalise an approved value stream operating model and connect strategy, Future State Architecture, roadmaps and delivery to measurable customer and business value. This role supports change delivery, readiness and adoption across VSO pilots and implementation waves so impacted teams can move to clear accountabilities, decision rights, governance and outcome-led ways of working. Working under the direction of the VS Change Lead you’ll translate operating-model designs into practical actions across communications, learning and stakeholder engagement. Success means implementation activity lands to the right quality and timescales with clear evidence of readiness and sustained use. You’ll keep stakeholders informed, surface risks and dependencies early and capture learning that supports controlled, repeatable scale-up.
  
  
What you'll be doing
  
  

* Deliver assigned change, readiness and adoption activity across one or more value stream pilots or implementation waves
* Translate approved designs and milestones into practical actions for impacted teams including owners, dependencies and readiness criteria
* Complete impact assessments across roles, accountabilities, governance, processes, tooling and management information
* Engage day-to-day stakeholders across business, technology and enabling functions to gather feedback and address routine queries
* Prepare and deliver communications, briefings, learning sessions and practical guidance using agreed messages and materials
* Coordinate pilot mobilisation, workshops and implementation events including logistics, materials, action tracking and follow-up
* Collect and evaluate readiness and adoption indicators to surface barriers and propose follow-up actions to the Change Lead
* Maintain accurate logs and records for people and operational impacts, issues, dependencies and control considerations, escalating where needed

What we're looking for
  
  

* Bring practical experience supporting change, readiness, communications, learning or adoption within a transformation, operating-model or technology-enabled programme
* Build and maintain impact assessments, change plans, stakeholder materials, readiness actions and adoption reporting with guidance from a change lead or programme manager
* Coordinate workshops, pilots and phased implementations across business and technology teams
* Organise feedback and data, identify straightforward themes and support follow-up actions through to completion
* Maintain action, issue, dependency and readiness logs and escalate risks and decisions clearly and promptly
* Apply working knowledge of Value Stream Management, product or portfolio operating models, Lean and agile delivery with deeper expertise developed in role
* Use tools such as Clarity, JIRA and Confluence or comparable platforms to support delivery and reporting
* Hold a change management qualification such as Prosci, APMG Change Management or equivalent certification, or bring equivalent demonstrable experience

Scaling change through VSO
  
  
If you want to help teams adopt a value stream operating model in a way that’s practical, evidence-based and repeatable this role offers the scope to make a visible impact. You’ll work alongside Optimisation Execution, Design, Future State Architecture, Maturity and Tooling & Insights teams while partnering closely with colleagues in pilots and implementation waves. The work is hands-on and grounded in delivery - turning approved designs into adoption that sticks. Apply to help shape how VSO is mobilised, measured and scaled across HSBC.
  
  
You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.
  
  
www.hsbc.com/careers
  
  
HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

description:

title: Data Architect
description:
Cordance is dedicated to accelerating the growth of vertically focused business-to-business (B2B) software-as-a-service (SaaS) companies through acquisition and long-term tactical and financial guidance. We’re experienced operators and subject-matter experts with a passion for software and building businesses. We partner with founders to help them scale their businesses and realize their companies’ full potential.
  
  
We look for businesses with strong leadership and high potential for profitable growth, and work together to increase year-over-year revenue, company efficiency, and impact. Cordance envisions that all companies we work with achieve their full potential. We embrace what makes each company great and build on those foundations. We believe in elevating a company as it scales, delivering dignity to the organization and its employees, and sharing a passion for building a legacy.
  
  
Position Overview
  
  
The Data Architect will define and lead the enterprise data architecture for Cordance Commerce, with primary responsibility for unifying reporting platforms, data models, and analytics capabilities across Solutions, Secure Retail, Upright, and Pearl Dive. This is a hands-on technical leadership role for someone who can turn fragmented operational data and customer-specific reporting into a scalable, governed, and reliable data platform.
  
  
The role partners closely with Database Administrators, Business Intelligence professionals, Engineering, Product, Finance, Customer Success, and business leaders. The Data Architect will establish a practical migration strategy that separates analytical workloads from transactional systems, protects product performance, preserves critical customer reporting, and enables a trusted source of data across the portfolio.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Own the target-state data architecture and roadmap for a unified reporting and analytics platform across Cordance Commerce products.
* Assess current transactional databases, data pipelines, reporting tools, standard BI reports, and customer-specific reports; document dependencies, duplication, performance risks, and migration constraints.
* Define a shared enterprise data model, canonical business definitions, master-data strategy, and system-of-record ownership for core entities such as customer, item, store, employee, transaction, inventory, donation, processing, and e-commerce activity.
* Design the separation of transactional and analytical workloads using fit-for-purpose patterns such as a cloud data warehouse or lakehouse; evaluate platforms including Snowflake and recommend the appropriate solution based on scale, security, cost, operability, and business needs.
* Create the phased migration strategy for consolidating reporting from Solutions, Secure Retail, Upright, and Pearl Dive while maintaining business continuity and customer commitments.
* Develop patterns and standards for data ingestion, transformation, orchestration, semantic models, APIs, data quality, lineage, metadata, retention, archival, and observability.
* Partner with BI professionals to rationalize the Solutions standard report catalog and reduce the support burden created by hundreds of Secure Retail customer-specific reports through reusable datasets, governed self-service analytics, and configurable reporting patterns.
* Guide DBAs and engineering teams on database architecture, PostgreSQL and Microsoft SQL modernization, replication or change-data-capture patterns, performance isolation, backup, recovery, and operational readiness.
* Establish data governance practices covering data ownership, access controls, privacy, security, auditability, quality thresholds, and change management.
* Lead technical discovery, architecture reviews, proofs of concept, and vendor evaluations; translate findings into actionable designs, sequencing, estimates, risks, and investment recommendations.
* Provide hands-on technical guidance to delivery teams, review implementation designs, and ensure new product capabilities align with the target architecture instead of creating additional data silos.
* Enable trusted enterprise dashboards and cross-product reporting that support operational, customer, financial, and executive decision-making.

**Competencies**

* Enterprise Data Architecture: Converts complex, fragmented data estates into pragmatic target-state architectures and phased roadmaps.
* Technical Depth: Designs modern warehouses or lakehouses, dimensional and relational models, pipelines, semantic layers, and reporting platforms.
* Business Translation: Connects architecture decisions to customer value, product performance, operational efficiency, and measurable business outcomes.
* Data Governance: Establishes clear ownership, definitions, lineage, quality, security, and lifecycle controls without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.
* Migration Leadership: Plans incremental transitions that protect customer reporting and production stability while retiring duplication and technical debt.
* Influence and Collaboration: Builds alignment across DBAs, BI, Engineering, Product, Customer Success, and executive stakeholders.
* Ownership: Drives decisions through implementation, manages ambiguity, and remains accountable for platform adoption and results.
* AI and Analytics Readiness: Designs governed, reusable data foundations suitable for advanced analytics and AI-enabled workflows.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Management, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8+ years of experience in data engineering, database architecture, analytics engineering, or business intelligence, including 3+ years in a data architecture or senior technical leadership role.
* Demonstrated experience designing enterprise data warehouses, lakehouses, or analytical platforms and migrating data from multiple operational systems.
* Strong data-modeling expertise across conceptual, logical, and physical models, including dimensional modeling and normalized transactional designs.
* Hands-on proficiency with SQL, relational databases, ETL/ELT patterns, orchestration, data quality, metadata, lineage, and BI semantic models.
* Experience separating reporting workloads from high-volume transactional systems and designing for performance, resilience, scalability, and cost control.
* Experience with cloud data platforms and modern data integration patterns, including APIs, replication, and change data capture.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present architecture decisions and tradeoffs to technical and non-technical audiences.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Hands-on experience with Snowflake and at least one major cloud platform such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
* Experience with PostgreSQL and Microsoft SQL, including modernization or migration initiatives.
* Experience consolidating reporting platforms following acquisitions or across a multi-product SaaS portfolio.
* Experience rationalizing large libraries of standard and customer-specific reports and enabling governed self-service analytics.
* Familiarity with retail, point-of-sale, inventory, e-commerce, donation, or thrift/resale data domains.
* Knowledge of data privacy, security, role-based access, audit, retention, and compliance practices.
* Experience enabling machine learning, generative AI, or agentic AI use cases through governed enterprise data products.
* Relevant cloud, Snowflake, data-management, or architecture certification is a plus.

**What We Offer**

* Work with a mission-driven team building impactful software solutions for the thrift and resale industry.
* Opportunity to shape shared technology capabilities across a growing portfolio of commerce products.
* Collaborative culture that values innovation, accountability, continuous learning, and transparency.
* Competitive compensation, benefits, and opportunities for career growth.

**Success Measurements**
**Architecture & Roadmap**

* Completes an agreed current-state assessment and target-state architecture covering all Commerce reporting platforms and critical data domains.
* Delivers an approved, sequenced migration roadmap with clear dependencies, costs, risks, and ownership.

**Unified Data & Reporting**

* Establishes common business definitions and governed data models that are adopted by reporting and product teams.
* Reduces duplicated datasets and one-off reporting solutions while preserving priority customer capabilities.
* Enables reliable cross-product operational and executive reporting from trusted data sources.

**Performance, Reliability & Quality**

* Moves resource-intensive analytics away from transactional systems where appropriate and measurably reduces reporting-related production impact.
* Implements measurable data-quality, freshness, lineage, observability, and recovery standards for critical data products.

**Migration & Adoption**

* Achieves agreed migration milestones without material disruption to customer reporting or operational workflows.
* Builds strong adoption among DBAs, BI professionals, engineers, business users, and product stakeholders.

**Governance & Cost Effectiveness**

* Establishes accountable data ownership and access controls for priority domains.
* Provides transparent platform usage and cost metrics and demonstrates progress toward a scalable, supportable reporting model.

*Please note that we do not accept unsolicited resumes, work on a Corp-to-Corp basis, or engage with non-vetted external agencies.*

description:
**Hiring for Lean SuperIntelligence**
— via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role.

**About the Company**

LSI (Lean SuperIntelligence) is a security AI lab building self-improving cybersecurity LLMs. LSI-Offense-1 finds, exploits and validates vulnerabilities; LSI-Defense-1 detects, investigates and responds to attacks. The two train against each other inside LSI Cyber World Models, realistic instrumented enterprise environments where every outcome is verified, and they run on-prem or air-gapped inside the enterprise that owns them.

LSI is founded by the team behind India's first sovereign LLM and AI labs at Alexa, Uber AI and Salesforce Research, with elite security researchers, and is backed by Accel, Fusion Fund, SVQ, Inventus Capital and Dreamit Ventures, plus angels who led AI and security at OpenAI, CrowdStrike, SentinelOne and Zscaler.

**About the Role**

You will architect LSI's agentic security system: a team of AI agents that attack, defend and harden a customer's estate continuously. Offense agents probe like an attacker, defense agents detect, investigate and respond like the best responder, and remediation agents turn findings into fixes. You own how they reason, act, hand off to each other and stay under human control.

You are fluent on both sides: you have run adversary simulations and led investigations, and you have built agents that do both. You will turn that into system architecture, training signal and evaluations, working with ML researchers, offense and defense engineers and design partners.

**What you'll do**

* Architect the multi-agent system: offense, defense and remediation agents, the orchestrator that routes work between them, and the shared context that carries a finding from attack path to detection to fix.
* Design the harness and actuators agents use across endpoint, identity, cloud, SaaS, code and CI/CD, and SIEM/XDR/SOAR, with every action scoped, traceable and replayable.
* Build the security context graph that unifies endpoint, identity, cloud, app and agent signals with threat intel, past incidents and policy.
* Own routing between LSI's specialised cyber models and frontier models, trading accuracy, latency and cost per task.
* Define agent identity, least privilege, autonomy levels, human sign-off for high-impact actions, audit trails and rollback.
* Own one evaluation scorecard across find, exploit, detect, investigate, triage and fix, and lead staff engineers and design-partner pilots.

**What you bring**

* 10+ years with hands-on depth in both offense (red teaming, adversary simulation, pentest, AppSec, vulnerability research) and defense (detection engineering, threat hunting, incident response, threat research).
* Has designed and shipped a security platform, detection and response system or SOC used at enterprise or cloud scale.
* Has built production LLM agents or multi-agent systems for security with tool use, orchestration and measured results, and knows how to catch hallucinated findings.
* Has led full-kill-chain adversary simulations and investigations into sophisticated intrusions.
* Depth in SIEM/XDR/SOAR, AWS/Azure/GCP, Entra/Okta, Kubernetes, large-scale log pipelines and security graphs.
* Has designed human-in-the-loop controls, service identity and permissions, or guardrails for automated response.
* Fluent in Python plus one of Go, Rust or TypeScript.

**Nice to have**

* RL environments, reward functions, verifiers or post-training for agentic tasks.
* Built agentic SOC, autonomous pentest or exposure-management products at a security vendor or AI lab.
* Security of AI agents: prompt injection, tool and MCP abuse, agent identity (OWASP LLM / Agentic Top 10, MITRE ATLAS).
* Public CVEs, open-source detection content, or talks and papers at Black Hat, DEF CON, USENIX Security or IEEE S&P.

FinTech at Amazon is an organization where people, technology and innovation come together to build products and solve problems for the broader finance organization.
  
  

* The FinTech team owns the technical platform responsible for billions of dollars of payments each month to Amazon vendors across the globe. We build and utilize services and applications using AWS and other cutting edge technologies such as serverless application development, large scale event and data processing, machine learning for anomaly detection and automation at scale. We partner with financial institutions and other Amazon teams to leverage the best in class features that the banks and finance technology companies have to offer. We delight our payees by paying them when they want and how they want. We build software Applications that facilitate global payments transactions worth billions (USD) annually that rival the complexity and scope of dedicated payments fin-tech companies.
* The systems we build enable us to provide a wide variety of payments including real time payments, email, wires and international cross-border FX payments. Our technology also provides end to end payment tracking, bank account validation and payee communication.

If you are passionate about moving real money, paying people on time, innovating payments, using the latest and greatest technologies to help scale a system with 100% up-time, we have the opportunity for you!
  
  
We are looking for a Software Development Manager to lead a team of software engineers in our Gurugram office. Our ideal candidate is customer focused and enjoys the challenge of highly complex business contexts that are typically being defined in real-time. You will be a passionate builder of talent and teams. As a Manager within Finance Technology you will help set the vision for a suite of products that automates payments and improves visibility of millions of payables and receivables processed by Amazon to our customers and partners.
  
  
Software Development Managers at Amazon are owners. You will own your team, your roadmap and the end to end customer experience. You will drive engineering and operational excellence in your team and build delightful products for your customers. You will partner with business stakeholders and will strive to earn their trust. You will work directly with your customers and will constantly innovate on their behalf. You will be a great people manager and enjoy working with diverse mindsets.
  
  
In this role you will be responsible for creating truly innovative finance systems that support Amazon's global footprint. You will ensure the highest standards for quality, maintainability, and performance. The systems we own are responsible for trillions of financial events and payment flows that would rank among the largest countries in the world by GDP. You will ensure that engineering best practices are followed and that software is designed to be highly-available, dynamically scalable, and resilient to continuity threats.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
As a technology leader, you will drive architectural and design choices and invent new features. We have a team culture that encourages innovation where developers and management alike take a high level of ownership for the product vision, technical architecture and project delivery. Successful candidates will be high-bandwidth leaders who can cut through the noise, simplify relentlessly, deliver results, and build great teams around themselves.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Develop and own product vision, strategy and road map.
  
  
Build and manage a team of software engineers.
  
  
Execute projects within an Agile/Scrum environment
  
  
Participate in business reviews with executive leadership and provide status updates.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 7+ years of engineering experience

title: Factory Manager
description:
**Role: Factory Manager**

**Location:**
 Pollachi, Tamil Nadu

**Employment Type:**
 Full-time | On-site

The Factory Manager will be responsible for the 
**end-to-end management of factory operations**
, ensuring that production targets, quality standards, shipment schedules, manpower productivity, safety requirements, and operational controls are consistently achieved.

This is a 
**hands-on factory leadership role**

* Manage and oversee day-to-day factory and manufacturing operations.

* Prepare and review daily production reports, productivity reports, efficiency reports and other operational MIS.

* **8+ years of experience**
   in manufacturing operations, with relevant experience in a factory/production leadership position.
* Strong knowledge of 
  **production planning, factory operations, manpower management and quality control**
  .
* Experience in 
  **coir, textile, home furnishings, floor coverings, rubber products or other labour-intensive manufacturing industries**
   will be preferred.
* Experience in an 
  **export-oriented manufacturing environment**
   will be an added advantage.
* Strong leadership skills with the ability to manage supervisors, workers and multiple production departments.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting and decision-making capabilities.
* Ability to work under production and shipment deadlines while maintaining quality standards.
* Working knowledge of 
  **Excel, production reporting and ERP/MIS systems**
   is preferred.
* Good communication skills in 
  **Tamil and English**
  .
* Diploma or Degree in 
  **Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Operations Management or a related discipline**
   is preferred.

We are looking for someone who can 
**take ownership of factory performance rather than simply supervise production**
.

The right candidate should be comfortable spending significant time on the factory floor, identifying problems, working with supervisors and workers, improving processes, and ensuring that production commitments are achieved consistently.

 Based on experience and capability. (7,00,000 - 9,00,000 CTC)

  are encouraged to apply.

description:
**Job Description**
Customer Project Management (CPM) ensures customer projects/programes are delivered within agreed scope, budget, schedule, and quality. Monitor, control and report KPIs defined in customer contract, seek to define new opportunities to expand and renew contracts with the customer, lead the project team and may perform some line manager responsibilities.
