title: Assistant General Manager – Project Implementation & Plant Maintenance
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Assistant General Manager – Project Implementation & Plant Maintenance**

*Processing Division | Jay Jay Mills India Pvt. Ltd.*

**Role Title**

Assistant General Manager – Project Implementation & Plant Maintenance

**Department**

Projects & Maintenance

**Reporting To**

General Manager / Plant Head

**Division**

Processing Division

**Qualification**

B.E/M.E - Mechanical/Electrical/Mechatronics

**Experience**

18 to 20 years

**01  Role Summary**

The Assistant General Manager – Project Implementation & Plant Maintenance is responsible for the planning, execution, and monitoring of plant projects along with the overall maintenance and reliability of machines, utilities, and factory infrastructure.

The role ensures that all production equipment, utilities, and technical systems operate efficiently with minimal downtime while supporting production targets and operational requirements. The AGM will also oversee the successful implementation of new projects including machine installation, plant expansion, and process improvement initiatives.

**02  Roles & Responsibilities**

•   Plan and execute preventive and corrective maintenance programs for all production machinery and equipment to ensure smooth functioning, minimize unexpected breakdowns, and restore operations quickly in the event of failures. Coordinate closely with the production team to minimize machine downtime.

•   Manage all plant utilities including steam systems, boilers, chillers, compressors, electrical distribution systems, Effluent Treatment Plant (ETP), Sewage Treatment Plant (STP), and other supporting infrastructure required for production operations. Continuously monitor utility performance to ensure uninterrupted supply to production departments.

•   Plan and execute capital projects such as installation of new machines, plant upgrades, expansion projects, automation initiatives, and infrastructure improvements. Ensure all projects are implemented within approved timelines, budgets, and technical specifications.

•  Coordinate with equipment suppliers, contractors, and technical service providers for project implementation, machine commissioning, and technical support. Maintain proper documentation and verification during installation and commissioning activities.

•   Evaluate existing equipment performance and identify opportunities for technical upgrades, modernization, and process automation to improve plant productivity and reliability.

•   Prepare the annual maintenance budget and ensure all maintenance activities are executed within the approved budget. Monitor maintenance costs and ensure efficient utilization of spare parts, maintenance materials, and external service resources.

•   Maintain proper spare parts management and inventory planning to ensure availability of critical components and prevent production disruptions.

•   Ensure all maintenance and project activities comply with safety standards, statutory requirements, and regulatory guidelines. Promote safe maintenance practices and ensure all technicians and maintenance staff follow proper safety procedures.

•   Supervise maintenance engineers, technicians, and support staff while ensuring proper training, skill development, and operational discipline within the maintenance department.

•   Maintain maintenance records, equipment history logs, breakdown reports, and preventive maintenance documentation to ensure effective tracking and continuous improvement of plant reliability.

• Identify technical improvement opportunities to enhance machine efficiency, reduce energy consumption, and improve overall plant performance.

Interested candidates may send your resume to
**careers@jayjaymills.com or mbhuvaneshwari@jayjaymills.in**

title: Staff Software Engineer, Backend
description:
**The world still has coverage blind spots. You could help eliminate them at Skylo.**
Skylo has pioneered a standards-based approach to satellite connectivity. We connect smartphones and IoT devices directly to satellites. No special hardware, no entirely new networks. Just billions of existing devices, suddenly reachable anywhere on Earth. We're not building toward this future. We're already in it.
  
  
Our direct-to-device service is live on millions of activated devices across five continents, covering more than 72 million square kilometers, in partnership with leading satellite operators, mobile network operators, Tier-1 chipset makers, and OEMs worldwide. And we're just getting started.
  
  
At the heart of it all is Skylo's commercial NTN vRAN: a 3GPP standards-based, cloud-native platform that seamlessly bridges terrestrial and satellite networks. It's the infrastructure that makes true anywhere, anytime connectivity possible.
  
  
When you join Skylo, you'll work at the intersection of three markets reshaping how the world stays connected: mass-market consumer devices, automotive, and industrial IoT. Enabling people outdoors and critical workflows in the world's most remote places.
  
  
**This is a rare chance to work on technology that matters, at a company that's already proving it works**
*This role is located in Bangalore, India where we are onsite 3 days a week in office.*

Skylo is hiring a
**Staff Software Engineer - Backend**

In this role, you will be a key contributor to the design, architecture, and implementation of the Skylo Data Mobility Platform or/and Subscriber & Provisioning Platform. * Wide-ranging experience with cloud technologies and tech stacks, with the ability to resolve complex issues creatively and effectively.
* Proficiency in Java and Go programming languages.
* Experience developing microservices using the Spring-Boot framework or Go language frameworks.
* Expertise in query optimization, partitioning, and performance tuning in SQL and big data query engines.

description:

Benefits include, but are not limited to; Discretionary bonus, Provident fund contributions, 1+5 medical insurance + top up options and access to Practo online Doctor consultation App, Employee assistance program, 3X CTC Life Assurance, 3X CTC Personal accident insurance, childcare services, 20 days holiday + statutory holidays,

You'll also build and apply tooling to test its findings against benchmark applications with known vulnerabilities, measuring both false positives and missed vulnerabilities.We build the engine with artificial intelligence (AI) agents that write and review code from written specifications, under human direction. Measure detection quality against known vulnerabilities, judging changes primarily on false positive and false negative rates.Develop static application security testing (SAST) rules mapped to Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) and the Open Worldwide Application Security Project (OWASP), along with test fixtures that demonstrate they work.Implement component specifications with engineers and AI agents through phased plans and small, reviewable changes. Keep specifications and code in sync.Improve the harness, agent instructions, and skills that keep agent-written code trustworthy. Use separate coding and reviewing agents, performance checks, application programming interface (API) checks, and dependency checks, and escalate risky changes to human review.Solve technical problems of moderate scope and complexity, and identify and address technical debt that slows the team down.Write maintainable code that meets our internal standards, and help maintain those standards through code review.Participate in on-call rotations to help troubleshoot product operations, security operations, and urgent engineering issues.Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.What You'll BringExperience using AI or large language model (LLM) tools to generate or evaluate technical content, with the judgment to assess when their output is trustworthy.Solid professional experience writing and testing production code in a systems language, particularly Rust or Go. Our engine is written in Rust, the analyzer wrapper in Go, and the monolith integration in Ruby. You'll be willing to work across them.An interest in static analysis and application security, including parsing, intermediate representations, taint and data-flow analysis, and how vulnerabilities arise in code. Deep expertise isn't required; we'll help you grow it.Organize and progress your work independently in a remote, largely asynchronous environment.The ability to communicate technical problems clearly and concisely and propose iterative solutions.Helpful but not required: experience with performance optimization, Docker and continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), web or mobile frameworks, guardrails for agent-written code such as mutation testing and fuzzing, or program analysis and security research through publications or open source contributions. Willingness to learn performance optimization and containerized workflows is also welcome.About The TeamThe Security Factory: Code Scanning team develops GitLab's SAST capabilities for customer software repositories. We work closely with the Code Security team on scanning rules and flows, with Composition Analysis on the broader software supply chain, and with other groups across the Sec section. title: SW Engineer (1 - 2 years of exp as Full Stack Developers Python / Java,  Angular / React and GenAI)
description:
**About Us**
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
  
  
At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
  
  
Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Role Summary:**
**Enterprise Data Intelligence (EDI), part of Visa’s Corporate Information Technology organization, brings together data, analytics, and AI capabilities to turn enterprise data into actionable insights and enable data-driven decision-making. EDI delivers secure, high-quality, and accessible data assets alongside reliable, scalable platforms that help Visa’s business teams and partners develop innovative products and services.**
**Our areas of focus span Business Intelligence and Analytics, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Platform as a Service**
. With a portfolio of over 60 data products and platforms supporting internal lines of business and external clients, EDI provides the technology and processes to manage Visa’s data assets and deliver valuable information and services at scale.
  
  
The Software Engineer would be a part of a high-performance global team responsible for the delivery of features in the Enterprise Data Intelligence (EDI) program. We are seeking an Associate Software Engineer to join the Enterprise Data Intelligence (EDI) Engineering team. You will contribute to the development of next-generation AI solutions that transform Business Intelligence through Generative AI, Machine Learning, Conversational AI, and Developer Productivity tools.
  
  
This role is ideal for engineers who are passionate about AI technologies and eager to work on enterprise-scale solutions that directly impact customer experience and operational efficiency. Every engineer in this team will work in close collaboration with Generative AI tools as development companions, leveraging Visa’s extensive portfolio of AI models, tools, and experimentation platforms.
  
  
As a key member of the delivery execution team, candidates would need to create scalable designs, write maintainable code, reusable components/services/utilities, and test cases.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Work independently on defined problems and features
* Apply established architectural patterns with good technical judgment
* Take ownership of code quality, testing, and production reliability
* Partner with GenAI agents for code generation, refactoring, and automated testing.
* Experiment in Visa’s AI sandbox, where multiple GenAI models and frameworks are available for employee-driven innovation.
* Apply Generative AI models to API integration challenges, anomaly detection, and intelligent automation.
* Collaborates actively within a cross‑functional team
* Translate functional requirements into clean, efficient, and maintainable code.
* Write high‑quality, readable, and testable code aligned with defined engineering standards.
* Develop and maintain automated unit and component tests.
* Identify and address defects, performance issues, and reliability gaps in owned areas.
* Participate in production releases and operational readiness activities.
* Work closely with Product Managers, DevOps, and peer engineers.

**Visa requires at least 3 days in office,**
expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Basic Qualifications:
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline, OR 3+ years of relevant work experience.

**Preferred Qualification**

* 1–2 years of hands-on software engineering experience building, delivering, and supporting enterprise-grade Java/J2EE applications, preferably using Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, and modern front-end frameworks such as Angular or React.
* Hands-on experience with AI-assisted software delivery, including effective use of generative AI coding assistants and developer productivity tools such as Claude Code CLI, GitHub Copilot, Cline, or similar tools for prompt engineering, AI-supported code review, test generation, documentation, and productivity workflows.
* Working knowledge of applied AI concepts relevant to software engineering, such as large language models, embeddings, retrieval-augmented generation, agentic workflows, model limitations, data privacy, and responsible AI practices.
* Strong foundation in software engineering principles, clean code practices, object-oriented design, data structures, algorithms, distributed systems, and scalable application architecture.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex issues across application, integration, data, infrastructure, and AI-assisted delivery workflows.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain technical decisions clearly, collaborate across Product, Architecture, DevOps, QA, and Security teams, and document designs and trade-offs concisely.
* Experience in financial services, payments, or other high-volume, mission-critical enterprise platforms is a strong plus

**Visa is an EEO Employer**
Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

title: Senior Engineer, Full-Stack Development
description:
Full-Stack Web Developer
  
  
We Are
  
  
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
  
  
You Are
  
  
You are an early-career developer who has moved past tutorials and built things that actually run in production or close to it. You know the difference between code that works on your laptop and code that someone else can deploy, maintain, and extend six months later. When something breaks, you dig in. When requirements are unclear, you ask the right questions instead of guessing or waiting.
  
  
You have written enough JavaScript and TypeScript to know when a component is getting too complicated, and you care about that. Working across front-end, back-end, and database layers does not intimidate you because you have done it before, even if not at scale. You learn by building, not by collecting certifications.
  
  
Small teams appeal to you because your work is visible and your contributions matter from day one. You want to be in a place where asking good questions is valued, where senior engineers actually review your code and explain the why, and where you can see the impact of what you ship. At Synopsys, you will work on internal platforms that employees across the company depend on, and the team you join operates like a high-trust startup inside a global organization.
  
  
What You'll Be Doing
  
  

* Build and maintain full-stack web applications using the PANN stack: PostgreSQL, Angular, NestJS, and Node.js
* Implement features across the entire application layer, from UI components in Angular to API endpoints in NestJS to database schema changes in PostgreSQL
* Work with Prisma ORM to model data, manage migrations, and write clean database access logic
* Collaborate with cybersecurity, engineering, and business teams to translate requirements into working software that solves real problems
* Containerize and deploy applications using Docker and orchestrate services in environments managed with Kubernetes, Nginx, and Apache
* Contribute to AI-enabled features including retrieval-augmented generation workflows, prompt engineering, and automation that pulls from internal knowledge repositories
* Support CI/CD pipelines and help maintain production systems through monitoring, debugging, and performance tuning

The Impact You Will Have
  
  

* Your code will power internal platforms used daily by employees across Synopsys to get work done faster and more securely
* You will reduce manual effort and operational overhead by automating repetitive workflows and integrating disconnected systems
* The features you build will improve how teams access organizational knowledge, make decisions, and collaborate across functions
* Your contributions will help scale cybersecurity, compliance, and engineering operations across a 30,000-person global organization
* You will enable better data-driven decision-making by building intuitive interfaces that surface the right information at the right time
* Working in a small, high-impact team means your individual work will be visible and valued, not lost in a backlog
* You will help lay the foundation for scalable solutions that can be adopted across multiple business units as the platform grows

What You'll Need
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent hands-on experience building and shipping web applications
* 2 to 4 years of experience developing full-stack web applications, though stronger evidence of end-to-end delivery can matter more than years
* Hands-on experience with the PANN technology stack: PostgreSQL, Angular, NestJS, and Node.js in real projects, not just side experiments
* Solid working knowledge of JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and REST API design
* Experience using Prisma or a comparable ORM for data modeling, schema migrations, and database access patterns
* Familiarity with Docker for containerization and exposure to Kubernetes, Nginx, or Apache in deployment contexts
* Practical exposure to AI technologies such as large language models, prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, or automation workflows, whether through work, coursework, or personal projects
* Understanding of CI/CD pipelines, testing methodologies, and secure coding principles
* Experience integrating systems through APIs and working with both relational and non-relational databases
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, you can explain what you built, why you built it that way, and what tradeoffs you made

Who You Are
  
  

* You take ownership of your work and follow through, even when it means asking for help or clarification along the way
* When you encounter a problem you do not immediately know how to solve, you research, test, and ask targeted questions instead of spinning or guessing
* You write code with the next person in mind, whether that is a teammate doing a review or your future self debugging at 3pm on a Tuesday
* You are comfortable working in a small team where accountability is high and your contributions are visible from day one
* Curiosity drives you, especially around emerging technologies like AI, and you are eager to apply them to solve real business problems, not just experiment
* You can collaborate effectively with people outside engineering, translating technical constraints into language that product and business stakeholders actually understand
* You care about user experience and think through how the features you build will actually be used, not just whether they technically function
* Results matter to you more than process for its own sake, you want to ship things that work and make a measurable difference

The Team You'll Be Part Of
  
  
Your team develops platforms and capabilities that help scale cybersecurity, compliance, engineering, and business operations across Synopsys. The team operates with a startup mindset, focusing on high-impact initiatives, rapid execution, and practical innovation. You will work closely with a small group of technical and domain experts to build solutions that enable automation, knowledge management, and data-driven decision making. Individual contributions are highly visible, and you will have direct access to senior engineers who will review your work, explain tradeoffs, and help you grow.
  
  
Rewards and Benefits
  
  
We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.
  
  
At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

These roles focus on solving complex engineering problems across web systems that serve multiple enterprise product lines and industry verticals.
  
  
Key responsibilities
  
  

* Design, development, maintenance, and enhancement of platform software in alignment with established architecture and engineering standards.
* Participation in code reviews to ensure code quality, consistency, and maintainability.
* Use AI-assisted tools as part of the standard software development workflow.

title: Senior Fullstack Developer (.Net+Angular)
description:
**Company Description**

Eurofins is a global leader in food, environmental, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in agroscience CRO services. It is also one of the global independent market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, discovery pharmacology, forensics, CDMO, advanced material sciences and in the support of clinical studies.

In over just 35 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to 62,000 staff across a network of over 1,000 independent companies in 61 countries, operating 900 laboratories. Performing over 450 million tests every year, Eurofins offers a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products, as well as providing innovative clinical diagnostic testing services, as one of the leading global emerging players in specialised clinical diagnostics testing.
  
  
Eurofins is one of the fastest growing listed European companies with a listing on the French stock exchange since 1997.
  
  
Eurofins IT Solutions India Pvt Ltd (EITSI) is a fully owned subsidiary of Eurofins and functions as a Global Software Delivery Center exclusively catering to Eurofins Global IT business needs. The code shipped out of EITSI impacts the global network of Eurofins labs and services.
  
  
The primary focus at EITSI is to develop the next generation LIMS (Lab Information Management system), Customer portals, e-commerce solutions, ERP/CRM system, Mobile Apps & other B2B platforms for various Eurofins Laboratories and businesses. **Job Description**
Senior Software Engineer
  
  
Eurofins IT Solutions, Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
  
  
With 36 facilities worldwide, Eurofins BioPharma Product Testing (BPT) is the largest network of bio/pharmaceutical GMP product testing laboratories providing comprehensive laboratory services for the world's largest pharmaceutical, biopharmaceutical, and medical device companies.

* 4-7 years of experience with developing end-to-end web applications using Microsoft stack of technologies.
* Good working knowledge of Web application development using .NET Core (6/7/8), C#, Asp.net Core, MVC, WebAPI, Postman.
* Good Working knowledge of Angular 7 or above, JavaScript, TypeScript, jQuery, HTML5 and CSS3.
* Decent working knowledge of Cosmos DB, Elastic Search, Redis, Azure Functions, Azure DevOps, CI/CD, Event Driven Architecture, Domain Driven Architecture, Microservices, MSSQL – SQL etc.
* Experience with usage of Azure DevOps
* Familiar with UI testing and Unit Testing (MS Test/ Jasmine/ MOQ/ NUnit/ Karma etc.)
* Good understanding of object-oriented programming (OOP); able to solve technical problems

* Should be aware of best practices in programming
* Should know how to troubleshoot complex issues, performance-related issues, how to write efficient code and query
* Good to have experience in guiding junior team members and grooming them
* Working knowledge Authentication and Authorization [Plus OAuth2, OpenIDC etc.] (5+)
* Should have worked on at least one SOA (Service Oriented Architecture) project
* Should have worked in an AGILE practice methodology (preferably SCRUM)

****Required Qualifications:****

* MCA or Bachelors in Engineering, Computer Science or equivalent.

****Personal Skills:****

* Excellent analytical and problem solving skills
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to articulate and present different points-of-views on various topics related to project and otherwise.
* Successful teamwork experience and demonstrated leadership abilities are required.
* Eager to learn and continuously develop personal and technical capabilities.

****Responsibilities****

* Implementing customer feedback (changes/enhancements)
* Understand the expectation clearly, design and build it
* Advanced Troubleshooting & Issue Resolution
* Investigate and resolve complex issues (or escalated issues from Level 1 and Level 2 support).
* Analyze logs, application behavior, and system performance to identify root causes.
* Handle incidents involving application crashes, data inconsistencies, or integration failures.
* Root Cause Analysis (RCA) & Permanent Fixes
* Conduct detailed RCA for recurring or high-impact issues.
* Collaborate with development teams to implement long-term fixes or enhancements.
* Application Monitoring & Performance Tuning
* Use monitoring tools (e.g., app insights, Grafana, kibana etc.) to proactively detect anomalies.
* Optimize application performance and scalability.
* Deployment & Release Support
* Support production deployments, hotfixes, and rollback procedures.
* Validate post-deployment stability and performance.
* Compliance & Validation
* Ensure support activities align with GxP, and any other applicabl regulatory requirements.
* Maintain audit trails and documentation for all changes and incidents.
* Collaboration & Communication
* Work closely with DevOps, QA, and product teams to resolve issues.
* Communicate technical findings to non-technical stakeholders when needed.
* Grooming next level
* Guide and groom junior members to next level challenges to inepnedently handle product improvement and customer feedback
* Knowledge Management
* Document solutions, workarounds, and known issues in a knowledge base.
* Provide guidance and training to L1/L2 teams.

Additional Information
  
  
****Personal Skills:****

* Customer-service oriented with a problem-solving attitude;
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy is essential;
* Entrepreneurial thinking and flexibility to change;
* Very good English communication skills (concise writing and orally convincing);
* Structured and clear writing skills;
* Proven ability to solve complex business problems using analytical reasoning;
* Demonstrated positive attitude, self-motivated, team player.

****Required Qualifications:****

* MCA or Bachelors in Engineering, Computer Science or equivalent.

: Eurofins has a strong focus on Performance Management system. This includes quarterly calibrations, half-yearly reviews and annual reviews. The KPIs shall be set and may vary slightly between projects. These will be clearly communicated, documented during the first 30 days of your joining.

title: R&D Senior Member of Technical Staff, Product Development
description:
**AVEVA is creating software trusted by over 90% of leading industrial companies.**
**Position Title:**
R&D Senior Developer (Full Stack | AI-First SaaS)
  
  
**Previous Experience:**
5–8+ years of experience in full stack engineering (Microsoft stack + Angular), building cloud-native SaaS applications with exposure to AI-driven capabilities.
  
  
**Location:**
Bangalore, India (Hybrid – 3 days/week)
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-time
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a
**Senior Full Stack Engineer**
to build
**AI-first, cloud-native SaaS applications**
using the Microsoft stack and Angular. You will work in a
**High Velocity Engineering (HVE)**
environment focused on rapid delivery, automation, and continuous improvement.
  
  
This role is ideal for engineers passionate about
**scalable systems, AI integration, and delivering real business outcomes**
.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain full stack applications using .NET 8+/C# and Angular (v20+)
* Design and build scalable SaaS solutions on Microsoft Azure
* Integrate AI-powered features (copilots, automation workflows, LLM-based capabilities)
* Implement microservices and API-first architectures
* Drive CI/CD pipelines and DevOps best practices
* Optimize performance, scalability, and cloud cost efficiency
* Ensure code quality through reviews and best practices
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams in an Agile/HVE setup

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 5–8+ years of experience in full stack development
* Strong expertise in:

+ C#, .NET Core / .NET 8+
+ Angular (v20+), TypeScript, HTML, CSS
+ REST APIs & microservices architecture

* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure
* Experience with CI/CD tools (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions)
* Solid understanding of SaaS architecture (multi-tenancy, scalability)
* Experience working in Agile environments

**AI & Modern Engineering**

* Exposure to AI/LLM integrations (Azure OpenAI, OpenAI APIs)
* Experience with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot)
* Understanding of automation-driven workflows and intelligent systems

**Good to Have**

* Docker, Kubernetes (AKS)
* Event-driven systems (Service Bus, Kafka)
* GraphQL, API gateways
* Observability tools (App Insights, Prometheus, Grafana)
* Security standards (OAuth2, OpenID Connect)

**R&D at AVEVA**
Join a global team of 2,000+ engineers and evolves a broad portfolio of industrial software solutions that power industries delivering life’s essentials from energy and infrastructure to food and pharmaceuticals. As a global leader in industrial software, AVEVA enables over 20,000 enterprises across 100+ countries to engineer smarter, operate more efficiently, and drive sustainable growth.
  
  
Work in an AI-first, cloud-native SaaS ecosystem that connects data, people, and insights at scale.
  
  
Be part of a High Velocity Engineering culture driven by innovation, backed by 150+ patents globally.
  
  
Build scalable, impact-driven solutions that advance efficiency and sustainability.
  
  
Grow into technical and leadership roles while shaping the future of industrial intelligence.
  
  
**India Benefits include:**
Gratuity, Medical and accidental insurance, very attractive leave entitlement, emergency leave days, childcare support, maternity, paternity and adoption leaves, education assistance program, home office set up support (for hybrid roles), well-being support
  
  
It’s possible we’re hiring for this position in multiple countries, in which case the above benefits apply to the primary location. Specific benefits vary by country, but our packages are similarly comprehensive.
  
  
Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/benefits/
  
  
**Hybrid working**
We work in a hybrid way at AVEVA. Most roles are based at a local AVEVA office, with an expectation of being on-site 50% of your working hours to support collaboration and connection. Some positions are fully office-based depending on the nature of the work, and certain roles that support specific customers or markets may be remote. The working arrangement for this position will be confirmed during the hiring process.
  
  
**Hiring process**
Interested? Great! Get started by submitting your cover letter and CV through our application portal. AVEVA is committed to recruiting and retaining people with disabilities. Please let us know in advance if you need reasonable support during your application process.
  
  
Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/hiring-process
  
  
**About AVEVA**
AVEVA is a global leader in industrial software with more than 6,500 employees in over 40 countries. Our cutting-edge solutions are used by thousands of enterprises to deliver the essentials of life – such as energy, infrastructure, chemicals, and minerals – safely, efficiently, and more sustainably.
  
  
We are committed to embedding sustainability and inclusion into our operations, our culture, and our core business strategy. Learn more about how we are progressing against our ambitious 2030 targets: sustainability-report.aveva.com/
  
  
Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/
  
  
AVEVA requires all successful applicants to undergo and pass a drug screening and comprehensive background check before they start employment. Background checks will be conducted in accordance with local laws and may, subject to those laws, include proof of educational attainment, employment history verification, proof of work authorization, criminal records, identity verification, credit check. Certain positions dealing with sensitive and/or third-party personal data may involve additional background check criteria.
  
  
AVEVA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to being an exemplary employer with an inclusive culture, developing a workplace environment where all our employees are treated with dignity and respect. We value diversity and the expertise that people from different backgrounds bring to our business. AVEVA provides reasonable accommodation to applicants with disabilities where appropriate. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the application and hiring process, please notify your recruiter. Determinations on requests for reasonable accommodation will be made on a case-by-case basis.

Apply now to take your career global

title: Lead Consultant-1
description:
At CDW, we make it happen, together. Trust, connection, and commitment are at the heart of how we work together to deliver for our customers. It’s why we’re coworkers, not just employees. Coworkers who genuinely believe in supporting our customers and one another. We collectively forge our path forward with a level of commitment that speaks to who we are and where we’re headed. We’re proud to share our story and Make Amazing Happen at CDW.
  
  
Lead Consultant – Full Stack & AI Developer
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for an experienced Lead Consultant – Full Stack & AI Developer to design, develop, and lead the implementation of modern full-stack applications powered by Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs).
  
  
The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in React, Node.js, RAG, LLMs, LangChain, and LangGraph, along with a solid understanding of application architecture, APIs, cloud technologies, and AI engineering practices.
  
  
You will work closely with product managers, architects, and engineering teams to build scalable, secure, and enterprise-ready applications leveraging AI.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead the design and development of full-stack web applications using React.js and Node.js.
* Design and implement GenAI/LLM-powered applications using RAG and agentic AI approaches.
* Develop and optimize Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines for enterprise use cases.
* Build LLM workflows and AI agents using LangChain and LangGraph.
* Integrate LLMs with enterprise applications, APIs, databases, and external services.
* Design RESTful APIs and backend services using Node.js.
* Develop responsive and scalable front-end applications using React.js.
* Work with vector databases, embeddings, document processing, and semantic search.
* Implement prompt engineering, context management, evaluation, and optimization of LLM applications.
* Design multi-step AI workflows, tool calling, agent orchestration, and state management using LangGraph.
* Ensure AI solutions are scalable, secure, reliable, and production-ready.
* Collaborate with architects and technical teams to define application and AI solution architecture.
* Conduct code reviews, establish development best practices, and mentor junior developers.
* Troubleshoot application and AI/LLM-related performance and production issues.
* Stay current with emerging GenAI, LLM, AI Agent, and full-stack development technologies.

Mandatory Skills
  
  

* 7–12 years of software development experience with strong hands-on development expertise.
* Strong experience in React.js and modern front-end development.
* Strong experience in Node.js and backend/API development.
* Hands-on experience building Generative AI / LLM applications.
* Strong understanding of RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) architecture and implementation.
* Hands-on experience with LangChain.
* Hands-on experience with LangGraph and agentic workflows.
* Experience working with LLM APIs such as OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar.
* Strong knowledge of Python or JavaScript/TypeScript for AI application development.
* Experience with REST APIs, microservices, databases, and third-party integrations.
* Good understanding of vector databases, embeddings, chunking, retrieval, and semantic search.
* Strong understanding of software design principles, architecture, and development best practices.

Leadership Expectations
  
  

* Act as a technical lead for full-stack and AI development initiatives.
* Translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Provide technical guidance and mentorship to development teams.
* Drive architecture, design decisions, code quality, and engineering standards.
* Communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Take ownership of deliverables from design through development, deployment, and production support.

**CDW is committed to being an AI-fluent organization**
We’re looking for people who bring curiosity, a learner’s mindset, and a willingness to engage with ever-evolving technology and tools. We value adopting AI as a partner, openness to experimentation, and a shared interest in learning together on AI. Our goal is to create a culture where AI enhances—not replaces—human creativity and decision-making. You don’t need to be an expert today; what matters is your readiness to explore, adapt, and grow with us as we integrate AI responsibly and effectively into our work.
  
  
Additionally, CDW is committed to fostering an equitable, transparent, and respectful hiring process for all applicants. During our application process, our goal is to understand your experience, strengths, skills, and qualifications. As an AI forward company, we see AI not just as a tool, but as a catalyst for new ways of thinking, creating, and communicating. We encourage candidates to embrace an AI mindset, one that’s curious, adaptive, and ready to explore what’s possible. We welcome thoughtful use of AI to expand your perspective and elevate how you share your story, while ensuring your application remains rooted in your own background, judgment, and voice.
  
  
**About Us**
CDW is a Fortune 500 technology solutions provider that helps businesses, government, education, and healthcare organizations achieve what’s possible through technology. What makes CDW different isn’t just what we do—it’s how we do it. At CDW we act as one—building trust, speaking candidly, and working together to achieve more. We play to win—focusing on what matters most and delivering for our customers. And we think forward—staying curious, moving fast, and continuously learning. We believe meaningful work happens when people feel supported, heard, and empowered to contribute. That’s why we think of ourselves as coworkers, not just employees—working together to solve complex challenges and deliver real impact for our customers and communities.
  
  
As a full‑stack, full‑lifecycle technology partner, CDW brings deep expertise, strong relationships, and broad industry knowledge to help turn ideas into outcomes. When you join CDW, you become part of a collaborative environment where your work matters, your growth is supported, and your contributions help shape what’s next.
  
  
Together, we deliver the full promise of what technology can do.
**Together, we Make Amazing Happen.**
CDW is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status or any other basis prohibited by state and local law.

title: Fullstack Java + Python
description:
Position Description
  
  
As a PRTM Full Stack Developer you are responsible for developing and enhancing NXP's enterprise application for Product Requirements and Test Management, with a focus on building the capabilities required for the Polarion to IBM ELM transformation project. You will use your hands on Java full stack and Python expertise to develop migration utilities, capabilities and integrations between Polarion and IBM ELM. You should have experience in application development, have excellent problem solving skills and able to work independently with a business focused mindset.This position is based out of Bangalore, India and offers the opportunity to work in a globally distributed team where the candidate will get a unique opportunity of personal development in a multi cultural environment. The candidate will get a challenging environment to develop expertise useful in the industry.Primary responsibilities:
  
  

* Following industry best practices to develop efficient and reliable software.
* Providing inputs during solution reviews, refinement and other technical discussions.
* Design and develop utilities and interfaces to enhance business workflow.
* Working with stakeholders, Business Analysts and QA team to closely understand the requirement and test cases.
* Design and develop capabilities for the Polarion to IBM ELM transformation project using Java full stack technologies and Python.
* Develop Python scripts and tools to automate extraction, transformation, validation and loading of Polarion data (work items, documents, test cases, traceability links) into IBM ELM (ERM, ETM, EWM).
* Build and maintain REST/OSLC based integrations, APIs and user interfaces between Polarion and IBM ELM to support the migration and the transition of users to ELM.
* Continually seeking methods to improve the application and according to development processes.
* Ensure industry standard best practices are followed during development lifecycle.
* Work with mindset of delivering quality along with quantity with "first time right approach".

Job qualifications:
  
  

* Degree in Computer Science and relevant work experience of 5 years or more.
* Excellent analytical, problem solving, and logical thinking skills.
* Excellent English communication skills, both oral and written.
* Hands on experience in Java full stack development, with strong proficiency in Java programming (Java 8 and above), React and JavaScript.
* Hands on experience in Python development for scripting, automation, data processing and API integration (e.g., requests, pandas), preferably for data migration or tooling between enterprise applications.
* Familiarity with Java frameworks such as Spring boot, Spring Data JPA, Hibernate.
* Experience with REST APIs and web services.
* Experience in working with microservice architecture.
* Experience in working with deployment servers preferably WAS Liberty or Apache Tomcat.
* Experience in databases (preferably Oracle) and SQL.
* Experience with Webpack, Redux and similar.
* Experience in developing Junit and JEST test cases.
* Proven experience in building client software (user interfaces) or single page applications (SPA) in REACT JS framework.
* Experience with working on design patterns is a plus.
* Experience with working with AI coding platform /copilot /any other AI platform as a plus.
* Knowledge of Siemens Polarion ALM (work items, documents, REST API) or IBM ELM application and experience in data migration between ALM / requirements management tools is a plus.
* Experience with Bitbucket and source code management practices.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments.

Your future duties and responsibilities
  
  
**Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role**
**Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.**
Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because…
  
  
You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction.
  
  
Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise.
  
  
You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons.
  
  
That same commitment to fairness extends to how we use technology. To support our recruitment team, AI tools may be used to help assess applications though they never replace human judgement. All hiring decisions remain entirely in the hands of our recruitment professionals.
  
  
Come join our team—one of the largest IT and business consulting services firms in the world.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Full Stack, YouTube Creator Support
description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages.
* 3 years of experience with full stack development, across back-end such as Java, Python, Golang, or C++ codebases, and front-end experience including JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML, CSS or equivalent.
* Experience with Generative AI and full-stack web development.
* Experience programming in C++, Python or Java.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, or a related technical field.
* 1 year of experience in a technical leadership role.
* Experience testing, maintaining, and launching software products.
* Experience with software design and architecture.
* Experience integrating Generative AI tools or large language model (LLM) interfaces into software workflows.
* Experience developing accessible technologies.

**About The Job**
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.
  
  
The Creator Support team designs and builds systems to support millions of creators through authoritative data, creator-facing products, intelligent workflow platforms, and advanced technologies like Generative AI-powered assistants. Our work directly impacts the growth of YouTube by scaling high-quality, trustworthy support to a much larger cohort of creators, making every interaction easy, helpful, and empowering.
  
  
We are an autonomous, cross-functional team owning end-to-end product and engineering strategy for creator support, with product management, user experience design, and user research.
  
  
In this role, you will lead engineers, build scalable full-stack products and distributed systems, and innovate with Generative AI while staying customer-obsessed.
  
  
At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we listen, share, and build community through our stories. We work together to give everyone the power to share their story, explore what they love, and connect with one another in the process. Working at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. We explore new ideas, solve real problems, and have fun — and we do it all together.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead a team of software engineers, driving technical direction, system architecture, and end-to-end execution for YouTube Creator Support products and platforms.
* Design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance scalable full-stack software systems and Generative AI-powered workflows serving millions of creators and global support operations.
* Partner closely with Product Management, User Experience Design, User Research, and cross-functional engineering teams to translate ambiguous product problems into clear technical roadmaps.
* Uphold high engineering standards through architecture and design reviews, code reviews, operational reliability, security, and data privacy best practices.
* Mentor and coach software engineers on the team, fostering technical growth, ownership, and engineering excellence.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

description:
Location: Noida Berger Tower, India

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.

Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.

We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented **UI Developer** with **3–5 years of professional experience** in front-end development, specializing in **React.js, Next.js, and TypeScript**. The ideal candidate will be responsible for developing scalable, high-quality, and responsive user interfaces that align precisely with **Figma design specifications** and business requirements.

This role requires a developer who can independently understand requirements, contribute to architectural decisions, and deliver efficient, maintainable code while adhering to modern engineering standards. Strong experience in **unit testing**, **end-to-end testing**, **Tailwind CSS**, and exposure to **cloud and DevOps practices** is expected.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain scalable UI applications using **React.js**, **Next.js**, **TypeScript**, and **Tailwind CSS**.
* Implement **server-side rendering (SSR)** and **static site generation (SSG)** using Next.js where applicable.
* Translate **Figma** and design assets into pixel-perfect, responsive, and reusable UI components.
* Collaborate with designers, backend engineers, and QA teams to deliver cohesive and high-performing user experiences.
* Ensure adherence to **coding standards**, **accessibility guidelines**, and **best practices** for maintainability and scalability.
* Write and maintain **unit tests** (Jest, React Testing Library) to ensure code quality and reliability.
* Contribute to **end-to-end (E2E) testing** using **WebdriverIO (WDIO)** to validate user journeys.
* Participate in **code reviews**, providing constructive feedback and ensuring high-quality deliverables.
* Work with **CI/CD pipelines** and support deployment processes in **cloud environments**.
* Optimize applications for **performance**, **SEO**, and **cross-browser compatibility**.

### **Required Skills and Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 3–4 years of hands-on experience in **front-end/UI development**.
* Strong proficiency in **React.js**, **Next.js**, and **TypeScript**.
* Solid understanding of **Tailwind CSS**, **JavaScript (ES6+)**, **HTML5**, and **responsive design principles**.
* Experience with **Material UI (MUI)** or similar component libraries.
* Hands-on experience with **unit testing frameworks** such as **Jest** and **React Testing Library**.
* Exposure to **WebdriverIO (WDIO)** or similar **end-to-end testing frameworks**.
* Strong understanding of **RESTful APIs** and asynchronous data handling.
* Experience with **Git**, **modern build tools** (Webpack, Vite), and code versioning practices.
* Working knowledge of **cloud platforms** (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and **DevOps workflows** (CI/CD pipelines).

### **Preferred Skills**

* Experience with **state management libraries** such as **Redux and** **React Query**.
* Knowledge of **frontend performance optimization** and **code splitting strategies**.
* Familiarity with **containerization tools** (Docker) and automated deployment pipelines.
* Understanding of **design systems**, **component-driven development**, and scalable frontend architecture

At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

**Role: Solution Architecture - Retail & Supply Chain**

**Location**: Bangalore

**About the role**

You will be the solution architect embedded with a global retail client's Integrated Planning team. You'll own the end-to-end architecture for supply chain and inventory initiatives across regions. The role sits between business stakeholders, client architects and delivery teams: you turn complex business problems into robust, scalable designs with practical short-term fixes and long-term target-state solutions.

  

**Key responsibilities**

* + Understand business and operational problems across supply chain, inventory and fulfilment, and translate them into clear architecture solutions.
  + Create and present High-Level Designs (HLDs) covering systems, integration flows, data flows and interfaces, and take them through review and sign-off with client architects and stakeholders.

  + Define both interim solutions and long-term target architecture, with trade-offs, risks and dependencies clearly documented.
  + Work with business, product, delivery and regional teams across Europe, the Americas and APAC to keep architecture aligned with programme timelines and release plans.
  + Support delivery teams through build, testing and rollout by clarifying design intent, resolving integration issues and governing changes.
  + Spot opportunities to apply AI and new technology to the client's business problems, and shape them into proposals.

**Must-have skills**

* + 8+ years in IT, with 4+ years in solution or integration architecture roles.
  + Strong grounding in retail or supply chain domains: inventory, order management, distribution and fulfilment.
  + Hands-on experience with integration patterns (APIs, event-driven/messaging, batch and file-based) and enterprise systems (ERP, OMS, POS, WMS).

  + Smooth releases with no architecture-driven delays.
  + High client satisfaction and trust from client architects and business leads.

description:
**The Company**

PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

title: System Software Engineer
description:
We are seeking software engineers to work on next-generation graphics and computing products. Our charter is to build the most stressful set of applications a GPU or high performance computing server would see in its life cycle. The best candidates will have strong C/C++ programming skills, a solid foundation of systems software with emphasis on OS fundamentals, and a deep understanding of current generation PC/hardware architecture. Excellent communication skills and a dedication to meticulous engineering practices are a requirement. As a system software engineer, you will extensively use your knowledge of operating systems, algorithms, and computer architecture to provide robust and efficient solutions to validate and test next generation processors.

  

**What you'll be doing:**

* Working closely with architecture, hardware and driver teams through the product development lifecycle of computing and graphics processors, as well as compute products.
* Responsible for crafting software tools and infrastructure required for new chip development, validation, and productization.
* Assess new hardware features and architect manufacturing diagnostic solutions using pre-beta driver extensions.
This job will require an understanding of our hardware and software architectures.  

  

**What we need to see:**

* BTech or MTech degree in one of following areas: Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science or equivalent experience.
* 3+ years' experience in a related hardware/software position.
* Strong C/C++ programming skills.
* Familiarity with PC architecture, and ability to work close to the hardware.
* Previous experience of working on a large system software code base is preferable.
* Very strong problem solving and debugging skills.
Ability to self-manage, show leadership, and have good interpersonal skills.  

  

With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and talented people in the world working for us and, due to unprecedented growth, our elite engineering teams are rapidly growing. If you're a creative and autonomous engineer with a real passion for technology, we want to hear from you.

description:

**Your Role**

Certification

title: Software Engineer II
Software Engineer, Debug Tools
description:
**Description**

  
**Invent the future with us.**

Ampere is a semiconductor design company for a new era, leading the future of computing by developing SoCs and platform solutions focused on high-performance, energy efficient AI compute. As a pioneer in the new frontier of energy efficient high-performance computing, Ampere is part of the Softbank Group of companies driving sustainable AI compute for cloud, edge, and physical applications.

AI is showing up in essentially every part of the technology landscape, and we’re focused on delivering the performance, efficiency, and reliability those workloads require. Ampere is building compute silicon and platforms for AI applications spanning a broad range of industries. We focus on solving exciting challenges in areas such as robotics and automotive, among others, but the core of our work is enabling efficient AI at scale and across multiple application domains.

**About the Role**

As a core member of the Ampere Debug Tools team, you will be responsible for the architecture, design, and development of Debug Tools solutions for the next generation of Ampere products. This role is distinguished by deep technical ownership, architecture leadership, and cross-team influence.  
  
The Debug Tools Team is part of the Ampere Software Team. Our mission is to develop a comprehensive debug strategy and roadmap for internal debug capabilities, as well as to develop and deploy debug solutions for all internal and external Ampere SoC users.

* Internal users include Debug Tools software users from the Virtual Platform, Emulation, Platform, Design Validation (DV), Post-Silicon Validation, Design For Test (DFT), Firmware, Operating System, Software, Performance, and Application Engineering teams.
* External users include partners, ODMs, OEMs, datacenter, edge and embedded customers.
* Debug solutions include Arm Development Studio, TRACE32 PowerView, and OpenOCD debuggers, Arm Self-Hosted Trace for Linux, and utilities for invasive debug, bus trace, instruction trace, array dump, and scan dump. This role will be for the lead of the Arm Development Studio implementation.

**What You’ll Achieve:**

* Architect, design, develop, and deploy software-based Debug Tools for custom 64-bit Armv9 SoC and other processors.
* Invent new debug tools and techniques for future products and technologies.
* Influence the architecture and design team decisions with knowledge of internal and external debug tools on Ampere SoCs.
* Contribute to software architecture and design documents, application notes, and other software product documentation.
* Develop tooling for advanced debugging techniques, such as instruction trace, bus trace, array dump, scan dump, and ATE bootstrapping.
* Develop open source JTAG and self-hosted trace and debugger software for internal and external use in debugging Ampere microprocessors.
* Develop Arm Development Studio, TRACE32, and OpenOCD utilities for internal and external use in debugging Ampere microprocessors.
* Perform pre-silicon bring-up of debug software on software simulators and hardware emulation platforms.
* Collaborate with hardware design, architecture, post-silicon validation, and platform AE teams, as necessary, to resolve critical customer issues.

**About You:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or Software Engineering or related technical field & 5 years of related experience; or MS degree & 3+ years.
* Proficiency with Arm® architecture and ecosystem, including Armv8-a/v9-a and Armv7-m processor architectures, Arm Debug Interface Architecture, Arm CoreSight™ Architecture, Arm AMBA® APB, AXI, AHB, and CHI protocols.
* Proficiency in C/C++, Python, and Bash programming.
* Experience using Arm Development Studio, TRACE32 PowerView, OpenOCD, and GDB debuggers.
* Experience with instruction trace, bus trace, scan dumps, array dumps, and crash capture.
* Experience with version control tools such as git, and software best practices.
* Strong analytical, debugging, and testing methodology skills.
* Proven ability to own problems and drive them to a resolution.
* Experience with system software debugging, tracing, and analysis tools, such as perf, ftrace, etc, is recommended.

**What We’ll Offer:**

  
At Ampere we believe in taking care of our employees and providing a competitive total rewards package that includes base pay, cash long-term incentive, and comprehensive benefits.  
  
Benefits highlights include:

* Premium medical, dental, vision insurance, parental benefits including creche reimbursement, as well as a retirement plan, so that you can feel secure in your health, financial future and child care during work.
* Generous paid time off policy so that you can embrace a healthy work-life balance
* Fully catered lunch in our office along with a variety of healthy snacks, energizing coffee or tea, and refreshing drinks to keep you fueled and focused throughout the day.

  
And there is much more than compensation and benefits. At Ampere, we foster an inclusive culture that empowers our employees to do more and grow more. We are excited to share more about our career opportunities with you through the interview process.  
  
#LI-Hybrid

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

  
Ampere is an inclusive and equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, religion, age, veteran and/or military status, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, physical or mental disability, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law.

title: Senior Principal Systems Software Engineer
description:

Decomposes ambiguous, multi-domain problems into tractable workstreams; mentors engineers across teams. * Uses deep knowledge to design, develop, and deploy software layers and tooling to automate hardware provisioning and onboarding of servers to large-scale fleet.

* Conducts performance profiling and optimization of coding that may require innovation.
* Troubleshoots and resolves highly complex issues related to application programming interface (API) functionality and integration.
* Implements API versioning, lifecycle, and interoperability strategies that may require innovation.

* Provides technical guidance and domain expertise to suggest software architecture decisions that impact organizational success, mentoring peers and contributing to team development through role modeling and decision-making.
* Conducts periodic reviews and ensures adherence to architectural standards.
* Collaborates across lines of business and may communicate externally to align and build a narrow scope of software architecture with business and/or customer goals and priorities.
* Implements highly complex performance optimization and scalability strategies in software design within scope.
* Conducts regular technology research and evaluation for architectural enhancements having a moderate impact on the organization.

* Contributes to strategies to advocate for customers' interests and suggests product enhancements based on feedback.
* Influences strategies to ensure customer satisfaction through timely resolution of issues and effective communication.
* Implements and provides guidance on customer issue and/or defect handling and training processes.
* Investigates and troubleshoots the most complex and broadly reaching product maintenance issues to ensure customer agreement on short- and long-term solutions (e.g., future enhancements).
