* Collaborates with the team and cross-functionally to follow and suggest improvements to development practices and coding standards, providing coaching to less experienced team members.
* Participates in peer review processes, provides technical leadership, and ensures quality and adherence to broad acceptance criteria during development, reporting results to management.
* Demonstrates and shares expert knowledge of and contributes to industry best practices and applies them to software development processes.
* Implements highly complex secure coding practices to prevent security vulnerabilities, leveraging automated solutions to augment the manual review process.

**Development Operations - System Maintenance:**

* Utilizes innovation to perform periodic maintenance and testing operations for systems that require upgrading or patching (e.g., for critical vulnerabilities).
* Utilizes expert knowledge to drive improvements, ensures automation, testing, and debugging of systems to ensure service/product availability, health, support, and reliability.

**Core Responsibilities**  
**Planning & Execution:**

* Oversees and tracks timelines and/or budgets for large-scale projects or initiatives to ensure timely progress and adherence to requirements.
* Strategically balances multiple projects and adjusts plans to accommodate shifts in resources or schedules, mitigating risks to project outcomes.

**Collaboration & Partnership:**

* Fosters collaboration across the line of business and with external stakeholders to ensure alignment of expectations and strategic objectives.
* Builds and maintains partnerships with business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to address barriers and contribute to organizational success.
* Drives transparency and inclusivity by actively seeking, listening to, and leveraging diverse perspectives.

**Problem Solving:**

* Develops and refines problem-solving strategies and serves as an escalation point for complex issues across multiple projects or teams.
* Leads the analysis of complex data and/or information to identify patterns and root causes, reviewing recommendations for resolution, and implementing solutions that prevent future issues.

**Continuous Learning:**

* Builds expertise within one's area and actively pursues learning opportunities to stay current with the latest industry trends and best practices.
* Acts as a role model for continuous learning by identifying new areas to grow skills.
* Applies new knowledge to drive advancement and mentors others to do the same, fostering a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing.

**Continuous Improvement:**

* Develops and leads efforts to implement ideas that increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across teams, as well as evaluates the impact on key stakeholders.
* Actively encourages team to recommend ideas for improvement and provide feedback on approaches and methods for continued improvement.

**Performance and Development:**

Leverages subject matter expertise to sustain the talent development pipeline by participating in candidate interviews, assessing candidates, and providing hiring recommendations.

title: Senior Consulting Software Developer (Health Information Exchange)
description:
**ORACLE CSS INNOVATION STUDIOS**

**Senior Consulting Software Developer - Health Information Exchange**

Develop customer-specific Millennium solutions for the HIE team.

About Oracle Customer Success Services (CSS)

Oracle Customer Success Services (CSS) helps customers maximize the value of their Oracle technology investments, from implementation and adoption to ongoing improvement. Bringing together Oracle product expertise, industry understanding, and delivery experience, CSS works with customers to address business priorities, strengthen technology adoption, and achieve measurable outcomes.

Within CSS, Oracle Innovation Studios brings together specialists across AI Studio, Cloud Platforms Studio, Industry Studios, Fusion Apps Studios, and Security Studio. Our teams co-innovate with customers to identify valuable use cases, validate ideas through prototypes, and deliver secure, scalable solutions. We collaborate across Studios, Product Development, sales, and delivery, combining reusable assets and practical AI capabilities to improve delivery productivity and turn business priorities into lasting customer value.

Why join CSS?

* Build on your expertise. Deepen your Oracle specialization while expanding your understanding of connected business processes and technologies across the Oracle ecosystem.
* Apply AI to real business needs. Develop practical knowledge of AI and automation through customer solutions and improvements to the way we design, build, and deliver.
* Connect your work to customer outcomes. Contribute across discovery, solution design, prototyping, delivery, and adoption, with opportunities shaped by your role and Studio.
* Learn through collaboration. Work with specialists, architects, engineers, and functional experts across Studios and Product Development to strengthen your solution judgment.
* Extend your impact. Create reusable assets and share knowledge through mentoring, workshops, demonstrations, technical publications, and continuous learning.

Industry Studios

Industry Studios bring an industry-focused approach to customer co-innovation, connecting business priorities and domain knowledge with Oracle technologies. The work centers on understanding industry processes, identifying valuable use cases, and shaping solutions that address operational needs. Depending on the role and engagement, this can include discovery workshops, prototypes, industry-specific accelerators, and collaboration with AI, applications, cloud, data, and security specialists. Join Industry Studios to deepen your domain expertise while translating customer challenges into practical solutions and measurable business outcomes.

Oracle Health:

Oracle Health is reimagining the future of healthcare by connecting clinical, operational, and financial data across the entire care continuum. Combining the proven clinical depth of the Millennium platform with the scale, security, and AI capabilities of Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), our consulting practice partners directly with healthcare providers, hospital networks, and public health organizations worldwide to implement, optimize, and modernize their health IT ecosystems.

Role Overview

Based in India in the HIE (Health Information Exchange) team, you will develop customer-specific Oracle Health Millennium solutions using Cerner Command Language (CCL). You will own assigned projects from requirements gathering and technical design through development, testing, deployment, and post-go-live support. Working with customers, consultants, and clinical teams, you will deliver reports, extracts, clinical print outputs, labels, and requisitions that address clinical and operational needs. Your responsibilities include analysis of the Millennium data model, performance troubleshooting, code reviews, customer testing, and production readiness. You will maintain technical documentation and handover guides, communicate progress and risks, and contribute reusable scripts and delivery improvements. The role requires strong CCL and SQL skills, full-lifecycle delivery experience, and the ability to manage assigned work independently. You will also use Oracle-approved AI development tools with effective prompts, appropriate technical context, and critical review of generated code and documentation, retaining accountability for quality and validation.

Key Responsibilities

* Gather requirements, assess feasibility and prepare technical designs, effort estimates and delivery plans.
* Develop and enhance CCL reports, data extracts, clinical print outputs, labels and requisitions.
* Analyze Millennium tables, fields, relationships and code sets to implement accurate data retrieval and processing.
* Troubleshoot functional issues, data discrepancies and performance problems in custom solutions.
* Conduct code reviews, prepare test cases and validate outputs against agreed requirements.
* Coordinate customer testing, resolve defects and support packaging, deployment and production readiness.
* Maintain technical documentation, project summaries and customer handover guides.
* Communicate progress, dependencies and risks to customers and project stakeholders.
* Use Oracle-approved AI tools and reusable components across delivery, including code review and documentation, while retaining accountability for quality and validation.
* Mentor colleagues and contribute reusable scripts, technical guidance and delivery improvements.

Skills - Mandatory

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

**Oracle Products**

* Strong hands-on experience developing and troubleshooting CCL solutions in Oracle Health Millennium.
* Sound understanding of the Millennium data model and clinical or operational workflows.

**Technical Skills**

* Proficiency in SQL, relational databases, query optimization and data validation.
* Experience with version control, code reviews, testing and controlled deployments.
* Practical experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Oracle-approved ChatGPT and Codex.
* Ability to write effective prompts, provide relevant technical context and critically review AI-generated code and documentation.

**Experience**

* Experience delivering custom reports, extracts or clinical outputs through the full development lifecycle.

**Functional Skills**

* Ability to independently manage assigned work, estimate effort and resolve complex technical issues.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Clear communication skills and the ability to translate customer requirements into technical solutions.

**Work Requirements**

* Willingness to work the 4 p.m.–1 a.m. IST shift.
* Willingness to work additional or irregular hours as needed and permitted by local regulations.
* Perform other responsibilities as assigned and follow corporate and organizational security policies and procedures, including safeguarding corporate and client assets and preventing and reporting security compromises within the scope of the role.

Good to Have

* Experience with Java, JavaScript, HTML and CSS for custom interfaces and workflow enhancements.
* Experience with MPages, Discern Rules, PIE, DA2 or healthcare interfaces.
* Familiarity with pharmacy, laboratory, blood bank, registration or financial reporting workflows.
* Experience supporting customer implementations and go-live activities.

Self Assessment Questions

Before applying, please consider the following questions:

* Can I demonstrate strong hands-on CCL development and troubleshooting experience in Oracle Health Millennium and knowledge of its data model and workflows?
* Am I proficient in SQL, relational databases, query optimization, and data validation?
* Have I delivered custom reports, extracts, or clinical outputs through the full development lifecycle, using version control, code reviews, testing, and controlled deployments?
* Can I independently estimate and manage assigned work, resolve complex technical issues, and communicate customer requirements as technical solutions?
* Do I have the specified bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience, and can I demonstrate effective use and critical review of Oracle-approved AI development tools?

Working with customers, consultants, and clinical teams, you will deliver reports, extracts, clinical print outputs, labels, and requisitions that address clinical and operational needs. Your responsibilities include analysis of the Millennium data model, performance troubleshooting, code reviews, customer testing, and production readiness. You will maintain technical documentation and handover guides, communicate progress and risks, and contribute reusable scripts and delivery improvements. The role requires strong CCL and SQL skills, full-lifecycle delivery experience, and the ability to manage assigned work independently. You will also use Oracle-approved AI development tools with effective prompts, appropriate technical context, and critical review of generated code and documentation, retaining accountability for quality and validation.

Key Responsibilities

* Gather requirements, assess feasibility and prepare technical designs, effort estimates and delivery plans.
* Develop and enhance CCL reports, data extracts, clinical print outputs, labels and requisitions.
* Analyze Millennium tables, fields, relationships and code sets to implement accurate data retrieval and processing.
* Troubleshoot functional issues, data discrepancies and performance problems in custom solutions.
* Conduct code reviews, prepare test cases and validate outputs against agreed requirements.
* Coordinate customer testing, resolve defects and support packaging, deployment and production readiness.
* Maintain technical documentation, project summaries and customer handover guides.
* Communicate progress, dependencies and risks to customers and project stakeholders.
* Use Oracle-approved AI tools and reusable components across delivery, including code review and documentation, while retaining accountability for quality and validation.
* Mentor colleagues and contribute reusable scripts, technical guidance and delivery improvements.

Skills - Mandatory

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

**Oracle Products**

* Strong hands-on experience developing and troubleshooting CCL solutions in Oracle Health Millennium.
* Sound understanding of the Millennium data model and clinical or operational workflows.

**Technical Skills**

* Proficiency in SQL, relational databases, query optimization and data validation.
* Experience with version control, code reviews, testing and controlled deployments.
* Practical experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Oracle-approved ChatGPT and Codex.
* Ability to write effective prompts, provide relevant technical context and critically review AI-generated code and documentation.

**Experience**

* Experience delivering custom reports, extracts or clinical outputs through the full development lifecycle.

**Functional Skills**

* Ability to independently manage assigned work, estimate effort and resolve complex technical issues.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Clear communication skills and the ability to translate customer requirements into technical solutions.

**Work Requirements**

* Willingness to work the 4 p.m.–1 a.m. IST shift.
* Willingness to work additional or irregular hours as needed and permitted by local regulations.
* Perform other responsibilities as assigned and follow corporate and organizational security policies and procedures, including safeguarding corporate and client assets and preventing and reporting security compromises within the scope of the role.

Good to Have

* Experience with Java, JavaScript, HTML and CSS for custom interfaces and workflow enhancements.
* Experience with MPages, Discern Rules, PIE, DA2 or healthcare interfaces.
* Familiarity with pharmacy, laboratory, blood bank, registration or financial reporting workflows.
* Experience supporting customer implementations and go-live activities.

Self Assessment Questions

Before applying, please consider the following questions:

* Can I demonstrate strong hands-on CCL development and troubleshooting experience in Oracle Health Millennium and knowledge of its data model and workflows?
* Am I proficient in SQL, relational databases, query optimization, and data validation?
* Have I delivered custom reports, extracts, or clinical outputs through the full development lifecycle, using version control, code reviews, testing, and controlled deployments?
* Can I independently estimate and manage assigned work, resolve complex technical issues, and communicate customer requirements as technical solutions?
* Do I have the specified bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience, and can I demonstrate effective use and critical review of Oracle-approved AI development tools?

title: Software Engineer; Service Observability Platform
description:
**About SiFive**
----------------

*As the pioneers who introduced RISC-V to the world, SiFive is transforming the future of compute by bringing the limitless potential of RISC-V to the highest performance and most data-intensive applications in the world. SiFive’s unrivaled compute platforms are continuing to enable leading technology companies around the world to innovate, optimize and deliver the most advanced solutions of tomorrow across every market segment of chip design, including artificial intelligence, machine learning, automotive, data center, mobile, and consumer. With SiFive, the future of RISC-V has no limits.*

At SiFive, we are always excited to connect with talented individuals, who are just as passionate about driving innovation and changing the world as we are.

Our constant innovation and ongoing success is down to our amazing teams of incredibly talented people, who collaborate and support each other to come up with truly groundbreaking ideas and solutions. Solutions that will have a huge impact on people's lives; making the world a better place, one processor at a time.

Are you ready?

To learn more about SiFive’s phenomenal success and to see why we have won the GSA’s prestigious Most Respected Private Company Award (for the fourth time!), check out our website and Glassdoor pages.

**Job Description:**

As a Service Observability Platform development engineer, you will be joining the DevOps team to develop and maintain data flow infrastructure, data pipelines, and visualizations for the systems and services usage on our high performance compute infrastructure You will build scalable database and streaming platforms, run Kafka and supporting services on Kubernetes, and maintain the microservices and deployment systems that connect data producers and consumers. You will own projects end to end and help make these systems observable, secure, resilient, and straightforward for engineering teams to use.

  

You will work closely with the design engineers, platform engineers and build engineers reporting to the Senior Manager of DevOps Engineering. You will ensure that needs are met on building the dashboards and visualizations along with building the data flow pipelines.

This is a perfect opportunity for a Data and Visualization engineer with good applications development skills, looking to expand their horizons and become involved in developing innovative products used by our customers to design state-of-the-art silicon for an emerging powerhouse in a the RISC-V ecosystem.

  

**Responsibilities:**

* Design, deploy, and operate scalable data infrastructure, including databases, Kafka clusters, and supporting services.
* Run data-pipeline components on Kubernetes, with attention to capacity, availability, upgrades, storage, networking, and failure recovery.
* Build and maintain microservices that ingest, transform, route, expose, or manage data-pipeline workloads.
* Design data-collection and ingestion systems for AI and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) applications, connecting structured and unstructured sources through APIs, connectors, and batch or streaming pipelines.
* Build and operate retrieval infrastructure, including document processing, metadata and access-control propagation, embeddings, indexing, and vector or hybrid search systems.
* Improve data quality, freshness, lineage, and evaluation for AI pipelines; monitor ingestion and retrieval outcomes and address failures such as stale, incomplete, or improperly permissioned data.
* Develop and improve deployment automation, CI/CD workflows, configuration management, and release practices for services and platform components.
* Define and evolve operational practices for Kafka topics, partitions, replication, retention, access controls, and schema or data-contract changes.
* Improve database reliability and performance through capacity planning, backups, restore testing, replication, observability, and maintenance automation.
* Establish service-level monitoring, alerting, logging, and tracing; lead troubleshooting and resolution of production issues.
* Collaborate with data producers, consumers, and platform teams to translate requirements into durable interfaces and infrastructure.
* Lead technical design and reviews, document operational procedures, and mentor engineers.
* Apply security and reliability principles throughout the lifecycle, including least-privilege access, secrets handling, encryption, and controlled rollouts.
* Work closely with a diverse team of software engineers and business stakeholders dispersed geographically across various time zones.

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5+ (3+ with Masters) years of professional software engineering experience building or operating production services and infrastructure.
* Strong programming skills in one or more languages such as Go, Java, Python, or similar.
* Hands-on experience deploying and operating workloads on Kubernetes, including containerized services, resource configuration, networking, storage, upgrades, and troubleshooting.
* Experience running Kafka through Kubernetes operators or similar lifecycle-management tooling.
* Familiarity with streaming or batch-processing frameworks such as Flink, Spark, or Kafka Connect.
* Experience with schema registries, data contracts, CDC, event-driven architectures, or multi-tenant data platforms.
* Experience supporting AI/ML data workflows or RAG systems, including document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector or hybrid search, and retrieval evaluation.
* Familiarity with AI data governance concerns such as source permissions, provenance, privacy, and preventing stale or unauthorized content from entering retrieval indexes.
* Experience with database clustering, sharding, replication, backup and restore, or performance tuning at scale.
* Experience with cloud infrastructure, service meshes, GitOps, Helm, or platform observability tools.
* Experience defining service-level objectives, incident response processes, and disaster-recovery plans..

**Role Expectations:**

* Data-pipeline services meet agreed reliability, latency, and throughput expectations as workloads grow.
* Kafka, databases, and Kubernetes-hosted microservices are observable, secure, maintainable, and recoverable.
* Deployments and upgrades are repeatable, well-tested, and performed with appropriate rollout and rollback plans.
* Operational issues are diagnosed efficiently, and recurring failure modes are reduced through engineering improvements.
* Internal teams can integrate with the platform using clear interfaces, documentation, and support practices.
* AI and RAG data flows provide timely, traceable, permission-aware content and can be monitored and evaluated in production.
* Bonus: Experience building ETL/ELT pipelines and observability platforms using
* OpenTelemetry, ClickHouse, Prometheus, and Grafana.

**Additional Information:**

This position requires a successful background and reference checks and satisfactory proof of your right to work in:

India

Any offer of employment for this position is also contingent on the Company verifying that you are a authorized for access to export-controlled technology under applicable export control laws or, if you are not already authorized, our ability to successfully obtain any necessary export license(s) or other approvals.

SiFive is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Principal Software Engineer - AI Platforms
description:

As the Senior Engineering Manager for AI Compute, you will lead teams building and operating Arm’s central platform for AI training, evaluation, model serving, and CPU and accelerator fleet management. * Proven experience as a **hands‑on developer** who delivers configuration and code independently.
* Experience integrating CPQ with ERP and CRM platforms.

**Technical Skills**

* Oracle CPQ Cloud configuration and scripting (BML, commerce rules, Util Library)

* Oracle CX ecosystem familiarity (Sales, Service, Commerce preferred)

* Strong documentation and communication skills

* Experience in complex manufacturing, engineered‑to‑order, or highly configurable product environments
* Familiarity with Oracle Fusion Order Management and Pricing
* Exposure to CPQ performance tuning and optimization of large product models

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**An Amazing Career Opportunity for** **Senior Software Engineer – AI**  
**Location: Chennai, India (Hybrid)**  
**Job ID: 52831**

  

**Profile Summary:**  
Experienced software engineering position responsible for designing and developing AI-enabled solutions and accelerating software engineering through AI-assisted and Agentic SDLC practices.

The role combines strong software engineering fundamentals with hands-on experience in Generative AI, AI coding agents, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), LLM integration, context/token optimization, and cloud-based application development.

The engineer will work across the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) to apply AI effectively to requirements analysis, design, implementation, testing, code review, debugging, and documentation while ensuring generated solutions comply with established architecture, security, and engineering standards.

**About HID Global**

HID Global powers the trusted identities of the world’s people, places and things. We make it possible for people to transact safely, work productively and travel freely. Our trusted identity solutions give people secure and convenient access to physical and digital places and connect things that can be accurately identified, verified and tracked digitally. Millions of people around the world use HID products and services to navigate their everyday lives, and over 2 billion things are connected through HID. We work with governments, educational institutions, hospitals, financial institutions, industrial businesses, and some of the most innovative companies on the planet. Headquartered in Austin, Texas, HID Global has over 4500 employees worldwide and operates international offices that support more than 100 countries. HID Global® is an ASSA ABLOY Group brand. HID Global has is the trusted source for secure identity solutions for millions of customers and users around the world. In India, we have two Engineering Centre (Bangalore and Chennai). Global Engineering Team is based in Chennai and one of the Business Unit Engineering team is based in Bangalore. Check us out: www.hidglobal.com and https://youtu.be/23km5H4K9Eo

LinkedIn: www.linkedin.com/company/hidglobal/mycompany/

  

**Are You Ready to Join the Team?**
  
Our company is committed to finding the best and the brightest talent to help us reach the top. If you are a dynamic, highly skilled, experienced Cloud engineer and technology enthusiast, and you enjoy working in a rapid pace within a rapidly growing business environment, then you will want to consider this position. If you excel at communication, collaboration, and unrelenting innovation, we want to talk to you. And if you bring dedication, positive energy and integrity to the table, you just might be the right fit for our team.

  

**Qualifications**  
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**Roles & Responsibilities** **(Other duties may be assigned)**

* Strong software engineering skills with hands-on experience in one or more languages such as Java, Python.
* Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools and AI IDEs such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Codex or equivalent.
* Apply Agentic AI across SDLC phases, including requirements, design, planning, implementation, testing, code review and documentation.
* Design and implement reusable AI agents, skills, prompts and workflows for software engineering use cases.
* Strong understanding of LLMs, prompt engineering and context engineering.
* Understanding of RAG, including embeddings, vector databases, semantic search, chunking, retrieval and reranking strategies.
* Experience integrating AI APIs and cloud AI platforms such as Azure OpenAI/AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Claude or equivalent.
* Optimize token/context consumption, latency and AI inference cost while maintaining solution quality.
* Understand model capabilities and select appropriate models based on reasoning complexity, coding requirements, latency and cost.
* Develop AI-enabled applications, APIs, microservices, PoCs and reusable engineering components.
* Implement AI-assisted approaches for code generation, automated testing, debugging, refactoring and code review.
* Implement appropriate human-in-the-loop validation and approval mechanisms for AI-generated outputs.
* Ensure AI-generated solutions comply with architecture, security, coding and Responsible AI standards.
* Build and deploy cloud-based AI applications using modern DevOps and CI/CD practices.
* Evaluate emerging AI frameworks, coding agents and open-weight models for engineering use cases.
* Contribute reusable AI engineering patterns and best practices across the team.

**Preferred Qualifications**.

* Communicates technical design, implementation decisions, risks and status clearly to team members and stakeholders.
* Collaborates effectively with architects, product teams, developers, DevOps and security teams.
* Provides technical guidance and mentoring to junior engineers.
* Demonstrates HID core values in day-to-day engineering activities.
* Actively contributes to AI engineering knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.

  

**Education and/or Experience**

* **5–7 years of software engineering experience**, with hands-on experience applying Generative AI technologies to software development.
* Engineering degree, Computer Science degree or equivalent relevant experience.
* Strong understanding of Software Development Lifecycle and software design principles.
* Experience developing and deploying cloud-based applications.
* Practical experience with AI APIs, RAG and AI-assisted development tools.
* Experience with APIs, microservices, CI/CD and modern engineering practices

  

**Why apply?**
--------------

* **Empowerment:** You’ll work as part of a global team in a flexible work environment, learning and enhancing your expertise. We welcome an opportunity to meet you and learn about your unique talents, skills, and experiences. You don’t need to check all the boxes. If you have most of the skills and experience, we want you to apply.
* **Innovation:** You embrace challenges and want to drive change. We are open to ideas, including flexible work arrangements, job sharing or part-time job seekers.
* **Integrity:** You are results-orientated, reliable, and straightforward and value being treated accordingly. We want all our employees to be themselves to feel appreciated and accepted.

This opportunity may be open to flexible working arrangements.

HID is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer – Minority/Female/Disability/Veteran/Gender Identity/Sexual Orientation.

**We make it easier for people to get where they want to go!**
  
On an average day, think of how many times you tap, twist, tag, push or swipe to get access, find information, connect with others or track something. HID technology is behind billions of interactions, in more than 100 countries. We help you create a verified, trusted identity that can get you where you need to go – without having to think about it.
  
  
When you join our HID team, you’ll also be part of the ASSA ABLOY Group, the global leader in access solutions. You’ll have 63,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally. As we welcome new people on board, it’s important to us to have diverse, inclusive teams, and we value different perspectives and experiences.

JOB DESCRIPTIONPosition: Machine Shop Supervisor cum Programmer

**Department:** Machine Shop / Production  
**Designation:** Machine Shop Supervisor cum Programmer  
**Experience:** 5–10 Years  
**Location:** Thirumudivakkam, Chennai  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Industry:** Engineering / Medical Equipment Manufacturing

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced **Machine Shop Supervisor cum Programmer** to manage day-to-day machine shop operations while independently handling **CNC/VMC programming, machining processes, production planning, quality, and manpower supervision**.

The candidate should have strong practical knowledge of **CNC/VMC machining, CNC programming, tool selection, cutting parameters, drawing interpretation, production planning, and shop-floor management**.

Key Responsibilities1. Machine Shop Supervision

* Supervise daily activities of the Machine Shop and ensure smooth production operations.
* Allocate jobs and manpower based on production priorities and machine availability.
* Monitor machine utilization, production output, cycle time, and productivity.
* Ensure jobs are completed within the planned production schedule.
* Coordinate with Production, Design, R&D, QC, Stores, Maintenance, and other departments.
* Maintain proper discipline, housekeeping, and 5S practices within the machine shop.
* Monitor machine condition and coordinate with Maintenance for breakdowns and preventive maintenance.

2. CNC / VMC Programming

* Prepare, modify, and optimize CNC/VMC programs based on engineering drawings and job requirements.
* Develop CNC programs using appropriate programming methods/software.
* Understand and work with **G-code and M-code**.
* Select suitable cutting tools, inserts, holders, and machining strategies.
* Set appropriate cutting speed, feed rate, depth of cut, spindle speed, and machining parameters.
* Optimize programs to reduce cycle time, tool wear, and machining cost.
* Prove out and validate new programs before production.
* Make necessary program corrections based on machining and inspection results.

3. Drawing & Technical Understanding

* Read and interpret engineering drawings, dimensions, tolerances, GD&T, and machining specifications.
* Understand material specifications such as MS, SS, Aluminium, EN-series materials, etc.
* Identify machining requirements and determine suitable processes.
* Coordinate with the Design/R&D team regarding drawing and machining-related issues.

4. Production Planning & Monitoring

* Prepare daily and weekly machine-shop production plans.
* Prioritize urgent and critical jobs.
* Monitor job progress against production targets.
* Track pending, running, completed, rejected, and rework jobs.
* Ensure proper machine loading and minimize machine idle time.
* Maintain production records and provide regular status reports to management.

5. Quality Control

* Ensure machining is carried out according to approved drawings and specifications.
* Coordinate with QC/Inspection teams for first-piece and final inspection.
* Identify dimensional and machining defects and take corrective action.
* Minimize rejection, rework, and material wastage.
* Ensure proper use of measuring instruments such as Vernier Caliper, Micrometer, Height Gauge, Bore Gauge, etc.

6. Tool & Material Management

* Monitor availability and usage of cutting tools, inserts, holders, coolant, and other consumables.
* Maintain proper tool inventory and usage records.
* Recommend suitable tooling to improve productivity and quality.
* Control tool consumption and avoid unnecessary wastage.

7. Manpower Management

* Supervise CNC/VMC operators, machinists, helpers, and other machine-shop personnel.
* Allocate operators according to machine and job requirements.
* Train and guide operators on machine operation, programming, safety, and quality requirements.
* Monitor attendance, productivity, discipline, and work performance.
* Identify skill gaps and recommend training requirements.

8. Safety & Compliance

* Ensure all employees follow machine-shop safety procedures.
* Ensure proper use of PPE and safety equipment.
* Maintain safe working conditions around CNC/VMC and conventional machines.
* Ensure proper handling of tools, materials, chips, coolant, and finished components.
* Immediately report unsafe conditions, accidents, or machine-related hazards to management.

Required Technical Skills

* Strong knowledge of **CNC / VMC machining operations**.
* CNC programming and program editing.
* Knowledge of **G-code and M-code**.
* Knowledge of cutting tools and machining parameters.
* Ability to read engineering drawings and GD&T.
* Knowledge of tooling selection and machining processes.
* Knowledge of CNC/VMC machine setting and offset correction.
* Understanding of production planning and shop-floor management.
* Knowledge of inspection and measuring instruments.
* Knowledge of 5S, productivity improvement, and rejection control.
* Basic knowledge of CAD/CAM software will be an added advantage.

Educational Qualification

* Diploma / ITI / BE / B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, or related discipline.
* Candidates with strong practical CNC/VMC machining experience may also be considered.

Experience

**5–10 years of relevant experience** in CNC/VMC machining and machine-shop supervision.

Experience in **engineering manufacturing, precision machining, medical equipment manufacturing, or similar industries** will be preferred.

* On-time completion of production schedules

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------

  
  

Docusign brings agreements to life. More than 1.8 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using the Docusign AI-native IAM platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).

  
  

**What you'll do**
------------------

  
  

Docusign is looking for a Senior Performance Engineer to make our production systems faster, more efficient, and more resilient. In this role, you will investigate complex performance issues across applications, services, infrastructure, and cloud environments to deliver measurable improvements. You will turn production data into actionable root-cause findings while combining systems thinking, software troubleshooting, and fleet optimization. Collaborating with development, SRE, and infrastructure teams, you will identify bottlenecks and safely deploy optimizations across large-scale environments. Additionally, you will scale engineering practices by building reusable tools, dashboards, and knowledge-sharing content that empower teams to resolve issues independently.

This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the Senior Director, Engineering.

**Responsibility**

* Investigate production performance issues involving high CPU, high memory, latency, queuing, crashes, timeouts, throughput degradation, resource saturation, and service availability
* Collect and analyze the right evidence for each symptom using logs, metrics, traces, dumps, profiles, ETW data, application telemetry, and infrastructure signals
* Apply a structured investigation process: define the problem, reproduce or isolate the behavior, form and test hypotheses, identify the root cause, implement or recommend a fix, and validate the result after deployment
* Use profilers, debuggers, memory analysis tools, distributed tracing, and application performance monitoring systems to diagnose issues across application and infrastructure layers
* Analyze CPU, memory, garbage collection, thread activity, I/O, network behavior, database calls, request queues, and dependency interactions to identify performance constraints
* Design and maintain performance dashboards, health checks, alerts, and measurement pipelines that make latency, throughput, utilization, capacity, and saturation visible to engineering teams
* Lead or contribute to capacity planning, headroom analysis, workload characterization, right-sizing, and fleet optimization across cloud and production environments
* Measure before-and-after results for tuning changes and communicate impact using meaningful metrics such as P95/P99 latency, throughput, CPU and memory utilization, concurrency, error rates, and cost efficiency
* Design workload models from production traffic characteristics, including request mix, arrival patterns, payload distributions, and representative data volumes
* Build and run load, stress, soak, scalability, and regression tests using appropriate automation and load-generation tools
* Partner with development teams on performance-focused code, configuration, architecture, and deployment improvements
* Develop reusable data-collection tools, diagnostic workflows, automation, and self-service capabilities that reduce time to resolution and scale performance investigations
* Coach and mentor engineers and Performance Leads through investigation techniques, systems thinking, debugging tools, and knowledge-sharing sessions
* Document findings, root causes, remediation plans, operational procedures, and lessons learned in a way that can be reused across teams
* Participate in production support and collaborate on complex incidents, while helping teams distinguish symptoms from underlying causes

  

**Job Designation**
-------------------

  
  

**Hybrid:** Employee divides their time between in-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in-office expectation)

Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.

  
  

**What you bring**
------------------

  
  

**Basic**

* 5+ years of professional experience in software engineering, systems engineering, SRE, production engineering, or performance engineering
* Demonstrated experience diagnosing performance problems in production or large-scale test environments
* Proficiency in at least one programming or scripting language such as C#, Java, C++, Go, Python, or Shell
* Experience analyzing application and system behavior using metrics, logs, traces, profiles, dumps, or comparable diagnostic data
* Understanding of operating-system and runtime concepts such as processes, threads, memory allocation, garbage collection, I/O, networking, concurrency, and resource contention
* Experience with monitoring and observability tools, dashboards, alerting, and telemetry design
* Experience performing root-cause analysis and communicating technical findings to developers, SREs, and technical leaders
* Experience with cloud infrastructure, Linux or Windows production systems, and containerized services
* Ability to participate in on-call or incident-response activities and improve runbooks based on operational learning

**Preferred**

* Experience with distributed tracing and APM platforms such as Dynatrace, Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Prometheus, or Grafana
* Experience with Azure or Google Cloud, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, and cloud resource management
* Experience with capacity modeling, headroom analysis, forecasting, fleet right-sizing, infrastructure efficiency, or cost optimization
* Experience designing and operating load-generation and performance-test systems using tools such as k6, Gatling, Locust, or JMeter
* Experience creating production-representative workload models and interpreting latency, throughput, concurrency, saturation, and error-rate data
* Experience with database performance analysis, including query plans, indexing, lock contention, connection pooling, and workload optimization
* Hands-on experience with performance tools such as PerfView, Windows Performance Analyzer, WinDbg, ProcDump, GC dumps, .NET diagnostics, profilers, or equivalent Linux tooling
* Experience improving CI/CD pipelines, ephemeral test environments, performance gates, or automated regression detection
* Experience investigating .NET or JVM applications, Windows services, web servers, distributed systems, or Kubernetes workloads
* Experience teaching performance investigation techniques or building a community of practice across engineering teams
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience
* Ability to work independently on well-defined investigations and small engineering projects with limited supervision

  

**Life at Docusign**
--------------------

  
  

**Working here**

Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.

We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live.

**Accommodation**

Docusign is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need such an accommodation, or a religious accommodation, during the application process, please contact us at accommodations@docusign.com.

If you experience any issues, concerns, or technical difficulties during the application process please get in touch with our Talent organization at taops@docusign.com for assistance.

title: Senior Software Engineer II
description:
**Who we are**

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

**About the role:**

Samsara Technologies India Private Limited is looking for an experienced Senior Full Stack Software Engineer to be part of our Platform & Infrastructure organization. This org is responsible for building the foundational systems that drive Samsara's products.

  

**This role is Hybrid - 2 days per week in the office.**

**You should apply if:**

* **You want to impact the industries that run our world:** The software, firmware, and hardware you build will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
* **You want to build for scale:** With over 2.3 million IoT devices deployed to our global customers, you will work on a range of new and mature technologies driving scalable innovation for customers across industries driving the world's physical operations.
* **You are a life-long learner:** We have ambitious goals. Every Samsarian has a growth mindset as we work with a wide range of technologies, challenges, and customers that push us to learn on the go.
* **You believe customers are more than a number:** Samsara Technologies India Private Limited engineers enjoy a rare closeness to the end user and you will have the opportunity to participate in customer interviews, collaborate with customer success and product managers, and use metrics to ensure our work is translating into better customer outcomes.
* **You are a team player:** Working on our Samsara Technologies India Private Limited Engineering teams requires a mix of independent effort and collaboration. Motivated by our mission, we're all racing toward our connected operations vision, and we intend to win—together.

**In this role, you will:**

* Work with product managers, designers, staff engineers, and internal/external customers to architect, build, test, and deliver full stack features across the React and TypeScript frontend, the GraphQL layer, and Go backend services.
* Own the load time and responsiveness of high-traffic dashboard pages that show large lists and maps of assets. Measure them with real user monitoring and tracing, find where the time goes in the browser and on the server, and deliver measurable improvements.
* Improve how pages fetch and render data: sequence and batch requests, defer non-critical work, split and lazy-load code, virtualize long lists, and reduce unnecessary re-renders and main-thread work.
* Design and evolve GraphQL schemas, resolvers, and the backend services and data stores behind them, so that pages get the data they need in as few round trips as possible.
* Roll out changes safely with feature flags, staged releases, and before-and-after measurement, and partner with the Web Experience, time-series, and infrastructure teams on shared dependencies.
* Continuously evaluate and improve the performance, reliability, and user experience of our applications.
* Propose technical solutions and guide the technical direction of some of the team's initiatives.
* Help mentor, develop, and support other engineers on the team, including backend engineers who are growing their frontend skills.
* Maintain a regular feedback loop to allow for implementation iterations and making adjustments.
* Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

**Minimum requirements for the role:**

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science/Engineering or equivalent practical experience.
* 7+ years of relevant industry experience in software development, including production experience on both frontend and backend systems.
* Proficiency in TypeScript or JavaScript and React, including state management, hooks, component design, and automated testing of UI code.
* Proficiency in at least one backend language such as Go, Java, or Kotlin, and experience building and operating APIs (GraphQL or REST) backed by relational or NoSQL data stores.
* Experience diagnosing and improving web performance using browser developer tools, a React profiler, and real user monitoring or tracing tools.
* Excellent communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills, with a demonstrated ability to manage technical discussions and mentor junior engineers.

**An ideal candidate also has:**

* Experience building data-heavy single-page applications with large tables, lists, or interactive maps (for example Mapbox or Google Maps, marker clustering, and live location updates).
* Deep knowledge of browser performance: Core Web Vitals, long tasks and the main thread, bundle size and code splitting, caching, and the cost of network request waterfalls.
* Experience with GraphQL at scale, including schema design, query batching, pagination, subscriptions or live queries, and client-side caching.
* Experience with observability tools such as Datadog RUM and APM, and with defining and tracking percentile-based performance goals.
* Expertise working with web services at massive scale deployed on hyperscalers such as AWS, GCP or Azure.
* Experience with real-time or time-series data and with caching strategies for frequently read, rarely updated data.
* Experience working within a design system and building accessible, internationalized user interfaces.
* Experience writing high-quality, performant, and maintainable code on large-scale enterprise software applications.
* Hands-on experience applying AI/ML techniques or using AI-driven tools to improve system reliability, developer productivity, or customer-facing features.

**Total Rewards**

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

**Flexible Working**

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

**Belonging at Samsara**

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

**Accommodations**

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

**Our Commitment to Authenticity**

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

title: Associate Software Engineer
description:
At New Relic, we shape the future of intelligent observability, building technology that helps companies understand and optimize their complex systems. We are a collaborative, global team that values curiosity, mutual support, and solving hard technical challenges together. As we grow, we are looking for thoughtful problem-solvers ready to make a real impact.

That open, forward-thinking approach extends to how we hire. We actively work with modern AI tools every day and support candidates using them to prepare for interviews. To keep our process authentic and fair, please review our Candidate AI Interview Guide to see our general guidelines, including where AI is encouraged and what practices are prohibited before you apply.

**Your opportunity**
--------------------

At New Relic, we provide our customers real-time insights, so they can innovate faster. Our software delivers insightful observability tools across different technologies and distributed systems, enabling software engineering teams to quickly identify, understand and tackle issues, analyze performance, and get the most out of their software and infrastructure.

If you are a curious, driven engineer eager to learn and make an impact from day one, apply now for the position of Associate Software Engineer at New Relic.

At New Relic, you will learn and contribute to our massive-scale streaming data platform that powers our industry-leading observability ingestion pipelines. Join us in our mission to revolutionize observability alongside a team of experienced engineers who are passionate about mentorship and technical growth.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* **Build real-time data pipelines:** Design and develop streaming pipelines that capture database changes (inserts, updates, deletes) from PostgreSQL and MySQL and deliver them to Apache Kafka using Apache Flink. This includes joining, filtering, and transforming the data along the way.
* **Develop platform code:** Write clean, well-tested Java for shared libraries, connectors, and developer tooling that make the platform easier to use.
* **Design data schemas:** Define and evolve data schemas (Protobuf) so data stays consistent and compatible as systems change.
* **Modernize data flows:** Help move existing data flows onto modern streaming infrastructure, and confirm the data stays accurate and complete throughout.
* **Operate production systems:** Deploy, monitor, and troubleshoot high-volume pipelines running on AWS, Docker, and Kubernetes. Build dashboards and alerts, and take part in an on-call rotation.
* **Collaborate and learn:** Join design discussions, code reviews, and agile ceremonies. Work closely with partner engineering teams to understand their data needs.
* Write and improve unit and integration tests to help maintain service reliability.
* Continuously learn from senior engineers, internal resources, and the broader engineering community.

**This role requires**
----------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or international equivalent), or equivalent practical experience
* 1 to 2 years of software engineering experience. Internships and substantial project work count.
* Strong programming fundamentals in **Java**, or another object-oriented language such as Kotlin, Scala, Go, or Python
* Solid grasp of data structures, algorithms, and problem solving
* Working knowledge of **SQL** and relational databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL
* Familiarity with Git, unit testing, and the Linux command line
* Curiosity about how large-scale backend and data systems work, and eagerness to learn quickly
* Clear communication and a collaborative, ownership-driven attitude

**Good to have skills**
-----------------------

* Exposure to streaming or messaging systems such as **Apache Kafka**, **Apache Flink**, Spark Streaming, Kafka Connect, or Debezium
* Understanding of change data capture, database replication logs (WAL/binlog), or ETL pipelines
* Familiarity with serialization formats such as Protobuf, Avro, or JSON Schema
* Hands-on experience with AWS (for example S3 or IAM), Docker, or Kubernetes
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and observability (metrics, logging, alerting, dashboards)
* Open-source contributions, hackathon projects, or personal projects involving distributed systems or data processing

**Bonus points if you have**
----------------------------

* Academic projects, internships, or personal work involving backend services, data pipelines, or system-level programming.
* Familiarity with the MELT stack (Metrics, Events, Logs, Traces) or observability concepts.
* Contributions to open-source projects or a public portfolio of technical work (GitHub, etc.).
* Competitive programming background or strong algorithmic problem-solving track record.

  

Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this position.  
  
Qualified applicants may inquire about visa sponsorship (including transfer of a current H-1B visa), but the company does not support or sponsor O-1, F-1, or J-1 visas, or candidates who require commencement of an H-1B "cap case" petition for future work authorization. This position is to be filled as soon as possible.

You will work across the entire stack — from designing RESTful APIs on the backend to crafting responsive, high-performance user interfaces on the frontend.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Design, develop, and maintain robust Java-based backend services and microservices

* Build dynamic, responsive web applications using React, Next.js, and/or Angular

* Implement component-driven development using reusable UI libraries and design systems

**Required Skills & Experience**
--------------------------------

* 6–8 years of hands-on, professional experience in full stack software development
* Strong proficiency in Java (Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Hibernate)
* Experience with RESTful API design and microservices architecture
* Familiarity with JUnit, Mockito, or similar testing frameworks
* Solid SQL expertise — complex queries, schema design, indexing, and performance tuning
* Experience with one or more: Oracle, MySQL, PostgreSQL, MS SQL Server
* Frontend expertise in at least two of: React, Next.js, Angular
* Strong understanding of JavaScript (ES6+) and TypeScript
* Experience building headless websites / Jamstack architectures
* Proficiency with Node.js for server-side rendering or middleware layer development

\*\*Position:\*\* .NET Web Application Developer

\*\*Experience:\*\* 3–5 Years

\*\*Employment Type:\*\* Full-Time

## Job Summary

We are looking for a skilled .NET Web Application Developer with 3–5 years of hands-on experience in developing, maintaining, and enhancing web applications using ASP.NET Core, C#, and Entity Framework Core.

The ideal candidate should have strong backend development skills, experience designing and developing RESTful APIs, and a good understanding of web application architecture and database management.

The candidate will work closely with frontend developers, business analysts, and other technical team members to develop scalable, secure, and high-performance web applications.

2. Develop and maintain RESTful Web APIs for frontend applications and third-party integrations.

3. Implement business logic, application services, and backend workflows.

4. Work with Entity Framework Core for database operations, LINQ queries, migrations, and performance optimization.

5. Work with relational databases, including Microsoft SQL Server and PostgreSQL.

6. Develop secure and reusable backend components following SOLID principles and clean coding standards.

7. Implement API validation, exception handling, logging, and error management.

8. Optimize API performance, database queries, and application response times.

9. Integrate third-party APIs and external services.

10. Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve application issues.

### 2. Entity Framework & Database

### 3. REST API Development

- Basic knowledge of Docker and containerization.

- Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and deployment processes.

- Knowledge of Redis caching.

- Experience with Hangfire or background job processing.

- Knowledge of SignalR and real-time communication.

- Familiarity with React, Angular, or other frontend frameworks.

- Experience with AWS or Azure cloud services.

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field.

title: Crypto Trading Bot Developer
description:
**Location:** Powai, Mumbai | **Type:** Full-time | **Experience:** 2+ years

**About the Role:** We run a live fleet of automated crypto trading bots across multiple centralized exchanges. You will own and extend this fleet. That means building new bots, adding exchange integrations, and keeping production bots reliable, fast and safe. You will work directly with the team that trades with these systems, so your code ships to production and shows up in P&L.

**What You’ll Do:**

* Build and maintain **volume/market-making bots** and **chart-pattern-based order bots** (e.g. M, V and W patterns with validator logic) for spot markets.
* Integrate new exchanges and maintain existing ones (currently MEXC, Toobit, WEEX, BingX, Poloniex, XT and BloFin). This covers REST and WebSocket APIs, authentication/signing, rate limits and exchange-specific quirks.
* Manage token liquidity: order placement, self-matching/volume logic, spread and depth management, and inventory and risk controls.
* Optimize execution: order latency, retry and failure handling, partial fills, and cancel/replace flows.
* Build risk and monitoring tooling: P&L snapshots, transaction logs, position limits, kill-switches and alerts.
* Extend the web control panel (per-bot start/stop, config, live logs, P&L views) and its per-user authentication.
* Deploy and operate bots in production using Docker Compose, nginx and persistent data/log volumes, and debug live issues.
* Write tests for pattern and execution logic, and document each bot’s behaviour and its operating procedure.

**Required Skills:**

* **2+ years of professional experience** in Python (primary language here). Rust or C++ is a strong plus for latency-critical components.
* **Hands-on crypto trading bot development**: you have shipped bots that traded real funds.
* Solid understanding of **order book mechanics, liquidity, spreads, slippage and market microstructure**.
* Experience with **exchange REST and WebSocket APIs**, including real-time data processing, reconnect/heartbeat handling and rate limiting.
* Knowledge of **algorithmic market-making** concepts (quoting, inventory risk, volume generation).
* Practical grasp of technical analysis and **chart-pattern detection** logic.
* Backend experience with **Flask (or similar), JSON/SQLite persistence and REST API design**.
* Working knowledge of **Docker/Docker Compose, Linux, Git and nginx**.
* Strong discipline around **secrets/API-key handling, input validation and failure-safe design** (a bug here costs real money).

**Nice to Have:**

* Experience with Binance or Bybit (spot and futures) and with lower-tier exchanges’ undocumented behaviour.
* Rust or C++ for performance-critical paths; asyncio or multithreaded Python.
* Front-end basics (vanilla JS/HTML dashboards, data visualization).
* Backtesting or paper-trading frameworks; Pandas/NumPy.
* CI/CD, monitoring (logs, metrics, alerting) and VPS/cloud deployment (TLS, Let’s Encrypt).
* Prior exposure to token-listing, liquidity-provision or market-maker engagements.

title: Software Engineer, Debug Tools
description:
**Description**

  
**Invent the future with us.**

Ampere is a semiconductor design company for a new era, leading the future of computing by developing SoCs and platform solutions focused on high-performance, energy efficient AI compute. As a pioneer in the new frontier of energy efficient high-performance computing, Ampere is part of the Softbank Group of companies driving sustainable AI compute for cloud, edge, and physical applications.

AI is showing up in essentially every part of the technology landscape, and we’re focused on delivering the performance, efficiency, and reliability those workloads require. Ampere is building compute silicon and platforms for AI applications spanning a broad range of industries. We focus on solving exciting challenges in areas such as robotics and automotive, among others, but the core of our work is enabling efficient AI at scale and across multiple application domains.

**About the Role**

As a core member of the Ampere Debug Tools team, you will be responsible for the architecture, design, and development of Debug Tools solutions for the next generation of Ampere products. This role is distinguished by deep technical ownership, architecture leadership, and cross-team influence.  
  
The Debug Tools Team is part of the Ampere Software Team. Our mission is to develop a comprehensive debug strategy and roadmap for internal debug capabilities, as well as to develop and deploy debug solutions for all internal and external Ampere SoC users.

* Internal users include Debug Tools software users from the Virtual Platform, Emulation, Platform, Design Validation (DV), Post-Silicon Validation, Design For Test (DFT), Firmware, Operating System, Software, Performance, and Application Engineering teams.
* External users include partners, ODMs, OEMs, datacenter, edge and embedded customers.
* Debug solutions include Arm Development Studio, TRACE32 PowerView, and OpenOCD debuggers, Arm Self-Hosted Trace for Linux, and utilities for invasive debug, bus trace, instruction trace, array dump, and scan dump. This role will be for the lead of the Arm Development Studio implementation.

**What You’ll Achieve:**

* Architect, design, develop, and deploy software-based Debug Tools for custom 64-bit Armv9 SoC and other processors.
* Invent new debug tools and techniques for future products and technologies.
* Influence the architecture and design team decisions with knowledge of internal and external debug tools on Ampere SoCs.
* Contribute to software architecture and design documents, application notes, and other software product documentation.
* Develop tooling for advanced debugging techniques, such as instruction trace, bus trace, array dump, scan dump, and ATE bootstrapping.
* Develop open source JTAG and self-hosted trace and debugger software for internal and external use in debugging Ampere microprocessors.
* Develop Arm Development Studio, TRACE32, and OpenOCD utilities for internal and external use in debugging Ampere microprocessors.
* Perform pre-silicon bring-up of debug software on software simulators and hardware emulation platforms.
* Collaborate with hardware design, architecture, post-silicon validation, and platform AE teams, as necessary, to resolve critical customer issues.

**About You:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or Software Engineering or related technical field & 5 years of related experience; or MS degree & 3+ years.
* Proficiency with Arm® architecture and ecosystem, including Armv8-a/v9-a and Armv7-m processor architectures, Arm Debug Interface Architecture, Arm CoreSight™ Architecture, Arm AMBA® APB, AXI, AHB, and CHI protocols.
* Proficiency in C/C++, Python, and Bash programming.
* Experience using Arm Development Studio, TRACE32 PowerView, OpenOCD, and GDB debuggers.
* Experience with instruction trace, bus trace, scan dumps, array dumps, and crash capture.
* Experience with version control tools such as git, and software best practices.
* Strong analytical, debugging, and testing methodology skills.
* Proven ability to own problems and drive them to a resolution.
* Experience with system software debugging, tracing, and analysis tools, such as perf, ftrace, etc, is recommended.

**What We’ll Offer:**

  
At Ampere we believe in taking care of our employees and providing a competitive total rewards package that includes base pay, cash long-term incentive, and comprehensive benefits.  
  
Benefits highlights include:

* Premium medical, dental, vision insurance, parental benefits including creche reimbursement, as well as a retirement plan, so that you can feel secure in your health, financial future and child care during work.
* Generous paid time off policy so that you can embrace a healthy work-life balance
* Fully catered lunch in our office along with a variety of healthy snacks, energizing coffee or tea, and refreshing drinks to keep you fueled and focused throughout the day.

  
And there is much more than compensation and benefits. At Ampere, we foster an inclusive culture that empowers our employees to do more and grow more. We are excited to share more about our career opportunities with you through the interview process.

That’s the kind of impact your work can have here. You’ll solve meaningful challenges with AI, simplify complexity and build solutions that help hotels perform. Supported by clear purpose, a strong platform and teams who care about what they’re building, you’ll have the opportunity to shape the future of an industry that never stands still.

**About the Senior Software Engineer role (Salesforce)…**

The Senior Software Engineer is a vital member of the GTM team, expected to remain hands-on while ensuring the team is technically equipped and adhering to established design principles and standards. In this role, you will operate within a continuous release cycle, balancing 60-70% of your time on critical major and minor requirements that add significant value to the business. The remaining 30% of your capacity will be dedicated to managing production incidents and resolving code-related issues as they arise.

The work involves navigating a complex and exciting technical landscape characterized by multiple integration points. With a substantial backlog of projects, your primary focus will be digitizing the entire customer journey and bolstering the integration between Salesforce and other SiteMinder systems. This includes working across the SiteMinder product suite, Marketo, Zuora, and a diverse range of other COTS products and homegrown systems.

**What you’ll do…**

* **Technical Governance & Documentation:** Master the business and system landscape to act as the primary technical gatekeeper, maintaining comprehensive documentation for the data model, integrations, and sharing architecture to ensure long-term platform ownership.
* **End-to-End Agile Delivery:** Lead the independent design, build, and deployment of solutions within an Agile framework, taking full accountability for project throughput, defect remediation, and the successful delivery of assigned projects.
* **Release & Version Control Excellence:** Manage the technical lifecycle of release candidates through meticulous code branching and version control practices, while proactively communicating task and offshore team statuses during planning ceremonies.
* **Platform Maintenance & Leadership:** Oversee BAU production code issues and Salesforce release impacts while evolving as a technical leader by mentoring team members and identifying innovation opportunities that add business value.
* **AI Tooling:** Exposure to a variety of AI tools such as Claude Code and Grokbot to enhance and accelerate development capabilities.

**What you have…**

* **Technical Leadership:** Hands-on Extensive experience in GTM, Sales, Service, and Experience Clouds to act as a hands-on lead and quality gatekeeper for global teams.
* **Modern Development:** Built scalable solutions using Apex, LWC and Aura, utilizing deep expertise in Salesforce data modeling and architectural design.
* **Integration & AI:** Designed complex REST API integrations and deploy advanced features like Agentforce, Data Cloud, and Einstein AI to drive digital innovation.
* **End-to-End Delivery:** Lead the Agile lifecycle—from design workshops and impact analysis to building, testing, and deploying high-value features and fixes.
* **DevOps Excellence:** Managed version control (Git) and automated CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Gearset/SFDX) to ensure stable, high-quality production releases.

· Strong programming skills in **ladder logic**, **structured text**, and **function block programming**.

· Hands-on experience with **HMI programming** and integration.

· Interpersonal skills and patience

Excellent communication skills, presentation skills, Intrapersonal skills, Interpersonal skills

title: Intern
description:

WRI India is seeking a GeoAnalytics Intern who will be an integral member of WRI India’s Ross Centre for Sustainable Cities GeoAnalytics team and will work on a variety of data driven analyses across our core practice areas, leveraging data, information and technical expertise to make informed urban infrastructure choices and design.
  
  
The role involves working with colleagues across cohorts, providing core analytical expertise and customized visualization insights using appropriate spatial modeling tools and methods. By transforming data into actionable insights and solutions, we aim to assist our stakeholders to design solutions that enable sustainable city growth.
