title: UN Women National Consultant – PMU (GRB-MWCD), New Delhi, India
description: Job DescriptionBackground:UN Women, grounded in the vision of equality enshrined in the Charter of the United Nations, works for the elimination of discrimination against women and girls; the empowerment of women; and the achievement of equality between women, men and diverse genders as partners and beneficiaries of development, human rights, humanitarian action and peace and security.All human development and human rights issues involve gender dimensions. UN Women globally focuses on key priority areas that are fundamental to women’s equality, and that can unlock progress across the board. UN Women’s priority areas include increasing women’s leadership and participation in political spaces, ending violence against women, enhancing women’s economic empowerment, engaging in all aspects of women peace and security processes, making gender equality central to national planning and budgeting through Gender Responsive Budgeting (GRB) and advancing gender in intergovernmental processes.UN Women’s work on Gender Responsive Budgeting (GRB) or Gender Budgeting (GB) involves ensuring that national planning, budgeting, monitoring and evaluation processes incorporate a gender perspective. UN Women’s GRB programmes at the regional and country level have made significant contribution towards this by building political support, developing technical resources and capacities, generating good practices for improving women's access to services and increasing accountability for Gender Equality and Women’s empowerment (GEWE). At the forefront of global, regional and local advocacy for application of GRB, UN Women has built partnerships with diverse government, inter-governmental and non-governmental partners to further efforts and demonstrate GRB’s relevance to sustainable development, aid effectiveness, public sector reform and financing for development.UN Women’s India Country Office, based in New Delhi is implementing a project with the objective of strengthening institutional mechanisms for GRB resulting in an increase of gender perspective in budgets, improved availability of data, and tracking of progress on gender equality initiatives across ministries and select states/UTs. It will aim to create a conducive policy environment and enhance institutional capacities on gender budgeting at the national and State/UT level. It will identify strategies and operational approaches to strengthen on-going efforts in the area of GRB. Insights generated from this project will enable key stakeholders at the national and state level to accelerate their efforts to ensure that women’s priorities are adequately reflected in national and state budgeting processes, and to make concrete changes for adequate resource allocation towards women’s priorities.UN Women through this programme will work with national ministries including Ministry of Women and Child Development (MWCD), Ministry of Finance and line ministries to deepen anchoring of GB across union ministries and sectors. It will create and strengthen institutional mechanisms for GRB and institute methodological changes in Planning-Budgeting and Auditing (PBA) systems for enabling gender responsive actions. The project will aim to enhance capacities of government officials and other stakeholders to implement the gender responsive PBA measures, and leverage technology to advance gender budgeting including through and e-governance tool.Within this context, UN Women seeks the services of Consultant – PMU (GRB-MWCD) to be embedded in Ministry of Women and Child Development, Government of India in New Delhi. The Consultant will provide specialised technical and programmatic support to strengthen the implementation and institutionalization of Gender Responsive Budgeting (GRB) across Union Ministries and selected States/UTs.Reporting to the Program Analyst, GRB, UN Women India Country Office, and working closely with the designated nodal officials in MWCD, the Consultant – PMU (GRB-MWCD) will support the Ministry in strengthening coordination mechanisms, monitoring progress on gender budgeting initiatives, and advancing institutional systems for integrating gender perspectives in planning, budgeting, and monitoring processes across government institutions. The consultant will support in monitoring frameworks, evidence generation, capacity building, and policy inputs related to gender budgeting.Roles And ResponsibilitiesUnder the overall guidance and supervision of Coordinator- GRB, and reporting to the Programme Analyst – GRB, the National Consultant – PMU (GRB-MWCD) will support MWCD in strengthening institutional mechanisms and monitoring frameworks for Gender Responsive Budgeting.The National Consultant – PMU (GRB-MWCD) will work closely with the nodal official in MWCD, and have the following deliverables:Strengthening coordination with relevant Ministries on GB-Technical assistance to MWCD on expansion of GB to central ministries/ departments and states/UTsProviding inputs to various Ministries/Departments on gender issues, particularly for new policies, programmes and legislations.Undertaking assessment of Ministries/Departments and States on their progress on GRB and supporting in the development of the Ministry wise and State wise Action Plans on GRB.Administer self-assessment tool on GB and support ministries/ departments to undertake and update tool periodically. Cells to monitor implementation progress.Research, Documentation and Dissemination of relevant GRB ResourcesContributes substantively to the analysis and research of the political, social and economic monitor progress of unutilized receipts and disbursements, utilization certificates, vouchers, etc. related to assignments pertaining to Gender Budgeting Scheme;Assist in preparatory work for review meetings with Secretary and Ministers, including, preparation of resource materials, agenda papers, minutes etc;Support IT specialist in roll out and implementation of e governance tool on gender budgetingFacilitating Training and Capacity Development of various stakeholders on GRBConduct trainings and orientation programmes on Gender Budgeting for (i) Union Government, (ii) State Governments, furthering the aims and objectives of Gender Budgeting and providing technical inputs on Gender Budgeting;Developing Training and IEC Material on GRBDeveloping training tools, manual, and other IEC materials on GRB, as required; Provide technical assistance to MWCD in developing guidelines on deepening gender budgeting at panchayat/ urban ward levels Provide technical assistance to MWCD in Analytical inputs provided on Gender Budget Statements and sectoral allocations, including pre-budget and post-budget gender analysis.Capacity Building of Government Stakeholders.Competencies :Core Values:Integrity;Professionalism;Respect for Diversity.Core Competencies:Awareness and Sensitivity Regarding Gender Issues;Accountability;Creative Problem Solving;Effective Communication;Inclusive Collaboration;Stakeholder Engagement;Leading by Example.Please visit this link for more information on UN Women’s Values and Competencies Framework:Functional Competencies:Consistently approaches work with energy and a positive, constructive attitudeDemonstrates good oral and written communication skillsFocuses on impact and result for the partners and responds positively to feedback.Sound understanding of development issues and genderAdheres to deadlines and follows up on time-bound issuesMaintains diplomacy, tact and strict confidentiality with internal and external partners and clients.EducationMaster’s Degree or equivalent in Social Sciences/Economics/Social Work /Gender Studies/Public Administration/Policy or related fields.ExperienceMinimum of 5 years of relevant experience at the national/state level working with development projects preferably on Gender Responsive Governance, Gender Equality and Women Empowerment; with hands-on experience of design, implementation and monitoring/evaluation of projects.Some experience of working with national/ state governments on gender issues, preferable on gender responsive budgeting. title: Global Operational Innovations Senior Analyst
description:
Who We Are
  
  
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
BCG’s internal functions are the foundation of how our firm operates— representing thousands of professionals and hundreds of millions in investment that enable BCG to deliver exceptional client impact at global scale. As the firm continues to grow and technology changes rapidly, our internal operations face an extraordinary opportunity: to continue to evolve to an even more scalable, technology-enabled, global organization.
  
  
Our
**Operational Innovations (OI)**
team is at the center of this transformation. We are trusted partners to our functions and firm leadership for driving this ambitious change agenda. We enable step-change improvement in the effectiveness and efficiency of the firm by accelerating high-priority initiatives sponsored by the Operations Leadership Team and/or our Operating Committee. From technology & AI deployments to end-to-end process redesign, we partner with functional and geographic leaders to re-architect how the firm operates — faster, smarter, and more connected than ever before.
  
  
We don’t just manage change — we partner with the business to make it happen. Our team helps shape and accelerate BCG’s most strategic initiatives, providing hands-on executional leadership and deep expertise in transformation, digital enablement, and change management. We enable functions to scale effectively, improve performance, and unlock new sources of value through data, automation, and forward-thinking design.
  
  
**Key Activities And Responsibilities Include**

* In partnership with initiative owners and OI Project Managers, provide content support, research, expertise, analyses, or documentation to support project management and accelerate various functional or geographic improvement initiatives. Project emphasis to include operational improvement projects, and often the digital delivery of operational improvements, digital collaboration, and/or digital employee services.
* Support development of deliverables, ensuring highest potential for value delivery. Deliverables could include business improvement plans, process design, effective communication & engagement plans, implementation plans or supporting analyses for any of these. Expectation that analysts can distil key insights from analyses to presentation formats
* Work with line owners and OI team members to identify potential investments and/or process improvements to accelerate BCG’s digital and operational development. Assist in defining end-state processes and organizational models, as well as the path to achieve those end states.
* Work with Program Managers and Change Managers/Leads to support on the ground implementation of Change initiatives including enabling impacted users, embedding behavioral change and doing change impact analysis.
* Work with Program Managers and Change Managers/Leads translate project objectives and change needs into concrete employee communications, engagement actions and campaigns using a range of channels and media.
* Track project success and progress, working with project managers to ensure projects remain on course and objectives are realized on-time and within budget parameters, and that projects deliver against stated objectives and KPIs.
* Support development of senior management reporting and broader communications, as required, in part by providing related analyses and supporting documentation

What You'll Bring
  
  

* University degree or equivalent – ideally in a business related subject
* Experience working in a multi-national or large scale environment
* Data Analysis – strong data analysis skills, able to communicate key insights effectively
* Curiosity and focus on continuous development, learning
* Creativity and openness to new approaches, digital tools, Agile methodologies
* Project and Program Management a plus

Who You'll Work With
  
  

* The OI Leadership Team and OI team members, especially project managers and change managers
* Internal Clients / stakeholders to develop communications to deliver project and stakeholder change objectives
* External Associates – our network of BCG approved contingent resources, when appropriate

Additional info
  
  
**YOU’RE GOOD AT**

* Organizing and managing project details with a bias for getting to great output quickly – You are flexible and organized in your work and can be effective across a range of activities and stakeholders
* Working in a complex environment at pace – You are analytical and comfortable managing multiple deliverables with multiple inputs often with high impact, time sensitive requirements
* Data Analysis – Qualitative and quantitative evaluation of information and data to draw out insights and help shape project plans, business cases, etc.
* Stakeholder Engagement – You can hear what someone needs, translate it into your own words, and create it. You are politically and organizationally savvy and can navigate/influence complex matrix organizations
* Structuring and analyzing information. You can take an idea for organizing or analyzing data and turn it into a useful deliverable. Strong attention to detail
* Culture and collaboration – you care deeply about the experience and engagement of your colleagues and believe in the core tenets of BCG’s purpose statements
* Learning and adapting – you are an eager and consistent learner, are naturally curious, open to feedback and interested in continuous improvement

At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.
  
  
For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.
  
  
We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: Quality Analyst
description:
**Job Description – Quality Analyst**

**Department:**
Quality Assurance (QA)

**Industry:**
Ophthalmic / Eye Care Manufacturing / Contact Lens Care Solutions

**Location:**
Greater Noida

**Reporting To:**
Head – Quality / Management

**Experience:**
2-5 Years (preferably in Ophthalmic or eye care manufacturing)

**Salary:**
Open for discussion as per the experience

**1. Job Purpose**

* We are looking for a detail-oriented and technically competent Quality Analyst to manage and maintain quality documentation, ensure manufacturing and packaging process compliance, and support the implementation of Quality Management Systems (QMS).
* The candidate will be responsible for preparing, reviewing and maintaining Batch Manufacturing Records (BMR), Batch Packaging Records (BPR), and other quality-related documents for contact lens solution manufacturing.
* The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of ISO standards, particularly ISO 13485, and European CE regulatory requirements under the Medical Device Regulation (EU MDR 2017/745).

**2. Key Roles & Responsibilities**

**A. Batch Documentation & Process Control**

● Prepare, review and maintain Batch Manufacturing Records (BMR) and Batch Packaging Records (BPR).

● Ensure all manufacturing and packaging activities are documented accurately and in accordance with approved SOPs.

● Verify batch records for completeness, accuracy, traceability and compliance before batch release.

● Maintain batch-wise documentation of raw materials, packaging materials, in-process checks and finished goods.

● Ensure proper documentation of manufacturing parameters, process controls, yields and reconciliation.

● Review deviations and discrepancies identified during manufacturing and packaging.

● Maintain batch traceability from raw material procurement to finished product dispatch.

**B. Quality Management System (QMS)**

● Implement, monitor and maintain the company's Quality Management System.

● Prepare, review and update SOPs, work instructions, quality manuals, formats and other controlled documents.

● Maintain document control systems, revision history and records.

● Handle Non-Conformance Reports (NCR), CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Actions), deviations and change control.

● Coordinate internal quality audits and support external and certification audits.

● Ensure timely closure of audit observations and implementation of corrective actions.

● Maintain quality records in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements.

**C. ISO & Regulatory Compliance**

● Ensure compliance with ISO 13485 – Medical Devices Quality Management Systems.

● Have working knowledge of ISO 9001 and other applicable quality standards.

**D. Manufacturing & Quality Assurance**

● Monitor quality compliance across manufacturing, filling, packaging and finished product inspection.

● Support validation and qualification activities, including process validation, equipment qualification and cleaning validation, as applicable.

● Monitor environmental conditions and hygiene requirements in manufacturing areas.

● Assist in investigating product complaints, quality failures and manufacturing deviations.

**E. Testing, Validation & Quality Records**

● Coordinate with internal and external laboratories for raw material, in-process and finished product testing.

● Maintain records of analytical testing, stability studies and product quality evaluations.

● Review test reports against approved specifications.

● Maintain calibration and preventive maintenance records for quality-related equipment.

● Support preparation and review of product specifications, testing protocols and validation reports.

**3. Required Qualifications & Experience**

● B.Sc. / M.Sc. in Chemistry, Microbiology, Biotechnology or related scientific discipline.

● B.Pharm / M.Pharm or equivalent qualification will also be considered.

● 2–5 years of experience in Quality Assurance / Quality Control in pharmaceutical, medical device or healthcare manufacturing.

● Prior experience in preparing and reviewing BMR, BPR and quality documentation is essential.

● Practical exposure to ISO 13485 implementation and audit requirements.

● Good understanding of CE certification and EU MDR 2017/745 requirements.

**4. Technical Skills & Competencies**

The candidate must have:

● Strong knowledge of ISO 13485 and Quality Management Systems.

● Working knowledge of EU MDR 2017/745 and CE compliance requirements.

● Experience in preparation, review and maintenance of BMR and BPR.

● Knowledge of SOP preparation, document control and record management.

● Understanding of CAPA, NCR, deviation management and change control.

● Knowledge of risk management and validation documentation.

● Familiarity with manufacturing quality controls and batch traceability.

● Strong analytical, documentation and problem-solving skills.

● Good working knowledge of MS Excel, Word and documentation systems.

**5. Preferred Skills**

● Experience in contact lens solutions, ophthalmic products, medical liquids or sterile/ non-sterile liquid manufacturing.

● Exposure to medical device technical file preparation.

● Knowledge of ISO 14971 risk management.

● Experience in internal and external quality audits.

● Familiarity with microbiological testing, preservative efficacy testing and stability studies.

● Understanding of product labeling and packaging compliance.

● Exposure to supplier qualification and vendor quality management.

**6. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

The candidate will be evaluated on:

1. Accuracy and completeness of BMR and BPR documentation.

2. Timely review and closure of batch documentation.

3. Compliance with ISO 13485 and applicable MDR requirements.

4. Timely preparation, review and updating of SOPs and quality documents.

5. Reduction in documentation errors and non-conformities.

6. Timely closure of CAPA and audit observations.

7. Successful completion of internal and external quality audits.

8. Maintenance of complete batch traceability and quality records.

9. Timely coordination of testing, validation and quality compliance activities.

**7. Ideal Candidate Profile**

* Experience in Ophthalmic or Eye Care Manufacturing will be preferred.
* The ideal candidate should be hands-on and capable of independently managing quality documentation and compliance activities in a manufacturing environment.
* We are looking for someone who understands not just the preparation of quality documents but also the practical implementation of quality systems on the factory floor.
* The candidate should be proactive, detail-oriented, disciplined in documentation and capable of coordinating effectively with Production, Purchase, Stores, Finance and external regulatory consultants.
* **Most importantly, the candidate should have practical knowledge of ISO 13485 and EU MDR requirements, rather than merely theoretical familiarity with these standards.**

title: Analyst-Risk Management
description:
**Job Description**
The Business Resilience team at American Express plays a critical role in strengthening the organization's ability to anticipate, prepare for, respond to, and recover from disruptions while safeguarding our colleagues, customers, and critical business services.
  
  
As part of the Business Resilience organization, the
**Unified Resiliency Capabilities**
function focuses on developing and implementing integrated, scalable, and technology-enabled capabilities that bring together Business Continuity Management, Operational Resilience, crisis preparedness and response, and other interconnected resilience disciplines into a cohesive enterprise framework.
  
  
This role will be instrumental in shaping and delivering the Unified Resiliency Capabilities by partnering closely with Technology and Business stakeholders. The incumbent will support the development, implementation, and continuous enhancement of enterprise resilience capabilities, leveraging platforms such as
**ServiceNow and Archer**
to enable integrated workflows, standardized processes, effective governance, and data-driven decision-making.
  
  
The role requires a combination of business resilience domain knowledge, technology platform familiarity, stakeholder management, and
**Product Owner capabilities**
to translate business needs into actionable technology requirements and deliver solutions aligned with enterprise resilience objectives.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Unified Resiliency Capability Development and Implementation
* Support the design, development, and implementation of enterprise-wide Unified Resiliency Capabilities, bringing together Business Continuity, Operational Resilience, and related resilience processes into an integrated capability framework.
* Define business and functional requirements for scalable, standardized, and interconnected resilience capabilities across
* Product Ownership and Technology Partnership
* Serve as a Product Owner for Unified Resiliency Capabilities, collaborating with Technology and Engineering teams to translate business needs into technology solutions.
* Contribute to product vision, capability roadmaps, feature prioritization, and release planning in alignment with business objectives and stakeholder requirements.
* Develop and manage business requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and product backlogs to support Agile delivery and technology implementation.
* Partner with Engineering teams throughout solution design, development, testing, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), deployment, and post-implementation enhancements.
* Enterprise Resilience Platforms – ServiceNow and Archer
* Leverage familiarity with ServiceNow and Archer to support the development, configuration requirements, integration, and enhancement of enterprise resilience capabilities.
* Collaborate with platform owners and Technology teams to define workflows, data structures, reporting requirements, and integration opportunities across resilience and risk management systems.
* Support the establishment of consistent, reliable resilience data and appropriate systems of record, enabling transparency, traceability, and effective governance.

**Required Skills**

* Working knowledge of Business Resilience Preferred, including Business Continuity Management, Operational Resilience, and interconnected enterprise resilience processes.
* Familiarity with ServiceNow and Archer, including their potential application to enterprise risk, resilience workflows, governance, and reporting.
* Ability to perform Product Owner responsibilities, including requirements gathering, backlog prioritization, user story development, stakeholder coordination, and Agile delivery support.
* Experience partnering with Technology and Engineering teams to deliver business capabilities, process improvements, or enterprise platform enhancements.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, stakeholder management, and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex business needs into clear functional requirements.
* Ability to work across multiple business functions and global teams, manage competing priorities, and support large-scale enterprise transformation initiatives.

**Qualifications**
***Experience and Background:***

* 3+ Years of Product Ownership experience.
* Capabilities/Product Development experience is required..
* Strong understanding of American Express products, services, and organizational structure.
* Strong problem-solving skills; ability to see the big picture with attention given to critical details.
* Demonstrated ability to successfully manage multiple priorities under pressure
* Bachelor’s degree required.
* Strong/Advanced skills in Excel and Powerpoint is expected in this role.
* Excellent relationship, collaboration, and presentation skills with ability to interact and influence leaders across all levels and teams in a matrixed organization.
* Self-confident with a strong sense of integrity and the ability and willingness to challenge and be challenged.
* Ability to communicate key risks to colleagues, business partners, and senior leaders.
* Proven track record of liaising with different stakeholder groups and senior leadership teams.
* Strong Collaboration and effective communication are required skills for this role.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Knowledge of product architecture and technology implementation methodologies.
* Experience working on regulatory / compliance projects or programs.
* Familiarity with Operational Resilience regulatory requirements (e.g., SR 20-24, DORA, UK FCA regulations).
* Experience or Strong understanding of Risk Management.
* Prior experience and/or knowledge of Archer/Service Now or similar product suite.

At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.

Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.

title: Founder's Office
description:
Mynzo Carbon is hiring for our Founder's Office.

This role is for someone who wants to work directly with the founder and run everything at Mynzo except the tech: business development, programs, compliance, growth and operations. It is not a support role. You will own real outcomes and see how a climate-tech company gets built from the inside.

About Mynzo Carbon

Mynzo is a climate-tech company helping governments, project developers and large corporates make Net Zero real with assets, not offsets. We use AI and satellite data to measure carbon, track biodiversity and monitor green cover down to the individual tree.

What a week could look like

Preparing a client proposal, tracking a plantation project across three states, closing out an audit requirement and putting together an investor update. If you like variety, ownership and moving fast without a playbook, you will enjoy it here.

Responsibilities

Business development

• Research and qualify prospects across large corporates, government bodies and project developers

• Draft proposals, pitch decks and commercial offers, and join client meetings with the founder

• Follow up on leads and keep the pipeline moving to closure

Program and project management

• Run client projects day to day: timelines, field partners, deliverables and reporting

• Coordinate between the tech team, on-ground partners and clients so nothing slips

• Set up simple trackers and review rhythms that keep everyone aligned

Compliance and governance

• Manage statutory, legal and secretarial compliance with our CA, CS and legal advisors

• Support third-party audits, certifications and client vendor onboarding

• Keep contracts, agreements and company records organised and up to date

Growth and strategy

• Work on fundraising material, investor updates and data room upkeep

• Prepare applications for accelerators, grants, awards and industry events

• Track the market, competitors and climate regulations (BRSR, TNFD, SBTi and others) and turn them into clear recommendations

Operations
  
• Handle hiring coordination, vendor management, finance follow-ups and internal processes
  
• Pick up whatever the founder needs closed this week, and close it
  
Qualifications
  
Must have
  
• Graduate from a Tier 1 or Tier 2 college, in commerce or science
  
• 2 to 4 years of work experience
  
• Clear, crisp writing and comfort presenting to senior stakeholders
  
• Strong with Excel or Sheets, slides and documents
  
Good to have
  
• Prior experience in a Founder's Office, investment banking or program management role
  
• Exposure to a startup or a fast-moving team
  
• Interest in climate, sustainability or ESG
  
How you work
  
• You take ownership and don't wait to be told twice
  
• You're comfortable with ambiguity and can switch between five different things in a day
  
• You're structured, follow through on details and keep people informed
  
• You'd rather learn by doing than wait for a perfect process

Job title: Knowledge Management Coordinator

The KM Coordinator plays a key role in supporting Global Financial Services in L.E.K to deliver outstanding results for our clients. Knowledge Management (KM) is critical to capture the best of our consulting staff’s individual and collective expertise and to make it available to the broader firm. Working in close collaboration with the KM Specialist for the Global Financial Services, the KM Coordinator is responsible for transforming final case deliverables into valuable intellectual property (IP). In addition, the KM Coordinator conducts targeted IP searches to support ongoing casework, business development, and client development (CD) efforts. By proactively identifying and disseminating relevant insights, the coordinator helps ensure that teams have timely access to the most pertinent and impactful knowledge. * Collaborate with KM Specialist to address IP-related search requirements on the enterprise knowledge management system, supporting Global Financial Services case teams in case delivery and client development.

* Actively support KM Director (APAC and GFS) and KM Specialist in building productized offerings, solution specific playbooks and innovative analysis models for Global Financial Services

* Engage in strategic KM discussions through APAC and Global KM forums, contributing to advancements in knowledge management practices, including AI-driven initiatives and testing efforts.
* Actively leverage approved AI tools and KM technologies to improve IP creation, content discovery, tagging, summarization, and knowledge asset development, ensuring AI is used responsibly to build scalable innovations and strengthen Global Financial Services knowledge products.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree required with strong academic credentials
* 1-3 years of experience, ideally in the professional services environment.

* Strong foundation in data preparation, transformation, visualization with expertise in Excel. Alteryx or Tableau is preferred

title: Senior Associate - Content Writer
description:
About the Role

We're looking for a skilled and detail-oriented Content Writer who can create compelling, well- researched and engaging content for Unicommerce.

This is an execution-focused role for someone who enjoys writing, understands B2B technology and can translate complex product capabilities, industry trends and customer challenges into clear, impactful content.

You will work closely with the content marketing team to develop content across formats and stages of the buyer journey, ensuring consistent quality, accuracy and timely delivery.

**What You'll Do**

● Write high-quality blogs, articles, website pages, landing pages, product pages and solution-focused content.

● Create long-form content such as ebooks, guides, whitepapers, playbooks and industry reports.

● Translate complex product features and technical concepts into simple, benefit-driven narratives.

● Adapt content for different audiences, personas, platforms and stages of the buyer journey.

**Research & Content Development**

● Conduct in-depth research on assigned topics, industry developments, customer challenges and competitor content.

● Ensure content is factually accurate, relevant and aligned with brand messaging.

● Write SEO-friendly content based on keyword research, search intent and content briefs.

● Apply on-page SEO best practices, including keyword placement, headings, metadata and internal linking.

● Understand emerging AEO and GEO practices and incorporate relevant optimisation techniques.

● Update and optimize existing content based on editorial feedback, SEO recommendations and performance insights.

**Editing & Content Quality**

● Review and edit content for clarity, readability, grammar, tone and consistency.

● Ensure all content meets editorial guidelines and brand communication standards.

● Incorporate feedback from internal stakeholders and manage multiple rounds of revisions.

● Maintain high standards of quality while meeting content deadlines.

**AI-Assisted Content Production**

● Use AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini to support research, ideation, outlining and content production.

● Leverage AI to improve writing efficiency without compromising originality, accuracy or editorial quality.

● Stay updated with emerging content formats, tools and writing practices.

**What We're Looking For**

● 4–5 years of experience in content writing, preferably in B2B SaaS, technology or enterprise-focused organisations.

● Excellent writing, editing, storytelling and research skills.

● Experience creating long-form and short-form content across multiple marketing formats.

● Ability to simplify complex technology, software products and business concepts.

● Working knowledge of SEO, keyword research, search intent and on-page optimisation.

● Familiarity with AEO, GEO and AI-powered search experiences.

● Strong attention to detail, grammar, structure and content accuracy.

● Ability to work with content briefs, incorporate feedback and manage multiple assignments simultaneously.

● Comfortable collaborating with different teams and subject matter experts.

● Hands-on experience with AI writing and productivity tools.

**Good to Have**

● Experience writing for e-commerce, retail technology, supply chain, logistics, CRM or MarTech.

● Basic understanding of Google Analytics and Google Search Console.

**Success Metrics**

● Quality, originality and accuracy of content delivered.

● Timely execution of assigned content deliverables.

● Ability to manage multiple content assignments and meet deadlines.

● Adherence to editorial guidelines and brand messaging.

● SEO optimisation and search-readiness of published content.

● Ability to incorporate feedback and improve content quality.

● Consistency and efficiency in content production.

title: Senior Associate, Change Management - Global Capability Center
description:

* Excellent written and oral communications and presentation skills, including explaining technical concepts to non-technical audiences, with a portfolio of clear, engaging content for professional audiences
* Excellent project management skills, including managing multiple workstreams, timelines, and deliverables with attention to detail and follow-through
* Creativity in designing and executing change communications and enablement content
* Hands-on experience with email marketing tools, from building and sending campaigns to measuring results.

* AI proficiency: daily hands-on use of at least two enterprise LLM platforms (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot), including building effective prompts and repeatable workflows, supported by AI certifications such as Claude 101 and other recognized credentials
* Experience creating user guides, training materials, and demos for technology products
* Experience with Microsoft 365, Teams, and polished PowerPoint materials
* Analytical skills to measure engagement and adoption and turn results and feedback into recommendations
* Ability to manage several workstreams at once, work with colleagues across time zones, and handle confidential information with care.

**Your journey at A&M**
We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top-notch training and on-the-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career. We prioritize your well-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A&M. title: Regulatory Affairs Specialist
description:
Senior Manager – Quality Assurance & Regulatory Affairs

**Location:**
South Delhi, India (Full-time, office-based)

About Consure Medical

Consure Medical is a rapidly growing medical device company focused on developing innovative solutions to address critical healthcare needs. We go beyond developing medical devices - we are advancing technologies that improve patient care and clinical outcomes.

Driven by innovation and a deep commitment to patient well-being, our vision is to become a global leader in the medical device industry.

We foster a dynamic, collaborative, and entrepreneurial environment where talented professionals work together to develop cutting-edge solutions to complex healthcare challenges. We believe in challenging conventional approaches, embracing innovation, and empowering our people to make a meaningful impact on global healthcare.

The Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced and results-driven
**Senior Manager - Quality Assurance & Regulatory Affairs**
to lead our global quality and regulatory functions.

This is a key position with end-to-end ownership of the company's Quality Management System (QMS), regulatory compliance, and global regulatory strategy. The successful candidate will play a critical role in ensuring that our medical devices meet applicable international regulatory requirements while supporting product development, commercialization, and business growth.

We are looking for an individual with a strong ownership mindset, the ability to operate independently, and the experience to build, strengthen, and scale quality and regulatory functions within a growing medical device organization.

Key Responsibilities

1. **Global Regulatory Strategy:**
   Develop and execute regulatory strategies for new and existing medical devices, ensuring compliance with FDA, EU MDR, and other applicable international regulatory requirements.
2. **Quality Management System (QMS):**
   Lead the development, implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the QMS in accordance with ISO 13485, FDA 21 CFR Part 820, and other applicable standards.
3. **Regulatory Submissions & Approvals:**
   Oversee the preparation, review, and submission of regulatory applications, including FDA 510(k), PMA, IDE, CE marking, and other international product registrations, as applicable.
4. **Risk Management:**
   Establish and oversee risk management processes throughout the product lifecycle, ensuring product safety, performance, and compliance with applicable standards.
5. **Audits & Inspections:**
   Plan, coordinate, and lead internal and external audits, including FDA inspections, notified body audits, and ISO certification audits. Ensure timely resolution of audit findings and implementation of corrective and preventive actions.
6. **Post-Market Surveillance:**
   Establish and oversee post-market surveillance, vigilance, complaint handling, and adverse event reporting processes to monitor product performance and address potential safety concerns.
7. **Design & Development Controls:**
   Ensure appropriate quality and regulatory oversight of product development activities, including Design History Files (DHF), Risk Management Files (RMF), and Device Master Records (DMR).
8. **Team Leadership:**
   Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing QA/RA team across global locations, fostering accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
9. **Cross-Functional Collaboration:**
   Work closely with R&D, manufacturing, operations, and commercial teams to integrate quality and regulatory requirements into business and product development processes.
10. **Regulatory Intelligence:**
    Monitor changes in global regulatory requirements, standards, and industry practices and proactively assess their impact on the company's products and operations.

title: Computational Grammarian (English Syntax)
description:
About Moleculyst

Moleculyst Ventures Private Limited is a deep-tech startup building a reasoning checker for natural language. We break text into small reasoning steps and check each step deterministically against source documents such as contracts and laws. Only genuinely ambiguous cases go to human reviewers. Our goal is to make AI reasoning reliable enough for high-stakes use.

The role

We are turning English grammar into explicit, checkable rules. Our main reference is The Cambridge Grammar of the English Language (Huddleston & Pullum), a large and careful book. In this role you will work through it slowly and thoroughly, understand each analysis properly, and turn it into precise rules our system can use.

You don't need to know the book already. We need someone who can read dense material patiently, question every claim, and stay with a hard idea until it is fully clear.

What you'll do

• Study the grammar chapter by chapter and write each analysis as clear, explicit rules

• Compare these rules with existing computational grammars and note where they differ

• Find ambiguities in real text, such as contracts and legal language, and work out how each should be resolved

• Work with our engineers and semantics team so the rules fit into the larger system

• Keep careful, readable documentation of what you learn and decide

Who we're looking for

• Someone who enjoys reading difficult material slowly and carefully

• A precise thinker who notices small inconsistencies and won't settle for a vague understanding

• Strong written English and the ability to explain things clearly

• A background in linguistics, English, philosophy, mathematics, computer science or a related field (any discipline that trained you to think rigorously)

Good to have

• Some exposure to syntax, formal semantics or logic

• Familiarity with computational linguistics or any programming

title: Senior Data Quality
description:

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Data Quality SME / Solution Architect to lead Data Quality strategy, requirements translation, solution design, and delivery for enterprise client engagements.

The ideal candidate will work directly with client stakeholders/client proxies, understand complex business and data requirements, translate them into actionable Data Quality rules, and guide a small team of Data Quality Engineers to deliver the solution.

Experience with the specific Data Quality platform is not mandatory. Platform training, onboarding and certification will be provided. We are primarily looking for strong expertise in SQL, Data Quality/Data Testing, data modelling, enterprise data environments, troubleshooting, and client-facing solution design.

Key Responsibilities

Lead Data Quality requirements gathering with client stakeholders and translate business requirements into concrete rule designs.

Define and own the overall Data Quality and testing strategy across different data pipeline layers.

Design appropriate rules covering validation, duplicate detection, reconciliation, checksum, pushdown and script-based testing.

Determine the appropriate pipeline layer for each rule and avoid redundant or overlapping checks.

Define rule parameters including thresholds, severity, exception handling and routing.

Work closely with client engineering, data and business teams to understand data flows and quality requirements.

Present, explain and defend Data Quality logic and results to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Act as the escalation point for complex Data Quality issues, job failures and platform-related problems.

Analyse logs, stack traces and query performance issues to identify root causes.

Guide engineering teams on resolution and provide clear technical escalations where required.

Lead and mentor a small team of Data Quality Engineers and ensure timely delivery against client timelines.

Identify scope creep, delivery risks and unrealistic sequencing and proactively communicate them to stakeholders.

Support platform architecture and configuration, including users, roles, workspaces, connections, notifications and related administration.

Ensure appropriate separation between active Data Quality testing, data cataloguing and upstream data governance.

Maintain high standards of documentation, rule inventories, exception handling and delivery processes.

Required Technical Skills

SQL – Must Have

Strong/advanced SQL skills with experience in enterprise databases.

Complex joins, CTEs and window functions.

Query optimisation and performance tuning.

Experience working with large-scale datasets.

Snowflake

Oracle

SQL Server

Databricks / Databricks SQL

PostgreSQL

Teradata

Other enterprise-scale SQL environments

Data Quality & Data Testing

Strong practical understanding of:

Data validation

Duplicate detection

Data reconciliation

Checksum/control-total validation

Cross-system validation

Exception handling

Threshold-based quality checks

Data Quality strategy and rule design

Data Modelling

Strong understanding of relational data models.

Star and snowflake schemas.

Normalised and denormalised data structures.

Primary and foreign key relationships.

Referential integrity.

Orphan-record detection.

Cross-system key reconciliation.

Enterprise Data

Experience working with large and complex enterprise data environments such as:

Data warehouses

Data lakes

Multi-layer data pipelines

Partitioned and incremental data

Slowly Changing Dimensions

Multi-source enterprise datasets

Experience with technologies such as SAP, Snowflake, Databricks, Microsoft Fabric/OneLake, Oracle, SQL Server or similar is an advantage.

Programming / Scripting

Python or Groovy scripting experience.

Ability to create or modify scripts used for Data Quality rules and workflow utilities.

Understanding of parameterisation, conditional workflows and automation is preferred.

Client & Leadership Skills

Strong client-facing communication and stakeholder management.

Ability to convert ambiguous business requirements into clear technical solutions.

Comfortable presenting Data Quality findings and explaining technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

Ability to lead and mentor a small team of Data Quality Engineers.

Strong ownership, reliability and problem-solving mindset.

Ability to identify delivery risks and manage priorities in a client environment.

Platform Experience

Experience with a commercial Data Quality/Data Testing platform is preferred but not mandatory.

Candidates with strong SQL + Data Quality/Data Testing + enterprise data experience will be considered even if they have not worked on the specific platform.

Platform training, onboarding and certification will be provided.

Preferred Candidate Background

We are open to candidates from backgrounds such as:

Data Quality

Data Testing / ETL Testing

Data Governance

Data Engineering with strong hands-on Data Quality experience

Data Architecture with strong Data Quality exposure

Technology / Data Consulting

Industry and specific platform experience are flexible for candidates with strong relevant technical and client-facing experience.

Experience & Education

8–10 years of overall experience preferred.

Candidates with strong relevant experience can be considered irrespective of exact years.

Any graduate degree with strong relevant technical experience is acceptable.

B.Tech/B.E./M.Tech/MCA or equivalent technical backgrounds preferred.

* Recommend and adopt appropriate testing tools and technologies to improve quality engineering effectiveness.
* Drive adoption of established QA practices and foster a quality-first culture within the VMS team.

What You'll Bring
  
  
**Required Experience**

* 8+ years of experience in Software Quality Assurance / Quality Engineering, with expertise in both manual and automation testing.
* Experience leading or technically guiding QA/Quality Engineering teams and mentoring engineers.
* Strong hands-on experience developing and maintaining automated test suites and frameworks.
* Experience testing SaaS-based enterprise products, preferably multi-tenant and cloud-native applications.
* Experience testing workflow-driven enterprise platforms such as Vendor Management, Procurement, Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM), HR, or similar business applications.
* Experience across functional, integration, regression, API, UI, end-to-end, and data validation testing.
* Experience working with APIs, databases, backend services, and enterprise system integrations.
* Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments with globally distributed, cross-functional teams.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience testing SaaS-based Vendor Management or Procurement platforms such as SAP Fieldglass, Coupa, or similar enterprise workflow applications.
* Experience with performance and load testing.
* Exposure to AI-enabled testing tools or applications of AI within Quality Engineering.

**Key Skills**

* Strong understanding of QA methodologies, SDLC, STLC, Agile testing practices, and Quality Engineering principles.

* Experience with API testing using Postman; knowledge of REST Assured or similar frameworks is an advantage.
* Experience with test and defect management tools such as JIRA, Zephyr, and QMetry.
* Experience with Git and CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or equivalent technologies.
* Strong understanding of enterprise SaaS applications, APIs, integrations, databases, and workflow-driven systems.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving capabilities.

Who You'll Work With
  
  
You’ll work with a globally distributed, cross-functional team of
**product owners, business analysts, software engineers, DevOps engineers, architects, quality engineers, and business stakeholders**
in a fast-paced Agile environment.
  
  
  
  
As a hands-on technical quality leader, you will mentor quality engineers and partner with product and engineering teams to ensure quality is embedded throughout the development lifecycle
  
  
Additional info
  
  
**You’re Good At**
  
  
**Technical Leadership**

* Providing clear technical direction while remaining hands-on when needed.

**Problem Solving & Decision Making**

title: Software Engineer (2-5 years) (only from Premier Institute
description:
**Full stack engineer, platform experiences**

MRI Software is building the operating system for real estate, and we are hiring exceptional full stack engineers in India to build how the world experiences it. If you want your work to shape how an entire industry runs, and you want real ownership early in your career, this is the role.

**Role :** Full Stack Engineer (multiple openings; Engineer to Senior Engineer levels, 1 to 5 years)

**The opportunity**

Real estate runs on some of the most valuable and least modernized software in the world. MRI is rebuilding its foundations as a unified platform of services, data and AI. Your job is to build the layer people actually touch: the applications, workflows and AI-native interfaces built on top of it.

You will not be handed a ticket queue. You will be handed a real problem, a strong team around you, and the room to decide how it gets built. The platform services are being built so that you can move fast on top of them, and the best engineers will grow into technical leaders quickly.

**What you will do**

* Design, build and ship customer-facing web applications and workflows, from architecture to production.
* Own the quality of what you ship: front end, APIs, data access, performance, security, accessibility and reliability.
* Build AI-native experiences: conversational interfaces, agent-driven workflows and copilots that act on real customer data.
* Help set engineering standards: design system, code review, testing, CI/CD and observability.
* Contribute to architecture decisions, and write down the trade-offs so others can build on them.
* Learn from senior engineers, mentor those who join after you, and take on technical leadership as you grow.
* Work directly with product, design and domain experts, so the thing you ship is the thing customers need.
* Prototype fast, then harden: turn a promising idea into a product that runs at global scale.

**What you bring**

**Required**

* Bachelor's, Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics or a related field.
* 0 to 5 years of experience building software. Experience is not the bar: we welcome freshers with exceptional academics and a portfolio to show for it.
* Solid full stack fundamentals: modern TypeScript and React (or equivalent) on the front end, and at least one strong back-end language and framework (Node, Python, Java or .NET).
* Strong computer science foundations: data structures, algorithms, databases, networking and operating systems.
* Good instincts for API and system design, and a habit of testing and measuring your work.
* Evidence of building real things: shipped products, internships, open-source work, hackathon or competition results, or substantial personal projects (a GitHub or portfolio link is expected).
* Clear communication and sound judgment, including the ability to explain a trade-off to a non-engineer.

**Strong plus**

* Hands-on experience integrating LLMs: retrieval, tool use, agents, evaluation and guardrails.
* Cloud-native experience (Azure or AWS), containers and CI/CD.
* Experience with enterprise SaaS, identity and security, or regulated data.
* Design-system or micro-frontend experience.
* Domain interest in real estate, finance or proptech.

**What great looks like**

You care about the pixel and the query plan. You would rather delete code than defend it. You learn faster than the job description expects, and you want to build something that lasts.

**Why join**

* Real ownership: take on meaningful product areas early, not a corner of someone else's roadmap.
* A greenfield foundation: build on a modern platform and AI stack instead of working around legacy.
* Global scale: your work reaches customers across the world's real estate portfolios.
* Access to leadership: work close to the architecture and innovation team and see your decisions land.
* A senior peer group: strong engineers, data scientists and product leaders who expect your best thinking, and who will help you grow.

**Benefits:**

* Ability to learn leading technical / industry standards and technologies
* Annual performance-related bonus
* 6x Flexi Time offs: knock 2.5 hours off your day on any day
* + Engaging, fun & inclusive culture: check out the MRI Software APAC Insta feed and stories!

**About Us**

From the day we opened our doors, MRI Software has built flexible, game-changing real estate software that powers thriving communities and helps make the world a better place to live, work and play. Fulfilling that mission is only possible because of one thing: exceptional people. People like you!

Our people-first approach to PropTech is defining a new industry standard for client experiences that, quite frankly, can’t be duplicated. Experiences that deliver real value every day. And we know those experiences begin with our people.

We believe MRI is more than just a workplace; it’s a connected community of people who truly feel they belong. Whether we’re investing in employee resource groups or providing tailored resources for each person to reach their full potential, we’re passionate about creating a work environment that makes you excited to show up every single day.

At MRI, one of our core values is to *strive to amaze.* From the intelligent solutions we create to the culture we cultivate, that’s our goal every day. Because that’s what industry leaders do. Whether you’re joining as a new Pride member or rejoining us after a short time away, your talent is vital to us, our partners and our clients.

**Amazing growth requires amazing employees. Are you up to the challenge?**

We know confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting remarkable candidates, so please don’t hesitate to apply. We’d love to hear from you!

*MRI is proud to be an inclusive employer. We welcome and celebrate diversity across all backgrounds, including ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, age, military, veteran status and more.*

*We believe that Belonging is a direct result of Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion. Those values are woven into the fabric of who we are and are foundational to our continued success. Come and see for yourself!*

title: Software Engineer II
description:
**About Parexel**
Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.
  
  
We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose, moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry leading innovation, With Heart.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a
**Software Engineer II (Software Test Engineer)**
with a focus on life sciences technology to join our team. As a Software Engineer II, you will apply hands-on software testing expertise to help deliver reliable applications that advance clinical research and new treatments for patients. This position plays a key role in software quality and reliability for the applications that support clinical research.
  
  
You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams, follow industry-standard processes, and contribute to testing activities from requirement walkthroughs through test reporting. Responsibilities include designing and executing functional, regression, and integration testing, tracking defects to resolution, and partnering with Product Owners and Developers, with opportunities to deepen your expertise and influence product quality.
  
  
You'll join a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment focused on making a meaningful impact through rigorous test design, clear defect management, and close collaboration with Product Owners and Developers. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, the Software Engineer II can explore career paths and expand skills across clinical research technology.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and develop test scenarios, test cases and scripts, and test data that reflect application requirements and functionality.
* Execute functional, regression, and integration testing in line with defined procedures to verify application quality.
* Analyze application requirements and functionality to shape effective test coverage.
* Identify, document, track, and support the resolution of defects, helping teams deliver stable, high-quality software.
* Prepare and maintain test documentation, including test execution evidence and test summary reports.
* Participate in requirement walkthroughs and discussions with Product Owners and Developers.
* Collaborate with Product Owners, Developers, and other stakeholders to clarify requirements and resolve testing-related questions.

**You'll thrive in this role if you bring**

* Strengths in problem-solving, analytical thinking, and managing multiple priorities.
* An interest in life sciences and clinical research, with an appreciation for the quality standards of regulated environments.
* The ability to collaborate across teams and communicate clearly.
* A patient-focused mindset and strong attention to detail.
* Comfort working with Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint, defect and test management tools, and AI-assisted tools.

**Required Qualifications**

* 2 to 6 years of experience in software testing or quality assurance.
* Familiarity with the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC).
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Experience with defect management and test management tools.
* Basic knowledge of Java, SQL, and JavaScript.
* Basic understanding of artificial intelligence (AI) and generative AI technologies and their application in software testing and quality assurance activities.
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, communication, and organization skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and manage multiple priorities.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Life sciences domain knowledge.
* Knowledge or hands-on experience with Oracle Argus, ArisG (LifeSphere), or Veeva.
* Knowledge of Good Practice (GxP), computer system validation and computer software assurance (CSV/CSA), Good Automated Manufacturing Practice 5 (GAMP 5), and Title 21 Code of Federal Regulations Part 11 (21 CFR Part 11).
* Experience using AI-assisted tools for test case design, test documentation, defect analysis, and productivity improvement.

We believe in flexibility, growth, and creating space for people to do their best work. Join us and be part of a team where your contributions help shape the future of clinical research.
  
  
If this job doesn't sound like the next step in your career, but perhaps you know of someone who'd be a perfect fit, send them the link to apply!

title: Software Engineer (Secrets Manager )
description:
**About Bitwarden**
Bitwarden is the trusted identity security leader for millions of users worldwide, empowering enterprises, developers, and individuals to securely manage and share sensitive information anywhere. Bitwarden makes it easy for all users to extend robust security across their devices with password management, secrets management, and passwordless and passkey innovations. The company is headquartered in Santa Barbara, California with team members located across the globe. Learn more at bitwarden.com.
  
  
**THE ROLE**
As a Software Engineer on Bitwarden's Secrets Manager team, you will contribute to the design and development of the Secrets Manager application stack that lets developers, DevOps, and cybersecurity teams alike centrally store, manage, and deploy sensitive credentials. You'll build upon the core concepts of secrets, projects, machine accounts, and access tokens across the product suite.
  
  
This role is for an engineer early in their career who wants to develop deep expertise across a breadth of languages/frameworks. You will start with well-scoped work and grow into larger, more independent ownership, with senior engineers alongside you on design, review, and the parts of the system that take time to learn.
  
  
**WHAT YOU WILL DO**

* Feature Delivery: Build well-scoped parts of features across the API, the web client, and the SDK. Take on larger and more independent pieces as you grow into the codebase.
* Learning the Security Model: Work inside a zero-knowledge architecture and learn why it is built the way it is. Where a secret gets encrypted, what the server is allowed to see, and how a machine account proves who it is. Asking questions here is the job, not an interruption to it.
* Automated Quality: Write tests alongside your code, and help maintain the automated suites and CI/CD pipelines that keep the team shipping safely.
* Code Review: Take part in pull request review. Act on the feedback you receive, and read your teammates' changes as one of the fastest ways to learn a large codebase.
* Operational Support: Help keep services healthy in production.
* Collaboration: Work closely with Product, Design, and your fellow engineers to understand what you are building and why, and raise questions and risks early.
* Documentation: Keep internal architecture notes, API contracts, and public open source developer documentation accurate as you work on the code they describe.
* AI-Assisted Development: Use AI coding assistants effectively, and understand every line you ship. Generated code gets reviewed as carefully as your own.

**WHAT YOU BRING TO BITWARDEN**

* Overall Experience: 3+ years as a Software Engineer paired with AI assisted development practices
* Technical Stack - Experience

+ You should be genuinely capable enough to work independently on a well-scoped task:

- C# and .NET
- TypeScript and Angular
- Rust

* Technical Stack - Familiarity

+ Relational databases and SQL, and ideally an ORM such as Entity Framework Core
+ HTTP and REST API design
+ Git, code review workflows, and CI/CD
+ Automated testing across unit and integration layers

* Technical Stack - Exposure

+ You will pick these up here. Prior exposure is welcome, not required:

- Languages such as Go, Rust and Python
- Tooling such as Terraform, Ansible, and GitHub Actions
- Containerized environments such as Kubernetes
- Writing, consuming, and using SDKs / APIs
- Languages such as C++, Java, PHP
- WASM instruction format

* Growth Mindset: You seek out feedback and act on it, you say when you are stuck rather than quietly staying stuck, and you are honest about what you do not know yet.
* Collaborative Spirit: A highly collaborative and adaptable mindset, excited to work in rapid, outcome-driven feedback loops with a globally distributed team.
* Open Source Passion: Excitement and enthusiasm for open source, developer advocacy, and building a more secure internet.
* Problem-Solving: Strong problem-solving skills, valuing written, clear documentation and using data to make technical decisions.

**WHY JOIN US**

* Our user community loves us and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone from our friends and family to the world’s largest organizations.
* Become an expert. You’ll get immersed in the prominent technology markets of security and open source software.
* We are dedicated to building a diverse and talented team. Work remotely with motivated and supportive team members across the world.
* Learn and grow. Take on new challenges with the support of your team, and join our #growth-club to continue personal and professional development.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone can do their best work. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and make employment decisions based on skills, experience, qualifications, and business needs.
  
  
**If you enjoy being hands-on, solving hard engineering problems, and having a genuine influence on how products are built, we'd love to hear from you.**

title: Full Stack Developer
description: Company: EVOCSLocation: Mumbai/ Noida, HybridExperience:3–4 yearsEmployment Type: Full-timeAbout The RoleVelloe – an EVOCS Company is looking for a Junior Full Stack Developer to join our engineering team and work across our headless, multi-platform product architecture. Our stack pairs a Drupal 10 headless CMS with a Next.js 14 web portal and React Native mobile apps for iOS and Android, all sharing synchronized state, unified data contracts, and end-to-end AES-256-CBC payload encryption. You'll work across mobile, web, and backend layers, contributing to features that span our entire platform rather than sitting in a single silo.This role suits someone with 3–4 years of hands-on development experience who is comfortable moving between a React Native codebase, a Next.js frontend, and a PHP/Drupal backend, and who wants to keep building breadth across a modern, security-conscious stack.What You'll Work WithOur architecture is headless and decoupled: Drupal 10 serves content and business logic through REST and GraphQL APIs, consumed by a Next.js 14 web portal and React Native 0.78 mobile apps. All three layers share unified data contracts and encrypt API payloads end-to-end with AES-256-CBC.Key Responsibilities Build and maintain features across our React Native (iOS & Android), Next.js web, and Drupal backend codebases, depending on sprint needs. Implement UI screens and components using React Native Paper, Reanimated, and React Navigation on mobile, and React with Tailwind CSS on web. Integrate with REST and GraphQL APIs exposed by our Drupal 10 backend, including handling CSRF token injection, authenticated requests, and AES-256-CBC encrypted payloads. Manage application state using Redux Toolkit and RTK Query, including offline persistence via redux-persist and AsyncStorage on mobile. Build and validate forms using React Hook Form and Yup on the web portal. Implement and troubleshoot push notifications, deep linking, and local/remote notification handling using Firebase Cloud Messaging and Notifee. Contribute to backend features in Drupal 10 (PHP 8.2), including custom REST endpoints, GraphQL schema/resolvers, and content model changes. Work with MySQL 8.0 for data modeling, queries, and performance tuning as needed. Integrate third-party services such as Razorpay (payments), FingerprintJS (device fraud prevention), Google Analytics 4, Firebase Crashlytics, and Vimeo/YouTube video embeds. Support release processes: generate Android `.aab`/`.apk` builds via Gradle and iOS `.ipa` builds via Xcode Archive, and assist with manual submissions to Google Play Console and TestFlight/App Store. Write clean, typed code in TypeScript across mobile and web, following our ESLint/Prettier standards and Conventional Commits via Husky and Commitizen. Participate in code reviews, sprint planning, and cross-functional discussions with design, QA, and product. Debug and resolve issues across the stack, using tools like Firebase Crashlytics and network/API debugging to trace problems from client to backend.Required Skills & Experience 3–4 years of professional software development experience, with demonstrated work across both frontend and backend, or frontend and mobile. Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, with practical experience writing typed, interface-driven code. Hands-on experience with React (web) and ideally React Native for mobile app development. Working knowledge of Redux or Redux Toolkit for state management, including async data fetching patterns (RTK Query or similar). Experience consuming REST APIs; exposure to GraphQL is a plus. Familiarity with a server-side language such as PHP, and comfort working with a CMS or backend framework (Drupal experience is a strong plus, but not required if you're comfortable picking it up). Basic to intermediate SQL and relational database experience (MySQL, PostgreSQL, or similar). Understanding of Git workflows, including feature branching, pull requests, and code review practices. Familiarity with authentication/security concepts such as token-based auth, CSRF protection, or payload encryption (AES-256 or similar) is a plus. Ability to work across the mobile, web, and backend layers of a project, and willingness to learn unfamiliar parts of the stack. Good communication skills and comfort collaborating in a cross-functional agile team. Nice to Have Experience with Next.js (App Router) and Tailwind CSS. Experience with Drupal or another headless/decoupled CMS. Exposure to Firebase services (FCM, Analytics, Crashlytics). Experience integrating payment gateways such as Razorpay, Stripe, or similar. Familiarity with mobile release processes (Gradle builds, Xcode Archive, Play Console/App Store submissions). Experience with mapping libraries (Leaflet, Google Maps) or media/video integrations (React Player, PDF.js, Vimeo/YouTube APIs). Exposure to AWS S3 or other cloud object storage for media/asset handling. Tools & Practices You'll Use Bitbucket for version control, Husky pre-commit hooks with Commitizen for Conventional Commits, ESLint and Prettier for code quality, and Composer for backend dependency management.Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Portfolio or prior project experience demonstrating full-stack or cross-platform development work.
