title: AI Full-Stack Engineer
description:
**About R Systems**
R Systems is a global digital product engineering company that helps enterprises design, build, and run AI-native, data-driven, and cloud-native products and platforms. Our AI, Data & Intelligent Engineering teams partner with U.S. enterprise clients to move AI beyond isolated pilots toward governed, production-grade "Enterprise Digital Brains" — unified platforms that combine modern data engineering, semantic ontologies, knowledge graphs, and multi-agent orchestration to deliver measurable business outcomes.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
As an AI, Data & Full-Stack Engineering Intern at R Systems, you will learn how modern enterprise cognitive architectures ("Enterprise Digital Brains") are built from the ground up. Working alongside principal architects, data engineers, and full-stack developers on U.S. client and internal programs, you will gain practical exposure across data platforms, real-time pipelines, semantic knowledge graphs, agentic AI workflows, APIs, and web interfaces while contributing to real engineering prototypes and internal tooling.
  
  
What You Will Do
  
  

* Support Data & Ingestion Pipelines: Assist in building and testing data connectors, SQL/dbt transformations, and document/text parsing workflows that feed Snowflake and Databricks, and learn how medallion (Bronze / Silver / Gold) layers turn raw data into trusted data products.
* Explore Real-Time Data: Help prototype simple event-driven flows with Kafka or Kinesis and learn how change data capture (CDC) and streaming keep data and AI agents up to date.
* Explore Ontologies & Knowledge Graphs: Help curate sample domain entities, relationships, and taxonomies, and test graph/search queries in Neo4j (Cypher), Graphiti, and Elasticsearch under senior guidance.
* Build Agentic Prototypes & Tools: Learn how PydanticAI / LangGraph agents and Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools interact with enterprise data; help build retrieval (RAG) prototypes; evaluate outputs; and assist with prompt/dataset curation (Argilla, distilabel).
* Contribute to Full-Stack UI & APIs: Build UI components in Angular (or React) with TypeScript and Tailwind CSS, including charts and graph views (ECharts, AntV G6), and support REST APIs in NestJS or Python (FastAPI) documented with OpenAPI.
* Practice Modern Engineering Hygiene: Write unit tests, use Git/GitHub workflows and pull requests, run local Docker environments, and learn CI/CD, cloud (AWS) basics, observability, and secure coding fundamentals.

What You Will Learn
  
  

* Data Engineering: How enterprise data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, Informatica, Talend, dbt) fit together and how data quality and governance are enforced.
* Agentic AI: How multi-agent systems are designed, grounded, evaluated, and governed for enterprise use.
* Semantic Architecture: How ontologies, knowledge graphs, and semantic layers give AI systems reliable business context.
* Client Delivery: How forward-deployed engineering teams work with U.S. enterprise clients from discovery to production.

**Required**
Qualifications & Mindset
  
  

* Education: Currently pursuing (or recently completed) a degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related technical field.
* Programming: Strong foundational skills in Python and/or TypeScript/JavaScript, plus comfort with SQL and Git.
* Mindset: Curiosity about how data engineering, knowledge graphs, and AI agents fit together — and eagerness to learn fast, ask sharp questions, and ship clean code.

**Preferred**

* Coursework or Projects: Databases, distributed systems, machine learning/NLP, or web development; a GitHub portfolio, hackathon, or personal project involving LLMs, data pipelines, or a web app.
* Exposure: Any hands-on use of a cloud platform (AWS, Azure, GCP), a frontend framework (Angular, React), or a data tool (Snowflake, Databricks, dbt, Kafka).

Relevant Certifications (Valued, Not Required)
  
  

* Cloud & AI Foundations: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner or AWS Certified AI Practitioner; Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900) or Azure AI Fundamentals (AI-900); Google Cloud Digital Leader.
* Data Platforms: SnowPro Associate: Platform or SnowPro Core; Databricks Fundamentals or Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate; dbt Fundamentals.
* Graph & GenAI Learning: Neo4j Graph Academy courses/certification; DeepLearning.AI or vendor generative-AI and agent courses.

**Business Technology Manager – Life Sciences R&D**
Role Overview
  
  
The Business Technology Manager is a senior techno-functional role within ZS's Life Sciences practice, responsible for leading end-to-end delivery of data and technology solutions across Clinical and Regulatory R&D domains. This role combines hands-on technical leadership with client relationship ownership, business development, and team management. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in pharmaceutical data architecture, cloud platforms, and AI/ML-enabled solutions, paired with the ability to shape strategic engagements, grow accounts, and develop high-performing teams.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Delivery Leadership
  
  

* Own end-to-end delivery of data strategy, architecture, and platform engagements across R&D, Clinical, and Regulatory domains, ensuring alignment with timelines, quality standards, and business objectives
* Design and implement enterprise data solutions aligned with clinical and regulatory business processes, ensuring compliance with industry standards and guidelines (e.g., GxP, FDA, EMA)
* Provide techno-functional leadership to bridge the gap between clinical/regulatory business requirements and scalable technical implementation
* Design and develop cloud-based solutions leveraging platforms such as AWS, Databricks, and Snowflake, in alignment with enterprise architecture standards for data processing, analytics, and reporting
* Design robust data models for structured and semi-structured datasets, particularly for clinical trial, regulatory submission, and healthcare data
* Design and implement ETL/ELT data pipelines to ingest, transform, and harmonize data from multiple clinical and regulatory source systems
* Architect integration solutions across clinical systems and platforms (e.g., EDC, CTMS, Regulatory Information Management systems, MDM platforms)

People Management & Team Development

* Drive capability building within the team across cloud data platforms, AI/ML tooling, clinical data standards, and consulting delivery skills

* Conduct performance reviews, set development goals, and provide ongoing coaching and feedback

* Lead executive-level presentations, steering committee updates, and governance reviews for active engagements
* Stay updated with the latest trends in clinical data standards, regulatory requirements, AI/ML in R&D, and modern data technologies

Required

* Strong understanding of clinical trial processes, regulatory requirements, and data standards (e.g., CDISC, SDTM, ADaM is a plus)
* Proven techno-functional experience with the ability to translate business needs into scalable data solutions and enterprise architecture
* Hands-on experience in Data Engineering with strong exposure to cloud and modern data platforms (AWS, Databricks, Snowflake), including cloud-based data and analytics solutions
* Experience designing and implementing ETL/ELT pipelines and data integration architectures across clinical and regulatory systems
* Good understanding of AI/ML tools and agentic architectures, with the ability to leverage them for solutioning and improving efficiency across R&D workflows
* Strong programming skills in Python; familiarity with data processing frameworks and infrastructure-as-code is preferred
* Experience designing data models and working with both structured and semi-structured data in pharmaceutical contexts
* Deep understanding of data governance, data quality, and regulatory compliance requirements
* Demonstrated experience in business development activities: proposal writing, SOW development, client presentations, and opportunity identification
* Proven track record in people management, team development, and performance coaching
* Strong client-facing experience, and communicate effectively across business and technical teams
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Life Sciences, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field

**Preferred**

* Experience with Master Data Management (MDM) platforms and data product architecture design
* Familiarity with enterprise data governance tools (e.g., Collibra) and data cataloging solutions
* Exposure to clinical systems such as EDC, CTMS, Veeva Vault, or Regulatory Information Management (RIM) systems

title: App Testing
description:
**Job Title:**
App Testing Executive

**Location:**
Delhi NCR (On-site)
  
**Experience:**
1–3 years
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-time
  
**About StockBazaar**
StockBazaar is a stock market terminal built for Indian traders and investors, giving them fast, data-rich market insights in one place, on mobile and web. Our users make real market decisions with our product, so accuracy and reliability are everything to us.
  
  
**About the Role**
Stock bazaar We are looking for an App Testing Executive who understands the stock market and has a sharp eye for detail. You will test our mobile apps and web terminal, find and report bugs before our users do, and research our products and competitors to help shape what we build next.
  

**Key Responsibilities**

*Testing and Bug Hunting*

* Test the StockBazaar Android app, iOS app and web terminal for functionality, usability, performance and UI issues.
* Find, reproduce and log bugs clearly, with steps, screenshots or recordings, device details and severity.
* Write and maintain test cases and checklists for new and existing features.
* Run regression and smoke testing before every release, and verify fixes once bugs are resolved.
* Test across devices, screen sizes, OS versions and network conditions.
* Work closely with developers and the product team to get issues prioritised and fixed quickly.

*Market Data Accuracy*

* Check that live prices, charts, indices, option chains, screeners and technical indicators match NSE and BSE data.
* Test the app during live market hours, including market open, closing and high-volatility sessions.
* Catch delays, wrong values or missing data in market feeds and report them immediately.

*Product Research*

* Learn every StockBazaar feature in depth and become the go-to person for how the product works.
* Study competitor platforms and compare features, speed and user experience.
* Track user feedback from app store reviews, support tickets and social media, and turn it into improvement ideas.
* Share regular research notes and feature suggestions with the product team.

Requirements
  
  

**Requirements**

* 1–3 years of experience in manual testing of mobile apps and/or web applications.

title: Salesforce Team Lead
description:
**About Payoneer**
Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We’re a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.
  
  
By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.
  
  
If you are looking for a place to make a real impact, passionate about Salesforce tech and leading a team that builds complex solutions from scratch, enjoy reading Salesforce release notes and trying out all the new stuff – this unique opportunity is for you.
  
  
We are looking for a talented, experienced, and highly technical Salesforce Team Lead to lead a Salesforce Tech team on an adventure to reshape our Salesforce. The Salesforce team is part of the Applications & Integrations Group - globally responsible for business applications and cross organizational integrations, ensuring the delivery of innovative, high-quality solutions to meet business and operational needs.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a hands-on technical leader – highly motivated, curious, and with a deep understanding of Salesforce architecture and functionalities. A people person who grows engineers, makes best practices part of the team’s DNA, and takes full ownership of the team’s domains and delivery.
  
  
What you’ll do?
  
  

* Lead, mentor and grow a team of Salesforce engineers.
* Own the team’s delivery end-to-end: work with the group to prioritize the backlog, plan sprints and deliver on time and with high quality.
* Act as the team’s technical authority – own solution design and architecture decisions, making sure solutions are scalable, secure and easy to maintain.
* Stay hands-on: design, build, and maintain solutions using AI Coding Agents, Apex, LWC, and declarative tools like Flow, plus other tools/packages.
* Lead the design and delivery of internal and customer-facing AI agents on Salesforce, powered by Agentforceand Data Cloud.
* Define and enforce development standards, code reviews, release management, and CI/CD processes across the team.
* Drive org-health initiatives – technical debt reduction, refactoring the user experience (Lightning Pages, Dynamic Forms, Dynamic list views) and cleanup projects.
* Make sure knowledge is shared across our teams through process documentation and architecture.
* Follow the Salesforce roadmap and introduce new features and tools from the ecosystem that can help our company and processes.

Who you are?
  
  

* 6+ years of hands-on experience in a technical Salesforce team, as a Salesforce Admin/Implementor/Developer.
* 2+ years of experience leading Salesforce engineers as a Team Lead or Tech Lead, including mentoring and day-to-day management.
* Proven track record of designing and delivering complex end-to-end Salesforce projects, from requirements to production.
* In-depth understanding of Salesforce architecture, data model and security model, and of the platform’s core functionalities, features and configuration options.
* Strong hands-on experience with Flows (screen and record-triggered), Apex and LWC, Lightning pages, dynamic forms and other Page/App Builder tools.
* Sales Cloud Expertise, including EAC, ECI, Pipeline Inspection and other Sales Cloud Features.
* Familiar with Agentforce and Data Cloud, building agents and data-driven solutions that support business processes.
* Experience leading cleanup projects like moving from WF and PB to Flow, consolidating profiles and Fields/Objects cleanup.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to small details and the ability to balance hands-on work with leadership.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills in English, with the ability to influence stakeholders and work effectively in a global team environment.

Not a must but a great advantage
  
  

* Agentforce Agents Experience – both internal Agents and Customer Facing Agents.
* Experience working with Communities (Experience Cloud).
* Hands On experience with tools like Gearset, Azure DevOps, OwnBackup, DocuSign, Docomotion, FormAssembly, Varonis.
* Familiarity with Event Monitoring, Privacy Center and CRM Analytics.
* Experience setting up Git, Version Control and CI/CD processes for a Salesforce team.
* Knowledge of QA processes, test methodologies and Duplication Management tools and processes.

**The Payoneer Ways of Working**
**Act as our customer’s partner on the inside**
*Learning what they need and creating what will help them go further.*
**Do it. Own it.**
*Being fearlessly accountable in everything we do.*
**Continuously improve**

title: Software Engineer II
description:
**About Parexel**

Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.

We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose, moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry leading innovation, With Heart.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a **Software Engineer II (Software Test Engineer)** with a focus on life sciences technology to join our team. As a Software Engineer II, you will apply hands-on software testing expertise to help deliver reliable applications that advance clinical research and new treatments for patients. This position plays a key role in software quality and reliability for the applications that support clinical research.

You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams, follow industry-standard processes, and contribute to testing activities from requirement walkthroughs through test reporting. Responsibilities include designing and executing functional, regression, and integration testing, tracking defects to resolution, and partnering with Product Owners and Developers, with opportunities to deepen your expertise and influence product quality.

You'll join a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment focused on making a meaningful impact through rigorous test design, clear defect management, and close collaboration with Product Owners and Developers. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, the Software Engineer II can explore career paths and expand skills across clinical research technology.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and develop test scenarios, test cases and scripts, and test data that reflect application requirements and functionality.
* Execute functional, regression, and integration testing in line with defined procedures to verify application quality.
* Analyze application requirements and functionality to shape effective test coverage.
* Identify, document, track, and support the resolution of defects, helping teams deliver stable, high-quality software.
* Prepare and maintain test documentation, including test execution evidence and test summary reports.
* Participate in requirement walkthroughs and discussions with Product Owners and Developers.
* Collaborate with Product Owners, Developers, and other stakeholders to clarify requirements and resolve testing-related questions.

**You'll thrive in this role if you bring**

* Strengths in problem-solving, analytical thinking, and managing multiple priorities.
* An interest in life sciences and clinical research, with an appreciation for the quality standards of regulated environments.
* The ability to collaborate across teams and communicate clearly.
* A patient-focused mindset and strong attention to detail.
* Comfort working with Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint, defect and test management tools, and AI-assisted tools.

**Required Qualifications**

* 2 to 6 years of experience in software testing or quality assurance.
* Familiarity with the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC).
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Experience with defect management and test management tools.
* Basic knowledge of Java, SQL, and JavaScript.
* Basic understanding of artificial intelligence (AI) and generative AI technologies and their application in software testing and quality assurance activities.
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, communication, and organization skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and manage multiple priorities.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Life sciences domain knowledge.
* Knowledge or hands-on experience with Oracle Argus, ArisG (LifeSphere), or Veeva.
* Knowledge of Good Practice (GxP), computer system validation and computer software assurance (CSV/CSA), Good Automated Manufacturing Practice 5 (GAMP 5), and Title 21 Code of Federal Regulations Part 11 (21 CFR Part 11).
* Experience using AI-assisted tools for test case design, test documentation, defect analysis, and productivity improvement.

We believe in flexibility, growth, and creating space for people to do their best work. Join us and be part of a team where your contributions help shape the future of clinical research.

At Cin7, we are transforming the way businesses manage inventory, sales, and operations to make it cheaper, faster, and easier for businesses all over the world to get their products into their customers’ hands.

This role focuses on .NET development across .NET Framework, .NET, and ASP.NET MVC applications, with frontend work using JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. * Write and maintain unit and integration tests to keep features reliable as they evolve.
* Review code from peers for quality, maintainability, and adherence to coding standards, providing constructive feedback.
* Identify and resolve performance issues and bugs in existing code.
* Share knowledge, provide guidance to less experienced developers, and contribute to a collaborative engineering environment.
* Explore where AI can add value to our product and contribute to building AI-powered capabilities.

* A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

* Working knowledge of JavaScript, HTML, and CSS, including DOM manipulation, form validation, and working with API responses.

* Experience writing unit and integration tests and using Git for version control.
* Hands-on experience using AI tools in professional development work, such as coding assistants or agentic workflows, and a good sense of when to rely on them and when to verify their output.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills and a collaborative approach to teamwork.

* Experience on cloud-based SaaS products, particularly on Microsoft Azure.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, agile development, and secure coding practices.
* Experience mentoring junior engineers or contributing to team engineering practices.

**Why work at Cin7?**

* We are a fast growing business going through a huge amount of growth.
* You’ll have the opportunity to work on products that are used by our global customer-base and at the same time you’ll be growing your career and developing new skills.
* Hybrid work environment

* Celebrate your birthday with a paid day off
* A Global Cin7 Day celebrated companywide, providing you a dedicated holiday to focus on your own wellbeing.
* Recruitment referral bonus
* Work for a Great Place to Work®

**Why CIN7?**
CIN7 is a leader in one of the most exciting software verticals right now, and we're growing exponentially. We're looking to add people to our team who are passionate about working with a fast growth tech company.
  
  
At CIN7, we make great products available to everyone. Every month, millions of sales orders flow through our platform reducing the cost, effort and time for product sellers so they can quickly get products to customers and build their brands without worrying about their operations. Cin7 is expanding very quickly with a mission to become the leading Inventory Management Software brand in the world, and we are looking for a motivated and driven individual to join the team.

**How You'll Make An Impact**
At Cin7, we are transforming the way businesses manage inventory, sales, and operations to make it cheaper, faster, and easier for businesses all over the world to get their products into their customers’ hands.
  
  
We’re looking for a Junior Software Engineer to join our engineering team and grow with us. **What You'll Do**

**What You'll Bring**

* A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* Some practical experience with software development through internships, personal projects, university projects, or professional work.

* Familiarity with AI-powered development tools and an interest in using them to improve productivity and code quality.

* Basic understanding of unit testing and version control with Git.
* Strong communication skills and a willingness to ask questions and learn.

**It's a Nice To Have If You Bring**

* Experience building or integrating AI or LLM-powered features, such as calling LLM APIs or working with retrieval-based workflows.
* Experience on cloud-based SaaS products, particularly on Microsoft Azure.
* Exposure to CI/CD pipelines or agile development environments.

**Why work at Cin7?**

* We are a fast growing business going through a huge amount of growth.
* You’ll have the opportunity to work on products that are used by our global customer-base and at the same time you’ll be growing your career and developing new skills.
* Hybrid work environment
* Work From Anywhere for 30 days in a six month period
* Celebrate your birthday with a paid day off
* A Global Cin7 Day celebrated companywide, providing you a dedicated holiday to focus on your own wellbeing.
* Recruitment referral bonus
* Work for a Great Place to Work®

**Why CIN7?**
CIN7 is a leader in one of the most exciting software verticals right now, and we're growing exponentially. We're looking to add people to our team who are passionate about working with a fast growth tech company.
  
  
At CIN7, we make great products available to everyone. Every month, millions of sales orders flow through our platform reducing the cost, effort and time for product sellers so they can quickly get products to customers and build their brands without worrying about their operations. We pride ourselves on providing Inventory Management and Supply Chain software to help medium-large product businesses thrive in a highly competitive, digital world. CIN7 centrally manages inventory across multiple locations and channels, connecting 500+ systems to support receiving, selling and shipping stock.
  
  
***We value diversity at Cin7, and bring people into the heart of everything we do. We hire, recruit, and promote without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, pregnancy or maternity, veteran status or any other status protected by applicable law. Role Overview: We are seeking an experienced and dedicated Core PHP Developer to design, build, and maintain robust,

high-performance web applications and custom content engines. In this role, you will be responsible for pure server-side

scripting using Core PHP (OOP concepts, design patterns, PDO/MySQLi), relational schema design, custom RESTful API

architecture, and seamless integration with third-party web services and frontend interfaces without relying exclusively on

heavy frameworks.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Custom PHP Engineering: Develop, test, and deploy clean, maintainable, object-oriented PHP code (PHP 8.x) utilizing

standard design patterns (MVC, Singleton, Factory).

Database Architecture & Query Tuning: Design normalized MySQL relational schemas, write optimized complex queries,

manage indexing, transactions, and PDO connection pooling.

RESTful API Development: Build lightweight, custom RESTful web services (JSON/XML) and integrate third-party APIs

(SMS gateways, payment processors, CRM, and cloud storage).

Security & Session Hardening: Implement enterprise-grade application security defenses including SQL Injection prevention

(prepared statements), CSRF tokens, XSS mitigation, secure cookie handling, and encrypted user authentication.

Performance Optimization: Troubleshoot, debug, refactor procedural legacy PHP scripts into structured classes, optimize

server response times, and implement in-memory caching (Redis / Memcached).

Frontend & Team Collaboration: Work alongside UI/UX designers and frontend developers to integrate dynamic

title: SAP -Software Lead Developer
description:
**Job Information**
-------------------

* Job Type Permanant (Full Time)
* Work Experience 10 - 14 years
* City Coimbatore
* Country India

**Job Description**
-------------------

**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced SAP Lead Developer with a strong professional background in ABAP and SAP UI5 and/or SAP Integration Suite. In this hands-on leadership role, you will develop and support high-quality SAP solutions while providing technical direction to developers and working closely with functional and technical colleagues in Belgium and India.  
With AI assistants now writing much of the code, we expect you to think as a designer first: shape the solution, define the guardrails, review critically, and let tools accelerate the build. You combine hands-on depth with the curiosity to keep learning, inside and outside the SAP world.

Beyond technical expertise, this role requires ownership, excellent communication, and strong collaboration skills in an international, multicultural team. You will act as the point of contact for development topics, turn functional needs and architectural direction into implementable technical solutions, challenge ideas constructively, coach developers, and ensure consistent delivery standards across technologies and locations.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Technical Responsibilities**

  

* Guide BTP tooling setup (IDE, Git, CI/CD, transport management, environments) with SAP Basis and the technical architect, informed by hands-on experimentation.
* Document BTP standards for project structure, naming, branching, configuration, secrets, logging and monitoring.
* Evaluate emerging SAP capabilities (Joule Studio, SAP AI Core / Generative AI Hub, SAP Business AI foundation) and advise the architect on adoption timing and approach.
* Lead technical delivery across S/4HANA, RAP, CAP (Node.js), Integration Suite, SAP Build Process Automation and event-driven integration.
* Coordinate team delivery from design to deployment, supporting estimates, dependencies and risks; align with Colruyt standards for Control-M scheduling, monitoring, security, identity and operations.
* Design API- and event-based integrations with non-SAP systems alongside integration and Java teams.
* Coach junior Software Engineers end to end through pairing, design reviews and constructive code reviews.
* Define, maintain and promote design patterns, clean-core principles, coding and naming standards, and reusable development guidelines.
* Ensure code quality through peer reviews, testing, documentation, quality gates and SAP best practices, using AI to streamline the work.
* Proactively resolve or coordinate complex technical issues, merge conflicts, deployments, incidents and defects.
* Promote test automation at every level, validate go-live and coordinate technical readiness across end-to-end flows and stakeholders.
* Translate analysts’ functional needs into clean technical designs; accelerate implementation with AI coding assistants such as Claude, GitHub Copilot or SAP Joule.
* Set responsible AI practices: guardrails, reviews, prompt/context conventions and limits on unchecked delegation.
* Critically review AI-generated code for correctness, security and standards compliance.
* Participate in Colruyt’s development community and connect with Java and other non-SAP engineers experienced in Git, CI/CD, Node.js and event-driven architecture.
* Bring relevant practices and shared tooling into SAP and share SAP expertise with the wider community.
* Follow SAP Community and SAP Developer resources, sharing new ecosystem insights with the team.

**Collaboration & Communication**

  

* Actively collaborate with colleagues and stakeholders in Belgium, participating in meetings, workshops, and design discussions.
* Clearly explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* Communicate progress, risks, and solutions in a transparent and professional manner.
* Respect cultural differences and contribute positively to a multicultural team environment.

### **Requirements**

**Technical Skills**

  

* At least 10-12 years of hands-on experience developing solutions with core SAP ABAP, including ABAP Objects.
* Demonstrated experience as a technical lead, lead developer, or senior developer coordinating technical design and delivery across a development team.
* Experience with UI5, Fiori, Gateway, OData, and CDS views on SAP HANA.
* Experience with one or more SAP BTP development and integration technologies, such as Integration Suite, CAP, RAP, or SAP Build Process Automation.
* Proven ability to create end-to-end technical designs, refine development tasks, estimate effort, and assess technical risks and dependencies.
* Experience defining or applying coding standards, design patterns, clean-core principles, code-review practices, and development governance.
* Practical knowledge of Git-based version control, branching and merge practices, CI/CD pipelines, and controlled deployment processes.
* Experience coordinating integrations and APIs across SAP and non-SAP systems, including monitoring, alerting, and operational documentation.
* Experience coaching developers and sharing technical knowledge in a distributed or multicultural delivery team.

**Soft & Social Skills**

  

* Strong communication skills in English (spoken and written).
* Ability to work independently while being a strong team player. You seek out colleagues in other teams, join communities and conferences and share what you learn.
* Comfortable working with colleagues across different countries and cultures.
* Open-minded, proactive, and constructive attitude.
* Willingness to ask questions, share knowledge, and give/receive feedback.
* A coach. You make others better through patient explanation, honest feedback and good examples.
* Constructively critical. You ask "what happens when this fails?" and can challenge an estimate or design respectfully, with arguments.
* A designer at heart. You think in architecture, interfaces and trade-offs, not only in lines of code.

**Nice to Have**

  

* Experience working with European or Belgian teams.
* Knowledge of SAP security, authorization, or integration with non-SAP systems.
* Exposure to Agile/Scrum working methods.
* Experience in finance, logistics, or retail-related SAP processes.

### **Benefits**

**What We Offer**

  

* An international working environment with strong collaboration between India and Belgium.
* Greenfield work on BTP, Integration Suite, events and AI, next to a stable S/4HANA core.
* A large internal development community, including Java and cloud engineers, to learn from and with.
* Close collaboration with architects and teams in Belgium.
* Opportunities for professional growth and continuous learning.
* A culture that values collaboration, respect, and quality.

title: Lead System Hardware Engineer
description:
**Who We Are**

  

Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.

  
  

**What We Offer**

  

Location:

Bangalore,IND

You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.

At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits .

Applied Materials' PDC (Process Diagnostics and Control) division designs and manufactures advanced semiconductor inspection and metrology tools. Each tool is paired with a dedicated, purpose-built computing platform -comprising servers, storage, and networking elements - that drives the tool's real-time processing, data acquisition, and control workloads. These platforms are self-contained computing environments, engineered specifically for each tool family and deployed in semiconductor fab conditions worldwide.
  
  
The System Engineer is responsible for defining and delivering the next generation of computing platforms for PDC tools. The role begins with a High Level Design (HLD) from R&D -defining what the software and algorithms require in terms of compute power, memory, storage throughput, and network bandwidth - and ends with a fully productized, manufacturing-ready computing platform. Everything in between is owned by this role.
  
  
This is a senior pivot role. The System Engineer drives a structured review process (KO PDR CDR DVR FDR ECO), manages technical interfaces with R&D, software, procurement, manufacturing, and external vendors, and serves as the computing hardware authority for new tool development programs.

  
  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

**Platform Definition & Vendor Selection**

* Receive and analyze HLD documents from R&D computing architecture; translate computational requirements into hardware specifications.

* Research and evaluate computing platform solutions from leading vendors, identifying configurations that meet performance, reliability, power, and form-factor requirements.

* **Define platform specifications: CPU generation and configuration, memory capacity and speed, storage topology (NVMe, SAS/SATA, RAID), networking (Ethernet, InfiniBand, fiber), and GPU/AI** accelerator integration where required.

* Lead vendor engagement: issue RFQs, conduct technical reviews with vendor platform architects, and negotiate platform customization requirements.
  

  

**NPI Process Execution**

* **Drive the full structured NPI review cycle from Kickoff (KO) through PDR, CDR, DVR, FDR, and ECO -owning the technical content and scheduling of each gate.**

* Define and manage the Bill of Materials (BOM) for new computing platforms, ensuring accuracy and configuration control throughout the development process.

* Author technical deliverables at each gate: requirements documents, platform selection rationale, validation test plans, and manufacturing transfer packages.

* Identify and resolve technical obstacles that could delay the program schedule; escalate risks early and propose mitigation strategies.
  

  

**Validation & Productization**

* **Design and execute hardware validation plans: performance benchmarking, stress testing, thermal characterization, and compatibility validation with the tool's software stack.**

* **Collaborate with R&D and software teams to verify driver compatibility, BIOS/firmware configuration, and OS/application performance on the selected platform.**

* Lead the transition of validated platforms from engineering to manufacturing, including production BOM release and manufacturing documentation.

* Support the manufacturing team during initial production builds and resolve any hardware-related integration issues.
  

  

**Cross-Functional Interface Management**

* Collaborate with engineering peers across multiple disciplines -Electronics, Mechanics, Safety, and others -to ensure the computing platform integrates cleanly into the overall tool design.

* Serve as the technical interface with procurement for component sourcing, lead time management, and supply chain risk mitigation.

* Engage with external integrators and customer sites as needed to support platform integration and field validation activities.

* Coordinate with the SPI team to ensure that NPI platform decisions account for long-term serviceability and component lifecycle.
  

  

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* BE in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering.

* **7-14+ years of hands-on experience with computing hardware platforms: a deep working knowledge of x86 server architecture, CPU/memory/storage configuration, RAID design, networking** hardware, and GPU/accelerator integration.

* Proven ability to define hardware specifications from functional requirements -translating software workload descriptions into server configuration decisions.

* **Experience engaging with computing hardware vendors in a technical capacity: evaluating platforms, understanding vendor roadmaps, and customizing off-the-shelf configurations.**

* Familiarity with structured engineering processes (PDR/CDR or equivalent design review gates) in a hardware development or productization context.

* Strong BOM management discipline; experience maintaining configuration-controlled hardware specifications.

* Fluent English -written and verbal -required for vendor engagement, cross-site collaboration, and technical documentation.

* Structured, analytical approach to technical decision-making; able to present hardware tradeoff analysis clearly to both engineering and management audiences.
  

  

**Preferred**

* **Background in semiconductor equipment, defense computing systems, data center engineering, or high-tech industrial computing environments.**

* **Experience with GPU/AI accelerator integration (NVIDIA, AMD, Intel Gaudi) in server platforms.**

* Familiarity with PLM and BOM management tools (TeamCenter, Agile PLM, or equivalent).

* Technical background in computing, communications, intelligence systems, or airborne computing - highly relevant.

* E **xperience with hardware qualification and validation methodologie** s (performance benchmarking, thermal testing, reliability testing).

* Exposure to manufacturing transfer and production ramp activities for hardware products.

**Additional Information**

**Time Type:**

Full time

**Employee Type:**

Assignee / Regular

**Travel:**

Yes, 20% of the Time

**Relocation Eligible:**

Yes

Applied Materials is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

* **Shape and advocate** a forward-looking technology vision for **Exchange Online and cloud messaging platforms**; champion modern, secure, and scalable approaches.
* **Execute migrations** to/from **Exchange Online (M365)**, including hybrid, tenant‑to‑tenant, and cloud transformation initiatives - planning, tooling, cutover, and post‑migration stabilization.
* **Administer Microsoft 365 services** related to the role (e.g., Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate) where applicable.
* **Administer Active Directory**, including objects, policies, and integrations relevant to messaging services.
* **Troubleshoot** deeply across Exchange Online, hybrid environments, identity, and networking layers and prevent recurrence.
* **Innovate & lead**: **Generate, prioritize, and deliver SIP (Service Improvement Plan)** and **automation** initiatives that reduce toil, improve reliability, and measurably enhance user experience; **build the business case, secure alignment, and drive adoption** across engineering and operations.
* **Gather and document** business/technical requirements; design **hybrid and cloud-aligned messaging solutions**, with on‑prem components **as applicable** (sizing, documentation, cost estimates).
* **Plan and execute** pre‑production testing (test cases, pilot planning, risk/issue mitigation) and **manage production deployments**.
* **Follow ITIL processes** for Incident, Problem, and Change; contribute to continual service improvement.

* **Evaluate and test** new capabilities through PoCs; recommend product/service enhancements with vendors.
* **Perform maintenance and upgrades** to sustain performance, reliability, and security.

  

**Skills and attributes for success**

  

* **Strong** **analytical capability across Exchange Online (M365), mail flow, identity, and Active Directory technologies**.
* Demonstrates **sound judgment, discretion, and professionalism** in decision‑making.
* Excellent **communication skills**—verbal, written, listening—along with strong interpersonal, organizational, and project‑coordination abilities.
* Effective **teaming and collaboration**, with strong organization and time‑management skills.
* High **cross****‑****cultural awareness** and ability to work seamlessly with global stakeholders.
* Solid understanding of **ITIL processes** and their application within enterprise operations.
* **Ability to manage** strategic vendors, including Microsoft.
* Commitment to **knowledge sharing**, with the ability to deliver hands‑on or classroom‑style training to peers and team members.

  

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

  

* **8+ years of hands-on experience with Microsoft Exchange Online (M365) design & implementation**, including administration, troubleshooting, and engineering at scale; on‑prem Exchange experience is beneficial but not mandatory
* Proven experience supporting **large-scale** **Exchange Online implementations**, including hybrid and cloud transformation initiatives, complex migrations and hybrid/on‑premises–to–M365 transition projects.
* Extensive hands‑on administration of **Exchange Online (M365)** in enterprise-scale environments; familiarity with Exchange Server (2016/2019) is a plus in enterprise-scale environments.
* Hands-on experience with **Exchange Online security and compliance features** (e.g., Defender for Office 365, DLP, transport rules, anti-phishing, etc.)
* Strong proficiency in **Microsoft 365 / Office 365 administration**.
* **PowerShell scripting** expertise for automation, reporting, and operational tasks.
* Working knowledge of **Microsoft Outlook** (2016/2019/2021) and its integration with Exchange services.
* Experience using **Exchange management, maintenance, and monitoring tools**.
* Ability to support **Digital Workplace technologies** and related productivity tools.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

  

* **Exposure** to or experience with on‑premises Exchange environments (hybrid scenarios, legacy integrations), including planning, designing, installing, implementing, monitoring, and optimizing Exchange infrastructure.
* Strong knowledge of **Backup, High Availability (HA), Disaster Recovery (DR), and Site Resilience** strategies for enterprise messaging platforms.
* Understanding of **server and SAN sizing** and experience with **email security solutions** such as anti‑virus and anti‑spam gateways (e.g., IronPort, Exchange Online Protection).
* Familiarity with **Exchange security technologies**, including authentication, access controls, and secure configuration practices.
* Experience with **email archiving and retention** solutions and policies.
* Ability to configure and maintain **remote access capabilities** (OWA, Outlook Anywhere, etc.).
* Experience acting as a **technical SME for on****‑****premises to Office 365 (M365) migrations**, including planning, execution, and cutover.
* Exposure to and interest in **implementing new products, tools, and service offerings** within messaging and collaboration technologies.

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. TEC4 Team Member
  
  
Job Description
  
  
Technology Command, Technology Crisis Management, Planned Event Coordination Communications Support
  
  
Field
  
  
Details
  
  
Role Title
  
  
TEC4 Team Member
  
  
Role Family
  
  
Technology Operations, Technology Crisis Management, Planned Event Coordination and Communications Support
  
  
Location
  
  
**India:** Bangalore / Hyderabad / Remote (subject to business needs)
  
  
Shift Pattern
  
  
24x7 rotational shift coverage supporting Global Technology Operations
  
  
Seniority
  
  
Experienced Operational Specialist
  
  
1. Introduction to the Role and Operating Model
  
  
TEC4 stands for Technology Command, Coordination and Communication Center.
  
  
TEC4 serves as the central coordination and communication function for:
  

* Significant technology incidents
* Technology crisis events
* Business-critical planned technology activities
* Elevated operational risk periods

The TEC4 Team Member works in a 24x7 global team providing operational support during:
  

* High-severity technology incidents
* Business-critical planned technology events
* Elevated monitoring periods
* Technology crisis coordination activities

Key Concepts
  
  
Aspect
  
  
Explanation
  
  
Technology Crisis Management
  
  
Structured response model used when incidents may have broad business, operational, client, regulatory, or reputational impact.
  
  
Technology Response Team (TRT)
  
  
Senior assessment group convened for incident/event impact assessment and crisis coordination decisions.
  
  
Technology Command Center (TCC)
  
  
Formal command structure activated for significant crisis events.
  
  
Planned Technology Event
  
  
Major scheduled technology activity such as migration, infrastructure change, security implementation, market readiness event, etc.
  
  
Elevated Operations Command (EOC)
  
  
Temporary enhanced monitoring and coordination model during increased operational risk periods.
  
  
High-Severity Incident
  
  
Technology incident with significant actual or potential business impact (e.g., Sev1, Sev2 Critical).
  
  
2. Role Overview
  
  
**The TEC4 Team Member is responsible for:**  

* Monitoring significant technology incidents and events
* Coordinating planned technology activities
* Supporting incident and event bridges
* Maintaining operational records
* Delivering clear stakeholder communications

Purpose of the Role
  

* Detect, validate, assess and escalate significant incidents/events early.
* Coordinate planned technology events in a controlled, documented manner.
* Support TRT and TCC activities when required.
* Provide operational support during Elevated Operations Command periods.
* Maintain accurate records of status, impact, actions, decisions and evidence.
* Deliver clear, factual and timely communications.

3. Key Responsibilities
  
  
3.1 Major Incident Monitoring, Validation and Escalation
  

* Monitor major technology incidents and events globally, including Sev1 and Sev2 Critical incidents.
* Validate:
* Severity
* Business impact
* Technical impact
* Affected services
* Recovery progress
* Escalation requirements
* Evaluate operational, client and service impacts.
* Monitor vendor and cloud service status for potential impacts.
* Provide crisis assessment updates and recommendations.
* Monitor operational channels for outages, vendor degradation, infrastructure alerts and other escalation triggers.
* Monitor TEC4 and Technology Command Center mailboxes, Teams channels and hotlines.
* Escalate incidents/events to TEC4 leadership when enhanced coordination is needed.
* Coordinate with Engineering, Workplace Technology and Service Delivery teams.

3.2 Planned Technology Event Project Coordination
  

* Coordinate support for:
* Planned technology events
* Major changes
* Migrations
* Infrastructure activities
* Cloud/vendor events
* Work with:
* Project Managers
* Event Managers
* Engineers
* Business stakeholders
* Maintain:
* Event schedules
* Milestone trackers
* Dependency trackers
* Risk/Issue logs
* Readiness checklists
* Confirm readiness before execution.
* Send event invitations and communications.
* Start and facilitate event bridges.
* Conduct roll calls and participation checks.
* Track execution against approved runbooks.
* Support Go/No-Go readiness decisions.
* Update event pages and Confluence documentation.
* Escalate blockers and delays.
* Coordinate checkpoint calls and bridge extensions.
* Support post-event reviews and closure reporting.

3.3 Technology Crisis Management Elevated Operations Support
  

* Support Technology Response Team and Technology Command Center activities.
* Start, monitor and staff Zoom/Audio bridges.
* Track attendance and follow up with missing participants.
* Support commanders and communication leads with:
* Incident facts
* Business impact
* Risk status
* Mitigation progress
* Decision tracking
* Maintain command center documentation.
* Track action items and closure activities.
* Support Elevated Operations Command monitoring and reporting.

3.4 Communications Support
  

* Prepare and distribute operational communications.
* Support incident, event and crisis communications.
* Ensure communications are:
* Clear
* Factual
* Concise
* Timely
* Gather information from commanders, technical teams and project managers.
* Include:
* Current status
* Impact
* Actions
* Owners
* Risks
* Next checkpoints
* Escalate communication gaps and approval delays.

3.5 Regulatory Documentation Support
  

* Maintain:
* Incident records
* Decision logs
* Action logs
* Evidence trails
* Support governance, audit and regulatory requirements.
* Assist with regulatory assessments.
* Support post-crisis reviews.
* Follow up on open actions.
* Contribute to:
* Procedures
* Training materials
* Work instructions
* Onboarding documentation
* Recommend process improvements.

4. Required Skills Competencies
  
  
Skill Area
  
  
Required Capability
  
  
Incident Management
  
  
Major incident monitoring, escalation, business impact assessment
  
  
Planned Event Coordination
  
  
Milestone tracking, readiness checks, dependency management
  
  
Bridge Facilitation
  
  
Roll calls, checkpoint meetings, execution bridge support
  
  
Communication
  
  
Clear written and verbal operational communications
  
  
Stakeholder Management
  
  
Coordination across technical and business stakeholders
  
  
Risk Issue Management
  
  
Identifying blockers, escalation triggers and dependencies
  
  
Documentation Discipline
  
  
Accurate incident records, logs and evidence management
  
  
Risk Governance Awareness
  
  
Crisis coordination and regulatory sensitivity
  
  
Execution Under Pressure
  
  
Calm, structured operation during major incidents
  
  
5. Technical Tooling Knowledge
  

* ServiceNow or equivalent Incident Management systems
* Microsoft Teams
* Zoom
* Shared Mailboxes
* Enterprise Chat Platforms
* Confluence
* SharePoint
* Incident/Action Tracking tools
* Enterprise infrastructure concepts
* Networks
* Databases
* Cloud platforms

Cloud Knowledge
  
  
**Awareness of:**  

* AWS
* Microsoft Azure
* Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
* Oracle Cloud
* Cloudflare
* Zoom

**Knowledge of:**  

* Change Management
* Release Management
* Migration Execution
* Cutover Activities

6. Experience Requirements
  
  
Required Experience
  

* Minimum 5 years in one or more of:
* Technology Operations
* Major Incident Management
* Command Center Operations
* Service Operations
* Production Support
* Planned Event Coordination
* Project Coordination
* Experience supporting global teams in a 24x7 environment.
* Experience coordinating multiple technical teams during incidents and production changes.
* Experience maintaining status reports, trackers and operational updates.

Preferred Experience
  

* Financial Services or regulated-industry experience.
* Support of technology migrations and infrastructure changes.
* Executive and leadership communications.
* Crisis management and regulatory assessments.
* Postmortems and continuous improvement activities.

7. Personal Attributes
  

* Strong ownership and accountability
* Calm under pressure
* Professional communication style
* Attention to detail
* Proactive problem identification
* Comfortable with technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Strong prioritization skills
* Collaborative and reliable

8. Role Boundaries
  

* TEC4 coordinates crisis execution and communications but does not own technical remediation unless explicitly assigned.
* Supports Go/No-Go decisions and execution visibility without replacing accountable leaders.
* Maintains coordination discipline, evidence capture and escalation management.

9. Success Measures
  
  
Success Looks Like
  

* Significant incidents identified and escalated early.
* Planned events are execution-ready.
* Accurate checkpoint tracking and ownership management.
* Stakeholders receive timely and factual updates.
* Records are complete and auditable.
* Lessons learned are converted into improvements.

10. Terminology
  
  
Term
  
  
Meaning
  
  
TEC4
  
  
Technology Command, Coordination and Communication Center
  
  
Technology Crisis Management
  
  
Structured operating model for major incidents
  
  
Technology Response Team (TRT)
  
  
Senior assessment forum for major incidents
  
  
Technology Command Center (TCC)
  
  
Formal crisis command structure
  
  
Elevated Operations Command (EOC)
  
  
Enhanced monitoring during high-risk periods
  
  
Planned Technology Event
  
  
Major migration, upgrade or business-critical technology activity
  
  
Sev1
  
  
Highest severity technology incident
  
  
Sev2 Critical
  
  
High-risk incident with potential critical impact
  
  
Incident Management System
  
  
System used to track and manage incidents
  
  
Incident Commander
  
  
Individual leading incident response
  
  
Communication Lead
  
  
Individual responsible for incident communications
  
  
Runbook
  
  
Execution plan with steps, owners and checkpoints
  
  
Checkpoint Call
  
  
Scheduled progress review meeting
  
  
Go/No-Go Decision
  
  
Readiness decision to proceed or pause
  
  
Postmortem / Post-Event Review
  
  
Review performed after an incident or event
  
  
Regulatory Assessment
  
  
Review of reporting or evidence requirements
  
  
Confluence
  
  
Documentation and collaboration platform
  
  
This role is essentially a Major Incident Management / Technology Operations Command Center / Crisis Coordination Specialist position focused on incident response, event coordination, communications, governance, and global operational monitoring.

title: Extension of Naveen Shenoi Work Contract as Contractor
description:
Location: Bengaluru

Other locations: Primary Location Only

Salary: Competitive

Date: Nov 25, 2026

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1762333

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**Security Consultant**

**Job Summary:**

  

As an Information Security Consultant, the individual will be responsible for providing security guidance to projects and operations teams responsible for delivering, respectively maintaining, IT cloud-based solutions. The Consultant will support the entire system development lifecycle (SDLC) of business IT solutions with information security expertise and guidance. This includes performing a risk assessment of the solution and the underpinning cloud infrastructure in order to derive adequate risk treatment options, driving the security assurance activities with cloud vendors, specifying and prioritizing security requirements, directing the design of security controls, supervising the security attestation activities and effectively articulating all related findings, issues, recommendations to team members and management, assessing the security impact of change requests and providing the operations teams with related recommendations and decisions.

  

The successful candidate should have solid background in web services architecture and design, networking principles supporting hybrid cloud models, experience in applications development processes and methodologies (experience in agile application development and DevOps operations mode is strongly preferred), as well as oversight knowledge of infrastructure and hosting technologies leveraging virtualization and containerization. The successful candidate should have broad consulting or security assurance experience across all Information Security knowledge areas relevant to modern cloud-based architectures.

  

**EY Technology:**

Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently. We have 250,000 people in more than 140 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. Everything from the laptops we use, to the ability to work remotely on our mobile devices and connecting our people and our clients, to enabling hundreds of internal tools and external solutions delivered to our clients. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and is key to us being more innovative as an organization.

**EY Technology** supports our technology needs through three business units:

**Client Technology (CT)** - focuses on developing new technology services for our clients. It enables EY to identify new technology-based opportunities faster, and pursue those opportunities more rapidly.

**Enterprise Workplace Technology (EWT)** – EWT supports our Core Business Services functions and will deliver fit-for-purpose technology infrastructure at the cheapest possible cost for quality services. EWT will also support our internal technology needs by focusing on a better user experience.

**Information Security (Info Sec) -** Info Sec prevents, detects, responds and mitigates cyber-risk, protecting EY and client data, and our information management systems.

  

**The opportunity:**

  

The Security Consultant reports to Deputy CISO of Enterprise Workplace Technology in a hands-on role, focused on the secure design, architecture and development for applications, which processes sensitive data and constitutes core as well as critical business services. The Security Consultant works directly with Architects, Developers, IAM engineers, Project Managers and other resources; through collaboration and mentoring, they help teams to deliver secure business solutions.

The Security Consultant’s role is a technical position which will support the global strategies and architecture vision as it relates to the development of secure design, build, deployment and operation of business applications and related infrastructure.

  

**Your key responsibilities:**

This position is an individual contributor capable of supporting multiple project teams in the design, implementation and validation of security controls across applications and services (incl. underpinning infrastructure and cloud hosting platform), as well as providing the operations teams with consultancy, reviews and decisions upon deployment of changes to existent operational services. The core responsibilities are as listed in the following.

  

* Directing and managing solution-specific information security assurance efforts with 3rd parties and vendors, like backend reviews, controls verification and validation, etc., oriented on standards and frameworks like ISO, COBIT, NIST, TSC, etc.
* Risk assessments (threats, vulnerabilities) of cloud services and applications
* Risk assessments of cloud hosting infrastructure underpinning the services and applications
* Security assessment of architecture and networking supporting the services and applications
* Derivation of risk treatment options from risk assessments and effectively facilitating the implementation of the optimal security-usability trade-off in interactions with project teams and management
* Identifying, specifying and prioritizing security requirements in new applications and services deployment, as well as specifying and facilitating security changes in DevOps operations mode of existent applications
* Directing the design of security controls to satisfy the approved security requirements
* Supervising and managing various types of security attestation activities (scans, pentests, audits), including the definition of scope, pass criteria, contribution to test scenarios, articulating and formalizing findings and decisions
* Assessing the security posture impact of change requests and providing the operations teams with related recommendations and decisions
* Effectively communicating the findings, recommendations and decisions from all above activities, by adapting the form and depth of statements adequately to audiences and stakeholders
* Translating technical security terms and concepts into business risk terminology to facilitate making objective and security-aware risk decisions by management
* Providing knowledge sharing and technical assistance to other team members
* Acting as an agile team member according to established agile development best practices and guidelines

  

**Skills and attributes for success:**

The position requires knowledge of various IT system architectures and technologies like cloud, virtualization, containerization, mobile, as well as expertise and experience in security subject matter areas such as IAM, network and perimeter security, web applications security, user account management, privileged access, auditing & logging, and others as outlined in ISO 27001, OWASP, NIST and related guidelines and standards. The consultant filling the position should also have experience in conduction of 3rd party security assessments, in particular within the scope of SOC1, SOC2 reports, and in vendor risk management.

  

A successful candidate should have significant security working experience and knowledge in the design, implementation and operation of security controls in any two or more of the following areas:

* Agile & DevOps Methodologies – Experience as a contributing member of a balanced team within an Agile development or DevOps environment.
* Application Security - Experience with the design of security controls for multi-tier business solutions including the design of application-level access and entitlement management, data tenancy and isolation, encryption, and logging. Working familiarity with REST API and micro services architecture.
* Cloud Security –Technical understanding of virtualization, cloud infrastructure, and public cloud offerings and experience designing security configuration and controls within cloud based solutions in Microsoft Azure and Azure PAAS services
* Infrastructure Security – Experience with the integration of common infrastructure security technologies and solutions into business solution architectures including the integration of identity & access management, intrusion detection and prevention, security monitoring, and data encryption solutions.
* Identity and Access Management - Active Directory based Identity and Access Management and Authorization design experience and integration with IDaaS and Federation technologies.

  

**To qualify for the role you must have:**

A BSc or MSc degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related discipline, or equivalent work experience, with preference towards advanced degrees.

Seven or more years of experience in Information Technology disciplines. Five or more years of experience in Information Security subject matter area with demonstrated experience in the following:

  

* Experience providing and validating security requirements related to applications and information system design and implementation
* Experience providing and validating security requirements related to cloud services and underlying networking and architectures
* Experience conducting risk assessments, vulnerability assessments, vendor and third party risk assessments and recommending risk remediation strategies
* Experience in the use of tools and methods to identify security exposures and business risks
* Knowledge of common information security standards, such as: ISO, NIST, COBIT
* Familiarity with information system attack methods and vulnerabilities and threat modelling
* Working experience with web technologies and programming languages
* Working experience with more than one of these technologies and products - Java, .NET, NodeJS, Angular, Power Apps, Kubernetes

  

**Ideally, you’ll also have:**

  

* A vendor-neutral security certification of DoD IAT Level II-III or DoD IAM Level II-III is strongly preferred (SSCP, Security+, CEH, CISSP, CISM)
* A vendor-specific cloud security certification would be an additional asset (Microsoft AZ-500, AWS Security Specialty, …)
* Proven experience as a standing member of an agile development team (in any agile role) or as DevOps operations mode contributor would be an additional asset,
* Proven experience with either of the Adobe cloud products would be an additional assets.

  

**What we look for:**

* Ability to team well with others to facilitate and enhance the understanding & compliance to security policies
* Ability to work effectively with customers, management, staff members, vendors, and consultants and articulate findings and recommendations
* Strong English communication and writing skills are required
* Strong judgment and analytical ability
* Excellent interpersonal, communication, organizational, and project management skills

title: Civil Engineer – Property Operations, Projects & Liaison
description:
MaxIndia Developers is hiring a hands-on Civil Engineer to run maintenance, small projects, contractors and government-office paperwork across our Bengaluru properties.

**Location**

Indiranagar, Bengaluru (on-site, with regular field visits across the city)

**Job type**

Full-time

**Experience**

2–5 years

**Qualification**

Diploma or B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering

**Salary**

₹15,000 – ₹25,000 per month, based on experience and skills

**Benefits**

Commuter assistance

**Reports to**

Management

**Languages**

Kannada and English (Tamil or Hindi a plus)

About the role

MaxIndia Developers is a Bengaluru-based real estate development and property management company with residential and commercial properties across the city.

You will be the person who keeps our properties in good shape and keeps paperwork moving. Roughly half your time is on site (inspections, repairs, contractor supervision) and half is coordination (quotes, bills, tenants, and follow-ups at BBMP/GBA, BDA and Sub-Registrar offices).

This role suits a civil engineer with real site experience who enjoys variety, follows things through to closure, and wants to grow into real estate and property operations.

What you will do

**Site inspections and maintenance**

* Inspect our residential and commercial properties on a regular schedule and log their condition.
* Diagnose civil issues: cracks, seepage and waterproofing, roofing, flooring, plastering, painting, plumbing and drainage.
* Plan and supervise repairs, renovations and refurbishment.
* Escalate structural or safety concerns to management and specialist consultants.

**Contractors and vendors**

* Build and maintain a reliable network of contractors, plumbers, electricians, painters, fabricators and waterproofing specialists.
* Get at least three quotes for major works and prepare a comparison for management.
* Negotiate rates and timelines within approved limits.
* Supervise work on site, then verify measurements, quality and materials before bills go for approval.

**Estimates, BOQs and billing**

* Take site measurements and prepare quantity sheets, basic BOQs and cost estimates.
* Check contractor invoices against agreed scope, rates and measurements, and flag variations.
* Work with accounts to process approved payments and keep budget records.

**Small projects**

* Coordinate scope, schedule, materials and contractor mobilisation for renovations and improvement works.
* Track progress, flag delays or cost overruns early, and inspect work before handover.

**Property operations and tenants**

* Handle tenant move-ins, move-outs, handovers and inventory checklists.
* Track complaints and maintenance requests through to closure.
* Follow up on electricity, water, sewage and property tax payments.
* Report unauthorised alterations, encroachments or damage promptly.

**Government liaison and documentation**

* Follow up with BBMP/GBA, BDA, the Revenue Department and Sub-Registrar offices on e-Khata, Khata transfer, mutation, property tax, land records, registrations, building approvals and utility connections.
* Prepare, verify and submit application documents, and track every application to approval.
* Coordinate with our advocates, surveyors and architects on document collection and submissions. This is coordination only; no legal advice is expected.

**Reporting**

* Send a short daily update and a weekly summary of works, applications and pending items.
* Keep property-wise files (physical and digital) of quotes, invoices, receipts, inspections and approvals.
* Keep management informed of delays, urgent issues and unexpected costs.

------------

As a trusted voice for many of the world’s most successful organizations, we use our knowledge to advance safety and performance, set industry benchmarks, and inspire and invent solutions to tackle global transformations.

We help customers navigate the complex transition to a decarbonized and more sustainable energy future. We also help industries and governments to navigate the many complex, interrelated transitions taking place globally and regionally, in the energy industry.

### **About the role**

DNV is looking for a Senior Energy Storage Consultant to join our energy storage APAC team and deliver technical advisory services for utility-scale Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) projects in India and internationally. You will work as an Independent Engineer (IE) or Owner's Engineer (OE) for developers, investors, lenders, and utilities and OEMs, helping them build and operate safe, bankable and high-performing storage assets.

* Benefits may vary based on position, tenure/contract/grade level.

DNV is an Equal Opportunity Employer and gives consideration for employment to qualified applicants without regard to gender, religion, race, national or ethnic origin, cultural background, social group, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age or political opinion. Diversity is fundamental to our culture and we invite you to be part of this diversity.

### **About you**

Experience and background

* 8–18 years of professional experience, with substantial hands-on involvement in utility-scale BESS projects.
* Practical project experience in one or more of the following: design, testing, commissioning, project management, project development, tendering, and operations and maintenance of BESS.
* Experience gained with consultancies (IE/OE), developers, EPC contractors, OEMs, utilities, or IPPs. We are looking for candidates with real project delivery experience rather than primarily research or academic backgrounds.

Technical skills

* Solid understanding of BESS architecture and key components: battery systems and BMS, PCS, transformers, MV/HV integration, EMS/SCADA and plant controllers.

Professional skills

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with proven client-facing experience.
* Strong technical writing and ability to produce professional reports and presentations.
* Ability to lead and manage multiple projects in parallel while meeting quality and schedule requirements.
Fluent English and Hindi.  

Advantages

Experience in hybrid (solar + storage) projects.
