title: AI Innovation Lead
description:
**Vestas is a major company in sustainable energy solutions and a driving force in the wind energy industry. Our core business encompasses the development, manufacturing, sales, installation, and servicing of wind turbines worldwide. At Vestas, we are committed to accelerating the transition to renewable energy while creating innovative solutions that deliver value to our customers and stakeholders.**
**Digital Solutions & Development > Digital Solutions > Autonomous Flows Advisors**
The Autonomous Flows Advisors team sits within Vestas' Digital Development Platform and accelerates the AI and automation transformation across the business. We act as internal advisors and enablers, partnering with product teams and business areas across the value chain (R&D, commercial, manufacturing, supply chain, services and business services) to help shape the AI strategy, scope high-impact solutions, and ensure responsible, scalable AI adoption. We work closely with cyber, legal, and data governance, and collaborate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders at all levels.
  
  
As an AI Innovation Lead, you will redesign and operationalize frontline workflows using AI and automation. Working closely with the business teams, local technology leads, and global product teams, you will translate business priorities into measurable workflow transformations and working operational prototypes. You'll be responsible for running the automation work, aligning scope, implementing the local solutions while keeping in mind potential risks and opportunities to turn your solutions into global product features. This is not a research or purely strategic role. You will be expected to get into the details, test assumptions, and deliver tangible innovation.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
As an AI Innovation Lead, you will play an instrumental role in our efforts to enable the Vestas AI transformation. You will be responsible for:
  
  

* Coordinating the mapping and redesign of frontline workflows together with the relevant business teams - Partnering with key business stakeholders to identify and scope work packages with clearly defined resource needs, measurable outcomes, and target problems- Assessing data readiness, technical feasibility, and implementation complexity for proposed automation initiatives
* Defining success metrics and expected business outcomes for each AI initiative, in collaboration with stakeholders
* Overseeing the development of local automations in collaboration with business stakeholders and subject matter experts
* Testing deployed prototypes with live frontline data and iteratively improving solution quality based on structured SME feedback and evaluation results
* Working directly with frontline users to embed the redesigned workflow and supporting automation into daily operations
* Identifying recurring workflow patterns, reusable components, and enterprise-scaling opportunities
* Translating learnings into a structured backlog for global solutions product owners

**Qualifications**
This role requires someone who is highly motivated, engaged, and able to work well both on their own and alongside a diverse group of stakeholders. We imagine that you have most of the qualifications and skills below:
  
  

* A relevant degree in a quantitative field (IT, physics, mathematics, etc.), business transformation, or similar, combining solid technical understanding and effective communication skills - At least 6 years of relevant experience in a similar role- Practical understanding of automation and AI use cases, limitations, and pitfalls
* Experience building AI, automation, or software solutions using modern AI development tools
* Experience with product discovery, business process redesign, automation, operational excellence, or digital transformation initiatives

**Competencies**

* Business oriented, value-focused mindset
* Effective communication skills, both spoken and written, plus the ability to navigate complex organizations and align differing stakeholder needs- Ability to translate complex AI concepts into clear, actionable language for non-technical stakeholders
* Pragmatic and structured approach to problem solving, with a focus on value creation
* You seek to constantly acquire new knowledge, stay up to date within AI, and challenge yourself
* Fluent spoken and written English is a prerequisite

**What We Offer**

* Purpose - An opportunity to support climate action and improve the future for people to come using automation and AI
* Steep learning curve - You will be part of a highly knowledgeable AI advisory team with wide-ranging and in-depth experience. That means that you will have somebody to learn from, just as we will invest in continuous learning, knowledge sharing, and upskilling
* Strong relationships - We plan to cultivate an open and supportive atmosphere with a tight-knit team that can learn from one another and contribute meaningful value to Vestas
* Opportunity to shape your role - We have been asked to scale and anchor the impact of AI and automation across Vestas. The rest is up to us
* Healthy work life balance, with flexible working options
* Commitment to building a diverse and inclusive workplace
* Everyone can thrive and bring their unique perspectives and skills to the team

**Additional Information**
Your primary location will be in Chennai, India
  
  
Please note: We do amend or withdraw our jobs and reserve the right to do so at any time, including prior to the advertised closing date. Please be advised to apply on or before 30th Nov 2026
  
  
Learn more about Vestas at www.vestas.com and follow us on our social media channels
  
  
**Our commitment to a fair hiring.**
At Vestas, we evaluate all candidates solely based on their professional experience, education, and relevant skills. To support a fair recruitment process, we kindly ask that you remove any photos, dates of birth or graduation, gender pronouns, marital status, or other personal information not relevant to the role before submitting your CV/resume. Your CV/resume should focus on your professional and educational background, along with the necessary contact details (email and phone number). We train our hiring teams in inclusive evaluation and regularly review process outcomes to ensure fairness.
  
  
**DEIB Statement**
At Vestas, we recognize the value of diversity, equity, and inclusion in driving innovation and success. We strongly encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply, particularly those who may hesitate due to their identity or feel they do not meet every criterion. As our CEO states, "Expertise and talent come in many forms, and a diverse workforce enhances our ability to think differently and solve the complex challenges of our industry". Your unique perspective is what will help us powering the solution for a sustainable, green energy future.
  
  
**BEWARE – RECRUITMENT FRAUD**
It has come to our attention that there are a number of fraudulent emails from people pretending to work for Vestas. Read more via this link, https://www.vestas.com/en/careers/our-recruitment-process
  
  
**About Vestas**
Vestas is the energy industry’s global partner on sustainable energy solutions. We are specialised in designing, manufacturing, installing, and servicing wind turbines, both onshore and offshore.
  
  
Across the globe, we have installed more wind power than anyone else. We consider ourselves pioneers within the industry, as we continuously aim to design new solutions and technologies to create a more sustainable future for all of us. With more than 200 GW of wind power installed worldwide and 40+ years of experience in wind energy, we have an unmatched track record demonstrating our expertise within the field.
  
  
With 39,000 employees globally, we are a diverse team united by a common goal: to power the solution – today, tomorrow, and far into the future.
  
  
Vestas promotes a diverse workforce which embraces all social identities and is free of any discrimination. We commit to create and sustain an environment that acknowledges and harvests different experiences, skills, and perspectives. We also aim to give everyone equal access to opportunity.
  
  
To learn more about our company and life at Vestas, we invite you to visit our website at www.vestas.com and follow us on our social media channels. We also encourage you to join our Talent Universe to receive notifications on new and relevant postings.

title: Director, Team Lead, Engineering F&GBS
description:
**Use Your Power for Purpose**
Technology impacts everything we do. Pfizer’s digital and ‘data first’ strategy is dedicated to implementing innovative and impactful technology solutions across all functions, from research to manufacturing. Whether you are digitizing drug discovery and development, identifying solutions, or making our work easier and faster, you will be making a significant difference to countless lives. By focusing on these advancements, you contribute to a future where technology enhances every aspect of our operations, ultimately benefiting patients worldwide.
  
  
**Role Summary**
Pfizer’s Finance & Global Business Services (GBS) organization is building the F&GBS Technology & AI Solutions Capability Center in Chennai to build and run AI solutions for Finance and GBS teams worldwide, in areas such as financial close, forecasting, accounts receivable, procure-to-pay, tax, treasury and shared services operations. Reporting directly to the Senior Director, F&GBS AI Lead, and serving as Engineering & Site Lead for Chennai, the Director, Engineering leads the Chennai team of 12. Eight Forward Deployed Engineers, including senior engineers, report directly to the role, along with the Senior Manager, Run & Support Lead, who leads three Senior Associate Support Analysts (L1/L2). It is the senior engineer and technical authority for the team, sets design and build standards and best practices, keeps the team current with the latest AI technology, trends and tools, and stays hands-on when the work calls for it. This role owns the people on the team, the technical leadership of what they build, their engineering quality and production readiness, and the team’s engineering skill coverage.
  
  
**Role Responsibilities**

* Technical leadership and solution design

+ Acts as technical lead for the team’s engagements, or names a Senior Manager engineer as technical lead for each
+ Leads and reviews solution design for complex, multi-system builds on market-leading runtimes
+ Turns Product Owner priorities into sound technical approaches, with clear estimates of effort, risk and tradeoffs
+ Makes platform and build-versus-buy recommendations with Digital platform and architecture teams

* People management

+ Hires, develops and manages performance for 8 Forward Deployed Engineers, including senior engineers
+ Leads the Senior Manager, Run & Support Lead, and through them 3 Senior Associate Support Analysts (L1/L2), so the people who build solutions and the people who support them work as one team
+ Assigns engineers to the highest-priority work set by Product Owners and rotates them across engagements as work moves from build into production
+ Develops Senior Manager engineers as craft leaders and technical leads, and grows Manager-level engineers toward Senior Manager
+ Hires people who embrace change, want varied problems and move quickly

* Engineering practice and standards

+ Defines and maintains design and build standards, including architecture patterns, coding standards, testing, evaluation practice, security and review of AI-generated code
+ Writes engineering playbooks, reference architectures and templates that the team and F&GBS function engineers can reuse
+ Runs design and code reviews, and holds colleagues and partner engineers to one engineering bar
+ Keeps AI, data and full-stack engineering skills covered in the team, and contributes to the shared F&GBS Data & AI Foundation

* Technology, trends and tools

+ Tracks developments in models, agent frameworks, AI coding tools, LLMOps and data platforms, and assesses what matters for Finance and GBS
+ Runs proofs of concept and technical spikes before the team adopts new tools and approaches
+ Recommends which technologies, tools and patterns to adopt, retire or watch, and shares what is learned through tech talks, demos and written guidance

* Production quality, controls and responsible AI

+ Sets the standard for production readiness, observability and LLMOps, and works with the Run & Support Lead so handoffs to support are clean
+ Builds controls into standards so solutions pass SOX, Internal Audit, Privacy, Legal, Security and AI governance review, including GDPR, India DPDP Act and EU AI Act review
+ Leads root cause fixes for engineering issues and pays down technical debt before it blocks scale

* Ways of working

+ Uses coding agents for routine engineering and reviews their output before it ships
+ Keeps technical ownership of the team’s work when vendors and contractors are involved

**This role covers a broad spectrum of skills and we encourage you to apply even if you meet partially.**
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, data science or a related field
* [10] or more years of software or data engineering experience, including [2] or more years leading engineering teams, including leading managers
* Track record of designing and shipping LLM-based or other AI solutions to production that business users rely on
* Expert-level Python, with strong TypeScript or JavaScript and Structured Query Language (SQL), and current hands-on coding ability
* Experience with cloud architecture (Azure preferred, or Amazon Web Services (AWS)), API-first design, continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD) and observability
* Hands-on LLMOps practice, including evaluation, tracing and prompt, model and agent versioning
* Experience defining engineering standards, reference architectures or best practices adopted by a team
* Experience hiring, managing performance and developing senior engineers
* Experience leading engineers and influencing peers and stakeholders without direct authority
* Experience communicating technical decisions to product owners, business stakeholders and engineers, and working across regions and time zones

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master’s degree in a technical field
* Experience managing engineers and leading delivery at the same time as a technical lead, in a matrixed organization
* Experience leading both build and run (support) teams
* Experience growing senior and junior engineers while keeping sustainable spans and succession
* Experience balancing staffing, delivery, technical debt and partner capacity across competing priorities
* Experience keeping technical ownership when working with vendors and contractors, and comfort with change and rotation
* Knowledge of finance processes such as record-to-report, order-to-cash, procure-to-pay, FP&A or treasury
* Experience with SAP (S/4HANA, Ariba), Snowflake (including Cortex), Databricks, the Azure AI stack, Vertex AI or Oracle EPM
* Experience with agent orchestration frameworks, Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Agent2Agent (A2A)
* Relevant certifications, such as AWS or Azure Solutions Architect, or equivalent

**Non-standard Work Schedule, Travel Or Environment Requirements**
Ability to work non-traditional work hours interacting with global teams spanning across the different regions (eg: North America, Europe, Asia)
  
  
**ORGANIZATIONAL RELATIONSHIPS**

* F&GBS AI leadership team
* Product Owners for F&GBS AI
* Finance and GBS function leaders and process owners
* Digital platform, architecture and security teams
* Run & Support team

***Supervision:***
12 roles in total: 8 Engineers and the Senior Manager, Run & Support Lead, who leads 3 Senior Associate Support Analysts (L1/L2)

* 4+ years of development and design experience on Sitecore
* Sitecore Certified Developer
* Strong skills in ASP.NET, C#, MVC and SQL
* Solid knowledge of Helix architecture and Sitecore development best practices
* Proven experience creating templates, pages and custom personalization rules
* Experience customizing Sitecore content APIs used by other applications
* Experience deploying and supporting Sitecore in a scaled enterprise environment

* Able to influence teams on technical decisions by sharing deep knowledge

**About Global Delivery Services**

Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.

Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.

Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.

Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.

  

**The Opportunity**

As a Senior AI QA & Automation Engineer, you will lead automation-first quality engineering for cloud-native and AI-powered solutions. This role requires 5–8 years of experience and strong hands-on capability in Python, Playwright automation, cloud platforms, AI/ML, Generative AI, Agentic AI, and LLM testing.

You will design scalable test and evaluation frameworks that validate conventional applications as well as RAG, conversational AI, copilot, and agentic workflows for functional correctness, task success, grounding, safe tool use, policy compliance, reliability, and release readiness.

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Define and own automation-first quality strategies for web, API, microservices, cloud-native, GenAI, RAG, LLM, and Agentic AI solutions.
* Design and develop scalable Python-based automation frameworks using Playwright and PyTest for UI, API, integration, and end-to-end testing.
* Define AI quality dimensions, scoring rubrics, acceptance thresholds, and representative evaluation datasets with product, business, and engineering SMEs.
* Build automated evaluation harnesses covering task success, grounding, hallucination, retrieval relevance, tool selection and execution, policy compliance, response format, consistency, and regression.
* Write deterministic tests for tools, APIs, integrations, permissions, memory, state management, workflow control, and agent orchestration.
* Validate AI/ML, Generative AI, and Agentic AI systems, including RAG applications, copilots, conversational AI, and multi-agent workflows.
* Use human evaluation and LLM-as-judge approaches with appropriate calibration, sampling, bias controls, traceability, and periodic human review.
* Execute adversarial and failure-mode testing covering prompt injection, jailbreaks, unsafe actions, data leakage, PII exposure, harmful content, tool misuse, and security vulnerabilities.
* Integrate automated tests and AI evaluations into CI/CD pipelines as release gates, with quality dashboards, trace evidence, and actionable reporting.
* Translate production defects, model failures, and AI incidents into repeatable regression cases and continuously improve evaluation datasets and automated suites.
* Collaborate with Product Owners, Business SMEs, Developers, Data Scientists, AI Engineers, Architects, and DevOps teams to define acceptance criteria and drive resolution.
* Provide technical leadership, review framework design and test coverage, mentor team members, and communicate delivery risks and quality outcomes to stakeholders.

  

**Skills and attributes for success**

**Mandatory skills and experience**

* 5–8 years of Quality Engineering experience with a strong automation engineering background; this is an automation-focused role.
* Advanced Python programming with hands-on experience building reusable automation and evaluation frameworks using PyTest.
* Hands-on Playwright automation experience for modern web applications; experience validating APIs and end-to-end business workflows is required.
* Practical cloud experience with Azure, AWS, or GCP, including testing cloud-native services and integrating test execution into CI/CD pipelines.
* Strong understanding of AI/ML, Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector retrieval, and Agentic AI architectures.
* Hands-on LLM and AI application testing, including grounding, hallucination, retrieval relevance, task completion, tool use, response quality, safety, bias, and compliance evaluation.
* Experience designing evaluation datasets, scoring rubrics, thresholds, automated evaluation harnesses, and regression suites for probabilistic AI systems.
* Experience with adversarial AI testing techniques such as prompt injection, jailbreak, unsafe action, data leakage, PII protection, and failure-mode testing.
* Working knowledge of REST APIs, microservices, Git, CI/CD platforms such as GitHub Actions or Jenkins, and Agile engineering practices.
* Strong analytical, debugging, stakeholder communication, and technical leadership skills.

  

**Good to have**

* Hands-on exposure to LangChain, LangGraph, Langfuse, and LangSmith for orchestration, observability, tracing, and evaluation.
* Experience with DeepEval, RAGAS, MLflow, Garak, LLM-as-judge, MCP, Playwright MCP, or other AI evaluation and agent-testing tools.
* Exposure to GitHub Copilot, Codex, Cline, Roo, or similar AI-assisted engineering tools.
* Understanding of Responsible AI controls, OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, guardrails, model validation, bias testing, drift testing, metamorphic testing, and back-to-back testing.
* Experience with SQL, Postman, Docker or containerized execution, observability platforms, and test reporting dashboards.

title: Senior IT Infrastructure Lead
description:
Uniphore is the Business AI company. Our sovereign, composable and secure AI platform connects enterprise data, fine-tunes AI models and deploys agentic AI across the enterprise. We empower every worker to boost productivity and help businesses grow faster, operate smarter and reduce costs. Trusted by more than 2,000 businesses globally, and recognized on the Deloitte Fast 500, Uniphore delivers on the promise of AI as a transformative force for business.

  

**Job Description:**

**Experience: 10 - 15 Years**

  

**Job location: Chennai**

  

**Role Requirement**

* Strong understanding of IT infrastructure, network hardware, and enterprise security architecture.

* Must have very good working knowledge of the Microsoft 365 / Azure (Entra ID) platform end-to-end, including Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps and Defender for Endpoint; AWS knowledge is an added advantage.

* Good understanding of core networking concepts (VLANs, layer 2/3 routing, access lists, load balancing) and hands-on experience administering enterprise firewalls (rule management, VPN, NAT, segmentation).

* Ability to think through problems and design solutions across hybrid, cross-platform environments (Windows and macOS); ability to implement, administer, and troubleshoot end-to-end.

* Automate manual processes using AI tools wherever possible, to improve troubleshooting, documentation, and day-to-day infrastructure operations.

**Job Requirements**

**Identity & Hybrid Directory Services**

* Designing, planning, migrating, and implementing Active Directory in environments with 2,500+ users.

* Designing, implementing, and troubleshooting Directory Synchronization and Federation Services (Azure AD Connect / Cloud Sync, ADFS) for Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD).

* Managing Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) services including users, groups, device management, Enterprise Applications, App Registrations, and Conditional Access.

* Configuring SSO (SAML, OAuth2/OIDC) integrations and API/App Registrations, including service principals, API permission scopes, and certificate/secret-based authentication.

* DNS/DHCP and Group Policy design.

* Hands-on experience managing DNS records (A, CNAME, MX, TXT, including SPF/DKIM/DMARC) across internal and external DNS zones.

* Designing on-premises AD with Hybrid Azure AD Sync.

* Active Directory hands-on experience in multi-site / multi-domain / multi-forest environments.

* Deep knowledge of Active Directory and Entra ID, including Group Policy, Federation, and Single Sign-On.

* Strong experience with AD enterprise certificate services, rights management server, AD Federation Services, and identity manager.

* Experience with Active Directory consolidation/migration (Quest migration experience and ADMT a plus) and running AD health checks.

* Strong experience with IP Address Management (IPAM) solutions.

**Cloud & Endpoint Security (Microsoft Defender Suite)**

* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps (CASB) policy creation, OAuth app governance, shadow IT / cloud app discovery.

* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, device onboarding, EDR, attack surface reduction, vulnerability management.

* Working knowledge of Defender for Identity and/or Microsoft Sentinel is a plus.

* Hands-on experience with email security solutions such as Microsoft Defender for Office 365 or similar anti-phishing, anti-spam, safe links/attachments, and mail flow security.

* O365 security and compliance administration.

**Endpoint Management- Windows & Mac**

* Hands-on experience with O365, Intune, and MDM for Windows endpoints.

* Hands-on experience managing macOS/Apple devices using Kandji, Jamf, or a similar Apple MDM, including Apple Business Manager and Automated Device Enrollment.

* Hands-on experience handling servers such as Windows Server 2012, 2016, 2019, and 2022.

* Cross-platform patching, security, performance, and backup/recovery best practices across Windows and macOS.

**Network & Firewall**

* Strong experience with core networking (VLANs, layer 2/3 routing, ACLs, load balancing).

* Hands-on administration of enterprise firewalls, including rule management, site-to-site and remote-access VPN, NAT, and network segmentation.

* Working knowledge of SD-WAN technologies and ISP/circuit concepts (MPLS, broadband, leased lines, last-mile connectivity, failover and redundancy).

* Working knowledge of Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) solutions such as FortiClient EMS or Zscaler, or similar.

* Working knowledge of NaaS (Network as a Service), enterprise WiFi/Access Point management, and RADIUS-based authentication (802.1X).

**Collaboration & Meeting Room Technology**

* Hands-on experience managing meeting room/conferencing platforms such as Cisco (Webex Room devices), Microsoft Teams Rooms, and Zoom Rooms.

* Configuring and managing collaboration hardware from Logitech and Cisco (room cameras, speakers, controllers) across meeting spaces.

* Willing to partner with internal teams (facilities, events, business stakeholders) to plan and support large town halls and company-wide gatherings, including AV setup and live event support.

**Cloud Infrastructure, Virtualization & VDI**

* Proven experience with Virtualization, Storage, Compute, Cloud (Azure), Network, Backups, and Automation/Scripting (PowerShell).

* Hands-on experience with backup and disaster recovery solutions such as Veeam or similar, covering Microsoft 365, virtual machines/servers, and cloud workloads.

* Experience creating and maintaining documentation for the Azure VDI environment, including architecture diagrams, configuration guides, and standard operating procedures.

* Managing and maintaining the Azure VDI environment, including monitoring, troubleshooting, performance optimization, and security.

* Staying current with industry trends and best practices in VDI and cloud computing, and applying them to improve the environment.

**Technical Leadership & Escalation**

* Own end-to-end technical direction and standards across identity, cloud, endpoint, and network/security domains — not execution within a single domain only.

* Define and maintain standards for Conditional Access, CASB policy, EDR/MDM enrollment, and firewall change management.

* Evaluate and recommend tools and vendors (e.g., MDM platform selection, CASB/EDR tooling, firewall vendor).

* Act as the technical escalation point for complex, cross-domain incidents beyond L2/L3 support; mentor and guide L1–L3 engineers.

title: L2/L3 Systems & Infrastructure Support Engineer
description:

This is a hands-on, client-facing role in an MSP environment. You will work independently, take full ownership of your tickets through to closure, and support the MSP Manager on infrastructure projects such as server builds, domain controller migrations and Microsoft 365 migrations.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Backup & Recovery**

* Check all client backup jobs daily, fix failed or missed jobs and confirm successful re-runs.
* Own every backup ticket and alert in HaloPSA and make sure it is closed the same business day.
* Administer Arcserve UDP (including immutable storage), Microsoft 365 backup, VM backups (Hyper-V, VMware, Sangfor HCI), NAS/SAN targets and LTO tape.
* Perform file, mailbox, database, VM and full server restores on request.
* Run quarterly test restores for each client and record the results.
* Monitor backup storage capacity and raise risks early.
* Keep backup documentation and restore procedures up to date for every client.

**L2/L3 Technical Support**

* Take escalated tickets from L1 and field engineers and resolve them within SLA.
* Troubleshoot Windows Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS and DHCP.
* Administer and support Microsoft 365: Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Entra ID, MFA and Intune.
* Support Hyper-V and Sangfor HCI environments and NAS/SAN storage.
* Troubleshoot firewalls and VPNs (FortiGate, SonicWall, Sophos), VLANs and connectivity issues at L2.
* Identify recurring problems, find the root cause and add fixes to the knowledge base.

**Projects & Infrastructure**

* Configure new physical and virtual servers remotely (Windows Server 2019/2022/2025).
* Carry out server and domain controller migrations from legacy versions, including FSMO transfer, DNS/DHCP move and file server migration.
* Set up new Microsoft 365 tenants and migrate mailboxes and data from Exchange, IMAP, Google Workspace and file servers.
* Manage internal and public DNS for clients (MX, SPF, DKIM, DMARC).
* Prepare migration plans, runbooks, cut-over and rollback steps, and handover documents.
* Work with the MSP Manager and UAE field engineers to deliver project tasks on time.

**Service Delivery & Documentation**

* Give clients clear, timely updates on findings, progress and next steps.

* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in IT, Computer Science or a related field.

* Strong Windows Server and Active Directory skills, including server builds and DC migrations.
* Solid DNS and DHCP knowledge, including public DNS records for email.
* Strong Microsoft 365 / Office 365 and Entra ID administration, with migration experience.
* Working knowledge of Hyper-V and/or VMware, NAS/SAN storage and RAID.

**Advantageous**

Travel based on business needs.

title: Software Engineer, Precision Instrumentation
description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.

  
  
  

**Group/Division**

The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The RAPID division leads the industry in reticle inspection solutions, helping ensure high lithography yields and cost-effective semiconductor manufacturing. Its systems support both mask shops and fabs by detecting defects early in the process, enabling faster, more reliable production.

**What You'll Do**

In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.

  
  

**Responsibilities**

* Learn the existing LabVIEW diagnostics software architecture and take ownership of features and development tasks that meet project goals.
* Design, implement, and maintain diagnostic and calibration software in LabVIEW and other languages (e.g., Python, Java, C++, C#).
* Translate user needs and system-level requirements into clear software specifications and working, tested code.
* Develop diagnostic tools that characterize subsystem and system health, including hardware-in-the-loop tests, automated calibration routines, and data analysis and reporting.
* Interface with instruments and hardware such as motion stages, cameras, sensors, DAQ, and lasers.
* Improve software reliability, maintainability, and performance through design reviews, refactoring, and automated testing.
* Perform root cause analysis of system and software issues using logs, measurement data, and image-based data, and iterate on solutions.
* Use AI tools and techniques to speed up development and improve diagnostics, such as faster log and data analysis or detecting anomalies in instrument and image data.
* Collaborate with hardware, subsystem, system, manufacturing, and service teams to deliver integrated solutions.
* Spend time in clean-room and lab environments for integration and testing (10%–20%).
* Occasional global travel to customer sites to support installations and field issues (10%–20%).
  

  

**Required Qualifications**

* B.E./B.Tech/B.S. (or equivalent) with 2–4 years of relevant experience, or M.Tech/M.E./M.Sc./M.S. (or equivalent) with 1–2 years of relevant experience, in Electronics/Electrical/Instrumentation Engineering, Computer Science, Physics, Optics, or a related field.
* Proficiency in LabVIEW, including object-oriented design (LVOOP).
* Experience with at least one other language such as Python, C++, or C#.
* Hands-on experience building test, measurement, automation, or instrument-control software that interfaces with hardware.
* Experience working on medium or large applications in multi-developer teams, with source control and code review.
* Strong problem-solving skills, including system-level debugging.
* Demonstrated ability to convert user input into technical specifications and functional software.
* Excellent communication and teamwork skills. Self-motivated, curious, and a fast learner who turns prototypes into production-quality code.
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Certified LabVIEW Developer (CLD).
* Experience in semiconductor characterization or metrology labs, such as SEM/TEM, AFM, optical metrology, ellipsometry, or electrical and materials characterization. Experience writing the software that controls and automates these instruments is a plus.
* Experience with optics, microscopy, lasers, or precision motion systems.
* Experience with computer vision, image processing, or image analysis.
* Experience in semiconductor capital equipment (semi CAPEX) or other high-precision hardware products.
* Data analysis and visualization (Python/NumPy/pandas), CI/CD, and automated test frameworks.
* Experience with NI hardware (PXI, cDAQ, FPGA/RIO) and communication protocols (TCP/IP, serial, GPIB, EtherCAT).
* Hands-on use of AI tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot) to speed up scripting, debugging, data analysis, and documentation.
* Exposure to applying AI/ML to instrument, sensor, or image data, such as for anomaly detection or defect classification.

**Minimum Qualifications**

Master's Level Degree and 0 years related work experience; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 2 years

**About KLA**

We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.

  
  

**Use of AI Statement**

At KLA, our interviews seek to understand your individual skills, problem-solving approach and authentic thinking. To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation, the use of AI, recording tools or other technologies to generate, suggest or provide responses during interviews—whether virtual or in person—is not permitted unless explicitly approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation or invited by the interviewer. Use of these tools may interfere with our ability to evaluate your individual qualifications and affect your candidacy. KLA is committed to advancing innovation through responsible AI, and we value candidates who share this mindset.

*KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.*

title: Database Engineer, Senior (SQL Server Primary | Cross-Platform Database Engineering)
description:
**About**
The Database Engineer (DBE) designs, builds, and operates automated, resilient, secure, and observable database services. The role requires deep SQL Server expertise while also supporting and navigating PostgreSQL and other database platforms. The engineer applies reliability engineering, automation, and standardized operational practices across on-premises, hybrid, and public-cloud environments.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Cross-Platform Database Reliability Operations: Own day-to-day database health, availability, performance, capacity, patching, and lifecycle management. Lead SQL Server operations and contribute effectively to PostgreSQL and other supported platforms.
* Reliability Engineering: Define and improve service-level indicators, service-level objectives, error budgets, availability patterns, operational readiness, and reliability controls for database services.
* Automation and Infrastructure as Code: Reduce repetitive work and operational risk by developing automated provisioning, configuration, patching, validation, and maintenance workflows using Python, Shell, PowerShell, Ansible, Terraform, and CI/CD pipelines.
* High Availability and Disaster Recovery: Engineer, test, and maintain platform-appropriate HA/DR solutions, including SQL Server Always On availability groups, and PostgreSQL replication and failover patterns.
* Observability and Proactive Monitoring: Implement consistent monitoring, telemetry, alerting, dashboarding, and anomaly detection across database platforms. Improve alert quality and convert recurring incidents into engineering improvements.
* Performance and Capacity Engineering: Diagnose complex workload and resource issues using platform-native tools and sound database principles. Recommend indexing, query, configuration, storage, and scaling improvements.
* Backup, Recovery, and Data Protection: Establish auditable backup, restore, recovery, and resilience validation practices using technologies such as SQL Server backup and restore, and PostgreSQL backup and point-in-time recovery tooling.
* Security and Compliance: Apply least privilege, encryption, auditing, vulnerability remediation, secrets management, secure configuration, and timely patching across supported platforms.
* Cloud and Platform Modernization: Assess and execute migrations, upgrades, consolidation, and modernization across on-premises, hybrid, and cloud database services, including Oracle multitenant architectures and appropriate managed database offerings.
* Incident Response and Problem Management: Participate in production support and incident response, perform root-cause analysis, document recovery procedures, and drive permanent corrective actions.
* Standards and Collaboration: Create reusable engineering standards, runbooks, automation modules, and operational documentation. Partner with application, platform, security, network, and cloud engineering teams.

**What you'll bring:**

* Experience: 6 to 8+ years in enterprise database engineering, database administration, production operations, or site reliability engineering, with substantial hands-on Oracle expertise with an engineering mindset.
* Primary SQL Server Expertise: Deep hands-on expertise in Microsoft SQL Server administration and engineering, including Always On Availability Groups, clustering, backup and recovery, performance diagnostics and tuning, patching and upgrades, security, automation, and high availability/disaster recovery. Strong experience supporting large-scale production environments and SQL Server on Azure IaaS and/or Azure SQL platforms is preferred.
* Automation and DevOps: Strong Hands-on scripting or programming experience with Python and one or more of Bash/Shell or PowerShell. Experience with Terraform, Ansible, source control, code review, and CI/CD platforms such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps.
* Mindset: Analytical, automation-oriented, and calm under pressure. Able to balance platform depth with cross-platform learning, communicate clearly during incidents, and work effectively in a 24x7 production reliability environment or on-call rotation.
* Cross-Platform Capability: Working knowledge of PostgreSQL & Oracle sufficient to troubleshoot common availability, performance, backup/recovery, security, and operational issues, and collaborate with platform specialists when deeper expertise is required.
* Engineering & Cloud Database Platforms: Experience with SQL Server in highly available and cloud-based architectures, including Azure SQL Managed Instance, Azure SQL Database, SQL Server on Azure VMs, and comparable enterprise database platforms is desirable.
* Cloud Platforms: Operational experience with at least one major cloud platform such as OCI, Azure, AWS, or GCP, including exposure to infrastructure-based and managed database services.
* Systems Fundamentals: Solid understanding of Linux and Windows fundamentals, networking, storage, authentication, encryption, and distributed-system failure modes as they relate to databases.
* Experience developing common operational patterns across heterogeneous database platforms.
* Experience with containerized or Kubernetes-based database-adjacent services and automation.
* Familiarity with AIOps, event correlation, predictive monitoring, or natural-language-assisted operational tooling.
* Experience leading database migrations, major upgrades, consolidation, or platform standardization initiatives.
* Relevant Oracle, Microsoft, PostgreSQL, cloud, SRE, or DevOps certifications.

description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**

At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-plus-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, advisory, and consulting groups as well as our enabling services functions. That’s why we continually invest in innovation, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

As a **MSFT AI Business Solutions****Technical** team member in **Crowe’s Consulting Practice**, your role will be focused on helping clients resolve business needs through analyzing data along with defining, crafting, developing, and implementing business and technology solutions. At Crowe, we empower you to take risks, challenge yourself in specialized areas of consulting & technology, and generate solutions that impact the firm and your professional growth. Crowe cultivates a creative corporate culture where you will have the opportunity to share your ideas and knowledge with clients from your very first day with the firm.

Help clients improve performance and efficiency across a broad array of issues across financial management, operational efficiency and information technology by implementing Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) technology. You will be part of the team that assists with the design and development of cloud application features, architects’ infrastructure for cloud and hybrid environments, and configures integrations between enterprise systems using Azure services. ERP is integrated business management software used to collect, store, manage and analyze data from many business activities. Crowe has been successful in building ERP solutions across organizations varying in size, complexity, and industry.

**Skills and Requirements:**

* Assist clients with the implementation of technology as they transform their business.
* Enhance governance, identify risks, and support compliance through system implementation and/or enhancement.
* Assist clients with technology-enabled process improvement and help them refine their information security environment.
* Develop, implement, support, and deliver existing Crowe technology solutions and play a key role through innovation.
* Assist clients by understanding their business processes and corresponding technical requirements in the areas of system integration, business intelligence, enhancement design and development, and by providing technical client training.
* Develop and extend core ERP functionality, while providing hands-on support for clients, integrating with third-party applications and building apps.
* Assist in the execution of cloud adoption plans, configure integrations between enterprise systems using Azure services, integrate iOT on Azure, and implement multi factor security and identity management solutions.
* Focus knowledge building on specific ERP technologies, such as D365, NetSuite and Salesforce.
* Provide custom development, when needed.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to troubleshoot and identify root cause and resolve issues.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Ability to effectively simplify and communicate complex concepts to stakeholders.
* Ability to work collaboratively across skillsets and geographies. Strong interpersonal skills and team building
* Ability to adapt to changing priorities and work in a fast-paced environment. Willingness to learn new technologies and continuously upskill
* Willingness to travel 75% or more annually
* Experience in data mapping and validation to ensure data integrity and accuracy.

**Education:**

We are seeking college seniors or graduate students to complete their studies in the coming year and are pursuing academic degrees in one of the following preferred majors (or similar background).

* Audit or Business Administration paired with Information Systems/Information Technology focus
* Computer Science
* Management Information Systems or Technology
* Supply Chain
* Computer Engineering
* Software Engineering

What It Means to Be a Consultant at Crowe: Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. title: Software Dev Engineer II
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Customer Service handles hundreds of millions of customer contacts each year across every Amazon business. Our Associate Experience Technology (AE-Tech) organization owns the products, platforms, and AI systems that determine how Customer Service Associates (CSAs) handle contacts, compose responses, wrap up interactions, and collaborate with AI—across every contact channel worldwide.  
The Opportunity  
Within AE-Tech, our team owns the end-to-end associate-facing tools, workflows, and AI capabilities that power how CSAs interact with customers across contact channels. Our charter spans five high-impact workstreams:  
  
Email Contact Channel & Systems — End-to-end ownership of the Email contact channel, one of the highest-volume and most complex channels in Amazon Customer Service—encompassing email ingestion, routing, associate-facing workflows, response management, and channel-level performance optimization  
  
Contact Handling & Composition Tools — The systems associates use to handle and respond to customer contacts, including Email Composer, After Contact Work (ACW), annotation systems, and order selection workflows  
  
Wrap-up Automation & Contact Lifecycle — Intelligent automation that streamlines post-contact workflows, reduces manual documentation burden, and accelerates wrap-up to improve Average Contact Handle Time (ACHT)  
  
GenAI-Powered Customer Service — AI-assisted composition, automated response generation, intelligent summarization, and full contact automation powered by Large Language Models and Generative AI  
  
Native Widget Experiences — Modern, performant native widgets that replace legacy page-based experiences, delivering faster and more intuitive tooling for associates across all contact channels  
  
We are investing deeply in transforming the associate experience through AI and automation. Our team has already automated a meaningful percentage of contacts and delivered millions in annualized cost savings, and we are just getting started. The opportunity ahead includes scaling automation across channels, building next-generation GenAI-powered tools, and creating intelligent workflows that make every associate more effective.  
This is a high-impact, hands-on engineering role. You will own the design, implementation, and delivery of key features and services across these workstreams—writing production code, building scalable systems, and contributing to the tools and platforms that hundreds of thousands of associates use every day to serve Amazon customers worldwide.  
What You’ll Do  
As a Software Development Engineer within AE-Tech, you will be a core builder on the team—taking ownership of features and components, delivering high-quality code, and contributing to system design decisions. You will work at the intersection of associate experience, Generative AI, and operational efficiency—collaborating with senior engineers, SDMs, Product Managers, Applied Scientists, and Business Intelligence Engineers across India and North America to deliver systems that improve associate effectiveness and customer satisfaction at global scale.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Design, build, and deliver features across the Email contact channel and associate-facing systems — own end-to-end feature delivery for email contact handling workflows, Email Composer, ACW, Wrap-up Automation, annotation systems, and native widget experiences, from design through production deployment
* Contribute to GenAI-powered capabilities — implement AI-assisted composition, automated response generation, and intelligent summarization features by integrating LLMs, building prompt pipelines, and developing model orchestration components
* Build and maintain scalable, reliable services — write clean, well-tested, production-quality code; design APIs, data models, and service interfaces that meet performance, scalability, and reliability requirements across the Email channel and broader AE-Tech systems
* Deliver native widget experiences — contribute to the migration from legacy page-based tools to modern, high-performance native widgets that improve associate efficiency and reduce latency across contact channels
* Own operational excellence for your services — monitor, alarm, troubleshoot, and resolve production issues; participate in on-call rotations and drive root-cause analysis and corrective actions
* Participate in and contribute to technical design — author design documents for your features, participate in team design reviews, and provide constructive feedback in code reviews to improve overall code quality
* Collaborate effectively across teams — work with AE-Tech and partner teams (Routing, Quality, Applied Science, Operations) to understand requirements, resolve dependencies, and deliver integrated solutions
* Grow and help others grow — actively seek feedback, invest in your own technical development, and mentor junior engineers through code reviews, pairing sessions, and knowledge sharing

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
* • Exposure to Generative AI / Large Language Model (LLM) technologies, including prompt engineering, model integration, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), or AI-assisted application development
* • Experience designing and building data pipelines, event-driven architectures, or asynchronous processing systems
* • Familiarity with AWS services (e.g., Lambda, DynamoDB, Kinesis, S3, SQS, Step Functions, or equivalent)
* • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to author clear technical design documents and participate in design reviews
* • Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment and deliver results with minimal guidance
* • Experience mentoring junior engineers and contributing to a culture of engineering excellence

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Go-to-Market Global Operations, Sales Tools & Technologies Product Owner
description:
**Our Company:**

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.

**A) Who You’ll Work With**
===========================

On our team, we build and run the systems that help Teradata’s sellers, marketers, services teams, and partners win and serve customers. Salesforce is the system of record for our go-to-market engine, spanning accounts, opportunities, pipeline, forecasting, quoting, and customer engagement. You will own that platform as a product.

You will partner closely with Sales, Sales Operations and Revenue Operations, Marketing, Customer Success, Global Services, Finance, Legal and Privacy, and Technology Services platform administrators and developers. You will also work alongside other product owners on the Business Technology team to keep Salesforce integrated with the broader systems landscape, including Workday, CPQ, ERP/Finance, marketing automation, and learning systems. This position reports to the Senior Manager, Business Technology.

**B) What You’ll Do**
=====================

As the Salesforce Product Owner, you will translate business and user needs into clear, prioritized requirements, guide delivery in an agile model, and measure whether the platform is improving how Teradata sells and serves. Success means a Salesforce environment that is reliable, easy to use, well governed, and visibly tied to revenue and productivity outcomes.

Key responsibilities:

* Support the execution of the Salesforce product roadmap and backlog, prioritizing features, enhancements, and fixes based on business value, user impact, and risk.
* Write clear user stories and acceptance criteria; lead backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews, and daily scrums with platform admins, developers, and implementation partners.
* Own requirements across Salesforce clouds and capabilities in use (such as Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, CPQ, reporting and forecasting, and Agentforce/AI features), including release readiness and user acceptance testing.
* Own requirements for integrations with adjacent systems, including SSO (Microsoft Entra ID), Workday, CPQ, ERP/Finance, Microsoft 365 and Teams, marketing automation, and data platforms; coordinate design, testing, and release.
* Partner with Sales and Revenue Operations to streamline lead-to-cash and opportunity-to-quote processes, reducing manual effort and improving data quality and forecast accuracy.
* Define and maintain data standards, object and field governance, and metadata ownership; oversee data quality, deduplication, and hygiene for accounts, contacts, and opportunities.
* Drive adoption and governance of AI-enabled capabilities, including usage controls, cost tracking, and responsible-use guardrails.
* Build and track platform KPIs (user adoption, data quality, process cycle time, release quality, user satisfaction) and deliver reporting and dashboards to stakeholders and leadership.
* Run intake and triage for enhancement requests and incidents, manage the Salesforce vendor and implementation partner relationships, and publish release notes.
* Manage the Salesforce seasonal release cycle, evaluating new functionality and sequencing change to minimize disruption and maximize adoption.
* Partner with Legal, Privacy, Security, and Compliance to keep the platform aligned with data protection requirements, access controls, and regional obligations.
* Create admin and end-user enablement, and support change management and communications for platform updates.

**C) What Makes You a Qualified Candidate**
===========================================

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 4–6 years of experience in product ownership, business systems, or CRM, including at least 2 years owning, administering, or configuring Salesforce in an enterprise environment.
* Hands-on experience managing a product backlog and writing user stories in an agile/Scrum environment.
* Working knowledge of the Salesforce data model, declarative configuration (Flow, validation rules, permission sets), and integration patterns including REST/SOAP APIs, SSO/SAML, and middleware.
* Strong analytical skills; able to build Salesforce reports and dashboards, interpret pipeline and adoption data, and turn metrics into decisions.
* Proven stakeholder management across business, IT, and vendor teams, with the ability to balance competing priorities and say no with data.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including presenting to senior leaders.

**D) What You’ll Bring**
========================

* Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO), Professional Scrum Product Owner (PSPO), or similar certification.
* Salesforce certifications such as Administrator, Platform App Builder, Sales Cloud Consultant, or CPQ Specialist (strongly preferred).
* Experience with CRM implementations, migrations, or multi-org consolidation, and with quote-to-cash processes.
* Familiarity with AI and generative AI capabilities in CRM (such as Agentforce and Einstein), and interest in applying them responsibly.
* Experience with Jira, ServiceNow, and reporting tools such as Power BI or SQL.
* Understanding of data privacy requirements (e.g., GDPR) as they apply to customer and prospect data.
* Exposure to Workday, CPQ, ERP/Finance, or Microsoft 365 integrations.
* A customer- and seller-first, systems-oriented mindset, and the initiative to keep making the platform better. By owning Salesforce, you will directly shape how Teradata’s teams sell, serve, and succeed.

#LI-TC1

Why We Think You’ll Love Teradata We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are committed to actively working to foster an inclusive environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.

description:
**Job Summary**
---------------

We are seeking an Agentic Software Developer at MTS+ or equivalent scope to build intelligent automation for IOQ, AMD Fleet Services. This role will design and engineer agent-assisted workflows that improve alert intake, ticket triage, evidence collection, knowledge retrieval, procedure execution, operational reporting, and safe remediation across compute, storage, networking, identity, and cloud services. The developer will convert operational intent into reliable software. The focus is not on demonstrations alone, but on governed, observable, testable, and maintainable capabilities that operate within approved access, change, data-handling, and human-approval boundaries. development, fullstack delivery, infrastructure automation, and production operations discipline. You are fluent in Python and build production agentic systems with Google\'s Agent Development Kit (ADK), and you understand the fundamentals underneath the framework — context windows and context management, embeddings and retrieval, tool and function calling, structured output and schema enforcement, model failure modes, and evaluation methodology — well enough to debug behavior that a framework abstraction is hiding. You ship the whole path: the model and orchestration layer, the services and APIs around it, and the operator-facing interface where an L1/L2 engineer actually reviews evidence, approves an action, or overrides a recommendation. An agent nobody can inspect or interrupt is not a finished product. You design for deterministic outcomes where required, make uncertainty visible, and treat evaluation, telemetry, security, rollback, and human oversight as core product requirements — not follow-on work. You communicate effectively with L1/L2 operators, SREs, domain experts, architects, security teams, and service managers, translating recurring operational pain into scalable automation.Collaborates globally with IOQ operations, SRE Fleet Services engineering, platform, security, and architecture teams.Participates in production support and release validation for automation services as required

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

Architect and develop agentic workflows in Python using Google ADK — agents and sub-agents, tool definitions, session and state management, callbacks, multi-agent delegation, and artifact handling — packaged for repeatable, version-controlled deployment. • Build workflows for alert enrichment, Jira intake, classification, evidence collection, knowledge retrieval, recommended actions, handoff preparation, and operational reporting. • Integrate approved AI models and tools with monitoring, ticketing, documentation, inventory, and automation platforms through secure APIs and controlled service identities. • Engineer deterministic orchestration, validation rules, confidence handling, human approval gates, stop conditions, rollback, and audit trails for operational use cases. Fullstack Delivery • Design and build the fullstack surface for agentic services: backend APIs and service layer (FastAPI or equivalent), plus the operator-facing web application where approval gates, evidence review, override, and audit history are exposed. • Own the end-to-end path from data model and API contract through authentication, state management, front-end implementation, and deployment — including responsiveness, accessibility, and behavior under partial failure or streaming/long-running agent responses. Evaluation, Telemetry & Reliability • Develop evaluation suites using representative and historical incidents to measure accuracy, completeness, repeatability, safety, and escalation quality. • Implement telemetry for prompts, tool calls, latency, failures, costs, outcomes, user overrides, and operational impact while protecting confidential data. • Support production incidents involving agentic services and drive root-cause correction, reliability improvement, and reduction of false or inconsistent outcomes. Standards, Security & Enablement • Partner with L1/L2/L3 domain owners to codify SOPs and runbooks into reusable automation components without obscuring ownership or change-control requirements. • Create version-controlled software, prompts, policies, schemas, tests, deployment pipelines, documentation, and operational support procedures. • Apply secure software development practices, least privilege, secrets management, input/output validation, dependency controls, and appropriate data retention. • Establish reusable patterns for agent design, tool integration, evaluation, front-end operator experience, and production readiness across Fleet Services.

**Skill Requirements**
----------------------

Python (expert level). Strong software engineering experience in Python, including API development, type hints, asynchronous and concurrent systems, packaging, automated testing, and production support of services you wrote. • Google Agent Development Kit (ADK). Demonstrated experience building and shipping agents with ADK — agent and tool definition, session/state handling, callbacks, multi-agent orchestration, artifact management, and ADK\'s evaluation tooling. Be prepared to discuss a specific agent you built, what broke in production, and how you fixed it. • AI fundamentals. Working command of the mechanics beneath the frameworks: prompt and context construction, context-window and token budget management, embeddings and retrieval-augmented generation (chunking, indexing, retrieval quality), tool/function calling, structured output and schema validation, temperature and sampling behavior, hallucination and model failure modes, and how to design an evaluation that actually detects regression. • Fullstack engineering. End-to-end delivery of web applications: TypeScript/JavaScript with a modern front-end framework (React or equivalent), REST or GraphQL API design, authentication and authorization, relational and/or vector data stores, and deployment through CI/CD. You should be able to build the operator UI for your own agent without waiting on another team. • Enterprise integration. Experience integrating with platforms such as Jira, Confluence, Git, monitoring systems, automation controllers, or cloud services through authenticated APIs. • Secure AI application design. Strong understanding of prompt injection, privilege boundaries, secrets, data classification, auditability, model failure modes, and safe tool-execution patterns.

**Must Have Skill**
-------------------

Social Network Development,Network Automation

**Good to Have Skill**
----------------------

**Other Requirements**
----------------------

A second production language among Go, Java, C++, or Rust. • Broader agent-framework exposure (LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, MCP-based tool servers) and the judgment to explain where each fits relative to ADK. • Google Cloud AI stack beyond ADK — Vertex AI, Gemini APIs, Agent Engine, or comparable managed agent runtimes. • Infrastructure automation and configuration tooling such as Ansible, Terraform, shell, or CI/CD systems. • SRE practices: incident management, observability, runbooks, SLIs/SLOs, and production change control. • Ability to influence architecture across teams and communicate tradeoffs to both technical and operational stakeholders. • GPU/HPC infrastructure, Azure AI services, or on-premises model deployment.

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a highly motivated Product Stability Test - Staff Engineer to champion the system-level stability validation, debugging, and commercialization readiness for next-generation SoC and software platforms. * Drive system-level stability initiatives spanning Android, Linux, QNX, Hypervisor, and embedded software environments.
* Develop end-to-end validation strategies covering modem, cellular network, GNSS, IMS, connectivity, automotive interfaces, and cloud communication.

  + System hangs

  + Power and thermal anomalies

* Analyze QXDM logs, protocol traces, OS/kernel logs, and crash dumps.

**Automation & Data Analytics**

* Develop automation frameworks to improve stability testing efficiency, triage, and reporting.
* Enable AI-assisted and data-driven approaches for defect identification and coverage optimization.
* Build dashboards and metrics to monitor:
  + MTBF
  + Stability escapes
  + Defect aging
  + Test effectiveness
  + Commercialization readiness
* Champion continuous improvement through automation and analytics.

**Commercialization Readiness**

* Assess product readiness and provide recommendations for release decisions.
* Analyze customer-reported issues and incorporate learnings into validation strategies.
* Ensure field issues are reproduced, debugged, and resolved effectively.
* Minimize stability escapes and ensure customer satisfaction.

* Drive knowledge sharing and debugging best practices across teams.

Since our inception back in 2006, Navitas has grown to be an industry leader in the digital transformation space, and we’ve served as trusted advisors supporting our client base within the commercial, federal, and state and local markets.

Navitas is hiring a Staff Full-Stack Engineer whose main focus is the backend. You will report to the CTO and own the GraphQL API and domain services behind our apps and internal admin: customers, boxes, orders, subscriptions, billing, and warehouse operations. You'll also work across the stack, shipping web admin features and making changes in our iOS and Android apps when a feature needs them. This is Staff-level ownership of a production money path, not a ticket queue.

**What you'll do:**

* Design, build, and operate our TypeScript GraphQL and REST APIs, including schema design, resolvers, and access control
* Own persistence in PostgreSQL and Sequelize: models, migrations, performance, and transactional integrity for orders and billing
* Build background processing: BullMQ job queues, scheduled work, webhooks, and an outbox pattern for side effects
* Integrate and harden third-party systems for payments, tax, address validation, auth, and shipping
* Ship features in our Next.js admin app when operations needs them
* Carry features into the mobile apps when needed: update GraphQL queries, screens, and flows in our native iOS (Swift) and Android (Kotlin/Compose) apps, partnering with our mobile engineers
* Use AI coding agents and tools every day to design, write, test, and review code, and help shape how our team uses them
* Raise the quality bar through tests (unit, integration, Testcontainers), code review, and production debugging

* 8+ years building production software, most of it backend, including Staff-level ownership of a substantial domain
* Expert TypeScript/Node.js, with production GraphQL (Apollo or equivalent) and REST/webhooks
* PostgreSQL and an ORM (Sequelize or similar) used seriously in production, including migrations and query performance
* Job queues and async processing (BullMQ, Sidekiq, or equivalent)
* You've owned checkout, billing, subscriptions, or similarly unforgiving money flows: idempotency, retries, webhook reconciliation
* Comfortable shipping React/Next.js features end to end
* Comfortable working in a native mobile codebase (Swift or Kotlin) with AI tools. You don't need to be a mobile specialist, but a mobile change shouldn't be a blocker for you.
* Daily hands-on use of AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or similar), with a view on where they help and where they need guardrails
* Strong testing habits, and the judgment to fix a messy module without rewriting it
* Nice to have: Braintree, Avalara, Auth0, Zod, Sentry/pino, hexagonal or vertical-slice architecture, or logistics/subscription experience
* BS in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience

**Stack:** Node.js 24, TypeScript, Express 5, Apollo Server 5 · PostgreSQL 15, Sequelize 6, Zod · Redis, BullMQ · Jest, Testcontainers, Sentry · Auth0, Braintree, Avalara, GCP · Next.js 15, React 18, Apollo Client · iOS (Swift/UIKit), Android (Kotlin/Compose)

description:

Citrix Product Owner

  

*Job Description*

**Job Summary**
===============

The Citrix Product Owner is a position within the Charles River Laboratories Global Technology organization responsible for owning, governing, and continuously improving the enterprise Citrix service across virtual applications, virtual desktops, and secure remote access.

This role blends product ownership accountability with service management and project/program execution, ensuring Citrix capabilities are well-defined, prioritized, reliable, secure, and aligned with business requirements. The role serves as the central point of coordination between Citrix engineering and support teams, infrastructure, application owners, security, compliance, vendors, and business stakeholders.

The scope covers Citrix services supporting global business operations across data centers, branch offices, and public cloud environments. The Product Owner is accountable for service outcomes, roadmap, and priorities, with technical implementation and daily administration delivered through engineering and support teams.

**Duties and Responsibilities**
===============================

* Serve as the leader for the global Citrix service, accountable for its vision, business value, service performance, and continuous improvement.
* Define, maintain, and evolve the Citrix strategy and multi-year roadmap, balancing business requirements, user experience, security, cost, and technical feasibility.
* Act as the voice of the customer, translating business and application requirements into clear, prioritized capabilities for virtual application delivery, virtual desktops, and secure access.
* Own and actively manage the Citrix backlog, including service enhancements, recurring incident remediation, platform upgrades, automation, capacity improvements, and technical debt.
* Define the Citrix service catalog, supported use cases, service boundaries, ownership model, and support responsibilities across internal teams and external providers.
* Partner with Citrix architects, engineers, and application owners to establish platform standards, validate solution designs, and ensure applications are suitable for delivery through the Citrix environment.
* Govern the lifecycle of applicable Citrix components, including Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops, Citrix DaaS, Workspace, StoreFront, Delivery Controllers, Cloud Connectors, Virtual Delivery Agents, provisioning services, and NetScaler Gateway.
* Coordinate dependencies across compute, virtualization, storage, networking, identity, DNS, certificates, databases, endpoint devices, and public cloud services.
* Establish and review service-level objectives and SLAs for availability, support responsiveness, application access, session reliability, and user experience.
* Measure and report on service health, including login duration, application launch success, connection failures, session responsiveness, capacity utilization, incident trends, and user satisfaction.
* Partner with support and engineering teams to drive root-cause analysis and permanent resolution of recurring issues, including slow logins, profile failures, session disconnects, application launch failures, and performance degradation.
* Coordinate major incident escalations and stakeholder communications with incident management teams, ensuring business impact, restoration priorities, and follow-up actions are clearly understood.
* Own the planning and acceptance of Citrix upgrades, migrations, image releases, and service enhancements, with defined testing, business validation, change controls, and rollback criteria.
* Establish governance for desktop and application images, provisioning, profile management, Citrix policies, and application compatibility in partnership with the responsible technical teams.
* Drive proactive monitoring and automation opportunities, including health checks, provisioning workflows, image maintenance, capacity management, and repeatable support activities.
* Partner with Security and Identity teams to embed appropriate access controls, multifactor authentication, privileged access management, secure configuration, vulnerability remediation, and audit logging into the service.
* Ensure Citrix changes and operational practices meet applicable compliance, documentation, and validation requirements for regulated business processes.
* Partner with Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity teams to define Citrix recovery requirements, validate recovery dependencies, and demonstrate resilience through planned exercises.
* Be accountable for accurate service documentation, architecture records, operational runbooks, support procedures, knowledge articles, and recovery documentation.
* Own demand and capacity planning with business and infrastructure teams, ensuring the service can support expected concurrency, geographic requirements, and critical business periods.
* Partner with procurement, finance, and vendors to manage licensing requirements, renewals, support agreements, utilization, and service costs.
* Prioritize Citrix investments and tradeoffs to improve user productivity, reduce operational risk, and optimize total cost of ownership.
* Provide monthly program and service updates to the executive steering committee, covering performance, roadmap progress, risks, costs, and decisions required.
* Identify and manage risks, dependencies, and constraints, escalating decisions that affect service availability, security, user experience, or business continuity.
* Incorporate feedback from users, incidents, monitoring, audits, and vendors into continuous service improvement.

* Agile self-determination, trust, transparency, and open collaboration
* All Support needed for the realization of business goals,
* Stable employment with a great atmosphere and ethical corporate culture
