title: Backend and Full-Stack Engineer
description:
**About the Role**

We’re building AI-powered smart devices and connected-home experiences used by millions of people. As a Backend and Full-Stack Engineer, you’ll design and ship the services, APIs and web and app interfaces that connect devices, cloud and AI. You’ll work with Python and Node.js, collaborating closely with AI, firmware, mobile and QA teams to deliver fast, reliable and secure products at scale.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, build and maintain scalable backend services and REST/WebSocket APIs using Python and Node.js
* Develop full-stack features, including responsive web dashboards and admin tools, using modern frontend frameworks
* Integrate AI services such as LLM APIs, speech and vision pipelines, and vector databases into production systems
* Build secure device-to-cloud communication for pairing, media upload, settings sync and over-the-air updates
* Design efficient database schemas and optimize queries across SQL and NoSQL stores
* Write clean, tested and well-documented code; take part in code reviews
* Set up CI/CD, monitoring, logging and alerting with the DevOps team
* Troubleshoot production issues and improve performance, reliability and cost
* Follow best practices for data privacy and security, since our products handle sensitive audio and camera data

**Required Skills**

* 3+ years of hands-on backend development in
  **Python**
  (FastAPI, Django or Flask) and
  **Node.js**
  (Express or NestJS)
* Strong fundamentals in data structures, algorithms and system design
* Experience building and consuming REST APIs; familiarity with WebSockets or event-driven systems
* Frontend experience with
  **React**
  (or similar), along with HTML, CSS and JavaScript/TypeScript
* Solid knowledge of databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL, plus MongoDB or Redis
* Working knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, GCP or Azure), Docker and Git
* Understanding of authentication and authorization (OAuth, JWT) and API security

**Good to Have**

* Experience integrating LLM APIs, prompt and context handling, or RAG pipelines
* Exposure to IoT or device-connected systems, MQTT or Bluetooth/Wi-Fi onboarding flows
* Kubernetes, message queues (Kafka, RabbitMQ) and infrastructure-as-code
* Experience with multilingual applications or speech and media processing
* Familiarity with automated testing (Pytest, Jest) and observability tools

title: ELCHEMY - Senior Full Stack Software Developer - Python/Django
description: About ElchemyElchemy is a tech-enabled, cross-border specialty chemicals distribution platform helping companies across the US and Europe source high-quality chemical raw materials from trusted manufacturers across Southeast Asia and beyond. We operate at the intersection of discovery, quality assurance, and fulfillment, simplifying what has traditionally been a fragmented and opaque procurement process. By combining deep industry expertise with a technology-first approach, we enable faster sourcing, greater reliability, and scalable global supply chains for our customers.In just 4 years of operations, Elchemy has scaled rapidly, serving customers in over 55 countries and building active partnerships with 200+ suppliers across more than 15 manufacturing geographies. Our platform supports a wide range of specialty chemical applications, helping businesses access the right materials with confidence and speed. Our vision is to build the world's largest global specialty chemicals distributor, reimagining the industry through technology-led discovery, seamless fulfillment, and data-driven decision-making.Elchemy is backed by marquee investors and has raised over $7.5 million to date. Our team brings together alumni from IITs, IIMs, and NITs, along with professionals who have built and scaled startups and worked across global multinational organizations. We are here to fundamentally transform the $800B specialty chemicals industry - making it more transparent, efficient, and globally connected through new-age technology.We are seeking talented software developers who are passionate about coding and building and scaling products. If you love taking on new challenges and have a problem solving mindset to solve problems through code, you will be a perfect fit for our rockstar engineering team.Roles And Responsibilities Design and develop backend architectures to support robust, scalable, and secure web applications and systems with a focus on backend development using Django. Design, implement and maintain high quality RESTful APIs to support seamless communication between frontend, backend and other services. Design, implement, and maintain database schemas. Ensure the integrity, performance, and security of data. Ensure the scalability and reliability of our backend infrastructure on AWS. Ensure reliable management of infrastructure on cloud aiming for 0 downtime of systems. Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code, while adhering to best practices and industry standards. Develop and maintain documentation for our backend systems, APIs, and data models. Conduct high quality code reviews and provide feedback to other team members to ensure best practices are adhered to. Take ownership of the development, testing, and deployment of web applications. Break down high-level business problems into smaller chunks and build systems. Work closely with the frontend development team, product managers, and designers to plan new features and optimize existing ones. Constantly aim to improve performance and optimize systems by identifying bottlenecks and resolving them for increased efficiency. Stay up-to-date with the latest technologies such as LLMs, and implement them as and when required.Skills And Qualification Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a related field. 5+ years of experience in full-stack web development, with a focus on backend development. Strong proficiency in Python and Django, including experience with Django Rest Framework. Experience working with SQL/PostgreSQL databases, including schema design, querying, and optimization. Proficiency in AWS services such as EC2, RDS, S3, and Lambda. Familiarity of integrations with third party services and open source frameworks. Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, and software design patterns. Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes is a plus. Familiarity with LLM frameworks such as Langchain, OpenAI, Anthropic, LLaMa is a plus. Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work in a fast-paced environment. Excellent communication and collaboration skills.(ref:hirist.tech)

* Understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and adherence to resiliency and security expectations; ability to guide peers on safe and effective usage within team practices

**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* DevOps practices — Production monitoring, alerting, and reliability practices. C I/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker), orchestration (Kubernetes), and infrastructure as code.

title: Node js developer
description:
We are looking for an experienced Node.js Backend Developer to develop, maintain and enhance the backend systems of our websites and mobile applications.

The candidate should have strong hands-on experience in Node.js, MongoDB, REST APIs, backend architecture, third-party integrations and production application maintenance.

This is a long-term, part-time/freelance opportunity for a developer who can independently manage backend development, implement new features, resolve bugs and collaborate with our frontend and DevOps teams.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop, maintain and enhance backend applications using Node.js.
* Design, develop and maintain RESTful APIs for websites and mobile applications.
* Manage MongoDB databases, including schema design, queries, indexing and performance optimisation.
* Integrate backend APIs with web and mobile applications.
* Implement secure authentication and authorisation using JWT, OAuth or equivalent technologies.
* Integrate third-party APIs, payment gateways, notification services and other external systems.
* Identify and resolve bugs, production issues and backend performance bottlenecks.
* Implement input validation, error handling, logging and API security measures.
* Write clean, reusable, scalable and well-documented code.
* Manage source code using Git and GitHub.
* Collaborate with frontend developers and the DevOps engineer for application releases and production deployments.
* Support existing applications, implement new features and improve backend reliability.
* Follow secure coding practices to protect source code, credentials and sensitive application data.

Required Skills and Qualifications

* Minimum 4–5 years of hands-on experience in Node.js backend development.
* Strong proficiency in JavaScript and asynchronous programming.
* Experience with Express.js or NestJS.
* Strong knowledge of MongoDB, Mongoose and database optimisation.
* Proven experience designing and developing REST APIs.
* Knowledge of authentication, authorisation, API security and access control.
* Experience with Git, GitHub, debugging and production issue resolution.
* Understanding of application architecture, environment configuration and server-side troubleshooting.
* Experience integrating third-party APIs and external services.
* Ability to work independently and deliver tasks within agreed timelines.

Preferred Skills

* Experience working with React-based frontends and mobile applications.
* Familiarity with AWS, Docker, Nginx and deployment workflows.
* Experience with Redis, caching, background jobs and queues.
* Knowledge of automated testing and API documentation using Swagger/OpenAPI.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and production application monitoring.

Engagement Details

* Part-time, freelance or contract-based engagement.
* Remote working opportunity across India.
* Flexible working hours with mutually agreed weekly availability.
* Long-term engagement opportunity based on performance and business requirements.
* Collaboration with the existing technology team, including frontend and DevOps resources.

Application Process

Interested candidates should share their updated resume or LinkedIn profile along with:

* Total years of Node.js development experience.
* Experience with MongoDB and REST API development.
* Examples of backend applications or mobile application APIs developed.
* Experience with production applications and third-party integrations.
* Current availability and preferred engagement model.
* Expected professional fee or monthly retainer.

**Preference will be given to candidates who have independently developed and maintained production-grade backend systems for websites and mobile applications.**

Pay: ₹14,000.00 - ₹66,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Backend Developer
description:
**Job Summary**

Ansu Trade and Fiscals Pvt. Ltd. is looking for an experienced Senior Backend Developer to develop, maintain, and optimize backend services for its loan application platform. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in PHP 8.4, PostgreSQL, and REST API development, along with knowledge of Redis, Docker, Nginx, and AWS ECS.

**Location:** Borivali East, Mumbai  
**Experience:** 5–9 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Industry:** NBFC / Financial Services

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, test, and maintain backend services for the loan application platform.
* Develop and maintain RESTful APIs for web and mobile applications.
* Implement backend workflows for customer onboarding, loan applications, approvals, disbursements, repayments, and payment processing.
* Write clean, efficient, and maintainable PHP code using strict typing.
* Design and optimize PostgreSQL database schemas, SQL queries, indexes, and relationships.
* Implement caching and background-job processing using Redis.
* Integrate third-party APIs and financial service providers.
* Ensure application security and protection of customer and financial data.
* Troubleshoot backend, API, database, and production issues.
* Optimize application performance, reliability, and scalability.
* Work with Docker, Nginx, and AWS ECS for deployment and operations.
* Maintain code quality and version control using Git and GitHub.
* Collaborate with frontend and mobile developers for seamless API integration.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Strong proficiency in **PHP 8.4 with strict types**.
* Hands-on experience with **PostgreSQL and SQL**.
* Expertise in RESTful API development.
* Knowledge of Redis for caching and background jobs.
* Familiarity with Docker, Nginx, and AWS ECS.
* Hands-on experience with Git and GitHub.
* Understanding of backend architecture, database design, and query optimization.

**Preferred Skills**

* Knowledge of API authentication, authorization, and data protection.

title: Senior MTO Product & Platform Lead
description:
Job Description – Senior MTO Product & Platform Lead

**(Monitoring, Telemetry, Observability & Reliability Engineering)**

**Location:** Mumbai / Global Engagement  
**Experience:** 15+ Years (Preferred)  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Role Category:** IT Infrastructure / Cloud / Platform Engineering / Technology Leadership

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced **Senior MTO Product & Platform Lead** to drive the strategy, roadmap, architecture, governance and evolution of the enterprise Monitoring, Telemetry & Observability (MTO) ecosystem.

The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in enterprise-scale observability platforms, product and platform ownership, telemetry pipeline architecture, cloud monitoring and reliability engineering.

This is a strategic leadership position requiring expertise in managing multiple observability platforms, leading global transformation programmes, optimising technology costs and engaging with senior business and technology stakeholders.

The successful candidate will be responsible for establishing a unified observability strategy, improving platform adoption, standardising telemetry practices and ensuring the reliability, scalability and cost-effectiveness of enterprise monitoring solutions.

**This is a strategic product and platform leadership role, not a tool administration or individual-product SME position.**

Key Responsibilities

* Own and drive the enterprise-wide MTO product vision, strategy, roadmap and operating model.
* Lead the architecture, governance and continuous evolution of enterprise observability platforms.
* Manage and optimise platforms including Splunk Enterprise/Cloud, AppDynamics, SolarWinds, Cribl Stream, Cribl Edge and OpenTelemetry.
* Establish enterprise-wide standards for logs, metrics, traces and events across applications, infrastructure, networks and cloud environments.
* Design and govern enterprise telemetry pipelines, including data collection, routing, filtering, enrichment, processing and distribution.
* Drive observability adoption across AWS, Azure, Kubernetes, containerised applications and cloud-native environments.
* Lead platform modernisation, consolidation, standardisation and enterprise transformation initiatives.
* Establish platform governance frameworks, onboarding standards and operational best practices.
* Drive licence optimisation, telemetry consumption governance, platform utilisation and cost management.
* Implement and mature Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices, including Service Level Indicators (SLIs), Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and error budgets.
* Improve distributed tracing, service dependency mapping and end-to-end application visibility.
* Manage vendor relationships, technology partners, service providers and platform performance.
* Collaborate with enterprise architects, engineering teams, infrastructure operations and senior leadership.
* Define platform maturity assessments, technology roadmaps, architecture standards and innovation recommendations.
* Identify opportunities for automation, AIOps and AI-assisted operations to improve operational efficiency.

Mandatory Skills & Experience

**1. Product & Platform Leadership**

* Strong experience in enterprise product and platform ownership.
* Expertise in technology strategy, roadmap development and investment planning.
* Experience managing global platforms and large-scale transformation programmes.
* Ability to define platform operating models, governance structures and technology standards.
* Strong executive stakeholder management, vendor governance and cross-functional leadership skills.
* Experience managing platform budgets, technology investments and financial optimisation.

**2. Observability & Monitoring Technologies**

Strong enterprise-level knowledge and experience across the following platforms:

* **Splunk Enterprise / Splunk Cloud:** Platform governance, data ingestion, indexing, search optimisation, monitoring and licence management.
* **AppDynamics:** Application performance monitoring, transaction monitoring and application health management.
* **SolarWinds:** Infrastructure, server and network monitoring.
* **Cribl Stream & Cribl Edge:** Telemetry collection, processing, routing, filtering, enrichment and pipeline optimisation.
* **OpenTelemetry:** Instrumentation standards, telemetry collection, distributed tracing and vendor-neutral observability.
* **ServiceNow Integrations:** Event management, incident management, alert correlation and IT service management workflows.
* **AWS & Azure:** Cloud infrastructure monitoring, cloud-native observability and hybrid-cloud monitoring.
* **Kubernetes:** Container monitoring, cluster visibility, microservices observability and cloud-native application monitoring.

**3. Telemetry & Enterprise Architecture**

* Strong understanding of logs, metrics, traces and events.
* Experience designing enterprise telemetry pipeline architecture.
* Expertise in distributed tracing and service dependency mapping.
* Knowledge of telemetry data routing, filtering, enrichment and lifecycle management.
* Experience with multi-platform data distribution and integration.
* Ability to establish enterprise observability architecture and standardisation frameworks.
* Understanding of telemetry governance, data quality, retention and consumption management.

**4. Reliability Engineering & SRE**

* Strong understanding of Site Reliability Engineering and reliability engineering practices.
* Experience implementing SLIs, SLOs and error budget frameworks.
* Knowledge of service availability, resilience, incident management and operational excellence.
* Experience improving application and infrastructure reliability.
* Exposure to AIOps, automation, intelligent alerting and AI-assisted operations.
* Ability to drive continuous improvement in service performance and operational efficiency.

Preferred Experience

* Experience leading enterprise-wide observability and monitoring transformation programmes.
* Global product and platform ownership within large or regulated enterprises.
* Experience in pharmaceutical, healthcare or life sciences environments.
* Experience establishing Observability Centres of Excellence (CoE).
* Expertise in platform rationalisation, technology modernisation and cost optimisation.
* Experience managing global engineering teams, technology vendors and strategic partners.
* Exposure to enterprise cloud transformation and modern distributed application architectures.

Key Deliverables & Expected Outcomes

* Define and execute the enterprise MTO strategy, product vision and technology roadmap.
* Improve observability coverage and platform adoption across applications, infrastructure, cloud and network environments.
* Establish standardised telemetry architecture, governance and onboarding practices.
* Deliver measurable reductions in telemetry ingestion, storage and licensing costs.
* Improve reliability engineering maturity through SRE practices and standardised service-level objectives.
* Drive platform consolidation, integration, modernisation and future-state architecture recommendations.
* Strengthen vendor governance, operational performance and technology innovation.
* Develop platform capabilities and enable knowledge transfer across engineering and operations teams.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for a strategic technology leader who combines **enterprise product ownership, platform strategy, observability architecture, telemetry engineering, financial governance and executive stakeholder management**.

The ideal candidate should have successfully led global observability transformation programmes and managed multiple enterprise monitoring platforms. They should be capable of connecting business requirements with technology strategy, influencing senior stakeholders and delivering measurable improvements in platform performance, reliability, governance and cost efficiency.

Candidates with broad enterprise-level experience across Splunk, AppDynamics, SolarWinds, Cribl, OpenTelemetry and cloud-native monitoring platforms will be strongly preferred.

**Important:** Candidates whose experience is primarily limited to tool administration, dashboard development, individual-product support or L1/L2 monitoring operations will not be the primary target profile. We are specifically looking for an experienced product and platform leader with enterprise-wide ownership and strategic transformation experience.

* Hands-on experience with both white-box and black-box testing.

title: Senior Data Engineer - Vice President
description:
**Job Overview**
----------------

  
  

**Job Description**

Finance Technology is looking for a hands-on senior data engineering technical lead who is passionate about solving complex business problems through innovation and engineering excellence. In this role, you will use deep technical expertise to set the technical direction for, design, and personally build a scalable, high-quality, data-intensive platform. The platform uses modern methodologies such as Data Virtualization, Data Domains, and Data Mesh. You will be a technical leader and force multiplier for the engineering team. You will remain deeply hands-on in architecture, design, code, and production support, and you will mentor engineers, raise engineering standards, and partner with business, architecture, and control-function stakeholders. The ideal candidate has a strong foundation in data engineering principles, broad experience across batch and real-time data pipelines, and a proven record of optimizing and scaling data processing and analytics solutions in a regulated enterprise environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the design and hands-on development of scalable, resilient, and secure data pipelines and platform components that support Finance business and regulatory use cases.
* Define and drive the technical architecture and roadmap for data virtualization, data federation, and domain-oriented data products. Make and document key design decisions and trade-offs.
* Act as the technical authority for the team. Conduct design and code reviews, set engineering standards, and champion best practices in testing, CI/CD, observability, and automation.
* Mentor and coach senior and junior engineers, and help grow technical capability across the team.
* Partner with Finance product owners, architects, data governance, risk, and control functions to translate business requirements into technical solutions. Ensure data quality, lineage, and regulatory compliance.
* Lead the diagnosis and resolution of complex performance, scalability, and production issues. Drive root-cause analysis and long-term remediation.
* Evaluate emerging technologies, including AI agents and MCP-based tooling. Lead proofs of concept and drive adoption where they add measurable value.
* Contribute to agile planning and estimation, and help manage technical risk, dependencies, and delivery across multiple workstreams.

**Qualifications:**

**Core Data Engineering Skills**

* 10+ years of overall experience in Big Data or enterprise large-scale application development using scalable tools such as Databricks, Scala, Java, and the Python ecosystem.
* 7+ years of relevant experience in technology, designing and delivering data-intensive solutions using agile methodologies.
* Demonstrated experience as a technical lead or senior individual contributor. This includes leading the end-to-end design and delivery of complex, multi-team data platforms or programs while staying hands-on.
* Expert-level understanding of data modeling, data warehousing concepts, methodologies, and best practices, with the ability to set standards and guide others.
* Strong experience with data processing (e.g., Spark, Starburst, Snowflake, Redshift), storage (e.g., Hadoop, MongoDB, Oracle), and ETL (e.g., Airflow, Ab Initio, Talend) solutions.
* Experience with data engineering techniques such as building data lakes and data warehouses, data mesh architectures, data pipelines, and ETL vs. ELT patterns, including architecting these at enterprise scale.
* Deep expertise in Starburst/Trino, with a thorough understanding of data federation and data virtualization architectures. This includes query optimization, cluster tuning, connector design, security and access control, and performance at scale.
* Experience with real-time and streaming data processing and data virtualization technologies such as Starburst, Snowflake, and Flink (preferred).
* Proven experience designing, developing, and operating distributed systems that handle structured and unstructured data for storage, analysis, and reporting.
* Experience developing and maintaining large and complex database systems using relational databases such as Oracle, and big data technologies such as Hadoop and Spark.
* Advanced proficiency in PL/SQL and Unix Shell scripting. Strong SQL, PL/SQL development, and database performance tuning experience.
* Experience designing Online Transaction Processing (OLTP), Operational Data Store (ODS), and Data Warehouse applications.
* Strong experience implementing Data Quality, data lineage, and data governance frameworks in a regulated environment.
* Strong knowledge of software engineering best practices, including CI/CD, automated testing, source control, infrastructure-as-code, and observability.
* Experience with cloud-based data platforms and with application and data security, resiliency, and disaster recovery (preferred).
* Experience in financial services or Finance technology (preferred).

**AI Agents, Orchestration & Applied AI**

* Demonstrable experience designing, developing, and integrating AI Agents into data engineering workflows and software systems, with the ability to lead adoption and set patterns for the broader team.
* Practical, hands-on knowledge of Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, including: Setting up, configuring, and securing MCP servers to expose data tools, database connections, and APIs as contextual resources for LLM-powered agents.
* Solid understanding of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) principles, including vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, ChromaDB) and advanced retrieval techniques for grounding agents in enterprise data.
* Working knowledge of Large Language Models (LLMs) (e.g., OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, Llama) and their practical application in data engineering. Examples include automated schema inference, natural language querying, and intelligent data cataloging. This includes the ability to evaluate their risks, limitations, and fit for regulated use cases.

**Leadership & Collaboration**

* Proven ability to influence technical direction across teams and communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including senior management.
* Track record of mentoring engineers and raising the technical bar of a team.
* Ability to balance hands-on delivery with technical strategy, prioritization, and risk management in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with a bias toward ownership and delivery.

**Education:**

* Bachelor's degree/University degree or equivalent experience

title: Data Engineer II
description:
Nium provides global infrastructure for real-time cross-border payments. We were founded on the mission to deliver the global payments infrastructure of tomorrow, today. Our platform enables banks, fintechs, and global businesses to move money instantly, everywhere.

Co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore with offices in 14 markets worldwide, we are entering one of the most exciting chapters in our journey. In March 2026, we delivered the largest month in our 11-year history with record revenue, record volumes, and EBITDA profitability. Today, Nium moves nearly $60B in payments annually, almost entirely for enterprises, while continuing to strengthen an already healthy balance sheet.

It is an incredible time to join us, and we are only just getting started.

Our payout network spans 190+ countries and 100 currencies, with 100 + corridors in real time. We power seamless transfers to accounts, wallets, and cards, support local collections in 35 markets, and as a principal card issuer on Visa, Mastercard, Discover, and UATP, Nium issues over 50 million card tokens every year. Backed by regulatory licenses in 40+ markets, we make it simple for our partners to onboard, integrate, and scale globally. This scale and innovation have earned us recognition as one of CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025, winner of Best Cross-Border Payments Solution at the PayTech Awards, and inclusion in FXC Intelligence’s Top 100 Cross-Border Payments Companies list.

In 2024, we raised US$50 million in Series E funding at a US$1.4 billion valuation to accelerate network expansion, product innovation, and talent growth. With the B2B payments market projected to hit US$175 trillion by 2030, Nium offers ambitious builders the chance to shape the future of global money movement with the scale of a leader and the energy of a high-growth company.

**The Role**

At Nium, we’re revolutionising the global payments industry — and data sits at the core of everything we do. We’re looking for a **passionate and skilled Data Engineer** to join our India-based Data Engineering team.

This is more than a purely technical role. You’ll help shape the future of our data platform as we migrate from on-premises systems to **AWS cloud**. You’ll work hands-on with modern tools such as **Airflow, Redshift, dbt**, and **Kafka**, collaborating closely with product, engineering, analytics, and business teams to deliver high-quality, scalable data solutions that power real-world payments and enable data-driven decision-making.

You’ll have the opportunity to contribute to high-impact projects, solve complex technical problems, and work on a platform that supports millions of users globally. If you’re motivated by learning, collaboration, and building resilient data platforms at scale, this role offers a strong opportunity for growth.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Build and optimise **scalable**, **maintainable**, and **high-performance data pipelines** and workflows.
* Ingest, transform, and deliver high-volume data from a range of structured and unstructured sources, including **MySQL** databases and **real-time Kafka** streams.
* Design and maintain performant data models in Redshift, and optimise SQL queries to support analytics and reporting workloads.
* Contribute to our **cloud migration journey** and help evolve the data architecture with new ideas and improvements.
* Collaborate with cross-functional, globally distributed teams to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions.
* Embed **data quality, reliability, observability,** and **security** as first-class principles across the data platform.
* Support and enhance data solutions operating in a mission-critical payments environment.
* Continuously learn, share knowledge, and help raise standards across data governance, quality, and security practices.

### **Requirements**

* **2–3 years of professional experience** in Data Engineering or a related role.
* **Strong SQL expertise**, including query optimisation, complex transformations, and **datamodelling**.
* Solid **Python** skills for data engineering and pipeline development.
* Hands-on experience with **AWS services** such as Redshift, Lambda, Glue, and S3, as well as Airflow for orchestration.
* Familiarity with modern transformation and modelling practices using tools such as dbt.
* A collaborative mindset, strong problem-solving skills, critical thinking, and a willingness to take ownership and initiative.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience contributing to **large-scale cloud migration** initiatives.
* Knowledge of **real-time data streaming** using Kafka.
* Exposure to **CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code** for data platforms.
* Interest in exploring AI/ML use cases within modern data ecosystems.
* Understanding of the payments domain or fintech data challenges.

**What we offer at Nium**

**We Value Performance:** Through competitive salaries, performance bonuses, sales commissions, equity for specific roles and recognition programs, we ensure that all our employees are well rewarded and incentivized for their hard work.

**We Care for Our Employees:** The wellness of Nium’ers is our #1 priority. We offer medical coverage along with 24/7 employee assistance program, generous vacation programs including our discretionary year-end shut down (dependant on company OKRs). We also provide a flexible working hybrid working environment (3 days per week in the office).

**We Upskill Ourselves:** We are curious, and always want to learn more with a focus on upskilling ourselves. We provide role-specific training, internal workshops, and a learning stipend.

**We Celebrate Together:** We recognize that work is also about creating great relationships with each other. We celebrate together with company-wide social events, team bonding activities, happy hours, team offsites, and much more!

**We Thrive with Diversity:** Nium is truly a global company, with more than 33 nationalities, based in 18+ countries and more than 10 office locations. As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to providing a safe and welcoming environment for everyone.

  

**Beware of recruitment scams:** Be cautious of individuals impersonating Nium via WhatsApp, social media, email or unofficial websites. **Do not respond, share personal or financial information, or make any payments**. Nium will never ask candidates to transfer money or cryptocurrency as part of our recruitment process.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Birdeye builds AI coworkers for multi-location brands. They run on BirdAI, the Agent OS built on 13 years of multi-location data infrastructure and 3,000+ integrations. G2 ranks Birdeye #1 in Enterprise Multi-Location Marketing Platforms and named it to the 2026 Best Agentic AI Products list. Learn more at birdeye.com.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) for AI Voice Agents, you will play a critical role in deploying, building, updating, and optimizing production-grade voice agents for local businesses. You will work closely with product, engineering, and client teams to integrate telephony and AI pipelines, customize agent workflows, and debug agentic behaviors to ensure low-latency, human-like conversational experiences.
  
  
**What You Will Own**

* Voice Agent Deployment & Customization: Build, configure, and update AI voice agents for real-time conversations across multiple verticals, tailoring prompts, tool calls, and workflows to meet specific client needs.
* API & System Integrations: Integrate STT/TTS pipelines, telephony systems (Twilio, SIP, Voice APIs), and third-party CRMs/PMS systems to enable seamless data synchronization and appointment booking.
* Agentic Optimization & Debugging: Monitor, debug, and optimize agentic behaviors, prompt performance, and inference latency to ensure high reliability and smooth conversational flows.
* Cross-functional Deployment: Partner with engineering and customer success teams to onboard clients, troubleshoot technical hurdles, and feed production insights back into core agent platforms.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Smooth, rapid deployment and configuration of high-performing AI voice agents for incoming clients and verticals.
* Reliable, low-latency execution of voice workflows, telephony integrations, and API tool calls in production environments.
* Robust debugging, telemetry tracking, and continuous improvement of agent behavior and response quality.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 2–5 years of relevant hands-on software engineering experience, with strong proficiency in Python.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field from a Tier-1 college background (IIT/NIT/BITS only).
* Hands-on experience working with LLMs, generative AI, prompt engineering, and agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex).
* Practical familiarity with STT/TTS systems (e.g., OpenAI, Deepgram) and telephony/voice integrations (Twilio, SIP, Webhooks).
* Experience building and consuming REST APIs, asynchronous systems, and backend microservices using FastAPI or gRPC.
* Solid experience working with SQL and NoSQL databases, along with Docker containerization and cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure).

****These will help you succeed****

* Domain experience in vertical SaaS, healthcare, dental, home services, or automotive software.
* Strong problem-solving skills for debugging complex agentic workflows and multi-step tool calls.
* Excellent stakeholder engagement and communication skills for direct client collaboration and technical onboarding.

title: Data Scientist
description:
**About noon**

We are hiring a Data Scientist to help build the models and optimisation tools that run our fulfilment network, from large warehouses to small, fast-moving urban stores. This is a hands-on, independent role. You will own clearly scoped problems end to end, from understanding the data to building models and getting them into production with engineering and operations teams. As the business grows, you will take on bigger problems and more ownership.

Noon’s fastest hyper-local delivery platform, Noon Minutes, offers a localized assortment of FMCG & grocery products with delivery within 15-minutes. Currently live across the UAE and Saudi Arabia, offering thousands of products to customers in record time.

noon’s mission: Every door, every day.

**Role Overview**

You will help improve the core decisions that drive speed, cost and availability in fulfilment operations:

* Inventory accuracy: risk-based cycle counting and early detection of stock discrepancies.
* Space and layout: data-driven slotting and shelf/storage layout decisions.
* Picking and fulfilment efficiency: pick-path optimisation, batching and order-to- picker assignment.
* Workforce and task allocation: assigning tasks to people based on task type, skill and workload.
* Routing and dispatch: trip planning, order clubbing and route optimisation for fast delivery.
* Quality and exception control: using risk scores to decide where checks and audits add the most value.
* Turn operations problems into clear data science questions, working directly with operations and product teams to scope them.
* Explore and clean operational data, build features, and develop models such as risk scoring, anomaly detection and classification.
* Pick a sensible approach for each problem: statistical or machine learning models, basic optimisation (linear/integer programming, assignment, routing), or simple rules where they are enough
* Help replace hand-maintained business rules with models that adapt as volume, assortment and network change.
* Work with engineering to ship models as services or scheduled batch jobs.
* Build LLM-powered tools and simple agentic workflows where they help, such as summarising exceptions or answering operations queries.
* Set up and analyse A/B tests and pilots, and measure impact on metrics like inventory accuracy, pick time, cost per order and delivery time.
* Monitor models in production and flag drift or data quality issues.
* Share findings through clear dashboards and short write-ups, and explain results to operations and product teams in plain language.
* Write clean, documented, well-tested code that engineers can easily build on.

**Requirements:**

* 2–3 years of experience in data science, applied ML or advanced analytics, ideally with some work on e-commerce, supply chain, logistics or marketplace problems.
* At least one model you built and put into production largely on your own, that was used in real business decisions.
* Solid foundations in ML and statistics: regression, classification, tree-based models (XGBoost, LightGBM), clustering and model evaluation.
* Strong Python (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn) and SQL; comfortable with large datasets in a cloud data warehouse (BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift or similar).
* Working knowledge of experiment design: hypothesis testing, A/B tests and confidence intervals.
* Some exposure to optimisation tools like OR-Tools or PuLP, or a strong interest in learning them.
* Hands-on experience with LLM APIs (e.g. OpenAI GPT, Google Gemini), prompt design or basic RAG.
* Familiarity with Git and a basic understanding of how models are deployed (APIs, batch jobs, Docker).
* Self-driven and comfortable with messy data; able to work through problems independently and pick up new methods quickly.
* Clear communication: able to explain your work to non-technical teammates.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in a quantitative field (Computer Science, Statistics,
* Mathematics, Engineering, Operations Research or similar).

**Who will excel?**

* We’re looking for people with high standards, who understand that hard work matters.
* You need to be relentlessly resourceful and operate with a deep bias for action.
* We need people with the courage to be fiercely original.
* noon is not for everyone; readiness to adapt, pivot, and learn is essential.

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Senior Data Scientist
  
  
Job Title: Senior Data Scientist, Executive Reporting Centre of Excellence
  
  
Product Data & Analytics is a centralized global team that enables Mastercard product business units to make better data‑driven decisions. We build internal analytics partnerships that strengthen focus on business performance, portfolio and revenue optimization, initiative tracking, new product development, and go‑to‑market strategies. These capabilities are underpinned by our data platforms that enable insights to be delivered in a standardized, scalable, and cost‑efficient manner.
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
We are seeking a highly analytical and business-oriented Senior Data Scientist to drive enterprise-level KPI reporting, business performance tracking, and strategic analytics initiatives across global business units and regions.
  
  
The role will be responsible for owning end-to-end analytics solutions from requirement gathering, conceptualization, KPI framework design, data engineering, dashboard development, stakeholder alignment, finance automation, and ongoing commercialization of reporting solutions. The candidate will partner with global business leaders, Finance, FP&A, data providers, and technology teams to transform complex business requirements into scalable analytical products that enable executive decision-making. This role requires a unique combination of business acumen, technical expertise, product thinking, and team leadership capabilities.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Own and manage executive-level KPI reporting across multiple business units, products, and regions.
* Design and implement scalable KPI measurement frameworks, reporting methodologies, and governance processes.
* Develop and maintain analytics solutions, dashboards, and reporting products using Tableau, Power BI, SQL, and Python.
* Drive automation initiatives to improve reporting efficiency, data accuracy, and operational scalability.
* Lead finance automation initiatives that transform manual FP&A reporting packs into governed, scalable, role-based dashboards and financial intelligence layers.
* Partner with global stakeholders to gather requirements, define metrics, resolve reporting issues, and provide actionable insights.
* Monitor data quality, perform validations, and ensure accuracy of business-critical reporting.
* Lead cross-functional projects from conceptualization through implementation, commercialization, and business adoption.
* Translate complex business problems into data-driven and AI-enabled solutions for senior leadership.
* Evaluate, identify, and integrate GenAI and AI capabilities into existing products and business processes.
* Contribute to AI product roadmap planning by identifying opportunities for AI-driven features, automation, insights generation, and user experience enhancements.
* Collaborate with technology teams to define AI solution architecture, integration requirements, data dependencies, and governance standards.
* Mentor and guide team members on technical tools, analytics best practices, AI adoption, and business processes.
* Manage stakeholder expectations, prioritize deliverables, and ensure timely execution of strategic initiatives.

Job Requirements
  
  

* 4+ years of experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Data Science, Product Analytics, Product Management, or related fields.
* Experience designing and managing enterprise-level KPI frameworks and executive reporting solutions with proven ability to build scalable analytics products and automate reporting processes.
* Experience automating finance or FP&A reporting processes, including revenue, expense, driver, budget, forecast, and P&L reporting, with strong understanding of financial data governance and validation.
* Solid understanding of AI/ML and Generative AI concepts, including LLMs, RAG architectures, prompt engineering, AI agents, and enterprise AI use cases.
* Experience evaluating, planning, and integrating AI capabilities into business products and analytical solutions.
* Understanding of AI solution architecture, data flows, API integrations, model governance, and deployment considerations.
* Ability to translate business requirements into product roadmaps and identify opportunities for AI-driven innovation.
* Strong understanding of data modelling, data validation, performance measurement, and reporting governance.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with experience working across global teams and senior leadership.
* Demonstrated ability to lead projects independently and manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, strategic thinking, and product planning capabilities.
* Experience working in Agile/Product-oriented environments; CSPO, CSM, Product Management, AI, or Cloud certifications are preferred.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Remote Mathematics Expert (PhD)
description:
**About Turing:**

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable on projects that improve and evaluate large language models by applying advanced mathematical reasoning, problem-solving, computational thinking, and clear written communication impact, and lasting results on the P&L.

**Role Overview:**

* In this role, you will work on projects that improve and evaluate large language models by applying advanced mathematical reasoning, problem-solving, computational thinking, and clear written communication.
* The ideal candidate should have a solid foundation in mathematics, particularly at the level expected in engineering entrance exams, as well as graduate or PhD-level programs.
* You should be able to break down complex mathematical concepts into simple, clear explanations and work efficiently.
* The role also includes computational projects where you design precise, closed-ended prompts, write reliable Python code, verify numerical answers, and provide clear rationales.
* The projects will also help you learn how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!

**What does day-to-day look like:**

* Design original and challenging mathematics problems that test the reasoning limits of large language models, especially in multi-step, abstract, and proof-based settings.
* Solve problems independently and write detailed, logically structured solutions with clear justifications.
* Review model-generated solutions, identify mathematical errors or missing arguments, and provide precise feedback, annotations, and corrections..
* Contribute to defining new evaluation benchmarks based on Mathematics curricula spanning from early undergraduate to PhD-level topics.
* Develop and validate Python-based solutions for computational tasks using approved scientific libraries.
* Work on theorem-prover tasks using Lean, including translating mathematical problems and proofs into formal language, verifying that formal proofs compile correctly.

**Requirements:**

* Analytical Skills: Good research and analytical skills
* Feedback Skills: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
* Creative Thinking: Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
* Communication: Excellent structured communication and collaboration skills in a remote setting.
* Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
* Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Candidates pursuing a Master’s/Ph.D./Postdoctoral degree in Mathematics, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field are eligible and encouraged to apply.
* Ability to analyze and solve complex math problems with a structured and logical approach.
* Ability to explain math concepts clearly using simple language, visuals, and examples.

**Perks of Freelancing With Turing:**

* Work in a fully remote environment.
* Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
* Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.

**Offer Details:**

* Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and a minimum of 20 hours per week, with 4 hours of overlap with PST. (We have 3 options of time commitment: 20 hrs/week, 30 hrs/week, or 40 hrs/week)
* Engagement type: Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)

title: Ecommerce Manager
description:
**Job Title: E-Commerce & Marketplace Growth Manager**

We are looking for a highly driven and commercially minded
**E-Commerce & Marketplace Growth Manager**
to take ownership of our online sales channels and drive growth across marketplaces, our website, and other digital commerce platforms.

This is not a purely operational role. We are looking for someone who can think like a business owner—someone who can identify opportunities, improve sales, optimise profitability, study competitors, develop new product ideas, and build new revenue channels.

The ideal candidate will manage and grow our presence across platforms such as
**Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, our own website, and other relevant marketplaces and aggregator portals**
.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Marketplace Management & Growth**

* Manage and grow sales across Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra and other relevant e-commerce and aggregator platforms.
* Create, optimise and manage product listings, including titles, descriptions, keywords, images and product information.
* Monitor product performance and identify opportunities to improve sales and visibility.
* Plan and execute pricing, discounts, offers, bundles and promotional campaigns.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure inventory availability and minimise stock-outs.
* Monitor product ratings, reviews, returns and customer feedback.
* Identify underperforming SKUs and develop strategies to improve or discontinue them.
* Identify high-performing products and opportunities to scale them.

**2. Website Sales & Digital Commerce Growth**

* Drive sales and growth through the company website.
* Identify opportunities to improve website conversion rates and customer experience.
* Create product bundles, combo offers, trial packs, family packs, premium packs and other initiatives to increase average order value.
* Develop cross-selling and upselling opportunities across the product portfolio.
* Work with internal and external teams to improve product pages, offers and customer journeys.
* Develop strategies to increase repeat purchases and customer retention.

**3. Customer Feedback, Testimonials & Retention**

* Develop and manage a structured process for collecting customer feedback.
* Conduct customer calls to understand product experience and satisfaction.
* Identify satisfied customers and collect written and video testimonials.
* Build a strong repository of customer reviews, testimonials and user-generated content for use across digital platforms.
* Follow up with customers to encourage repeat purchases and referrals.
* Analyse customer complaints and feedback to identify opportunities for product and service improvement.

**4. Competitor Research & Pricing Strategy**

* Continuously monitor competitors, their products, pricing, offers and promotions.
* Conduct regular market research to identify trending products and emerging opportunities.
* Identify products that competitors are selling successfully and evaluate whether they can be developed, manufactured or sourced in-house.
* Work with internal teams to identify opportunities for competitive pricing while maintaining healthy margins.
* Prepare regular competitor and market intelligence reports for management.

**5. New Product & Revenue Opportunities**

* Identify new product categories and opportunities that can generate additional revenue.
* Research products currently performing well in the market and assess their commercial potential.
* Identify opportunities to manufacture, source or develop products at competitive pricing.
* Work with internal teams to develop new SKUs, variants, sizes, bundles and product extensions.
* Explore high-margin complementary products and add-on opportunities.
* Present commercially viable new product and revenue ideas to management on a regular basis.

**6. New Digital Sales Channels**

* Identify and onboard relevant e-commerce platforms, aggregator portals and other digital sales channels.
* Explore opportunities for affiliate marketing, referral programs and micro-influencer partnerships.
* Develop strategies to increase direct-to-consumer sales and reduce dependency on any single marketplace.
* Identify potential opportunities in bulk orders, corporate sales, gifting and B2B partnerships where relevant.

**7. Sales, Data & Profitability**

* Track daily, weekly and monthly sales performance across all channels.
* Monitor profitability at a product and channel level.
* Analyse the impact of discounts, commissions, returns and promotional campaigns on margins.
* Identify opportunities to reduce costs and improve profitability.
* Prepare regular MIS and growth reports for management.
* Take ownership of assigned revenue and growth targets.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Proven experience in managing e-commerce marketplaces such as Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra or similar platforms.
* Strong understanding of online product listings, pricing, promotions and marketplace operations.
* Commercial mindset with the ability to identify new sales and revenue opportunities.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to understand product profitability, margins and pricing.
* Experience with website sales and D2C e-commerce will be an advantage.
* Comfortable speaking with customers and conducting feedback or testimonial calls.
* Ability to conduct competitor and market research.
* Highly proactive, organised and result-oriented.
* Strong communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of business outcomes.

**Preferred Profile**

We would prefer someone who:

* Has hands-on experience managing multiple e-commerce platforms.
* Understands both
  **sales growth and profitability**
  .
* Can independently identify problems and propose solutions.
* Is comfortable working in a fast-paced and entrepreneurial environment.
* Has a strong interest in consumer products, digital commerce and new product development.
* Thinks beyond day-to-day operations and actively looks for new business opportunities.

title: Dam Break Analysis Expert (National Expert)
description:
Dam Break Analysis & Emergency Planning Specialist (National Expert)
  
  
**Experience:**
Minimum
**15 years**
of relevant experience in dam break analysis, hydraulic and hydrologic modelling, flood routing, and emergency planning for dam and water resources projects.
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are seeking an experienced
**Dam Break Analysis & Emergency Planning Specialist (National Expert)**
to provide technical expertise in dam break analysis, flood inundation modelling, emergency action planning, and hydraulic simulations for dam safety and water resources projects. The ideal candidate will possess extensive experience in hydrologic and hydraulic modelling, preparation of Emergency Action Plans (EAPs), inundation mapping, and integrated reservoir operation studies using internationally recognized modelling tools.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead dam break analysis and flood inundation studies for existing and proposed dam projects.
* Develop and calibrate hydrologic and hydraulic models using software such as MIKE, HEC-HMS, HEC-RAS, or equivalent modelling platforms.
* Perform flood routing, dam breach simulations, and downstream flood impact assessments.
* Prepare dam break inundation maps and hazard assessment reports to support dam safety planning.
* Develop and review Emergency Action Plans (EAPs) for dams in accordance with national and international dam safety guidelines.
* Carry out operational protocol studies for reservoirs, including emergency response and reservoir operation strategies.
* Support integrated operation studies of cascade reservoir systems to optimize water resources management and dam safety.
* Assess flood risks and recommend mitigation measures for downstream communities and critical infrastructure.
* Prepare technical reports, modelling documentation, manuals, and recommendations related to dam safety and emergency preparedness.
* Coordinate with project authorities, dam owners, consultants, regulatory agencies, and multidisciplinary teams to ensure successful implementation of dam safety initiatives.
* Provide technical support for capacity-building programs and knowledge-sharing initiatives related to dam break analysis and emergency planning.

Educational Qualification
  
  

* Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering from a recognized university.
* Postgraduate Degree (Master's or higher) in Hydraulic Engineering, Hydrology, Water Resources Engineering, or a related discipline.

**Required Experience & Skills**

* Minimum 15 years of professional experience in hydrologic and hydraulic modelling for dam and water resources projects.
* Proven experience in using MIKE, HEC-HMS, HEC-RAS, or equivalent software for hydraulic and hydrologic modelling.
* Strong expertise in flood routing, dam break analysis, flood inundation mapping, and reservoir operation studies.
* Demonstrated experience in preparing Emergency Action Plans (EAPs) for dams.
* Experience in integrated operation studies of cascade reservoir systems is desirable.
* Proven involvement in the preparation of dam break analysis and inundation mapping for at least 10 large dam projects.
* Strong understanding of dam safety regulations, emergency preparedness, and disaster risk management.
* Excellent analytical, report writing, technical communication, and stakeholder coordination skills.

**Preferred Criteria**

* Experience working on nationally or internationally funded dam safety and water resources projects.
* Familiarity with national dam safety regulations and international guidelines, including ICOLD and FEMA methodologies for dam break analysis and emergency planning.
* Experience in GIS-based flood inundation mapping and spatial analysis will be an added advantage.
* Prior experience in multidisciplinary dam safety assessments and emergency preparedness planning is highly desirable.

**Job Description**
**YOUR TEAM**
Our Sustainable Water Management team works across a spectrum of services covering water quality and catchment management water resources and security, hydrology and hydraulics, geomorphology, hydroecology and hydrogeology. YOUR NEW ROLE, WHAT’S INVOLVED?
  
  
We are seeking senior professionals to join our rapidly expanding team of Water Quality and Catchment Management specialists so that we can continue to deliver sustainable solutions to the water sector and environmental regulators in the UK and help protect the water environment.
  
  
With a background in earth sciences and working knowledge of water quality and geochemistry / environmental chemistry you should be aware of the UK situation with regard to:
  
  

* How river, lake and TraCs water quality is protected through the WFD and other regulatory tools;
* Be aware / have working knowledge of water quality modelling tools (SAGIS, SIMCAT, InfoWorks, ICM etc.).
* Experience on national level infrastructure projects, particularly for National Highways. Experience of HEWRAT or drainage would be advantageous.
* Experience of EIA scoping, reviews and assessments for water/hydrology chapters.
* Experience of water quality permitting and completion or review of H1 and RQP assessments.
* Demonstrate understanding of how to conceptualise a water quality problem and knowledge of the available datasets which can be used in problem solving.

Prior work experience, either postdoctoral or in consultancy or working in the water sector (regulator or industry) would be desirable.
  
  
You should have an interest in problem solving through interrogation of time series and spatial datasets, good conceptualisation skills and understand the important of source pathway receptor models and be able to clearly communicate ideas either through your writing or visualisations. An awareness of how groundwater and surface water interact would also be useful.
  
  
Awareness of sampling network design, liaising with UK teams on risk assessment before field work, and data collation and interpretation (for river and / or groundwater sampling and monitoring) would also be beneficial and some knowledge of catchment management / agri-environment schemes.
  
  
The role will include the following:
  
  

* Water quality data analysis, conceptualisation and visualisation and clear communication;
* Carrying out desk-based investigations / interpretation of datasets.
* Helping to design field monitoring campaigns including traditional and non-traditional approaches;
* Delivery of technical reports and presentations to clients; and
* Winning new work and writing proposals for new projects.

WE’D LOVE TO HEAR FROM YOU IF YOU HAVE

* Develop strategies to increase direct\-to\-consumer sales and reduce dependency on any single marketplace.
* Identify potential opportunities in bulk orders, corporate sales, gifting and B2B partnerships where relevant.



  





**7\. Sales, Data \& Profitability** 



* Track daily, weekly and monthly sales performance across all channels.
* Monitor profitability at a product and channel level.
* Analyse the impact of discounts, commissions, returns and promotional campaigns on margins.
* Identify opportunities to reduce costs and improve profitability.
* Prepare regular MIS and growth reports for management.
* Take ownership of assigned revenue and growth targets.



  





**What We Are Looking For**

* Ability to conduct competitor and market research.
* Highly proactive, organised and result\-oriented.
* Strong communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of business outcomes.



  





**Preferred Profile** 




 We would prefer someone who:

* Understands both
 **sales growth and profitability** 
 .
* Can independently identify problems and propose solutions.
* Is comfortable working in a fast\-paced and entrepreneurial environment.

title: Officer, Personal Banker, Consumer Banking Group
AI/ML Engineer, Aladdin Data, VP
description:
**About This Role**
**Your team**
BlackRock Data Office (BDO) is powering the next stage of enterprise innovation with artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML). The team combines industry-leading data standards with advanced intelligence capabilities to transform how BlackRock operates and to help define what is possible with technology at enterprise scale.
  
  
BDO takes a full-stack approach, bringing together engineers, data scientists, data analysts, and domain specialists to address challenges ranging from core computing infrastructure to end-user applications. The BDO AI team works on strategic initiatives including generative AI systems, predictive systems, and data-intensive operations. The team is globally distributed and partners with stakeholders across BlackRock to deliver both near-term solutions and long-term transformation.
  
  
**Your role and impact**
As an AI/ML Engineer within BDO AI, you will design, build, and deploy production-grade AI and ML systems that address complex business challenges. You will combine hands-on software engineering with emerging AI capabilities, working across the technology stack to take ideas from early exploration through reliable production deployment.
  
  
You will collaborate with domain experts, data analysts, engineers, and business stakeholders to translate business processes into technical solutions. You will evaluate emerging AI and ML capabilities, communicate complex technical concepts clearly, and help build consensus around forward-looking solutions that can operate at enterprise scale.
  
  
**Your Responsibilities**
In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and combine the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies with the rigor to challenge the results. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities:
  
  

* Pioneer and evaluate novel AI/ML capabilities, applying emerging technologies to solve specific business problems and build forward-looking solutions.
* Make frequent, high-quality code contributions to existing and greenfield projects.
* Model and demonstrate emerging solutions using first-principles problem solving, building stakeholder understanding and consensus around proposed approaches.
* Deploy reliable services to development and production environments while maintaining enterprise software development lifecycle standards.
* Communicate granular technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Partner with domain experts and data analysts to translate business processes into effective technical processes.
* Match computing requirements to available enterprise resources, including containerized deployments.

**Your Experience**

* Undergraduate degree in a relevant technical or scientific field, such as Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Data Science, Software Engineering, Physics, or Chemistry; a postgraduate degree in a relevant technical discipline is preferred.
* 7+ years of software engineering experience, including significant experience designing, building, and deploying production-grade systems.
* 2+ years of generative AI/ML engineering experience, including designing, developing, and deploying production-grade AI/ML systems.
* Expert-level proficiency in Python, Java, Structured Query Language (SQL), and data systems.
* Demonstrated systems-level problem-solving abilities, including experience deploying containerized services to production environments without reliance on managed cloud services.
* Strong communication skills in both technical and non-technical forums.
* Knowledge of machine learning and statistical modeling, including fundamental natural language processing (NLP) concepts, professional experience with pre-GPT transformer technologies such as BART, and familiarity with how GPT-2-like models are trained.

**Our Benefits**
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
  
  
**Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
  
  
**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
**guidance**
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
  
  
**About BlackRock**
At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
  
  
This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
  
  
To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
  
  
BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

* Work directly with some of the world's leading AI research teams and labs on cutting\-edge model development
