We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer to help us build the next generation of AI-powered experiences and foundational capabilities for SimCorp’s products and workflows.
  
  
The team works where AI, cloud technologies, and enterprise software engineering come together. We build intelligent solutions that help users access trusted knowledge, make informed decisions, and safely complete complex business activities. These solutions must integrate with existing business capabilities while meeting high standards for security, reliability, auditability, transparency, and user control.
  
  
You will shape technical direction across intelligent experiences, agentic systems, and reusable foundational capabilities. You will work primarily with Microsoft Azure and C#/.NET while collaborating closely with engineers, architects, product stakeholders, UX designers, and business-domain experts across SimCorp.
  
  
This is a hands-on principal engineering role. You will contribute to critical implementation, lead complex architectural decisions, create reusable engineering patterns, and help move AI solutions from experimentation into secure, scalable, observable, and production-quality software.
  
  
AI will play an important role both in what we build and how we build. You will help advance AI-native software-development practices while maintaining strong engineering, security, and quality standards.
  
  
**What You Will Be Responsible For**

* Shape the technical direction for AI-powered experiences and reusable foundational capabilities.
* Design intelligent software that understands user intent, works with trusted enterprise knowledge, uses available tools, and safely supports business actions.
* Lead architectural decisions involving agentic systems, cloud services, distributed systems, enterprise integration, security, and operational readiness.
* Translate complex business and user needs into coherent capabilities, technical boundaries, and incremental delivery strategies.
* Connect AI-powered solutions with existing services and business capabilities while preserving domain ownership and avoiding duplication of business logic.
* Establish stable and reusable service and tool contracts around meaningful business capabilities.
* Define reference architectures, engineering patterns, and guardrails that can be adopted across teams.
* Evaluate AI models, platforms, protocols, frameworks, and engineering approaches based on business value, architectural fit, reliability, security, and cost.
* Establish effective approaches for measuring answer quality, relevance, groundedness, tool selection, task completion, safety, latency, and cost.
* Design for identity, authorization, entitlements, auditability, traceability, appropriate human control, and safe failure.
* Address distributed-system concerns including latency, partial failure, retries, idempotency, concurrency, consistency, source availability, and uncertain outcomes.
* Establish engineering practices covering automated testing, AI evaluation, CI/CD, security, observability, and production readiness.
* Contribute hands-on to critical code, technical spikes, reference implementations, and complex problem resolution.
* Review technical designs and code, mentor engineers, and raise engineering capability across teams.
* Help advance AI-native software development across discovery, specification, design, implementation, testing, code review, documentation, and troubleshooting.

**What We Value**

* You have 10–15 years of software-engineering experience, with substantial recent hands-on contribution to complex production systems.
* You have demonstrated experience designing, building, and productionising AI-powered applications, intelligent assistants, or agentic systems, beyond prompt-based prototypes.
* You have a strong understanding of large language models, agent orchestration, context engineering, tool use, structured outputs, and multi-step workflow execution.
* You have practical experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation, including grounding, chunking, embeddings, retrieval strategies, vector or hybrid search, metadata filtering, reranking, citations, and evaluation.
* You understand Model Context Protocol, or comparable approaches for securely connecting AI agents with enterprise systems, information, and tools.
* You have experience evaluating AI systems for accuracy, relevance, groundedness, task completion, safety, latency, and cost.
* You understand AI-specific risks such as hallucination, prompt injection, excessive agency, sensitive-data exposure, insecure tool use, and unreliable action execution.
* You have experience with Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Semantic Kernel, or comparable AI platforms and frameworks.
* You have strong production-engineering experience with C#/.NET and Microsoft Azure.
* You have experience designing secure, observable, cloud-native services and distributed systems.
* You understand service contracts, versioning, compatibility, identity, authorization, security, resilience, and operational readiness.
* You have experience with automated testing, AI evaluation, CI/CD, observability, and Azure DevOps.
* You have practical experience applying AI-assisted engineering across specification, design, implementation, testing, code review, documentation, and troubleshooting.
* You critically evaluate AI-generated designs, code, tests, and documentation for correctness, security, maintainability, and architectural fit.
* You demonstrate strong architectural judgment, balanced with pragmatism and incremental delivery.
* You can lead technical direction across teams, influence without formal authority, and turn ambiguous business objectives into executable technical strategies.
* You enjoy mentoring engineers, sharing ideas, and contributing to a curious, collaborative, and high-performing engineering culture.
* Experience with multi-agent orchestration, GraphQL, messaging, event-driven architecture, API gateways, identity platforms, enterprise integration, or investment-management workflows is valuable, but not required.
* We know that great candidates rarely match every point perfectly. Most importantly, we are looking for someone motivated by learning, improving, and building meaningful, production-quality solutions with the team.

**Benefits**

* Global hybrid work policy: We ask you to work two days a week from the office. You may work remotely on the other days or work from the office if that is your preference.
* Culture: An inclusive and diverse company culture where different perspectives and expertise are valued.
* Work-life balance: We believe that a sustainable balance between professional and personal responsibilities helps everyone perform at their best.
* Empowerment: We believe all voices are valuable and should be heard. You will be involved in shaping our technical direction and ways of working.
* Career and growth: SimCorp provides opportunities for professional development and supports individual career paths based on your strengths and aspirations.
* Innovation: You will have opportunities to contribute to engineering improvements, technical modernization, and strategic capabilities with impact across SimCorp.

**NEXT STEPS**
Please send us your application in English through our career site as soon as possible. We assess applications continuously, and only applications submitted through our system can be processed.
  
  
At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur during recruitment. To support fairness and equal opportunity for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal information such as photographs, age, or other non-professional details from your application.
  
  
If you are interested in joining SimCorp but are unsure whether this role is the right fit, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to help you identify suitable opportunities.
  
  
We continuously seek to improve our talent-acquisition process and make every candidate’s experience positive and valuable. During the process, we may ask you to provide feedback, which will be highly appreciated.
  
  
**Who We Are**
For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become a leading provider of integrated investment-management solutions. Our colleagues represent a broad range of nationalities, educational backgrounds, professional experiences, and perspectives.
  
  
SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of Deutsche Börse Group. Following the merger with Axioma, we combine the strengths of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full front-to-back offering for our clients.
  
  
SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other status protected under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work.
  
  
We believe in the continuous growth and development of our employees so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

title: Principal Site Reliability Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
We are seeking an experienced and highly technical DevOps Engineer (IC4) to join Oracle's Cloud Enablement Team (CET). This role focuses on designing, developing, implementing, and maintaining enterprise-scale automation solutions that support application deployments, infrastructure management, production operations, and service reliability across Oracle Cloud environments.
  
  
The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on expertise in PowerShell, Python, Ansible, Oracle Linux Automation Manager (OLAM), Windows Server, Linux, CI/CD pipelines, and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). Responsibilities include developing reusable automation frameworks, automating application installations, upgrades, patching, password rotation, configuration management, and rollback procedures. The engineer will also modernize legacy automation, implement automated testing and validation, and improve deployment consistency and operational efficiency.
  
  
The position requires advanced troubleshooting and problem-solving skills to investigate complex issues involving application services, automation jobs, infrastructure, databases, networking, and load balancers. The engineer will collaborate with Development, QA, Cloud Operations, SRE, and other engineering teams to support production applications, resolve incidents, perform root cause analysis, and implement long-term reliability improvements.
  
  
As an IC4 engineer, the successful candidate is expected to independently own complex technical initiatives, provide technical guidance, mentor other engineers, and drive continuous improvements in automation, security, monitoring, and operational processes. Experience supporting enterprise SaaS applications, implementing Infrastructure as Code, and using AI-assisted tools for automation development and troubleshooting is highly desirable.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities – DevOps Engineer IC4 (Cloud Enablement & Automation)**
**Capacity Ingestion and Management**

* Designs, architects, implements, and maintains reliable, scalable, and secure cloud infrastructure and automation services supporting enterprise SaaS applications.
* Forecasts infrastructure capacity requirements, monitors resource utilization, and recommends improvements to optimize performance, reliability, and operational costs.
* Collaborates with Development, QA, Cloud Operations, SRE, and Infrastructure teams to design and maintain environments that support application installations, upgrades, migrations, and production operations.
* Develops and maintains infrastructure provisioning and configuration automation using Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), PowerShell, Python, Ansible/OLAM, and related technologies.
* Evaluates and prototypes new automation approaches, infrastructure configurations, and deployment solutions to improve operational scalability and efficiency.
* Supports infrastructure lifecycle activities, including server provisioning, capacity expansion, operating system upgrades, cloud migrations, and decommissioning.

**Incident and Service Lifecycle Management**

* Maintains and optimizes application services, infrastructure, and automation platforms to ensure availability, reliability, security, and operational performance.
* Performs complex incident investigation, technical analysis, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis across Windows/Linux servers, application services, automation jobs, databases, and networking components.
* Designs, develops, and maintains automation supporting application installations, in-place upgrades (IPUs), migrations, patching, configuration updates, password rotation, and rollback procedures.
* Supports enterprise application lifecycle operations, including Oracle Client upgrades, security patching, certificate renewals, vulnerability remediation, backup, and recovery.
* Monitors infrastructure and application health using OpenSearch, OCI Monitoring, OCI Logging, OCI Log Analytics, and related observability tools.
* Develops operational reporting, dashboards, and automated validation processes to identify performance issues, automation failures, and service reliability risks.
* Supports scheduled maintenance, customer-facing deployments, environment provisioning, and infrastructure decommissioning activities while minimizing service disruption.

**Automation**

* Designs, develops, implements, and maintains production-grade automation using PowerShell, Python, Bash, Ansible, and Oracle Linux Automation Manager (OLAM).
* Develops reusable automation frameworks, Ansible playbooks, roles, job templates, dynamic inventories, and scripts to support application and infrastructure operations across multiple environments.
* Automates application installations, upgrades, patching, password rotation, configuration management, deployment validation, and rollback procedures.
* Implements automated testing, error handling, logging, exception management, and recovery mechanisms to improve automation quality and reliability.
* Modernizes legacy automation by migrating existing Chef, BladeLogic, and other configuration management solutions to PowerShell, Ansible/OLAM, and standardized automation frameworks.
* Develops automated tests using PowerShell Pester or equivalent testing frameworks to validate scripts, application configurations, and infrastructure changes.
* Continuously identifies opportunities to reduce manual operational effort, improve deployment consistency, shorten maintenance windows, and reduce operational errors.
* Maintains CI/CD pipelines, source code repositories, and automation workflows using Git, GitLab, OCI DevOps, Jenkins, or equivalent platforms.

**Technical Communication and Guidance**

* Communicates infrastructure changes, application deployment requirements, automation designs, security considerations, operational risks, and service impacts to technical teams and stakeholders.
* Collaborates with Development, QA, Cloud Operations, SRE, Security, and other engineering teams to define technical requirements and deliver reliable automation solutions.
* Develops and maintains technical documentation, automation design specifications, operational runbooks, release procedures, troubleshooting guides, and knowledge-sharing materials.
* Provides technical guidance on PowerShell, Python, Ansible/OLAM, OCI infrastructure, application lifecycle automation, and production troubleshooting.
* Proactively identifies potential impacts of infrastructure changes, application upgrades, and automation enhancements, communicating risks and mitigation strategies.
* Mentors engineers, performs code and automation reviews, and promotes consistent engineering standards and operational best practices across globally distributed teams.

**Troubleshooting and Resolution**

* Serves as a technical escalation point for complex infrastructure, application deployment, automation, networking, and production support issues.
* Investigates and resolves failures involving Ansible/OLAM jobs, PowerShell scripts, application upgrades, configuration changes, and infrastructure services.
* Diagnoses technical issues across Windows/Linux operating systems, Oracle databases, application services, DNS, load balancers, SSL/TLS certificates, and network connectivity.
* Participates in on-call rotations and supports critical customer-facing incidents, scheduled maintenance, and production deployments.
* Performs root cause analysis (RCA), documents incidents, and implements corrective and preventive actions to minimize recurring failures.
* Develops automation and troubleshooting improvements to reduce mean time to detect (MTTD) and mean time to resolve (MTTR), supporting established service level objectives (SLOs).
* Collaborates with cross-functional engineering teams to resolve complex technical dependencies and minimize customer impact.

**Innovation and Improvement**

* Evaluates emerging automation, DevOps, cloud infrastructure, and SRE technologies to improve application reliability, operational efficiency, and scalability.
* Identifies and implements improvements to automation frameworks, deployment processes, monitoring capabilities, and infrastructure management.
* Drives modernization of legacy automation platforms by adopting reusable PowerShell functions, Ansible playbooks, automated validation, and standardized source code management.
* Evaluates approved AI-assisted tools to improve automation development, code analysis, log investigation, incident triage, and troubleshooting efficiency.
* Analyzes operational metrics, automation failures, deployment performance, and infrastructure utilization to recommend improvements.
* Develops solutions that reduce manual intervention, improve deployment success rates, strengthen security compliance, and optimize infrastructure costs.
* Maintains current knowledge of DevOps, cloud automation, SRE, and security best practices, sharing recommendations and technical insights across engineering teams.

**Core Responsibilities**
**Planning & Execution**

* Independently manages and executes moderately complex to complex DevOps automation and infrastructure initiatives, ensuring technical requirements, timelines, and deliverables are met.
* Plans and coordinates application upgrades, automation releases, infrastructure changes, and production maintenance activities across multiple teams and environments.
* Identifies technical dependencies, prioritizes competing operational requirements, and proactively addresses risks that could impact customer-facing services.
* Provides technical oversight, reviews implementation plans, and ensures appropriate testing, validation, and rollback procedures are established.

**Collaboration & Partnership**

* Collaborates across Development, QA, Cloud Operations, SRE, Security, Infrastructure, and Product Engineering teams to deliver reliable and scalable automation solutions.
* Works closely with global engineering teams to support application lifecycle activities, infrastructure modernization, security improvements, and production operations.
* Understands business and customer requirements and translates them into practical technical solutions that improve operational efficiency and service reliability.
* Promotes knowledge sharing, constructive collaboration, and consistent automation practices across teams.

**Problem Solving**

* Independently investigates and resolves complex technical problems involving automation frameworks, application services, operating systems, infrastructure, databases, and networking.
* Analyzes system logs, automation job failures, performance metrics, and configuration dependencies to identify root causes and implement sustainable solutions.
* Evaluates technical alternatives, anticipates operational risks, and recommends solutions that improve reliability, maintainability, and scalability.
* Documents troubleshooting procedures, lessons learned, and reusable solutions to improve future operational response.

**Continuous Learning**

* Maintains advanced technical knowledge of PowerShell, Python, Ansible/OLAM, Windows/Linux administration, OCI, CI/CD, and enterprise application lifecycle automation.

title: Senior AI Engineer | Applied AI
description:
We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to turn the rapidly evolving capabilities of AI into useful

products, systems and business capabilities.

This is a hands‑on engineering role for someone who can take an ambiguous business problem,

explore what AI makes possible and build reliable solutions that people actually use. Working

closely with product, engineering and business teams, you will take ideas from discovery and

prototyping through integration, deployment and continuous improvement.

You will write production code, make practical technical decisions and take ownership of delivery.

The emphasis is on applied AI engineering and measurable business value, rather than research or

proofs of concept alone.

What You'll Work On

The work will evolve as we discover valuable applications of AI. It may include:

- Building AI‑powered products and features for customers.

- Developing internal AI tools that improve productivity and decisions.

- Creating AI agents that retrieve knowledge, use tools and connect to systems.

- Building searchable knowledge and decision‑support tools from unstructured data.

- Improving customer and employee experiences with smarter workflows.

- Exploring emerging AI capabilities with meaningful business potential.

Early projects may focus on sales and CRM workflows, with scope across the business.

What You'll Do

- Partner with business, product and engineering teams to identify valuable AI use cases and

translate unclear needs into practical technical approaches.

- Own delivery from rapid prototyping and feasibility assessment through implementation,

integration and production deployment.

- Build LLM‑powered applications and agents using RAG, embeddings, tool/function calling,

structured outputs and, where useful, multimodal AI.

- Integrate AI capabilities with APIs, databases and existing business systems.

- Design evaluations, monitoring and guardrails to improve accuracy, safety and reliability in

production.

- Apply sound engineering practices to deployment, security, performance, latency and operating

costs.

- Evaluate new models and tools, make pragmatic technology choices and build reusable

components for future solutions.

- Measure adoption and business impact, gather feedback and continuously improve the solutions

you ship.

title: Software Engineer - Infrastructure (L2)
description:
### **Description**

**Job location:** Gurugram (Hybrid)

**About the role:**  
Sun King is looking for a self-driven Infrastructure Engineer, who is comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment and balancing the needs of multiple development teams and systems. You will work on improving our current IAC, observability stack, and incident response processes. The Infrastructure Engineer will work with the data science, analytics, and engineering teams to build optimized CI/CD pipelines, scalable AWS infrastructure, and Kubernetes deployments.

### **What you would be expected to do:**

  

* Work with engineering, automation, and data teams to work on various infrastructure requirements.
* Designing modular and efficient GitOps CI/CD pipelines, agnostic to the underlying platform.
* Managing AWS services for multiple teams.
* Managing custom data store deployments like sharded MongoDB clusters, Elasticsearch clusters, and upcoming services.
* Deployment and management of Kubernetes resources.
* Deployment and management of custom metrics exporters, trace data, custom application metrics, and designing dashboards, querying metrics from multiple resources, as an end-to-end observability stack solution.
* Set up incident response services and design effective processes.
* Deployment and management of critical platform services like OPA and Keycloak for IAM.
* Advocate best practices for high availability and scalability when designing AWS infrastructure, observability dashboards, implementing IAC, deploying to Kubernetes, and designing GitOps CI/CD pipelines.

  

### **You might be a strong candidate if you have/are:**

  

* Hands-on experience with Docker or any other container runtime environment and Linux with the ability to perform basic administrative tasks.
* Experience working with web servers (nginx, apache) and cloud providers (preferably AWS).
* Hands-on scripting and automation experience (Python, Bash), experience debugging and troubleshooting Linux environments and cloud-native deployments.
* Experience building CI/CD pipelines, with familiarity with monitoring & alerting systems (Grafana, Prometheus, and exporters).
* Knowledge of web architecture, distributed systems, and single points of failure.
* Familiarity with cloud-native deployments and concepts like high availability, scalability, and bottleneck.
* Good networking fundamentals — SSH, DNS, TCP/IP, HTTP, SSL, load balancing, reverse proxies, and firewalls.

  

### **What Sun King offers:**

  

* Professional growth in a dynamic, rapidly expanding, high-social-impact industry.
* An open-minded, collaborative culture made up of enthusiastic colleagues who are driven by the challenge of innovation towards profound impact on people and the planet.
* A truly multicultural experience: You will have the chance to work with and learn from people from different geographies, nationalities, and backgrounds.
* Structured, tailored learning and development programs that help you become a better leader, manager, and professional through the Sun King Center for Leadership.

  

### **About Sun King**

Sun King is the world’s leading off-grid solar energy company, combining cutting-edge product design, fintech, and field operations to deliver energy access for the 1.8 billion people who live without an affordable and reliable electric-grid connection.

Sun King has built a new kind of energy utility: distributed, green, customer-centric, and affordable. We bring clean, reliable, decentralized energy directly into people’s lives — from solar kits that provide first-time energy access to multi-kilowatt systems that serve both off-grid users and grid-connected customers powering larger homes, schools, hospitals, farms, offices, and light manufacturing.

Already, 25 million homes and businesses rely on Sun King for electricity supply and the appliances and services it enables: lighting, televisions, fans, refrigeration, and smartphones.  
  
Sun King combines energy generation, energy-efficient appliances, installation, and financing into one seamless offering. Think of it as a distributed utility, designed for wherever energy is needed and designed to scale with its users as incomes and energy needs grow.  
  
Sun King makes solar products affordable to low-income households and businesses via ‘pay-as-you-go’ (PAYG) purchase financing. Sun King installs solar after customers pay a small deposit. Customers then make small, manageable payments of as little as US $0.14 a day via mobile money or cash.

Instead of paying for expensive, polluting, and health-damaging kerosene for lighting or diesel for power, customers unlock savings through accessing solar power and after one to two years of payments, customers own their solar equipment outright.  
  
Sun King collects payments digitally through mobile money systems and its 35,000 field agents — over 1 million payments each day. To date, Sun King has extended more than $1.4 billion in PAYG loans to customers.  
  
Sun King began by powering homes and businesses with solar systems delivered through PAYG financing. Now, we’re using the same model to make smartphones and clean cooking equipment affordable: helping households connect to the digital economy and transition from wood-based fuels to modern, sustainable alternatives.  
  
Sun King employs 3,500 full-time staff in 14 countries, with specialties spanning product design, data science, logistics, customer service, sales, software, operations, and more — all with a passion to serve off-grid families. Sun King is committed to gender diversity in the workplace. Women represent 42% of Sun King’s workforce.

* Familiarity with AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real-world products, including safely integrating AI/ML‑enabled capabilities into existing services.

title: Technical/Senior Technical Architect - Agentforce Data 360

* Guide integration of Agentforce with Salesforce platform capabilities and enterprise systems

* Align enterprise data architecture with agent grounding and knowledge retrieval patterns

* Build reusable assets, accelerators, and technical reference materials
* Deliver internal enablement programs and mentor architects and engineers
* Provide field insights and Voice-of-Customer feedback to influence product evolution

* Experience implementing and supporting CI/CD and APIOps automation pipelines.
* Knowledge of cloud networking, DNS, load balancing, IAM, routing, and security controls.
* Experience with API Security implementation including OAuth2, JWT, TLS/mTLS, API Keys, and gateway policies.
* Strong Linux administration, scripting, troubleshooting, and production support experience.

**Additionally, Good To Have**

* Experience with Apigee Hybrid installation, upgrades, and runtime troubleshooting.
* Hands-on experience with Terraform, Helm, Kustomize, Ansible, or GitOps-based platform provisioning
* IBM API Connect (APIC) and IBM DataPower migration experience
* Experience with DevSecOps and vulnerability scanning tools such as Trivy, Snyk, Checkov, tfsec, and SonarQube
* Experience in regulated, private cloud, multi-cloud, or hybrid environments.
* Relevant certifications such as:

+ Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect
+ Google Apigee API Engineer Certification
+ Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA)

**Ideally, You Will Also Have**

* Possesses good communication skills to coordinate, resolve queries of both external and internal customers
* Self-motivator and result oriented to complete task as per timelines
* Must have good analytical and problem-solving skills
* Good written/Verbal Communication, Presentation, Interactive skills with team across geography.
* Flexible to work either independently or work in tandem with Cloud Infrastructure team to identify and implement the most efficient cloud-based solutions for the company.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Our Company
  
  
Changing the world through digital experiences is what Adobe’s all about. We give everyone—from emerging artists to global brands—everything they need to design and deliver exceptional digital experiences. We’re passionate about empowering people to craft beautiful and powerful images, videos, and apps, and transform how companies interact with customers across every screen.

The Opportunity
  
  
As a Data Engineer, you’ll join our data engineering and BI team and work closely with business analysts to understand requirements and translate them into reliable data pipelines, data models and curated datasets that power reporting. You’ll also interact directly with business users and support their ad-hoc requests from time to time.
  
  
What you’ll Do
  
  

* Build and maintain ELT/ETL pipelines on Databricks and SQL Server using SQL, PySpark, Delta Lake, Workflows/Jobs and Unity Catalog.
* Develop dimensional models (star/snowflake schemas, facts, dimensions, SCDs) and curated datasets for reporting.
* Monitor data quality, SLAs and failures, and resolve pipeline issues.
* Clarify requirements with business and analytics teams, flag gaps early, and turn them into reliable datasets and key metrics.
* Write unit and integration tests, and build pipelines that are easy to test.
* Contribute to query and pipeline performance tuning.
* Use Git, code reviews and documentation to keep work clear, and share what you learn with the team through demos.
* Occasionally support important pipelines outside normal hours, when business needs require.

* 2-7 years in business intelligence, data warehousing and data analysis, with hands-on Databricks development and SQL as the core skill.
* Solid SQL skills: complex joins, CTEs, window functions and reading execution plans.
* Working knowledge of data warehousing: dimensional modelling, SCD types, incremental/CDC loads and medallion (Bronze-Silver-Gold) architecture.
* Python/PySpark for transformation, validation and automation.
* Familiarity with Delta Lake (MERGE, time travel), Git, and Azure or AWS data services.
* Curiosity, attention to detail, and clear communication with technical and non-technical colleagues.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field.

title: Sr. Engineer - Indirect Purchase
description:
**Material Planning & On-Time Delivery**
Ensure assigned indirect materials, services, and capital items are delivered to internal departments on or before the scheduled requirement date.
  
  

* Coordinate with internal stakeholders, suppliers, stores and user departments to track purchase requirements, order status and delivery commitments.
* Proactively identify supply risks, expedite critical items and communicate potential delays with clear recovery actions.

**Cost Analysis & Commercial Management**

* Conduct detailed cost analysis, price benchmarking and total-cost evaluation to establish the appropriate purchase cost for indirect materials and services.
* Monitor pricing and cost trends across affiliated and approved suppliers, and maintain visibility of commercial changes.
* Lead commercial negotiations covering price, payment terms, delivery terms, freight, warranty and other relevant conditions.
* Identify and implement cost-reduction, value-engineering and process-improvement initiatives at the supplier end or within internal processes.

**Supplier Analysis & Development**

* Scan the market to identify capable suppliers and create alternate vendors wherever required to improve availability, competitiveness and supply continuity.
* Assess supplier capability with reference to technical competence, capacity, quality systems, delivery performance, financial/commercial suitability and responsiveness.
* Maintain an appropriate vendor base for assigned commodities and support supplier onboarding, evaluation and development.

**Supplier Performance Management**

* Analyze existing supplier performance using data and past experience, including rejection rate, rework issues, delivery issues, stock levels, supplier capacity and service responsiveness.
* Conduct periodic supplier performance reviews, agree corrective actions and monitor closure of identified gaps.
* Escalate recurring supplier risks and support decisions relating to development, alternate sourcing or supplier rationalization.

**Inventory & Quality Control**

* Ensure commodity-wise inventory control by monitoring stock levels, consumption trends, lead times, reorder requirements and excess or obsolete inventory risks.
* Monitor incoming quality and address commodity-wise quality issues in coordination with Quality, Stores, Engineering, Finance and user departments.
* Drive root-cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions, replacement or rework, and timely closure of supplier quality concerns.

**Data, MIS & ERP Discipline**

* Prepare procurement data, management information reports and periodic dashboards covering spend, savings, supplier performance, inventory, delivery and quality.
* Ensure timely and accurate creation and maintenance of purchase-related data and transactions in the ERP system.
* Maintain complete procurement records, quotations, comparative statements, approvals, purchase orders, contracts and supplier documents in accordance with internal controls.

**Governance & Stakeholder Management**

* Follow the approved procurement process, delegation of authority, compliance requirements and ethical sourcing standards.
* Partner with internal departments to understand demand, define specifications, prioritize requirements and improve purchasing effectiveness.
* Support audits and provide procurement records, supplier data and transaction evidence as required.

**Procurement**
Indirect procurement, sourcing strategy, RFQ / comparative analysis, supplier negotiation, contracting and purchase-order management.
  
  
**Commercial & Analytical**
Cost breakdown, should-cost analysis, spend analysis, price benchmarking, total-cost-of-ownership thinking and savings validation.
  
  
**Supplier & Quality**
Supplier assessment, performance scorecards, alternate-vendor development, root-cause analysis and corrective-action follow-up.

title: GM/ Sr. GM – Engineering Head (Ankleshwar, Gujarat)
description:
GM / Sr. GM – Engineering Head (Ankleshwar, Gujarat)

**Industry:**
Pharmaceutical – API Manufacturing

**Location:**
Ankleshwar, Gujarat

**Department:**
Engineering & Maintenance

**Experience:**
10–15 years (relevant API plant experience preferred)

**Qualification:**
B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering; Electrical or Instrumentation Engineering may be considered based on the role

**Reporting To:**
Plant Head / General Manager – Engineering / Site Head

1. Job Purpose

To lead and manage engineering, maintenance, plant utilities, equipment reliability, and engineering projects at an API manufacturing facility. The role is responsible for ensuring uninterrupted production operations, equipment availability, regulatory compliance, cost optimization, and adherence to cGMP, EHS, and statutory requirements.

2. Key Responsibilities

**A. Plant Engineering & Maintenance**

* Lead day-to-day engineering and maintenance activities for the API manufacturing plant.
* Ensure reliable operation of reactors, centrifuges, dryers, filters, pumps, agitators, heat exchangers, condensers, vacuum systems, and other process equipment.
* Plan and execute preventive, predictive, corrective, and breakdown maintenance.
* Minimize equipment downtime through root cause analysis (RCA) and implementation of corrective and preventive actions.
* Develop equipment maintenance plans, critical spares lists, shutdown schedules, and equipment history records.
* Coordinate with Production to resolve technical issues and maintain production continuity.

**B. Utilities & Facility Management**

* Oversee operation and maintenance of boilers, thermic fluid heaters, chillers, cooling towers, air compressors, vacuum systems, HVAC, and electrical distribution systems.
* Manage utility systems such as RO/DM water, purified water where applicable, nitrogen, compressed air, and other process utilities.
* Monitor utility consumption, system performance, energy efficiency, and operating costs.
* Ensure reliable operation of effluent treatment and other environmental utility systems in coordination with the relevant departments.

**C. GMP, Quality & Regulatory Compliance**

* Ensure engineering activities comply with applicable cGMP, Schedule M, company SOPs, and site quality systems.
* Maintain engineering documentation, maintenance records, equipment logbooks, calibration records, and qualification documents.
* Coordinate equipment qualification, requalification, and engineering support for validation activities.
* Participate in internal, customer, and regulatory audits and ensure timely closure of observations.
* Initiate and implement change controls, deviations, CAPA, and other quality-system actions related to engineering.
* Ensure proper documentation practices and data integrity in all engineering records.

**D. Projects & Capex Management**

* Plan and execute equipment installation, plant modifications, revamping, and capacity expansion projects.
* Prepare technical specifications, scope of work, BOQs, cost estimates, and project schedules.
* Coordinate with consultants, contractors, OEMs, procurement, Production, QA, and EHS teams.
* Supervise equipment erection, commissioning, trial runs, and handover to operations.
* Monitor project cost, timelines, quality, and compliance with approved engineering standards.

**E. Safety & Statutory Compliance**

* Ensure safe execution of maintenance, shutdown, hot work, confined-space work, and work-at-height activities.
* Implement permit-to-work, lockout/tagout (LOTO), and equipment isolation procedures.
* Ensure statutory inspections and certifications of applicable pressure vessels, boilers, lifting equipment, and electrical installations.
* Coordinate with EHS to manage engineering risks, incident investigations, and corrective actions.
* Promote safe working practices among employees, contractors, and service providers.

**F. Team & Cost Management**

* Lead, supervise, and develop engineers, technicians, and maintenance personnel.
* Allocate jobs, monitor performance, and ensure timely completion of maintenance activities.
* Manage maintenance budgets, spare parts, AMC contracts, and vendor performance.
* Drive cost reduction, energy conservation, reliability improvement, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Use SAP PM or another CMMS for maintenance planning, work orders, and equipment history, where applicable.

3. Required Technical Skills

* Strong experience in engineering and maintenance at an API pharmaceutical manufacturing plant.
* Knowledge of API process equipment and associated mechanical systems.
* Good understanding of plant utilities, HVAC, electrical systems, and instrumentation interfaces.
* Experience in preventive maintenance, breakdown troubleshooting, RCA, and equipment reliability.
* Working knowledge of cGMP, engineering documentation, qualification, calibration, and validation support.
* Experience in project execution, commissioning, vendor management, and cost control.
* Knowledge of EHS practices and applicable statutory requirements.
* Familiarity with SAP PM / CMMS and maintenance performance indicators.

4. Educational Qualification & Experience

* B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering preferred.
* Candidates from Electrical or Instrumentation Engineering may be considered depending on the engineering scope.
* 10–15 years of overall engineering and maintenance experience, preferably in API manufacturing.
* Prior experience handling a team and independently managing plant engineering activities.
* Exposure to regulated pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities and customer or regulatory audits is preferred.

5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Equipment availability and reduction in unplanned downtime.
* Adherence to preventive maintenance schedules.
* Timely closure of maintenance work orders.
* Reduction in recurring equipment failures and maintenance costs.
* Utility reliability and energy consumption optimization.
* Timely execution of engineering projects within approved budgets.
* Compliance with GMP documentation and audit requirements.
* Timely closure of engineering deviations, CAPA, and audit observations.
* EHS performance and compliance with statutory requirements.

title: Site Supervisor

title: Operational Excellence Manager
description:
The Operational Excellence Manager will lead the site’s Lean transformation and continuous-improvement agenda across turbine and generator manufacturing operations. The role will improve safety, quality, delivery, cost, productivity, equipment effectiveness, and lead time through structured problem solving, standard work, value-stream improvement, daily management, and selective automation. Operational Excellence roles typically focus on eliminating losses, deploying Lean/Six Sigma methods, improving throughput and yield, and sustaining improvements through standardized processes and performance reviews.
  
  
This is a hands-on, shop-floor leadership role requiring deep engagement with heavy machining, fabrication and welding, assembly, and generator-component manufacturing team.
  
  
Function: Manufacturing / Operations
  
  
Location: Sanand, Ahmedabad (Gujarat)
  
  
Reports to: Operational Excellence Leader
  
  
Management level / band: LPB
  
  
**Manufacturing scope**
The role will support improvement across the full value stream, including:
  
  

* Machining of turbine rotors, casings, diaphragms, and other major nuclear components.
* Blade machining, inspection, handling, and preparation processes.
* Heavy fabrication, welding, stress relieving (PWHT), blasting-painting, machining, and assembly of fabricated structures.
* Turbine assembly, alignment, balancing, testing, and final inspection operations.
* Generator parts manufacturing, including stator green bar production, insulation and processing operations.
* Generator stacking, slotting, wedging, winding support, impregnation, and related assembly processes.
* Material flow, tooling, fixtures, cranes, handling equipment, machine loading, and layout optimization.
* Interface with Quality, Manufacturing Engineering, Maintenance, Planning, Supply Chain, EHS, and Production teams.

**Key Responsibilities**
**Lean transformation and daily management**

* Develop and deploy the site Operational Excellence roadmap aligned with plant safety, quality, delivery, cost, and productivity objectives.
* Lead daily management systems, including SQDC boards, tiered meetings, escalation routines, visual management, and action follow-up.
* Establish and monitor plant KPIs, including safety events and risks, quality performance, plan versus actual, schedule adherence, OEE, productivity, labor hours, lead time, 5S, TPM, and Kaizen effectiveness.
* Conduct structured performance reviews with production, support, and cross-functional teams to identify gaps and drive corrective actions.
* Ensure improvement actions are assigned, tracked, verified, and sustained through standardization.

**Process improvement and waste elimination**

* Lead Value Stream Mapping for turbine and generator manufacturing value streams, identifying bottlenecks, waiting time, transport, inventory, rework, and non-value-added activities.
* Conduct time studies, capacity analysis, line balancing, and cycle-time reduction studies for machining, welding, assembly, and generator-component operations.
* Define and improve work methods, standard work, work instructions, process sequences, tooling requirements, and shop-floor controls.
* Lead root-cause analysis and problem-solving reports (PSR/A3/8D as applicable) for recurring quality, productivity, delivery, and equipment issues.
* Reduce changeover, setup, material-handling, inspection, and waiting losses through Lean methods such as SMED, 5S, Kanban, pull systems, and flow optimization.
* Improve process repeatability, first-time quality, throughput, and on-time delivery while respecting product and process specifications.

**Machining, welding, and assembly improvement**

* Partner with Manufacturing Engineering and Production teams to improve heavy machining processes for rotors, casings, diaphragms, and blades.
* Analyze machine utilization, setup time, tool life, fixture changeover, inspection cycles, operator waiting, and material availability to improve machining output.
* Support improvement of heavy fabrication and welding operations, including weld sequencing, fit-up, distortion control, rework reduction, handling, and workflow design.
* Improve turbine assembly and generator stator manufacturing processes through better layout, kitting, sequencing, standard work, ergonomic design, and visual controls.
* Identify opportunities to reduce lead time and work-in-process across long-cycle, high-value components.

**Automation, ergonomics, and technology**

* Identify, evaluate, and implement cost-effective low-level automation, robotics, mechanized handling, digital tools, and assistive technologies.
* Lead feasibility studies, benefit calculations, investment justifications, supplier coordination, pilot trials, and implementation for selected automation projects.
* Apply human-factors and ergonomic principles to reduce manual effort, improve safety, and improve operator productivity in heavy-component handling and assembly areas.
* Stay current with Industry 4.0, AI, machine learning, robotics, digital performance management, and relevant manufacturing technologies; assess practical applications for the site

**Building Capability and Culture**

* Train, coach, and develop production supervisors, engineers, operators, and cross-functional teams in Lean thinking, structured problem solving, standard work, 5S, TPM, and daily management.
* Lead Kaizen events, improvement workshops, and cross-functional projects from diagnosis through implementation and benefit validation.
* Communicate the Operational Excellence vision, expectations, and results across the plant.
* Build a culture of ownership, data-based decision making, safety awareness, quality discipline, and continuous improvement.

**Area**
**Indicative KPIs**
Safety
  
  
EHS events, near misses, risk closure, ergonomic improvement actions
  
  
Quality
  
  
First-time right, rework, scrap, customer/internal complaints, process adherence
  
  
Delivery
  
  
Plan versus actual, schedule adherence, lead time, on-time completion
  
  
Productivity
  
  
OEE, machine utilization, output per labor hour, cycle time, variance and utilization
  
  
Cost
  
  
Cost-reduction savings, labor-hour reduction, rework reduction, inventory/WIP reduction
  
  
Lean maturity
  
  
5S score, standard-work adherence, TPM effectiveness, Kaizen completion and benefit realization
  
  
Improvement governance
  
  
PSR closure, action-plan effectiveness, project milestone delivery, sustained savings
  
  
**Candidate Profile**
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in industrial engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 7–10 years of experience in manufacturing operations, industrial engineering, Lean/continuous improvement, or operational excellence.
* Proven experience leading Lean manufacturing initiatives, Kaizen events, Value Stream Mapping, standard-work development, and structured problem solving.
* Hands-on shop-floor experience in heavy engineering, turbine manufacturing, power-generation equipment, capital-goods manufacturing, or a comparable heavy-machining environment.
* Experience analyzing complex manufacturing data and translating findings into practical improvement actions.
* Strong working knowledge of MS Excel, PowerPoint, and manufacturing-performance reporting; familiarity with ERP systems is desirable.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple projects, and influence cross-functional teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification.
* Experience with turbine, generator, rotating equipment, heavy fabrication, machining, or large-assembly manufacturing.

As an IC4 engineer, the successful candidate is expected to independently own complex technical initiatives, provide technical guidance, mentor other engineers, and drive continuous improvements in automation, security, monitoring, and operational processes. Experience supporting enterprise SaaS applications, implementing Infrastructure as Code, and using AI-assisted tools for automation development and troubleshooting is highly desirable.

* Maintains and optimizes application services, infrastructure, and automation platforms to ensure availability, reliability, security, and operational performance.
* Performs complex incident investigation, technical analysis, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis across Windows/Linux servers, application services, automation jobs, databases, and networking components.
* Designs, develops, and maintains automation supporting application installations, in-place upgrades (IPUs), migrations, patching, configuration updates, password rotation, and rollback procedures.
* Supports enterprise application lifecycle operations, including Oracle Client upgrades, security patching, certificate renewals, vulnerability remediation, backup, and recovery.
* Monitors infrastructure and application health using OpenSearch, OCI Monitoring, OCI Logging, OCI Log Analytics, and related observability tools.
* Develops operational reporting, dashboards, and automated validation processes to identify performance issues, automation failures, and service reliability risks.
* Supports scheduled maintenance, customer-facing deployments, environment provisioning, and infrastructure decommissioning activities while minimizing service disruption.

**Automation**

* Designs, develops, implements, and maintains production-grade automation using PowerShell, Python, Bash, Ansible, and Oracle Linux Automation Manager (OLAM).
* Develops reusable automation frameworks, Ansible playbooks, roles, job templates, dynamic inventories, and scripts to support application and infrastructure operations across multiple environments.
* Automates application installations, upgrades, patching, password rotation, configuration management, deployment validation, and rollback procedures.
* Implements automated testing, error handling, logging, exception management, and recovery mechanisms to improve automation quality and reliability.
* Modernizes legacy automation by migrating existing Chef, BladeLogic, and other configuration management solutions to PowerShell, Ansible/OLAM, and standardized automation frameworks.
* Develops automated tests using PowerShell Pester or equivalent testing frameworks to validate scripts, application configurations, and infrastructure changes.
* Continuously identifies opportunities to reduce manual operational effort, improve deployment consistency, shorten maintenance windows, and reduce operational errors.
* Maintains CI/CD pipelines, source code repositories, and automation workflows using Git, GitLab, OCI DevOps, Jenkins, or equivalent platforms.

**Technical Communication and Guidance**

* Communicates infrastructure changes, application deployment requirements, automation designs, security considerations, operational risks, and service impacts to technical teams and stakeholders.
* Collaborates with Development, QA, Cloud Operations, SRE, Security, and other engineering teams to define technical requirements and deliver reliable automation solutions.
* Develops and maintains technical documentation, automation design specifications, operational runbooks, release procedures, troubleshooting guides, and knowledge-sharing materials.
* Provides technical guidance on PowerShell, Python, Ansible/OLAM, OCI infrastructure, application lifecycle automation, and production troubleshooting.
* Proactively identifies potential impacts of infrastructure changes, application upgrades, and automation enhancements, communicating risks and mitigation strategies.
* Mentors engineers, performs code and automation reviews, and promotes consistent engineering standards and operational best practices across globally distributed teams.

**Troubleshooting and Resolution**

* Serves as a technical escalation point for complex infrastructure, application deployment, automation, networking, and production support issues.
* Investigates and resolves failures involving Ansible/OLAM jobs, PowerShell scripts, application upgrades, configuration changes, and infrastructure services.
* Diagnoses technical issues across Windows/Linux operating systems, Oracle databases, application services, DNS, load balancers, SSL/TLS certificates, and network connectivity.
* Participates in on-call rotations and supports critical customer-facing incidents, scheduled maintenance, and production deployments.
* Performs root cause analysis (RCA), documents incidents, and implements corrective and preventive actions to minimize recurring failures.
* Develops automation and troubleshooting improvements to reduce mean time to detect (MTTD) and mean time to resolve (MTTR), supporting established service level objectives (SLOs).
* Collaborates with cross-functional engineering teams to resolve complex technical dependencies and minimize customer impact.

**Innovation and Improvement**

* Evaluates emerging automation, DevOps, cloud infrastructure, and SRE technologies to improve application reliability, operational efficiency, and scalability.
* Identifies and implements improvements to automation frameworks, deployment processes, monitoring capabilities, and infrastructure management.
* Drives modernization of legacy automation platforms by adopting reusable PowerShell functions, Ansible playbooks, automated validation, and standardized source code management.
* Evaluates approved AI-assisted tools to improve automation development, code analysis, log investigation, incident triage, and troubleshooting efficiency.
* Analyzes operational metrics, automation failures, deployment performance, and infrastructure utilization to recommend improvements.
* Develops solutions that reduce manual intervention, improve deployment success rates, strengthen security compliance, and optimize infrastructure costs.
* Maintains current knowledge of DevOps, cloud automation, SRE, and security best practices, sharing recommendations and technical insights across engineering teams.

**Core Responsibilities**
**Planning & Execution**

* Independently manages and executes moderately complex to complex DevOps automation and infrastructure initiatives, ensuring technical requirements, timelines, and deliverables are met.
* Plans and coordinates application upgrades, automation releases, infrastructure changes, and production maintenance activities across multiple teams and environments.
* Identifies technical dependencies, prioritizes competing operational requirements, and proactively addresses risks that could impact customer-facing services.
* Provides technical oversight, reviews implementation plans, and ensures appropriate testing, validation, and rollback procedures are established.

**Collaboration & Partnership**

* Collaborates across Development, QA, Cloud Operations, SRE, Security, Infrastructure, and Product Engineering teams to deliver reliable and scalable automation solutions.
* Works closely with global engineering teams to support application lifecycle activities, infrastructure modernization, security improvements, and production operations.
* Understands business and customer requirements and translates them into practical technical solutions that improve operational efficiency and service reliability.
* Promotes knowledge sharing, constructive collaboration, and consistent automation practices across teams.

**Problem Solving**

* Independently investigates and resolves complex technical problems involving automation frameworks, application services, operating systems, infrastructure, databases, and networking.
* Analyzes system logs, automation job failures, performance metrics, and configuration dependencies to identify root causes and implement sustainable solutions.
* Evaluates technical alternatives, anticipates operational risks, and recommends solutions that improve reliability, maintainability, and scalability.
* Documents troubleshooting procedures, lessons learned, and reusable solutions to improve future operational response.

**Continuous Learning**

* Maintains advanced technical knowledge of PowerShell, Python, Ansible/OLAM, Windows/Linux administration, OCI, CI/CD, and enterprise application lifecycle automation.
* Stays current with developments in DevOps, cloud infrastructure, SRE, automation testing, security, and AI-assisted engineering tools.
* Proactively develops new technical skills and applies emerging technologies to improve operational processes.
* Coaches and mentors engineers through technical guidance, code reviews, knowledge-sharing sessions, and troubleshooting support.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Identifies and implements improvements to automation processes, operational workflows, application deployment procedures, and infrastructure management.
* Develops reusable automation libraries, standardized Ansible playbooks, PowerShell modules, testing frameworks, and operational documentation.
* Continuously evaluates opportunities to reduce deployment times, improve automation reliability, minimize incidents, and reduce manual operational effort.
* Establishes measurable improvements in automation execution, deployment success rates, incident resolution, maintenance efficiency, and infrastructure utilization.
* Encourages feedback from engineering and operations teams to improve automation quality, maintainability, and adoption.

**Performance and Development**

* Mentors junior engineers and contributes to the development of technical capabilities across the Cloud Enablement Team.
* Participates in candidate interviews, technical assessments, and hiring recommendations to support team growth and capability development.
* Promotes engineering excellence, continuous learning, automation standards, and operational reliability across the organization.

description:
**Job Title:**
Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)

**Location:**
Ahmedabad, Gujarat (PWFH)

**Job Type:**
Full-time

**Department:**
Tech

**About Simform:**

Simform is a premier digital engineering company specializing in Cloud, Data, AI/ML, and Experience Engineering to create seamless digital experiences and scalable products. Simform is a strong partner for Microsoft, Google Cloud, and Databricks. With a presence in 5+ countries, Simform primarily serves North America, the UK, and the Northern European market.

Simform takes pride in being one of the most reputed employers in the region, having created a thriving work culture with a high work-life balance that gives a sense of freedom and opportunity to grow.

**Role Summary:**

Simform is hiring a Senior L1 Support Engineer to support production systems across multiple client engagements. The role combines strong SRE/DevOps fundamentals (CI/CD, infrastructure automation, monitoring, incident response) with the ability to coordinate directly with clients, understand SLA commitments, and own issues end-to-end against TTR/TTO targets

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Monitor production systems (uptime, performance, alerts) and respond to incidents against defined MTTR/TTR targets.
* Act as a technical point of contact for the client coordinate directly on status updates, incident RCAs, and planned changes
* Triage, troubleshoot, and resolve infrastructure, deployment, and application issues across cloud environments.
* Own incident response end-to-end: acknowledge, diagnose, mitigate, resolve, and document root cause (RCA).
* Write clear, structured RCA documents for major incidents - timeline, root cause, impact, and corrective actions.
* Conduct thorough shift handovers - open issues, in-progress incidents, and pending follow-ups documented and communicated so the incoming shift can pick up without delay.
* Escalate per the support/escalation matrix when an issue needs deeper architecture or product-level involvement.
* Automate repetitive operational tasks (deployments, scaling, backups, alerting) to reduce manual toil.
* Maintain runbooks, dashboards, and documentation so operational knowledge compounds across engagements.
* Participate in a 24/7 on-call/shift rotation and report SLA/TTR/TTO metrics to internal and client stakeholders Monthly

**Required Skills**

**Technical**

* Must have Cloud platform experience (Azure preferred; AWS/GCP plus) - compute, networking, IAM, storage.
* Must have Hands-on experience with CI/CD tools (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or similar).
* Must have Scripting (Python, Bash, or PowerShell) for automation and tooling.
* Working knowledge of Infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Bicep/ARM, or CloudFormation) and configuration management.
* Working knowledge of Containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes) and observability stacks (Azure Monitor, Datadog, or similar).
* Working knowledge of databases and data pipelines is a plus when supporting data platform engagements.

**ITSM & Alerting Tools**

* Working with any ITSM tools like Jira Service Desk, Freshdesk, or similar.
* Worked with alerting and on-call tools like PagerDuty, Opsgenie, or similar.

**Communication**

* Confident, clear communicator who can run or join client calls, give status updates, and explain technical root causes to non-technical stakeholders.
* Able to coordinate across the client and internal engineering/support teams during an incident without dropping the thread.
* Strong shift-handover discipline - able to hand off and pick up open incidents cleanly across time zones with no information loss.
* Skilled at writing clear RCA documentation that a reader with no prior context can follow.
* Disciplined documentation habits - every incident, change, and escalation logged as it happens

**Support Process**

* Solid understanding of SLA (Service Level Agreement) structures - severity/priority tiers and what each commits to.
* Working knowledge of TTR (Time to Resolve) and TTO/TTA (Time to Respond/Acknowledge) and how they're measured and reported.
* Understands escalation matrices and when to escalate vs. own an issue

**Qualifications & Experience**

* 2–4 years in a Support / DevOps / Infrastructure Engineering role (B.E./ B. Tech. or equivalent practical experience).
* Proven experience supporting production systems with defined SLAs/uptime commitments.
* Cloud certification (Azure, AWS, or GCP) is a strong plus
* Experience directly coordinating with clients or external stakeholders, not just internal teams, preferred.
* Willingness to work in rotating shifts / on call, with overlap into client time zones

**Why Join Us:**

* Young Team, Thriving Culture
* Flat-hierarchical, friendly, engineering-oriented, and growth-focused culture.
* Well-balanced learning and growth opportunities
* Work on high-impact client projects across Cloud, Data, and AI/ML for North America, the UK, and Northern Europe.
* Flexible work timing with remote and hybrid options.

title: Risk Consulting - Actuarial - FAST implementation - Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Role name**
**Senior, FAST Policy Admin System, Life Actuarial, EY GDS Consulting**
Be part of a high-performing, supportive culture
  
  

* Work with a team of collaborators, innovators and the brightest minds in the industry

Global Delivery Services is one of EY's greatest global assets – a network of service delivery centers that provide high-quality services at a competitive cost for all EY’s client serving and enablement teams. Every day, we combine our subject matter expertise with our technology and automation skills to develop new solutions that deliver greater value for EY. If you have a passion for enabling world class actuarial services globally to solve the most complex challenges in the financial services industry, come join our dynamic GDS team!
  
  
**The opportunity**
We are looking for a Senior to join our Life Insurance Actuarial Practice delivering FAST policy admin system team to the leading clients in Insurance Sector, working closely with other Staff/Assistants, Consultants/Seniors, Managers, Senior Managers or Client partners in EY’s global network of insurance sector and consulting professionals
  
  
You can expect to work along with senior managers/directors to support large scale engagements and deliver high-quality client solutions. You will develop and maintain long-term relationships and networks, build and energize a high performing team.
  
  
Our growing team of professionals come from a diverse background, all committed to being long term trusted advisors to our clients.
  
  
**Key Requirements**
As a Senior within the Life Policy Admin System or FAST product configuration team your role involves developing and implementing solutions both within the Insurance service line and in collaboration with other services lines.
  
  

* Strong life insurance and/or annuity product knowledge
* Product Values Testing (PVT) and expected-value development
* Actuarial testing tool development (Excel/VBA, Python preferred)
* Conversion validation and reconciliation experience
* Defect triage and root-cause analysis
* FAST, ALIP, LifePro, CyberLife, or similar PAS experience preferred
* Ability to translate product specifications into test scenarios and expected results
* Strong excel skills, capable of running and modifying macros used to transform Actuarial Cashflows
* Ability to develop regression models on excel to test the model developments
* Hands-on or Advance level experience in Life Policy Admin System or FAST product configuration.
* Strong experience on Excel is must and experience on VBA would be good
* Good experience of preparing PPT decks
* In-depth understanding of insurance products and regulations of US, Canada and other geographies

We are looking for individuals who have a proactive attitude and are seeking the opportunity for personal and professional growth, leveraging and supporting our global network.
  
  
**Skills And Attributes For Success**
Skills and attributes for a successful career at EY require a learning mindset and passion to add value to GDS, member firms and client organisations. Bright and enthusiastic individuals who give their all to each assignment they work on will find themselves at home within our energetic GDS actuarial team.
  
  
**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* 3-6 years of Life Policy Admin System or FAST product configuration experience in life team of an insurance / consulting / outsourcing company
* Good analytical skills
* Ability to do investigations in models / reporting process and independently solve problems
* Willingness to learn and apply learning actively in project work Proficiency in MS-Office Suite, Power BI, VBA, SAS, R Programming, Python, SQL, SPSS, etc., will be a plus

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Good actuarial exam progress
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for report writing, industry studies and stakeholder presentations
* The ability to build relationships with colleagues across the business, support them and promote a collaborative environment
* Overseas exposure (especially US/Canada/Europe market experience)

**What We Look For**

* Up to date knowledge of the regulatory environment impacting insurers and other financial service organisations
* Experience of supporting teams to high quality timely delivery, actively building relationships and promoting a collaborative culture when working with colleagues

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. Degree required

description:
**Role Description**
**Mulesoft Developer**
**Location : Bangalore, Chennai, Pune, Noida, Kochi & Trivandrum**
**Role Summary**
We are looking for a MuleSoft Integration Developer to design, build and support the APIs and integrations that connect our Salesforce orgs to client systems and partners. You will work in an Agile team with Salesforce developers, architects and QA, and own integrations from design through production support. You will work with member and provider data, so secure, HIPAA-compliant design is part of the job.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and build: Create Mule 4 APIs and integrations using API-led connectivity (System, Process and Experience APIs).
* API specs: Write RAML/OAS specs and publish them to Anypoint Exchange for reuse.

* Security: Apply API Manager policies (OAuth 2.0, client ID, rate limiting), secure properties and encryption; protect PHI/PII.
* Reliability: Build error handling, retries, logging and s; tune performance.
* DevOps: Use Git/Bitbucket and CI/CD (Bamboo, Maven) to deploy to CloudHub / Runtime Fabric; follow code review and scan gates (SonarQube, Checkmarx).
* Testing: Write MUnit tests (target 80%+ coverage) and support SIT and UAT.
* Support: Monitor with Anypoint Monitoring, fix production issues and take part in on-call rotation.
* Teamwork: Join sprint ceremonies, estimate stories in Jira, and document designs in Confluence.

**Required Skills And Experience**

* 5+ years of integration development; 3+ years building Mule 4 applications.
* Strong DataWeave 2.0, Anypoint Studio, Anypoint Platform (Exchange, API Manager, Runtime Manager).
* Hands-on Salesforce integration experience (REST/SOAP/Bulk APIs, Platform Events, CDC).
* REST and SOAP web services, JSON, XML, and API security (OAuth 2.0, JWT, TLS).
* Messaging and patterns: Anypoint MQ, JMS or Kafka; batch and real-time integrations.
* Git, Maven and CI/CD pipelines; MUnit testing.
* Clear written and verbal communication; able to explain technical work to business partners.

**Preferred**

* Healthcare or payer experience (HIPAA, HL7, FHIR, X12 EDI such as 834/837).
* Runtime Fabric or CloudHub 2.0, and Kubernetes basics.
* Java for custom components; SQL and database connectors.
* Experience with Salesforce Health Cloud and Flosum or similar release tools.

MuleSoft, Salesforce, Salesforce Health Cloud, API Development, Git, HIPAA, HL7, JSON

description:
**Job Overview**
Provide experienced technical expertise to develop process methodology for department to meet internal and external clients’ needs. Plan and coordinate the development of integrated programming solutions serving the full spectrum of statistical programming needs. Provide technical expertise and leadership to the department. Provide internal consulting services, including specifications and user needs analysis for complex project or client requirements.
  
  
**Essential Functions**

* Perform, plan and co-ordinate the following for complex studies: (i) the programming, testing, and documentation of statistical programs for use in creating statistical tables, figures, and listing summaries and (ii) the programming of analysis databases (derived datasets) and transfers of data for internal and external clients. May perform and plan the programming of database quality control checks.
* Program and plan the integration of databases from multiple studies or sources.
* Develop and co-ordinate programming documentation including plans and specifications, as appropriate, for complex studies.
* Provide advanced technical expertise in conjunction with internal and external clients, and independently bring project solutions to teams and department, for complex studies.
* Perform, plan and co-ordinate the development, implementation and validation of new process technologies, macros and applications.
* Fulfill project responsibilities at the level of statstical team lead for single complex studies or group of studies.
* Understand the Scope of Work, budget and quote assumptions, estimate the work completed, manage Out of Scope and resource forecasts for single studies. May manage project budget and resource requirements, and provide revenue forecasts for single studies.
* Provide training and guidance to lower level staff.

* Master's Degree Computer science or related field and 3 years relevant experience Req Or
* Bachelor's Degree Computer science or related field and 4 years relevant experience Req
* Equivalent combination of education, training and experience in lieu of degree Req
* Knowledge of statistics, programming and/or clinical drug development process
* Advanced knowledge of computing applications such as Base SAS, SAS Graph and SAS Macro Language
* Excellent knowledge of CDISC SDTM standards and SDTM mapping process, P21 Enterprise/Community tool, SDTM mapping specification, etc.
* Good organizational, interpersonal, leadership and communication skills
* Ability to effectively manage multiple tasks and projects
* Excellent accuracy and attention to detail
* Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with coworkers, managers and clients

Our end-to-end software solutions connect professional designers, retailers and manufacturers to the world's largest repository of product content. We are looking for a highly experienced, hands-on Senior Developer / Technical Architect with 10–15 years of software engineering experience to develop, enhance, and support our fenestration software platform. The role will focus on resolving complex product defects, delivering new features, improving product stability and performance, and modernizing existing components. * Design and develop scalable solutions using Vite, TypeScript, .NET/C#, and MS SQL Server.
* Troubleshoot performance, concurrency, data integrity, integration, and high-volume processing issues.
* Work with Product, QA, Support, and domain experts to understand and resolve customer-impacting issues.
* Perform code reviews and provide technical guidance and mentorship to developers.
* Improve code quality, automated testing, diagnostics, maintainability, and overall product stability.
Contribute to the technical modernization of a mature enterprise application while protecting existing customer workflows.  

**Required Experience and Qualifications:**

* 10–15 years of software development experience in Senior Developer, Technical Lead, or Architect roles.
* TypeScript & Vite, C# / .NET / .NET Core, Microsoft SQL Server.
* REST APIs and system integrations.
* Strong understanding software architecture, design patterns, SOLID principles, scalability, and application performance.
* Expert troubleshooting skills across frontend, API, backend, database, integrations.
* Strong SQL expertise includes query optimization, transactions, concurrency, locking, and performance tuning.
* Experience supporting and enhancing large, mature, business-critical enterprise applications.
* Strong experience with unit/integration testing, CI/CD, source control, and code reviews.
Ability to independently drive complex technical problems from root cause through resolution.  

**Nice to Have:**

* Experience in fenestration, window & door, manufacturing, or fabrication software domain.
* Understanding of product configuration, quoting, BOM generation, order processing, purchasing, supplier/dealer workflows, and manufacturing processes.
* Experience with CPQ, ERP, or complex rules-driven product configuration systems.
Experience modernizing legacy enterprise applications and integrating modern web technologies with established platforms.

At Cyncly, we call our team OneCyncly, a reflection of how we work together as one, united by our purpose: powering businesses that bring spaces to life. If you want to work in a place where your ideas matter, your growth is valued, and your work shapes the spaces people live, work, and play in - Come join us.
