title: Software Test Engineer
description:
**About Voxtron**

Voxtron Solutions LLP is a technology solutions company focused on delivering enterprise software solutions, digital transformation services and business applications. We develop and implement software solutions that help organisations streamline business operations, improve productivity and enhance operational efficiency.

We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive **Software Test Engineer** to join our team at Infopark, Kochi. The candidate will be responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability and performance of our software solutions, particularly in the areas of Human Resource Management Systems (HRMS) and Asset Management.

Candidates with hands-on experience testing HRMS and Asset Management applications are required. Experience in testing enterprise products and participating in product development and release cycles will be an added advantage.

**Role Overview**

The Software Test Engineer will be responsible for understanding business requirements, preparing test scenarios, executing functional and regression testing, identifying defects and working closely with development and product teams to ensure the delivery of high-quality software.

The role requires a good understanding of business workflows, the ability to identify functional gaps and edge cases, and a systematic approach to software quality assurance.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Requirement Analysis and Test Planning**

* Understand business requirements, functional specifications and user stories.
* Analyse requirements and identify test scenarios, business rules, dependencies and potential gaps.
* Prepare test plans, test scenarios, test cases and test data.
* Identify positive, negative, boundary and exception scenarios.
* Participate in requirement clarification and design discussions with business analysts, developers and product teams.
* Ensure adequate test coverage for functional requirements.

**2. Functional Testing – HRMS**

* Perform functional testing of HRMS modules and business workflows.
* Validate employee lifecycle processes, including employee onboarding, employee records, transfers, promotions and separation.
* Test leave management, attendance, shift management, overtime and employee self-service functionalities.
* Validate payroll-related workflows, salary structures, allowances, deductions and payroll calculations, where applicable.
* Test approval workflows, employee requests, notifications and role-based access.
* Validate HR reports, dashboards and data exports.
* Verify integrations with biometric attendance devices, payroll systems and other external applications, where applicable.

**3. Functional Testing – Asset Management**

* Test end-to-end asset lifecycle management processes.
* Validate asset creation, categorisation, allocation, assignment and return workflows.
* Test asset transfers, maintenance, repair, depreciation and disposal processes, where applicable.
* Verify asset tracking, ownership, employee-to-asset mapping and location-based tracking.
* Validate asset approval workflows, alerts, notifications and audit trails.
* Test asset reports, dashboards and reconciliation-related functionalities.
* Ensure accuracy and consistency of asset information across relevant modules.

**4. Functional and Regression Testing**

* Execute functional, integration, system and regression testing.
* Validate end-to-end business scenarios across different modules.
* Perform retesting of resolved defects and ensure that fixes do not impact existing functionalities.
* Test application behaviour across supported browsers, devices and screen resolutions.
* Identify inconsistencies in business logic, calculations, workflows, validations and user interfaces.
* Verify data integrity and consistency across interconnected modules.

**5. Defect Management and Coordination**

* Identify, document and report software defects with clear reproduction steps.
* Classify defects based on severity and business impact.
* Maintain defect logs and track issues through resolution.
* Work closely with developers to reproduce, analyse and validate reported defects.
* Perform retesting and regression testing after defect fixes.
* Communicate testing progress, blockers and quality risks to the project or product team.

**6. Product Development Testing**

* Participate in testing new product features and enhancements.
* Validate new functionalities against approved requirements and acceptance criteria.
* Test product releases, patches and upgrades.
* Identify usability issues, functional gaps and potential improvements.
* Support release validation and production-readiness assessments.
* Maintain reusable test scenarios and regression test suites.

**7. Documentation and Reporting**

* Maintain test plans, test cases, test execution reports and defect reports.
* Prepare test completion and quality status reports.
* Maintain traceability between requirements, test cases and defects.
* Document test evidence and maintain appropriate testing records.
* Contribute to improving QA processes, standards and testing practices.

**Mandatory Skills and Experience**

* Previous hands-on experience as a Software Tester, QA Engineer or Software Test Engineer.
* Practical experience in testing **HRMS solutions**.
* Practical experience in testing **Asset Management solutions**.
* Good understanding of enterprise application workflows and business processes.
* Strong knowledge of functional testing, regression testing, integration testing and system testing.
* Ability to analyse requirements and independently prepare detailed test scenarios and test cases.
* Experience in defect identification, documentation, tracking and retesting.
* Good analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to work systematically.
* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively with developers, business analysts and product teams.

**Preferred / Added Advantage**

The following skills and experience will be considered an advantage:

* Experience in testing enterprise software products or SaaS applications.
* Experience working in a product development environment.
* Exposure to test automation tools such as Selenium, Playwright or Cypress.
* Knowledge of API testing tools such as Postman.
* Basic SQL knowledge for database validation and backend data verification.
* Understanding of web technologies, browser behaviour and client-server architecture.
* Experience with test management and defect tracking tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps or similar.
* Experience in testing mobile applications.
* Exposure to Agile / Scrum development methodologies.
* Knowledge of payroll, attendance, employee self-service and asset lifecycle management processes.

**Educational Qualification**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics or a related discipline.
* Relevant software testing certifications will be an added advantage.

**Key Competencies**

* Strong analytical and logical thinking.
* Good understanding of business processes and application workflows.
* Ability to identify edge cases and potential functional issues.
* Ownership and accountability for testing deliverables.
* Effective collaboration and communication.
* Ability to manage multiple testing activities and meet release timelines.
* Willingness to learn new technologies, products and business domains.

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹45,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Experience:

* Product testing: 3 years (Required)
* HRMS Testing: 3 years (Required)

Work Location: In person

title: Business Analyst
description:
**Location: Kochi, India (Hybrid)**  
**Permanent - Full Time**

**About Us**  
Cyncly is a global technology powerhouse with 2,400+ employees and 70,000+ customers across 100+ countries. Cyncly transforms the way customizable products and spaces are imagined, designed, sold, managed and made. Our end-to-end software solutions connect professional designers, retailers and manufacturers to the world's largest repository of product content. Today, our business spans across the Kitchen & Bath, Furniture, Window, Glass & Door, and Flooring industries with operations in North & South America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Africa.

Cyncly brings over 30 years of experience to deliver more value for our customers through an expanded portfolio of end-to-end solutions. Our global presence allows us to provide world-class support and sales with a local touch, providing the best possible customer experience.

Cyncly is now embarking on an exciting journey as we continue to expand through strong organic growth and complementary acquisitions, backed by leading growth private equity firms specializing in technology.  
  
  
  
***Availability between 7:00 PM to 4:00 PM IST is required to support collaboration with our global teams.***  
  
  
**About the Role**  
We are hiring a Business Analyst in Kochi to turn the needs of window, door and glass manufacturers into clear, buildable requirements for the Soft Tech product in Cyncly's Windows, Doors & Glass (WDG) business unit. You will work in an async-first, distributed Agile team spanning New Zealand and India, and act as the bridge between product stakeholders and the engineering team.

**Key Position Responsibilities Include:**

* The analyst owns the path from a customer or product need to a requirement the engineering team can estimate, build and test.
* Elicit and document requirements for WDG workflows such as quoting and estimating, order entry, bills of materials, cut lists, production scheduling and glass optimization.
* Write user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows and business rules in the backlog, in a form developers and QA can use without a follow-up call.
* Work with the New Zealand Product Manager and Product Owner to refine and prioritize the backlog and bring back clear scope and trade-offs.
* Participate in backlog refinement, sprint planning and other Agile ceremonies, and run requirement walkthroughs with developers and QA across both locations, closing open questions within the working day where possible.
* Support QA by reviewing test cases, preparing UAT scenarios and checking that delivered features match the agreed behavior.
* Analyze customer-reported issues and change requests, and separate defects, gaps and genuine enhancements.
* Document how existing V6 functionality and integrations behave, including REST API and JSON payload interactions, so that behavior is captured accurately.
* Prepare release notes for delivered features and changes.
* Keep requirement documents, decision logs and domain glossaries current so knowledge does not sit with one person.
Help new India team members, including freshers, learn the WDG domain and the product.  

**Required Experience and Qualifications:**

* Candidates need 4–6 years of business analysis in enterprise or manufacturing software, with a track record of writing requirements that developers could build from directly.
* Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, business or a related field.
* Strong requirements practice user stories, acceptance criteria, use cases, process modelling (UML/BPMN) and traceability.
* Good understanding of Agile/Scrum and the software development lifecycle.
* Hands-on experience with Azure DevOps for backlog management.
* Ability to work through a large legacy application, read its behavior and business rules, and document them accurately.
* Working knowledge of SQL to inspect data and validate behavior.
* Understanding of REST APIs, integrations and JSON payloads.
* Comfort with an async-first way of working across a ~6.5-hour time gap with New Zealand: written clarity, concise updates and well-prepared handovers.
* Excellent written and spoken English, as most stakeholder communication is with New Zealand colleagues.
Ability to challenge unclear scope politely, propose practical solutions and escalate risks early.  

**Good to Have:**

* Experience in the fenestration or building-products industry is the strongest differentiator, though we will consider strong analysts from adjacent manufacturing domains.
* Exposure to window, door, glass, aluminum, uPVC or timber fabrication, including how products are configured, priced, cut and assembled.
* Understanding of the value chain from manufacturer to dealer, installer and builder, and of quote-to-order-to-production flows.
* Familiarity with configurators, estimating or CPQ tools, optimization (cutting, nesting) or shop-floor and ERP integrations.
* Experience working with distributed teams in New Zealand, Australia, the UK or the US.
* Experience in software product companies or enterprise application development.
Certification such as CBAP, PMI-PBA or CSPO is a plus, not a requirement.  

**Working for Us**  
At Cyncly, we call our team OneCyncly, a reflection of how we work together as one, united by our purpose: powering businesses that bring spaces to life. Our strength comes from our diversity of experiences, perspectives, and skills - and we thrive when we work together with openness, trust, and respect.
  
  
Here, you’ll join a group of colleagues who take ownership, solve problems, and focus on making an impact. We embrace curiosity, welcome new ideas, and see mistakes as opportunities to learn. You’ll have the freedom to work flexibly and autonomously, supported by teammates and leaders who are committed to your growth.
  
  
We celebrate the different ways people contribute and encourage everyone - from every background - to bring their authentic self to work. Because when we collaborate, challenge each other, and share what we know, we build something better together.
  
  
If you want to work in a place where your ideas matter, your growth is valued, and your work shapes the spaces people live, work, and play in - Come join us.

**About the job**
-----------------

The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.

In this role, you will be part of a global team that provides support to help customers seamlessly make the switch to Google Cloud. When customers cannot resolve issues themselves, your job is to ensure that we have the necessary tools and processes to resolve the issue. You will troubleshoot technical problems for customers with a mix of debugging, networking, system administration, updating documentation, and when needed, coding/scripting. You will make our products easier to adopt and to use by making improvements to the product, tools, processes, and documentation. You will help drive the success and business growth of Google Cloud by understanding and advocating for our customers’ issues.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

--------------------

* Manage customer problems through effective diagnosis, resolution or implementation of investigation tools to increase productivity for customer issues on Google Cloud Platform products.
* Develop an in-depth understanding of Google Cloud Data Analytics products (e.g., BigQuery, Dataflow, Dataproc, Cloud Composer) and underlying architectures by troubleshooting, reproducing, and determining the root cause for customer-reported issues, building tools for faster diagnosis.
* Act as consultant and subject matter expert for internal stakeholders in engineering, sales, and customer organizations to resolve technical deployment obstacles and improve Google Cloud.
* Work as part of a team of engineers/consultants that globally ensure 24-hour customer support, including working non-standard work hours/shifts, and may include weekend work.
* Advocate customer issues and their needs with cross-functional teams, including product and engineering teams to find ways to improve the product and drive quality production.

title: Business Analyst
Lead Analyst, Private Markets Data (VC/PE Deals & Financials)
description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

‍

##### **Tracxn Technologies Ltd (NSE: TRACXN) | Bengaluru | Work from office**

‍

##### **Why this role**

‍

Every funding round tells a story, and the paperwork rarely tells it cleanly. A term sheet says one thing, a regulatory filing says another, and the financial statements raise a third question. At Tracxn, you will be the person who settles it.

Lead Analyst, Private Markets Data (VC/PE Deals & Financials) You will be the final authority on how private-company financing and financial performance are interpreted and represented across a global private markets intelligence platform used by investors, corporates and bankers. Data, Product and Engineering teams will come to you when an instrument, a deal structure or a set of financials doesn't add up, and your call becomes the standard that the whole
  
platform follows.

‍

If you think in preference shares and liquidation waterfalls, read balance sheets for fun, and want your judgement to shape how the market sees private-company data, this is the role.

‍

##### **What you will own**

‍

* Be the final authority on funding deals and financial instruments. Decide how complex cases (structured rounds, tranched investments, secondaries, convertibles, down rounds, recapitalisations) are interpreted and represented as data.
* Read primary sources and resolve conflicts. Work through term sheets, shareholders' agreements, regulatory filings (MCA in India, SEC in the US, Companies House in the UK) and company financial statements, and reconcile conflicting or incomplete information with sound judgement.
* Tie deals to financials. Check that valuations, round sizes, ownership, dilution and share issuances are consistent with a company's revenue, profitability, cash position and capital structure, and flag implied multiples that look off.
* Write the rulebook. Define the SOPs, methodology, data standards and edge-case rules for capturing instruments, terms, deal flows and financial metrics at scale, so customers can consume them easily and trust them.
* Turn expertise into automation. Partner with Product, Engineering and Data teams to convert your judgement into scalable processes and automation, and test what gets built.
* Set the accuracy bar. Audit data quality across deals and financials, root-cause errors, and own the quality standard for the unit.
* Raise the team's capability. Train and guide analysts on instruments, deal structures, and financial statement reading, and share key findings and metrics with senior leadership.

##### **What makes this role different**

‍

* Expert track, real influence. You will not be managing people, and you will not be a back-office checker. Your decisions become the product's data standard.
* Breadth most finance roles don't offer. You will see structures and financials across thousands of private companies, geographies and stages, far beyond a single deal desk or coverage universe.
* Work directly with senior leadership and Product/Engineering, and build the systems that scale your judgement.
* A publicly listed company with a global customer base across venture capital, private equity, investment banking and corporate development.

‍

##### **What you bring**

‍

* Instrument expertise. Deep command of equity, preference shares (CCPS, OCRPS), convertible notes and CCDs, warrants, SAFEs and ESOPs, and their terms: liquidation preferences, conversion mechanics, anti-dilution (full ratchet, weighted average), participation, vesting, and drag/tag rights.
* Deal-flow fluency. How funding deals move from term sheet to closing: pre-money and post-money valuation, tranches, primaries and secondaries, follow-ons, bridge rounds and exits, and how each appears in documents and filings (for example, allotment returns and share transfer filings).
* Financial statement fluency. Comfort reading P&Ls, balance sheets and cash flow statements of private companies, including standalone vs consolidated numbers, and linking them to funding events, valuations and implied revenue multiples.
* Document and filings reading. The ability to quickly and accurately pull out what matters from dense legal and financial documents.
* Analytical judgement. First-principles thinking, strong instincts for when a number looks off, and comfort with ambiguity.
* Systems thinking. Comfort working with engineering teams and technical systems to design practical, scalable solutions.
* Communication. The ability to explain a complicated deal structure, or what a set of financials says about a company, in two sentences, in writing and in conversation.

‍

##### **Who we are looking for**

‍

You will have a strong academic base and demonstrated depth, not just awareness, in financial instruments, deal terms, and financial statement analysis. You are likely to be one of the following:
  

* Bachelor's degree holders: A degree from a Tier-1 institution (IITs, BITS Pilani or equivalent) and 2-4 years of experience in investment banking, venture capital or private equity, equity research, corporate finance, data strategy or a similar analytical role with strong exposure to funding deals and company financials. This experience is mandatory.

* MBA holders: An MBA from a Tier-1 institution (IIMs or equivalent) with a commerce or finance background (BCom, BBA/BMS Finance, CA, or equivalent). Depth in instruments and financial analysis can come through coursework, internships, projects, or certifications.

‍

Good to have: CA, CFA or FRM credentials; experience with startup valuation, cap structure modelling, due diligence or deal documentation; familiarity with SQL, Excel or Python.

Genuinely interested in building SOPs, standards and systems that others will follow.

description:
**At a Glance: The Story Behind AMINA**

Founded in April 2018 and headquartered in Zug, AMINA Bank is a pioneer in the financial industry. In August 2019, AMINA received a Swiss banking and securities dealer license from FINMA. The broad, vertically integrated spectrum of services, combined with the highest security standards, make AMINA’s value proposition unique.

AMINA operates globally from its regulated hubs in Switzerland, Abu Dhabi, and Hong Kong to offer fiat and crypto services to progressive investors, traditional and crypto-native alike, whether individuals, corporates, or institutions.

CVVC Global Report and CB Insights named AMINA as one of the Top 50 Companies within the blockchain ecosystem. Aite Group awarded AMINA their 2021 Digital Wealth Management Impact Innovation Award in the ‘Digital Startup of the Year’ category, and LinkedIn listed AMINA as one of the Top Startups 2021 in Switzerland. In 2022, AMINA won the Digital Assets Offering or Service at the WealthBriefing Swiss EAM Awards, and the bank was also recognised for its product offering SEBAX and won the Best ETP of the Year award at the Swiss ETF Awards 2022. In 2023, AMINA won the European WealthBriefing Award in the Digital Assets Solution, Fund Manager category.

AMINA India is a wholly owned subsidiary of AMINA Bank AG. AMINA India acts as a virtual extension of the bank supporting activities spanning trading & liquidity management, digital assets research, marketing, investment solutions, risk management, account management, mid/back-office, product management, technology & engineering, IT support, finance and human resources.

**Your Mission (Should You Choose to Accept It)**

We are looking for a hands-on
**Lead Front-End Engineer**
to take technical ownership of the Bank’s client-facing applications, including Online and Mobile Banking, Onboarding and our corporate website, while leading our front-end engineering teams.

You will own the front-end architecture and technology roadmap, actively shape solutions with Product, UX and architecture and backend engineering teams, and remain close to the code through design, code reviews, troubleshooting and development where required. This role combines deep
**technical leadership with team responsibility**
and is intended for someone who wants to remain an active engineer.

**Your AMINA To-Do List**

* Act as the technical owner for Online Banking, Mobile Banking, Digital Onboarding and the corporate website.
* Own and evolve the front-end architecture, technology roadmap and engineering standards across web and mobile applications.
* Lead, coach, develop and support the front-end engineering team, including capacity and resource allocation across the different product domains.
* Drive pragmatic technical decisions balancing client experience, delivery needs, security, scalability and long-term maintainability.
* Collaborate with product managers, UX designers, architects, back-end engineers, and security specialists to deliver reliable digital experiences.
* Remain hands-on, participating in solution design, architecture and code reviews, prototyping, troubleshooting and development when required.
* Act as the subject-matter expert for front-end engineering, driving quality, consistency and continuous improvement across the domain.

**Your golden ticket to the AMINA team:**

* Extensive front-end engineering experience, including experience as a Lead, Principal, Architect or similar technical leadership role.
* Strong hands-on expertise in JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, React and React Native.
* Proven experience designing and owning scalable architectures for complex web and mobile applications.
* Experience leading engineers while remaining actively involved in technology and software development.
* Strong knowledge of APIs, WebSockets, automated testing, CI/CD, performance, accessibility and secure development practices, including OWASP guidance.
* Strong understanding of modern front-end engineering practices, reusable components and mobile/web application architecture.
* Strong communication and technical decision-making skills, with the ability to work effectively with Product, UX and engineering stakeholders.
* Experience in banking, financial services, FinTech or another regulated environment is an advantage. Crypto experience is a significant plus

**Why We’re Awesome**

We owe our exponential growth to our innovative and collaborate team spirit and talented workforce. Every voice counts as we are always committed to learning from diverse perspectives and backgrounds because our people make the difference at AMINA Bank. Regardless of your age, gender, belief, and background, at AMINA EVERYONE is welcome!

Join our skilled team and together redefine finance.

engineers turn them into production-grade software for enterprise clients. We build solutions from

the ground up and take over systems others started, then keep them running and audit-ready after

go-live.

secure software live in production. Some you’ll build from scratch; others start from someone else’s

code, which you’ll review, fix and take live. You’ll work directly with the founder and the team writing

title: Data Engineer, Aladdin Data, Vice President
description:
**About This Role**
**Data Engineer, Aladdin Data, Vice President**
**Your team**
The Aladdin BlackRock Data Office (BDO) builds trusted, scalable, and governed data products that advance the firm’s enterprise data strategy. ClientIQ is a strategic initiative bringing together data, analytics, and artificial intelligence (AI) to power next-generation client intelligence and engagement.
  
  
The team builds modern data and technology capabilities powering our global sales organization, partnering across engineering teams, data governance, and client teams to deliver intuitive data solutions, actionable insights, and AI-powered workflows.
  
  
**Your role and impact**
In this role, you will provide hands-on technical and architectural leadership for the data capabilities underpinning ClientIQ. You will define architecture, establish engineering standards, and work closely with teams from technical discovery and prototyping through production delivery and adoption.
  
  
A critical expectation is the ability to quickly learn and leverage BlackRock’s internally developed Data Platform as a Service (dPaaS) capabilities. You will champion a reuse-first approach, leveraging and extending existing platform capabilities before building new solutions.
  
  
You will lead data engineering across structured and semi-structured data, creating trusted, reusable, and AI-ready data products that power applications, analytics, generative AI (GenAI), and agentic experiences.
  
  
**Your Responsibilities**
In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and combine the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies with the rigor to challenge the results. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities:
  
  

* Define and evolve ClientIQ’s target-state data architecture, leveraging internal dPaaS capabilities and applying a reuse-first approach across data products, models, application programming interfaces (APIs), metadata, and shared services.
* Provide hands-on architecture and engineering leadership from technical discovery and prototyping through production delivery, partnering across platform, product, engineering, AI, governance, and business teams.
* Architect the ingestion, integration, and modeling of client, product, sales, marketing, servicing, interaction, behavioral, and external data into trusted and reusable data products.
* Lead engineering across batch and real-time processing, distributed systems, APIs, workflow orchestration, and event streaming.
* Design capabilities across structured and semi-structured data that support AI-ready architectures, including document processing, semantic search, embeddings, vector retrieval, knowledge graphs, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).

**guidance**
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
  
  
**About BlackRock**
At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.

To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.

title: L3 Support Engineer
description:
**About Nebius:**

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

### **The role**

Nebius runs its own AI cloud, where hardware, firmware, the OS and fleet automation are each owned by dedicated engineering teams. Our L3 Support Line sits at the top of datacenter operations: we take the issues that sites and L2 can't resolve, find where they really come from, and work with the owning teams and vendors to get them fixed. We are the datacenter center of expertise for servers, GPU platforms, firmware (BIOS/BMC) and deep Linux diagnostics across Europe and the US, and we are growing.  
  
This is a senior technical role focused on deep investigations, cross-site pattern detection, and driving permanent fixes with R&D, platform teams and ODM vendors. You will turn complex incidents into scalable solutions and elevate L1/L2 capabilities through strong technical enablement.  
  
**How we work**  
  
You'll work from the operations side, with telemetry, logs, BMC and fleet tooling, while engineering teams own the code. Your impact comes from finding the real cause fast and making sure it reaches the right team with the evidence to act on it.

**Your responsibilities will include:**

Deep Technical Investigation (Primary Focus)  

* Lead root cause analysis of issues that site teams and L2 can't resolve, across GPUs, firmware, Linux and the fleet automation around them.
* Spot recurring patterns across the fleet and turn them into durable fixes, better health checks and smarter automation.
* Own technical workstreams during high-severity incidents.

  
Vendor & R&D Collaboration  

* Build evidence packs and drive escalations with R&D, platform teams and ODM vendors.
* Push for firmware, component, and platform-level resolutions.
* Track outcomes and ensure knowledge flows back to operations.

  
Firmware & Platform Readiness (BIOS/BMC)  

* Support validation and rollout of firmware updates (risk assessment, staging, rollback planning).
* Help operationalize platform standards across datacenters.

  
Knowledge & Enablement  

* Create scalable runbooks, troubleshooting guides, and error catalogs.
* Turn investigations into playbooks that elevate L1/L2 teams.

  
Hands-on Support (As Needed)  

* Travel to datacenters for complex troubleshooting, new platform readiness, or incident containment.

  
Alongside incident work, you'll also:  

* Build tools and scripts for diagnostics, log collection and analysis.
* Grow our knowledge base, error catalogs and runbooks.
* Help improve how the fleet is monitored, validated and repaired.

**We expect you to have:**

* Strong hands-on experience with datacenter servers and deep Linux troubleshooting.
* Ability to diagnose across hardware, BIOS/BMC firmware, and Linux (logs, drivers, storage basics, performance triage).
* Ability to get to a well-founded root cause from logs and telemetry, working across many teams.
* Structured incident response experience and clear communication under pressure.
* Experience driving evidence-based escalations with vendors/R&D.
* Fluent English (written and spoken).

**It will be an added bonus if you have:**

* Strong familiarity with GPU server platforms and tooling (for example: nvidia-smi, dcgmi, Linux logs correlation).
* Experience with ipmitool and Redfish workflows, firmware lifecycle, and staged rollouts.
* Scripting skills (bash and basic Python) for log collection, triage automation, and simple reliability analysis.
* Exposure to OCP-based platforms and ODM manufacturing ecosystems.
* Experience supporting enterprise bare metal customers under contractual SLAs.

  

**Benefits & Perks:**

* Competitive compensation
* Career growth and learning opportunities
* Flexibility and ownership
* Collaborative and innovative culture
* Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
* International environment and talented teams

**What's it like to work at Nebius:**

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

**Equal Opportunity Statement:**

Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the country in which they apply and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility as a condition of hire.

If you need accommodations during the application process, please let us know.

title: SOFTWARE EMBEDDED ENGINEER ( INVERTER AND POWER ELECTRONICS)
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Software Embedded R&D Engineer – Power Electronics (Solar Inverters)**

**Company:** Gautam Solar  
**Department:** Research & Development (R&D)  
**Designation:** Software Embedded R&D Engineer  
**Location:**  
**Experience:** 2–6 Years  
**Qualification:** B.E./B.Tech in Electrical / Electronics / ECE / Instrumentation or related disciplines  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**About Gautam Solar**

Gautam Solar is a leading Indian solar energy company focused on delivering high-quality and innovative solar energy solutions. With a commitment to technological advancement and sustainability, Gautam Solar is expanding its capabilities in solar inverter technology and power electronics to develop reliable, efficient, and intelligent solar power conversion solutions.

**Role Overview**

Gautam Solar is looking for a passionate and technically proficient Embedded Software R&D Engineer specializing in Power Electronics and Solar Inverters.

The candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, implementing, and validating embedded firmware and digital control algorithms for solar inverters. The role requires a strong understanding of power electronics, microcontroller-based embedded systems, inverter control strategies, and real-time firmware development.

The candidate will work closely with hardware, power electronics, and testing teams to develop high-performance solar inverter products.

**Key Roles & Responsibilities**

**1. Embedded Firmware Development**

* Design, develop, and maintain embedded firmware for solar inverter applications.
* Develop real-time embedded software using Embedded C/C++.
* Develop firmware for microcontroller/DSP-based inverter control platforms.
* Implement peripheral interfacing, ADC sampling, PWM generation, timers, interrupts, and protection logic.
* Develop firmware architecture for efficient and reliable inverter operation.
* Debug, optimize, and maintain firmware throughout the product development lifecycle.

**2. Solar Inverter Control & Power Electronics**

* Develop and implement digital control algorithms for solar inverters.
* Work on DC-AC inverter control, DC-DC converter control, and power conversion systems.
* Implement MPPT algorithms for solar PV applications.
* Develop voltage and current control loops using PI/PID controllers.
* Work on SPWM/SVPWM techniques and PWM-based switching control.
* Understand and implement grid synchronization techniques such as PLL.
* Work on grid-connected and off-grid inverter control strategies.
* Implement inverter protection mechanisms, including overvoltage, overcurrent, overload, short circuit, and over-temperature protection.
* Understand power electronics topologies, switching devices, gate driver interfaces, and sensing circuits.

**3. Communication & System Integration**

* Develop and integrate communication protocols such as UART, SPI, I2C, CAN, RS485, and Modbus.
* Interface embedded controllers with display units, communication modules, sensors, and monitoring systems.
* Support communication between inverter control boards and other system components.
* Work on inverter monitoring, fault detection, diagnostics, and data acquisition.

**4. Testing, Debugging & Validation**

* Conduct firmware testing, debugging, and functional validation of solar inverter systems.
* Perform hardware-software integration and system-level testing.
* Validate inverter performance under different operating conditions and load profiles.
* Use oscilloscopes, digital multimeters, power analyzers, and other laboratory instruments.
* Identify and troubleshoot firmware, control, and system-level issues.
* Support prototype development, design validation, and product qualification.

**5. Research & New Product Development**

* Participate in the development of new solar inverter platforms and product upgrades.
* Research and implement improved control techniques for inverter efficiency, stability, and reliability.
* Collaborate with hardware engineers to optimize inverter performance.
* Prepare technical documentation, firmware specifications, test procedures, and validation reports.
* Support continuous improvement of existing inverter products.

**Technical Skills Required**

* Strong programming skills in Embedded C/C++.
* Hands-on experience with microcontrollers/DSPs such as:
* Texas Instruments C2000 series (TMS320F280xx).
* STM32 series or equivalent microcontrollers.
* Strong understanding of power electronics and inverter circuits.
* Knowledge of single-phase and three-phase inverter control.
* Experience with PWM, SPWM, SVPWM, ADC, DAC, timers, and interrupts.
* Understanding of MPPT algorithms (P&O, Incremental Conductance).
* Knowledge of PI/PID control, voltage/current control loops, and digital control systems.
* Understanding of PLL and grid synchronization techniques.
* Familiarity with communication protocols: UART, SPI, I2C, CAN, RS485, and Modbus.
* Experience in firmware debugging, testing, and hardware-software integration.
* Knowledge of MATLAB/Simulink for control algorithm development and simulation is preferred.

**Educational Qualifications**

* B.E./B.Tech in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Electronics & Communication, or Instrumentation Engineering.
* M.Tech in Power Electronics, Control Systems, or Embedded Systems will be an added advantage.

**Experience Requirements**

* 2–6 years of experience in embedded firmware development and power electronics.
* Hands-on experience in solar inverter, UPS, VFD, EV charger, or power converter firmware development will be preferred.
* Candidates with practical experience in inverter control algorithm development and DSP-based power electronics applications will be highly preferred.

**Key Competencies**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Good understanding of power electronics hardware and embedded software interaction.
* Ability to independently debug and resolve technical issues.
* Strong fundamentals in electrical circuits, control systems, and embedded architecture.
* Innovation-driven mindset with an interest in renewable energy technologies.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced R&D environment.

**Key Deliverables / Performance Expectations**

* Development and successful implementation of inverter control firmware.
* Implementation and optimization of MPPT and inverter control algorithms.
* Improvement in inverter efficiency, stability, and operational reliability.
* Successful hardware-software integration and product validation.
* Timely resolution of firmware bugs and system-level issues.
* Contribution to new inverter product development and technology upgrades.

**Why Join Gautam Solar?**

* Opportunity to work on next-generation solar inverter technologies.
* Hands-on exposure to power electronics and advanced embedded control systems.
* Opportunity to contribute to indigenous solar inverter product development.
* Work with a multidisciplinary R&D team focused on innovation and product excellence.

Pay: ₹500,000.00 - ₹1,000,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical or Industrial Engineering, related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in mission critical facility design and construction environments.
* Experience in data center mechanical systems including air-cooled/water-cooled chilled water plant, data hall air-side and liquid-side cooling systems, fuel oil systems, fire alarm and fire protection systems.
* Ability to travel 15% of the time across APAC countries as required.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree in Engineering, Business or other relevant field, or a professional engineering license.
* Experience managing or executing greenfield/brownfield data center developments, expansions and colocation fit-outs.
* Track record of evaluating and negotiating technical requirements with colocation operators and external engineering/construction partners.
* Understanding of global mechanical standards and local standards/practices in various APAC countries.

**About the job**
-----------------

Our thirst for technology is a part of everything we do. The Data Center Engineering team takes the physical design of our data centers into the future. Our lab mirrors a research and development department - cutting-edge strategies are born, tested and tested again. Along with a team of great minds, you take on complex topics like how we use power or how to run state-of-the-art, environmentally-friendly facilities. You're a visionary who optimizes for efficiencies and never stops seeking improvements - even small changes that can make a huge impact. You generate ideas, communicate recommendations to senior-level executives and drive implementation alongside facilities technicians.  
  
With your technical expertise, you ensure compliance with codes and standards, develop infrastructure improvements and serve as an expert in your specialty (e.g., cooling, electrical).

Our multidisciplinary engineering team provides engineering support in the design, construction, and operation of Google's data centers. As a Senior Mechanical Engineer based in India, you will drive the engineering outcomes for mission-critical complex third-party development, leased and colocation data center sites across the APAC region. You will serve as the primary technical authority representing the company’s design, engineering, and operational standards during technical due diligence, design document reviews, and construction submittal reviews and commissioning ensuring that complex power infrastructure is built safely and correctly.

This role is critical for evaluating new facility opportunities, supporting major infrastructure expansion and retrofit projects, optimizing colocation deployments, and ensuring our critical infrastructure is delivered safely, reliably, and efficiently. Leveraging your deep technical expertise, you will collaborate with cross-functional partner teams, lead technical assessments, and mentor other engineers.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Lead technical due diligence assessments for potential new leased and colocation data center facilities across APAC, focusing on the entire mechanical system including chilled water plant, data hall air-side and liquid-side cooling systems, fuel oil systems, fire alarm and fire protection systems.

title: Mobile Security Expert Team Lead
description:
Location: Noida, India

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.

Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.

As a Mobile Security Expert Team Leader within Thales Cybersecurity and Digital Identity, you will lead a team responsible for defining, delivering, and advancing mobile application security across an international environment. Working with teams in France, India, Singapore, and the United States, you will provide recognized technical expertise, lead complex security assessments, influence product and engineering decisions, and mentor cybersecurity and development teams. You will collaborate with specialists from multiple security domains and use your experience to shape methods, standards, tooling, and strategic direction for the mobile cybersecurity ecosystem.

**Roles and responsibilities:**

* Lead a dedicated team of mobile security experts, including setting priorities, planning and following up on team activities, providing technical guidance, and supporting the development of team members.
* Lead and contribute to complex penetration testing and reverse-engineering activities for Android and iOS applications
* Lead and contribute to threat modelling and security risk assessments, identifying threats, evaluating business and product impact, and recommending appropriate countermeasures.
* Act as security advisor for product architecture and feature design, driving secure-by-design decisions.
* Lead security research into emerging threats, technologies, attack techniques, and tooling, including AI-based security capabilities, and translate findings into operational improvements.
* Stay up to date with mobile threat landscape and propose new defence mechanisms for our products.
* Provide technical oversight for security documentation and customer-facing assessments
* Organize mobile security awareness trainings for the different mobile development teams.
* Help define, maintain, and support the application of mobile security processes across development teams, including the evaluation of security tools.

**Requirements:**

* Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain security risks and recommendations to developers, architects, product teams, management and customers.
* Experience leading, coordinating, or providing technical leadership to highly autonomous security experts or penetration testers.
* Hands-on experience in mobile application security assessment and penetration testing (Android and/or iOS), with the technical depth necessary to guide and challenge experienced mobile security specialists.
* Experience assessing, prioritizing and communicating security vulnerabilities based on technical severity, exploitability and business/product impact, and supporting remediation decisions with engineering teams.
* Experience defining, improving or applying security processes, methodologies, standards and technical security requirements within a product or software development environment.
* Knowledge of applied cryptography and security best practices
* Understanding of low-level aspects of operating systems
* A certification in project management or security related field is a plus.

Mobile Security Experts have a strong tradition of contributing to the wider security community, including presentations at international security conferences

**Location**: India (Noida).

At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

title: Test Automation Engineer Hybrid — Full-time Chennai
description:
For nearly 40 years, PDI has helped convenience retailers and petroleum wholesalers adapt to changes in the industry by leveraging the latest technologies. Simplifying the complexity in your world is our main focus. That's why we're delivering an integrated portfolio of global, cloud-based solutions and services to meet our customers needs today and well into the future. From the back office to fuel logistics, and the latest wave of consumer demands and digital commerce, PDI solutions and services are designed to give you a competitive edge. Our deep domain knowledge is backed by our industry-specific software offerings and a people-first approach. Serving the entire supply chain means that we’ve had to solve a wide range of industry challenges and deliver measurable value. To address the increasingly dynamic convenience retail and petroleum wholesale industry, PDI leads the way with converged digital, cloud-optimized, secure, and scalable solutions including ERP, Loyalty, Fuel Pricing, Point-of-Sale and Logistics to create a broader industry ecosystem. The result is unparalleled insights, simplified operations, and higher profitability for your employees and business. We’re dedicated to helping our more than 1,500 customers in over 50 countries, providing solutions and services to over 200,000 sites.

You will own automated testing for Essentials features across the web application, its APIs and the mobile app, as part of a team split between India and the United States. The team works AI-first: coding agents are part of how every engineer plans, builds, tests and reviews work, and this role is expected to use them well from day one.

### **Job Responsibilities:**

* Design, build and maintain automated tests for the Essentials web application (Playwright with TypeScript, BDD style), its REST APIs and the React Native mobile app.
* Turn user stories and acceptance criteria into test plans and test cases, and decide what belongs in unit, API, UI and manual exploratory testing.
* Take part in design and story refinement so that features are testable before development starts.
* Run the automated suites in the CI/CD pipeline, keep them fast and reliable, and track down and fix flaky tests.
* Build and maintain test data, seeds and fixtures across SQL Server and PostgreSQL so tests are repeatable in every environment.
* Verify fixes and new features in the QA environment, file clear defects with reproduction steps, logs and evidence, and retest them through to closure.
* Work with developers during release stabilization to isolate root causes and confirm fixes.
* Report test coverage, results and release risk to the team and your manager in terms a non technical reader can act on.

### **Required Skills & Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field plus 4–6 years of experience in software test automation or software development, or equivalent experience.
* Hands-on experience building UI automation with Playwright, or with Cypress or Selenium and the willingness to move to Playwright.
* Working proficiency in TypeScript or JavaScript; able to read C# well enough to follow the code under test.
* Experience testing REST APIs, with tools such as Postman or in code.
* Solid SQL skills on a relational database (SQL Server or PostgreSQL) for test data setup and result verification.
* Hands-on experience using coding agents or AI coding assistants in real project work, and the ability to show how you directed and verified their output.
* Practical experience with Git, pull requests, CI/CD pipelines and Agile delivery.
* Sound testing fundamentals: test design techniques, risk-based prioritization, the test pyramid, and what makes a test reliable.
* Strong written and spoken English. Clear writing matters more here than usual, because it is how you report defects and also how you direct agents.
* Self-starter who can work independently as part of a distributed team, manage competing priorities and learn an unfamiliar product quickly.

### **Other Skills and Experience:**

Nice to have:

* BDD and Gherkin experience (Cucumber, SpecFlow or playwright-bdd).
* Mobile test automation for React Native apps on iOS and Android (Appium, Detox or Maestro).
* Experience building agent workflows: custom instructions, skills, MCP servers or agent-run test and review loops.
* Unit test frameworks used by the developers: xUnit and Vitest.
* Azure DevOps Boards and Test Plans, Jenkins and Docker.
* Performance, accessibility or security testing.
* AWS basics and reading logs and traces in Datadog or a similar tool.
* Payments or subscription billing testing, such as Stripe test mode.
* Retail, convenience store, point-of-sale or fuel domain experience.

### **Behavioral Competencies:**

* Cultivates Innovation
* Decision Quality
* Manages Complexity
* Drives Results
* Business Insight

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

We empower every worker to boost productivity and help businesses grow faster, operate smarter and reduce costs. * Lead QA strategy and roadmap for Uniphore’s AI and SaaS platforms, driving continuous improvements in automation, coverage, and release quality.

* Design and implement scalable automation frameworks for API, UI, and data validation testing. Expertise using AI tools for automation.

* Partner with Data Science and Engineering teams to validate AI/ML workflows, analytics pipelines, and model integration within production environments.

* Lead efforts in performance, security, and regression testing, ensuring Uniphore’s enterprise platforms deliver reliability at scale.

* Perform root cause and trend analysis to identify process gaps and recommend automation or process enhancements.

* Document QA processes, release notes, and best practices in Confluence / Jira and maintain alignment with Agile/SAFe practices.

* Ensure end-to-end testing coverage across microservices, APIs, mobile, and web-based solutions in a multi-tenant cloud environment.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering

* 9+ years of experience in Software Quality Assurance, including significant automation experience.

* Expert-level proficiency in at least one programming language (e.g., Java, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript).

company: Comcast India Engineering Center I, LLP
description:
Comcast brings together the best in media and technology. We drive innovation to create the world's best entertainment and online experiences. As a Fortune 50 leader, we set the pace in a variety of innovative and fascinating businesses and create career opportunities across a wide range of locations and disciplines. We are at the forefront of change and move at an amazing pace, thanks to our remarkable people, who bring cutting-edge products and services to life for millions of customers every day. If you share in our passion for teamwork, our vision to revolutionize industries and our goal to lead the future in media and technology, we want you to fast-forward your career at Comcast.

**Job Summary**

This job focuses on the creation and maintenance of automated test scripts, ensuring alignment with software engineering standards. The role requires executing tests, analyzing results, and reporting defects to enhance product quality. Key responsibilities include collaborating with developers to integrate testing strategies, crafting detailed documentation, and contributing to code reviews. The position requires staying current with test automation advancements and repairing scripts of intermediate complexity with some guidance.

**Job Description**

**Responsibilities**

* Design, develop and maintain scalable automation testing frameworks covering UI, API and integration layers, following reusable, maintainable and well-documented design patterns
* Build and maintain API test suites for RESTful services, validating status codes, payloads, schemas, authentication and error handling
* Create and manage CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions to run automated tests on every pull request and merge, with reporting, parallel execution and quality gates
* Perform defect triage: analyze failures, identify root cause, separate product defects from test/environment issues, reduce flaky tests and drive fixes with development teams
* Own end-to-end (E2E) feature validation from requirements through release, ensuring new features work across systems, browsers and devices before go-live
* Create and use GitHub Copilot agents and AI-assisted workflows to generate test cases, automate test authoring, speed up triage and improve test coverage
* Follow Agile development methodologies and best practices; help put tools, processes and documentation in place to improve code quality

**Technical Skills**

* At least 2-5 years of experience in test automation framework design and development (such as Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, Jest)
* Strong programming expertise in JavaScript, TypeScript or equivalent languages used for test automation
* Hands-on experience with API testing for RESTful services using tools such as Postman, REST Assured or Supertest, including schema and contract validation
* Strong experience with Git and GitHub: branching strategies, pull requests and code reviews
* Experience building CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions, including workflow authoring, test execution, artifacts and reporting
* Experience creating GitHub Copilot agents and applying AI tools (prompting, custom instructions, agent workflows) to testing and development tasks
* Proven experience in defect triage, root cause analysis and E2E feature validation across UI, API and backend layers
* Understanding of web fundamentals (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) and React-based applications from a testing perspective

**Employees at all levels are expected to:**

* Understand our Operating Principles; make them the guidelines for how you do your job.
* Own the customer experience - think and act in ways that put our customers first, give them seamless digital options at every touchpoint, and make them promoters of our products and services.
* Know your stuff - be enthusiastic learners, users and advocates of our game-changing technology, products and services, especially our digital tools and experiences.
* Win as a team - make big things happen by working together and being open to new ideas.
* Be an active part of the Net Promoter System - a way of working that brings more employee and customer feedback into the company - by joining huddles, making call backs and helping us elevate opportunities to do better for our customers.
* Drive results and growth.
* Respect and promote inclusion & diversity.

title: Institutional Equity Division - Vice President, Quantitative Researcher – Algorithmic Trading (Mumbai)
description:
**Company Profile**
Morgan Stanley is a leading global financial services firm providing a wide range of investment banking, securities, investment management and wealth management services. The Firm's employees serve clients worldwide including corporations, governments, and individuals from more than 1,200 offices in 43 countries.
  
  
As a market leader, the talent and passion of our people is critical to our success. Together, we share a common set of values rooted in integrity, excellence and strong team ethic. Morgan Stanley can provide a superior foundation for building a professional career - a place for people to learn, to achieve and grow. A philosophy that balances personal lifestyles, perspectives and needs is an important part of our culture.
  
  
**Department Profile**
From global institutions to hedge funds, investors come to Morgan Stanley for sales, trading, and market-making services in almost every type of financial instrument in all the world’s financial markets. Morgan Stanley professionals use our network and technology to provide liquidity and sophisticated analysis, to manage risk and execute reliably in the fast-changing markets.
  
  
Morgan Stanley’s Institutional Equity Division (IED) is a world leader in the origination, distribution and trading of equity, equity-linked and equity-derivative securities. Our broad and deep client relationships, market-leading platform and intellectual insights enable us to be a world-class service provider to our clients for their financing, market access and portfolio management needs.
  
  
Morgan Stanley's Equities Quantitative Research (QR) team develops quantitative models, trading strategies and technology that support the Firm's electronic trading business.
  
  
We are looking for an experienced
**Quantitative Researcher**
to join the team in Mumbai, focusing on research and development for
**Morgan Stanley Electronic Trading (MSET)'s algorithmic trading products**
.
  
  
The role will apply techniques and insights from
**high-frequency trading, market making and electronic market microstructure**
to improve algorithmic trading performance and execution outcomes. The successful candidate will combine rigorous quantitative research with strong software engineering skills and experience conducting realistic, high-fidelity simulations using
**full-depth, order-level market data**
.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Research and develop quantitative techniques to improve the performance, execution quality and trading outcomes of MSET's algorithmic trading products.
* Apply concepts from high-frequency trading and market making to algorithmic execution, including short-horizon price prediction, order placement, liquidity capture, fill probability, queue dynamics and adverse selection.
* Analyze large-scale full-depth order book and order-level (Level 3) market data to understand market behaviour and identify opportunities to improve trading decisions.
* Develop quantitative models, signals and features using order flow, liquidity, cross-asset information and other market data to forecast short-horizon market behaviour and improve execution decisions.
* Apply rigorous statistical techniques including time-series analysis, statistical inference and predictive modelling to evaluate research hypotheses and identify robust effects.
* Design and implement high-fidelity, event-driven simulations using historical order-level market data to evaluate trading strategies under realistic conditions, including appropriate modelling of queue position, fill behaviour, latency and transaction costs.
* Conduct cross-asset research, incorporating information from multiple instruments and order books to improve trading decisions and execution performance.
* Develop rigorous methodologies for measuring execution quality and trading performance, including transaction-cost analysis and evaluation against relevant execution benchmarks, while accounting for latency, market impact, transaction costs, adverse selection and simulation bias.
* Apply appropriate out-of-sample testing and validation methodologies to distinguish robust signals from overfitting and simulation artefacts.
* Translate successful research into high-performance implementations suitable for latency-sensitive production environments.
* Profile and optimize performance-critical code for latency, throughput and computational efficiency.
* Work closely with quantitative researchers, electronic traders and technology teams globally to take research from hypothesis and simulation through to production.

**Qualifications**

* 3+ years of professional quantitative R&D experience in high-frequency trading, electronic market making, algorithmic trading or a closely related systematic trading environment.
* Experience applying market microstructure concepts to real-world trading problems.
* Strong programming skills in a performant, low-latency language such as C++, Java or Rust, including experience developing efficient, performance-critical software.
* Strong proficiency in Python or a comparable quantitative research environment for data analysis, modelling and rapid research iteration.
* Experience working with full-depth / Level 3 order book data and order-level market events, including analysis of detailed order-book state and dynamics.
* Experience developing or using event-driven market simulation and backtesting frameworks for high-frequency trading or execution research.
* Strong quantitative and statistical modelling skills, including experience with time-series analysis, statistical inference, predictive modelling and empirical research.
* Experience designing rigorous experiments and applying out-of-sample validation to evaluate predictive signals and guard against overfitting.

title: Vice President, DataDesk – Vendor Onboarding & Automation
description:
Your Team Responsibilities
  
  
MSCI's DataDesk team owns the onboarding of new vendor datasets into MSCI's data ecosystem — ensuring new sources are integrated quickly, validated rigorously, and governed well from day one. We're looking for a Vice President to lead and scale this function by embedding AI and automation into the onboarding lifecycle, while bringing genuine technical fluency with data to work credibly alongside Research content, Products, engineering and AI teams.
  
  
Your Key Responsibilities
  
  
**Vendor Onboarding & Due Diligence**

* Own end-to-end onboarding of new vendor datasets — from initial due diligence and scope assessment through integration and go-live
* Define and enforce onboarding standards: identifier mapping at ingestion, full scope pre-onboarding assessment, QA assessment and fit for purpose qualification, formal SLAs definition with clear escalation ownership
* Conduct vendor due diligence and maintain trusted relationships with data providers
* Assess onboarded datasets to identify coverage gaps and quality issues, and partner with the vendor to remediate them
* Lead root-cause analysis on onboarding delays or quality gaps, and drive process fixes (as opposed to one-off fire-fighting)

**AI & Automation-Led Scaling**

* Identify and implement AI/automation opportunities across the onboarding pipeline — e.g., automated identifier/field mapping, validation rule generation, matching and reconciliation logic
* Partner with engineering/AI teams to build or adopt tooling that automates QA diagnostic and certification, reduce manual onboarding effort and turnaround time, acting as the functional expert who validates outputs against real onboarding scenarios
* Continuously evaluate emerging AI techniques and apply them to reduce onboarding cycle time and error rates
* Track and report onboarding efficiency metrics (cycle time, automation coverage, error/rework rates) to leadership
* Incorporate AI-based data usage/rights validation into the data collection process, ensuring new vendor sources are governance-compliant before integration
* Enrich and expose AI powered catalogue of data, QA / Diagnostic and other DataDesk Services

**Data Quality & Governance**

* Define validation rules and quality benchmarks for newly onboarded vendor data
* Ensure onboarded datasets meet MSCI's data standards for accuracy, consistency, and compliance before integration
* Collaborate with product and downstream teams to assess data fit and flag risks early in the onboarding process
* Conduct a quarterly assessment of MSCI's vendor data risk across product lines and single points of failure, identify possible remediations or alternatives, and present findings to senior leadership to inform operational planning and investment decisions

**Leadership & Collaboration**

* Lead and mentor a team of analysts/associates involved in onboarding and vendor evaluation
* Engage with internal and external stakeholders to align on onboarding priorities, resolve escalations, and ensure timely, transparent communication throughout the onboarding lifecycle
* Partner with global stakeholders across product, research, technology, and operations to align onboarding priorities and standards
* Present onboarding pipeline status, risks, and automation roadmap to senior leadership

**Your Skills And Experience That Will Help You Excel**
**Experience:**
10+ years in data operations, vendor management, or data onboarding, ideally in financial data/index/analytics
  
  
**Technical Skills**

* Strong understanding of data structures, formats, and identifiers (LEI, DUNS, CUSIP/ISIN) sufficient to assess vendor data fit and define validation logic
* Working proficiency in SQL and Python — able to review/write validation and matching logic, not just specify requirements
* Experience applying AI/ML or automation tools to data matching, validation, or process acceleration
* Comfort working directly with engineering/AI teams as a technical counterpart, not just a requirements source

**Domain Knowledge**

* Familiarity with vendor data landscape (e.g., FactSet, LSEG/EJV, ICE, EDI) and cross-vendor field mapping challenges
* Understanding of financial reference data concepts (entities, securities, classifications) as they relate to onboarding validation

**Soft Skills:**
Strong stakeholder and vendor relationship management, project management, and the ability to translate operational pain points into automation opportunities
  
  
**About MSCI**
**What we offer you**

* Transparent compensation schemes and comprehensive employee benefits, tailored to your location, ensuring your financial security, health, and overall wellbeing.
* Flexible working arrangements, advanced technology, and collaborative workspaces.
* A culture of high performance and innovation where we experiment with new ideas and take responsibility for achieving results.
* A global network of talented colleagues, who inspire, support, and share their expertise to innovate and deliver for our clients.
* Global Orientation program to kickstart your journey, followed by access to our Learning@MSCI platform, AI Learning Center , LinkedIn Learning Pro and tailored learning opportunities for ongoing skills development.
* Multi-directional career paths that offer professional growth and development through new challenges, internal mobility and expanded roles.
* We actively nurture an environment that builds a sense of inclusion belonging and connection, including eight Employee Resource Groups. All Abilities, Asian Support Network, Black Leadership Network, Climate Action Network, Hola! MSCI, Pride & Allies, Women in Tech, and Women’s Leadership Forum.

At MSCI we are passionate about what we do, and we are inspired by our vision – to power better decisions. You’ll be part of an industry-leading network of creative, curious, and entrepreneurial pioneers. This is a space where you can challenge yourself, set new standards and perform beyond expectations for yourself, our clients, and our industry.
  
  
MSCI strengthens global markets by connecting participants across the financial ecosystem with a common language. Our research-based data, analytics and indexes, supported by advanced technology, set standards for global investors and help our clients understand risks and opportunities so they can make better decisions and unlock innovation. We serve asset managers and owners, private-market sponsors and investors, hedge funds, wealth managers, banks, insurers and corporates.

description: SOLARSQUARE ENGINEERINGSDE , Platform EngineeringTeam: Platform Engineering Experience: 3–6 years Location: Mumbai Full-timeFor engineers who would rather change how a whole company builds software than ship one more feature.Read This FirstThis is not a role for someone who wants a tidy backlog.
