The quality of the design, the clarity of the interfaces between systems and the strength of the guardrails now decide how good our software is. The Platform team owns that layer.If you are the engineer whose work makes ten others faster, and you get restless when something is done the wrong way only because it has always been done that way, keep reading.About SolarSquareAt SolarSquare we are building the Home-Energy brand of future India. We help homes switch to rooftop solar and move away from traditional coal electricity. We are a full-stack D2C residential solar brand — designing, installing, maintaining (after-sales), and financing solar systems for home-owners across India.In a few short years we have scaled to become the leading residential solar brand in India. We are obsessed with quality, customer service, and innovating to make it simple for homes to switch to solar. We are looking for leaders to join us in this mission.Get to know usSolarSquare — www.solarsquare.inFeatured by TIME as one of the World’s Top GreenTech Companies of 2025SolarSquare raises $53M Series C led by B Capital (Moneycontrol)India’s rooftop solar market and SolarSquare’s growth (TechCrunch)What Platform Is Here To DoPlatform builds the systems every other team depends on and makes them simple to use. In practice that means:Designing systems and the contracts between them so teams can work together without knowing each other’s internals.Hiding complexity behind clean interfaces: one way to authenticate, publish an event, schedule work or call a vendor, instead of five.Treating cost as a design requirement. A service should be cheaper to run next quarter than it is today.Keeping the architecture small enough for one person to understand and able to scale without a rewrite.Defining the guardrails, templates and standards that engineers and coding agents both build within.What You’ll DoWrite TRDs precise enough for an agent to execute and clear enough for a new engineer to review, then drive them to production, checking and correcting what the agents produce.Build and run shared backend services such as authentication, event streaming, scheduling and deep linking, and the integrations that connect them.Find the same problem being solved in three places and replace it with one service, library or guardrail.Make the infrastructure calls for what you own (data stores, queues, caching, scaling, failure handling) and write down the trade-offs.Turn what works into org-wide practice: reusable skills, agent instructions, review checklists and sessions that bring other pods along.Question decisions, including leadership’s, when the evidence points to a better way.You’ll Fit IfYou have 3–6 years building backend systems in production, with strong fundamentals: data structures, concurrency, networking, and how databases and queues behave under load.You think in systems and interfaces. You can explain why a boundary sits where it does, and you notice when an abstraction has started costing more than it saves.You work hands-on with AI coding agents every day and have opinions, backed by experience, on where they help, where they fail and how to constrain them.You write well. Your design docs remove ambiguity instead of moving it somewhere else.You can’t leave a known problem alone, and you insist on doing things the right way. title: AI/ML Engineer, Aladdin Data, VP
description:
**About This Role**
**Your team**
BlackRock Data Office (BDO) is powering the next stage of enterprise innovation with artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML). The team combines industry-leading data standards with advanced intelligence capabilities to transform how BlackRock operates and to help define what is possible with technology at enterprise scale.
  
  
BDO takes a full-stack approach, bringing together engineers, data scientists, data analysts, and domain specialists to address challenges ranging from core computing infrastructure to end-user applications. The BDO AI team works on strategic initiatives including generative AI systems, predictive systems, and data-intensive operations. The team is globally distributed and partners with stakeholders across BlackRock to deliver both near-term solutions and long-term transformation.
  
  
**Your role and impact**
As an AI/ML Engineer within BDO AI, you will design, build, and deploy production-grade AI and ML systems that address complex business challenges. You will combine hands-on software engineering with emerging AI capabilities, working across the technology stack to take ideas from early exploration through reliable production deployment.
  
  
You will collaborate with domain experts, data analysts, engineers, and business stakeholders to translate business processes into technical solutions. You will evaluate emerging AI and ML capabilities, communicate complex technical concepts clearly, and help build consensus around forward-looking solutions that can operate at enterprise scale.
  
  
**Your Responsibilities**
In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and combine the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies with the rigor to challenge the results. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities:
  
  

* Pioneer and evaluate novel AI/ML capabilities, applying emerging technologies to solve specific business problems and build forward-looking solutions.
* Make frequent, high-quality code contributions to existing and greenfield projects.
* Model and demonstrate emerging solutions using first-principles problem solving, building stakeholder understanding and consensus around proposed approaches.
* Deploy reliable services to development and production environments while maintaining enterprise software development lifecycle standards.
* Communicate granular technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Partner with domain experts and data analysts to translate business processes into effective technical processes.
* Match computing requirements to available enterprise resources, including containerized deployments.

**Your Experience**

* Undergraduate degree in a relevant technical or scientific field, such as Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Data Science, Software Engineering, Physics, or Chemistry; a postgraduate degree in a relevant technical discipline is preferred.
* 7+ years of software engineering experience, including significant experience designing, building, and deploying production-grade systems.
* 2+ years of generative AI/ML engineering experience, including designing, developing, and deploying production-grade AI/ML systems.
* Expert-level proficiency in Python, Java, Structured Query Language (SQL), and data systems.
* Demonstrated systems-level problem-solving abilities, including experience deploying containerized services to production environments without reliance on managed cloud services.
* Strong communication skills in both technical and non-technical forums.
* Knowledge of machine learning and statistical modeling, including fundamental natural language processing (NLP) concepts, professional experience with pre-GPT transformer technologies such as BART, and familiarity with how GPT-2-like models are trained.

**Our Benefits**
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
  
  
**Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
  
  
**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
**guidance**
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
  
  
**About BlackRock**
At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
  
  
This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
  
  
To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
  
  
BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.
  
  
The role is based out of Pune.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To design, develop and improve software, utilising various engineering methodologies, that provides business, platform, and technology capabilities for our customers and colleagues.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Collaboration with peers, participate in code reviews, and promote a culture of code quality and knowledge sharing.
* Stay informed of industry technology trends and innovations and actively contribute to the organization’s technology communities to foster a culture of technical excellence and growth.

Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes

They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.

* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.

**Job Title: Senior Product Security Engineer - Mobile**
**Location: Pune, India**
**Job Type: Full-time**
**Experience Required: 5-7 years**
**Job Summary**
As a Senior Product Security Engineer you will own operational security for assigned RIB Software products, executing secure development lifecycle (SDL) requirements and ensuring compliance through coordinated security reviews and assessments. Serves as the primary security point of contact for product teams while collecting evidence required for compliance.
  
  
This role requires a blend of hands-on technical expertise, security leadership, and the ability to work collaboratively across multidisciplinary teams including Security Architects, Product Owners, Developers, Quality Engineers, DevOps, Security Operations, and Governance. You will be a key driver in our mission to embed security into every stage of our products’ lifecycles, from initial design through to decommissioning and end-of-life.
  
  
This role operates in RIB's AI-augmented product security environment, you will be expected to incorporate AI tools into your security workflows, critically evaluate AI-generated outputs, and help embed AI-fluency practices within SDLC of the product teams.
  
  
This role requires comfort and curiosity about working alongside AI tools. You don’t need experience with specific tools – but you must have experience incorporating AI tools into your workflow. Whether used for writing, research, coding, design, or analysis, you’ve formed your own view on when AI adds value and when it doesn’t, and you can describe how you’ve adapted how you work as a result. You review AI output critically before accepting it.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Execute SDL requirements across the full product development lifecycle.
* Drive regular threat modelling, security reviews, and risk assessments for assigned products.
* Track and manage product-specific security issues through resolution, communicating status to leadership.
* Manage supply chain security risks for externally provided components used within the product.
* Collect and maintain compliance evidence for compliance requirements.
* Coordinate security activities with development teams through Security Architects and Product Owners in collaboration with our Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing team.
* Identify and refine security requirements applicable to the product across its lifecycle.
* Serve as primary contact for customer security discussions, assessments, and vulnerability disclosure.
* Support security training and assessment initiatives to ensure product teams have demonstrated security expertise.
* Mentor assigned Product Security Engineers through collaborative review and guidance (when PSE support is available).
* Contribute to the security architecture and roadmap by advising on evolving threats and new technologies.
* Leverage AI tools to accelerate security reviews, threat modelling, and vulnerability analysis and critically assess AI-generated outputs before accepting results.
* Assess AI-specific security risks in products that integrate LLMs, generative AI features, or AI-powered components (e.g., prompt injection, model data leakage, non-deterministic output handling).
* Empower the team's use of AI by sharing knowledge of effective human-AI collaboration practices in product development and security workflows.

**Qualifications And Experience**

* 5+ years experience in product security or application security.
* Strong understanding of SDL processes and security compliance frameworks.
* Proven ability to conduct security testing using SAST, DAST, and SCA tools.
* Familiarity with one or more of C#, Typescript, Java, JavaScript, Dart, C++, Python, and/or Delphi
* Experience with vulnerability management and risk assessment.
* Excellent communication skills for technical and business stakeholders.
* Project management experience with cross-functional teams.

Every day at FIS, innovators, problem solvers and changemakers work together to create technology that advances the world of finance. We embrace new ideas, challenge what's possible and empower our teams to make a lasting impact. If you're ready to help shape the future of fintech, unlock your next chapter with FIS.
  
  
**About The Role**
As an AI Engineer, you’ll design, build and deliver AI-powered workflows that automate complex business and operational processes. You’ll work with large language models (LLMs), agentic AI, enterprise data and orchestration frameworks to turn emerging AI capabilities into secure, reliable and scalable solutions. You’ll own solutions from early prototypes and evaluation through integration, deployment and continuous improvement in production.

* Design and build LLM-powered agentic workflows using prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), tool use and multi-step orchestration

* Partner with technical teams, business stakeholders, risk and compliance teams to identify automation opportunities and build appropriate controls, escalation paths and responsible AI practices

**What You Bring**
*Required qualifications*

* 3+ years of software engineering experience, including at least 1 year of hands-on experience building applications using large language models or other machine learning systems
* Strong programming skills in Python and/or TypeScript/Java, with experience working with APIs, data pipelines and cloud technologies such as Azure or AWS
* Hands-on experience with LLM application development, including prompt engineering, agent frameworks or orchestration tools, embeddings/vector search, RAG or model evaluation
* Experience designing, deploying and supporting software in production environments, with exposure to technologies such as Kubernetes and CI/CD
* Strong problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to evaluate AI solutions using measurable outcomes and translate technical concepts into business outcomes

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working in financial services, fintech or another regulated industry, with exposure to AI governance, model risk management or responsible AI practices
* Experience developing internal platforms, SDKs, developer tooling or reusable components used across multiple teams
* Familiarity with machine learning fundamentals, distributed systems, observability, process automation technologies or operating services at scale

**The impact you’ll make**

Your work will help turn complex workflows into dependable, auditable and secure AI solutions while establishing patterns that allow future use cases to move from idea to production faster. You’ll contribute to how AI is engineered and operated responsibly within a global financial technology environment.

* Opportunities to innovate in fintech

title: Senior Identity Saviynt AI Engineer
description:
**Role Description**
At FNZ, our purpose is to make wealth management more accessible, bringing easier, fairer and more inclusive solutions to people worldwide. Here in the Security Technology & Operations team, we are on a mission to embed cyber resilience across FNZ, protecting the platforms that support investment solutions for over 20 million people.
  
  
We are seeking an Identity Security AI Engineer to design, engineer and operationalise AI-enabled identity security capabilities. The role will combine identity engineering, security automation and responsible AI to strengthen how FNZ governs human, privileged and non-human identities, including AI agents and workload identities through Saviynt and Entra.
  
  
The successful candidate will work across Identity Security, Cyber Security, cloud engineering and application teams to develop secure AI-assisted workflows, identity analytics and policy enforcement. The role will support global services spanning Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Saviynt, CyberArk and secrets management platforms, while ensuring solutions are explainable, auditable and aligned with FNZ security standards.
  
  
**Specific Role Responsibilities**

* Contribute to the Identity Security roadmap, identifying practical uses of AI that improve control effectiveness, user experience and operational efficiency.
* Design and build AI-assisted identity workflows for Joiner, Mover and Leaver processes, access requests, approvals, certification campaigns and exception handling.
* Develop identity analytics and recommendation capabilities for entitlement analysis, role mining, access review prioritisation, toxic combination detection and excessive privilege reduction.
* Engineer secure identity patterns for AI agents, service principals, managed identities, APIs and other non-human identities across Azure, AWS and GCP.
* Implement authentication, authorisation, least privilege, Just-In-Time access and Zero Standing Privilege controls for AI-enabled services and autonomous agents.
* Integrate AI and automation capabilities with Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Saviynt, CyberArk, Infisical and FNZ service-management workflows.
* Develop and maintain Python, PowerShell and API-based automation, with appropriate testing, version control, CI/CD, monitoring and support documentation.
* Build safeguards for AI solutions, including prompt and input protection, data minimisation, human approval points, audit logging and model or agent access controls.
* Create monitoring and detection use cases for anomalous access, privilege escalation, dormant access, credential misuse and unusual non-human identity behaviour.
* Ensure AI-generated recommendations remain explainable and reviewable, and do not directly grant privileged or high-risk access without defined policy and human oversight.
* Support security architecture reviews, threat modelling, control assessments, audit evidence and the development of policies, standards and engineering patterns.
* Work closely with global engineering, security, risk, privacy and business stakeholders to move approved prototypes into reliable, supportable production services.
* Measure delivered outcomes, including automation coverage, recommendation accuracy, false-positive rates, access-review effort reduction, standing privilege reduction and control adoption.

**Experience Required**
Primary requirements
  
  

* Strong hands-on experience in Identity security, encompassing identity lifecycle management, access governance, authentication, authorisation and privileged access.
* Practical engineering experience with Microsoft Entra ID and Active Directory, including Conditional Access, Privileged Identity Management, enterprise applications, service principals and managed identities.
* Strong automation and software-engineering skills using Python and/or PowerShell, REST APIs, Git-based version control, testing and CI/CD practices.
* Experience integrating with identity platforms such as Saviynt and CyberArk, and with secrets-management services such as Infisical and Azure Key Vault
* Knowledge of AI and large language model concepts, including agents, guardrails and secure prompt handling.
* Ability to apply security controls to AI solutions, including least privilege, data protection, logging, traceability, human oversight and secure model or agent access.
* Good knowledge of RBAC, SAML, SCIM, MFA and Zero Trust principles.
* Experience working with cloud identity and workload identity patterns across Azure
* Ability to translate identity risks and AI use cases into secure, scalable and supportable technical solutions.
* Strong stakeholder communication skills and the ability to explain technical, security and risk concepts to engineering, control and leadership audiences.
* Experience producing engineering documentation, operating procedures, security standards and auditable technical evidence.

Desirable experience
  
  

* Experience with Azure AI Foundry, Microsoft Copilot Studio, AI engineering frameworks.
* Experience with identity threat detection, graph analytics, behavioural analytics or permissions-management technologies.
* Relevant certifications such as Microsoft Identity and Access Administrator, Azure AI Engineer Associate, Azure Security Engineer Associate, CISSP or equivalent practical experience.

**About FNZ Culture**
Our culture is what drives us. It's at the heart of who we are and everything we do. It's what inspires, excites and moves us forward. Our ambition is to create a culture for growth, one that opens up limitless opportunities for our employees, customers and the wider world. At FNZ we know that great impact is only possible with great teamwork.
  
  
That’s why we value the strength and diversity of thought in our global team.
  
  
The FNZ Way is the cornerstone of what we do. It is comprised of four values that set the standard for how everyone at FNZ interacts with each other, with our customers, and with all our diverse stakeholders around the world.
  
  

* Customer obsessed for the long-term
* Think big and make an impact
* Act now and own it all the way
* Challenge, commit and win together

**Read more about The FNZ Way and our values**
: www.fnz.com/culture
  
  
**Opportunities**

* Right from day one, you will work alongside exceptional, multicultural teams - experts in their respective fields - who will inspire and challenge you to make your greatest impact.
* Be part of a highly successful, rapidly growing, global business that is leading the delivery of financial services via cloud computing and partners with some of the world’s largest companies.
* Working in a flexible and agile way that meets the needs of the business and personal circumstances.
* Remuneration, significant financial rewards and career advancement is based on individual contribution and business impact rather than tenure or seniority;
* We provide global career opportunities for our best employees at any of our offices in the UK, EU, US, Canada, South Africa and APAC undefined

**Commitment to Equal Opportunities**
At FNZ, we recognise that diversity, equity and inclusion are important factors contributing to our success. We embrace the unique perspective and capabilities of our current and future employees, which will help us continue to drive innovation and achieve our business goals. Recruitment decisions at FNZ are made in a non-discriminatory manner without regard to gender, ethnicity/race, faith, age, nationality, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, socio-economic background, disability or military veteran status where all applicants and employees are valued and respected.
  
  
In addition, we want to ensure accessibility needs are well supported, if you require specific support please advise us.
  
  
**About FNZ**
*FNZ is committed to opening up wealth so that everyone, everywhere can invest in their future on their terms. We know the foundation to do that already exists in the wealth management industry, but complexity holds firms back.*
*We created wealth’s growth platform to help. We provide a global, end-to-end wealth management platform that integrates modern technology with business and investment operations. All in a regulated financial institution.*
*We partner with the world’s leading financial institutions, with over US$2.5 trillion in assets on platform (AoP).
  
  
Together with our clients, we empower nearly 30 million people across all wealth segments to invest in their future.*

title: Senior Principal - Automation Engineer / Architect
description:
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
  
  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
  
  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The Automation Architect owns the technical design of a DPTF platform, defining the reference architectures, patterns and standards that make solutions secure, scalable and consistent, and guiding engineering teams in applying them. The role provides design assurance across the platform's services, architects for reliability and resilience rather than treating them as later additions, and designs AI into the platform through reference patterns for AI-assisted delivery and intelligent operations. Platforms span cloud, network and digital workplace domains, and the specific platform is set on appointment.
  
  
The role sets standards and assures designs; it does not build. Engineering delivery sits with the platform engineering teams, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, domain target architecture and the architecture team sit with the Platform Architecture Director, and enterprise-level standards sit with Enterprise Architecture. Solution designs for major cross-domain initiatives sit with the Solution Architect in Enterprise Architecture.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Define reference architectures, patterns and standards for the platform, aligned to DPTF strategy and to enterprise architecture.
* Design AI into the platform, producing reference patterns for AI-assisted delivery and for intelligent, self-healing operations.
* Architect for reliability and resilience by design, so that platform SLOs and error budgets are achievable rather than aspirational.
* Provide design assurance and technical guidance to engineering teams, reviewing designs against the standards before build rather than after.
* Ensure platform solutions are secure and compliant, including GxP requirements where the platform supports regulated activity.
* Evaluate and introduce new technologies, measuring the result against architecture OKRs rather than adopting on vendor claim.
* Set architecture standards that supplier and managed-service solutions must meet, and assure their designs to the same bar as internal work.
* Partner with Enterprise Architecture and Information Security on standards, roadmaps and exceptions.
* Increase pattern reuse across the platform, tracking where teams have adopted a pattern and where they have diverged and why.
* Reduce rework by intervening early in design, and evidence the reduction rather than asserting it.
* Advise the Product Owner and Platform Manager on the architectural consequence of roadmap choices, including technical debt being accepted.
* Hold the boundaries with the Platform Architecture Director on domain target architecture, the Solution Architect on cross-domain initiative designs, and the engineering teams on build.

**Education & Professional Qualifications**

* Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e.g., Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems).
* Architecture certifications desirable (e.g., TOGAF, or recognised cloud or network architecture certification relevant to the platform).

**Job Experience:**

* Typically 15+ years in technology architecture or senior engineering, including at least three years producing reference architectures or standards others build to.
* Deep hands-on depth in the relevant platform domain, whether cloud, network or digital workplace.
* Experience running design assurance or architecture review, including declining designs that did not meet the standard.
* Track record of architecting for reliability and resilience, working to SLOs and error budgets.
* Experience designing secure and compliant solutions, ideally including GxP or another regulated context.
* Experience setting architecture standards that supplier or managed-service solutions had to meet.
* Awareness of AI reference patterns for assisted delivery and intelligent operations.

**Desirable**

* Hands-on experience architecting and building AI/agentic systems — LLMs, evaluation pipelines, ML lifecycle — at production scale.
* Experience assessing data readiness (availability, quality, access, labeling) and flagging risks before builds start.
* Working knowledge of at least one pharma value chain area (R&D, manufacturing, or commercial).
* Background spotting reusable patterns across engagements and turning them into shared, durable technical capability.
* Ability to influence engineering teams without line authority, so that patterns are adopted rather than circumvented.
* Judgement about when to grant an architectural exception and when to hold the standard.
* Clear design documentation, since patterns are only reusable if others can follow them.
* Comfort challenging vendor claims and evaluating technology on measured outcome.
* Pragmatism about technical debt, making the cost visible rather than blocking delivery outright.
* Collaborative habit with Enterprise Architecture and Security, whose standards constrain the platform.

#AGTech
  
  
**Skills**
Asset Life Cycle Management, Data Integrity, Digital Fluency, Enterprise Architecture (EA), Enterprise IT Architecture, GxP Regulations, Information Security, Lean Management, Manufacturing Technologies, Pharmaceutical Manufacturing, Platform Architecture, Problem Solving, Risk Awareness, Solution Architecture, Standards Compliance
  
  
**Why GSK?**
**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**
GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.
  
  
People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.
  
  
**Inclusion at GSK:**
As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.
  
  
Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. This role is responsible for building and managing the foundational platform capabilities required to scale AI Agents across the enterprise, including agent orchestration frameworks, LLM platform services, AI security controls, governance frameworks, observability, and operational excellence.
  
  
The individual will work closely with Enterprise Architecture, Data & AI teams, Security, Platform Engineering, and Business stakeholders to establish a secure, scalable, and governed Agentic AI ecosystem that accelerates AI adoption while ensuring compliance, reliability, and responsible AI practices.

**Agentic AI Platform Leadership**

* Establish platform capabilities that enable the development, deployment, and management of AI Agents at scale.
* Lead platform engineering teams responsible for Agentic AI infrastructure, tooling, and operational support.

**Orchestrator Layer & Multi-Agent Framework**

* Design and manage the enterprise orchestration layer for AI agents.
* Establish standards for agent-to-agent communication, workflow orchestration, task planning, memory management, and tool integration.
* Build reusable frameworks that accelerate agent development and deployment.
* Enable integration with enterprise systems, APIs, data sources, and workflow platforms.

**LLM Platform Management**

* Own enterprise LLM services and model infrastructure.
* Evaluate, onboard, and manage proprietary and open-source foundation models.
* Establish model lifecycle management processes, including model selection, benchmarking, deployment, monitoring, and optimization.
* Drive LLM cost management, performance optimization, and reliability engineering.

**AI Governance & Responsible AI**

* Define and implement AI governance frameworks, policies, and operating procedures.
* Establish controls for Responsible AI, model risk management, auditability, explainability, and regulatory compliance.
* Partner with Legal, Risk, Compliance, and Information Security teams to ensure AI solutions meet enterprise requirements.
* Create governance reporting and executive dashboards for AI platform adoption and risk management.

**AI Security & Compliance**

* Define enterprise AI security architecture and controls.
* Implement safeguards against prompt injection, jailbreak attacks, data leakage, model abuse, and unauthorized access.
* Establish identity, access management, and secret management controls for AI services.
* Ensure compliance with organizational security standards, privacy regulations, and industry best practices.

**Observability & Platform Operations**

* Establish comprehensive monitoring for agent performance, model behavior, platform reliability, and operational health.
* Define SLAs, SLOs, and platform support processes.
* Build automated incident management and operational response capabilities.
* Drive continuous improvement through platform telemetry and analytics.

**Stakeholder & Team Leadership**

* Lead a team of AI Platform Engineers, MLOps Engineers, AI Security Specialists, and Platform Administrators.
* Collaborate with Enterprise Architects, Data Engineering, Security, and Business stakeholders.
* Provide technical leadership, mentoring, and talent development.
* Manage vendor relationships and strategic technology partnerships.

**Qualifications**
**Required Experience**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or related field.
* 10+ years of experience in software engineering, AI/ML platforms, cloud platforms, or enterprise platform management.
* 5+ years of leadership experience managing engineering or platform teams.
* Experience building and operating enterprise AI/ML platforms.
* Hands-on experience with LLMs, Generative AI, Agentic AI frameworks, and cloud-native architectures.

**Preferred Technical Skills**

* Agentic AI Frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, OpenAI Agents, etc.)
* LLM Platforms (Azure OpenAI, OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Open Source Models)
* MLOps and AI Operations
* Kubernetes, Docker, API Gateways
* Databricks, Azure AI Foundry, Snowflake
* Security by Design and Zero Trust Architecture
* AI Governance and Responsible AI Frameworks
* DevSecOps and Platform Engineering Practices

**Success Metrics**

* Enterprise adoption of Agentic AI Platform.
* Reduction in time to deploy production-grade AI agents.
* AI platform reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency.
* Compliance with AI governance and security standards.
* Successful implementation of Responsible AI controls.
* Optimized LLM usage, performance, and cost management.
* Improvement in developer productivity and AI solution delivery velocity.

A strategic technology leader who combines platform engineering expertise, AI innovation, governance discipline, and operational excellence to build a secure, scalable, and enterprise-grade Agentic AI ecosystem.

The Kraft Heinz Information Technology organization is hiring an AI Engineer to help build and deploy enterprise Generative AI (GenAI) and Agentic solutions within our Data Science function. As an individual contributor, you will implement models and GenAI features end to end, from data preparation, prompt engineering, agent/workflow building, testing and performance tuning, working within established engineering patterns and under the guidance of senior engineers.
  
  
This is a hands-on, execution-focused role (approximately 90% execution and 10% strategy). You will solve well-defined to moderately complex problems, collaborate closely with the delivery team, and ship reliable AI capabilities that generate value for the business.

* Implement and deploy GenAI features and models, including data preparation, prompt engineering, agent/workflow building, testing and performance tuning, within established engineering patterns.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology or a related field.

* Familiarity building and deploying solutions on a major cloud platform, preferably Microsoft Azure.
* Solid programming skills (e.g., Python) and good software-engineering practices in coding, testing and integration.
* Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail, applying established patterns and seeking guidance when needed.
* Collaborative team player with clear communication skills.
* Preferred: Microsoft Certified Azure AI Engineer Associate.

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
About the role

We're looking for an engineer who can take an AI product from an idea to a live, reliable application, and then keep making it better. You'll own complete applications, not just tickets. You'll decide what to build, build it, test it, ship it, and watch how it performs in production.

This role suits someone who uses AI tools heavily every day and can cover product, engineering, QA, data, and documentation work on their own. If you like shipping fast, owning outcomes, and learning new domains quickly, we'd like to hear from you.

**What you'll do**

* **Own AI applications end to end.**
  Take live AI products from idea through planning, building, testing, release, monitoring, and ongoing improvement.
* **Turn user problems into features.**
  Understand what users need, decide what's worth building, and ship it.
* **Build LLM-powered systems.**
  Develop and maintain agents, tools, APIs, and data pipelines.
* **Test your own work.**
  Write test cases and evaluations, and check results against real data before anything ships.
* **Run what you ship.**
  Deploy to production and monitor logs, alerts, and usage. When something breaks, fix it, find the root cause, and make sure it doesn't happen again.
* **Keep improving.**
  Use user feedback and usage data to make the products you own better over time.
* **Work AI-first.**
  Use AI tools to their full potential across product, engineering, QA, data, and documentation.
* **Juggle priorities.**
  Manage several applications and workstreams in parallel.

**What we're looking for**

**Engineering fundamentals**

* Strong Python skills and solid coding fundamentals
* SQL and hands-on experience with real databases
* Backend basics: REST APIs, authentication, configuration, and logging
* Deployment basics: Git, Docker, cloud platforms, and CI/CD
* Experience monitoring and debugging production systems

**AI and LLM experience**

* Hands-on experience building applications with LLM APIs (Claude, GPT, or similar)
* Good understanding of AI agents, tool calling, prompt design, and MCP
* Experience testing and evaluating LLM output and verifying it with data
* Daily, fluent use of AI coding and productivity tools such as Claude Code or Cursor

**How you work**

* Product thinking: you can break a user problem down into a plan and a shipped feature
* Ownership: you finish work end to end and flag blockers early
* Clear written communication and good documentation habits
* Comfort with multitasking and picking up new domains quickly

**Nice to have**

* Interest in markets, trading, or fintech

title: Lead Data & AI Engineer - Semantic Intelligence
description:
**Job Description**
We are looking for a
**Lead Data & AI Engineer - Semantic Intelligence**
to build trusted data and semantic foundations that turn enterprise AI into scalable business capability. You will combine data engineering, data-product thinking, dimensional and semantic modelling, application development, AI engineering, and practical data science. You will own delivery from raw data to AI-enabled decisions. This covers medallion architecture, reusable data products, semantic models, agents, and applications.
  
  
You will partner early with business, product, Data & Analytics, and technology stakeholders to define outcomes, success measures, and data needs. You will turn ambiguous challenges into technical designs, prototypes, and production solutions, and you will stay involved through adoption and improvement. This is a hands-on technical leadership role with mentoring responsibilities. It has no direct people management.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Deliver production-ready Data & AI solutions, staying hands-on in investigation, architecture, coding, modelling, testing, and implementation.
* Build AI-ready data foundations and agentic solutions grounded in structured data, governed measures, semantic metadata, and enterprise knowledge.
* Build production-ready Agentic AI, LLM, RAG, and tool/API orchestration patterns using enterprise engineering standards.
* Build analytical and AI-enabled applications using Fabric application capabilities, Rayfin, or comparable frameworks, integrated with semantic models, APIs, agents, and enterprise security.
* Build robust ELT/ETL pipelines using Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, SQL, Python, dbt, Apache Airflow, or comparable technologies.
* Implement bronze, silver, and gold medallion layers with lineage and auditability. Integrate lakehouse, warehouse, and semantic assets using batch, streaming, Direct Lake, or API patterns.
* Deliver reusable, domain-aligned data products with clear ownership, data contracts, quality controls, documentation, and consumption interfaces.
* Design dimensional models with explicit grain, conformed dimensions, facts, hierarchies, slowly changing dimensions, and bridge and relationship patterns.
* Build and optimize Fabric and Power BI semantic models with governed measures, DAX, relationships, and metadata, so analytics, applications, and AI share consistent business context.
* Explore data, frame hypotheses, engineer features, and apply segmentation, forecasting, classification, or anomaly detection where they support a business decision.
* Evaluate analytical and machine-learning approaches against suitable baselines using statistical reasoning, validation, and business-relevant measures. Explain limitations and integrate useful results into data products or applications.
* Lead end-to-end technical delivery: define scope, estimate and plan work, manage dependencies and risks, coordinate stakeholders, and own release readiness, adoption, and operational handover.
* Mentor engineers through architecture, design, and code reviews, debugging, testing, and production-readiness practices.
* Build data quality, observability, automated testing, lineage, security, privacy, responsible AI, version control, and CI/CD into every stage of delivery.
* Turn successful solutions into reusable data products, semantic assets, agent capabilities, and engineering accelerators.
* Start with the business decision or workflow, and co-shape outcomes, success measures, data needs, and adoption with stakeholders.
* Move from discovery to prototype to production, validating assumptions with real enterprise data and early feedback.
* Measure success by business value, trusted metrics, adoption, engineering quality, and reuse. Solve immediate needs while strengthening reusable enterprise foundations.

**Required Qualifications**

* 10+ years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, AI engineering, or closely related technical roles.
* Hands-on experience with Agentic AI, LLMs, agents, RAG, and tool/API integration or orchestration.
* Experience building data-driven or AI-enabled applications using Fabric, Rayfin, or comparable frameworks.
* Experience with Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, or comparable analytical platforms, including lakehouse and warehouse patterns.
* Strong SQL and Python skills, with experience delivering production-grade data solutions.
* Experience delivering data products through bronze, silver, and gold layers, with quality controls, lineage, and clear consumption interfaces.
* Strong dimensional modelling skills, including grain, facts, dimensions, star and snowflake schemas, slowly changing dimensions, and many-to-many patterns.
* Proven enterprise semantic modelling experience, including governed business definitions and reusable measures. Proficiency in Power BI, DAX, and performance optimization, or equivalent technologies.
* Working knowledge of exploratory analysis, statistical reasoning, feature engineering, and practical predictive methods such as forecasting, classification, or anomaly detection.
* Ability to frame hypotheses, select baselines and evaluation measures, validate results, communicate uncertainty, and work with data scientists on modelling approaches.
* Experience with orchestration, automated testing, version control, CI/CD, data quality, and operational support.
* Ability to lead technical workstreams as a hands-on senior individual contributor and mentor engineers through design and code reviews.
* Experience managing scope, estimates, dependencies, risks, releases, and operational handover, taking solutions from concept through adoption.
* Clear communication with technical, business, and senior stakeholder audiences.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with dbt, Apache Airflow, Git/GitHub, and automated deployment frameworks.
* Broader Power BI and Fabric experience across OneLake, Lakehouse, Warehouse, Notebooks, Direct Lake, and application capabilities.
* Experience with AI solutions grounded in semantic models, metadata, knowledge graphs, or governed enterprise data.
* Experience with agentic frameworks, model evaluation, observability, and responsible AI practices.
* Exposure to machine-learning experimentation, feature pipelines, and operationalizing lightweight predictive solutions.
* Knowledge of governance, privacy, security, lineage, and enterprise architecture.
* Experience delivering reusable data products and platforms in Agile or iterative models.
* Experience designing data contracts and consumption interfaces that enable reuse across analytics, applications, and AI solutions.
* Experience integrating lakehouse, warehouse, and semantic assets through batch, streaming, Direct Lake, or API-based patterns, with end-to-end lineage and auditability.
* Experience optimizing dimensional and semantic models with conformed dimensions, hierarchies, bridge tables, and complex relationships.
* Experience evaluating analytical and AI-enabled solutions against suitable baselines and business-relevant measures, communicating limitations, and incorporating stakeholder feedback.
* Experience partnering with business and product stakeholders to take ambiguous needs from discovery and prototyping through production adoption and operational handover.
* Experience creating reusable engineering accelerators and guiding engineers through architecture reviews, debugging, and production-readiness practices.

**What’s in it For You?**

* Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.
* Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.
* Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.
* Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.
* Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.
* Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.
* Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.

Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. title: AI Engineer
description:
# AI/ML Engineer — Gemba Concepts
  
  

* Location:\*\* Bengaluru, India (Hybrid)
* Experience:\*\* ~2–5 years
* Type:\*\* Full-time

## About Gemba Concepts
  
  
Gemba Concepts is a lean manufacturing and technology consulting firm helping clients across pharma, manufacturing, and logistics modernize how they operate. We build production systems that sit close to the shop floor: warehouse management, manufacturing traceability, and an applied AI/ML platform whose flagship use cases are visual quality inspection and predictive maintenance. We're a tight engineering team that ships real systems for demanding, often regulated, environments.
  
  
## The Role
  
  
We're looking for an AI/ML Engineer to take ML capabilities from prototype to production. You'll own models end-to-end: framing the problem with stakeholders, building and validating the model, and deploying it as a reliable service that holds up against real-world, messy industrial data. This is a hands-on building role, not a pure research seat. Your work goes into client-facing systems.
  
  
## What You'll Do
  
  

* Build and ship \*\*computer vision models\*\* for visual quality inspection (defect detection, classification, segmentation) that perform under real factory lighting, throughput, and edge-case conditions.
* Develop \*\*predictive maintenance models\*\* using sensor/time-series data: anomaly detection, remaining-useful-life estimation, failure prediction.
* Own the \*\*full ML lifecycle\*\*: data pipelines, feature engineering, training, evaluation, and deployment, with proper versioning and monitoring.
* \*\*Deploy and serve models in production on Azure (AKS)\*\*, and keep them healthy by tracking drift, retraining triggers, and latency.
* Integrate \*\*LLM-based capabilities\*\* (we use the Claude API and self-hosted open models) into delivery and product workflows where they add leverage.
* Collaborate with product, engineering, and domain experts to translate fuzzy operational problems into well-scoped ML solutions, and to know when ML is not the right answer.
* Communicate results and limitations clearly to non-ML stakeholders, including clients.

## What We're Looking For
  
  

* 2–5 years of hands-on experience building and deploying ML models in production (not just notebooks or coursework).
* Strong Python and the modern ML stack: PyTorch or TensorFlow, scikit-learn, NumPy/Pandas.
* Solid grounding in at least one of: computer vision (CNNs, object detection/segmentation, image preprocessing) or time-series / anomaly detection.
* Practical MLOps experience: containerization (Docker), model serving, experiment tracking, and deploying on a cloud platform. Azure / Kubernetes (AKS) is a strong plus.
* Comfort working with imperfect, real-world data: labeling strategy, class imbalance, data drift, and validation that reflects production reality.
* Good engineering hygiene (Git, testing, code review) and the ability to write code others can build on.

## Nice to Have
  
  

* Experience with industrial / manufacturing data or regulated environments (pharma, 21 CFR Part 11 awareness).
* Hands-on LLM integration experience: RAG, prompt engineering, working with APIs or self-hosted models (vLLM, Qwen, etc.).
* Edge deployment experience (running CV models on-device / near the line).
* Exposure to data pipeline tooling and orchestration.

## What You'll Get
  
  

* Real ownership of ML systems that go into production for serious clients.
* A lean, senior-heavy team where you ship fast and learn across the stack.
* Direct exposure to applied AI in manufacturing, a domain where the work has tangible, physical impact.
* To apply:\*\* Share your résumé and links to relevant production ML work.

Skills:- Python, Machine Learning (ML), Computer Vision, Deep Learning, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-Learn, Total productive maintenance, Time series, MLOps, Docker, SQL Azure and Generative AI

**Job Title**
Senior AI Engineer (Hybrid)
  
  
**Job Description**
The Senior AI Engineer leads the design, build and operation of the machine learning models, large language model (LLM) services and agentic systems that drive Kaplan’s AI strategy. Your remit spans learner-facing products and internal AI-first business processes. You will be a technical reference point for the AI Engineering team, owning the design of the systems you build and helping set the standard for how we deliver reliable, secure and scalable AI services.
  
  
**As The Senior AI Engineer, You Will**

* Lead the design, development and delivery of machine learning, LLM and agentic solutions for learner products and internal business workflows.
* Architect agentic workflows, including tool use, structured outputs, multi-agent orchestration and human-in-the-loop patterns.
* Champion engineering standards and best practice, and review the designs and code of other engineers.
* Own the reliability, cost, security and performance of AI services in production.
* Build and maintain evaluation tooling and observability for models and LLM-based systems.
* Mentor AI Engineers and help grow our engineering capability.
* Collaborate with teams across Kaplan, including product, data science, design and learning teams, to translate requirements into technical direction.
* Stay current with new AI tools and techniques and set direction on their practical adoption.

**Detailed Responsibilities**
Technical leadership and mentoring
  
  

* Set and champion standards for engineering quality, code review and reusable patterns.
* Lead the technical approach on ambiguous or novel problems.
* Own the design of the systems you build and shape architectural decisions across the AI platform, aligned with enterprise architecture.
* Mentor and develop AI Engineers through review, pairing and technical guidance.

Model and agent development
  
  

* Lead algorithm and framework selection, and design retrieval and grounding strategies, prompts and embeddings.
* Design, build and evaluate agentic workfl ows using frameworks such as Microsoft Agent Framework.
* Evaluate models and LLM-based systems using agreed metrics and methods, including golden datasets, LLM-as-judge evaluation, and tracing and observability tooling.
* Partner with data science colleagues, who own modelling and evaluation

Innovation and growth
  
  

* Assess emerging techniques and paradigms and set direction on their practical adoption.
* Champion new ideas by building prototypes and translating research into tangible solutions.
* Share fi ndings with product and learning stakeholders with clear impact statements.

You’ll also carry out other duties, within the broad scope and spirit of your role, as requested by your manager. Our business continuously evolves, so your role will too.
  
  
**What you might be doing now; Your current role, or recent roles, may be:**

* AI Engineer at Kaplan, ready to step up
* Senior Machine Learning Engineer
* Senior Software Engineer leading AI features
* Machine Learning Engineer leading the delivery of LLM or agentic systems

**What You’ll Bring To The Role**
This role suits an experienced, pragmatic engineer who leads by example: someone who balances rapid experimentation with production-level rigour and raises the standard of those around them.
  
  
**You Will Have**

* 5+ years’ experience in software or machine learning engineering.
* Substantial experience (typically 2+ years) building and operating LLM-based or agentic systems in production.
* Strong Python skills and knowledge of ML libraries (PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn).
* Experience with agent and LLM frameworks (e.g. Microsoft Agent Framework, LangGraph) and prompt engineering.
* Strong MLOps experience: CI/CD, container orchestration and infrastructure-as-code, with cloud platforms (Azure preferred).
* Knowledge of NoSQL/document databases (e.g. Azure Cosmos DB) and vector search (e.g. Azure AI Search), plus a solid grounding in relational/SQL database design and querying.
* Experience leading technical decisions, mentoring engineers and reviewing designs and code.
* A strong understanding of data privacy, security and responsible AI, and the ability to explain complex ideas to non-specialists.

**Desirable**

* Experience with Google’s agent platform (Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform/Vertex AI, including the Agent Development Kit).
* Familiarity with agent interoperability standards such as the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Agent2Agent (A2A).
* Additional programming languages such as C# and the .NET framework.
* Experience with education-specific standards such as xAPI, LTI or LMS plug-ins.

**How You Can Build Your Career At Kaplan**
From this role, your potential paths for career progression at Kaplan include:
  
  

* Principal AI Engineer, deepening technical expertise as a senior individual contributor
* AI Platform Lead, owning our AI platform and engineering standards
* Head of AI Engineering, leading the engineering function

Bangalore, KA, India
  
  
**Additional Locations**

Employee

IT Operations

Kaplan is committed to cultivating an inclusive workplace that values diversity, promotes equity, and integrates inclusivity into all aspects of our operations. We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of age, race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, veteran status, nationality, or sex. We believe that diversity strengthens our organization, fuels innovation, and improves our ability to serve our students, customers, and communities. Learn more about our culture here.
  
  
Kaplan considers qualified applicants for employment even if applicants have an arrest or conviction in their background check records. Kaplan complies with related background check regulations, including but not limited to, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. There are various positions where certain convictions may disqualify applicants, such as those positions requiring interaction with minors, financial records, or other sensitive and/or confidential information.

description:

You will use your strategic acumen and presentation skills to engage with technical and business leaders, and persuasively present practical and useful solutions on Google Cloud. You will have excellent technical, communication and organizational skills.  

You will focus on identifying, pursuing, and winning new business workloads and driving engagement within existing ones. You will have a breadth of technical expertise, spanning infrastructure modernization, application modernization, data analytics and more. You will blend sales expertise, market knowledge and direct technical engagement to prove the value of the Google Cloud portfolio.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

title: Software Development Consultant (Cerner Command Language)
description:
**ORACLE CSS INNOVATION STUDIOS**

About Oracle Customer Success Services (CSS)

Oracle Customer Success Services (CSS) helps customers maximize the value of their Oracle technology investments, from implementation and adoption to ongoing improvement. Within CSS, Oracle Innovation Studios brings together specialists across AI Studio, Cloud Platforms Studio, Industry Studios, Fusion Apps Studios, and Security Studio. We collaborate across Studios, Product Development, sales, and delivery, combining reusable assets and practical AI capabilities to improve delivery productivity and turn business priorities into lasting customer value.

Why join CSS?

* Build on your expertise. Deepen your Oracle specialization while expanding your understanding of connected business processes and technologies across the Oracle ecosystem.
* Apply AI to real business needs. Develop practical knowledge of AI and automation through customer solutions and improvements to the way we design, build, and deliver.
* Connect your work to customer outcomes. Contribute across discovery, solution design, prototyping, delivery, and adoption, with opportunities shaped by your role and Studio.
* Learn through collaboration. Work with specialists, architects, engineers, and functional experts across Studios and Product Development to strengthen your solution judgment.
* Extend your impact. Create reusable assets and share knowledge through mentoring, workshops, demonstrations, technical publications, and continuous learning.

Industry Studios

Industry Studios bring an industry-focused approach to customer co-innovation, connecting business priorities and domain knowledge with Oracle technologies. The work centers on understanding industry processes, identifying valuable use cases, and shaping solutions that address operational needs. Depending on the role and engagement, this can include discovery workshops, prototypes, industry-specific accelerators, and collaboration with AI, applications, cloud, data, and security specialists. Join Industry Studios to deepen your domain expertise while translating customer challenges into practical solutions and measurable business outcomes.

Oracle Health:

Oracle Health is reimagining the future of healthcare by connecting clinical, operational, and financial data across the entire care continuum. Combining the proven clinical depth of the Millennium platform with the scale, security, and AI capabilities of Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), our consulting practice partners directly with healthcare providers, hospital networks, and public health organizations worldwide to implement, optimize, and modernize their health IT ecosystems.

Role Overview

Based in India in the EDGE - CCL team, you will develop customer-specific Oracle Health Millennium solutions using Cerner Command Language (CCL). You will own assigned projects from requirements gathering and technical design through development, testing, deployment, and post-go-live support. Working with customers, consultants, and clinical teams, you will deliver reports, extracts, clinical print outputs, labels, and requisitions that address clinical and operational needs. Your responsibilities include analysis of the Millennium data model, performance troubleshooting, code reviews, customer testing, and production readiness. You will maintain technical documentation and handover guides, communicate progress and risks, and contribute reusable scripts and delivery improvements. The role requires strong CCL and SQL skills, full-lifecycle delivery experience, and the ability to manage assigned work independently. You will also use Oracle-approved AI development tools with effective prompts, appropriate technical context, and critical review of generated code and documentation, retaining accountability for quality and validation.

Key Responsibilities

* Gather requirements, assess feasibility and prepare technical designs, effort estimates and delivery plans.
* Develop and enhance CCL reports, data extracts, clinical print outputs, labels and requisitions.
* Analyze Millennium tables, fields, relationships and code sets to implement accurate data retrieval and processing.
* Troubleshoot functional issues, data discrepancies and performance problems in custom solutions.
* Conduct code reviews, prepare test cases and validate outputs against agreed requirements.
* Coordinate customer testing, resolve defects and support packaging, deployment and production readiness.
* Maintain technical documentation, project summaries and customer handover guides.
* Communicate progress, dependencies and risks to customers and project stakeholders.
* Use Oracle-approved AI tools and reusable components across delivery, including code review and documentation, while retaining accountability for quality and validation.
* Mentor colleagues and contribute reusable scripts, technical guidance and delivery improvements.

Skills - Mandatory

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

**Oracle Products**

* Strong hands-on experience developing and troubleshooting CCL solutions in Oracle Health Millennium.
* Sound understanding of the Millennium data model and clinical or operational workflows.

**Technical Skills**

* Proficiency in SQL, relational databases, query optimization and data validation.
* Experience with version control, code reviews, testing and controlled deployments.
* Practical experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Oracle-approved ChatGPT and Codex.
* Ability to write effective prompts, provide relevant technical context and critically review AI-generated code and documentation.

**Experience**

* Experience delivering custom reports, extracts or clinical outputs through the full development lifecycle.

**Functional Skills**

* Ability to independently manage assigned work, estimate effort and resolve complex technical issues.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Clear communication skills and the ability to translate customer requirements into technical solutions.

**Work Requirements**

* Willingness to work the 4 p.m.–1 a.m. IST shift.
* Willingness to work additional or irregular hours as needed and permitted by local regulations.
* Perform other responsibilities as assigned and follow corporate and organizational security policies and procedures, including safeguarding corporate and client assets and preventing and reporting security compromises within the scope of the role.

Good to Have

* Experience with Java, JavaScript, HTML and CSS for custom interfaces and workflow enhancements.
* Experience with MPages, Discern Rules, PIE, DA2 or healthcare interfaces.
* Familiarity with pharmacy, laboratory, blood bank, registration or financial reporting workflows.
* Experience supporting customer implementations and go-live activities.

Self Assessment Questions

Before applying, please consider the following questions:

* Can I demonstrate strong hands-on CCL development and troubleshooting experience in Oracle Health Millennium and knowledge of its data model and workflows?
* Am I proficient in SQL, relational databases, query optimization, and data validation?
* Have I delivered custom reports, extracts, or clinical outputs through the full development lifecycle, using version control, code reviews, testing, and controlled deployments?
* Can I independently estimate and manage assigned work, resolve complex technical issues, and communicate customer requirements as technical solutions?
* Do I have the specified bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience, and can I demonstrate effective use and critical review of Oracle-approved AI development tools?
