The AI Studio helps customers turn AI opportunities into working solutions using embedded AI in Oracle applications, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) AI services, and Oracle database capabilities. The team identifies valuable use cases, develops and evaluates prototypes, and supports integration, adoption, and scale. Work can include AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation, document intelligence, and intelligent automation, with attention to security, governance, and measurable business value. Join the Studio to combine Oracle expertise with practical AI engineering and help customers embed intelligence into everyday work.

**Role Overview**
=================

As Extensions Architect, you will define end-to-end architectures for Oracle Fusion SaaS extensions, integrations, and applications with AI capabilities. You will connect customer outcomes with platform decisions, establish reusable patterns, and guide complex solutions from discovery through production. This hands-on role combines deep expertise in Oracle Visual Builder Studio, Oracle Integration Cloud, and Oracle APEX with practical AI architecture and leadership of AI-assisted engineering. Working with business and technology stakeholders, delivery teams, other Studios, and Product Development, you will define solution boundaries, nonfunctional requirements, roadmaps, and architectural tradeoffs. You will validate critical designs through prototypes and reviews, guide consistent implementation, and shape technical proposals and estimates. The role suits an experienced architect who can influence senior customer stakeholders, mentor technical leads and engineers, and balance security, operational needs, cost, and performance while demonstrating customer value and measurable delivery improvements.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* Lead architecture discovery with business and technology stakeholders to define target architectures, solution boundaries, nonfunctional requirements, delivery roadmaps, and measures of business value.
* Select Fusion configuration, Redwood and VBS extensions, APEX applications, OIC integrations, and OCI services, documenting tradeoffs in maintainability, security, cost, performance, and resilience.
* Design end-to-end application, integration, API, and data flows across Oracle Fusion ERP, SCM, HCM, and external systems using supported interfaces and patterns that accommodate SaaS updates.
* Establish repeatable AI-assisted practices across analysis, development, testing, review, documentation, and delivery automation to improve engineering consistency and productivity.
* Architect assistants, RAG solutions, and agent workflows, defining model and service selection, knowledge access, tool invocation, orchestration, evaluation, and human approval for consequential actions.
* Own cross-cutting architecture for identity, authorization, data isolation, secrets, auditability, performance, availability, disaster recovery, observability, and AI cost and latency controls to meet operational needs.
* Validate high-risk assumptions through hands-on prototypes and code reviews; lead architecture reviews and resolve complex design issues to guide implementation and production readiness.
* Create reference architectures and reusable accelerators, set engineering and AI evaluation standards, and mentor Leads and engineers to support consistent adoption across engagements.
* Shape presales solutions, estimates, assumptions, and technical proposals; present architecture and value to customer leaders, collaborate across Studios and Product Development, and contribute technical thought leadership.

**Skills - Mandatory**
======================

**Education**

* Bachelor's or master's degree in engineering, computer science, information technology, MCA, or equivalent practical experience.

**Experience**

* 15+ years of overall IT experience, with substantial responsibility for enterprise application and integration architecture. A record of owning architecture across multiple Oracle extension projects through production delivery is required.

**Oracle Products**

* Visual Builder Studio: Deep hands-on expertise in Oracle Visual Builder Studio (VBS), Visual Builder, Redwood extensibility, Oracle JET, JavaScript or TypeScript, and extension lifecycle management. Ability to define modular UI patterns, service contracts, repositories, and CI/CD standards.
* Oracle Integration Cloud: Deep expertise in OIC architecture, adapters, orchestration, REST and SOAP APIs, asynchronous and event-based integration, bulk processing, security, monitoring, and recovery. Ability to design for idempotency, throughput, API limits, and operational support.
* Oracle APEX: Strong hands-on expertise and architectural judgment in APEX, Oracle Database, SQL, PL/SQL, ORDS, data modeling, application security, performance, and deployment. Ability to explain when APEX or VBS is appropriate and how each connects to Fusion and OCI.

**Technical Skills**

* AI driven delivery: Demonstrated leadership in applying AI assistants and agents across the software lifecycle. Ability to define context and prompt practices, automated workflows, human review, quality gates, and measurement of productivity, rework, defects, and business value.
* AI architecture and knowledge: Practical experience architecting solutions using large language models, embeddings, vector retrieval, RAG, tool use, agent orchestration, and OCI Generative AI or comparable services. Strong understanding of model evaluation, grounding, prompt injection defenses, data boundaries, human oversight, latency, and cost tradeoffs.
* Enterprise architecture and influence: Strong knowledge of Fusion extensibility and APIs, OCI architecture, SSO, OAuth, RBAC, data security, API management, and DevOps. Ability to define nonfunctional requirements, evaluate architectural tradeoffs, estimate complex work, and communicate with technical teams and senior customer stakeholders.

**Good to Have**
================

* Experience with Oracle Fusion AI Agent Studio, MCP, agent interoperability, Python, or agent frameworks such as LangGraph or LangChain.
* Relevant Oracle architecture or AI certifications; experience shaping service offerings, reusable intellectual property, or technical publications.

**Self Assessment Questions**
=============================

Before applying, please consider the following questions:

* Do I have at least 15 years of overall IT experience, substantial enterprise application and integration architecture responsibility, and a record of owning architecture across multiple Oracle extension projects through production?

* Can I demonstrate deep hands-on expertise in VBS, Visual Builder, Redwood extensibility, Oracle JET, JavaScript or TypeScript, and extension lifecycle standards?

* Can I design OIC architectures covering adapters, orchestration, REST and SOAP APIs, asynchronous and event-based integration, bulk processing, idempotency, throughput, API limits, and recovery?

* Can I demonstrate hands-on APEX and Oracle Database expertise and explain architectural choices between APEX and VBS for Fusion and OCI solutions?

* Can I demonstrate leadership of measurable AI-assisted delivery and practical architecture experience with LLMs, embeddings, vector retrieval, RAG, agent orchestration, evaluation, human oversight, and AI safeguards?

title: Database Architect
description:
**Role Scope**
--------------

Owns data architecture across multiple domains, with dual focus: (1) modernizing legacy database systems—particularly large-scale SQL Server environments with complex stored procedures containing embedded business logic, and (2) designing AI-native data infrastructure—semantic data models, vector databases, and RAG architectures that power AI agents and workflows. Establishes patterns for domain-driven data models, event-driven data flows, and canonical schemas across relational, NoSQL, analytical, and AI-optimized data platforms.

**The Problem We're Solving**
-----------------------------

We have two interconnected data architecture challenges.

Legacy modernization: SQL Server stored procedures that have grown to thousands of lines, with business logic deeply embedded in T-SQL that should live in application services. These procedures are difficult to test, impossible to reuse, and create tight coupling between business rules and data access. They slow down development, complicate domain ownership, and resist modernization efforts.

AI data infrastructure: We're building AI agents and agentic workflows that require purpose-built data architecture—semantic models that capture domain knowledge, vector databases for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embedding pipelines, and knowledge graphs that give AI systems the context they need to operate effectively. This isn't about bolting AI onto existing data systems; it's about designing data infrastructure that makes AI-native applications possible.

These challenges intersect: the domain knowledge locked in legacy systems becomes training data and context for AI agents. The canonical models we build for modernization become the semantic foundation for AI retrieval. We need database architects who can work across both dimensions—modernizing legacy while building for an AI-native future.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

We are seeking a Senior Database Architect who combines deep expertise in legacy database systems with forward-looking vision for AI-native data architecture. You'll lead the decomposition of complex stored procedures while simultaneously designing the vector databases, embedding strategies, and semantic models that power our AI agents and workflows.

This is an AI-first role in two senses: you'll leverage AI to accelerate your own work (stored procedure analysis, migration generation, schema documentation), and you'll design the data infrastructure that AI systems depend on. If you're excited about both solving hard legacy database problems and architecting the data layer for AI-native applications, this role is for you.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

### **Legacy Database Modernization**

* Analyze and decompose large SQL Server stored procedures (1,000+ lines) with embedded business logic, creating migration strategies that extract logic into domain services
* Design patterns for separating business rules from data access, enabling stored procedures to become thin data-access layers while business logic moves to application services
* Lead refactoring efforts that align database structures with domain-driven design: bounded contexts, aggregates, and domain events
* Implement event-driven patterns that decouple systems from direct database dependencies: change data capture, outbox patterns, event sourcing where appropriate
* Optimize query performance, indexing strategies, and execution plans as part of modernization efforts
* Create migration playbooks and tooling that engineering teams can apply to their own stored procedure modernization

### **AI Data Infrastructure & Semantic Modeling**

* Design semantic data models that capture domain knowledge in structures optimized for AI retrieval and reasoning
* Architect vector database solutions for RAG implementations: embedding strategies, chunking approaches, similarity search optimization, and hybrid retrieval patterns
* Design and implement embedding pipelines that transform domain content into vector representations suitable for AI agent consumption
* Establish knowledge graph patterns where appropriate: entity relationships, ontologies, and graph-based retrieval for complex domain reasoning
* Define data architectures for AI agent context: what data agents need, how it's structured, how freshness and consistency are maintained
* Design evaluation frameworks for RAG quality: retrieval accuracy, relevance scoring, and feedback loops for continuous improvement

### **Modern Data Platform Architecture**

* Design canonical data models and schemas that are flexible, extensible, and aligned with business domain concepts
* Architect data solutions across multiple platforms: SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MongoDB/Cosmos DB, Snowflake, and vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector, Azure AI Search)
* Design event-driven data flows: Kafka-based event streaming, materialized views, CQRS patterns, and real-time data synchronization
* Establish data platform infrastructure patterns: data pipelines, ETL/ELT orchestration, data quality frameworks, and observability
* Define data residency, partitioning, and multi-region strategies for performance and compliance
* Create reference architectures for common data patterns that domain teams can adopt

### **AI-First Database Engineering**

* Leverage AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code) to accelerate stored procedure analysis, refactoring, and migration
* Build AI-powered tools for database engineering: automated stored procedure analysis, schema documentation generators, migration assistants, and query optimization recommenders
* Create AI-consumable artifacts: structured documentation, annotated schemas, and context files that enable AI agents to understand and work with database systems
* Author database architecture skills that encode patterns, constraints, and best practices for AI-assisted development
* Develop prompts, workflows, and tooling that help engineering teams apply AI effectively to database modernization tasks

### **Cross-Domain Leadership**

* Partner with AI/ML teams to ensure data architecture supports agent and workflow requirements
* Collaborate with domain teams to understand their data requirements and design solutions aligned with domain ownership
* Work with application architects to ensure data architecture supports service-oriented and event-driven designs
* Contribute to Enterprise Architecture Council (EAC) standards for data architecture, modeling conventions, and technology selection
* Mentor engineers on database design, optimization, semantic modeling, and AI data infrastructure

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

### **Required Experience**

* 8–12 years in database engineering and architecture, with significant experience in enterprise-scale SQL Server environments
* Deep SQL Server expertise: T-SQL optimization, stored procedure design and refactoring, query plan analysis, indexing strategies, and performance tuning
* Hands-on modernization experience: track record of decomposing complex stored procedures and migrating business logic to application services
* Multi-platform data architecture: experience designing solutions across relational (SQL Server, PostgreSQL), NoSQL (MongoDB, Cosmos DB), and analytical (Snowflake, data lakehouse) platforms
* Event-driven data patterns: CDC, Kafka, outbox pattern, event sourcing, CQRS—practical experience implementing these in production
* Data modeling expertise: canonical models, dimensional modeling, schema evolution, and designing for extensibility

### **AI & Semantic Data Competencies**

* Vector database experience: hands-on with at least one vector DB (Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, pgvector, Azure AI Search, or similar)
* RAG architecture understanding: embedding models, chunking strategies, retrieval optimization, hybrid search, and reranking patterns
* Semantic modeling: experience designing data structures optimized for AI retrieval—knowledge representation, ontologies, or domain-specific schemas for AI consumption
* Understanding of embedding pipelines: text preprocessing, embedding generation, vector indexing, and incremental updates
* Familiarity with LLM context requirements: what data AI agents need, token constraints, context window optimization

### **AI-Native Engineering Practices**

* 2+ years actively using AI coding assistants for database work; deep understanding of how to prompt effectively for SQL and data engineering tasks
* Experience building tools, scripts, or automation that leverage AI/LLM capabilities
* Familiarity with structured artifact creation for AI consumption: documented schemas, annotated procedures, context files
* Vision for AI-assisted database engineering and ability to build tooling that enables it

### **Technical Depth**

* Strong programming skills in at least one backend language (C#, Java, Python) for building migration tooling, embedding pipelines, and services
* Cloud data services experience: Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, Azure AI Search, Azure Synapse, Snowflake, or AWS equivalents
* Infrastructure-as-code for data platforms: Terraform, ARM/Bicep, or CloudFormation
* Understanding of domain-driven design and how data architecture supports bounded contexts
* Familiarity with data governance, lineage, and compliance requirements (HIPAA, PCI-DSS)

### **Preferred Experience**

* Background in healthcare, benefits, payments, or similarly regulated industries
* Experience building RAG systems or AI-powered search/retrieval applications
* Knowledge graph experience: Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, or similar graph databases
* Contributions to database tooling, AI/ML data infrastructure, or open-source projects
* Experience mentoring engineers or leading database/data architecture communities of practice

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

In 90 days: Completed assessment of priority stored procedure modernization targets and AI data infrastructure needs; delivered first AI-assisted analysis tooling; established vector database patterns for initial RAG implementations

In 6 months: Led decomposition of at least one major stored procedure system; semantic data models and RAG architecture patterns established and being adopted; AI-powered database engineering tools in active use by teams

In 12 months: Measurable reduction in stored procedure complexity across priority systems; AI data infrastructure supporting production agent workflows; recognized as the go-to expert for both database modernization and AI-native data architecture

**Why This Role Matters**
-------------------------

Data architecture is being transformed from two directions simultaneously.

From the legacy side: business logic buried in stored procedures creates invisible dependencies that resist refactoring. Traditional approaches to database modernization are slow, manual, and error-prone—but AI can analyze thousands of lines of T-SQL, identify patterns, and accelerate migrations in ways that weren't possible before.

From the AI side: agents and workflows need purpose-built data infrastructure. The semantic models, vector databases, and knowledge representations you design will determine how effectively AI can reason about our domains. This isn't a nice-to-have capability; it's foundational to our AI-native engineering strategy.

You'll work at the intersection of these transformations—solving hard legacy problems while building the data infrastructure that makes AI-native applications possible. The patterns you establish will shape how we approach data architecture across the enterprise.

description:

The Security Studio helps customers strengthen security and trust across Oracle applications, cloud platforms, databases, and AI solutions. The team combines security assessments, architecture, identity modernization, and governance to address business risks and improve access controls. Work can include identity and access management, access reviews, security roadmaps, and AI-assisted security intelligence, in collaboration with specialists across Studios. Join the Studio to deepen your security expertise and help customers adopt new capabilities with the controls, resilience, and governance their businesses require.

Oracle Health is reimagining the future of healthcare by connecting clinical, operational, and financial data across the entire care continuum. Combining the proven clinical depth of the Millennium platform with the scale, security, and AI capabilities of Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), our consulting practice partners directly with healthcare providers, hospital networks, and public health organizations worldwide to implement, optimize, and modernize their health IT ecosystems.

Based in India, you will lead Identity and Access Management strategy, architecture, and implementation across Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) and connected enterprise applications. The role combines architecture ownership with hands-on OCI IAM and Identity Domains configuration, federation, lifecycle processes, and least-privilege access. title: Client Delivery Partner
description:
**Overview**

As a part of the Complex Delivery team within Industry Solutions Delivery, the Client Delivery Partner (CDP) is responsible for leading large, transformational deals from origination through delivery stabilization. Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

You will be responsible for leading large transformational deals from origination through delivery stabilization and this includes leading cross-functional, cross-organizational deal teams through Strategic Deal pursuit, negotiation, and close phases; initiating and stabilizing delivery; and providing customer facing executive leadership throughout these deal and delivery stages.

You will be the main counterpart for the customer and work in unison with the customer executive sponsor to originate, shape and deliver customer business value.

Required Qualifications:

* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Information Technology, Business, or related field AND 12+ years solution delivery, customer-facing consulting, or digital transformation experience

o OR Master's Degree in Engineering, Information Technology, Business, or related field AND 10+ years solution delivery, customer-facing consulting, or digital transformation experience  
o OR equivalent experience  

* 6+ years leadership experience in a matrixed environment

Preferred Qualificiations:

* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Information Technology, Business, or related field AND 15+ years solution delivery, customer-facing consulting, or digital transformation experience
* OR equivalent experience
* 12+ years relevant work experience in solution delivery
* 5+ years relevant work experience within Financial Services industry & financial management (e.g Profit and loss)

The role requires proficiency in English at an advanced level.

  
  

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process**.**

title: Solution Area Specialists - Digital Natives
description:
**Overview**

The Azure Solution Specialist for India's Digital Native business plays a pivotal role in accelerating cloud and AI adoption, driving strategic customer engagements, and delivering sustained Azure consumption growth in one of the most dynamic, technically sophisticated, and highly competitive market segments.

The role requires a **strong challenger mindset, deep technical acumen, commercial agility, and an uncompromising focus on execution and customer outcomes**. Digital Native customers operate at exceptional speed, with technically proficient founders, CTOs, and engineering leaders who expect credible technical engagement, differentiated thinking, rapid turnaround, and tangible outcomes from every interaction.

The Solution Specialist is expected to operate as a trusted strategic advisor and growth leader, proactively challenging conventional approaches, shaping customer technology strategies, and identifying opportunities across AI, cloud infrastructure, data platforms, migration, and modernization. Success requires the ability to connect Microsoft's technology differentiation with customer business priorities, influence complex technical and commercial decisions, and compete effectively in a rapidly evolving cloud and AI ecosystem.

Working across customer leadership, engineering teams, partners, and Microsoft's broader organization, the specialist will lead high-value opportunities from identification through execution, accelerate pipeline conversion, and drive predictable business results. The role demands strong ownership, bias for action, disciplined sales execution, and the ability to navigate ambiguity while consistently delivering at the pace of Digital Native customers.

**Above all, this role calls for a technically strong, commercially astute, and outcome-driven professional who thrives in high-velocity environments, brings a challenger perspective to every customer conversation, and translates innovation into measurable customer success and Azure business growth.**

 **Responsibilities**  

### **1. Customer Engagement & Business Ownership**

* **Drive high-impact customer engagement:** Lead strategic conversations with founders, CTOs, engineering leaders, and senior decision-makers across Digital Native accounts. Demonstrate strong technical credibility, business acumen, and the ability to translate complex Azure and AI capabilities into differentiated customer outcomes.
* **Operate at Digital Native speed:** Embrace a customer-first, high-velocity execution mindset, ensuring rapid turnaround, proactive follow-through, and measurable outcomes from every customer interaction. Prioritize meaningful customer-facing engagements and maintain a strong field presence to accelerate business opportunities.
* **Demonstrate a hunter and challenger mindset:** Proactively identify, create, and pursue new business opportunities across existing and prospective customers. Challenge conventional thinking, uncover unmet needs, influence technology decisions, and position Microsoft as a strategic partner for cloud and AI innovation.
* **Lead with ownership and accountability:** Take end-to-end ownership of customer opportunities, proactively navigating technical, commercial, and organizational complexities. Demonstrate leadership in removing execution barriers, driving decisions, and ensuring timely delivery of customer commitments.
* **Orchestrate the Microsoft virtual team (v-team):** Lead cross-functional collaboration across Account Teams, Customer Success, Engineering, Global Partner Solutions, and other stakeholders. Mobilize the right expertise, establish clear accountability, and drive coordinated execution to deliver customer outcomes.
* **Build trusted, long-term customer partnerships:** Align Azure and AI transformation strategies with customer priorities, including security, scalability, reliability, performance, and cost optimization. Strengthen executive relationships while driving adoption, expansion, and sustained customer success.

### **2. Sales & Pipeline Management**

* **Own predictable business outcomes:** Drive accountability for Azure revenue, consumption growth, pipeline creation, and sales commitments. Maintain a rigorous operating rhythm focused on forecast accuracy, opportunity progression, and consistent delivery against business targets.
* **Build and accelerate a healthy pipeline:** Demonstrate a strong hunter mindset by continuously identifying whitespace, creating qualified opportunities, expanding workload penetration, and converting customer engagements into measurable business growth.
* **Drive proactive risk management and churn prevention:** Establish early visibility into consumption risks, competitive threats, customer dissatisfaction, workload migration risks, and potential revenue erosion. Proactively mobilize stakeholders and execute mitigation plans to protect and grow the Azure business.
* **Maintain disciplined forecasting and pipeline hygiene:** Ensure accurate opportunity qualification, realistic close dates, consumption projections, and timely CRM updates. Surface risks, dependencies, and forecast deviations early, with clear mitigation actions and ownership.
* **Accelerate deal execution and consumption realization:** Lead complex, high-value opportunities through technical validation, commercial alignment, deal closure, deployment, and consumption ramp-up. Partner effectively with the broader v-team to minimize friction and accelerate time to value.
* **Leverage data and AI-driven insights:** Utilize customer consumption trends, market intelligence, sales analytics, and AI-powered tools to identify growth opportunities, improve forecast predictability, anticipate risks, and strengthen sales execution.

### **3. Sales Strategy, Competitive Leadership & Market Development**

* **Drive a differentiated Azure and AI growth strategy:** Develop and execute account-specific strategies that position Microsoft Azure as a preferred platform for Digital Native innovation, spanning AI applications, agentic AI, data platforms, cloud-native architectures, infrastructure, and modernization.
* **Demonstrate strong competitive intelligence:** Maintain a deep understanding of competing cloud and AI platforms, emerging technologies, market dynamics, and competitive positioning. Confidently articulate Microsoft's differentiation across technology, performance, economics, security, and ecosystem capabilities.
* **Lead with a challenger perspective:** Bring informed points of view into customer discussions, constructively challenge existing architectures and technology choices, and influence strategic decisions through technical insights, commercial understanding, and compelling business value.
* **Continuously develop technical and market expertise:** Demonstrate intellectual curiosity and a strong learning mindset. Stay current with rapid advancements in AI models, cloud infrastructure, developer platforms, architecture patterns, and competitive offerings to remain relevant to highly technical customers.
* **Translate market insights into actionable growth opportunities:** Proactively identify emerging workloads, whitespace, industry trends, and customer investment priorities. Build targeted sales plays that accelerate Azure adoption, expand market share, and create new consumption opportunities.
* **Lead cross-organizational execution:** Influence and align account teams, technical specialists, engineering, customer success, and partner organizations around shared business priorities. Demonstrate leadership beyond direct reporting lines to accelerate execution and deliver results.
* **Champion a culture of urgency, accountability, and continuous improvement:** Bring an entrepreneurial mindset, bias for action, resilience, and strong execution discipline. Continuously challenge the status quo, simplify complexity, and raise the bar for customer engagement and business performance.

  
**Qualifications**  

#### **Required Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Business, or a related field, with relevant experience in enterprise technology sales, cloud solutions, solution consulting, or business development. Equivalent practical experience will also be considered.
* Proven experience driving complex, high-value technology sales opportunities, with demonstrated success in customer acquisition, strategic account development, pipeline creation, and revenue or consumption growth.
* **Broad understanding of cloud and AI technologies**, with the ability to lead strategic customer conversations across cloud infrastructure, application modernization, cloud-native architectures, developer platforms, artificial intelligence, data and analytics, databases, and security.
* Ability to connect multiple technology domains into cohesive customer transformation strategies, identify cross-solution opportunities, and lead differentiated sales plays aligned with customer business priorities, technology roadmaps, and long-term growth objectives.
* Strong technical acumen and architectural understanding, with the confidence to engage technically sophisticated founders, CTOs, CIOs, architects, and engineering leaders. Ability to translate complex technical concepts into compelling business value and influence strategic technology decisions.
* Demonstrated **hunter and challenger mindset**, with the ability to proactively create demand, uncover whitespace, challenge established approaches, compete for strategic workloads, and convert emerging customer needs into qualified business opportunities.
* Strong understanding of the competitive cloud and AI landscape, including hyperscale cloud platforms, emerging AI ecosystems, developer technologies, and evolving customer architecture preferences. Ability to articulate differentiated value propositions across technical capabilities, commercial considerations, and business outcomes.
* Proven ability to operate in **high-velocity, competitive, and ambiguous environments**, demonstrating agility, urgency, resilience, and a strong bias for action. Comfortable managing multiple priorities while ensuring rapid turnaround and meaningful outcomes from customer engagements.
* Strong business ownership and commercial acumen, including opportunity qualification, deal strategy, pipeline management, consumption forecasting, competitive positioning, and proactive identification of business risks and customer churn signals.
* Demonstrated ability to lead and influence cross-functional virtual teams, orchestrating technical, engineering, customer success, partner, and commercial resources to accelerate opportunity execution and customer value realization.
* Customer-first approach, with a strong commitment to spending meaningful time engaging customers, understanding their technology and business challenges, and building trusted relationships through consistent execution and measurable outcomes.
* Strong analytical and strategic thinking capabilities, with the ability to leverage customer consumption insights, market intelligence, competitive trends, and AI-powered sales tools to identify growth opportunities, improve forecast predictability, and drive informed business decisions.
* **Strong learning agility and intellectual curiosity**, with a commitment to continuously developing technical depth, broadening solution-area expertise, and staying ahead of rapidly evolving cloud, AI, and competitive technologies.
* Excellent communication, executive presence, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence both technical and business decision-makers and lead outcome-oriented discussions.

#### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Preferred experience working with Digital Native businesses, SaaS companies, technology startups, ISVs, or high-growth technology organizations.
* Experience engaging directly with technical founders, CTOs, engineering leadership, and product teams in fast-paced, innovation-led environments.
* Demonstrated success in driving multi-workload cloud adoption, including infrastructure modernization, cloud-native application development, AI transformation, data platform modernization, and security-led customer engagements.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Azure, Azure AI Foundry, cloud infrastructure, modern application and database platforms, Microsoft Fabric, GitHub, and cloud security technologies, or equivalent competitive platforms.
* Experience developing competitive displacement strategies, winning strategic workloads, expanding cloud consumption, and protecting existing business through proactive customer engagement.
* Relevant cloud, AI, architecture, or security certifications, along with demonstrated commitment to continuous technical and professional development.

  
  

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. title: Principal Design Engineer, Design Systems
description:
**Who are we?**

Whatfix is an AI platform advancing the “userization” of enterprise applications, empowering companies to maximize the ROI of their digital investments. Technology needs adoption. It’s no different for AI. As AI reshapes roles, workflows, and human-machine interactions, it also introduces new layers of complexity and user friction. This is where Whatfix plays a pivotal role. A decade old DNA of empowering people to succeed with technology and not replacing them. We call this philosophy Userization: the belief that technology must adapt to the user, not the other way around.

At the heart of userization philosophy is ScreenSense, our proprietary AI engine, which continuously interprets both the context of what users are doing in an application or an AI tool and the intent behind their actions. By combining these signals, Whatfix delivers real-time guidance, nudges, knowledge, and automation directly in the flow of work.

**This intelligence powers our entire product suite.**

* Digital Adoption helps users get productive faster.
* Product Analytics uncovers friction and closes adoption gaps.
* Mirror allows employees to train in safe, simulated environments.

**These are ur embedded with Whatfix AI Agents which supercharge creation, insights, and user guidance.**

**Our upcoming AI-first products are already creating a buzz in the market.**

* Seek is an AI-native assistant that not only knows your business context but can also act across applications to get work done on your behalf.
* Whatfix Mirror 2.0 is the world’s only System plus Role simulation with a complete assessment to lead the Gen AI simulation category
* Together, these products reflect Whatfix’s commitment to building enterprise-ready AI teammates that maximize productivity and ROI. It gives users a unified, intelligent way to find answers across systems, apps, and knowledge silos and helps anyone looking to deliver fast and contextual answers.
* Whatfix is bridging the gap between rapid technological change and human enablement—ensuring AI is not only embedded but also usable, trusted, and outcome-driven for every employee.
* At Whatfix, we’re not just making software easier—we’re making AI work for people.
* The company has seven offices across the US, India, UK, Germany, Singapore, and Australia and a presence across 40+ countries.
* Customers: 700+ enterprise customers, including 80+ Fortune 500 companies such as Shell, Schneider Electric, and UPS Supply Chain Solutions.
* Investors: A total of ~$270 million USD has been raised as yet. Most recently Series E round of $125 Million USD led by Warburg Pincus, with participation from existing investor SoftBank Vision Fund 2. Other investors include Cisco Investments, Eight Roads Ventures (A division of Fidelity Investments), Dragoneer, Peak XV Partners, and Stellaris Venture Partners.

**Whatfix’s leadership is consistently recognized across top industry analysts and business rankings:**

* Won the 2025 AI Breakthrough Award for the Overall AI-based Analytics Solution of the Year
* Only DAP to be recognized as a “Leader” across various DAP reports for the past 5+ years by leading analyst firms like Gartner, Forrester, IDC, and Everest Group.
* With over 45% YoY sustainable annual recurring revenue (ARR) growth, Whatfix is among the “Top 50 Indian Software Companies” as per G2 Best Software Awards.
* Named a Gartner Customers’ Choice for DAP for the second year in a row (2024 and 2025)—the only vendor in the market to earn this distinction consecutively.
* We also boast a star rating of 4.6 on G2 Crowd, 4.5 on Gartner Peer Insights, and a super-high CSAT of 99.8%
* Stevie Award winner in the category (Bronze): Customer Service Department of the Year – Computer Software - 100 or More Employees.
* Winner of the ISG Paragon Innovation Award in partnership with Sophos (customer) for the EMEA region and finalist in the Transformation Award category.
* RemoteTech Breakthrough Awards winner for “Software Asset Management Solution of the Year”
  

**These recognitions are matched by business performance:**

* Highest-Ranking DAP on 2023 Deloitte Technology Fast 500™ North America for Fifth Consecutive Year
* Listed on the Financial Times & Statista's High-Growth Companies Asia-Pacific 2025 list.
* Won the Silver for Stevie's Employer of the Year 2023 – Computer Software category and also recognized as Great Place to Work 2022-2023
* Only DAP to be among the top 35% companies worldwide in sustainability excellence with EcoVadis Bronze Medal

**Be one of the key Leaders in this awesome journey of building a billion-dollar company!**

**About the role**
------------------

You'll own the architecture of the Whatfix design system and lead it through its next stage. The system serves our 16 product designers, the entire engineering organization, and the AI agents that increasingly build alongside them.

You're inheriting a rebuild that is well underway. The system's foundations and design language are in place, and its decisions are written down. You'll lead what it grows into: a component library that expands to cover patterns for AI-powered and agent-driven experiences, and the move of a live product portfolio onto the system, incrementally and without forced breaking changes. You know the difference between the right long-term architecture and what can ship today.

**You are a design engineer:** you have worked professionally as both a designer and a front-end engineer, and design systems are the core of your practice. You work directly in the system's code and direct coding agents under written rules.

**You report to the Head of Product Research & Design and have full ownership of the system's architecture.** You are the approver for how tokens and components look and what they mean. You partner with Platform engineering on packages, releases, and adoption.

This is a build role. It isn't a fit for a designer who specifies a system for engineers to build, or an engineer who implements designs without owning the design decisions.

**What you'll own**
-------------------

**Architecture and shipping**

* Own the token architecture: DTCG tokens in primitive, semantic, and component tiers, with modes for theme and density, kept forward-compatible with AI and agentic tooling.
* Own naming conventions, component taxonomy, and documentation standards. Keep the decisions that hold. Change the ones that don't through the system's decision process, and write down why.
* Design the migration path as carefully as the destination: versioning strategy, deprecation patterns, and incremental adoption that doesn't require product teams to stop and refactor.
* Architect shared capabilities once, in the system: internationalization, accessibility, content density, theming, and directionality.
* With Platform, own how the system ships: the build and its checks, CI, versioned packages, and releases. Review contributions from product teams.

**Components**

* Build the React components directly in the system codebase, on accessible headless primitives. Own their APIs, composition, and slots.
* Own the libraries distribution: variable-driven, 1:1 with code, and kept in sync by system tooling rather than by hand.
* Establish each component's contract: usage guidelines, do's and don'ts, required and optional attributes, edge cases, and full state coverage. Keep Storybook as the living, testable reference.
* Build accessibility into every component (keyboard, focus, screen reader, contrast) and test it with assistive technology, not only automated checks.

**Agent layer and AI patterns**

* Own the agent layer: the machine-readable rules, token and icon references, and lookup tools that let agents use the system correctly in product code and designers' prototypes.
* Build with coding agents such as Claude Code every day. Write and maintain the rules, skills, and checks that keep their output correct, review what they produce before it merges, and help designers and engineers work the same way.
* Design AI-native patterns into the component architecture: disclosure, generative content containers, confidence indicators, and agent interaction models. Treat them as Whatfix-specific design problems, not patterns borrowed from other systems.

**Adoption and measurement**

* Define success metrics beyond component coverage: adoption rates, usage patterns, and the gap between what's in the system and what ships.
* Drive adoption across designers and engineering through documentation, enablement, and direct partnership. Make the system easy to use correctly and hard to misuse.
* Represent the system to product, engineering, and executive leadership, and mentor the senior designers and engineers who contribute.

**What you bring**
------------------

* 12-14 years across product design and front-end engineering, with 5+ in design systems as the core of your practice, not a side responsibility.
* 3+ years writing production React and TypeScript (or equivalent) that other teams depend on, and a design portfolio that shows the judgment to set standards for other designers. It shows how you document what components are for and when not to use them, and how you design dense enterprise interfaces without losing usability.
* You've owned a multi-team design system end to end: tokens (global, semantic, and component tiers, multi-mode theming), build, versioned releases, and adoption. You've built or significantly rebuilt one from a broken or incomplete state and moved a live product portfolio onto it. You're fluent in the engineering around it: monorepo tooling, Node and npm, CI, git workflows, package publishing, and lint rules.
* Design-tool components (Figma today) built with variants, variables, modes, and properties that stay 1:1 with code, and experience keeping design tooling in sync with code through automation.
* Daily, hands-on use of AI coding agents (such as Claude Code or Codex) on production code, including writing the rules and context that guide them. You can show something you built this way and how you checked it.
* Deep accessibility knowledge: WCAG, ARIA patterns, and testing components with keyboards and screen readers.
* A record of leading across teams you don't manage: setting direction with engineering and product leaders, winning adoption, and mentoring senior designers and engineers.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Experience implementing internationalization at the system level.
* Familiarity with observability or analytics tooling applied to design system adoption.
* Work at the frontier of AI-native UX: disclosure patterns, agent interfaces, and generative content states.
* Color science in design systems, such as perceptual color spaces (OKLCH) and contrast models.

**How you'll work**
-------------------

* You respect what's decided. You learn why a decision was made before changing it, and when you change one, you write down why.
* You build with agents and verify. Agent output gets the same scrutiny as any contributor's: checked by the build, reviewed, and owned by you.
* You lead without managing. You set direction, explain your decisions in writing, and bring engineering, product, and design leaders along.

title: Staff Engineer, SRAM Circuit Design
description:
**About Marvell**

Marvell’s semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities.

At Marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. For those looking to make their mark on purposeful and enduring innovation, above and beyond fleeting trends, Marvell is a place to thrive, learn, and lead.

**Your Team, Your Impact**

As a Digital IC Design Staff Engineer with Marvell, you’ll be a member of the Central Engineering business group. If you picture Marvell as a wheel, Central Engineering is the center hub providing IP to be used by all the other spokes on that wheel, including Automotive, Storage, Security, and Networking. You’ll be part of a SRAM team making a big impact on this organization, working on ultra-dense and performance Static Random Access Memory (SRAM) memory compilers.  
This team hires some of the biggest problem solvers in Silicon and has a huge impact on the work done at Marvell. The customers served by this team are often other chip companies and big tech companies, familiar names to all candidates.  
The role requires you to be a technically strong Memory circuit designer well versed in all aspects of memory design of SRAM/RF/ROM/TCAM Memory compilers. The candidate is expected to have hands-on experience in many activities of memory design

**What You Can Expect**

* Architect & Design: Develop high-performance, low-power memory IP (SRAM, Register Files) and compiler architectures. Expect the individual to be innovative and develop new circuit ideas and architectures. Expect the individual to have led the development of all kinds of memory compilers such as 1R1W, SRAM, 2R2W, ROM, etc. Expect the individual to be well versed in all aspects of memory compiler design such as circuit design of all sub-blocks of memories, critical path, block-wise design validation of all blocks (sense, bitcell, rowdec, level shifter, etc.), memory-level design validation such as self-time analysis, Monte Carlo analysis, race check analysis, etc. Expect the individual to also be aware of characterization methodology and process. Expect the individual to be well aware of all deliverables of memory compilers. Your role involves conducting in-depth circuit analysis for compact sub-circuit blocks within our overall design, considering process, voltage, and temperature (PVT) factors. Using your experience with transistor-level circuit design software like Cadence Virtuoso or Spectre X for design analysis, you will be mentoring others to optimize performance within specified area and power constraints, utilizing engineering judgment to balance trade-offs and refine designs.
* PPA Optimization: Drive design methodologies for power, performance, and area targets. Push the designs to achieve the maximum PPA targets.
* Design Validation : The engineer will be responsible for all types of design validation: margin, full instance, ESPCV, SA, bit cell, self-time analysis, Monte Carlo analysis.
* Characterization: The engineer will also be involved in characterization of memory compilers and will be responsible for generating views after characterization and for validating the characterized timings.
* Leading Edge Process-Design Co-optimization for Robust Design: Expect the individual to have worked on leading-edge nodes like 2nm, 3nm, etc and on GAE, FinFET, and planar. Expect the individual to understand all the process complexities and build robust compilers.
* Automation: Enhance compiler flows, generators, and design libraries using scripting (Python, Tcl).
* Collaboration: Work across teams.
* Proficiency in a Linux environment is essential for seamless execution.

**What We're Looking For**

To be successful in this role, the candidate must:

* Have a Bachelor's or Master's in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, VLSI Design, or a similar field.
* Have a minimum of 3 years of experience in SRAM/RF memory circuit design & validation.
* Have experience in deep sub-micron nodes (7nm/5nm/3nm/2nm/A14, etc.), compiler IP development, foundry PDKs, memory design, validation & characterization.
* Be able to independently design, analyze, and optimize small sub-circuit blocks within our overall design across process, voltage, and temperature (PVT).
* Identify and propose innovative solutions to enhance the design of at least one major sub-circuit block.
* Participate in root cause investigation and silicon validation of model-to-hardware correlation issues.
* Have experience with tools such as Cadence Virtuoso, Synopsys tools (Design Compiler, PrimeTime), HSPICE, Spectre, Solido, Tiler, Netlister, etc.

This role is eligible to participate in Marvell's bonus and equity plans, including a new hire equity grant and annual equity refreshers, ensuring you are rewarded for your contributions and remain invested in the company's long-term success.

**Additional Compensation and Benefit Elements**

With competitive compensation and great benefits, you will enjoy our workstyle within an environment of shared collaboration, transparency, and inclusivity. We’re dedicated to giving our people the tools and resources they need to succeed in doing work that matters, and to grow and develop with us. For additional information on what it’s like to work at Marvell, visit our Careers page.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status.

**Interview Integrity**

To support fair and authentic hiring practices, candidates are not permitted to use AI tools (such as transcription apps, real-time answer generators like ChatGPT or Copilot, or automated note-taking bots) during interviews.

These tools must not be used to record, assist with, or enhance responses in any way. Our interviews are designed to evaluate your individual experience, thought process, and communication skills in real time. Use of AI tools without prior instruction from the interviewer will result in disqualification from the hiring process.

**This position may require access to technology and/or software subject to U.S. export control laws and regulations, including the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). As such, applicants must be eligible to access export-controlled information as defined under applicable law. Marvell may be required to obtain export licensing approval from the U.S. Department of Commerce and/or the U.S. Department of State. Except for U.S. citizens, lawful permanent residents, or protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), all applicants may be subject to an export license review process prior to employment.**

title: Junior Product Assurance Engineer
description:
ReOrbit is looking for a Junior Product Assurance (PA) Engineer to join our growing PA & Quality team at our headquarters in Helsinki, Finland. Working alongside a senior PA engineer, you will help make sure our satellites are designed, built and tested right the first time, from early design reviews all the way to flight acceptance.

As our Junior Product Assurance (PA) Engineer, You will learn how PA works across a full satellite programme, while taking real ownership of documentation, nonconformances and supplier follow-up from day one.

It's an exciting chance to join a dynamic start-up, with the opportunity to make a real impact, to reach our goal of pushing the boundaries of space data transfer.

**Responsibilities**

* Support the senior PA engineer in maintaining the project PA Plan and verifying that deliverables (design, procurement, manufacturing/AIT, test and acceptance) conform to PA requirements.
* Take part in internal and external design reviews, making sure subsystems and equipment integrate cleanly into the satellite system.
* Document and track nonconformances, deviations and waivers, and follow corrective actions through to closure, including supplier defects.
* Support engineering change control (Class I / Class II) and make sure the right approvals are in place.
* Request and review supplier PA/QC documentation, with a focus on COTS-heavy subsystems.
* Participation and support Electrical, Electronic and Electromechanical (EEE) parts management activities.
* Perform preliminary radiation analysis at parts, sub-system, or system level using a tool like SPENVIS, FASTRAD, OMERE.
* Help keep PA evidence consistent across engineering and flight models and EGSE, and contribute to reliability, availability and radiation-mitigation tracking.

**Skills and Requirements**

To be considered for this role, you must have:

* A Bachelor's or Master's degree in aerospace, electrical, electronics or physics or systems engineering, or a closely related field.
* A working knowledge of product assurance: the difference between PA (proactive, process-driven) and QC (inspection and verification), and how nonconformances, deviations, waivers and RCA/CAPA work.
* Awareness of the ECSS-Q (Product Assurance) standards and their philosophy.
* Comfort working with controlled documentation such as plans, compliance matrices, review minutes, NCRs and deviation requests.
* Solid knowledge of electronics, electronic devices, the space environment, and radiation effects on electronics.
* Proficiency in Python, C++, or both.
* Fluent written and spoken English, including clear technical writing.

We are also looking for someone who is comfortable asking "what is the risk?", constructively challenging engineering decisions, and working across systems, hardware, software, AIT and suppliers.

**Nice to have**

* Exposure to satellite technology through an internship, thesis or student satellite project (CubeSat, nanosat, payloads).
* Awareness of IPC/ECSS standard of PCB design and inspection concepts, qualification, and PA process.
* Introductory knowledge of risk management and single-point-failure identification.

**What does ReOrbit do?**

ReOrbit builds the foundation for the next generation of space applications by transforming satellites into truly intelligent, interconnected platforms, defined by software. Our satellite design philosophy revolves around the idea that satellites must network, communicate with each other and thus improve mission efficiency. How can this be achieved? Thanks to a flexible software-first architecture, where all these aspects are dealt with upfront in the mission concept, as integrated functionalities.

ReOrbit’s top-notch team of software engineers and system architects develop in-house software, procure hardware from the best-in-class suppliers, and seamlessly integrate the components to create flexible and secure satellites. Today, we are a rapidly growing company building a very strong multidisciplinary team to support our activities. We are headquartered in Helsinki, Finland with a subsidiary in Bariloche, Argentina.

**Working at ReOrbit**

At ReOrbit, we are focused on building a strong team as we believe nothing can be accomplished without innovative, humble and curious minds working together on a common goal. We’re all about fostering an inclusive, dynamic environment where equality and diversity are our strength.

We offer

* A challenging but rewarding environment where your ideas will be heard.
* Mentoring from experienced PA engineers and a supportive team bringing expertise from both classic and new space.
* Benefits such as lunch vouchers, events, occupational health care and additional health insurance.
* Plenty of time together: runOrbit, climbOrbit, ping pong and board games.
* Support with relocation and integration into Finnish society.

Please, submit your application as soon as possible - we are excited to hear from you and can’t wait to discover your unique skills and experiences.

*For agencies: We do not accept unsolicited CVs for our open vacancies. Any CV sent to our team unsolicited will reserve us the right to pursue a candidate without obligation to the sender. All candidate submissions must be conducted through our official channels and in accordance with our terms of engagement.*

By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to work on cutting-edge projects and contribute to the development of innovative solutions for our customers – including new wireless and 5G technologies – not yet adopted by most companies.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

Broad cross-functional exposure across AI/ML and cloud consulting, combined with deep technical specialization in core software delivery practices.

title: ServiceNow ITOM Architect
description:
**The Company**

PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

**Job Summary:**

The ServiceNow ITOM Architect owns the architecture of PayPal’s ServiceNow IT Operations Management platform, with a focus on AIOps. The role designs how the platform discovers the estate, correlates events, and acts on them, moving IT from detecting problems to resolving them automatically, with human supervision and audit built in.
  
  
This individual contributor sets ITOM and AIOps standards, owns third-level escalation, and directs the contingent-worker and vendor engineers who build. Scope spans Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management, and orchestration, plus the AIOps layer: alert correlation, AI agents, and observability integrations, on a CSDM-aligned CMDB.
  
  
The role leads work from proof of concept to production, sets approaches other teams adopt, and judges trade-offs such as alert noise and when automation is safe. It defines the guardrails for autonomous action: what agents may do alone, what needs approval, and how every action is logged, reversible, and audit-ready.

**Job Description:**

**Essential Responsibilities:**

* Acts as a project or system leader, coordinating the activities of other engineers on the project or within the system
* Determines the technical tasks that other engineers will follow
* Actions result in the achievement of customer, operational, program or service objectives
* Proactively improves existing structures & processes
* Exercises judgement in reconciling diverse and competing priorities (time, quality, complexity risk) to identify optimal solutions to problems
* Notices patterns and condenses repetition into densely meaningful generalized solutions
* Collaborates with management to set/improve standards for engineering rigor
* Trusted to represent PayPal, Inc to the outside world via interactions with partners, customers, or industry organizations
  

  

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* 5+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

**Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications****:**

**Your way to impact**
----------------------

You will move PayPal's IT operations from detect-and-ticket to detect-and-fix. The architecture you set will determine how quickly issues are found, how much alert noise reaches people, and how many problems resolve without human touch, measured in mean time to detect (MTTD), mean time to resolve (MTTR), and touchless resolution.

You will also define the guardrails that let AI agents act safely in production, so that automation meets PayPal's change-management, security, and audit standards, and you will set the approaches that other engineers and teams adopt.

  
  

**Your day to day**

In your day to day role you will:

* **AIOps target architecture —** Define the target-state AIOps architecture on ServiceNow: event sources and ingest, normalization, deduplication, correlation, and the hand-off from alert to incident, change, and automated remediation.

* **Event Management from proof of concept to production —** Take ServiceNow Event Management from proof of concept to production, including connector design for observability platforms (e.g., Datadog), event rules, alert thresholds, and operational runbooks.

* **Alert correlation & noise reduction —** Design rules-based and machine-learning correlation and grouping that reduce alert noise and surface probable cause, and measure their accuracy over time.

* **AI agents for triage & remediation —** Design AI agents and automated workflows that triage, enrich, and resolve alerts, defining when an agent acts on its own, when it asks a human, and how it escalates.

* **Supervision, audit & safe automation —** Build in human-in-the-loop controls, action logging, rollback, and change-management integration so that every automated action is traceable and meets security and audit requirements.

* **CMDB & CSDM service context —** Partner with the existing ITOM architect and engineers so that configuration items (CIs), relationships, and business-service maps give AIOps the context it needs, and contribute to the CSDM-aligned CMDB re-build design.

* **Integration architecture —** Design integrations between ServiceNow and monitoring, logging, cloud, and collaboration tools using IntegrationHub, REST, and streaming patterns, with the performance and resilience that enterprise scale requires.

* **Engineering standards & technical direction —** Set design patterns, coding standards, and definitions of done for AIOps work, and review the designs and code produced by contingent-worker and vendor engineers.

* **Third-level (L3) technical ownership —** Own L3 escalation for AIOps capabilities, and lead root-cause analysis when automation or correlation behaves unexpectedly.

* **Operational outcome measurement —** Define and report outcomes such as alert-to-incident ratio, noise reduction, mean time to detect (MTTD), mean time to resolve (MTTR), and the share of alerts resolved without human touch.

* **Technology evaluation —** Evaluate ServiceNow roadmap capabilities and third-party AIOps options, run proofs of concept, and recommend best practices and build-versus-buy decisions to Autonomous Operations leadership.

* **Mentoring & knowledge sharing —** Mentor engineers and administrators on ITOM, event management, and AI-agent design, and document the architecture for business, leadership, and technical audiences.

**What do you need to bring-**

* 5+ years of relevant experience and a Bachelor's degree OR any equivalent combination of education and experience

* Hands-on experience designing and implementing ServiceNow ITOM at enterprise scale, including Event Management, Discovery or Service Mapping

* Experience integrating ServiceNow with observability and monitoring platforms (e.g., Datadog, Splunk, Dynatrace, or cloud-native monitoring)

* Working knowledge of the CMDB and the Common Service Data Model, including CI classes, relationships, identification and reconciliation, and service maps

* Experience designing alert correlation, deduplication, or noise-reduction approaches and measuring their effectiveness

* Experience building automation and AI-assisted workflows on ServiceNow (e.g., Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, Now Assist, or AI Agents) or a comparable platform

* Proficiency in JavaScript (ServiceNow scripting), experience using PowerShell or Bash over Secure Shell (SSH) for orchestration and discovery, plus REST API design

* Experience defining controls for automated actions, such as approval gates, logging, rollback, and change-management integration

* Experience documenting technical architecture for business stakeholders, leadership, and engineers

* Ability to work effectively in a global team and to influence engineers and vendors without formal reporting authority

**Preferred qualifications**

* ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) in Event Management, Discovery, or Service Mapping; ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) in Data Foundations; ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD)

* Experience with dedicated AIOps platforms (e.g., ServiceNow Health Log Analytics, BigPanda, or Moogsoft)

* Experience applying large language models (LLMs) or agentic AI to IT operations, including tool design, evaluation, and guardrails

* Cloud or reliability credentials, such as Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Amazon Web Services (AWS), or Microsoft Azure certifications

* Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) 4 Foundation or higher

title: Customer Experience Engineer II
description:
**Overview**

The Mission Critical Services for Microsoft Security Cloud (MCSfMSC) organization supports Microsoft Security's mission to make the world a safer place. We anticipate and solve customer support needs by amplifying the voice of the customer within engineering and delivering solutions that scale. Every engagement is built on trust, resilience, and long-term customer success, guided by a commitment to diversity, inclusion, and innovation. Here, generative AI solutions such as Microsoft Security Copilot help security and IT professionals respond to cyberthreats faster and process signals at scale. As a Senior Security Customer Experience Engineer, you'll serve as a trusted advisor and engineering advocate for a focused portfolio of Microsoft's largest global enterprise and regulated-industry customers, where a single escalation can reach product engineering leadership within hours. You'll provide proactive guidance, technical advocacy, and crisis leadership to help customers maximize their Microsoft Security investments, strengthen operational excellence, and collaborate seamlessly across Microsoft. This is a deeply technical, customer-focused, and relationship-driven role. Candidates may bring relevant experience from consulting, enterprise architecture, technical account management, cloud architecture, or other customer-facing technical security roles, along with experience managing complex, time-sensitive, and high-visibility situations and driving customer outcomes through engineering-led support. We're not just looking for someone who can do this job well; we're seeking someone who will improve how we do it. In your first year, success looks like customers who escalate less because their environments are healthier, and at least one change you drove that enhanced how the whole team works. This role supports flexible work arrangements consistent with Microsoft policies, customer commitments, and business needs. Team members collaborate across a globally distributed organization and have flexibility in how and where they work while maintaining required customer coverage and on-call commitments.
  
  
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 **Responsibilities**

- Strategic Technical Leadership: Serve as the Customer Lead Engineer (CLE) for assigned strategic customers, acting as the primary engineering advocate and technical lead for the MCSfMSC engagement. Develop a deep understanding of each customer's security architecture, business goals, and operational environment, and represent the engagement with stakeholders up to and including the CISO level. - Technical Escalation Management: Directly engage and swiftly respond to technical escalations from Microsoft's mission-critical security customers as part of a globally distributed engineering team providing follow-the-sun coverage. - Accelerated Incident Resolution: With minimal guidance, lead the coordinated response to high-severity product and service incidents and major escalations, serving as Incident Manager both for your assigned customers and through participation in a rotational incident management function. Drive mitigation, engineering engagement, stakeholder alignment, executive communications, and timely root-cause analysis while maintaining clear accountability boundaries with product engineering and support teams. - Customer Advocacy: Represent the voice of the customer within Microsoft Security Engineering, influencing product roadmaps, engineering priorities, and support strategies through customer insights and escalation trends. - Collaboration: Partner with customers, account teams, product managers, core engineering, and support engineers to understand customer architecture, troubleshoot complex product issues, and align stakeholders across Microsoft on shared customer priorities. - Proactive Engagement: Own and drive customer Service Improvement Plans, health reviews, and outcome-based improvement tracking. Analyze customer telemetry, product-health signals, support trends, and escalation patterns to identify systemic risks and recommend improvements to resilience, security posture, operational readiness, and product supportability. - Continuous Improvement: Identify systemic issues and use insights from customer engagements to improve how MCSfMSC delivers mission-critical services. Develop and scale better practices, tools, technical readiness materials, playbooks, and lessons learned that strengthen product quality, supportability, customer experience, business operations, and future incident response. Mentor peers and share technical expertise to raise engineering capability across the team.

  
  
**Qualifications**

**Required:** - Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Computer or Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. - 4+ years of experience in a customer-facing technical security role, including leadership of high-severity product or service incidents, crisis situations, or complex technical escalations. - Deep working knowledge of at least one Microsoft Security solutions (Purview, Defender, Entra, Intune, or Sentinel) sufficient to advise customers on capabilities, architecture, implementation, and operational considerations. - Ability to diagnose and scope complex technical issues across enterprise security environments, including interpreting logs and telemetry, assessing product behavior, and reasoning across identity, endpoint, network, and cloud architecture to validate customer impact and engage the right engineering teams. - Professional proficiency in written and spoken English sufficient to translate complex technical issues into clear business impacts and communicate effectively with customers, engineers, product teams, and executive stakeholders.

**Other Requirements:**  
  
Other Requirements  
Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings: Microsoft Cloud Background Check:  

* This position will be required to pass the Microsoft background and Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

  

* Ability to participate in a shared, scheduled 24x7x365 on-call rotation, including occasional work outside standard business hours and on weekends.
