title: Memory Subsystem Firmware Engineer
description:
We are now looking for a Senior Firmware Engineer to join our Memory Subsystem Team!

NVIDIA's SoC Memory Subsystem team is looking for a curious, motivated embedded firmware engineer to help take our memory subsystem from architecture and pre-silicon validation through to production silicon! This role will work at the hardware/software boundary on DDR/LPDDR firmware, RAS, memory subsystem power management features in pre silicon and post silicon phases.

**What you'll be doing:**

* Work on cutting-edge hardware/software co-development — pairing embedded software development with ASIC design, from architecture through deployment in silicon.
* Implementing C/C++ embedded firmware for Memory subsystem initialization, Dram Trainings, low power states, RAS, telemetry functions.
* Develop C models for h/w IP blocks for pre-silicon firmware validation.
* Support silicon bring-up and lab validation: board bring-up, log triage, regression runs.
* Profile and refactor existing embedded firmware to improve code coverage and performance KPIs.
Exercising your expertise in software, digital and analog systems, computer architecture, and debugging skills to tackle exciting problems.  

**What we need to see:**

* BS or MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* 3 years of embedded firmware development (internship + new-grad experience can count toward the low end).
* Understanding of core embedded building blocks: CPUs, memory hierarchies, DMA, timers, interrupt controllers, and interconnect buses.
* Hands-on experience designing and implementing bare-metal control firmware that is tightly optimized for both cycle count and memory footprint.
* Proficiency in C/C++, with a solid grasp of data structures, compilers, and build and version-control tooling.
Strong debugging instincts — able to decompose unfamiliar problems from first principles.  

**Ways to stand out from the crowd:**

* Exposure to DDR / LPDDR / HBM memory technologies.
* Experience with an RTOS or bare-metal embedded firmware.
Understanding of SOC Boot architecture.  

NVIDIA is on the move and our technology and vision position us as one of the world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and talented people on our journey. If you're inventive and autonomous, we want to hear from you!

title: Early Professional, Mining Engineering
description:
WSP is seeking an Assistant Engineer - Geotechnical to join the Mining Global Capability Centre in India. This early-career role will support global mining projects across rock engineering and tailings / mine-waste workstreams under the direction of experienced geotechnical, mining and tailings professionals.

The successful candidate will assist with geotechnical data review, development of geological and geotechnical models, stability and seepage analyses, numerical modelling, design documentation and preparation of technical reports. The role requires close collaboration with WSP teams in other countries and a strong commitment to technical quality, safety, learning and timely delivery.

  

* Assist with geotechnical assessments for open-pit mines, underground mines, tailings storage facilities, water-retaining structures and other mine-waste facilities.
* Compile, validate and interpret geological, geotechnical, hydrogeological and laboratory data for use in engineering assessments.
* Support the development of geological and geotechnical models, design domains, material-property datasets and engineering assumptions.
* Undertake supervised analyses such as slope stability, seepage, deformation, stress, ground-support and earth-structure assessments using appropriate analytical and numerical methods.
* Assist in identifying credible geotechnical hazards, failure modes and design risks, and document assumptions, limitations and sensitivity checks.
* Prepare calculations, figures, technical notes, report sections, presentations, drawings and other project deliverables in accordance with agreed templates and quality requirements.
* Work with senior engineers to translate project scope and technical requirements into clear tasks, inputs, analysis steps and deliverables.
* Coordinate with multidisciplinary teams including mining, civil, water, geology, hydrogeology, environmental and CAD / digital-design specialists.
* Complete assigned work in line with project scope, schedule and budget, and communicate progress, constraints and data gaps promptly.
* Participate in technical reviews, address review comments, maintain calculation records and follow document-control and QA/QC procedures.
* Contribute to internal technical guidance, standard workflows, knowledge libraries, training sessions and continuous-improvement initiatives.
* Follow WSP requirements for health and safety, environment, quality, information security, ethical conduct and risk management.

**Technical Exposure**  
**Rock Engineering and Mine Geotechnics**  

* Geotechnical characterisation of rock masses and interpretation of structural-geology information.
* Open-pit slope and underground excavation stability assessments.
* Ground-support assessment, stress analysis and deformation evaluation under supervision.
* Development and checking of numerical models and sensitivity cases for mining applications.

**Tailings and Mine-Waste Geotechnics**  

* Geotechnical inputs for tailings storage facilities, water-storage impoundments, waste-rock facilities and associated earthworks.
* Slope-stability and seepage assessments, material characterisation, filter compatibility and geosynthetic or ground-improvement considerations.
* Preparation of design calculations, risk inputs, technical specifications, drawings, report sections and supporting documentation.
* Exposure to recognised tailings-management frameworks and guidance such as GISTM, ICOLD and CDA, as relevant to the project and under senior direction.

**Software and Digital Skills**  
Candidates are not expected to be proficient in every package at entry level. Experience through academic projects, internships or research is acceptable. The role may use:
  

* FLAC / FLAC3D, PLAXIS 2D / 3D or similar finite-difference / finite-element tools.
* Rocscience applications such as Slide2 / Slide3, RS2 / RS3, Dips, UnWedge or RocFall.
* GeoStudio applications such as SLOPE/W and SEEP/W.
* GIS, CAD, geological-modelling, spreadsheet and data-visualisation tools, depending on project needs.
* Microsoft 365 applications, particularly Excel, Word and PowerPoint; ability to learn collaboration and task-tracking platforms used by global teams.

  

**Required Qualifications and Experience**  

* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Mining Engineering, Geological Engineering or a closely related discipline.
* A Master’s degree in Geotechnical Engineering, Rock Engineering, Geomechanics, Mining Geotechnics or a related field is advantageous.
* Typically 0-2 years of relevant industry, internship or research experience. Strong graduate candidates with relevant academic project work may also be considered.
* Academic or practical exposure to soil mechanics, rock mechanics, engineering geology, foundation engineering, slope stability, groundwater / seepage or numerical methods.
* Good written and spoken English, with the ability to prepare clear calculations, technical notes and presentations.
* Ability to work accurately with data, follow engineering procedures and seek guidance when assumptions or inputs are uncertain.

**Key Competencies and Personal Qualities**  

* Strong analytical thinking, curiosity and a practical approach to engineering problem-solving.
* Attention to detail and a disciplined approach to data, calculations, file management and checking.
* Ability to collaborate respectfully across disciplines, cultures, offices and time zones.
* Willingness to learn new software, methods, standards and project-delivery processes.
* Proactive communication of progress, risks, data gaps and support needs.
* Commitment to safety, technical integrity, sustainability, inclusion and professional development.

**What Success Looks Like**  

* Delivers assigned analyses and documentation safely, accurately and on time with appropriate supervision.
* Produces traceable calculations and models with clearly documented inputs, assumptions, checks and limitations.
* Responds constructively to technical review comments and demonstrates measurable growth in engineering judgement and software capability.
* Builds trusted working relationships with GCC colleagues and WSP’s global project teams.
* Contributes to a collaborative culture through knowledge sharing, continuous learning and reliable project delivery.

title: AI Solutions Engineer
description:
### **Job Type:**

Permanent

### **Experience:**

2–3 Years

### **Location:**

Bangalore

#### **Life at EvoluteIQ:**

We at EvoluteIQ believe in the power of transformation. We are committed to building a industry-leading technology that will revolutionize the way enterprises conduct business.

To make that happen, we need people who are generous, genuine, self-driven and collaborative. People who not only want to be a part of a fast-growing and radical thinking company, but who are kind and care—about each other. We at EvoluteIQ thrive in the company of each other and make each other a better version of ourselves every day.

**Could that be you?**

#### **The EIQ Mission:**

Our culture is who we are, and it defines us. We are nimble, fast, dedicated, humble and bold. We see opportunities everywhere around us to make a **“dent in the universe”.** Our core fabric is Innovation! And this is not just a word, but the way of life within EvoluteIQ.

Changing the way business is done, reimagining the future of work, and enabling people to improve their quality of work every day, is a daunting task. That is what we all strive every day at EvoluteIQ. To enable everyone to automate complicated processes with their instinct and knowledge.

We make building of automation simple for everyone, so that it is not mystery for a few.

**Would you like to be part of this journey?**

We are looking for an **AI Solutions Engineer** who uses AI coding assistants (Claude Code or Cursor) as their main way of working. You will turn business needs into working software, an architecture and documents a client can see, often within days.

One week you might build an enterprise portal component, the next an AI agent or a dashboard, then write the BRD and the deck that explain it. You will be a fast, careful builder who directs AI well, checks its output and ships.

**Function:** Solutions Engineering / Platform & AI Delivery

#### **What you'll do at EvoluteIQ:**

##### **Platform Features & UI**

* Build portal themes and portlets (Java/OSGi, JSP, Maven).
* Build stand-alone web apps with React/Vite, TypeScript and HTML/CSS/JS.
* Deliver dashboards, consoles, forms, data grids and branded light/dark themes.

##### **AI Agents & LLM Solutions**

* Design and build conversational and task agents, such as text-to-SQL agents, document and contract analyzers, and RFP/BRD agents.
* Build multi-agent orchestration (A2A, MCP).
* Design prompts and fix poor agent output.

##### **Backend & Integrations**

* Write services and APIs in Java or Python.
* Connect RESTAPIs, with an understanding of WebSockets.
* Proxy tokens on the server side and design data models.

##### **Decision & Optimization Problems**

* Solve decision and optimization problems, using tools such as OR-Tools, Timefold/OptaPlanner or PuLP.

##### **Solution Work & Documentation**

* Write BRDs, solution approaches and case studies.
* Produce customer-ready PPT and Word documents, often generated with code (python-pptx, python-docx).

##### **AI-Native Way of Working**

* Write reusable AI skills, templates and prompts so repeated work becomes automatic.
* Keep project context (notes, CLAUDE.md-style memory) so work can pick up across sessions.

##### **Quality & Secure Coding**

* Build, deploy and test what you make in a real browser or server. Never hand over unverified output.
* Follow secure-coding defaults: no hardcoded secrets, parameterized queries, input validation.

#### **What will you bring to the team?**

##### **At around two years of experience, we expect:**

* **AI-assisted development:** Daily use of Claude Code or agents on real projects. You can break a problem into steps, review AI-written code critically and catch its mistakes.
* **Web fundamentals:** Strong JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML/CSS (responsive, theming with CSS variables) and React.
* **Backend:** One backend language, Java or Python, with working comfort in the other.
* **LLM application basics:** Prompt writing, function/tool calling, RAG concepts, and an understanding of how agents fail.
* **SQL and data:** Writing and debugging SQL, with an understanding of schemas, joins and aggregations.
* **Build tooling:** Git, npm, Maven and the command line (Windows and Linux).
* **Communication:** Clear written English.
* **Education:** B.E./B.Tech. in CS/IT or equivalent. A strong portfolio or implemented project counts for more than the degree.

##### **How You Work**

* **Takes ownership:** Turns an unclear brief into a delivered result without step-by-step direction.
* **Fast but careful:** Ships prototypes quickly and still checks them before calling them done.
* **Thinks in systems:** Sees when a one-off task should become a reusable template or skill.
* **Comfortable switching context:** Moves between UI, backend, AI and documentation in the same week.
* **Has an eye for presentation:** Cares that client-facing output looks polished and on-brand.
* **Handles data responsibly:** Treats client data and IP as confidential.

#### **Good To Have:**

* Liferay DXP/Portal 7.x, or any enterprise portal or low-code platform.
* Google ADK, Vertex AI / Gemini, A2A protocol, MCP servers, LangGraph or a similar agent framework.
* NestJS, Prisma or TypeORM, and PostgreSQL.
* Optimization tools (OR-Tools, Timefold/OptaPlanner, PuLP).
* Data visualization (ECharts, Recharts, D3).
* Generating documents and slides with Python (python-pptx, python-docx, openpyxl).
* Domain exposure: finance/MIS reporting, HR tech, contact centres, maritime/logistics, LMS.
* Cloud basics (GCP preferred) and Docker.

#### **How Success Will Be Measured:**

* Business needs are turned into working software, architecture and client-ready documents, often within days.
* Everything handed over has been built, deployed and tested in a real browser or server, with no unverified output.
* AI agents and LLM solutions behave reliably, and poor agent output is caught and fixed.
* Repeated work becomes reusable AI skills, templates and prompts.
* Client-facing output is polished and on-brand, code follows secure-coding defaults, and client data and IP stay confidential.

description:

**Job Summary**
---------------

Lead the definition and enforcement of AI design standards, architecture patterns, and governance frameworks to ensure all AI solutions are scalable, consistent, compliant, and high-quality.
  
This role acts as a bridge between innovation and control, enabling teams to build rapidly while ensuring adherence to risk, compliance, and responsible AI principles.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Strategy**  
• Define and lead a comprehensive AI Governance & Evaluation strategy aligned with the Group’s AI North Star and business priorities, translating strategic goals into clear deliverables and ensuring AI solutions are safe, scalable, auditable, and aligned to enterprise standards.
  
• Embed governance into the AI CoE’s operating model, integrating oversight and checkpoints into AI product lifecycles and fostering cross-functional alignment (tech, data, risk, compliance) to ensure “responsible-by-design” AI development without slowing value delivery.
  
• Establish and maintain AI design standards and reference architectures (e.g., for Retrieval-Augmented Generation, AI copilot solutions, agentic workflows) across L1/L2/L3 use case tiers, driving consistency, efficiency, and scalability in AI solution development.
  
• Champion Responsible AI principles by embedding ethical guidelines (fairness, transparency, privacy) and design-for-quality & explainability practices into AI solutions from inception, and by influencing stakeholders to prioritize responsible AI throughout all initiatives.

**Business**  
• Bridge business innovation and risk control by advising business, product, and technology teams on how to build AI solutions responsibly – providing guidance on model choices, prompt design, and control requirements – to enable rapid innovation without compromising risk or compliance.
  
• Align AI initiatives with business value by focusing governance on high-impact opportunities (productivity, efficiency, customer experience) and ensuring AI use cases deliver measurable business outcomes while reducing risk.
  
• Demonstrate ROI and defensibility by linking governance efforts to tangible results (e.g., risk reduction, efficiency gains) and delivering transparent reporting and evidence to stakeholders (business and regulators) to highlight the value and safety of AI initiatives.

**Processes**  
• Establish a structured AI governance process across the development lifecycle, implementing risk-tiered checkpoints and approval tollgates from ideation to retirement, so that no AI use case proceeds without meeting required standards, validations, documentation and sign-offs.
  
• Standardize AI evaluation and monitoring practices by defining consistent methodologies for testing AI outputs (e.g., functional accuracy, prompt robustness, hallucination checks) and protocols for ongoing monitoring (e.g., drift detection, performance metrics) to ensure early issue detection and reliable oversight.
  
• Drive continuous improvement by updating governance standards, design templates, and control frameworks based on monitoring insights, emerging AI patterns and regulatory changes, and by leveraging automation to simplify compliance tasks and evidence capture.

**People & Talent**  
• Provide AI governance expertise and leadership. Act as the go-to expert on AI governance and evaluation, guiding and influencing teams (and senior stakeholders) to embed accountability, transparency, and disciplined innovation into AI development.
  
• Build organizational capability in AI governance through targeted training, playbooks, workshops, and knowledge-sharing forums, developing practical skills across teams for responsible AI design, risk management, and rigorous evaluation.
  
• Collaborate and engage stakeholders. Work closely with Risk, Compliance, Legal, Data and business stakeholders to shape governance standards and ensure their adoption, and represent the AI CoE in relevant audits, regulatory engagements and governance forums to uphold trust and alignment.

**Risk Management**  
• Identify, classify and mitigate AI risks. Proactively assess key AI-related risks (e.g., bias, privacy, security breaches, model drift) and enforce robust controls, including a risk-tier classification (L1/L2/L3), so that each AI solution remains within the Bank’s risk appetite and aligned with the Risk Management Framework.

* Review and challenge AI use cases at design and pre-deployment stages, ensuring all material risks are mitigated or explicitly accepted with appropriate guardrails (e.g., human oversight, usage constraints) and escalating issues as needed before approval.

• Ensure regulatory compliance & audit readiness. Integrate evolving AI regulations and responsible AI guidelines into governance processes and maintain comprehensive documentation (e.g., model inventory, approvals, performance logs) to demonstrate compliance and support internal audits and regulatory reviews.

**Governance**  
• Own and enforce AI governance policies and standards. Develop, maintain, and enforce the AI governance framework (policies, standards, templates, checklists) covering AI model development, testing, deployment, documentation, and monitoring, with clear accountability assigned for compliance at each stage.
  
• Oversight reporting & communication. Provide regular status updates to senior management and risk committees on AI governance – including compliance metrics, key issues, incidents, and remediation actions – to ensure transparency and informed oversight.
  
• SMCR and accountability. Meet Senior Manager & Certification Regime (SMCR) obligations by exercising robust oversight, due diligence and accountability, acting as the first line of defense for AI governance and a key partner to second-line functions to ensure no gaps in control.

**Key Deliverables**  
• AI Governance & Evaluation Framework
  
• AI Lifecycle Governance Standards
  
• Risk-Tier Classification Model
  
• Reusable AI Architecture Patterns & Design Standards
  
• AI Evaluation & Testing Framework
  
• Design Review & Approval Mechanism
  
• AI Governance Artefact Library
  
• AI Inventory / Use Case Register
  
• Monitoring, Evidence & Continuous Improvement Loop
  
• Governance Reporting & Stakeholder Enablement

**Skills and Experience**
-------------------------

**Strong understanding of:**  
• LLMs, RAG, agentic workflows
  
• AI system design & architecture
  
**Experience in:**  
• AI/ML solution delivery
  
• Risk, compliance, or governance frameworks
  
**Ability to balance:**  
• Innovation vs control
  
**Exposure to:**  
• Responsible AI frameworks
  
• Cloud AI platforms (Azure/OpenAI,
  
• etc.)
  
**Experience in:**  
• Defining enterprise standards
  
• Cross-functional leadership

The Director will be accountable for ensuring that Advantage has the right capability, in the right roles, at the right level of maturity, when the business needs it. The role will establish common capability standards, strengthen domain and functional depth, build leadership and specialist pipelines, reduce critical-person dependencies and enable scarce expertise to be leveraged effectively across products.  
This is not a traditional learning or training role. It is a senior Product Engineering leadership position working closely with Product Engineering Directors, Product Leaders and functional leaders to ensure that the organization has the capability required to deliver product outcomes today while building the skills required for the future.

**Your future duties and responsibilities**

Key Responsibilities  
Capability Strategy & Workforce Readiness  

* Define the capability strategy and operating model across critical Product Engineering roles including functional/product roles, business analysis, domain SMEs, solution architecture and specialist engineering disciplines.
* Translate product strategy, roadmap, modernization, SaaS, cloud and AI priorities into future capability requirements.
* Develop product- and portfolio-level capability maps identifying critical skills, capacity risks, succession gaps and future capability needs.
* Ensure persistent/core capabilities and shared specialist capabilities are appropriately identified and developed.

Role & Competency Model  

* Establish clear role charters, competency expectations and proficiency models for critical roles.
* Create consistent expectations across Product Lines while allowing appropriate domain specialization.
* Define career and progression pathways that build deep functional, domain and technical expertise.

Talent Depth & Succession  

* Build strong pipelines for critical roles and reduce dependence on individual experts.
* Drive succession and readiness planning for business-critical positions.
* Enable mobility of talent and specialist expertise across Product Lines.
* Partner with Engineering Directors and leadership on build/buy/borrow decisions for emerging capability requirements.

Capability Excellence & Communities  

* Establish and strengthen communities of practice and capability forums across Advantage.
* Drive common methods, standards, reusable patterns, templates, accelerators and knowledge assets.
* Promote adoption of leading engineering, solutioning, analysis and product practices across teams.
* Ensure lessons and capabilities developed in one Product Line can be effectively leveraged across the broader portfolio.

Transformation & Future Skills  

* Lead capability transformation required for the evolving Build & Run model.
* Accelerate skills in AI-assisted engineering, cloud/SaaS, automation, modern architecture, product engineering and data-driven delivery.
* Identify opportunities where capability improvements can materially improve quality, productivity, predictability and engineering effectiveness.
* Create mechanisms for rapidly developing and scaling new capabilities as technology and market needs evolve.

Partnership with Product Engineering  

* Partner closely with Product Engineering Directors to understand capability demand and delivery challenges.
* Ensure capability development remains grounded in real Product Engineering outcomes rather than becoming a centralized or theoretical function.
* Support product organizations with the right specialist capability while avoiding unnecessary organizational hand-offs or approval layers.
* Provide transparent visibility into capability health, gaps, risks and readiness.

Capability Measurement  

* Establish a capability health framework and measurable indicators.
* Track areas such as critical-role coverage, proficiency maturity, succession readiness, capability-gap closure, specialist availability, mobility and reduction in key-person dependencies.
* Demonstrate tangible impact of capability initiatives on engineering quality, productivity and organizational effectiveness.

* Typically 18+ years of experience in enterprise product engineering, software/product organizations, technology consulting or equivalent environments.
* Significant leadership experience in a large, complex, multi-product engineering organization.
* Demonstrated experience building capabilities, practices, CoEs, engineering excellence organizations or cross-product competency models.
* Strong understanding of enterprise software/product development across the lifecycle — product definition, architecture, analysis, engineering, quality and production support.
* Demonstrated ability to work across both functional / domain and technology disciplines.
* Experience developing senior specialists, architects, functional leaders, domain experts or engineering leaders.
* Strong track record influencing senior stakeholders in a matrix organization.
* Experience driving organizational transformation and establishing new operating models.
* Exposure to enterprise SaaS, cloud modernization, AI-enabled engineering and contemporary product-development practices strongly preferred.

Good to have skills:  
The successful candidate should be someone who:  

* thinks several years ahead about capability rather than simply responding to today's staffing needs;

* can create standards without creating bureaucracy;

* is comfortable working through influence in a matrix;

* **Architecture & Technical Design:** Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous requirements into architecture, RFCs, prototypes, implementation strategies, and production-ready solutions.
* **Reliability & Observability:** Strong understanding of observability, resilience, performance, incident analysis, capacity/scalability engineering, and production operations.
* **Automation & Delivery:** Experience with CI/CD, infrastructure and configuration automation, Git-based development, automated testing, and repeatable deployment/release practices.
* **Technical Leadership:** Demonstrated ability to influence technical direction, make sound engineering trade-offs, mentor engineers, and build alignment across globally distributed teams without relying on formal reporting authority.
* **Communication:** Strong written and verbal communication with the ability to clearly explain technical decisions, alternatives, risks, and trade-offs to engineering and non-engineering stakeholders.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 10–15 years of relevant software engineering experience.
* Significant experience designing and delivering **production-grade platforms or distributed systems used by multiple applications, teams, or customers**.
* Demonstrated ability to solve complex engineering problems spanning software, infrastructure, cloud, networking, security, and operational concerns.
* Experience designing systems for **scale, robustness, reliability, resilience, performance, security, maintainability, and operational supportability**.
* Experience working across cloud, on-premises, hybrid, or distributed environments and integrating with dependent applications and external systems.
* Demonstrated technical leadership across multiple engineers, components, or teams.

**Desirable Experience**

* Experience with GCP/GKE or equivalent services on AWS/Azure, including identity, networking, storage, messaging, secrets, artifact management, and observability.

* Platform engineering, developer platforms, control planes, or infrastructure-as-a-product experience.

title: AI Product Strategy
description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

‍

##### **ABOUT TRACXN**

Tracxn is a leading global market intelligence platform tracking 7.9M + private companies across 3,000+ sectors and 50+ geographies. We turn deep data into decision-ready insights, powering deal sourcing, market mapping, and due diligence for 850+ clients worldwide, including VC firms, Private Equity, Investment Banks, and Corporates.

‍

##### **ABOUT THE ROLE**

As an AI Product Strategist at Tracxn, you will help decide what we build, and what we don’t, for our AI offerings, including the AI Assistant and the MCP connector. You will track how AI technology and our competitors are moving, study how customers actually use our AI products, and turn both into clear, data-backed recommendations for the product roadmap.

**This role requires a good understanding of technology, especially AI, and strong business acumen to help build the product roadmap.** You will not own delivery or the backlog; you will make sure the roadmap is built on evidence and a sound business case.

‍

##### **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Tracking AI Market & Competitors:**

* Track AI technology shifts and competitor moves in data, intelligence and AI products, and separate real capabilities from hype.
* Maintain a current view of how competitors and customers adopt AI, and where Tracxn can build a defensible advantage from its data.
* Publish a regular brief that ends in a clear “what this means for Tracxn”.

**Customer & Usage Insight:**

* Understand how users use Tracxn’s AI offerings: what they ask for, and what they do without asking.
* Gather feedback from customers, sales and customer success, and turn it into inputs for the AI roadmap.

**Strategy & Roadmap Input:**

* Identify, structure and prioritise AI use cases.
* Build a business case for each bet, covering revenue, retention, cost, pricing and positioning, and recommend what to build and what not to.
* Present recommendations to business leaders, backed by data and research.

**Collaboration & Positioning Inputs:**

* Partner with product, engineering, data, sales, marketing and customer success to turn strategy into practical initiatives.
* Run small pilots: form a hypothesis, test it, and measure the outcome before we scale.
* Give marketing and sales the competitive differences and customer evidence they need; marketing owns the messaging.
‍

##### **WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR**

* **2-5 years of experience** in product management, product or business strategy, consulting, growth or business operations, preferably in B2B SaaS, data or intelligence products.
* **A good understanding of technology, especially AI:** how LLMs, agents, retrieval and MCP-style integrations work, what they can and cannot do reliably, and what they cost. You can judge feasibility with engineers and use AI tools hands-on. Coding is not required.
* **Strong business acumen:** you understand how investors, bankers, corporate teams and sales teams make decisions and money, and can reason about pricing, packaging, retention and revenue to build a business case and set priorities.
* A first-principles, structured approach to problem solving, and comfort with ambiguity.
* A data-driven habit: you separate what users say from what they do, and back every recommendation with evidence.
* Excellent communication: short, clear strategy notes, and the ability to influence product, engineering, sales and marketing without owning their teams.
* A team player with empathy and a “get-it-done” mindset.
* Preferred: experience in positioning or product marketing, defining who a product is for and why it wins.
* Preferred: familiarity with venture capital, private equity or data and intelligence platforms, or a consulting or strategy background.
‍

##### **WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT AT TRACXN**

* Fixed work timings - 9 hrs × 5 days. Respect for personal time; no taking work home.
* A transparent, meritocratic culture where everyone explains the “why” behind their decisions.
* A candid and collaborative environment that values learning, curiosity, and open discussions.
* Managers and mentors who invest in your growth with timely, actionable feedback.
* Continuous learning through real-time projects and cross-functional exposure.
‍

**Ready to apply?**

Send your resume to **careers@tracxn.com** with the subject line

**“AI Product Strategist – Tracxn”**

title: Product Manager II - SmartHub, Amazon Smart Commerce
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

What if running an e-commerce business could become dramatically simpler — with AI helping sellers manage orders, inventory, pricing and operations across every channel they sell on?  
  
Amazon Smart Commerce is looking for a Product Manager for SmartHub, our multi-channel e-commerce operations platform. SmartHub brings together orders, inventory, catalog, returns, warehousing and business insights across marketplaces and D2C channels into a single system, helping businesses operate at scale without navigating multiple disconnected tools.  
  
We are now at an exciting inflection point. Advances in generative and agentic AI create an opportunity to fundamentally rethink how sellers operate their businesses — moving from dashboards and workflows, toward intelligent experiences that understand their business, identify what needs attention, recommend actions and increasingly execute work on their behalf.  
  
As the Product Manager for SmartHub, you will be at the forefront of defining and executing this journey by identifying the opportunities, defining the product and deliver exceptional seller experiences. Your work will directly impact the growth and success of sellers leveraging Amazon SmartHub, enabling them to scale their business to new heights.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Understand seller problems to identify unmet needs and emerging trends in the e-commerce landscape.

  

* Monitor and analyze competitor activities and market trends to identify opportunities for differentiation and innovation.

  

* Translate seller insights and market opportunities into detailed product requirements and user stories for the engineering team.

  

* Collaborate with GTM, engineering, UX, support and marketing teams throughout the product development lifecycle, from concept to launch.

  

* Analyze product performance data, identify areas for improvement, and iterate on the product based on customer feedback and business results.

  

* Conduct A/B testing and other experiments to optimize product features and improve key metrics.

  

* Develop and maintain product documentation, including user guides, training materials, and FAQs.

  
Required Skillset:  
  

* Proven ability to conduct market research, competitive analysis, and customer insights to inform product strategy.

  

* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret data, draw conclusions, and make data-driven decisions.

  

* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate effectively across teams.

  

* Deep understanding of online product management principles, agile development methodologies, and A/B testing techniques.

  

* Bachelor's degree in a related field; MBA preferred with 3years of experience in product management

  
A day in the life  
You will start your day by reviewing the product and business metrics. You morning might involve speaking to a seller processing thousands of orders across Amazon, Flipkart and other channels, identifying where manual work and exceptions slow them down. Later, you could work with engineers and scientists on an AI agent that detects inventory risks or automates an operational workflow. You will move fluidly between speaking to sellers, thinking of solutions, brainstorming with engineers, driving adoption and thinking strategy.  
  
About the team  
Amazon Smart Commerce is building the technology infrastructure for agentic commerce that helps businesses sell and operate wherever their customers shop.  
  
SmartHub is our multi-channel operations platform, helping sellers bring orders, inventory, catalog, returns and business insights from multiple marketplaces and D2C channels into one system. It is built for the operational realities of commerce - high-volume events, warehouse workflows, complex integrations and businesses that cannot afford downtime.  
  
We believe AI creates an opportunity to reinvent this category. Our ambition is to evolve from a software that helps sellers manage workflows to an intelligent commerce operating system that helps them run and grow their businesses.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of product management experience
* Experience managing technical products or online services

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in product, program, or project management in leading cross-functional teams in delivery of major new products or services
* Experience building and analyzing cost/benefit scenarios and business cases and communicating results throughout the organization
* Experience in creating PRFAQs, BRDs and other product documentation. Experience in leveraging AI for documentation, prototyping and business data analysis.

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Director Product Management (IC) - Sovereign AI
description:
**Our Company**
---------------

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.

**The Role**
------------

In this role, you will own the product strategy and roadmap for Teradata Sovereign AI: running AI models on infrastructure the customer controls — on premises or in a private cloud — with the security, governance, and cost control enterprises need to put them into production. Your impact will be measured by customer adoption of on-prem model deployments, the pace and quality of capabilities delivered to market, and the trust you build with engineering, architecture, security, and go-to-market teams. Success looks like a clear, well-sequenced roadmap, customers running production AI workloads on infrastructure they control, and measurable gains in usage and customer satisfaction.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Own the end-to-end product strategy and roadmap for Sovereign AI across three areas:
  + **Security:** model access control, data isolation, protection against prompt injection and data leakage, and a secure model supply chain (provenance, signing, scanning).
  + **Governance:** model registry and lifecycle, policy enforcement, guardrails, audit trails, and compliance with data residency and AI regulation.
  + **Tokenomics:** token usage metering, cost attribution and chargeback by team or use case, quotas, and GPU capacity planning for on-prem deployments.
* Define how customers select, adapt, and run small language models (SLMs) and open-weight models — including fine-tuning, quantization, and routing between SLMs and larger models based on cost and accuracy.
* Build model evaluation into the product: accuracy, safety, latency, and cost benchmarks that customers run on their own data, before and after deployment.
* Write PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and success metrics that give engineering a precise foundation for delivery.
* Drive customer and market discovery — direct customer conversations, competitive analysis, and analyst engagement — with a focus on regulated industries (banking, government, telecom, healthcare) where data cannot leave customer control.
* Partner with Engineering and Architecture to turn roadmap priorities into a sequenced delivery plan, resolving trade-offs between scope, performance, and timeline.
* Work with Go-to-Market, Pricing, and Customer Success on positioning, packaging, pricing, and enablement.
* Track product health — adoption, model quality, cost per use case, customer satisfaction — and use it to steer the roadmap.
* Represent Sovereign AI in cross-product planning to keep it aligned with the AI & Data Platform roadmap.
* Guide and review the work of associate and senior product managers contributing to the roadmap.

**Who You'll Work With**
------------------------

This role sits within Teradata's AI Platform product organization and reports to the Senior Director of Product Management for AI. You'll work closely with the engineering and architecture teams building model serving, security, and governance capabilities, and with product managers across adjacent AI and platform areas to keep priorities aligned. You'll partner regularly with Security, Legal and Compliance, Go-to-Market, Pricing, and Customer Success to turn the roadmap into a strong customer and field experience. This is an individual product leadership role with the opportunity to shape how Teradata delivers AI that customers fully control.

**What Makes You a Qualified Candidate**
----------------------------------------

### **Required**

* 10+ years of product management experience, including meaningful experience with enterprise AI/ML platforms, data platforms, or infrastructure software.
* Demonstrated experience owning a product area end to end — from discovery and strategy through delivery and post-launch iteration.
* Working knowledge of how language models are served on private infrastructure: inference servers (e.g., vLLM, NVIDIA NIM, Triton), GPU resource management, and Kubernetes.
* Experience with enterprise security and governance requirements: identity and access management, encryption, audit, and data residency.
* Experience writing strategy and vision documents (e.g., PRFAQs), PRDs, user stories, and measurable success criteria that engineering teams can execute against.
* Experience partnering directly with engineering and architecture teams in enterprise software.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

### **Preferred**

* Hands-on experience with SLMs and open-weight models (e.g., Llama, Mistral, Phi, Gemma, Qwen), including fine-tuning, distillation, or quantization.
* Experience designing or running model evaluations: benchmarks, LLM-as-judge, red-teaming, and tools such as lm-evaluation-harness, Ragas, or DeepEval.
* Experience with usage metering, cost attribution, or pricing for AI or cloud services.
* Experience delivering sovereign cloud or air-gapped deployments for government or regulated industries.
* MBA or advanced technical degree.

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

* Technical depth in AI model deployment, and the judgment to decide where Sovereign AI should invest next — including when an SLM is good enough and when a larger model is worth the cost.
* A bias toward direct customer engagement, using firsthand discovery to shape roadmap decisions.
* Comfort with real ownership of a product area, including the trade-offs and accountability that come with it.
* Clear, structured written and verbal communication that lets engineering and cross-functional partners move quickly.
* A collaborative style that builds trust with technical stakeholders, even through disagreement or shifting priorities.
* Curiosity about how Sovereign AI fits the broader AI & Data Platform strategy, including where to build and where to partner.

title: Product Manager - Weighing Solutions
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Sales Manager

**Your role and responsibilities**

In this role, you will support the development and growth of ABB's weighing solutions portfolio by optimizing the offer portfolio and improving return on investment. You will be responsible for understanding market needs, customer requirements, and industry trends, translating these insights into product strategies, specifications, and development initiatives. You will play a key role throughout the product lifecycle, supporting portfolio planning, product launches, market positioning, pricing strategies, profitability, and continuous portfolio enhancement to deliver sustainable business growth and customer value.

The work model for the role is: #LI - Onsite

This role is contributing to the development of weighing portfolio for the Force measurement business line of ABB Measurement and Analytics division for Business area Automation in India region supporting globally.

  

**You will be mainly accountable for:**

* Managing the product portfolio of weighing solutions.
* Maintain product documentation including technical specification, product brochures, product manuals, application notes, success stories and other technical and sales material. Prepare and maintain price lists for review and approval
* Maintains and follows annual cycle of activities to govern product management for the assigned offering.
* Keeps the product group, Sales team, and channels informed on topics related to the offering, such as new offering availability, market, competition, quality, configuration, trends, and limitations.
* Ensures appropriate product training materials are available to train internal (Sales/Engineering/Service JFGs) and external customers, delivers training on new offering(s) to internal teams and customers.
* Understanding and following global or assigned area standards, market and customer requirements, and their impact on the current offer portfolio.
* Conducting valuation of market size and trends, as well as competitor analyses including identification of offering gaps and evaluating ABB’s market standing.
* Ensuring whether technical solutions can be used across the Product Group’s offer portfolio to the maximum possible extent.

**Qualifications for the role**

* You have 6-8 years of experience in product management, application engineering, or business development within the weighing, force measurement, process automation, or related industrial sectors.
* You possess knowledge of weighing solutions, applications, and systems, with exposure to industries such as Ferrous and Non-Ferrous metals, mining, cement, power, or other process industries.
* You have experience in managing product portfolios, supporting product lifecycle activities, developing technical documentation, and developing market-oriented product strategies.
* You demonstrate a solid understanding of market trends, customer requirements, competitor offerings, and value proposition development for industrial products and solutions.
* You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation Engineering, or a related discipline.
* You are motivated by developing innovative customer-centric solutions and collaborating with global stakeholders to support business growth and product performance.
* You are comfortable working in a global matrix organization and engaging with cross-functional teams across product management, sales, engineering, and service.
* You communicate effectively in English, both written and spoken.

**More About Us:**

The Measurement & Analytics Division is among the largest manufacturers and suppliers of smart instrumentation and analyzers, working at the heart of industrial digital transformation. The Measurement & Analytics Division’s portfolio consists of analyzers measuring compositions of gases and liquids; instrumentation measuring process variables such as temperature, pressure, flow, and level; force measurement solutions measuring parameters such as flatness, thickness, and tension; and advanced digital solutions for device management, device health check and predictive maintenance. The Measurement & Analytics Division serves key industries such as oil and gas, chemical, water and wastewater, power, hydrogen, batteries, as well as the marine industry. The Division enables the optimization of industrial processes by providing and analyzing data collected from sensing and smart measurement devices. Parameters such as emission levels and production inputs are measured by providing ‘before’ and ‘after’ values, enabling efficient operations and environmental sustainability through measurement.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

title: Sr. Product Manager
description:

Qualifications:

* Strong technical fluency and experience working with APIs, microservices, cloud infrastructure, and integration frameworks.
* A track record of delivering and improving platforms or shared capabilities used by multiple teams, domains, or product lines.

title: Brand Manager - Movado
description:
The Brand Manager will lead the overall brand and business development strategy for Movado in India, with responsibility for strengthening brand positioning, expanding distribution channels, developing strategic retail partnerships and driving sustainable business growth.
  
  
Reporting directly to the General Manager – India, the incumbent will be responsible for managing existing business partnerships, identifying new business opportunities, developing retail formats and executing brand strategies to accelerate Movado's growth and market presence in India.
  
  
The role requires a commercially driven business leader with strong experience in premium retail, luxury brand management, channel development and partner management, with the ability to translate brand strategy into measurable business outcomes.

**Key Responsibilities**

Brand Strategy & Business Management
  

* Develop and execute the overall brand strategy for Movado in India, aligned with global brand positioning and local business objectives.
* Drive brand awareness, market positioning and brand equity within the premium and luxury watch segment.
* Develop annual business and brand plans in consultation with the General Manager – India.
* Identify opportunities to strengthen market presence, expand distribution and improve brand penetration.
* Monitor market trends, competitor activities and consumer preferences to identify business opportunities.
* Ensure consistency in brand identity, positioning and customer experience across all channels.

  
Business Development & Channel Expansion
  
- Lead channel development initiatives to expand Movado's presence across India.
  

* Identify, evaluate and onboard new business partners, distributors, franchisees and retail partners.
* Develop and strengthen existing partner relationships to drive business growth.
* Explore new retail formats and distribution opportunities aligned with the brand's premium positioning.
* Negotiate commercial terms and develop strategic partnerships to support business expansion.
* Identify potential markets, locations and retail opportunities for expansion.
* Drive partner performance through regular business reviews, sales planning and strategic engagement.

  
Retail Business & Operations
  

* Drive retail growth through effective management of existing retail channels and development of new retail formats.
* Work closely with retail partners to improve store performance, productivity and customer experience.
* Develop strategies to enhance store visibility, footfall, conversion and sales performance.
* Ensure retail execution is aligned with Movado's global brand and merchandising standards.
* Collaborate with Sales and Visual Merchandising teams to ensure effective implementation of brand initiatives.
* Monitor retail performance, identify gaps and implement corrective action plans.
* Support the development of new stores, shop-in-shops and other retail distribution formats.

Product & Category Management
  

* Develop a strong understanding of Movado's collections, product portfolio, design philosophy and Swiss heritage.
* Drive product positioning and go-to-market strategies for new collections.
* Work closely with global teams on product launches, assortment planning and market requirements.
* Analyse product performance, sales trends and consumer preferences.
* Identify opportunities to strengthen the product mix and improve category performance.

  
Business Performance & Financial Management
  

* Take ownership of business performance and contribute towards achieving annual revenue and growth objectives.
* Develop annual business plans, budgets and forecasts in consultation with the General Manager – India.
* Monitor sales performance, profitability, channel productivity and business KPIs.
* Review partner performance and identify opportunities to improve commercial outcomes.
* Track marketing expenditure and ensure effective utilisation of budgets.
* Prepare periodic business performance reports and strategic recommendations for GM India.
* Identify business risks and develop appropriate action plans.

  
Stakeholder & Partner Management
  
- Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective business partners.
  

* Collaborate with global brand teams to ensure alignment with international brand strategy.
* Work closely with Sales, Retail, Finance, Visual Merchandising, Supply Chain and other internal stakeholders.
* Represent the brand in business meetings, partner discussions, industry events and consumer engagement initiatives.
* Drive cross-functional collaboration to ensure effective execution of business and brand priorities.

  
**Qualifications & Experience**  

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing or a related discipline. MBA preferred.
* 8–12 years of experience in brand management, business management or retail leadership.
* Experience in luxury watches, premium fashion, jewellery, accessories or lifestyle brands is strongly preferred.
* Proven experience in channel development, distribution management and strategic partnerships.
* Strong exposure to retail operations, franchise management and business expansion.
* Experience in managing business performance, budgets and commercial targets.
* Experience working with international brands and multicultural stakeholders will be an advantage.

  
**Key Skills & Competencies**  

* Strategic business and brand management.
* Channel development and distribution strategy.
* Strategic partnership and stakeholder management.
* Retail operations and business expansion.
* Strong commercial acumen and P&L understanding.
* Negotiation and relationship management.
* Consumer engagement and brand activation.
* Financial planning and business performance analysis.
* Leadership, decision-making and execution capabilities.

  
  
**Role Expectations**  
  
The Brand Manager will be expected to operate as the business custodian for Movado in India, combining strategic brand leadership with strong commercial and retail execution.
  
  
The incumbent will play a critical role in expanding the brand's market presence, strengthening strategic partnerships, developing new retail opportunities and delivering sustainable business growth in alignment with the India leadership and global brand strategy.

title: Solutions Architect
description:
We are looking for a Solutions Architect to join our Architecture team in Noida, India. This is an exciting opportunity to define and drive solution architecture for database, data and Content platforms within the Intellectual Property domain. You will play a key role in modernizing business-critical Content applications and data platforms, designing scalable and resilient solutions, and enabling the evolution of our Content technology landscape toward modern cloud-native architectures.

**About You – Experience, Education, Skills, and Accomplishments**

  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent experience.
* Minimum 10 years of experience in software engineering, solution architecture, data architecture, or enterprise platform delivery.
* Minimum 5 years of experience designing enterprise database, data-intensive, or cloud-based solutions.
* Strong knowledge of relational database architecture, data modeling, schema design, data persistence and database modernization.
* Strong experience with PostgreSQL and/or Oracle and large-scale enterprise databases.
* Experience with **Databricks**, including its use for enterprise data processing, transformation and integration workloads.
* Experience with AWS database and data technologies such as Amazon RDS, Aurora, S3, DynamoDB and Redshift, or equivalent Azure services.
* Strong understanding of data ingestion, processing, movement, distribution and consumption patterns.
* Strong knowledge of cloud-native architecture patterns, distributed systems, microservices, APIs and event-driven architectures.
* Experience designing highly available, resilient, secure and scalable data and Content solutions.
* Experience modernizing legacy applications and databases, including re-platforming, refactoring and migration to cloud-managed services.
* Understanding of database performance, scalability, availability, backup, recovery and lifecycle management.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to work effectively with engineering, product and business teams.
* Strong technical documentation and architecture modeling skills.

**It Would Be Great If You Also Have...**

* AWS Solutions Architect, Azure Solutions Architect, database or equivalent cloud certifications.
* Experience with large-scale Content, publishing, search, information management or data-distribution platforms.
* Experience with modern data platform and lakehouse architectures, including technologies such as Snowflake and Delta Lake.
* Experience with enterprise integration patterns, API management, event streaming and messaging technologies such as Kafka, Amazon SQS or SNS.
* Experience with search technologies such as Amazon OpenSearch or Elasticsearch.
* Experience with database migration, schema evolution and modernization of large legacy data estates.
* Familiarity with data governance, lineage, retention and lifecycle management.
* Experience supporting AI/ML or Generative AI solutions that consume structured and unstructured enterprise Content.

**What Will You Be Doing in This Role?**

You will be responsible for:

* Designing solution architectures for database, data and Content platforms across the Intellectual Property domain.
* Providing architecture guidance for business-critical Content applications and services.
* Understanding existing database structures, data relationships, ownership, read/write patterns and data flows across applications.
* Designing scalable, secure, resilient and cost-effective database and data solutions on AWS and Azure.
* Leading solution design for modernization of legacy Content applications and databases, including adoption of cloud-native and managed data services.
* Defining appropriate patterns for data persistence, ingestion, processing, integration, distribution and downstream consumption.
* Designing solutions that leverage Databricks and other modern data technologies where appropriate for data processing, transformation and integration.
* Producing solution designs and architecture documentation and providing guidance to engineering teams throughout the delivery lifecycle.
* Applying reusable architecture patterns and engineering guardrails to data-intensive applications.
* Collaborating with Enterprise and Technical Architects, Product Teams and Engineering Teams to align solution designs with architecture strategy and target-state direction.
* Driving adoption of modern architecture approaches including APIs, event-driven architecture, microservices and managed cloud data services.
* Ensuring solutions address performance, scalability, resilience, security, operational excellence and cost.
* Participating in architecture reviews and technology evaluations.
* Identifying technical debt, architectural risks, simplification opportunities and modernization priorities across the Content technology landscape.

**About the Team**

The Architecture team supports Intellectual Property technology by providing strategic technology leadership, defining architecture standards and enabling modernization across the organization. The team works closely with Enterprise Architects, Technical Architects, Product Teams, Engineering Teams, Security Teams, DevOps Engineers, Data Teams and business stakeholders to deliver modern, resilient and scalable technology solutions.

**Hours of Work:**

This is a permanent position with Clarivate. The standard working day is 9 hours, including the lunch break.

At Clarivate, we are committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all qualified persons with respect to hiring, compensation, promotion, training, and other terms, conditions, and privileges of employment. We comply with applicable laws and regulations governing non-discrimination in all locations.

title: Solution Architect - Presales (India)
description:
**Lyzr, in a minute**
=====================

Lyzr is an enterprise software company that helps large organisations put AI agents — software that handles real tasks on its own — to work in their everyday operations. Most companies’ AI projects never move past the pilot stage; Lyzr provides the platform that takes them into dependable, day-to-day use. Today, 500+ enterprises build on Lyzr, more than 1,000 agents run live in production, and 85% of Lyzr projects reach production against an industry average of roughly 30%. Customers include Accenture, WTW, Hitachi, and Verifone, and the company recently raised $100M at a $500M valuation.

Our Presales team is where enterprise leaders decide that AI agents are worth serious investment. This

**The role**
============

This is a sales role, not a delivery one. You join an opportunity when it reaches solution validation and are its technical owner for the rest of the sales cycle, as part of the team that works the deal: the Account Executive, who owns the deal and orchestrates it; the Reimaginer Consultants, who build the client's baseline and the business case; the prototyping teams, who build and demo the proof; the Sales Engineer, who owns the functional requirements; and the Bid Manager, who runs RFP responses.

**What you will own**

* The IT discussion during solution validation: how Lyzr fits the client's architecture, systems and data, how it is deployed, and how it integrates.

* Security: answering security questionnaires and InfoSec reviews with the Sales Engineer, and taking the client's security and risk teams through how the platform handles their data.

* The client's sandbox or environment, set up with the Sales Engineer so the client can try Lyzr on its own ground.

* The technical answers inside RFP, RFX and RFI responses, written for the Bid Manager, who runs the response end to end.

* The technical side of the business case, as it goes through the client's IT, security and risk reviews.

* Knowing when a question needs platform engineering, and keeping the deal team informed of where the technical conversation stands.

**What will make you win this role**
====================================

* 8 years or more in solutions architecture, pre-sales engineering or technical consulting for enterprise software, with time spent on the selling side of complex deals.

* Hands-on depth in at least one of AWS, Azure or Google Cloud, and in enterprise integration: APIs, identity and single sign-on, data platforms and networking.

* A working understanding of large language models, retrieval, and how AI agents are built, orchestrated and governed in production.

* Fluency in enterprise security and compliance - SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA - and experience answering security questionnaires and leading InfoSec reviews.

* Experience with SaaS, private cloud and on-premises deployment, and the trade-offs a client weighs between them.

* The ability to draw an architecture and explain it to a CIO, a CISO and an engineer in the same meeting, and to write a clear technical answer to a deadline.

Good to have

* A cloud architecture certification from AWS, Microsoft or Google.

* Experience selling into regulated industries - banking, insurance, healthcare.

**Life at Lyzr**
================

* Benefits. Zomato meal allowance, an extensive PTO policy, and company-paid subscriptions to leading AI tools — you work with the same tooling our customers rely on.
* Hybrid structure. Office days for collaboration and team problem-solving; remote days for deep, uninterrupted work.
* An exceptional team. You will work alongside genuinely strong engineers and operators — the kind of colleagues who raise the level of everyone around them.
* Autonomy and ownership. We hire people who think like founders. You are given a problem and the space to drive your own outcomes — and with them, your own growth.
* Everybody is a visionary. Ideas are evaluated on merit, not seniority. You lead projects, make decisions, and shape what Lyzr becomes.

title: Principal Consultant
description:
**About Providence**
--------------------

Providence, one of the US’s largest not-for-profit healthcare systems, is committed to high quality, compassionate healthcare for all. Driven by the belief that health is a human right and the vision, ‘Health for a better world’, Providence and its 121,000 caregivers strive to provide everyone access to affordable quality care and services.

Providence has a network of 51 hospitals, 1,000+ care clinics, senior services, supportive housing, and other health and educational services in the US.

Providence India is bringing to fruition the transformational shift of the healthcare ecosystem to Health 2.0. The India center will have focused efforts around healthcare technology and innovation, and play a vital role in driving digital transformation of health systems for improved patient outcomes and experiences, caregiver efficiency, and running the business of Providence at scale.

  

**Why Us?**
-----------

* Best In-class Benefits
* Inclusive Leadership
* Reimagining Healthcare
* Competitive Pay
* Supportive Reporting Relation

**What will you be responsible for?**

As a Firewall Implementation Engineer, you will play a critical role in designing, implementing, modernizing, and securing enterprise network security infrastructure across a large-scale, highly available environment. You will lead end-to-end firewall deployments, support strategic business initiatives, and ensure secure connectivity between applications, users, vendors, and partner organizations.

Key responsibilities include:

* Building and implementing firewall services for new sites, enterprise programs, and infrastructure initiatives.
* Converting legacy firewall environments to modern enterprise security architectures and standards.
* Delivering network security solutions for mergers, acquisitions, site migrations, and modernization projects.
* Implementing secure connectivity for applications, vendors, medical systems, third-party integrations, and business-to-business communications.
* Configuring and maintaining enterprise firewall policies, including security rules, NAT policies, routing, application controls, logging, and monitoring.
* Deploying and supporting VPN solutions, including site-to-site, business-to-business, and remote-access VPN services.
* Performing advanced troubleshooting and root-cause analysis for complex application and network connectivity issues across firewalls, proxies, VPNs, and network infrastructure.
* Conducting packet captures, protocol analysis, and network traffic investigations to identify and resolve issues.
* Managing software upgrades, firewall lifecycle activities, policy audits, and remediation efforts.
* Creating and maintaining implementation plans, network diagrams, configuration standards, operational procedures, and technical documentation.
* Ensuring compliance with change management, security, and operational governance processes.
* Supporting operational handoffs and knowledge transfer activities to network operations and support teams.

**How would your day look like?**

A typical day for a Firewall Implementation Engineer involves collaborating with multiple technical and business stakeholders while driving network security projects from planning through implementation.

You will:

* Participate in project planning and technical design discussions for new site deployments, network modernization efforts, and security initiatives.
* Configure and deploy firewall policies, VPN connectivity, and security services across enterprise environments.
* Work closely with application teams, vendors, architects, security teams, and infrastructure engineers to enable secure business connectivity.
* Review application traffic flows and security requirements to develop appropriate firewall and access-control solutions.
* Perform troubleshooting sessions using packet captures, traffic analysis tools, logs, and network visibility platforms.
* Validate implementations through testing, connectivity verification, and performance assessments.
* Prepare implementation documentation, change requests, and rollback plans for scheduled deployments.
* Execute production changes during maintenance windows while adhering to change management processes.
* Conduct firewall policy reviews, optimization activities, and rule cleanup initiatives.
* Support post-implementation validation and transition completed projects to operational support teams.

**Who are we looking for?**

We are seeking mid-to-senior-level, hands-on implementation engineers who are passionate about building and delivering enterprise network security solutions. This role is ideal for candidates with extensive implementation experience rather than those whose backgrounds are primarily focused on architecture, monitoring, ticket escalation, or operational support.

**Required Qualifications**

* 8-12+ years of hands-on enterprise network engineering experience, with demonstrated ownership of large-scale implementation, migration, modernization, and integration projects in complex, 24x7 enterprise environments.
  

* 5+ years of hands-on network engineering experience supporting large, complex, 24x7 enterprise environments.
* Proven experience leading end-to-end network deployment projects, including:
* + Greenfield site implementations
  + Legacy-site modernization and architecture transformations
  + Mergers and acquisitions integrations
  + Application and vendor connectivity deployments
* Deep technical expertise in enterprise firewall and security technologies.
* Strong troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills, including:
* + Packet capture and protocol analysis
  + Network visibility tools and packet brokers
  + Application connectivity troubleshooting
  + Complex network traffic analysis
* Working knowledge of:
* + DHCP and DNS
  + RADIUS and TACACS+
  + LDAP and Active Directory
  + Network access control and authentication services
* Experience working within formal change-management, implementation, and documentation processes.
* Ability to create and maintain implementation plans, network diagrams, configuration documentation, operational procedures, and technical runbooks.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills with the ability to work directly with customers and cross-functional teams.

**Technical Expertise Required**

Hands-on implementation and troubleshooting experience with:

* Palo Alto Networks Firewalls
* Cisco Firepower Threat Defense (FTD)
* Cisco Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA)
* Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA)
* Zscaler Private Access (ZPA)
* Zscaler Zero Trust Branch (ZTB)

Strong understanding of:

* Enterprise firewall policy administration
* Security policies and access control
* Network and application objects
* Network Address Translation (NAT)
* Routing concepts
* Logging, monitoring, and event analysis
* Software upgrades and lifecycle management
* Rule auditing and policy remediation
* Site-to-site VPNs
* Business-to-business VPN connectivity
* Remote-access VPN services
* Application traffic flows
* Network segmentation and security zones
* High-availability firewall architectures

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Healthcare industry experience or experience supporting similarly complex, highly regulated enterprise environments.
* Experience delivering large-scale security transformation and network modernization initiatives.
* Ability to operate effectively in customer-facing environments while coordinating with vendors, security teams, application owners, architects, and infrastructure teams.
