title: Solutions Architect
description:
We are looking for a Solutions Architect to join our Architecture team in Noida, India. This is an exciting opportunity to define and drive solution architecture for database, data and Content platforms within the Intellectual Property domain. You will play a key role in modernizing business-critical Content applications and data platforms, designing scalable and resilient solutions, and enabling the evolution of our Content technology landscape toward modern cloud-native architectures.
  
  
**About You – Experience, Education, Skills, And Accomplishments**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent experience.
* Minimum 10 years of experience in software engineering, solution architecture, data architecture, or enterprise platform delivery.
* Minimum 5 years of experience designing enterprise database, data-intensive, or cloud-based solutions.
* Strong knowledge of relational database architecture, data modeling, schema design, data persistence and database modernization.
* Strong experience with PostgreSQL and/or Oracle and large-scale enterprise databases.
* Experience with Databricks, including its use for enterprise data processing, transformation and integration workloads.
* Experience with AWS database and data technologies such as Amazon RDS, Aurora, S3, DynamoDB and Redshift, or equivalent Azure services.
* Strong understanding of data ingestion, processing, movement, distribution and consumption patterns.
* Strong knowledge of cloud-native architecture patterns, distributed systems, microservices, APIs and event-driven architectures.
* Experience designing highly available, resilient, secure and scalable data and Content solutions.
* Experience modernizing legacy applications and databases, including re-platforming, refactoring and migration to cloud-managed services.
* Understanding of database performance, scalability, availability, backup, recovery and lifecycle management.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to work effectively with engineering, product and business teams.
* Strong technical documentation and architecture modeling skills.

**It Would Be Great If You Also Have...**

* AWS Solutions Architect, Azure Solutions Architect, database or equivalent cloud certifications.
* Experience with large-scale Content, publishing, search, information management or data-distribution platforms.
* Experience with modern data platform and lakehouse architectures, including technologies such as Snowflake and Delta Lake.
* Experience with enterprise integration patterns, API management, event streaming and messaging technologies such as Kafka, Amazon SQS or SNS.
* Experience with search technologies such as Amazon OpenSearch or Elasticsearch.
* Experience with database migration, schema evolution and modernization of large legacy data estates.
* Familiarity with data governance, lineage, retention and lifecycle management.
* Experience supporting AI/ML or Generative AI solutions that consume structured and unstructured enterprise Content.

**What Will You Be Doing in This Role?**
**You Will Be Responsible For**

* Designing solution architectures for database, data and Content platforms across the Intellectual Property domain.
* Providing architecture guidance for business-critical Content applications and services.
* Understanding existing database structures, data relationships, ownership, read/write patterns and data flows across applications.
* Designing scalable, secure, resilient and cost-effective database and data solutions on AWS and Azure.
* Leading solution design for modernization of legacy Content applications and databases, including adoption of cloud-native and managed data services.
* Defining appropriate patterns for data persistence, ingestion, processing, integration, distribution and downstream consumption.
* Designing solutions that leverage Databricks and other modern data technologies where appropriate for data processing, transformation and integration.
* Producing solution designs and architecture documentation and providing guidance to engineering teams throughout the delivery lifecycle.
* Applying reusable architecture patterns and engineering guardrails to data-intensive applications.
* Collaborating with Enterprise and Technical Architects, Product Teams and Engineering Teams to align solution designs with architecture strategy and target-state direction.
* Driving adoption of modern architecture approaches including APIs, event-driven architecture, microservices and managed cloud data services.
* Ensuring solutions address performance, scalability, resilience, security, operational excellence and cost.
* Participating in architecture reviews and technology evaluations.
* Identifying technical debt, architectural risks, simplification opportunities and modernization priorities across the Content technology landscape.

**About The Team**
The Architecture team supports Intellectual Property technology by providing strategic technology leadership, defining architecture standards and enabling modernization across the organization. The team works closely with Enterprise Architects, Technical Architects, Product Teams, Engineering Teams, Security Teams, DevOps Engineers, Data Teams and business stakeholders to deliver modern, resilient and scalable technology solutions.
  
  
**Hours Of Work**
This is a permanent position with Clarivate. The standard working day is 9 hours, including the lunch break.
  
  
At Clarivate, we are committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all qualified persons with respect to hiring, compensation, promotion, training, and other terms, conditions, and privileges of employment. We comply with applicable laws and regulations governing non-discrimination in all locations.

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
Job Req Number: 133773
  
  
Time Type: Full Time
  
  
  

* Job Overview

The Platform Engineer, Container Platforms designs, implements and maintains secure, reliable and standardised container platforms used by DSV applications and services.
  
  
The role contributes to the engineering and lifecycle management of Kubernetes-based platforms across private cloud, hybrid cloud and public cloud environments. The Platform Engineer works with other platform teams, application teams, security functions and service providers to automate platform delivery, improve operational stability and ensure that container services comply with agreed DSV architecture and security standards.
  
  
The position is part of Private Cloud within EOS Platform Services and has no direct staff responsibility.
  
  
Job Highlights
  
  
  

* Work with business-critical Kubernetes and container platforms across private cloud and public cloud environments.
* Contribute to the automation, reliability and security of platforms supporting DSV’s global application landscape.
* Participate in platform transformation initiatives involving OpenShift Container Platform, TALOS Linux and cloud-managed Kubernetes services.
* Collaborate with international platform, application, architecture and security teams.
* Help establish secure, repeatable and automated platform-engineering practices.
* Purpose of the Job

The purpose of the role is to engineer and operate scalable container platforms that provide application teams with secure, automated and reliable environments for deploying containerised workloads.
  
  
The Platform Engineer translates platform standards and architecture into working technical solutions. The role supports platform lifecycle activities, automation, upgrades, observability, incident resolution, capacity planning and continuous service improvement.
  
  
The position works within established architecture, security and governance frameworks. Organisation-wide capability ownership, strategic decision authority, formal technical leadership and people-management responsibilities are not part of this role.
  
  
  

* Overall Responsibility

The Platform Engineer, Container Platforms is responsible for implementing, maintaining and continuously improving the technical components of DSV’s container platforms. The role ensures that assigned platform services:
  
  
  

* Operate securely and reliably.
* Comply with approved architecture and technical standards.
* Remain within supported product and component lifecycles.
* Can be delivered and maintained through repeatable, automated processes.
* Provide application teams with consistent platform capabilities.
* Meet agreed operational, security and service-management requirements.
* Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Platform Engineering
  
  
  

* Design, implement, configure and maintain Kubernetes-based container platforms in accordance with DSV architecture, security and operational standards.
* Support the engineering and lifecycle management of Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform, TALOS Linux-based Kubernetes and upstream Kubernetes environments.
* Support cloud-managed Kubernetes services, including Microsoft Azure Kubernetes Service, Google Kubernetes Engine and Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service, where applicable to the assigned platform scope.
* Implement standard configurations, reusable platform components and repeatable deployment patterns.
* Translate approved technical designs and platform standards into working configurations and services.
* Support the evaluation, testing and introduction of new platform components and capabilities.
* Participate in technical proofs of concept and controlled platform pilots.
* Contribute to platform architecture and design reviews by providing implementation and operational input.

Automation and Infrastructure as Code
  
  
  

* Automate platform provisioning, configuration, upgrades and operational activities.
* Develop and maintain infrastructure-as-code and configuration-management components.
* Implement repeatable deployment processes for platform infrastructure and services.
* Contribute to GitOps-based platform and application-delivery practices.
* Maintain source-controlled platform configurations, automation code and deployment manifests.
* Reduce manual operational activities through appropriate automation.
* Test automation changes before their introduction into production environments.
* Document the purpose, dependencies and operational requirements of automation components.

Kubernetes Platform Components
  
  
  

* Configure and maintain Kubernetes cluster services and platform components.
* Implement and maintain cluster networking, ingress and load-balancing configurations.
* Support integration with enterprise DNS, network and security services.
* Configure persistent storage and Container Storage Interface integrations.
* Implement identity integration, authentication, authorisation and role-based access control.
* Support the integration of secrets-management capabilities.
* Configure container registries and image-management processes.
* Maintain namespaces, quotas, limit policies and other platform-governance controls.
* Support certificate management and certificate-renewal processes.
* Maintain approved Kubernetes operators and platform extensions.

Monitoring and Observability
  
  
  

* Implement and maintain monitoring, logging, alerting and observability capabilities for container platforms.
* Monitor platform health, performance, availability and capacity.
* Investigate alerts and take corrective action when defined thresholds are exceeded.
* Create and maintain operational dashboards that support platform monitoring and troubleshooting.
* Ensure that logs, metrics and relevant platform events are available for operational and security analysis.
* Improve alert quality by reducing false positives and ensuring that alerts lead to actionable responses.
* Support application teams in using platform observability capabilities where required.

Lifecycle and Maintenance
  
  
  

* Perform platform upgrades, security updates and component lifecycle activities within agreed maintenance and change processes.
* Maintain platform components within approved vendor-support and DSV lifecycle windows.
* Plan and execute certificate renewals and other time-sensitive maintenance activities.
* Test platform upgrades and significant configuration changes before production implementation.
* Maintain accurate records of platform versions, dependencies and lifecycle dates.
* Identify lifecycle risks and communicate them to the responsible technical and management stakeholders.
* Support the retirement and replacement of obsolete or unsupported platform components.

Incident and Problem Management
  
  
  

* Analyse and resolve technical incidents affecting container platforms.
* Troubleshoot Kubernetes, Linux, networking, storage, identity and application-platform integration issues.
* Participate in root-cause analysis for significant and recurring incidents.
* Implement corrective and preventive measures following incidents and problem investigations.
* Escalate complex issues to Senior or Lead engineers, architects, vendors or other technical teams when required.
* Maintain incident-resolution documentation and reusable troubleshooting guidance.
* Contribute to operational reviews and lessons-learned activities.
* Participate in an on-call or operational support rotation where required by the applicable service model.

Security and Compliance
  
  
  

* Support the implementation and maintenance of approved platform-security baselines.
* Apply hardening requirements to Kubernetes clusters and supporting platform components.
* Support vulnerability identification, assessment and remediation.
* Maintain appropriate authentication, role-based access control and privileged-access configurations.
* Support container-image and software-supply-chain security controls.
* Assist with audit, compliance and security-review activities.
* Document platform-security configurations and approved exceptions.
* Escalate security risks, vulnerabilities and non-compliant configurations.
* Ensure that technical changes comply with applicable DSV security and change-management requirements.

Availability, Recovery and Capacity
  
  
  

* Contribute to platform availability and resilience designs.
* Support backup and restore procedures for platform components and relevant platform data.
* Participate in disaster-recovery planning and testing.
* Monitor current capacity and identify emerging capacity constraints.
* Support capacity forecasting based on platform usage and expected demand.
* Implement approved resilience and recovery improvements.
* Maintain relevant recovery procedures and technical documentation.
* Assist with the resolution of service-continuity and capacity risks.

Documentation and Knowledge Management
  
  
  

* Create and maintain technical platform documentation.
* Maintain operational procedures, runbooks and troubleshooting guides.
* Document platform configurations, interfaces and technical dependencies.
* Maintain implementation and operational records required for audit and compliance purposes.
* Record known errors, workarounds and recurring platform issues.
* Share technical knowledge within the Container Platforms team and with relevant stakeholders.
* Ensure that documentation is updated when platform configurations or processes change.
* Contribute to internal knowledge articles and platform-consumer guidance.

Collaboration and Service Enablement
  
  
  

* Collaborate with application, DevOps, security, network, storage, compute and architecture teams.
* Support the integration of application workloads with container-platform services.
* Provide technical guidance to application teams consuming the platforms.
* Support application onboarding and migration activities.
* Help application teams understand platform standards, service boundaries and technical requirements.
* Participate in technical workshops and implementation planning.
* Coordinate technical dependencies with other platform teams and service providers.
* Support project and programme teams delivering changes that depend on container-platform capabilities.
* Work with vendors and external service providers during implementation, troubleshooting and lifecycle activities.

Continuous Improvement
  
  
  

* Identify opportunities to improve platform reliability, security, scalability and operational efficiency.
* Propose and implement approved improvements to tools, configurations and operational processes.
* Contribute to platform standardisation and reduction of technical complexity.
* Evaluate new platform features and technologies through structured testing.
* Document the outcome of evaluations and provide evidence-based recommendations.
* Support the definition and tracking of technical improvement activities.
* Contribute to automation and self-service capabilities for platform consumers.
* Participate in team retrospectives, technical reviews and improvement planning.
* Other Duties
* Comply with applicable DSV policies, security requirements, technical standards and operational procedures.
* Adhere to the DSV Group Code of Conduct.
* Maintain accurate documentation and records required for operational, audit and compliance purposes.
* Participate in relevant technical and professional training and continuously develop relevant platform-engineering skills.
* Support technical projects, migrations and transformation initiatives within the Private Cloud portfolio.
* Participate in agreed service-management and governance processes.
* Perform other job-related tasks assigned by the direct manager.
* Success Criteria and Key Performance Indicators

Platform Reliability
  
  
  

* Assigned container-platform services meet agreed availability and stability targets.
* Platform incidents are addressed within agreed response and resolution targets.
* Recurring technical issues are identified and reduced through corrective measures.
* Capacity and lifecycle risks are identified and communicated before they affect service delivery.

Security and Compliance
  
  
  

* Security updates and identified vulnerabilities are addressed within agreed remediation timelines.
* Platform configurations comply with approved security baselines and hardening requirements.
* Access-control and privileged-access configurations are maintained accurately.
* Audit and compliance evidence is complete and available when required.

Automation and Standardisation
  
  
  

* Platform deployments and configuration changes are performed through controlled and repeatable processes.
* Manual operational activities are progressively reduced through automation.
* Automation code and platform configurations are maintained in source control.
* Platform implementations follow approved patterns and technical standards.

Lifecycle Management
  
  
  

* Platform versions, certificates and supporting components remain within approved lifecycle and support windows.
* Upgrades and maintenance activities are planned and executed within agreed timeframes.
* Lifecycle dependencies and risks are recorded and communicated.
* Obsolete or unsupported components are replaced through agreed plans.

Operational Quality
  
  
  

* Changes are implemented with an acceptable success rate and without avoidable service disruption.
* Technical documentation, operational procedures and runbooks remain accurate and current.
* Monitoring and alerts provide relevant and actionable information.
* Root-cause analysis and corrective actions are completed for significant incidents.

Delivery and Collaboration
  
  
  

* Assigned engineering deliverables are completed according to agreed scope, quality and timelines.
* Technical dependencies and delivery risks are communicated early.
* Application and platform teams receive effective support during onboarding and implementation activities.
* Knowledge is shared effectively within the team.
* Collaboration with internal teams and service providers supports successful delivery outcomes.
* Authority Level

The Platform Engineer works within approved architecture, engineering standards, security controls and change-management processes.
  
  
The Role May
  
  
  

* Implement approved technical solutions and platform changes.
* Execute standard engineering and operational procedures.
* Perform troubleshooting and technical recovery activities.
* Recommend technical improvements and remediation actions.
* Raise platform risks, capacity constraints, security concerns and lifecycle issues.
* Participate in technical evaluations and proofs of concept.
* Provide technical input into design and architecture discussions.
* Stop or escalate an implementation where there is a material risk to security, service availability or data integrity.

The Role May Not Independently
  
  
  

* Approve platform strategy or major architectural direction.
* Approve material exceptions to DSV architecture or security standards.
* Commit unbudgeted expenditure.
* Select strategic vendors or enter contractual commitments.
* Approve major changes outside authorised change and governance processes.
* Define organisation-wide engineering standards without appropriate technical and governance approval.
* Make people-management, compensation or staffing decisions.
* Staff Responsibility

None.
  
  
The Platform Engineer role does not include formal line-management or supervisory responsibility. The role may support colleagues through knowledge sharing, peer collaboration and informal technical guidance. Formal people management, accountable capability ownership and organisation-wide technical leadership are not part of this role.
  
  
  

* Working Relations

Internal Working Relations
  
  
  

* Container Platforms team members
* Private Cloud management and capability owners
* Application development and application operations teams
* DevOps and platform-consumer teams
* Enterprise and solution architects
* Cyber Security and Identity and Access Management
* Network, compute, storage and database platform teams
* Service Management, including Incident, Problem and Change Management
* Project and programme delivery teams
* Regional Platform Services teams
* Vendor and service-provider technical teams

External Working Relations
  
  
  

* Technology vendors
* Implementation partners
* Managed-service providers
* External consultants
* Technical support organisations
* Cloud-service providers
* Hardware and software suppliers

External engagement must remain within approved commercial, security and governance arrangements.
  
  
  

* Professional Qualifications

**Required**

* Practical experience administering or engineering Kubernetes or an enterprise Kubernetes distribution.
* Experience with Linux system administration and troubleshooting.
* Working knowledge of containers, container images, container registries and container-runtime concepts.
* Experience with automation, scripting or infrastructure as code.
* Understanding of networking concepts relevant to Kubernetes, including DNS, load balancing, ingress, routing and network policies.
* Understanding of persistent storage and Kubernetes storage concepts, including Container Storage Interface-based integration.
* Knowledge of identity, authentication, authorisation and role-based access control.
* Experience with monitoring, logging and troubleshooting distributed systems.
* Understanding of IT service-management processes, including incident, change and problem management.
* Ability to create and maintain accurate technical documentation.
* Ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Professional working proficiency in English.

**Preferred**

* Experience with Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform.
* Experience with TALOS Linux or comparable immutable Kubernetes operating-system approaches.
* Experience with Microsoft Azure Kubernetes Service, Google Kubernetes Engine or Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service.
* Experience with upstream Kubernetes in private-cloud or bare-metal environments.
* Experience with GitOps tooling and practices, such as Argo CD.
* Experience with infrastructure-as-code and automation tools such as Terraform or Ansible.
* Experience with continuous integration and continuous delivery platforms.
* Experience with Git-based source-control and delivery workflows.
* Familiarity with Kubernetes operators and the OpenShift Operator Framework.
* Experience with Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry or comparable observability technologies.
* Understanding of container security and software-supply-chain security.
* Experience operating production platforms in a large, globally distributed enterprise.
* Experience collaborating with international teams and external service providers.
* Computer and Technical Skills
* Kubernetes administration and troubleshooting
* Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform
* TALOS Linux and Linux operating systems
* Microsoft Azure Kubernetes Service, Google Kubernetes Engine and Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service
* YAML, JSON, Kubernetes manifests and Helm
* Git and Git-based delivery workflows
* Shell scripting and one or more general-purpose scripting languages
* Terraform and Ansible
* Argo CD or comparable GitOps tooling
* Container registries and container-image management
* Prometheus, Grafana and OpenTelemetry or comparable observability technologies
* REST APIs and basic integration concepts
* Networking, DNS and load-balancing concepts
* Kubernetes storage and Container Storage Interface concepts
* Identity and role-based access control
* Standard IT service-management and documentation tools used within DSV

Candidates are not expected to have expert-level knowledge of every listed technology. The required technical profile should be adjusted to the specific platform assignment and local candidate market.
  
  
  

* Education and Experience

Education
  
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, engineering or a comparable discipline.
* Equivalent relevant professional experience may be accepted where permitted by local hiring practice.

**Experience**

* Typically three or more years of relevant experience in infrastructure, cloud, Linux, DevOps, site reliability engineering or platform engineering.
* Practical experience supporting or operating production IT services.
* Experience implementing technical changes through controlled deployment and change processes.
* Experience troubleshooting infrastructure or distributed-platform issues.
* Experience maintaining technical and operational documentation.
* Experience working with geographically distributed teams is an advantage.

The proposed experience period is a hiring guideline and should be validated against local market conditions, P&O grading requirements and applicable employment rules.
  
  
  

* Certificates, Licences and Professional Designations

The following certifications are advantageous but should not be mandatory where equivalent practical experience can be demonstrated:
  
  
  

* Certified Kubernetes Administrator
* Certified Kubernetes Application Developer
* Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist
* Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift Administration
* Red Hat Certified Engineer
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate or Azure Solutions Architect Expert
* Google Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer or Professional Cloud Architect
* AWS Certified Solutions Architect or AWS Certified DevOps Engineer
* HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate
* ITIL 4 Foundation
* Personal Qualifications
* Uses a structured and analytical approach to technical problems.
* Takes ownership of assigned engineering and operational tasks.
* Communicates clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Works effectively in an international and distributed organisation.
* Collaborates constructively across platform and application teams.
* Balances delivery speed with security, stability and standardisation.
* Documents work accurately and shares knowledge with colleagues.
* Identifies risks early and escalates them appropriately.
* Demonstrates attention to detail and can prioritise operational and project responsibilities.
* Is willing to learn new technologies and engineering practices.
* Responds constructively to incidents, changing priorities and technical challenges.
* Demonstrates behaviour consistent with DSV values and the DSV Code of Conduct.
* Role Definition

Senior Platform Engineer, Container Platforms
  
  
Delivers engineering work within established platform architecture and standards.
  
  
Independently handles defined technical tasks and operational responsibilities.
  
  
Troubleshoots both common and more complex platform issues.
  
  
Implements approved platform designs and technical changes.
  
  
Contributes to automation, documentation, and continuous improvement.
  
  
Supports application teams in adopting and using platform services.
  
  
Contributes technical input to platform designs and implementation plans.
  
  
Escalates major architecture decisions, material risks, and highly complex technical issues.
  
  
Works collaboratively with team members, Lead engineers, architects, and capability owners.
  
  
Does not carry formal capability ownership, people management or organization-wide technical authority.
  
  
**DSV – Global transport and logistics**
**What moves you?**
At DSV, we move more than goods. We move careers, ambitions and opportunities.
  
  
With close to 150,000 colleagues in over 90 countries, we are the global leader in transport and logistics, and it is our people who bring our services and solutions to life every day. From frontline operations to business functions, every role contributes to keeping supply chains flowing and societies running.
  
  
Here, you are trusted to take ownership, act on your ideas and make decisions that create real impact. It is a place where people, careers and ideas keep moving forward. We value transparency in how we communicate and collaborate, and we win together by supporting each other, challenging each other and delivering results as a team.
  
  
**Start here. Go anywhere**
This is our promise of movement. A promise that your work matters, your contribution counts, and your career can move as far as your ambition takes it.
  
  
If you are looking to make an impact, grow your career and be part of something bigger, DSV is the place to be.
  
  
Visit dsv.com and follow us on LinkedIn, Instagram and Facebook
  
  
#StartHereGoAnywhere

title: Storage Manager
description:
**Storage Monitoring and Management – HP, NetApp, IBM & Brocade Fabric:**

title: Senior IT Specialist
description:
Job Req Number: 133772
  
  
Time Type: Full Time
  
  
  

* Job Overview

The Platform Engineer, Container Platforms designs, implements and maintains secure, reliable and standardised container platforms used by DSV applications and services.
  
  
The role contributes to the engineering and lifecycle management of Kubernetes-based platforms across private cloud, hybrid cloud and public cloud environments. The Platform Engineer works with other platform teams, application teams, security functions and service providers to automate platform delivery, improve operational stability and ensure that container services comply with agreed DSV architecture and security standards.
  
  
The position is part of Private Cloud within EOS Platform Services and has no direct staff responsibility.
  
  
Job Highlights
  
  
  

* Work with business-critical Kubernetes and container platforms across private cloud and public cloud environments.
* Contribute to the automation, reliability and security of platforms supporting DSV’s global application landscape.
* Participate in platform transformation initiatives involving OpenShift Container Platform, TALOS Linux and cloud-managed Kubernetes services.
* Collaborate with international platform, application, architecture and security teams.
* Help establish secure, repeatable and automated platform-engineering practices.
* Purpose of the Job

The purpose of the role is to engineer and operate scalable container platforms that provide application teams with secure, automated and reliable environments for deploying containerised workloads.
  
  
The Platform Engineer translates platform standards and architecture into working technical solutions. The role supports platform lifecycle activities, automation, upgrades, observability, incident resolution, capacity planning and continuous service improvement.
  
  
The position works within established architecture, security and governance frameworks. Organisation-wide capability ownership, strategic decision authority, formal technical leadership and people-management responsibilities are not part of this role.
  
  
  

* Overall Responsibility

The Platform Engineer, Container Platforms is responsible for implementing, maintaining and continuously improving the technical components of DSV’s container platforms. The role ensures that assigned platform services:
  
  
  

* Operate securely and reliably.
* Comply with approved architecture and technical standards.
* Remain within supported product and component lifecycles.
* Can be delivered and maintained through repeatable, automated processes.
* Provide application teams with consistent platform capabilities.
* Meet agreed operational, security and service-management requirements.
* Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Platform Engineering
  
  
  

* Design, implement, configure and maintain Kubernetes-based container platforms in accordance with DSV architecture, security and operational standards.
* Support the engineering and lifecycle management of Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform, TALOS Linux-based Kubernetes and upstream Kubernetes environments.
* Support cloud-managed Kubernetes services, including Microsoft Azure Kubernetes Service, Google Kubernetes Engine and Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service, where applicable to the assigned platform scope.
* Implement standard configurations, reusable platform components and repeatable deployment patterns.
* Translate approved technical designs and platform standards into working configurations and services.
* Support the evaluation, testing and introduction of new platform components and capabilities.
* Participate in technical proofs of concept and controlled platform pilots.
* Contribute to platform architecture and design reviews by providing implementation and operational input.

Automation and Infrastructure as Code
  
  
  

* Automate platform provisioning, configuration, upgrades and operational activities.
* Develop and maintain infrastructure-as-code and configuration-management components.
* Implement repeatable deployment processes for platform infrastructure and services.
* Contribute to GitOps-based platform and application-delivery practices.
* Maintain source-controlled platform configurations, automation code and deployment manifests.
* Reduce manual operational activities through appropriate automation.
* Test automation changes before their introduction into production environments.
* Document the purpose, dependencies and operational requirements of automation components.

Kubernetes Platform Components
  
  
  

* Configure and maintain Kubernetes cluster services and platform components.
* Implement and maintain cluster networking, ingress and load-balancing configurations.
* Support integration with enterprise DNS, network and security services.
* Configure persistent storage and Container Storage Interface integrations.
* Implement identity integration, authentication, authorisation and role-based access control.
* Support the integration of secrets-management capabilities.
* Configure container registries and image-management processes.
* Maintain namespaces, quotas, limit policies and other platform-governance controls.
* Support certificate management and certificate-renewal processes.
* Maintain approved Kubernetes operators and platform extensions.

Monitoring and Observability
  
  
  

* Implement and maintain monitoring, logging, alerting and observability capabilities for container platforms.
* Monitor platform health, performance, availability and capacity.
* Investigate alerts and take corrective action when defined thresholds are exceeded.
* Create and maintain operational dashboards that support platform monitoring and troubleshooting.
* Ensure that logs, metrics and relevant platform events are available for operational and security analysis.
* Improve alert quality by reducing false positives and ensuring that alerts lead to actionable responses.
* Support application teams in using platform observability capabilities where required.

Lifecycle and Maintenance
  
  
  

* Perform platform upgrades, security updates and component lifecycle activities within agreed maintenance and change processes.
* Maintain platform components within approved vendor-support and DSV lifecycle windows.
* Plan and execute certificate renewals and other time-sensitive maintenance activities.
* Test platform upgrades and significant configuration changes before production implementation.
* Maintain accurate records of platform versions, dependencies and lifecycle dates.
* Identify lifecycle risks and communicate them to the responsible technical and management stakeholders.
* Support the retirement and replacement of obsolete or unsupported platform components.

Incident and Problem Management
  
  
  

* Analyse and resolve technical incidents affecting container platforms.
* Troubleshoot Kubernetes, Linux, networking, storage, identity and application-platform integration issues.
* Participate in root-cause analysis for significant and recurring incidents.
* Implement corrective and preventive measures following incidents and problem investigations.
* Escalate complex issues to Senior or Lead engineers, architects, vendors or other technical teams when required.
* Maintain incident-resolution documentation and reusable troubleshooting guidance.
* Contribute to operational reviews and lessons-learned activities.
* Participate in an on-call or operational support rotation where required by the applicable service model.

Security and Compliance
  
  
  

* Support the implementation and maintenance of approved platform-security baselines.
* Apply hardening requirements to Kubernetes clusters and supporting platform components.
* Support vulnerability identification, assessment and remediation.
* Maintain appropriate authentication, role-based access control and privileged-access configurations.
* Support container-image and software-supply-chain security controls.
* Assist with audit, compliance and security-review activities.
* Document platform-security configurations and approved exceptions.
* Escalate security risks, vulnerabilities and non-compliant configurations.
* Ensure that technical changes comply with applicable DSV security and change-management requirements.

Availability, Recovery and Capacity
  
  
  

* Contribute to platform availability and resilience designs.
* Support backup and restore procedures for platform components and relevant platform data.
* Participate in disaster-recovery planning and testing.
* Monitor current capacity and identify emerging capacity constraints.
* Support capacity forecasting based on platform usage and expected demand.
* Implement approved resilience and recovery improvements.
* Maintain relevant recovery procedures and technical documentation.
* Assist with the resolution of service-continuity and capacity risks.

Documentation and Knowledge Management
  
  
  

* Create and maintain technical platform documentation.
* Maintain operational procedures, runbooks and troubleshooting guides.
* Document platform configurations, interfaces and technical dependencies.
* Maintain implementation and operational records required for audit and compliance purposes.
* Record known errors, workarounds and recurring platform issues.
* Share technical knowledge within the Container Platforms team and with relevant stakeholders.
* Ensure that documentation is updated when platform configurations or processes change.
* Contribute to internal knowledge articles and platform-consumer guidance.

Collaboration and Service Enablement
  
  
  

* Collaborate with application, DevOps, security, network, storage, compute and architecture teams.
* Support the integration of application workloads with container-platform services.
* Provide technical guidance to application teams consuming the platforms.
* Support application onboarding and migration activities.
* Help application teams understand platform standards, service boundaries and technical requirements.
* Participate in technical workshops and implementation planning.
* Coordinate technical dependencies with other platform teams and service providers.
* Support project and programme teams delivering changes that depend on container-platform capabilities.
* Work with vendors and external service providers during implementation, troubleshooting and lifecycle activities.

Continuous Improvement
  
  
  

* Identify opportunities to improve platform reliability, security, scalability and operational efficiency.
* Propose and implement approved improvements to tools, configurations and operational processes.
* Contribute to platform standardisation and reduction of technical complexity.
* Evaluate new platform features and technologies through structured testing.
* Document the outcome of evaluations and provide evidence-based recommendations.
* Support the definition and tracking of technical improvement activities.
* Contribute to automation and self-service capabilities for platform consumers.
* Participate in team retrospectives, technical reviews and improvement planning.
* Other Duties
* Comply with applicable DSV policies, security requirements, technical standards and operational procedures.
* Adhere to the DSV Group Code of Conduct.
* Maintain accurate documentation and records required for operational, audit and compliance purposes.
* Participate in relevant technical and professional training and continuously develop relevant platform-engineering skills.
* Support technical projects, migrations and transformation initiatives within the Private Cloud portfolio.
* Participate in agreed service-management and governance processes.
* Perform other job-related tasks assigned by the direct manager.
* Success Criteria and Key Performance Indicators

Platform Reliability
  
  
  

* Assigned container-platform services meet agreed availability and stability targets.
* Platform incidents are addressed within agreed response and resolution targets.
* Recurring technical issues are identified and reduced through corrective measures.
* Capacity and lifecycle risks are identified and communicated before they affect service delivery.

Security and Compliance
  
  
  

* Security updates and identified vulnerabilities are addressed within agreed remediation timelines.
* Platform configurations comply with approved security baselines and hardening requirements.
* Access-control and privileged-access configurations are maintained accurately.
* Audit and compliance evidence is complete and available when required.

Automation and Standardisation
  
  
  

* Platform deployments and configuration changes are performed through controlled and repeatable processes.
* Manual operational activities are progressively reduced through automation.
* Automation code and platform configurations are maintained in source control.
* Platform implementations follow approved patterns and technical standards.

Lifecycle Management
  
  
  

* Platform versions, certificates and supporting components remain within approved lifecycle and support windows.
* Upgrades and maintenance activities are planned and executed within agreed timeframes.
* Lifecycle dependencies and risks are recorded and communicated.
* Obsolete or unsupported components are replaced through agreed plans.

Operational Quality
  
  
  

* Changes are implemented with an acceptable success rate and without avoidable service disruption.
* Technical documentation, operational procedures and runbooks remain accurate and current.
* Monitoring and alerts provide relevant and actionable information.
* Root-cause analysis and corrective actions are completed for significant incidents.

Delivery and Collaboration
  
  
  

* Assigned engineering deliverables are completed according to agreed scope, quality and timelines.
* Technical dependencies and delivery risks are communicated early.
* Application and platform teams receive effective support during onboarding and implementation activities.
* Knowledge is shared effectively within the team.
* Collaboration with internal teams and service providers supports successful delivery outcomes.
* Authority Level

The Platform Engineer works within approved architecture, engineering standards, security controls and change-management processes.
  
  
The Role May
  
  
  

* Implement approved technical solutions and platform changes.
* Execute standard engineering and operational procedures.
* Perform troubleshooting and technical recovery activities.
* Recommend technical improvements and remediation actions.
* Raise platform risks, capacity constraints, security concerns and lifecycle issues.
* Participate in technical evaluations and proofs of concept.
* Provide technical input into design and architecture discussions.
* Stop or escalate an implementation where there is a material risk to security, service availability or data integrity.

The Role May Not Independently
  
  
  

* Approve platform strategy or major architectural direction.
* Approve material exceptions to DSV architecture or security standards.
* Commit unbudgeted expenditure.
* Select strategic vendors or enter contractual commitments.
* Approve major changes outside authorised change and governance processes.
* Define organisation-wide engineering standards without appropriate technical and governance approval.
* Make people-management, compensation or staffing decisions.
* Staff Responsibility

None.
  
  
The Platform Engineer role does not include formal line-management or supervisory responsibility. The role may support colleagues through knowledge sharing, peer collaboration and informal technical guidance. Formal people management, accountable capability ownership and organisation-wide technical leadership are not part of this role.
  
  
  

* Working Relations

Internal Working Relations
  
  
  

* Container Platforms team members
* Private Cloud management and capability owners
* Application development and application operations teams
* DevOps and platform-consumer teams
* Enterprise and solution architects
* Cyber Security and Identity and Access Management
* Network, compute, storage and database platform teams
* Service Management, including Incident, Problem and Change Management
* Project and programme delivery teams
* Regional Platform Services teams
* Vendor and service-provider technical teams

External Working Relations
  
  
  

* Technology vendors
* Implementation partners
* Managed-service providers
* External consultants
* Technical support organisations
* Cloud-service providers
* Hardware and software suppliers

External engagement must remain within approved commercial, security and governance arrangements.
  
  
  

* Professional Qualifications

**Required**

* Practical experience administering or engineering Kubernetes or an enterprise Kubernetes distribution.
* Experience with Linux system administration and troubleshooting.
* Working knowledge of containers, container images, container registries and container-runtime concepts.
* Experience with automation, scripting or infrastructure as code.
* Understanding of networking concepts relevant to Kubernetes, including DNS, load balancing, ingress, routing and network policies.
* Understanding of persistent storage and Kubernetes storage concepts, including Container Storage Interface-based integration.
* Knowledge of identity, authentication, authorisation and role-based access control.
* Experience with monitoring, logging and troubleshooting distributed systems.
* Understanding of IT service-management processes, including incident, change and problem management.
* Ability to create and maintain accurate technical documentation.
* Ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Professional working proficiency in English.

**Preferred**

* Experience with Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform.
* Experience with TALOS Linux or comparable immutable Kubernetes operating-system approaches.
* Experience with Microsoft Azure Kubernetes Service, Google Kubernetes Engine or Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service.
* Experience with upstream Kubernetes in private-cloud or bare-metal environments.
* Experience with GitOps tooling and practices, such as Argo CD.
* Experience with infrastructure-as-code and automation tools such as Terraform or Ansible.
* Experience with continuous integration and continuous delivery platforms.
* Experience with Git-based source-control and delivery workflows.
* Familiarity with Kubernetes operators and the OpenShift Operator Framework.
* Experience with Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry or comparable observability technologies.
* Understanding of container security and software-supply-chain security.
* Experience operating production platforms in a large, globally distributed enterprise.
* Experience collaborating with international teams and external service providers.
* Computer and Technical Skills
* Kubernetes administration and troubleshooting
* Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform
* TALOS Linux and Linux operating systems
* Microsoft Azure Kubernetes Service, Google Kubernetes Engine and Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service
* YAML, JSON, Kubernetes manifests and Helm
* Git and Git-based delivery workflows
* Shell scripting and one or more general-purpose scripting languages
* Terraform and Ansible
* Argo CD or comparable GitOps tooling
* Container registries and container-image management
* Prometheus, Grafana and OpenTelemetry or comparable observability technologies
* REST APIs and basic integration concepts
* Networking, DNS and load-balancing concepts
* Kubernetes storage and Container Storage Interface concepts
* Identity and role-based access control
* Standard IT service-management and documentation tools used within DSV

Candidates are not expected to have expert-level knowledge of every listed technology. The required technical profile should be adjusted to the specific platform assignment and local candidate market.
  
  
  

* Education and Experience

Education
  
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, engineering or a comparable discipline.
* Equivalent relevant professional experience may be accepted where permitted by local hiring practice.

**Experience**

* Typically three or more years of relevant experience in infrastructure, cloud, Linux, DevOps, site reliability engineering or platform engineering.
* Practical experience supporting or operating production IT services.
* Experience implementing technical changes through controlled deployment and change processes.
* Experience troubleshooting infrastructure or distributed-platform issues.
* Experience maintaining technical and operational documentation.
* Experience working with geographically distributed teams is an advantage.

The proposed experience period is a hiring guideline and should be validated against local market conditions, P&O grading requirements and applicable employment rules.
  
  
  

* Certificates, Licences and Professional Designations

title: SSE/Lead/Architect - AI
description:
**About Us:**

CLOUDSUFI is a Silicon Valley-based specialist Data Engineering & Cloud Technologies player with top-tier clients, favorable revenue mix, strong financial performance, and robust management. We help organizations with Data Discovery, Insights, and Monetization, offering our engineers the opportunity to work on new platforms and technologies—including Cloud Hyper Scalers and AI/ML/NLP—that put them ahead of peers in the IT Services industry. Started in 2019, CLOUDSUFI is a family of 250+ members working towards a common goal of making enterprise data dance.

**Our Values**

We are a passionate and empathetic team that prioritizes human values. Our purpose is to elevate the quality of lives for our family, customers, partners and the community.

**Equal Opportunity Statement**

CLOUDSUFI is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified candidates receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation and national origin status. We provide equal opportunities in employment, advancement, and all other areas of our workplace. Please explore more at https://www.cloudsufi.com/

### **About the Role**

We are building a **unified AI platform** for our Client. It lets every engineering team build, test, deploy and run AI agents and applications through standard **paved paths**, so they don't have to set up infrastructure, CI/CD, security or observability themselves. The platform is built on **Google Cloud's managed agent ecosystem** (Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform / Vertex AI). Today it serves **Google ADK agents** running on Agent Runtime, with MCP tools hosted on Cloud Run.

As an AI Platform Engineer, you will build the platform itself: the golden-path templates, SDKs, pipelines, governance and telemetry that let a product team go from "I need an agent" to "it's in production, secure and observable" in hours instead of weeks.

### **What the Platform Covers**

* **Self-service onboarding:** one reviewed config turns into a provisioned GitHub repo, CI/CD pipelines, webhooks, a baseline agent instance and access policies.
* **Golden-path templates and an internal SDK:** a standard agent repo layout (agent code, prompts, evals, tests, Dockerfile) and a versioned Python SDK/CLI that holds the platform-owned logic.
* **Agent CI/CD:** pre-merge quality and security gates, smart diff detection (agent vs. prompt changes), immutable artifact promotion dev test stage prod, and approval gates.
* **Prompt lifecycle:** prompts are versioned in Vertex AI Prompt Management, deployed separately from container builds, and fetched dynamically with caching.
* **Self-service RAG infrastructure:** standard, on-demand provisioning of document ingestion, embeddings, vector search and retrieval, so teams can ground their agents in enterprise data without building that pipeline themselves.
* **Agent evaluation:** golden datasets, LLM-as-a-judge and trajectory/tool-call evals, and post-deployment eval jobs on Cloud Run that report back to the pipeline.
* **Security and governance:** Agent Identity (per-agent SPIFFE identity), Agent Gateway (ingress/egress), Agent Registry, access policies with default-deny tool access, Model Armor, IAM/PAM and org-policy guardrails, all managed as Terraform.
* **Observability:** conversation and token analytics in BigQuery (ADK BigQuery Analytics plugin), custom telemetry, Cloud Logging/Monitoring, and cost attribution per use case.
* **Model abstraction:** model routing and abstraction strategies so teams aren't locked into one model or version.

### **Role Summary**

You will be the technical lead responsible for building a unified AI platform for one of our clients. You will own the platform architecture, define the paved paths the client's engineering teams use to ship AI agents, and make sure the platform is secure, governed, observable and cost-efficient at enterprise scale. You will set engineering standards and work closely with the client's architects, cloud infrastructure, SRE and QA teams.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* **Own the platform architecture and roadmap**: the reference architecture for agent development, deployment and runtime on GCP, across golden-path templates, SDK, CI/CD, evaluation, RAG infrastructure, governance and observability.
* **Design the paved paths**: a standard agent/prompt/tool repo model, the versioning strategy, and a developer workflow that keeps business logic separate from platform-owned code, so onboarding is self-service and keeps getting faster.
* **Drive onboarding automation**: design a config-driven, single-approval flow (e.g., a GitOps/control-plane approach) that provisions repos, pipelines, webhooks, infrastructure and access policies across multiple IaC repos with no manual steps.
* **Define the agent security and governance model**: Agent Identity, Agent Gateway ingress/egress, Agent Registry, access policies (dry-run enforce), Model Armor, org-policy exceptions, PAM/JIT access, and least-privilege IAM. Present these designs to the client's security and cloud governance reviewers and get them approved.
* **Set the agent quality strategy**: decide which evaluations run in CI and which run after deployment, the eval-as-a-service architecture, quality thresholds and release gates, and regression protection for prompt and model changes.
* **Lead the model abstraction and runtime strategy**: model routing, versioning and fallback, context caching, prompt management, memory, and multi-agent patterns (A2A).
* **Build the observability and FinOps foundation**: a telemetry standard, BigQuery-based analytics, token and cost attribution per use case, SLOs and alerting, and closing observability gaps for onboarding teams.
* Lead **architecture reviews** (ARB), write design docs and decision records, and run POCs that compare build-vs-buy options.
* **Mentor and grow** L1/L2 engineers: code and design reviews, engineering standards for Python, Terraform and pipelines, and technical hiring.
* Work with client stakeholders (product teams, cloud infra, SRE, QA) to prioritise platform work, drive adoption, and represent the platform in technical forums.

### **Must-Have Skills**

* 4.5–8 years in software, platform, DevOps/SRE or AgentOps engineering, with **2+ years designing and building an internal developer platform or paved paths** used by multiple engineering teams.
* **Deep GCP expertise**: IAM and org policies, resource hierarchy, VPC/PSC networking, Cloud Run, Vertex AI, BigQuery, Artifact Registry, Workload Identity Federation, Cloud Logging/Monitoring.
* Proven experience **architecting and shipping GenAI/agent systems to production**, including tool calling, MCP (Model Context Protocol) integrations, prompt management, evaluation, guardrails and multi-agent patterns.
* Expert-level **Terraform** (module design, multi-repo/multi-environment layouts, policy-as-code, org-level IaC workflows).
* Has designed **enterprise CI/CD**: reusable templates, artifact promotion, approval gates, progressive delivery, pipeline security (Harness, GitHub Actions, GitLab or similar).
* Strong **Python** and API/SDK design skills. You can set code standards and review complex code.
* Strong foundation in **cloud security**: zero-trust, workload identity, secrets management, egress control, auditability.
* Track record of **technical leadership**: writing architecture documents, influencing without authority, mentoring engineers, and handling reviews with security and infra governance teams.
* Excellent written and verbal communication with senior stakeholders.

### **Good-to-Have**

* Hands-on with **Google ADK** and **Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform** (Agent Runtime, Agent Gateway, Agent Registry, Agent Identity, Memory Bank, Prompt Management).
* **A2A** protocol, **Apigee**, **Model Armor**, and AI-specific threat models (prompt injection, tool abuse, data exfiltration).
* Platform tooling such as **Backstage**, Crossplane, or GitOps control planes (Argo CD/Flux).
* LLM evaluation frameworks (Vertex AI Gen AI Evaluation, ADK eval, DeepEval, Ragas) and LLM observability (OpenTelemetry GenAI conventions, Langfuse, Arize).
* Classic **MLOps** on GCP: Vertex AI Pipelines, Model Registry, Feature Store, BQML.
* Kubernetes/GKE experience.
* GCP Professional Cloud Architect / Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer certification.

title: Senior Software Test Engineer (ACCT)
description:
**Description**
===============

**Trintech** is an award-winning AI driven Fintech SaaS organization transforming the way finance teams operate and we are seeking a highly skilled and experienced **Senior Software Test Engineer** to lead quality assurance efforts and ensure the delivery of reliable, high-performing software solutions. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, implementing and overseeing comprehensive test strategies across all phases of the software development lifecycle. Your expertise in test automation, performance testing and quality standards will guide the team in identifying and resolving issues effectively, fostering a culture of quality.

As a senior member of the team, you will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, mentor junior engineers and provide technical leadership to improve testing processes, tools and methodologies. Your role will have a significant impact on enhancing the efficiency, scalability and reliability of our products, ensuring an exceptional user experience.

This position is ideal for a seasoned professional with a strong technical foundation, excellent problem-solving skills and a passion for ensuring the delivery of high-quality software products.

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**

* The Sr Software Test Engineer will be responsible for end-to-end testing activities.
* Develop and execute test plans consisting of both manual and automated test cases to validate software functionality against requirements and specifications.
* Identify, troubleshoot, report, and track software defects and issues.
* Perform functional, performance, and regression testing of software products.
* Report test results and defects to the development team and other stakeholders and work on the resolution.
* Provide suggestions and feedback to improve the quality of the software development process across teams.
* Stay updated with industry trends in software testing methodologies and tools.
* Active participation in planning, analysis, and estimation of backlog requirements.
* Configure test environments with different platform combinations for testing.
* Ability to work in a close team environment and engage with other departments.
* Able to work with minimal supervision and still meet job requirements and tight deadlines.
* Learn an automation tool (if new to automation) and automate the test cases.
* Learn a performance testing tool (if new to performance testing) and run the performance test cases.

**WHO YOU ARE**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering or related field (or equivalent work experience).
* 4-6 years of experience in software testing
* Extensive experience with manual and automated testing methodologies, including functional, regression and performance testing.
* Experience in test automation tools and frameworks such as Selenium or playwright
* Familiarity with performance testing tools such as JMeter, LoadRunner or other related tools to validate scalability and system performance under load.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify, isolate and troubleshoot issues, ensuring high-quality test coverage.
* Proven ability to work effectively with developers, product managers and other stakeholders, ensuring that testing needs are integrated early in the development process.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills to clearly report issues, document test cases and collaborate with cross-functional teams.
* Ability to mentor and provide technical guidance to junior engineers, promoting best practices and continuous improvement within the team.
* Basic knowledge of programming languages such as Java, Python, JavaScript or similar.
* Hands-on experience with AI-powered testing tools and working knowledge of how AI and ML model behaviors influence test strategy, test data design, and validation approaches.
* Experience testing cloud-native applications on Azure, or any other cloud platform, including validation of microservices, APIs, and cloud service integrations
* Previous experience with Reconciliation and/or month-end close applications is preferred

**Cultural Fit:**

* Excellent interpersonal skills
* Superior analytical and problem-solving abilities
* Desire to work in a team-oriented, collaborative environment
* Detail-oriented with excellent organization skills
* Strong writing and communication skills
* Continuous improvement mindset
* Creative and Innovative thinking
* Embraces change, growth, and evolution

*At our core, Trintechers stand committed to fostering a culture rooted in our core values – Humble, Empowered, Reliable, and Open. Together, these values guide our actions, define our identity, and inspire us to continuously strive for excellence in everything we do.*

*All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin or disability.*

title: Administrator - AWS IAC, Terraform,Python
description:
**Job Summary**
---------------

The SRE Administrator is responsible for maintaining the reliability, availability, performance, and operational stability of applications and infrastructure hosted on AWS. The role focuses on monitoring, incident management, platform administration, observability, automation, and operational excellence to ensure seamless business services across the technology estate. The AWS SRE Administrator works closely with application, cloud, infrastructure, security, and operations teams to proactively identify issues, optimize platform performance, and drive continuous service improvements.  
  
Key Responsibilities:  
Monitor AWS-hosted applications, infrastructure, and services to ensure high availability and performance.  
Perform proactive health checks, alert monitoring, incident triage, and operational support activities.  
Manage AWS services including EC2, EKS, ECS, Lambda, RDS, S3, Route 53, CloudWatch, and related platform components.  
Investigate production incidents, perform root cause analysis, and coordinate resolution with support and engineering teams.  
Administer observability platforms and monitoring tools, including dashboard maintenance, alert tuning, and reporting.  
Support production releases by performing deployment validation, smoke testing, and post-change monitoring activities.  
Develop and maintain operational runbooks, standard operating procedures, and knowledge documentation.  
Automate repetitive operational tasks using AWS native services, scripting, and infrastructure-as-code tools.  
Monitor platform capacity, utilization trends, and system reliability metrics to support capacity planning.  
Collaborate with security, infrastructure, and application teams to ensure compliance with operational and security standards.  
Generate operational reports, SLA/KPI dashboards, and service health updates for stakeholders.  
Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on reliability, automation, operational efficiency, and reduction of manual effort.

title: SME - AzureMSSQL DBA, Microsoft Azure
description:
**Job Summary**
---------------

**Job Summary :** \"We are looking for an experienced Senior Microsoft SQL Server Database Administrator with 10+ years of hands-on experience managing large-scale, business-critical SQL Server environments. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in SQL Server administration, Always On Availability Groups, clustering, performance tuning, backup and recovery, database security, migrations, automation, troubleshooting, and high availability/disaster recovery solutions. Experience with Microsoft Azure and hybrid database environments is highly desirable.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

SQL Server Administration • Install, configure, patch, upgrade, and administer Microsoft SQL Server environments. • Manage SQL Server instances and databases across Development, UAT, Staging, and Production environments. • Perform database refreshes, restores, migrations, upgrades, and server consolidation activities. • Manage database files, filegroups, storage capacity, SQL Server Agent jobs, linked servers, and database configurations. • Maintain database standards, documentation, operational procedures, and runbooks. High Availability & Disaster Recovery • Design, implement, administer, and troubleshoot SQL Server Always On Availability Groups. • Manage Windows Server Failover Clustering (WSFC) and SQL Server Failover Cluster Instances where applicable. • Support synchronous and asynchronous replicas, automatic/manual failover, listener configuration, and read-only routing. • Work with clusterless/read-scale Availability Group architectures where appropriate. • Design and maintain backup, recovery, DR, RPO, and RTO strategies. • Participate in scheduled DR drills and validate database recoverability. Performance Monitoring & Tuning • Troubleshoot complex performance issues involving CPU, memory, disk I/O, blocking, deadlocks, waits, and query execution. • Analyze execution plans and optimize poorly performing SQL queries. • Perform index analysis, statistics maintenance, fragmentation management, and database health checks. • Use tools such as Query Store, Extended Events, Dynamic Management Views (DMVs), Performance Monitor, and SQL Server execution plans. • Identify database performance bottlenecks and provide long-term remediation rather than temporary fixes. Backup, Recovery & Maintenance • Design and manage Full, Differential, and Transaction Log backup strategies. • Perform point-in-time database recovery when required. • Regularly test database backups and recovery procedures. • Configure and monitor integrity checks using DBCC CHECKDB. • Design and maintain database maintenance and housekeeping processes. Security & Compliance • Administer SQL Server logins, database users, roles, permissions, and schemas. • Implement the principle of least privilege and role-based access controls. • Manage Windows/Active Directory authentication and SQL authentication. • Support encryption technologies such as Transparent Data Encryption (TDE) and TLS where required. • Conduct database access and permission reviews. • Assist security and audit teams with database compliance requirements and remediation. title: SSE/Lead- Full Stack AI Engineer
description:

CLOUDSUFI is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified candidates receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation and national origin status. We provide equal opportunities in employment, advancement, and all other areas of our workplace. Please explore more at https://www.cloudsufi.com/

#### **Role Overview**

As a Full Stack AI Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in designing, building, and deploying end-to-end AI applications. You will combine deep expertise in machine learning and Generative AI/LLMs with robust full-stack engineering skills—building intuitive user interfaces using modern frontend frameworks like React or Next.js, architecting scalable backend APIs, and integrating AI models seamlessly into seamless, user-facing digital products. This role requires technical leadership, innovative problem solving, and a holistic product mindset.

#### **Key Responsibilities**

* **Architect & Develop AI Solutions:** Design, build, and deploy robust and scalable machine learning models, with a primary focus on Natural Language Processing (NLP), Generative AI, and LLM-based Agents.
* **Build Full-Stack AI Infrastructure & APIs:** Architect and scale web applications and microservices using Python frameworks like FastAPI or Node.js, ensuring robust integration between backend services, database platforms, and frontend systems.
* **Contribute to AI Research & Innovation:** Stay abreast of the latest advancements in AI/ML. Participate in research and development initiatives to evaluate and implement state-of-the-art models and techniques for performance and cost optimization.
* **Solve Business Problems:** Collaborate with product and business teams to understand challenges and develop data-driven solutions that create significant business value, such as building business rule engines or predictive classification systems.
* **End-to-End Project Ownership:** Take ownership of the entire lifecycle of AI projects—from ideation, data processing, and model development to deployment, monitoring, and iteration on cloud platforms.
* **Peer Guidance & Mentorship:** Support learning initiatives within the engineering team, mentor junior engineers and data scientists, and encourage best practices for AI development.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Work closely with software engineers to integrate AI models into production systems and contribute to the overall system architecture.
* **Frontend Development & User Experience:** Design and implement responsive, high-performance web user interfaces using frameworks such as React or Next.js to expose AI features directly to end-users.

#### **Required Skills and Qualifications**

* Master’s (M.Tech.) or Bachelor's (B.Tech.) degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 6+ years of professional experience in software engineering, with dedicated experience in Full Stack Development and AI/ML engineering.
* Expert-level proficiency in **Python** and its core data science libraries (e.g., PyTorch, Huggingface Transformers, Pandas, Scikit-learn).
* Demonstrable, hands-on experience building and fine-tuning **Large Language Models (LLMs)** and implementing **Generative AI** solutions.
* Proven experience in developing and deploying scalable systems on cloud platforms, particularly **GCS**.
* Strong background in **Natural Language Processing (NLP)**, including experience with multilingual models and transcription.
* Experience with containerization technologies, specifically **Docker**.
* Solid understanding of software engineering principles and experience building APIs and microservices.
* Proven experience with **frontend frameworks** (e.g., **React**, **Next.js**, TypeScript) and building interactive web interfaces for AI-driven products.
* Strong proficiency in **backend API development** (FastAPI, Express/Node.js) and database management systems (SQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or Vector Databases like Pinecone/Weaviate).

#### **Preferred Qualifications**

* A strong portfolio of projects.
* Experience with state management libraries (Redux, Zustand) and real-time streaming architectures (WebSockets, Server-Sent Events) for live LLM responses.
* Familiarity with setting up and managing CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins).
* Experience developing custom tools or packages for data science workflows.

title: Project Lead
description:

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. Track project costs, variations, billing, and commercial deliverables.

Prepare and present periodic project progress reports to clients and stakeholders.
  
Ensure compliance with applicable codes, regulations, sustainability objectives, and JLL policies.

Relevant experience in MEP project management for commercial, industrial, retail, hospitality, or institutional projects.
  
Strong knowledge of MEP design, installation, testing, commissioning, and statutory requirements.
  
Experience managing multidisciplinary teams, consultants, contractors, budgets, and schedules.
  
Proficiency in project management tools, MS Office, AutoCAD, and relevant MEP software is desirable.

Technical and commercial understanding of MEP systems
  
Planning, problem-solving, and risk management
  
Effective communication and negotiation
  
Commitment to health, safety, quality, and sustainability
  
Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver under tight timelines

Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
