And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

title: Project Manager
description:
**Designation:** Project Manager  
**Department:** Project Management / Operations  
**Location:** Kudasan, Gandhinagar, Gujarat  
**Experience:** 2–3 Years  
**Industry:** IT / Software Development  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Job Summary**

The Project Manager will be responsible for managing end-to-end project coordination, acting as a bridge between clients and internal teams, ensuring smooth communication, resolving queries, tracking deliverables, and maintaining project timelines and quality standards.

The ideal candidate should have excellent communication and email drafting skills, strong organizational abilities, and the capability to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced startup environment.

**Key Roles & Responsibilities**

**1. Client Communication & Relationship Management**

* Handle regular communication with clients through emails, calls, and meetings.
* Understand client requirements, expectations, and project objectives.
* Provide timely project updates and maintain professional client relationships.
* Address client queries, concerns, and feedback and ensure appropriate resolution.
* Prepare professional emails, meeting summaries, project updates, and follow-up communications.

**2. Team Management & Coordination**

* Coordinate with internal technical and development teams to ensure smooth project execution.
* Assign, communicate, and track tasks among team members.
* Conduct regular follow-ups with team members regarding task progress and pending activities.
* Resolve team queries and coordinate with relevant stakeholders to avoid delays.
* Ensure team members understand project requirements, responsibilities, and deadlines.

**3. Project Planning & Delivery**

* Monitor project progress from initiation to final delivery.
* Prepare project plans, timelines, task schedules, and delivery trackers.
* Ensure projects are delivered within agreed timelines and quality standards.
* Identify delays, challenges, and potential project risks and take timely action.
* Track pending tasks, milestones, and deliverables.

**4. Documentation & Reporting**

* Maintain project-related documentation, trackers, reports, and records.
* Prepare daily/weekly project status reports for management.
* Document client requirements, meeting discussions, action points, and project changes.
* Ensure all project guidelines, processes, and delivery standards are properly followed.

**5. Process Management & Problem Solving**

* Ensure internal teams follow project guidelines, workflows, and company processes.
* Proactively identify operational issues and coordinate for effective solutions.
* Handle project-related escalations and ensure timely resolution.
* Maintain accountability and transparency between clients, teams, and management.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 2–3 years of experience in Project Management, Project Coordination, or IT Operations.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong email drafting and professional business communication skills.
* Good team handling, coordination, and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.
* Strong follow-up, planning, and time-management skills.

title: Project Lead-Planning
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  
Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
Planner - Semiconductor Manufacturing FacilityJLL Project & Development Services (PDS) | GujaratAbout JLLJones Lang LaSalle (JLL) is a leading professional services firm specializing in real estate and investment management. Our Project & Development Services (PDS) team delivers world-class project and program management services for complex, large-scale industrial and infrastructure projects globally.
  
Project OverviewJLL PDS is supporting the development of a state-of-the-art semiconductor manufacturing facility for Micron Technology in Dholera Special Investment Region (DSIR), Gujarat. This landmark project represents one of India's most significant technology infrastructure investments and requires exceptional planning expertise to ensure successful delivery.
  
Position OverviewWe are seeking a highly skilled Planner with experience in large-scale industrial or semiconductor projects to develop, monitor, and control project schedules for this mega semiconductor manufacturing facility. This role demands deep technical planning knowledge, analytical rigor, and the ability to coordinate across multiple disciplines in a fast-paced, high-stakes environment.
  
Key ResponsibilitiesSchedule Development & Management
  
You will develop comprehensive baseline schedules using Primavera P6 for all project phases including design, procurement, construction, testing, and commissioning. Creating integrated master schedules that incorporate civil, structural, architectural, MEP, process utilities, cleanroom systems, and equipment installation activities will be central to your work. You will establish critical path analysis, float management protocols, and milestone tracking systems while ensuring schedules align with project objectives, contractual commitments, and client requirements.
  
Planning & Coordination
  
Coordinating schedule inputs from multiple contractors, consultants, equipment suppliers, and specialty vendors is essential. You will facilitate schedule integration meetings with design teams, construction contractors, MEP contractors, and process equipment vendors. Developing look-ahead schedules at various horizons (1-week, 4-week, 3-month) and coordinating with procurement teams to ensure material delivery schedules align with construction sequences will be critical responsibilities. Managing interdependencies between parallel work streams and identifying potential conflicts or constraints early is fundamental to project success.
  
Monitoring & Reporting
  
You will track actual progress against baseline schedules through regular site visits and coordination meetings. Updating project schedules weekly with actual progress, resource deployment, and completion percentages is required. Preparing comprehensive progress reports, schedule variance analysis, and earned value metrics for client and management review will be regular deliverables. Identifying schedule deviations, analyzing root causes, and recommending corrective actions with quantified impact assessments is essential.
  
Risk & Mitigation Planning
  
Conducting schedule risk assessments and identifying potential delays or bottlenecks proactively is paramount. You will develop what-if scenarios and recovery schedules for critical path activities, maintain risk registers with schedule impact assessments, and collaborate with project teams to develop and implement mitigation strategies. Analyzing the schedule impact of design changes, RFIs, and variations while recommending optimization opportunities to compress schedules or improve efficiency will be ongoing responsibilities.
  
Stakeholder Communication
  
Presenting schedule status, critical issues, and recommendations to project leadership and client representatives clearly and effectively is required. You will participate in project review meetings, providing planning insights and supporting decision-making processes. Coordinating with contractors to ensure understanding of schedule requirements and commitments while maintaining professional relationships with all project stakeholders is essential.
  
Documentation & Compliance
  
Maintaining comprehensive planning documentation including baseline schedules, schedule updates, progress reports, and change logs is necessary. You will ensure compliance with project planning procedures, standards, and contractual requirements. Archiving planning records and supporting project closeout documentation activities will be required at project completion.
  
Required QualificationsEducation & Experience
  
Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or Construction Management is required. A minimum of 8-12 years of experience in project planning and scheduling with specific focus on large-scale industrial, manufacturing, pharmaceutical, or semiconductor projects is essential. Demonstrated experience planning projects valued at ₹2,000+ crores or equivalent complexity is highly preferred. Prior experience with cleanroom environments, high-tech manufacturing facilities, or critical utility systems is advantageous.
  
Technical Competencies
  
Expert-level proficiency in Primavera P6 (version 20.x or later) is mandatory, including schedule development, resource loading, critical path analysis, and reporting capabilities. Strong understanding of planning methodologies including Critical Path Method (CPM), Program Evaluation and Review Technique (PERT), and Earned Value Management (EVM) is required. Proficiency in MS Excel for schedule analysis and data manipulation, along with experience with MS Project, PowerBI, or other planning tools is expected. Knowledge of construction methodologies for industrial facilities including civil works, structural steel, MEP systems, cleanroom construction, and process equipment installation is necessary.
  
Industry Knowledge
  
Understanding of semiconductor manufacturing facility requirements including cleanroom classifications, process utilities (UPW, CDA, PCW, chemical distribution), HVAC systems, and specialized infrastructure is highly valued. Familiarity with international standards and codes applicable to semiconductor facilities (SEMI standards, FM Global requirements) is beneficial. Knowledge of fast-track project delivery methods and design-build execution strategies is advantageous.
  
Professional Skills
  
Exceptional analytical and problem-solving abilities with attention to detail and accuracy are essential. Strong communication skills in English (both written and verbal) with the ability to present complex schedule information clearly to diverse audiences is required. Collaborative mindset with ability to work effectively across multi-disciplinary teams and multiple contractors simultaneously is necessary. Proactive approach to identifying issues and developing solutions independently is valued. Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities is fundamental.
  
Preferred QualificationsProfessional certification such as PMI Scheduling Professional (PMI-SP) or Planning & Scheduling Professional (PSP) demonstrates planning excellence. Experience with semiconductor, pharmaceutical, or other high-tech manufacturing projects requiring controlled environments is highly desirable. Exposure to international EPC contractors and multinational client environments is valuable. Knowledge of Indian construction practices combined with international quality standards is beneficial. Familiarity with Lean Construction or Last Planner System methodologies is advantageous.
  
Work Environment & ConditionsThis position is based at the project site in Dholera Special Investment Region, Gujarat, with regular site presence required for progress monitoring and coordination. You will work in both office and active construction site environments, requiring appropriate PPE and safety awareness. Extended working hours may be necessary during critical project phases or milestones. This is a project-based assignment with duration aligned to the construction and commissioning timeline (approximately 24-36 months).
  
What We OfferOpportunity to work on one of India's most significant semiconductor manufacturing projects with global visibility. Exposure to international best practices in planning and project controls for high-tech facilities. Collaborative environment working alongside experienced professionals from JLL and leading global contractors. Professional development opportunities including training in advanced planning techniques and tools. Competitive compensation package commensurate with experience, including project-based allowances. Career growth potential within JLL's expanding PDS practice in India.
  
LocationDholera Special Investment Region (DSIR), Gujarat (Site-based position with accommodation support available)
  
JLL is an Equal Opportunity Employer
  
We are committed to creating an inclusive work environment that reflects the diversity of our clients and communities. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of gender, race, religion, age, disability, or other protected characteristics.
  
To apply, please submit your resume through JLL's career portal or contact your local HR representative in Gujarat for application procedures.
  
**Note:** Candidates must be willing to undergo background verification and security clearance processes as required for this strategic infrastructure project.
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  
Personalized benefits that support personal well-being and growth:
  
  
JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  
About JLL –
  
  
We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  
Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  
Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. title: Product Manager – Nutraceuticals Division
description:
About Vieroots

Vieroots is a pioneering health-tech and wellness company specializing in personalized, genomics-driven preventive healthcare. By combining epigenetic lifestyle modifications (EPLIMO) with targeted nutritional supplementation, we empower individuals to optimize their healthspan and prevent lifestyle diseases. We are looking for an entrepreneurial, end-to-end Product Manager to spearhead the entire product lifecycle for our Nutraceuticals Division.

Role Overview

The Product Manager – Nutraceuticals will own the vision, strategy, formulation roadmap, launch, and lifecycle management of Vieroots’ nutritional supplement portfolio. You will act as the central bridge between our scientific/genomics team, R&D partners, regulatory affairs, supply chain, and marketing/sales teams—taking concepts from scientific insight to commercially successful, high-efficacy products.

Key Responsibilities

\* Product Strategy & Roadmap: Define and execute the multi-year product roadmap for the nutraceuticals division, aligning product launches with Vieroots’ personalized genomics and epigenetic recommendations.

\* End-to-End Product Development: Lead the full product development lifecycle (NPD)—from ideation, market research, and ingredient sourcing to formulation, stability testing, packaging design, and commercial scale-up.

\* Scientific & R&D Collaboration: Partner closely with in-house geneticists, nutritionists, and external R&D labs/contract manufacturers (CDMOs) to develop evidence-based, bioavailable, and differentiated formulations.

\* Regulatory & Quality Compliance: Ensure all formulations, claims, labels, and manufacturing processes strictly comply with FSSAI guidelines and relevant international nutraceutical standards (e.g., GMP, ISO, USFDA norms where applicable).

\* Vendor & Supply Chain Coordination: Identify, evaluate, and onboard contract manufacturers and raw ingredient suppliers; oversee cost optimization, COGS management, and vendor quality audits.

\* Go-To-Market (GTM) & Positioning: Craft compelling product positioning, value propositions, and scientific dossiers; collaborate with marketing, digital, and sales teams to drive product launches, medical/practitioner education, and customer adoption.

\* Lifecycle & P&L Management: Monitor post-launch performance, customer feedback, clinical efficacy data, and unit economics; drive product iterations, line extensions, and SKU rationalization.

Qualifications & Experience

\* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Pharmacy (B.Pharm / M.Pharm), Food Technology, Biotechnology, Nutrition, Life Sciences, or a related field. An MBA in Product Management or Marketing is a strong plus.

\* Experience: 2–5 years of experience in product management, new product development (NPD), or brand management within the nutraceutical, dietary supplements, functional foods, or consumer healthcare/pharma industries.

\* Domain Expertise: Proven track record of taking nutraceutical or OTC health products from concept to market launch. Deep familiarity with FSSAI nutraceutical regulations, ingredient bioavailability, and formulation challenges.

\* Analytical & Commercial Acumen: Strong understanding of pricing strategy, COGS, margin optimization, and market trend analysis.

\* Soft Skills: Exceptional cross-functional leadership, project management, and communication skills—capable of translating complex scientific/genomic concepts into clear consumer benefits.

Preferred Qualifications

\* Prior experience working in personalized nutrition, preventative healthcare, or direct-to-consumer (D2C) wellness brands.

\* Familiarity with nutrigenomics, epigenetics, or metabolic health supplements.

What We Offer

\* Opportunity to shape the product portfolio of a fast-growing, science-first personalized wellness brand.

\* High autonomy and end-to-end ownership across R&D, operations, and commercial strategy.

\* Collaborative, innovation-driven work culture with competitive compensation and growth opportunities.

* Salary Range is - 45000.00 - 70000.00

building modular, multicloud-portable codebases — not just single-cloud templates.

title: Cloud Analytics Engineer
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

### **Role Description**

The Cloud Analytics Engineer will join eBay’s Data Services team within Information Technology Services and Solutions (ITSS), responsible for delivering enterprise data, analytics, and business intelligence solutions supporting eBay’s global business and corporate functions.

This hands-on role focuses on designing, developing, and operating scalable data and analytics solutions using **Google Cloud Platform (GCP), BigQuery, and Looker**. The engineer will work closely with business, application development, and infrastructure teams to deliver end-to-end solutions, from data ingestion and transformation to analytics and reporting.

The role also involves developing proof-of-concept solutions, contributing to product roadmaps, implementing CI/CD and DevOps automation, and supporting secure, reliable hybrid cloud operations.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* **Cloud Analytics Engineering:** Design, develop, and optimize scalable data pipelines, data models, and analytics solutions using GCP, BigQuery, and Looker, working with structured and unstructured data.
* **Architecture & Integration:** Contribute to end-to-end cloud and hybrid data architectures, covering ingestion, transformation, governance, and analytics enablement.
* **Business Intelligence:** Build and maintain a secure, governed, high-performing enterprise BI foundation, establishing reusable solutions and consistent development standards.
* **DevOps & Automation:** Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and GitHub Actions. Automate deployments, platform administration, and operational processes using Python or Shell scripting.
* **Security & Governance:** Implement data governance, access controls, security, and compliance requirements in alignment with enterprise standards and platform capabilities.
* **Operational Excellence:** Deliver stable, scalable, and observable solutions, including monitoring, troubleshooting, technical specification documentation, standard operating procedures, and production support handoffs.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with business, engineering, and global application teams to translate requirements into technical solutions, resolve issues, and support the full software development lifecycle (SDLC).
* **Innovation & Continuous Improvement:** Develop proofs of concept, contribute to product strategy and technology roadmaps, and find opportunities to simplify processes through an automation-first approach.

### **Skills & Qualifications**

**Required Experience**

* 4+ years of technology consulting or industry experience in solution architecture and development using Google Cloud Platform.
* Experience delivering at least one full lifecycle GCP implementation.
* 2+ years of hands-on SQL and Python development experience.
* 1+ year of experience leading technical workstreams involving cross-functional or geographically distributed teams.
* Strong understanding of business intelligence, data warehousing, relational databases, and data integration patterns.
* Experience developing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and GitHub Actions.
* Proficiency in Python or Shell scripting for platform automation and operational support.
* Understanding of data security, governance, compliance, and enterprise SDLC practices.

**Preferred Experience**

* Hands-on experience with **Google BigQuery, Looker, and Tableau**.
* Experience implementing and supporting enterprise BI platforms in hybrid cloud environments.
* Experience establishing platform standards, operational procedures, and automated monitoring.

**Professional Skills**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to understand complex technical and business processes.
* Ability to independently manage technical deliverables, coordinate across teams, and balance competing priorities.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Self-motivated, adaptable, and committed to continuous learning and process improvement in a fast-paced environment.

**Additional Details**

description:

---------------

As a BIE you will enable effective decision making by retrieving and aggregating data from multiple sources and triangulating the data points/ metrics into reports and actionable format. ------------------------

* 2+ years of analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc. experience

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, or related field

* Knowledge of data modeling and data pipeline design

title: Product Definition Analyst
description:
**Job Title**

Product Definition Analyst

**Summary of the Role**
-----------------------

  

Join the Travel Distribution (TRD) Artificial Intelligence (AI) organization and help shape the next generation of AI-powered travel distribution products.

As a Product Definition Analyst (PDA), you’ll connect business and technical stakeholders, understand user and business needs, and translate them into clear product capabilities. You’ll work closely with Product Management, Architecture, Engineering, and AI specialists to develop solutions that are valuable for users, aligned with business needs, and sustainable over time.

**In This Role You’ll / Your Main Responsibilities**
----------------------------------------------------

  

* **Understand user and business needs:** Collaborate with customers, business stakeholders, and product teams to understand user journeys, processes, challenges, and opportunities, and translate these insights into clear functional requirements and expected outcomes.
* **Define product capabilities and experiences:** Create user stories, business rules, workflows, acceptance criteria, and functional specifications, while designing end-to-end experiences that are understandable, testable, and maintainable.
* **Contribute to AI-enabled solutions:** Explore how technologies such as Generative Artificial Intelligence (Generative AI), AI agents, and intelligent automation can address user and business needs, and define the functional requirements that support their responsible integration into products.
* **Support delivery and validation:** Work with Agile software development teams throughout the product lifecycle to clarify requirements, support implementation, validate delivered functionality against agreed expectations, and contribute to resolving functional issues.
* **Connect teams and share knowledge:** Work across Product Management, Architecture, Engineering, Operations, and business teams to maintain a shared understanding of product goals, provide functional expertise, maintain relevant documentation, and contribute to continuous product improvement.

  

**About the Ideal Candidate**
-----------------------------

  

You’ll be a good fit for this role if you bring relevant experience and enjoy working across business, technology, and user needs. We encourage you to apply even if your experience does not match every aspect listed below.

* Experience in Product Definition, Functional Analysis, Business Analysis, or a related role, including translating business needs into clear product requirements or specifications.
* Experience working with Agile software development teams, with knowledge of areas such as requirements elicitation, user stories, functional specifications, business process modelling, functional design, Scrum methodologies, or product lifecycle management.
* Understanding of technical concepts relevant to digital products, including Application Programming Interfaces (APIs) and data integration, with an interest in developing your understanding of AI-enabled products and workflows.
* Effective problem-solving, critical-thinking, communication, and facilitation skills, including the ability to simplify complex topics, organize information clearly, and work effectively with business and technical stakeholders.
* Ability to understand customer needs and collaborate across teams, together with an interest in learning and applying new approaches. Experience in the travel search or shopping domain can help you get started in the role, but candidates with relevant experience from other domains are also encouraged to apply.

**What We Can Offer You**
-------------------------

* A critical mission and purpose - At Amadeus, you'll power the future of travel with a critical mission and extraordinary purpose.
* A truly global DNA - Everything at Amadeus is global, from our people to our business, which translates into our footprint, processes, and culture.
* Great opportunities to learn - Learning happens all the time and in many ways at Amadeus, from on-the-job training to formal activities and daily interactions.
* A caring environment – Amadeus fosters a caring environment that supports both professional growth and personal well-being.
* A complete rewards offer - Amadeus provides attractive compensation packages, including salary, bonus, caregiving and health benefits.
* A flexible working model - Embrace our flexible working model, enabling you to excel wherever and however you work best.
* A diverse, equitable, and inclusive community – We are committed to enabling each employee to reach their full potential by fostering a culture of belonging and fair treatment.
* A Reliable Company - Trust and reliability are fundamental to shaping our relationships with customers, partners, and employees.

**Diversity & Inclusion**

  

Amadeus aspires to be a leader in Diversity and Inclusion in the tech industry, enabling every employee to reach their full potential by fostering a culture of belonging and fair treatment, attracting the best talent from all backgrounds, and as a role model for an inclusive employee experience.

  

Amadeus is an equal opportunity employer and committed to an accessible recruitment process. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, age, beliefs, disability or any other characteristics protected by law.

**Be aware of recruitment scams**

  

Amadeus Group never charges fees, requests payment, or asks for financial information during recruitment. Any payment request or outreach via unofficial platforms (e.g., WhatsApp, Telegram) should be treated as fraudulent.

description:
**Job Description:**

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a Senior Oracle EBS Engineering & Manufacturing Functional Support Analyst to join Terex's TMS (Terex Management System) Level 2 support organization. This role is the primary escalation point for Oracle EBS Engineering and Manufacturing incidents across Terex's global, multi-org manufacturing footprint. You will resolve functional issues, reduce ticket backlog, drive continuous improvements and ensure engineering and manufacturing teams across our business segments — including Genie, Materials Processing, and Environmental Solutions — can operate without disruption.

**Key Responsibilities**

Incident Management & Resolution (Engineering & Manufacturing)

* Provide day-to-day Level 2 support of Oracle EBS Engineering and Manufacturing modules and related applications for Terex users globally.

* Log, categorize, prioritize, and resolve incidents and service requests in line with defined SLAs and operational procedures.

* Execute routine, playbook-driven activities that contribute to system stability and operational continuity.

* Troubleshoot and resolve complex sales and service issues that may span Oracle EBS modules, middleware and other applications.

* Communicate clearly with end users and stakeholders, providing timely updates, setting expectations, and confirming resolution prior to ticket closure.

Manage escalations and escalate effectively when needed.  



Terex Engineering & Manufacturing Process Support

* Ensure that monthly, quarterly and yearly inventory close proceed without IT impact.

* Support Oracle EBS Engineering, Inventory, BOM, Routing, Costing, Quality and WIP.

Act as an escalation point for complex issues, coordinating thorough troubleshooting and restoration of service.

Look for opportunities to streamline or automate existing functionality and processes.

Strong communication skills; ability to interface with business users across Asia Pacific, EMEAR and North America time zones.

ITIL certification (or strong ITIL-aligned operational experience).

title: Sr Advanced Data Analyst
description:
The Senior Data Analyst will support the core development team by connecting business requirements with data and technical development. The role will work closely with business stakeholders to understand business needs, translate them into clear Business Requirement Documents (BRDs) and workflows, identify and validate the required data, and provide initial insights that help the development team build the right solutions.

  

**Key Skills**

* SQL - Data extraction, joins, validation, reconciliation, and analysis.
* Excel - Pivot tables, lookups, data validation, reconciliation, and analysis.
* Business Relationships - Build strong stakeholder relationships and understand business needs.
* Requirement Gathering - Convert business needs into clear, actionable requirements.
* BRD Creation - Document scope, business rules, KPIs, dependencies, and acceptance criteria.
* Workflow Mapping - Create clear business, process, and data workflows.
* Data Identification - Identify the right data elements and sources for the requirement.
* Data Validation - Check data completeness, accuracy, consistency, and usability.
* Initial Insights - Identify trends, anomalies, and early business insights.
* Communication - Explain requirements clearly to business and technical teams.

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree / Graduation in Engineering, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Business, or a related discipline.
* 6-10 years of relevant experience in Data Analytics, Business Analytics, Business Analysis, BI, or a similar role.
* Experience working directly with business stakeholders and development or technical teams.
* Hands-on experience with requirement gathering, BRD creation, workflow definition, data identification, and data validation.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Act as the bridge between business stakeholders and the core development team.
* Gather and clarify business requirements, expected outcomes, and success criteria.
* Create and maintain BRDs, including business rules, KPIs, assumptions, dependencies, and acceptance criteria.
* Document business processes, data flows, and current- and future-state workflows.
* Identify required data elements, data sources, mappings, and dependencies.
* Profile and validate data for completeness, accuracy, consistency, and suitability.
* Perform initial analysis to identify trends, gaps, anomalies, and early insights.
* Work with business and development teams to resolve questions and keep solutions aligned with requirements.

  
Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

title: Business Analytics Analyst
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


**Overview**:


Citi, the leading global bank, has approximately 200 million customer accounts and does business in more than 160 countries and jurisdictions. Citi provides consumers, corporations, governments and institutions with a broad range of financial products and services, including consumer banking and credit, corporate and investment banking, securities brokerage, transaction services, and wealth management. Our core activities are safeguarding assets, lending money, making payments and accessing the capital markets on behalf of our clients.

  

  

Citi’s Mission and Value Proposition explains what we do and Citi Leadership Standards explain how we do it. Our mission is to serve as a trusted partner to our clients by responsibly providing financial services that enable growth and economic progress. We strive to earn and maintain our clients and the publics trust by constantly adhering to the highest ethical standards and making a positive impact on the communities we serve. Our Leadership Standards is a common set of skills and expected behaviors that illustrate how our employees should work every day to be successful and strengthens our ability to execute against our strategic priorities.


Diversity is a key business imperative and a source of strength at Citi. We serve clients from every walk of life, every background and every origin. Our goal is to have our workforce reflect this same diversity at all levels. Citi has made it a priority to foster a culture where the best people want to work, where individuals are promoted based on merit, where we value and demand respect for others and where opportunities to develop are widely available to all.


The **Operations Analytics** team uses data analysis to improve efficiency, reduce costs, and enhance customer experience across the front and back office. They focus on optimizing contact center performance, automating processes, resolving customer issues, and supporting all back office and front office of operations. Projects include enhancing First Contact Resolution, performance analysis, improving complaints and sentiment analysis, streamlining card issuance and return mail processes, and optimizing capacity planning and staffing. They leverage tools like NLP and AI to reduce complaints and identify agent coaching opportunities. Their goal is to drive data\-driven decision\-making for operational improvements.


The **Senior Business Analyst** will be part of Operations Analytics within Citi AIM vertical, a global community driving data\-driven transformation across Citi. AIM's objective is to generate actionable intelligence for business leaders. The role is critical for driving strategy, process discovery, design, and implementation of analysis solutions and recommendation within Citi Personal Banking Operations. This includes areas such as Customer Service, Core Operations, Credit Operations, Collections, and Recoveries for various lines of business. The role aims to enhance the Operations startegy, reduce expenses, and improve operational efficiency through data\-driven insights, analysis and automation.


**In this role, you are expected to:**


* Gathers operational data from various cross functional stakeholders to examine past business performance
* Identifies data patterns \& trends, and provides insights to enhance business decision making capability in business planning, process improvement, solution assessment etc.
* Recommends actions for future developments \& strategic business opportunities, as well as enhancements to operational policies.
* Involved in exploratory data analysis, confirmatory data analysis and/or qualitative analysis.
* Translate data into consumer or customer behavioral insights to drive targeting and segmentation strategies, and communicate clearly and effectively to business partners and senior leaders all findings
* Continuously improve processes and strategies by exploring and evaluating new data sources, tools, and capabilities
* Work closely with internal and onshore business partners in building, implementing, tracking and improving decision strategies
* Bring thought leadership in team projects discussions and help team manger as SME for business and team members
* Mentor juniors in teams and provides guidance day to day basis
* Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.
  

  

**As a successful candidate, you’d ideally have the following skills and exposure:**


* **Data Analysis \& Process Improvement:** Expertise in Analytical problem formulations, statistical analysis, data mining and analysis, process mapping, and process re\-engineering.
* **Automation \& Programming:** Experience with automation tools (e.g., SAS, PySpark) and programming languages (e.g., Python, SQL) to develop and implement analytics solutions for operational processes.
* **Business Acumen \& Communication:** Strong understanding of business operations and financial metrics. Ability to translate data insights into actionable recommendations and communicate effectively with stakeholders.
* **Customer Focus \& Problem\-Solving:** Demonstrated ability to analyze customer feedback (complaints, sentiment), identify pain points, and develop solutions to improve customer experience. Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills to address operational challenges.
* **Domain Expertise (Finance/Banking):** Knowledge of financial services operations, regulatory requirements (e.g., Contact centers, Collections, Core Banking, KYC, AML), and industry best practices is highly beneficial.

**Qualifications:**


* Experience: 4 years with Masters as Education background, 6\+ years with Bachelors as Education background and experience in the relevant domain.
* Analytics Solutions: Proven experience in providing end to end analytics solutions, building story, analysis output presentations, and data management.
* Technical Skills: Exposure in leveraging appropriate tools / technology for data extraction, manipulation and analysis and solutions building solution, including SQL, SAS, Python, Pyspark, MS Excel, Tableau, and other BI tools.
* Coding Expertise: Strong coding expertise in SQL, Pyspark, Python and SAS
* Gen AI exposure: Hands\-on exposure building gen AI solution to improve productivity in Operations such as to automate Ops processes, Document summarizations and performance management solution.
* Visualization Tools: Experience with data visualization tools such as Tableau is advantageous.
* Banking Knowledge: Good understanding of the banking domain, banking products and Operations in banking is preferred.

title: Senior Associate / Associate Specialist – Planning & Forecasting Analyst
description:
**Job Purpose**

We are looking for a **Senior Associate / Associate Specialist – Planning & Forecasting Analyst** with strong analytical skills and finance acumen to help deliver the full monthly and annual planning and forecasting cycle for markets within the Planning & Forecasting Hub.

Success in the role requires the ability to think critically and constructively challenge key stakeholders. You will be instrumental in producing high quality, accurate and timely forecasts, plans and analysis that give management confidence and support decision making, while highlighting risks and opportunities. Along the way, you will build broad finance experience and a network of colleagues across our markets.

**Key responsibilities**

  

* Deliver the P&F promise to drive financial Plan commitments, ensuring reliability of forecast to support market guidance and smart resource allocation (P&F Standard scope, agreed exceptions and analysis requests):
* Reporting: P&L and Flash Sales performance commentaries and Price-Volume analysis, explaining variances to Plan, Last Year and forecast
* Forecasting: own the market forecast update including new product launches, consolidate Risks & Opportunities, and prepare presentations for management review
* Planning: annual Plan activities including managing the plan calendar and coordinating submissions and sign-offs
* Analysis: respond to ad hoc business requests
* Prepare management reports to support decision making. Be a point of contact for questions on reports
* Partner with senior Planning & Forecasting team members and embedded teams to reflect a realistic and ambitious outlook, with potential swings clearly articulated. Provide insightful intelligence on business performance drivers, anticipate risks and propose interventions to meet targets
* Work with the Close and Control hub to ensure accuracy of financial results and support financial compliance and financial risk management
* Create healthy accountability, ensuring promises are clear and delivered on time and in full to your customers. Navigate the cross-functional matrix and form an internal network, working closely with in-market Finance teams, area teams and the Close and Control hub, being both a reliable partner and an effective customer of the services you depend on
* Simplify how we work and drive globally aligned ways of working. Reduce non-standard work, and continuously improve agility and efficiency in planning, budgeting and forecasting through digital fluency and the adoption of AI in standard ways of working
* Build healthy, trustworthy relationships and role model a ONE Finance mindset

**Basic qualifications / experience**

  

* Experience of supporting a full planning and forecasting cycle
* 3 to 5yrs of experience into planning and forecasting.
* Strong analytical skills, with confidence working in spreadsheets and systems such as SAP and Microsoft Power BI, and the ability to turn data into clear, concise commentary
* Understanding of financial systems and processes, with an interest in digital, AI and automation.
* University degree in Finance or Business (or equivalent)
* Ability to connect with and influence business stakeholders
* Studying towards or holding a professional accountancy qualification.

Business Reporting Tools, Critical Thinking, Data Analytics, Data Visualization, Digital Fluency, Financial Controlling, Financial Reporting and Analysis, Influencing Without Authority, Stakeholder Management

title: Capacity Management Analyst (Immediate joiners preferred)
description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*

Job Category

Operations

Job Details

**About Salesforce**

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Our team is recruiting! What are we looking for?

The Workforce Strategy & Operations team manages the end-to-end workforce life cycle, globally, for services engagements. Capacity Planning is a dedicated function within the team. It is responsible for demand and supply forecasting, bench visibility and data-driven decision support for hiring and staffing strategy.

The Capacity Analyst is a hands-on data and modelling role. It supports capacity forecasting for our Global Delivery Center & APAC businesses.
  
This is not a role for reporting what the system already shows. We need someone who can take raw, messy data, clean it, model it and forecast beyond what is available in the system. They add their own analysis and intelligence, and turn the result into clear visuals that leaders can act on.

Key areas of responsibility include: Data Preparation & Integrity, Forecasting & Modelling, Visualization & Insight, Scope & Collaboration.
  
  
We are looking for someone with 3+ years of experience in capacity planning, workforce planning, data analytics or a similar analytical role. You should have proven data mining, statistical modelling and visualisation skills.

You should Up-skill on AI Fluency and AI-native delivery, using AI tools and developer assistants (e.g. Agentforce Vibes, Cursor, Claude).
  
  
**Data Preparation & Integrity**  
  

* Source, mine and combine data from multiple systems and offline sources, going beyond what is available in the system of record
* Clean, validate and reconcile large, messy datasets into a trusted, decision-ready source
* Correct known data issues (e.g. unrealistic demand swings) before they reach stakeholders
* Document data logic, assumptions and definitions so outputs are repeatable and auditable

  
**Forecasting & Modeling**  
  

* Build and maintain demand and supply forecasts across a rolling horizon of two high-likelihood quarters plus a third best-case quarter. This gives leadership enough runway for hiring decisions
* Develop statistical and predictive models, including scenario and sensitivity analysis, rather than only relying on system-reported numbers
* Model demand and supply at the role and cloud-practice level, so business leaders can self-serve more granular slices of the data
* Flag growth areas where in-house hiring or cross-skilling is the right call, rather than defaulting to subcontractor backfill
* Track forecast accuracy against actuals and continuously refine the models

  
**Visualization & Insight**  
  

* Own and evolve self-service dashboards (e.g. in Tableau)
* Maintain the supply & demand dashboard tracking demand change by role and skill
* Turn analysis into clear, visual data stories that show supply, demand and skills-profile challenges for leadership
* Add intelligence on top of the data: highlight drivers, risks and recommended actions, not just number

  
**Minimum Requirements**  
  

* Strong analytics background with proven data mining, statistical and data modelling skills
* Hands-on experience building forecasting models, not only consuming system reports
* Hands-on experience with Tableau or a similar BI tool, including building dashboards end to end
* Ability to interpret large, messy datasets and deliver clean, trustworthy data
* Ability to present analysis visually and clearly

  
  
  
**Must-Have Skills**  
  

* Capacity planning and forecasting modeling
* Data mining, cleansing and analytics
* Tableau (or equivalent BI tool such as Power BI)
* Dashboard design and maintenance
* Advanced Excel / Google Sheets
* SQL and/or Python (or R) for data prep and modeling
* AI-assisted analysis (e.g. Claude, Agentforce, ChatGPT, Gemini) for faster analysis, modeling and insight generation

  
**Good-to-Have Skills**  
  

* Workforce or resource management background
* CRM Analytics / Tableau Next
* Exposure to Org62 / FinancialForce (Certinia) or similar PSA tools
* Experience automating data pipelines and refreshes

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and *be your best* , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can *do your best* . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form .

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

Posting Statement

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

title: Research Analyst
description:
**About the team**
------------------

At Zillow, we understand that there’s nothing more powerful than home, providing physical and emotional security for today, and financial opportunity for tomorrow. But for many, finding and getting home is a challenge, marked by complexity at best, and real barriers at worst. So just as we gave customers the advantage of information that helped them to find home, today we’re giving them everything they need to get home. We believe that home should be more than just a dream and our purpose is to make home a reality for more and more people.
  
  
This has led our business to build solutions related to financing, buying, selling, and renting. Our work is also changing as we learn to collaborate in a cloud HQ environment, with team members spread across the nation. Together, we are all stewards of a promise we make to those we serve - a promise that is built on trust through every touchpoint people have with us. As a team, we are ensuring that every Zillow employee feels a sense of shared ownership of this promise, so they understand it, feel connected to it, and are equipped to live it every day.
  
  
In that light, Zillow's Brand Strategy & Insights (BS&I) team is kicking off a search for someone to help us better understand the perceptions of our customers and partners. Our team carries the brand measurement programs and research tooling the marketing organization uses to answer those questions with evidence, and to see whether the brand is gaining or losing ground over time.
  
As a Sr Insights Analyst, you will play a meaningful role in developing a truly iconic brand. This role reports to our Senior Manager, Insights

**Zillow Group is a strategic, mission-driven organization focused on delivering exceptional experiences and measurable outcomes.** Our work spans cross-functional partnership, scalable programs and operational excellence in support of Zillow’s mission. We bring deep experience working across diverse teams in a dynamic, high-growth environment, balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution to drive meaningful business impact. We are seeking an experienced professional to support our workforce expansion in India.

**About the role**
------------------

As a Senior Brand Measurement Analyst, you own the methodology, fielding, and analysis behind Zillow's brand measurement programs. You design and weight our longitudinal surveys, build the analyses that turns tracking data into a defensible read on brand health, and connect survey data to onsite behavioral data so the business can see which way a metric is heading and why.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own sampling plans, quotas, and weighting approaches across our longitudinal programs.
* Triangulate data with other sources to tell more complete stories.
* Write and maintain advanced questionnaires, including logic, branching, and bias checks, and make instrument changes that protect trend comparability.
* Build reproducible longitudinal analyses, and set the goal projections Marketing uses in annual planning.
* Build and maintain dashboards and AI-first automated reporting outputs so partners can answer their own questions without routing through us.
* Connect survey data to first-party behavioral data to explain why a metric moved.

This role has been categorized as an Office position. “Office” employees regularly work at the Zillow India office for approximately 80 to 100 percent of their time each month. Employees must live within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Zillow has not defined a reasonable distance, and expects employees will use judgment in determining this for themselves and understand the implications re: time commitment and cost of daily commute.

**Who you are**
---------------

* 5+ years in quantitative research, survey methodology, or marketing analytics.
* Expertise in survey design and methodology for repeated cross-sectional and longitudinal studies, including sampling, quotas, and weighting.
* Expertise in descriptive and inferential statistics, with proficiency in R or Python and SQL.
* Experience building reproducible analysis pipelines and automated reporting, ideally in Qualtrics and Databricks.
* Experience automating survey and analysis workflows using AI (Claude)
* Ability to translate analysis into concrete insight that a senior audience can act on, and to defend a methodological call when challenged.
* Experience collaborating with other marketing, data and analytics disciplines on combining disparate data sources.

**Get to know us**
------------------

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.

  

Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.

  

No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.

  

*Zillow Group is committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment and to providing equal employment opportunities. We comply with applicable laws that prohibit discrimination in employment and recruitment.*

  

*If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation during the recruitment process, please contact your recruiter directly.*

  

*Qualified applicants will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable law.*

Blue Yonder WMS certification preferred and any recognized certification in Generative AI or advanced data analytics such as a cloud provider AI certification

description:

NCR Voyix is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, and serves customers in more than 35 countries worldwide.**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Location:** Hyderabad / Chennai

**About Us**

NCR Voyix Corporation (NYSE: VYX) is a global technology company delivering technology solutions for the retail and hospitality industries across global markets.

**Role Overview**

Join our Edge Platform team as an **Engineering Manager**, leading and developing a team of software engineers responsible for delivering reliable, scalable platform capabilities used by multiple applications and customers.

You will be accountable for **people development, roadmap execution, engineering quality, and team effectiveness**, while partnering with Product Management, Architecture, SRE, QA, application teams, and engineering leaders across locations. You will operate within a **globally distributed engineering model**, where engineers may contribute to initiatives across teams and locations while continuing to receive people management, coaching, and career support locally.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead, coach, and develop software engineers through regular feedback, career development, performance management, mentoring, and meaningful growth opportunities.

* Own execution of committed roadmap priorities, ensuring predictable delivery with appropriate engineering quality, testing, security, reliability, and operational readiness.
* Partner with Product Management, Architecture, and engineering stakeholders to translate priorities into achievable plans and proactively manage dependencies, risks, and delivery challenges.
* Collaborate with engineering managers and globally distributed teams to align skills and capacity to priority initiatives, maintain clear ownership, and enable effective cross-site delivery.
* Enable application, integration/SIT, SRE, and other teams that depend on the platform through clear engagement, ownership, and effective technical collaboration.
* Maintain strong engineering practices across design, development, reviews, CI/CD, testing, release management, observability, and production support.
* Build sustainable team capability through hiring, onboarding, knowledge sharing, succession planning, and reducing dependency on individual engineers or locations.
* Use delivery, quality, operational, and team indicators to identify improvement opportunities and drive appropriate actions.
* Maintain sufficient technical depth to participate meaningfully in design discussions, engineering trade-offs, technical planning, and production escalations.
* Foster a culture of **ownership, collaboration, continuous learning, engineering quality, and continuous improvement**.

* **People Leadership:** Proven experience developing engineers through coaching, feedback, career planning, performance management, recognition, and development opportunities.
* **Engineering Execution:** Demonstrated ability to lead teams delivering complex software or platform roadmaps while balancing priorities, quality, dependencies, risks, and timelines.

* **Operational Excellence:** Strong understanding of production software practices including reliability, observability, incident management, release readiness, and continuous improvement.
* **Planning & Prioritization:** Ability to translate roadmap priorities into executable plans, balance capacity against commitments, manage dependencies, and make pragmatic trade-offs when priorities or constraints change.

* Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* **10–18 years of relevant software engineering experience**, including demonstrated engineering leadership or people-management responsibility.

* Experience leading teams responsible for production software, distributed systems, cloud platforms, SaaS products, or similarly complex technology environments.
* Demonstrated experience managing roadmap execution, engineering quality, cross-team dependencies, and stakeholder expectations.
* Strong understanding of modern software engineering practices across the complete development and production lifecycle.
* Experience building effective engineering teams through hiring, onboarding, coaching, performance management, and career development.
* Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in environments with changing priorities, dependencies, and business requirements.

**Desirable Experience**

* Experience managing **platform engineering, distributed systems, cloud-native, SaaS, infrastructure, or developer-platform teams**.

* Experience working with **globally distributed engineering teams**, including cross-site delivery, knowledge sharing, and distributed ownership.
* Familiarity with reliability engineering, observability, security, CI/CD, and production operations.
* Experience working with Product Management to deliver reusable platform capabilities consumed by multiple applications or customers.

title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
**Senior AI Platform Engineer – PDLC / Generative AI**

**About the role**

We are hiring a hands-on Senior AI Platform Engineer to take Generative AI use cases from proof of concept to secure, scalable production across our Product Development Lifecycle (PDLC) initiatives.

You will work with product, engineering, architecture, security and platform teams. Your focus is enterprise GenAI: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), agentic workflows, LLM integration, model abstraction and routing, and internal AI developer platforms such as Aura.

This role suits an engineer who knows that a successful AI solution is more than an LLM call. It needs strong software engineering, security, observability, evaluation, scalability and operational controls.

**Key responsibilities**

**GenAI solution engineering**

* Design and build production-grade GenAI and AI-assisted applications for PDLC use cases.
* Build and optimize RAG pipelines end to end: document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector search, retrieval, reranking, grounding and response generation.
* Build agentic workflows and tool integrations using modern orchestration frameworks and MCP-based patterns where appropriate.
* Integrate foundation and enterprise models (Claude, Gemini, OpenAI and internally hosted models) through secure APIs and AI platforms.

**Platform and architecture**

* Abstract the LLM layer so models can be evaluated, routed, upgraded or replaced without tight coupling to any one model.
* Work with platform teams on Aura-like capabilities: model gateways, prompt management, tool invocation, context management, model routing, usage controls and developer experience.
* Engineer for scale: concurrency, latency, caching, token utilization, resiliency, fallback strategies and cost optimization.

**Quality, security and operations**

* Establish AI evaluation frameworks covering response quality, grounding, hallucination, retrieval accuracy, latency, cost and regression testing.
* Build security in from day one: authentication and authorization, secrets management, data protection, prompt-injection defenses, model and data isolation, auditability and secure tool execution.
* Ensure compliance with enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, privacy, data governance and responsible-AI requirements.
* Implement production observability for prompts, model calls, agent and tool execution, retrieval performance, errors, latency, token consumption and cost.

**Enablement and leadership**

* Partner with application teams to turn AI prototypes into maintainable production services using sound API, microservice, CI/CD and cloud-native practices.
* Lead technical design and code reviews, and create reusable patterns adopted across multiple PDLC initiatives.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies and judge where they add real engineering or productivity value versus unnecessary complexity.

Required skills and experience

* Strong software engineering background, building production systems in Python, Java, Go, TypeScript or similar.
* Hands-on experience designing and implementing RAG-based applications.
* Solid grasp of LLM APIs, prompting, structured outputs, embeddings, vector databases, context management and retrieval techniques.
* Experience developing enterprise Generative AI or AI platform capabilities.
* Experience with agent frameworks, tool/function calling and multi-step AI workflows.
* Strong understanding of cloud-native architecture, containers, Kubernetes, APIs, distributed systems and scalable service design.
* Experience deploying AI workloads on a major cloud platform, preferably GCP.
* Experience with vector and search technologies such as Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus or Vertex AI Vector Search.
* Working knowledge of LLM evaluation, observability, experimentation and production monitoring.
* Strong application and AI security knowledge: OWASP principles, prompt injection, data leakage, identity and access controls, secrets management and secure API integration.
* Experience with CI/CD, automated testing, infrastructure-as-code and production operations.
* Ability to collaborate across application engineering, architecture, AI/ML, cybersecurity, cloud and product teams.

Preferred experience

* Built or contributed to an internal AI developer platform, AI gateway, developer copilot or a platform comparable to Aura.
* Implemented model gateways, model routing, fallback mechanisms, quotas, token budgets, caching and cost controls.
* Built MCP servers or clients and enterprise tool integrations.
* Used LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel or comparable orchestration frameworks.
* Worked with Vertex AI / Model Garden, Anthropic Claude, Gemini, OpenAI or self-hosted open-source models.
* Implemented AI red-teaming, automated security testing and responsible-AI controls.
* Modernized traditional applications or development processes using AI-assisted engineering.

Technology environment

Area

Technologies

Languages

Python, Java, Go, TypeScript

Models

Claude, Gemini, OpenAI, internally hosted and open-source models

Orchestration

LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, MCP

Retrieval

Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, Vertex AI Vector Search

Cloud and runtime

GCP (Vertex AI, Model Garden), containers, Kubernetes

Engineering practice

CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, automated testing, observability

What success looks like

Success means PDLC teams move past AI proofs of concept to repeatable patterns for secure, scalable, observable and cost-effective AI in production.

* **First 90 days:** understand the PDLC portfolio and platform landscape, and help take at least one GenAI use case toward production.
* **First 6 months:** publish reusable reference patterns for RAG, agents, evaluation and security that other teams adopt.
* **First 12 months:** be the go-to technical resource PDLC teams engage to speed delivery while meeting enterprise engineering and security standards.

How to apply

Send your CV with a short note covering:

* A GenAI or RAG system you took to production, and your role in it.
* How you handled evaluation, security and cost for that system.
* Your notice period and current location.
