title: Senior Associate Technical Operations
description:
#### **Overview**

Founded in 1988, Trimont (www.trimont.com) is a specialized global commercial real estate loan services provider and partner for lenders and investors seeking the infrastructure and capabilities needed to help them scale their business and make informed, effective decisions related to the deployment, management and administration of commercial real estate secured credit. As the largest master servicer of commercial real estate loans in the United States, Trimont manages securitizations with meticulous oversight and coordination—protecting cash flows, mitigating risk, and ensuring portfolio performance.

TriVinna, a Trimont company, is rebuilding commercial real estate lending software from the ground up. For decades, CRE lenders have run trillion-dollar portfolios on fragmented legacy systems, disconnected spreadsheets, and manual re-keying of borrower financials, rent rolls, and loan events. Leveraging Trimont’s access to approximately 11% of all U.S. commercial real estate lending data and nearly four decades of servicing expertise, we are building an AI-native platform that captures loan data at the source, unifies it across the full loan lifecycle, and turns it into decisions lenders can act on.

TriVinna is an innovative firm where visionary professionals come to learn, grow, and thrive with colleagues driven by curiosity and collaboration.

* **Learn:** We believe ongoing learning is critical and are focused on providing a work environment where all team members can take ownership of their careers.
* **Grow:** We work alongside the largest institutional lenders in the world, overseeing the most significant projects in the industry. This unique opportunity allows us to broaden our skillset and develop our abilities by tackling some of the industry’s most challenging and exciting endeavors.
* **Thrive:** Our firm is a place where ethics and excellence meet to create an experience that matches our capabilities. There are no limits to what we as team members and as an organization, can achieve together.

*Where people, purpose, and progress come together every day.*

#### **Job Summary**

TriVinna is seeking an Operations Manager to handle day-to-day logistics for our Hyderabad team. Our engineers, analysts, and product teams in India work hand in hand with colleagues across the United States to build software that is changing how commercial real estate lenders work. Great work across two continents depends on the details being handled well: the right people in the right room, at the right time, with everything they need.

You will be our US leadership’s eyes, ears, and hands on the ground in Hyderabad. You will coordinate schedules across time zones, run logistics for visits and events, manage purchasing and vendors, set up and look after our workspaces, and act on the team’s behalf whenever something needs to happen, or be seen, in person. You will also be the engineering managers’ right hand on team records: keeping sprint records current, matching task assignments to who is actually available, and making sure great collaboration and wins get noticed and rewarded. This is a high-trust role for someone who is organized, resourceful, and calm under pressure, and who takes pride in making a growing team run smoothly.

#### **Key Responsibilities**

**Scheduling and coordination**

* Coordinate calendars and meetings across India and US time zones for leadership and the Hyderabad team.
* Plan and run the logistics for leadership visits, team gatherings, offsites, and client or partner meetings in India.
* Keep shared calendars, agendas, and follow-ups organized so nothing falls through the cracks.

**Office and workspace**

* Set up, maintain, and improve our Hyderabad workspaces, including desks, meeting rooms, equipment, and supplies.
* Serve as the main point of contact for facilities, building management, and on-site vendors.
* Coordinate new joiners’ first days on site: workspace, equipment, access, and a warm welcome.

**Purchasing and vendors**

* Manage purchasing for the Hyderabad team, from supplies and equipment to services, within budget and company policy.
* Find, evaluate, and manage local vendors, and keep clear records of orders, invoices, and spend.
* Work with Trimont’s finance, procurement, and IT teams to follow the right processes and keep purchases moving.

**Events and culture**

* Organize team dinners, celebrations, and events that build connection across a growing team.
* Arrange travel, accommodation, and local logistics for visiting colleagues.

**On-the-ground support**

* Act as the US team’s representative in Hyderabad whenever something needs to be handled, checked, or observed in person, and report back clearly and promptly.
* Spot operational problems early, propose practical fixes, and follow them through.
* Build and document simple, repeatable processes as the team grows.

**Sprint records and team support**

* Keep the team’s sprint records up to date: what was planned, what was finished, and what carried over.
* Reconcile task assignments with real life, such as planned leave, sick days, and Indian and US holidays, and flag capacity gaps to engineering managers before they affect a sprint.
* Maintain the team’s shared leave and holiday calendar across both countries.
* Help engineering managers note strong collaboration and notable wins, and organize recognition and rewards for the people behind them.

#### **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Management, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 4-8 years of experience in office management, operations, or executive support.
* Experience supporting teams that work with colleagues in the United States or other countries, including coordinating across time zones.
* Strong organization and follow-through, with the ability to manage many moving parts at once.
* Experience managing purchasing, vendors, and budgets.
* Excellent written and spoken English, and confidence communicating with senior leaders.
* Strong attention to detail and record-keeping, including comfort with tracking tools such as Jira or spreadsheets. No technical background is required.
* Flexibility to work some hours that overlap with the US business day.

#### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in a technology company or a fast-growing team in India.
* Experience supporting software or project teams, such as keeping sprint or project records, leave calendars, or team recognition programs.
* Experience with facilities management, workspace setup, or office moves.
* Experience planning events and corporate travel.
* Familiarity with modern collaboration tools, such as shared calendars, spreadsheets, and AI assistants, and a habit of using them to work faster.
* Experience working within the policies of a larger parent organization.

#### **How We Work**

* **Be the reliable one.** When you say it will be handled, it is handled, and people know they can count on you.
* **Think ahead.** You anticipate what a visit, event, or new joiner will need before anyone asks.
* **Report clearly.** When you observe or handle something on the team’s behalf, you say what you saw, what you did, and what still needs a decision.
* **Spend wisely.** You treat the company’s money and time as carefully as your own.
* **Raise issues early.** If something is going to slip, you say so the day you see it, with what you need to fix it.

#### **Why This Role**

Commercial real estate lending is one of the largest asset classes in the world, and it still runs on software built for a different era. The team building what replaces it spans two continents, and this role is what keeps it running as one. This is a rare chance to shape how a growing team works, backed by the operational expertise of the largest master servicer in the United States.

* **Be essential.** Keep a world-class team focused on building by handling everything around them.
* **Build it as it grows.** Set up the spaces, processes, and rhythms of a growing Hyderabad team.
* **Work across borders.** Partner directly with leaders in the United States and India.
* **Be part of something new.** Help a team that is changing how commercial real estate lending works.

Trimont and TriVinna are equal opportunity employers, and we’re proud to support and celebrate diversity in the workplace. If you have a disability and need an accommodation or assistance with the application process and/or using our website, please contact us. We are proud to maintain a drug-free policy, ensuring that our community is a secure and productive space for all our team members.

title: Staff Data Engineer
description:
As a Staff Data Engineer on FloQast's Data Platform team, you'll be a key technical leader setting the direction for how our data is modeled and transformed, and how it becomes the foundation for data intelligence. In this role you'll focus on transformation and the shared derived models that analytics, product, and AI teams build on, applying modern AI and machine learning to the financial data our customers work with every day. You will define the standards and patterns that make that data trustworthy, well-documented, and ready for AI to use.  
  
You've spent years turning complex source data into models that many teams rely on. You design shared models around real business questions, write dbt and Spark transformations with tests and documentation, and know when a model needs a rewrite rather than another patch. You drive decisions on how data is modeled, transformed, and served, and you own the outcome in production, from design through the decisions that follow. At this level, you don't just build models. You set the standards and the architecture others build on.  
  
At FloQast, you'll apply that depth across our lakehouse and AI stack. Job Posting: Senior Electronics Engineer (8+ Years Experience)

Job Title: Senior Electronics Engineer

Experience: 8+ Years

Location: Pune, Maharashtra (On-site)

Employment Type: Full-Time

Salary Range: ₹20,00,000 – ₹26,00,000+ per year (Commensurate with experience; up to ₹32+ LPA for top-tier global R&D / GCC profiles)

About the Role

We are seeking a seasoned Senior Electronics Engineer with 8+ years of hands-on experience in end-to-end electronics hardware design, development, and testing. In this role, you will take full ownership of the architecture, schematic design, PCB layout oversight, board bring-up, and validation of high-reliability electronic systems—guiding products from initial concept through prototyping, compliance certification, and mass production.

If you thrive in high-reliability hardware/aerospace & embedded product development environments and bring deep expertise in high-speed digital design or mission-critical compliance (DO-160 / MIL-STD), we want to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities

System Architecture & Circuit Design: Lead the design and development of complex analog, digital, and mixed-signal electronic assemblies, including embedded processors/microcontrollers, FPGAs, power management systems, and advanced sensor interfaces.

Schematic Capture & Simulation: Perform detailed schematic entry, component selection (factoring in obsolescence and cost), worst-case circuit analysis, and simulations using tools like LTspice, PSpice, or MATLAB.

PCB Layout & Signal Integrity: Collaborate closely with layout engineers (or execute layouts directly) for high-density, multi-layer boards, ensuring strict adherence to Signal Integrity (SI), Power Integrity (PI), EMI/EMC, and thermal management guidelines.

Board Bring-Up & Validation: Own hardware debugging, board bring-up, root-cause analysis (RCA), and functional/environmental stress testing using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, spectrum analyzers, and network analyzers.

**ABOUT MACHINE MAKER**  
Machine Maker (an initiative of Mart Infomedia Private Limited) is a B2B media platform focused on the manufacturing sector, connecting manufacturers, industry professionals, SMEs, technology providers and other stakeholders. Through print, digital, visual storytelling and on-ground events, Machine Maker highlights industry trends, innovations, business developments and the people shaping Indian manufacturing.

**ROLE OVERVIEW**  
The Sales Manager – B2B Media & Business Development will drive revenue growth by acquiring new clients, expanding existing accounts and developing integrated media partnerships across Machine Maker’s print, digital, video, social media, webinar, event and exhibition platforms. The role requires a consultative sales approach: understanding a client’s marketing and business objectives, translating them into relevant media solutions, and owning the commercial process from prospecting to closure, execution coordination, renewal and collections. The Manager will also strengthen sales discipline, reporting and team performance.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**• Revenue Strategy & Target Ownership:** Develop and execute monthly, quarterly and annual sales plans; own assigned revenue targets, budgets, forecasts and conversion goals across the media portfolio.

**• New Business Development:** Build a strong prospect pipeline through research, outbound calls, email, LinkedIn, referrals, networking, industry databases, trade fairs and manufacturing events. Identify decision-makers in marketing, corporate communications, business leadership and product divisions.

**• B2B Media & Advertising Sales:** Pitch and sell relevant solutions including print advertising, digital display and website visibility, sponsored articles and branded content, video interviews / brand films, social media campaigns, newsletters, webinars, event partnerships, exhibition visibility and integrated packages, as applicable to the current portfolio.

**• Industrial Market Coverage:** Develop accounts across manufacturing and allied sectors such as machine tools, automation, robotics, engineering, industrial components, cutting tools, metrology, material handling, industrial software, electronics, automotive, aerospace, energy and manufacturing services.

**• Consultative Selling & Proposals:** Understand client objectives, target audiences, campaign budgets and timelines. Prepare tailored media plans, proposals, presentations, quotations, sponsorship packages and commercial recommendations that demonstrate value and expected deliverables.

**• Negotiation & Deal Closure:** Lead commercial discussions, negotiate rates and terms within approved pricing and discount policies, follow up systematically, close business and ensure written confirmation / purchase orders or insertion orders are secured.

**• Account Management & Retention:** Own relationships with assigned clients and agencies; conduct regular reviews, identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities, secure renewals and build long-term strategic partnerships.

**• Campaign Handover & Delivery:** Coordinate with editorial, digital, design, video, social media, production and event teams to communicate approved scope, specifications, timelines and client expectations. Monitor delivery against commitments and escalate risks early.

**• Client Servicing & Reporting:** Ensure timely client communication, campaign updates, proof of publication / delivery and post-campaign reports where relevant. Capture feedback and resolve service issues in coordination with internal teams.

**• Sales Operations & CRM:** Maintain accurate CRM / lead tracker records, contact history, meeting notes, proposal status, deal value, probability, next action and closure dates. Keep pipeline data current and submit weekly and monthly reports.

**• Market Intelligence:** Track competitor offerings, media rates, industry events, marketing trends and client activity. Share market insights and product feedback to improve Machine Maker’s commercial offerings.

**• Team Leadership & Collaboration:** Guide and support sales executives where applicable, review activity and pipeline quality, coach on pitches and follow-ups, share best practices and foster accountability for collective targets.

**• Invoicing & Collections:** Coordinate with accounts and clients on billing milestones, payment follow-ups and outstanding receivables; support timely collections in line with company policy.

**• Industry Representation:** Represent Machine Maker professionally at exhibitions, conferences, customer visits, networking forums and industry associations; build relationships with senior stakeholders across the manufacturing ecosystem.

**REQUIRED SKILLS & COMPETENCIES**

**•** Strong B2B sales, consultative selling, business development and revenue ownership capabilities.

**•** Excellent communication, presentation, pitching, negotiation and stakeholder-management skills.

**•** Ability to prospect independently, reach senior decision-makers and convert leads into paying accounts.

**•** Understanding of media sales, advertising formats, sponsorships, branded content and integrated marketing solutions.

**•** Commercial acumen, including proposal development, pricing, margin awareness, forecasting and deal management.

**•** Strong account-management skills with the ability to retain, grow and renew client relationships.

**•** Working knowledge of CRM systems or structured sales trackers, MS Excel / Google Sheets and PowerPoint / presentation tools.

**•** Ability to interpret campaign briefs, coordinate cross-functional execution and manage multiple deadlines.

**•** Data-driven approach to pipeline reviews, sales reporting, conversion analysis and performance improvement.

**•** Self-motivated, organised, resilient and comfortable working in a target-driven environment with regular client meetings and industry travel.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE**

**•** Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Sales, Mass Communication or a related discipline; an MBA / postgraduate qualification is an advantage.

**•** 5+ years of experience in B2B sales, media sales, advertising sales, publishing, sponsorship sales, events or business development.

**•** Prior experience selling to manufacturing, engineering, industrial technology or other enterprise B2B clients is strongly preferred.

**•** Experience managing key accounts, annual media plans, integrated campaigns, event sponsorships or high-value commercial partnerships.

**•** Prior experience mentoring or supervising sales executives is an advantage.

**•** Existing relationships with manufacturing brands, marketing heads, advertising agencies or industry associations will be an added advantage.

**KEY PERFORMANCE AREAS (KPIS)**

**•** Achievement of monthly, quarterly and annual revenue targets.

**•** New client acquisition and revenue generated from new accounts.

**•** Qualified lead generation, meeting activity, proposal volume and lead-to-deal conversion rate.

**•** Revenue mix and sales across print, digital, video, branded content, events and sponsorship offerings.

**•** Average deal value, gross contribution / margin discipline and quality of commercial closures.

**•** Existing-client retention, renewal rate, repeat business, upsell and cross-sell revenue.

**•** Pipeline coverage, forecast accuracy and timely CRM / sales tracker updates.

**•** Timely campaign handover, client satisfaction and fulfilment of agreed deliverables.

**•** Timely invoicing coordination and collection of receivables.

**IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE**

A commercially driven B2B sales professional who can confidently engage with business owners, marketing leaders and senior decision-makers in the manufacturing ecosystem. The candidate should combine a hunter’s mindset for new business with the discipline to manage accounts, forecast revenue and work collaboratively with internal teams to deliver measurable value to clients.

title: DevOps Engineer II
description:
**Job Description**

**CloudOps Engineer II**
========================

**Location:** Jasola, Delhi

**About Chegg**
---------------

  

Chegg is a student-first learning and skilling company focused on helping learners build confidence, develop practical skills, and achieve better outcomes. Our teams use technology, data, and thoughtful product experiences to make learning and skill development more accessible, useful, and effective for learners around the world.

  

**About the Role**
------------------

  

As a CloudOps Engineer II, you will help build, operate, and improve secure, reliable, scalable, and cost-efficient cloud infrastructure. You will work closely with engineering, security, and product teams to automate infrastructure, support deployments, strengthen observability, troubleshoot production issues, and reduce operational toil.

  

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Design, provision, and maintain AWS infrastructure using Terraform and other automation practices.
* Build, maintain, and troubleshoot CI/CD pipelines that enable safe, frequent software delivery.
* Administer and troubleshoot systems across development, staging, and production environments.
* Create Python or Bash automation to reduce manual effort and improve operational consistency.
* Implement and improve monitoring, logging, and alerting to support system health and rapid incident detection.
* Respond to production incidents, contribute to root-cause analysis, and drive follow-up remediation.
* Review cloud resources for security, reliability, performance, scalability, and cost optimization.
* Partner with engineering and security teams on deployments, capacity planning, and infrastructure design.
Maintain clear runbooks, operational procedures, and infrastructure documentation.  

  

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* **2+ years of hands-on experience** in CloudOps, DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or a similar role.
* Strong practical experience working with the AWS Cloud.
* Practical systems troubleshooting skills, with a working understanding of networking concepts in cloud environments.
* Experience with infrastructure as code, preferably Terraform.
* Proficiency in automation or scripting; Python is preferred, and Bash experience is valuable.
* Working knowledge of CI/CD and monitoring or observability platforms; experience with GitLab CI/CD is preferred.
* Strong understanding of DevOps principles and cloud operations practices.
* Ability to work calmly through production issues, collaborate across teams, communicate clearly, and continuously learn and adopt new technologies.
Hands-on experience with Docker.  

  

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with container orchestration platforms such as Amazon ECS, Kubernetes, or Amazon EKS.
* Exposure to cloud security, secrets management, vulnerability management, or compliance practices.
* Familiarity with AWS cost optimization or FinOps principles.
* Relevant AWS certification or experience in a consumer-facing technology company.
Comfort using AI-assisted engineering tools responsibly to improve day-to-day productivity.  

  

**Join Us**
-----------

If you are curious, collaborative, and motivated to build reliable cloud platforms while continuously learning and adopting new technologies, we would like to hear from you. Join Chegg and help shape technology that supports learning and skilling for learners around the world.

Why do we exist?

Students are working harder than ever before to stabilize their future. Our recent research study called State of the Student shows that nearly 3 out of 4 students are working to support themselves through college and 1 in 3 students feel pressure to spend more than they can afford. We founded our business on provided affordable textbook rental options to address these issues. Since then, we’ve expanded our offerings to supplement many facets of higher educational learning through Chegg Study, Chegg Math, Chegg Writing, Chegg Internships, Chegg Skills, and more to support students beyond their college experience. These offerings lower financial concerns for students by modernizing their learning experience. We exist so students everywhere have a smarter, faster, more affordable way to student.

title: Executive | Control-M Administrator / Developer
description:

Our team collaborates with infrastructure, application and cloud engineering teams to modernise scheduling services and improve operational resilience.

We are a global financial services group operating in 30 markets with 57 years of unbroken profitability. At Macquarie, you’re empowered to shape a career that is fulfilling and creates value. ### **What role will you play?**

In this role, you will manage and support the enterprise Control-M platform while designing scalable scheduling workflows and automation solutions. You will monitor critical batch processing, resolve production incidents, lead root-cause analysis and support platform upgrades and cloud migrations across AWS environments.

### **What you offer**

* 3 to 5 years of extensive experience in BMC Control-M administration and development, including Enterprise Manager, Servers, Agents, workflows, calendars, dependencies and scheduling migrations.
* Experience with Control-M Automation API and software development or scripting using Python or Java, supported by strong Linux/Unix production support skills.

* Proven ability to troubleshoot high-severity production issues, perform root-cause analysis, manage upgrades and patches, and work within incident, problem and change management processes, including P1/P2 and on-call support.
* Strong ownership, communication and automation mindset; experience in financial services or a large enterprise is valued, with Terraform, Ansible, Agile/Scrum or relevant Control-M, AWS or Kubernetes certifications considered advantageous.

  

We love hearing from anyone inspired to build a better future with us, if you're excited about the role or working at Macquarie we encourage you to apply.

### **What we offer**

At Macquarie, you’re empowered to shape a career that’s rewarding in all the ways that matter most to you. Macquarie employees can access a wide range of benefits which, depending on eligibility criteria, include:

  
  

* 1 wellbeing leave day per year
* 26 weeks’ paid maternity leave or 20 weeks’ paid parental leave for primary caregivers along with 12 days of paid transition leave upon return to work and 6 weeks’ paid leave for secondary caregivers
* Company-subsidised childcare services
* 2 days of paid volunteer leave and donation matching
* Benefits to support your physical, mental and financial wellbeing including comprehensive medical and life insurance cover, the option to join parental medical insurance plan and virtual medical consultations extended to family members
* Access to our Employee Assistance Program, a robust behavioural health network with counselling and coaching services
* Access to a wide range of learning and development opportunities, including reimbursement for professional membership or subscription

### **About Technology**

Technology enables every aspect of Macquarie, for our people, our customers and our communities. We’re a global team that is passionate about accelerating the digital enterprise, connecting people and data, building platforms and applications and designing tomorrow’s technology solutions.

### **Inclusion at Macquarie**

We are committed to providing an inclusive environment for all, where different experiences, skills and perspectives are valued and respected. Macquarie provides access to opportunities for all individuals regardless of race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, genetic information, marital status, gender identity or any other characteristic or circumstance.

title: Specialist-HVAC
description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
  
  
Your impact
  
  
**Job Summary**
The HVAC Subject Matter Expert (SME)/Specialist - provides strategic and technical leadership in the design, validation, and operation of HVAC systems for pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities. This role ensures compliance with global regulatory standards (cGMP, WHO, USFDA, EU-GMP) and supports cross-functional teams in delivering robust, compliant, and energy-efficient HVAC solutions. The SME is recognized as an expert with deep, specialized knowledge of HVAC systems, providing technical leadership for complex design, operation, and maintenance projects. His role involves high-level strategic planning, problem-solving, and quality assurance, within the organization, contributing to functional strategy, solving complex problems, and leading initiatives that have a broad impact on business operations. Manage the activity as assigned by Group Lead / DM.
  
  
**HVAC Technical Expertise & Design Leadership**

* Serve as the go-to expert for all HVAC-related technical matters.

* Recognized as an expert within the company with in-depth expertise in HVAC and broad knowledge of related disciplines (e.g., automation, quality, validation).
* Serve as the subject matter expert for all HVAC-related technical matters across pharmaceutical projects.
* Lead HVAC system design and engineering, ensuring compliance with ASHRAE, ISHRAE, NBC, EU GMP Annex 1, USFDA 21 CFR Part 11, WHO, ISPE, and ISO 14644.
* Design and validate HVAC systems for sterile and non-sterile pharmaceutical manufacturing areas, including cleanroom classification, pressure cascade zoning, and HEPA filtration.
* Review and validate complete HVAC design packages including heat load calculations, AHU zoning, pressure zoning, and equipment selection.
* Perform CFD analysis and energy modelling to optimize airflow, thermal zoning, and system efficiency.
* Develop and maintain HVAC design standards, specifications, and best practices across regulated environments.

**Project & Performance Management**

* Lead HVAC project execution across pharmaceutical facilities, managing timelines, budgets, and multidisciplinary resources.
* Oversee HVAC scope definition, procurement strategy, and contractor coordination to ensure timely and cost-effective delivery.
* Conduct risk assessments and implement mitigation plans for HVAC-related project risks including compliance delays and equipment failures.
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams to ensure HVAC deliverables align with overall facility design and operational goals.
* Establish KPIs and dashboards to monitor HVAC system reliability, compliance, uptime, and energy efficiency across multiple sites.
* Implement performance tracking systems for HVAC assets using CMMS and BMS/EMS integrations.
* Lead commissioning and qualification activities, ensuring HVAC systems meet design intent and regulatory requirements.
* Manage change control processes for HVAC scope modifications, ensuring documentation and validation are updated accordingly.
* Conduct post-project reviews and lessons-learned sessions to drive continuous improvement in HVAC project execution.
* Maintain comprehensive project documentation including meeting minutes, hold lists, comment logs, assumption registers, and technical clarifications.

**Regulatory Compliance & External Representation**

* Ensure HVAC systems meet global regulatory standards and inspection readiness criteria.
* Prepare and review HVAC validation protocols (DQ, IQ, OQ, PQ), risk assessments, and change control documentation.
* Represent the organization in regulatory audits, external forums, and industry working groups.
* Develop internal HVAC audit frameworks and conduct periodic gap assessments for GMP and Pharmaceuticals standards.
* Anticipates internal and external business challenges, vendor and regulatory issues, and recommends improvements to processes, products, or services.

Qualification - B.Tech Mechanical (Full time)

Experience in Pharma/Lifescience projects

title: TC-CS-IAM-ISAM-GIG
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**GIG- ISAM**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**Role Summary**
As part of our EY-cyber security team, you shall Engage in Identity & Access Management projects in the capacity of execution of deliverables. An important part of your role will be to actively establish, maintain and strengthen internal and external relationships. You’ll also identify potential business opportunities for EY within existing engagements and escalate these as appropriate.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We’re looking for Security Consultant in the cyber security team to work on various Identity and Access Management projects for our customers across the globe. Also, the professional shall need to report any identified risks within engagements and share any issues and updates with senior members of the team.
  
  
In line with EY’s commitment to quality, you’ll confirm that work is of the highest quality as per EY’s quality standards and is reviewed by the next-level reviewer. As an influential member of the team, you’ll help to create a positive learning culture, coach and counsel junior team members and help them to develop.
  
  
As a member of the Identity and Access Management (IAM) team this position will contribute towards execution of an IAM roadmap that meets security requirements, including but not limited to security for customer applications using policy driven security, SSO, authentication and authorization, user provisioning/de-provisioning, and federation focusing on multiple protocols (SAML2.0, OpenID, OAuth2.0, WS-FED).
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Engage and contribute to the Identity & Access Management projects
* Work effectively as a team member, sharing responsibility, providing support, maintaining communication and updating senior team members on progress
* Execute the engagement requirements, along with review of work by junior team members
* Help prepare reports and schedules that will be delivered to clients and other interested parties
* Develop and maintain productive working relationships with client personnel
* Build strong internal relationships within EY Consulting Services and with other services across the organization
* Help senior team members in performance reviews and contribute to performance feedback for staff/junior level team members
* Contribute to people related initiatives including recruiting and retaining IAM professionals
* Maintain an educational program to continually develop personal skills
* Understand and follow workplace policies and procedures
* Manage the performance management for the direct reportees, as per the organization policies
* Foster teamwork and lead by example
* Training and mentoring of project resources
* Participating in the organization-wide people initiatives

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong understanding of Identity Access Management solutions.
* Strong experience in designing and implementing Customer Identity and Access Management (CIAM) solutions, including customer registration, profile management, and self-service account capabilities.
* Knowledge of CIAM best practices, including customer lifecycle management, identity federation, consent management, privacy compliance, and secure customer onboarding.
* Hands-on experience on IBM Security Access Manager or IBM Security Verify Access end-to-end implementation involving requirement gathering, designing, implementation, customization and testing.
* Implementation experience in Web Module, Federation Module and Advance Access control module of IBAM/ISVA
* Hands-on experience with IBM ISAM WebSEAL administration, including configuration and management of various junction types, reverse proxy services.
* Experience implementing Single Sign on, Multi Factor Authentication, adaptive authentication, and customer/partner identity solutions using ISAM/ISVA.
* Working experience in application integration with header-based, SAML2.0, OIDC, OAuth2.0, WS-Fed protocols.
* Experience in implementing social login and third-party Identity Provider (IdP) integrations using ISAM/ISVA for secure authentication and federation use cases.
* Ability to design and customize authentication policies, access controls, identity workflows, and customer-facing access experiences.
* Experience in developing and integrating REST APIs, web services, and identity-related connectors to enable seamless customer and application integrations
* Ability to develop and maintain ISAM custom JavaScript mapping rules, API protection policies, and federation configurations.
* Proficiency in Java, JavaScript, and scripting technologies used for IAM customizations and automation.
* Experienced in diagnosing and resolving complex authentication, authorization, and federation issues.
* Experience in supporting platform administration activities, including upgrades, deployments, patching, and environment maintenance.
* Strong knowledge of certificate administration in ISAM, including troubleshooting SSL/TLS, signer, personal, and key database certificate-related issues.
* Understanding of IAM governance, configuration management, operational controls, and industry best practices.
* Willingness to work in a client-focused environment with flexibility to support evolving business and operational requirements.
* Should have knowledge of different integration and architecture in customer’s IAM environment such as Load Balancer, network components
* Understanding of latest technology such as Zero trust framework, Fine-grained authorization, Password less authentication, CIAM
* Ability to develop documentation such as business requirement document, high and low level design document, training and user procedures document.
* Should be flexible to work on new technologies in IAM domain.
* Should have had direct client experience, including working with client teams in an on-site or offshore mode.
* Need to liaise with Business stakeholders and seek requirement clarification. Should be able to map business requirements to technical specifications.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* B. Tech./ B.E. with sound technical skills
* Strong command on verbal and written English language.
* Relevant experience in IBM Security Access Manager or IBM Security Verify Access.
* Strong interpersonal and presentation skills.
* 5 – 9 Years’ Work Experience

**Certification:**

* Desirable to have certifications in security domain, such as CISSP and CISA or any IAM product specific certifications
* Desirable to have certifications in IBM Security Access Manager or IBM Security Verify Access

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment**
: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development**
: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture**
: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits**
: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply:**
If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

description:

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Role name**
**Senior, FAST Policy Admin System, Life Actuarial, EY GDS Consulting**
Be part of a high-performing, supportive culture
  
  

* Work with a team of collaborators, innovators and the brightest minds in the industry

Global Delivery Services is one of EY's greatest global assets – a network of service delivery centers that provide high-quality services at a competitive cost for all EY’s client serving and enablement teams. Every day, we combine our subject matter expertise with our technology and automation skills to develop new solutions that deliver greater value for EY. If you have a passion for enabling world class actuarial services globally to solve the most complex challenges in the financial services industry, come join our dynamic GDS team!
  
  
**The opportunity**
We are looking for a Senior to join our Life Insurance Actuarial Practice delivering FAST policy admin system team to the leading clients in Insurance Sector, working closely with other Staff/Assistants, Consultants/Seniors, Managers, Senior Managers or Client partners in EY’s global network of insurance sector and consulting professionals
  
  
You can expect to work along with senior managers/directors to support large scale engagements and deliver high-quality client solutions. You will develop and maintain long-term relationships and networks, build and energize a high performing team.
  
  
Our growing team of professionals come from a diverse background, all committed to being long term trusted advisors to our clients.
  
  
**Key Requirements**
As a Senior within the Life Policy Admin System or FAST product configuration team your role involves developing and implementing solutions both within the Insurance service line and in collaboration with other services lines.
  
  

* Strong life insurance and/or annuity product knowledge
* Product Values Testing (PVT) and expected-value development
* Actuarial testing tool development (Excel/VBA, Python preferred)
* Conversion validation and reconciliation experience
* Defect triage and root-cause analysis
* FAST, ALIP, LifePro, CyberLife, or similar PAS experience preferred
* Ability to translate product specifications into test scenarios and expected results
* Strong excel skills, capable of running and modifying macros used to transform Actuarial Cashflows
* Ability to develop regression models on excel to test the model developments
* Hands-on or Advance level experience in Life Policy Admin System or FAST product configuration.
* Strong experience on Excel is must and experience on VBA would be good
* Good experience of preparing PPT decks
* In-depth understanding of insurance products and regulations of US, Canada and other geographies

We are looking for individuals who have a proactive attitude and are seeking the opportunity for personal and professional growth, leveraging and supporting our global network.
  
  
**Skills And Attributes For Success**
Skills and attributes for a successful career at EY require a learning mindset and passion to add value to GDS, member firms and client organisations. Bright and enthusiastic individuals who give their all to each assignment they work on will find themselves at home within our energetic GDS actuarial team.
  
  
**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* 3-6 years of Life Policy Admin System or FAST product configuration experience in life team of an insurance / consulting / outsourcing company
* Good analytical skills
* Ability to do investigations in models / reporting process and independently solve problems
* Willingness to learn and apply learning actively in project work Proficiency in MS-Office Suite, Power BI, VBA, SAS, R Programming, Python, SQL, SPSS, etc., will be a plus

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Good actuarial exam progress
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for report writing, industry studies and stakeholder presentations
* The ability to build relationships with colleagues across the business, support them and promote a collaborative environment
* Overseas exposure (especially US/Canada/Europe market experience)

**What We Look For**

* Up to date knowledge of the regulatory environment impacting insurers and other financial service organisations
* Experience of supporting teams to high quality timely delivery, actively building relationships and promoting a collaborative culture when working with colleagues

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

title: Manager, Data Science and AI
description:
**Role Summary**
Data Science and AI Group harnesses the power of data to drive robust analytical insights that inform some of Pfizer's most critical business questions. With colleagues across the globe, DS&AI rigorous analytical expertise is depended on as the compass and decision support for the enterprise. Our dynamic, exciting team of subject-matter experts comes from diverse backgrounds and experiences, including market research, data science, digital analytics, finance, and consulting. As a team, we partner to turn data into meaningful insights that will have a direct impact on patient's lives and the future of Pfizer as a data-driven organization.
  
  
The person in this role is accountable for delivering data science projects in Emerging markets. The person will partner with IIS, Commercial and Medical teams, to develop and implement models and data-science derived insights that drive commercial strategic priorities. This will include executing and interpreting AI/ML models, framing problems, shaping solutions
  
  
Also, this person will help shape the brands’ strategies and tactics by interfacing closely with Data Science COEs and leveraging capabilities that have been developed around bespoke AI/ML models, and interface closely with omnichannel-operations to drive execution.
  
  
This role is dynamic, fast-paced, highly collaborative, and covers a broad range of strategic topics that are critical to our business. The successful candidate will join BAI colleagues worldwide that are constantly supporting business transformation through their proactive thought leadership, innovative analytical capabilities, and their ability to communicate highly complex and dynamic information in new and creative ways.
  
  
**Role Responsibilities**
Role definition and key accountabilities include, but are not limited to:
  
  
**Commercial and Medical Data Science and Insights**

* Provide data science hands on generated insights to Country Commercial and Medical teams to drive brand tactic decisions
* Assist to frame, investigate, translate complex data related models, and answer key business questions related to the identification and evaluation of Commercial and Medical brand strategies and tactics
* Connect machine learning models and insights together to identify Medical and Commercial brand opportunities and tactics to execute
* Guide Medical and Commercial brand teams via compelling and persuasive story and deliver clear and actionable brand tactic recommendations
* Track and analyze impacts of Medical and Commercial brand strategies and tactics using dashboards and data products

**Collaborate with Data Science COE**

* Partner with Data Science COE to develop bespoke AI and machine learning models; Configure pre-built models and interpret updated results
* Ensure alignment with Data Science COEs teams to ensure cohesive activities with stakeholders

**Collaboration With Other IIS And Analytics Teams**

* Partner with IIS market lead to incorporate and prioritize data science insights into analytics plans and recommendations
* Align across GCA & Data Science teams and Data Science COE teams to ensure cohesive activities with our stakeholders
* Partner with other analytic functions to advance the use of novel data sources, including RWD

**PROFESSIONAL CHARACTERISTICS**

* Analytical Thinker: Understands how to synthesize facts and information from varied data sources, both new and pre-existing, into discernable insights and perspectives; takes a problem-solving approach by connecting analytical thinking with an understanding of business drivers and how IIS can provide value to the organization
* Data and Information Manager: Understands and uses analytical skills/tools to produce data in a clean, organized way to drive objective insights
* Communicator: Can understand, translate, and distill the complex, technical findings of the data science team into commentary that facilitates effective decision making; can readily align interpersonal style with the individual needs of others
* Collaborative: Manages projects with and through others; shares responsibility and credit; develops self and others through teamwork
* Self-Starter: Takes an active role in one’s own professional development; stays abreast of analytical trends, and cutting-edge applications of data
* Hands on deep expertise with machine learning models, proficiency in:
* Python/R and at least one of visualization tools Tableau/Qlik/Power BI/Dash
* Strong hands-on experience in ML/LLM/Agentic platform development & deployment Knowledge of API, MCP, cloud environments and data engineering workflows
* Agentic Workflows ( multi step reasoning, reinforcement, Eval etc )
* Fluent in English (written and spoken), Spanish would be a plus
* Preferred experience in understanding pharmaceutical commercial product lifecycle, its strategy, and tactics
* Experience in management of secondary data with application of real-world data
* Ability to partner with cross-functional teams (Commercial, Medical, Operations) to generate insights and ensure actions
* Ability to connect, integrate and synthesize analysis and data into a meaningful ‘so what’ to drive concrete strategic recommendations for brand tactics. Capable of describing relevant caveats in data or in a model and how they relate to business question
* Ability to be flexible, prioritize multiple demands and deal with ambiguity
* 5+ years experience in data science function, country strategy and/or strategic consulting
* Experience using data science models to solve problems in a business environment setting

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree required, ideally in quantitative discipline like engineering or data science; also advanced degree preferred in business administration, statistics, or other relevant field

For external applicants and contractors, the initial contract for this position is set for one year, with the intention and possibility of extension based on performance and future business needs
  
  
Work Location Assignment: Hybrid
  
  
This role is posted in multiple locations. If you are applying for the role in an secondary job posting location where pay transparency regulations apply, your Talent Advisor will share the local pay information with you during the first interview.
  
  
Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates.
  
  
Pfizer's aim is to provide equality of opportunity in the recruitment process by avoiding any bias or potential discrimination on any grounds including (but not limited to): sex, age, race, religion or belief, sexual orientation or disability. At Pfizer we are creating an organization and promoting a culture that respects each individual's unique character and life experiences and reflects the diversity of our society, customers and markets. title: Maconomy Support Analyst
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role :**

  

As a Maconomy Support Analyst, you will provide Level 2 functional and transactional support for the Maconomy ERP platform, ensuring stable and efficient business operations across Finance, Projects, Billing, Purchasing, and related business functions. You will work closely with Finance teams, IT teams, and business stakeholders to resolve issues, improve processes, support system enhancements, and drive operational excellence across the ERP landscape.

  

**What Will You Do:**

  

* Provide Level 2 functional and transactional support for Maconomy ERP, ensuring timely resolution of incidents, service requests, and business-critical issues within SLA commitments.
* Investigate system issues, collaborate with technology teams to identify defects, perform root-cause analysis, and support timely remediation.
* Support ERP business processes including Accounting, Purchasing, Production, Distribution, Billing, Customer Order Management, and related operational functions.
* Create and maintain ERP process documentation, user manuals, operational procedures, knowledge articles, and support guides.
* Develop incident reports, project status reports, monthly service reports, and analytical insights to support decision-making and continuous improvement.
* Coordinate with Finance teams, key users, and IT teams to address operational challenges, gather requirements, and improve user experience.
* Support ERP enhancements, testing activities, special projects, system improvements, and ad-hoc business initiatives.
Conduct service review meetings with Finance leads and business stakeholders while promoting governance, best practices, and continuous improvement.  

  

Your Future at Kyndryl
  
The career path ahead is full of exciting opportunities to grow and advance within the job family. With dedication and hard work, you can climb the ladder to higher bands, achieving coveted positions such as Principal Engineer or Vice President of Software. These roles not only offer the chance to inspire and innovate, but also bring with them a sense of pride and accomplishment for having reached the pinnacle of your career in the software industry.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  

**Required Technical and Professional Experience:**

  

* 3+ years of experience working within complex global organizations in ERP support, ERP operations, or business systems support roles.
* Proven experience supporting ERP platforms such as Maconomy, SAP, Oracle, or Microsoft Dynamics 365, with Maconomy experience preferred.
* Strong understanding of ERP business processes including Finance, Accounting, Billing, Purchasing, Project Management, and operational workflows.
* Experience troubleshooting ERP applications, supporting system installations, investigating incidents, and resolving user issues.
* Experience documenting business processes, operational procedures, support knowledge bases, and user training materials.
* Strong reporting, analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills with the ability to identify improvement opportunities.
* Ability to build trusted relationships with Finance teams, business stakeholders, key users, and technology teams.
Excellent communication, organizational, stakeholder management, and time-management skills with the ability to work independently.  

  

**Preferred Professional and Technical Expertise:**

  

* Hands-on experience with Deltek Maconomy support, administration, implementation, or enhancement projects.
* Experience supporting Finance, Project Accounting, Professional Services Automation (PSA), or ERP transformation initiatives.
* Experience training end users and supporting ERP adoption, change management, and business process improvements.
* Familiarity with ERP reporting, testing methodologies, governance practices, and service management processes.
Experience with ERP/accounting software and relevant ERP certifications is highly desirable.  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

description:

Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.

  

**Job Overview**
----------------

Systems and Cloud Engineer – Global IT Infrastructure

**Location:** Kochi, Kerala  
**Work Model:** Work from Office  
**Department:** Global IT Infrastructure  
**Employment Type:** Full-time  
**Experience:** 5–7 years preferred

Role Overview

We are looking for a hands-on **Systems and Cloud Engineer – Global IT Infrastructure** to join our Global IT Infrastructure team based in Kochi.

The position will be responsible for supporting and managing critical infrastructure services across **virtualization, backup, Linux servers, infrastructure monitoring, SFTP, web/domain hosting, DNS, SSL/TLS certificates, AWS Cloud and DevOps-related technologies**.

The engineer will also serve as a secondary/backup resource for network infrastructure, supporting technologies such as **Palo Alto Networks firewalls, Cisco Switching, Cisco ISE and Cisco Meraki** when required.

This is an operational role requiring strong troubleshooting skills, ownership of infrastructure incidents and changes, good documentation discipline, and the ability to support a global IT environment.

Key Responsibilities

1. Virtualization – VMware

* Administer and support **VMware vSphere, ESXi and vCenter** environments.
* Manage VM provisioning, configuration, snapshots, resource allocation and lifecycle activities.
* Monitor virtualization infrastructure performance, availability and capacity.
* Troubleshoot virtual machine, hypervisor, storage and related infrastructure issues.
* Support infrastructure upgrades, patching and planned maintenance.

2. Backup & Recovery – Veeam

* Administer and maintain **Veeam Backup & Replication**.
* Monitor daily backup jobs and proactively resolve failures.
* Perform VM, server, file and application recovery as required.
* Conduct periodic restore testing to validate recoverability.
* Support backup retention, disaster recovery and business continuity requirements.
* Maintain backup and recovery procedures and documentation.

3. Linux Server Administration

* Administer and support **Linux-based servers and services**.
* Perform server provisioning, configuration, patching and upgrades.
* Monitor performance, disk utilization, processes and system services.
* Manage user access, permissions and basic security hardening.
* Troubleshoot Linux operating system and application/service-related issues.
* Use scripting and command-line tools for administration and automation.

4. Infrastructure Monitoring – OpManager

* Administer and maintain **ManageEngine OpManager**.
* Configure and monitor servers, network devices and infrastructure services.
* Manage alerts, thresholds, dashboards and notifications.
* Investigate infrastructure alerts and identify performance or availability problems.
* Perform proactive trend and capacity analysis to prevent service interruptions.

5. AWS Cloud

* Support and administer **Amazon Web Services (AWS)** environments.
* Assist with provisioning, configuration, monitoring and troubleshooting of AWS resources.
* Support services involving compute, storage, networking, IAM and monitoring.
* Follow cloud security, access-control and operational best practices.
* Assist with availability, performance and AWS cost-optimization initiatives.

6. DevOps & Automation

* Support DevOps-related infrastructure and operational requirements.
* Work with **Git/GitHub, CI/CD pipelines and scripting/automation** where applicable.
* Assist with infrastructure automation and repeatable deployment processes.
* Experience with technologies such as **Terraform, Ansible, Docker, PowerShell, Bash or Python** would be advantageous.
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive infrastructure administration and monitoring activities.

7. SFTP, Hosting, DNS & Certificates

* Administer and maintain **SFTP servers and secure file-transfer services**.
* Manage account access, permissions and connectivity troubleshooting.
* Support corporate and application **domain-hosting and DNS requirements**.
* Create and maintain DNS records and troubleshoot DNS-related issues.
* Manage **SSL/TLS certificates**, including certificate requests, renewals, deployments and expiry monitoring.
* Maintain an accurate inventory of domains and certificates to prevent service disruption due to expiration.

8. Network & Security Infrastructure – Backup Support

Act as a backup to the Network Engineer when required and provide operational support for:

* **Palo Alto Networks firewalls**
* **Cisco Switches**
* **Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE)**
* **Cisco Meraki**
* LAN/WAN connectivity
* VLANs and switching
* DNS/DHCP/IP addressing
* VPN connectivity
* Basic routing
* Firewall rules/policies
* Network troubleshooting

The candidate does not need to be a dedicated Network Engineer but should have sufficient networking knowledge to troubleshoot infrastructure issues and perform routine operational changes when required.

9. Incident, Request & Change Management

* Own and resolve infrastructure **incidents and service requests** within agreed service levels.
* Perform infrastructure changes through established **Change Management** processes.
* Troubleshoot infrastructure issues and perform root-cause analysis for recurring incidents.
* Participate in critical/major incident resolution.
* Coordinate with other Global IT teams, application teams and vendors as required.
* Ensure tickets and changes contain accurate technical details, resolution information and supporting documentation.

10. Security, Compliance & Documentation

* Maintain accurate infrastructure and operational documentation.
* Create and maintain:
  + Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)
  + Knowledge Base articles
  + Technical runbooks
  + Architecture/configuration documentation
  + Backup and recovery procedures
  + Certificate and DNS records
  + Infrastructure inventories
  + Change records
* Provide technical evidence and documentation for **security, compliance and audit requirements**.
* Support remediation of audit or compliance findings related to infrastructure.
* Follow organizational security standards and infrastructure hardening practices.

Required Skills & Experience

Candidates should ideally have:

* **4–7 years of relevant experience** in Systems, Infrastructure and/or Cloud Engineering.
* Strong hands-on experience with **VMware vSphere / ESXi / vCenter**.
* Good hands-on experience with **Veeam Backup & Replication**.
* Experience administering **Linux servers**.
* Experience with enterprise infrastructure monitoring tools, preferably **ManageEngine OpManager**.
* Working knowledge of **AWS Cloud**.
* Good understanding of **DNS, domains, SSL/TLS certificates and SFTP**.
* Strong infrastructure troubleshooting and root-cause-analysis capabilities.
* Understanding of networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, VLAN, DNS, DHCP, routing and switching.
* Familiarity with ITSM processes covering **Incident, Request, Problem and Change Management**.
* Experience creating technical, operational and compliance documentation.

Preferred / Good-to-Have Skills

Exposure to the following would be an advantage:

* Palo Alto Networks firewalls
* Cisco Switching
* Cisco ISE
* Cisco Meraki
* AWS infrastructure
* DevOps / CI/CD
* Terraform / Infrastructure as Code
* Ansible
* Docker
* PowerShell / Bash / Python scripting
* Git / GitHub
* Windows Server administration
* IT security and infrastructure hardening

Certifications – Preferred

Relevant industry certifications will be considered an advantage and are **not mandatory**.

Virtualization & Backup

* **VMware Certified Professional – Data Center Virtualization (VCP-DCV)** or equivalent VMware certification
* **Veeam Certified Engineer (VMCE)**

Cloud

* **AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate**
* **AWS Certified CloudOps Engineer – Associate** or equivalent AWS operations-focused certification

Linux

* **Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA)**
* **Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE)**
* Linux Foundation certifications such as **LFCS**

Networking & Security

* **Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA)**
* Relevant Cisco professional/specialist certifications
* Relevant **Palo Alto Networks** certifications

DevOps / Automation

* **HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate**
* Relevant DevOps, Kubernetes, Docker or automation certifications

IT Service Management

* **ITIL 4 Foundation**

Communication & Behavioral Skills

* **Good written and verbal communication skills in English are essential.**
* Able to communicate effectively with technical teams, end users, vendors and global stakeholders.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting abilities.
* Good ownership and accountability for assigned incidents and activities.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a global IT team.
* Strong documentation and knowledge-sharing discipline.
* Willingness and ability to learn new technologies.
* Ability to prioritize tasks during multiple simultaneous infrastructure incidents.

Location & Working Requirements

* The position is **based in Kochi, Kerala**.
* This is a **Work from Office position**.
* The engineer will support a **global IT environment** and therefore needs flexibility around working hours when business requirements demand it.
* Must be willing to provide **extended-hours support** during:
  + Critical/Major incidents
  + Infrastructure outages
  + Planned maintenance
  + Production changes
  + Upgrades and migrations
  + Disaster recovery activities
* Occasional weekend or after-hours support may be required for planned or critical infrastructure activities.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer - Intern
description:
**Forward Deployed Engineer — Intern**  
**Blue Machines AI**  
**Location:** Bangalore (in-office) | **Duration:** [3–6] months, full-time | **Reports to:** Engineering Manager, Forward Deployed Engineering

**About the role**

Blue Machines AI builds enterprise CX systems for clients in banking, insurance, health insurance and e-commerce — voice agents, workflow automation, and the integrations that tie both into the customer’s existing stack.

Forward Deployed Engineers own live accounts: keeping deployments healthy, root-causing what breaks, and turning interaction data into decisions for both the client and our product team. As an intern, you will work on real accounts from week one, alongside the FDE who owns them.

**What you’ll do**

* Map and configure client workflows on the platform — the full journey across voice, backend systems and human handoff, not just a single agent turn
* Run root cause analysis on production issues: trace a failed interaction across logs, integration calls and workflow steps down to a specific cause, then write it up so it does not recur
* Build and maintain the integrations these workflows run on — REST APIs, webhooks, CRM / ticketing / core system connections — and debug them when auth, payloads or timeouts break
* Own account reporting: containment and deflection rates, drop-off points, latency, resolution rates — including the queries and dashboards behind the numbers
* Analyse call transcripts and workflow logs at volume to find failure patterns and quantify their impact before proposing a fix
* Support UAT and go-lives with scenario testing across the whole workflow, plus defect logging and triage
* Document RCAs, runbooks and configuration so an account can be handed over cleanly
* Track your work in JIRA and join the daily standup

  
**Requirements**

**Must have**

* Final-year student or recent graduate in CS / IT / Engineering, or equivalent self-taught ability
* Python or JavaScript/TypeScript at a working level — enough to script, parse logs and call APIs
* SQL and genuine comfort with data — you can pull the number yourself, not just read a dashboard
* REST APIs, JSON, and a real debugging instinct: able to follow a problem across systems rather than stopping at the first error message
* Clear written English — RCAs and client updates are written deliverables
* Structured thinker who documents as they go

**Good to have**

* A BI or analytics tool (Metabase, Looker, Power BI or similar)
* Postman, Git
