A Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ Leader for 16 years in a row, Qlik helps teams get more out of AI with trusted data products, a powerful analytics engine, and AI agents. This helps teams reduce risk and operating costs, while scaling AI responsibly.

  

Used by 75% of the Fortune 500, Qlik works with the systems organizations already use, maintaining flexibility without lock-in.

**The Technical Support Engineer Role**

At Qlik, our support Technicians are our HEROES. That’s because our technicians do more than manage complex technical support cases they are determined, resilient, and have an unshakable positive mindset. Our team in Bangalore consists of support professionals from multiple backgrounds, who work and play closely together. We have a larger Global support team that we interact with daily, with locations in Bangalore, Barcelona, Lund, Sydney, Tokyo, China, Raleigh and North Carolina USA. We think you will love it here!

We operate 24x7 which involves working during one of the below shifts determined as per business need and have a non-standard work week (Ex: Tue - Sat, Wed - Sun). While we have 5 days a work week, your weekly offs may fall on any day of the week depending on the shift rosters that are prepared on a two-month basis.

* **AMER hours (Eastern Standard Time - 5.30 PM/6.30 PM IST or Pacific Standard Time – 8:30 PM/9:30 PM IST onwards depending on Daylight Savings Time)**
* **EMEA hours – 12:00 PM/1 PM/2PM IST onwards depending on Daylight Savings Time**
* **APAC hours – 5.30 AM IST onwards**

**Work hours are subject to change depending on Business needs.**

**What makes this role interesting?**

Teamwork is important and we are looking for someone who’s up for collaborating. A buddy will be there for you at the start, and you’ll report to the team manager.

We will support you in your onboarding and training, and we expect you to quickly take ownership of tasks. It won’t be long before you’re running your own assignments and making a real difference all by yourself. Prove yourself and you’ll find career progression will follow.

  

We’ll share ways of working and expect you to follow them, it’s all about keeping professional standards high and errors low while delivering the best experience and outcomes for our customers.

**Here’s how you’ll be making an impact:**

* The Technical Support Engineer team members will provide telephone, screen sharing, and ticket/chat-based support to our customers.
* Troubleshoots customer-submitted problems by working together with our customers in a collaborative manner.
* Keeps customers updated regularly with the current state of their tickets.
* Investigate customers’ current situation and desired end state to understand our customers’ needs and problems.
* Provides world-class customer experience by delivering satisfaction to every case for every customer.
* Interact with customers, understanding their problems and needs.
* Seeks workarounds and communicates technical solutions to the customer.
* Remain current with the Qlik and Talend product portfolio functions and features, and with related technologies in the DI ecosystem.
* Participate in the 24\*7 weekend support for production down tickets.
* Reproduces customer problems in the lab.
* Assists in translating the customer problem into suitable technical terms for the R&D Support team to work on.
* Exhaust all efforts according to the working procedures before escalating a case.
* Maintain a shared knowledge base across the team by writing technical solution articles, documenting lessons learned from support cases, and participating in weekly meetings.
* Keep case summaries on cases for escalations and continuity.
* Maintain coherent working procedures to reflect a professional attitude and maintain efficiency.

description:

VN1078

Bangalore

  

**About Solifi**

Solifi deliver a solid financial technology foundation for equipment, working capital, wholesale, and automotive finance firms. At Solifi, we believe that commerce is only as strong as the system it runs on. Our mission is to reshape finance technology by bringing together proven solutions into a singular powerful technology platform designed to help protect and scale financial organizations. We guard our customers by being precise and reliable, we guide their success by combining powerful technology with proven expertise, and we help them grow by unleashing their potential.

  

**About the Team**

We are a small, high-ownership AI team operating with the pace and ownership of a startup within a global enterprise. We build production grade AI products that are used by real customers, taking ideas from early experimentation and prototyping through evaluation, production deployment and continuous improvement. The team brings together AI product management, AI engineering and data expertise, with a strong emphasis on shipping, experimentation, quality and measurable customer outcomes. We work closely with product, engineering and domain teams across the business to identify where AI can create meaningful value and then build the systems required to deliver it reliably at scale. This is an opportunity to work on some of the core AI products shaping how modern AI is applied within enterprise software, while having significant influence over what we build, how we evaluate it and how AI products are built and operated in production.

  

**About the Position**

We are looking for a skilled Data Engineer with 3+ years of hands-on experience in building, maintaining, and optimizing scalable data pipelines and data processing solutions on AWS.
  
  
The ideal candidate should have experience with Apache Spark, AWS Glue, S3, EMR, Apache Airflow, Kafka, Debezium, and Change Data Capture (CDC). The role involves developing robust data pipelines, supporting data migration activities, maintaining data dictionaries, and ensuring data quality and reliability.

  

**Role and Responsibilities**

1. Data Engineering & Pipeline Development:
  
  
- Develop and maintain scalable batch and streaming data pipelines.
  
- Build ETL/ELT pipelines using Apache Spark (PySpark/Scala) and AWS services.
  
- Develop reusable and robust data pipelines.
  
- Optimize data processing jobs for performance, scalability, and cost efficiency.
  
  
2. AWS Cloud & Big Data Processing:
  
  
- Work extensively with AWS S3, AWS Glue, and Amazon EMR.
  
- Develop and optimize distributed data processing jobs using Spark on EMR.
  
- Manage data ingestion, transformation, and storage in S3-based data lakes.
  
- Implement partitioning, schema evolution, and efficient storage formats such as Parquet.
  
  
3. Data Migration & Change Data Capture (CDC):
  
  
- Understand data migration approaches and pipelines from relational databases to cloud-based data platforms.
  
- Have knowledge of Debezium, Apache Kafka, and Kafka Connect for near-real-time CDC-based data ingestion.
  
- Understand CDC concepts, including initial snapshots, incremental changes, inserts, updates, and deletes.
  
- Handle schema changes and understand data consistency, error recovery, and reconciliation during data migration.
  
  
4. Data Dictionary & Metadata Management:
  
  
- Build and maintain comprehensive data dictionaries covering tables, columns, data types, descriptions, and business definitions.
  
- Document source-to-target mappings, transformation logic, primary keys, foreign keys, and table relationships.
  
- Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand business terminology and map it to technical data attributes.
  
- Maintain metadata documentation to support data discovery, governance, and downstream analytics.
  
- Identify and document data dependencies and lineage across pipelines.
  
  
5. Workflow Orchestration – Apache Airflow:
  
  
- Develop and maintain Apache Airflow DAGs for batch processing and data workflows.
  
- Implement task dependencies, scheduling, retries, failure handling, and alerting.
  
- Monitor production pipelines and troubleshoot operational issues.
  
- Ensure workflows meet defined data freshness requirements and SLAs.
  
  
6. Data Quality & Production Support:
  
  
- Implement data validation, reconciliation, and quality checks across data pipelines.
  
- Troubleshoot pipeline failures, performance bottlenecks, and data inconsistencies.
  
- Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting for production data workflows.
  
- Ensure reliable, secure, and maintainable data engineering solutions.

  

**About You**

Required Skills & Experience: • Programming: Python, PySpark, SQL; Scala is an advantage. • Big Data: Apache Spark, distributed data processing, batch and streaming architectures. • AWS: S3, AWS Glue, Amazon EMR. • Orchestration: Apache Airflow, DAG development and scheduling. • Streaming & CDC: Knowledge of Apache Kafka, Kafka Connect, Debezium, and CDC concepts. • Data Integration: ETL/ELT, data migration, incremental ingestion. • Databases: Strong SQL knowledge and experience with relational databases such as Oracle and SQL Server. • Metadata Management: Data dictionaries, schema documentation, source-to-target mappings, and data lineage. • Storage: Parquet, partitioned datasets, data lake fundamentals. Good to Have: • Experience with Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, or Hudi. • Experience with Spark Structured Streaming. • Knowledge of AWS IAM, CloudWatch, and Glue Data Catalog. • Understanding of data modeling and data warehouse concepts. • Familiarity with Git, CI/CD, and deployment automation. • Knowledge of schema registries and Kafka event-driven architectures. Qualifications: • Minimum 3 years of professional experience in data engineering or big data development. • Hands-on experience building and supporting production-grade data pipelines. • Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills. • Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams and translate business requirements into technical solutions.

  

**Preferred Experience Level**

3 years

  

**Preferred Education Level**

Bachelor's Degree

  

**Employment Basis**

Full Time

  

**Benefits**

Group Medical Insurance, Group Personal Accident, Employee Anniversary gift, Loyalty Bonus, Employee Referral Bonus, Rewards and Recognition program, Wellness Allowance, Privilege Leave (PL): 15 days per year, Casual Leave (CL) 12 days per year, Maternity/paternity/Bereavement leave

  

**Applications Close Date**

08 Apr 2027

title: Customer Data engineer
description:
**About the role**  
  
This role is a strong fit for data engineers with 2 to 4 years of experience who want to take their technical depth into a customer-facing role. If you have spent the last few years building pipelines, working with cloud warehouses, and solving real data problems, but you are starting to wonder what comes next, this is worth a closer look.  
  
In this role, you will work directly with Heads of Data, Data Engineering Managers, and CTOs at companies evaluating Hevo across the US, Europe, Southeast Asia, and ANZ. You will help them design the right data architecture, walk them through trade-offs, and earn the technical trust that turns an evaluation into a partnership. You will do this independently, often as the sole technical person on the call. There is no senior SE in the background. You need to walk into a Zoom with a VP of Data Engineering at a US fintech or a Head of Analytics at a European e-commerce company, earn their technical respect in the first five minutes, and hold it for the rest of the engagement.  
  
The technical depth you have built does not go away. It gets applied to a much wider set of problems, a much larger audience, and a global stage.  
  
Hevo runs real-time data pipelines from 150+ sources into modern warehouses for over 1,000 companies, including DoorDash and Shopify. You will be the person customers rely on to make sure Hevo fits their stack, their scale, and their goals.  
  
**Why this role is worth considering**  
  
A. You move from building pipelines to shaping data strategy  
  
In your current role, you build what is specified. In this role, you sit with senior data leaders and help them decide what to build across the modern data stack. Your existing experience in CDC, warehouse design, and pipeline reliability becomes the foundation for higher-leverage work.  
  
B. You get global exposure that is hard to find elsewhere  
  
You will be in regular technical conversations with Heads of Data and CTOs at fast-growing companies across North America, Europe, and beyond. You will run discovery, defend architecture choices, and present in rooms where decisions get made. This is rare exposure for someone at the 2 to 4 year mark, and almost unheard of from Bangalore.  
  
C. Your technical depth stays central  
  
This is not a pivot away from engineering. Everything you know about Postgres, CDC, Kafka, dbt, Snowflake, and pipeline reliability gets used every day. The difference is that your technical opinion shapes the customer’s architecture instead of staying inside a Jira ticket.  
  
D. The career path is real  
  
Strong performers in this role grow into senior individual contributor roles, lead the function, or move into product, customer success leadership, or founding-engineer roles at their next company. The optionality this role builds is significant.  
  
**What you will do**  
  
Run technical discovery calls with Heads of Data, Data Engineering Managers, and CTOs to understand their stack, pain points, and constraints. These are global conversations, primarily with customers in North America and Europe, and you will own them end to end.  
Design and present reference architectures showing how Hevo fits into their existing data stack (e.g., Salesforce, Postgres, GA4, Snowflake, dbt).  
Run live product demos tailored to the customer’s stack. These are not scripted walkthroughs. You will need to read the room, adapt on the fly, and handle unexpected technical questions with confidence.  
Own the technical evaluation from first conversation to closed deal by addressing deep technical questions and earning trust with engineering teams.  
Build proofs-of-concept by configuring real pipelines from source systems (Salesforce, Outreach, Postgres, MySQL) into destinations like Snowflake or BigQuery.  
Develop deep expertise in the data integration landscape, including native solutions from AWS, GCP, and Azure (AWS Glue, Azure Data Factory, Google Cloud Dataflow) as well as other data pipeline and integration platforms, and articulate Hevo’s technical advantages in a way that lands with both technical and non-technical buyers.  
Partner with Account Executives to drive technical wins, and with Customer Success to ensure smooth handoffs after a deal closes.  
Share customer feedback and patterns with Product and Engineering to influence the roadmap.  
  
**What we are looking for**  
  
**Must-haves**  
  
2 to 4 years of hands-on experience as a data engineer, analytics engineer, ETL/ELT developer, or data warehouse engineer.  
Experience building and operating real data pipelines in production, including handling source schema changes, failures, and reliability issues.  
Strong fundamentals in SQL and at least one cloud data warehouse (Snowflake, BigQuery, or Redshift).  
Experience with at least one orchestration or transformation tool (Airflow, dbt, or similar).  
Exceptional communication and presentation skills. This is non-negotiable. You will be the face of Hevo’s technical capability to a global customer base. That means:  
Your spoken English is clear, confident, and easy to follow for an international audience. You are comfortable presenting to groups of 5 to 15 people, including senior technical leaders, over video calls. You can structure a technical narrative, not just answer questions but guide a conversation toward the right conclusion. You can hold your own when a customer pushes back or challenges your recommendation. You have presented or demo’d something technical to an audience before, in any context: internal reviews, client calls, meetups, or conferences.  
Genuine interest in customer-facing work, even if you have not done it formally before.  
  
**Good to have**  
  
Experience with CDC tools or data integration platforms, whether cloud-native (AWS Glue, Azure Data Factory, Google Cloud Dataflow) or third-party pipeline and integration tools.  
Exposure to multiple source system types such as CRMs, ad platforms, SaaS APIs, and OLTP databases.  
Public technical writing, conference talks, or open-source contributions.  
Prior experience in customer conversations, even informally. For example, presenting to internal stakeholders, analytics teams, or working with international teams across time zones.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

description:
Total Number of Openings

1

The Chevron Engineering and Innovation Excellence Center (ENGINE) in Bengaluru India brings together the resources and expertise of the Chevron global network with talent in India to enhance agility and technological innovation to optimize solutions for the world’s current and future energy challenges. As one of the leading energy providers worldwide, Chevron is involved in the production of crude oil and natural gas, manufacturing of transportation fuels, lubricants, petrochemicals, and additives, and the development of enabling technologies.  
  
Chevron's vision is to be the global energy company most admired for its people, partnerships, and performance. With a clear purpose to develop affordable, reliable, ever-cleaner energy that enables human progress, we believe human ingenuity has the power to solve any challenge and overcome any obstacle. Meeting the world’s growing energy needs requires the pursuit of innovations and advancements that deliver a better future for all.

**About the position:**  
  
The FEIM Document Controller is responsible for managing, controlling, and maintaining engineering and Process Safety Information (PSI) throughout the information lifecycle to ensure accuracy, compliance, traceability, and audit readiness. This role serves as the custodian of engineering records, drawings, technical documents, and project deliverables supporting Infrastructure Operations, capital projects, Management of Change (MOC), and Process Safety programs and FEIM close‑out readiness, this role directly reduces regulatory risk, supports safe operations, and ensures Infrastructure maintains a defensible, single source of truth for process safety information.

**Job Description Summary**:

The position partners closely with Engineers, Project Managers, FEIM Analysts, Operations personnel, Contractors, and Design & Drafting organizations to ensure all documentation is complete, properly classified, accurately maintained, and retained within approved Systems of Record.

Applications to Infrastructure projects, facilities, and MOCs requiring PSI management

Covers PSI and FEIM documentation from project initiation through closeout

Interfaces with FEIM Analysts, Project Managers, Engineers, Contractors, and Operations

**Key responsibilities:**

* PSI Governance & FEIM Lifecycle management, compliance, and information stewardship:
* Identify and track required PSI deliverables across the FEIM lifecycle, Ensure PSI aligns to the correct facility, asset, and MOC context and Coordinate with project and FEIM stakeholders to resolve documentation gaps
* Manage and maintain facility and engineering information to ensure compliance with Chevron Operational Excellence (OE) requirements, including PSI and MOC obligations.
* Ensure process safety and facility engineering information remains accurate, current, and accessible for stakeholders and audits.
* Own and maintain the PSI document register as the authoritative tracking tool, ensure metadata accuracy (title, type, revision, facility, MOC reference, location), Reconcile discrepancies between registers, SharePoint, and the System of Record
* Enforce Infrastructure naming conventions, document migration, version control, metadata management, location codes, and sequence numbering, validate document versions and prevent duplication or obsolescence, Ensure PSI is searchable and correctly classified in Documentum‑D2
* Prepare PSI for upload by verifying completeness, accuracy, and approval status, ensure timely upload of final, approved documents, Maintain Documentum‑D2 as the single source of truth for PSI
* Interface with third‑party engineering and drafting contractors to ensure deliverables meet Chevron standards, specifications, and procedures.
* Review and validate engineering documents and drawings prior to acceptance into the system of records.
* Serve as an information management resource to engineering, operations, and project teams, balancing workload across multiple assets and stakeholders.
* Support PSI deliverables associated with MOC activities, Validate required documentation before MOC closure, Coordinate document updates resulting from approved changes, Ensure revised documentation is incorporated into the System of Record (D2), Support MOC verification and compliance reviews.
* Support FEIM Project Closeout activities, verify documentation completeness prior to turnover, validate final document packages and engineering deliverables, Assist Verification & Validation (V&V) efforts, provide objective evidence supporting project completion, ensure all required information has been properly archived and retained
* Collaborate with Engineers, FEIM personnel, Operations teams, Project Managers, and contractors, Coordinate collection and review of project deliverables, resolve documentation deficiencies and quality issues, Provide document control expertise and guidance
* Partner with Infrastructure teams to ensure quality records reflect current approved processes and practices.
* Monitor compliance with document control requirements and escalate gaps or risks as necessary.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Associate degree or higher in Engineering, Information Management, Technical Design, Records Management, or a related technical discipline; or equivalent relevant experience.
* Experience supporting engineering, technical, operational, or project information.
* Working knowledge of Process Safety Information (PSI) and Management of Change (MOC).
* Experience managing controlled technical documentation.
* Experience with document management or records management systems.
* Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Exceptional attention to detail and data quality.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliverables simultaneously.
* Strong attention to detail, including the ability to self-check work products and maintain quality across multiple assignments.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across Engineering, Operations, and Maintenance teams.
* Proficiency aware of computer-aided design tools (for example, AutoCAD and CADWorx) and demonstrated ability to apply drafting standards and conventions.

**Preferred qualification**

* 10+ years of experience in document control, FEIM, records management, or engineering information management environments.
* Experience supporting capital projects, facility operations, or infrastructure engineering teams.
* Familiarity with FEIM governance processes and PSI compliance requirements.
* Manage controlled documents and records associated with ISO 9001 and Quality Management Systems for Specialty Operations Infrastructure.
* Experience working in pipeline, terminal, energy, manufacturing, or industrial environments.
* Knowledge of engineering, drawing and drafting practices

Everything we do at Chevron is guided by our values and our commitment to The Chevron Way.

Have the opportunity to take part in world-leading energy projects, advance your professional development and expand your career within an inclusive and collaborative workplace.

title: Information Security Engineer
description:
**Job Title**

Information Security Engineer

**Summary of the Role**
-----------------------

  

As a Security Software Engineer within Travel Distribution (TRD) Artificial Intelligence (AI), you’ll help secure AI-powered products throughout their lifecycle. You’ll work with Product, Engineering, Architecture, Security, and Governance teams to develop secure and reliable solutions for travel sellers.

**In This Role You’ll / Your Main Responsibilities**
----------------------------------------------------

  

* **Contribute to AI security architecture and risk management:** Apply security architecture principles to AI systems, including Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) and AI agents. You’ll identify and assess risks and help ensure solutions align with relevant enterprise security policies, governance requirements, and regulations.
* **Assess and address AI-specific security risks:** Carry out security assessments and threat modelling for AI use cases, addressing risks such as prompt injection, data leakage, model misuse, and insecure AI agent interactions across models, data pipelines, integrations, and monitoring.
* **Integrate security into product development:** Collaborate with Engineering teams to apply secure development practices, vulnerability management, security testing, and validation throughout the product lifecycle. You’ll contribute to Secure Development Lifecycle (SDL) and relevant compliance activities.
* **Support governance, compliance, and operational security:** Contribute to security controls and governance practices, including audit and risk-acceptance activities. You’ll help teams apply relevant security frameworks and regulatory requirements while supporting transparency, explainability, and appropriate oversight of AI systems.
* **Collaborate and share security knowledge:** Provide security guidance to Product, Architecture, Engineering, and Governance teams, contribute to cross-functional initiatives, and share practical security knowledge that helps teams incorporate security throughout AI development.

  

**About the Ideal Candidate**
-----------------------------

  

You’ll be a good fit for this role if you have security engineering experience and an interest in applying security practices to AI-powered products and services.

* Experience or knowledge in security architecture, security risk management, threat modelling, vulnerability management, and secure software development practices.
* Knowledge of AI and Machine Learning (ML) technologies and associated security risks, which may include Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI agents, data pipelines, prompt injection, data leakage, or model misuse.
* Experience or knowledge related to Identity and Access Management (IAM), Application Programming Interface (API) security, or cloud security, with the ability to translate identified risks into practical security controls.
* Understanding of relevant security and compliance frameworks, such as International Organization for Standardization/International Electrotechnical Commission (ISO/IEC) 27001, National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) frameworks, Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS), or relevant AI governance and data-protection requirements.
Effective problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to explain technical security topics clearly, collaborate across technical and business teams, share knowledge, and make practical security recommendations.  

  

**What We Can Offer You**
-------------------------

* A critical mission and purpose - At Amadeus, you'll power the future of travel with a critical mission and extraordinary purpose.
* A truly global DNA - Everything at Amadeus is global, from our people to our business, which translates into our footprint, processes, and culture.
* Great opportunities to learn - Learning happens all the time and in many ways at Amadeus, from on-the-job training to formal activities and daily interactions.
* A caring environment – Amadeus fosters a caring environment that supports both professional growth and personal well-being.
* A complete rewards offer - Amadeus provides attractive compensation packages, including salary, bonus, caregiving and health benefits.
* A flexible working model - Embrace our flexible working model, enabling you to excel wherever and however you work best.
* A diverse, equitable, and inclusive community – We are committed to enabling each employee to reach their full potential by fostering a culture of belonging and fair treatment.
* A Reliable Company - Trust and reliability are fundamental to shaping our relationships with customers, partners, and employees.

**Diversity & Inclusion**

  

Amadeus aspires to be a leader in Diversity and Inclusion in the tech industry, enabling every employee to reach their full potential by fostering a culture of belonging and fair treatment, attracting the best talent from all backgrounds, and as a role model for an inclusive employee experience.

  

Amadeus is an equal opportunity employer and committed to an accessible recruitment process. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, age, beliefs, disability or any other characteristics protected by law.

**Be aware of recruitment scams**

  

Amadeus Group never charges fees, requests payment, or asks for financial information during recruitment. All legitimate opportunities are communicated solely through official Amadeus channels, including our careers website. Any payment request or outreach via unofficial platforms (e.g., WhatsApp, Telegram) should be treated as fraudulent.

title: SOC Analyst
company: Revantage Global Services India Private Limited
description:
**POSITION SUMMARY**

The SOC Analyst (L1) is the first line of detection and response within Revantage's Security Operations Center, responsible for continuous monitoring of security alerts, performing initial triage, and ensuring timely escalation to L2 analysts. The role operates using the ReliaQuest GreyMatter MDR platform as the primary investigation interface, supported by Microsoft Defender for Endpoint and Microsoft Sentinel for alert review and basic log analysis. The L1 Analyst is expected to develop strong foundational skills across the Revantage security toolset, maintain disciplined documentation practices, and contribute to consistent shift handoff quality. This is a growth-oriented role designed to build the analytical foundation for progression to L2 responsibilities.

**ESSENTIAL JOB DUTIES**

**1.** **Alert Monitoring & Initial Triage**

* Monitor the security alert queue continuously across shift, ensuring no alerts are missed, delayed, or left without an initial disposition.
* Perform initial triage of incoming alerts: review alert context, classify by type and potential severity, and determine whether the alert warrants escalation or closure as a false positive.
* Apply documented playbooks and runbooks to guide triage decisions; escalate promptly to L2 when an alert exceeds L1 scope or confidence threshold.
* Maintain accurate, timely documentation of all triage actions: alert details, initial findings, disposition rationale, and escalation notes.
* Support shift handoff quality by ensuring all open items are clearly documented and communicated to the incoming analyst.

**2.** **ReliaQuest GreyMatter**

* Use GreyMatter as the primary platform for alert review, case management, and initial investigation workflows.
* Navigate GreyMatter case queues, apply filters, and use built-in enrichment and AI-assisted features to support triage decisions — always validating outputs before acting.
* Document findings, disposition notes, and escalation rationale within GreyMatter case records in accordance with SOC documentation standards.
* Develop proficiency with GreyMatter investigation workflows through structured on-the-job learning and guidance from L2 analysts and the SOC Manager.

**3.** **Microsoft Defender for Endpoint**

* Review MDE alerts surfaced through GreyMatter or the MDE portal; understand alert categories, severity levels, and associated device context.
* Perform basic endpoint investigation tasks: review device timelines for obvious indicators, check process trees, and identify key artifacts to include in escalation notes.
* Understand and apply MDE alert triage criteria to support accurate initial severity classification.

**4.** **Microsoft Sentinel**

* Review Sentinel incidents and alerts as part of the monitoring queue; understand alert sources and the log types that feed detections.
* Run basic KQL queries using provided templates to retrieve log evidence and support initial triage findings.
* Develop foundational KQL proficiency over time, progressing toward independent query construction for common triage scenarios.

**5.** **SSE/SWG Platforms — Zscaler & Netskope**

* Develop working familiarity with Zscaler and Netskope alert types, log sources, and basic policy constructs.
* Review web security alerts and support L2 analysts with initial context gathering for Zscaler and Netskope-related investigations.
* Follow documented workflows for reporting and escalating SSE/SWG events that exceed L1 triage capability.

**6.** **ServiceNow Ticket Handling**

* Manage ServiceNow tickets assigned to the InfoSec/SOC queue: acknowledge, classify, document, and escalate or resolve within SLA.
* Handle routine, low-complexity security tickets: user-reported suspicious emails, access queries, and basic security tool questions — following documented resolution procedures.
* Maintain accurate ticket records: classification, evidence summary, actions taken, and resolution notes aligned to SOC documentation standards.
* Flag repeat patterns or unresolved issues for L2 review and knowledge article creation.

**7.** **Email Security**

* Perform initial triage of user-reported phishing and suspicious email submissions using Mimecast and/or Abnormal.ai.
* Apply documented phishing triage criteria: assess sender, links, attachments, and headers; classify and escalate confirmed or suspected malicious emails to L2.
* Support quarantine and release workflows under L2 direction; document findings and outcomes in the relevant ticket or case record.

**REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE**

* 1+ years of experience in a SOC, IT operations, helpdesk, or security monitoring role.
* Basic understanding of networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, common ports and protocols.
* Familiarity with Windows operating system concepts: processes, services, event logs, and common file system paths.
* Awareness of common attack types and indicators: phishing, malware, credential abuse, and suspicious scripting.
* Ability to follow structured procedures, playbooks, and escalation paths with precision and consistency.
* ServiceNow or equivalent ITSM tool experience: ticket creation, classification, and documentation.
* Strong attention to detail and clear written communication for ticket notes, case documentation, and shift handoffs.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Prior exposure to a SIEM platform (Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, or similar) for alert review or basic log analysis.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Defender for Endpoint or equivalent EDR tooling.
* Exposure to phishing analysis and email security tools (Mimecast, Abnormal.ai, or similar).
* Understanding of the MITRE ATT&CK framework at a foundational level.
* Experience working in a 24×7 shift environment.

**EDUCATION & CERTIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* CompTIA Security+ — preferred or actively pursuing.
* Microsoft SC-900 (Security, Compliance, and Identity Fundamentals) — a plus.
* CompTIA CySA+ or equivalent — desirable as a development target.

**SUCCESS MEASURES**

* SLA compliance and accurate, complete documentation for all assigned ServiceNow tickets.
* Alert triage accuracy: low false-positive closure rate and appropriate, timely escalations to L2.
* Shift handoff quality: all open items documented and communicated clearly with no gaps.
* Demonstrated progression in GreyMatter proficiency and foundational tool knowledge over the first 90 days.
* Positive contribution to team knowledge through flagging repeat patterns and supporting runbook updates.

**WORKING CONDITIONS**

* 24×7 rotational shifts including nights, weekends, and holidays.
* On-call support may be required for high-severity incidents.
* Role demands sustained alertness, consistent process adherence, and composed, methodical work under pressure.

title: AI Software Tester

title: Founding Product Manager Voice AI - Karta AI
description:
**Founding Product Manager – Voice AI**

**Department:** Product

**Reports to:** Founders

**Location:** HSR Layout, Bengaluru

**Stage:** Seed

**Role Type:** Founding Team / Individual Contributor

**Scope:** Voice AI, Conversational Intelligence, Product Strategy, Agent Performance, Customer Outcomes

  

**About Karta**

Karta is building the AI operating system for customer-facing teams. We build AI agents that handle complex customer conversations across voice, chat and WhatsApp. Our agents don't just respond to questions—they understand context, reason through workflows and take action across business systems. We're building for high-volume, complex industries like fintech, where conversations require contextual understanding, objection handling, multilingual communication and reliable execution. Our ambition is to make AI conversations indistinguishable from great human interactions—not just in how they sound, but in how intelligently they work. We need a product leader who can turn this ambition into reality.

**Why This Role Exists**

Voice AI is moving beyond speech recognition and text-to-speech. The real challenge is building agents that can listen, understand, respond, interrupt, reason and act in real time. A great voice agent must know when to speak, when to listen, how to handle objections, when to retrieve context and how to recover when a conversation goes wrong. Your job is to own this experience end-to-end. You will work directly with customers, engineers and AI researchers to identify the biggest problems, design solutions and ship improvements that materially change agent performance.
  
You won't just build voice features. You'll build agents that perform better in real conversations.

**What You Own**

**1. Voice Experience**

Build natural, low-latency, human-like voice interactions.

Latency and response-time optimisation

Interruption handling and turn-taking

Natural pauses, speech rhythm and conversational flow

Full-duplex voice experiences

Multilingual conversations across Indian languages

Emotion-aware responses and contextual acknowledgement

**2. Conversational Intelligence**

Make agents better at handling complex conversations.

Intent and context understanding

Objection handling and root-problem identification

Memory across turns and sessions

Contextual personalisation

Conversation recovery when agents misunderstand

Natural transitions between listening, reasoning and responding

The goal is to move beyond agents that sound human to agents that think and respond appropriately in human conversations.

**3. Agent Evaluation & Observability**

Build the system that tells us whether our agents are actually good.

Voice-specific evaluation frameworks

Automated conversation simulations

Golden evaluation datasets

Failure categorisation and root-cause analysis

Real-time monitoring and agent observability

Metrics across latency, resolution, CSAT and conversation quality

You will turn production failures into systematic product improvements.

**4. Product Discovery & Customer Outcomes**

Work with customers and business leaders to understand where voice AI creates measurable value.

Identify high-value use cases

Shadow real customer conversations

Analyse human-agent performance

Translate customer pain into product requirements

Prioritise features based on business impact

Define success metrics and validate outcomes

Start with the problem, not the feature request.

**5. Product Execution**

Own the product lifecycle from idea to production.

Product strategy and roadmap

PRDs and feature specifications

UX and conversational flow design

Engineering and research prioritisation

Release quality and adoption

Feedback loops from customers and production data

You will work closely with engineering, AI/ML and GTM teams to ship quickly without compromising reliability.

**What We're Looking For**

**Voice AI experience:** Hands-on experience with conversational AI, speech systems, voice agents or real-time AI products.

**Technical depth:** Understand ASR, TTS, speech pipelines, latency, LLMs, tool calling and agent architectures.

**Product judgment:** Can distinguish a technically interesting feature from one that materially improves customer outcomes.

**Customer obsession:** Will listen to hundreds of conversations to understand what is actually going wrong.

**Execution intensity:** Can move from an ambiguous problem to a shipped solution quickly.

**High agency:** Comfortable operating without a fully defined roadmap, process or team.

**Data-driven:** Comfortable designing evaluations, analysing failures and prioritising based on evidence.

We care more about what you've built and how you think than the title you held previously.

**What This Role Is Not**

This is not a feature factory PM role.

It is not a role where you simply write PRDs and hand them to engineering.

It is not limited to managing a speech API or improving a voice interface.

You will be expected to understand the technology, listen to actual conversations, investigate failures, make trade-offs and drive solutions into production.

**You own whether the product works—not just whether it ships.**

**What Success Looks Like**

**First 30 days — Understand**

Understand the voice stack, listen to production calls, identify major failure modes and establish a baseline for quality and latency.

**First 60 days — Improve**

Ship improvements to conversational quality, interruption handling, latency or objection resolution, with measurable results.

**First 90 days — Systematise**

Establish a repeatable evaluation and improvement loop that makes every release more reliable and effective.

**Core Metrics**

End-to-end conversational latency

Interruption and turn-taking quality

Task completion and resolution rates

Conversation quality and objection handling

Agent failure rates and recovery

CSAT and customer business outcomes

**Why Take It**

**Ownership:** Shape the core product experience at an early-stage AI company.

**Technical depth:** Work at the intersection of voice, LLMs, real-time systems and agent intelligence.

**Customer impact:** See your work change how thousands of customer conversations are handled.

**Founder exposure:** Work directly with founders and influence product direction, architecture trade-offs and company strategy.

**Career trajectory:** Build toward Head of Product or Product Leadership as Karta scales.

**The Person We're Really Looking For**

Someone who listens to a voice agent call and doesn't stop at saying:

"The voice sounds robotic."

They ask:

Why did the agent interrupt the customer?

Why did it miss the underlying objection?

Why did it repeat the same question?

Why did it respond without retrieving the right context?

What should the agent have done differently?

How do we measure that improvement and prevent the failure from recurring?

Then they work with engineering and AI researchers to fix it, test it and ship the solution.

**Obsessive. Technical. Customer-first.**

**That's the Founding Product Manager at Karta.**

title: Training Manager, Relay Product Excellence
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Relay Product Excellence (RPE) bridges Relay technology and operations. We deliver fast-paced investigations, exception management, and quality improvement programs that protect Carriers, Drivers, and Amazon Relay globally. We apply human judgment to the complex and ambiguous cases, identify gaps in automated and manual mechanisms, and surface the patterns in exceptions that point to a fix. Partnering with Relay Product and Tech, we turn those patterns into automation and high data quality — so repetitive work scales, and risk does not.  
  
Good human judgment depends on good training, and we are looking for a Training Manager to build and own the RPE training program in Bengaluru. This is an individual contributor role. You will design the curriculum, the mechanisms, and the standards; subject matter experts (SMEs) will deliver training under your direction. You will own the program end to end, from new-hire onboarding to developing associates, and you will define how success is measured. The ideal candidate is a skilled instructional designer who is comfortable with data, can earn trust from operations leaders they don't manage, and likes building programs from scratch more than inheriting them.  
  
Curriculum and Program Design: You will redesign and standardize new-hire training, covering curriculum, assessments, certification gates, and handoff to the floor. You will build a cross-training framework so associates can be certified on several processes, and design a development curriculum for associates.  
  
SOP and Knowledge Management: You will turn our SOPs and team wiki into a governed knowledge base, with clear owners, version control, a review schedule, and a defined process for pushing policy and process changes into training quickly.  
  
SME Enablement: You will run a train-the-trainer program that certifies SMEs as trainers, review their delivery quality, and hold them to the standards you set. You will agree SME time with operations leads and influence without formal authority.  
  
Measurement and Stakeholder Management: There is no training baseline today. You will establish one, then own the metrics that show training effectiveness: time-to-proficiency, new-hire quality, and cross-training coverage. You will partner with Quality to turn audit defect trends into targeted refresher training, and report results to leadership in operating reviews.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Own the RPE training program end to end for Bengaluru investigators.
* Revamp and standardize the new-hire training framework, including curriculum, assessments, certification gates, and floor-readiness criteria.
* Design and roll out an associate cross-process training framework, and maintain a certification matrix by process.
* Design a development training curriculum for associates .
* Own SOP governance and the team wiki, with a review schedule, version control, and an agreed turnaround for pushing process changes into training.
* Build and run a train-the-trainer program; certify SMEs as trainers and review their delivery quality.
* Measure the training baseline, set targets, and report time-to-proficiency, new-hire quality gap, and cross-training coverage in WBRs.
* Partner with Operations and Quality to find knowledge gaps from audit and case data, and close them with targeted training.
* Write clear documents (training strategy, curriculum designs, program reviews) and present recommendations to leadership for sign-off.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree
* 4+ years of experience in training, learning & development, or instructional design, including 2+ years owning a training program end to end.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* Hands-on experience with an instructional design model such as ADDIE, SAM, or similar.
* Experience designing assessments and measuring training effectiveness (e.g., Kirkpatrick levels 1–3).
* Strong facilitation skills, including experience training and certifying trainers.
* Advanced Excel skills; able to build training dashboards and analyze performance data to drive decisions.
* Experience influencing stakeholders you don't manage, such as SMEs, operations leaders, and quality teams.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Master's degree
* Experience in relevant industry fields like operations, risk, or fraud investigations
* Knowledge of SQL
* Experience with Learning Management Systems (LMS), or experience with multimedia content creation
* Certification in instructional design or L&D (e.g., CPTD or ATD credentials).
* Experience building training programs from scratch in an ambiguous, fast-scaling operations environment.

title: Principal Security Engineer, AI Security & SecOps
description:
Uniphore is the Business AI company. Our sovereign, composable and secure AI platform connects enterprise data, fine-tunes AI models and deploys agentic AI across the enterprise. We empower every worker to boost productivity and help businesses grow faster, operate smarter and reduce costs. Trusted by more than 2,000 businesses globally, and recognized on the Deloitte Fast 500, Uniphore delivers on the promise of AI as a transformative force for business.

  

**Job Description:**

**About The Role**

We are seeking a Principal Security Engineer to lead AI-native security and security automation, and to orchestrate our security operations and incident response. Our frontline monitoring and triage are delivered by a managed MXDR partner, so this is not a 24x7 analyst seat. Instead, you will set detection and response strategy, own the security of our agentic AI platform, and drive automation toward automated remediation so the function scales through engineering rather than headcount. You will be the technical owner of our AI and cloud security tooling (Wiz) and the architect of a lean, high-leverage SecOps capability.

This is a hands-on, strategic role for an engineer who wants to build resilient, automated systems and define what AI security looks like for a frontier agentic platform.

**What You Will Do (Key Responsibilities)**

* Own AI and agentic security tooling, including Wiz AI Security Posture Management and AI Lens for visibility across AI, MCP, agents, and models, runtime guardrails, and the AI Bill of Materials (AIBOM).
* Drive MCP and agent protection from visibility to active enforcement, and integrate model and AI supply-chain scanning into CI/CD.
* Build and run the AI red-teaming program, aligned to the OWASP LLM and Agentic Top 10 and MITRE ATLAS, and partner with product and engineering to embed AI security controls into the platform lifecycle.
* Operationalize Wiz CNAPP, CSPM, and DSPM for cloud and data security posture, and drive risk-based prioritization of findings toward automated remediation.
* Build detection-as-code and Security Orchestration, Automation, and Response (SOAR) workflows; automate alert triage, enrichment, and assignment, and progressively automate remediation of well-understood risks.
* Own the risk-based vulnerability prioritization model (severity-based SLAs, triage within SLA) and feed automated ticketing and sprint assignment, moving SecOps from manual to automated.
* Own the MXDR and MSSP relationship as the primary technical lead: detection tuning, log source onboarding, service delivery, budget, and performance metrics.
* Act as incident commander for major security incidents and own the incident response lifecycle at the orchestration level, while the MXDR partner runs frontline monitoring and triage.
* Maintain incident response playbooks, run purple-team exercises with IT, Engineering, Legal, and Communications, and report MTTD, MTTR, and SecOps metrics to leadership, driving post-incident remediation to closure.

**Required Qualifications**

* 8 to 10+ years in a hands-on security engineering or operations role, with strong depth in security operations, incident response, and cloud security.
* Hands-on experience with cloud security posture and CNAPP tooling (Wiz strongly preferred) and with detection engineering.
* Demonstrated automation capability: SOAR, detection-as-code, scripting (Python), and a track record of building toward automated remediation.
* Experience securing AI, ML, or LLM and agentic systems, or a strong, demonstrable ability to ramp quickly (guardrails, AI red-teaming, MCP and agent security).
* Experience managing third-party security partners, particularly MSSPs or MXDR providers.
* Expert knowledge of the incident response lifecycle (e.g., NIST) and experience acting as incident commander, with SIEM and XDR depth.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Demonstrated AI security specialization: OWASP LLM and Agentic Top 10, MITRE ATLAS, AIBOM, and model scanning.
* Proficiency with SOAR and automation platforms and hands-on automated-remediation experience.
* Proven experience standing up or maturing a SecOps function that scales through automation rather than headcount.
Relevant certifications (e.g., GCIH, GCFA, CISSP, or a cloud security certification) and a degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field.

  

**Location preference:**

India - Bangalore  

Uniphore is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity in the workplace. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, disability, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.
  
  
For more information on how Uniphore uses AI to unify—and humanize—every enterprise experience, please visit www.uniphore.com.

title: Chief Information Security Officer (CISO)
description:
**Company Description**
-----------------------

With AI and cloud-native solutions, BETSOL accelerates cloud transformation for enterprises across 17+ countries. BETSOL holds several engineering patents, and is recognized with industry awards. BETSOL maintains a net promoter score that is 2x the industry average.

BETSOL’s open source backup and recovery product line, Zmanda (Zmanda.com), delivers up to 50% savings in total cost of ownership (TCO) and delivers best-in-class performance.

BETSOL Global IT Services (BETSOL.com) builds and supports end-to-end enterprise solutions, reducing time-to-market for customers.

BETSOL offices are set against the vibrant backdrops of Broomfield, Colorado and Bangalore, India.

We take pride in being an employee-centric organization, offering comprehensive health insurance, competitive salaries, volunteer programs, and scholarship opportunities. Office amenities include a fitness center, cafe, and recreational facilities.

Learn more at betsol.com

**Job Description**
-------------------

The Chief Information Security Officer will own BETSOL's enterprise information security strategy, governance and operations across the organization and its global delivery ecosystem. You will lead our certified management systems, including ISO/IEC 27001:2022 alongside ISO 9001:2015, take BETSOL toward ISO/IEC 42001 certification for responsible AI, and build a security program that holds up to customer audits, regulatory scrutiny and real-world threats.

**Key responsibilities**

Security strategy and governance

* Define and run a multi-year information security strategy and roadmap aligned to BETSOL's business goals, customer commitments and risk appetite.
* Own the information security policy framework, including acceptable use, access control, data protection, secure development and supplier security, and keep it current and enforced.
* Chair the information security steering forum, and report security posture, risks and program progress to the CEO and leadership team.
* Build and lead the security team, setting clear roles across governance, risk and compliance, security engineering and security operations.

Certifications, audit and compliance

* Own BETSOL's ISO/IEC 27001:2022 information security management system end to end: scope, risk assessment, Statement of Applicability, internal audits, management reviews and corrective actions.
* Lead annual surveillance and recertification audits with external certification bodies, working with the quality team on the integrated ISO 9001:2015 management system.
* Drive ISO/IEC 42001:2023 (AI management system) implementation and certification readiness as BETSOL expands AI-enabled delivery.
* Ensure compliance with applicable data protection, privacy, cybersecurity and breach-notification laws, and support relevant customer, contractual and assurance requirements wherever BETSOL processes customer data.
* Respond to customer security questionnaires, due-diligence reviews and contractual security obligations, and represent BETSOL's security program in customer audits.

Security operations and engineering

* Oversee vulnerability management, patching and asset inventory across corporate IT, cloud and customer-hosted environments, with risk-based remediation timelines.
* Run security monitoring, alerting and incident response, including a tested incident response plan, defined severity levels, 24x7 escalation coverage and post-incident root cause analysis.
* Set standards for identity and access management: SSO, MFA, privileged access, role-based access aligned to job functions, and periodic access reviews.
* Embed security into the software delivery lifecycle: secure design reviews, code and dependency scanning, penetration testing and security sign-off before release.
* Define cloud security baselines for Azure, AWS and Kubernetes workloads, and for backup, retention and disaster recovery.
* Govern third-party and vendor risk, including onboarding assessments and ongoing reviews.

Culture and awareness

* Run security awareness and phishing programs for all employees, with role-specific training for engineers, administrators and leaders.
* Partner with HR, IT, legal and delivery leaders so security is built into how BETSOL hires, onboards, delivers and offboards.

**Qualifications**
------------------

Required qualifications

* 8+ years of experience in information security, with at least 3 years leading a security program, function or team.
* Proven ownership of an ISO/IEC 27001 management system through certification and surveillance audits.
* Strong working knowledge of cloud security (Azure and/or AWS), identity and access management, vulnerability management and incident response.
* Experience applying data protection, privacy and cybersecurity regulations across a global business, including customer and contractual security requirements in regulated industries.

title: Sr. System Admin
description:
**1. Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced Senior System Administrator to manage, secure, maintain, and optimize the organization's IT infrastructure, servers, cloud environments, networks, Microsoft 365 services, and cybersecurity systems.

The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in Windows and Linux server administration, cloud infrastructure, Microsoft 365 administration, email security, network security, backup and disaster recovery, malware and ransomware prevention, monitoring, and incident management.

The candidate will be responsible for ensuring the availability, performance, confidentiality, and integrity of company systems and data while protecting corporate email accounts and infrastructure from phishing, unauthorized access, malware, ransomware, and other cyber threats.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Server and System Administration**

* Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Windows Server and Linux environments.
* Manage Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, file servers, user accounts, and access permissions.
* Monitor server performance, availability, CPU, memory, disk utilization, and system capacity.
* Perform operating system upgrades, security patching, updates, and routine maintenance.
* Troubleshoot complex server, operating system, software, and infrastructure issues.
* Maintain production and internal IT systems to meet agreed uptime and performance requirements.
* Manage user onboarding, offboarding, access provisioning, and permission revocation.

**B. Cloud and Infrastructure Management**

* Manage cloud infrastructure on AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Configure and maintain virtual machines, storage, cloud networking, security groups, IAM, and access policies.
* Manage virtualization platforms such as VMware and Microsoft Hyper-V.
* Monitor cloud resource utilization, availability, performance, and infrastructure costs.
* Implement infrastructure monitoring, alerting, automation, and capacity planning.
* Coordinate with development and DevOps teams to support application hosting, deployment, and production infrastructure.
* Maintain infrastructure documentation, architecture diagrams, and configuration records.

**C. Microsoft 365 and Corporate Email Security**

* Administer and secure Microsoft 365, Exchange Online, Outlook, and corporate email services.
* Implement Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), Conditional Access, and least-privilege access policies.
* Configure and maintain Microsoft Defender for Office 365 or equivalent email security solutions.
* Implement and validate SPF, DKIM, and DMARC to protect the company's email domain from spoofing and impersonation.
* Configure anti-phishing, anti-spam, anti-malware, malicious URL, and attachment protection policies.
* Monitor suspicious sign-ins, unusual login locations, repeated authentication failures, mailbox rule changes, and unauthorized email forwarding.
* Prevent and investigate Business Email Compromise (BEC), phishing, credential theft, and unauthorized email account access.
* Review Microsoft 365 audit logs, Entra ID sign-in logs, mailbox activity, and security alerts regularly.
* Detect and investigate suspicious OAuth application permissions and unauthorized third-party integrations.
* Establish secure email account onboarding, offboarding, password reset, and access revocation procedures.
* Ensure appropriate retention, audit logging, and recovery settings are configured for corporate email services.

**D. Cybersecurity, Malware and Ransomware Prevention**

* Implement security controls to protect company systems against malware, ransomware, viruses, spyware, trojans, and other cyber threats.
* Deploy and manage endpoint protection and Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) solutions, such as Microsoft Defender for Endpoint.
* Monitor security alerts and investigate suspicious processes, malicious scripts, unauthorized software, and abnormal system behavior.
* Implement OS and application hardening, firewall rules, secure configurations, and endpoint security policies.
* Conduct regular vulnerability assessments and coordinate remediation of identified security weaknesses.
* Protect servers, laptops, employee workstations, cloud infrastructure, and corporate networks against unauthorized access and exploitation.
* Monitor and investigate suspicious network traffic, brute-force attempts, unauthorized access, and other indicators of compromise.
* Implement controls to reduce risks associated with malicious attachments, harmful links, compromised credentials, and social engineering.
* Maintain secure backups, including immutable or offline copies where appropriate, to minimize the impact of ransomware.
* Perform root cause analysis after security incidents and implement preventive measures to avoid recurrence.

**E. Network and Access Security**

* Manage LAN, WAN, VPN, VLANs, DNS, DHCP, routing, switching, and network connectivity.
* Configure and maintain firewalls, network access controls, and secure remote access.
* Monitor network availability, traffic, suspicious connections, and potential security incidents.
* Implement secure administrator access, privileged account management, and least-privilege permissions.
* Review user accounts, administrative privileges, service accounts, and third-party access periodically.
* Secure Wi-Fi, remote access, and employee devices according to company security policies.
* Support network segmentation and restrict unnecessary access to critical servers and business systems.

**F. Security Monitoring and Incident Response**

* Monitor infrastructure and security alerts through available monitoring and security platforms.
* Investigate compromised email accounts, suspicious logins, malicious mailbox rules, and unauthorized forwarding configurations.
* Respond promptly to suspected cyber incidents by disabling or restricting compromised accounts, revoking active sessions and tokens, and resetting credentials as appropriate.
* Isolate affected endpoints or servers when necessary to prevent the spread of malware or ransomware.

title: Applied Scientist I, Worldwide Returns & Recommerce - Science
description:
**Description**
Welcome to the Worldwide Returns & ReCommerce team (WWR&R) at Amazon.com.
  
  
WWR&R is an agile, innovative organization dedicated to ‘making zero happen’ to benefit our customers, our company, and the environment. Our goal is to achieve the three zeroes: zero cost of returns, zero waste, and zero defects. We do this by developing products and driving truly innovative operational excellence to help customers keep what they buy, recover returned and damaged product value, keep thousands of tons of waste from landfills, and create the best customer returns experience in the world. We have an eye to the future – we create long-term value at Amazon by focusing not just on the bottom line, but on the planet. We are building the most sustainable re-use channel we can by driving multiple aspects of the Circular Economy for Amazon – Returns & ReCommerce.
  
  
Amazon WWR&R is comprised of business, product, operational, program, software engineering and data teams that manage the life of a returned or damaged product from a customer to the warehouse and on to its next best use. Our work is broad and deep: we train machine learning models to automate routing and find signals to optimize re-use; we invent new channels to give products a second life; we develop highly respected product support to help customers love what they buy; we pilot smarter product evaluations; we work from the customer backward to find ways to make the return experience remarkably delightful and easy; and we do it all while scrutinizing our business with laser focus.
  
  
You will help create everything from customer-facing and vendor-facing websites to the internal software and tools behind the reverse-logistics process. You can develop scalable, high-availability solutions to solve complex and broad business problems.
  
  
We are a group that has fun at work while driving incredible customer, business, and environmental impact. We are backed by a strong leadership group dedicated to operational excellence that empowers a reasonable work-life balance. As an established, experienced team, we offer the scope and support needed for substantial career growth.
  
  
Amazon is earth’s most customer-centric company and through WWR&R, the earth is our customer too. Come join us and innovate with the Amazon Worldwide Returns & ReCommerce team!
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Design, develop, and evaluate highly innovative models for Natural Language Programming (NLP), Large Language Model (LLM), or Large Computer Vision Models.
* Use SQL to query and analyze the data.
* Use Python, Jupyter notebook, and Pytorch to train/test/deploy ML models.
* Use machine learning and analytical techniques to create scalable solutions for business problems.
* Research and implement novel machine learning and statistical approaches.
* Mentor interns.
* Work closely with data & software engineering teams to build model implementations and integrate successful models and algorithms in production systems at very large scale.

**About The Team**
When a customer returns a package to Amazon, the request and package will be passed through our WWRR machine learning (ML) systems so that we could improve the customer experience, identify return root cause, optimize re-use, and evaluate the returned package. Our problems touch multiple modalities spanning from: textual, categorical, image, to speech data.
  
  
We operate at large scale and rely on state-of-the-art modeling techniques to power our ML models: XGBoost, BERT, Vision Transformers, Large Language Models.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
* Experience with SQL and an RDBMS (e.g., Oracle) or Data Warehouse

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience implementing algorithms using both toolkits and self-developed code
* Have publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

description:
**Role :-** Senior Databricks Data Architect / Lead Data Engineer (ERP & AI/BI Modernization)

**Exp :-** 6 + Years

L**ocation :-** Hyderabad

**Notice :-** Immediate

**Mode of Work :-** Hybrid

**Shift Timings :-** 3PM – 11PM

**Role Overview:**

We are seeking an experienced Senior Databricks Data Architect / Lead Data Engineer to take ownership of, support, and scale our existing Databricks Lakehouse environment. Our current platform ingests data from Oracle Fusion, transforms it through a Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold), and powers enterprise reporting via Databricks AI/BI Dashboards and AI/BI Genie.

You will audit our current setup, resolve performance bottlenecks, implement FinOps best practices to reduce compute and storage costs, and architect scalable ingestion frameworks to onboard additional ERPs and legacy systems.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Architecture Assessment, Support & Scaling**. Conduct a comprehensive review of the existing Databricks environment, workflows, Unity Catalogue setup, and Oracle Fusion data pipelines to identify architectural bottlenecks and single points of failure. Design and implement a scalable, modular Lakehouse blueprint capable of handling growing data volumes and concurrent business users.

Architect reusable ingestion and transformation frameworks to integrate additional ERP platforms (e.g., SAP, NetSuite, Dynamics) and legacy on-premise/cloud databases via batch, CDC, and streaming patterns.Provide Level 3 production support, establish robust CI/CD pipelines (Databricks Asset Bundles / Git), and set up proactive observability, alerting, and data quality guardrails.

* **Performance Tuning & Cost Optimisation (FinOps)**

Optimise PySpark/SQL jobs, Delta Lake table layouts (Liquid Clustering, Z-Ordering, partitioning, file compaction), and Photon acceleration to maximise throughput and reduce query latency.  
Right-size all-purpose clusters, job clusters, and Serverless SQL Warehouses; enforce cluster policies, autoscaling rules, and auto-termination guardrails to eliminate idle compute spend.  
Monitor workspace consumption using Databricks System Tables to establish cost-per-pipeline baselines, chargeback/show back tagging, and continuous cost-reduction initiatives.

* **AI/BI Dashboards & AI/BI Genie Optimisation**

Tune SQL datasets, caching strategies, and SQL Warehouse concurrency settings to ensure fast load times for Databricks AI/BI Dashboards.  
Refine, govern, and scale Databricks AI/BI Genie spaces built on top of Oracle Fusion and Gold-layer tables—curating table metadata, instructions, joins, and sample SQL queries to improve natural-language-to-SQL accuracy.  
Establish semantic layer standards and metric definitions so self-service AI/BI queries remain performant, governed, and cost-controlled.

* **Governance & Security**

Manage and enforce fine-grained access controls, data lineage, row/column-level security, and audit logging using Unity Catalogue.

**Required Qualifications & Technical Skills:**

* Core Databricks Stack: 4+ years of hands-on experience designing and scaling production workloads on Databricks (Apache Spark, PySpark, Spark SQL, Delta Lake, Lake flow / Delta Live Tables, Workflows, Auto Loader, Unity Catalogue).
* ERP & Legacy Integration: Proven experience extracting and modelling complex transactional data from Oracle Fusion (ERP/HCM/SCM via BICC, BIP, REST APIs, or connectors) as well as other enterprise ERPs and legacy relational databases.
* Data Modelling: Deep expertise in Medallion Architecture, dimensional modelling (Star/Snowflake schemas), Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD Type 1/2), and Change Data Capture (CDC).
* BI & AI Analytics: Hands-on experience building and optimising Databricks AI/BI Dashboards, Databricks SQL (DBSQL), and AI/BI Genie spaces.
* Performance & FinOps: Demonstrated track record of reducing Databricks DBU and cloud infrastructure costs through query execution plan tuning (AQE, shuffle/skew mitigation), Liquid Clustering, and Serverless Warehouse optimisation.
* Cloud & DevOps: Strong proficiency in cloud storage and networking (AWS, Azure, or GCP) alongside Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform) and CI/CD tools.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional or Databricks Certified Solutions Architect.
* Experience with Lakehouse Federation for querying external legacy databases without heavy upfront data movement.
* Strong stakeholder communication skills with the ability to translate technical trade-offs and cost-saving roadmaps to leadership.

Pay: ₹800,000.00 - ₹2,400,000.00 per year

description:

**What You'll Do**

* Execute IT audits under the direction of the Manager, including planning, process walkthroughs, risk and control matrix development, test design, fieldwork, and workpaper documentation
