title: Silicon Design Engineer - Analog IO
description:
Overview:

**ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.**

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.

Responsibilities:

**MTS SILICON DESIGN ENGINEER**

**THE ROLE:**

We are looking for an accomplished **Analog IO Circuit Design Engineer** with relevant **years of semiconductor design experience** to develop high-performance, power-efficient GPIOs, analog, mixed-signal, and chip-chip circuits for advanced SoCs.

This is a highly technical role for an engineer who thrives on solving challenging circuit-design problems across **advanced process nodes, high-speed interfaces, GPIO/I/O subsystems, power management, sensing, and mixed-signal integration**. You will take designs from architecture and transistor-level implementation through verification, physical design, sign-off, and silicon bring-up, working closely with architecture, SoC, package, SI/PI, reliability, verification, and product engineering teams.

**THE PERSON:**

You are a strong circuit designer with deep understanding of **CMOS Analog and Mixed-signal design**, complemented by the ability to see the larger SoC and system context. You are comfortable making design trade-offs across **performance, power, area, reliability, signal integrity, process variation, and time-to-market**.

You combine hands-on transistor-level expertise with technical leadership and can independently drive complex designs, resolve ambiguous technical problems, and collaborate effectively across geographically distributed engineering teams.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Architect, design, and deliver advanced **analog, mixed-signal, and I/O circuits** for high-performance SoCs.
* Develop and optimize circuits such as **GPIO/I/O interfaces, transmitters and receivers, level shifters, voltage detectors, clocking/support circuits, sensors, bias circuits, analog control circuits, and power-management interfaces**.
* Perform detailed **PVT, Monte Carlo, mismatch, noise, jitter, timing, power, and reliability analyses** to ensure robust operation across manufacturing and operating conditions.
* Analyze I/O interfaces for **signal integrity, power integrity, supply droop, ground bounce, termination, loading, and package/board interactions**.
* Ensure designs meet appropriate **ESD, EOS, electromigration, aging, TDDB, voltage-stress, and device-reliability** requirements.
* Partner closely with **layout engineers** to drive matching, shielding, parasitic management, floorplanning, power routing, and analog layout quality.
* Collaborate with **SoC architecture, RTL/DV, DFT, physical design, package, board, SI/PI, firmware, reliability, and product engineering** teams to enable successful IP integration.
* Develop behavioral models and specifications that enable efficient **mixed-signal and SoC-level verification**.
* Support **post-layout verification, design reviews, tape-out, silicon bring-up, characterization, debug, and production qualification**.
* Identify design risks early and drive technically sound solutions through data-driven analysis.
* Contribute to circuit and design-methodology innovation and help drive **next-generation IP architecture and reuse**.
* Own circuit design from **specification and architecture through schematic design, simulation, layout supervision, extraction, sign-off, and silicon characterization**.
* Provide technical guidance and mentoring to engineers while raising the overall engineering quality of the team.

**PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:**

  

* Industry experience in analog, mixed-signal, I/O, or custom IC design.
* Strong transistor-level design fundamentals and extensive experience with **CMOS circuit design and simulation**.
* Proven experience delivering complex analog/mixed-signal or I/O IP to **production silicon**.
* Experience with advanced semiconductor process technologies and understanding of **device scaling, process variation, reliability, and low-voltage design challenges**.
* Strong knowledge in several of the following areas:
  + GPIO and general-purpose I/O
  + High-speed transmitter/receiver circuits
  + Level shifters and multi-voltage-domain interfaces
  + Analog/PVT/voltage/temperature monitoring
  + Power and droop detection
  + Clocking and timing circuits
  + Bias and reference circuits
  + Low-power analog techniques
  + Signal and power integrity
* Hands-on experience with industry-standard **schematic, simulation, layout, extraction, and sign-off flows**, including SPICE-class circuit simulation.
* Solid understanding of **PVT analysis, Monte Carlo analysis, mismatch, parasitics, timing, jitter, duty-cycle distortion, noise, and circuit stability**.
* Experience debugging challenging **pre-silicon and post-silicon** circuit issues.
* Ability to translate system-level requirements into clear **circuit specifications and verification requirements**.
* Strong technical communication skills and demonstrated ability to influence architectural and design decisions across multiple engineering teams.

**ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS:**

* **Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Microelectronics, or a closely related discipline**, with substantial industry experience in Analog IO/Mixed-signal IC design.

description:

**About the job**
-----------------

A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.

The Geo Data Operations (GDO) Tools team is focused on building the next generation of operational tooling to scale Google Maps and Geo data production. We are looking for a highly technical, AI-forward Technical Program Manager (TPM) to drive our transition toward machine-led operations and agentic workflows, while ensuring our systems maintain the highest standards of security and access governance.

In this role, you will sit at the intersection of AI innovation, security, and operational excellence. You will not only manage complex, cross-functional programs but will also be technically in designing and implementing AI agents to solve operational pain points. Additionally, you will own critical aspects of our tooling security, ensuring that access controls, and automation, and data governance scale securely alongside our AI investments.

The Geo team is focused on building the most accurate, comprehensive, and useful maps for our users, through products like Maps, Earth, Street View, Google Maps Platform, and more. Every month, more than a billion people rely on Maps services to explore the world and navigate their daily lives.  
  
The Geo team also enables developers to use the power of Google Maps platforms to enhance their apps and websites. As they plot a course for the future of mapping, they are solving complex computer science problems, designing beautiful and intuitive product experiences, and improving our understanding of the real world.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Work with the global Program Manager (PgM) team to develop and deliver AI Automation projects from conception to implementation, and seamlessly manage relationships across engineering and operations.
* Be direct with AI technologies (including Jetski, ADK, Gemini, and custom agents) to actively build solutions that solve complex operational pain points and automate manual workflows.

title: Project Manager Construction, HYD
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  
  
The Data Center Construction Manager (CM) is responsible for managing some of the most technical, cost efficient, and fast paced construction project schedules achievable. Amazon Construction Managers are constantly challenged to drive continuous improvement and deliver the highest quality, most technically efficient data centers in the world.
  
  
As a Data Center CM you will be a part of highly creative, efficient team tasked with tackling the most fascinating and challenging problems in building Amazon data facilities. Amazon CM's are always at the forefront of the construction industry in terms of innovation, and maintain a focus to deliver the most innovative products to our customers.
  
  
Our data centers are industry leading facilities in terms of energy efficiency and cost effectiveness. The Data Center CM is ultimately responsible for the day to day construction oversight and management of the contractors. The CM will also be utilized as a leader in their specific discipline (construction management, building services, architectural, electrical or mechanical engineering) and be responsible as a team member for delivering construction of some of the most sophisticated electrical and mechanical systems in the world.
  
At Amazon we leverage unique opportunities presented to us by owning everything from the substation, to the server, and back to the cooling towers. We are diverse, upbeat, creative, team-oriented construction professionals working on a daily basis to develop data centers that are changing the face of data facilities  
  
Key job responsibilities  
The Data Center CM will be responsible for:
  

* Assist in project management and oversight of construction-related activities for new builds or general capital projects in Hydrabad area, under guidance from senior team members.
* Support efforts to drive costs down and shorten schedules while maintaining quality.
* Contribute to Construction Management for specific initiatives aimed at increasing the resiliency of our data centers.
* Participate in reviews of construct-ability of electrical and mechanical systems and building designs associated with the construction of new data centers or the optimization of existing data centers.
* Assist in creating project scope and equipment requirements, help with request for proposals, and capital requests.
* Support total project quality by assisting with commissioning and integrated system testing, and helping oversee the execution of the project.
* Help manage the Request for Information process during construction and coordinate construction administration with engineers.
* Record and report key metrics to team members and management.
* Learn to manage multiple projects concurrently, including new data center building and capital improvement projects associated with existing data centers.
* Provide operational support of installed facilities, including review of procedures, best practices, and maintenance initiatives.
* Develop leadership skills within the group and in internal and external teams that support the data center.
* Travel to datacenter sites for electrical, mechanical system audits and reviews, construct-ability reviews, startup testing, and full commissioning, as required, under supervision.

  
A day in the life  
At Amazon we are a global team responsible for the design and operation of industry leading, geographically diverse, large scale critical facilities. Each team member is a highly motivated individual with demonstrated construction management and analytical expertise in the areas of complex, mission critical facilities. Daily responsibilities will include all aspects of the entire data center lifecycle construction starting with the site feasibility, through the procurement of the design teams and design review, daily construction oversight, and commissioning of completed facilities.  
  
About the team  
About AWS  
Diverse Experiences  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  
  
Why AWS?  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  
  
Inclusive Team Culture  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.  
  
Work/Life Balance  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
* Experience in vendor management
* Experience in a data center or other critical environment

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3+ years of construction or project management experience
* Experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings
* Knowledge of critical data center equipment
* Experience in construction or project management

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Manager, Technical Documentation
description:
About Us:

Seismic is the Go-To-Market Performance company, driving how organizations turn their strategy into revenue. Seismic brings together signals from customer conversations, buyer engagement, governed content, coaching and seller behavior to turn intelligence into winning action. Through its AI revenue execution platform, the company equips customer-facing teams with the insights, governance, and contextual guidance they need to execute with confidence and deliver measurable business outcomes. Trusted by 2,500 organizations and over 3.5 million users around the globe, Seismic is headquartered in San Diego with offices across North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific. Learn more at seismic.com.

Seismic is committed to building an inclusive workplace that ignites growth for our employees and creates a culture of belonging that allows all employees to be seen and valued for who they are. Learn more about DEI at Seismic here.

Overview:

Technical writers play an instrumental role at Seismic, delivering product documentation that drives product adoption, reduces Support demand, and serves as the source of truth for the AI-powered answers our customers rely on.  
  
Our writers use DITA for authoring AI-ready product documentation, and we deliver it through an AI-powered, enterprise-class, multi-channel content delivery platform. Our documentation team sits within Product & Engineering with shared governance, tools, and processes, and our writers are embedded with product development teams in India, China, Europe, and the US.  
  
We have had technical writers in India for three years, and we're now growing a team in our Hyderabad office. We're looking for experienced documentation professionals who will help us keep pace with growing demand and shape how we work.  
  
We're implementing agentic documentation workflows to help us keep up with accelerating product innovation and focus our energy where it delivers the most value. Our writers will continue to own the quality of everything that reaches our customers, and increasingly will help shape the templates, prompts, skills, and quality criteria our AI workflows run on. If you're curious, empathetic, detail-oriented, and thrive in fast-paced environments, you sound like one of us. If you want to help redefine what a documentation professional looks like in an agentic world, this is your chance.  
  
This is a hybrid role: you'll lead the Hyderabad team while owning documentation for one or more product areas, keeping you close to the tools, the content, and the day-to-day realities your team faces.

Who you are::

* BA/BS degree in English, Technical Communication/Writing, Computer Science or a related technical discipline, or relevant professional experience (required)
* 8+ years relevant experience in Scrum/Agile development environments (required)
* 2+ years leading or managing documentation teams authoring in DITA and producing structured, topic-based content (required)
* Experience hiring, onboarding, and developing technical writers (required)
* Experience with Oxygen, Ixiasoft, Fluid Topics, Jira, or similar tools a plus
* Hands-on experience using generative AI tools (Claude or comparable) in documentation work (required)
* Experience developing Claude skills (or comparable) and publishing them to GitHub (preferred)
* Experience rolling out or governing AI-assisted or agentic content workflows, or leading teams through other process and tooling change, a plus
* Experience with information architecture or API documentation a plus
* Impeccable oral and written English skills
* Flexibility to accommodate synchronous work across time zones as needed

What you'll be doing::

**Team leadership**

* Act as in-region leader for the Hyderabad Technical Communications team and primary point of contact to US-based leadership
* Oversee the India team's documentation delivery, monitoring the product development pipeline in Jira to ensure work is assigned, loads are balanced, and documentation is delivered on schedule
* Help recruit, onboard, and ramp new technical writers; lead regular 1:1s; coach, develop, and provide performance feedback
* Edit and coach writers to ensure flawless, style-compliant written English, and help them build strong relationships with product managers, designers, and engineers
* Partner with US team leaders to balance workload across distributed teams, establish global best practices, drive quality and consistency, and build a positive team culture
* Drive continuous improvement of the India team's documentation using analytics and feedback from customers and internal users
* Develop a deep understanding of Seismic's information model and publishing platform

**Hands-on documentation**

* Deliver documentation for new product features and updates using Oxygen XML and Ixiasoft, our DITA authoring and cCMS tools
* Analyze existing documentation and update, revise, replace, and retire as needed
* Serve as documentation lead for one or more product areas: scope and plan work, track feature development in Jira, coordinate with other writers, and partner with product managers, designers, and engineers to deliver all required documentation on schedule
* Build deep knowledge of our products, technology, and customers, and relationships with the experts who inform your work
* Collaborate with knowledge architects on architecture and taxonomy changes, and lead the India team in adopting enhancements that improve authoring efficiency and content delivery

**As our agentic workflows mature, you will also:**

* + Lead the India team's adoption of agentic documentation workflows: training, operating procedures, and change management
  + Partner with US leadership to define human-in-the-loop controls, approval authority, and exception handling for the region, and monitor workflow health metrics
  + Develop Claude skills and champion their use across the team, ensuring the India team contributes to our shared skill library in GitHub

Job Posting Footer:

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Please be aware we have noticed an increase in hiring scams potentially targeting Seismic candidates. Read our full statement on our Careers page.

title: Database Administrator (MSSQL - PostgreSQL / MySQL) - 24*7 Operations
description:
**Keyloop bridges the gap between dealers, manufacturers, technology suppliers and car buyers.**

We empower car dealers and manufacturers to fully embrace digital transformation. How? By creating innovative technology that makes selling cars better for our customers, and buying and owning cars better for theirs.

We use cutting-edge technology to link our clients’ systems, departments and sites. We provide an open technology platform that’s shaping the industry for the future. We use data to help clients become more efficient, increase profitability and give more customers an amazing experience. **Want to be part of it?**

**Role Summary**

We are looking for an L2 Database Engineer to join our 24/7 Operations Centre. You will be the second line of support for production databases running on Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL and MySQL across AWS and on-premises environments. You will own database monitoring, alert triage, read-only investigation, and incident response using approved runbooks, and escalate to the L3 Database Infrastructure team with clear diagnostics for remediation and deeper engineering work. The ideal candidate has strong hands-on experience in at least two of these technologies, with MSSQL combined with PostgreSQL or MySQL being highly preferred

### **Key Responsibilities**

**Database Monitoring and Incident Response**

* Monitor database health, performance, availability, and capacity alerts; triage incidents and coordinate them through to resolution and closure within SLA, working with the L3 team.

* Act as the first technical escalation point for L1 operations engineers on database-related alerts and tickets.

* Troubleshoot common production issues such as blocking and deadlocks, long-running queries, connection exhaustion, storage and log growth, failed jobs, and replication lag.

* Escalate to the L3 DBA team with complete diagnostics (timeline, evidence, queries run, actions taken) and participate in major incident bridge calls.

**Microsoft SQL Server Operations**

* Support SQL Server instances, including Always On Availability Groups, log shipping, and SQL Agent jobs.

* Investigate blocking, waits, TempDB pressure, and transaction log growth using DMVs, Query Store, and Extended Events.

* Monitor backup jobs and backup history, and escalate failures or recoverability gaps to the L3 team.

* Monitor scheduled maintenance jobs (index and statistics maintenance, integrity checks) and escalate failures with diagnostics.

**PostgreSQL and MySQL Operations**

* Support PostgreSQL clusters, including streaming replication and Patroni-based high availability; monitor replication health, lag, and cluster status.

* Investigate sessions, locks, and slow queries using pg\_stat\_activity, pg\_stat\_statements, and EXPLAIN; monitor autovacuum, bloat, and transaction ID age.

* Support MySQL instances, including replication status, slow query log analysis, InnoDB lock investigation, and backup status monitoring.

* Support databases hosted on AWS (Amazon RDS, Aurora, and EC2), using CloudWatch and Performance Insights for diagnostics.

**Backup Monitoring and Investigation**

* Verify daily backup success across the estate, and raise and track failures to closure.

* Investigate production issues using a read-only, evidence-first approach, validating findings before recommending remediation to the L3 team.

**Process and Continuous Improvement**

* Maintain and improve database runbooks, SOPs, and knowledge base articles based on recurring incidents.

* Run structured shift handovers covering open incidents, risks, and pending escalations.

* Identify alert noise and automation opportunities (SQL, PowerShell, Bash, or Python) and work with the L3 team to reduce manual toil.

* Ensure compliance with security, access control, audit, and data protection policies.

### **Essential skillsets & experience:**

* 6–10 years of hands-on experience supporting production databases, including experience in a 24/7 operations or on-call environment.

* Strong hands-on experience in at least two of the following: Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL. MSSQL combined with PostgreSQL or MySQL is highly preferred.

* Solid understanding of database internals: locking and concurrency, indexing, execution plans, transaction logs/WAL, and backup and recovery concepts.

* Practical experience with high availability and replication: SQL Server Always On, PostgreSQL streaming replication (Patroni is a plus), and MySQL replication.

* Strong SQL skills for diagnostics, plus scripting in PowerShell, Bash, and/or Python.

* Disciplined, evidence-first troubleshooting approach: validating findings before escalating, and clearly documenting diagnostics for the L3 team.

* Working knowledge of Linux and Windows Server from a database support perspective.

* Exposure to AWS database services (RDS, Aurora, EC2-hosted databases) and monitoring tools (e.g., CloudWatch, Datadog, Grafana, SolarWinds DPA).

* Working knowledge of ITIL processes (incident and problem management) and ticketing tools (e.g., ServiceNow, Jira Service Management).

* Ability to stay calm, methodical, and decisive under pressure, with excellent written and verbal communication, including clear incident updates and handover notes.

* Willingness to work rotational shifts, nights, weekends, and public holidays.

### **Desirable skills:**

**Desirable Skills**

* Exposure to Oracle Database or MongoDB operations.

* Experience supporting database migrations, particularly to PostgreSQL.

* Relevant certifications (e.g., Microsoft Azure/SQL Server, AWS Certified Database – Specialty, PostgreSQL or MySQL certifications).

**Why join us?**

We’re on a journey to become market leaders in our space – and with that comes some incredible opportunities. Collaborate and learn from industry experts from all over the globe. Work with game-changing products and services. Get the training and support you need to try new things, adapt to quick changes and explore different paths. Join Keyloop and progress your career, your way.

**An inclusive environment to thrive**

We’re committed to fostering an inclusive work environment. One that respects all dimensions of diversity. We promote an inclusive culture within our business, and we celebrate different employees and lifestyles – not just on key days, but every day.

**Be rewarded for your efforts**

We believe people should be paid based on their performance so our pay and benefits reflect this and are designed to attract the very best talent. We encourage everyone in our organisation to explore opportunities which enable them to grow their career through investment in their development but equally by working in a culture which fosters support and unbridled collaboration.

Keyloop doesn’t require academic qualifications for this position. We select based on experience and potential, not credentials.

**We are also an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. We value diversity and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply***.*

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. title: SAP BASIS EXPERT
description:
Job Summary
  
  
We are seeking an experienced SAP Basis Administrator to manage, monitor, administer, and support SAP ECC systems running on SAP HANA. The candidate will be responsible for ensuring the availability, performance, security, and stability of the SAP landscape while supporting implementation, upgrade, migration, and day-to-day operational activities.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
SAP System Administration (Install, configure, and administer SAP ECC systems, Perform SAP kernel upgrades and patching, Execute SAP Support Package and Enhancement Package implementations, Manage SAP profiles and instance parameters, Administer SAP application servers and services.)
  
  
SAP HANA Administration (Monitor SAP HANA database health and performance, Perform HANA backups and recovery activities, Monitor disk usage, memory utilization, and CPU performance, Execute HANA revision upgrades and patching, Manage HANA users, roles, and privileges. )
  
  
System Monitoring Performance (Perform proactive monitoring, Analyze system performance and recommend optimization, Troubleshoot memory, CPU, database, and work process issues, Review EarlyWatch Alert reports and implement recommendations)

title: Senior Associate Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
#### **Overview**

Founded in 1988, Trimont (www.trimont.com) is a specialized global commercial real estate loan services provider and partner for lenders and investors seeking the infrastructure and capabilities needed to help them scale their business and make informed, effective decisions related to the deployment, management and administration of commercial real estate secured credit. As the largest master servicer of commercial real estate loans in the United States, Trimont manages securitizations with meticulous oversight and coordination—protecting cash flows, mitigating risk, and ensuring portfolio performance.

TriVinna, a Trimont company, is rebuilding commercial real estate lending software from the ground up. For decades, CRE lenders have run trillion-dollar portfolios on fragmented legacy systems, disconnected spreadsheets, and manual re-keying of borrower financials, rent rolls, and loan events. Leveraging Trimont’s access to approximately 11% of all U.S. commercial real estate lending data and nearly four decades of servicing expertise, we are building an AI-native platform that captures loan data at the source, unifies it across the full loan lifecycle, and turns it into decisions lenders can act on.

TriVinna is an innovative firm where visionary professionals come to learn, grow, and thrive with colleagues driven by curiosity and collaboration.

* **Learn:** We believe ongoing learning is critical and are focused on providing a work environment where all team members can take ownership of their careers.
* **Grow:** We work alongside the largest institutional lenders in the world, overseeing the most significant projects in the industry. This unique opportunity allows us to broaden our skillset and develop our abilities by tackling some of the industry’s most challenging and exciting endeavors.
* **Thrive:** Our firm is a place where ethics and excellence meet to create an experience that matches our capabilities. There are no limits to what we as team members and as an organization, can achieve together.

*Where people, purpose, and progress come together every day.*

#### **Job Summary**

TriVinna is seeking a Senior QA Engineer to own the depth and quality of testing for the products that are replacing the legacy tools CRE lenders have relied on for decades. Our multi-service .NET platform handles loan review and servicing for institutional lenders, and when a lender imports a rent roll or approves a loan action, the result has to be right.

You will design each product’s tests, build them with a coding agent, and keep them valid as the products change. You will report to the QA Lead, who sets how testing works across the platform, and you will make it work for your products. Your job is to pair close knowledge of those products with sharp judgment about what the agent wrote, so that a passing test means the product works.

#### **Key Responsibilities**

**What you’ll work on**

* **Browser tests:** Playwright and TypeScript journeys through each product’s React screens.
* **Workflow and API tests:** flows that cross services, such as a rent roll import through review and approval.
* **Access tests:** which roles can reach which endpoints and data, across organizations and sub-organizations.
* **Test data:** the files and seeded records each feature’s tests need, with the values a correct result produces.
* **Tests in the pipeline:** your tests run in CI against a fresh environment for each feature, not only on a laptop.
* **Failed runs:** telling a product fault from a faulty test, and keeping the tests reliable.

**Examples of work you’d own end to end**

* Review a new feature’s requirements, list what can’t be tested as written, and plan its tests before work starts.
* Write the browser journey for a document upload: import a rent roll, check the values it produced against the expected ones, and take it through approval.
* Build access tests for a service: every role against every endpoint, allowed or refused.
* Investigate a failed overnight run, decide whether the product or the test is at fault, then file the bug or fix the test.
* Get a new test running at the right stage of the pipeline, and debug it when it fails only in CI.
* Fix the tests after an intended UI change, as a pull request.
* Add a test for a bug that reached users, and show that it fails without the fix.

#### **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5-12 years testing software products, including test automation with Playwright and TypeScript.
* Experience owning a product’s tests end to end, from a feature’s requirements to its test design, the tests themselves, their data, and the failures they raise.
* Real experience with coding agents in testing: you can describe a test an agent wrote that passed for the wrong reason, and how you caught it.

**Expert (you could teach it)**

* Test design: turning requirements into cases that cover the behavior, its boundaries, and its failure paths, and knowing which are worth automating.
* Playwright and TypeScript: browser journeys, fixtures, locators that survive UI changes, tracing, and debugging a flaky test.
* Reading a failure: telling a product fault from a faulty test, and a test that proves behavior from one that only passes.

**Strong (you do it independently)**

* API testing: HTTP, authentication, tokens and roles, and request and response contracts.
* Test data design: seeded organizations, users, and roles, and input files with known expected results.
* Tests in CI: GitHub Actions, tests selected by tag, reading a failed run, and telling an environment problem from a test problem.
* Bug reports a developer can act on: steps, evidence, expected, and actual.

**Working knowledge (you deliver, with some lookup)**

* C# and .NET, enough to follow an endpoint to its permission check.
* SQL, enough to check what a workflow wrote.
* Accessibility checks and screenshot comparisons.

#### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in commercial real estate lending or servicing.
* Experience testing spreadsheet and document imports.
* Contract testing and exploratory testing.

#### **How We Work**

**With agents**

* You use a coding agent to write most of the test code, and you treat the output as a draft.
* You check every generated assertion against the requirement. A test has to fail when the behavior is wrong.
* You give the agent the right context: the requirement, the screen or endpoint, the test data, and how the existing tests are written.
* You never paste secrets or customer data into a tool, and test data never comes from production.

**With the team**

* You review requirements before work starts, and ask questions until a feature is testable.
* Collaborate with data engineers to curate accurate data schemas and manage data quality in the test environment.
* You send each failure to whoever can fix it, with what they need to reproduce it.
* You work to the standards the QA Lead sets, and tell the lead where they don’t fit your products.
* Developers write unit tests and the tests for their own code; you own the tests of the running product.
* You raise a blocker the day you see it, in writing, with what’s blocked, what you tried, and what you need.
* You say up front when a feature’s testing won’t fit its schedule.

#### **Why This Role**

Commercial real estate lending is one of the largest asset classes in the world, and it still runs on software built for a different era. The software that replaces it has to be trusted with every number. This is a rare chance to be the person who makes sure it is, backed by the data, client relationships, and operational expertise of the largest master servicer in the United States.

* **Own real quality.** Be the reason lenders can trust what TriVinna’s products produce.
* **Work at the frontier.** Test in one of the most advanced AI-assisted engineering practices in financial services.
* **Learn the domain.** Build deep knowledge of CRE lending through the workflows you test.
* **Work with the industry’s leaders.** Your work will support some of the largest institutional lenders and investors in commercial real estate.

Trimont and TriVinna are equal opportunity employers, and we’re proud to support and celebrate diversity in the workplace. If you have a disability and need an accommodation or assistance with the application process and/or using our website, please contact us. We are proud to maintain a drug-free policy, ensuring that our community is a secure and productive space for all our team members.

title: Senior Associate CRE Data Analytics
description:
#### **Overview**

Founded in 1988, Trimont (www.trimont.com) is a specialized global commercial real estate loan services provider and partner for lenders and investors seeking the infrastructure and capabilities needed to help them scale their business and make informed, effective decisions related to the deployment, management and administration of commercial real estate secured credit. As the largest master servicer of commercial real estate loans in the United States, Trimont manages securitizations with meticulous oversight and coordination—protecting cash flows, mitigating risk, and ensuring portfolio performance.

TriVinna, a Trimont company, is rebuilding commercial real estate lending software from the ground up. For decades, CRE lenders have run trillion-dollar portfolios on fragmented legacy systems, disconnected spreadsheets, and manual re-keying of borrower financials, rent rolls, and loan events. Leveraging Trimont’s access to approximately 11% of all U.S. commercial real estate lending data and nearly four decades of servicing expertise, we are building an AI-native platform that captures loan data at the source, unifies it across the full loan lifecycle, and turns it into decisions lenders can act on.

TriVinna is an innovative firm where visionary professionals come to learn, grow, and thrive with colleagues driven by curiosity and collaboration.

* **Learn:** We believe ongoing learning is critical and are focused on providing a work environment where all team members can take ownership of their careers.
* **Grow:** We work alongside the largest institutional lenders in the world, overseeing the most significant projects in the industry. This unique opportunity allows us to broaden our skillset and develop our abilities by tackling some of the industry’s most challenging and exciting endeavors.
* **Thrive:** Our firm is a place where ethics and excellence meet to create an experience that matches our capabilities. There are no limits to what we as team members and as an organization, can achieve together.

*Where people, purpose, and progress come together every day.*

#### **Job Summary**

TriVinna is seeking a CRE Data Analyst to make sure the data behind the next generation of commercial real estate lending software is true to the loans it describes. Loan data lives in many systems that were never designed to agree. We are bringing it together into one consistent, well-tested model that our products, our teams, and our AI agents can rely on, and accuracy is everything.

You will define what each field means, check what we load against the loan documents, and establish the verified answers our products and AI agents are tested against. You will bring first-hand experience of CRE loans to a team of data engineers, serve as the team’s authority on what the data means, and be its link to the servicing, asset management, and loan boarding professionals who work with these loans every day. You will join a small team early, while the model is still taking shape, and help decide how it represents a loan.

#### **Key Responsibilities**

**Data accuracy**

* Verify loaded data against loan agreements, servicing records, and source systems, and log every mismatch with its cause.
* Use SQL and Excel to profile data, find exceptions, and size a problem before raising it.
* Write the business rules that settle conflicts between systems, such as which maturity date applies after an extension.
* Map code lists from source systems to industry standards such as CREFC IRP.

**Ground truth for products and AI**

* Build and maintain the verified answer set: for selected loans, establish by hand the correct answers to the questions our products and AI agents will be asked.
* Review the answers our products and AI agents give, and judge whether each is right for the loan.
* Trace business scenarios through the data, such as a covenant breach, a major tenant leaving, or a loan nearing maturity, and report which data each needs and whether we hold it.

**Capturing expertise**

* Document how experienced servicing and asset management professionals assess and act on real situations, so that expertise can be built into our products.
* Partner with servicing, asset management, and loan boarding teams, and explain findings clearly to engineers who know the tables better than the business.

#### **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Real Estate, Economics, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 4-10 years of experience in CRE loan servicing, asset management, loan boarding, CMBS surveillance, or underwriting.
* Experience reading loan agreements and identifying covenants, triggers, reserve requirements, and extension terms.
* Working knowledge of CRE loan metrics, including DSCR, LTV, debt yield, and NOI, and how each is built from operating statements and rent rolls.
* Experience writing SQL to query, join, and summarize data, and advanced Excel.
* Precise written communication: definitions and rules that other people can build from.

#### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Hands-on experience with a loan servicing or asset management system.
* Experience with CREFC IRP reporting, and familiarity with MISMO.
* Experience on a system migration, data conversion, or data clean-up project.
* Experience with both balance-sheet and securitized (CMBS) loans.
* Basic Python for data analysis.
* Experience using AI tools in day-to-day work, with a habit of checking results and following your organization’s data-handling rules.
* Experience in financial services, working with regulated client data under privacy, audit, and data-governance rules.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, including explaining loan concepts to technical colleagues.

#### **How We Work**

* **Team player.** You share what you learn, ask for review early, and make the people around you faster. Much of our progress depends on the teams that own source systems, so good relationships are part of the job.
* **Honor everyone’s time.** Questions are batched, not drip-fed. A meeting gets a short pre-read; a request is small and specific, with the answer made easy to give.
* **Think before you act.** Data systems are shared and the data belongs to clients. You understand a source before you query it, think about the load before a heavy job, and run it once.
* **Own your piece.** When you take something on, you see it through: built, tested, documented, and explained in plain words. If it is going to slip, you say so early.

#### **Why This Role**

Commercial real estate lending is one of the largest asset classes in the world, and its data has never lived in one place. AI can only be as good as the data it reasons over, and this is a rare chance to make that data right, backed by the client relationships and operational expertise of the largest master servicer in the United States.

* **Be the source of truth.** Define what the data means and decide what “correct” looks like for every product and AI agent we build.
* **Put your CRE expertise to new use.** Turn years of servicing and asset management experience into the foundation of AI-native lending software.

title: Business Analyst, Strategy
description:
**Our Company:**

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.

**Business Analyst, Strategy**

The Business Analyst, Strategy is a key planning, analysis, and execution role within Teradata’s Strategy organization. Reporting to the VP of Strategy and Strategic Planning, this individual will deliver market and competitive intelligence, business analysis, executive decision support, and program management for priority strategic initiatives. The analyst will combine rigorous qualitative and quantitative analysis with effective use of approved AI tools to accelerate research, identify insights, test hypotheses, and improve the quality and speed of deliverables. The role also supports initiative tracking, cross-functional execution, and other high-priority needs across a global organization.

The ideal candidate has experience synthesizing qualitative and quantitative information, using analytics and visualization tools, and drafting executive-ready reports and presentations. Success requires sound judgment in the responsible use of AI, including validating outputs, protecting confidential information, documenting sources, and applying human review. The candidate must work effectively across functions, cultures, countries, and time zones with a high degree of confidentiality, independence, adaptability, attention to detail, and ownership in a fast-paced environment.

**The Team:**

We are a mission-driven, globally connected team focused on helping Teradata anticipate change, make stronger decisions, and drive measurable impact. We gather input from diverse internal and external sources, develop clear points of view, and partner across Product, Go-to-Market, Finance, Services, People, and other functions to translate strategy into action.

**The Day-to-Day Experience:**

You will bring curiosity, structured problem-solving, and a proactive, collaborative mindset. You will analyze complex issues, communicate clearly with global stakeholders, manage workstreams, and use modern digital and AI tools responsibly to increase productivity and insight. You will do this by:

* Frame strategic questions, identify root causes, and engage cross-functional leaders and subject-matter experts to develop fact-based perspectives.

* Conduct market, customer, competitor, and technology research; synthesize findings into actionable recommendations for senior leaders.

* Use approved generative AI, copilots, search, and automation tools to accelerate research, analysis, scenario development, drafting, and knowledge management while verifying accuracy, documenting sources, and safeguarding confidential data.

* Help build clear, concise, executive-ready presentations, written communications, and decision materials for senior management.

* Manage strategic workstreams, milestones, metrics, risks, dependencies, and action items; proactively surface issues and drive follow-through.

* Support ongoing strategic programs, including win-loss analysis, strategy refreshes, initiative acceleration, and enterprise performance tracking.

* Develop and maintain dashboards and analyses using tools such as Excel and Power BI, translating data into insights for stakeholders.

* Collaborate effectively with colleagues across regions and time zones, adapting communication and working practices for a global environment.

**Preferred Experience & Qualifications:**

* 2+ years of relevant experience in strategy, business analysis, market intelligence, consulting, corporate development, finance, operations, or a related field.

* Strong analytical skills and demonstrated ability to turn complex information into concise insights, recommendations, and executive-level communications.

* Practical proficiency with AI-enabled productivity and research tools, Microsoft 365, and data analysis or visualization tools; willingness to learn new tools rapidly.

* Understanding of responsible AI practices, including verification, privacy, security, intellectual property, bias awareness, and appropriate human oversight.

* Familiarity with enterprise technology, data, analytics, cloud, and AI market dynamics is preferred.

* Demonstrated ability to collaborate in a multicultural, distributed environment; professional fluency in English is required, and additional language skills are welcome.

* Candidates may be considered in countries where Teradata has an employing entity and can support the position. Employment is subject to local requirements, including eligibility to work in the applicable country; any immigration or sponsorship support will depend on role location and company policy.

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience.

**Teradata’s Global Culture and ESG Commitment**

Teradata supports global teams through competitive, equitable, and inclusive programs and continues its environmental, social, and governance journey across data, people, stewardship, and integrity. Employment practices, benefits, workplace arrangements, and eligibility requirements vary by country and role. Learn more at https://bit.ly/3DZOD60.

title: Multi Assets Index Quant Research Analyst
description:
Your Team Responsibilities
  
  
The Multi-Asset Class (MAC) research team at MSCI designs, builds and documents multi-asset and complex indices, building on the capabilities acquired with Compass Financial Technologies. The team develops quantitative index methodologies spanning multiple asset classes and investment strategies, including derivatives-based investment strategies. The successful candidate will join the MAC research team contributing to the research and development of innovative index solutions.
  
  
Your Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Respond to requests from Coverage, Product and external clients for complex (covered call, autocall, intraday) and multi-asset index construction.
* Design and implement portfolio construction methodologies, including weighting, rebalancing and risk-control rules.
* Conduct quantitative research, backtesting and analysis of investment strategies using historical market data to support the development of new index methodologies.
* Analyse backtesting results, assess methodology robustness and generate insights to support index design decisions.
* Translate quantitative methodologies into reliable simulations and indexes.
* Work with product teams to scope requirements and validate methodological feasibility.
* Produce backtests and write methodology documentation for complex indices.
* Collaborate with global research, product, coverage and technology teams to support index development.
* Work within the Vulcain platform development environment (developed by Compass).

**Required Expertise**
Your skills and experience that will help you excel
  
  

* Master’s degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Financial Engineering, Quantitative Finance or a related quantitative discipline.
* Around 1-3 years of of relevant experience in quantitative research, financial engineering, derivatives, portfolio analytics or a related field. Strong candidates with relevant academic or internship experience will also be considered.
* Strong, demonstrated expertise in derivatives, including option pricing, and the mechanics of futures, options and other derivative instruments. Experience structuring or valuing products such as covered calls or autocallables is highly valued.
* Hands-on experience implementing portfolio construction methods (optimisation, weighting schemes, rebalancing and risk-control rules).
* Strong programming skills, with Python proficiency essential, including NumPy, pandas and SciPy.
* Strong quantitative and analytical skills, including familiarity with time-series analysis and statistical methods.
* Understanding of financial markets and investment strategies across asset classes, including equities, fixed income and currencies.

**Nice to have**

* Knowledge of NoSQL databases, particularly MongoDB.
* Experience with Bloomberg and/or Refinitiv APIs.
* Knowledge of crypto markets.
* Familiarity with quantitative investment strategies, including long/short and leveraged strategies.
* Familiarity with financial market data providers

**Soft Skills**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* High degree of autonomy, ownership and initiative.
* Rigorous approach with excellent attention to detail.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Collaborative mindset, able to work across technical, research and business teams.
* Curiosity and willingness to learn in a fast-evolving quantitative and technological environment.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality work within deadlines.
* Strong interpersonal and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate quantitative concepts to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**About MSCI**
**What we offer you**

* Transparent compensation schemes and comprehensive employee benefits, tailored to your location, ensuring your financial security, health, and overall wellbeing.
* Flexible working arrangements, advanced technology, and collaborative workspaces.
* A culture of high performance and innovation where we experiment with new ideas and take responsibility for achieving results.
* A global network of talented colleagues, who inspire, support, and share their expertise to innovate and deliver for our clients.
* Global Orientation program to kickstart your journey, followed by access to our Learning@MSCI platform, AI Learning Center , LinkedIn Learning Pro and tailored learning opportunities for ongoing skills development.
* Multi-directional career paths that offer professional growth and development through new challenges, internal mobility and expanded roles.
* We actively nurture an environment that builds a sense of inclusion belonging and connection, including eight Employee Resource Groups. All Abilities, Asian Support Network, Black Leadership Network, Climate Action Network, Hola! MSCI, Pride & Allies, Women in Tech, and Women’s Leadership Forum.

At MSCI we are passionate about what we do, and we are inspired by our vision – to power better decisions. You’ll be part of an industry-leading network of creative, curious, and entrepreneurial pioneers. This is a space where you can challenge yourself, set new standards and perform beyond expectations for yourself, our clients, and our industry.
  
  
MSCI strengthens global markets by connecting participants across the financial ecosystem with a common language. Our research-based data, analytics and indexes, supported by advanced technology, set standards for global investors and help our clients understand risks and opportunities so they can make better decisions and unlock innovation. We serve asset managers and owners, private-market sponsors and investors, hedge funds, wealth managers, banks, insurers and corporates.

title: Forward Deployed Analyst
description:
Role: Forward Deployed Analyst
  
Experience: 3-6 years
  
Location: Mumbai
  
Reports to: Chief Product Officer, Risk and PA
  
Full-time. Works closely with the customer success and product teams.
  
  
About EDS
  
- Investment analytics platform for hedge funds and asset managers: research management, portfolio construction, risk and performance.
  
- Clients are fundamental and quantitative long/short funds in the US, Europe and Asia.
  
  
Purpose of the role
  
- Technical partner to clients and to our customer success team.
  
- Gets clients live on EDS, answers their hardest risk and data questions, and feeds what they learn back into the product.
  
  
Responsibilities
  
- Onboard new clients and run trials: load portfolios, baskets and paper books; set up users, entitlements, views and factor models.
  
- Reconcile client data from administrators and order management systems (e.g. Enfusion, SS&C) against EDS, and own data issues through to resolution with engineering.
  
- Answer client questions on risk and performance: factor exposures, risk decomposition, stress tests, P&L attribution (including Brinson), optimization and hedging.
  
- Build analyses and examples for clients and prospects, such as hedge baskets, model comparisons, stress scenarios and risk summaries.
  
- Roll out AI to clients: set up and support MCP connections to Claude and ChatGPT, test answers for accuracy, and build reusable skills and workflows.
  
- Run working sessions and training for analysts and PMs, and write clear follow-ups after every client call.
  
- Turn client feedback into well-specified product requests, and test new features before clients see them.
  
- Document client-specific setups and data pipelines so they are repeatable.
  
  
Must-haves
  
- 3 to 6 years in buy-side risk or portfolio analytics, or in solutions/client engineering at a fintech or data vendor.
  
- Strong working knowledge of equity factor risk models (MSCI Barra, Axioma, Wolfe or similar), portfolio risk and performance attribution.
  
- Strong SQL and Python, comfortable with large position and returns datasets.
  
- Clear written and spoken communication with senior investment professionals.
  
- Owns a problem across client, product and engineering until it is solved.
  
- Regular overlap with US Eastern hours, including client calls: until 10p IST
  
  
Nice-to-haves
  
- CFA (or progress toward it), FRM, or a quantitative degree.
  
- Experience with OMS/PMS and administrator data feeds, or Snowflake.
  
- Hands-on experience with LLM tools, MCP, or building AI workflows.
  
- Product sense: writing requirements or working with an engineering team on features.

title: Data Engineer, Aladdin Data, Vice President
description:
**About This Role**
**Data Engineer, Aladdin Data, Vice President**
**Your team**
The Aladdin BlackRock Data Office (BDO) builds trusted, scalable, and governed data products that advance the firm’s enterprise data strategy. ClientIQ is a strategic initiative bringing together data, analytics, and artificial intelligence (AI) to power next-generation client intelligence and engagement.
  
  
The team builds modern data and technology capabilities powering our global sales organization, partnering across engineering teams, data governance, and client teams to deliver intuitive data solutions, actionable insights, and AI-powered workflows.
  
  
**Your role and impact**
In this role, you will provide hands-on technical and architectural leadership for the data capabilities underpinning ClientIQ. You will define architecture, establish engineering standards, and work closely with teams from technical discovery and prototyping through production delivery and adoption.
  
  
A critical expectation is the ability to quickly learn and leverage BlackRock’s internally developed Data Platform as a Service (dPaaS) capabilities. You will champion a reuse-first approach, leveraging and extending existing platform capabilities before building new solutions.
  
  
You will lead data engineering across structured and semi-structured data, creating trusted, reusable, and AI-ready data products that power applications, analytics, generative AI (GenAI), and agentic experiences.
  
  
**Your Responsibilities**
In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and combine the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies with the rigor to challenge the results. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities:
  
  

* Define and evolve ClientIQ’s target-state data architecture, leveraging internal dPaaS capabilities and applying a reuse-first approach across data products, models, application programming interfaces (APIs), metadata, and shared services.
* Provide hands-on architecture and engineering leadership from technical discovery and prototyping through production delivery, partnering across platform, product, engineering, AI, governance, and business teams.
* Architect the ingestion, integration, and modeling of client, product, sales, marketing, servicing, interaction, behavioral, and external data into trusted and reusable data products.
* Lead engineering across batch and real-time processing, distributed systems, APIs, workflow orchestration, and event streaming.
* Design capabilities across structured and semi-structured data that support AI-ready architectures, including document processing, semantic search, embeddings, vector retrieval, knowledge graphs, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).
* Embed data quality, metadata, lineage, governance, observability, security, resilience, and performance into data products and production engineering practices.
* Build reusable data services that power applications, analytics, AI models, agents, and downstream platforms while improving interoperability, scalability, and speed to market.

**Your Experience**

* Demonstrated experience in data engineering, data architecture, distributed systems, or large-scale software engineering, including delivery of scalable enterprise data platforms and data products.
* Strong hands-on engineering skills in Python, Java and/or Scala, Structured Query Language (SQL), Snowflake, and data build tool (DBT), with experience across distributed processing, batch and real-time pipelines, APIs, event streaming, and data orchestration using directed acyclic graph-based workflow orchestration frameworks for data and batch processing.
* Experience developing production data solutions using Snowflake capabilities such as Streams, Tasks, Dynamic Tables, Snowpipe, semi-structured data, and role-based data access controls.
* Experience developing transactional database solutions using Microsoft SQL Server and PostgreSQL, including relational data modeling, complex SQL, stored procedures, database programming, query optimization, and performance tuning.
* Ability to rapidly learn and leverage internal platforms and dPaaS capabilities, applying strong architectural judgment to balance reuse, speed, scalability, reliability, security, cost, and maintainability.
* Experience with AI-ready data architectures and exposure to GenAI, machine learning, semantic technologies, document processing, embeddings, vector retrieval, knowledge graphs, RAG, and agentic architectures.
* Strong knowledge of data modeling, quality, metadata, lineage, governance, security, observability, resilience, performance, production engineering, Microsoft Azure, enterprise-grade container orchestration platforms supporting declarative infrastructure and horizontal scaling, containerized environments, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), and infrastructure automation.

**Our Benefits**
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
  
  
**Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
  
  
**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
**guidance**
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
  
  
**About BlackRock**
At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
  
  
This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
  
  
To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
  
  
BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

title: Sr Data Engineer
description:
Nium provides global infrastructure for real\-time cross\-border payments. We were founded on the mission to deliver the global payments infrastructure of tomorrow, today. Our platform enables banks, fintechs, and global businesses to move money instantly, everywhere.
   

  

 Co\-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore with offices in 14 markets worldwide, we are entering one of the most exciting chapters in our journey. In March 2026, we delivered the largest month in our 11\-year history with record revenue, record volumes, and EBITDA profitability. Today, Nium moves nearly $60B in payments annually, almost entirely for enterprises, while continuing to strengthen an already healthy balance sheet.
   

  

 It is an incredible time to join us, and we are only just getting started.
   

  

 Our payout network spans 190\+ countries and 100 currencies, with 100 \+ corridors in real time. We power seamless transfers to accounts, wallets, and cards, support local collections in 35 markets, and as a principal card issuer on Visa, Mastercard, Discover, and UATP, Nium issues over 50 million card tokens every year. Backed by regulatory licenses in 40\+ markets, we make it simple for our partners to onboard, integrate, and scale globally. This scale and innovation have earned us recognition as one of CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025, winner of Best Cross\-Border Payments Solution at the PayTech Awards, and inclusion in FXC Intelligence’s Top 100 Cross\-Border Payments Companies list.
   

  

 In 2024, we raised US$50 million in Series E funding at a US$1\.4 billion valuation to accelerate network expansion, product innovation, and talent growth. With the B2B payments market projected to hit US$175 trillion by 2030, Nium offers ambitious builders the chance to shape the future of global money movement with the scale of a leader and the energy of a high\-growth company.
   

  

**The Role**
 At Nium, we’re revolutionising the global payments industry — and data sits at the core of everything we do. We’re looking for a
 **passionate and skilled Data Engineer** 
 to join our India\-based Data Engineering team.
   

  

 This is more than a purely technical role. You’ll help shape the future of our data platform as we migrate from on\-premises systems to
 **AWS cloud** 
 . You’ll work hands\-on with modern tools such as
 **Airflow, Redshift, dbt** 
 , and
 **Kafka** 
 , collaborating closely with product, engineering, analytics, and business teams to deliver high\-quality, scalable data solutions that power real\-world payments and enable data\-driven decision\-making.
   

  

 You’ll have the opportunity to contribute to high\-impact projects, solve complex technical problems, and work on a platform that supports millions of users globally. If you’re motivated by learning, collaboration, and building resilient data platforms at scale, this role offers a strong opportunity for growth.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Build and optimise scalable, maintainable, and high\-performance data pipelines and workflows
* Ingest, transform, and deliver high\-volume data from a range of structured and unstructured sources, including MySQL databases and real\-time Kafka streams
* Design and maintain performant data models in Redshift, and optimise SQL queries to support analytics and reporting workloads
* Contribute to our cloud migration journey and help evolve the data architecture with new ideas and improvements
* Collaborate with cross\-functional, globally distributed teams to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions
* Embed data quality, reliability, observability, and security as first\-class principles across the data platform
* Support and enhance data solutions operating in a mission\-critical payments environment
* Continuously learn, share knowledge, and help raise standards across data governance, quality, and security practices


**Requirements**
* 4\-6 years of professional experience in Data Engineering or a related role
* Strong SQL expertise, including query optimisation, complex transformations, and datamodelling
* Solid Python skills for data engineering and pipeline development
* Hands\-on experience with AWS services such as Redshift, Lambda, Glue, and S3, as well as Airflow for orchestration
* Familiarity with modern transformation and modelling practices using tools such as dbt
* A collaborative mindset, strong problem\-solving skills, critical thinking, and a willingness to take ownership and initiative


**Nice to Have**
* Experience contributing to large\-scale cloud migration initiatives
* Knowledge of real\-time data streaming using Kafka
* Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure\-as\-code for data platforms
* Interest in exploring AI/ML use cases within modern data ecosystems
* Understanding of the payments domain or fintech data challenges


**What We Offer At Nium**
**We Value Performance:** 
 Through competitive salaries, performance bonuses, sales commissions, equity for specific roles and recognition programs, we ensure that all our employees are well rewarded and incentivized for their hard work.
   

  

**We Care for Our Employees:** 
 The wellness of Nium’ers is our \#1 priority. We offer medical coverage along with 24/7 employee assistance program, generous vacation programs including our year\-end shut down. We also provide a flexible working hybrid working environment (3 days per week in the office).
   

  

**We Upskill Ourselves:** 
 We are curious, and always want to learn more with a focus on upskilling ourselves. We provide role\-specific training, internal workshops, and a learning stipend.
   

  

**We Celebrate Together:** 
 We recognize that work is also about creating great relationships with each other. We celebrate together with company\-wide social events, team bonding activities, happy hours, team offsites, and much more!
   

  

**We Thrive with Diversity:** 
 Nium is truly a global company, with more than 33 nationalities, based in 18\+ countries and more than 10 office locations. As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to providing a safe and welcoming environment for everyone.
   

  

**Beware of recruitment scams:** 
 Be cautious of individuals impersonating Nium via WhatsApp, social media, email or unofficial websites.
 **Do not respond, share personal or financial information, or make any payments** 
 . Nium will never ask candidates to transfer money or cryptocurrency as part of our recruitment process.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
