title: Business Analyst
description:
**About Lepton Software:**

Lepton Software is a leading provider of
**Location Intelligence, Smart Mapping, and GIS-based software solutions**
, empowering enterprises across Telecom, BFSI, Government, Retail, and Automotive sectors. With over
**25+ years of expertise**
, Lepton delivers innovative geospatial products, network planning solutions, and enterprise-grade digital transformation services across global markets. Our culture encourages ownership, collaboration, continuous learning, and customer-centric innovation.

**(A) JOB SUMMARY**

We are seeking an experienced and customer-focused
**Business Analyst (Wireless Telecom)**
to lead business analysis, requirement gathering, and end-to-end project delivery for wireless telecom solutions. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in
**4G/5G RAN architecture, RF planning and optimization, telecom inventory, GIS workflows, and OSS/NMS integrations**
. The role involves engaging with customer stakeholders, translating business requirements into functional specifications, managing project scope, timelines, risks, and deliverables, and coordinating with cross-functional teams to ensure successful implementation. The candidate should have excellent communication, stakeholder management, and project management skills, along with
**6–8 years of overall experience, including at least 4 years in the wireless telecom domain.**

**(B) JOB DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITY**

· Run requirement workshops with customer stakeholders across
**RAN planning, RF optimization, transmission, site acquisition, NOC, IT and circle operations.**
Document as-is and to-be processes for each.

· Map Customer's wireless asset model into Lepton Solution. This covers
**sites, towers, BTS/eNodeB/gNodeB, sectors, antennas, cells, backhaul links (fiber and MW), and passive infra such as power and shelters.**
Define attributes, relationships and naming conventions.

· Prepare
**BRDs, FRDs, user stories and acceptance criteria**
that the Lepton product team can build against without repeated clarification calls.

· Own the
**requirement traceability matrix**
from Customer's contract scope down to test cases. Flag any requirement that falls outside the signed scope before it is built.

· Define data migration rules for legacy sources such as
**site databases, planning tools, NMS/OSS exports and Excel trackers.**
Specify data cleansing, de-duplication and geo-coordinate validation rules. Track data quality per circle.

· Specify integration requirements with Customer systems like
**OSS, NMS, ticketing, ERP/SAP and planning tools.**
Capture interface type, frequency, payload and ownership for each.

· Work with the product team on
**GIS workflows relevant to wireless operations.**
Examples include coverage and site-gap analysis, new site feasibility, backhaul path planning, site-to-fiber proximity and outage impact mapping.

· Prepare
**UAT scenarios**
with Customer's business users. Run UAT sessions, log defects, and drive closure with sign-off eCustomerdence.

· Prepare
**training material and user guides.**
Conduct training for Customer circle and corporate users.

· Track milestones against the
**contractual delivery schedule and payment milestones.**
Raise slippage early with a recovery plan, not after the date has passed.

· Run
**weekly status calls**
with Customer and
**fortnightly steering reCustomerews**
with Customer leadership. Publish status reports,
**RAID logs (risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies) and MoMs within 24 hours.**

· Coordinate internal resources across
**product, engineering, GIS data, QA and DevOps.**
Hold sprint plans to the committed scope.

**(C) QUALIFICATION & SKILLSET**

**Required skills and experience**

·
**4 or more years**
working with wireless networks.

· Very Good knowledge of
**4G/5G RAN architecture, site and cell parameters, RF planning, optimization, and transmission (MW and fiber backhaul).**

· Good knowledge of
**GIS, Telecom inventory, planning and OSS processes.**
Familiarity with the Feasibility-to-Order and Fault-to-Repair cycles.

· Hands-on experience writing
**BRDs, FRDs, user stories and UAT test cases**
for enterprise software.

·
**3 or more years**
managing customer-facing software delivery projects, with ownership of plan, scope, risk and stakeholder reporting.

·
**Good communication skills.**
Able to hold a room with senior operator stakeholders and push back on scope when needed.

**Qualifications**

·
**B.E./B.Tech**
in Electronics and Communication, Telecommunications, Computer Science or an equivalent discipline. An MBA is an advantage but not required.

**Why Join Lepton Software:**

· Fast-paced, growth-focused environment

· Opportunity to drive processes independently

title: Product Manager - API & Data Management
description:
***Where will your career take you next? Let’s find out together.***

At Zurich Cover-More, we’re proud to be one of the world’s leading travel insurance and assistance providers
*.*
Each year, we protect more than 20 million travellers worldwide, making sure we’re there every step of their journey with proactive care, personalised cover and specialist support. Zurich Cover-More partners with many of the world’s best-known brands – think major airlines, travel giants, top banks, credit card providers, and large retailers – to deliver more care, more cover, for all.

Launched in December 2024, Zurich Cover-More is the global travel brand of Zurich Insurance Group, one of the world’s leading multi-line insurers. Our family of customer-facing brands includes trusted names like Travel Guard, Cover-More Travel Insurance, Travelex Insurance, Universal Assistance, World Travel Protection, Freely, and Blue Insurance. Together, we’re redefining what it means to travel safely and with confidence. Whether it’s a long-awaited holiday, a last-minute business trip, or an unexpected detour, we deliver in the moments that matter.

**About the opportunity:**

We're looking for an experienced Product Manager who treats APIs and data as products, with real consumers, roadmaps, service levels and adoption targets. You'll own two of Sirius's Phase 1 priorities: our enterprise API library and data and reporting optimization, plus the canonical data model that connects our brands, regions and partners. This is a product role that owns priorities and outcomes, not a hands-on developer or data engineering position.

**What you’ll be doing:**

* Own the vision, roadmap and backlog for the API library across quote, buy, policy servicing, claims and assistance
* Know your API consumers — internal channels, Freely, airlines, travel agents, banks and affinity partners — and build for them
* Set API standards with Enterprise Architecture: design conventions, security, versioning and deprecation
* Launch a developer portal and self-service partner onboarding, and cut the time it takes a partner to go live
* Act as product owner for API delivery on MuleSoft, and help shape our move toward a group-wide integration platform
* Own the canonical data model for customer, policy, product, quote, claim, partner and payment
* Establish master data, data quality, lineage and stewardship with business domain owners
* Rationalize reporting so the business has one trusted source for core metrics
* Build privacy, consent and data residency into every API and data product
* Lead the API & Data pods with our SI partner: epics, acceptance criteria, sprint reviews and sign-off

**What skills and experience you’ll bring on this journey:**

* 8+ years in product management, integration, data management or enterprise technology, including 4+ years owning APIs, integration platforms or data products
* A track record shipping an API program with external partner consumers
* Experience defining or governing an enterprise or canonical data model
* Fluency in REST, OpenAPI, event-driven integration, OAuth 2.0 and API gateways; MuleSoft Anypoint or similar
* Strong grounding in data quality, master data, lineage and BI tools such as Power BI or Tableau
* Experience in large transformation programs with multiple partners and regions
* The ability to turn competing asks from many stakeholders into one clear, defensible priority list

**Nice to have**

* Insurance, financial services, or travel and assistance experience
* Familiarity with ACORD or other insurance data standards
* Experience consolidating integration estates onto a shared platform
* Exposure to AWS data services, Snowflake or Databricks
* MuleSoft, SAFe or Scrum Product Owner (CSPO or PSPO) certification

**Why you’ll love working with us!**

We value optimism, caring, togetherness, reliability, results-orientation, and forward-thinking.

We have more than 3000 employees worldwide. We are a global group of digital specialists, actuaries, marketers, doctors, nurses, case managers, claims specialists, finance experts, customer service and corporate services professionals. We share a global purpose to look after travellers, at every step of their journey.

**Job flexibility**
. We understand the importance of making sure that work fits into your life, not the other way around. Our hybrid approach ensures you can maintain work-life balance with the flexibility of 3 days in the office and 2 days working from home, after an initial training period.

**Career growth**
. This is an extremely exciting time for us at Zurich Cover-More, as we rapidly expand our business across the globe. We’re committed to helping our people thrive through a comprehensive onboarding experience, continuous professional development, and a supportive work environment that empowers growth at every stage of your career.

**Take the time you need, for you and your community**
. We encourage you to take the time you need when you need it. We offer regular annual and personal leave benefits along with anniversary leave, volunteer leave and a comprehensive paid parental leave scheme.

**Diversity and inclusion**
. We respect who you are and thoroughly embrace diversity. Wherever life has taken you, we welcome you to bring your whole self to work. Just be you – because that’s exactly who we’re looking for.

**We also offer some other perks including:**

* Mediclaim insurance cover in case of any health emergency
* Coverage under group personal accident insurance
* Flexible and compressed work weeks and hybrid working options.
* Generous range of paid leave – 21 annual leave days, 6 sick leave days, 12 public holidays
* An extra day off for you to take on your birthday or your annual work anniversary.

***Apply today and let’s go to great places together!***

The role involves translating business challenges into mathematical models, solving large-scale optimisation problems and generating actionable insights to improve operational efficiency, reduce costs, enhance service levels and strengthen network resilience.

The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in mathematical modelling, programming, optimisation algorithms and supply chain network design.

Key Responsibilities:

* Design, develop and maintain network optimisation models covering facility location, network design, material flow allocation, capacity planning and transportation routing.
* Formulate complex business problems using Linear Programming (LP), Mixed Integer Programming (MIP) and Network Flow models.
* Implement and solve optimisation models using Python and commercial or open-source optimisation solvers.
* Conduct scenario planning and sensitivity analysis to evaluate changes in demand, transportation costs, facility locations, capacity and supply chain disruptions.
* Develop heuristics and metaheuristics to solve large-scale optimisation problems where conventional methods are computationally expensive.
* Extract, clean, validate and analyse data from ERP, Transportation Management Systems (TMS), Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) and other enterprise platforms.
* Collaborate with supply chain, logistics, operations and commercial teams to understand business requirements and translate them into optimisation models.
* Present model outputs, recommendations and business trade-offs through dashboards, reports and presentations.
* Monitor model performance and measure the impact of optimisation recommendations on cost, service levels and operational efficiency.

Required Skills & Qualifications:

* 3–6 years of relevant experience in Operations Research, Mathematical Optimisation, Network Optimisation or Supply Chain Analytics.
* Strong understanding of Linear Programming (LP), Mixed Integer Programming (MIP), Integer Programming and Network Flow models.
* Hands-on programming experience in Python for mathematical modelling and optimisation.
* Experience working with optimisation solvers such as Gurobi, IBM CPLEX, Google OR-Tools or equivalent.
* Knowledge of optimisation modelling frameworks such as Pyomo or PuLP.
* Strong SQL skills and experience in data extraction, manipulation and validation.
* Understanding of supply chain network design, logistics optimisation, transportation planning and capacity allocation.
* Experience developing heuristics or metaheuristics for large-scale optimisation problems.
* Familiarity with Power BI, Tableau or other visualisation tools.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science or a related quantitative discipline.
* Experience working in manufacturing, logistics, supply chain, transportation or consulting environments.
* Exposure to GIS, spatial analytics, digital twins or simulation-based optimisation.
* Experience working with large datasets and enterprise systems such as ERP, TMS and WMS.

Pay: ₹10,000.00 - ₹51,000.00 per month

title: Internal Audit, Regional Audit Mumbai – Business Auditor, Vice President, Mumbai
description:
**Internal Audit – Regional Audit Mumbai – Business Auditor (Vice President, Mumbai)**

  

**What We Do**
  
As the third line of defense, Internal Audit’s mission is to independently assess the firm’s internal control structure, including the firm’s governance processes and controls, and risk management and capital and anti-financial crime frameworks, raise awareness of control risk and monitor the implementation of management’s control measures. In doing so, internal Audit:

  

* Communicates and reports on the effectiveness of the firm’s governance, risk management and controls that mitigate current and evolving risk
* Raises awareness of control risk
* Assesses the firm’s control culture and conduct risks; and
* Monitors management’s implementation of control measures
  

Goldman Sachs Internal Audit comprises individuals from diverse backgrounds including chartered accountants, developers, risk management professionals, cybersecurity professionals, and data scientists. We are organized into global teams comprising business and technology auditors to cover all the firm’s businesses and functions, including securities, investment banking, consumer and investment management, risk management, finance, cyber-security and technology risk, and engineering.

  

**Who We Look For**
  
Goldman Sachs Internal Auditors demonstrate strong risk and control mindsets, analytical skills, exercise professional skepticism and are able to challenge and discuss effectively with management on risks and control measures. We look for individuals who enjoy learning about audit, businesses and functions, have innovative and creative mindsets to adopt analytical techniques to enhance audit techniques, build relationships and are able to evolve and thrive in teamwork and in a fast-paced global environment.

**Regional Audit Mumbai – Business Audit**

As a Business Auditor, you will be leading audits supporting various businesses, including Trading Desks across our Primary Dealer, Mortgages & Structured Credit, and Listed Equities & Derivatives businesses; Investment Banking & Equity Capital Market activity; Operations; Compliance; and Product Controllers. You will provide assurance on controls related to trade execution, trade booking, supervision, regulatory compliance, middle office operations and settlements, as well as other general business controls such as balance sheet substantiation, Sarbanes-Oxley 404 control assessments and other processes that support the firm’s activities in Mumbai. In addition, the role may designate you as the Head of Audit for regulated entities, as required under certain regulatory requirements. This will require regular engagement with regulators, external and concurrent auditors, the Board of Directors and senior management independently.

  

**Your Impact**

As part of the third line of defense, you will independently assess the firm’s overall control environment and communicate the effectiveness of the controls that mitigate current and emerging risks to the firm’s local and global management. You will also monitor management’s implementation of control measures. In doing so, you will support the provision of independent, objective and timely assurance around the firm’s internal control structure, and help the Audit Committee, the Board of Directors and the Risk Committee fulfill their oversight responsibilities.

  

**Responsibilities**

As a Vice President, you will be responsible for leading audit deliverables through effective project management and review of the team’s work. You will plan the scope of each audit, manage the audit team through execution, and discuss and agree audit results with the firm’s local and global management and other key stakeholders. You will play a vital role in executing the Mumbai annual audit plan, reviewing business processes, analyzing the risks involved, and assessing the design and operating effectiveness of the controls implemented to mitigate those risks.

In addition, you will monitor and follow up with management on the resolution of open audit issues and maintain stakeholder relationships to monitor risk in their space. You will also drive the department’s continuous monitoring effort with stakeholders to evaluate incidents, market and regulatory events, and business and technology updates. You are strongly encouraged to participate in department-wide initiatives aimed at continually improving Internal Audit’s processes and supporting infrastructure.

  

**Basic Qualifications**

* Chartered Accountant, Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA), MBA specialized in Finance, or a Master’s or equivalent university degree in Accounting or Finance.
* At least 7 years of experience in risk-based audits, preferably focusing on financial services.
* Experience in managing audits related to Primary Dealers, Non-Banking Financial Companies (NBFC), Mortgage and Structured Credit Trading, Broker Dealers and/or Equities and Listed Derivatives business in India.
* Experience in interfacing with regulators (RBI, SEBI, etc.) in India, including managing regulatory queries and inspections related to Primary Dealers, NBFCs, and/or Broker Dealers.
* Strong understanding of the regulatory framework across securities product types in India (fixed income, currencies, equities, listed derivatives and/or structured credit), along with experience handling audits related to regulatory compliance.
* Experience in handling senior stakeholder interaction including the ability to effectively challenge and advise management on the existing risks and control framework.
* Experience in managing audit engagements, with good judgement to think ahead and plan for contingencies.
* Strong technical skills required for the role with attention to detail, strong analytical and succinct documentation skills.
* Experience in people management and adaptable to differential ways of working
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, interpersonal skills, as the job requires frequent interaction with cross functional teams and various hierarchies within management across geographies.
* Highly motivated with the ability to multi-task and remain organized in a fast-paced environment.
  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with data analytics tools and techniques
* Relevant certification or industry accreditation
* Knowledge of Financial Products and Services
* Capable of efficiency improvement or automated solutions that assist audit work

At TrendAI™, we’re always seeking exceptional talent; people who want to collaborate with the best and push boundaries together. Here, your work goes beyond building a career. You will help protect what matters and play a vital role in shaping a safer, more trustworthy AI-powered future.

  

AI Fearlessly.

**Job Description**

**Customer Success Technical Advisor** **– (Post Sales Engineer)**

  

**ABOUT TRENDAI (TREND MICRO)**

Trend Micro, a global cybersecurity leader, helps make the world safe for exchanging digital information across enterprises, governments, and consumers. Fueled by over three decades of security expertise and relentless innovation, Trend leverages the full power of AI to protect more than 500,000 organizations and millions of individuals worldwide.

In 2026, Trend Micro evolved its enterprise business under the **TrendAI™** brand, reflecting a strategic shift from protecting infrastructure to governing how AI systems, agents, and data-driven decisions act across the enterprise attack surface. At the core of this protection is **TrendAI Vision One™** , the industry’s first AI-powered enterprise cybersecurity platform. It centralizes cyber risk exposure management and security operations, delivering robust, layered protection across on-premises, hybrid, and multi-cloud environments—including critical partnerships with NVIDIA, AWS, Google, and Microsoft. With 7,000 employees across 70 countries and world-class threat intelligence from the **Zero Day Initiative™ (ZDI)** , Trend empowers organizations to move from reactive defense to proactive resilience. In an era of industrialized, machine-driven cybercrime, Trend Micro ensures enterprises can innovate with confidence. Proactive security starts here.

  

**Position Overview :**

As a **Customer Success Technical Advisor (CSTA)** , you are the strategic technical linchpin for Trend Micro’s enterprise clients. Your mission is to move beyond reactive troubleshooting to become a **Trusted Advisor** , ensuring customers achieve measurable cybersecurity resilience. You will lead the technical journey for our most strategic accounts, transforming complex security requirements into scalable, operational successes within the TrendAI Vision One™ ecosystem.

  

**Primary Responsibilities**

* Provide direct technical support to premium and key customers.
* Manage customer accounts by providing technical updates, conducting monthly and quarterly case reviews, delivering threat assessments and advisories for proactive protection, training customers on products and emerging threats, communicating product enhancements and bug fixes, and fostering strong customer relationships to support account retention.
* Be a trusted threat advisor for nominated customers ·
* Act as the customer’s champion within Trend Micro ·
* Be available 24x7 to provide crisis support services to nominated customers ·
* Manage and progress technical support cases ·
* Provide assistance to nominated backup customers when other team members are absent ·
* Regularly meet with clients for the purpose of relationship building ·
* Participate in strategic account planning with the Trend Micro account team ·
* Work closely with account managers to identify sales opportunities ·
* Conduct presentations for potential customers to drive growth in Premium Support Program enrollments .
* Provide guidance, consultancy, technical support, and problem resolution to key customers/channel partners in implementation projects ·
* Collaborate with internal teams to enhance customer/partner experience ·
Perform back-up pre-sales role as required  

  

**Our Ideal Candidate: Required Skills & Qualifications**

* 8+ years of experience in technical support, security architecture, post-sales technical support, system administration, or a related field..
* Technical certifications such as TCAP, TSCE, VCP, CCNA, CCNP, CISSP, MCSE, Sun Certified Professional, or equivalent certifications will be an advantage ·
* Strong interpersonal, customer service, and problem-solving skills.
* In-depth knowledge of multiple operating systems (Windows, Windows Server, Linux, Solaris) and networking environments ·
* Good interpersonal skills and service orientation · Good problem-solving skills ·
* Able to cope with customer demands and take challenges positively ·
* Resourceful, self-managed, energetic, friendly, with excellent communication skills ·
Strong documentation skills and adherence to process methodologies  

**Why Joining TrendAI**

Do you believe in a workplace where you can be your unique self by celebrating your perspectives and ideas? Do you value a culture of values, empathy and where people are encouraged to challenge the status quo? Do you believe that environment of cooperation and collaboration drives performance and innovation? If yes, be part of Trend Micro, an inclusive, global company where your opportunity to make an impact is endless and you are empowered to learn, lead and perform at your best.

We embrace change, empower people, and encourage innovation. Join Trend Micro and Thrive with us.

title: Infrastructure Engineer I – eApps
description:
**COMPANY OVERVIEW**

We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.

  

**OVERVIEW**

• **Support the Enterprise Applications (E-Apps) team** in operating reliable, secure, and efficient infrastructure for third-party enterprise applications across GCP and hybrid environments.

• **Perform hands-on platform administration, monitoring, troubleshooting, patching, automation, and operational support** under established standards and guidance from senior engineers.

• **Contribute to Infrastructure as Code and automation** using Terraform, Ansible, Python, Shell scripting, and PowerShell to improve consistency and reduce manual effort.

• **Work with senior engineers, infrastructure teams, application stakeholders, and vendors** to support deployments, project activities, incident resolution, and continuous improvement.

**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES**

• **Platform operations:** Support the health, availability, configuration, and day-to-day administration of the E-Apps infrastructure and application platforms.

• **Administration and maintenance:** Perform standard platform configuration, patching, upgrades, certificate updates, access changes, backup checks, and routine maintenance across Windows and Linux environments.

• **Web and application platforms:** Support IIS, JBoss, and Apache environments, including application hosting, configuration, service restarts, reverse proxy settings, ports, certificates, and basic Java application troubleshooting.

• **Cloud and infrastructure:** Support GCP resources and approved hybrid infrastructure patterns involving compute, networking, IAM, load balancing, DNS, SSL/TLS, storage, and connectivity.

• **Automation:** Develop and maintain Terraform configurations, Ansible playbooks, Python utilities, and Shell or PowerShell scripts for repeatable operational tasks.

• **Observability and performance:** Use Datadog or equivalent monitoring tools to review metrics, logs, dashboards, alerts, health checks, and basic performance indicators; escalate abnormal conditions promptly.

• **Incident and ITSM support:** Resolve routine incidents, document actions, participate in incident and change processes, maintain knowledge articles, and escalate complex issues with clear evidence and impact details.

• **Project delivery:** Support infrastructure and application activities for assigned projects, deployments, testing, environment readiness, and operational handover.

• **Collaboration and knowledge sharing:** Work effectively with D&T, network, OS, security, application, and vendor teams; follow standards and share operational knowledge.

• **Resilience and continuous improvement:** Help improve monitoring, reliability, patch compliance, recovery readiness, runbooks, and standard operating procedures for third-party enterprise applications.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

• **Education:** Full-time graduation from an accredited university in engineering, computer science, information technology, or a related discipline.

• **Experience:** 3–5 years of experience supporting infrastructure, middleware, or enterprise application platforms in production or business-critical environments.

• **GCP and infrastructure:** Working knowledge of GCP services, cloud and hybrid infrastructure concepts, load balancers, SSL/TLS certificates, DNS, networking, and access management.

• **Automation and scripting:** Practical experience with Terraform, Ansible, Python, Shell scripting, or PowerShell for operational support, configuration, validation, and automation.

• **Middleware and platform administration:** Working knowledge of IIS, JBoss, and Apache across Windows and Linux platforms, including configuration, troubleshooting, patching, service management, and application integration.

• **Operating systems and databases:** Familiarity with Windows Server and Linux administration, relational database concepts, and supporting applications that use Oracle, SQL Server, or MySQL.

• **Monitoring and operations:** Experience with Datadog or equivalent observability tools, incident handling, patching, operational documentation, and basic root-cause investigation.

• **ITSM and communication:** Working knowledge of incident, change, service request, escalation, and problem-management practices, with strong written and verbal communication skills.

• **Core proficiency:** Ability to follow standards, troubleshoot methodically, learn new technologies, and collaborate with senior engineers, stakeholders, and vendors.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

• **Cloud breadth:** Exposure to AWS or Azure administration; GCP remains the primary cloud platform for this role.

• **Delivery practices:** Understanding of CI/CD pipelines, source control, DevOps practices, and release or deployment automation.

• **Continuous improvement:** Demonstrates analytical thinking, identifies operational improvements, and uses AI capabilities where they provide business value.

• **Professional behaviors:** Demonstrates reliability, ownership, integrity, teamwork, learning agility, and a positive service mindset.

  

**SUPPORT REQUIREMENT**

• Participate in extended off-hours shift coverage, including overnight, weekend, holiday, and on-call support on a weekly rotational basis, aligned to US business-hours support needs.

  

**ELIGIBILITY**

Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

title: Data Center Technician, Data Center Operations (DCO)
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
  
Design, implement, and maintain Linux-based server infrastructures with a focus on reliability and scalability.  
Perform comprehensive system monitoring, diagnostics, and performance optimization  
Configure and manage network hardware, including switches, routers, and complex cabling systems  
Develop and maintain robust backup and disaster recovery strategies.  
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless technological integration.  
  
About the team  
About AWS  
Diverse Experiences
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  
Work/Life Balance
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field
* Experience working with Linux operating systems
* Can lift and rack equipment up to 40 pounds

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Can work in cramped spaces or in elevated locations while adhering to health & safety guidelines
* 2+ years of Computer Hardware Repair, Infrastructure Cabling, Network Deployment, Data Center Operations, or Technical Project Management experience
* 2+ years of Linux operating systems experience
* 2+ years of network cabling, fiber optics, and test equipment including VFL, power meter, and OTDR experience
* 2+ years of data center, critical environment, computer hardware repair, infrastructure cabling, network deployment, or data center operations experience

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: BMS Engineer
description:

title: RF Engineer - Medical device
description:
**Job Requirements**  

As an RF designer, you will be designing and developing the RF hardware modules for the RF Coils sub system of MR products, for hospital and outpatient radiology facilities. Together with other electronic hardware designers (RF, analog, digital and mixed signal), mechanical engineers, system engineering, manufacturing, and service engineers you will take products from concept through design into production to meet our customer’s needs. If you're passionate about healthcare innovation and cutting-edge technology, this is your chance to make a meaningful impact.

**Your role:**

* You will be responsible for the design (models, schematics, and layout), realization, integration, and verification of analog and RF components of the MRI systems.
* Contribute to the electronic design and development of analog circuits including RF circuits, PCB schematics, layout plans, wiring drawings, and assembling.
* Assemble, configure, repair, and connect electronic systems and devices.
* Debug and characterize complex electronic circuits using standard test and measurement equipment (oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, network analyzers).
* The present result, root cause analysis to a broader audience and drive for best possible performance of RF Front End.
* Support on various technical aspects of regulatory compliance.
* Participation in the activity of verification and validation for the design process
* Actively participate in cost saving opportunities, design maintenance and solving end-of-life issues.
* Document development efforts for subsystem component and module, including requirements, specifications, design plans, reviews, test procedures and test reports.
* Coordinate, support, and execute product tests to provide a traceable verification of the product.

  
**Work Experience**  

* You hold a bachelor’s or master’s degree in electrical or electronics engineering specialised in RF Circuit design.
* 8-12 years of experience in RF hardware development, preferably in a (safety) regulated industry such as medical devices, gas appliances and aviation equipment.
* Solid understanding of RF concepts such as impedance matching, impedance transformation, distributed systems, passive RLC and resonant circuits, noise, linearity, bandwidth, and stability from tens of kHz to a few Mhz.
* Familiar with lab instruments including Network Analyzers, Spectrum Analyzers, Signal Generators, RF Probe Stations, Noise Figure Analyzers
* Strong lab skills in data collection & analysis, lab debugging & tuning, and product troubleshooting
* Familiarity with various component blocks inside the RF transceiver lines, including coils, tuning and matching circuits, LNA, upconverters/downconverters, baseband filters, driver amplifiers/power amplifiers, linear RF switches, attenuators, low noise regulators, amplifiers, transimpedance amplifier, and biasing circuits.
* A self-starter and team player with a strong desire to learn on the job. Strong desire and commitment to take product from concept to volume production
* You have outstanding communication skills, are highly motivated and a good team player.

title: Performance Analyst Engineer
description:
**JOB PURPOSE**

To monitor, analyse, identify gaps in the operational performance of wind and solar assets through data analytics, SCADA monitoring and performance analytics tool. Co-ordinate with the RE asset managers on regular basis to rectify the identified gap and ensure overall improvement in performance of the RE assets. The role is responsible for delivering actionable insights to maximize energy generation, improve availability and revenue from the RE assets while ensuring compliance with contractual obligations, and organizational performance standards. The incumbent shall support site asset managers and operations teams in identifying performance losses, root causes of underperformance or abnormal behaviour of equipment, and opportunities for operational excellence across renewable energy assets.

Accountabilities :

1. Performance Monitoring & Analytics

Major Activities :

Monitor real-time performance of wind turbines, solar inverters, substations, and associated systems using SCADA platforms & analytical tools.

* Analyse generation, availability, Plant Load Factor (PLF), Performance Ratio (PR), Capacity Utilisation Factor (CUF), machine downtime, and operational KPIs including temperature analysis of RE asset components.

* Identify underperforming assets or abnormal behaviour of equipment’s in report to asset managers.

* Develop daily, weekly, and monthly performance reports. • Benchmark site and equipment performance against contractual and industry standards.

Loss Analysis & Optimization:

* Conduct generation loss analysis due to machine & grid availability, curtailment, environmental factors, and operational constraints.

* Identify energy yield improvement opportunities.

* Perform root cause analysis for recurring performance issues.

* Support implementation of corrective and preventive actions.

* Monitor effectiveness of improvement initiatives.

Asset Reliability & Condition Monitoring:

* Monitor turbine, converter & inverter health indicators.

* Analyse alarms, event logs, and condition monitoring data.

* Support predictive maintenance initiatives through data analytics.

* Coordinate with asset managers to track critical failures and reliability trends.

Reporting & Stakeholder Management:

* Generate MIS reports for management and stakeholders.

* Present performance trends, KPI analysis, and improvement recommendations.

* Support preparation of business reviews presentations & reports.

* Collaborate with site incharges & operations team.

Data Management & Digitalization:

* Track correction done by OEM/ISP’s at site against under performance identified.

* Maintain accuracy and integrity of operational databases.

* Develop automated dashboards using Power BI, Excel, or similar visualization tools.

* Support digital transformation initiatives involving SCADA, IoT, analytics, and AI applications.

* Ensure consistency between operational and reporting systems.

* Raise tickets for defects in the performance analytics tool & ensure 100 % data accuracy in monitoring tool & site DGR.

* Ensure data availability of SCADA data from OEM to Apraava Central Monitoring Tool/ Performance Analytics Tool. Co-ordinate with OEM/ISP for any data gap.

* Ensure > 95% Scada data is going to QCA’s for Forecasting & Scheduling.

DECISIONS

Decisions made by job holder

Escalation of asset underperformance to asset managers/ cluster managers/regional managers.

Identification of performance improvement opportunities in asset / equipment

Recommendation of corrective actions based on analytics tools / SCADA monitoring

INTERACTIONS :

Internal Clients

1. Roles you need to interact with inside the organization to enable success in your day-to-day work

Operations team – Understanding different O&M Practices of Renewables (Wind & Solar)

Operations team – Daily basis with regards to the performance issues related to the assets

Operations team – Communication & follow up with site team on performance monitoring KPIs

Operations team – Failure analysis and operational improvements

External Clients

2. Roles you need to interact with outside the organization to enable success in your day-to-day work

Monitoring dashboard developers – Ensure uptime of dashboard & data availability for plant monitoring.

Data Availability – OEMs / ISPs

Wind resource data provider – Communication to get wind resource data for budgeting & MIS preparation

SKILLS AND KNOWLEDGE

Educational Qualifications - Mandatory Qualification: B. E/ B.Tech (Electrical/Mechanical/Electronics) Preferred: Certification in Data Analytics & Power BI. Physical fitness - Medical test mandatory before joining Relevant and total years of Experience - 2-3 years of Experience in wind/solar plant performance monitoring.

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Commuter assistance
* Flexible schedule
* Food provided
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

title: Business Operations Analyst
description:
Company Overview
  
  
Siemens brings together the real world of automation and the digital worlds of IT and AI to create value across every industry. Our software business is all about computer-aided design, 3D modeling and simulation, helping innovative manufacturers worldwide design better products, faster! With the resources of a large company, and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together while creating a world class software portfolio. Our culture encourages creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth, so our people, our business, and our customers can achieve their full potential.
  
  
Position Overview
  
  
We are looking for a Business Operations Analyst to act as the engine behind our Operational efficiency, Finance reporting and day-to-day execution. In this role, you will bridge the gap between Business and Core Finance turning complex operational metrics into clear, actionable insights, building robust automation, and helping leadership scale our processes smoothly.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
**Data-Driven Insights:** Analyze operational performance, financial metrics, and resource utilization to identify bottlenecks, cost drivers, and growth opportunities.
  
  
**Reporting & Dashboards:** Design, build, and maintain executive-level dashboards and management reports (using Excel, Power BI, or similar tools) to track key performance indicators (KPIs).
  
  
**Process Automation:** Streamline recurring reporting and operational workflows by developing advanced macros, scripts, or automated pipelines to eliminate manual toil.
  
  
**Strategic Projects:** Partner cross-functionally with finance, IT, procurement and leadership on high-impact projects, from cost optimization analyses (e.g., cloud/SaaS spend) to capacity planning.
  
  
**Operational Governance:** Standardize operational cadences, track strategic initiative milestones, and ensure cross-team alignment on key deliverables.
  
  
**Operations:** Liaise with Internal / external vendors, clients, and stakeholders to facilitate business operations. Assist in Procurement and Invoicing activities.
  
  
Qualifications
  
  
**Experience:** 2–5 years of experience in business operations, finance, management consulting, or a highly analytical data role.
  
  
**Technical Toolkit:** Advanced Excel skills (complex modelling, Power Query, VBA/macros).
  
  
**Technical Toolkit:** Familiarity with data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau).
  
  
**Technical Toolkit:** Basic scripting or data manipulation skills (Python, SQL) are a strong plus.
  
  
**Business Acumen:** Ability to translate raw data into a compelling narrative for management and executive stakeholders.
  
  
**Problem-Solving Mindset:** A natural curiosity for how things works and a bias toward action when spotting inefficiencies.
  
  
**Education:** Bachelor's degree in business, Finance, or a related quantitative field.
  
  
Why Us
  
  
**We are Siemens:**  
At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work—hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world.
  
  
You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!
  
  
We value your unique identity and perspective. We are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society, while ensuring that we attract the best talent based on qualifications, skills, and experiences. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday with us.
  
  
Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday

title: BUSINESS ANALYST (WIRELESS TELECOM)
description:
**About Lepton Software:**

Lepton Software is a leading provider of **Location Intelligence, Smart Mapping, and GIS-based software solutions**, empowering enterprises across Telecom, BFSI, Government, Retail, and Automotive sectors. With over **25+ years of expertise**, Lepton delivers innovative geospatial products, network planning solutions, and enterprise-grade digital transformation services across global markets. Our culture encourages ownership, collaboration, continuous learning, and customer-centric innovation.

**(A) JOB SUMMARY**

We are seeking an experienced and customer-focused **Business Analyst (Wireless Telecom)** to lead business analysis, requirement gathering, and end-to-end project delivery for wireless telecom solutions. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in **4G/5G RAN architecture, RF planning and optimization, telecom inventory, GIS workflows, and OSS/NMS integrations**. The role involves engaging with customer stakeholders, translating business requirements into functional specifications, managing project scope, timelines, risks, and deliverables, and coordinating with cross-functional teams to ensure successful implementation. The candidate should have excellent communication, stakeholder management, and project management skills, along with **6–8 years of overall experience, including at least 4 years in the wireless telecom domain.**

**(B) JOB DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITY**

* Run requirement workshops with customer stakeholders across **RAN planning, RF optimization, transmission, site acquisition, NOC, IT and circle operations.** Document as-is and to-be processes for each.
* Map Customer's wireless asset model into Lepton Solution. This covers **sites, towers, BTS/eNodeB/gNodeB, sectors, antennas, cells, backhaul links (fiber and MW), and passive infra such as power and shelters.** Define attributes, relationships and naming conventions.
* Prepare **BRDs, FRDs, user stories and acceptance criteria** that the Lepton product team can build against without repeated clarification calls.
* Own the **requirement traceability matrix** from Customer's contract scope down to test cases. Flag any requirement that falls outside the signed scope before it is built.
* Define data migration rules for legacy sources such as **site databases, planning tools, NMS/OSS exports and Excel trackers.** Specify data cleansing, de-duplication and geo-coordinate validation rules. Track data quality per circle.
* Specify integration requirements with Customer systems like **OSS, NMS, ticketing, ERP/SAP and planning tools.** Capture interface type, frequency, payload and ownership for each.
* Work with the product team on **GIS workflows relevant to wireless operations.** Examples include coverage and site-gap analysis, new site feasibility, backhaul path planning, site-to-fiber proximity and outage impact mapping.
* Prepare **UAT scenarios** with Customer's business users. Run UAT sessions, log defects, and drive closure with sign-off eCustomerdence.
* Prepare **training material and user guides.** Conduct training for Customer circle and corporate users.
* Track milestones against the **contractual delivery schedule and payment milestones.** Raise slippage early with a recovery plan, not after the date has passed.
* Run **weekly status calls** with Customer and **fortnightly steering reCustomerews** with Customer leadership. Publish status reports, **RAID logs (risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies) and MoMs within 24 hours.**
* Coordinate internal resources across **product, engineering, GIS data, QA and DevOps.** Hold sprint plans to the committed scope.

**(C) QUALIFICATION & SKILLSET**

**Required skills and experience**

* **4 or more years** working with wireless networks.
* Very Good knowledge of **4G/5G RAN architecture, site and cell parameters, RF planning, optimization, and transmission (MW and fiber backhaul).**
* Good knowledge of **GIS, Telecom inventory, planning and OSS processes.** Familiarity with the Feasibility-to-Order and Fault-to-Repair cycles.
* Hands-on experience writing **BRDs, FRDs, user stories and UAT test cases** for enterprise software.
* **3 or more years** managing customer-facing software delivery projects, with ownership of plan, scope, risk and stakeholder reporting.
* **Good communication skills.** Able to hold a room with senior operator stakeholders and push back on scope when needed.

**Qualifications**

* **B.E./B.Tech** in Electronics and Communication, Telecommunications, Computer Science or an equivalent discipline. An MBA is an advantage but not required.

**Why Join Lepton Software:**

* Fast-paced, growth-focused environment
* Opportunity to drive processes independently

title: SOC Engineer
description:
Security Operations Center Engineer

1.1 Overview

DNEG's expanding Information Security function requires a hands-on Security Engineer to strengthen security monitoring, detection, vulnerability management, incident response, security engineering, and automation across endpoint, network, cloud, identity, application, and data environments. The role will support DNEG's strategic priorities in AI innovation, product development, and cloud transformation, with a strong focus on improving day-to-day security operations through effective use of automation and approved AI-assisted tools. The ideal candidate will work closely with InfoSec, IT, infrastructure, engineering, product, and GRC teams to implement and maintain effective technical controls, investigate security events, reduce vulnerabilities, improve detection and response capabilities, and identify opportunities to automate repetitive security activities. The role is expected to make practical and responsible use of approved AI-assisted tools for activities such as alert investigation, threat intelligence enrichment, vulnerability analysis, detection development, scripting, reporting, and security operations, while independently validating AI-generated outputs against security telemetry and trusted sources. The role will help protect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of DNEG systems, services, and content while supporting applicable security, client, and compliance requirements, including ISO 27001, TPN, NIST, CIS Controls, OWASP guidance, and relevant privacy obligations.

1.2 Mandatory Requirements and Expectations

A hands-on Security Operations professional is required who can operate effectively within a global 24x7 Security Operations environment and independently investigate security events, support incident response, improve detection capabilities, manage vulnerability exposure, and continuously improve SOC processes.

* Demonstrable experience monitoring, triaging, investigating, and responding to security alerts and incidents across enterprise environments.
* Strong practical experience using SIEM, EDR/XDR, endpoint telemetry, network logs, identity logs, cloud logs, email security telemetry, and threat intelligence during security investigations.
* Demonstrable experience performing incident triage, determining severity and business impact, distinguishing true positives from false positives, escalating incidents, and supporting containment and remediation activities.
* Practical experience developing, testing, tuning, and maintaining SIEM detection rules, correlation logic, queries, dashboards, and alerting workflows.
* Strong working knowledge of MITRE ATT&CK, attacker tactics, techniques and procedures, indicators of compromise, and common attack paths.
* Hands-on vulnerability management experience, including vulnerability scanning, validation, remediation tracking, re-testing, and risk-based prioritization.
* Ability to assess vulnerability risk using CVSS, EPSS, CISA KEV, exploit intelligence, asset criticality, exposure, and business context.
* Strong understanding of endpoint, network, identity, cloud, email, and enterprise security fundamentals.
* Demonstrable ability to use scripting, APIs, automation, or workflow orchestration to improve Security Operations efficiency and reduce repetitive analyst activity.
* Ability to maintain clear investigation records, incident timelines, runbooks, escalation procedures, threat-hunting documentation, and operational metrics.
* Strong analytical and investigative skills with the ability to correlate information from multiple telemetry sources and reach defensible conclusions.
* Demonstrable ability and willingness to leverage approved AI-assisted tools to improve alert investigation, threat intelligence, vulnerability research, detection development, scripting, reporting, and SOC automation while independently validating outputs against trusted security data.

**2. Duties and Operational Responsibilities**
----------------------------------------------

* Monitor and investigate security alerts generated across SIEM, EDR/XDR, network, identity, cloud, email, and other security monitoring platforms as part of a 24x7 Security Operations function.
* Perform initial triage of security events, determine severity and business impact, distinguish true positives from false positives, and escalate confirmed or high-risk incidents in accordance with defined incident response procedures.
* Investigate security incidents using available telemetry, including endpoint activity, authentication logs, network events, cloud logs, email activity, threat intelligence, vulnerability information, and other relevant security evidence.
* Support incident containment, remediation, recovery, and post-incident activities in coordination with infrastructure, IT, cloud, application, and business teams while maintaining accurate investigation records and incident timelines.
* Manage incidents against defined operational priorities and response targets, ensuring timely escalation, clear ownership, appropriate handover, and follow-through until resolution or formal transfer of responsibility.
* Tune and continuously improve SIEM, EDR/XDR, and other detection capabilities by reviewing noisy alerts, reducing false positives, identifying detection gaps, and developing or refining correlation rules, detection queries, dashboards, and monitoring logic.
* Conduct proactive threat hunting to identify suspicious activity that may not have generated existing alerts.
* Conduct threat intelligence analysis to identify emerging threats, attacker techniques, indicators of compromise, exploited vulnerabilities, and relevant campaigns that may affect DNEG.
* Correlate threat intelligence, CISA KEV, exploit information, attacker TTPs, and vulnerability data with internal assets and security telemetry to identify potential exposure and recommend appropriate action.
* Support vulnerability management by reviewing and validating high-risk findings, confirming exposure or exploitability, coordinating remediation with asset owners, tracking agreed timelines, and performing re-validation or re-scans where required.
* Support authenticated and unauthenticated vulnerability scanning activities across internal, external, cloud, infrastructure, and applicable enterprise environments.
* Identify recurring vulnerabilities, systemic exposure patterns, remediation delays, and security-control gaps and escalate material risks through appropriate channels.
* Use scripting, APIs, automation, and workflow orchestration to improve alert enrichment, investigations, log analysis, threat intelligence processing, vulnerability analysis, reporting, and repetitive SOC workflows.
* Use approved AI-assisted tools to support security investigations, threat intelligence analysis, vulnerability research, scripting, detection development, reporting, and SOC automation while maintaining appropriate human validation and data protection.
* Maintain and continuously improve SOC runbooks, investigation procedures, escalation paths, detection documentation, incident records, threat-hunting notes, and operational documentation required for consistent 24x7 execution.
* Participate in shift handovers, daily operational reviews, incident bridges, major incident response activities, and other SOC coordination forums to maintain continuity of monitoring and investigation across shifts.
* Support continuous improvement of Security Operations by identifying recurring incidents, monitoring blind spots, control gaps, inefficient analyst workflows, and opportunities for improved detection or automation.
* Produce clear operational metrics and reporting covering alerts, incidents, vulnerabilities, threat activity, response performance, detection effectiveness, false-positive rates, remediation progress, and other relevant SOC effectiveness measures.
* Work closely with internal technology and business teams during security investigations while maintaining appropriate confidentiality, evidence handling, documentation, and escalation discipline.
* Support security audits, client assurance, compliance activities, and evidence requests where Security Operations records, logging, vulnerability management, incident response, or monitoring controls are in scope.
* Maintain current knowledge of emerging threats, vulnerabilities, attack techniques, security technologies, and industry developments relevant to the DNEG environment.

**3. Job Requirements**
-----------------------

### **3.1 Mandatory Job Requirements**

A successful candidate will meet the majority of the requirements listed below and will be able to demonstrate suitable experience and competency in each of the following:

* Approximately 4–6 years of relevant hands-on professional experience across Security Operations, SOC, Incident Response, Detection Engineering, Vulnerability Management, Threat Intelligence, or closely related cybersecurity disciplines.
* Demonstrable experience investigating security alerts and incidents using SIEM, EDR/XDR, endpoint telemetry, network logs, identity data, cloud logs, email security telemetry, and threat intelligence.
* Practical experience performing event triage, incident classification, severity assessment, escalation, containment support, remediation tracking, and incident documentation.
* Practical experience with SIEM and detection engineering, including developing, testing, tuning, and maintaining detection rules, correlation logic, queries, dashboards, and alerting workflows.
* Strong working knowledge of MITRE ATT&CK and attacker tactics, techniques, and procedures.
* Hands-on experience with vulnerability management, including scanning, validation, remediation coordination, re-testing, reporting, and risk-based prioritization.
* Practical knowledge of CVSS, EPSS, CISA KEV, exploit intelligence, asset criticality, exposure, and other factors used to prioritize vulnerabilities.
* Strong technical knowledge across multiple Security Operations domains, which may include:

  + SIEM and security monitoring.
  + EDR/XDR and endpoint security.
  + Incident response.
  + Threat detection and threat hunting.
  + Threat intelligence.
  + Vulnerability and exposure management.
  + Network security.
  + Identity and access security.
  + Cloud security monitoring.
  + Email security.
  + Security logging and telemetry.
  + SASE, SWG, CASB, and DLP technologies.
* Strong understanding of Windows, macOS, Linux, TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, authentication, MFA, privileged access, logging, and common enterprise security technologies.
* Hands-on experience with a combination of enterprise security technologies such as SIEM/SOAR, EDR/XDR, vulnerability management, network security, email security, SASE/SWG, CASB/DLP, and cloud security platforms.
* Ability to investigate complex security events, correlate evidence across multiple telemetry sources, identify root cause or likely attack paths, and reach defensible conclusions.
* Scripting and automation capability using Python, PowerShell, Bash, APIs, or similar technologies to automate repetitive SOC activities, enrich alerts, correlate security data, support investigations, or improve operational efficiency.
* Demonstrable experience creating or maintaining SOC documentation, including runbooks, investigation procedures, escalation paths, incident records, detection documentation, threat-hunting notes, and operational reporting.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to clearly communicate security incidents, technical findings, remediation requirements, and operational risks to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to work effectively within a 24x7 Security Operations environment, including shift handovers, escalation processes, major incident response, and operational coordination.
* Experience working within complex, distributed, or global enterprise technology environments.
* Demonstrable practical experience using approved AI-assisted tools, automation, scripting, or analytics to improve Security Operations efficiency, investigation quality, threat analysis, detection development, or reporting, or a demonstrated ability to rapidly develop and apply these capabilities.
* A continuous-improvement mindset with the ability to identify monitoring gaps, repetitive manual processes, noisy detections, recurring incidents, and opportunities to improve SOC effectiveness.

### **3.2 Desired Job Requirements**

A successful candidate may also have experience with the following:

* Experience with vulnerability management platforms such as Tenable/Nessus, Qualys, Rapid7, or equivalent, including authenticated scanning, remediation tracking, re-testing, and reporting.
* Experience with enterprise SIEM, SOAR, EDR/XDR, network security, SASE/SWG, CASB/DLP, email security, or cloud security platforms.
* Experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP security controls, including cloud logging, IAM, posture management, threat detection, and secure configuration practices.
* Experience developing security automation, scripts, API integrations, enrichment workflows, or workflow orchestration for SOC, incident response, vulnerability management, or threat intelligence.

title: Senior Identity Saviynt AI Engineer
description:
**Role Description**

  

At FNZ, our purpose is to make wealth management more accessible, bringing easier, fairer and more inclusive solutions to people worldwide. Here in the Security Technology & Operations team, we are on a mission to embed cyber resilience across FNZ, protecting the platforms that support investment solutions for over 20 million people.

  

We are seeking an Identity Security AI Engineer to design, engineer and operationalise AI-enabled identity security capabilities. The role will combine identity engineering, security automation and responsible AI to strengthen how FNZ governs human, privileged and non-human identities, including AI agents and workload identities through Saviynt and Entra.

  

The successful candidate will work across Identity Security, Cyber Security, cloud engineering and application teams to develop secure AI-assisted workflows, identity analytics and policy enforcement. The role will support global services spanning Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Saviynt, CyberArk and secrets management platforms, while ensuring solutions are explainable, auditable and aligned with FNZ security standards.

  

**Specific Role Responsibilities**

  

* Contribute to the Identity Security roadmap, identifying practical uses of AI that improve control effectiveness, user experience and operational efficiency.

  

* Design and build AI-assisted identity workflows for Joiner, Mover and Leaver processes, access requests, approvals, certification campaigns and exception handling.

  

* Develop identity analytics and recommendation capabilities for entitlement analysis, role mining, access review prioritisation, toxic combination detection and excessive privilege reduction.

  

* Engineer secure identity patterns for AI agents, service principals, managed identities, APIs and other non-human identities across Azure, AWS and GCP.

  

* Implement authentication, authorisation, least privilege, Just-In-Time access and Zero Standing Privilege controls for AI-enabled services and autonomous agents.

  

* Integrate AI and automation capabilities with Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Saviynt, CyberArk, Infisical and FNZ service-management workflows.

  

* Develop and maintain Python, PowerShell and API-based automation, with appropriate testing, version control, CI/CD, monitoring and support documentation.

  

* Build safeguards for AI solutions, including prompt and input protection, data minimisation, human approval points, audit logging and model or agent access controls.

  

* Create monitoring and detection use cases for anomalous access, privilege escalation, dormant access, credential misuse and unusual non-human identity behaviour.

  

* Ensure AI-generated recommendations remain explainable and reviewable, and do not directly grant privileged or high-risk access without defined policy and human oversight.

  

* Support security architecture reviews, threat modelling, control assessments, audit evidence and the development of policies, standards and engineering patterns.

  

* Work closely with global engineering, security, risk, privacy and business stakeholders to move approved prototypes into reliable, supportable production services.

  

* Measure delivered outcomes, including automation coverage, recommendation accuracy, false-positive rates, access-review effort reduction, standing privilege reduction and control adoption.

  
  

**Experience required**

  

Primary requirements

  

* Strong hands-on experience in Identity security, encompassing identity lifecycle management, access governance, authentication, authorisation and privileged access.

  

* Practical engineering experience with Microsoft Entra ID and Active Directory, including Conditional Access, Privileged Identity Management, enterprise applications, service principals and managed identities.

  

* Strong automation and software-engineering skills using Python and/or PowerShell, REST APIs, Git-based version control, testing and CI/CD practices.

  

* Experience integrating with identity platforms such as Saviynt and CyberArk, and with secrets-management services such as Infisical and Azure Key Vault

  

* Knowledge of AI and large language model concepts, including agents, guardrails and secure prompt handling.

  

* Ability to apply security controls to AI solutions, including least privilege, data protection, logging, traceability, human oversight and secure model or agent access.

  

* Good knowledge of RBAC, SAML, SCIM, MFA and Zero Trust principles.

  

* Experience working with cloud identity and workload identity patterns across Azure

  

* Ability to translate identity risks and AI use cases into secure, scalable and supportable technical solutions.

  

* Strong stakeholder communication skills and the ability to explain technical, security and risk concepts to engineering, control and leadership audiences.

  

* Experience producing engineering documentation, operating procedures, security standards and auditable technical evidence.

  

Desirable experience

  

* Experience with Azure AI Foundry, Microsoft Copilot Studio, AI engineering frameworks.

  

* Experience with identity threat detection, graph analytics, behavioural analytics or permissions-management technologies.

  

* Relevant certifications such as Microsoft Identity and Access Administrator, Azure AI Engineer Associate, Azure Security Engineer Associate, CISSP or equivalent practical experience.

Our culture is what drives us. It's at the heart of who we are and everything we do. It's what inspires, excites and moves us forward. Our ambition is to create a culture for growth, one that opens up limitless opportunities for our employees, customers and the wider world. The FNZ Way is the cornerstone of what we do. It is comprised of four values that set the standard for how everyone at FNZ interacts with each other, with our customers, and with all our diverse stakeholders around the world.

title: Senior Applied Data Scientist, Context Intelligence & Autonomous Systems
description:
**Our Company**

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.

**What You will Do**

At Teradata, we are building the next generation of enterprise AI systems that understand, reason over, and act on complex business data. Our **Context Intelligence team** sits at the heart of the **Knowledge & Autonomous Platform organization**, creating the intelligence layer that enables AI agents to understand enterprise data, metadata, business meaning, and operational context at scale (**Tera Context Engine**).

We are looking for an exceptional Senior Data Scientist with a startup mindset: someone who obsessively focuses on customer outcomes, moves fast without sacrificing quality, challenges conventional approaches, and thrives in ambiguity. This is not a traditional analytics role. You will invent, experiment, build, validate, and ship production-grade AI capabilities that become core components of the Teradata's Context Engine platform.

Most data science roles optimize existing systems. This role invents the future.

You'll operate at the intersection of AI research, enterprise-scale data systems, agentic architectures, and real-world product delivery. You'll have the freedom to experiment, the responsibility to own outcomes, and the opportunity to build technology that powers the next generation of intelligent enterprise platforms.

As a Senior Data Scientist, you will partner closely with AI engineers, architects, product leaders, and platform teams to solve some of the hardest problems in enterprise AI.

You will:

Build New Capabilities

* Design and develop novel approaches for context understanding, knowledge representation, semantic reasoning, and agent intelligence.
* Apply machine learning, deep learning, graph techniques, LLMs, agent frameworks, and statistical methods to solve previously unsolved customer problems.
* Transform ambiguous ideas into measurable experiments and production-ready solutions.
* Rapidly prototype new concepts and determine viability within days, not months.

Drive AI Quality and Trust

* Define and own evaluation frameworks for agentic systems, retrieval systems, reasoning pipelines, and autonomous workflows.
* Build large-scale evaluation datasets, synthetic benchmarks, golden datasets, and adversarial test suites.
* Design rigorous experimentation methodologies to validate model improvements.
* Develop measurable quality standards around accuracy, robustness, explainability, latency, cost, and business value.
* Investigate failures deeply and systematically until root causes are fully understood.

Innovate and Think Beyond Conventional Solutions

* Challenge assumptions and existing approaches.
* Apply first-principles thinking to difficult data and AI problems.
* Leverage emerging technologies and research to create competitive advantages.
* Identify opportunities where automation, AI, and advanced analytics can fundamentally change customer experiences.

Deliver Production Impact

* Partner with engineering teams to move models and experiments into production.
* Own results from ideation through deployment and operational monitoring.
* Balance speed and scientific rigor while maintaining exceptionally high quality standards.
* Establish testing, validation, observability, and continuous improvement processes for AI systems.

Influence the Organization

* Act as a technical leader for complex cross-functional initiatives.
* Mentor other data scientists and engineers.
* Raise the technical bar through reviews, experimentation practices, and scientific rigor.
* Help shape the future AI strategy of the Knowledge & Autonomous Platform organization.

Within your first year, you will have:

* Delivered production-ready context intelligence capabilities that materially improve AI agent performance.
* Created evaluation and benchmarking frameworks that become company standards.
* Reduced model and agent failure rates through systematic analysis and optimization.
* Influenced product direction through data-driven insights and innovation.
* Established yourself as a trusted technical leader across the organization.

**What Makes You A Qualified Candidate**

Startup DNA

You are someone who:

* Has repeatedly built products or capabilities from zero to one.
* Is energized by ambiguity and ownership.
* Moves quickly while maintaining engineering and scientific discipline.
* Takes accountability for business outcomes, not just technical deliverables.
* Constantly looks for simpler, smarter, and more scalable solutions.
* Demonstrates curiosity, resilience, and the ability to learn rapidly.

Technical Excellence

You have deep expertise in several of the following areas:

* Machine Learning
* Deep Learning
* Reinforcement Learning
* Natural Language Processing
* Large Language Models
* Agentic Systems
* Knowledge Graphs
* Information Retrieval
* Recommendation Systems
* Graph Neural Networks
* Statistical Modeling
* Causal Inference
* Experimentation and A/B Testing
* Time Series Analysis

You are highly proficient in:

* Python
* SQL
* PyTorch or TensorFlow
* Modern LLM ecosystems
* Vector databases
* Data science and MLOps tooling
* Cloud-native AI platforms

**Scientific Rigor**

You possess strong foundations in:

* Statistics
* Probability
* Experimental Design
* Statistical Inference
* Model Evaluation
* Ranking Systems
* Precision, Recall, F1, NDCG, and Retrieval Metrics
* Error Analysis and Failure Mode Identification

You instinctively validate assumptions with data and can distinguish genuine improvement from noise.

**What You Will Bring**

* Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, or a related field.
* 7+ years of hands-on industry experience solving complex data science and AI problems.
* Experience building and shipping production AI systems used by real customers.
* Proven track record of delivering measurable business impact.
* Experience working in high-growth startups or startup-like environments.
* Demonstrated success operating across research, product, and engineering boundaries.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex concepts to technical and executive audiences.
* Evidence of continuous learning through publications, patents, open-source contributions, conference participation, or technical leadership.

**Ideal candidate profile:** Someone who has worked at companies such as Databricks, Snowflake, Palantir, Confluent, Stripe, OpenAI, Anthropic, Scale AI, NVIDIA, Uber, Airbnb, or high-growth AI startups, and is excited about bringing startup velocity, innovation, and ownership into a large-scale enterprise AI platform environment.

title: Data Scientist
description:
