**Job Description**
**About The Role**
We are looking for a motivated Data Scientist to join our dynamic AI team in Pune. This role will focus on proving concepts through rapid prototypes and building Minimum Viable Products (MVPs) in context of machine learning (ML) and Generative AI (GenAI) solutions, including GenAI-based chatbots. * Collaborate with AI Engineers to integrate models into enterprise applications.

**Data Handling & Preprocessing**

* Collect, clean, and preprocess data to ensure quality inputs for model training.

* Work closely with the AI Lead and cross-functional teams to align projects with business objectives.
* Document model development processes, code, and findings for transparency and reproducibility.
* Contribute to the development of best practices and playbooks for AI and ML solutions.

**Continuous Learning & Development**

* Stay updated with the latest trends and advancements in AI, ML, and GenAI technologies.
* Participate in team knowledge-sharing sessions and training opportunities.

**Education**
**Qualifications & Skills:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, AI, or a related field.

**Experience**

* 1-3 years of experience in data science, machine learning, or AI-related roles.
* Hands-on experience with ML model development and deployment.
* Exposure to GenAI technologies, including LLMs and chatbot development, is a plus.

**Technical Skills**

* Proficient in Python and SQL for data manipulation and model development.
* Familiarity with ML frameworks and libraries such as scikit-learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch.
* Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Matplotlib, Seaborn) and EDA techniques.

**Soft Skills**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Eagerness to learn and adapt in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
* Detail-oriented with a focus on delivering high-quality work.

title: Senior Data Engineer - Vice President
description:

Finance Technology is looking for a hands-on senior data engineering technical lead who is passionate about solving complex business problems through innovation and engineering excellence. In this role, you will use deep technical expertise to set the technical direction for, design, and personally build a scalable, high-quality, data-intensive platform. The platform uses modern methodologies such as Data Virtualization, Data Domains, and Data Mesh. You will be a technical leader and force multiplier for the engineering team. You will remain deeply hands-on in architecture, design, code, and production support, and you will mentor engineers, raise engineering standards, and partner with business, architecture, and control-function stakeholders. The ideal candidate has a strong foundation in data engineering principles, broad experience across batch and real-time data pipelines, and a proven record of optimizing and scaling data processing and analytics solutions in a regulated enterprise environment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the design and hands-on development of scalable, resilient, and secure data pipelines and platform components that support Finance business and regulatory use cases.
* Define and drive the technical architecture and roadmap for data virtualization, data federation, and domain-oriented data products. Make and document key design decisions and trade-offs.
* Act as the technical authority for the team. Conduct design and code reviews, set engineering standards, and champion best practices in testing, CI/CD, observability, and automation.
* Mentor and coach senior and junior engineers, and help grow technical capability across the team.
* Partner with Finance product owners, architects, data governance, risk, and control functions to translate business requirements into technical solutions. Ensure data quality, lineage, and regulatory compliance.
* Lead the diagnosis and resolution of complex performance, scalability, and production issues. Drive root-cause analysis and long-term remediation.
* Evaluate emerging technologies, including AI agents and MCP-based tooling. Lead proofs of concept and drive adoption where they add measurable value.
* Contribute to agile planning and estimation, and help manage technical risk, dependencies, and delivery across multiple workstreams.

**Qualifications:**
**Core Data Engineering Skills**

* 10+ years of overall experience in Big Data or enterprise large-scale application development using scalable tools such as Databricks, Scala, Java, and the Python ecosystem.
* 7+ years of relevant experience in technology, designing and delivering data-intensive solutions using agile methodologies.
* Demonstrated experience as a technical lead or senior individual contributor. This includes leading the end-to-end design and delivery of complex, multi-team data platforms or programs while staying hands-on.
* Expert-level understanding of data modeling, data warehousing concepts, methodologies, and best practices, with the ability to set standards and guide others.
* Strong experience with data processing (e.g., Spark, Starburst, Snowflake, Redshift), storage (e.g., Hadoop, MongoDB, Oracle), and ETL (e.g., Airflow, Ab Initio, Talend) solutions.
* Experience with data engineering techniques such as building data lakes and data warehouses, data mesh architectures, data pipelines, and ETL vs. ELT patterns, including architecting these at enterprise scale.
* Deep expertise in Starburst/Trino, with a thorough understanding of data federation and data virtualization architectures. This includes query optimization, cluster tuning, connector design, security and access control, and performance at scale.
* Experience with real-time and streaming data processing and data virtualization technologies such as Starburst, Snowflake, and Flink (preferred).
* Proven experience designing, developing, and operating distributed systems that handle structured and unstructured data for storage, analysis, and reporting.
* Experience developing and maintaining large and complex database systems using relational databases such as Oracle, and big data technologies such as Hadoop and Spark.
* Advanced proficiency in PL/SQL and Unix Shell scripting. Strong SQL, PL/SQL development, and database performance tuning experience.
* Experience designing Online Transaction Processing (OLTP), Operational Data Store (ODS), and Data Warehouse applications.
* Strong experience implementing Data Quality, data lineage, and data governance frameworks in a regulated environment.
* Strong knowledge of software engineering best practices, including CI/CD, automated testing, source control, infrastructure-as-code, and observability.
* Experience with cloud-based data platforms and with application and data security, resiliency, and disaster recovery (preferred).
* Experience in financial services or Finance technology (preferred).

**AI Agents, Orchestration & Applied AI**

* Demonstrable experience designing, developing, and integrating AI Agents into data engineering workflows and software systems, with the ability to lead adoption and set patterns for the broader team.
* Practical, hands-on knowledge of Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, including: Setting up, configuring, and securing MCP servers to expose data tools, database connections, and APIs as contextual resources for LLM-powered agents.
* Solid understanding of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) principles, including vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, ChromaDB) and advanced retrieval techniques for grounding agents in enterprise data.
* Working knowledge of Large Language Models (LLMs) (e.g., OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, Llama) and their practical application in data engineering. Examples include automated schema inference, natural language querying, and intelligent data cataloging. This includes the ability to evaluate their risks, limitations, and fit for regulated use cases.

* Ability to balance hands-on delivery with technical strategy, prioritization, and risk management in a fast-paced environment.

description:
As a Staff Data Engineer on FloQast's Data Platform team, you'll be a key technical leader setting the direction for how our data is modeled and transformed, and how it becomes the foundation for data intelligence. In this role you'll focus on transformation and the shared derived models that analytics, product, and AI teams build on, applying modern AI and machine learning to the financial data our customers work with every day. You will define the standards and patterns that make that data trustworthy, well-documented, and ready for AI to use.
  
  
You've spent years turning complex source data into models that many teams rely on. You design shared models around real business questions, write dbt and Spark transformations with tests and documentation, and know when a model needs a rewrite rather than another patch. You drive decisions on how data is modeled, transformed, and served, and you own the outcome in production, from design through the decisions that follow. At this level, you don't just build models. You set the standards and the architecture others build on.
  
  
At FloQast, you'll apply that depth across our lakehouse and AI stack. FloLake runs on Iceberg over S3, orchestrated through MWAA, cataloged in AWS Glue, and queried via Trino and Athena, and the models you own will serve products used by 3,000+ tenants. You'll work with data platform, product, and applied AI leaders, mentor engineers, and be flexible about collaborating across geographies.
  
  
FloQast is headquartered in Los Angeles & San Jose, CA and this role is based in Pune, India.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Set the technical direction for data modeling and transformation across the lakehouse (dbt, Spark, Trino)
* Design and own the shared derived models that analytics, product and AI teams build on
* Drive decisions on data architecture, including when to use dbt, Spark or Trino, and document them
* Build the models and context that power data intelligence and AI agents, working with applied AI and product teams
* Define how we measure and improve model quality, testing, lineage, freshness and cost
* Review designs and code, and mentor engineers at every level
* Partner with the US lead on direction, staying flexible across geographies and time zones

**What You'll Bring**

* 8+ years in data engineering, with deep hands-on dbt and data modeling experience
* Prior experience working with complex data, such as many source systems, large volumes and evolving schemas, and turning it into models people trust
* Strong SQL and Python, and experience with Spark and distributed SQL query engines (Trino, Athena or similar)
* Experience with a lakehouse format (Iceberg or similar) and Airflow or similar orchestration
* Proven record of owning shared data models used by many teams, and of driving data architecture decisions
* Experience with data testing, quality and lineage frameworks
* General knowledge of knowledge graphs, context engineering and AI-ready data models
* Technical leadership: influence across teams, clear writing, design reviews and mentoring

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. ou have 7 to 10+ years of relevant professional experience, including experience working with data warehouses.

Knowledge of the telecommunications domain, ITIL and Amazon QuickSight is advantageous.

You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
  
  
**What's In It For You**
Opportunity to work on modern AWS-based data engineering solutions within a global technology environment.
  
  
Exposure to scalable data pipelines, data warehouses and data lake technologies.
  
  
Opportunity to collaborate with technical and business stakeholders on data quality and data product initiatives.
  
  
Hands-on involvement in automation, reusable data frameworks and Proof-of-Concept development.

Deeper practical expertise in AWS data engineering services including AWS Glue, Amazon Redshift, Amazon Athena and Amazon S3.
  
  
Advanced implementation of Apache Spark, Python and Apache Iceberg for modern data architectures.

✅ Curate and manage data platform capabilities consumed by application, analytics, and data teams

title: Lead Implementation Engineer
description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The Lead Implementation Engineer is a technical delivery person who partners with government customers to bring OpenGov cloud software to life across the most complex and highest-stakes deployments. This role owns the end-to-end technical strategy for large, multi-module implementations, from solution architecture and data migration design through configuration, testing, and go-live, and sets the technical quality bar for the entire Implementation Engineering organization.
  
  
Acting as a trusted advisor to senior government leaders, the Implementation Engineer IV combines deep product expertise with advanced data architecture, database, and automation skills. The role translates complex customer goals, legacy system constraints, and cross-departmental workflows into scalable, governed, and maintainable solutions. Beyond hands-on delivery, the Implementation Engineer IV shapes how the organization works: defining standards and reusable frameworks, coaching senior and mid-level engineers, resolving escalated technical risk, and driving the process and product improvements that make implementations faster, more consistent, and more repeatable for every customer.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own the technical strategy and solution architecture for the most complex, multi-module government implementations across the United States, including large-scale data migrations, multi-system integrations, and multi-department rollouts
* Set the standard for configuration and data reviews across the implementation organization, approving final designs for high-risk deployments and ensuring alignment with documented requirements, product best practices, and long-term maintainability
* Lead data architecture for customer migrations, defining source-to-target mapping strategies, ETL frameworks, reconciliation controls, and validation approaches that produce audit-ready data at scale
* Resolve critical technical blockers escalated from active implementations, performing root-cause analysis on data integrity, performance, and configuration issues and driving corrective action with Product and Engineering
* Lead requirements discovery with executive and technical stakeholders, pressure-testing assumptions, resolving conflicting departmental needs, and advising customers on design trade-offs with clear business impact
* Define comprehensive test strategies and quality gates for complex deployments, and ensure test scenarios validate that configuration, integrations, and migrated data produce accurate outcomes before go-live
* Serve as the senior technical advisor to government executives, Budget Directors, CIOs, and IT leadership, building long-term trust and guiding them through deployment, integration, and adoption strategy
* Mentor and develop Implementation Engineers across all levels, providing technical leadership, reviewing complex configuration and data work, and building the skills and career paths of the broader engineering team
* Establish and continuously improve implementation standards, playbooks, reusable tooling, and automation frameworks that raise delivery quality, consistency, and speed across the organization
* Identify systemic patterns in customer pain points and lead cross-functional initiatives with Product, Engineering, Data/Integration, Project Management, and Customer Success to simplify and automate workflows at scale
* Represent the voice of the customer in product and roadmap discussions, translating field insights into prioritized, well-scoped recommendations that shape the future of the platform
* Evaluate and champion emerging technologies, including AI-driven automation, to accelerate migration, validation, and implementation workflows while maintaining rigorous data governance and security standards

**Requirements And Preferred Experience**

* 9 to 12 years of experience in software implementation, data migration, or technical consulting, with a proven record of leading complex enterprise or SaaS deployments
* 7+ years of hands-on SQL experience, including advanced query design, performance tuning, data transformation, and reconciliation across large datasets
* 5+ years of Python or similar scripting experience for automation, data processing, and building reusable delivery tooling
* Deep expertise in database architecture and ETL and data-migration methodologies, including schema design, indexing and performance optimization, and governance of data quality at scale
* Demonstrated experience designing and leading AI-driven solutions for automation, workflow optimization, and data-driven insights, using modern frameworks and AI models
* Proven track record of owning multiple concurrent complex implementations end to end and of raising the technical capability of other engineers through mentorship, reviews, and formal knowledge sharing
* Strong executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior government stakeholders, align cross-functional teams, and present technical strategy clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
* Exceptional attention to detail and a rigorous approach to validation, reconciliation, and sign-off, with a demonstrated ability to establish quality standards that others adopt
* Comfort operating with ambiguity in a rapidly changing product environment, making sound decisions under pressure, and adapting strategy as customer needs evolve
* Experience working with or within government, public sector, or regulated environments is strongly preferred
* Bachelor's degree in a technical or related field; advanced degree or relevant certifications are a plus

**Why OpenGov?**
**A Mission That Matters.**
At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it’s the core of our democracy.
  
  
**Opportunity to Innovate**
The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.
  
  
**A Team of Passionate, Driven People**
This isn’t your typical 9-to-5 job; we operate in a fast-paced, results-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.
  
  
**A Place to Make Your Mark**
We pride ourselves on our performance-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.
  
  
**Benefits That Work For You**
Enjoy an award-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:
  
  

* Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families
* Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions
* Professional development and growth opportunities
* A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.

title: SW QA Engineer – AI Agents & Engineering Simulation
description:
**We are Siemens**
Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our software.
  
  
Siemens Digital Industries Software is looking for a Quality Assurance Engineer – AI Agents to help validate next-generation AI-enabled capabilities within the Simcenter portfolio.
  
  
In this role, you will test AI agents, agentic workflows, and Large Language Model (LLM)-based interactions designed to support engineering and CAE simulation use cases. You will validate how AI agents interpret user requests, interact with tools and external systems, execute workflows, and generate accurate, relevant, and reliable responses.
  
  
Working closely with AI developers, software engineers, QA teams, and engineering domain experts, you will develop manual and automated testing approaches to ensure the quality, usability, traceability, and release readiness of AI-powered engineering applications.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Validate AI agents and agentic workflows: Design and execute test scenarios covering agent interactions, task execution, multi-step workflows, orchestration, and integration with engineering applications.
* Evaluate LLM-based interactions: Assess response accuracy, relevance, consistency, context handling, and domain appropriateness against defined engineering and CAE use cases.
* Test MCP and tool integrations: Validate Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations, including server connectivity, tool discovery, invocation, parameter handling, response processing, and error handling.
* Develop AI testing strategies: Create and maintain test plans, test cases, evaluation scenarios, and regression suites for AI-enabled product capabilities.
* Build test automation: Develop automated validation scripts and frameworks using Python and tools such as Pytest, Playwright, Selenium, or Robot Framework.
* Drive continuous quality validation: Collaborate with development teams to integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and improve repeatability, coverage, and regression detection.
* Support product quality and release readiness: Investigate defects, communicate quality risks, identify coverage gaps, and contribute to testing standards and best practices for AI-enabled engineering applications.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Hands-on experience in software QA/testing, preferably involving AI-enabled applications, LLM-based systems, AI agents, or intelligent automation workflows.
* Understanding of AI agents and agentic workflows, including tool calling, multi-step task execution, orchestration, and interactions with external systems.
* Experience creating test plans, test cases, validation scenarios, defect reports, and structured quality documentation.
* Basic to intermediate programming or scripting skills in Python, JavaScript, or a comparable language.
* Experience with test automation frameworks such as Pytest, Playwright, Selenium, Robot Framework, or equivalent tools.
* Understanding of API testing, application integrations, and CI/CD-based software validation practices.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate AI-generated outputs and identify functional, contextual, and domain-specific quality issues.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Hands-on experience testing Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations, including MCP servers, tool discovery, invocation, and response handling.
* Experience testing multi-agent systems, agent orchestration frameworks, or enterprise AI workflows.
* Familiarity with LLM evaluation techniques, including response quality assessment, hallucination detection, contextual relevance, and consistency testing.
* Understanding of CAE, engineering simulation, or scientific computing workflows, preferably through experience with Simcenter or other engineering software platforms.
* Experience validating AI agents that interact with engineering tools, simulation applications, APIs, or domain-specific data sources.
* Experience with desktop, cloud-based, API, and cross-platform testing environments.
* Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, Git, and collaborative software development practices.

We're dedicated to equality, and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. title: Functional AI Tester - GenAI
description:
- - - - - - - - - - - -
  
  
We are seeking a Quality Assurance (QA) Engineer focused on testing Generative AI (GenAI) applications with a strong emphasis on Python-based test automation, GenAI evaluation, and ETL/data quality validation. You will design and execute end-to-end test strategies that ensure our AI solutions are accurate, reliable, safe, and compliant.
  
  
**About The Role**
You will be involved in QA for GenAI features including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), conversational AI and Agentic evaluations. The role centers on:
  
  

* Systematic GenAI evaluation (qualitative and quantitative metrics)
* ETL and data quality testing for the data flows that feed AI systems
* Python-driven automated testing

This position is hands-on and collaborative, partnering with AI engineers, data engineers, and product teams to define measurable acceptance criteria and ship high-quality AI features.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Test strategy and planning

+ Define risk-based test strategies and detailed test plans for GenAI features.
+ Establish clear acceptance criteria with stakeholders for functional, safety, and data quality aspects.

* Python test automation

+ Build and maintain automated test suites using Python (e.g., PyTest, requests).
+ Implement reusable utilities for prompt/response validation, dataset management, and result scoring.
+ Create regression baselines and golden test sets to detect quality drift.

* GenAI evaluation

+ Develop evaluation harnesses covering factuality, coherence, helpfulness, safety, bias, and toxicity etc.
+ Design prompt suites, scenario-based tests, and golden datasets for reproducible measurements.
+ Implement guardrail tests including prompt-injection resilience, unsafe content detection, and PII redaction checks.
+ Track quality metrics over time.

* RAG and semantic retrieval testing

+ Verify alignment between retrieved sources and generated answers.
+ Verify adversarial tests.
+ Measure retrieval relevance, precision/recall, grounding quality, and hallucination reduction.

* API and application testing

+ Test REST endpoints supporting GenAI features (request/response contracts, error handling, timeouts).

* ETL and data quality validation

+ Test ingestion and transformation logic; validate schema, constraints, and field-level rules.
+ Implement data profiling, reconciliation between sources and targets, and lineage checks.
+ Verify data privacy controls, masking, and retention policies across pipelines.

* Non-functional testing

+ Performance and load testing focused on latency, throughput, concurrency, and rate limits for LLM calls.
+ Cost-aware testing (token usage, caching effectiveness) and timeout/retry behavior validation.
+ Reliability and resilience checks including error recovery and fallback behavior.

* Share results and insights; recommend remediation and preventive actions.

**Required Qualifications**

* Experience

+ 5+ years in software QA, including test strategy, automation, and defect management.
+ 2+ years testing AI/ML or GenAI features, with hands-on evaluation design.
+ 4+ years testing ETL/data pipelines and data quality.

* Technical skills

+ Python: Strong proficiency building automated tests and tooling (PyTest, requests, pydantic or similar).
+ API testing: REST contract testing, schema validation, negative testing.
+ GenAI evaluation: crafting prompt suites, golden datasets, rubric-based scoring, and automated evaluation pipelines.
+ RAG testing: retrieval relevance, grounding validation, chunking/indexing verification, and embedding checks.
+ ETL/data quality: schema and constraint validation, reconciliation, lineage awareness, data profiling.

* Quality and governance

+ Understanding of LLM limitations and methods to detect/reduce hallucinations.
+ Safety and compliance testing including PII handling and prompt-injection resilience.
+ Strong analytical and debugging skills across services and data flows.

* Soft skills

+ Excellent written and verbal communication; ability to translate quality goals into measurable criteria.
+ Collaboration with AI engineers, data engineers, and product stakeholders.
+ Organized, detail-oriented, and outcomes-focused.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with evaluation frameworks or tooling for LLMs and RAG quality measurement.

Experience creating synthetic datasets to stress specific behaviors.

+ Identifying opportunities to automate manual workflows (e.g., data validation, testing support, reporting, or operational processes)
+ Partnering with engineering to define automation-ready workflows and scalable solutions

* Demonstrated ability to think in terms of efficiency, scalability, and leverage—not just task execution

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience in pharmaceutical, life sciences, or healthcare data domains (e.g., pricing, rebates, chargebacks, aggregate spend)
* Familiarity with US healthcare systems and data environments

**What Sets You Apart:**

* Structured thinker who brings clarity to ambiguous problems
* Strong ownership mindset with a focus on outcomes, not just outputs
* Ability to balance detail orientation with speed and execution
* Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, evolving product environment
* Collaborative, proactive, and continuously improving mindset

title: Senior Applied AI Engineer
description:
As a Senior Applied AI Engineer on FloQast's Data Platform team, you'll be a key technical contributor turning documents into connected, queryable data across our products. In this role you'll focus on AI products and data intelligence, applying modern AI and machine learning to the financial data and documents our customers work with every day. You will build the document processing, retrieval, and context engineering systems that our AI agents and products rely on.  
  
You've spent years shipping document AI and retrieval systems from prototype to production. You've built pipelines that parse, chunk, and embed unstructured documents, tuned retrieval and reranking on real workloads, and built evaluation that tells you whether a change actually made the system better. You own what you build in production. At this level, you don't just build systems. You raise the quality of the work around you.  
  
At FloQast, you'll apply that depth on top of our lakehouse and AI stack. Our data lives in Iceberg on S3, orchestrated through Airflow on MWAA and queried via Trino and Athena, and the systems you build will serve products used by 3,000+ tenants. You'll work with data platform, product, and applied AI teammates, help connect documents, knowledge graphs, and structured data into context our AI can trust, and be flexible about collaborating across geographies.  
  
FloQast is headquartered in Los Angeles & San Jose, CA and this role is based in Pune, India.

### **What you'll do**

* Build document processing, retrieval and context engineering systems end to end
* Turn unstructured data (documents, spreadsheets, transactions) into structured, connected data
* Build the eval framework for extraction and retrieval quality, and use it to drive improvements
* Serve these systems in production with solid latency, cost and reliability
* Review code, share what you learn, and work with product and data platform teammates
* Collaborate with teammates on scope and priorities, staying flexible across geographies and time zones

### **What you'll bring**

* 5+ years of software engineering, including 2+ years shipping applied AI or ML systems
* Shipped document AI or RAG systems (parsing, chunking, embeddings, retrieval, reranking)
* Experience with unstructured data and context engineering for LLM applications
* Experience with modern agentic frameworks
* General knowledge of knowledge graphs
* Experience designing evals for LLM systems
* Strong Python and production AWS experience
* General knowledge of building data pipelines and transformation (Spark, Airflow), and of backend services
* Strong sense of ownership from idea to production, and a clear communicator who works well across geographies

#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture

We are seeking an experienced Senior Windows & Endpoint Security Engineer to manage enterprise-scale Windows Server environments across on-premises and Microsoft Azure platforms. The position is based in Pune and sits within Data Center Operations.

------------------

* Act as an L3 escalation point for complex Windows Server incidents and technical problems.

* Collaborate with SOC and Cyber Security teams and support security audits and compliance reporting.
* Drive Windows security baselines, patch compliance, vulnerability remediation and security posture improvements.
* Design, administer and optimise Active Directory Domain Services, including GPO structures, OU design, delegated administration, Domain Controllers, replication, FSMO roles and recovery scenarios.
* Support Active Directory security hardening, logging and privileged access monitoring.
* Administer Windows Server workloads hosted on Microsoft Azure IaaS, including virtual machines, availability sets/zones, scaling strategies, monitoring agents and security integrations. [
* Support hybrid identity scenarios and on-premises-to-Azure migration and post-migration optimisation.
* Troubleshoot Azure networking, VM health, extensions and performance issues, while using automation and operational standards to reduce recurring problems.

**Who you are**

You bring 6–8+ years of experience working with Windows Server and Active Directory environments.  
You have advanced Windows Server administration expertise and practical knowledge of AD DS, GPO, DNS and DHCP.  
You have strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, particularly for Windows Servers.  
You have proven experience administering Windows Servers on Microsoft Azure IaaS and working with hybrid Active Directory environments.  
You can use PowerShell for scripting and automation.  
You understand patch management, vulnerability remediation and virtualisation technologies such as Hyper-V and VMware.  
You bring strong analytical, troubleshooting, technical communication and mentoring capabilities, with a security- and compliance-focused approach.

This role provides the opportunity to work with enterprise-scale Windows infrastructure across both on-premises and Microsoft Azure environments, alongside SOC and Cyber Security teams. **What skills you will learn**

**Job Purpose**

The Data Support Analyst provides responsive, controlled and customer-focused support for database and data-related incidents, service requests and operational tasks. Reporting to the Business Applications and Data Support Team Lead, the role owns tickets through ServiceNow from initial triage to resolution or escalation, keeps users informed and works with application, data, infrastructure and supplier teams to restore service.

The role undertakes routine database administration, monitoring and maintenance tasks for databases supporting critical business applications, while protecting data integrity, security, auditability and service availability. It supports planned changes, service recovery and operational improvement, and helps ensure recurring incidents are converted into knowledge, automation and preventative action.

**Key Accountabilities**

ServiceNow ticket ownership

* Own data and database incidents, service requests and operational tasks from acknowledgement through investigation, resolution, validation and closure.
* Classify, prioritise and progress tickets in line with impact, urgency, service levels and agreed support procedures.
* Maintain accurate ticket records, diagnostic evidence, user communications and resolution notes.

Data and database support

* Investigate connectivity, access, availability, capacity, performance and data-processing issues affecting supported business applications.
* Provide first- and second-line diagnosis using approved SQL queries, scripts, monitoring information, logs and support documentation.
* Engage application owners, database specialists, infrastructure teams, data engineering and suppliers when specialist intervention is required.

Database administration

* Investigate data quality, reconciliation and processing issues, distinguishing source-data, application, integration and database causes.
* Ensure data access, extracts, corrections and administrative activity are authorised, traceable and compliant with security and segregation-of-duties controls.
* Protect confidential and personal data by following approved handling, retention and secure-transfer procedures.

Critical application support

* Support databases underpinning critical business applications, recognising business impact and using appropriate priority and escalation routes.
* Participate in incident recovery, service restoration, post-incident review and preventative improvement activity.
* Support planned changes, release validation, maintenance and operational readiness for new or changed services.

Data quality and controls

* Investigate data quality, reconciliation and processing issues, distinguishing source-data, application, integration and database causes.

Knowledge and improvement

Service communication

* Provide clear and timely user updates, translating technical findings into business impact and next steps.
* Escalate risks, ageing tickets, service-level threats and high-impact issues promptly to the Team Lead and Service Management.
* Contribute to operational reviews, handovers and support coverage aligned to UK business hours.

  

**Role-Specific Responsibilities**

* Manage assigned ServiceNow data and database work, ensuring correct categorisation, priority, ownership and closure quality.

**Data operations**

**Essential capability**

**Expected evidence**

**SQL and diagnostics**

Ability to write and safely execute SQL queries for investigation, validation, reconciliation and controlled operational support, with a clear understanding of production-data risk.

  

**Database administration**

Experience with user and permission administration, monitoring, scheduled jobs, maintenance, performance checks, backup status and capacity management.

Working knowledge of incident, request, problem, change and knowledge-management practices. Hands-on experience using ServiceNow or a comparable ITSM platform is required.

**Job Purpose**

The Data Architect supports the definition and implementation of the organisation’s data architecture, helping ensure that data is structured, integrated, secured and used effectively across business operations, reporting, analytics, automation and decision-making.

Working with the Senior Data Architect, IT Architecture Team Lead and Head of Data, the role translates agreed data strategy, principles and standards into practical solution designs, data models, patterns and delivery artefacts. The Data Architect provides hands-on architecture support to projects and product teams and contributes to the continued development of the enterprise data landscape.

The role combines data design with delivery support across data modelling, information architecture, master and reference data, integration, data platforms, reporting and analytics. It works collaboratively with colleagues in the UK, India and Group IT, applying architecture governance proportionately and escalating complex or strategically significant decisions where required.

The role is expected to improve the quality, consistency, accessibility and reusability of data while developing strong architecture capability and contributing reusable knowledge to the wider technology function.

**Key Accountabilities**

Data strategy delivery

* Support the Senior Data Architect and Head of Data in translating agreed data strategy into practical designs, standards, roadmaps and delivery activities.
* Contribute to current-state, target-state and transition architecture work for assigned data initiatives.
* Identify opportunities to simplify the data landscape and improve the value derived from information assets.

Data architecture and solution design

* Produce data architecture options and solution designs for projects, products and business change.
* Maintain accurate views of relevant data domains, platforms, flows, dependencies, risks and opportunities.
* Evaluate options against business value, cost, risk, scalability, security, supportability and delivery complexity.

Data modelling and information design

* Create and maintain conceptual, logical and physical data models aligned to agreed business concepts and requirements.
* Define core entities, relationships, common definitions and ownership touchpoints for assigned domains.
* Promote consistent interpretation and use of data across platforms, integrations, reports and business processes.

Data platforms, integration and solutions

* Apply approved patterns for data ingestion, transformation, storage, access, APIs, events and enterprise data exchange.
* Design data flows and solutions that are resilient, scalable, observable, maintainable and aligned to non-functional requirements.
* Work with engineering and solution teams to encourage reuse and reduce unnecessary duplication or point-to-point complexity.

Analytics, reporting and AI enablement

* Design reliable data foundations for business intelligence, reporting, analytics, automation and appropriate AI use cases.
* Work with data and analytics teams to improve data accessibility, usability and consistency.
* Support common metrics, semantic definitions and trusted data products based on understood sources.

Data governance implementation

* Implement agreed technical approaches for data quality, metadata, lineage, classification, retention, access and lifecycle management.
* Ensure designs support security, privacy, regulatory, risk and audit requirements.
* Work with data owners and governance colleagues to embed controls without assuming ownership of the wider data governance function.

Delivery enablement and assurance

* Engage early with projects and product teams to shape requirements, options and designs before technology choices are fixed.
* Prepare designs for review through Technical Design Authority and other governance routes, recording decisions, exceptions, risks and technical debt.
* Support delivery teams through implementation, testing, transition, operational handover and resolution of design issues.
* Escalate complex, high-risk or strategically significant decisions to the Senior Data Architect or IT Architecture Team Lead.

Collaboration and capability development

* Work effectively across UK, India and Group IT teams, including collaboration across time zones where required.
* Contribute technical knowledge, reusable patterns and constructive design challenge to architecture and delivery communities.
* Support less experienced colleagues and continue to develop personal architecture capability through feedback, learning and practical experience.

Architecture quality and documentation

* Produce clear data architecture artefacts, including models, diagrams, options papers, high-level designs, standards, patterns and decision records.
* Ensure artefacts are accurate, version-controlled, reusable and accessible to delivery, operations, security, audit and business stakeholders.
* Contribute to the architecture repository and continuous improvement of templates, reference architectures and documentation quality.

**Role-Specific Responsibilities**

**Working with data leadership**

* Work with the Senior Data Architect, IT Architecture Team Lead and Head of Data to implement agreed data priorities through practical architecture and design.
* Translate defined outcomes and requirements into data models, solution designs, standards and delivery artefacts.
* Provide evidence on feasibility, dependencies, sequencing, risk and design trade-offs, escalating material issues appropriately.
* Maintain traceability between the problem being addressed, agreed architecture decisions and delivered solutions.

**Business partnership and domain understanding**

* Develop a strong understanding of business services, core processes, client service needs, information flows and operational pain points.
* Work with business stakeholders, product owners and process owners to clarify information needs and shape pragmatic solutions.
* Explain data topics in clear language and create shared understanding of options, risks, decisions and expected outcomes.

**Data landscape and roadmap contribution**

* Maintain reliable documentation for assigned data domains, sources, stores, integrations, consumers and dependencies.
* Contribute to roadmaps for data platform evolution, simplification, interoperability and legacy reduction.
* Identify architecture risks, gaps and duplication and propose proportionate remediation options.

**Patterns, standards and reusable assets**

* Apply and improve reusable patterns for data ingestion, transformation, storage, access, quality, lineage, security and observability.
* Use consistent modelling conventions, naming standards, metadata practices and design evidence.
* Help delivery teams reuse approved patterns and reference designs rather than creating unnecessary local solutions.

**Governance and design assurance**

* Prepare and present data designs for Technical Design Authority and related decision forums, supported by the Senior Data Architect where appropriate.

* Record decisions and exceptions clearly and follow through agreed actions during delivery.

**Continuous improvement and professional development**

* Maintain awareness of developments in data architecture, cloud data platforms, analytics, AI and information management.

**Company Description**

**About Datakrew**

Datakrew is revolutionizing EV fleet intelligence with cutting-edge IoT/AI solutions. Our flagship solution, OXRED Platform Suite, provides deep insights into vehicle fleet performance and diagnostics. Our goal is to serve one million EVs within the next 5 years, and as a company, touch a billion lives with technology.

**This is a Global and remote position and we are looking for candidates outside India also.**

 **Job Description**

**Job Overview:**

We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Customer-Facing Project Manager to oversee the successful delivery of various customer projects. The ideal candidate will possess a strong understanding of both technical and commercial aspects, ensuring that customer goals are met through precise project management and regular communication. This role requires managing hybrid projects that involve both product (hardware and software) delivery and customized development services with certifications and compliances.  
This is a technical project management role — the ideal candidate will be as comfortable discussing firmware updates, API integrations, or compliance test reports as they are managing timelines and customer relationships.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Project Handover:** Understand the technical and commercial scope of customer projects through detailed handover from the sales team.
* **Project Management:** Manage hybrid projects, including both hardware and software components, along with customized development services.
* **Timeline Management:** Plan and oversee the project delivery timeline with structured documentation and consistent progress reporting.
* **Customer Success:** Ensure customer goals and success are aligned with project deliverables through a deep understanding of their needs.
* **Regular Communication:** Maintain frequent communication with customers through cadence meetings and various communication channels (Slack, Email, WhatsApp, etc.).
* **Stakeholder Coordination:** Collaborate with internal technical teams and management to schedule tasks and align resources for timely project delivery.
* **Tool Management:** Use internal back-office management tools to maintain up-to-date project details and progress.
* **Project Management Software:** Utilize and be proficient in project management tools such as Monday, Asana, Jira, Bitrix24, etc.
* **Remote Collaboration:** Work efficiently in a remote-first environment using asynchronous communication while coordinating across various time zones.
* **Certifications and Compliances:** As our products (hardware and software platform) are sold to customers globally, the Customer Project Manager is also expected to understand the regional requirements of product certifications and compliances and liaise with the correct agencies to obtain these on behalf of the company.
* **Technical Scoping**: Translate customer requirements into technical specifications alongside engineering teams, and flag technical risks or trade-offs early in the project lifecycle.  
    
  **Requirements:**
* Proven experience managing customer-facing projects involving hardware and software delivery.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to handle multiple communication platforms and channels effectively.
* Strong proficiency in written and spoken English (IELTS, TOEFL, or other scores can be submitted).
* Experience working in remote-first companies, with a preference for experience in asynchronous communication environments.
* Solid technical foundation (engineering, IoT, embedded systems, or SaaS background preferred) combined with strong project management methodology, especially for hybrid hardware+software delivery.
* Proficiency in project management tools like Monday, Asana, Jira, Bitrix24, or similar.
* Knowledge of IoT hardware and SaaS software certifications and compliances (like CE, RoHS, SOC-2, ISO, etc) is a plus point.
* Excellent organizational skills and a structured approach to managing project timelines and documentation.
* Strong problem-solving abilities and a customer-oriented mindset.

 **Qualifications**

* 4-6 years of hands-on experience with project management.
* Experience in handling projects that involve both product delivery and customized development services.
* Prior experience as a Technical Program Manager (TPM), Solutions Engineer, or similar hybrid technical/customer-facing role in an IoT, hardware, or embedded-systems company.
* A background in working closely with technical teams, ensuring alignment between technical requirements and customer expectations.

 **Additional Information**

**Why Join Us:**

* Work on an ecosystem of cutting-edge products combining web tech, automation, and AI.
* Directly influence product architecture and team growth.
* Engage with leading automotive and AI-driven innovation challenges.

Remote working

title: Systems Engineer
description:
We are seeking a Systems Engineer to support and enhance our internal healthcare application platform. You will handle Kubernetes-based application deployments, CI/CD pipeline support, infrastructure automation, platform reliability, and cost optimization. You will work within established standards and security practices.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Deploy, upgrade, and maintain healthcare applications on Kubernetes using standardized patterns and Helm charts.
* Implement, maintain, and troubleshoot CI/CD pipelines using modern DevOps practices.
* Automate infrastructure provisioning and routine operational tasks using Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
* Monitor platform health, respond to alerts, troubleshoot issues, and contribute to root cause analysis.
* Identify manual processes and automate them to improve operational efficiency.
* Identify and implement cost-saving opportunities such as rightsizing, cleaning up unused resources, and tuning autoscaling.
* Follow security and compliance practices (HIPAA, access controls, secrets management) in all platform work.
* Maintain runbooks and technical documentation.
* Collaborate with development, operations, and support teams to improve application delivery.

### **Required Skills**

* 3+ years of experience in Systems Engineering, DevOps, or Platform Engineering.
* Strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and containerized applications.
* Experience with Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, or Jenkins.
* Proficiency in Terraform, Ansible, or other IaC tools.
* Scripting experience with PowerShell, Python, or Bash.
* Experience with Azure or another cloud platform.
* Strong troubleshooting, automation, and problem-solving skills.

### **Preferred Skills**

* Experience with AKS, EKS, or OpenShift.
* Helm charts and Kubernetes administration.
* Monitoring tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Azure Monitor, or ELK.
* Experience in healthcare or other regulated environments.
* Certifications such as CKA/CKAD, Azure Administrator, or Terraform Associate.

### **What Success Looks Like**

* Applications are deployed consistently using standardized Kubernetes patterns.
* Automation has measurably reduced manual work.
* Platform reliability has improved and incidents are resolved faster.
* Cost-saving actions have been delivered and documented.
* Runbooks and documentation are kept current.

title: AI Engineer
description:
***Job Title:*** AI Engineer

***Experience***: 4+ years in software engineering (3+ with an advanced degree), including 2+ years shipping LLM/RAG features to production

***Candidates from Tier 1 institute are preferred (IIIT, NIT, VIT, BITS Pilani etc)***

***Immediate Joiners Preferred***

***Mandatory Skills:*** Python, production LLM/RAG, retrieval (chunking, embeddings, vector search, pgvector), LLM evaluation harness, prompt engineering, guardrails (PII masking, output validation, prompt injection defence)

***Role Summary***

Own the retrieval core and every AI feature in the product: simplifying dense privacy notices into plain language, showing what changed between notice versions, and classifying and routing grievances within statutory timelines. Every output must be grounded in a citable source, logged for auditability and continuously evaluated. Personal data must never be readable by a model, so AI has to be architected within that boundary.

***Key Responsibilities***

* RAG core: Ingestion, chunking, embeddings, retrieval and reranking over privacy notices, policies and regulatory text.
* Notice simplification: Convert legal language into plain language without changing its meaning.
* Version diff: Explain in plain language what changed when a notice was updated.
* Grievance classification and routing: Classify and route grievances against statutory response timelines.
* Grounding and auditability: Source logging, citation and an evaluation harness that runs in CI.
* Guardrails: PII masking, prompt injection defence and correct refusal behaviour.
* Multilingual support: Make simplification, diffing and classification work across Indian languages.

***Minimum Qualifications***

* 4 years of software engineering, or 3 years with an advanced degree, or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 years shipping LLM or RAG features to production and keeping them running.
* Strong Python, with the discipline to write services rather than scripts.
* Retrieval built properly: defensible chunking strategy, embedding model selection and tuned vector search (pgvector preferred).
* Has built and run an evaluation harness: offline evals, regression on prompt changes, and measurement of grounding and faithfulness.
* Prompt engineering as an engineering practice: versioned, tested and changed on evidence.
* Guardrails in production: PII detection and masking, output validation, refusal behaviour and prompt injection defence.

***Preferred Qualifications***

* MLOps: model and prompt versioning, drift and cost monitoring, rollback.
* Adversarial work on LLM systems: red-teaming, jailbreak resistance, injection defence.
* NLP for Indian languages, especially Indic-script tokenisation and evaluation.
* Experience with legal, regulatory or other high-stakes text.
* Running open-weight models where data cannot leave the boundary.

***Education***

B.E./B.Tech or M.Tech in CS/IT, or equivalent demonstrated experience.

Pay: ₹1,500,000.00 - ₹2,200,000.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* How many years have you spent shipping LLM or RAG features to production?
* Which RAG components have you built and tuned in production? Example- Ingestion and chunking / Embedding model selection / Vector search (pgvector or other) / Reranking / None
* Have you built and run an offline evaluation harness that measures grounding or faithfulness and runs on prompt changes?
* Which guardrails have you implemented in production? Example- PII detection a
* Describe one LLM or RAG feature you kept running in production and how you measured and protected its quality

description:

We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role :**

  

As a Maconomy Support Analyst, you will provide Level 2 functional and transactional support for the Maconomy ERP platform, ensuring stable and efficient business operations across Finance, Projects, Billing, Purchasing, and related business functions. You will work closely with Finance teams, IT teams, and business stakeholders to resolve issues, improve processes, support system enhancements, and drive operational excellence across the ERP landscape.

  

**What Will You Do:**

  

* Provide Level 2 functional and transactional support for Maconomy ERP, ensuring timely resolution of incidents, service requests, and business-critical issues within SLA commitments.
* Investigate system issues, collaborate with technology teams to identify defects, perform root-cause analysis, and support timely remediation.
* Support ERP business processes including Accounting, Purchasing, Production, Distribution, Billing, Customer Order Management, and related operational functions.
* Create and maintain ERP process documentation, user manuals, operational procedures, knowledge articles, and support guides.
* Develop incident reports, project status reports, monthly service reports, and analytical insights to support decision-making and continuous improvement.
* Coordinate with Finance teams, key users, and IT teams to address operational challenges, gather requirements, and improve user experience.
* Support ERP enhancements, testing activities, special projects, system improvements, and ad-hoc business initiatives.
Conduct service review meetings with Finance leads and business stakeholders while promoting governance, best practices, and continuous improvement.  

  

Your Future at Kyndryl
  
The career path ahead is full of exciting opportunities to grow and advance within the job family. With dedication and hard work, you can climb the ladder to higher bands, achieving coveted positions such as Principal Engineer or Vice President of Software. These roles not only offer the chance to inspire and innovate, but also bring with them a sense of pride and accomplishment for having reached the pinnacle of your career in the software industry.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  

**Required Technical and Professional Experience:**

  

* 3+ years of experience working within complex global organizations in ERP support, ERP operations, or business systems support roles.

* Strong understanding of ERP business processes including Finance, Accounting, Billing, Purchasing, Project Management, and operational workflows.
* Experience troubleshooting ERP applications, supporting system installations, investigating incidents, and resolving user issues.

* Strong reporting, analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills with the ability to identify improvement opportunities.
* Ability to build trusted relationships with Finance teams, business stakeholders, key users, and technology teams.
Excellent communication, organizational, stakeholder management, and time-management skills with the ability to work independently.  

  

**Preferred Professional and Technical Expertise:**

  

* Hands-on experience with Deltek Maconomy support, administration, implementation, or enhancement projects.
* Experience supporting Finance, Project Accounting, Professional Services Automation (PSA), or ERP transformation initiatives.
* Experience training end users and supporting ERP adoption, change management, and business process improvements.
* Familiarity with ERP reporting, testing methodologies, governance practices, and service management processes.
Experience with ERP/accounting software and relevant ERP certifications is highly desirable.

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.

title: Microsoft Security Engineering Manager
description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**

At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-plus-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, advisory, and consulting groups as well as our enabling services functions. That’s why we continually invest in innovation, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**What It Means to Be a Consultant at Crowe**  
Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.

In management at Crowe, you play a pivotal role in leading teams, guiding project execution, and deepening client relationships. You are expected to contribute to account planning, identify opportunities to add value, and ensure high-quality delivery. As your responsibilities expand, you take on broader account ownership, balancing project leadership with growing involvement in client strategy and solution development.

Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.

**Grow Your Career in Microsoft Security**
------------------------------------------

Help us build the India foundation of a growing Microsoft Security practice that helps enterprise organizations modernize and transform security architectures by simplifying fragmented security platforms, protecting identities and data, and securing cloud and AI environments. As our first Microsoft Security Engineering Manager in India, you will take architectures and solution designs produced by our U.S.-based Security Architect and Security Engineer and turn them into hands-on configuration, development, and delivery — leading a growing team of India-based security engineers to execute that work to a high standard.

You are a working manager: still hands-on in Microsoft Purview, Microsoft Entra, and Microsoft Sentinel, but focused on translating architecture into implementation plans, assigning and reviewing your team's work, and being the technical quality bar for everything the India team delivers. You report into U.S. security practice leadership and are the primary point of contact between that leadership and the India delivery team.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Translate architecture and solution designs from the U.S.-based Security Architect and Security Engineer into detailed implementation plans, work breakdowns, and delivery assignments for the India engineering team.
* Personally configure and tune Microsoft security solutions — such as sensitivity labels, DLP and insider risk policies in Microsoft Purview, conditional access and identity governance in Microsoft Entra, and analytics rules, workbooks, and playbooks in Microsoft Sentinel — on complex or high-priority workstreams, setting the technical bar for the team.
* Review and quality-check configuration, detection, and automation work completed by India-based engineers to ensure it matches the architect's design intent and meets client requirements before it ships.
* Manage day-to-day delivery for the India team — assigning work, tracking progress against implementation plans, unblocking technical issues, and escalating risks to U.S. engagement leadership.
* Build, mentor, and grow a team of India-based Microsoft security engineers, including hiring, onboarding, and ongoing technical development.
* Serve as the primary technical point of contact in India for the U.S.-based Security Architect and Security Engineer, ensuring designs are correctly understood and implemented.
* Establish and enforce delivery standards, documentation practices, and QA checkpoints so client-facing work is consistently high quality across the India team.
* Participate in architecture reviews with U.S. leadership, providing implementation-feasibility feedback and surfacing delivery risks early. Stay current on new features and best practices, and share that knowledge with the India team.

**Microsoft Security Expertise**
--------------------------------

We are looking for a hands-on manager with implementation depth in at least two of the following Microsoft security products: Microsoft Purview (data governance, protection, and compliance), Microsoft Entra (identity and access management), and Microsoft Sentinel (security operations and detection engineering) — enough to personally configure solutions and credibly review a team's work across all three. Additional familiarity with Microsoft Defender XDR and related Defender products, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Security Copilot, or Azure Logic Apps is a plus.

You should also understand how these Microsoft security technologies integrate with third-party SIEM, endpoint, identity, email-security, data-security, vulnerability-management, and cloud platforms — enough to guide your team through integration work and speak knowledgeably with U.S. architects about it. Exposure to platforms such as Splunk, CrowdStrike, Palo Alto Networks, CyberArk, Okta, Proofpoint, Zscaler, Netskope, Tenable, Rapid7, AWS, or Google Cloud is valuable.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* 10+ years of overall experience in cybersecurity or IT, with hands-on implementation and configuration experience in at least two of Microsoft Purview, Microsoft Entra, and Microsoft Sentinel, including at least 6 years leading or managing a technical team.
* Demonstrated ability to read and interpret architecture and solution designs, and translate them into concrete implementation plans and work assignments for a team — not just execute a pre-built checklist.
* Working knowledge of core security concepts, including Zero Trust, identity and access management, data protection, and security operations/incident response — sufficient to quality-review your team's configuration and detection work.
* Strong people-management skills, including assigning work, giving technical feedback, and developing engineers, plus the ability to document standards and configurations clearly.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work directly with U.S.-based architects, engagement leaders, and client technical teams across time zones.

We don’t expect any one candidate to check every box above. If you bring hands-on Microsoft security implementation experience and a track record of leading technical teams to high-quality delivery, we encourage you to apply.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* At least one active Microsoft security certification, such as SC-200 (Security Operations Analyst), SC-300 (Identity and Access Administrator), SC-400 (Information Protection Administrator), or SC-401. Candidates without an active certification will be expected to obtain one within 90 days of joining, and to encourage the same of their team.
* Hands-on experience in all three of Microsoft Purview, Microsoft Entra, and Microsoft Sentinel, rather than the minimum two, so you can review work and unblock issues across the full stack.
* Prior experience managing an India- or offshore-based technical delivery team supporting U.S. or other onshore stakeholders, in a consulting, managed-services, or client-facing environment.
* Experience supporting regulated organizations or industries such as financial services, insurance, manufacturing, retail, or life sciences, including their heightened documentation and QA expectations.
* Familiarity with scripting or automation (e.g., PowerShell, KQL, Logic Apps) to streamline configuration and detection work, and to teach these practices to your team.
* Bachelor’s degree in cybersecurity, computer science, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent hands-on and leadership experience.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

In your first six months, you will ramp up on client environments and delivery expectations, begin building and stabilizing your India engineering team, and establish yourself as the trusted technical translator between U.S. architects and hands-on India delivery. Over your first year, you will grow the team, instill consistent quality standards across configuration and detection work, and become the leader U.S. practice leadership relies on to deliver complex work reliably from India — building the track record needed to grow the team and take on broader regional leadership.

**Working Expectations**
------------------------

* Maintain sufficient daily overlap with U.S. business hours to collaborate in real time with U.S.-based architects and engagement leaders; occasional travel to the U.S. for team events and planning.
* Participate occasionally in after-hours activities related to security incidents, production deployments, or scheduled maintenance windows, including coordinating your team's coverage.
* Collaborate closely and daily with the U.S.-based Security Architect and Security Engineer, and directly manage a distributed team of India-based security engineers.
* Operate effectively in a growing practice where offerings, assets, processes, and team structures are still being established — including standing up the India team's structure and delivery processes from the ground up.

Ready to make an impact? If you are a hands-on Microsoft security leader who wants to build and run our first India delivery team — turning U.S.-designed architectures into high-quality, real-world configurations in Purview, Entra, and Sentinel — we encourage you to apply.

  
What It Means to Be a Consultant at Crowe: Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes. In management at Crowe, you play a pivotal role in leading teams, guiding project execution, and deepening client relationships. You are expected to contribute to account planning, identify opportunities to add value, and ensure high-quality delivery. As your responsibilities expand, you take on broader account ownership, balancing project leadership with growing involvement in client strategy and solution development. Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.

We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.

**Our Benefits:**  
At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We value our people and offer employees a comprehensive benefits package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!  
  
**How You Can Grow:**  
We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!  
  
**More about Crowe:**

Crowe Capability Center – India, operating under the legal entity C3 India Delivery Centre LLP (formerly known as Crowe Horwath IT Services LLP) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Crowe LLP (U.S.A.), a public accounting, consulting and technology firm with offices around the world. Crowe LLP is an independent member firm of Crowe Global, one of the largest global accounting networks in the world. The network consists of more than 200 independent accounting and advisory firms in more than 130 countries around the world.

Crowe does not accept unsolicited candidates, referrals or resumes from any staffing agency, recruiting service, sourcing entity or any other third-party paid service at any time. Any referrals, resumes or candidates submitted to Crowe, or any employee or owner of Crowe without a pre-existing agreement signed by both parties covering the submission will be considered the property of Crowe, and free of charge.

We are committed to a merit-based hiring process, evaluating all candidates consistently using objective, job-related criteria such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, measurable impact, and alignment with the role’s responsibilities, and making employment decisions in a fair and inclusive manner free from discrimination.
