title: App Dev & Support Engineer II
description:
Through our dedicated associates, Conduent delivers mission-critical services and solutions on behalf of Fortune 100 companies and over 500 governments - creating exceptional outcomes for our clients and the millions of people who count on them. You have an opportunity to personally thrive, make a difference and be part of a culture where individuality is noticed and valued every day.

  
  

We are looking for a **Web Administrator / WebAdmin Engineer** responsible for administration, monitoring, maintenance, patching, deployment, and production support of enterprise web and application environments. The resource will help ensure availability, performance, security, and stability across Production and Non-Production systems.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Monitor web/application servers and proactively identify availability, performance, and infrastructure issues.
* Perform **Production and Non-Production server patching** and scheduled maintenance activities, consistent with the WebAdmin activities documented for your team.
* Perform application/service health checks and service restarts when required.
* Troubleshoot web server, application server, infrastructure, connectivity, SSL/TLS, and environment-related issues.
* Support application deployments, releases, configuration changes, and environment setup.
* Install, renew, and troubleshoot **SSL/TLS certificates**.
* Perform configuration and administration of web technologies such as **IIS and/or Apache HTTP Server**.
* Support middleware or application servers such as **Apache Tomcat** where applicable.
* Monitor CPU, memory, disk space, services, logs, and server availability.
* Analyze logs and provide **Root Cause Analysis (RCA)** for Production incidents.
* Coordinate with application, database, network, firewall, security, Windows/Linux, and infrastructure teams for issue resolution.
* Execute approved changes through organizational change-management processes.
* Maintain operational documentation, SOPs, configuration details, troubleshooting procedures, and patching records. Your existing administration function similarly includes documenting changes and troubleshooting Production/Non-Production issues with RCA.
* Participate in Production support, scheduled maintenance, weekend activities, and on-call support as required.
* Experience required is 6-10 Years

**Required Technical Skills**

**Core skills**

* IIS / Apache Web Server administration
* Windows Server and/or Linux administration
* Apache Tomcat or similar application-server knowledge
* SSL/TLS certificate management
* Server monitoring and log analysis
* Application deployment and configuration
* Production troubleshooting and incident management
* Server patching and vulnerability remediation
* Basic networking knowledge: **DNS, TCP/IP, HTTP/HTTPS, ports, load balancers and firewalls**
* PowerShell and/or Shell scripting

**Good to Have**

* Azure DevOps / CI-CD
* Jenkins
* Git
* F5 or other load balancer knowledge
* Web/application security and vulnerability remediation

ITIL-based Incident, Problem and Change Management

description:
About company

ECE is a renowned name in the data centre industry, specializing in HVAC and Fire designing, testing, and project execution in India and abroad. Our clients include leading organizations such as Amazon Web Services, Bharti Airtel, Jio, Reliance, Vodafone, TCS, TCE, STT, Haldiram, Indian Air Force, and more.

As we expand, we are looking for dynamic and motivated professionals who are eager to grow with us.

https://effisenseconsulting.com/

Job description

Role & responsibilities

ELV DESIGN ENGINEER

\* Bachelor Degree in Mechanical/ Electrical Engineering

\* At least 5 year work experienced on electrical design and electrical engineering works.

\* Have knowledge & Experience on Extra Low Voltage Systems CCTV, Access Control system, Fire Alarm system, Fire Intercom, MATV/CATV, Public address system, Building management system

\* Have Experience in MS Office, MS Excel, AutoCAD, Projects 2000.

\* Good in both languages English & Hindi

\* Design and implementation of Fire Alarm Systems (FAS) and Public Address & Voice Alarm Systems (PAS/VA), utilizing a wide range of control panels, detectors, sensors, notification devices, speakers, amplifiers, interfaces, and actuating elements compliant with relevant international standards (e.g., NFPA, EN, BS, local codes).

\* Preparation of detailed automation hardware layouts, network architectures (including loop wiring, zoning, addressable protocols), and software configurations for FAS and PAS integration within IBMS environments.

\* Development of pre-bid designs, Bill of Quantities (BOQ), technical specifications, cost estimates, and method statements for FAS and PAS in new project proposals and tenders.

\* Coordination and finalization of General Arrangement drawings, equipment sizing, placement, and technical specifications for fire alarm and public address equipment, ensuring seamless integration with mechanical, electrical, and instrumentation disciplines.

\* Technical evaluation and review of vendor/supplier proposals for FAS and PAS components, including assessment of datasheets, compliance schedules, performance parameters, and preparation of base design documents or comparison matrices.

\* Close coordination with Project Management Consultants (PMC), site engineers, field teams, and internal project management to resolve design and site-related issues, propose efficient solutions, and ensure timely project delivery while managing design budgets, schedules, and accountability.

\* Proficiency in using design software/tools, personal computers, instrumentation for testing/calibration, and full knowledge of applicable codes, standards, and international regulations governing fire detection, alarm, voice evacuation, and emergency communication systems.

\* Strong design coordination skills with clients, internal departments, consultants, and vendors, leveraging excellent communication and interpersonal abilities to align on project objectives and achieve high-quality outcomes.

Pay: From ₹30,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Life insurance

Work Location: In person

title: Information & Cybersec Lead
description:
**Job Summary**
---------------

We are looking for a skilled ZTNA Engineer (E2) to manage day-to-day operations, monitoring, troubleshooting and support of Zero Trust Network Access solutions. The candidate will be responsible for resolving user connectivity issues, managing access policies, supporting application onboarding and ensuring secure access to enterprise applications

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **E2 / L2 Operational Responsibilities**

  + Independently resolve routine and moderately complex ZTNA incidents.
  + Perform initial troubleshooting and root cause analysis.
  + Validate user identity, device posture and access permissions.
  + Analyze ZTNA logs for authentication and connectivity failures.
  + Support ZTNA policy changes following approval processes.
  + Perform application connectivity testing.
  + Coordinate with OEM/vendor support for unresolved issues.
  + Ensure SLA adherence and timely ticket resolution.
  + Escalate complex architectural or platform-level issues to E3/L3.Provide L2 operational support for ZTNA infrastructure.
* Monitor ZTNA platform health, connectivity and access activities.
* Troubleshoot user access, authentication and application connectivity issues.
* Configure and maintain ZTNA access policies as per approved requests.
* Support user onboarding and offboarding activities.
* Manage application access and connectivity configurations.
* Troubleshoot ZTNA client/agent installation and connectivity issues.
* Coordinate with network, firewall, endpoint and IAM teams for issue resolution.
* Support MFA, SSO and Active Directory integration-related issues.
* Perform access policy validation and routine health checks.
* Monitor security alerts and investigate access-related incidents.
* Handle incident, service request and change management tickets.
* Maintain SOPs, troubleshooting documents and knowledge-based articles.
* Escalate complex issues to E3/L3 teams with proper technical analysis.

**Skill Requirements**
----------------------

* Good understanding of Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) concepts.
* Hands-on experience with any one or more ZTNA technologies:

Zscaler Private Access (ZPA), Palo Alto Prisma Access, Netskope Private Access

Cloudflare Zero Trust, Cisco Secure Access

* Knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, HTTP/HTTPS and routing fundamentals.
* Understanding of VPN, firewall and proxy technologies.
* Knowledge of Active Directory, LDAP, SAML and MFA.
* Basic understanding of SSO and identity management.
* Knowledge of endpoint security and device posture checks.
* Basic understanding of SIEM monitoring and security logs.
* Experience with ITSM tools such as ServiceNow or Jira.

**Must Have Skill**
-------------------

Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) tools - Others

**Good to Have Skill**
----------------------

**Other Requirements**
----------------------

**Educational Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, IT, Electronics or a related field.
* Relevant networking or cybersecurity certifications are preferred:
  + CCNA, CompTIA Security+, Zscaler certifications, Palo Alto Networks certifications, Netskope certifications

**Required Soft Skills**

* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting abilities.
* Customer-focused approach.
* Ability to work in a shift-based or 24×7 support environment, if required.
* Good documentation and incident management skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

title: Steel Sector / Technical Project Lead
description:
**Steel Sector / Technical Project Lead**

DEFINE is looking for a Project Lead with 5–8 years of experience to serve as the technical project lead for DEFINE’s industrial research and process-improvement engagements, primarily in the steel sector.

The role combines process engineering, plant measurements, experimental trials and predictive modelling to improve resource recovery, product quality and operating efficiency. You will coordinate with plant teams and work with AI/ML engineers to turn operating data and research findings into practical recommendations.

Steel industry experience, particularly in coke ovens and associated operations, is preferred. Process engineers from other industrial sectors with relevant experience are also encouraged to apply. Exposure to AI/ML-based process modelling is valued.

**Travel:** Regular travel to steel plants and other industrial sites, including site stays during assessments and trials, is required.

Type of Position-Full-Time (Gurgaon), Requires Travelling

Department-Research

Experience-5-8 years

No. of Positions-1

Reports to-Rohan Sharma

Apply by-10th Dec, 2026

**About DEFINE**

DEFINE is our AI-powered climate-intelligence system that transforms how industrial operations measure, verify, and act on emissions. Our award-winning platform has been globally recognised for replacing static, survey-based emission factors with dynamic, real-time, asset-level intelligence generated directly from factories, production lines and value-chain activities. By integrating operational data, sensor signals, geospatial inputs, and machine-learning models, DEFINE creates primary-data-driven emission factors that reflect actual technology configurations, process parameters, and energy mixes inside plants.

**Key ResponsibilitiesSector Research & Process Analysis**

* Lead technical assessments of industrial processes to identify opportunities for improved efficiency, resource recovery and product quality.
* Apply material and heat balances, engineering calculations and operating-data analysis to investigate process performance.
* Translate plant problems into research questions, measurable objectives and practical work plans.
* Evaluate proposed improvements against equipment, production, utility and safety constraints.

**Data Collection & Platform Support**

* Coordinate with plant operations, instrumentation, laboratory, maintenance and IT teams for data access and project execution.
* Assess measurement reliability, establish sampling protocols and identify essential instrumentation requirements.
* Work with AI/ML engineers to select process variables, interpret model outputs and validate predictions against plant behaviour.
* Support the integration of plant data and engineering insights into DEFINE’s analytical applications.

**Experimental Trials & Project Delivery**

* Own the technical work plan, coordinate contributions from process, AI/ML and plant teams, and manage schedules, dependencies, risks and milestone delivery.
* Plan and supervise plant trials, including comparison conditions, sampling, operating limits and acceptance criteria.
* Assess technical improvements, measurement uncertainty, utility implications and financial value.
* Ensure that recommendations are practical and supported by reliable evidence.

**Reporting & Knowledge Contribution**

* Prepare technical reports, trial protocols, milestone submissions and operating guidance.
* Communicate findings clearly to plant personnel, project partners and internal teams.
* Develop training materials and support adoption of validated recommendations.
* Contribute technical inputs to new research proposals and industrial projects.

**Key Deliverables**

* Agreed project work plans, responsibilities and milestone schedules.
* Process assessments, measurement and sampling plans, and plant-approved trial protocols.
* Validated improvement recommendations supported by technical and financial evidence.
* Accepted milestone reports, operating procedures, training materials and project handover documentation.

**What does the Ideal Candidate Look Like?**

We need you to be the kind of person who:

* Can lead technical work from initial plant assessment through trials and validation.
* Is comfortable working with operators, engineers, researchers and data scientists.
* Questions data quality and uses engineering judgement to test assumptions.
* Can connect physical process behaviour with predictive-model outputs.
* Takes ownership of deliverables and is open to regular travel and site-based work.

**QualificationsRequired**

* B.Tech/B.E. or M.Tech/M.E., Ph.D. in Chemical, Metallurgical, Process Engineering or a closely related discipline.
* 5–8 years of relevant experience in industrial operations, process engineering, optimisation or applied research.
* Practical knowledge of material and heat balances, process instrumentation and operating-data analysis.
* Experience planning or executing plant trials, commissioning or process-improvement activities.
* Strong technical writing, stakeholder coordination and project-execution skills.
* Willingness to travel regularly and work at industrial sites.

**Preferred**

* Experience in the steel industry, particularly coke oven batteries, by-product recovery or coal chemical operations.
* Experience leading a similar industrial research or process-improvement project, including plant coordination, experimental trials, performance validation and delivery of technical milestones.
* Knowledge of coke oven gas cooling, condensation, tar recovery or comparable industrial gas–liquid systems.
* Exposure to AI/ML-based process models, soft sensors, process simulation or industrial analytics.
* Familiarity with historian data, time-series analysis, experimental design and measurement uncertainty.
* Working knowledge of Python, MATLAB or relevant process-modelling tools.
* Experience coordinating multidisciplinary teams and delivering industry-linked research projects.

Join us in our mission to decarbonise industries and make a meaningful impact through your work at DEFINE.

**How to Apply: Please submit your resume along with a cover letter outlining your qualifications and interest in the role to rohan@define.global and neetu@mysuperhumanrace.com**

*DEFINE is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.*

Pay: ₹2,200,000.00 - ₹2,500,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule
* Provident Fund
* Work from home

Application Question(s):

* Do you have direct experience in the steel sector—specifically in coke oven batteries, by-product recovery, coal chemical operations, or gas-liquid systems (gas cooling/condensation/tar recovery)? Please briefly specify your plant/process exposure.
* Briefly describe a plant trial or process-improvement project you led, and mention your familiarity with historian/time-series data, Python/MATLAB, or AI/ML-based process modelling.
* This role is based in Gurgaon and requires regular travel to steel plants and industrial sites, including extended site stays during plant trials. Are you comfortable with this?
* How many years of hands-on experience do you have in industrial operations, process engineering, optimisation, or applied plant research?
* What is your current location, notice period, and expected CTC?

The incumbent will be responsible for controlling the project costs; This includes planning, developing, controlling, and forecasting the project’s budget and schedule. ================================

§ Familiarization with the process of project control procedures

§ Understanding Contract vis-à-vis project scope of work

§ Developing Cost WBS structure and control budget for the project based on the approved estimate.

§ Proactively monitor and communicate budget, actual status, and forecast costs/labor hours for projects monthly.

§ Consolidate performance data to support performance measurement, data analysis, and cost forecasting.

§ Assist in the development of project work plans and schedules.

§ Create client and internal status reports that effectively communicate schedule status and identify critical path.

§ Provide technical guidance to other project controls staff in project financial status

§ Ensuring all financials are in order, preparing spreadsheets and a wide variety of routine cost analyses, cash flow, and other cost related evaluations.

§ Set-up, monitor & report earned value progress measurement systems for projects, including analysis based on input from project leads

§ Identify business acumen by identifying for us potential project problems early, report issues and problems to operations leadership, and work with project teams to address and implement recovery plans.

§ Review of expenditure details, identifying incorrect charges, and commencement of the charge correction process will ensure our financials are accurate. To review, process, and track sub consultant invoices on various projects.

§ Prepare and update project schedules and cost/resource loading them.

§ Identify and drive optimizations in planning and execution of projects

§ Advise Project Controls Lead and Project Leadership Team of any potential schedule issues and when necessary, provide guidance on corrective action and measures to mitigate any adverse trends.

§ Develop and review schedule corrective actions and recovery plans and verify needed actions plans are implemented.

§ Review project changes to evaluate detail schedule impact; responsible for quantifying and incorporating the effect and impact of approved changes in the overall schedule stewardship and reporting.

§ Monitor and report on schedule implications of changes

§ Support project team with ongoing project progress measurement and schedule analysis, reporting, and forecasting activities.

§ Develop change management and maintaining change log.

§ Support in monitoring of cost developments of engineering/vendors/contractors and develop the cost reports.

§ Look for ways to reduce project costs and for ways to improve our work processes.

§ Perform price estimation and price budgeting from contract commitment to fit the baseline program

§ Provide planning / scheduling, and cost controlling mechanism for all projects which includes variation reporting, monitoring of milestone progress to the preparation of customer billing processes, etc.

§ Ensure effective project implementation and utilize productive reports from the creation of WBS with the use of project management system to monitor the status of the project.

§ Perform project costing related reporting to the team and management’s review monthly to ensure that expenditures are kept within the project budget.

§ Performing and/or managing the analysis of cost and risks for projects with a focus on support of project management.

§ Accountable for investment of project cost, and schedule and reports to the Project Manager of one or more projects during the planning and execution phase.

Here's what you'll need

  

§ Graduate / Advanced degree in Engineering or other technical disciplines

§ Experience in the infrastructure sector or in construction industry is highly preferable, with exposure in site engineering, project management, project planning, project costing, project scheduling, coordination, procurement and construction workflows.

§ Knowledge in cost control tools and technics to drive /contribute project financial health, knowledge in Estimation, Project / Cost Controlling, Project Tracking, Project Scheduling

§ Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of interdependency of underlying cost and schedule drivers.

§ Demonstrate excellent understanding of the entire system of the business, relationship between productivity vs profitability

§ Good team player with excellent communication and interpersonal skills

§ Ability to communicate effectively (written and verbal) with project stakeholders and proficient to work in any project environment.

§ Ability to prioritize and organize assigned tasks in a timely manner.

§ Ability to follow company procedures and work independently without guidance

§ Proactive and analytic, becoming an integrated part of the team, despite remote engagement

The incumbent will have relationships with one or more of the following:

§ Project Managers, Senior Project Managers, Manager of Projects

§ Project Controllers, Planning Leads, Project Accountants, Commercial Analysts, Procurement

§ Mastery in MS Excel and strong skillset in other MS Office software (Word, PowerPoint, SharePoint, Outlook)

§ Proficiency in any other cost control tool

§ Knowledge in Planning software like MSP / Primavera, Power BI / Data Visualization software will provide an advantage

At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients’ expectations.

  
  

Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you.

  
  

At Jacobs it’s all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!

We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.

Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability.

title: CONSULTANT - DATA
description:
**Senior Platform Engineer (AI Gateway, Identity & Observability)**

**Agentic AI Platform | Financial Services | Full-time**

*Experience: 8+ years overall, including 5+ years hands-on API platform, identity or observability engineering*

**ABOUT THE ROLE**
==================

We are building an enterprise agentic AI platform for a financial services client: the runtime, gateway, developer tooling and data interfaces that internal engineering teams will use to build and run AI agents in production.

You will build the control plane every agent passes through, regardless of where that agent runs. That means three connected things: the AI gateway that fronts all model traffic, the identity and registration path that governs which agents are allowed to call it, and the observability plane that makes the whole fleet visible and attributable.

These are deliberately held together in one position rather than split. The gateway is where identity is enforced and where much of the telemetry originates, so an engineer who understands only one of the three will build seams into what should be a single plane. You will be expected to work across all three, with depth in at least one and real working competence in the others.

This work is also the most time-critical on the platform: an external engineering team needs the gateway carrying production traffic early in the engagement, and the interface published to them cannot change afterwards.

This is a hands-on engineering position on a small, senior delivery team. It is not an oversight or coordination role.

**INDICATIVE RESPONSIBILITIES**
===============================

*The platform is being designed as the engagement progresses, so responsibilities will evolve. Indicative, and not limited to:*

**? Deliver the AI gateway** that routes model traffic across cloud-hosted models, other providers and on-premises inference, presenting one consistent, provider-agnostic interface to every consuming agent.

**? Implement gateway policy:** routing and backend pools, token-based rate limiting and quotas, retries, failover and circuit breaking, caching, and request and response transformation.

**? Harden an existing service for production** and run a controlled migration to the long-term gateway, moving consumers across without changing the contract they already integrated against.

**? Build the agent identity and registration path:** workload or service identity for agents, registration on deployment, and the promotion gate that governs what reaches production. Full automation is not assumed; part of the work is automating what can be automated and designing a clean, documented path for the steps that require human approval.

**? Design and implement the telemetry schema** and the OpenTelemetry pipelines that carry it, spanning agents in every runtime, so traces are consistent and attributable to an owning team.

**? Build the fleet view** showing each agent, its owner, version, environment, health and consumption, including the identifiers that make usage chargeable back to consuming teams.

**? Own the reliability view of the platform:** defining what good telemetry looks like, verifying that traces are complete and correctly attributed across every runtime, setting service level indicators and objectives for the gateway and the agent fleet, and building the alerting that surfaces failures, latency regressions and cost anomalies before consuming teams report them.

**? Apply guardrails at the gateway,** including content safety policy and a callout path to custom filtering services.

**? Establish the network and integration paths** the control plane depends on, including private connectivity or controlled egress to observability backends and third-party services, DNS and certificate handling, and the security review each path requires.

**? Load test and prove the gateway** under realistic production volume, and produce the runbooks and operational documentation the client will run it from.

**MUST HAVE**
=============

**? 5+ years hands-on engineering across API platforms, identity or observability,** with production depth in at least one and working competence in the others. All three areas are in scope for this position.

**? 4+ years building and operating API gateways in production:** routing, policy authoring, rate limiting and quotas, authentication, transformation and versioning. Azure API Management is strongly preferred; comparable depth in Apigee, Kong or an equivalent enterprise gateway is acceptable.

**? 3+ years enterprise identity and access engineering:** OAuth2, OpenID Connect and JWT validation, service principals and workload or managed identity, and secrets management using an enterprise vault.

**? 3+ years hands-on OpenTelemetry** or equivalent distributed tracing: instrumentation, collectors, resource attributes, span design, and trace, metric and log pipelines.

**? 3+ years in a site reliability, production engineering or platform operations role,** or equivalent hands-on responsibility for a service other teams depend on: service level objectives and error budgets, alerting design, on-call and incident response, and post-incident analysis. This position owns whether the telemetry is trustworthy, not only whether it is being collected.

**? 2+ years working with LLM or AI workloads in production,** including model routing across providers, token-based limits and quotas, streaming responses, content filtering, and how inference cost accrues and is attributed.

**? Experience with LLM observability tooling,** such as Langfuse, LangSmith, Arize or an equivalent platform, including how agent traces differ from conventional application traces.

**? 3+ years production API operations:** failover, circuit breaking, caching, load testing to prove capacity, and incident response for a service other teams depend on.

**? 2+ years integrating third-party or self-hosted services into an enterprise network,** including private connectivity or controlled egress, DNS resolution, TLS and certificate management, and working the firewall and security review needed to get each path approved.

**? Working knowledge of cloud infrastructure** on at least one major hyperscaler: networking, identity, container platforms and infrastructure-as-code.

**? Programming competence** in Python, C# or an equivalent language, sufficient to build and maintain policy extensions, callout services and instrumentation libraries.

**PREFERRED**
=============

**? Familiarity with Azure AI Foundry observability and Azure Monitor or Application Insights,** including agent tracing, continuous evaluation and how a managed observability plane compares with a self-hosted one such as Langfuse. This platform may run one, the other, or both, and the choice is still open.

**? Azure API Management depth,** including policy expressions, reusable policy fragments and the AI or LLM policy set.

**? Microsoft Entra ID experience,** including managed identity, app registrations and conditional access.

**? Experience with reliability engineering for AI or machine learning systems,** including quality regression detection, drift monitoring or evaluation-driven alerting.

**? Familiarity with emerging agent identity models** and how agent-to-service authentication differs from conventional service-to-service patterns.

**? Experience implementing chargeback or showback** for a shared platform service.

**? Content safety or guardrail services,** such as Azure AI Content Safety, or custom filtering and moderation services.

**? Enterprise workflow integration,** such as ServiceNow APIs for approval-driven provisioning.

**? Experience in financial services or another regulated industry,** where security review governs the pace of change.

**? Familiarity with agent frameworks** and how agents consume model endpoints, tools and memory.

**WAYS OF WORKING**
===================

**? Communication.** Explaining technical trade-offs clearly to client stakeholders, including non-specialists, and holding a position under challenge without escalating friction.

**? Distributed teamwork.** Working effectively across time zones with a limited daily overlap window, and using written handover so work continues outside shared hours.

**? Documentation.** Writing design decisions, interface documentation and runbooks as part of delivery rather than afterwards.

**? Working with ambiguity.** Making progress and sequencing work sensibly while direction is still forming, since several architectural decisions will still be open on joining.

**? Client-facing judgement.** Working directly with client engineering and security teams, and representing the delivery team professionally.

**? Collaboration across disciplines.** Working alongside platform, gateway, identity, observability, data and SDK engineers whose work connects to your own.

As a multinational digital services and technology company, Coforge is a trusted innovation partner to leading enterprises across the world, supporting transformation and growth in industries such as Banking, Financial Services & Insurance (BFSI), Travel & Transportation, Healthcare, Public Sector, Manufacturing, and Digital Commerce. Senior Consultants act as reviewers, quality controllers, and process leads, ensuring high‑quality, audit‑ready outputs while guiding junior team members.

**Responsibilities**
====================

* Execute quarterly Solvency II capital calculations across Standard Formula and/or Internal Model components under established methodologies.

* Market Risk (interest rate, equity, spread, currency, concentration)
* Credit Risk (counterparty default, credit migration)

* Operational Risk using prescribed methodologies
* Support calculation of Loss-Absorbing Capacity of Deferred Taxes (LAC DT) and technical provisions.
* Assist in risk aggregation, diversification and correlation adjustments as part of SCR computation.
* Prepare draft Quantitative Reporting Templates (QRTs) and supporting analysis for capital-related submissions.
* Conduct first-level data checks, reconciliations, and validation of capital inputs and outputs.
* Maintain detailed documentation including calculation files and methodological documentation.
* Support stakeholder queries by providing data extracts, explanations and supporting evidence.

**Qualifications we seek in you!**
==================================

### **Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Actuarial Science, Finance, Economics, or related fields.
* Professional certifications such as Actuary, FRM, CFA or MBA preferred (not mandatory but strongly valued).

* Experience in:
  + Solvency II Directive and Delegated Acts
  + Insurance capital concepts and risk drivers
  + Risk & Compliance
* **Capital Modelling & Cashflow Mechanics**: Strong understanding of stochastic and deterministic cashflow generation across assets and liabilities, including projection logic, discounting frameworks, and linkage to BEL, Risk Margin, and SCR calculation under Solvency II.
* **Scenario & Stress Transmission**: Ability to articulate how market, credit, lapse, mortality, and expense shocks propagate through valuation models and impact SCR, Own Funds, diversification effects, and solvency ratios.
* **Capital Methodologies & Simulation Techniques**: Theoretical/ working knowledge of full revaluation vs sensitivity-based approaches, nested simulations, proxy models, Monte Carlo methodologies, and aggregation/correlation structures within Internal Model and Standard Formula frameworks.
* Ability to assess, and improve regulatory processes across the organization
* Proficient in preparing process narratives, and high‑quality working papers.
* Strong analytical abilities with the capability to interpret complex evidence and identify root causes.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, including report writing and issue drafting.
* Ability to work on multiple assignments simultaneously and manage deadlines in a global delivery model.

title: Supply Planning Analyst
description:
At Crocs, Inc., every career offers a chance to make a real impact. No two journeys look the same. And that's exactly how we like it. Whether you’re welcoming customers into our stores, collaborating with global teams at our headquarters, or keeping operations moving at our distribution centers, your impact is real and valued. At Crocs, Inc. you’re not expected to fit a mold. You’re encouraged to break it and create something better.

**Overview**
------------

The **Supply Planner** will be part of a centralized India‑based Transactional Supply Planning Pod, supporting all Global regions under the Global Supply Planning Center of Excellence (COE). This role is responsible for executing core supply planning transactions with a strong focus on process discipline, data accuracy, and operational excellence, enabling regional teams and the COE to scale consistently. The role operates within the India Planning organization, with accountability to the Global Supply Planning COE for adherence to global standards, KPIs, and governance, and plays a critical role in building a foundation for future AI‑enabled supply planning capabilities.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Create and update Purchase Orders in the system based on approved inputs, including converting approved wholesale orders into Purchase Orders and supporting PO placement for Charms, Bags, and Accessories across all regions.
* Perform PO changes including cancellations, cancel/replace actions, and quantity updates, and process supplier-requested PO changes following defined guidelines.
* Support final PO placement activities, including rounding and Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) compliance.
* Run and update standard reports to track PO confirmation status, gaps, and excess, ensuring timely system updates to support accurate supply planning reporting.
* Maintain accurate vendor and sourcing data in SAP following defined procedures, and support vendor sourcing confirmation after Production Requirements are submitted to the central sourcing team.
* Perform availability checks and update material status in SAP as required.
* Work with the Trade Company production team in Singapore and internal partners to support daily execution needs, providing updates to Regional Supply Planners on PO status and confirmations.
* Follow shared calendars, cutoffs, and supply milestones to support on-time execution.

**What You'll Bring to the Table**
----------------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Analytics, or a related field preferred
* 1–2 years of experience in supply chain, planning, inventory management, or operational roles
* Relevant internships or early-career experience in planning, supply chain, or operations considered
* Strong working knowledge of **Microsoft Excel** (filters, formulas, basic data analysis)
* Basic understanding of **ERP systems** (SAP preferred) and transactional data maintenance
* Familiarity with planning systems (e.g., o9 or similar tools) is a strong plus but not required
* Strong problem-solving mindset with ability to follow guidance and ask questions when needed
* Interest in building foundational skills to support **future automation and AI-enabled planning**

The Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability, or any other protected classification.

At Crocs, Inc. we believe in the power of a blend of in-person and virtual collaboration to drive creativity and strengthen relationships. Your participation in this flexible schedule plays a key role in building a connected and successful team. In-office requirements vary by our work personas: Resident (5 days), Collaborator (4 days), Connector (2-3 days), Explorer (fully remote). This role has been aligned to the Collaborator persona.

description:
Overview:

Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 5,500+  
employees and ~30,000 customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500. Founded in 1999,  
Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event  
professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help  
them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people  
together at events around the world. In short, we’re transforming the meetings and events industry  
through innovative technology that powers human connection.

Headquartered in Tysons Corner, Virginia, Cvent (formerly NYSE: CVT) was acquired by Blackstone  
and Vista for $4.6B in 2023.

Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like  
entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and  
celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections.

Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At  
Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our  
DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to  
experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI-augmented work, you’ll  
thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering  
exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation.  
Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn,  
iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AIpowered

media platforms. Cvent is not responsible for losses or damages arising from communications,  
payments, or disclosures made to third parties impersonating Cvent.

fraud.

title: Security Engineer - Application Security
description:
**About Gartner IT:**

Join a world-class team of skilled engineers who build creative digital solutions to support our colleagues and clients. We make a broad organizational impact by delivering cutting-edge technology solutions that power Gartner. Gartner IT values its culture of nonstop innovation, an outcome-driven approach to success, and the notion that great ideas can come from anyone on the team.

**About the Role:**

The Senior Security Engineer will be responsible for supporting Gartner’s AppSec function. This individual will play an integral role in, executing daily vulnerability Assessments functions; working closely with Information Security partners, and technology stakeholders to identify risks/vulnerabilities and collaborate with key stakeholders on remediation, developing and tracking risk/vulnerability remediation and prioritize effort across our various business units, partnering to implement security tools, technologies and controls with an appropriate balance of security, business, and user experience, while providing education and training; and engineer automation solutions and/or security tool integrations to assist with day-to-day AppSec responsibilities.

**Pls note** : Our Security engineering team operates on a continuous 2-11 PM model to protect global systems and support business needs across time zones.

  

**What you’ll do:**

* Collaborate with business stakeholders to design secure applications, test applications for security weakness, and partner on remediation of identified issues.

* Mentor engineers and security champions on practical threat modeling techniques

* Triage and prioritize security risks, vulnerabilities, and exceptions in alignment with business impact and risk tolerance.

* Coordinate the orchestration, automation, and management of security technologies and platforms.

* Own day-to-day life cycle management, including identification, threat assessment, threat modeling and risk avoidance.

* Create reasonable and actionable reports showing direct impact to the security posture.

* Define and implement meaningful metrics to measure the effectiveness of security controls through KRIs and security scorecards.

* Serve as a subject-matter-expert for Application Security; act as a first point of contact for critical issues, security risk assessments and triaging CI/CD issues with Partners and stakeholders.

* Evaluate business and technical requirements to identify and implement tools, processes, and technologies to improve our security posture in our environments.

Use data to drive prioritization, highlight systemic issues, and influence roadmap decisions  



**What you’ll need:**

Ideal candidates will have 2-4 years of experience in a Security Engineering role with proven experience in DevSecOps, Cloud Security, and Application Security. Candidates should have strong independent critical thinking, problem-solving skills, and the ability to consistently evaluate and pivot based on the current organizational priorities.

  

**Must Have:**

* Experience using vulnerability scanning technologies, AST platforms, and cloud security tooling.

* Formal experience with threat modeling.

* Experience leading projects, initiatives, and resources through direct and indirect leadership.

* Deep knowledge of Assessing and prioritization of Risk with an ability to think like a bad actor and use that context to conduct threat models.

* Cloud experience (AWS, Azure, GCP)

title: Global Operational Innovations Senior Analyst
description:
Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

What You'll Do

BCG’s internal functions are the foundation of how our firm operates— representing thousands of professionals and hundreds of millions in investment that enable BCG to deliver exceptional client impact at global scale. As the firm continues to grow and technology changes rapidly, our internal operations face an extraordinary opportunity: to continue to evolve to an even more scalable, technology-enabled, global organization.

Our **Operational Innovations (OI)** team is at the center of this transformation. We are trusted partners to our functions and firm leadership for driving this ambitious change agenda. We enable step-change improvement in the effectiveness and efficiency of the firm by accelerating high-priority initiatives sponsored by the Operations Leadership Team and/or our Operating Committee. From technology & AI deployments to end-to-end process redesign, we partner with functional and geographic leaders to re-architect how the firm operates — faster, smarter, and more connected than ever before.

We don’t just manage change — we partner with the business to make it happen. Our team helps shape and accelerate BCG’s most strategic initiatives, providing hands-on executional leadership and deep expertise in transformation, digital enablement, and change management. We enable functions to scale effectively, improve performance, and unlock new sources of value through data, automation, and forward-thinking design.

**Key Activities and Responsibilities include:**

* In partnership with initiative owners and OI Project Managers, provide content support, research, expertise, analyses, or documentation to support project management and accelerate various functional or geographic improvement initiatives. Project emphasis to include operational improvement projects, and often the digital delivery of operational improvements, digital collaboration, and/or digital employee services.
* Support development of deliverables, ensuring highest potential for value delivery. Deliverables could include business improvement plans, process design, effective communication & engagement plans, implementation plans or supporting analyses for any of these. Expectation that analysts can distil key insights from analyses to presentation formats
* Work with line owners and OI team members to identify potential investments and/or process improvements to accelerate BCG’s digital and operational development. Assist in defining end-state processes and organizational models, as well as the path to achieve those end states.
* Work with Program Managers and Change Managers/Leads to support on the ground implementation of Change initiatives including enabling impacted users, embedding behavioral change and doing change impact analysis.
* Work with Program Managers and Change Managers/Leads translate project objectives and change needs into concrete employee communications, engagement actions and campaigns using a range of channels and media.
* Track project success and progress, working with project managers to ensure projects remain on course and objectives are realized on-time and within budget parameters, and that projects deliver against stated objectives and KPIs.
* Support development of senior management reporting and broader communications, as required, in part by providing related analyses and supporting documentation

What You'll Bring

* University degree or equivalent – ideally in a business related subject
* Experience working in a multi-national or large scale environment
* Data Analysis – strong data analysis skills, able to communicate key insights effectively
* Curiosity and focus on continuous development, learning
* Creativity and openness to new approaches, digital tools, Agile methodologies
* Project and Program Management a plus

Who You'll Work With

* The OI Leadership Team and OI team members, especially project managers and change managers
* Internal Clients / stakeholders to develop communications to deliver project and stakeholder change objectives
* External Associates – our network of BCG approved contingent resources, when appropriate

Additional info

**YOU’RE GOOD AT**

* **Organizing and managing project details with a bias for getting to great output quickly** – You are flexible and organized in your work and can be effective across a range of activities and stakeholders
* **Working in a complex environment at pace** – You are analytical and comfortable managing multiple deliverables with multiple inputs often with high impact, time sensitive requirements
* **Data Analysis** – Qualitative and quantitative evaluation of information and data to draw out insights and help shape project plans, business cases, etc.
* **Stakeholder Engagement** – You can hear what someone needs, translate it into your own words, and create it. You are politically and organizationally savvy and can navigate/influence complex matrix organizations
* **Structuring and analyzing information**. You can take an idea for organizing or analyzing data and turn it into a useful deliverable. Strong attention to detail
* **Culture and collaboration** – you care deeply about the experience and engagement of your colleagues and believe in the core tenets of BCG’s purpose statements
* **Learning and adapting** – you are an eager and consistent learner, are naturally curious, open to feedback and interested in continuous improvement

At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.

For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.

We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork.

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. title: Brand Designer II
description:
### **Design Team at Innovaccer**

Our Design Team is driven by a passion for healthcare and a commitment to making a meaningful impact in the industry. As the forefront of our external efforts, we lead with purpose and champion our organization's vision. We are dedicated to understanding our customers' needs and delivering solutions that address their challenges. If you're excited to join us as a Brand Designer and help craft our unique story, let's connect!

### **About the Role**

We are looking for a highly creative, detail-oriented Brand & UI/UX Designer who can shape brand identity and carry it into digital experiences that feel consistent and intuitive. This role combines strategic brand thinking with hands-on UI/UX design, ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of visual storytelling and user-centered design. You will collaborate with marketing, product, and engineering teams to create visually strong, intuitive, and consistent brand experiences across platforms.

### **How We Work**

Our design team works AI-first. Claude and Claude Code are part of how we research, write, prototype, and ship design work every day. We're looking for a designer who already works this way from day one. This position offers an exciting opportunity to be a brand and UI/UX designer while working in a dynamic, collaborative environment. If you are passionate about crafting compelling visual identities and designing intuitive digital experiences that resonate with users, we would love to hear from you.

### **A Day in the Life**

* **Brand Identity Development:** Create, evolve, and maintain cohesive brand guidelines including typography, color palettes, iconography, illustrations, and tone of voice.
* **Visual & UI Design:** Design brand assets such as logos, marketing visuals, social media creatives, and presentation decks, as well as intuitive, visually consistent UI components for web and product interfaces.
* **UI/UX Design Execution**: Use Figma to design user flows, wireframes, high-fidelity mockups, and interactive prototypes, ensuring strong usability and aesthetic quality.
* **AI-Assisted Design**: Use Claude to research audiences and competitors, explore concepts, write and refine copy, and pressure-test your work before review.
* **Prototyping with Claude Code:** Use Claude Code to turn designs into working HTML prototypes, landing pages, and branded documents, and to automate repetitive production work such as assetresizing, exports, and template generation.
* **Design-to-Code Workflow**: Connect Figma and our design system to Claude so designs, tokens, and code stay in sync. Build and maintain reusable Claude skills and prompts that encode our brand guidelines for the wider team.
* **Quality Assurance**: Ensure brand consistency, design accuracy, and excellent user experience across all digital channels. Review AI-generated output for brand fit, factual accuracy, and accessibility before it ships. Conduct design reviews and iterate based on feedback and usability testing.
* **Trend & Tool Awareness**: Stay current on UI/UX trends, Figma best practices, design systems, and AI design tools, and bring new approaches that keep our design practice moving forward.

### **What You Need**

* Proven experience as a Brand Designer, UI/UX Designer, or similar role with a strong multi-disciplinary portfolio.
* Proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite for UI design, prototyping, and brand asset creation.
* Hands-on proficiency with Claude (or a comparable AI assistant) for research, ideation, writing, and design critique, with the judgment to tell when AI output is ready and when it needs more work.
* Day-one working ability with Claude Code (or a comparable agentic coding tool, such as Cursor): comfortable in a terminal, able to direct Claude Code to build and iterate on HTML/CSS prototypes and small tools, and able to read the result well enough to spot and fix problems. You don't need to be an engineer, but you shouldn't be afraid of code.
* A portfolio that includes at least one project where AI tools changed how the work got done, with a short note on your process.
* Strong understanding of UI/UX design principles, including interaction design, layout, and usability.
* Ability to develop and maintain design systems to ensure consistency across products and platforms.
* Excellent problem-solving and storytelling skills with a sharp eye for detail and design.
* Familiarity with responsive design and web design best practices.
* Interest in creating scalable and cohesive visual languages.
* Experience collaborating in Agile or cross-functional environments.
* Strong communication skills to clearly present design ideas and receive feedback.
* Good to have: experience connecting Claude to Figma through MCP, or writing Claude skills for a design team.

### **Benefits**

We offer competitive benefits to set you up for success in and outside of work.  
  
**Here’s What We Offer**

* Parental Leave: Leverage one of industry's best parental leave policies to spend time with your new addition.
* Sabbatical: Want to focus on skill development, pursue an academic career, or just take a break? We've got you covered.
* Health Insurance: We offer comprehensive health insurance to support you and your family, covering medical expenses related to illness, disease, or injury. Extending support to the family members who matter most.
* Care Program: Whether it’s a celebration or a time of need, we’ve got you covered with care vouchers to mark major life events. Through our Care Vouchers program, employees receive thoughtful gestures for significant personal milestones and moments of need.
* Financial Assistance: Life happens, and when it does, we’re here to help. Our financial assistance policy offers support through salary advances and personal loans for genuine personal needs, ensuring help is there when you need it most.

We celebrate diversity, and we are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace where all employees, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, marital status, or veteran status, feel valued and empowered.

Disclaimer:

Innovaccer does not charge fees or require payment from individuals or agencies for securing employment with us. title: AI Engineer, LLM Applications
description:
We’re looking for an AI Engineer who has built and deployed applications powered by large language models (LLMs). You’ll work with product and engineering to turn business needs into working prototypes, ship them to production, and improve them based on how they perform with real users.

What you’ll do

* Build and deploy LLM-powered features such as document search, assistants, and workflow automation.

* Use AI to improve website visibility through search engine optimization (SEO), answer engine optimization (AEO), and generative engine optimization (GEO). Identify content gaps, audit site content, and build tools to improve pages and structured data.

* Track website visibility by measuring organic search impressions and clicks, and monitoring brand mentions and citations in AI-generated answers.

What you’ll bring

* Hands-on experience building, deploying, and supporting at least one LLM-powered application in production.

* Strong software engineering skills in Python or a comparable backend language, including experience building APIs, writing tests, and deploying services.

* Experience with LLM APIs or open-weight models, plus practical knowledge of prompting, structured outputs, and retrieval or tool calling.

* Experience evaluating model outputs and diagnosing failures such as unsupported answers, poor retrieval, and inconsistent responses.

* Ability to explain technical trade-offs and collaborate with technical and nontechnical teammates.

You will run delivery as a business, not a reporting function. You own the delivery P&L, the delivery operating model, and the managers who run our accounts. You collaborate with the CEO, who owns client relationships and new business, and with the CTO, who owns technology strategy, architecture standards and engineering practices.

Key responsibilities:

· Own delivery revenue, gross margin and utilization across all active engagements.

· Run monthly portfolio reviews covering health, burn, forecast, risk and margin for every account.

**Delivery operating model**

· Define and enforce one delivery framework: governance cadence, status reporting, change control, RAID management and release readiness.

· Set delivery KPIs and make them visible to leadership weekly.

· Embed AI-assisted delivery practices (planning, estimation, testing, documentation) in collaboration with the CTO.

· Standardize estimation so fixed-price bids reflect real delivery data.

· Act as the senior escalation point for delivery issues and recover at-risk programs.

· Run delivery-side steering committees and quarterly reviews with client stakeholders, alongside the CEO.

· Turn delivery performance into expansion: surface phase-2 and adjacent opportunities to the CEO.

· Join solutioning calls for large or high-risk deals.

**People and leadership**

· Lead, hire and develop delivery and project managers; build a bench of account-level leaders.

· Run performance reviews and succession planning for the delivery organization.

· Work with HR and practice heads on capacity planning, skills mix and hiring forecasts.

**Quality and compliance**

· Ensure delivery meets security and compliance obligations (GDPR, HIPAA, SOC 2 where applicable) and client audit requirements.

· Run post-mortems on failed milestones and drive the fixes into the framework.

**Must-have requirements**

· 10+ years in IT services or product engineering services, with 6+ years leading delivery across multiple concurrent client accounts.

· Has owned a delivery organization of 150+ engineers.

· Direct P&L accountability: has been measured on margin and utilization, not only on schedule.

· Has run fixed-price, time-and-materials and dedicated-team engagements and can explain where each one loses money.

· Has delivered for enterprise clients in the US, UK, Europe or Middle East, including C-level stakeholder management.

You will be tackling Machine Learning challenges in Supervised, Unsupervised, and Semi-supervised Learning; utilizing modern methods such as deep learning and classical methods from statistical learning theory, detection, estimation.
  
  
Great candidates for this position will have strong skills in the areas of machine learning, computer vision, optimization, Generative AI, or statistics. You will have hands-on experience with multiple science initiatives as well as be able to balance technical skills with business judgment to make the right decisions about technology, models and methodological choices. You will strive for simplicity, and demonstrate creativity and high judgment.
  
  
Come join us as we revolutionize the book industry and deliver an amazing experience to our Kindle authors and readers.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
In this role, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining science-based systems for optimizing manufacturing, fulfillment, and quality processes for our Print On Demand (POD) business.

Kindle Direct Publishing (KDP) and Print On Demand (POD) have empowered a new wave of self-motivated creators, tearing down barriers that once blocked writers from reaching readers. Our team builds rich applications and systems that empower anyone to realize their dream of becoming a published author. We strive to provide an experience that is powerful, yet simple to use and accessible to all. We focus on building tools that enable authors to design high quality digital and print books, reaching readers all around the world. Each Minerva scientist owns a large space and works closely with respective senior leaders across business, engineering, and operations for the science area they lead. You'll work on one of the largest enterprise systems anywhere. SAP SuccessFactors HCM powers Core HR, Time, Payroll, and Talent Management for

in the product. Very few systems run at that scale or that depth of real-world complexity. As part of the
**SAP Autonomous Suite**
, SuccessFactors is the trusted people-data and process foundation that enterprise AI runs on – and the AI agents you'll help build sit right on top of it.
  
  
Anyone can demo an AI agent. What makes SAP's different is
**accuracy and trust**
– and that is exactly the hard problem you'll lead. As a Senior Data & Applied Scientist, you'll set direction on the hardest problems, own solutions end to end, and mentor other scientists, taking ownership of the design and delivery of these agents. It's a role for people with
**deep applied-AI experience**
and a
**genuine passion for getting AI right**
where the stakes are real.
  
  
You don't necessarily need prior SAP experience – we hire for depth in applied ML and data science and the ability to evaluate and improve AI systems. The SAP-specific stack (SAP Business AI Platform) you'll pick up here, with support.
  
  
****What You'll Build****

* Design and scale AI agents and assistants – generative AI, LLMs, RAG, embeddings, vector search, tool use, memory, and multi-agent orchestration – grounded in SAP's enterprise data and process context.
* Own the evaluation and quality strategy for the agents: define what “good” means, build evaluation datasets, and measure accuracy, reliability, and decision quality in production.
* Apply machine learning, statistical modeling, and calibration so the agents' recommendations, risk scores, and rankings are trustworthy and measurable, not guessed. In plain terms: turn the agents' guessed scores and cut-offs into ones learned from real outcomes and proven right.
* Lead experimentation and continuous improvement (prompt engineering, RAG tuning, model selection) and hold the quality bar for releases.
* Work across the SAP Business AI Platform (AI Core, Generative AI Hub, HANA Cloud) and modern data / AI platforms (Databricks, MLflow, cloud) with LLM frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel).
* Collaborate with product, engineering, and HR domain experts, and mentor junior scientists.
* Close the learning loop: use production signals, feedback, and agent memory to find what the agent gets wrong and improve it over time.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
* 5-10 years delivering ML and generative-AI solutions in production, including senior or lead scope.
* Deep expertise in generative and agentic AI: RAG, embeddings, vector databases, orchestration, memory, and tool use.
* Strong Python with ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face) and LLM frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel).

* Ability to define strategy and metrics where none exist, influence across teams, and mentor; clear, collaborative communication.

We foster a culture of collaboration, learning, and growth in a diverse, international environment.

**SAP Autonomous Suite**
, SuccessFactors is the trusted people-data and process foundation that enterprise AI runs on – and the AI agents you'll help build sit right on top of it.

**accuracy and trust**
– and that is exactly the hard problem you'll lead. As a Senior Data & Applied Scientist, you'll set direction on the hardest problems, own solutions end to end, and mentor other scientists, taking ownership of the design and delivery of these agents. It's a role for people with
**deep applied-AI experience**
and a
**genuine passion for getting AI right**
where the stakes are real.

description: Experience: 5+ Years Work Mode: On-site Location: Bangalore Job Summary We are looking for an experienced Senior Data Scientist to develop and own end-to-end Machine Learning solutions that drive commercial business decisions across forecasting, optimization, and simulation. title: Data Scientist
description:
Accellor is an AI-native services firm focused on delivering measurable business outcomes through advanced AI, data, and engineering capabilities. We help global innovators and Fortune 100 enterprises modernize their architectures, scale operations, and operationalize intelligence across the enterprise.
  
  
Our core focus centers on transforming advanced AI from proofs-of-concept into production-grade systems. Spanning AI solutions, robust data services, enterprise applications, and product engineering — we tailor our offerings to the distinct operational needs of industries such as healthcare, life sciences, telecom, retail, financial services, and technology.
  
  
Operating as an extension of our clients' teams, we combine design thinking with technology-agnostic architectures to ensure faster time-to-value and seamless system interoperability. From initial strategy to full-scale deployment, we build intelligent, connected ecosystems that drive sustained enterprise value and redefine the future of transformation.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are hiring a hands-on Data Scientist with 4–6 years of experience building and shipping classical machine-learning models on enterprise business data. The role sits in a central AI team at an enterprise client that serves the whole business, so the problems change with demand: sales, marketing, pricing, operations, procurement, HR, finance.
  
  
The core of the role is classical, hands-on data science: supervised learning - classification, regression, forecasting - on structured, tabular data, taken from business question to validated model to production handover. Generative-AI and LLM skills are welcome on top of that foundation, as the team applies both where each fit.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Pick up problems from any function as the business needs them and frame them as supervised-learning tasks — e.g. deal win/loss and churn classification, price and margin prediction, demand and revenue forecasting, lead scoring and customer segmentation for marketing, supplier risk and spend classification in procurement, attrition prediction in HR, anomaly detection in operations.
* Build, tune and validate models end to end: feature engineering, model selection, cross-validation, hyperparameter tuning, calibration and error analysis.
* Work with structured enterprise data from CRM, ERP, product master and finance systems — profiling, cleaning, joining and resolving data-quality gaps before modelling.
* Run exploratory analysis and statistical tests (hypothesis testing, A/B analysis, causal reasoning) to back recommendations with evidence.
* Explain model behaviour to business stakeholders using interpretability techniques (SHAP, feature importance, partial dependence) and plain-language insight.
* Package models for production with engineering teams: reproducible pipelines, versioned artefacts, batch or API scoring, monitoring for drift and performance decay.
* Define and track success metrics (precision/recall, AUC, MAPE, lift, uplift) and the business KPIs they map to.
* Document approach, assumptions and results; present findings to leadership.

**Required Skills And Experience**

* 4–6 years as a data scientist or ML practitioner, with a few models delivered into production use.
* Strong grounding in classical ML: logistic regression, tree ensembles (random forest, XGBoost / LightGBM / CatBoost), linear and regularised regression, SVMs, clustering, and time-series forecasting (ARIMA, Prophet, gradient-boosted forecasting).
* Solid statistics: probability, distributions, hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, bias/variance, handling class imbalance and leakage.
* Expert Python for data science — pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, statsmodels — and strong SQL on large relational or lakehouse datasets.
* Experience with at least one enterprise data platform: Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake or similar, including Spark / PySpark for large data.
* Feature engineering on messy, real-world business data; comfortable with missing values, categorical encoding, time-based features and entity resolution.
* MLOps basics: experiment tracking (MLflow), model versioning, pipeline scheduling, and monitoring in production.
* Ability to translate a business question into a modelling plan and the result back into a decision — strong stakeholder and communication skills.
* Degree in a quantitative field (statistics, mathematics, computer science, engineering, economics or similar).
* Experience with deep learning and neural networks (PyTorch or TensorFlow / Keras) — MLPs on tabular data, sequence models for time series, or embeddings — and judgement on when they beat classical methods.
* Working knowledge of LLMs, generative AI or agent frameworks, applied alongside classical models — a strong plus. Hands-on with one or more of Microsoft Agent Framework (MAF), LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI or Semantic Kernel.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience modelling sales operations, pricing, quoting or supply-chain data.
* Pricing, margin or revenue modelling: price elasticity, win-probability curves, discount optimisation, deal-impact analysis.
* Exposure to one business function such as HR, operations or procurement, with examples of models that changed a decision there.
* Experience with Salesforce data (opportunities, quotes, accounts) as a modelling source.
* Familiarity with causal inference or uplift modelling.
* Azure data and ML stack (Azure ML, Fabric, Databricks on Azure)

**Benefits**
**Exciting Projects:**
We focus on industries like High-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.
**Collaborative Environment:**
You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centres.
  
  
**Work-Life Balance:**
Accellor prioritizes work-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
Our dedicated Learning & Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training, Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.
  
  
**Excellent Benefits:**
We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Personal Accident Insurance, Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.
  
  
**Disclaimer: -**
Accellor is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic

title: Lead Data Scientist – Research & Rapid Prototyping
description:

Lead Data Scientist - Research & Rapid Prototyping
  
  
**Experience Level:**
5-8 Years
