Hybrid - 3 Days per Week from Office
  
  
**Role Description**
We are looking for a Lead Data Scientist to drive research, experimentation, and rapid prototyping within the Research & Rapid Prototyping team at Consilio.
  
  
The role involves applying Large Language Models (LLMs), Machine Learning, and advanced Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques to enterprise and legal documents, including emails and PDFs.
  
  
The candidate will own research initiatives end to end, translating ambiguous business problems into research objectives, developing prototypes, defining model evaluation methodologies, and driving promising solutions towards production.
  
  
This is a senior individual contributor role requiring strong technical ownership, research capabilities, and the ability to mentor and guide other data scientists without formal people management responsibilities.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end research initiatives, from problem identification and scoping to experimentation, prototype development, and engineering handover.
* Design, implement, fine-tune, and deploy locally hosted and open-weight Large Language Models (LLMs) for legal document processing and analysis.
* Establish model evaluation frameworks, benchmarks, and methodologies to measure accuracy, reliability, and performance for legal-specific use cases.
* Build rapid prototypes to demonstrate practical applications of emerging AI, LLM, and NLP technologies.
* Mentor data scientists through experimental design reviews, code reviews, technical guidance, and knowledge sharing.
* Evaluate emerging AI models, tools, and technologies and recommend appropriate build, buy, or adoption strategies.
* Apply statistical analysis, Machine Learning, and traditional NLP techniques to extract insights from enterprise and legal documents.
* Collaborate with engineering, product, and business stakeholders to translate research outcomes into scalable solutions.
* Communicate research findings, technical limitations, and trade-offs to leadership and influence product and technology decisions.
* Explore multi-modal AI and Knowledge Graph technologies to enhance document intelligence capabilities.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5-8 years of experience in Applied Data Science, Machine Learning, or AI/ML engineering, with strong expertise in modern NLP.
* Hands-on experience with Large Language Models (LLMs), particularly locally hosted and open-weight models.
* Strong programming and modelling experience using Python, PyTorch, and Hugging Face Transformers.
* Experience with LLM fine-tuning techniques such as PEFT and LoRA.
* Hands-on experience with LLM serving and inference frameworks such as vLLM.
* Experience with agentic AI and workflow orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph or equivalent.
* Strong understanding of embedding models, vector databases, and retrieval technologies such as pgvector.
* Experience with traditional NLP and Machine Learning libraries such as spaCy and scikit-learn.
* Knowledge of experiment tracking and model development tools such as DVC or equivalent.
* Working knowledge of Docker, Git, containerisation, and deployment infrastructure.
* Experience taking research initiatives or AI/ML prototypes towards production or demonstrated research contributions through publications, patents, or recognised technical work.
* Demonstrated experience mentoring or guiding other data scientists or technical practitioners.
* Ability to independently define research problems, drive experimentation, and make technical decisions with minimal supervision.

**Education & Soft Skills**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline.

title: Product Specialist NatCat
description:
**About The Role**
As a NatCat Specialist within Swiss Re's Risk Data Solutions (RDS) Integrated CoE, you will combine strong NatCat expertise with analytical thinking, product innovation and stakeholder management, working across scientific, product and sales teams to develop and deliver commercially relevant NatCat solutions that make a tangible difference for clients.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead as a subject matter expert within RDS providing technical leadership across natural hazard and catastrophe risk assessment topics.
* Drive the development, enhancement and validation of NatCat solutions, including hazard layers, risk scores, portfolio analytics, and live post event-based assessments.
* Evaluate internal and external NatCat models, datasets and technologies, including buy-versus-build assessments to inform strategic decisions.
* Collaborate with Product Managers and cross-functional teams to translate scientific capabilities and client needs into scalable, commercially impactful solutions.
* Support client engagements, RFPs, workshops and commercialization of NatCat products and analytics.
* Coordinate NatCat initiatives across various Swiss Re units and collaborate with external vendors, research organizations and academic partners.
* Incubate innovative concepts and proof-of-concepts leveraging catastrophe models, geospatial analytics, remote sensing, machine learning, AI and emerging data sources.
* Champion knowledge sharing and mentorship, demonstrate a team-first mindset, and promote cross-functional collaboration to enable collective success across the division and organization.

**About The Team**
The Integrated Center of Expertise (CoE) within Swiss Re’s Risk Data Solutions (RDS) division combines expertise in natural catastrophe and weather risk, catastrophe modeling, geospatial analytics, data science, and analytics. While organizationally positioned within the Products vertical, the CoE supports both Products and Risk Consulting & Analytics, contributing to risk solution development and providing specialized analytical expertise for client consulting engagements, including risk assessments, advanced modeling, and bespoke solutions. Through a unified operating model, the CoE fosters cross-functional collaboration, knowledge sharing, and efficient resource utilization, strengthening the RDS value proposition and supporting client engagement and business growth.
  
  
**About You**
You are a highly collaborative and intellectually curious professional who brings together sound natural catastrophe expertise with a genuine passion for innovation, problem solving and creating value for clients. Your technical expertise, combined with strong communication skills, enables you to convey complex technical concepts to diverse audiences, helping to build meaningful solutions that deliver real impact to clients
  
  
**We Are Looking For Candidates Who Meet These Requirements**

* Advanced degree in Meteorology, Climate Science, Geoscience, Hydrology, Hazard assessment, Statistics, Engineering or in a very closely related discipline
* 5+ years of relevant experience in catastrophe modeling and / or model development, natural hazard analytics or risk assessment, preferably in insurance/reinsurance related industry.
* Strong understanding of catastrophe modelling, hazard, vulnerability and exposure data, loss assessment, and portfolio risk analytics.
* Proven experience in developing analytical products, solutions, or client-facing risk applications.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication and stakeholder-management skills, with demonstrated experience working across multidisciplinary and global teams.
* Programming experience, particularly in Python or similar languages.

**These Are Additional Nice To Haves**

* Experience with catastrophe modelling platforms, industry models and NatCat datasets including Swiss Re’s proprietary NatCat modelling framework.
* Knowledge of GIS, remote sensing, spatial analytics, and geospatial data processing.
* Understanding climate risk and climate adaptation applications.
* Experience with client engagements, RFPs, business cases, and commercialization of analytical solutions.
* Experience applying machine learning, AI or advanced analytics to natural hazard and risk problems.

Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week.
  
  
**About Swiss Re**
Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.
  
  
Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.
  
  
If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.
  
  
We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. title: Sr Data Scientist
description:
**Job Description Summary**
As a Senior Data Scientist at GE Vernova, you will lead cross disciplinary teams (comprising statisticians, software developers, engineers, and product managers) to design, develop, and deploy scalable analytics and AI solutions. You will tackle complex industrial challenges, such as remote monitoring and diagnostics across infrastructure sectors, financial portfolio risk, and operations optimization, owning the end-to-end journey from problem framing to production deployment, MLOps, and enterprise integration.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Key Responsibilities**

* End-to-End Solution Leadership: Drive the design, development, and deployment of applied predictive and prescriptive analytics solutions, translating customer needs into scalable commercial products.
* Advanced AI & GenAI Development: Build AI-enabled solutions, including Large Language Models (LLMs), RAG systems, and agentic workflows that deliver measurable business value.
* MLOps, DevOps & Services Integration: Own analytic prototyping, model scale-up, and seamless integration into production environments, ensuring robust CI/CD pipelines and software engineering best practices.
* Data Quality & Pipelines: Partner with data engineers to define data quality standards, lead data assessment, cleansing, and build robust analytics pipelines.
* Cross-functional Collaboration & Mentorship: Mentor junior data scientists, guide technical execution, and present findings and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders, including senior leadership.

**Education & Experience Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a STEM field with a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience. A Master’s or PhD in a quantitative field is preferred.

**Core Technical Competencies**
**1. DevOps, MLOps & Services Integration**

* MLOps & LLMOps: Experience implementing model versioning, CI/CD for ML, automated drift detection, model monitoring, and retraining pipelines (e.g., MLflow, Kubeflow).
* DevOps & Containerization: Working knowledge of containerization, orchestration, and software engineering principles (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).
* Services Integration: Experience translating complex algorithms into commercially viable APIs, microservices, and integrated production services; familiarity with tool/function calling and interoperability standards.

**2. Core Analytics & Machine Learning**

* Programming & SQL: Advanced proficiency in analytic languages (Python, R) and strong SQL skills for data manipulation and feature extraction.

* GenAI Fundamentals: Practical experience with LLMs, prompt engineering, fine-tuning, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and vector databases.
* Agentic Workflows: Experience with agent frameworks and orchestration libraries (e.g., LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI) to build multi-step, tool using AI systems.

**4. Cloud, Big Data & Edge**

* Cloud Platforms: Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and its native machine learning services.
* Big Data & Edge: Experience with distributed data processing tools (e.g., Spark, Databricks, Snowflake) and exposure to deploying low-latency analytics on edge devices.

**Professional & Leadership Attributes**

* Structured Problem-Solving: Strong critical thinking skills with the ability to turn ambiguous business challenges into structured technical frameworks.
* Communication: Excellent presentation and storytelling skills, capable of communicating complex technical concepts clearly to diverse audiences.
* Teamwork: Collaborative mindset with a proven ability to lead technical work and drive business impact across diverse, multidisciplinary teams.

title: Product Data Scientist
description:
**Company Overview**
Docusign brings agreements to life. More than 1.8 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using the Docusign AI-native IAM platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).
  
  
What you'll do
  
  
Docusign's Product Data Science team is looking for a Data Scientist to support the development of key data products and capabilities to enable data-driven product development and decision making. In this role, you would be part of the Product Data Science team and work directly in partnership with a variety of stakeholders including but not limited to Product, Engineering and User Experience partners to support and empower them with data-driven actionable insights. You will be embedded in specific product spaces requiring you to establish and grow relationships. As a Data Scientist, you’ll dig into the data to uncover insights, identify opportunities for product improvements and new product development, define product metrics with goals, design experiments and develop data science models to drive customer experience, engagement, and adoption of Docusign’s products. If you are an experienced data scientist passionate about data-driven product development and building products and capabilities that enable a culture of “test and learn,” then this could be a great role for you.
  
  
This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the Director of Product Data Science.
  
  
**Responsibility**

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to research, build and improve data analysis to identify opportunities for product improvements, new product features, product utilization, and improve customer experience, engagement, and retention
* Be the subject matter expert for driving the product data strategy for the areas you support
* Partner closely with the product managers, user researchers, engineers, and leadership to capture and prioritize potential insights, analysis, and data product opportunities that will drive maximum business impact
* Specify and help implement product telemetry, define key performance indicators with goals, and own and manage regular reports to create insights around product usage and success
* Partner with Global Data Analytics team to automate data pipelines to snowflake from different source systems
* Design and build automated dashboards that connect data from internal and external data sources, with visualizations and tools that allow business users to self-serve on their website data needs
* Partner with Product teams to design, administer, and analyze the results of A/B and multivariate tests and other ML models
* Leverage data to develop actionable analytical insights and present findings to senior management
* Evangelize models, frameworks, analysis, and insights with stakeholders and business partners
* Act with a sense of urgency and purpose, identify and resolve roadblocks, reach out to cross-functional team members to solicit input and/or assist when appropriate

Job Designation
  
  
**Hybrid:**
Employee divides their time between in-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in-office expectation)
  
  
Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.
  
  
What you bring
  
  
**Basic**

* BA/BS degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Statistics, Math, Computer Science, Economics, Finance) or equivalent practical experience
* 4+ years of experience in product analytics or data science within a SaaS/Cloud environment
* Proficiency with SQL and scripting languages (Python or R) for data manipulation, analysis, and ETL processes
* Hands-on experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, HEX) to create self-service dashboards and report insights
* Experience applying rigorous statistical methods and analytical techniques to solve business problems
* Experience designing, launching, and evaluating A/B and multivariate tests
* Track record of collaborating with technical teams (Engineering, Telemetry) and translating complex data into actionable insights for stakeholders

**Preferred**

* Strong leadership and cross-functional communication skills, with the ability to lead through influence across organizational lines
* Experience with advanced data analytics methodologies, including cohort analysis, user segmentation, and machine learning models
* Experience analyzing product usage or building telemetry for Generative AI and LLM-based products
* Familiarity with cloud data platforms (e.g., Snowflake) and modern transformation tools (e.g., dbt)
* Highly organized self-starter who thrives in a dynamic, fast-paced environment

Life at Docusign

title: Data and Applied Scientist
description:
**Job Description**
You'll work on one of the largest enterprise systems anywhere. SAP SuccessFactors HCM supports Core HR, Time, Payroll, and Talent Management for over 10,000 organizations. It serves 280 million users in more than 200 countries and territories. The product is available in 104 countries and territories and in 46 languages. It operates in over 20 global data-center regions. Additionally, it includes more than 40 embedded AI models. Very few systems run at that scale or that depth of real-world complexity. As part of the
**SAP Autonomous Suite**
, SuccessFactors is the trusted people-data and process foundation that enterprise AI runs on – and the AI agents you'll help build sit right on top of it.
  
  
Anyone can demo an AI agent. What makes SAP's different is
**accuracy and trust**
– and that is exactly the hard, interesting part you'll work on. As a Data & Applied Scientist, you'll own solutions and do hands-on work on hard problems from day one, designing and delivering these agents alongside senior scientists. It's a role for people ready to
**take ownership**
and
**genuinely passionate about applied AI**
.
  
  
You don't necessarily need prior SAP experience – we hire for depth in applied ML and data science and the ability to evaluate and improve AI systems. The SAP-specific stack (SAP Business AI Platform) you'll pick up here, with support.
  
  
**What You'll Build**

* Build and improve AI agents and assistants using generative AI, LLMs, RAG, embeddings, vector search, tool use, and enterprise knowledge grounding.
* Design and run evaluation for agent quality: build evaluation datasets and measure accuracy, reliability, and decision quality.
* Apply ML, statistical modeling, and calibration so the agents' recommendations, risk scores, and rankings are trustworthy and measurable. In plain terms: turn the agents' guessed scores and cut-offs into ones learned from real outcomes and proven right.
* Run experiments to improve agents (prompt engineering, RAG tuning, model selection) and prove that changes help.
* Work with the SAP Business AI Platform and modern data / AI platforms (Databricks, MLflow) and LLM frameworks.
* Collaborate with product, engineering, and HR domain experts.
* Close the learning loop: use production signals, feedback, and agent memory to find what the agent gets wrong and improve it over time.

Prepare, clean, annotate, and engineer high-quality training and evaluation datasets. Train, fine-tune, and optimize models. This includes classical machine learning, deep learning, and foundation models or large language models. Ensure these models perform well, are scalable, and are robust.
  
  

* Apply responsible AI – fairness, data privacy (PII / GDPR), and monitoring – so agents that touch pay and personal data stay compliant.

**What You'll Bring**
**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science,Engineering, or a related field.
* 3-5 years delivering ML and / or generative-AI solutions, ideally in production.
* Strong Python (and SQL) with ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face, scikit-learn).
* Hands-on with GenAI: RAG, embeddings, vector databases, prompt engineering, and LLM evaluation.
* Experience evaluating and improving AI or agent quality(evaluation design, metrics, error analysis, calibration).
* Ability to work independently on a defined problem; clear, collaborative communication.
* Awareness of responsible AI, data privacy, and compliance(PII / GDPR), and of feature engineering and model-evaluation fundamentals.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Hands-on experience with the SAP Business AI Platform(SAP AI Core, Generative AI Hub, SAP HANA Cloud) and platforms such as Databricks, SAP Datasphere, or a major cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Exposure to HR, payroll, or compensation domains, or to enterprise software ecosystems (SAP, Workday, ServiceNow, Salesforce).
* Familiarity with knowledge graphs, semantic models, or ontologies (W3C stack: OWL, RDF / RDFS, SHACL; or property-graph languages such as Cypher, GQL, SPARQL).

You should know about MLOps and LLMOps practices. It is also important to have knowledge of agent-evaluation techniques. This includes LLM-as-judge, experimentation, and both offline and online evaluation.
  
  

* Comfort using AI-assisted development tools and LLM frameworks to prototype and ship faster.

**Where you belong**
You'll join the SAP SuccessFactors Core HR and Payroll agents team, building AI agents and assistants that managers and HR teams rely on every day, at global scale, for high-stakes work – pay, fairness, workforce changes, and employee data. The problems are real, and so is the ownership: you'll see your work run in production, stretch into new domains, and build foundations others will stand on. We foster a culture of collaboration, learning, and growth in a diverse, international environment.

Our team is a fundamental part of Goldman Sachs' (GS) Prime Brokerage business, one of the key revenue streams within the Global Banking & Markets division. We drive major business decisions and client franchise strategy through insightful analytics and data-driven recommendations. In this entrepreneurial role, we balance our time between building scalable platforms that democratize data and running complex ad-hoc analyses for the desk, management and clients. Our team has a direct impact on key revenue streams for the group.
  
  
**Your Impact**
If you are looking for a commercially impactful position that allows you to leverage your strong quantitative, analytical, programming and communication skills, then our team is the ideal opportunity for you. You will build data analytics systems, platforms and models, and use them to identify and execute new opportunities while working closely with Sales, Trading, Senior Management and clients. You will strengthen existing partnerships and build new ones with colleagues across diverse functions in the firm, frequently serving as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in client discussions to deliver sophisticated analytical insights. You will enjoy a role that rewards multi-tasking, initiative, adaptability and strong execution.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**RESPONSIBILITIES AND QUALIFICATIONS**
As a member of this team, you will develop analytics and platforms to track market and hedge fund trends, conduct deep-dive analyses across client portfolios, and research and implement Equity and FICC factor models and macroeconomic models. You will also build factor risk analytics that help the business risk management to understand, measure and monitor its factor risk exposures. Additionally, as a client-facing SME, you will communicate complex quantitative strategies and technical analytics clearly and confidently to key stakeholders.
  
  
**Who We Look For**
Goldman Sachs Engineers are innovators and problem-solvers, building solutions in risk management, portfolio analytics, big data and more. We look for creative collaborators who evolve, adapt to change, leverage modern productivity tools, and thrive in a dynamic global environment.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's, Master's or PhD in a relevant field, such as Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Physics or Finance
* Minimum of 3 years of professional experience in a quantitative, analytical or financial technology role
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present detailed analyses directly to clients as an SME
* Strong programming skills in Python or an equivalent language
* Working knowledge of AI tools to optimize research, automate workflows or accelerate software development
* Ability to work as part of a global team and deliver results on time
* Comfortable managing multiple projects, taking initiative and demonstrating commercial impact

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Strong knowledge of portfolio construction techniques, risk models, factor analytics, and positioning and flows metrics
* Working knowledge of Equity and FICC asset classes
* Hands-on experience handling large datasets

The Oracle DBA will be responsible for end‑to‑end administration of on‑premises and cloud‑hosted Oracle databases. This includes designing, implementing, and maintaining business‑critical environments on OCI & On premise Databases. The role requires strong technical expertise in high‑availability architecture, performance tuning, backup & recovery, and cloud migrations.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Core Oracle Database Administration**

* Install, configure, and upgrade Oracle Database (12c | 19c | 21c| 26ai).
* Perform day‑to‑day DB monitoring, health checks, space management, and tuning.
* Manage database objects, privileges, auditing, and security policies.
* Implement and manage RMAN-based backups, restores, and disaster recovery.

**2. Oracle RAC Administration**

* Install, configure, and administer Oracle RAC multi-node clusters.
* Manage and troubleshoot Oracle Grid Infrastructure and ASM.
* Analyze and resolve RAC-specific issues (node evictions, interconnect latency, cache fusion performance).
* Optimize cluster performance, scalability, and load balancing.

**3. Oracle Data Guard / DR Administration**

* Set up and maintain Data Guard: Physical & Logical Standby.
* Monitor redo transport, apply lag, and synchronization.
* Perform switchovers, failovers, and disaster recovery simulations.
* Automate Data Guard monitoring and alerting.

* Provision and administer OCI Database Services:
* Autonomous Database (ATP/ADW)

* VCN, Subnets, Load Balancers
* IAM policies
* Object Storage (backups, snapshots)
* Migrate databases using:
* Data Pump
* RMAN
* GoldenGate
* Zero-Downtime Migration (ZDM)

**5. Performance Tuning**

* Use AWR, ASH, ADDM, OEM, and SQL Tuning Advisor.
* Tune SQL queries, indexes, memory structures, and storage performance.
* Optimize application‑DB interactions in conjunction with developers.

**6. Automation & Scripting**

* Automate DB tasks using Shell, Python, Ansible, or OCI CLI.

**7. Security, Compliance & Governance**

* Implement auditing and DB security standards.
* Ensure compliance with internal security policies and regulatory frameworks.
* Patch management and vulnerability remediation for on‑prem and OCI.

**8. Monitoring & Support**

* Configure OEM Cloud Control, OCI Monitoring, or third‑party tools.
* Troubleshoot RAC, Data Guard, OCI, network, and storage issues.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* 7–12+ years of Oracle DBA experience in production environments.
* Strong hands‑on expertise in:

* Oracle Data Guard

* Proficient in SQL, PL/SQL, Linux/Unix.

**Soft Skills**

* Excellent communication skills.
* Strong documentation and planning skills.

title: Information Security Audit Analyst
description:
**Information Security Audit Analyst**
======================================

**1.1 Overview**
================

DNEG’s expanding global Information Security program requires an audit-experienced Information Security Audit Analyst to support the delivery of the Information Security internal audit program across DNEG Group.

The Information Security Audit Analyst forms part of the Security Audit & Assurance function within the Global CISO Office and reports to the Information Security Audit Lead.

Working under the direction and review of the Information Security Audit Lead, the role will support audits across three primary areas:

* Internal audits supporting applicable ISO certification and assurance requirements.
* Physical and site security audits against the DNEG Unified Security Control Framework, including applicable mappings to ISO, TPN, and other relevant security requirements.
* Technical security audits of business-critical systems, applications, platforms, infrastructure, and supporting technology environments.

The Analyst combines practical audit skills with AI-enabled workflow improvement to deliver reliable evidence reviews, control-test results, documentation, and timely audit coordination and follow-up.

Work follows the scopes, procedures, and priorities set by the Lead.

The role requires practical audit experience and working Information Security knowledge. The Analyst will examine evidence, document test results, identify potential control gaps, and prepare observations for review.

Audit strategy, program ownership, final audit conclusions, report approval, and findings-closure decisions remain with the Lead.

The Analyst will collaborate with the Global CISO Office and business, technology, engineering, facilities, and control owners while maintaining objectivity, confidentiality, and the independence of the Security Audit & Assurance function.

Remediation ownership remains with the relevant control owners.

**1.2 Mandatory Requirements and Expectations**
===============================================

An audit-experienced professional who works methodically, objectively, and accurately is required to support the DNEG Group Information Security internal audit program under the direction of the Lead.

* Typically requires 3+ years of progressive experience in Information Security, IT Audit, or Technology Risk Assurance (or equivalent combination of education and experience).
* Demonstrable practical experience contributing to Information Security, technology, or cybersecurity audits, including evidence review, control testing, and audit documentation.
* Experience supporting audit fieldwork and follow-up, completing assigned procedures, and maintaining traceable working papers for review.
* Working knowledge of audit methodologies and the principles of independence, objectivity, evidence-based assessment, sampling, control testing, documentation, and reporting.
* Working knowledge of ISO 27001 requirements and controls, with the ability to support internal audits against defined criteria and learn other applicable standards, including ISO 42001.
* Ability to support physical or site security assessments against established security standards and control frameworks, using agreed checklists and evidence requirements.
* Working Information Security knowledge sufficient to review evidence and support control testing across relevant systems, applications, infrastructure, cloud, networks, and identity and access environments.
* Ability to recognize potential control weaknesses, distinguish evidence gaps from confirmed test exceptions, and escalate observations with supporting evidence for the Lead’s review.
* Strong analytical, organizational, documentation, and communication skills, with careful attention to evidence accuracy and completeness.
* Ability to describe test procedures, results, evidence gaps, and draft observations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to complete assigned work with appropriate initiative, seek guidance when needed, and collaborate effectively with the Lead and relevant control owners.
* Ability to coordinate multiple assigned audit tasks, evidence requests, dependencies, and due dates, escalating delays and competing priorities promptly.
* Commitment to consistent audit quality, evidence integrity, confidentiality, and continuous improvement.
* Ability to identify opportunities and design, prototype, and adopt AI-assisted workflows and automation that improve audit efficiency, using approved tools, appropriate data safeguards, and human validation.

**2. Duties and Operational Responsibilities**
==============================================

* Assist the Lead with external audits, TPN studio appraisals, and major client security assessments by coordinating evidence requests and walkthrough meetings with technical control owners.
* Strictly adhere to DNEG Information Security and Client Content Protection policies when prototyping AI-assisted tools, ensuring no client or confidential data is processed outside approved enterprise environments.
* Support delivery of the Lead’s risk-based audit plan by maintaining assigned schedules, evidence-request lists, fieldwork trackers, and audit records using the approved methodology.
* Coordinate evidence requests and audit meetings with control owners, track responses and dependencies, and escalate missing information or delays to the Lead.
* Support ISO 27001 and ISO 42001 internal audit activities by gathering evidence, mapping it to agreed criteria, and completing assigned procedures under the Lead’s direction.
* Support physical and site security audits against the DNEG Unified Security Control Framework, including applicable ISO, TPN, SOC, and other security requirements, using agreed checklists and evidence requests.
* Support technical security audits of business-critical systems, applications, platforms, infrastructure, cloud environments, and supporting services within the scope and access authorized by the Lead.
* Collect and review evidence proportionate to the agreed audit scope and risk, checking relevance, completeness, consistency, and traceability. Complete assigned sampling and control tests using approved procedures and document the results.
* Identify evidence gaps, test exceptions, and potential control weaknesses; clarify factual questions with control owners and escalate issues for the Lead’s assessment and conclusions.
* Prepare clear working papers and draft observations recording the audit criteria, evidence reviewed, testing performed, and results. Incorporate review feedback and support report preparation without issuing final conclusions.
* Maintain the findings and remediation tracker, follow up with control owners on agreed actions and due dates, and collect remediation evidence. Perform assigned retesting for review; the Lead approves findings closure and control owners retain remediation ownership.
* Prepare factual progress summaries and identify recurring observations or overdue actions for the Lead’s review and reporting to relevant stakeholders.
* Maintain objectivity and confidentiality while coordinating with GRC, Architecture & Engineering, Security Operations, ISPM, Data Protection & Privacy, technology teams, Facilities, business stakeholders, and control owners.
* Maintain orderly, access-controlled audit files and evidence records in accordance with approved handling and retention requirements, and keep relevant audit and security knowledge current.
* Identify opportunities to streamline audit coordination, evidence handling, analysis, and reporting; design and prototype proposed AI-assisted workflows and automation using approved tools and data safeguards, and adopt them after the Lead’s approval.
* Evaluate workflow improvements for efficiency and audit quality, validate outputs before use, and document reusable approaches while preserving evidence integrity and human judgment.

**3.1 Mandatory Job Requirements**
==================================

A successful candidate will demonstrate practical audit experience and competency in the following areas:

* Relevant professional 3+ years experience in Information Security audit, technology audit, cybersecurity audit, security assurance, or closely related work involving audit evidence and control testing.
* Practical experience contributing to Information Security or technology audit engagements as part of an audit or assurance team.
* Familiarity with media production environments, including secure remote workstation tech (e.g.PCoIP) and MPA/TPN Content Security Best Practices.
* Ability to complete assigned audit tasks under an established plan and methodology, respond to review feedback, and recognize when further guidance or escalation is required.
* Experience using defined audit scopes, testing procedures, sampling instructions, working-paper templates, evidence registers, and findings trackers.
* Practical experience using enterprise GRC systems (e.g., JIRA/Confluence) and identity/cloud platforms (e.g., Entra ID/Okta, AWS, Azure).
* Working knowledge of control design and operating-effectiveness testing, objective evidence, audit sampling, documentation, draft findings, and remediation follow-up.
* Working knowledge of ISO 27001 requirements and controls and practical experience supporting audits or assessments against a recognized security framework.
* Ability to map evidence to audit criteria and maintain an accurate record of evidence sources, test steps, results, and outstanding questions.
* Ability to support site-based security reviews and coordinate with Facilities and other control owners using agreed procedures.
* Working technical knowledge of relevant Information Security controls, with experience in one or more of the following domains and the ability to develop broader knowledge:

  + Identity and Access Management and privileged access.
  + Network and infrastructure security.
  + Cloud security.
  + Application and product security.
  + Vulnerability and exposure management.
  + Security monitoring and logging.
  + Security operations and incident-response controls.
  + Endpoint and platform security.
  + Data security and protection controls.
  + Secure configuration and change management.
  + Software development and supporting technology processes.
* Ability to understand the technology and process being tested, review technical evidence, ask clear factual questions, and document potential issues for the Lead’s review.
* Practical experience supporting the testing of Information Security control design or operating effectiveness and documenting the results.
* Ability to identify potential control deficiencies and describe the evidence and possible security or business impact without overstating the conclusion.
* Strong written communication skills and experience preparing accurate audit working papers, draft observations, and progress summaries for review.
* Professional stakeholder communication skills, including the ability to request evidence, follow up constructively, and escalate unresolved issues appropriately.
* Ability to organize multiple assigned audit tasks and deliver accurate work against agreed schedules.
* Ability to collaborate with distributed technology and business teams and handle sensitive evidence appropriately.
* Ability to translate audit needs into AI-assisted workflows and automation using approved no-code, low-code, audit, or workflow tools, with human validation of outputs. Software development expertise is not required.
* A continuous-improvement mindset, with the ability to suggest more efficient ways of completing audit tasks without compromising quality or professional standards.

**3.2 Desired Job Requirements**
================================

A successful candidate may also have experience with the following:

* Experience supporting audits across multiple countries, business units, or geographically distributed locations.
* Experience in film, visual effects, media, entertainment, technology, or other environments handling highly confidential intellectual property and client information.
* Working knowledge of the Trusted Partner Network (TPN) or comparable content-security requirements.
* Experience working with common control frameworks that map organizational controls across multiple standards or customer assurance requirements.
* Experience supporting audits or control assessments of cloud-native or hybrid technology environments.
* Experience reviewing evidence for business-critical applications, internally developed systems, SaaS platforms, production technology, or supporting services.
* Experience using GRC, audit-management, data-analysis, automation, or evidence-management platforms to support audit execution.
* Experience using scripting, queries, APIs, or data-analysis techniques to analyze evidence and support assigned control tests.
* Experience designing, prototyping, or implementing approved AI-assisted workflows or automation that improve audit coordination, evidence handling, analysis, or reporting, with safeguards for sensitive data and human validation.
* Knowledge of ISO 42001, SOC 2, NIST, CIS Controls, CSA CCM, or other security and assurance frameworks relevant to DNEG’s audit scope.
* Experience supporting physical or site security audits, remediation retesting, or the preparation of audit progress and findings summaries.

**3.3 Education**
=================

* A bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Accounting, Audit, or a related discipline is desirable but not essential where equivalent practical experience can be demonstrated.
* Recognized audit training or qualifications, including ISO/IEC 27001 or ISO/IEC 42001 auditor qualifications, are desirable. Lead Auditor certification is not required for this support role.
* Relevant professional certifications such as CISA, CIA, or comparable Information Security, technology audit, or assurance credentials, or progress towards them, are desirable rather than mandatory.
* Technical security, cloud, or other relevant technology training or certifications are advantageous where they support practical evidence review and control testing.

Deloitte is where you’ll find unrivaled opportunities to succeed and realize your full potential.

title: Senior Data Platform Engineer
description:
A hands-on Technical Lead / Senior Data Platform Engineer responsible for designing, building, and operating ISDP — Ford's cloud-native, event-driven data ingestion and identity-resolution platform. ISDP ingests vehicle engineering, manufacturing, service, PLM (3DX), supply chain, and quality data from multiple enterprise source systems (IVS, FEDE Workbench, DVP, 3DX, Ascent, SIMPSN) through a 5-layer architecture — GCS ingestion, Cloud Function event triggers, Airflow/Astronomer orchestration, Apache Beam/Dataflow processing, and BigQuery/AlloyDB storage — with full identity resolution (deterministic UUID v5), schema-contract data quality validation, observability, and downstream graph/analytics layers.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Pipeline & Platform Engineering**

* Design, build, and enhance the ISDP ingestion and identity-resolution engine using Apache Beam and Google Cloud Dataflow (Flex Templates, Java 21) to process PLM, manufacturing, service, and quality data into a BigQuery domain event store.
* Implement pluggable file-reader strategies for JSON, JSONL, and XML payloads (XPath/JSONPath-based field extraction, namespace handling) and support 3 processing strategies: flat\_records, tree\_flatten, and tree\_relationships.
* Implement the YAML-driven Mapping Engine: field mappings, transforms (upper/lower/strip/split/replace/regex\_filter/compose\_from), deterministic UUID v5 primary-key minting, and cross-domain foreign-key resolution via a frozen namespace\_id registry.
* Own the Schema Contract Validation layer — required fields, allowed values, regex patterns, min/max length checks — routing failing records to a BigQuery Dead Letter Queue (domain\_event\_store\_dlq.identity\_quality\_events) prior to canonical mapping.
* Design and implement streaming pipelines (e.g., the ODS AlloyDB job) that subscribe to canonical-record Pub/Sub topics (isdp-canonical-records) and upsert transformed records into AlloyDB as an Operational Data Store for low-latency API serving.
* Build and maintain the downstream Graph Layer — a config-driven, entity-agnostic property graph (BigQuery) that projects domain\_event\_store events into graph\_nodes/graph\_edges via registry-driven, watermark-based incremental refresh procedures.

Domain / Data Source Onboarding
  
  

* Onboard new business domains and source systems (IVS Manufacturing/Service, FEDE Workbench, DVP, 3DX PLM, Ascent Supplier Commit/Survey, SIMPSN Quality, Part Return) by authoring per-domain YAML configs (sources, key\_rules, mappings, foreign\_keys, schema\_contract), BigQuery JSON schemas, and Terraform table definitions.
* Register new domains in domains\_index.yaml, assigning immutable, rename-stable namespace\_id values that seed the UUID v5 namespace for each domain.
* Run the ISDP data-source onboarding process end-to-end: profile source files, propose domains/PKs/FKs/data-quality rules, build and iterate YAML contracts with the source team, validate in Dev then Pre-Prod, and finalize go-live plans.
* Author and maintain validation test cases (unit tests for MappingEngine, SchemaContractValidationFn; Cucumber BDD integration tests) to certify each onboarded domain end-to-end against a local SQLite/PostgreSQL sink without requiring live GCP infrastructure.

Orchestration, Infrastructure & CI/CD
  
  

* Maintain the Cloud Function event trigger (Gen2, Python) that detects GCS object-finalize events and launches the Airflow DAG (isdp\_processing\_engine) via the Astronomer/Airflow REST API, including duplicate-run prevention.
* Maintain the Airflow DAG orchestration logic (list\_and\_move, trigger\_dataflow, archive, check\_requeue tasks) governing the file lifecycle (new/ → processing/ → archive/ or invalid/) across all source buckets.
* Own Terraform infrastructure-as-code (github-60318-isdp-tf) provisioning BigQuery datasets/tables, GCS buckets, Cloud Functions, Workload Identity Federation bindings, IAM, and Secret Manager entries across Dev, Pre-Prod, and Prod GCP projects.
* Manage CI/CD via Tekton Pipelines-as-Code: Gradle builds, JIB container publishing, Dataflow Flex Template registration, SonarQube quality gates, and FOSSA dependency scanning.
* Support local development workflows — Gradle/Java 21 builds, DirectRunner local pipeline execution, portable local PostgreSQL (AlloyDB-equivalent) provisioning, and Pub/Sub sample message replay for ODS streaming testing.

Operations, Quality & Observability
  
  

* Monitor and maintain the six-pillar observability suite (freshness, volume/anomaly, quality, schema drift, lineage, DLQ analysis) backed by BigQuery observability tables and MS Teams alerting (MsTeamsAlertFn).
* Perform production support: health checks across Cloud Function, Airflow DAG, and Dataflow job status; BigQuery write-recency verification; DLQ triage and root-cause investigation; incident response for stuck/failed jobs.
* Own release coordination, security remediation (dependency CVE patching via Gradle constraints, FOSSA/SonarQube gates), QA validation, and post-production support across Dev, Pre-Prod, and Prod environments.
* Perform detailed requirement analysis, solution design, development, code review, unit/integration testing, and defect resolution across the full ISDP delivery lifecycle.

**Qualifications (Required)**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline.
* 9+ years of backend application development and cloud data engineering experience, including hands-on technical leadership.
* Strong proficiency in Java (Java 21), Spring Boot, and Microservices architecture; comfort with Java records, Lombok, and stateless/immutable design patterns.
* Deep, hands-on expertise with Google Cloud Platform: Apache Beam / Cloud Dataflow (Flex Templates), BigQuery (STORAGE\_WRITE\_API, partitioning/clustering), Pub/Sub, Cloud Run, Cloud Functions (Gen2), GCS, and Dataproc/Apache Spark.
* Experience with AlloyDB / PostgreSQL (or equivalent relational stores) for low-latency Operational Data Store patterns, including JDBC-based Beam sinks.
* Proficiency with Terraform for infrastructure as code across multi-environment GCP projects (Dev/Pre-Prod/Prod), including Terraform module registries and Tekton-based Terraform CI/CD.
* Experience with Astronomer/Apache Airflow for pipeline orchestration, including DAG design, REST API integration, and duplicate-run prevention logic.
* Experience with CI/CD and code-quality tooling: Tekton Pipelines-as-Code, SonarQube quality gates, FOSSA dependency scanning, Gradle (shadowJar, JIB container builds).
* Strong experience with PLM and enterprise data integration (3DX, C3P, DCA, Teamcenter) and building schema-validated, event-driven, YAML-configuration-driven ETL/ELT pipelines.
* Practical knowledge of deterministic identity resolution techniques (UUID v5 / RFC 4122), XPath/JSONPath field extraction, and cross-domain foreign-key resolution patterns.
* Version control proficiency with GitHub/Bitbucket, including PR-based code review workflows.
* Strong analytical, written communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills — able to work directly with source-system teams, QA, business stakeholders, and platform leadership through structured onboarding and release processes.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience building or operating config-/YAML-driven ETL frameworks where all domain logic (mappings, transforms, key rules, schema contracts) lives in configuration rather than code.
* Experience with Cucumber BDD and building infrastructure-independent local test harnesses (e.g., SQLite or portable local PostgreSQL sinks) for end-to-end pipeline validation.
* Familiarity with dead-letter-queue (DLQ) design patterns and structured data-quality gating (required fields, allowed-value enums, regex patterns, length constraints) prior to data warehouse load.
* Experience with property-graph / knowledge-graph layers on BigQuery (GRAPH\_TABLE, GQL MATCH queries), multi-source entity resolution, and watermark-based incremental refresh patterns.
* Experience with observability engineering: freshness SLAs, anomaly detection (Z-score/schema drift), data lineage tracking, and chat-ops alerting (e.g., MS Teams webhook integrations).
* Experience with Workload Identity Federation (cross-cloud, e.g., Azure AD → GCP) and Secret Manager-based credential management (zero static keys/secrets in code).
* Prior experience migrating legacy systems to GCP (e.g., Cassandra → BigTable, on-prem ETL → Dataflow/Dataproc), demonstrating cloud migration maturity.
* Familiarity with structured, multi-team data-source onboarding processes (profiling → YAML contract → Dev validation → Pre-Prod sign-off → go-live).
* Exposure to adjacent Ford platform tooling: JFrog Artifactory, Rouge Docs, Ford GCP CCoE standards, and OpenShift-hosted Tekton pipelines.

**Position: Data Modeler/Data Architect +Salesforce**

**Location: Chennai/Pune/Hyderabad-Hybrid/Remote**

**Position Summary:**

The Enterprise Data Modeler / Data Architect designs and leads enterprise-scale data models that power cloud data warehouses, data lakes, and analytics platforms. This role partners closely with business stakeholders, data engineers, and analytics teams to translate business and analytical needs into scalable, high‑quality data models and metadata that enable trusted, self-service reporting, advanced analytics, and data science use cases.

**What You'll do as a Enterprise Data Modeler / Data Architect:**

* **Design, implement, and maintain conceptual, logical, and physical data models for enterprise data warehouses, data lakes, and specialized data stores.**
* Collaborate with business and technical stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into efficient, scalable data designs.
* Define and govern enterprise data modeling and metadata standards, best practices, and design patterns.
* **Partner with data engineering teams to ensure data models align with ETL/data pipelines, lineage, and performance requirements.**
* Develop and maintain data documentation, including data dictionaries, business glossary entries, and data catalog metadata.
* Support and evolve the Enterprise Data Catalog and Business Glossary, capturing business, technical, and operational metadata.
* Work with Data Owners and Data Stewards to ensure key data elements have clear definitions, ownership, lineage, and data quality context.
* Serve as a technical leader and mentor, promoting data modeling, metadata, and governance best practices across the organization.

**The Experience, Abilities and Skills Needed:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, MIS, Informatics, or related field
* **10+ years of experience in enterprise data modeling, preferably in cloud-based data warehouse and data lake environments.**
* **Strong expertise in dimensional modeling (star and snowflake schemas) and relational data design.**
* **Hands-on experience with cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, AWS Redshift, or Google BigQuery.**
* **Advanced SQL skills and experience designing database schemas and structures.**
* Proven experience with Enterprise Data Catalogs and Business Glossaries, including tools like Collibra, Alation or MS Purview
* Experience with defining metadata standards, mandatory attributes, and data stewardship workflows.
* Ability to collaborate on metadata strategy supporting self-service BI, analytics, and data governance. Proficiency with data modeling tools (e.g., Erwin, ER Studio, IBM InfoSphere Data Architect or similar).
* **Solid understanding of data engineering concepts, ETL/data pipelines, data lineage, and integration practices.**
* **Experience embedding metadata, naming standards, and data quality practices into data platforms and development processes.**
* **Excellent communication and collaboration skills across business, analytics, and technology teams.**
* Expertise with data and metadata modeling best practices to design data repositories optimized to support AI/ML applications and use cases is highly desired.

title: Payroll Manager II
description:
Overview:

The **Payroll Manager II** is an experienced payroll leader responsible for managing complex, multi-jurisdictions payroll operations while overseeing the day-to-day execution of **payroll activities and supervising a team of payroll specialists and analyst**s. This role combines deep payroll processing expertise with advanced leadership responsibilities, ensuring accurate, timely, and compliant payroll delivery across multiple jurisdictions.

The Payroll Manager II serves as a **subject matter expert for complex payroll and timekeeping environments, including compliance, vendor validation, and statutory requirements.** This position plays a key role in driving operational excellence, strengthening governance, and developing team capability while partnering cross-functionally with HR, Finance, IT, and external vendors

Responsibilities:

* Lead and oversee payroll operations for assigned countries or regions, ensuring accurate and timely execution of payroll cycles across complex, multi-jurisdiction employee populations
* Manage payroll operations involving complex timekeeping environments, ensuring compliance with labor laws, overtime regulations, leave policies, and statutory requirements
* Supervise and develop payroll staff, including Payroll Specialists and Analysts, by providing structured coaching, performance management, and career development support
* Review and approve complex payroll transactions, including retroactive pay, bonuses, statutory deductions, tax adjustments, and payroll corrections, ensuring alignment with internal controls
* Ensure compliance with country-specific payroll regulations, tax requirements, and statutory reporting obligations across multiple jurisdictions
* Serve as the escalation point for complex payroll and timekeeping issues, partnering with HR, Finance, IT, and external vendors to resolve discrepancies and mitigate risk
* Oversee managed payroll vendor relationships, validating payroll outputs, ensuring SLA adherence, and monitoring service quality and compliance performance
* Monitor and reconcile payroll accounts, including payroll liabilities, tax withholdings, and statutory deductions, in coordination with Finance and external vendors

title: Vice President, DataDesk – Vendor Onboarding & Automation
description:
Your Team Responsibilities:

MSCI's DataDesk team owns the onboarding of new vendor datasets into MSCI's data ecosystem — ensuring new sources are integrated quickly, validated rigorously, and governed well from day one. We're looking for a Vice President to lead and scale this function by embedding AI and automation into the onboarding lifecycle, while bringing genuine technical fluency with data to work credibly alongside Research content, Products, engineering and AI teams.

Your Key Responsibilities:

**Vendor Onboarding & Due Diligence**

* Own end-to-end onboarding of new vendor datasets — from initial due diligence and scope assessment through integration and go-live
* Define and enforce onboarding standards: identifier mapping at ingestion, full scope pre-onboarding assessment, QA assessment and fit for purpose qualification, formal SLAs definition with clear escalation ownership
* Conduct vendor due diligence and maintain trusted relationships with data providers
* Assess onboarded datasets to identify coverage gaps and quality issues, and partner with the vendor to remediate them
* Lead root-cause analysis on onboarding delays or quality gaps, and drive process fixes (as opposed to one-off fire-fighting)

**AI & Automation-Led Scaling**

* Identify and implement AI/automation opportunities across the onboarding pipeline — e.g., automated identifier/field mapping, validation rule generation, matching and reconciliation logic
* Partner with engineering/AI teams to build or adopt tooling that automates QA diagnostic and certification, reduce manual onboarding effort and turnaround time, acting as the functional expert who validates outputs against real onboarding scenarios
* Continuously evaluate emerging AI techniques and apply them to reduce onboarding cycle time and error rates
* Track and report onboarding efficiency metrics (cycle time, automation coverage, error/rework rates) to leadership
* Incorporate AI-based data usage/rights validation into the data collection process, ensuring new vendor sources are governance-compliant before integration
* Enrich and expose AI powered catalogue of data, QA / Diagnostic and other DataDesk Services

**Data Quality & Governance**

* Define validation rules and quality benchmarks for newly onboarded vendor data
* Ensure onboarded datasets meet MSCI's data standards for accuracy, consistency, and compliance before integration
* Collaborate with product and downstream teams to assess data fit and flag risks early in the onboarding process
* Conduct a quarterly assessment of MSCI's vendor data risk across product lines and single points of failure, identify possible remediations or alternatives, and present findings to senior leadership to inform operational planning and investment decisions

**Leadership & Collaboration**

* Lead and mentor a team of analysts/associates involved in onboarding and vendor evaluation
* Engage with internal and external stakeholders to align on onboarding priorities, resolve escalations, and ensure timely, transparent communication throughout the onboarding lifecycle
* Partner with global stakeholders across product, research, technology, and operations to align onboarding priorities and standards
* Present onboarding pipeline status, risks, and automation roadmap to senior leadership

Your skills and experience that will help you excel:

**Experience:** 10+ years in data operations, vendor management, or data onboarding, ideally in financial data/index/analytics

**Technical Skills:**

* Strong understanding of data structures, formats, and identifiers (LEI, DUNS, CUSIP/ISIN) sufficient to assess vendor data fit and define validation logic
* Working proficiency in SQL and Python — able to review/write validation and matching logic, not just specify requirements
* Experience applying AI/ML or automation tools to data matching, validation, or process acceleration
* Comfort working directly with engineering/AI teams as a technical counterpart, not just a requirements source

**Domain Knowledge:**

* Familiarity with vendor data landscape (e.g., FactSet, LSEG/EJV, ICE, EDI) and cross-vendor field mapping challenges
* Understanding of financial reference data concepts (entities, securities, classifications) as they relate to onboarding validation

**Soft Skills:** Strong stakeholder and vendor relationship management, project management, and the ability to translate operational pain points into automation opportunities

  
About MSCI:

**What we offer you**

* Transparent compensation schemes and comprehensive employee benefits, tailored to your location, ensuring your financial security, health, and overall wellbeing.
* Flexible working arrangements, advanced technology, and collaborative workspaces.
* A culture of high performance and innovation where we experiment with new ideas and take responsibility for achieving results.
* A global network of talented colleagues, who inspire, support, and share their expertise to innovate and deliver for our clients.
* Global Orientation program to kickstart your journey, followed by access to our Learning@MSCI platform, AI Learning Center , LinkedIn Learning Pro and tailored learning opportunities for ongoing skills development.
* Multi-directional career paths that offer professional growth and development through new challenges, internal mobility and expanded roles.
* We actively nurture an environment that builds a sense of inclusion belonging and connection, including eight Employee Resource Groups. All Abilities, Asian Support Network, Black Leadership Network, Climate Action Network, Hola! MSCI, Pride & Allies, Women in Tech, and Women’s Leadership Forum.

At MSCI we are passionate about what we do, and we are inspired by our vision – to power better decisions. You’ll be part of an industry-leading network of creative, curious, and entrepreneurial pioneers. This is a space where you can challenge yourself, set new standards and perform beyond expectations for yourself, our clients, and our industry.

MSCI strengthens global markets by connecting participants across the financial ecosystem with a common language. Our research-based data, analytics and indexes, supported by advanced technology, set standards for global investors and help our clients understand risks and opportunities so they can make better decisions and unlock innovation. We serve asset managers and owners, private-market sponsors and investors, hedge funds, wealth managers, banks, insurers and corporates.

title: Sr Software - Quality Assurance Analyst
description:

* Experience integrating automated testing into **CI/CD pipelines** .
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and problem-solving skills.

We’re on a mission to make clean energy more accessible, affordable, and reliable — and we’re looking for ambitious people who want to grow with us.

We are hiring an **AI & Business Automation Intern** to support the development of internal automation systems that improve efficiency, reduce manual work, and connect various platforms within our operations. This role is hands-on and ideal for someone who enjoys building smart systems using modern no-code and AI tools.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Create Automated Workflows Using Notion, Make, and n8n:** Use tools like **Notion**, **Make (Integromat)**, and **n8n** to create logic-driven workflows that automate data movement, task tracking, notifications, and lead qualification processes.
* **Automate Tasks Across Google Sheets, Forms, APIs, and CRM Systems:** Set up integrations that eliminate repetitive data entry by connecting Google Workspace apps, forms, CRM databases, and APIs to enable seamless automation from lead capture to assignment.

* **Collaborate with the Founder and Tech Team to Solve Process Bottlenecks:** Work closely with the leadership team to identify inefficiencies in current processes and propose smart automation-driven solutions that can scale as the company grows.
* **(Optional but Preferred) Use Python for Custom Scripts Where Needed:** Where no-code tools fall short, write basic scripts in **Python** to handle edge cases, parse data, or connect systems not directly supported by Make or n8n.

**Skills Required:**

* Experience with **Custom GPTs** and prompt workflows

* Strong logical thinking and system design capability

title: AI/ML Trainer
description:

You will teach the full AI/ML journey, from Python and statistics to machine learning, deep learning, and Gen AI, and guide students from beginner to job-ready. curriculum

- Prepare and update course materials, notebooks, lab exercises, assessments, and case studies in line with the fast-moving AI landscape

- Mentor students on resumes, GitHub and Kaggle portfolios, project explanation, and AI/ML interview preparation

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering,  
Mathematics, or a related field

years of AI/ML training experience

core ML algorithms and model evaluation

- Hands-on experience with TensorFlow/Keras or PyTorch

- Has personally built LLM or RAG applications, and can walk through the design of at least  
one

title: DATA SCIENTIST II
description:
We are seeking a motivated and analytical Junior Data Scientist to support machine learning, analytics, and AI-driven initiatives. The ideal candidate will work closely with senior data scientists and engineers to prepare data, perform exploratory analysis, build predictive models, and contribute to research in deep learning and generative AI. This role is well-suited for someone early in their career who is eager to learn, experiment, and grow in a collaborative environment.

**Roles & Responsibility:**
---------------------------

**Statistics, Data Preparation & Exploration**

* Perform data cleaning, transformation, feature engineering, and validation to prepare datasets for modeling.
* Conduct Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) to identify trends, patterns, anomalies, and correlations.
* Apply foundational statistical techniques such as hypothesis testing, probability distributions, regression analysis, sampling methods, and confidence intervals.
* Assist in developing reproducible data workflows and ensuring data quality and integrity.

**Data Visualization & Reporting**

* Create clear and insightful data visualizations using Python libraries (matplotlib, seaborn, plotly) or dashboard tools.
* Summarize findings in reports and presentations for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Support the creation of visual stories for product metrics, experiments, and model performance.

**SQL & Data Retrieval**

* Use SQL to query, aggregate, join, and filter data from relational databases.
* Collaborate with data platform teams to understand schemas and extract datasets efficiently.
* Build and optimize queries for ad hoc analysis, prototype features, and model preparation.

**Machine Learning & Analytics**

* Assist in developing supervised and unsupervised learning models such as classification, regression, clustering, and time-series forecasting.
* Support feature engineering, hyperparameter tuning, and model evaluation using standard metrics.
* Document experiments and help improve model accuracy and reliability under guidance.

**AI & Generative AI Support**

* Contribute to early-stage work using Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, and agent-based AI for automation and insights extraction.
* Assist with prompt design, API integration, fine-tuning small models, and testing prototypes.
* Deep Learning & Computer Vision (Foundational Support)
* Support research and prototyping of neural networks such as ANNs, RNNs/LSTMs, CNNs, and transformer-based architectures.
* Help prepare datasets, run training experiments, and perform basic error analysis.

**Data Engineering & ML Workflows**

* Work with data engineers to understand data pipelines and cloud storage systems.
* Assist in setting up notebooks, scripts, or light automation for ML workflows.
* Follow best practices for version control, documentation, and reproducibility.

**Collaboration & Communication**

* Partner with product, engineering, and business teams to gather requirements and deliver insights.
* Present findings through visuals, dashboards, or written summaries.
* Participate in code reviews and contribute to team knowledge-sharing.

**Desired Candidate Profile:**
------------------------------

**EDUCATION/KNOWLEDGE :**

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, Mathematics, or related field.

  

**QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE:**

* 5 years of experience in machine learning, deep learning, natural language processing, or applied AI.
* Strong foundation in **statistics**, probability, and data analysis methods.
* Good working knowledge of **Python**, SQL, and ML libraries such as pandas, numpy, scikit-learn, and matplotlib.
* Familiarity with EDA, visualization best practices, and basic ML model development.
* Basic understanding of deep learning frameworks (PyTorch or TensorFlow).
* Databricks - Delta Lake, Auto Loader, Pipelines, Feature Store, Unity Catalog, Notebooks, MLflow Tracking, AutoML, MLflow Models (pyfunc, flavor) + Model Registry
* Strong analytical mindset, attention to detail, and willingness to learn.

title: Applied Scientist, Print On Demand Science
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Are you passionate about automation, optimization, knowledge extraction, and artificial intelligence through the use of Machine Learning, Computer Vision, Optimization, Natural Language Processing, and Recommender systems? We have a team of experienced scientists with a critical business mission making revolutionary leaps forward in these spaces. On this team, the applied scientists will work with large multimodal datasets to build generative and discriminative models for optimizing large-scale manufacturing and fulfillment processes, analyze and model customer reading behavior to measure engagement and detect risks, and build AI-based systems for helping indie authors make their businesses successful.  
  
This will involve combining methods from several science domains with domain knowledge across multiple businesses into sophisticated ML workflows. Our team has mature areas and green-field opportunities. We offer scientific autonomy, value end-to-end ownership, and have a strong customer-focused culture.  
  
As an Applied Scientist at Amazon, you will be working with large distributed systems of data and collaborating with the product managers, teams, and organizations building machine learning solutions. You will be tackling Machine Learning challenges in Supervised, Unsupervised, and Semi-supervised Learning; utilizing modern methods such as deep learning and classical methods from statistical learning theory, detection, estimation.
  
  
Great candidates for this position will have strong skills in the areas of machine learning, computer vision, optimization, Generative AI, or statistics. You will have hands-on experience with multiple science initiatives as well as be able to balance technical skills with business judgment to make the right decisions about technology, models and methodological choices. You will strive for simplicity, and demonstrate creativity and high judgment.  
  
Come join us as we revolutionize the book industry and deliver an amazing experience to our Kindle authors and readers.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
In this role, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining science-based systems for optimizing manufacturing, fulfillment, and quality processes for our Print On Demand (POD) business.
  
  
About the team  
Kindle Direct Publishing (KDP) and Print On Demand (POD) have empowered a new wave of self-motivated creators, tearing down barriers that once blocked writers from reaching readers. Our team builds rich applications and systems that empower anyone to realize their dream of becoming a published author. We strive to provide an experience that is powerful, yet simple to use and accessible to all. We focus on building tools that enable authors to design high quality digital and print books, reaching readers all around the world. This role will help ensure we maintain the trust of both our Authors and Readers by ensuring all books published to Amazon meet our standards.  
  
Minerva is a team of experienced scientists with a broad charter and critical mission for the Books business. At Minerva, we build science-based systems for optimizing manufacturing, fulfillment, and quality processes for our Print On Demand (POD) business. We also use science for marketing and content-discovery for indie authors, fraud/abuse, and content risk. Each Minerva scientist owns a large space and works closely with respective senior leaders across business, engineering, and operations for the science area they lead. We have mature areas and green-field opportunities. We have engineering, BIE, and DE support across our areas. Minerva scientists don't have on-call rotations.  
  
POD Science Team in Minerva Science is focused on optimizing manufacturing, fulfillment, and quality processes for our Print On Demand (POD) business.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of building machine learning models or developing algorithms for business application experience
* Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* PhD in engineering, technology, computer science, machine learning, robotics, operations research, statistics, mathematics or equivalent quantitative field
* Experience developing and implementing deep learning algorithms, particularly with respect to computer vision algorithms
* Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing
* Have publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals
