title: Partner Knowledge & Training Manager
description:
### **The Opportunity**

Sitetracker's partner ecosystem is growing fast. Systems integrators and consultancies now lead implementations for customers across Europe, the Middle East, the Americas and Asia-Pacific, across the full Sitetracker product portfolio, as well as Scout, our AI product.

As our first dedicated Partner Knowledge & Training Manager, you will run the training domain within our Partner Success function, delivering how partners learn to implement Sitetracker. You will inherit a substantial library of partner courses and certifications, take it over in stages from the Partner Success Director, and build out what comes next. This is a high-visibility role working with some of the world's leading SIs, close to our Product team, where your expertise directly determines how well our customers' projects are delivered.

### **What You'll Do**

Reporting directly to the Global VP Partners, you will run partner training worldwide as part of the Partner Success function. The Partner Success Director sets the standards, learning objectives and content priorities; you own how training is produced, delivered and administered. You will also work closely with regional partner leaders, Product and the PoC team. You will:

* Design, build and maintain partner enablement content across the Sitetracker portfolio, including Scout, maximising self-paced learning paths and using live sessions where they add most value, so the programme scales.
* Deliver and administer partner training courses and certifications, mostly virtually, to audiences in Europe, the Americas and Asia.
* Administer the partner LMS, training orgs and trial orgs, and support any future move to a new LMS.
* Hold Product to account for providing complete, sufficient and current technical documentation, and make it available to partners at general availability, including through Scout.
* Capture partner feedback on the product and its documentation, route it to Product, and track it through to action.
* Work with partner managers and the Partner Success Director so partner teams are trained and certified before each project starts.
* Work in close partnership with the Partner Success Director, aligning on priorities and standards and drawing on their delivery expertise.
* Use AI to accelerate how you research, create and maintain content.

### **The Skills You'll Have**

#### **Technical training design and delivery**

* 5+ years designing and delivering technical training or certification for implementers, consultants or admins.
* A proven ability to structure courses around clear outcomes, hands-on practice and assessment, grounded in adult learning principles.
* Experience designing blended programmes that maximise self-paced learning and keep live sessions for where they add most value.
* Confident, clear live delivery to audiences across regions, with a track record of handling challenging questions well.
* Experience running a training programme independently within agreed priorities and standards, holding clear scope boundaries.
* Experience administering an LMS and measuring training effectiveness.
* Experience running train-the-trainer programmes is a strong advantage.

#### **Salesforce platform expertise**

* 5+ years of demo building and/or implementation experience on the Salesforce platform.
* Current Salesforce certifications; please include them with your application.
* Hands-on experience creating and maintaining training or demo orgs.
* Confidence demonstrating live, including troubleshooting unexpected behaviour in front of an audience.
* Experience with AppExchange managed packages or industry solutions is a strong advantage.

#### **Knowledge management and product feedback**

* Experience curating a technical knowledge base and holding product teams to account for providing documentation with each release.
* A track record of running feedback loops from partners or customers to Product and reporting back what was actioned.
* The ability to work effectively with product managers and technical writers without formal authority.
* Experience structuring content for AI retrieval is a strong advantage.

#### **SI ecosystem and partner enablement**

* Experience training or working within systems integrators or consultancies, including offshore delivery centres.
* An understanding of how SIs staff and certify their teams, and how to time enablement to project mobilisation.
* Experience at a Salesforce SI or in an ISV partner programme is a strong advantage.

#### **AI fluency**

* Daily, practical use of generative AI to accelerate content work, with a strong eye for quality.
* The ability to explain AI product concepts clearly to technical audiences.
* Experience enabling partners or customers on an AI product is a strong advantage.

### **Within 90 Days, You'll**

* Integrate into the Partners team and build strong working relationships with Product, the PoC team and regional partner leaders.
* Lead delivery of partner courses, including instructor-led bootcamps, with the Partner Success Director contributing as subject-matter expert.
* Achieve the Sitetracker certifications our partners are expected to hold.
* Take over the self-paced foundations content, supported online cohorts, the partner LMS and training and trial orgs.
* Build a deep, hands-on understanding of the Sitetracker and Scout solutions, including how they are configured and implemented, using the product documentation and Scout to get up to speed quickly.
* Assess current content coverage, documentation gaps and partner feedback, and advise the Partner Success Director on effort as they set content backlog priorities

### **Within 180 Days, You'll**

* Run all certification cycles end to end, including assessment, results and tier updates.
* Run the training domain self-sufficiently, including sole bootcamp delivery, with the Partner Success Director providing cover and subject-matter input by agreement only.
* Deliver the first new content from the prioritised backlog, including Scout enablement for priority partners.
* Put a repeatable process in place to get partner teams trained and certified before project kickoff.
* Agree a working model with the Partner Success Director for subject-matter support in sessions and cover during absences or scheduling conflicts.
* Establish baseline metrics for certified partners and resources, content coverage and partner feedback.

### **Within 365 Days, You'll**

* Keep partner feedback at or above baseline, and extend enablement content and certification paths across the Sitetracker portfolio in the priority order Partner Success sets.
* Have partner-facing documentation complete for the portfolio, with a working feedback loop that shows partners what Product has actioned.
* Ensure partners are certified to the level needed for the scope of their deliveries, with every new partner-led project starting with a team certified for that scope.
* Be recognised by partners and colleagues as the authority on how Sitetracker is implemented.

title: Finance Manager
description:

title: Senior Oracle EBS Finance Functional Support Analyst
description:
**Job Description:**

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a Senior Oracle EBS Finance Functional Support Analyst to join Terex's TMS (Terex Management System) Level 2 support organization. This role is the primary escalation point for Oracle EBS Finance incidents across Terex's global, multi-org, multi-currency manufacturing environment. You will resolve functional issues, reduce ticket backlog, drive continuous improvements and ensure finance teams across our business segments — including Genie, Materials Processing, and Environmental Solutions — can operate without disruption.

**Key Responsibilities**

Incident Management & Resolution (Finance)

* Provide day-to-day level 2 support of Oracle EBS Finance modules and related applications for Terex users globally.

* Log, categorize, prioritize, and resolve incidents and service requests in line with defined SLAs and operational procedures.

* Execute routine, playbook-driven activities that contribute to system stability and operational continuity.

* Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues that may span Oracle EBS modules, middleware and other applications.

* Communicate clearly with end users and stakeholders, providing timely updates, setting expectations, and confirming resolution prior to ticket closure.

Manage escalations and escalate effectively when needed.  



Terex Financial Process Support

* Ensure that monthly, quarterly and yearly financial close proceed without IT impact.

* Support all Oracle EBS Finance modules.

Act as an escalation point for complex issues, coordinating thorough troubleshooting and restoration of service.  



Continuous Improvement & Automation

* Identify recurring incidents and contribute to problem management by capturing symptoms, workarounds, and supporting root cause investigations.

Look for opportunities to streamline or automate existing functionality and processes.  



Collaboration & Communication

* Partner with the Technical team on defects and enhancements, providing functional specifications, test scenarios, and validation of fixes.

* Partner with other tracks (Finance, Sales & Service, Supply Chain and Engineering & Manufacturing) as necessary for support and enhancements.

* Create and maintain knowledge articles, troubleshooting guides, and standard operating procedures to improve first-contact resolution.

* Support change implementation activities (communication, requirements, UAT support, validation and hypercare) and ensure end user and support team readiness for new or changed functionality and processes.

* Support Oracle EBS projects and activities outside of Enterprise Support when requested.

Ensure accurate ticket documentation, categorization, and reporting inputs to support service performance, auditability, and continuous improvement.  



**Education**

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Finance, Information Technology, or a related discipline.  



**Experience & Skills**

* At least 8 years of hands-on functional support experience with Oracle EBS R12.2+ Finance modules (GL, AP, AR, Fixed Assets, Cash Management).

title: Sr Manager, Accounting (Product Controllership)
description:
**The Company**

PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

**Job Summary:**

What you need to know about the role-
  
We have an exciting opportunity for a seasoned accounting leader to join PayPal’s global Product Controllership Team, based in India. In this position, you will oversee the accounting team members located in India, providing day-to-day leadership and oversight of their work, while taking full ownership of accounting operations and supporting the global Team, with a primary focus on Revenue, Transaction Loss and Transaction Margin activities. This role requires deep knowledge of US GAAP, accounting operations, regulatory reporting and internal controls, along with the ability to develop people and partner with global stakeholders across time zones.
  
  
Meet our team
  
The product controllership/accounting team plays a pivotal role in supporting PayPal’s activity, ensuring that we can consolidate and ultimately integrate our business units in an efficient, well controlled manner.

**Job Description:**

**Essential Responsibilities:**

* Partner with PayPal business leaders and wider PayPal finance organization on accounting and reporting matters
* Drive accounting support within finance transformation work programs and other process enhancements
* Provide accounting expertise and leadership to finance and business organizations
* Consult with business partners regularly to ensure awareness of significant transactions and potential accounting impact

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* 8+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

**Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications****:**

**Your day to day:** Duties include but may not be limited to the following:

* Lead and oversee the product controllership team members in India, including direct and indirect reports; set priorities, review work product, coach and develop talent, manage performance and build a strong bench
* Serve as the India site leader for the product controllership team ensuring seamless handoffs, consistent processes and strong collaboration with transaction margin team members and leadership in the US and other regions
* Fully own the accounting and financial reporting for smaller business units, including the monthly, quarterly and annual close, journal entries, account reconciliations and balance sheet substantiation
* Support the global Team on Transaction Margin and customer fund accounting, close activities and review of worldwide activity for PayPal and its subsidiaries
* Perform technical accounting analysis of complex and non-routine transactions; partner with Accounting Policy on positions and new accounting standards
* Prepare and review reporting packages for reporting units assigned to the team
* Maintain and update accounting policies, process documentation and procedures related to Transaction Margin and assigned business units
* Lead SOX and external audit activities for the area, including control ownership, remediation of deficiencies and timely delivery of PBCs
* Partner with the Data and Business Applications teams to deliver enhanced reporting, automation and analytics across business units
* Represent the Product Accounting Team and proactively engage cross-functional stakeholders across Finance (PMO teams, Accounting Policy, Tax, Corporate Controllership, Financial Operations, International Controllership, Finance Systems, etc.), partnering effectively across US and India time zones
* Design and implement business and accounting processes that strengthen internal controls and drive consistent reporting, analysis and insights across business units
* Lead accounting and control assessments for new product launches and business changes, and support Finance-wide special projects
  

  

**What do you need to bring-** An ideal candidate for this role would possess the following skills/experience:

**Required Skills -**

* **Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance**;
* **CPA, Chartered Accountant (CA) mains or equivalent required**
* At least **10 years** of progressive accounting experience, **including Big 4 and/or large public company experience,** and at least **3 years of people management** experience.
* Strong knowledge of **US GAAP**; experience with **SOX and external audit**
* Experience **owning revenue, expenses and losses** at prior organizations, ideally under US GAAP
* Proven ability to lead through influence, manage competing priorities, and thrive in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment
* Experience driving **process improvement, automation and finance transformation initiatives**
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present to senior leaders
* Strong organizational skills, detail orientation, and a reputation for getting things done
* Comfortable leading diverse teams and collaborating with stakeholders across multiple locations and time zones

Preferred Qualifications

* Working knowledge of AI tools and generative AI, such as Claude, ChatGPT or similar, with hands-on experience applying them to improve accounting analysis, reporting, documentation and process efficiency
* Experience working in **SAP S/4HANA (or SAP ECC)** for general ledger, financial close and reporting
* Experience in fintech, payments or other financial services, including accounting for revenue, transaction losses and customer funds
* Hands-on experience with data and analytics tools and reconciliation or close automation platforms to streamline accounting processes

**Subsidiary:**

PayPal

**Travel Percent:**

0

PayPal does not charge candidates any fees for courses, applications, resume reviews, interviews, background checks, or onboarding. For over 20 years, Algoworks has partnered with Fortune 500 organizations across the Americas, Europe and Asia to define, build and run technology that drives meaningful business outcomes. Our work combines human-centered design, engineering excellence and AI-powered capabilities to solve complex challenges with clarity and precision. Innovation, particularly in the responsible application of AI, is embedded in how teams approach problem-solving and continuous improvement.

At Algoworks, growth is continuous and closely tied to impact. Teams collaborate across geographies and disciplines, strengthening outcomes through shared insight and collective expertise. The culture values transparency, open dialogue and an environment where every voice is heard and contribution is recognized.

Through collaboration, accountability and a focus on results, Algoworks operates at the intersection of technology and people, building not only advanced systems but strong global teams that elevate performance and create lasting impact.

Follow the video below to know about us!
Clipchamp

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a world-class, experienced, and proven Revenue Operations leader to strengthen how Algoworks understands, manages, and improves commercial performance. Reporting to the Chief Financial Officer and working closely with senior leadership across Sales, Marketing, Delivery, and Technology, this role will be responsible for making the go-to-market (GTM) operating model work better, not simply reporting on its performance.

The position combines revenue intelligence with process design, data governance, systems effectiveness, and adoption to create a trusted, forward-looking view of the revenue engine. The role will improve how teams operate from lead generation through revenue realization.

This is not a Salesforce architect or engineering role. The successful candidate must understand GTM systems deeply enough to define how they should support the business, identify where processes or data are failing, and work hand-in-hand with technical
specialists to implement scalable improvements.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Executive Revenue Intelligence**

* Create integrated, forward-looking views of pipeline, bookings, backlog, forecast, revenue, and customer growth.
* Explain material movements, underlying drivers, emerging risks, and growth opportunities in concise, executive-ready terms.
* Ensure leadership receives actionable insights and recommendations rather than simply reports and dashboards.

**2. Commercial Performance & Predictability**

* Evaluate pipeline health, coverage, movement, conversion, sales velocity, deal slippage, and forecast risk.
* Analyze performance across customers, service lines, markets, geographies, and revenue streams.
* Recommend focused interventions to improve commercial performance and revenue predictability.

**3. Revenue Operating Model**

* Establish clear business definitions for pipeline stages, opportunity categories, forecast classifications, and critical revenue measures.
* Identify broken handoffs, recurring exceptions, duplicated effort, and unnecessary manual work across the revenue lifecycle.
* Redesign high-value processes, define required business rules and controls, and drive adoption of the improved operating model.

**4. Marketing, Sales & Finance Alignment**

* Connect Marketing activity to qualified pipeline and revenue outcomes, including funnel conversion, lead quality, attribution, and channel effectiveness.
* Support Sales with pipeline, forecast, conversion, and account insights.
* Help Finance connect commercial expectations with bookings, backlog, and revenue realization.
* Create a consistent and trusted fact base across Sales, Marketing, Alliances, Finance, and leadership while respecting each function's responsibilities and decision rights
  **.**

**5. GTM Systems Effectiveness, Data & CRM Governance**

* Be accountable for the business effectiveness, data quality, governance, and adoption of the GTM technology ecosystem, with Salesforce serving as the primary commercial source of truth.
* Define business requirements and operating standards for opportunity hygiene, field consistency, close dates, lead and campaign data, source attribution, metric definitions, workflows, reporting discipline, and user adoption.
* Work hand-in-hand with Salesforce, BI, data, and technology specialists to translate GTM requirements into scalable architecture, integrations, automation, and system improvements.
* Ensure business outcomes and user adoption remain the primary focus of technology improvements.

**6. Strategic Revenue Initiatives, Automation & AI**

* Lead a focused portfolio of initiatives that materially improve revenue visibility, predictability, or operating effectiveness.
* Frame complex commercial problems, prioritize opportunities by business impact and feasibility, and define the desired operating outcomes.
* Coordinate implementation with relevant functional and technical specialists.
* Identify practical applications of analytics, automation, and AI to improve forecasting, data quality, decision support, and recurring revenue processes.

**Required Technical Skills & Competencies**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Engineering, Analytics, Information Systems, or a related field.
* 10+ years of relevant experience in Revenue Operations, GTM Operations, Sales Operations, Commercial Operations, Revenue Intelligence, or Commercial Strategy.
* At least 5 years in senior roles involving revenue analysis, commercial operations, or cross-functional revenue management.
* Strong understanding of complex B2B revenue models, including pipeline, forecasting, bookings, backlog, revenue realization, and customer growth.
* Strong commercial and financial acumen, with the ability to connect revenue expectations to operational and financial outcomes.
* Deep working knowledge of Salesforce from a Revenue Operations perspective, including data model concepts, workflows, governance, adoption, and integration patterns. Hands-on development is not required.
* Experience with marketing automation and GTM platforms such as Pardot / Marketing Cloud Account Engagement, Amplemarket, or comparable tools.
* Advanced Excel capabilities and experience with BI platforms such as Power BI.
* Experience defining metrics, analytical frameworks, business requirements, GTM processes, data standards, system adoption measures, and executive reporting.
* Ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive cross-functional outcomes without relying on direct authority.

**Must-Have Skills**

* Substantial experience in Revenue Operations, GTM Operations, Sales Operations, Commercial Operations, Revenue Intelligence, or Commercial Strategy.
* Experience in senior roles involving revenue analysis, commercial operations, or cross-functional revenue management.
* Strong understanding of B2B revenue models, pipeline management, forecasting, bookings, backlog, and revenue realization.
* Strong commercial and financial acumen.
* Deep working knowledge of Salesforce for Revenue Operations, including governance, data quality, workflows, adoption, and integrations.
* Advanced Excel skills and experience with BI tools such as Power BI.
* Experience developing executive-level reporting, defining business metrics, and
  translating analysis into actionable recommendations.
* Ability to align Sales, Marketing, Finance, Alliances, and other stakeholders around shared commercial outcomes.
* Strong process design, analytical, prioritization, and problem-solving capabilities.

**Good to Have Skills**

* Experience in technology services, SaaS, consulting, cloud, AI, digital engineering, or another complex B2B environment.
* Experience with marketing automation and GTM platforms such as Pardot / Marketing Cloud Account Engagement and Amplemarket.
* Practical experience using AI tools such as Claude or equivalent platforms to improve analysis, workflows, data quality, or decision support.
* Exposure to SQL, data modeling, advanced analytics, automation, or AI-enabled decision support.
* Ability to learn adjacent GTM platforms and technologies quickly.

**Desired Attributes**

* A strategic thinker who remains grounded in data and measurable business outcomes.
* Intellectually curious, independent in judgment, and commercially pragmatic.
* Able to simplify complex business questions and communicate a clear point of view.
* Constructively challenges inconsistent information and unsupported assumptions.
* Comfortable working directly with senior executives and functional leaders.
* Strong at distinguishing between commercial, process, data, and technology issues.
* Highly structured, proactive, and disciplined in prioritization and follow-through.
* A collaborative team player with a positive attitude and a great personality.

title: Demand and Parts Planning Analyst
description:
Aristocrat is seeking a diligent and analytical Demand & Parts Planning Analyst to support global supply chain operations through forecasting, planning systems management, inventory analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  
  
This role plays an important part in maintaining planning system integrity, generating demand projections, evaluating operational performance, and identifying opportunities to improve inventory outcomes, forecast quality, and process efficiency. Working closely with planning, procurement, manufacturing, logistics, and operations teams, this position helps translate data into actionable insights that strengthen decision-making across demand and parts planning activities.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines supply chain planning experience with strong analytical capabilities, attention to detail, and a passion for improving business processes and operational results.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Manage critical system settings, replenishment parameters, and data relationships that influence inventory positioning and material availability.
* Build and maintain planning structures and product relationships that enable effective material, repair, returns, and service parts execution.
* Generate demand projections and planning inputs using established methodologies, system capabilities, and business assumptions.
* Evaluate performance trends, identify drivers of variance, and uncover opportunities to improve operational results.
* Investigate exceptions impacting inventory, service levels, or forecast performance and develop actionable corrective measures.
* Administer material disposition decisions and system transactions that optimize inventory outcomes and product flow.
* Monitor yield performance, highlight emerging risks, and recommend adjustments that improve operational effectiveness.
* Create recurring insights, metrics, and reporting that increase visibility and strengthen decision-making.
* Assemble information and business context for recurring reviews, operational discussions, and supply chain forums.
* Partner with cross-functional teams to resolve data issues, improve execution, and align business priorities.
* Find opportunities to simplify workflows, improve data quality, and increase organizational efficiency.
* Present findings, observations, and improvement opportunities to collaborators across a global organization.

What We’re Looking For
  
  

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Supply Chain, Operations, Business, Engineering, Analytics, or a related field.
* 5+ years of experience in demand planning, supply planning, inventory management, materials planning, procurement planning, or other supply chain roles involving forecasting, replenishment, or inventory optimization.
* Knowledge of forecasting methods, inventory concepts, replenishment strategies, and operational planning practices.
* Experience working with ERP, MRP, APS, or other technology platforms used to manage supply chain activities.
* Familiarity with planning master data, product structures, planning attributes, or related system administration responsibilities.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills with the ability to analyze large data sets and translate information into meaningful insights.
* Demonstrated problem-solving capability, including root cause investigation and recommendation development.
* Experience measuring business performance, interpreting trends, and driving data-informed decisions.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to build effective partnerships across global teams.
* Curiosity, attention to detail, process rigor, and a continuous improvement approach.

*This job description may have been reviewed and enhanced using AI-assisted tools to improve clarity, consistency, and inclusivity. All final content, role requirements and hiring decisions remain subject to human review and approval by Aristocrat.*
**Compensation Philosophy**
We offer a comprehensive pay and benefits package designed to stay competitive in the market, support your wellbeing, and recognise your contribution to our success. Our approach is underpinned by a pay-for-performance belief in rewarding individual impact. Your specific compensation package will be determined by factors such as your skills, experience, qualifications, and location.
  
  
Depending on your role and location, you may be eligible for annual bonuses and incentives, health and wellbeing benefits, paid time off, retirement plans, insurance coverage, and other local or statutory benefits.
  
  
Specific details about compensation and benefits for this position will be discussed during the recruitment process.

description:

**Manager, FAST Policy Admin System, Life Actuarial, EY GDS Consulting**

* Lead a diverse, highly motivated and collaborative team
* Be part of a high-performing, supportive culture
* Work with a team of collaborators, innovators and the brightest minds in the industry

Global Delivery Services is one of EY's greatest global assets – a network of service delivery centers that provide high-quality services at a competitive cost for all EY’s client serving and enablement teams. Every day, we combine our subject matter expertise with our technology and automation skills to develop new solutions that deliver greater value for EY. If you have a passion for enabling world class actuarial services globally to solve the most complex challenges in the financial services industry, come join our dynamic GDS team!
  
  
**The opportunity**
We are looking for a Manager to join our Life Insurance Actuarial Practice delivering Policy Admin System or FAST product configuration to the leading clients in Insurance Sector, working closely with other Staff/Assistants, Consultants/Seniors, Managers, Senior Managers or Client partners in EY’s global network of insurance sector and consulting professionals.
  
  
You can expect to work along with senior managers/directors to support large scale engagements and deliver high-quality client solutions. You will develop and maintain long-term relationships and networks, build and energize a high performing team.
  
  
Our growing team of professionals come from a diverse background, all committed to being long term trusted advisors to our clients.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
As a Manager within Policy Admin System or FAST product configuration your role involves developing and implementing solutions both within the Insurance service line and in collaboration with other services lines
*.*
**On engagements, you will:**

* Responsible for providing high quality results and generating effective solutions working along with Senior Consultants, Managers or Senior Managers in delivering the project

* Provide focused solutions and training to Staff/Senior members

* Establish/manage priorities, create/manage work plans, communicate the status of activities, and accumulate/report all chargeable hours
* Maintain a strong stakeholder focus and maintain/develop productive working relationships with stakeholders and other team members

**Within the actuarial practice you will:**

* Strong life insurance and/or annuity product knowledge
* Product Values Testing (PVT) and expected-value development
* Actuarial testing tool development (Excel/VBA, Python preferred)
* Conversion validation and reconciliation experience
* Defect triage and root-cause analysis
* FAST, ALIP, LifePro, CyberLife, or similar PAS experience preferred
* Ability to translate product specifications into test scenarios and expected results
* Ability to review work done by junior members, ensuring quality of work product during time sensitive deadlines
* Strong presentation and documentation skills
* We are looking for individuals who have a proactive attitude and are seeking the opportunity for personal and professional growth, leveraging, and supporting our global network.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
Skills and attributes for a successful career at EY require a learning mindset and passion to add value to GDS, member firms and client organisations. Bright and enthusiastic individuals who give their all to each assignment they work on will find themselves at home within our energetic GDS actuarial team.
  
  
**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Qualified or Part/ nearly Qualified Actuary or Policy Admin System expect with at least 8+ years to 15 years of experience in Life Insurance industry, either within a consulting firm or an Insurer or an organisation providing Insurance services
* Ability to multi-task and flexible work attitude packed with good analytical skills
* Experience of handling a moderate sized team will be an advantage
* Proficiency in MS-Office Suite, Power BI, VBA, SAS, R Programming, Python, SQL, SPSS, etc., will be a plus

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Strong academic background with a bachelor’s degree with an emphasis in actuarial science, mathematics, statistics or finance related supplemented ideally with a professional qualification
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for report writing industry studies and stakeholder presentations
* Ability to review work done by junior members, ensuring quality of work product during time sensitive deadlines
* The ability to build relationships with colleagues across the business, support them and promote a collaborative environment
* Overseas exposure (especially US/Canada/Europe/UK/Australia market experience)

**What We Look For**

* Deep knowledge and experience of the insurance industry and/or consulting. Relevant recent big 4 experience in leading actuarial engagement with recognised insurers will be an advantage. This ideally should be complemented by employment experience within the Insurance sector either at an insurer, intermediary or regulator
* Up to date knowledge of the regulatory environment impacting insurers and other financial service organisations
* Experience of supporting teams to high quality timely delivery, actively building relationships and promoting a collaborative culture when working with colleagues

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

description:
**ANSR is hiring for one of its clients.**

**ABOUT KROGER:**

The Kroger Co., founded in 1883 by Barney Kroger and headquartered in Cincinnati, Ohio, is one of the largest retailers in the United States, serving millions of customers every day through a family of supermarket, multi-department, and marketplace store formats. With more than 2,700 stores across 35 states, supported by 32 manufacturing locations, 38 distribution centers, and over 400,000 associates, Kroger operates on a significant scale. Guided by its purpose to Feed the Human Spirit™, Kroger focuses on providing fresh, affordable food and an outstanding customer experience while investing in communities through initiatives like Zero Hunger | Zero Waste. Combining a strong store footprint with a growing digital presence, Kroger is transforming how Americans shop.

**ABOUT KROGER CAPABILITY CENTER (KCC):**

At Kroger Capability Center (KCC), we help modernize how work gets done at Kroger. KCC brings together expertise, technology, and global delivery to simplify work and strengthen cross-functional execution, so teams across Kroger can improve focus, speed, and impact. Our goal is to help associates, stores, and customers by making work faster, smoother, and easier to use – so more time can be spent on the highest-value outcomes. We see ourselves as an extension of the Kroger Store Support Center in Cincinnati, where everything we do is designed to support stores, associates, and the customers they serve. Through KCC, we tap into strong talent and capabilities in India to bring Kroger’s purpose – To Feed the Human Spirit – to life in new and impactful ways.

**FUNCTIONAL EVP:**

**Keeping products moving to where customers need them:**

At Kroger Capability Center India, Supply Chain plays a critical role in ensuring Kroger customers find the products they need, when and where they need them. From sourcing and inventory planning to replenishment and logistics, our teams help keep products moving efficiently across the enterprise. At KCC, associates work at the center of key business decisions, partnering across Merchandising, Manufacturing, Transportation, Distribution, and Stores. The work is fast-paced, data-driven, and highly collaborative, with decisions that directly impact product availability, operational efficiency, and the customer experience.

**OUR VALUES:**

**In fulfilling Our Purpose, we live by our Kroger Values:**

**Honesty:**

We insist on truthfulness with each other, with our customers, with our vendors and in our business records. We expect and value openness.

**Integrity:**

We act in accordance with our values, even when it’s difficult.

**Respect:**

We treat all with dignity and value the opinions and perspectives of others.

**Diversity:**

We seek and embrace differences in the backgrounds, cultures and ethnicities of all associates, customers and vendors.

**Safety:**

We protect our customers and each other from injury with a safe and secure workplace and shopping environment.

**Inclusion:**

We encourage and expect collaboration, teamwork and the active involvement of all associates.

**OUR COMMITMENT TO EQUAL OPPORTUNITY:**

We are committed to creating an environment of respect, inclusion, and equal opportunity for all. We believe that a diverse workforce strengthens our ability to serve customers and communities effectively. We seek to attract, develop, and retain talent from a wide range of backgrounds and perspectives – ensuring that everyone has the opportunity to contribute and grow. We provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, age, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. This commitment reflects our broader purpose – to serve people, support communities, and create an environment where individuals can do their best work.

**Talent Value Proposition statement:**

At Kroger Capability Center India, your expertise becomes part of something bigger. Work alongside global teams, build capabilities across critical business functions, solve meaningful challenges, and help shape how Kroger operates and grows. As the center takes shape, you have the opportunity to contribute early, learn continuously, and see the connection between your work and the millions of customers Kroger serves.

**Position Summary:**

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
**What makes us Qlik?**
A Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ Leader for 16 years in a row, Qlik helps teams get more out of AI with trusted data products, a powerful analytics engine, and AI agents. This helps teams reduce risk and operating costs, while scaling AI responsibly.
  
  
Used by 75% of the Fortune 500, Qlik works with the systems organizations already use, maintaining flexibility without lock-in.
  
  
**The Technical Support Engineer Role**
At Qlik, our support Technicians are our HEROES. That’s because our technicians do more than manage complex technical support cases they are determined, resilient, and have an unshakable positive mindset. Our team in Bangalore consists of support professionals from multiple backgrounds, who work and play closely together. We have a larger Global support team that we interact with daily, with locations in Bangalore, Barcelona, Lund, Sydney, Tokyo, China, Raleigh and North Carolina USA. We think you will love it here!
  
  
We operate 24x7 which involves working during one of the below shifts determined as per business need and have a non-standard work week (Ex: Tue - Sat, Wed - Sun). While we have 5 days a work week, your weekly offs may fall on any day of the week depending on the shift rosters that are prepared on a two-month basis.
  
  

* AMER hours (Eastern Standard Time - 5.30 PM/6.30 PM IST or Pacific Standard Time – 8:30 PM/9:30 PM IST onwards depending on Daylight Savings Time)
* EMEA hours – 12:00 PM/1 PM/2PM IST onwards depending on Daylight Savings Time
* APAC hours – 5.30 AM IST onwards

**Work hours are subject to change depending on Business needs.**
**What makes this role interesting?**
Teamwork is important and we are looking for someone who’s up for collaborating. A buddy will be there for you at the start, and you’ll report to the team manager.
  
  
We will support you in your onboarding and training, and we expect you to quickly take ownership of tasks. It won’t be long before you’re running your own assignments and making a real difference all by yourself. Prove yourself and you’ll find career progression will follow.
  
  
We’ll share ways of working and expect you to follow them, it’s all about keeping professional standards high and errors low while delivering the best experience and outcomes for our customers.
  
  
**Here’s How You’ll Be Making An Impact**

* The Technical Support Engineer team members will provide telephone, screen sharing, and ticket/chat-based support to our customers.
* Troubleshoots customer-submitted problems by working together with our customers in a collaborative manner.
* Keeps customers updated regularly with the current state of their tickets.
* Investigate customers’ current situation and desired end state to understand our customers’ needs and problems.
* Provides world-class customer experience by delivering satisfaction to every case for every customer.
* Interact with customers, understanding their problems and needs.
* Seeks workarounds and communicates technical solutions to the customer.
* Remain current with the Qlik and Talend product portfolio functions and features, and with related technologies in the DI ecosystem.
* Participate in the 24\*7 weekend support for production down tickets.
* Reproduces customer problems in the lab.
* Assists in translating the customer problem into suitable technical terms for the R&D Support team to work on.
* Exhaust all efforts according to the working procedures before escalating a case.
* Maintain a shared knowledge base across the team by writing technical solution articles, documenting lessons learned from support cases, and participating in weekly meetings.
* Keep case summaries on cases for escalations and continuity.
* Maintain coherent working procedures to reflect a professional attitude and maintain efficiency.

**We’re Looking For a Teammate With**

* You have a bachelor’s degree in IT or equivalent.
* 2+ years of experience in three or more areas listed below.
* Database Administration: Strong DBA skills
* Good to have experience in Replication technology with emphasis on CDC (Change Data Capture) & FDL (Full Data Load)
* Database: You have good working knowledge of ONE or any of the following or RDBMS: Oracle, SQL Server, DB2, Teradata, MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB
* Strong grasp on SQL Commands such as DDL, DML, TCL commands.
* Linux: Seasoned on the command line; comfortable with built-in tools like top, iostat, lsof, and netstat.
* Should be willing to work on Shifts (Rotational Basis) including night shifts.
* Provide support for QLIK & Talend Data Integration product portfolio.
* Must have good Troubleshooting and analytical skills, Problem Management & RCA

**The location for this role is:**
Bangalore-India (This is a hybrid opportunity based in JP Nagar Bangalore location).
  
  
**Apply now and help change how the world transforms complex data landscapes into actionable insights and turns complex data challenges into new opportunities!**
**More About Qlik And Who We Are**
Find out more about ‘Life at Qlik’ on social: Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, and X/Twitter, and to see all other opportunities to join us and our values, check out our Careers Page.
  
  
**What else do we offer?**

* Genuine career progression pathways and mentoring programs.
* Culture of innovation, technology, collaboration, and openness.
* Flexible, diverse, and international work environment.

Giving back is a huge part of our culture. Alongside an extra “change the world” day plus another for personal development, we also highly encourage participation in our Corporate Responsibility Employee Programs
  
  
If you need assistance applying for a role due to a disability, please submit your request via email to accessibilityta@qlik.com. Any information you provide will be treated according to Qlik’s Recruitment Privacy Notice. Qlik may only respond to emails related to accommodation requests.

All resumes submitted by search firms to any employee at Qlik via-email, the Internet or in any form and/or method without a valid written search agreement in place for this position will be deemed the sole property of Qlik. No fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by Qlik as a result of the referral or through other means.

title: Oracle Exadata Architect
description:
**Job Description**
**About the Company / Team**
Join Oracle CSS organization, where you will work with enterprise customers to manage and optimize mission-critical database environments.

You will collaborate with experienced technical professionals to resolve complex database challenges, enhance system reliability, and deliver high-quality customer support.
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are seeking an experienced
**Oracle Exadata / RAC DBA Architect**
to provide advanced technical support, administration, troubleshooting, and architectural guidance for enterprise Oracle database environments.
  
  
The ideal candidate will have
**10+ years of experience in Oracle RAC database administration or Engineered Systems**

This role involves resolving complex production issues, implementing database upgrades and migrations, optimizing performance, and collaborating directly with enterprise customers.
  
  
The successful candidate must be comfortable working in a customer-facing technical environment, participating in 24×7 rotational shifts, including US working hours, and working from the Bengaluru office.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Database Architecture & Advanced Troubleshooting: Provide architect-level technical support for Oracle RAC and Exadata environments, diagnosing and resolving complex database, clustering, storage, and availability issues.
* Database Administration & Lifecycle Management: Manage Oracle database installations, configurations, upgrades, migrations, and patching to maintain stability, security, and operational efficiency.
* High Availability & Disaster Recovery: Implement, administer, and troubleshoot Oracle RAC, Data Guard, ASM, and RMAN backup and recovery solutions to ensure business continuity.
* Performance Monitoring & Optimization: Investigate database performance bottlenecks, analyze diagnostic data, and recommend effective tuning and optimization strategies.
* Customer Technical Engagement: Collaborate directly with enterprise customers to understand technical challenges, provide expert recommendations, and deliver timely, effective resolutions.
* Critical Incident Resolution: Lead technical investigations of high-priority production issues, coordinate with internal engineering and support teams, and drive issues toward resolution.
* Technical Documentation & Knowledge Sharing: Develop troubleshooting guides, technical documentation, knowledge articles, and best practices to improve support effectiveness.
* 8.24×7 Operational Support: Participate in rotational shifts, including night shifts and US timings, to provide continuous support for business-critical Oracle database and Exadata environments.

**Responsibilities**
**Qualifications & Skills**
**Mandatory Requirements**

* Experience: Minimum 10 years of hands-on experience in Oracle RAC database administration, Oracle Engineered Systems administration, or database architecture.
* Oracle RAC: Strong expertise in Oracle Real Application Clusters, including configuration, administration, troubleshooting, and high-availability operations.
* Oracle ASM: Advanced knowledge of Automatic Storage Management, including storage administration, disk group management, and troubleshooting.
* Oracle Data Guard: Practical experience configuring, administering, monitoring, and troubleshooting Data Guard environments.
* RMAN Backup & Recovery: Strong hands-on experience in Oracle Recovery Manager, database backup and recovery procedures, and restoration scenarios.
* Database Diagnostics: Demonstrated ability to investigate and resolve complex Oracle database issues using diagnostic tools, logs, and performance analysis.
* Database Lifecycle Management: Experience with Oracle database installation, patching, upgrades, and migrations.
* Customer Interaction: Strong customer-facing technical support experience, including troubleshooting discussions, proactive recommendations, and issue resolution.
* Communication & Collaboration: Ability to communicate complex technical findings clearly to both technical teams and non-technical stakeholders.
* Shift Flexibility: Willingness to work night shifts, US timings, and 24×7 rotational support schedules.
* Work Location: Willingness to work from the Bengaluru office.

**Good-to-Have Qualifications**

* Hands-on experience administering, troubleshooting, or optimizing Oracle Exadata Engineered Systems.
* Knowledge of Oracle Exadata hardware and software platforms, including X8, X9M, or newer generations.
* Experience with Oracle GoldenGate for replication and database migration.
* Exposure to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) and cloud-based database services.
* Familiarity with Zero Data Loss Recovery Appliance (ZDLRA).
* Advanced database performance tuning experience, including SQL optimization, wait-event analysis, AWR/ASH analysis, and performance troubleshooting.
* Experience participating in Exadata deployment, upgrade, patching, and migration projects.
* Educational qualification such as BE, BTech, MCA, CA, or equivalent.

**Candidate Self-Assessment Questions**
Before applying, consider the following questions to evaluate your suitability for this role.
  
  

* Oracle RAC & Architecture: Do I have at least 10 years of hands-on experience administering, architecting, and troubleshooting Oracle RAC databases or Oracle Engineered Systems in enterprise production environments?
* High Availability & Recovery: Can I independently configure, administer, and troubleshoot Oracle RAC, ASM, Data Guard, and RMAN backup and recovery solutions, including handling critical production recovery scenarios?
* Advanced Troubleshooting & Database Lifecycle: Have I successfully resolved complex Oracle database incidents and managed installations, patching, upgrades, or migrations in business-critical environments?
* Customer-Facing Technical Expertise: Am I comfortable working directly with enterprise customers, investigating challenging technical issues, and clearly communicating technical findings and recommendations to different stakeholders?
* 5.Shift & Work Location Flexibility: Am I willing and able to work from the Bengaluru office and participate in 24×7 rotational shifts

**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.

That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.

title: Redwood RunMyFinance Solution Designer
description:
**Job Information**
-------------------

* Date Opened 11/25/2026
* Job Type Full time
* City Chennai
* State/Province Tamil Nadu
* Country India
* Zip/Postal Code 600096
* Industry Technology

**Job Description**
-------------------

As a Redwood RunMyFinance Solution Designer, you will be responsible for translating Finance business requirements into scalable, secure, and supportable automation solutions using Redwood RunMyFinance capabilities. You will work closely with Finance stakeholders, process owners, functional consultants, Redwood engineers, integration teams, and platform experts to define end-to-end solution designs aligned with enterprise architecture principles, Finance controls, platform standards, and operational support requirements.

The role includes solution assessment, architecture and design documentation, technical guidance, governance oversight, solution standardization, and support throughout implementation, testing, deployment, and transition to operations.

**Who You Are**
===============

* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Finance Technology, or a related field.
* Language: Proficiency in English, both verbal and written.
* Strong ability to communicate technical concepts to Finance and business stakeholders.
* Comfortable working across global, cross-functional, and multi-technology teams.

**Professional Skills, Qualifications, and Experience**
=======================================================

**Primary Skills**
------------------

* 7–12 years of experience in enterprise automation, Finance technology, or solution design, including significant experience with Redwood RunMyFinance.
* Strong understanding of Finance processes, including Record to Report, General Ledger, Journal Entry processing, Intercompany Accounting, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Financial Closing, and Reconciliation.
* Experience designing Finance automation for accruals, BSC, BSAR, and journal-entry (JE) posting, including SAP FI/CO integration, posting controls, and reconciliation.
* Strong knowledge of Redwood components, including processes, chains, data transformers, tables, forms, parameters, calendars, queues, and alerting mechanisms.
* Experience designing solutions using Redwood Orchestrator, Runner, and Workbench.
* Ability to define automation logic using REL and JavaScript expressions.
* Strong understanding of SAP S/4HANA, SAP ECC, and relevant FI/CO integration patterns.
* Experience designing data ingestion, transformation, validation, exception-handling, and reconciliation logic.
* Ability to translate functional requirements into solution architecture, process-flow designs, technical specifications, data mappings, integration designs, security requirements, and monitoring concepts.
* Knowledge of APIs, file-based integrations, database connectivity, ETL patterns, and enterprise middleware.
* Understanding of secure development, auditability, segregation of duties, and Finance control requirements.
* Experience reviewing technical designs and guiding engineering teams during implementation.
* Knowledge of unit testing, system integration testing, regression testing, and user acceptance testing.
* Experience designing reusable components and scalable automation frameworks.

**Secondary Skills**
--------------------

* Strong analytical and structured problem-solving capabilities.
* Consulting mindset with the ability to challenge and refine requirements constructively.
* Ability to assess feasibility, complexity, dependencies, risks, and implementation options.
* Understanding of enterprise architecture and technology-governance practices.
* Familiarity with HTML, CSS, Java, SQL, scripting, and cloud or integration technologies is advantageous.
* Experience with IT service management, release management, and production-support processes.
* Ability to facilitate design workshops with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong documentation, presentation, and stakeholder-management skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience working within Global Business Services or Finance transformation environments.
* Knowledge of Power BI, SAP BW, SAP Datasphere, or Snowflake is an advantage.
* Redwood or SAP Finance certifications are an advantage.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* Lead discovery and solution-design workshops with Finance stakeholders, process owners, and technology teams.
* Understand business requirements, current process pain points, control requirements, data sources, and expected automation outcomes.
* Evaluate requirements for feasibility, suitability, complexity, dependencies, and alignment with Redwood RunMyFinance capabilities.
* Design end-to-end Redwood RunMyFinance solutions covering workflow orchestration, data processing, user interaction, business rules, controls, exception handling, and monitoring.
* Define end-to-end design patterns for accruals, BSC, BSAR, and JE-posting workflows, covering data validation, posting-status checks, exception handling, auditability, and reconciliation.
* Define the appropriate use of Redwood processes, chains, tables, forms, data transformers, parameters, calendars, and alerts.
* Produce solution-design documents, process flows, logical architecture diagrams, interface specifications, data mappings, and non-functional requirements.
* Define integration patterns between Redwood, SAP S/4HANA, SAP ECC, databases, file repositories, and other enterprise systems.
* Ensure proposed designs address security, access control, auditability, data protection, segregation of duties, performance, scalability, and operational support.
* Identify opportunities to reuse standardized components and reduce unnecessary customization.
* Provide technical direction and design clarification to Redwood engineers and integration teams during implementation.
* Review technical configurations, automation logic, and integration designs for adherence to approved standards.
* Support estimation and planning by identifying solution complexity, technical dependencies, delivery risks, and required skills.
* Establish acceptance criteria and support test scenarios for functional, integration, regression, and performance testing.
* Participate in solution reviews, design-authority forums, release-readiness reviews, and go-live decisions.
* Support SIT and UAT by analyzing defects, identifying root causes, and recommending design or configuration changes.
* Define monitoring, alerting, recovery, restart, reconciliation, and operational-support requirements.
* Ensure implementation, configuration, testing, and operational documentation is complete and maintained.
* Support production transition, knowledge transfer, hypercare, and handover to platform and operations teams.
* Contribute to the Redwood RunMyFinance roadmap, design standards, reusable patterns, and automation-governance framework.

**Key Deliverables**
====================

* Solution-design document and end-to-end process flows.
* Use-case solution designs for accruals, BSC, BSAR, and JE posting, with control points, interface mappings, and acceptance criteria.
* Integration architecture, interface specifications, and data-flow design.
* Security, access-control, error-handling, and exception-management design.
* Monitoring, alerting, recovery, and operational-support concept.
* Technical dependency, effort, and risk assessment.
* Testing approach and acceptance criteria.
* Deployment and production-transition design.
* Reusable solution patterns and design standards.

**Expected Outcomes**
=====================

* Scalable and maintainable Redwood RunMyFinance solutions.
* Clear alignment between Finance requirements and technical implementation.
* Reduced implementation risk through early design validation.
* Consistent application of platform and architecture standards.
* Improved reusability and reduced unnecessary customization.

Depends on business requirements.

title: BI Analyst
description:

We are hiring a BI Analyst to own the design, build and support of Power BI reporting for business teams across Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Credit, Mobility, Connected Vehicle and Warranty. The majority of the work is hands\-on Power BI development on top of data in Google Cloud (BigQuery). You will work directly with business users to understand what they need, model the data properly, and deliver dashboards people actually use.

* Build and maintain Power BI dashboards, reports and datasets end to end — requirement gathering, data model, DAX measures, visuals, publishing and support.

title: Database Architect
description:
**Job Role:**
Database Architect

**Experience:**
12+ years

**Job Location:**
Mumbai (Hybrid)

**Who we're looking for**

A Client-Facing Builder-Architect for databases: someone who can sit with a client's data and technology leaders and be deep in database schemas, execution plans, or data models. You bridge business priorities and technical execution, and you stay close enough to the database engine and the SQL code to know what you're advising on.

As our Lead Database Architect, you turn a fragmented, legacy database estate into a high-performing, resilient foundation the business can run on. You assess what's already there, decide what to retain, refactor, or migrate, and lead the build from operational persistence to scalable transactional and analytical workloads. Your mantra: a reliable, high-throughput database foundation with clean schemas and no more complexity than it needs.

**Here's what you look like:**

* **A trusted advisor.**
  You're the senior technical partner for client data and technology leaders, translating evolving business priorities into pragmatic database architecture and delivery decisions.
* **A zero-ego builder.**
  No ivory tower. You whiteboard schemas with the client, review queries, indexes, and stored procedures with the engineers, and dig into the execution plans yourself when it matters.
* **A data-integrity champion.**
  You care whether the data is accurate and consistent: ACID compliance, referential integrity, concurrency control, security, backup/recovery, and governance are part of the design from day one, not an afterthought.
* **A translator of business meaning.**
  You turn business rules, entity relationships, and integration requirements into normalized/denormalized schemas and precise database specifications that engineers can build from.
* **An enemy of unnecessary complexity.**
  You challenge over-engineering, favor clean relational and hybrid patterns that scale predictably, and keep the database tier ready for future operational and AI workloads without bloating it.
* **Calm with ambiguity.**
  When requirements shift and legacy schemas don't match the business story, you stay methodical and keep the work moving.
* **Commercially pragmatic.**
  You pick business outcomes, query speed, and delivery velocity over a theoretical, over-engineered design.
* **AI-forward.**
  You design database foundations that support modern AI-enabled workflows (such as vector search and RAG backends), and you use AI-assisted database engineering tools with appropriate security, privacy, and governance.
* **A mentor.**
  You lead and lift database developers and engineers through clear schema/code reviews and sound judgment.
* **At home in education data.**
  You're comfortable with education-sector data models and the standards around them, such as LTI, Ed-Fi, QTI, and CEDS.

**About the role**

We're hiring a senior Database Architect with deep cloud and enterprise database expertise (Azure SQL, PostgreSQL, and Microsoft data ecosystems) to lead a strategic database modernization and CRM-readiness engagement for a large education-sector client.

You'll work closely with client data and technology leaders as a senior technical partner, helping turn evolving business priorities into pragmatic database architecture and delivery decisions. You'll start by shaping and leading focused proofs of concept, then define the broader database modernization blueprint, migration strategy, and implementation roadmap.

**What you'll do**

* Assess the existing relational and operational database environment and decide what to retain, refactor, index, partition, or migrate.
* Define and guide end-to-end database architecture across transactional (OLTP), operational data stores (ODS), and analytical/reporting tiers.
* Design conceptual, logical, and physical database models, including normalized (3NF) core schemas, read-optimized views, and historical/temporal tracking structures.
* Turn business rules, entity definitions, and source mappings into robust schema specifications, ERD diagrams, and production-ready DDL scripts.
* Establish reusable patterns for database migrations, indexing strategies, partitioning, archival, data integrity, auditing, and role-based access control.
* Work with application developers, business analysts, and engineering teams so business logic is enforced properly across database constraints, transactions, and APIs.
* Define data readiness requirements, synchronization patterns, and integration boundaries between core databases and downstream CRM applications.
* Support master data management (MDM), identity resolution, deduplication, and cross-system entity matching at the database layer.
* Design high-performance query layers, materialized views, and reporting schemas that serve downstream BI and operational applications consistently.
* Lead and guide database engineers, reviewing schema changes, query performance, indexing, locking/blocking behavior, and deployment scripts.
* Ensure the database layer supports future analytics and AI use cases (e.g., vector embeddings, hybrid search) without adding unnecessary architectural complexity.
* Lead technical discovery, architecture reviews, whiteboarding sessions, and client discussions in a collaborative co-build model.

**What you'll bring**

* Strong hands-on expertise in enterprise relational and cloud databases (Azure SQL Database/Managed Instance, SQL Server, PostgreSQL), T-SQL/PLpgSQL, query tuning, execution plan analysis, indexing, and partitioning.
* Strong database-modeling experience across 3NF normalized models, dimensional models, surrogate/natural keys, temporal/SCD structures, and high-concurrency OLTP design.
* Experience with database security, encryption, row-level security, auditing, Entra ID integration, and governance tools like Microsoft Purview.
* Experience with database DevOps, schema version control (Git, Dacpac, Liquibase, or Flyway), and CI/CD pipelines.
* Deep understanding of high availability (HA), disaster recovery (DR), backup strategies, replication, and zero-downtime migration patterns.
* The ability to work through ambiguity, challenge unnecessary complexity, and explain database trade-offs clearly to business stakeholders.
* Strong consulting skills: converting strategic objectives into an executable database engineering roadmap.

**Nice to have**

* Experience integrating operational databases with Salesforce or other CRM platforms.
* Master Data Management (MDM) and identity resolution experience.
* Higher-education or K-12 data schema experience (e.g., Ed-Fi ODS, Banner, PeopleSoft).
* Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Cosmos DB, or pgvector/vector database capabilities.
* Experience with automated schema drift detection and database observability tools.

**Experience and qualifications**

* 12+ years of database engineering, administration, and architecture experience.
* At least five years leading enterprise database architecture, modeling, or modernization initiatives.

**How you work and communicate**

* **Builder first:**
  You'd rather benchmark a schema or query pattern in a proof of concept than argue it in a meeting.
* **Owner:**
  You care whether the database is fast, resilient, and trusted in production, not just whether the ERD got signed off.
* **Simplicity advocate:**
  You challenge unnecessary complexity and keep the schema and infrastructure as simple as the problem allows.
* **Calm with ambiguity:**
  You stay methodical when priorities shift and keep the work moving.
* **Bridge builder:**
  You translate between client data and technology leaders, application developers, and engineers, in terms each of them can use.
* **Clear explainer:**
  You describe database trade-offs to business stakeholders so they can make decisions with confidence.
* **Collaborative co-builder:**
  You lead discovery, reviews, and whiteboarding sessions with the client, not at them.
* **Mentor:**
  You guide database developers through reviews and share context generously.

title: Lead Security Engineer (Cloud & Application Security)
description:
***Experience***: 7+ years in security engineering, including 3+ years as lead / senior-most security engineer

***Mandatory Skills:*** Applied cryptography (envelope encryption, AWS KMS/HSM, mTLS), AWS security, application security (OAuth2/OIDC, JWT, OWASP, multi-tenant isolation), threat modelling, CI/CD security gates, incident response, Terraform, Python/shell

***Teir 1 institute candidates only apply***

***Role Summary***

First dedicated security engineer and sole owner of security for the product and platform: architecture, cryptography, application and cloud security, pipeline gates, detection and incident response. Personal data passing through the platform must be unreadable to the company, every record must be provable to a regulator years later, and one tenant must never see another’s data. Authority to block a release on a critical finding; this is not a scanner-and-report role.

***Key Responsibilities***

* Cryptography and key management: Envelope encryption, per-tenant key separation, customer-managed keys, crypto-shredding and key rotation under long retention.

* Ledger and receipt integrity: Signing keys, signing path and evidence chain for a tamper-evident consent ledger.

* Cloud security posture: SCP guardrails across multi-account AWS Organizations, IAM Identity Center, KMS key policy, network segmentation, CNAPP/CSPM selection and operation, and data residency in India.

* Application and SDK security: Design and code review of Node.js/TypeScript services, authorisation, tenant isolation, signed callbacks, and SDK supply chain (signed releases, SRI, CSP, iframe sandboxing).

* Shift-left and supply chain: SAST, SCA, secret and IaC scanning in GitLab CI/CD as blocking gates with a signed exception path.

* AI and LLM security: Secure patterns for Amazon Bedrock, RAG and vector stores; mitigations for prompt injection and data poisoning; OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and MITRE ATLAS.

* Detection and incident command: GuardDuty, CloudTrail, Security Hub and SIEM alerting; named incident commander for CERT-In and DPDP notifications.

* Assurance: Penetration tests, VAPT, tenant-isolation testing, ISO 27001/27701 and DPDP controls as automated checks, customer security questionnaires and a security whitepaper.

* Standards and team: Secure-by-design guidelines, threat models, design reviews and coaching engineers.

***Minimum Qualifications***

* 7 years of security engineering experience.

* At least 3 years as lead or senior-most security engineer for a production software product, owning design decisions.

* Applied cryptography designed, not just used: envelope encryption, key hierarchies and rotation on AWS KMS or HSM, certificate lifecycle and mTLS.

* Deep AWS security: IAM policy and trust boundaries, KMS key policies, SCPs, VPC segmentation, and CloudTrail, GuardDuty and Security Hub logging designed for auditors.

* Application security on a JavaScript/TypeScript codebase: OAuth2/OIDC, JWT, authorisation, multi-tenant isolation, OWASP Top 10 and API Top 10, and the browser security model (CSP, SRI, CORS, postMessage).

* Threat modelling as a practised discipline, with written threat models.

* Security gates built into CI/CD: SAST, SCA, secret and IaC scanning in GitLab or GitHub that block a build.

* Personally led incident response as incident commander, with a written postmortem.

* Terraform (read critically, write guardrails) and Python or shell for detection and remediation automation.

* Judgement to separate real risk from scanner noise and explain trade-offs in plain language.

***Preferred Qualifications***

* Tamper-evident or append-only structures in production: hash chaining, Merkle trees, signed receipts, RFC 3161 timestamping.

* Multi-tenant isolation designed and proved with authorisation testing.

* Customer-managed keys (BYOK/HYOK), HSM or KMIP delivery.

* Hands-on CNAPP/CSPM such as Wiz, or AWS-native security services at depth.

* Securing LLM integrations: Amazon Bedrock, RAG pipelines, vector stores, OWASP LLM Top 10, MITRE ATLAS.

* Supply-chain security: signed releases, SBOMs, build provenance (SLSA).

* Owning controls under DPDP, GDPR, ISO 27001, ISO 27701 or SOC 2 and producing audit evidence.

* Incident reported under a statutory clock to CERT-In or a regulator such as RBI, SEBI or IRDAI.

* Customer-facing security assurance: questionnaires, VAPT reports, architecture calls with BFSI or enterprise teams.

* Security beyond one cloud: private, on-premises or sovereign deployment.

* OSCP, penetration testing or bug bounty experience; AWS Certified Security – Specialty; CISSP or CCSP.

Pay: ₹1,600,000.00 - ₹2,800,000.00 per hour

Application Question(s):

* How many years of security engineering experience do you have in total?
* Have you been the lead or senior-most security engineer for a production software product for at least 3 years, owning the design decisions?
* Which AWS security services have you worked with hands-on? (Select all that apply)
* Which of the following have you personally designed or led? - Options- Envelope encryption and key rotation / mTLS and certificate lifecycle / Written threat models / CI/CD security gates (SAST, SCA, IaC) / Incident commander role / None
* Describe a security design decision you had to defend to an auditor, regulator or enterprise security team, and the evidence you produced.
