title: Senior Associate
description:
**Senior Associate, Consulting India**

**Chennai/Pune/Gurugram/Noida**

**Who is ZoomRx?**

ZoomRx is a rapidly growing life science market research and consulting company founded upon the belief that there is important work to be done at the intersection of data, healthcare, and technology. We help some of the world’s biggest biopharmaceutical companies answer questions no one else can. We support our clients through their entire business lifecycle; providing market intelligence that helps them launch new therapies, optimize promotional efforts, defend against competitive pressure, shape marketing strategies, and much more.

At ZoomRx we also have various impactful products (Ferma.AI, PERxCEPT, & HCP-PT). Ferma.AI provides healthcare intelligence to pharma firms of all sizes, making it easy for teams to stay on top of their market landscape and help them make informed decisions. PERxCEPT is a one-stop shop for omnichannel intelligence in the life sciences industry, providing visibility into every digital campaign in a market from the customer’s point of view. HCP-Pt conversations is a point-of-care market insights platform that gives a real-world view of the prescribing process. Brand Builder provides holistic insights programs for new brand launches and post-launch brand optimization.

At ZoomRx, we have a flat organization structure where everyone is encouraged to take risks, learn from mistakes, and continuously grow towards realizing their career goals. We offer a collaborative, environment that optimizes for the:

• pride in doing high-quality work

• joy of tackling creative, intellectually challenging work

• camaraderie of working with smart, grounded peers

**What will you be a part of?**

Consulting India works with drug commercialization teams at top pharma and biotech companies to understand their complex business needs and help them make informed decisions. The team creates strategic narratives for senior management teams of blockbuster drugs by designing and executing custom market research studies, conceiving new data analysis methods, and drawing insights from complex datasets.

**What does your day look like as a Senior Associate?**

• As a Senior Associate, you will be focusing on successful project execution

• You will be responsible for the execution of project activities that cover the project lifecycle from start to completion, including but not limited to:

o Data collection: Pressure-testing data collection tools and methods, ensuring that the data that flows in through these tools are accurate.

o Data processing: Monitoring data collected, performing pre-analysis sanity checks to ensure data quality and organizing the data in a way that’s easy to analyze

o Data analysis: Reviewing the data and data cuts in line with the client’s business questions and modifying existing/creating new views as required.

o Client delivery: Develop the client deliverable with inputs from the C/SC (typically in PowerPoint decks) in line with the storyboard finalized by the team. Through building these presentations, Associates are expected to build context on clients, projects and therapeutic areas

• At any given time, you will be expected to work on ~2 average-sized projects that span across different pharmaceutical brands/drugs from the same or different client.

**What will make you successful as a Senior Associate candidate?**

**Required Skills/Expertise:**

• A degree in life-sciences related/or a quantitative discipline (engineering, economics, business, statistics, mathematics)

• 1 to 3 years’ experience in life sciences and/or business analysis

• Demonstrated experience in preparing and delivering analytically robust, data-driven strategic stories

• Advanced level of proficiency in MS Office tools like Excel, PowerPoint, Word

• Good verbal and written communication skills. Ability to work in teams

**Preferred Skills/Expertise:**

• Experience in additional healthcare market intelligence functions besides primary market research (competitive intelligence; sales analytics; forecasting; etc.)

• Experience in qualitative market research

• Experience in Life Sciences or Healthcare industries.

**Why should you choose ZoomRx?**

• You will have wide-reaching creative control and the power to make impactful decisions. At ZoomRx, we favour collaboration over hierarchy.

• You will develop deep expertise in a wide range of topics within life sciences by drawing on existing knowledge bases while building new ones.

• You will work with smart, grounded peers who are experts in their own right and thrive on the camaraderie of working in high-performance, intelligent, impactful teams.

• You will join a vertically integrated organisation - with our own business consulting team, cutting-edge technology platform, and robust panels of healthcare professionals - empowered to provide our clients with highly tailored, fast, effective solutions that other consultancies cannot.

title: D365 Operations Subject Matter Expert (SME) - APAC
description:
Rotork is the market-leading global flow control and instrumentation company, helping our customers manage the flow or liquids, gases and powders across many industries worldwide.

Our purpose is Keeping the World Flowing for Future Generations.

For over sixty years, the world has relied on us to create the things that keep everything moving. From oil and gas to water and shipping, pharmaceuticals and food- these are the flows on which our modern world depends.

Today we're respected and admired for our people, performance and products. Our success flows from our commitment to engineering excellence, and that's what we will always pursue, safely and sustainably.

Rotork is going through an exciting period of change and growth, building on our existing market leadership. It's a great time to join us and make an impact in shaping the future of our business.

* Experience of driving continuous improvement

**Quality & Risk Management**

* Benchmark competitors on features, performance, technology, cost positioning and value proposition

**Business Case & Investment Planning**

* Build business case inputs: volume assumptions, cost estimates, investment needs, resources and profitability

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Work with Product Development, Manufacturing, Quality, Sourcing, Supply Chain, Sales & Marketing, Service, Finance and Program Management

**Governance & Program Support**

* Support stage-gate reviews, project approvals and program readiness assessments
* Track project assumptions, risks, dependencies and mitigation plans across the planning and industrialisation lifecycle

**Qualifications**

* B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical, Automobile, Electrical, Electronics or Mechatronics. An M.E./M.Tech or MBA is preferred.
* 5–10 years in automotive
* Working knowledge of market forecasting, competitor benchmarking, product costing and business case preparation
* Strong technical product orientation, commercial sense and stakeholder management

title: Associate Engineer (Computerized Maintenance Management System)
description:
At Shell, Early Career talent plays an important role in powering the future of energy. Through internships, apprenticeships, graduate programmes, and opportunities for students and early professionals, we empower individuals to learn, grow, and make meaningful contributions from day one. We support talent at different stages of their career journey through mentorship and exposure to diverse areas of our business, helping them build skills and explore future career pathways at Shell.
  
  
In our values-led culture, you'll have the opportunity to power your progress while helping develop the energy solutions of today and tomorrow.
  
  
**What’s The Role**
As an Associate Engineer - CMMS, you will support document management and data management activities for projects, plant changes, and ongoing operations. You will help maintain engineering documents and asset master data by ensuring information is captured, updated, controlled, validated, distributed, maintained, and archived in line with established information management standards and procedures. Working with global stakeholders, you will contribute to maintaining accurate, reliable, and high-quality information that supports safe and efficient operations.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Create and update asset master data and as-built information within maintenance management systems.
* Maintain asset tags, document-to-tag links, and maintenance management system data.
* Execute document control activities in accordance with approved procedures and standards.
* Perform document registration, numbering, transmittal processing, metadata maintenance, and dossier management activities.
* Support document review workflows, as-built document updates, records management, and data loading activities.
* Provide support across both data control and document control activities to ensure workload coverage and business continuity.
* Maintain the accuracy, completeness, and integrity of information within document and data management systems.
* Process document requests, archive searches, digitalisation activities, and document distribution requests.
* Ensure compliance with information management standards, procedures, and data quality requirements.
* Execute assigned document and data management activities and seek guidance for exceptional cases.
* Identify and support process improvement and digitalisation opportunities that improve productivity and operational efficiency.

**What You Bring**

* Fresh graduate or individual with up to 6 months of experience in information management, data management, or related activities.
* Exposure to field operations and maintenance within the oil and gas, refinery, petrochemical, or equivalent industry.
* Hands-on exposure to Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS) and data management tools such as GSAP or Aveva AIM-A.
* Hands-on exposure to document management systems such as Assai, AIM EDMS, or similar tools.
* Understanding of end-to-end project and operations information management lifecycle.
* Experience with either GSAP or Assai.
* Knowledge of Aveva AIM-A, E3D, SPI, Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, or Azure DevOps is advantageous.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
* Ability to adapt and work effectively with global teams across different cultures and time zones.
* Familiarity with Agile, Scrum, and continuous improvement practices.

**What We Offer**
You bring your skills and experience to Shell and in return you work with talented, committed people on one of the most important challenges facing our planet. You’ll have the opportunity to develop the skills you need to grow in an environment where we value honesty, integrity, and respect for one another. You’ll be able to balance your priorities as you become the best version of yourself.
  
  

* Progress as a person as we work on the energy transition together.
* Continuously grow the transferable skills you need to get ahead.
* Work at the forefront of technology, trends, and practices.
* Collaborate with experienced colleagues with unique expertise.
* Achieve your balance in a value-led culture that encourages you to be the best version of yourself.
* Benefit from flexible working hours, and the possibility of remote/mobile working.
* Perform at your best with a competitive starting salary and annual performance related salary increase – our pay and benefits packages are considered to be among the best in the world.
* Take advantage of paid parental leave, including for non-birthing parents.
* Join an organisation working to become one of the most diverse and inclusive in the world. We strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientation, and life experiences to apply.
* Grow as you progress through diverse career opportunities in national and international teams.
* Gain access to a wide range of training and development programmes.

We'd like you to know that Shell has a bold goal: to become one of the world’s most diverse and inclusive companies. You can get to know more about how we're working towards that goal,
**click here.**
**Shell in India**
Shell is a diversified energy company in India with 13,000 employees, and presence in Integrated Gas, Downstream, Power, Renewable and Upstream. Additionally, we have deep capabilities in R&D, digitalisation, and business operations.
  
  
Our global strategy, Powering Progress, is designed to generate value for our shareholders, customers, and the wider society, and focuses on creating more value with less emissions. The strategy supports our purpose of providing more and cleaner energy solutions, with the aim of profitably transforming Shell into a net-zero emissions energy business by 2050. As India moves towards its target of net-zero emissions by 2070, Shell India aims to play a leading role in securing vital energy for today, while investing in, and helping to build, the energy system of the future through strategic investments in the country.
  
  
Our Lubricants business serves over 50,000 consumers through a strong network of over 200 distributors, and operates an end-to-end value chain that spans conceptualization, development, and production at a world-class blending plant at Taloja. Through our 350-plus retail stations, we offer an integrated mobility experience including fuels, cafes, and convenience stores, with a prominent network of EV recharging facilities.
  
  
Shell owns and operates a LNG re-gasification terminal at Hazira, Surat, with a capacity of 5 MTPA and a LNG truck-loading unit that plays a crucial role in helping meet India’s growing demand for gas across sectors. In 2022, Shell acquired Sprng Energy in a $1.55 billion deal to build an integrated energy transition business in the country. Sprng is a leading renewable energy company in India which develops and manages solar, wind, and hybrid power generation facilities and infrastructure.
  
  
Our three capability centres across Bangalore and Chennai serve as a technology and innovation powerhouse for Shell globally, working as a delivery engine for core technical, digital, and finance processes: pioneering digital innovation and cutting-edge technologies across the energy sector. We also have strong academic partnerships and collaborations with leading universities and technology institutes to accelerate decarbonization efforts within the energy sector.
  
  
We are committed to positively contributing to the communities in which we operate through programmes on STEM Education, Skilling, and Livelihood across India. We nurture and invest in startups developing initiatives focused on accelerating energy innovation through programs such as Shell E4 and Shell Eco-marathon. We also have strategic investments in new energy companies such as Husk Power, d.light, Orb Energy, and Cleantech Solar.

description:
**About Rocketlane**

Rocketlane is a fast-growing, innovative SaaS company making waves in customer onboarding and professional services automation.

Our mission? To empower B2B companies with a smooth, consistent, and efficient way to onboard customers and manage client projects—reducing chaos and boosting customer satisfaction across industries.

We’re a close-knit team of over 200+ passionate professionals, all focused on building a product that teams love to use. Our journey has been fueled by $45M in funding from top investors, including 8VC, Matrix Partners, and Nexus Venture Partners.tners India, and super angels like Gokul Rajaram, Girish Mathrubootham, and Clark Valberg, etc.

**What will you do? (Role Overview)**

You’ll run discovery, solution design, configuration, integrations, and go-lives with a strong consultative voice. You’ll guide customers toward best practices, manage escalations when needed, and ensure they get value—fast. This is a high-ownership role designed for our future
**AI-first Professional Services org**
, where problem-solving, adaptability, and technical depth are essential.

**What You’ll Be Responsible For**

* Own the full onboarding lifecycle for enterprise customers—from kick-off to go-live.
* Lead requirement-gathering sessions and translate business workflows into Rocketlane configurations.
* Design and guide customers on best-practice implementations, even when that means pushing back or course-correcting.
* Work with customer teams (IT, HR, Finance, PMO, Ops) to design integrations with systems like HRMS, CRM, NetSuite, and fintech platforms.
* Collaborate with internal teams (Product, Engineering, Solutions) to unblock complex implementations.
* Manage risks, escalations, and tough conversations with clarity and calm.
* Adopt and shape AI-driven workflows to automate routine tasks and improve customer value delivery.
* Serve as the customer’s trusted advisor on onboarding processes, data flows, and integration patterns.

**Must-Have Skills**

**Technical & Integration Skills**

* **Hands-on experience with REST APIs, Webhooks**
  (reading API docs, testing endpoints, and understanding auth flows).
* Experience building or supporting
  **custom integrations**
  between SaaS platforms and third-party systems.
* Strong understanding of SaaS concepts: data models, webhooks, API limits, auth, and typical enterprise integration patterns.
* Comfortable working with tools like
  **Postman, Workato, Boomi, Zapier, Make, or other iPaaS solutions**
  .

**Implementation Expertise**

* 5+ years in a
  **customer-facing role at a SaaS company**
  (Implementations / Onboarding / Technical Consulting).
* Proven ability to
  **run enterprise onboarding projects**
  end-to-end with minimal supervision.
* Skilled in conducting discovery, documenting workflows, and translating requirements into system configurations.

**AI-First Aptitude**

* Strong curiosity and a builder mindset—someone who experiments, prototypes, and learns independently.
* Comfortable using modern AI-assisted development or scripting tools (e.g.,
  **Cursor, Replit, Lovable**
  or similar) to automate tasks, validate data, test APIs, or streamline workflows.
* Driven to “own your destiny” by building small scripts, utilities, or workflows that make onboarding faster, cleaner, and more scalable.

**Consultative & Communication Skills**

* Ability to
  **be assertive**
  —advise customers on the best approach rather than simply taking requirements.
* Experience navigating escalations and difficult conversations with professionalism.
* Excellent written and verbal communication; ability to simplify technical concepts.

**Problem-Solving & Ownership**

* Strong analytical skills with a bias for action—thrives in ambiguity.
* High ownership mentality: independently unblocks, drives outcomes, and keeps projects moving.

**Good-to-Have Skills**

* Experience implementing or supporting systems like
  **Salesforce, Workday/BambooHR, NetSuite, ERP/CRM/Finance tools**
  .
* Background in Professional Services, Customer Success, or PSA tools (Rocketlane, Asana, Wrike, Jira, ClickUp, Salesforce PSA).
* Understanding of SSO/SAML, enterprise IT processes, or data migration.
* Familiarity with SQL for basic data validation.
* Project Management certifications (PMP, CSM) or equivalent mindset.
* Experience in high-growth SaaS environments.

**You should apply if you:**

* Love owning customer outcomes end-to-end.
* Are technically curious and enjoy solving integration and workflow problems.
* Thrive in customer conversations—even the tough ones.
* I want to help shape the future of an
  **AI-first Professional Services org**
  .
* Are energized by autonomy, impact, and building something that scales.

**Why join us?**

At Rocketlane, we’re all about building a great product and a great place to work. Here’s why you’ll actually look forward to Mondays:

* **Impact and ownership**
  : You won’t just be another cog in the machine; here, you’re more like a turbocharged engine part. Bring your ideas, make them happen.
* **Work with the best**
  : We’re a team of passionate, quirky, and ridiculously talented people. Come for the work, stay for the memes.
* **Celebrate wins**
  : Whether we’re hitting major milestones or celebrating new funding, we like to mix it up. From
  rap videos
  to team outings, we believe in celebrating big.
* **Learn and grow**
  : We’re all about learning—and we’re not just talking about the latest SaaS trends. You’ll grow your career, pick up new skills, and maybe even learn to love Excel (or at least tolerate it).
* **Flexibility and balance**
  : While we love collaborating in the office five days a week, we know everyone has their own rhythm. That’s why we offer flexibility around hours—so you can bring your best energy, whether you’re an early bird or a night owl. Pyjamas optional (at least outside the office).

title: GxP Specialist
description:
The individual should serve as an independent Consultant for providing Compliance as a Service (CaaS) responsible for ongoing GxP compliance oversight and validation support for regulated systems across Clinical, Manufacturing, Quality, Regulatory and Learning domains (Eg{{:}} Trackwise Digital, Veeva QMS, Veeva RIM, Compliance wire, eTMF, Val Genesis, Kneat, SAP etc). This role ensures that computerized systems remain compliant with applicable regulations and industry standards through periodic reviews, vendor release assessments, data integrity oversight, audit trail reviews, risk assessments, validation lifecycle management, and inspection readiness activities.

The individual will work closely with business stakeholders, quality assurance, IT, system owners, and vendors to maintain validated states for GxP systems while supporting continuous compliance and operational excellence.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Serve as the Compliance consultant for computerized system implementation and enhancement projects
* Drive Computer Software Assurance (CSA) and Computer Systems Validation (CSV) activities in accordance with company SOPs and regulatory requirements
* Develop and execute validation strategies, plans, and related lifecycle documentation
* Support project teams in conducting risk assessments, impact assessments, and change assessments
* Ensure validation deliverables are completed on time and meet quality and compliance standards

* Author, review, and maintain validation documentation, including validation plans, protocols, reports, traceability matrices, and related records
* Collaborate with Business and IT teams to develop and execute validation test scripts
* Manage validation and compliance documentation throughout the system lifecycle
* Review and validate vendor software upgrades and associated documentation

* Plan, coordinate, and support periodic reviews of validated systems, including scheduling, review execution, and reporting
* Perform audit risk assessments to determine audit scope and requirements
* Support and participate in supplier/vendor audits with a focus on CSV, Data Integrity, Change Management, and Release Management processes
* Support in preparing audit reports and ensure follow-up actions are documented and completed

* Review, update, and manage SOPs, work instructions, user guides, templates, and other quality documents
* Draft, review, and maintain Quality Agreements with vendors and service providers
* Ensure ongoing compliance with GxP regulations, company standards, and quality requirements

* Proactively communicate project progress, risks, issues, and mitigation strategies to stakeholders
* Technical writing (e.g., User Requirements Specifications, SOPs, Work Instructions, User Guides, Templates)
* Perform Business Administration activities including support for business testing, issue escalation, and resolution.
* Perform production data entry activities such as creating/revising training curricula, assigning training, and preparing training reports
* Provide training support, including the development or revision of computer-based training modules and end-user training on QMS modules (as required).
* Perform data reviews to support improvements or resolve issues (e.g., User Access Reviews)
* Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, including Quality, IT, Business, and external vendors

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field
* 5+ years of job-related experience in Computer System Validation and Assurance
* Experience in Computer Systems Validation (CSV), Computer Software Assurance (CSA), or Quality/Validation roles within a regulated GxP environment
* Strong knowledge of GxP regulations, 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, GAMP 5, Data Integrity principles, and validation lifecycle methodologies
* Experience with risk-based validation approaches, change management, and supplier/vendor management
* Excellent problem-solving, technical writing, documentation, and communication skills
* Experience in leading validation activities for system implementations, upgrades and migration
* Ability to manage multiple projects and stakeholders in a fast-paced environment

title: Associate Engineer I - Mechanical Design
description:
**Job Overview**
The Associate Mechanical Engineer provides the engineering support needed for design and development of new and redesigned products to maintain production and performance of existing products. This role also provides additional engineering support for certification and standards activities.
  
  
A Day In The Life
  
  
Every Day At Hubbell Is Different And You’ll Contribute In Many Ways. On Any Given Day, You’ll Make a Difference By
  
  
Designing and developing new, redesigned, and purchased for resale products in accordance with the Hubbell Project Management System. With supervisor’s or manager’s direction, responsibility includes all PMS tasks assigned to engineering including concepts, design drawings, models, lab tests, project schedules and meetings, drawing release and tool and production approvals.
  
  
Providing engineer support for existing products and production issues. Analyzing and resolving production holds, Variation Notices, Deviation requests, EC / DCR’s, Tooling and Yellow Tag approvals, Product Transfers, Material Shortages and Product Modification Requests (Specials).
  
  
Providing engineer support for certification and standards (UL, CSA, etc.). With direction from the Manager, Standards and Certification, responsibility includes certifying new and revised products, product transfers and factory relocations, resolving variation notices, standard changes, bulletins and reviewing files and agency inspections and laboratory testing.
  
  
Keeping current with the codes, standards that affect our product lines and engineering procedures, materials, and processes.
  
  
Maintaining computer efficiency, which includes PC’s (word processor, spreadsheet, database, etc.), BOM systems (SAP), Codes and Standards Computer, and basic understanding of our CAD and drawing systems.
  
  
What will help you thrive in this role?
  
  
Associate Degree in Engineering or equivalent technical studies (required)
  
  
Understanding of CAD and drawing systems (required)
  
  
Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications
  
  
Proficiency with SAP
  
  
Experience with conflict resolution

As more products plug in to an aging grid, Hubbell solutions enable the transition to a more reliable, resilient and efficient energy infrastructure. Founded in 1888 our innovation has made us a leading global manufacturer of high quality electrical and utility solutions enabling customers to operate critical infrastructure reliably and efficiently.
  
  
The company operates in two segments. Hubbell Utility Solutions (HUS) enable the grid to conduct, communicate and control energy across utility applications and Hubbell Electrical Solutions (HES) are essential to managing power across a wide range of industries and applications. Our vertical market solutions can be applied to markets including Data Centers, Renewables, Commercial Buildings, Industrial, Telecom and Transportation. Supporting both of our business segments is our corporate and Hubbell Unified Business Solutions teams that provide consistent process, tools technologies across our businesses.
  
  
We are committed to operating sustainably and ethically while promoting an inclusive and supportive culture for our people to grow and develop in their careers. Our employees proudly work and serve our communities from our headquarters in Shelton, CT, across the United States and around the globe.

Functional areas include Engineering, Sales, Operations, Marketing, Finance, Legal, IT, Human Resources, Payroll, Environmental Health & Safety, and Compliance. title: Assembly & Integration Engineer
description:
**ABOUT**
**Agnikul Cosmos is a company incubated at IIT Madras and we build rockets that can take satellites up to 500 kg to Lower Earth Orbit (LEO). In May 2024, we successfully completed our maiden launch from our own launchpad (India's first private launchpad). The launch has proven all the new technologies developed by Agnikul and also earned recognition from Honourable Prime Minister of India.**
**We are looking for an
**Assembly & Integration Engineer**
to own the build definition of our launch vehicle — turning engineering designs into clear, repeatable, and safe
**assembly procedures**
that technicians execute on the production floor. This is a hands-on, floor-facing engineering role at the intersection of design, manufacturing, and quality. You will spend significant time on the shop floor with technicians, watching builds happen, and translating that first-hand knowledge into documentation that is precise enough to build flight hardware right the first time, every time.**
******RESPONSIBILITIES******
**Assembly Procedure Development (Primary Focus)**

* Author detailed, step-by-step assembly procedures for launch vehicle structures, propulsion systems, avionics, and subsystem integration — including torque values, fastener callouts, sequencing, tooling requirements, inspection/verification points, and acceptance criteria.
* Translate engineering drawings, CAD models, GD&T, and design intent into technician-executable work instructions with clear illustrations, photos, or callouts.
* Define build sequence and integration flow across major assemblies (e.g., stage structures, tanks, engines, avionics bays, harnessing, fluid/pneumatic systems).
* Build in mandatory inspection, hold, and verification points (in-process QA, torque checks, leak checks, continuity checks, fit checks) at the correct step in the sequence.
* Specify required tooling, jigs, fixtures, GSE, and PPE for each step; flag any special handling (ESD, cleanroom, hazardous fluids/gases, high-pressure systems).
* Own document control and revision of procedures — maintain traceability, incorporate engineering change orders (ECOs), and manage redlines/as-built markups from the floor.
* Pilot new procedures on the floor with technicians, capture feedback, and iterate until the procedure is unambiguous and repeatable.

**Hands-On Assembly & Integration Support**
  
  
  

* Work directly alongside technicians during builds, especially for first-articles and new hardware configurations, to validate procedures in real time.
* Troubleshoot fit, tolerance, and integration issues on the floor and drive them to root cause and corrective action.
* Lead or support mechanical/electrical integration of subassemblies into the final vehicle stack (structural mate, propulsion install, avionics integration, harness routing, fluid system buildup).

**Process & Quality Improvement**
  
  
  

* Continuously improve build procedures based on lessons learned, non-conformances, and technician feedback to reduce cycle time and defects.
* Drive non-conformance reports (NCRs) to disposition; support root-cause and corrective action (RCCA) investigations tied to assembly/procedure issues.
* Partner with Design Engineering to flag design-for-manufacturability/assembly (DFM/DFA) issues discovered during procedure creation or floor execution.
* Support configuration management — ensure procedures reflect the correct engineering baseline and as-built vehicle configuration.
* Develop and deliver training for technicians on new or revised procedures.

**Cross-Functional Interface**
  
  
  

* Work closely with Design Engineering, Systems Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, and Test teams to align procedures with requirements and verification needs.
* Support tooling and GSE requirement definition needed to execute procedures safely and repeatably.
* Provide technical support during launch site integration and vehicle processing, as needed.

Requirements
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Aerospace, Manufacturing, Electrical Engineering, or related field (or equivalent hands-on experience).
* 2+ years of experience in manufacturing/production engineering, assembly/integration, or test engineering — ideally in aerospace, automotive, or another highly regulated hardware industry.
* Demonstrated experience writing formal assembly, build, or test procedures/work instructions for complex hardware.
* Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, GD&T, schematics, and wiring diagrams.
* Hands-on experience with mechanical and/or electrical assembly (fasteners, torque tools, harnessing, fluid/pneumatic connections).

title: Support Engineer 2
description:
**Job Description**
Serves as a point of contact for customers, fielding inquiries via phone or electronic channels. Provides technical support by troubleshooting and resolving known issues encountered with assigned Oracle product(s). Collaborates with internal teams to report and contribute to the resolution of routine design, reliability, and maintenance issues. Maintains service request and/or product documentation and begins to create Knowledge Base articles and/or troubleshooting guides for resolved issues. Consults internal teams and stakeholders on diverse customer situations and technical issues. Begins to leverage automation/tooling (e.g., A.I. Assistance) to discover root causes of common issues and identities and begins to recommend enhancements to existing support processes, workflows, guidelines, and best practices.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Support and Solution Delivery-Customer Support and Advocacy:**

* Serves as a point of contact for customers and facilitates customer relationship building, fielding inquiries via phone, electronic, or in-person means.

**Technical Support and Solution Delivery-Technical Support Documentation:**

title: Analyst- Demand II IND
description:
**Job Description**
Basic Job Functions:
  
  
First Solar is the world's largest manufacturer of Thin-Film PV modules. Headquartered in Tempe, Arizona, USA, the company has developed and patented its thin-film PV module technology as an alternative to the silicon-based solar PV value chain that is largely consolidated in China. With a vision to lead the world's sustainable energy future, First Solar currently manufactures solar PV modules in the USA, Malaysia, Vietnam, and India and deploys its technology in over 45 countries globally. First Solar's PV module technology has been deployed in India for more than a decade, primarily in large utility-scale solar projects. The company continues to expand its manufacturing footprint in India to support the country's renewable energy transition.
  
  
As part of the Global Sales Operations organization, the Demand Planning team partners with Business Development, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Finance, and other cross-functional stakeholders to align customer demand with available supply and business objectives. The team drives demand planning, supply-demand balancing, inventory optimization, scenario planning, and Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) activities to support strategic and operational decision-making. This role leverages advanced analytics, planning tools, business intelligence platforms, and AI-enabled solutions to improve forecast accuracy, increase planning efficiency, and provide actionable insights that support business growth and operational excellence.
  
  
The Demand Planning Analyst II is responsible for analyzing global demand, supply, inventory, and revenue information to support demand forecasting, supply-demand balancing, and Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) processes. The role partners with cross-functional stakeholders to evaluate planning scenarios, identify risks and opportunities, and provide data-driven recommendations that align customer requirements with operational capabilities and business objectives. The Analyst II supports executive reporting and drives continuous improvement initiatives that enhance planning effectiveness, forecast accuracy, and business performance.

* 4-6 years of experience in Demand Planning, Supply Chain Planning, Sales Operations, Customer Service, Manufacturing Planning, or related analytical roles.

* Experience analyzing complex datasets and translating business requirements into actionable recommendations.
* Experience c ollaborating across global and cross-functional teams to support planning and business objectives.
* Experience driving process improvement and operational excellence initiatives.
* Familiarity with solar and renewable energy technologies, project development, and related market dynamics preferred.
* Experience supporting executive business reviews, developing KPI dashboards and reports, and performing scenario analysis to support planning and business decisions preferred.

* Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate effectively across all organizational levels.
* Ability to work independently while managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong planning, organization, and project management capabilities.
* Experience working with large datasets and performing data analysis to support business decision-making.
* Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Ability to identify process gaps, develop solutions, and drive implementation.
* High attention to detail with strong data integrity and governance mindset.
* Experience working with ERP, CRM, planning, or reporting systems.

* Experience using data visualization and analytics tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms.
* Experience using Microsoft Copilot, Power Automate, or similar productivity, analytics, and automation tools.
* Experience with process mapping and business process improvement tools and methodologies, such as Microsoft Visio.
* Knowledge of Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP), demand forecasting, inventory management, and supply chain planning processes.

Essential Responsibilities:
  
  

* Facilitate demand forecasting, supply-demand balancing, allocation management, and Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) processes.
* Analyze demand, supply, inventory, and revenue data to support business decisions and customer commitments.
* Develop and maintain forecasting models, planning reports, KPIs, dashboards, and executive-level reporting.

* Conduct scenario analysis and risk assessments to support planning and business decisions.
* Lead planning-related projects and continuous improvement initiatives focused on process optimization, analytics, and automation.
* Maintain data integrity across planning systems and support reporting requirements.

description:
**About Us:**

  

Morgan Stanley (“MS”) is a global financial services firm that conducts its business through three principal business segments—Institutional Securities, Wealth Management (WM), and Asset Management. Morgan Stanley provides comprehensive financial advice and services to its clients including brokerage, investment advisory, financial and wealth planning, credit and lending, deposits and cash management, annuities, insurance, retirement, and trust services. The WM and U.S. Banks Financial Crimes Risk Assistant Vice President (AVP) is part of Wealth Management and the Morgan Stanley Private Bank, National Association and the Morgan Stanley Bank, NA (collectively, the “U.S. Banks”) on the WM and U.S. Banks Financial Crimes Risk Team.

  

As a market leader, the talent and passion of our people is critical to our success. Together, we share a common set of values rooted in doing the right thing, putting clients first, leading with exceptional ideas and a commitment to diversity and inclusion. Morgan Stanley can provide a superior foundation for building a professional career – a place for people to learn, achieve, and grow.

  

**Department Profile:**

  

The WM and U.S. Banks Financial Crimes Risk Team is embedded within the Firm’s business line. It is responsible for identifying, assessing, and escalating potential money laundering and reputational risk issues associated with higher risk client types. The WM and U.S. Banks Financial Crimes Risk Team is considered the first line of defense and supports the onboarding, enhanced due diligence, and negative news processes for Morgan Stanley.

  

**Responsibilities:**

  

The First Line Financial Crime EDD Associate will be responsible for executing risk-relevant activities related to AML. The First Line Financial Crime EDD Associate will assess Bank Secrecy Act (BSA), money laundering and reputational risk matters identified through the execution of the Firm’s EDD protocols and will have ultimate responsibility for the escalation of issues or risks related to these processes. Additionally, this role is expected to periodically support ad-hoc projects and initiatives, including remediation lookbacks and/or root-cause analysis and solutions implementation.

  

**The** **First Line Financial Crime EDD Team Associate will:**

* Review documents and information to perform enhanced due diligence reviews on higher risk customers
* Act as key support for ad-hoc remediation projects and initiatives related to assessing and mitigating the Firm’s exposure to money laundering and reputational risk-relevant activities.
* Develop broad knowledge of the EDD review operations end-to-end cycle and provide subject matter guidance to project teams
* Ensure timely feedback loop on identified gaps or issues to stakeholders involved in EDD operations
* Actively identify, measure, control and remediate AML and reputational risk issues with partners in Global Financial Crimes, Compliance, and the Business Units
* Perform processes in accordance with internal policies, develop and monitor periodic AML reporting to senior stakeholders, and make recommendations to improve procedures governing AML-related activities
* Active pipeline management and engagement with Financial Advisors, Complex Management and Risk Officers to manage client relationships
* Collaborate with Global Financial Crimes to ensure the BSA/AML program operates effectively and continues to comply with regulatory requirements and expectations
  

**Required Experience:**

* Have 6months - 2 years of relevant experience with BSA/AML Regulations within the financial services industry, or at a financial services regulator (e.g., FINRA, Office of the Comptroller of the Currency, Federal Reserve Bank, Securities and Exchange Commission, etc.)
* Have a bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, or other related field
* Strong knowledge of Know Your Customer, Customer Identification Program and CDD requirements
* Strong interpersonal skills and ability to communicate effectively both verbally and in writing
* Strong work ethic with an ability to work both independently and with team members, under tight deadlines
* Ability to work in a high volume, fast paced environment
* Ability to handle highly confidential information professionally and with appropriate discretion
  

**Skills Desired:**

* Working knowledge of MS Office
* Certified as an Anti-Money Laundering Specialist by ACAMS or equivalent AML certification/license is a plus
  

**WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM MORGAN STANLEY:**

At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values - putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back - aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. At Morgan Stanley, you’ll find an opportunity to work alongside the best and the brightest, in an environment where you are supported and empowered. title: Senior Customer Enablement Analyst
description:
At SiteMinder, we believe our success comes from our people. We build diverse, inclusive teams where different voices, backgrounds and perspectives are valued. Our differences drive innovation for our customers, and our people bring the ideas, expertise and energy that help us keep moving forward. We’re better together.  
  
**What We Do...**  
  
Right now, somewhere in the world, a hotel is taking a booking or increasing their revenue through technology you could help build. SiteMinder is the world’s leading hotel commerce platform. For more than 20 years, we’ve helped hotels attract guests, maximise revenue, forecast demand and perform at their best. Today, our platform supports 56,000+ hotels in 150+ countries, connects to 3,000+ partners and powers more than 140m reservations and AU$85 billion+ in hotel revenue each year.  
  
That’s the kind of impact your work can have here. You’ll solve meaningful challenges with AI, simplify complexity and build solutions that help hotels perform. Supported by clear purpose, a strong platform and teams who care about what they’re building, you’ll have the opportunity to shape the future of an industry that never stands still.

**About the Senior Customer Enablement Analyst role...**

The Senior Customer Enablement Analyst helps customer-facing teams identify, evaluate and deliver AI and technology solutions that support SiteMinder’s customer lifecycle, from onboarding through adoption, support, success management, renewal and expansion. The role acts as a catalyst ,and tech SME and delivery partner. It takes problems and opportunities raised by customer team leaders, explores solutions, and moves agreed initiatives from discovery through testing, launch and adoption. It then tracks operational outcomes.

The role is system-agnostic and outcome-focused. It works across the customer technology stack, including Intercom, and reviews and recommends workflow and configuration changes so that tools support how customer teams work. Customer Technology owns the technology roadmap and platform decisions. Process Excellence owns process design and improvement. This role makes sure customer-team needs are understood, solutions are grounded in real workflows, and changes are usable and adopted..

**What you will do...**

* Act as the primary engagement partner for Customer teams, shaping initiatives across Onboarding, Support, and Customer Success and ensuring they align to broader transformation priorities.
* Within Data and Business Systems ensure Customer teams requirements are reflected in tooling roadmaps, platform designs and delivery sequencing.
* Intake and prioritisation: capture problems and opportunities from Support, Onboarding and Success leaders, and help prioritise them with the Customer Technology Director.
* Solution exploration: research AI and technology options, run vendor demos and proofs of concept, and compare options against the need.
* Project delivery: manage initiatives from discovery through testing, launch and adoption, tracking timelines, risks and dependencies.
* Vendor liaison: act as the day-to-day contact for external partners on requirements, delivery and performance.
* Platform workflows: review and recommend configuration changes to customer-support platform workflows,
* Understand and improve customer workflows: Document processes, roles, handoffs and pain points; facilitate discovery; and help teams address process, data, training or technology issues.
* Shape and coordinate delivery: Turn business needs into clear requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria. Coordinate business-side work through design, testing, launch and hypercare, while tracking scope, risks, dependencies and decisions.
* Enable adoption: Support communications, training and rollout planning; gather feedback; resolve adoption barriers; and keep process and user guidance current.
* Support AI, data and automation opportunities: Help define use cases, expected benefits, data needs, human review and success measures. Support pilots and follow SiteMinder’s AI, privacy, security and data governance requirements.
* Measure outcomes: Agree measures with business and technology owners and report on adoption, customer impact and operational results.

**What you have...**

* Extensive experience in **business analysis, customer operations, enablement, service improvement, transformation** or a related field.
* Ability to analyse **customer-facing workflows and produce clear process maps**, requirements or delivery documentation.
* Experience supporting cross-functional work through testing, rollout, training and continuous improvement.
* Familiarity with onboarding, support, customer success, case handling or customer communications; B2B SaaS experience is an advantage.
* Strong facilitation, communication and stakeholder-management skills; able to manage ambiguity and competing priorities.
* Practical understanding of data, automation and AI, including privacy, quality, human oversight and controls.

**Our Perks & Benefits…**

* Flexibility to work in a Hybrid model (3 days in-office)
* Annual and Sick Leaves
* Paid Birthday, Study and Volunteering Leaves every year
* Medical Insurance Cover
* Employee Referral Bonus
* Tenure Bonus
* Team Events & Celebrations

Think this role sounds like you? If so, we’d love to hear from you. Please send us your resume and our Talent Acquisition team will be in touch.

When you apply, feel free to share your pronouns and let us know if you need any adjustments during the interview process, we’re here to support you. We also warmly encourage applications from people from underrepresented backgrounds.

title: Head of Information Security
description:
**Leapswitch Networks (CloudPe) · Contract consultants also considered**

We run data centres, a public cloud and VPS and hosting services for thousands of businesses. Attackers now use AI to find and exploit weaknesses at machine speed, so we need a security leader who defends at the same speed. --------------------

* See us as an automated attacker does: continuous attack-surface monitoring, and actively exploited vulnerabilities patched or mitigated in hours, not weeks.
* Build zero-trust access with phishing-resistant MFA, short-lived credentials and just-in-time admin access for people, services and AI agents.
* Run detection engineering, threat hunting and an AI-assisted SOC; lead incident response, including CERT-In reporting.
* Validate continuously with red-team and purple-team exercises, automated testing and a disclosure programme.
* Secure our own AI agents and LLM automation against prompt injection, excessive agency and credential leakage.
* Own supply-chain and vendor risk, backups and ransomware resilience, fraud and abuse, and ISO 27001 readiness.
* Build and lead a small security team.

**What you bring**
------------------

* 10+ years in infrastructure or security, 4+ leading security at a hosting, cloud, data centre or telecom company.
* An offensive mindset: you have run or led penetration tests or red-team work against infrastructure.
* A clear view of how attackers use AI, and real use of AI in your own security work, including where it fails.
* Hands-on depth in Linux hardening, SSH and key management, firewalls, network ACLs, and KVM, OpenStack, VMware or Virtuozzo security.
* Real incidents led end to end, from first hour to root cause.
* Knowledge of CERT-In directions and the DPDP Act; clear writing for engineers and leadership.

  **Nice to have**
  ----------------

1 OSCP or OSEP, GIAC, CISSP or CCSP; ISO 27001 or SOC 2 audit experience.

2 LLM red-teaming, MITRE ATLAS, detection-as-code, eBPF runtime security.

3 Published research, CVEs or open-source security tools.

  

**How to apply**
----------------

Apply with your CV and a short note in the Application Form on a security problem you fixed in an infrastructure environment: what you found, what you changed, and the result. Tell us one way you use AI in that work.

title: HR Data & Reporting Specialist
description:
**Life tastes better with ice cream**

With 19.000 expert ice cream colleagues and iconic brands like Wall’s, Cornetto and Ben & Jerry’s, loved in 76 countries, we are the world’s largest Ice Cream company leading the industry.

We create iconic ice cream brands that are part of everyday life, bringing moments of joy to millions of people around the world. Everybody loves ice cream. And as the world’s biggest pure‑play ice cream company, we have the scale and ambition to make a real difference.

What truly sets us apart is how we work.

We move fast and keep things simple. We turn ideas into action, trust people to take ownership, and work as one team to win together with integrity. Our culture is high‑performance, collaborative and focused on getting things done.

We’re curious and ready for what’s next. We embrace digital, use data to make better decisions, and keep learning, including how AI can help us work smarter and serve consumers better.

Job Purpose

The Workday Data & Reporting Analyst will provide hands-on Workday data, reporting and operational support during the separation of The Magnum Ice Cream Company from Unilever and the subsequent transition and stabilization period.

This is an individual contributor role and will focus on HR data quality, Workday reporting, EIBs, Supervisory Organizations and operational support, ensuring accurate, reliable and timely HR data across the organization.

The role will independently investigate and resolve complex data and reporting issues, manage ServiceNow tickets, and coordinate with AMS and third-party Workday partners to ensure issues are effectively resolved.

This role will suit someone who combines strong Workday data and reporting expertise with a hands-on operational mindset and an interest in using automation, AI and emerging Workday capabilities to improve how HR services are delivered.

Key Responsibilities

Workday Data & Data Quality

* Maintain high-quality Workday Core HCM data, ensuring accuracy, completeness and consistency.
* Perform data validation, reconciliation and quality checks to proactively identify and resolve issues.
* Create, execute and validate Workday EIBs and mass data changes, with appropriate pre-load and post-load controls.
* Create and maintain Supervisory Organizations and validate related organizational data.
* Investigate complex data discrepancies, identify root causes and drive corrective actions through to resolution.
* Develop data-quality controls and identify opportunities to prevent recurring issues.
* Ensure HR data changes comply with agreed data governance, approval and documentation standards.

Reporting & Analytics

* Create and maintain Workday Advanced Reports, dashboards and recurring or ad hoc reporting solutions.
* Translate business requirements into effective reporting solutions.
* Analyze HR data to identify trends, exceptions and data-quality issues.
* Support stakeholders in understanding and effectively using HR data.
* Troubleshoot and resolve reporting issues.
* Identify opportunities to standardize, automate and simplify reporting and data processes.

ServiceNow & Operational Support

* Manage Workday data and reporting tickets through ServiceNow (SNOW) from triage through resolution and closure.
* Provide hands-on investigation and data correction rather than acting solely as an escalation point.
* Manage priorities and ticket workloads in line with agreed service levels.
* Identify recurring ticket themes and recommend permanent fixes, controls or knowledge articles.
* Collaborate with HR Operations, Payroll, Finance and Technology teams to resolve cross-functional issues.

AMS & Third-Party Coordination

* Coordinate with AMS and third-party Workday support partners to resolve data and reporting issues.
* Ensure requirements and expected outcomes are clearly defined when work is assigned to external partners.
* Monitor ticket progress, SLAs, escalations and quality of resolution.
* Review and challenge proposed solutions where needed to ensure the underlying issue is resolved.
* Support effective knowledge transfer from external partners to the internal team.
* Identify opportunities to improve the support model and reduce recurring issues or unnecessary external dependency.

Knowledge & Continuous Improvement

* Maintain SOPs, knowledge articles, process documentation and user guidance.
* Provide practical guidance on Workday reporting, EIBs, mass data changes and organizational data.
* Use data-quality findings and recurring ticket themes to identify opportunities for continuous improvement and automation.
* Act as a Workday data and reporting subject-matter expert within a globally distributed team.
* Coach team members and transfer knowledge to strengthen internal Workday data and reporting capability.
* Explore opportunities to use AI, automation and emerging Workday capabilities to improve data management, reporting and operational support.

Experience & Technical Expertise

Essential

* 5+ years of hands-on experience in Workday, HRIS, HR data, reporting or a related field.
* Strong knowledge of Workday Core HCM data and HR organizational structures.
* Strong experience with Workday EIBs, mass data changes, data validation and reconciliation.
* Experience creating and maintaining Supervisory Organizations.
* Strong Workday reporting capability, including building and maintaining Advanced Reports.
* Strong understanding of HR data quality, controls and governance.
* Experience working within an operational support environment and managing incidents or service requests through ServiceNow (SNOW) or a comparable platform.
* Experience working with AMS and/or third-party Workday support providers.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with excellent attention to data accuracy.
* Ability to independently manage complex activities, ticket workloads and competing priorities.
* Strong stakeholder-management and communication skills.
* A hands-on mindset and willingness to investigate and resolve issues directly.
* Professional fluency in English.

Highly Desirable

* Experience coordinating or managing an AMS / third-party Workday support model, including tickets, SLAs and escalations.
* Experience in a global Workday production-support environment.
* Experience with Workday Prism Analytics.
* Experience with Power BI, Tableau or similar analytics tools.
* Experience supporting major HR transformation, separation, migration or stabilization activities.

Nice to Have

* Knowledge or experience with Workday Extend.
* Knowledge of AI agents, agentic AI or AI-enabled HR solutions, particularly their application to HR data, reporting or service delivery.
* Experience with VNDLY or Workday Adaptive
* Awareness of broader Workday capabilities, including integrations and security dependencies.

**Why join us?**

title: Sales Operations Manager
description:
**Meaningful Work From Day One**
The Sales and Operations Manager will serve as a strategic business partner to the Commercial Team responsible for maximizing revenue for the organization by driving state pricing strategies, negotiating distributor margins and trade discounts, forecasting distributor demand and inventories. Reporting directly to the Director - Commercial and Operations India Area, this individual will own the state-wise value chain optimization, pricing architectures, and commercial planning metrics.
  
  
The ideal candidate possesses deep, comprehensive knowledge of the Indian Alcohol Beverage (Alcobev) industry, specifically navigating complex Route-to-Consumer (RTC) models, local excise policies, and state-specific pricing models. They will blend high-level business planning with tactical market analysis to maximize revenue, stabilize operating income, and recommend optimal brand and geography mixes.
  
  
**What You Can Expect**

* State-Wise Cost Card & Value Chain Management
* Develop, update, and manage granular cost cards for each state based on its unique Route-to-Consumer (RTC) policy, distributor margin structures, and commercial setups.
* Conduct full state-wise value chain optimizations to accurately reflect active excise policies, import duties, and trade terms across diverse regulatory territories.
* Maintain tight compliance and commercial spend integration with localized corporate and state regulations.
* Pricing Architecture & Revenue Growth Management (RGM)
* Formulate data-driven pricing recommendations, channel pack-price architectures (PPA), and discount management programs.
* Oversee commercial net revenue management, evaluate competitive pricing maneuvers, and manage pricing structures relative to primary market competitors.
* Act as the direct financial gatekeeper for customer-facing commercial investments, establishing robust ROI evaluation models for trade spends, promotion effectiveness, and regional marketing initiatives.
* Strategic Planning & Resource Optimization
* Drive financial planning recommendations that optimize product portfolio mixes and prioritize geographic expansions (e.g., maximizing premium portfolio presence across Priority 1 & Priority 2 focus cities).
* Lead short- and long-term financial forecasting, scenario planning, and target-setting aligned with organizational milestones.
* Collaborate closely with regional sales leads and commercial excellence teams to design trade spend controls and review quarterly regional business performance

**What You Bring To The Table**

* Alcobev Industry Expertise: Mandatory, proven track record operating within the multi-layered Indian alcohol beverage landscape, demonstrating comprehensive familiarity with regional excise regulations, state distribution laws, and market-specific pricing sensitivities.
* Financial Modeling & Analytics: Highly specialized expertise in building multi-tiered financial cost models, performing price-volume-mix evaluations, and executing financial risk/return analytics.
* Systems Proficiency: Strong capability leveraging data systems and commercial management toolkits (e.g., SAP, Advanced Excel, Power BI) to generate highly automated and scannable commercial insights.
* Strategic Partnering: Proven capacity to influence cross-functional peers (Sales, Marketing, Supply Chain) and deliver persuasive, business-focused recommendations to executive leadership.
* Thinking Transparency: Strong objective analytical scaffolding with the ability to articulate trade-offs, project limitations, and distinct upside opportunities clearly.

description:
**Job Description**
**IT Operations Manager, India**
**IT Operations Team | New Delhi, India**
**Your Goal**
: To power Chegg's global workforce with exceptional IT support and productivity platforms so they can deliver on Chegg's mission — helping students go from learning to earning. You’ll ensure our IT systems and processes are high-quality, scalable and customer-centric.
  
  
**The Organization: Chegg IT Operations**
For years, Chegg has helped millions of students and learners achieve better learning outcomes. Chegg has expanded beyond academic support into a full learning-to-earning platform – helping students find, prepare for, and land the internships and jobs that launch their careers.
  
  
We are looking for an exceptional IT Operations Manager to join our Global IT Operations team in New Delhi, India. We’re not your typical IT team, we pride ourselves on our customer centricity, powering the productivity of Chegg's global workforce, understanding their needs and proactively providing solutions to make their jobs easier and reduce friction throughout the organization.
  
  
**The Role: IT Operations Manager, India**
As a key member of the Global IT Operations team, you’ll be responsible for providing leadership to our team of contractor Support Technicians and Systems Engineers, driving quality of team performance, leading key initiatives for optimizing the collaboration experience for Chegg’s workforce, acting as a subject matter expert for key IT systems, and supporting IT compliance and audit initiatives.
  
  
**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 7+ years in corporate IT operations, including 3+ years leading technical teams or managing outsourced/managed-service IT delivery against SOWs and SLAs.
* Proven track record of holding vendors and contractors accountable for quality. This includes defining metrics beyond SLA compliance, running regular service reviews, driving corrective action plans, and escalating when performance doesn’t improve.
* Hands-on experience building quality assurance for service desk and systems teams, such as ticket audits, CSAT, MTTR, backlog aging, and communication quality.
* Strong cross-regional stakeholder management. You should have experience representing a global function to local business leadership, translating local needs and constraints into terms global leadership can act on, and the reverse.
* Demonstrated customer advocacy. You use end-user feedback to drive change, and you push back on processes that meet the metrics but fail the user.
* Ability to contribute to IT strategy: spotting recurring problems, building the business case for improvements, and helping prioritize the roadmap.
* Enough technical depth across Windows, macOS, Office 365, Okta, Active Directory, Atlassian, endpoint management, and ITSM tools to evaluate engineering work, make sound technical calls, and step in hands-on when needed.
* Experience applying AI and automation to IT operations workflows.
* Excellent written and verbal English; comfortable presenting to senior leadership.
* Flexibility to overlap with US and European business hours and to support critical incidents outside standard hours.

**Preferred**

* Experience with India statutory asset audits and India finance/procurement processes.
* Experience in a lean or recently outsourced IT environment.
* ITIL certification or a strong ITSM process background (FreshService a plus).
* Experience supporting European offices.

Why do we exist?
  
  
Students are working harder than ever before to stabilize their future. Our recent research study called State of the Student shows that nearly 3 out of 4 students are working to support themselves through college and 1 in 3 students feel pressure to spend more than they can afford. We founded our business on provided affordable textbook rental options to address these issues. Since then, we’ve expanded our offerings to supplement many facets of higher educational learning through Chegg Study, Chegg Math, Chegg Writing, Chegg Internships, Chegg Skills, and more to support students beyond their college experience. These offerings lower financial concerns for students by modernizing their learning experience. We exist so students everywhere have a smarter, faster, more affordable way to student.

title: Lead Systems Engineer - Infra Reliability Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
**Job Title**
***–***
Lead Systems Engineer
  
  
The Infrastructure Reliability Engineer position will use automation, Infrastructure as Code, observability, operational data, and engineering practices to improve the availability and resiliency of infrastructure services.
  
  
**The Purpose of This Role**
Fidelity’s Enterprise Infrastructure & Operations Distributed Compute and Storage organization is looking for an Infrastructure Reliability Engineer to help engineer, automate, and improve the reliability of our enterprise infrastructure platforms.
  
  
We are a dynamic team of engineers focused on making infrastructure highly available, resilient, observable, automated, and easy to consume. We partner closely with infrastructure engineering, operations, application, cloud, and technology teams to improve platform reliability while reducing operational complexity through automation.
  
  
**The Value You Deliver**
This role will help us move from traditional infrastructure operations toward engineering-led operations, where repetitive activities are automated, infrastructure health is measurable, failures are anticipated, recovery is engineered and tested, and operational insights drive continuous improvement.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Engineer and operate resilient enterprise infrastructure services across on-premises and cloud environments.
* Develop automation that improves infrastructure reliability, scalability, supportability, and operational efficiency.
* Automate common operational activities and eliminate repetitive manual processes.
* Build observability capabilities that provide meaningful insight into infrastructure health and service reliability.
* Partner with Compute, Storage, Cloud, Network, Security, and Application Engineering teams to resolve complex infrastructure problems.
* Participate in major incident response and provide engineering expertise during infrastructure service disruptions.
* Conduct post-incident analysis and convert lessons learned into automation, monitoring, resiliency, or platform improvements.
* Improve infrastructure patching, maintenance, provisioning, lifecycle management, and recovery through automation.
* Participate in capacity planning and proactively identify scalability or performance constraints.
* Engineer and test backup, recovery, and disaster recovery capabilities.
* Develop reusable automation and self-service capabilities for infrastructure consumers.
* Contribute to technical standards, engineering best practices, documentation, and operational procedures.
* Challenge existing operational processes and identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, automate, and engineer away operational toil.

**How Your Work Impacts The Organization**
Improve stability, increase availability, and enhance customer and stakeholder satisfaction
  
  
**The Skill that are Key to this role**
**Technical/Behavioral**
**Reliability Engineering**

* Apply reliability engineering principles to improve the availability, resiliency, performance, recoverability, and operational readiness of infrastructure platforms.
* Identify reliability risks and engineer solutions that eliminate or reduce recurring infrastructure failures.
* Establish meaningful health indicators, operational metrics, dashboards, alerts, and reliability measures for infrastructure services.
* Use operational data and production insights to identify patterns and proactively address potential reliability issues.
* Participate in reliability reviews, failure analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Promote blameless root cause analysis and translate incident learnings into engineering improvements.

**Infrastructure Automation**

* Engineer automation that reduces repetitive manual activities and operational toil.
* Develop reusable automation utilizing technologies such as Python, PowerShell, Shell, Golang, Ansible, Terraform, APIs, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration, validation, maintenance, recovery, and operational workflows.
* Integrate infrastructure platforms through REST APIs and automation frameworks.
* Apply software engineering disciplines including source control, code reviews, automated testing, reusable components, and CI/CD to infrastructure automation.
* Identify opportunities to transition infrastructure activities from ticket-driven operations to automated and self-service capabilities.

**Observability & Operational Intelligence**- Build and maintain dashboards, monitoring, logging, and alerting capabilities for infrastructure platforms.
- Develop actionable infrastructure health signals rather than relying solely on threshold-based monitoring.
- Correlate telemetry across infrastructure components to accelerate issue identification and resolution.
- Analyze operational and infrastructure data to identify:

* recurring failures,
* performance bottlenecks,
* capacity risks,
* availability trends,
* automation opportunities,
* reliability improvement opportunities.
* Develop data-driven insights and visualizations using platforms such as Splunk, Datadog, Grafana, Power BI, or Tableau.

**Resiliency, Backup & Recovery**

* Engineer infrastructure platforms with recoverability as a core design principle.
* Support enterprise backup and recovery capabilities across compute, storage, virtualization, cloud, and application infrastructure.
* Automate backup validation and recovery workflows to improve consistency and reduce recovery time.
* Participate in disaster recovery and resiliency exercises, including recovery into alternate or newly established infrastructure environments.
* Validate that infrastructure recovery processes meet defined recovery objectives.
* Identify opportunities to continuously improve Recovery Time Objective (RTO) and Recovery Point Objective (RPO) capabilities.
* Use automation and testing to demonstrate that recovery capabilities work when required rather than relying solely on documented procedures.

**Soft skills required:**
Organizational agility, communications, influencing, time management, contextual awareness and ability to work under pressure.
  
  
**The Expertise We're Looking For**
The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with several of the following:
  
  
**Infrastructure**

* Linux / Unix
* Windows Server
* VMware / Virtualization
* Enterprise Compute
* Enterprise Storage
* Kubernetes / Container Platforms
* Backup & Recovery technologies

**Cloud**

* AWS
* Azure
* Private / Hybrid Cloud

**Automation & Infrastructure as Code**

* Python
* PowerShell
* Go Lang
* Shell scripting
* Ansible
* Terraform
* REST APIs

**Observability**

* Datadog
* Splunk
* Prometheus
* Grafana
* ELK / OpenSearch
* OpenTelemetry

**DevOps / Engineering**

* Git
* Jenkins
* CI/CD
* Agile engineering practices
* Automated testing

**Behaviours**

* Systems-thinking and engineering mindset when approaching complex infrastructure and reliability challenges.
* Curiosity and discipline in understanding root causes, with a focus on preventing recurrence rather than only restoring service.
* Automation-first mindset, continuously identifying opportunities to eliminate repetitive operational work and reduce manual effort.
* Strong problem-solving capabilities across complex, interconnected infrastructure technologies and services.
* Data-driven decision making, using telemetry, operational insights, and trends to identify and prioritize reliability improvements.
* Strong understanding of reliability principles, including availability, resiliency, recoverability, observability, scalability, and operational simplicity.
* Effective collaboration across infrastructure, engineering, operations, application, cloud, and technology teams.
* Clear communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical topics to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ownership and accountability, with a strong focus on delivering outcomes and driving continuous improvement.
* Commitment to engineering excellence, with an emphasis on automation, standardization, simplification, and sustainable operational practices.

**Location**
