title: Lead Site Reliability Engineer, Remote India / Bangalore
description:
**Description**
===============

Trintech is an award-winning AI-driven Fintech SaaS organisation transforming the way finance teams operate.

  

We are looking to hire a **Lead Site Reliability Engineer** to helm the technical delivery of reliability improvements across a broad service portfolio.

  

You will turn production evidence into a prioritised engineering plan, coordinate work across teams and ensure incident learning results in measurable improvement. This is a technical individual-contributor role with no direct reports.

  

You will remain hands-on across Kubernetes and OKD/OpenShift, Azure, VMware-based infrastructure, and Linux and Windows workloads. Grafana, Prometheus, Datadog, Sumo Logic and PagerDuty support investigation, service visibility and incident response.

  

**YOUR IMPACT**
---------------

* Own the integrated reliability engineering plan across services, regions and workstreams, with clear technical priorities and accountable follow-through.

* Strengthen the SRE team's effectiveness through practical direction, better operational tools, sustainable response practices and verified engineering outcomes.

  

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**
--------------------

* Build a prioritised reliability roadmap from customer impact, incident recurrence, service risk and operational effort, agreeing delivery capacity with the SRE manager.

* Lead adoption of meaningful service indicators, objectives and error-budget decisions with product and service owners, establishing ownership and review practices.

* Coordinate alert improvements across Grafana, Prometheus, Datadog, Sumo Logic and PagerDuty, addressing duplication, missing coverage, routing and diagnostic context.

* Lead technical response to complex incidents and strengthen regional handovers, escalation readiness and blameless reviews; verify completion of consequential follow-ups.

* Direct and contribute to automation that removes repeated operational work, with code review, testing, bounded permissions and safe recovery behaviour.

* Coordinate readiness, capacity and recovery work across application, data, infrastructure and Platform Engineering teams, resolving dependencies and technical blockers.

* Review high-risk changes and remain hands-on through diagnosis, prototypes and targeted implementation where direct involvement improves the outcome.

* Report customer impact, reliability trends, repeat failures, alert quality and engineering progress; raise gaps in capacity or ownership with clear recommendations.

  

**WHO YOU ARE**
---------------

* A record of leading reliability improvements across multiple production services and teams, with evidence of sustained outcomes after delivery.

* Strong practical judgement across Kubernetes, Linux, application behaviour, networks, storage and hybrid infrastructure, with the ability to involve specialists effectively.

* Hands-on depth in monitoring, PromQL, log analysis and alert design, including the ability to distinguish telemetry faults from service failures.

* Experience leading significant incidents, improving on-call practices and driving corrective actions through to verified resolution.

* Credible software and automation skills, including reviewing and implementing maintainable, tested operational tooling and controlled changes.

* Ability to coordinate dependencies, mentor technical leaders and negotiate delivery priorities and reliability trade-offs without relying on line-management authority **.**

  

**NICE TO HAVE**

* Experience with OKD/OpenShift, Azure, VMware, Windows, Datadog, Sumo Logic, PagerDuty, Terraform, SaltStack, Azure DevOps or Argo CD.

* Experience supporting distributed teams and SaaS services with database, integration, batch-processing or customer-facing financial-workflow dependencies.

  

**HOW YOU WILL WORK AND LEAD**

* Set technical priorities and guide Senior and Principal contributors, agreeing resource commitments with their managers and retaining clear service ownership.

* Partner with the SRE manager on on-call readiness and protected engineering capacity; provide coaching and technical input into development and recruitment.

* Make delivery and recovery decisions within agreed authority, escalating business-risk acceptance, funding and organisation-wide architecture choices to accountable owners.

**What success looks like**
---------------------------

* The reliability roadmap delivers measurable reductions in customer disruption, recurring incidents and avoidable operational effort.

* Critical services have agreed owners, meaningful health measures, actionable alerts and tested recovery procedures.

* Regional handovers, escalation and incident follow-ups work consistently, with response load and capacity constraints visible to management.

* Teams deliver coordinated improvements with verified outcomes while engineers develop stronger independent technical judgement.

  
  

*At our core, Trintechers stand committed to fostering a culture rooted in our core values – Humble, Empowered, Reliable, and Open. Together, these values guide our actions, define our identity, and inspire us to continuously strive for excellence in everything we do.*

*All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin or disability.*

title: Senior Systems Engineer
description:
At OneSpan, we specialize in digital identity and anti-fraud solutions that create exceptional and secure experiences.
  
  
We are looking for a
**Senior System Engineer**
to join our team in
**Noida**
.
  
  
The Senior Systems Engineer provides additional hands-on engineering capacity and end-to-end ownership for critical infrastructure, security platforms, and enterprise services. The role designs, implements, maintains, and improves resilient, secure, and supportable technology solutions across cloud and on-premises environments. Working closely with IT Infrastructure, Security, Architecture, application teams, and service owners, the engineer translates operational and project requirements into practical technical solutions and drives work from design through deployment and ongoing support.
  
  
This is a delivery and ownership focused role that increases capacity across infrastructure and security initiatives, accelerates modernization, and reduces technical debt, lifecycle-management gaps, and remediation backlogs. The engineer establishes clear operational ownership, improves monitoring and recovery readiness, standardizes repeatable engineering practices, and resolves complex service issues. By expanding senior-level engineering coverage and reducing dependency on a limited number of key resources, the role enables architects and senior leaders to spend more time on architecture, governance, security, and strategic priorities rather than routine operational work.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, implement, and maintain critical infrastructure, security platforms, and enterprise services across cloud and on-premises environments. Convert approved requirements and architecture standards into secure, reliable, and supportable production solutions.
* Take end-to-end technical ownership for assigned platforms and services, including configuration standards, documentation, monitoring, patching, upgrades, capacity planning, vendor coordination, incident support, lifecycle planning, and continuous improvement.
* Increase delivery capacity across infrastructure and security initiatives by leading or executing technical work packages, resolving dependencies, coordinating testing and change activities, and completing operational handover with service owners and support teams.
* Accelerate modernization and reduce technical debt by identifying aging, unsupported, overly complex, or manually administered technologies; developing practical remediation or replacement plans; and implementing standardized, automated, and maintainable solutions.
* Reduce lifecycle-management and remediation backlogs by assessing platform health, prioritizing work based on operational and security risk, coordinating maintenance windows, and completing upgrades, patching, configuration remediation, and technology refresh activities.
* Improve operational resilience by engineering platforms for availability, recoverability, scalability, and secure operation. Establish monitoring, alerting, backup, recovery, and failover requirements; validate procedures through testing; and address identified gaps.
* Automate repeatable infrastructure and operational tasks using scripting, configuration management, infrastructure as code, and orchestration tools. Maintain version-controlled code, technical standards, reusable modules, and tested deployment and rollback procedures.
* Troubleshoot complex incidents and recurring service issues using logs, metrics, traces, platform telemetry, and root-cause analysis. Implement corrective actions, document known errors and recovery procedures, and reduce repeated manual intervention.
* Engineer and operate services in alignment with approved security requirements. Apply least privilege, secure configuration, secrets and certificate management, vulnerability remediation, logging, segmentation, and access-control standards; identify and escalate exceptions or material risks.
* Improve team coverage and reduce key-person dependency by creating current architecture diagrams, build standards, inventories, operating procedures, support runbooks, and knowledge articles. Crosstrain colleagues and ensure critical services have effective primary and secondary support coverage.
* Partner with Architecture, Security, Service Management, application teams, and business stakeholders to evaluate technical options, explain tradeoffs, sequence work, and ensure solutions meet operational, security, compliance, and business requirements.
* Provide technical leadership during projects and operational changes by reviewing designs, identifying implementation risks, mentoring engineers, and promoting consistent engineering, documentation, testing, and change-management practices.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* Systems engineering experience: 10+ years of progressively responsible experience across systems engineering, infrastructure engineering, cloud operations, enterprise platforms, or security infrastructure, with demonstrated ownership of production services and delivery of maintainable technical solutions.
* Platform ownership: Demonstrated experience assuming end-to-end technical ownership for critical services, including design, implementation, operational support, monitoring, lifecycle management, documentation, risk remediation, vendor engagement, and continuous improvement.
* Cloud and on-premises infrastructure: Strong hands-on experience with enterprise cloud and data-center technologies, including compute, storage, virtualization, networking, DNS, load balancing, backup, identity integration, and high-availability design. Practical experience with at least one major cloud platform.
* Microsoft enterprise technologies: Strong working knowledge of Windows Server, Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft 365, endpoint and server management, PowerShell, certificates, authentication, and related enterprise administration and troubleshooting practices.
* Linux and heterogeneous environments: Working knowledge of Linux administration and the ability to support and troubleshoot services that span multiple operating systems, network zones, cloud services, and third-party platforms.
* Automation and infrastructure as code: Strong scripting and automation skills using PowerShell, Python, Bash, or comparable languages. Experience with configuration management, infrastructure as code, APIs, source control, automated testing, and repeatable deployment practices.
* Security engineering fundamentals: Practical experience implementing secure configuration, least privilege, privileged access controls, vulnerability and patch remediation, secrets and certificate management, audit logging, network security controls, and security monitoring requirements.
* Lifecycle and technical-debt management: Experience assessing platform health, supportability, dependencies, and end-of-life risk; building remediation plans; and executing upgrades, migrations, consolidation, decommissioning, and backlog-reduction work without disrupting critical services.
* Operational resilience: Experience designing and operating highly available services, defining service dependencies and recovery requirements, implementing monitoring and alerting, and validating backup, recovery, failover, and continuity procedures.
* Production operations and troubleshooting: Advanced ability to diagnose complex, multi-system issues using logs, metrics, traces, packet or protocol analysis, and structured root-cause analysis. Experience with incident, problem, change, release, and configuration management processes.
* Documentation and knowledge transfer: Ability to create accurate architecture diagrams, technical standards, build documentation, inventories, runbooks, recovery procedures, and knowledge articles, and to transfer operational knowledge effectively across the team.
* Project delivery and collaboration: Ability to translate business, architecture, security, and operational requirements into practical engineering plans; manage dependencies and implementation risks; and work effectively across Infrastructure, Security, Architecture, Service Management, application teams, vendors, and business stakeholders.
* Engineering judgment and independence: Ability to work independently within approved architecture and governance, prioritize competing operational and project demands, make sound technical decisions, escalate material risks, and select the simplest supportable solution that meets the requirement.

description:
**About Codewalla:**

Codewalla is a CTO-led product engineering company with teams in New York, Pune, and Chennai. Since 2005, we have been building and backing founder-led companies in the US and UK. We partner with ambitious founders to build technology products from the ground up, combining strong engineering capabilities with an ownership-driven approach. Our teams work on meaningful product challenges across emerging technology domains, with a focus on building scalable, AI-native solutions.

**Role Overview:**

Codewalla is looking for a TechOps Engineer to ensure smooth and reliable day-to-day IT operations by providing timely end-user support, managing IT assets and troubleshooting hardware, software, and network-related issues. The role is ideal for a hands-on problem solver who enjoys supporting users, resolving technical challenges, and maintaining a dependable IT environment in a fast-paced workplace.

* Basic understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud) is desirable.
* Knowledge of endpoint security tools, antivirus solutions, and patch management.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills with a strong customer-service mindset.
* Ability to work independently, take ownership of issues and follow through to resolution.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic, and evolving environment.

**What you will do:**

* Provide L1/L2 technical support for desktops, laptops, mobile devices, printers, and other IT assets.
* Install, configure, troubleshoot, and maintain Windows, macOS, and Linux operating systems.
* Manage user onboarding and offboarding, including account provisioning, access management, email setup, and device allocation.
* Administer Microsoft 365 and/or Google Workspace, including user management, group policies, and license administration.
* Troubleshoot hardware, software, VPN, Wi-Fi, DNS, DHCP, and LAN connectivity issues.

* Maintain purchase orders, quotations, invoices, contracts, and other vendor documentation.
* Track IT-related expenses and support budgeting, cost control, and technology procurement planning.

description:

Built on decades of manufacturing expertise, global operations and a proven ability to deliver complex systems at scale, Axiom combines innovation with real-world execution. We're helping close the gap between what the future demands and what the world can deliver.

**Cloud Principal Architect**
located in

Lead the architecture, design, governance and evolution of the enterprise cloud platforms, with primary focus on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and Amazon Web Services (AWS). Define secure, scalable, resilient and cost effective cloud architectures, including enterprise Landing Zones, network connectivity, identity and access management, security controls, observability, automation, FinOps, disaster recovery and cloud governance.

**Senior Director**

**What a typical day looks like:**

* Cloud Architecture & Strategy: Own enterprise cloud architecture across GCP and AWS; define reference architectures, design patterns, standards, guardrails and roadmaps; architect IaaS, PaaS, containers, serverless, data and AI/ML workloads; evaluate workload placement across public cloud, SaaS and hybrid; lead architecture reviews for complex transformation programs.

* Cloud Networking: Enterprise connectivity across GCP, AWS, on premises datacenters and SaaS: Shared VPC, Cloud Interconnect, Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, BGP routing, DNS/IPAM, load balancing, firewalls/WAF, private endpoints, SD-WAN and cloud WAN; highly available hybrid and multi cloud connectivity.

* Reliability, DR & Observability: Availability, resilience, backup and DR architecture against business RTO/RPO; multi zone and multi region patterns; centralized monitoring, logging and alerting; reviews to remove single points of failure.
* FinOps & Cost Optimization: Cost governance and FinOps standards: tagging, showback/chargeback, budgets, forecasting, rightsizing, commitments and reservations, autoscaling and architecture level optimization.
* Cloud Migration & Modernization: Technical architecture for large scale datacenter to cloud and cloud to cloud migrations using 6R/7R strategies; migration waves, dependencies, connectivity, security and target state architecture.

* Strong architecture and implementation experience with GCP and AWS, including enterprise scale Landing Zones.

title: Corporate IT Support Specialist
description:
Who We Are
  
  
Vultr is on a mission to make high-performance cloud infrastructure easy to use, affordable, and locally accessible for enterprises and AI innovators around the world. This role will serve as the primary Corporate IT support point of contact for Vultr's Chennai office, providing hands-on support for employees' endpoint, SaaS, identity, access, hardware, and day-to-day technology needs, while partnering with the global Corporate IT organization on enterprise-wide systems, processes, and initiatives.

title: Senior Engineer- Design, Quality & Compliance (Exports)
description:
**JOB PURPOSE**

As a Senior Engineer – Export Product Compliance, ensures that Bajaj Electricals’ consumer products (mixer grinders, air coolers, ceiling fans, table/pedestal/wall fans, water heaters) and lighting products (consumer and professional lighting) meet the statutory, safety, EMC, energy-efficiency, environmental and labelling requirements of the export markets – Europe (Spain, UK, Germany and others), USA, Africa, Middle East and other APAC markets. Tracks regulatory changes in each market, owns the export certification and technical-file process from NPD through life-cycle management, coordinates with test labs, certification bodies and importers, and supports audits to meet the QMS of the R&D process as per ISO 9001:2015 / ISO 17025.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Export Regulatory Intelligence & Market Compliance**

• Maintain and share up-to-date knowledge of product regulations, standards and market-entry requirements for Europe (EU/UK), USA, Africa, Middle East and other APAC markets.

• Maintain a market-wise compliance matrix (product category x country) covering mandatory marks, standards, labelling, energy efficiency and environmental requirements, and update it on every regulatory change.

• Assess the impact of new or revised regulations on the existing portfolio and highlight risks, timelines and actions to the CFT / project team.

**Product Safety, EMC & Environmental Compliance**

• Ensure compliance of designs with applicable IEC / EN standards (e.g., IEC 60335-1 with relevant Part 2 standards for fans, kitchen machines and water heaters; IEC 60598 series and related LED standards for luminaires; EMC standards).

• Ensure environmental and substance compliance – RoHS, REACH, WEEE, packaging and battery requirements – including supplier declarations and material compliance data.

• Ensure food-contact material compliance for applicable products (e.g., mixer grinder jars and blades).

• Ensure energy-efficiency, ecodesign and energy-label requirements for applicable products and markets (e.g., fans, water heaters, lighting).

**Export Product Certification**

• Manage the process for obtaining and renewing certifications and approvals – CE / UKCA conformity, UL / ETL (NRTL) and FCC for USA, G-Mark and schemes for Middle East, and conformity / pre shipment schemes for African and APAC markets.

• Coordinate IECEE CB scheme test certificates and reports where applicable, to support multi-country approvals.

• Act as the point of contact with regulatory bodies, certification agencies, accredited test labs and importers / distributors.

• Testing methodology alignment, test-plan finalisation and test report interpretation with external labs.

• Product manual, rating label and marking guidance to factory and Marketing for export certification and inclusion (language, symbols, warnings, instructions).

**Documentation and Reporting**

• Prepare and maintain technical files / construction files, risk assessments, Declarations of Conformity and compliance statements for regulatory submissions.

• Generate comprehensive export compliance requirements for NPD / LCM projects at the concept stage, so that country requirements are built into design.

• Maintain the certificate and approval tracker with validity, scope and renewal dates, and the product-change impact record for approved models. Design Quality Process & Tools

• Ensure projects are on track as per the NPD milestone process, with export compliance deliverables built into gates.

• Ensure application of design quality tools such as Design Review, DFMEA closure, HBSRA and FCR prediction for relevant new projects.

• Ensure design verification & validation by reviewing prototype / N10 test reports for safety, performance and warranty / reliability as per NPD requirements. Audit Preparation & Closure

• Prepare for and support regulatory, certification-body and customer audits, including factory surveillance audits for certification marks.

• Conduct internal audits (monthly / biannual / annual) to ensure ongoing compliance with regulations and standards; coordinate surveillance and recertification audits.

• Drive corrective and preventive actions for non-conformities using structured problem-solving (8D, 7 QC). USP & Claims

• Technical verification of USP / claims, including energy, performance and safety claims on export labels and marketing material, and clearance as per applicable guidelines.

**Learning & Development**

• Continuously enhance knowledge of international standards and market regulations, and share learnings with the design and quality teams to build capability and support better business performance.

**EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATIONS**

B. E, B.Tech / M.E, M.Tech – Mechanical / Electrical & Electronics.

**WORK EXPERIENCE**

5 to 10 years Worked in QA / DQC / product compliance role, or in certification bodies or test labs, with exposure to export-market certification.

**CERTIFICATIONS**

QMS – ISO 9001:2015 / ISO 17025 training certification. Internal Auditor Certification (organization based / external). Knowledge of IECEE CB scheme and CE / UL certification process (training certificate preferred). Six Sigma Green Belt (Optional).

**PREFERRED/ ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENT**

Industry Preference – Consumer durables / Lighting products – QA / DQC / product compliance, certification bodies or test labs in QA / technical lead roles. Good understanding and working knowledge of ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 17025:2017. Good understanding and interpretation of IEC / EN / IS standards and international test reports / certificates. Hands-on exposure to export certification (CE, UKCA, UL / ETL, G-Mark or equivalent) for appliances or lighting is preferred.

**INTERNAL / EXTERNAL INTERFACE**

Designer – ED & ID Project manager Product Development Tool development PRC Validation Marketing / Export Sales Supply Chain / Logistics Legal Factory Quality / Plant teams External test labs, certification bodies and importers / distributors

**FUNCTIONAL COMPETENCIES**

Ability to interpret IEC / EN / IS standards and test reports / certificates. Knowledge of export-market regulations and marks – CE / UKCA, UL / ETL, FCC, G-Mark and other country schemes. Ability to prepare and maintain technical files, DoCs and compliance matrices. Expert in systematic knowledge approach for SOP / format creation. Expert / ability to interpret product testing and test report review. Ability to manage internal / external audits and certification-body surveillance. Ability to consolidate energy-efficiency and ecodesign requirements for labelling in target markets. Ability to manage multiple compliance projects across markets simultaneously. Strong problem-solving / statistical skills like 8D, 7 QC, SPC, MSA, DFMEA, DFSS.

The team is part of the Cloud Protection and Licensing (CPL) business line of Thales’s Digital Identity & Security (DIS) Global Business Unit.

* Excellent knowledge of business process mapping, workflow optimization, and performance metrics.
* Ability to develop and implement training programs to ensure organizational-wide understanding and compliance.
* Strong project management skills, with experience leading complex, cross-functional initiatives.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* High attention to detail and strong analytical skills for conducting gap analysis and risk assessments.
* Proven ability to work independently and manage multiple projects in a deadline driven environment.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Certified ISO 9001 / 27001 Lead Implementer or Auditor.
* Experience in IT-related industries or other sectors requiring stringent process control and compliance.

Master's Degree

title: Quality Engineer
description:
**Job Summary**
We are looking for Quality Engineers with 3–5 years of experience in production/manufacturing quality and software quality assurance, preferably in the automotive, EV or engineering industry.
  
  
The selected candidates will be responsible for driving quality management activities across production and software development processes, conducting quality audits, monitoring quality KPIs, performing root cause analysis and implementing corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
  
  
Candidates should have hands-on experience in quality management tools such as 8D, 5 Why, FMEA, MSA, SPC, APQP and PPAP, along with an understanding of Software Quality Assurance (SQA) and automotive software quality processes such as ASPICE.
  
  
**Job Details**

* Job Title: Quality Engineer – Production & Software Quality
* Experience: 3–5 Years
* Number of Positions: 1
* Work Mode: Work from Office
* Job Location: Bangalore
* Qualification: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Automobile Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Science or a related engineering discipline.
* Target Joining Date: Immediate / 30 Days

**Technical Requirements**

* Primary Skills: Quality Management, Quality Assurance, Quality Control, Process Quality, Production Quality, Software Quality Assurance (SQA), Root Cause Analysis, Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA), 8D Problem Solving, 5 Why Analysis, FMEA, MSA, SPC, APQP and PPAP.
* Secondary Skills: Software Testing, Quality Audits, Process Compliance, Customer Complaint Analysis, Defect Management, Quality KPI Monitoring, Continuous Improvement, Customer Satisfaction, ASPICE Awareness, Competency Development and Business Excellence.
* Software / Tools: MS Excel, MS PowerPoint, Quality Management Systems (QMS), Statistical Analysis Tools, Defect Tracking Tools and Software Testing Tools.
* Industry Experience: Automotive, Two-Wheeler (2W), Electric Vehicles (EV), Manufacturing, Automotive Components, Engineering Services, Automotive Software Development and Product Quality.

**Job Description**
The Quality Engineer – Production & Software Quality will be responsible for ensuring quality excellence across manufacturing/production processes and software engineering activities.
  
  
The role involves implementing quality management systems, monitoring process performance, conducting internal and process audits, identifying quality gaps and driving corrective and preventive actions. Candidates should have a strong understanding of quality methodologies, problem-solving techniques, process compliance and software quality assurance.
  
  
The selected candidate will collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Production, Manufacturing, Design, Engineering, Software Development, Testing, Validation and Project Management teams, to improve product quality, software delivery and overall process efficiency.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Drive quality assurance initiatives across production, manufacturing and software development projects.
* Monitor and improve quality KPIs, process performance and customer satisfaction metrics.
* Conduct internal quality audits, process assessments and compliance reviews.
* Perform root cause analysis using 8D, 5 Why and other problem-solving methodologies.
* Identify quality issues and implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
* Apply FMEA methodologies to identify potential risks and prevent product or process failures.
* Support MSA and SPC activities to monitor and improve manufacturing process quality.
* Support APQP and PPAP activities to ensure product quality and process compliance.
* Drive Software Quality Assurance activities and support software testing and defect management processes.
* Support ASPICE assessments and automotive software process improvement activities.
* Analyze production defects, software defects, customer complaints and field failure reports.
* Prepare and maintain quality reports, audit reports, process documentation and improvement records.
* Monitor quality metrics and prepare periodic performance reports for management review.
* Identify process gaps and drive continuous improvement initiatives.
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams to resolve product, process and software quality issues.
* Support customer audits, supplier quality activities and quality-related assessments.
* Drive quality awareness, competency development and best-practice adoption across teams.
* Support business excellence initiatives and organizational process improvements.
* Ensure compliance with applicable quality standards, procedures and organizational requirements.
* Work closely with engineering and project teams to improve overall product and software delivery quality.

title: Technical Writer
description:
The Chevron Engineering and Innovation Excellence Center (ENGINE) in Bengaluru India brings together the resources and expertise of the Chevron global network with talent in India to enhance agility and technological innovation to optimize solutions for the world’s current and future energy challenges. As one of the leading energy providers worldwide, Chevron is involved in the production of crude oil and natural gas, manufacturing of transportation fuels, lubricants, petrochemicals, and additives, and the development of enabling technologies.
  
  
Chevron's vision is to be the global energy company most admired for its people, partnerships, and performance. With a clear purpose to develop affordable, reliable, ever-cleaner energy that enables human progress, we believe human ingenuity has the power to solve any challenge and overcome any obstacle. Meeting the world’s growing energy needs requires the pursuit of innovations and advancements that deliver a better future for all.
  
  
**About The Position**
The Specialty Operations Infrastructure Technical Writer partners with Specialty Operations Infrastructure teams to develop, revise, administer, and maintain technical documentation, standard operating procedures (SOPs), training materials, and competency frameworks that support safe, consistent, and compliant execution of infrastructure workflows. This role works closely with Infrastructure engineers, operations, maintenance, support teams, training resources, and ENGINE technical personnel to ensure procedures and related content accurately reflect current-state operations and governance requirements. This role will also be responsible for maintaining and updating various SharePoint sites across Infrastructure as needed.
  
  
**Job Description Summary**
In addition to technical writing responsibilities, this position may support training administration, readiness, and competency tracking across Infrastructure roles by coordinating required learning, monitoring completions/validations, and maintaining audit-ready records. The role contributes to meeting key performance metrics related to training compliance, documentation accuracy, and document lifecycle management.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Documentation Infrastructure & SOP Governance**

* To Execute technical writing tasks for Infrastructure technical controls and SOP governance workflows, including Change, Revision/Modification, and New Content requests. Create and maintain controlled documentation such as SOPs, Infrastructure Operating Procedures, Work Instructions, Job Aids, guidance documents, operating manuals, and reference documents.
* Collaborate with Specialty Operations Infrastructure engineers, technical leads, trainers, and subject matter experts to ensure documentation is accurate, current, usable, and fit-for-purpose.
* Ensure SOPs and other Infrastructure technical documents are formatted and structured in accordance with enterprise and Specialty Operations documentation standards, including Human and Organizational Performance (HOP) requirements where applicable.
* Identify opportunities to optimize, standardize, consolidate, and simplify SOPs and related technical documentation and training materials across Infrastructure teams.
* Partner with facilities to digitize records and build out, implement, and maintain paper-free processes
* Manage and maintain overarching document libraries as well as Infrastructure facilities' libraries and internal website pages.
* Build and maintain documentation automation solutions for Infrastructure facilities

**Training Administration & Readiness Support**

* Support Infrastructure training administration activities, including coordination of required role-based training, tracking of completions/recurrences, and management of training records.
* Partner with Infrastructure training resources and subject matter experts to ensure training materials align with current procedures, job roles, and competency expectations, and incorporate feedback and human factors considerations into procedures and training content.
* Maintain accurate training documentation and records to support audits, compliance requirements, and operational readiness, ensuring required training and documentation-related compliance activities are completed and kept current.

**Competency Tracking and Governance**

* Support competency framework implementation for Specialty Operations Infrastructure roles, including tracking required competencies, qualifications, and validations.
* Monitor completion of required competencies and escalate gaps or risks to appropriate stakeholders.
* Ensure competency and training data is maintained accurately in designated systems to support governance, reporting, and continuous improvement.

**Metrics and Continuous Improvement**

* Ensure timely processing of documentation and training-related workflows to meet established performance metrics (e.g., documentation cycle times, training compliance, and validation timeliness).
* Analyze trends in training and competency data to identify improvement opportunities and support standardization across Infrastructure teams.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives related to documentation quality, training effectiveness, and competency sustainability.

**Required Qualifications**

* Minimum of 5 years of relevant Technical Writing experience; training administration, competency tracking, or documentation management experience is strongly preferred.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office including Word, Adobe Pro, Excel, Teams, etc.
* SharePoint libraries/website management experience
* Experience working with digital procedure or document management systems and controlled documentation/SOP governance environments; experience with Hexagon AKMS (Procedure Hub) or similar platforms is highly desirable.
* Experience supporting operations, infrastructure, or engineering functions within large, complex enterprises (preferably industrial or technical environments).
* Degree or trade qualification in Engineering, Information Management, Operations, or a related technical discipline.
* Strong command of the English language, with proven ability to draft, edit, and interpret complex technical information.

**Preferred Qualification**

* Experience supporting training programs, competency frameworks, or learning administration in an operational or engineering environment.
* Familiarity with Specialty Operations Infrastructure workflows and governance expectations mainly in fuels and lubricants, pipelines and tank facilities.
* Proven ability to work collaboratively across multidisciplinary teams and manage multiple concurrent priorities with minimal supervision.

**What We Can Offer You**
Everything we do at Chevron is guided by our values and our commitment to The Chevron Way.
  
  
Have the opportunity to take part in world-leading energy projects, advance your professional development and expand your career within an inclusive and collaborative workplace.
  
  

* Join a workplace where innovation, collaboration and safety are at the core of how we work.
* Work in thoughtfully designed environments that support focus, well-being, and innovation enhanced by digital tools that enable seamless collaboration.
* Grow through structured learning, mentorship, and opportunities to contribute to impactful projects that align with Chevron’s values and business priorities.
* Access comprehensive benefits that support your health, well-being, and work-life balance.

Chevron ENGINE supports global operations, supporting business requirements across the world. Accordingly, the work hours for employees will be aligned to support business requirements. The standard work week will be Monday to Friday. Working hours are 8:00am to 5:00pm or 1.30pm to 10.30pm.

title: Subject Matter Expert (SME) - Data & AI
description:
**About The Role**
We're looking for a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in Data & AI to join our curriculum team. You'll be the technical backbone of our AI/ML and Data Analytics programs — reviewing content for accuracy, creating learning resources, supporting live sessions, and ensuring learners get a rigorous, up-to-date education in one of the fastest-moving domains in tech.
  
  
This role is ideal for someone who is deeply technical, can explain complex concepts clearly, and wants to shape how the next generation of data practitioners learns.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Review and validate curriculum content for technical accuracy across Python, SQL, ML, DL, and Gen AI topics
* Create and refine learning resources — code notebooks, problem sets, case studies, and project briefs
* Support live and recorded sessions as a technical expert — answer learner questions, review assignments, and provide structured feedback
* Design and evaluate assessments that test real-world application, not just recall
* Stay current on industry tools, frameworks, and Gen AI developments and flag updates to the curriculum team
* Collaborate with Curriculum Engineers and Program Managers to build cohesive, learner-first content

**What We're Looking For**
Technical Skills (must-have):
  
  

* Python — data manipulation, scripting, OOP basics; comfortable with NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib/Seaborn
* SQL — joins, aggregations, window functions, query optimization
* Machine Learning — supervised and unsupervised learning, model evaluation, cross-validation, common algorithms (regression, trees, clustering)
* Deep Learning — neural networks, CNNs, RNNs; familiarity with TensorFlow or PyTorch
* Gen AI & Agentic AI — LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG, agentic frameworks (LangChain, CrewAI, or similar); hands-on experience with OpenAI / Gemini / open-source models
* Data Visualization — Tableau or Power BI; ability to build and interpret dashboards

**What Makes You Stand Out**

* 0–2 years of experience in a data, AI/ML, or analytics role — internships and project-based experience count
* B.Tech / M.Tech / M.Sc in Computer Science, Data Science, AI/ML, Statistics, or a related field (8.0+ CGPA preferred for freshers)
* Strong communication skills — you can explain a gradient descent or a RAG pipeline to someone without a CS degree
* Comfort with Jupyter Notebooks, GitHub, and Google Sheets / Excel
* Curiosity-first mindset — you follow AI developments and have opinions about them

**Good to Have**

* Prior teaching, tutoring, or content creation experience
* Familiarity with instructional tools — LMS platforms, screen recording, slide design
* Exposure to MLOps basics or model deployment (Streamlit, FastAPI, Hugging Face)

**What You Get**

* Hands-on exposure to building curriculum for industry-relevant AI/ML programs
* Work closely with experienced curriculum and program leads
* Fast-paced, learning-first environment where your domain expertise directly shapes learner outcomes
* Competitive compensation based on skills and contribution

title: Security Master Function Analyst - Assistant Vice President
description:
**Who We Are Looking For**
An experienced Security Master Data Analyst to support ssAlpha client implementations and middle-office onboarding. The successful candidate will combine Security Master subject matter expertise, business analysis, and project management office discipline to translate client requirements and source data into clear mapping, transformation, validation, testing, and implementation outcomes. This role requires strong analytical, organizational, and stakeholder-management skills across global business and technology teams.
  
  
**Why this role is important to us**
The team you will be joining is a part of State Street Alpha. Alpha gives asset owners and managers access to the essential financial tools they need to deliver effective investment solutions. From core custody, accounting, fund administration and shareholder recordkeeping, to complete operations solutions and servicing for alternative assets like OTC derivatives, private equity and real estate, Alpha tools help our clients make better investment choices and act on growth opportunities.
  
  
The Security Master function is critical to providing accurate, complete, and timely instrument and reference data across the implementation lifecycle. The SMF Analyst helps connect client requirements, source data, target solutions, testing, governance, and conversion execution so that downstream platforms and operational teams are prepared for go-live and transition to business as usual.
  
  
Join us if making your mark in the financial services industry from day one is a challenge you are up for.
  
  
**What You Will Be Responsible For**

* As SMF Analyst, Assistant Vice President, you will:
* Analyze client Security Master requirements, operating models, security populations, and source data structures.
* Lead requirement-gathering sessions and document business, functional, data, control, and non-functional requirements.
* Define source-to-target mapping, transformation, enrichment, defaulting, exception-handling, and validation requirements.
* Develop and review mapping specifications that describe Security Master and reference data flows from client legacy systems to target applications.
* Support end-to-end solution design and partner with Product and Technology SMEs to clarify target data models, system functionality, integrations, and operational controls.
* Analyze data quality, completeness, referential integrity, tolerances, classifications, and consistency across systems.
* Support test strategy, scenario development, data preparation, readiness assessments, reconciliation, defect analysis, and entry and exit criteria.
* Investigate data and process issues, perform root-cause analysis, coordinate remediation, and document decisions and outcomes.
* Partner with Implementation, Conversion, Product, Technology, Operations, testing teams, and clients to document requirements, test evidence, defects, resolutions, and implementation outcomes.
* Coordinate Security Master support for dry runs, dress rehearsals, cutover, go-live, and post-production stabilization, including occasional weekend or off-hours activity.
* Build and maintain integrated work plans, milestone schedules, deliverable trackers, RAID logs, decision logs, dependency registers, and action-item trackers.
* Monitor progress against milestones, identify scope or schedule variance, and drive timely escalation and recovery actions.
* Prepare status reporting covering accomplishments, upcoming activities, risks, issues, dependencies, decisions, and leadership support required.
* Facilitate working sessions, governance meetings, readiness reviews, and checkpoint calls; publish agendas, minutes, actions, owners, and due dates.
* Maintain complete, current, and audit-ready project documentation in approved repositories.
* Support scope, change, resource, and cross-workstream dependency management while reinforcing agreed governance standards.
* Serve as a client-facing Security Master contact for requirements, solutioning, issue management, readiness, and delivery activities.
* Support transition to business as usual through knowledge transfer, operating procedures, open-item tracking, and stabilization reporting.
* During normal day-to-day operations, identify unusual or potentially suspicious transaction activity and report or escalate it in accordance with corporate policy and relevant operating procedures.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**What We Value**
These skills will help you succeed in this role
  
  

* Strong knowledge of capital markets, Security Master and reference data, financial instruments, and middle-office processes; familiarity with IBOR and ABOR concepts is beneficial.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze source data, define mappings and transformations, establish validation rules, and investigate data issues.
* Strong business analysis skills, including elicitation, process analysis, requirements documentation, traceability, and stakeholder validation.
* Practical PMO capabilities, including planning, milestone tracking, RAID management, governance reporting, meeting facilitation, and documentation control.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to lead discussions and communicate complex data topics to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, organizational, and time-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, work across global teams and time zones, and meet tight deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Ability to proactively identify risks, dependencies, and delivery gaps and drive timely resolution or escalation.
* Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio, and SharePoint; experience with Microsoft Project, JIRA, Confluence, or comparable tools.
* Working understanding of databases, data warehouses, SQL, reconciliation techniques, and data quality controls.

**Education & Preferred Qualifications**

* BS/BA in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Information Systems, Data Management, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
* 7 to 10 of relevant financial services experience, preferably in Security Master, reference data, middle office, client onboarding, implementation, conversion, or business analysis.
* Experience supporting complex, cross-functional programs with formal project governance and reporting responsibilities.
* A master’s degree or relevant business analysis, project management, data management, or Agile certification is a plus, but not required.

Occasional travel for client or global team onsite engagements may be required.
  
  
**About State Street**
Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.
  
  
We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.

title: Lead I - Engineering Design
description:
**Role Description**
The CSV Engineer will support the implementation and validation of the Rockwell PharmaSuite Manufacturing Execution System (MES) at Thermo Fisher Scientific’s Greenville, North Carolina manufacturing site. Based in India, this role will work closely with Greenville Operations, Manufacturing Science and Technology (MSAT), Quality, IT, and MES delivery teams to ensure electronic manufacturing workflows are validated, fit for intended use, and ready for GMP production. How will you make an impact? Own and execute day-to-day CSV deliverables for configured PharmaSuite workflows, with particular emphasis on electronic batch records (eBR), electronic logbooks (eLogs), and associated manufacturing execution processes. Translate manufacturing requirements into risk-based validation evidence, manage test execution and deviations, and support an efficient transition from project implementation into a controlled, validated production state. What will you do?
  
  

* Develop and maintain risk-based validation deliverables for Rockwell PharmaSuite MES workflows, including validation plans, requirements and specification traceability, risk assessments, test protocols, reports, and summary documentation.
* Review user requirements, process flows, and configured MES recipes/workflows to ensure testing reflects Greenville manufacturing processes and GMP requirements.
* Author, review, and execute IQ/OQ/PQ or equivalent lifecycle test scripts, with emphasis on functional and end-to-end testing of eBRs, eLogs, electronic signatures, audit trails, and exception handling.
* Coordinate remote validation execution with site subject-matter experts, MES configuration teams, IT, and Quality; document objective evidence, defects, and test outcomes in approved systems.
* Investigate and resolve validation test failures, discrepancies, and deviations; support impact assessments, remediation, retesting, and closure in collaboration with the site.
* Maintain requirements-to-test traceability, configuration/version control evidence, and documentation supporting inspection readiness and release for GMP use.
* Assess system changes and workflow revisions for validation impact; support regression testing, change controls, and continued maintenance of the validated state.
* Participate in deployment readiness, user acceptance testing, go-live support, and handover to site support teams; escalate risks to validation quality, schedule, or compliance promptly.
* Apply applicable site procedures and GxP expectations, including GAMP 5 principles, data integrity requirements, and FDA 21 CFR Part 11 as relevant to the implementation. How will you get here? Education Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Life Sciences, or a related technical field preferred; equivalent relevant validation experience will be considered. Required experience
* Hands-on computerized system validation experience in pharmaceutical or biotechnology GMP manufacturing, preferably 3+ years.
* Experience authoring and executing CSV protocols and managing validation deviations, traceability, and release documentation.
* Practical understanding of MES manufacturing workflows and the validation of configured applications, including recipe or workflow changes.
* Working knowledge of GAMP 5, data integrity (ALCOA+), electronic records/signatures, and applicable GMP regulatory expectations.
* Ability to work independently from India with US-based stakeholders and to communicate clearly in written and spoken English. Preferred experience
* Direct experience validating Rockwell PharmaSuite MES including eBR and/or eLog workflows.
* Experience with electronic batch record execution, manufacturing exception handling, equipment/material workflows, and MES interfaces to enterprise or shop-floor systems.
* Experience supporting US FDA-regulated manufacturing facilities and geographically distributed deployment teams. Knowledge, skills, and abilities
* Strong attention to detail, structured documentation practices, and ability to investigate and close complex test issues.
* Ability to prioritize multiple deliverables, work across Operations, QA, IT, and technical teams, and meet project milestones.
* Willingness to maintain regular overlap with Greenville, North Carolina working hours and flex schedule for critical execution, testing, and go-live activities.

ALCOA+, CSV, Change Management

title: Application Engineer - Signal Processing & HDL
description:
**Summary**
MathWorks has a hybrid work model that enables staff members to split their time between office and home. The hybrid model provides the advantage of having both in-person time with colleagues and flexible at-home life optimizations. Learn More: https://www.mathworks.com/company/jobs/resources/applying-and-interviewing.html#onboarding.
  
  
As an Application Engineer for Signal Processing, Communications, and FPGA Design, you will partner with our most innovative customers to establish MATLAB and Simulink as a platform for a variety of application areas including:
  
  

* Prototyping and Implementing Designs on FPGAs and SDRs
* HDL (VHDL / Verilog) Code Generation and Verification

You will work in a pre-sales manner with our customers to identify and understand their technical and business challenges. You will develop and deliver compelling demonstrations of solutions that help customers appreciate how the adoption of MathWorks products adds value towards enhancing their workflows. You will also engage strategically with customers in developing long-term adoption plans that will enable them to progressively roll-out increasingly productive workflows in their organizations.
  
  
Using your technical expertise as well as your excellent interpersonal, communication, and presentation skills, you will engage customers and prospects in seminars, conference calls, meetings, and through product evaluations to develop a shared vision for success.
  
  
MathWorks nurtures growth, appreciates inclusivity, encourages initiative, values teamwork, shares success, and rewards excellence.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Provide technical pre-sales support and guidance to the India sales organization, prospects, and customers in the domains of signal processing, communications, and radar system design, as well as implementing these designs on FPGAs SoCs and SDRs through automatic HDL code generation and verification techniques by:
  
  

* Preparing and delivering presentations, demonstrations, and application examples in customer meetings, seminars, and other public events
* Managing product evaluations and developing adoption plans that assist customers in adopting MathWorks products
* Partnering with Sales Account Managers to help develop account and territory level selling strategies
* Identify new trends and application areas and provide feedback to development and marketing teams. Collaborate with the worldwide team on developing compelling messages and demonstrations.
* Advocate for the future direction of MathWorks products based on customer interactions.
* Establish rapport and credibility with our customers across multiple hierarchy levels to build champion users and supporters of our solutions.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* A bachelor's degree and 6 years of professional work experience (or a master's degree and 3 years of professional work experience, or a PhD degree, or equivalent experience) is required.

**Additional Qualifications**

* Post-graduate degree in Engineering (M.E./M.Tech./Ph.D)
* 3-7 years of relevant industry experience preferably in the Communications, Electronics, Semiconductors, or Aerospace/Defence (Avionics) industries.
* Strong knowledge and experience in modeling and simulating signal processing and/or communications and/or radar systems using MATLAB and Simulink.
* Strong knowledge and experience in digital hardware design and implementation of signal processing/communications/radar algorithms on FPGAs. Strong knowledge of either VHDL or Verilog.
* Experience in using EDA tools for hardware design (Xilinx Vivado, System Generator, etc).
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Highly motivated toward working directly with customers
* This position is based in Bangalore with travel generally throughout India for various customer visits and seminars. Travel time can be expected to amount to approximately 30-40% with trips generally no longer than five days. Though far less frequent, some international travel is expected.

title: Senior Technical Writer
description:
The MongoDB Documentation team is a group of writers and engineers who develop and maintain the documentation for the MongoDB product family. Our goal is to help our readers, both humans and AI, successfully use MongoDB products by providing outstanding documentation. The MongoDB Documentation team is a part of the MongoDB Core Product organization and is tightly integrated with the engineering teams responsible for each product.
  
  
The Docs team is responsible for documenting all aspects of the MongoDB data platform including the database, query language, Atlas, Vector Search, VoyageAI models, Full-Text Search, Stream Processing, client libraries, administrative tools, connectors, and more.
  
  
Your AI-forward mindset coupled with strong writing and technical skills will create clear reference docs and tutorials on high-complexity features. Your work, along with the other two MongoDB Docs teams, support AI agents, answer engines, and a large global community of new and experienced MongoDB users.
  
  
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurgaon, Bengaluru or Mumbai for our hybrid working model.
  
  
Candidate Profile:
  
  
Candidates must have experience in a technical writing, technical communications, developer relations, or similar role in the software industry. Beyond industry experience, we are looking for someone who:
  
  

* Has experience writing technical documentation from scratch in English
* Possesses strong critical reading and writing skills
* Has hands-on experience using AI tools to accelerate documentation work
* Leverages sound editorial judgment to evaluate AI-generated content against source material for technical accuracy

title: Training Manager, Relay Product Excellence
description:
**Description**
Relay Product Excellence (RPE) bridges Relay technology and operations. We deliver fast-paced investigations, exception management, and quality improvement programs that protect Carriers, Drivers, and Amazon Relay globally. We apply human judgment to the complex and ambiguous cases, identify gaps in automated and manual mechanisms, and surface the patterns in exceptions that point to a fix. Partnering with Relay Product and Tech, we turn those patterns into automation and high data quality — so repetitive work scales, and risk does not.
  
  
Good human judgment depends on good training, and we are looking for a Training Manager to build and own the RPE training program in Bengaluru. This is an individual contributor role. You will design the curriculum, the mechanisms, and the standards; subject matter experts (SMEs) will deliver training under your direction. You will own the program end to end, from new-hire onboarding to developing associates, and you will define how success is measured. The ideal candidate is a skilled instructional designer who is comfortable with data, can earn trust from operations leaders they don't manage, and likes building programs from scratch more than inheriting them.
  
  
Curriculum and Program Design: You will redesign and standardize new-hire training, covering curriculum, assessments, certification gates, and handoff to the floor. You will build a cross-training framework so associates can be certified on several processes, and design a development curriculum for associates.
  
  
SOP and Knowledge Management: You will turn our SOPs and team wiki into a governed knowledge base, with clear owners, version control, a review schedule, and a defined process for pushing policy and process changes into training quickly.
  
  
SME Enablement: You will run a train-the-trainer program that certifies SMEs as trainers, review their delivery quality, and hold them to the standards you set. You will agree SME time with operations leads and influence without formal authority.
  
  
Measurement and Stakeholder Management: There is no training baseline today. You will establish one, then own the metrics that show training effectiveness: time-to-proficiency, new-hire quality, and cross-training coverage. You will partner with Quality to turn audit defect trends into targeted refresher training, and report results to leadership in operating reviews.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Own the RPE training program end to end for Bengaluru investigators.
* Revamp and standardize the new-hire training framework, including curriculum, assessments, certification gates, and floor-readiness criteria.
* Design and roll out an associate cross-process training framework, and maintain a certification matrix by process.
* Design a development training curriculum for associates .
* Own SOP governance and the team wiki, with a review schedule, version control, and an agreed turnaround for pushing process changes into training.
* Build and run a train-the-trainer program; certify SMEs as trainers and review their delivery quality.
* Measure the training baseline, set targets, and report time-to-proficiency, new-hire quality gap, and cross-training coverage in WBRs.
* Partner with Operations and Quality to find knowledge gaps from audit and case data, and close them with targeted training.
* Write clear documents (training strategy, curriculum designs, program reviews) and present recommendations to leadership for sign-off.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree
* 4+ years of experience in training, learning & development, or instructional design, including 2+ years owning a training program end to end.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* Hands-on experience with an instructional design model such as ADDIE, SAM, or similar.
* Experience designing assessments and measuring training effectiveness (e.g., Kirkpatrick levels 1–3).
* Strong facilitation skills, including experience training and certifying trainers.
* Advanced Excel skills; able to build training dashboards and analyze performance data to drive decisions.
* Experience influencing stakeholders you don't manage, such as SMEs, operations leaders, and quality teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's degree
* Experience in relevant industry fields like operations, risk, or fraud investigations
* Knowledge of SQL
* Experience with Learning Management Systems (LMS), or experience with multimedia content creation
* Certification in instructional design or L&D (e.g., CPTD or ATD credentials).
* Experience building training programs from scratch in an ambiguous, fast-scaling operations environment.

title: Compliance Engineer
description:
AMETEK/United Electronic Industries (UEI) is a well-established global manufacturer of computer-based measurement and control (I/O) products using leading edge technology to support aerospace, private space launch, and simulation customers. We are growing, and working here offers high visibility in a dynamic and highly collaborative environment.
  
  
We are looking to hire a full-time Compliance Engineer interested in leading the efforts to identify compliance gaps, coordinate qualification testing, maintain compliance documentation, establish engineering justifications, and support customer, third-party, and regulatory audits. The position works closely with Engineering, Quality, Operations, Product Management, Manufacturing, and external test laboratories to ensure compliance requirements are incorporated throughout the product lifecycle.
  
  
Reporting to the Senior Test Engineer, the Compliance Engineer will support EMI / EMC analysis of UEI product schematics, PCB layouts, BOMs, test data, and design documentation. The goal is to help determine product conformance to applicable US and EU requirements by pre-compliance measurements, engineering analysis, or similarity to previously tested and certified UEI designs. The Compliance Engineer is responsible for developing, implementing, and maintaining product compliance programs that ensure UEI products meet applicable regulatory, environmental, military, industry, and customer-specific requirements. This role serves as the company's subject matter expert for product qualification, verification, certification, and standards compliance, ensuring that objective evidence exists to support product claims, declarations of conformity, and customer requirements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Establish and maintain compliance strategies that support product qualification and certification objectives
* Compare new or modified UEI products against previously tested designs to support conformance-by-similarity assessments and identify design differences that may require additional testing
* Assist with pre-compliance EMI/EMC measurements, including conducted and radiated emissions checks and preparation for external lab certification when needed
* Maintain comprehensive compliance matrices that map product requirements to applicable standards, test methods, analyses, inspections, and supporting evidence.
* Document review results, test setups, observed failures, root-cause analyses, corrective actions, and similarity justifications in a clear engineering format
* Work with senior engineers to debug EMI/EMC issues using oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, near-field probes, LISNs, current probes, DMMs, waveform generators, and other lab instrumentation
* Participate in design reviews, maintain organized test data, compliance evidence, review checklists, and supporting documentation for future reuse and audits

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Systems Engineering, or closely related field. Relevant experience may be considered.
* 8+ years of experience in hardware engineering, product compliance, qualification testing, regulatory compliance, EMI / EMC engineering, or a related technical field.
* 8+ years of experience reviewing and interpreting and interpreting electronic schematics and hardware design documentation.
* 8+ years of experience supporting product qualification, verification, validation, or certification activities.
* 8+ years working with regulatory, military, aerospace, industrial, environmental, or customer-specific technical standards.

**Desired Qualifications**

* Experience supporting EMI / EMC compliance testing, troubleshooting, and certification activities.
* Familiarity with military and aerospace standards, including MIL-STD, RTCA DO-160, IEC, CE, FCC, RoHS, REACH, or comparable requirements.

* Over $300 million raised in funding
* 3,000 Tideans globally
* We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

**About Tide**
At Tide, we are building a finance & admin platform designed to save small businesses time and money. We provide our members with business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of connected administrative solutions from invoicing to accounting.
  
  
Launched in 2017, Tide is now the leading business financial platform in the UK with 900,000 SME members (15% market share) . Headquartered in London, Tide has over 3000 Tideans across the UK, Bulgaria, India, Serbia, Romania, Ukraine and Germany.
  
  
Tide is rapidly growing, expanding into new markets and always looking for passionate and driven people. Join us in our mission to empower small businesses and help them save time and money.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Tide Security Engineering team is made up of three core areas: Product Security, Threat Detection & Response, and Identity.
  
  
**Product Security**
(this role!) consists of application and cloud security experts. Their mission is to protect the products we build, covering everything from secure design reviews, secure code reviews to threat modelling and AI secure design review, ensuring security is embedded from the ground up.
  
  
**Threat Detection & Response**
focuses on protecting the company by building a robust detection and automation platform. We’re proactive in our defence, constantly hacking ourselves to improve our security posture and staying ahead of emerging threats. Our goal is to make Tide resilient against the ever-evolving threat landscape.
  
  
**Identity**
is responsible for managing Tide's staff identity platform, ensuring that access to systems and infrastructure is secure, seamless, and aligned with modern security practices. The team uses strategies like zero trust, multi-factor authentication, and granular role-based access controls to safeguard our internal operations.
  
  
While each area has its own focus, collaboration is key - it's why we share the same Slack channel and hold our standups together as one cohesive team, ensuring alignment and seamless communication across all security functions.
  
  
**What We’re Looking For**
First and foremost you will be passionate about security and resilient software development processes. You will enjoy hunting for vulnerabilities in our web, mobile applications and AI agents, working with our engineering teams to remediate them strategically. You will be comfortable explaining security issues and concerns to product owners, engineers, VPs and executives and love the feeling you get when this results in them releasing a more resilient product. You will be a keen follower of all things Infosec and constantly be on the lookout for ways to apply new industry trends, tools and automations to your day-to-day role.
  
  
**As a Senior Product Security Engineer You’ll**

* Regularly dive deep into mobile, web app technologies in order to understand feature development and proactively hunt for vulnerabilities
* Be proficient in securing cloud-native applications, ensuring that security best practices are applied consistently across our cloud environment
* Be proficient in threat modelling and guide developers in secure design principles to prevent vulnerabilities from being introduced in the first place

description:
**Job Description**
The Vulnerability Assessment Engineer is responsible for identifying, analyzing, and reporting security vulnerabilities across the organization's IT infrastructure, with a specific focus on integrating and securing new servers during their onboarding and commissioning phases using industry-leading tools like Qualys or Tenable.The Vulnerability Assessment Engineer is responsible for identifying, analyzing, and reporting security vulnerabilities across the organization's IT infrastructure, with a specific focus on integrating and securing new servers during their onboarding and commissioning phases using industry-leading tools like Qualys or Tenable.
  
  
**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**

* Execute regular and ad-hoc vulnerability scans across the enterprise network, applications, and systems using Qualys Vulnerability Management (VMDR) or Tenable.io/Nessus.
* Analyze scan results, prioritize vulnerabilities based on risk, and provide detailed reports to relevant stakeholders.
* Actively participate in the server commissioning process, ensuring all new servers are integrated into the vulnerability management program from day one.
* Perform initial baseline vulnerability assessments on newly provisioned servers before they enter production, identifying and reporting critical security gaps.
* Collaborate with server administrators and project teams to ensure identified vulnerabilities on new servers are remediated or mitigated according to security policies and timelines.
* Verify the secure configuration of new servers against established security baselines and compliance requirements.
* Work closely with IT operations, development, and system owners to facilitate the remediation of identified vulnerabilities.
* Track remediation efforts and re-scan systems to confirm the effectiveness of applied patches and configuration changes.
* Maintain, configure, and optimize vulnerability scanning platforms (Qualys or Tenable) to ensure accurate and comprehensive coverage.
* Develop and refine scanning policies, profiles, and reporting templates.
* Generate comprehensive vulnerability reports, dashboards, and metrics for various audiences, including technical teams and management.
* Maintain accurate documentation of vulnerability assessment processes, findings, and remediation activities.

**Key Skills And Experience**
**Must-Have:**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
* Up to 8-12 years of experience in cybersecurity, with a strong focus on vulnerability management or security operations.
* Demonstrable hands-on experience with either Qualys (VMDR, Cloud Agent) or Tenable (Nessus, Tenable.io, Security Center) platforms.
* Solid understanding of network protocols, operating systems (Windows, Linux), and common enterprise applications.
* Familiarity with security frameworks and standards (e.g., NIST, ISO 27001, CIS Benchmarks).

**Nice-to-Have:**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, capable of explaining complex technical issues to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Ability to prioritize tasks, manage multiple projects, and work effectively in a fast-paced environment.

title: Mobile Security Expert Team Lead
description:
