Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
  
  
Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
  
  
As a Mobile Security Expert Team Leader within Thales Cybersecurity and Digital Identity, you will lead a team responsible for defining, delivering, and advancing mobile application security across an international environment. Working with teams in France, India, Singapore, and the United States, you will provide recognized technical expertise, lead complex security assessments, influence product and engineering decisions, and mentor cybersecurity and development teams. You will collaborate with specialists from multiple security domains and use your experience to shape methods, standards, tooling, and strategic direction for the mobile cybersecurity ecosystem.
  
  
**Roles and responsibilities:**

* Lead a dedicated team of mobile security experts, including setting priorities, planning and following up on team activities, providing technical guidance, and supporting the development of team members.
* Lead and contribute to complex penetration testing and reverse-engineering activities for Android and iOS applications
* Lead and contribute to threat modelling and security risk assessments, identifying threats, evaluating business and product impact, and recommending appropriate countermeasures.
* Act as security advisor for product architecture and feature design, driving secure-by-design decisions.
* Lead security research into emerging threats, technologies, attack techniques, and tooling, including AI-based security capabilities, and translate findings into operational improvements.
* Stay up to date with mobile threat landscape and propose new defence mechanisms for our products.
* Provide technical oversight for security documentation and customer-facing assessments
* Organize mobile security awareness trainings for the different mobile development teams.
* Help define, maintain, and support the application of mobile security processes across development teams, including the evaluation of security tools.

**Requirements:**

* Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain security risks and recommendations to developers, architects, product teams, management and customers.
* Experience leading, coordinating, or providing technical leadership to highly autonomous security experts or penetration testers.
* Hands-on experience in mobile application security assessment and penetration testing (Android and/or iOS), with the technical depth necessary to guide and challenge experienced mobile security specialists.
* Experience assessing, prioritizing and communicating security vulnerabilities based on technical severity, exploitability and business/product impact, and supporting remediation decisions with engineering teams.
* Experience defining, improving or applying security processes, methodologies, standards and technical security requirements within a product or software development environment.
* Knowledge of applied cryptography and security best practices
* Understanding of low-level aspects of operating systems
* A certification in project management or security related field is a plus.

Mobile Security Experts have a strong tradition of contributing to the wider security community, including presentations at international security conferences
  
  
**Location**
: India (Noida).
  
  
At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

title: Senior Analytics Engineer, FinOps Reporting
description:
**Location:** Anywhere in India (Hybrid or Home based)

**Position Summary**
--------------------

Bentley Systems is seeking a Senior Power BI Data Modeler to own the reporting and semantic layer supporting the company’s Cloud and AI technology spend. In this role, you will develop and maintain certified datasets, establish appropriate access controls, and deliver executive, team-level, and self-service reporting through Power BI using data from Databricks and BigQuery.

This position is responsible for the quality and ongoing management of these data products, including how they are modeled, governed, secured, and maintained. Success in this role requires ensuring that technology cost data is accurate, current, appropriately permissioned, and accessible to the teams responsible for managing it.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Design, develop, and maintain certified shared datasets and semantic models supporting Cloud and AI technology spend.
* Create dimensional data models, star schemas, DAX measures, and incremental refresh processes using Power BI and the Databricks data catalog.
* Own the access model for technology spend data, ensuring that teams can securely access the information applicable to their areas.
* Configure and maintain access controls, including role-based access control, row-level security, object-level security, and sensitivity labels.
* Ensure reporting solutions comply with applicable security and data governance standards.
* Automate governance, security, deployment, and maintenance activities through APIs, scripts, and notebooks.
* Perform data validation, reconciliation, and tie-out exercises to support the testing of new and existing project financial data models and enhancements.
* Establish and monitor data refresh service-level expectations, failure alerts, and controls that allow issues to be identified and addressed promptly.
* Build and maintain executive, team-level, and self-service reports covering cost allocation, budget-to-actual variance, commitment coverage, and unit economics.
* Partner with engineering, product, finance, and other stakeholders to ensure that financial data models accurately reflect business requirements.
* Help engineering and product teams understand, interpret, and use their technology cost data effectively.
* Drive adoption of certified datasets and self-service reporting capabilities across participating teams.
* Apply Git-based development and deployment practices to semantic models and reporting solutions.
* Maintain clear documentation for datasets, calculations, access controls, and reporting processes.
* This is a full-time position. Travel requirements and typical working hours will be based on the role’s assigned location.
* Requires sitting or standing at will while performing work on a computer.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* 7 to 8 years of relevant experience in business intelligence, analytics engineering, data modeling, data warehousing, or a related discipline.
* At least two years of experience owning shared or certified datasets and data products, rather than focusing exclusively on individual report development.
* Advanced experience with Power BI semantic modeling, including star schemas, DAX, incremental refresh, and row-level security.
* Strong SQL skills and experience working with Databricks SQL and Delta Lake.
* Strong understanding of dimensional modeling and data warehousing principles.
* Experience designing star schemas and enterprise-level reporting models.
* Experience working with large-scale datasets and complex reporting environments.
* Experience implementing access and data security controls, such as role-based access control, row-level security, object-level security, and sensitivity labels.
* Experience using Git-based version control and deployment practices.
* Experience validating and reconciling financial or operational data across source systems, models, and reports.
* Working knowledge of financial and cost-allocation concepts, or the ability to develop that knowledge quickly, including the differences between amortized and billed costs.
* Ability to take ownership of data quality, refresh reliability, access governance, and the ongoing maintenance of data products.
* Ability to communicate complex data and financial concepts to engineering, product, finance, and executive stakeholders.
* Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate, or successful completion of the PL-300 certification exam.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience working with cloud and technology billing data from platforms such as Azure Cost Management, Google Cloud Billing, or AWS.
* Experience analyzing or reporting on AI-related technology costs, including services such as Claude or Microsoft Copilot.
* Experience developing cost-allocation models for multi-tenant products, platforms, or environments.
* Experience supporting FinOps, technology business management, cloud cost optimization, or related financial management practices.
* FinOps Certified Practitioner credential, or willingness to earn the certification within the first year of employment with company sponsorship.

This is a Hybrid role.  

**What We Offer:**

* Step into a collaborative work environment where ideas flourish, and teamwork propels us forward towards shared success.
* An attractive salary and benefits package.
* Bentley Impact Day: take a day off from work to volunteer with an organization of your choice.
* Celebrate milestone achievements and moments that matter through our colleague recognition award programs and our Bentley Achievers platform.
* A commitment to inclusion, belonging and colleague wellbeing through global initiatives and resource groups.
* Be part of a company committed to making a real difference by advancing the world’s infrastructure for better quality of life, where your contributions help build a more sustainable, connected, and resilient world. Discover our latest user success stories for an insight into our global impact.

**Who We Are:**

Bentley Systems (Nasdaq: BSY) is the infrastructure engineering software company. We provide innovative software to advance the world’s infrastructure – sustaining both the global economy and environment. Our industry-leading software solutions are used by professionals, and organizations of every size, for the design, construction, and operations of roads and bridges, rail and transit, water and wastewater, public works and utilities, buildings and campuses, mining, and industrial facilities. Our offerings, powered by the iTwin Platform for infrastructure digital twins, include MicroStation and Bentley Open applications for modeling and simulation, Seequent’s software for geoprofessionals, and Bentley Infrastructure Cloud encompassing ProjectWise for project delivery, SYNCHRO for construction management, and AssetWise for asset operations. Bentley Systems’ 5,200 colleagues generate annual revenues of more than $1 billion in 194 countries.

**Equal Opportunity Employer:**

Bentley is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and considers for employment all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, gender/gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, marital status, religion/belief, national origin, caste, age, or any other characteristic protected by local law or unrelated to job qualifications.

title: Fraud Control-Sr. Executive-Ahmedabad
description:

VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
  
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. #VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture

**About this Role**
-------------------

We are seeking a **Fraud Control Analyst** to identify, investigate and prevent activities that could result in financial loss or a poor customer experience. Based in **India or the EU** and reporting to a Team Leader within Security Operations, you will monitor customer activity, analyse suspected fraud cases and take timely decisions to prevent fraudulent activity.

This opportunity is suited to candidates with **3–5 years of experience in analytics, banking, telecommunications, fraud control, revenue assurance or customer support**, particularly where data analysis has been an important part of the role. The position operates in a **24/7 environment**.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* Monitor customer accounts, services and transactions to identify potentially fraudulent or suspicious activity, including roaming, domestic, artificially inflated traffic and first-party fraud.
* Conduct detailed investigations of identified fraud-risk cases and use available evidence to confirm or rule out fraudulent activity.
* Monitor accounts with unusually high local or international voice, messaging or data usage and take appropriate preventive action in line with established procedures.
* Identify emerging fraud patterns and recommend effective approaches for fraud prevention, detection and resolution.
* Manage internal fraud-related requests and complaints received through phone and email while maintaining high customer service standards.
* Make timely, evidence-based decisions to prevent fraudulent activity, including independently resolving complex cases within established processes.
* Maintain accurate case handling and meet agreed productivity, quality, service-level and process-compliance requirements.
* Contribute to performance reporting, including key performance indicators and service delivery standards.
* Collaborate professionally with colleagues, Team Leaders and other stakeholders, and recommend opportunities to improve fraud-control processes.
* Comply with applicable internal regulations, departmental procedures and the Code of Conduct.

Success in the role will be measured primarily through the **speed and effectiveness of fraud prevention, accuracy of decisions and adherence to required processes**.

**Who you are**
---------------

* You are a graduate from a recognised university with **3–5 years of relevant experience** in analytics, banking, telecommunications, fraud control, revenue assurance or a customer support role involving data analysis.
* You have strong analytical skills and knowledge of **telecommunications or banking fraud-control practices**, with the judgement to investigate complex information and make appropriate decisions.
* You are comfortable using **Microsoft Office and multiple systems or applications** to analyse information and manage cases.
* You have strong written and verbal English communication skills at approximately **C1/C2 proficiency** and can manage customer and internal interactions professionally, including challenging situations.
* You are organised, customer-focused and results-oriented, can prioritise competing activities, proactively manage your performance and are willing to work in a **24/7 operational environment**.

**Not a perfect fit?**
----------------------

Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.

**What's in it for you**
------------------------

* Opportunity to build practical expertise in **telecommunications fraud detection and prevention**.
* Exposure to customer and transaction monitoring across domestic and international telecommunications services.
* Experience investigating complex fraud-risk cases where decisions directly contribute to reducing financial loss and protecting customer experience.
* Opportunity to work collaboratively within Security Operations and contribute recommendations that improve fraud-control processes and service delivery.
* A role offering meaningful decision-making responsibility and exposure to evolving fraud behaviours and prevention approaches.

**What skills you will learn**
------------------------------

* Advanced fraud-risk analysis and investigation techniques within a telecommunications environment.
* Identification and interpretation of emerging fraud behaviours and suspicious usage patterns.
* Evidence-based decision-making for fraud prevention and loss mitigation.
* Monitoring and interpretation of operational performance measures, including quality, service standards and fraud-prevention effectiveness.
* Cross-functional communication, customer issue resolution and continuous process improvement.

description:

BDO is a global network of professional services firms with a presence in over 166 countries, revenue of over USD 14 billion, and experience of over 60 years. It's a leading service provider for the mid markets with client service at its heart.

BDO India Services Private Limited (or BDO India) is the India member firm of BDO International. BDO India offers strategic, operational, accounting and tax, and regulatory advisory & assistance for both domestic and international organizations across a range of industries. BDO India is led by more than 300+ Partners & Directors with a team of over 10,000 professionals operating across 14 cities and 20 offices. We expect to grow sizably in the coming 3-5 years, adding various dimensions to our business and multiplying and increasing the current team size multi-fold.

**About Cyber**

BDO India cyber security practice is one of the fastest growing areas of the business with significant ambition for the future through additional recruitment and acquisition. As part of our cyber team / tech risk you will be managing teams and projects delivering advisory and technical support to help our clients to improve their information / cyber security posture and respond to the dynamic nature of technology risks / cyber security threats. You will provide security domain expertise and utilise your business insight to work closely with our clients to advise, design, build and deploy pragmatic security solutions that will provide real and tangible benefits to protect their organisations. Furthermore, often carryout out IT Risk Assessments in line with industry better practices (NIST / ISF / Cloud Security / etc.), regulatory mandates (RBI / IRDAI), and various compliance standards focusing on data security, data privacy, etc.

**Role:**

Conduct advanced red team engagements and adversary emulation exercises to evaluate the effectiveness of security controls, detection capabilities, and incident response processes across enterprise environments. Simulate real-world attack scenarios, validate organizational cyber resilience, and identify exploitable attack paths through offensive security assessments. Collaborate with SOC, Threat Hunting, Incident Response, and Security Engineering teams to improve detections, strengthen defensive capabilities, and enhance the organization's overall security posture.

**Responsibilities:**

* Execute red team assessments, adversary emulation exercises, and penetration testing engagements across enterprise environments.
* Simulate real-world attack scenarios to evaluate the effectiveness of preventive, detective, and responsive security controls.
* Perform reconnaissance, enumeration, exploitation, privilege escalation, lateral movement, and post-exploitation activities in authorized environments.
* Conduct assessments across internal networks, Active Directory environments, web applications, cloud platforms, and external attack surfaces.
* Utilize offensive security tools and frameworks to identify vulnerabilities, attack paths, and security weaknesses.
* Develop attack scenarios based on current threat intelligence, adversary tactics, and industry-relevant threat actors.
* Document technical findings, attack chains, proof-of-concept demonstrations, and remediation recommendations.
* Support purple team engagements by collaborating with SOC and Threat Hunting teams to validate detections and improve monitoring capabilities.
* Assist in developing red team playbooks, adversary emulation plans, and testing methodologies aligned with MITRE ATT&CK.
* Validate remediation efforts through retesting and provide technical guidance to stakeholders on risk reduction measures.
* Contribute to the continuous enhancement of offensive security capabilities, tooling, and assessment methodologies.
* Present assessment findings and recommendations to technical teams and security stakeholders.

**Key Technical Skills:**

* Strong expertise in red teaming, adversary emulation, penetration testing, and offensive security methodologies.
* Hands-on experience with tools such as Burp Suite, Nmap, Metasploit, BloodHound, Impacket, CrackMapExec, Mimikatz, Covenant, Sliver, and similar offensive security frameworks.
* Strong understanding of Active Directory attack paths, Kerberos abuse, credential attacks, privilege escalation, and lateral movement techniques.
* Experience conducting assessments across Windows, Linux, cloud, hybrid, and enterprise network environments.
* Familiarity with Palo Alto Cortex XDR and Cortex XSIAM for detection validation, adversary simulation assessment, and purple team exercises.
* Deep understanding of MITRE ATT&CK, Cyber Kill Chain, OWASP Top 10, and modern attack methodologies.
* Proficiency in scripting and automation using PowerShell, Python, Bash, or similar technologies.
* Knowledge of endpoint security controls, EDR technologies, detection engineering, and security monitoring concepts.
* Ability to analyze complex attack chains and translate technical findings into actionable remediation recommendations.
* Strong analytical, reporting, stakeholder management, and presentation skills.
* Mentor junior consultants and contribute to the continuous improvement of offensive security capabilities, tools, and assessment methodologies.

**Certifications**

* OSCP
* CRTO
* CRTP
* PNPT
* eCPPT
* CARTP
* CARTE

description:

* Prepare Technical Reports: Prepare and present technical reports and briefings to Technical and Executive teams, detailing attempts, conclusions, and recommended countermeasures.

Master's Degree

* Exposure to Security Systems: Familiarity with evaluating system security configurations, assessing complex software systems, and identifying weaknesses in security systems.
* Experience with Penetration Testing: Exposure to attempting to hack into networks to access information without authorization, documenting and analyzing findings to determine root causes.
* Understanding of Countermeasures: Knowledge of designing, developing, and implementing countermeasures, system integration, and tools specific to Cyber and Information Operations.
* Familiarity with Technical Reporting: Exposure to preparing and presenting technical reports and briefings to Technical and Executive teams, detailing attempts, conclusions, and recommended countermeasures.
* Analysis of Complex Systems: Ability to analyze complex software systems to determine both functionality and intent of software systems.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* Mathematical Background: Exposure to mathematical concepts and techniques beneficial for analyzing complex software systems and identifying security weaknesses.
* Coding Skills: Familiarity with programming languages and coding principles useful for developing and implementing countermeasures and tools specific to Cyber and Information Operations.

* Bachelor of Commerce

* Bachelor of Computer Applications

* Master of Business Administration

* Cloud Architecture (5+ years)

We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

title: Senior Security Consultant
description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**Senior Security Consulting**
**EY Technology:**
Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently. We have 250,000 people in more than 140 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. Everything from the laptops we use, to the ability to work remotely on our mobile devices and connecting our people and our clients, to enabling hundreds of internal tools and external solutions delivered to our clients. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and is key to us being more innovative as an organization.
  
  
EY Technology supports our technology needs through three business units:
  
  

* Client Technology (CT) - focuses on developing new technology services for our clients. It enables EY to identify new technology-based opportunities faster and pursue those opportunities more rapidly.
* Enterprise Workplace Technology (EWT) – EWT supports our Core Business Services functions and will deliver fit-for-purpose technology infrastructure at the cheapest possible cost for quality services. EWT will also support our internal technology needs by focusing on a better user experience.
* Information Security (Info Sec) - Info Sec prevents, detects, responds, and mitigates cyber-risk, protecting EY and client data, and our information management systems.

**The opportunity**
As a Security Consultant within EY’s internal Global Information Security team, the individual will be a trusted security advisor to the Client Technology Platforms Delivery organization within IT Services. The Client Technology Platforms delivery organization is responsible for end-to-end delivery of technology programs and projects supporting EY’s Client Techmology service lines including delivery of a global managed services platform, big data and analytics solutions as well as individual line of business solutions and services. This role will directly engage in supporting a team of architects, engineers, and product managers for delivery on programs and projects, defining security risks and controls, providing security guidance, identifying and prioritizing security-related requirements, promoting secure-by-default designs and facilitating delivery of information security services throughout the system development life cycle (SDLC). The role will also develop and directly communicate appropriate risk treatment and mitigation options to address security vulnerabilities translated vulnerabilities into business risk terminology for communication to business stakeholders.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Support a technical team with a focuse on the following responsibilities:
* Define security architectures and provide pragmatic security guidance that balance business benefit and risks
* Engage IT project teams throughout the SDLC to identify and prioritize applicable security controls and provide guidance on how to implement these controls
* Perform threat modeling and risk assessments of information systems, applications and infrastructure
* Maintain and enhance the Information Security risk assessment and certification methodologies
* Define security configuration standards for shared and multi-tenant platforms and technologies
* Develop appropriate risk treatment and mitigation options to address security risks identified during security review or audit
* Translate technical vulnerabilities into business risk terminology for business units and recommend corrective actions to customers and project stakeholders
* Provide knowledge sharing and technical assistance to other team members
* Act as Subject Matter Expert (SME) in responsible technologies and have deep technical understanding of responsible services and technology portfolios

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Significant working security experience and knowledge in the design, implementation, and operation of security controls in the following areas:
* Identity and Access Management – Experience with Azure Active Directory (AAD) based Identity and Access Management and Authorization design and integration with API, IDaaS, and Federation technologies.
* Cloud Security – Technical understanding of virtualization, cloud infrastructure, and public cloud offerings and experience designing security configuration and controls within cloud-based solutions e.g., Microsoft Azure and Azure PAAS services or another cloud platform (GCP, AWS, IBM, AliCloud, etc.)
* Infrastructure Security – Experience with the integration of cloud native infrastructure security technologies and solutions into business solution architectures including the integration of identity & access management, Web Application Firewalls (WAFs), Application and API Gateways, intrusion detection and prevention, security monitoring, and data encryption solutions.
* Application Security - Experience with the design and testing of security controls for multi-tier business solutions including the design of application-level access and entitlement management, data tenancy and isolation, encryption, and logging. Working familiarity with REST API and microservices architecture.
* Strong leadership and organizational skills
* Ability to appropriately balance firm security needs with business impact & benefit
* Ability to facilitate compromise to incrementally advance security strategy and objectives
* Ability to team well with others to facilitate and enhance the understanding & compliance to security policies
* Although not required, it is preferred that candidates possess additional working security experience and knowledge in one or more of the following areas:
* Operational Security – Experience with defining operational security models and procedures for business solutions including the operation and maintenance of infrastructure and application security controls.
* Information Security Standards – Knowledge of common information security standards such as: ISO 27001/27002, CSA and CIS Controls, NIST CSF, PCI/DSS, FEDRAMP.
* Product Management – working with broader business and technology teams on aspects of security that affect all phases of PI Planning from concept to design to implementation and then operational support.
* Agile & DevSecOps Methodologies – Experience promoting automated security features in pipelines and security testing as a central feature in Agile workflows as a contributing member within an Agile development or DevOps environment.

**To qualify for the role, you must have:**

* Advanced degree in Computer Science or a related discipline; or equivalent work experience.
* Candidates are preferred to hold or be actively pursuing related professional certifications within the GIAC family of certifications or CISSP, CISM or CISA or similar cloud-security oriented certifications.
* Five or more years of experience in the management of a significant Information Security risk management function
* Experience in managing the communication of security findings and recommendations to IT project teams, business leadership and technology management executives

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Exceptional judgment, tact, and decision-making ability
* Flexibility to adjust to multiple demands, shifting priorities, ambiguity, and rapid change
* Excellent , communication, organizational, and decision-making skills
* Strong English language skills are required

**What Working At EY Offers**
We offer a competitive remuneration package where you’ll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings, and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
  
  
EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

title: Project Manager- Carrier Onboarding
description:
**Why project44?**

At project44, **we believe in better.**

We challenge the status quo because we know a better supply chain isn’t just possible—it’s essential. Better for our customers. Better for their business. Better for the world.

With our **Decision Intelligence Platform,** ***Movement*****,** we’re redefining how global supply chains operate. By transforming fragmented logistics data into real-time, AI-powered insights, we empower companies to connect instantly, see clearly, act decisively, and automate intelligently. Our Supply Chain AI enhances visibility, drives smarter execution, and unlocks next-gen applications that keep businesses moving forward.

Headquartered in Chicago, IL with a 2nd HQ in Bengaluru, India we are powered by a diverse global team that is tackling the toughest logistics challenges with innovation, urgency, and purpose.

**AI at project44**

We expect every project44 team member, regardless of role or function, to actively leverage AI in their day-to-day work. Whether you're building product, serving customers, managing people, or running operations, AI is a tool you're expected to use with intent, curiosity, and judgment. We don't expect everyone to be a data scientist. We do expect everyone to be an intelligent user of AI: able to identify where it adds value, direct it effectively, evaluate outputs critically, and govern it responsibly. We invest in our team's AI fluency because we believe it's a competitive advantage for every person at project44, not just our engineers.

If you’re driven to solve meaningful problems, leverage AI to scale rapidly, drive impact daily, and be part of a high-performance team – we should talk.

**What you’ll be working on:**

* Manage several engagements concurrently, potentially between 10 – 15 clients depending on project size
* Deliver our software solutions in time and on budget, being on top of project status and always driving issue resolution forward
* Manage various multi-national projects simultaneously and engage cross-functionally with stakeholders such as product management, engineering or network resources to achieve your project missions
* Manage financial metrics and enable pre-sales activities to support account expansion plans
* Present solutions effectively to diverse stakeholder groups and to engage effectively with senior executives of large enterprises on both technical and business topics
* Adhere to project44’s company standards, guidelines, policies and procedures .

**Requirements & Skills:**

* 3-5 years of experience in a customer facing role or at an enterprise SaaS company.
* Experience in the field of freight forwarding and supply chain management strongly preferred
* Proven track record of working for internally operating clients with a cross-functional and geographically dispersed team
* Must have excellent English, proficiency in French, Spanish or German are nice to have.
* Strong communication and problem-solving skills, customer focus and results orientation
* In-depth knowledge and experience implementing Enterprise software applications such as ERP, CRM or SCM
* Monitoring projects progress and oversee project contributors, ensuring that scope, planning, milestones, budgets and overall goals are met
* Strong client service and/or management consulting experience
* Strong communication and problem-solving skills, customer focus, attention to detail and results orientation
* Willingness to work during customer’s operating hours outside of standard office hours.

**In-office Commitment:** This position requires a commitment to contribute to our collaborative culture by working **in-office 5 days** weekly.

**Shift Time:** 5:00 PM - 2:00 AM IST (with flexibility)

**Diversity & Inclusion**

At project44, we're designing the future of how the world moves and is connected through trade and global supply chains. As we work to deliver a truly world-class product and experience, we are also intentionally building teams that reflect the unique communities we serve. We’re focused on creating a company where all team members can bring their authentic selves to work every day.

We’re building a company that every one of us at project44 is proud to work for, and our journey of becoming a more diverse, equitable and inclusive organization, where all have a sense of belonging, is shaped through the actions of our leadership, global teams and individual team members. We are resolute in our belief that each team member has an equal responsibility to mold and uphold our culture.

project44 is an equal opportunity employer seeking to enrich our work environment by creating opportunities for individuals of all backgrounds and experiences to thrive. If you share our values and our passion for helping the way the world moves, we’d love to review your application!

For any needed accommodations during the hiring process, please email recruiting@project44.com. Even if you don’t meet 100% of the above job description you should still seriously consider applying. Studies show that you can still be considered for a role if you meet just 50% of the role’s requirements.

**About project44**

Since 2014, project44 has been transforming the way one of the largest, most important global industries does business. As transportation and logistics continues to evolve and customer expectations around delivery become more demanding, industry technology must rise to the occasion. In just a few short years, we’ve created a digital infrastructure that eliminates the inefficiencies caused by dated technology and manual processes. title: Senior Product Program Manager
description:
**#RunwiththePack**
===================

  

At Arctic Wolf, we’re on a mission to **end cyber risk** .

  

We are a global leader in security operations, helping organizations stay resilient against evolving cyber threats through industry-leading security operations, threat intelligence, and a people-first approach to cybersecurity.

  

More than 3,000 Pack members across the world work together every day to protect our customers and empower security teams with new levels of speed, accuracy, and intelligence at scale. What sets us apart is our relentless focus on our customers, innovation at scale, and a collaborative culture where talented people can do meaningful work that truly makes a difference.

  

We’re constantly looking for talented people to join the Pack and help us take our performance to the next level.

**About the Position:**
=======================

**Position Overview and Objective**

The Senior Program Manager will manage and lead programs to drive the engineering development and implementation process for a subsystem and component of a product or service offering. Involvement lasts throughout all stages of a product’s lifecycle including ideation/concept, modifications, upgrades and maintenance of the product or product line.

  

The Senior Program Manager will manage and lead strategic programs and initiatives within our cybersecurity software and services organization. This role is responsible for planning, executing, and delivering complex programs that align with business objectives, customer needs, and regulatory requirements. The ideal candidate will drive cross-functional collaboration, ensure program alignment with company strategy, and manage risks and dependencies to deliver high-quality security solutions on time and within budget.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Strategic Influence & Thought Leadership – Guides executive decision-making on product strategy, technology investments, and long-term roadmap planning.
* Enterprise-Wide Program Management – Oversees multiple complex initiatives spanning business units, ensuring strategic objectives are met across products and teams.
* Technical Due Diligence – Leads deep dives into system architecture, performance, and scalability to assess risk and feasibility for high-impact initiatives.
* Executive & Stakeholder Alignment – Communicates trade-offs, investment rationales, and progress updates to C-suite and board-level stakeholders.
* Mentorship & Organization Impact – Develops best practices, frameworks, and coaching initiatives to elevate program management capabilities across the company.
* Lead and manage large-scale cybersecurity programs from initiation through completion, ensuring alignment with company objectives.
* Develop and maintain program roadmaps, timelines, and deliverables, ensuring effective coordination across engineering, product management, marketing, legal, sales and customer success teams.
* Oversee program governance, risk management, and compliance with industry security standards and regulations.
* Define and implement best practices for program execution, tracking, and reporting, ensuring visibility and accountability.
* Serves as the primary point of contact for program stakeholders, facilitating communication and alignment across business units.
* Manage budgets, resource allocation, and vendor relationships to optimize program efficiency.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance program execution, team collaboration, and customer satisfaction.
* Serves as the central resource with design, process, manufacturing, test, quality, and marketing as the product(s) move to production and distribution.
* Designs, develops, and manages activities for a specific product or group of products from product definition and planning through production, release, and end of life.
* Coordinate activities of supporting project teams and internal and external development partners.
* Track progress against established plan and makes decisions to alter or update schedule and resource allocation to meet product requirements and development schedule.
* Mentor direct and interdisciplinary team members.
* Champion AI & Automation in Program Management – Identify and implement AI-driven tools and automation workflows to streamline program planning, status reporting, risk tracking, and cross-functional coordination, reducing manual overhead and improving program execution speed.
Drive data-driven insights by leveraging AI-powered analytics and dashboards to proactively surface program health metrics, predict delivery risks, and support executive-level decision-making with real-time program intelligence.  

  

**Experience & Requirements**
-----------------------------

* 10-15 years’ experience in a technical or product role managing large-scale software deployments
* 10-15 years of experience in program / project/ product management, with at least 6 years in software development
* Bachelor’s degree required in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Business, or related field
* Understanding of project and program management skills and methodologies
* Expertise in program management methodologies (Agile, SAFe, etc.) and tools (JIRA, Confluence, Aha!, etc.).
* Ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments, ensuring effective communication between technical and non-technical teams.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to identify risks, dependencies, and optimization opportunities.
* Excellent leadership, negotiation, and change management skills to drive execution and adoption of cybersecurity initiatives.
* Experience communicating and representing work to leadership, framing discussions to gain valuable feedback, and experience working with technical management teams to develop systems, solutions, and products.
* Analytical and problem-solving experience with large-scale systems
* Proficient in building trust and establishing relationships across multi-disciplinary teams.
Aptitude towards establishing and leading teams through multi-disciplinary relationships including product management and engineering to drive product programs.  

  

**Nice to Have**

* PMP, PgMP, or SAFe certification.
* Experience in cybersecurity is a plus.
* Prefer degree in a technical area.
* Experience applying AI tools and automation platforms (e.g., Copilot, Claude, Notion AI, or similar) to enhance program management workflows such as meeting summarization, dependency tracking, and automated reporting.
Demonstrated interest or experience in evaluating and piloting AI/ML-driven solutions within a program or product management context to improve operational efficiency and team productivity.  

Arctic Wolf is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace and providing reasonable accommodations, appropriate support throughout the hiring process and employment, in accordance with applicable local laws. If you require support or adjustments during the recruitment process, please contact recruiting@arcticwolf.com .

**On Camera Policy**
====================

* To support a fair, transparent, and engaging interview experience, candidates interviewing remotely are expected to be on camera during all video interviews.
* Being on camera fosters authentic connection, improves communication, and allows for full engagement from both candidates and interviewers.
We understand that technical, bandwidth, or location-related challenges may occasionally prevent video use. If this applies, candidates are required to notify us in advance so we can explore appropriate accommodations.  

**Benefits**
============

  

All wolves receive compelling compensation and benefits packages, including:

  

* Equity for all employees
* 18 days annual leave, flexible holidays & festivals, and paid volunteer days
* Training and career development programs
* Comprehensive private benefits plan including medical insurance for you and your family, life insurance (3x compensation), and personal accident insurance.
A modern workplace in Helios Business Park in Bengaluru  

**Security Requirements**
=========================

At Arctic Wolf, protecting our people, customers, and data is fundamental to how we operate. All employees are expected to uphold our commitment to security, privacy, and compliance by following internal information security policies, standards, and controls designed to safeguard the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of business, customer, employee, and other confidential information and to support compliance with applicable legal and regulatory requirements.

Depending on the role and where permitted by applicable law, employment may be subject to background verification and additional regulatory, security, or compliance requirements, including obligations related to data protection and export control laws, and authorization requirements where applicable.

  

**Your next big opportunity starts here — apply today and help us end cyber risk.**

title: Global Project Lead
description:
Category: Medical Affairs

Location:
Bangalore, Karnataka, IN

**Team: P&PS GBS – Medical Communications -Global Medical Affairs**

**Location: Bangalore, Novo Nordisk Global Business Services (GBS), India**

  

**Your impact begins here**
  
As Global Project Lead, you will make sure the expert conversations that shape Novo’s medical strategy are well planned and flawlessly delivered. You will lead advisory board meetings from first scope to final closure, working with Global Medical Affairs teams and leading external experts. Your planning, budget oversight and stakeholder engagement will turn expert insight into clear direction, helping teams move with pace and focus for people living with serious chronic diseases.

**What you’ll bring**

* A master’s degree in life sciences, business or another relevant area.
* 5–6 years of relevant experience in cross-functional project management, business development or global event and meetings management in the pharmaceutical industry.
* Experience in budget management and strategic planning.
* Strong communication skills, with a passion for project management and stakeholder engagement.
* The ability to work in teams and to drive projects independently.
* An organised, strategic and process-oriented mindset.
  

**Useful, but not essential:**
  
Experience and understanding of Medical Affairs.

**What you’ll do**

* You will own the delivery of global advisory boards and related expert engagement, keeping scope, timelines, budget and quality on track.
* Lead advisory board meetings end to end, ensuring strategic impact and flawless execution.
* Define project scope, goals, deliverables and success metrics, and build timelines that keep progress and completion on track.
* Manage Key Opinion Leader (KOL) activities from contracting and invoicing through to closure.
* Oversee project budgets together with Global Medical Directors and Business Partners, and manage vendors to keep costs efficient and aligned with corporate procurement processes.
* Identify risks early and put mitigation plans in place during project execution.
* Map stakeholders, understand their needs and build the buy-in and motivation that cross-functional work depends on.
* Assess existing systems and processes on an ongoing basis, spot gaps and propose practical ways to work more efficiently.
  

**Who you’ll work with**

You will join MedComm Operational Excellence within Global Medical Affairs, part of Product & Portfolio Strategy (P&PS), based in Global Business Services (GBS) in Bangalore, India. The team brings together global scientific advisors, project managers and graphic designers who partner with the Global Medical Affairs teams in Denmark, where the function is headquartered.

Together, you communicate scientific and medical knowledge about Novo’s products to the ex-ternal scientific community and across the organisation, from in-house content development to project management for external medical events. Day to day, you will work closely with Global Medical Directors and Business Partners, and with external experts and vendors, to keep projects moving with clarity.

The atmosphere is dynamic and fast-paced, with a strong focus on teamwork and collaboration.

  

**What you can expect here**
  
You will work in a global setting where your expertise is valued and your contribution is visible. You will be trusted to take ownership of your projects, supported to perform at your best and encouraged to make your voice heard. The role offers the chance to build new skills by working closely with colleagues across locations and functions, and to grow through the work itself and relevant learning offerings.

**Start now**
  
Your impact begins today. If you are ready to bring structure, pace and strong stakeholder engagement to global medical events, apply for the Global Project Lead role by 3 December 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

title: Senior Technical Marketing Engineer (Remote Browser Isolation) - NetSec
description:
Bangalore, Karnātaka, India Product Engineering Ref ID: JR-024821

**Our Mission**

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

**Who We Are**

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.

**Job Summary**

As a Sr Technical Marketing Engineer (TME) for Remote Browser Isolation (RBI), you will serve as the senior technical authority and strategic driver for our browser isolation and secure web access portfolio across Prisma SASE. Operating at the intersection of product strategy, engineering, and go-to-market (GTM), you will define how our RBI capabilities are architected, positioned, and adopted in the enterprise market.

  
  

You will lead the technical marketing strategy for zero-trust web browsing, isolated cloud execution, and clientless/agent-based session isolation—protecting organizations against zero-day web exploits, phishing, ransomware, and unauthorized data exfiltration without degrading user experience. This is a highly visible, customer-facing role where your technical depth will directly accelerate revenue by translating complex browser-level rendering and isolation architectures into high-velocity sales tools.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

  
  

* **Drive Technical GTM Strategy:** Work with GTM team to execute the technical go-to-market strategy for Remote Browser Isolation, secure web access, and unmanaged/BYOD contractor access across Prisma SASE.
* **Build Automated Labs & Demos:** Design, build, and maintain advanced, automated demo environments, interactive click-paths, and hands-on workshops demonstrating real-time pixel-pushing vs. vector/DOM isolation trade-offs, and safe document rendering.
* **Develop Field Enablement Assets:** Create high-impact sales engineering tools, including Proof-of-Value (PoV) evaluation guides, latency/UX benchmarking methodologies, competitive battlecards, and deployment blueprints.
* **Competitive Intelligence & R&D Feedback:** Track key RBI and enterprise browser competitors, evaluate emerging isolation architectures, and translate field friction and technical gaps into actionable requirements for R&D.
* **Author Definitive Technical Content:** Produce authoritative Reference Architectures, Validated Designs, technical whitepapers, and deep-dive blogs covering browser security, zero-trust web access, and inline threat prevention.
* **Influence Product Roadmap:** Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to validate PRDs, test early builds, and prioritize roadmap capabilities based on field telemetry and customer requirements.
* **Executive Evangelism:** Represent Palo Alto Networks as a subject matter expert at Executive Briefing Center (EBC) sessions, industry conferences, analyst briefings, and strategic customer engagements.
* **Technical Mentorship:** Guide and mentor fellow Technical Marketing Engineers, establishing rigorous standards for architectural accuracy, benchmark integrity, and storytelling.

**Qualifications**

* Experience: 10+ years of experience in the cybersecurity industry in highly technical roles (e.g., Sr TME, Senior Solutions Architect, Sr Sales Engineer, or Security Researcher).
* Education: BS/BA in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).
* Deep RBI & Web Security Expertise**:** Proven architectural mastery of Remote Browser Isolation technologies—including DOM reconstruction, Document Object Model (DOM) mirroring, vector/stream rendering, pixel streaming, and Content Disarm and Reconstruction (CDR).
* Networking & SASE Foundations**:** Strong understanding of Secure Web Gateways (SWG), Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), HTTP/2 & HTTP/3, TLS decryption, WebSockets, WebRTC, and cloud-delivered SASE architectures.
* Hands-On Automation**:** Practical experience building production-grade labs, synthetic performance tests, and automated demos using Python, Terraform, REST APIs, or containerized cloud infrastructure.
* Executive & Technical Communicatio**n:** Exceptional ability to distill low-level browser rendering and network security mechanics into compelling narratives for both deep-technical architects and C-level executives.
* Cross-Functional Leadership**:** Demonstrated track record of influencing product, engineering, and sales teams to drive complex initiatives from concept to market launch.
* AI-First Mindset**:** Comfortable leveraging agentic AI tools and automation workflows to accelerate content creation, competitive analysis, and lab orchestration.
  

  

**Preferred**
-------------

  
  

* Familiarity with enterprise browser architectures, Chromium internals, JavaScript engines (V8), and browser extension security models.
* Experience integrating RBI with Data Loss Prevention (DLP) and AI Access Security controls (e.g., preventing copy/paste, upload/download, and prompt injection in GenAI web apps).
* Prior experience supporting Tier-1 industry analyst evaluations (e.g., Gartner Magic Quadrant, Forrester Wave) and leading technical briefings.
* Background as a Field SE or Field CTO working with highly regulated enterprises (Financial Services, Healthcare, Government/Public Sector).
* Hands-on experience integrating browser and web security telemetry with SIEM, SOAR, or XDR platforms such as Cortex XSIAM.

**Our Commitment**

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.

Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

* Partner with product development teams on upcoming releases and known issues to ensure seamless implementation and customer readiness.

* Proven experience in a technical support environment, preferably in a global setting.

* Ability to handle customer calls and interactions professionally across time zones.
* Knowledge of IT service management practices and frameworks.
* Good understanding of Cloud technologies (AWS, Azure) and disaster recovery concepts.
* Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to multitask under minimal supervision.
* Positive, proactive attitude with a commitment to continuous improvement.

**Education**
BE / B.Tech or equivalent in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.
  
  
**Key Working Relationships**

* AVEVA Support teams (local and global)
* Regional management and service delivery managers
* Customers’ technical representatives using AVEVA engineering and operational systems
* Product development, testing, and implementation teams

3 to 5 years of relevant experience

* Hands-on experience with Cloud-based applications and related technologies.

title: Lead Product Specialist & Solutions Architect
description:
**About Sprih**

Sprih helps enterprises turn operational data into business value. We bring sustainability, risk and cost together on a single data foundation. Energy, emissions, procurement, supplier and operations data feed one connected view, which powers sustainability reporting, risk management, cost and operational efficiency, and supply chain intelligence. Our customers are in India, Europe, the US and Japan. Sprih's AI layer, SustainSense, brings agents such as ReportSense, DataSense, AuditSense and ComplianceSense into the daily work of sustainability, finance, risk and supply chain teams.

We sell to large, demanding enterprises. They don't buy slides. They buy what they see working on their own data and their own problems. That's where you come in.

**The role**

You’ll be the person who makes the Sprih platform click for a buyer. You’ll run the in-depth demos that win deals, design solutions that map a customer’s real requirements to what Sprih does, and build the material and skills that let our sales team do the same.

This is part domain expert, part storyteller, part solution architect. You’ll work directly with the founders, sales, product and customer success.

**What you’ll do:**

**Demos that win**

* Run deep, tailored platform demos for prospects — from a sustainability head to a CFO, CPO or COO — built around their industry, frameworks and data.
* Build and maintain demo environments and storylines with realistic data for key sectors (manufacturing, pharma, consumer goods, logistics, financial services).
* Turn complex capabilities (carbon accounting, supplier engagement, audit trails, AI agents) into a clear story of business value.

**Solutioning**

* Join discovery calls, unpack customer requirements and map them to Sprih modules, services and integrations.
* Answer RFPs, security and technical questionnaires; write solution notes and scope sections for proposals.
* Design pilots and proofs of concept with clear success criteria, and see them through to a decision.
* Bring what you hear from the market back to product — gaps, objections, competitor moves, feature requests.

**Sales enablement**

* Make every salesperson able to run a confident first and second demo: scripts, click paths, talk tracks, objection handling and recorded walkthroughs.
* Run regular training on the platform, on new releases, and on frameworks and regulations.
* Create and keep current battlecards, use-case one-pagers, FAQs and demo videos.
* Certify the sales team on the demo, and coach through call reviews.

**Thought leadership**

* Write clear, credible content — blogs, explainers, regulation updates, webinar scripts.
* Represent Sprih at webinars, customer workshops and events such as industry conferences.

**What you bring**

**Must have**

* 4–7 years in sustainability / ESG, carbon accounting, or a closely related domain, with at least 2 years in a customer-facing presales, solutions consulting or product demo role for B2B SaaS.
* Real domain depth: GHG Protocol (Scope 1, 2, 3), and working knowledge of major frameworks and regulations — CSRD/ESRS, BRSR, CDP, ISSB/IFRS S1–S2, SBTi, CBAM, EcoVadis, and US disclosure rules (e.g. California SB 253/261).
* Understanding of how enterprise data flows — ERP, utility, procurement and supplier data — and the practical challenges of collecting, validating and auditing it.
* Excellent spoken communication: you can hold a room of senior stakeholders, think on your feet and handle tough questions live.
* Excellent writing: structured, crisp, jargon-free. You can write a solution note a CFO reads to the end.
* Comfort learning a product deeply and fast, and making it look effortless.

**Nice to have**

* Background in a Big 4 / consulting sustainability practice, followed by a move into SaaS.
* Experience with supply chain, operational efficiency or energy analytics use cases.
* Hands-on with data tools (Excel modelling, SQL, BI tools) and AI/LLM-based products.
* Experience selling into Europe, the US or Japan; additional languages (e.g. German, Japanese) are a plus.
* Experience building enablement programmes or sales training from scratch.

**Why join**

* Work directly with the founders on a category that is being shaped right now.
* Your demos and judgement will directly decide which deals we win.
* A global customer base and a front-row seat to how AI is changing sustainability and operations work.
* Competitive compensation, ESOPs and a lot of ownership.

**How to apply**

Send your CV and a short note (max. 300 words) on a product demo you ran that changed a customer’s mind — and why it worked. Shortlisted candidates will be asked to run a 20-minute mock demo on a scenario we’ll share in advance.

title: Project Manager
description:
**WE ARE HIRING | PROJECTS MANAGER**

**UNILIV | Building Better Living Experiences**

**Location:**
Noida (Regular Travel to Project Sites)

**Department:**
Projects & Transformation

**Experience:**
Relevant experience in Interior Fit-Outs, Construction, Furniture or Hospitality Projects

**Industry:**
Hospitality | Co-living | Student Accommodation | Hotels | Residential Projects | Interior Fit-Outs

**Qualification:**
Bachelor's Degree / Diploma in Interior Design, Architecture, Civil Engineering, Construction Management, Furniture Design or a related discipline

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Reporting To:**
Head of Projects

**ABOUT UNILIV**

UNILIV is a leading brand in premium co-living, student accommodation and managed living spaces. We create high-quality homes for students and young professionals through thoughtfully designed, professionally managed residences.

Our properties go beyond conventional hostels and PGs. We transform existing buildings into contemporary, functional and engaging living environments that bring together comfort, design and community.

The Projects & Transformation Team drives this mission end to end, from property assessment and design development to construction, interiors, furniture, procurement, installations and operational handover.

As we continue to expand our property portfolio, we are looking for a hands-on and result-oriented
**Projects Manager**
to lead property transformation, renovation and interior fit-out projects.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

The Projects Manager will be responsible for planning, coordinating and delivering assigned property transformation projects from initial assessment and mobilisation to execution, commissioning and final operational handover.

The incumbent will own project scope, cost, quality, safety and timelines while ensuring that approved designs are implemented accurately on-site.

This role requires strong practical knowledge of construction, interior fit-outs, furniture, procurement and site execution, along with the ability to manage contractors, vendors and multiple internal stakeholders.

We are looking for a professional who can translate project plans into tangible results, manage execution challenges and ensure timely delivery without compromising quality, safety or commercial discipline.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. Project Planning & Delivery**

* Take complete ownership of assigned projects from initial assessment and mobilisation through execution, snagging, commissioning and final handover.
* Develop project plans, work breakdown structures, schedules, milestone trackers and resource plans.
* Manage multiple work fronts and coordinate contractors, vendors and internal stakeholders.
* Monitor project progress against approved scope, budgets, quality standards and timelines.
* Identify potential delays, execution bottlenecks and project risks, and implement recovery plans.
* Maintain project documentation, progress reports, meeting minutes, decision logs and issue trackers.

**2. Site Execution & Interior Fit-Outs**

* Lead day-to-day site execution across civil works, interior fit-outs, MEP, furniture and installation activities.
* Coordinate contractors, fabricators, suppliers, consultants and site teams.
* Verify site conditions, measurements and execution requirements.
* Identify technical constraints and design conflicts and coordinate their resolution.
* Monitor workmanship, installation quality, site safety and housekeeping.
* Ensure adherence to approved drawings, specifications and execution standards.
* Drive snagging, rectification, testing, commissioning and final project close-out.

**3. Design Coordination**

* Work closely with the Head of Design and Interior Designer to understand approved concepts, drawings, specifications and design intent.
* Coordinate drawing releases, technical clarifications and approvals required for site execution.
* Ensure contractors and site teams work only with the latest approved drawings.
* Prevent unauthorised material substitutions and design deviations.
* Evaluate design changes and value-engineering proposals, obtaining necessary approvals before implementation.
* Ensure design observations are resolved within agreed timelines.

**4. Furniture, Fixtures & Equipment (FF&E) Management**

* Coordinate furniture manufacturing, fabrication, procurement, delivery, fitment and installation.
* Apply practical knowledge of joinery, materials, hardware, finishes and modular furniture systems.
* Plan furniture installation sequencing, site access, storage and protection.
* Inspect deliveries against approved quantities, specifications, dimensions and schedules.
* Resolve shortages, damages, quality issues and mismatches.
* Manage fast-track furniture fit-outs and installations without compromising quality or safety.

**5. Procurement & Vendor Coordination**

* Coordinate with Procurement for materials, furniture, fixtures, fittings and services.
* Consolidate project requirements, quantities, BOQs, specifications and delivery schedules.
* Support vendor enquiries, quotation comparisons, approvals and purchase order coordination.
* Ensure purchased materials and products match approved design specifications.
* Monitor procurement lead times, pending deliveries and material availability.
* Identify supply-chain risks and recommend alternatives after obtaining necessary technical and design approvals.
* Ensure materials reach the correct project site in the required quantity, condition and sequence.

**6. Operations & Real Estate Coordination**

* Act as the primary project coordination point for Operations and Real Estate throughout the project lifecycle.
* Coordinate property access, site possession, landlord interfaces, existing-condition information and required permissions.
* Understand operational requirements, maintenance considerations, room readiness and opening timelines.
* Translate operational feedback into clear project requirements.
* Plan phased handovers, including room readiness, asset documentation, warranties, manuals, keys and outstanding-item registers.
* Ensure completed properties are fully prepared for operational handover.

**7. Cost & Commercial Management**

* Prepare, review and monitor BOQs, quantity take-offs, estimates, budgets and cost trackers.
* Track committed costs, actual expenditure, variations and forecast final project costs.
* Review contractor and vendor measurements, bills and completion records before recommending certification.
* Identify cost, scope and schedule risks.
* Recommend practical cost optimisation and value-engineering solutions without compromising essential quality or design intent.
* Maintain documentation of approved variations, additional works and commercial decisions.

**8. Reporting, Coordination & Project Ownership**

* Provide regular project progress updates to the Head of Projects and Head of Design.
* Report on project milestones, risks, procurement dependencies, pending decisions and upcoming deliverables.
* Maintain transparent communication with Design, Procurement, Operations, Real Estate and external stakeholders.
* Escalate critical issues with clear options, impact assessments and recommended solutions.

**CANDIDATE PROFILE | WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

* Relevant professional experience in interior fit-outs, turnkey execution, construction, furniture manufacturing, fabrication, installations, renovation or hospitality projects.
* Degree or Diploma in Interior Design, Architecture, Civil Engineering, Construction Management, Furniture Design or a related discipline.
* Hands-on experience managing on-ground project execution and multiple work fronts.
* Strong understanding of construction sequencing, materials, finishes, furniture and site coordination.
* Ability to read and interpret architectural, interior, furniture and MEP drawings.
* Practical knowledge of BOQs, quantity take-offs, project estimates and cost management.
* Experience coordinating contractors, vendors, consultants and internal stakeholders.
* Strong project planning, execution and problem-solving capabilities.
* Ability to manage tight deadlines and fast-track project requirements.
* Excellent communication, negotiation and stakeholder management skills.
* Willingness to travel regularly to project sites.

**Preferred Background:**
Professionals from hospitality, hotels, co-living, student accommodation, serviced apartments, interior fit-out companies, turnkey contractors or multi-site property transformation projects.

**TECHNICAL SKILLS | REQUIRED EXPERTISE**

* **AutoCAD:**
  Ability to read, interpret and coordinate architectural, interior, furniture and services drawings.
* **MEP Drawings:**
  Working knowledge of electrical, lighting, power, plumbing, water supply, drainage and sanitary layouts.
* **SketchUp:**
  Basic proficiency in understanding spatial layouts and 3D design intent.
* **Microsoft Excel:**
  Strong proficiency in BOQs, estimates, cost trackers, procurement schedules, project plans and progress reports.
* **Word & PowerPoint:**
  Working knowledge of project documentation and presentations.
* **Sketching:**
  An additional advantage for communicating site observations and design requirements visually.

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)**

* **Project Delivery:**
  Completion of projects within approved timelines and milestones.
* **Cost Management:**
  Project expenditure within approved budgets, with variations properly documented and approved.
* **Execution Quality:**
  Adherence to approved drawings, specifications and quality standards.
* **Site Safety:**
  Compliance with safety practices and site housekeeping requirements.
* **Snag Closure:**
  Timely identification, rectification and closure of execution-related issues.
* **Procurement Coordination:**
  Timely availability and delivery of materials, furniture and equipment.
* **Vendor Management:**
  Effective contractor and vendor coordination and delivery performance.
* **Operational Handover:**
  Complete, documented and timely handover accepted by Operations.
* **Project Reporting:**
  Accurate progress tracking, proactive escalation and stakeholder coordination.

**Share your updated resume along with a brief portfolio or examples of projects handled at:**
hiring@uniliv.in

title: Creative Lead - Productions and Creative Operations
description:
**Department:**
