**Location:**
Noida

**Experience:**
8–12 Years

Role Overview

AAFT Online is looking for an experienced and dynamic Associate Director – Productions & Creative Operations to lead and manage end-to-end production, post-production, and creative operations for its digital learning ecosystem.

The individual will be responsible for overseeing the complete content production lifecycle, including pre-production planning, shoot execution, studio operations, video editing, motion graphics, animation, sound design, and final content delivery.

The role requires a combination of creative vision, technical expertise, and operational leadership, along with strong experience in leveraging AI-powered tools and technologies to enhance production workflows, improve creative output, and drive operational efficiency.

The individual will work closely with academic teams, faculty members, creative professionals, production teams, and other internal stakeholders to ensure the timely delivery of high-quality academic and non-academic content.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Production Planning & Execution**

* Lead end-to-end production activities, including planning, scheduling, budgeting, resource allocation, and execution.
* Oversee studio operations, shooting schedules, camera setups, lighting, sound, and production equipment.
* Manage the production of academic lectures, educational modules, promotional films, documentaries, and other multimedia content.
* Ensure effective coordination with faculty members, directors, production crew, and other stakeholders during shoots.
* Manage multiple production projects simultaneously while ensuring adherence to timelines and quality standards.
* Ensure optimum utilisation of production infrastructure, equipment, studios, and other resources.

**2. Post-Production Management**

* Lead end-to-end post-production activities, including video editing, colour grading, sound editing, audio mixing, motion graphics, animation, and final rendering.
* Supervise video editors, graphic designers, animators, and other post-production professionals.
* Ensure quality and consistency across all video and multimedia deliverables.
* Oversee content review cycles, revisions, approvals, and final publishing.
* Establish efficient post-production workflows to improve turnaround time and delivery quality.
* Ensure proper organisation, storage, and management of raw footage, project files, and final content assets.

**3. AI Integration & Technology-Driven Production**

* Identify, evaluate, and implement AI-powered tools across production and post-production workflows to enhance efficiency, creativity, and output quality.
* Leverage AI tools for video generation, automated editing, voiceovers, dubbing, image generation, animation, scripting, and content enhancement.
* Integrate AI-driven solutions to streamline repetitive production tasks, reduce turnaround time, and optimise operational costs.
* Experiment with emerging AI technologies to develop innovative content formats and improve digital learning experiences.
* Train and guide production and creative teams in adopting AI tools and integrating them into their daily workflows.
* Establish AI-enabled production processes while ensuring content accuracy, quality, originality, and consistency with brand guidelines.

**4. Creative Direction & Content Quality**

* Drive creative strategy and execution for academic, educational, and promotional content.
* Ensure consistency in visual identity, storytelling, presentation, and overall production quality.
* Collaborate with academic teams and subject matter experts to translate academic requirements into engaging digital learning experiences.
* Review and approve creative concepts, storyboards, scripts, video edits, and final deliverables.
* Introduce innovative production techniques and creative approaches to enhance the quality of digital content.

**5. Creative Operations & Team Management**

* Lead and manage production, post-production, video editing, graphic design, animation, and creative teams.
* Define team responsibilities, workflows, production standards, and performance expectations.
* Manage resource allocation and ensure optimum utilisation of internal teams, studios, and external vendors.
* Develop and implement SOPs for production and post-production operations.
* Monitor team productivity, project progress, and delivery timelines.
* Mentor team members and build a culture of creative innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement.

**6. Stakeholder & Vendor Management**

* Work closely with academic leaders, faculty members, instructional design teams, marketing, technology, and business teams.
* Understand academic and business requirements and translate them into actionable production plans.
* Ensure seamless coordination between all stakeholders involved in content development and delivery.
* Manage external production houses, agencies, freelancers, and creative partners.
* Ensure timely execution and delivery of projects in alignment with organisational requirements.

**7. Quality Assurance & Process Optimisation**

* Establish quality benchmarks for video production, editing, audio, graphics, animation, and final content delivery.
* Implement quality checks at pre-production, production, and post-production stages.
* Monitor production budgets, timelines, and resource utilisation.
* Identify operational bottlenecks and introduce process improvements.
* Maintain production trackers, project reports, and performance dashboards.
* Drive continuous improvements in production efficiency, content quality, and overall operational effectiveness.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Film Production, Mass Communication, Media Studies, Visual Communication, or a related discipline.
* 8-12 years of relevant experience in media production, film production, post-production, or creative operations.
* Strong experience in managing both production and post-production teams and workflows.
* Good working experience with AI-powered creative tools for video production, editing, animation, voiceovers, image generation, and content creation.
* Strong understanding of studio operations, cinematography, lighting, sound, editing, and post-production processes.
* Experience in managing production budgets, teams, timelines, and multiple projects simultaneously.
* Strong creative judgement, visual storytelling, and content development capabilities.
* Excellent leadership, communication, planning, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced and deadline-driven environment.

Preferred Experience

* Experience in the online education, ed-tech, media, or digital content production industry.
* Experience in managing large-scale educational video production operations.
* Hands-on familiarity with AI tools such as Runway, Adobe Firefly, Adobe Premiere Pro AI features, Descript, ElevenLabs, Synthesia, and other emerging AI-powered creative platforms.
* Experience in implementing AI-driven production workflows and automation.
* Experience in managing studio infrastructure, production equipment, and external production vendors.
* Ability to balance creative quality with operational efficiency and cost optimisation.

Key Competencies

* Production & Post-Production Management
* Creative Direction & Visual Storytelling
* AI Tools & Technology Integration
* Studio & Resource Management
* Team Leadership & Development
* Budgeting & Cost Optimisation
* Stakeholder & Vendor Management
* Quality Assurance
* Process Development & Operational Excellence

title: Validation Leader
description:
**Role - Testing Leader (Platform Quality & Validation)**

**Position - General Manager**

  

**About the Role**

  

LG Soft India is looking for an experienced Testing Leader to drive quality transformation across the webOS platform.

  
  

This role reports directly to the Platform Development Director and leads the evolution of our pre-QA validation organization, comprising approximately 20 SDET and QE engineers through either direct management or matrix leadership.

You will be responsible for driving Shift-Left Quality initiatives, optimizing validation assets, improving validation efficiency across multiple SoCs and products, and expanding automation and AI-driven testing capabilities.

This role focuses on ensuring defects are detected and prevented before reaching QA or customers, while continuously reducing validation lead time and maintaining consistent platform quality across products, platforms, and releases.

Unlike a product-specific testing leadership role, this position is responsible for the quality validation strategy of the entire webOS platform and its ecosystem.

  
  
  

**What You'll Do**

  

**1. ‎Lead Shift-Left Quality Transformation**

* Drive continuous improvements to the pre-QA validation pipeline (SDET & QE)
* Analyze defect escape patterns from QA and field environments and implement preventive measures
* Establish quality gates, risk-based validation practices, and early defect detection strategies
* Reduce validation lead time while improving overall product quality

  

**2. Optimize Validation Strategy and Test Assets**

* Assess, streamline, and optimize legacy test assets and regression suites
* Define risk-based validation coverage and test prioritization strategies
* Improve validation efficiency while balancing quality, cost, and execution effort

  

**3. Enable Scalable Multi-SoC and Multi-Product Validation**

* Define validation strategies across multiple SoCs, products, and release types
* Maximize validation result reuse while maintaining consistent platform quality
* Establish scalable approaches for new platforms, upgrades, maintenance releases, and hotfixes

  

**4. Drive Automation and AI-Enabled Testing**

* Expand automation across test execution, environment setup, result analysis, and reporting
* Build scalable validation infrastructure supporting multiple products and devices
* Leverage AI for areas such as test selection, log analysis, and defect classification
* Improve validation productivity, reliability, and scalability through automation

  

**5. ‎Lead Cross-Functional Quality Initiatives**

* Partner closely with Development, Validation, and QA organizations to drive quality improvements
* Lead organization-wide quality initiatives and large-scale adoption of best practices
* Define and track quality, efficiency, and defect prevention metrics
* Coach and develop engineering teams in testing, automation, and quality engineering excellence

  
  

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field
* 15+ years of experience in software testing, quality engineering, or validation for embedded software or device products
* Proven experience leading platform-level testing or quality transformation initiatives
* Experience building and scaling validation processes for products deployed at large global scale
* Strong understanding of software validation, test automation, defect analysis, and quality engineering methodologies
* Experience leading cross-functional programs involving Development, Test, and QA
* Ability to drive organizational change and innovation beyond direct reporting structures

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Linux- or Android-based embedded platforms
* Experience validating smart devices such as TVs, monitors, audio products, mobile devices, automotive systems, or IoT products
* Experience gained at large-scale consumer electronics(100M+) or technology companies such as Samsung, Sony, Apple, Google, Microsoft, or organizations operating at comparable deployment scale and release frequency.
* Deep understanding of SoC-based product architectures and platform software stacks
* Experience building automated test environments involving real devices and hardware test systems
* Experience applying AI technologies to software testing, validation, or quality engineering
* Professional certifications such as ISTQB Advanced Level, ASQ CSQE, or equivalent

title: Test Architect
description:
Job Description: Test Architect

Location: Mumbai, India (Preferred – Hybrid)

Experience: 10–11 Years

**About Straive (LearningMate)**

Straive (LearningMate) is a global technology company focused on helping education institutions and corporations build, manage, and deliver digital learning experiences. For over 20 years, we’ve been at the forefront of educational innovation, leveraging digital, cloud, and AI solutions to reshape how the world learns.

**Job Summary**

We are looking for an enthusiastic, hands-on Test Architect with 10–11 years of experience to join our engineering leadership team in Mumbai. In this pivotal role, you will own the test automation architecture, lead the transition from manual to automated testing, establish portfolio-wide quality standards, and champion AI-first quality engineering across our product delivery pods.

You will combine deep technical expertise in Playwright and Selenium with a proactive learning mindset and day-to-day, hands-on usage of AI tools and approaches to accelerate test design, code generation, and defect analysis. Exceptional communication skills are essential, as you will review existing architectures, recommend scalable improvements, track critical QA metrics across the portfolio, and partner closely with the broader QA competency to put standardized best practices in place.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Automation Framework Design: Architect and deploy an enterprise-grade, multi-tier test automation framework across front-end single-page applications (React/TypeScript), microservices API gateways (Java/Node.js), and database pipelines.
* Manual-to-Automation QA Transformation: Drive the cultural and technical transition from manual test execution to an automated-first QA culture, establishing test design patterns, script standards, and automation coverage benchmarks across all delivery pods.
* AI-First Daily QA Execution: Actively integrate AI tools, generative coding co-pilots, and AI-driven testing engines into your day-to-day workflow to synthesize test scenarios, accelerate automation script development, self-heal brittle locators, and optimize regression sweeps.
* Test Architecture & Technical Reviews: Conduct deep-dive architectural reviews of test automation frameworks across web, API, and microservices layers. Identify bottlenecks, technical debt, and coverage gaps, and recommend scalable architectural improvements.
* Hands-On Automation Engineering: Maintain real, hands-on involvement in writing, refactoring, and optimizing core automation frameworks and proof-of-concepts using Playwright and Selenium (with TypeScript, JavaScript, or Java).
* QA Standards & Competency Alignment: Collaborate closely with the central QA competency to define, document, and institutionalize standardized testing frameworks, AI usage guidelines, coding patterns, and CI/CD quality gates across all project teams.
* Portfolio QA Metrics & Governance: Establish, track, and report on portfolio-wide QA metrics (such as automation coverage, defect leakage, test execution stability, and AI efficiency gains) to leadership and stakeholders to drive data-backed quality decisions.
* Continuous Innovation & Mentorship: Stay at the forefront of emerging AI testing methodologies and tools, fostering a culture of curiosity, continuous learning, and technical excellence across QA teams.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* Experience: 10–11 years of progressive experience in software quality assurance and test automation, with a proven track record operating in a Lead QA or Test Architect capacity.
* Core Automation Mastery: Real, hands-on coding and architectural expertise in both Playwright and Selenium WebDriver across modern web applications (such as React/TypeScript SPAs).
* Hands-On AI Testing Proficiency: Practical, daily experience using AI tools and approaches in software testing—such as generative coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor), AI-powered test case generation, visual AI testing, or LLM prompt/output validation.
* API, Database & CI/CD Integration: Strong experience architecting automated API test suites (RESTful services, Postman, RestAssured), validating database pipelines, and integrating automated regression suites into CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or Jenkins).
* Transformation & Metrics Governance: Demonstrated experience transitioning manual QA teams to automation-first workflows, defining KPIs, tracking portfolio-level quality metrics, and rolling out standardized QA processes across multiple Agile/Scrum teams.

**Mindset & Soft Skills:**

* Exceptional Communication: Clear, articulate verbal and written communication skills with the ability to influence engineering teams, present metrics to leadership, and mentor QA engineers.
* Growth & Learning Attitude: An enthusiastic, curious, and adaptable self-starter who actively experiments with new AI tools, frameworks, and modern engineering practices.

**Job Overview & Location Parameters**

* Experience Range: 10–11 Years
* Location: Mumbai preferred (Hybrid work model; open to exceptional remote candidates within India)
* Key Focus Areas: Multi-Tier Automation Framework Design, Manual-to-Automation Transformation, Hands-On AI Testing Approaches, Architecture Reviews, Playwright & Selenium, QA Competency Standards, and Portfolio Metrics

Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.

Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We’re looking for Senior with expertise in SAP CPI Implementation to join the EYD GDS Integration practice. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Gathers specifications from the business and functional departments and deliver the solution that meets the needs presented.
* Interprets business and functional requirements and develops technical specifications documentation.
* Must be able to work on custom integration as well as standard integration packages.
* Must have knowledge of SAP Cloud Connector and CPI cockpit.
* Should have worked on Java and Groovy scripting.
* Must be aware of SAP CPI support activities.
* Must be able to perform root cause analysis of any re-occurring or critical issues and proposing solutions for them.
* Performs Unit, System and Integration testing at the various phases of the project lifecycle and document the results of the testing process.
* Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Experience with business process orchestration products like Hana Cloud Integration (HCI), Cloud Platform Integration (CPI), Dell Boomi, SAP Process Integration (PI) / Process Orchestration (PO).
* Experience to deliver projects for customers, including requirement gathering, analysis of system landscape, technical design, and development of interface.
* Experience to build Integration Strategy for customers having on premise and cloud application systems (SuccessFactors, Ariba etc) with an expertise on data architecture, governance and pre-packaged cloud integration.
* Exposure to various business scenarios (A2A and B2B) and experience in working on all major adapters like SFTP, SOAP, REST, IDOC, ODATA, JDBC, SuccessFactors etc.
* Clarity of security concepts - SSL and PGP encryptions etc.
* Prefer to have experience in Groovy scripts.

**<< Ideally, you’ll also>>**

* Should have understanding and experience of integration best practices.
* Excellent business communication skills.
* Excellent leadership skills.
* SAP certification is a plus.

**<< What we look for>>**

* College degree in related technology field (Computer, Engineering, Science, etc.) or comparable job experiences.
* Approximately 3+ years of experience in a development role. Able to exhibit a progression of increasingly complex job responsibilities during the period.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment:**
As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture**
: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits:**
Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply:**
If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: AI Platform Senior Engineer, QA
description:
**About Accrete**

Accrete is an agentic managed services company: an AI workforce that does high-stakes, judgement-heavy work for government and enterprise clients — at the economics of software, not labor.

At the core is Accrete’s Knowledge Engine, a dynamic context graph that captures an organization’s tacit knowledge, resolves data across silos, and builds a living, auditable ground truth. Expert agents reason against that ground truth to act on complex, high-stakes decisions — not just answer questions about them.

From national security to commercial operations, Accrete delivers the work on one platform, with unlimited expert agents and expert judgement.

**About the Role:**

We are seeking an
**AI Platform Senior Engineer, QA – Agentic AI & Automation**
to lead quality assurance for our agent-driven platforms and AI models. This role focuses on validating intelligent agents, non-deterministic AI outputs, and cross-product workflows using advanced automation and AI evaluation techniques.

You will play a key role in building our
**Enterprise AI Trust & Validation Framework**
, ensuring reliability, transparency, and scalability of AI systems.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Agentic AI & System Testing**

* Test multi-agent workflows, orchestration layers, and cross-domain intelligence systems
* Validate AI-generated narratives, themes, and analytical outputs.
* Perform groundedness, coherence, hallucination, and stability testing.
* Test conversational AI and chat-based agent systems.
* Evaluate consistency across multiple runs and detect output drift.

**Automation & Framework Development**

* Design and maintain automation frameworks using
  **Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Pytest, and Playwright**
  .
* Build E2E automation for UI, APIs, and agent pipelines.
* Develop reusable test utilities for AI validation and regression testing.
* Integrate automation with CI/CD pipelines.

**AI Model & Evaluation Testing**

* Validate in-house AI/ML models and inference pipelines.
* Implement LLM-as-Judge and semantic similarity-based validation.
* Perform statistical and comparative testing for model outputs.
* Support testing of models deployed on AWS.

**API & Performance Engineering**

* Perform API testing using Postman and automated scripts.
* Design and execute load and stress testing.
* Monitor system performance under AI-heavy workloads.
* Identify bottlenecks and scalability risks.

**Quality Strategy & Collaboration**

* Analyze business requirements, user stories, and AI specifications.
* Design test strategies for agentic and AI-driven systems.
* Work closely with Engineering, Product, and Data Science teams.
* Track defects, quality metrics, and release readiness.
* Drive continuous improvement in QA processes

**Required Qualifications**

* 6–8+ years of experience in QA, Automation, or Quality Engineering.
* Strong proficiency in
  **Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Pytest, and Playwright**
  .
* Experience testing AI systems, chatbots, or LLM-based platforms.
* Strong understanding of non-deterministic system testing.
* Experience with API testing (Postman, REST frameworks).
* Hands-on experience with performance testing. (K6 familiarity is a plus).
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
* Strong analytical and debugging skills.
* Excellent communication and documentation abilities.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with agent frameworks (LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, etc.).
* Knowledge of RAG systems and vector databases.
* Exposure to MLOps and AI observability tools.
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS preferred).
* Familiarity with statistical validation and NLP evaluation.
* CI/CD experience (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab).
* Familiarity with containerization technologies such as Docker/Kubernetes

**Core Competencies**

* AI Quality Engineering
* Agent Workflow Validation
* Automation Architecture
* Model Evaluation & Monitoring
* Performance Engineering
* Risk Assessment
* Cross-team Collaboration
* Ownership Mindset

**Career Growth**

This role offers growth into positions such as:

* Principal AI QA Engineer
* AI Systems Quality Architect
* QA Engineering Lead
* AI QA Engineering Manager

**Cultural Fit & Values**

At Accrete, success goes beyond technical expertise. We value:

* **Ownership & Accountability:**
  Drive initiatives to completion with high standards and proactive problem-solving.
* **Transparency & Communication:**
  Share information openly and give and receive constructive feedback.
* **Strategic Thinking & Problem-Solving:**
  Analyze challenges critically and develop effective, scalable solutions.
* **Collaboration & Professionalism:**
  Work effectively across teams and contribute to a culture of mutual respect.
* **Passion for AI & Innovation:**
  Stay curious, continuously learn, and push the boundaries of AI.
* **Going Beyond the Job Description:**
  Look for opportunities to create impact beyond your immediate responsibilities.
* These principles shape our culture, performance expectations, and growth opportunities.

**Company Benefits**

* **Competitive Compensation:**
  Aligned with experience and market standards.
* **Mediclaim:**
  ₹10 lakh coverage for you and your family.
* **Flexible PTO & Hybrid Work:**
  Take time off when needed and enjoy remote flexibility in accordance with company guidelines.
* **Growth & Development:**
  Access to professional learning opportunities and career advancement support.
* **Onsite Perks:**
  Catered lunches and snacks.
* **Team Bonding:**
  Company-sponsored social events and team activities.

*Accrete is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.*

title: Customer Success Software Solutions Engineer, Senior Analyst - Policy
description:
TITLE
  
  
Customer Success Software Solutions Engineer, Senior Analyst-Policy
  
  
**Who We Are**
Duck Creek Technologies is the intelligent solutions provider defining the future of the property and casualty (P&C) insurance industry. Our modern SaaS platform enables insurers to run agile, cloud-based operations and deliver better customer experiences.
  
  
Duck Creek is a flexible-first company, offering employees autonomy in how they manage their work. As part of our Flying Together approach, we are thoughtfully increasing opportunities for in-person collaboration by focusing on hiring in designated locations. This role is aligned to a specific location, and you’ll partner with your leader to participate in meaningful in-person moments that support team connection and collaboration.
  
  
**About Vista**
Duck Creek Technologies is a portfolio company of Vista Equity Partners, a global investment firm that partners with mission-critical enterprise software and technology-enabled businesses to drive growth and operational excellence. As part of a Vista portfolio company, you’ll work in an environment backed by deep expertise, long-term investment, and a strong commitment to building market-leading businesses and meaningful careers.
  
  
**Position Overview**
The Customer Success Software Solutions Engineer, Senior Analyst-Policy, plays a critical role and is responsible for upgrading client applications to the latest base versions. This involves a thorough understanding of the current application landscape and the new version's features and improvements. Post-upgrade, the engineer will identify, debug, and resolve any issues that arise. This ensures that the upgraded applications function seamlessly and meet client expectations. The engineer will analyze client code to identify deviations and determine what can be upgraded directly and what requires client confirmation.
  
  
The Customer Success Software Solutions Engineer, Senior Analyst-Policy will work closely with various departments, including development, quality assurance, and client support teams, to ensure a smooth upgrade process and effective issue resolution
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Meticulously analyze and assess the impact of upgrades based on release notes and code changes for new release features. This involves understanding the nuances of each release and predicting how these changes will affect the existing applications.
* Debugs custom code and base code to provide workarounds or solutions to third-party implementation teams or customers. This requires a deep understanding of the application and the ability to quickly diagnose and resolve issues.
* Leverage Duck Creek upgrade tools to generate differential analysis and produce low-impact upgrade paths for Duck Creek customers.
* Leverage AI-driven tools and processes to identify automation opportunities and reduce manual effort across product upgrade and certification activities.
* Apply strong product implementation knowledge and technical expertise to effectively support product upgrade and certification processes
* Expected to act independently, demonstrating initiative and self-reliance in managing their tasks and responsibilities.
* Identify opportunities to automate processes or develop utilities that assist in faster and more effective upgrades.
* Interacts with customer counterparts to triage issues and present solutions.
* Reviews, Mentors and Shares knowledge with the team members.
* Informs the Technical Lead and Project Manager of any issues and risk that may affect overall upgrade schedules.

* Perform all other duties and activities as required.
* Act in accordance with and as a good steward of Duck Creek Technologies mission, vision, and core values:

+ Mission: To empower insurers to reimagine the future of insurance
+ Vision: To transform insurance technology, helping insurers be smarter, faster, and more efficient, and ultimately provide the best protection for people and businesses
+ Values: We Prioritize Respect, We Listen, We Care, We Add Value, and We Lead

**What You’ve Done**
Education and Work Experience:
  
  


* Bachelor’s degree, or higher educational level, or foreign equivalent, in Computer Science strongly preferred
* Minimum 3 years’ related industry experience in system development and implementation
* Demonstrated proficiency in Analysis, Development, and Triage.
* Demonstrated proficiency and implementation experience in any of the Duck Creek Policy Product
* Strong understanding of Duck Creek Policy concepts such Policy Transactions and Policy Forms
* Hands-on development experience with C#, .NET, SQL Server, XML/XSLT, REST/SOAP APIs, and Duck Creek extensibility/configuration
* Hands- on experience of Duck Creek Policy debugging tools like Trace Monitor, TSV Monitor etc.
* Experience with SQL query development, stored procedures, database troubleshooting, and performance optimization
* Demonstrated proficiency in Insurance domain knowledge

**Skills, Knowledge, Abilities, And Behaviors**

* Knowledge of insurance products a plus
* Experience/knowledge of P&C Insurance software applications a plus
* Experience/knowledge of software development life cycle for P&C insurance software a plus
* Experience developing and troubleshooting integrations between Duck Creek Policy and external systems.
* Good to have knowledge in TFS, GitHub and GIT workflow.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Excellent communication skills, verbal and written
* Experience in Duck Creek Policy upgrades/certifications and assessing customizations, integrations, and compatibility

CORE COMPETENCIES
  
  
Our team is built on strong core values that guide how we work and grow together. We prioritize clear and thoughtful communication, fostering open collaboration across diverse perspectives to achieve shared goals. We approach challenges with curiosity and critical thinking, seeking creative solutions while remaining adaptable in a fast-changing environment. We take accountability for our work and outcomes, holding ourselves to high standards of integrity and professionalism. Above all, we are committed to doing the right thing—treating others with respect, embracing continuous learning, and engaging inclusively across cultures and backgrounds.
  
  
LEARN MORE
  
  

* Company Website – Transforming Insurance with Duck Creek's SaaS Solutions
* Life at Duck Creek – Life at Duck Creek - Duck Creek
* Benefits & Rewards – Wellbeing & Rewards - Duck Creek

LOCATION & WAYS OF WORKING
  
  
Duck Creek is a flexible-first company, offering employees autonomy in how they manage their day-to-day work. As part of our Flying Together approach, we are thoughtfully increasing opportunities for in-person collaboration by focusing on hiring in designated locations.
  
  
This role is aligned to a specific location, and you are expected to reside within reasonable proximity to that location. You will partner with your leader to participate in meaningful in-person moments that support team connection, collaboration, and business priorities.
  
  
At the start of your employment, your work may be performed remotely, subject to business needs and company guidelines. As our Flying Together approach continues to evolve, you may be expected to transition to a hybrid work arrangement, including working from a designated office location on a schedule determined by your leader and organizational needs.
  
  
The Company reserves the right to modify your work arrangement, including location expectations and in-person requirements, based on business needs, organizational policy, or regulatory considerations.
  
  
**What We Stand For**
Our global team values the unique perspectives each employee brings. Our success is driven by an inclusive culture where everyone can learn from one another, regardless of role or background. This collaborative approach helps us continuously improve our products, services, and systems.
  
  
Duck Creek is committed to equal opportunity for all employees and applicants, with decisions based on skills, experience, and achievements—without regard to any protected status.
  
  
We strive to lead by example in inclusion, diversity, and equity, creating an environment where employees can be their authentic selves. Our values guide us: We Prioritize Respect, We Listen, We Care, We Add Value, and We Lead.
  
  
To learn more: https://www.duckcreek.com/life-at-duck-creek/

title: Customer Success Technical Advisor - (Post Sales Engineer)
description:
TrendAI™, the global AI security leader and enterprise business unit of Trend Micro, empowers organizations with full AI visibility and consolidated security that inspires confidence, drives innovation, and eliminates risk.
  
  
At TrendAI™, we’re always seeking exceptional talent; people who want to collaborate with the best and push boundaries together. Here, your work goes beyond building a career. You will help protect what matters and play a vital role in shaping a safer, more trustworthy AI-powered future.
  
  
AI Fearlessly.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Customer Success Technical Advisor – (Post Sales Engineer)**
**About Trendai (trend Micro)**
Trend Micro, a global cybersecurity leader, helps make the world safe for exchanging digital information across enterprises, governments, and consumers. Fueled by over three decades of security expertise and relentless innovation, Trend leverages the full power of AI to protect more than 500,000 organizations and millions of individuals worldwide.
  
  
In 2026, Trend Micro evolved its enterprise business under the
**TrendAI™**
brand, reflecting a strategic shift from protecting infrastructure to governing how AI systems, agents, and data-driven decisions act across the enterprise attack surface. At the core of this protection is
**TrendAI Vision One™**
, the industry’s first AI-powered enterprise cybersecurity platform. It centralizes cyber risk exposure management and security operations, delivering robust, layered protection across on-premises, hybrid, and multi-cloud environments—including critical partnerships with NVIDIA, AWS, Google, and Microsoft. With 7,000 employees across 70 countries and world-class threat intelligence from the
**Zero Day Initiative™ (ZDI)**
, Trend empowers organizations to move from reactive defense to proactive resilience. In an era of industrialized, machine-driven cybercrime, Trend Micro ensures enterprises can innovate with confidence. Proactive security starts here.
  
  
**Position Overview**
As a
**Customer Success Technical Advisor (CSTA)**
, you are the strategic technical linchpin for Trend Micro’s enterprise clients. Your mission is to move beyond reactive troubleshooting to become a
**Trusted Advisor**
, ensuring customers achieve measurable cybersecurity resilience. You will lead the technical journey for our most strategic accounts, transforming complex security requirements into scalable, operational successes within the TrendAI Vision One™ ecosystem.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Provide direct technical support to premium and key customers.
* Manage customer accounts by providing technical updates, conducting monthly and quarterly case reviews, delivering threat assessments and advisories for proactive protection, training customers on products and emerging threats, communicating product enhancements and bug fixes, and fostering strong customer relationships to support account retention.
* Be a trusted threat advisor for nominated customers·
* Act as the customer’s champion within Trend Micro·
* Be available 24x7 to provide crisis support services to nominated customers·
* Manage and progress technical support cases·
* Provide assistance to nominated backup customers when other team members are absent·
* Regularly meet with clients for the purpose of relationship building·

**What do you need for this opportunity?
  
  
**Must have skills required:**
GenAI, LLM, automation, manual, Selenium, Python
  
  
**Bullet Microdrama is Looking for:******
**QA Engineer (Automation), Video Generation (Trinetra) Experience: 3+ years. Location: Noida, Onsite.**
**About The Role**
Trinetra is our AI video generation product. It covers text to video, multi language dubbing, lip sync and voice (TTS). We are looking for a QA engineer who can do two things well. First, you should be able to look at a generated video and tell whether it is actually good. Second, you should be able to write the automation that keeps the quality from slipping every time a model or a pipeline version changes. If you enjoy both breaking things by hand and building the scripts that catch them automatically, you will fit in here.
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing**
You will build and own automated API and regression suites for the video generation, dubbing and lip sync pipeline, and you will plug them into CI so every change gets tested before it ships. A good part of the work is writing scripted quality checks on the media itself, using tools like ffmpeg, ffprobe and OpenCV, to catch issues such as audio video syn problems, dropped frames, wrong resolution, loudness issues and missing or garbled audio. Alongside the automation, you will review generated output by eye, because many problems (lip sync drift, a character whose face or clothes change between shots, flicker, artifacts, or a dub in the wrong language) are things a metric will miss and a person will catch instantly. When you find a bug, you will log it clearly in Jira with the inputs, the exact clip or frame, and clean steps to reproduce.
  
  
**What We Need From You**
You should have at least 3 years in QA, with real hands on automation experience. We mean suites you have actually built and maintained, not just manual test cases you have run. You should be strong in Python (or JavaScript) and comfortable with a framework such as pytest, Playwright, Selenium or RestAssured. API test automation and CI experience (GitHub Actions, Jenkins or Cloud Build) are important. We also need media or video QA background, so you
  
  
understand audio video sync, encoding and playback, and you can use ffmpeg or ffprobe for automated checks. On top of that, you should have hands on experience or at least a solid working knowledge of generative AI and LLMs, including diffusion, text to video and TTS models. This matters because testing a model is very different from testing a normal API. You need to understand how these models behave so your tests actually mean something, rather than simply checking that a file came back. A sharp eye for audio and visual detail rounds it off, along with the usual comfort with Git and Jira.
  
  
**Nice to have**
It would help if you have worked with perceptual quality metrics like SSIM, LPIPS or FID, done visual diffing with OpenCV, handled dubbing or localization QA across Hindi and regional languages, or have some familiarity with GCP and GPU based inference pipelines.
  
  
**Who This Is Not For**
This role will not suit someone who has only done manual QA with no automation, or someone who has strong automation skills but has never touched media, video or generative AI. We need all three together, someone who writes good automation, can judge AI video output, and
  
  
understands how the models work underneath.
  
  
**A couple of things we will ask in the interview**
We will ask you to walk us through an automation suite you built from scratch, including the framework you chose, what it covered, how it ran in CI, and a real regression it caught. We will also ask how you would test the output of a text to video or TTS model beyond just confirming that the API returned a file.

title: SAP PP/QM Consultant
description:
**Company Description**
Synthite Industries Pvt. Ltd. is a global leader in plant-derived ingredients, specializing in spice oleoresins, essential oils, and flavor and fragrance solutions. Headquartered in India, the company manages a portfolio of over 500 products and serves clients in more than 70 countries, holding over 35% of the global market share in its core segments. With a turnover of USD 220 million and a workforce of around 3,000 employees, Synthite focuses strongly on quality, innovation, and sustainable growth. The organization emphasizes professional development, ethical business practices, and a collaborative work culture that supports employee success. Its vision is to be the partner of choice worldwide by consistently delivering high-quality ingredients for food, health, and fragrance applications.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site role for a SAP PP/QM Consultant based in Ernakulam. The SAP PP/QM Consultant will configure, maintain, and support SAP Production Planning (PP) and Quality Management (QM) modules to align with manufacturing and quality processes. Daily responsibilities include analyzing business requirements, designing and implementing solutions, handling master data related to materials and production, and ensuring seamless integration with other SAP modules such as SAP FICO. The role involves troubleshooting system issues, performing unit and integration testing, preparing functional documentation, and supporting end users through training and guidance. The consultant will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams in production, quality, finance, and IT to optimize processes, improve data accuracy, and enhance overall system performance.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong understanding of manufacturing and quality-related business processes, including production planning and quality control workflows.
* Demonstrated analytical skills to gather requirements, interpret data, perform root-cause analysis, and propose effective system and process improvements.
* Experience in SAP consulting, with hands-on configuration and support in SAP PP and QM, and ability to collaborate with business stakeholders.
* Working knowledge of SAP FICO and related integrations to ensure smooth data flow between production, quality, and finance functions.
* Proficiency in managing and maintaining master data (materials, BOMs, routings, inspection plans) with attention to accuracy and data governance.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field; SAP certifications in PP/QM are an advantage.
* Experience in process manufacturing or FMCG/food ingredients industry is preferred, along with exposure to quality and compliance standards.
* Effective communication and documentation skills, ability to work in cross-functional teams, and readiness to work on-site in Ernakulam.

title: Product Manager II - SmartHub, Amazon Smart Commerce
description:
**Description**
What if running an e-commerce business could become dramatically simpler — with AI helping sellers manage orders, inventory, pricing and operations across every channel they sell on?
  
  
Amazon Smart Commerce is looking for a Product Manager for SmartHub, our multi-channel e-commerce operations platform. SmartHub brings together orders, inventory, catalog, returns, warehousing and business insights across marketplaces and D2C channels into a single system, helping businesses operate at scale without navigating multiple disconnected tools.
  
  
We are now at an exciting inflection point. Advances in generative and agentic AI create an opportunity to fundamentally rethink how sellers operate their businesses — moving from dashboards and workflows, toward intelligent experiences that understand their business, identify what needs attention, recommend actions and increasingly execute work on their behalf.
  
  
As the Product Manager for SmartHub, you will be at the forefront of defining and executing this journey by identifying the opportunities, defining the product and deliver exceptional seller experiences. Your work will directly impact the growth and success of sellers leveraging Amazon SmartHub, enabling them to scale their business to new heights.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Understand seller problems to identify unmet needs and emerging trends in the e-commerce landscape.
* Monitor and analyze competitor activities and market trends to identify opportunities for differentiation and innovation.
* Translate seller insights and market opportunities into detailed product requirements and user stories for the engineering team.
* Collaborate with GTM, engineering, UX, support and marketing teams throughout the product development lifecycle, from concept to launch.
* Analyze product performance data, identify areas for improvement, and iterate on the product based on customer feedback and business results.
* Conduct A/B testing and other experiments to optimize product features and improve key metrics.
* Develop and maintain product documentation, including user guides, training materials, and FAQs.

**Required Skillset**

* Proven ability to conduct market research, competitive analysis, and customer insights to inform product strategy.
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret data, draw conclusions, and make data-driven decisions.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate effectively across teams.
* Deep understanding of online product management principles, agile development methodologies, and A/B testing techniques.
* Bachelor's degree in a related field; MBA preferred with 3years of experience in product management

A day in the life
  
  
You will start your day by reviewing the product and business metrics. You morning might involve speaking to a seller processing thousands of orders across Amazon, Flipkart and other channels, identifying where manual work and exceptions slow them down. Later, you could work with engineers and scientists on an AI agent that detects inventory risks or automates an operational workflow. You will move fluidly between speaking to sellers, thinking of solutions, brainstorming with engineers, driving adoption and thinking strategy.
  
  
**About The Team**
Amazon Smart Commerce is building the technology infrastructure for agentic commerce that helps businesses sell and operate wherever their customers shop.
  
  
SmartHub is our multi-channel operations platform, helping sellers bring orders, inventory, catalog, returns and business insights from multiple marketplaces and D2C channels into one system. It is built for the operational realities of commerce - high-volume events, warehouse workflows, complex integrations and businesses that cannot afford downtime.
  
  
We believe AI creates an opportunity to reinvent this category. Our ambition is to evolve from a software that helps sellers manage workflows to an intelligent commerce operating system that helps them run and grow their businesses.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of product management experience
* Experience managing technical products or online services

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in product, program, or project management in leading cross-functional teams in delivery of major new products or services
* Experience building and analyzing cost/benefit scenarios and business cases and communicating results throughout the organization
* Experience in creating PRFAQs, BRDs and other product documentation. Experience in leveraging AI for documentation, prototyping and business data analysis.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

You will help developers and product teams build and maintain high-quality experiences with less effort. A central part of your role is leading the development of a UI framework optimized for AI. The framework will also enable Rippling AI to compose interactive experiences at runtime that present information, collect input, and support actions, while preserving consistency and quality across web and mobile.

Additionally, you will be responsible for the core Rippling experience; from the homepage that users see when they log in to Rippling on web & mobile to how they navigate to different parts of the product. * You will work closely with designers and engineers on your team to develop UX patterns and technologies that help Rippling’s engineering, product, and design teams build high-quality experiences faster

* You will measure success through developer adoption, time to build, and the consistency, usability, accessibility, performance, and reliability of experiences built on the platform
* You’ll be eager to roll up your sleeves and dig into the technical details while obsessing over a simple, intuitive customer experience
* You’ll work cross-functionally with virtually every team – across product, engineering, design, marketing, and customer-facing functions – to design an extensible system that can meet the evolving needs of Rippling product teams and our customers

title: Associate Product Manager
description:
**Job Title: Associate Product Manager – Power & Magnetics (Bangalore, India)**

**Department: Product Management - Marketing**

**Company Overview:**

Abracon is a trusted supplier of leading-edge and innovative electronic components including Frequency Control, Timing, Power, Magnetics, RF and Antenna solutions. Servicing world-class companies across the data communication, transportation, industrial, medical, consumer, aerospace, and defense industries, Abracon accelerates customers’ time-to-market by providing unmatched product solutions, technical expertise, and service excellence.

**Position Summary:**

We are looking for a motivated, early-career Associate Product Manager to support Abracon's Power & Magnetics product line, which includes power inductors, supercapacitors, common mode chokes, and ferrite beads. Reporting to the Senior Product Line Manager, you will handle day-to-day product support for sales, distribution partners, and customers, and contribute to the analysis and launch activities that drive the line's growth — while building the foundation to grow into a Product Line Manager role. This is a hands-on opportunity to learn product management on the components at the heart of power conversion, energy storage, and EMI suppression in modern electronics.

**Work Environment:**

The successful candidate will be a full-time employee based at Abracon's office in Bangalore, India. A hybrid work-from-home arrangement is available. The role partners closely with the Senior Product Line Manager and headquarters teams in Austin, Texas, and requires regular overlap with U.S. business hours.

**Growth Opportunity:**

* Learn product line management directly from a Senior Product Line Manager, with a clear path toward owning product families and, over time, a product line
* Build deep technical expertise in magnetics, power conversion, and energy storage
* Support Tier 1 customers and distribution partners worldwide on next-generation power designs
* Gain cross-functional exposure to sales, engineering, operations, and marketing as part of Abracon's growing Bangalore team
* Opportunities for career advancement and meaningful impact in product development and marketing

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Serve as a regional point of contact for Power & Magnetics product inquiries from sales teams, representatives, distribution partners, and customers
* Support the Senior Product Line Manager on pricing and quotation requests, competitor cross-references, and part number recommendations
* Coordinate sample requests, custom part number set-ups, and datasheet, test report, and specification requests with engineering and operations
* Support new product introductions by gathering launch inputs, maintaining NPI documentation, and helping prepare launch collateral and sales training materials
* Assist with product lifecycle activities, including product change notifications (PCNs), last-time-buy, and end-of-life communications
* Conduct competitor benchmarking and market research on inductor, supercapacitor, and EMI component trends to inform product roadmaps and new product proposals
* Track product line sales, bookings, and design-win activity; prepare reports and presentation materials for the Senior Product Line Manager and leadership reviews
* Maintain accurate product data across the website, distributor catalogs, and internal systems
* Relay customer requirements and market trends to the Senior Product Line Manager and engineering teams

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electrical & Electronics Engineering, or a related field
* 2–3 years of experience in an engineering, applications, field application, product, or technical sales role, with an electronic component manufacturer or distributor
* Working knowledge of power electronics fundamentals, including DC-DC converter topologies and key magnetics parameters (inductance, saturation current, DCR, core loss)
* Familiarity with EMI filtering, supercapacitors, or magnetic simulation tools (e.g., Ansys Maxwell) is a plus
* Strong interest in product management and a basic understanding of the product lifecycle
* Solid analytical skills with proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint and AI tools.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
* Highly organized and responsive, with the ability to manage multiple requests in a fast-paced environment and work effectively with global teams across time zones

**Come join our team!**
Excellence through teamwork drives the company culture at Abracon. We provide opportunities and support for your professional growth and empower each other in exercising our individual strengths.

With a broad portfolio of passive and electromechanical timing, synchronization, power, connectivity and RF antenna solutions and more, Abracon helps engineers transform their ideas into products that meet future customer needs. For more information about Abracon, visit www.abracon.com

title: Sr Product Manager - Merchant
description:
**About the role and team**  
  
Product at Uber means making big decisions without perfect information—and owning the outcomes. As a Senior Product Manager (Tech), you will turn massive complexity into clarity at speed, navigating the "messy" reality of multi-sided marketplaces and high-stakes technical integrations. You will be at the heart of our most ambitious missions, architecting solutions that bridge the digital and physical worlds for millions of users globally.  
  
This is a high-visibility, high-impact role where you won’t just manage a roadmap; you will build 0-to-1 platforms that bridge the digital and physical worlds. You’ll need to lead through influence, not control, and stay resilient while balancing the needs of external partners, engineering teams, and global business units. If you are a curious, owner-minded product leader who is energized by challenge and motivated by real-world impact—this is where you’ll grow.  
  
**What you’ll do**  
  

* Build a bold product vision and strategy for your domain, identifying near and long-term initiatives that unlock the next wave of Uber’s global growth.
* Design and ship scalable technology solutions—including APIs, orchestration layers, and developer tools—to deeply interpret and respond to complex marketplace signals.
* Navigate and align cross-functional teams across Engineering, Data Science, Design, and Legal to drive cohesive product strategies despite competing priorities.
* Translate unstructured user pain points into clear product requirements by distilling complex problems, writing hypotheses, and defining measurable outcomes.
* Forge and manage strategic relationships with external partners, fintechs, or autonomous technology providers to scale deployments and optimize global operations.
Iterate relentlessly by distilling insights from performance dashboards, experimentation results, and user research to continuously raise the bar for quality and reliability.  

  
  
**Basic Qualifications**  
  

* 6 + years of experience as a Product Manager, with a proven track record of shipping large-scale projects each quarter that yield quantifiable impact.
* Proven ability to convert unstructured problems with significant ambiguity into clarifying, focused plans for multi-team projects.
* Strong technical depth: Able to coordinate large engineering efforts, identify potential technical risks, and act as an effective partner for engineering managers across teams.
* Experience defining OKRs and roadmaps for complex programs/platforms, ensuring teams operate with minimal noise and a rapid clip of high-quality delivery.
* Demonstrated leadership in overseeing deeply experimental teams, partnering with data science managers to drive strong experimentation and data-driven prioritization.
* Proficient in UX/UI paradigms: Ability to own the design process for complex products, providing deep context to designers while driving fast iteration cycles for new concepts.
* Experience representing significant areas of work to executives to gather feedback, generate alignment, and garner support.
Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related technical/quantitative field.  

  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**  
  

* Domain expertise in Financial Services, Autonomous Vehicles, or high-scale Marketplace mechanics.
* Passionate about shipping "magical," defect-free products, overseeing quality monitoring, alerting, and retrospective processes.
* Proven recruiter and mentor: Ability to successfully hire for the team and serve as a coveted member of all product interview loops.
* Strategic 0-to-1 experience: Generating innovative ideas for new product areas and incorporating customer feedback into long-term visions.
Global experience: Building and launching products that bridge digital and physical worlds across diverse regional contexts.  

  
  
**Ready to Ride?**  
  
This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook — it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves — we'd love to hear from you.  
  
You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.  
  
Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. title: Senior Software Engineer (Mobile)
description:
**About Ipsator**

Ipsator builds large-scale digital platforms across domains such as Food Tech, Travel Tech, Healthcare Tech, and Enterprise Systems. Our products operate under real-world constraints where reliability, scalability, and long-term maintainability matter more than short-term velocity.

Mobile systems at Ipsator are first-class citizens. We expect senior engineers to think beyond individual features and contribute to the coherence, health, and evolution of mobile systems over time.

**Role Overview**

You’ll take long-term ownership of native mobile apps, improving the ones people rely on and building new ones as needed. You’ll work closely with other mobile engineers on features and projects of varying complexity.

Most of our core apps are native Android apps built in Kotlin, and some use Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP) and Compose Multiplatform (CMP). New apps can use either stack, with KMP preferred. You’ll contribute to iOS primarily through shared code, using Swift where needed.

We’re looking for engineers who take pride in their work, ask thoughtful questions and act on the problems they find.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Identify and deliver app improvements, using customer feedback and production data to prioritise work in line with the wider team’s product strategy.

* Work with web engineers on shared features and the web assets and integrations they need. Coordinate API and service changes with backend engineers.
* Plan your work and document tasks, dependencies and technical decisions. Prepare releases with QA, including testing, rollout and post-release checks.
* Monitor crashes and app performance, investigate production issues and verify fixes.
* Guide technical design and build maintainable, secure and accessible features. Mentor engineers through design discussions and code reviews.
* Share engineering practices across mobile and web teams and suggest improvements where they fit.
* Experiment with new technologies, document the results and adopt what improves the apps or the way the team works.
* We welcome AI-assisted development. Understand how the resulting code works, check it against project patterns and standards, and test it before release.

**Requirements**

* Strong hands-on experience building, shipping and maintaining native Android applications using Kotlin.
* Experience building native interfaces and a sound understanding of app lifecycles, UI state, concurrency, API integration and local persistence.
* Experience owning complex features and explaining the trade-offs behind your technical decisions.
* Ability to test and debug mobile apps, investigate production issues and improve performance and reliability.

**Preferred**

* Hands-on experience with Kotlin Multiplatform or Compose Multiplatform.
* Production experience with Jetpack Compose.
* Experience improving build times, release quality or observability in a production mobile app.
* Experience with native iOS development in Swift.

**Why Join Us?**

* Build apps used at scale across food, travel and other domains.
* Stay hands-on and shape how we use KMP and CMP across products.
* Turn your ideas into shipped improvements with autonomy and leading development tools.

title: Research Program Manager
description:
**About the team**
------------------

At Zillow, we understand that there’s nothing more powerful than home, providing physical and emotional security for today, and financial opportunity for tomorrow. But for many, finding and getting home is a challenge, marked by complexity at best, and real barriers at worst. So just as we gave customers the advantage of information that helped them to find home, today we’re giving them everything they need to get home. We believe that home should be more than just a dream and our purpose is to make home a reality for more and more people.
  
  
This has led our business to build solutions related to financing, buying, selling, and renting. Our work is also changing as we learn to collaborate in a cloud HQ environment, with team members spread across the nation. Together, we are all stewards of a promise we make to those we serve - a promise that is built on trust through every touchpoint people have with us. As a team, we are ensuring that every Zillow employee feels a sense of shared ownership of this promise, so they understand it, feel connected to it, and are equipped to live it every day.
  
  
In that light, Zillow's Brand Strategy & Insights (BS&I) team is kicking off a search for someone to help manage the programs that unlock deeper understanding of our customers and partners. Our team carries the brand measurement programs and research tooling the marketing organization uses to answer those questions with evidence, and to see whether the brand is gaining or losing ground over time.
  
As a Sr Program Manager, you will play a meaningful role in developing a truly iconic brand. This role reports to our Senior Manager, Insights,

**Zillow Group is a strategic, mission-driven organization focused on delivering exceptional experiences and measurable outcomes.** Our work spans cross-functional partnership, scalable programs and operational excellence in support of Zillow’s mission. We bring deep experience working across diverse teams in a dynamic, high-growth environment, balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution to drive meaningful business impact. We are seeking an experienced professional to support our workforce expansion in India.

**About the role**
------------------

As a Senior Brand Measurement Program Manager, you run Zillow's brand measurement work as programs rather than a series of studies. You own the calendar that puts brand health and partner reporting in front of leadership on time, you are the first stop when the business brings a measurement question, and you own the tooling, vendors, and process the rest of the team's research runs on. Please reach out to your HRBP for a job description.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own the reporting calendar across our brand measurement programs, delivering quarterly tracker reporting, State of the Brand inputs, and Marketing goal metric reporting on schedule.
* Run intake and triage for measurement requests from marketing, product, and line of business partners, routing each to self-serve data, an existing cut, or a scoped project.
* Own sample, panel, and vendor relationships, including scoping, renewals, and quality checks on what gets delivered.
* Own our research tooling for tracking, from access and administration through finding and landing AI-first workflows that cut manual effort for the whole team.
* Build and maintain dashboards and AI-first automated reporting outputs so partners can answer their own questions without routing through us.

This role has been categorized as an Office position. “Office” employees regularly work at the Zillow India office for approximately 80 to 100 percent of their time each month. Employees must live within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Zillow has not defined a reasonable distance, and expects employees will use judgment in determining this for themselves and understand the implications re: time commitment and cost of daily commute.

**Who you are**
---------------

* 5+ years managing research, insights, or measurement programs, including 3+ years supporting research or analytics teams.
* Track record of owning a recurring research program end to end, accountable for schedule, quality, and stakeholder communication.
* Expertise in survey design and methodology for repeated cross-sectional and longitudinal studies, including sampling, quotas, and weighting.
* Hands-on Qualtrics, or similar, expertise across survey build, distribution logic, sample orders, and dashboards.
* Experience owning external sample, panel, and vendor relationships, including scoping and contract renewal.
* Experience automating research and reporting workflows using AI (Claude).
* Excellent written and verbal communication. You can engage senior stakeholders, push back on a request, and route it somewhere better.

**Get to know us**
------------------

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.

  

Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.

  

No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.

  

*Zillow Group is committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment and to providing equal employment opportunities. We comply with applicable laws that prohibit discrimination in employment and recruitment.*

  

*If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation during the recruitment process, please contact your recruiter directly.*

  

*Qualified applicants will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable law.*
