title: Medical Project Owner
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
  
  
**Organization Background:**  
Scientific data and information are core assets of Eli Lilly and Company (“Lilly”). Providing balanced, objective, and accurate information to regulators, the scientific community, healthcare professionals (HCPs), payers, and patients across the drug development lifecycle is fundamental to Lilly’s mission.
  
Global Content Hub (GCH) is a part of Global Commercial Capabilities and Innovation organisation and houses plethora of capabilities that help deliver impactful, scalable content that empowers informed decision making across the healthcare spectrum dedicated to crafting top-tier promotional/non-promotional materials for healthcare professionals (HCPs), patients, and payers.
  
  
**Position Description:**  
The Medical Project Owner (MedPO) is responsible for coordinating and tracking the end-to-end execution of medical and scientific content projects within Eli Lilly’s Global Content Hub. Operating at the intersection of project execution, workflow coordination, and operational visibility, this role ensures that projects move efficiently through initiation, development, review readiness, approval milestones, and closure.
  
The MedPO serves as the execution lead after project kickoff, working closely with Functional PMs, content teams, DRM, MCA teams, and other stakeholders to maintain progress, resolve blockers, and improve milestone visibility. The role holder coordinates deliverable movement through Medical-Legal-Regulatory-Operational (MLRO) review workflows in Veeva and across Adobe Workfront, ensuring that dependencies are tracked, handoffs are clean, and cycle times are minimized.
  
This role strengthens execution discipline so that Functional PMs can focus on planning, stakeholder engagement, and strategic alignment. The role is introduced as part of an evolving operating model and will continue to be refined based on pilot learnings.
  
  
**Key Objectives/Deliverables:**  
Execution Tracking & Lifecycle Coordination
  
  

* Drive execution tracking across the full project lifecycle after kickoff — from initiation through development, review readiness, approval, and closure — ensuring every stage is documented and progressing within agreed SLAs
* Monitor milestone progression for both end-to-end and mid-way projects depending on business needs, maintaining real-time visibility into deliverable status, scope, and stage transitions
* Identify delays, dormant projects, and emerging risks early; drive timely follow-ups and corrective actions to keep projects on track and minimize cycle-time delays
* Maintain the MCA Internal Tracker, daily planner, and supporting logs with up-to-date status, assignment data, and milestone updates — targeting 100% accuracy in project records
* Track deliverable turnaround against defined SLAs and surface bottlenecks that could impact downstream review or approval timelines

Workflow Coordination & Handoff Management
  
  

* Coordinate workflow movement across Adobe Workfront, Veeva Vault, and supporting tools — ensuring smooth transitions between development, review, and approval stages
* Facilitate handoffs between writers, designers, DRM, MCA, QMR, Content Editors, and other stakeholders, ensuring each party has the inputs and context needed to proceed without delays
* Route deliverables through Veeva for parallel MLRO review where applicable, minimizing sequential bottlenecks and supporting efficient processing
* Ensure alignment on timelines, dependencies, and next steps across all involved teams; proactively flag misalignments or unclear scope before they impact execution
* Assign and allocate deliverables to appropriate stakeholders during daily standups based on bandwidth, priority, and scope — ensuring prompt allocation within 24 hours

Project Setup & System Readiness
  
  

* Create and manage project structures in Adobe Workfront, ensuring all projects are initiated with the required metadata, workflow templates, and system readiness for execution
* Support Veeva placeholder creation as part of execution setup, in alignment with the evolving operating model and compliance requirements
* Maintain trackers, logs, and status dashboards with high accuracy to provide a single source of truth for project visibility across the team and leadership
* Ensure project setup reflects accurate scope, deliverable type, business unit alignment, and expected timelines — enabling downstream reporting and KPI measurement

Stakeholder Coordination
  
  

* Work closely with Functional PMs, BU leads, content owners, GCH teams, DRM, and MCA teams to ensure alignment on execution priorities, deliverable timelines, and quality expectations
* Support alignment across GCH, TPO, and affiliate workflows where applicable — bridging operational gaps and ensuring cross-team dependencies are surfaced early
* Surface missing inputs, unclear scope, and dependency gaps proactively; collaborate with Deliverable Owners and Operations teams to resolve issues promptly
* Participate in standups, planning sessions, and working meetings to maintain execution flow, provide status updates, and coordinate next steps across distributed teams
* Provide subject matter guidance to assigned business units on execution workflows, tool usage, and lifecycle processes

Visibility, Escalation & Reporting
  
  

* Maintain clear, real-time visibility of project status, risks, and bottlenecks through structured tracking, dashboards, and regular status updates
* Escalate delays, missing dependencies, or workflow issues through defined channels to Functional PMs, BU leads, and leadership — ensuring no critical blocker goes unaddressed
* Provide regular execution updates to stakeholders and leadership, including progress against milestones, risk summaries, and forecasting trends
* Support pilot reporting through structured tracking and actionable insights — translating execution data into recommendations for process and operating model refinement
* Drive KPI reporting discipline across assigned scope, pulling and presenting metrics on a weekly/monthly cadence to support evidence-based decision-making

Continuous Improvement & Pilot Evolution
  
  

* Identify workflow inefficiencies, duplication risks, and execution bottlenecks; recommend and implement targeted process improvement initiatives to enhance throughput and reduce rework
* Capture structured learnings on where the MedPO role adds the most value and where adjustments are required — feeding insights back into the operating model evolution
* Support refinement of the operating model based on pilot outcomes, stakeholder feedback, and performance data
* Contribute to playbooks, best practices, SOPs, and standardization efforts that codify execution excellence and enable scalable onboarding of new team members
* Drive a continuous improvement mindset across the team by facilitating knowledge-sharing sessions, lessons-learned reviews, and cross-BU benchmarking discussions

Become part of Something big with Extreme! As a global networking leader, learn why there’s no better time to join the Extreme team.

  

**Job Description**

  

What you will do (Job Specific Details on the nature of the job and responsibilities).

  

The individual will own program visibility and governance, identify and drive resolution of complex cross-functional dependencies across multiple teams and workstreams, ensure customer commitments are met, manage compliance/certification critical paths, maintain executive stakeholder alignment, and escalate risks early with clear impact analysis and mitigation options.

  

**Experience** : 5-10 Years

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Executive Stakeholder Management & Program Governance**

* Own program governance structure; establish and maintain executive steering committee cadence with clear decision-making authority
* Provide weekly executive reporting on program health, milestone status, critical risks, and pending decisions
* Communicate program status to SVP-level leadership and the customer steering committee with clear, actionable insights
* Escalate risks and resource conflicts to leadership with impact analysis, mitigation options, and recommended actions
* Ensure executive visibility into program timeline, customer commitments, and go/no-go readiness
* Manage executive decision-making on trade-offs (scope vs. schedule vs. quality) with full context

**Release & Program Management**

* Manage multiple concurrent software and hardware release programs across cloud management, security, controller, networking software, and manufacturing components
* Drive releases through development completion, QA, release readiness, and GA milestones
* Track release scope, feature readiness, must-fix defects, testing completion, and release criteria
* Lead release readiness meetings, ensuring actions, risks, dependencies, and decisions are documented
* Ensure release artifacts (release notes, technical documentation, customer guides) are completed before GA
* Identify schedule risks early and drive mitigation plans with responsible teams

**Hardware NPI & Manufacturing Coordination**

* Manage new hardware platform NPI program through development, manufacturing, QA verification, and GA
* Track development, firmware/image readiness, QA verification, manufacturing readiness, and GA milestones
* Ensure hardware engineering and software feature commitments remain aligned with manufacturing timeline
* Coordinate hardware-firmware-software dependencies required for platform launch
* Drive BOM finalization, manufacturing-image readiness, and ODM partner coordination to ensure hardware ships with appropriate firmware
* Coordinate dependencies across Hardware Engineering, Firmware, Software teams, Manufacturing, ODM partners, and other supporting organizations

**Quality & Defect Management**

* Participate in recurring defect/bug scrubs across multiple software platforms and hardware validation
* Track must-fix defects and ensure critical issues are resolved before release
* Work with Engineering and QA to prioritize defects based on release impact and schedule
* Monitor automated and manual test results; escalate failures threatening release readiness
* Ensure comprehensive end-to-end testing for features spanning multiple platforms (cloud management, security, controller, networking software)

**Dependency, Risk & Escalation Management**

* Maintain visibility into complex cross-functional dependencies across multiple teams and workstreams
* Proactively identify schedule, resource, technical, testing, compliance, and manufacturing risks
* Maintain a centralized risk register with probability/impact assessment and mitigation tracking
* Drive owners toward resolution of blocking issues rather than simply reporting status
* Escalate unresolved risks and resource conflicts to leadership with clear impact, options, and recommended actions
* Coordinate commitments when multiple programs compete for shared Engineering or QA resources
* Ensure critical dependencies have clearly defined owners, dates, and closure criteria

**International Compliance & Certification Management**

* Coordinate compliance deliverables required for government product release
* Track regulatory and international compliance dependencies (FCC, CE, telecom certifications, government security requirements)
* Ensure compliance requirements and certifications do not block customer deployment
* Coordinate dependencies involving external certification bodies and ODM partners
* Track certification timelines and identify delays or blockers early
* Assess and communicate release impact of delayed certifications or compliance deliverables

**Program Tracking & Reporting**

* Maintain accurate program plans, milestones, dependencies, risks, and status using Jira and portfolio management tools
* Use Jira epics, features, defects, and dashboards to assess program health across all workstreams
* Develop concise program status reports for PMO and executive leadership
* Clearly communicate milestone health, risks, decisions required, and leadership attention areas
* Use AI tools to generate automated reports, trend analysis, and program health dashboards
* Leverage AI-driven monitoring tools to track program metrics and flag risks proactively
Manage program coordination and reporting across multiple time zones to support global teams and customers

The Technical Program Manager will join the Project Management Office and drive a complex, multi-year strategic government program involving hardware platform NPI, concurrent software releases, private cloud infrastructure deployment, and international compliance certification. The role requires strong technical program management skills, disciplined execution, executive stakeholder management, and the ability to coordinate across Hardware Engineering, Firmware Development, Networking Software (cloud management, security, controller platforms), QA, Product Management, Manufacturing, International Compliance, and government customer teams across multiple time zones.

title: Associate Project Manager
description:

Lyzr is an enterprise software company that helps large organisations put AI agents — software that handles real tasks on its own — to work in their everyday operations. Most companies’ AI projects never move past the pilot stage; Lyzr provides the platform that takes them into dependable, day-to-day use. Today, 500+ enterprises build on Lyzr, more than 1,000 agents run live in production, and 85% of Lyzr projects reach production against an industry average of roughly 30%. Customers include Accenture, WTW, Hitachi, and Verifone, and the company recently raised $100M at a $500M valuation.

###### **About the role**

As Associate Project Manager on Lyzr's Platform team, you will make sure platform work ships on time and everyone knows where it stands. You'll plan sprints, track delivery, clear blockers and keep engineering, Applied AI and leadership aligned.

This is a hands-on role for someone who likes structure, follows through and is comfortable in a fast-moving AI company.

###### **What you'll do**

* Plan and run sprints for the Platform team: backlog grooming, sprint planning, stand-ups, reviews and retrospectives
* Turn platform priorities into clear project plans with scope, milestones, owners and timelines

* Coordinate with the Applied AI team and client-facing project managers so platform work lines up with customer commitments
* Keep senior stakeholders updated on status, risks and decisions
* Document processes, release notes and decisions so the team works from one source of truth
* Use AI tools to automate status reporting and routine project tasks

###### **What we're looking for**

* 2–3 years of project management or delivery experience in a software, SaaS or AI company

* Working understanding of cloud platforms (GCP, Azure or AWS) and how platform and DevOps teams work
* Clear written and verbal communication, with experience managing several stakeholders
* Everyday fluency with AI tools such as Claude, Copilot or similar

title: Global Project Director
description:
At **ABB**, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

**This position reports to:**

Business Manager - Commercial

\_\_

Before a customer selects an automation partner, they need confidence in the people who will deliver. In this role, you will be the person who brings that confidence to life.

As ABB’s Project Director for mega projects and highly complex automation opportunities, you will engage customers from the earliest stages - often before a formal tender exists. Working alongside Sales, you will turn first-hand execution experience into a compelling delivery approach, helping customers understand how ABB will manage complexity, reduce risk and deliver on its commitments.

Your influence will span opportunity identification, pre-FEED and FEED, tendering, negotiation, award and handover - and, where assigned, project execution. The scope includes major automation and integration opportunities across DCS, SIS, PLC/SCADA, electrical systems, digital solutions and advanced process control.  
  
**Global Opportunity – Open to Candidates Worldwide***\**

While this job posting may display only a limited number of locations, we welcome applications from qualified candidates globally. If you believe your skills and experience match this role, we encourage you to apply regardless of your current location.

This position does **not require relocation**. The selected candidate will be employed and hosted through their current ABB location or the nearest suitable ABB office

**Your responsibilities**

* **Establish customer confidence early.** Engage owners, EPCs and licensors as ABB’s execution lead, building trusted relationships with project directors, engineering managers, procurement teams and executive stakeholders.
* **Make delivery experience a competitive advantage.** Present credible reference cases that explain project scope, outcomes, challenges, recovery actions and lessons learned.
* **Shape an execution strategy that works.** Develop contracting and delivery approaches covering MAC/MAV models, integration responsibilities, interfaces, standardization, testing, commissioning and the global/local engineering split.
* **Own the execution commitments in the proposal.** Define realistic execution plans, schedules, project organizations, resource requirements, risk registers, and HSE and quality plans, securing internal commitment before submission.
* **Bring execution judgment into commercial decisions.** Assess and quantify risks and opportunities, support cost estimates, contribute to bid/no-bid decisions, and defend the execution case at tender and risk reviews.
* **Support negotiations with delivery insight.** Help establish achievable schedules, clear scope boundaries, acceptance criteria, payment milestones, change mechanisms, warranties and appropriate risk positions.
* **Preserve continuity after award.** Ensure a structured handover of commitments, assumptions, risks and customer expectations. Where assigned, lead execution as Project Director or remain involved as executive sponsor through critical phases.
* **Strengthen ABB’s pursuit and delivery capability.** Collaborate across Sales, Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, Legal and Finance; coach teams; and feed execution outcomes into future estimates, reference cases and delivery practices.

**Your background**

* A degree in instrumentation, control, electrical, chemical engineering or an equivalent discipline; an executive or business master’s degree is an advantage.
* At least 12 years of industrial automation project delivery experience, including substantial responsibility as Project Manager or Project Director on large, complex projects in oil and gas, chemicals, refining or energy.
* Full-lifecycle leadership of at least one extra-large or highly complex automation project, together with direct experience recovering a challenged project.
* Demonstrated contribution to winning major pursuits, such as MAC selections, FEED-to-EPC conversions or frame agreements.
* Deep understanding of EPC delivery, contracting models, interface management and the dynamics between owners, EPCs and technology vendors.
* Working knowledge of DCS, SIS, PLC/SCADA, advanced process control and OT/IT convergence, enabling you to connect execution choices with customers’ operational outcomes.
* A recognized project management certification, such as PMP, IPMA Level A/B, or an equivalent ABB certification.
* Fluent English and willingness to travel extensively

**What will help you succeed**

You build trust through first-hand delivery experience, candid advice and confidence with customer executives and EPC leaders. You connect execution decisions with commercial value and unite Sales and delivery teams around realistic, shared commitments.

**The impact you will make**

Engage customers earlier, strengthen ABB’s execution credibility and help win strategic projects - supported by smooth handovers, protected margins and lessons that improve future pursuits.

* *This opportunity is open to candidates in multiple countries, with the final work location determined based on the selected candidate. As compensation may vary by location, we are committed to being transparent throughout the hiring process and will share details of the salary range, variable compensation and benefits package with candidates who progress to the first interview stage for a location in the European Union, covered by the EU Pay Transparency Directive.*

*The final offer will be tailored based on your role location, experience, skills and qualifications, internal market positioning and alignment with ABB internal standards.*

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit **https://www.abb.com** to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

title: R2R Transformation Projects Lead
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Sen. Account.&Report. Mgr-Gen.Accounting

**Your role and responsibilities:**  
  
Record to Report (R2R) team provides ABB significant value through collaborative, compliant, digitalized accounting & reporting process. We are the team that owns the R2R process operating model including the process & embedded internal controls. We improve R2R process maturity towards best in-class. Our ultimate mission is to allow *business to focus on what matters by providing standard, compliant, and user-friendly digitalized processes.*

As the R2R Transformation Projects Lead, you will play a pivotal role in ABB's ERP deployment program. You will be accountable for managing end-to-end R2R process design activities, identifying and tracking key project and process design decisions, and serving as critical link between the R2R process community, ERP project teams and key stakeholders.

You will report to Global Process Owner Record to Report and collaborate closely with Finance and Accounting Operations (FAO), Finance Process Data and Solutions, Information Systems (FPDS), peer process teams, business stakeholders and program PMO.

You have a solid background in Record to Report process design and ERP deployments, with direct experience in end-to-end process flow mapping, business process analysis and optimization. You have built a deep perspective on how to structure and manage complex ERP programs to deliver planned results.

Role is permanent due to the nature and planned length of the program.

Travel will be required as part of this role (~40%).

The work model for the role is: **Hybrid.**  
  
You will be mainly accountable for:

* **Plan:** Create a short and long-term plan to deliver process design, harmonization and go-live readiness.
* **ERP Deployment Project Leadership:** Manage end-to-end R2R process design and deployment activities within the ERP transformation program. Ensure designed process maps reflect ERP system capabilities and global R2R best practices.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Manage and engage key stakeholders to secure alignment on R2R process design decisions, escalations and change impact throughout the ERP deployment lifecycle.
* **Cross-Functional Team Leadership:** Lead and coordinate cross-functional teams across R2R workstreams, ensuring clear ownership, accountability and collaborative ways of working between process experts, system integrators and business representatives.
* **Business Process Analysis, Design and Optimization:** Support business process analysis and redesign sessions, identify process gaps versus ERP standard, and develop optimized solutions aligned to R2R best practices.

* 10+ years of Record-to-Report (R2R) experience, including process design, transformation, and ERP-led finance process optimization; Big 4 and BPO transformation experience preferred.
* Solid SAP Finance skills, with practical experience in SAP FI/CO, GL, AP, AR, Asset Accounting, and Controlling, including SAP S/4HANA.
* Experience leading ERP and R2R transformation programs, managing complex projects, and resolving process, data, and system design challenges in large-scale deployments.

title: Sr Project Lead
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  
Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
Job Description - Sr. Project Lead
  
**Job Title:** Sr. Project Lead
  
**Industry:** Industrial Construction / Project Management Consultancy (PMC)
  
Role Overview / Purpose
  
The Sr, Project Lead holds overall accountability for the successful delivery of large-scale industrial green-field projects. Operating within a Project Management Consultancy (PMC) environment, this role provides strategic leadership, technical oversight, and commercial governance across mega projects while managing multidisciplinary teams and coordinating with overseas design consultants.
  
Key Responsibilities
  
1. Project Leadership & Team Management
  
Lead and manage a project team of 20+ members across engineering, planning, execution, quality, and safety functions.
  
Define project governance structures, roles, and accountability frameworks.
  
Mentor and develop project leadership talent within the team.
  
Drive a high-performance culture focused on delivery excellence and client satisfaction.
  
2. Project Planning & Scheduling
  
Utilize Primavera (P6) and Microsoft Project (MSP) to develop, monitor, and control master project schedules.
  
Establish baseline schedules and track progress across design, procurement, and construction phases.
  
Identify critical path risks and implement proactive schedule recovery strategies.
  
Oversee integrated master planning across multiple concurrent green-field projects.
  
3. Green-Field Industrial Execution
  
Direct execution of green-field industrial projects, including, clean rooms, and pharmaceutical, manufacturing plants.
  
Ensure technical compliance with clean room classifications, contamination control protocols, and process-critical infrastructure requirements.
  
Oversee integration of civil, structural, MEP, and specialty process systems across large-footprint sites.
  
Manage phased handover and commissioning of process-critical facilities.
  
4. Commercial & Budget Management
  
Oversee project budgets, cost control, and financial performance for projects exceeding
  
Review and approve contractor claims, variations, and running account (RA) bills.
  
Monitor cost-to-completion forecasts and implement corrective measures for budget overruns.
  
Support commercial negotiations with contractors, vendors, and consultants.
  
5. Procurement & Contractor Management
  
Oversee procurement strategy and contractor selection for large-scale industrial packages.
  
Monitor contractor and subcontractor performance against contractual obligations.
  
Resolve contractual and commercial disputes in coordination with legal and commercial teams.
  
6. Stakeholder & Overseas Consultant Coordination
  
Manage coordination with overseas design and engineering consultants, ensuring alignment between international design standards and local execution practices.
  
Serve as the primary escalation point between client leadership, PMC teams, contractors, and consultants.
  
Facilitate high-level technical and commercial discussions to resolve project risks and interface issues.
  
Represent the organization in client steering committee meetings and project reviews.
  
7. Quality, Health, Safety & Environment (HSE) Leadership
  
Establish and enforce project-wide QA/QC standards suited to industrial, semiconductor, and pharma environments.
  
Champion a zero-incident safety culture across all project sites.
  
Ensure adherence to statutory, regulatory, and client-specific compliance requirements.
  
Lead root-cause analysis and corrective action planning for safety or quality incidents.
  
8. Risk & Issue Management
  
Identify, assess, and mitigate project risks across schedule, cost, quality, and safety dimensions.
  
Maintain risk registers and drive timely resolution of critical issues.
  
Escalate unresolved risks to senior leadership with recommended mitigation plans.
  
9. Reporting & Governance
  
Present project status, risks, and financial performance to senior leadership and client stakeholders.
  
Establish governance frameworks for progress reporting, change management, and risk mitigation.
  
Ensure accurate and timely documentation for approvals, audits, and project handover.
  
Technical Skills & Knowledge
  
Strong domain expertise in manufacturing, FMCG, & pharmaceutical facility construction.
  
Proficiency in Primavera (P6) and Microsoft Project (MSP) for large-scale project scheduling.
  
Sound understanding of industrial green-field project methodologies, sequencing, and delivery frameworks.
  
Working knowledge of applicable codes, standards, and regulatory requirements for industrial facilities.
  
Strong commercial acumen, including budgeting, cost control, and contract administration.
  
Behavioral Competencies / Soft Skills
  
Strong leadership and people management capability for teams of 20+ members.
  
Excellent stakeholder management and executive-level communication skills.
  
Strong decision-making ability under pressure and in complex, multi-stakeholder environments.
  
High degree of ownership, accountability, and results orientation.
  
Cross-cultural sensitivity for effective collaboration with overseas consultants and teams.
  
Education & Certifications
  
Bachelor’s degree in Civil/ Mechanical/ or related Engineering discipline (mandatory).
  
Experience Requirements
  
Minimum 15+ years of industrial green-field project experience in Industrial Construction / Semiconductor, Clean Room & Pharmaceutical
  
Proven experience managing 2 to 3 projects
  
Mandatory prior experience managing or coordinating with overseas consultants.
  
Location & Site-Based Expectations
  
Role requires regular presence at industrial green-field project site.
  
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  
Personalized benefits that support personal well-being and growth:
  
  
JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  
About JLL –
  
  
We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  
Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  
Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

title: SAP Product Manager – Foundational Product Services
description:
Ford is implementing a modernized ERP using SAP S/4HANA to improve productivity, reduce the size and complexity of its technical footprint, and standardize business processes. This role in the SAP Enterprise Platform Organization manages and promotes the Dynamo and IERP Foundational Products portfolio (RICEFW development and support) across the product lifecycle, from requirements analysis and concept through launch and post-launch management and leads the Enterprise DataHub Strategy and Implementation.
  
  

* Own the Dynamo and IERP Foundational Products portfolio across the full product lifecycle: market and requirements analysis, product concept, development, launch and ongoing post-launch management.
* Analyze business needs, internal and external client requirements, and industry and SAP strategy trends to define the product concept and identify opportunities for new and enhanced product services.
* Work with cross-functional and cross-organizational teams to identify, prioritize and design solutions for business requirements, balancing business value, scope, effort and risk.
* Partner with the development team to determine product functionality for RICEFW objects, including enhancements using BADIs, user exits, customer exits and the enhancement framework, forms, Fiori apps, workflow objects, and BTP integration and customization.
* Define and communicate the product vision and own the product roadmap and backlog, including PI (Program Increment) planning and iteration planning, in line with release plans and program objectives.
* Track and manage reusability and fit-gap analysis to limit customization and meet program objectives, enabling a seamless migration and/or upgrade experience.
* Develop the strategy and lead the implementation of the Enterprise DataHub for the Corporate Backbone SAP environment and provide ongoing support.
* Work with sales, marketing and business stakeholders to define product positioning, value proposition and pricing, and drive product launches and releases through client adoption.
* Conduct internal and external training on the product to enable users, clients and support teams.
* Deliver product presentations and webcasts to clients and stakeholders on specialized topics and build strong client relationships through effective expectation setting and communication.
* Manage the product after launch with a focus on service quality, service availability and operational capability, using client feedback and periodic reviews of trends and metrics to meet committed SLAs and drive ongoing improvements and product enhancements.
* Lead creation of production support documentation and maintenance of operational metrics.
* Drive all phases of product delivery for the objects within your portfolio, from planning to post go-live, ensuring the desired scope, time and quality, and collaborate with other delivery managers and functional product teams to plan scope, schedule and risk and to synchronize effort across the program.
* Participate in the preparation of proposals and statements of work and develop project estimates to plan demand versus capacity periodically, achieving program objectives and ongoing support goals.
* Manage third-party vendors/SI partners to ensure the right resourcing level and expertise to deliver on requirements and perform as outlined in the SOW, with a strong understanding of how the work supports business processes and objectives.
* Participate in all product group SOS meetings and represent your portfolio in L3 and L2 governance, providing status updates, highlighting risks, blockers and impediments, and escalating issues early to seek support as needed.
* Monitor portfolio performance, analyze risks, establish contingency plans with triggering events and responsibilities for mitigation, and influence schedule changes, scope adjustments, prioritization and resource loading.
* Ensure teams follow all agile ceremonies, including retrospectives, across your portfolio for the desired outcome.
* Support CoEs for SAP SDLC and AI Innovation and liaise with platform and solution architecture teams to ensure industry benchmarks, best practices and standards are followed.
* Support processes and initiatives to enhance data security, privacy and integrity within the SAP environment, in collaboration with cybersecurity and compliance teams.
* Help the portfolio and program meet financial targets with timely inputs and effective resource planning.
* Coordinate with the leadership team and other IT resources to solve complex problems, develop innovative solutions and remove barriers, while managing a high degree of change in a fast-paced, complex and demanding environment.
* Actively participate in the development of project management best practices and ensure adherence to established project methodologies, standards, tools, policies and procedures, company project management standards and SDLC processes.
* Lead and manage a team of highly skilled developers, anchors and product managers, providing various types of product services across multiple projects and programs, and motivating the team toward a clear product vision to build a high-performing environment.
* Conduct regular 1:1s, check-ins and partnership conversations, complete periodic performance reviews, and support the career development of all direct reports.
* Support hiring, talent attraction and retention activities, and Ford India-related workstreams as representative/SPOC for the department.

**Required**

* 12 to 15 years of overall IT experience and a minimum of 5 years of relevant project/service delivery experience, specifically in managing SAP S/4HANA implementation projects.
* Proven product management experience across the full product lifecycle, including market and requirements analysis, defining the product concept, roadmap and backlog ownership, product launch, and ongoing post-launch management of the product.
* At least one full-cycle SAP S/4HANA implementation, preferably in the FICO and SD modules.
* Hands-on leadership experience in coordinating, planning, organizing, and executing programs, projects, and day-to-day operational responsibilities in delivery of SAP ABAP services with good exposure to programming in latest ABAP syntax, RICEFW development, CDS Views, AMDP, DDIC and UI5/Fiori.
* Strong experience in the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) and software development methodologies (e.g., Agile, Scrum, Iterative, Waterfall), including knowledge and experience with Agile and Lean process methodology.
* Experience in people management, including leading with and without direct reporting authority.
* Strong ability to understand business needs and manage services in a dynamic environment.
* Ability to work with cross-functional and cross-organizational teams to identify, prioritize and design solutions for business requirements, and with development teams to determine product functionality.
* Knowledge and experience with SLAs, OLAs and contracts in insourced and outsourced environments.
* Good understanding of SAP ERP and functional and/or technical SAP application knowledge, with strong technical and business acumen.
* Experience in Data Analytics and Reporting.
* Knowledge of industry trends, their impact on business strategies, and SAP’s strategy and service portfolio.
* In-depth knowledge of the domain and vertical, including the business processes the product supports.
* Experience working with sales and marketing teams to define product positioning and pricing and to drive product launches.
* Experience conducting internal and external trainings and delivering product presentations and webcasts to clients on specialized topics.
* Strong project and program management skills, including planning, risk management, governance and delivery across multiple concurrent initiatives.
* Excellent communication and client management skills, with the ability to influence and build relationships with clients, business partners and senior leaders.
* Experience in managing diversified teams working across the globe with an onsite and offshore model.

**Preferred**

* Exposure to RAP, SAP RISE, Datasphere, SAC, GCP BigQuery and the BTP integration platform.
* Certification in SAP S/4HANA.

title: Regional Product Manager – Taneira
description:
**Role Overview:**

Given the extensive difference in, customer preferences, fabrics, motifs, colors, and price points in Tamil Nadu as compared to rest of the country there’s a need for having a product manager in Chennai, which can address the requirements of consumers and stores.  The Regional Product Manager will act as the bridge between corporate office and stores of Tamil Nadu

The Regional Merchandiser will lead the curation and optimization of Indian Ethnic Wear assortments across South India, focusing on regional tastes, cultural nuances, and competitive dynamics. The role demands a sharp understanding of local fashion preferences, traditional nuances, price sensitivities, and cluster-wise demand to ensure the right product mix across stores. Collaboration with planning, design and retail teams is key to translating regional insights into effective merchandising strategies.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Business & Category Ownership**

·      Drive seasonal and monthly business plans of the stores and region aligned to overall annual targets

·      Identify growth opportunities across price points and Sub-occasions for each catchment in comparison to its competitors

**Regional Assortment Planning**

**Range building:**

* Build assortments based on catchment requirements.
* Analyze local cultural nuances, regional festivals, bridal season peaks, and micro-market preferences to curate precise product mixes per store.

·      Build data-led assortment plans based on historical performance and inclusive of traditional nuances, forecasted trends, and competition benchmarking

·      Assortment to balance core vs trend and volume drivers vs newness

**Cluster-Based Merchandising**

* Develop cluster-level merchandising strategies based on store performance, local demographics, and consumer behaviour.
* Recommend suggestive mix of SKUs across price bands to cater to varied customer segments (value, mid-premium, premium).

**Design, Sourcing & Vendor Coordination**

·      Collaborate with design team for stock pick-ups

·      Collaborate with sourcing teams to negotiate costs to meet competitive pricing and margin targets

·      Track production status and resolve delays or quality issues proactively

**Inventory & Store Execution**

* Drive store-level inventory optimisation by setting optimal base-stock norms aligned to sales potential, ensuring availability, improving stock turns and delivering sales targets

·      Closely monitor store-level sell-through rates, inventory turnover, and conversion metrics. Identify fast-moving regional trends and sluggish inventory early and enforcing prompt replenishment.

* Monitor store-level product movement and recommend timely replenishments or markdowns based on regional performance.

·      
Community understandings in the catchment and coordinating with all stakeholders from design to ensure in-store availability, with the right assortment, quantities and price points ahead of the season.

**Competitor and Consumer Study**

* Conduct ongoing competitive benchmarking across catchments to identify assortment opportunities and pricing strategies.
* Track ongoing fashion trends for each catchment

·      Prepare the regional festive calendar and plan curated collection drops aligned with it. Work backwards from in-store launch dates, coordinating all stakeholders from design to delivery to ensure products reach stores on time, in the planned quantities and price points.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with design,sourcing, VM, and marketing teams to ensure regional relevance in product launches and campaigns.
* Support retail teams with product knowledge to enhance customer engagement.
* Collaborate with the Visual Merchandising and Retail Operations teams to ensure regional windows and in-store displays highlight the right high-intent regional categories.

title: Go-to-Market Global Operations, Sales Tools & Technologies Product Owner
description:
**Our Company:**
At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.
  
  

* Who You’ll Work With

On our team, we build and run the systems that help Teradata’s sellers, marketers, services teams, and partners win and serve customers. Salesforce is the system of record for our go-to-market engine, spanning accounts, opportunities, pipeline, forecasting, quoting, and customer engagement. You will own that platform as a product.
  
  
You will partner closely with Sales, Sales Operations and Revenue Operations, Marketing, Customer Success, Global Services, Finance, Legal and Privacy, and Technology Services platform administrators and developers. You will also work alongside other product owners on the Business Technology team to keep Salesforce integrated with the broader systems landscape, including Workday, CPQ, ERP/Finance, marketing automation, and learning systems. This position reports to the Senior Manager, Business Technology.
  
  

* What You’ll Do

As the Salesforce Product Owner, you will translate business and user needs into clear, prioritized requirements, guide delivery in an agile model, and measure whether the platform is improving how Teradata sells and serves. Success means a Salesforce environment that is reliable, easy to use, well governed, and visibly tied to revenue and productivity outcomes.
  
  
Key responsibilities:
  
  

* Support the execution of the Salesforce product roadmap and backlog, prioritizing features, enhancements, and fixes based on business value, user impact, and risk.
* Write clear user stories and acceptance criteria; lead backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews, and daily scrums with platform admins, developers, and implementation partners.
* Own requirements across Salesforce clouds and capabilities in use (such as Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, CPQ, reporting and forecasting, and Agentforce/AI features), including release readiness and user acceptance testing.
* Own requirements for integrations with adjacent systems, including SSO (Microsoft Entra ID), Workday, CPQ, ERP/Finance, Microsoft 365 and Teams, marketing automation, and data platforms; coordinate design, testing, and release.
* Partner with Sales and Revenue Operations to streamline lead-to-cash and opportunity-to-quote processes, reducing manual effort and improving data quality and forecast accuracy.
* Define and maintain data standards, object and field governance, and metadata ownership; oversee data quality, deduplication, and hygiene for accounts, contacts, and opportunities.
* Drive adoption and governance of AI-enabled capabilities, including usage controls, cost tracking, and responsible-use guardrails.
* Build and track platform KPIs (user adoption, data quality, process cycle time, release quality, user satisfaction) and deliver reporting and dashboards to stakeholders and leadership.
* Run intake and triage for enhancement requests and incidents, manage the Salesforce vendor and implementation partner relationships, and publish release notes.
* Manage the Salesforce seasonal release cycle, evaluating new functionality and sequencing change to minimize disruption and maximize adoption.
* Partner with Legal, Privacy, Security, and Compliance to keep the platform aligned with data protection requirements, access controls, and regional obligations.
* Create admin and end-user enablement, and support change management and communications for platform updates.

title: Product Marketing Manager
description:
**About Plane**
===============

Plane's mission is to build the infrastructure the world's work runs on. Every organization runs on three things: the projects it's driving, the knowledge it keeps, and the requests it fields. Plane brings all three into one open, adaptable platform: simple enough for any team to adopt, dependable enough for organizations to build on. And we are building it for a future where humans and AI agents do that work together.

Plane began in public on GitHub at the end of 2022. Since then it has grown into a work management platform used by teams around the world: 63,000+ stars, 6,500+ forks, and a contributor community that reads our code and files our issues. Organizations run Plane as a managed Cloud service, on their own infrastructure, or inside fully isolated environments. Building in the open keeps us close to users and raises the standard for everything we ship.

Plane is the #1 work infrastructure in aerospace, defense, financial services, and other regulated industries: organizations whose requirements for control, auditability, and data residency rule most software out. When the strictest buyers pick a system of record, that choice means something. Adoption is growing fastest on Plane Cloud and in sovereign clouds, deployments that keep everything inside a country's own borders and rules.

Plane is backed by top investors and built across San Francisco, London, and Hyderabad. We work in tightly knit teams, stay close to users, and care about the visible product as much as the unglamorous details that make software dependable. People own problems end to end, and we add process only when it helps the work.

**Humans and agents**
---------------------

We believe the next decade of work will be done by humans and AI agents together. Not agents replacing people, and not a chat window bolted onto software built for humans clicking around, but both working in one system of action, where an agent's work is as visible and as accountable as a person's.

Most software treats AI as a feature. We treat agents as a kind of worker, and that changes what the system underneath has to be. Agents are only as good as the context they can see and the state they are allowed to change, so shared context, explicit state, durable history, and accountable action are not items on our roadmap. They are the product. Plane is built so that when an agent acts, the humans responsible can see what happened, why, and on whose authority, and the record survives.

This is what the infrastructure is for: making the future where humans and agents work together useful, legible, and fully within the organization's control. Every role at Plane is some part of building that.

**About the role**
------------------

Plane ships one product to three very different buyers: a team that signs up on Cloud in a minute, an organization that runs it on its own infrastructure, and one that runs it on machines with no internet connection. The same release has to be explained to all three, and the differences between what each one gets are real. You own the messaging system underneath that: what we claim for Projects, Wiki, Intake, and Plane AI, the proof behind each claim, and how a launch reaches the site, the docs, Sales, and the community as one story rather than three. You will work with product managers on what shipped, with Sales on the objections that decide enterprise deals, and with the community, who file an issue when a marketing page overstates the product.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Own positioning for Projects, Wiki, Intake, and Plane AI, and the source of truth for every claim and the proof behind it. When someone asks whether we can say something, you decide.
* Own how capability maps to edition and tier. Cloud, self-hosted commercial, and air-gapped customers get different things, and the page has to say which.
* Lead launches end to end: narrative, plan, page, announcement, email, in-product copy, and enablement, closed out with a review that names what moved and changes the next launch.
* Own the product, solution, industry, and comparison pages. These get read mid-evaluation against Jira, Asana, Monday.com, and ClickUp by people who use the competitor daily.
* Run the research the positioning rests on: customer and prospect interviews, lost-deal reasons, community threads, and competitive moves, turned into language we can publish.
* Work weekly with product managers, design, Sales, and the community team, and take contested claims to the engineer who built the feature before they ship.
* Maintain the library that goes stale on its own: battlecards, edition explainers, demo scripts, and FAQs. Check claims against the docs one page at a time before every launch, because an overstated claim returns as a support ticket or a lost deal.

**What you'll bring**
---------------------

* **You have owned positioning that changed results.** You can name the product, the claim you changed, and what moved after: adoption, conversion, or win rate.
* **You ship the copy, not only the brief.** Web-ready pages and launch assets that went live under your name.
* **You have run launches across functions.** You have held a date with product, design, Sales, and support attached to it, and you can describe one that went badly and what you changed.
* **You can hold your own with technical audiences and enterprise buyers.** You have written for developers and IT without distorting the product, and sat in evaluations where security and deployment decided the outcome.
* **You work from evidence.** Customer interviews, sales calls, and product data, used to settle positioning arguments.

**Nice to haves**
-----------------

* You have marketed an open-source or open-core product, where the community reads the code and corrects the page.
* You have shipped multi-edition software where capability differs by deployment.
* You have written security, compliance, and deployment narratives: SSO, audit logs, data residency, air-gapped installs.
* You have positioned a product where AI agents act on customer data, and you have opinions about what can honestly be claimed for them.

**Why Plane?**
--------------

Every company says it is different. We will try evidence instead.

**The scope is real.** We are a passion team serving companies of every size, including some of the largest in the world. Something you ship this month will run inside a Fortune 500 company and a 50-person startup in the same week, and you will hear from both.

**The constraints make you better.** Plane runs in our cloud, in customers' clouds, and on machines that will never touch the internet. Much of the work happens in the open, where the issues, the fixes, and the roadmap conversations are public. Building software that survives all of that is harder than building an ordinary SaaS product, and it is a better education than most companies can offer.

**The people-and-agents future is being built here, in production.** We think humans and AI agents will share one system of action for work. We are building that system now, for customers who already depend on it, and you will work on that problem directly whatever your role.

**Your name is on the work.** The teams are deeply connected enough that credit and responsibility both find you fast. That is some pressure. Mostly it is the fun part.

If that sounds like your kind of place, we would like to meet you.

*Plane is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.*

# Job Description: Production Manager – Jewellery Industry

\*\*Position:\*\* Production Manager

\*\*Industry:\*\* Jewellery Manufacturing

\*\*Experience:\*\* 6–7 Years

\*\*Salary:\*\* ₹50,000–₹1,00,000 per month

\*\*Job Location:\*\* Andheri East, Mumbai – 400096

\*\*Employment Type:\*\* Full-Time

\*\*Office Timings\*\*. - 9 AM to 6:15 PM

### Job Overview

We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Production Manager with 6–7 years of experience in the jewellery manufacturing industry. The candidate will be responsible for managing the overall jewellery production process, supervising production teams, ensuring product quality, monitoring production timelines, and maintaining operational efficiency.

The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of jewellery manufacturing processes, workforce management, production planning, quality control, and inventory coordination.

### Key Responsibilities

- Manage and supervise daily jewellery manufacturing and production activities.

- Plan, organize, and monitor production schedules to ensure timely completion of orders.

- Coordinate with design, CAD, manufacturing, finishing, and quality control teams.

- Monitor the entire production process, from raw materials to finished jewellery products.

- Ensure jewellery products meet the required quality standards and specifications.

- Supervise production staff, assign responsibilities, and monitor team performance.

- Identify production delays, technical issues, and operational challenges and take corrective action.

- Maintain production records, reports, and daily work progress.

- Monitor raw material usage, wastage, and inventory levels.

- Ensure efficient utilization of manpower, machinery, tools, and other resources.

- Coordinate with vendors and suppliers whenever required.

- Implement measures to improve production efficiency, reduce wastage, and control manufacturing costs.

- Ensure compliance with workplace safety standards and company policies.

- Handle customer-specific production requirements and ensure orders are completed within deadlines.

### Required Skills & Qualifications

- 6–7 years of experience in jewellery manufacturing or production management.

- Strong knowledge of jewellery manufacturing processes and techniques.

- Experience in handling and managing production teams.

- Good understanding of gold, diamond, gemstone, and other jewellery manufacturing processes.

- Knowledge of production planning, scheduling, and workflow management.

- Strong understanding of quality control and jewellery finishing standards.

- Ability to manage production targets and meet delivery deadlines.

- Knowledge of inventory management and material utilization.

- Good leadership, team management, and problem-solving skills.

- Strong coordination and communication abilities.

- Basic computer knowledge and experience in maintaining production reports.

- Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple production activities.

### Salary & Benefits

- \*\*Salary:\*\* ₹50,000–₹1,00,000 per month, depending on experience, skills, and industry knowledge.

- Other benefits as per company policy.

### Candidate Requirements

- Candidates must have relevant experience in the jewellery manufacturing industry.

- Experience in handling jewellery production teams and managing end-to-end production activities is preferred.

- Candidates should have strong knowledge of production planning, quality control, and manufacturing operations.

- Ability to manage production targets and ensure timely delivery of orders.

### How to Apply

Interested candidates with relevant experience in jewellery production management are encouraged to apply with their updated resume. Candidates with strong leadership skills and hands-on experience in jewellery manufacturing will be preferred.

Pay: ₹50,000.00 - ₹100,000.00 per month

**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Product Manager – Digital Payments & Financial Services**

**Company: AvenuesAI Limited**

**Location:** Mumbai, Maharashtra

**Department:** Product Management

**Experience:** 8–12 years

**Employment Type:** Full-time

**Reporting To:** Head of Product / Business Head / Senior Management

**Role Overview**

**AvenuesAI Limited** is looking for an experienced and result-oriented Product Manager to manage and drive the development, enhancement and performance of its digital payment products and financial technology solutions.

The ideal candidate should have strong experience in payment processing, digital payment ecosystems, prepaid payment instruments (PPI), banking and financial integrations, regulatory compliance and product operations.

The candidate will be responsible for managing the product lifecycle, identifying business opportunities, coordinating with technology and business teams, implementing product enhancements and ensuring seamless product delivery in line with business objectives, regulatory requirements and customer expectations.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Product Strategy & Lifecycle Management**

* + Define and execute product strategies aligned with the company's business goals.
  + Manage the complete product lifecycle, from conceptualisation and requirement gathering to development, launch and post-launch performance monitoring.
  + Identify opportunities for new product development, enhancements and business expansion.
  + Prepare product roadmaps, business requirement documents (BRDs), product requirement documents (PRDs) and functional specifications.
  + Monitor product performance and recommend improvements based on business and customer feedback.

**2. Digital Payments & Financial Integrations**

* + Manage and drive payment products and integrations across BBPS, PPI and other applicable payment channels.
  + Coordinate with banks, NPCI, payment aggregators, technology partners and other financial institutions for product integrations.
  + Oversee payment workflows, transaction processing, settlement, reconciliation and exception management.
  + Ensure smooth implementation, testing and deployment of new payment features and integrations.
  + Identify and resolve product-related operational challenges affecting transaction success rates and customer experience.

**3. Product Development & Technology Coordination**

* + Work closely with technology, engineering, QA and operations teams to translate business requirements into product specifications.
  + Define product priorities, development milestones and implementation timelines.
  + Coordinate UAT, functional testing, integration testing and product acceptance.
  + Track product development progress and ensure timely delivery.
  + Identify system gaps, process bottlenecks and opportunities for automation.

**4. Regulatory Compliance & Risk Management**

* + Ensure product processes and functionalities are aligned with applicable RBI guidelines, NPCI regulations and other relevant regulatory requirements.
  + Work closely with compliance, risk and legal teams to implement regulatory changes.
  + Monitor transaction risks, fraud indicators, operational exceptions and control mechanisms.
  + Support internal, external and regulatory audits by maintaining appropriate product documentation and operational records.
  + Ensure appropriate controls are incorporated into product design and delivery.

**5. Business & Operational Performance**

* + Define and monitor product KPIs, including transaction success rates, transaction volumes, revenue, active users, turnaround time and customer complaints.
  + Analyse product performance and identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency and profitability.
  + Drive initiatives to improve customer and merchant experience.
  + Work with sales and business development teams to support product adoption, partner onboarding and revenue growth.
  + Develop and implement standard operating procedures (SOPs) for product-related processes.

**6. Stakeholder & Team Management**

* + Act as the primary coordination point between business, technology, operations, compliance and external partners.
  + Manage relationships with banks, payment networks, vendors and technology service providers.
  + Lead product review meetings and provide regular updates to senior management.
  + Guide and mentor team members involved in product operations and implementation.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* + Graduate degree in Business Administration, Finance, Commerce, Technology or a related discipline.
  + 8–12 years of experience in fintech, digital payments, banking, financial services or payment operations.
  + Strong understanding of digital payment systems, payment processing and settlement mechanisms.
  + Practical experience in UPI, IMPS, PPI and other payment integrations.
  + Experience in product onboarding, implementation, product enhancement and operational management.
  + Good understanding of RBI guidelines, NPCI processes, compliance requirements and risk management.
  + Proven experience working with technology, operations, business and compliance teams.

**Required Skills**

* + Product lifecycle and roadmap management
  + Digital payment ecosystem knowledge
  + Payment processing and reconciliation
  + UPI, IMPS, PPI and banking integrations
  + BRD, PRD and functional requirement documentation
  + UAT and product implementation
  + RBI and NPCI regulatory understanding
  + Risk management and fraud monitoring
  + Data analysis and KPI monitoring
  + Stakeholder and vendor management
  + Team leadership and problem-solving
  + Strong communication and decision-making skills

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

Performance will be evaluated on the basis of:

* + Successful and timely delivery of product launches and enhancements.
  + Improvement in transaction success rates and payment processing efficiency.
  + Reduction in transaction failures, reconciliation issues and operational exceptions.
  + Timely completion of banking, NPCI and third-party integrations.
  + Compliance with applicable regulatory and internal control requirements.
  + Improvement in product adoption, customer experience and business performance.
  + Effective coordination with internal teams and external stakeholders.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

The preferred candidate should be a hands-on fintech professional with a strong understanding of the Indian digital payments ecosystem. The candidate should be capable of bridging the gap between business requirements and technology execution, while ensuring operational efficiency, regulatory compliance and sustainable product growth.

Experience in PPI services, UPI/IMPS integrations, payment settlements, banking partnerships and payment product implementation will be an added advantage.

**Job Description**
APAC Digital Customer Platforms Lead
  
  
DePuy Synthes is recruiting for a Digital Customer Platforms Lead.
  
  
Johnson & Johnson announced plans to separate our Orthopaedics business to establish a standalone orthopaedics company, operating as DePuy Synthes. The process of the planned separation is anticipated to be completed within 18 to 24 months, subject to legal requirements, including consultation with works councils and other employee representative bodies, as may be required, regulatory approvals and other customary conditions and approvals. Should you accept this position, it is anticipated that, following conclusion of the transaction, you would be an employee of DePuy Synthes and your employment would be governed by DePuy Synthes employment processes, programmes, policies, and benefit plans. In that case, details of any planned changes would be provided to you by DePuy Synthes at an appropriate time and subject to any necessary consultation processes.
  
  
**Job Overview**
The Digital Customer Platforms Lead is responsible for the business ownership, coordination and continuous improvement of the digital platforms and satellite systems that support Customer Service across the Asia Pacific (APAC) region. Acting as the functional SME lead for APAC, this role owns the business process and user experience view of the end-to-end digital customer journey across diverse markets, customer segments, languages and levels of digital maturity. The role ensures platforms such as EDI, DSOS, SFDC, Genesys, OCR and related customer interaction channels are understood, governed, prioritised and improved in line with APAC market needs. Working closely with APAC Customer Service, Commercial, Supply Chain, Finance, Technology, the RPA/AI Lead and external customers, the role translates regional and market requirements into practical platform enhancements that improve ease of doing business, service efficiency, data quality, self-service adoption, assisted service effectiveness and customer experience.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Act as the functional SME lead for Customer Service digital platforms, self-service channels, assisted service tools and customer interaction channels across APAC.
* Provide business ownership and day-to-day coordination across EDI, customer portals, DSOS, SFDC, Genesys, OCR and related satellite systems supporting APAC digital ordering, self-service and assisted service.
* Maintain a clear view of platform performance, customer and user pain points, adoption trends, issue themes and enhancement priorities across APAC markets, recognising differences in market maturity, language, regulation and customer operating models.
* Engage APAC market and regional stakeholders to capture local requirements and translate them into clear business needs, user stories, process requirements and enhancement requests for Technology and delivery partners.
* Support regional governance, prioritisation and tracking of platform enhancements, balancing common APAC capabilities with justified local market requirements.
* Track and communicate the impact of improvements by market and across the region, including adoption, channel shift, service efficiency, issue reduction, data quality and customer experience outcomes.
* Partner with APAC Customer Service, Commercial, Supply Chain, Finance, Technology and external customers to resolve platform issues and improve digital ordering, self-service adoption and assisted service experiences.
* Work closely with the RPA/AI Lead to identify APAC platform processes, data flows and user journeys that could be improved through automation or AI-enabled solutions.
* Develop and maintain regionally consistent platform documentation, process flows, training materials and user guidance, with appropriate localisation to support adoption across APAC markets.
* Facilitate knowledge sharing and adoption of leading practices across APAC, enabling markets to reuse solutions and avoid unnecessary duplication.
* Provide insight, recommendations and escalation support to APAC Customer Service leadership on digital platform risks, opportunities, dependencies and investment priorities.

* Required: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Operations, Analytics, or a related field.
* Preferred: Master’s degree (MBA or equivalent).

Experience and Skills
  
  
**Required**

* 4+ years of progressive experience in digital customer platforms, customer operations, customer service systems, analytics or related business functions, with demonstrable experience as a platform, process or customer operations SME.
* Hands-on experience supporting, improving or acting as business owner for customer-facing platforms, digital ordering channels, CRM tools or operational systems across multiple APAC markets or a similarly diverse region.
* Demonstrated ability to lead through expertise, influence and cross-functional collaboration across countries, cultures and time zones without direct senior manager accountability.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to use market data, user feedback and process insight to prioritise practical regional and local platform improvements.

**Preferred**

* Familiarity with CRM, ERP, contact centre, workflow, analytics or customer interaction platforms.
* Experience in a regulated industry such as medical devices, healthcare or life sciences, including awareness of differing APAC market and regulatory requirements.

* Experience localising processes, training or platform solutions for different languages, customer models and market requirements.
* Knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma or continuous improvement methodologies.
* Demonstrated ability to coordinate complex, cross-functional platform or process improvements in a regional, matrixed environment.

* Ability to translate local customer pain points and business requirements into scalable regional platform improvements.
