title: Product Manager
description:
**Mott MacDonald**
is a global engineering, management, and development consultancy committed to delivering impactful work that shapes the future.
  
  
We are a team of over 20,000 experts working across the world in more than 50 countries.
  
  
We are proud to be part of an ever-changing global industry, delivering transformative work that’s defining our future. It’s our people who power that performance. As an employee-owned business, we invest in creating a space for everyone to feel safe and valued and empowered with the right tools and support.
  
  
Whether you want to pursue excellence in your specialism or broaden your experience with flexible roles across our business, you’ll be connected to a community of global experts championing you to be your best. Join us and shape your story with Mott MacDonald, where everyone has the opportunity to be
**brilliant**
.
  
  
**Job profile-**
We are looking for an experienced
**Product Manager**
to shape the next generation of our time-series data capability.
  
  
Across major infrastructure projects, large volumes of sensor, monitoring and operational data are generated over time. Our Timeseries product enables project teams to bring this information together, connect it with other project data, understand trends and changes, and build data-driven applications and services around it.
  
  
You will join our digital product and engineering organisation in India and work with colleagues and project teams around the world.
  
  
**Role Description**
This is an opportunity to take ownership of a product at an important point in its evolution. We have an established legacy platform supporting real projects and customer use cases, alongside a new cloud-based Timeseries product that we are developing for the future.
  
  
Your role will be to understand how our customers and project teams use time-series data today, identify their most important needs, and translate those into a clear product strategy and roadmap for the new platform. Your job will not be to recreate the legacy system feature for feature. You will work with customers, project teams, engineers, architects and other Product Managers to determine:
  

* what should become part of the core Timeseries product;
* what should be redesigned or simplified;
* what should be enabled through APIs, events and integrations;
* how existing projects can safely transition to the new platform;
* and which legacy capabilities can ultimately be retired.

You will be comfortable working in a technically complex environment while keeping the product focused on user needs, reusable capabilities and measurable outcomes.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities -**

* Own the vision, strategy and roadmap for our Timeseries product.
* Understand how customers and project teams use time-series, sensor and operational data, and identify the problems that are most valuable for us to solve.
* Lead product discovery with users, project teams, engineers and subject-matter experts, translating their needs into clear product outcomes and priorities.
* Define MVPs and make deliberate decisions about what belongs in the core product and what does not.
* Work closely with the engineering team to maintain a clear, prioritised and delivery-ready product backlog, ensuring upcoming work is understood and aligned to product outcomes.
* Play an active role in the team's agile delivery rhythm, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews and retrospectives, maintaining clarity on priorities, outcomes and learning.
* Shape the product capabilities for ingesting, managing, finding, visualising and responding to time-series data, including ingestion, search and alarming.
* Define how Timeseries works with APIs, events and other applications so that specialist project needs don't create unnecessary complexity within the core product.
* Lead the product strategy for transitioning existing projects from our legacy platform, identifying what should be replaced, redesigned, supported differently or retired, and developing a repeatable migration approach.
* Improve onboarding and self-service so project teams can adopt and configure Timeseries without relying on specialist platform knowledge.
* Work closely with engineering, architecture, design and other product teams to turn product direction into delivered customer outcomes.
* Define meaningful measures of product adoption, customer value and migration progress.
* Communicate product direction, priorities, decisions and progress clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Candidate Specification**
We are looking for an experienced Product Manager who enjoys solving complex product problems and is comfortable working with technical products.
  
  
You may currently be working with a data platform, IoT product, analytics platform, developer platform, enterprise SaaS product or another technically complex B2B product.
  
  
You do not need to be a software engineer or database specialist. However, you should be technically curious and able to work confidently with engineers and architects, understand the implications of different approaches, and turn technical complexity into clear product decisions.
  
  
Most importantly, you will bring strong product judgement. You will be comfortable deciding not only what we should build, but also what we should not build.
  
  
Your experience is likely to include several of the following:
  

* Product strategy, discovery and roadmap ownership.
* B2B, enterprise, platform or data product management.
* Understanding customer and user problems through research and discovery.
* Translating complex needs into product outcomes rather than simply collecting feature requests.
* Defining MVPs and making evidence-based prioritisation and scope decisions.
* Working closely with engineering, architecture and design teams.
* APIs, integrations, data pipelines or other technically complex product capabilities.
* Cloud-based software products.
* Managing products with multiple customer or project use cases.
* Communicating complex product decisions clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

Experience leading or contributing to a legacy platform replacement, customer migration, data-platform migration or major product transformation would be particularly valuable.
  
  
**Qualifications Preferred -**
Experience in some of the following areas would be beneficial, but is not essential:
  

* time-series databases or time-series data products;
* IoT, sensors, telemetry or operational data;
* Microsoft Azure or other major cloud platforms;
* APIs and SDKs;
* event-driven systems;
* data ingestion and data pipelines;
* data visualisation and analytics;
* alerting or alarming products;
* geospatial or GIS products;
* multi-tenant SaaS or platform products.

We are more interested in finding an excellent Product Manager who is comfortable working with technical products, than somebody who already knows our particular technology stack.
  
  
**Further details-**
This role offers the opportunity to shape a product while it is being transformed rather than inheriting one where all the major product decisions have already been made.
  
  
You will help us take the best of an established capability, simplify areas that have become complex over time, and establish a modern Timeseries product that can support projects at scale.
  
  
You'll have the opportunity to work with real infrastructure use cases and diverse project teams, and to influence how sensor and operational data are used across our digital products in the future.
  
  
The successful candidate will ultimately help us answer three important questions:
  

* What should our Timeseries product become?
* How do we make it simple and valuable for projects to adopt?
* How do we successfully move from the platform we have today to the product we want for the future?

**Flexible working**
At Mott MacDonald, we support our staff to create work-life balance which works for them and welcome candidates looking for career flexibility. We are open to discussing flexible working at interview stage.
  
  
**Our benefits package is designed to enhance your experience:**

* Agile working
* Critical illness and compassionate leave
* Paternity Leave
* Group term life insurance, and Group medical insurance coverage
* Career mobility options
* Short and Long-term global employment opportunities
* Global collaboration and knowledge sharing

**Employment Compliance Requirement**
As part of our global compliance requirements, all candidates must hold a valid Right to Work (RTW) document in India, which will be verified during the recruitment process.
  
  
**Acceptable documents include a Passport, Voter ID, or Birth Certificate.**
By applying, you
**confirm**
that you can provide valid documentation if and when required.

title: Assistant Product Manager
description:
**About IndiaMART**

IndiaMART is India's largest online B2B (business-to-business) marketplace. Founded in 1996 by Dinesh Agarwal and Brijesh Agrawal, it connects over 230 million buyers with more than 8.7 million suppliers, offering over 129 million products and services. The company is headquartered in Noida, UP. We are the market leader in B2B e-commerce with a 60% market share.

**Why this role is different**

Most companies talk about AI. At IndiaMART, freshers actually ship it. If you join as an AI APM, you get access to frontier models, internal data, and — most importantly — permission to put your AI work into production. Not a sandbox. Not a demo deck that dies in a review meeting. Real features used by lakhs of buyers and suppliers.

We are looking for people who already play with AI on their own, without being told to. If you have built agents, automated your own boring work, or lost a weekend to a new model release, you will feel at home here.

**Key Responsibilities**

You will work with the development team to make sure requirements are clear and rational, make trade-offs where needed, and deliver a finished product that meets its goals — on schedule.

Core product work-

● Define and scope projects. Work closely with business customers to understand their needs and priorities, combine that with internal data and competitive information, and turn it all into clear, prioritised requirements.

● Identify and prioritise what to build, with a real understanding of trade-offs and impact. Knowing what not to build matters as much as knowing what to build.

● Deliver projects that meet the highest standards of performance, reliability, usability and customer delight.

● Proactively spot and resolve strategic issues and risks that could stop the team from hitting its goals —before they become fires.

● Drive the user workflow. Run user experience, review and clarification sessions with the software and QA engineering teams, so you get maximum customer value out of the time and resources you actually have.

● Build consensus. This is a fast-moving environment. You will need strong cross-functional coordination and the ability to align different verticals and departments to hit business objectives on time.

**What we expect on AI (hands-on, not theory)**

You should already be comfortable with both of these:

1. Using AI well

* ChatGPT / Claude / Gemini are part of your daily work, not a novelty.
* You can write structured prompts and know when to use system prompts, few-shot examples, and step-by-step reasoning.
* You can tell a good AI output from a confident wrong one, and you know how to test for it.

2. Building with AI

* You have built something real — an agent, a RAG chatbot over your own documents, or anautomated workflow.
* Comfortable with tools like n8n, Make, Zapier, Dify, LangFlow, Cursor, Claude Code, Lovable, Replit, or similar.
* You understand the basics: embeddings, vector search, context windows, hallucination, token cost, and latency.
* You do not need to write production code. But you must be able to read pseudo-code, follow an algorithm, and run simple queries without panicking.

**Growth at IndiaMART**

We are committed to helping every IndiaMARTian keep learning and keep growing.

● 6,000+ Super IndiaMARTians and growing every day.

● Over 1,000 employees with us for 5+ years, 400+ for 10+ years, 80+ for 15+ years.

iLEAD — IndiaMART Leadership Experience & Development Program

A 3-year programme designed to prepare new joiners for leadership roles in their area of expertise. Members get a 10% bonus raise (over and above the annual appraisal) on every joining anniversary while enrolled, along with learning experiences tailored to their goals.

iLEAP — IndiaMART Learning & Education Assist Program

Enroll in educational programmes of your choice and get reimbursed on successful completion. We also sponsor learning at top institutes like IIM Ahmedabad and FMS.

**Eligibility Criteria**

● 10th & 12th Standard: >=90%

● Graduation (B.Tech / B.E. - CS/IT): >=60%

● PGDM / MBA: >= 60%

**Marketing Executive**

Location:

**Job Title**
=============

* **Title:** Marketing Executive
* **Department:** Academic Marketing | Product & Platform Marketing

**About the Role**
------------------

### **Introduction**

Oxford University Press is looking for a Marketing Executive to join our Academic Marketing team. This is an excellent opportunity for an ambitious marketing professional who wants to develop their expertise in product and brand marketing while contributing to products that support researchers, institutions, libraries, and academic communities worldwide.

As part of a globally recognised educational and academic publisher, you will play a key role in delivering marketing campaigns for a portfolio of online products. Working alongside experienced Product Marketers and Marketing Managers, you will gain exposure to product strategy, campaign management, digital marketing, analytics, and go-to-market planning, while building valuable stakeholder relationships across the business.

This role offers the opportunity to work in a collaborative, innovative, and purpose-driven environment where marketing directly contributes to Oxford University Press’s mission of advancing education and research globally. You will have access to ongoing training, development opportunities, and exposure to modern digital marketing tools, analytics platforms, and campaign methodologies.

  

### **Opportunity**

As a Marketing Executive, you will be responsible for delivering product marketing campaigns and supporting wider product and platform marketing initiatives. You will work closely with Product Marketers to ensure marketing activity aligns with product strategy, institutional marketing objectives, and commercial priorities.

Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:

  

#### **Marketing Strategy**

* Develop an understanding of the institutional marketing strategy and wider divisional marketing objectives.
* Build knowledge of the broader product strategy and contribute to relevant working groups where appropriate.
* Use available analytics and performance data to inform marketing activity and measure campaign effectiveness.
* Continuously identify opportunities to optimise performance and improve marketing outcomes.

  

#### **Product Knowledge**

* Develop a strong understanding of the portfolio of online products, including key features, benefits, positioning, target audiences, and brand identity.
* Support Product Marketers with administrative and operational activities relating to online products.
* Work independently on assigned product marketing tasks and deliverables.

  

#### **Product Lifecycle and Go-to-Market Activity**

* Work closely with Product Marketers to understand product goals, market trends, campaign priorities, and commercial objectives.
* Take ownership of defined marketing campaigns from planning through execution.
* Develop campaign messaging, creative assets, and calls to action with guidance from Product Marketers.
* Communicate plans effectively and validate campaign approaches with key stakeholders.
* Share campaign results, performance insights, and learning outcomes to support continuous improvement.
* Support the maintenance and updating of marketing documentation, product materials, and sales enablement tools.

  

#### **Marketing Programmes and Campaign Execution**

* Execute marketing plans according to agreed timelines and budgets.
* Deliver campaigns using a range of marketing channels and tactics, including digital advertising, email marketing, and other promotional activities.
* Build expertise in marketing execution through training and practical experience.
* Analyse campaign results and apply insights to improve future activity and performance.

  

#### **Platform Marketing Support**

* Support platform marketing initiatives through collaboration with the Platform Marketer.
* Use ClickUp to request, coordinate, and monitor updates to online pages and associated marketing activities.
* Assist with platform-related projects and campaign execution as required.

  

#### **Collaboration Across the Marketing Function**

* Provide support to colleagues across Product Marketing and Library Marketing teams when priorities require and capacity allows.
* Work collaboratively with internal stakeholders to ensure campaigns and projects are delivered successfully.

  

#### **Team Contribution and Behavioural Expectations**

* Act as a collaborative, proactive, inquisitive, and supportive member of the Product and Institutional Marketing team.
* Share knowledge, ideas, experience, and best practices with colleagues.
* Adhere to Oxford University Press performance and development frameworks.
* Demonstrate the ethical standards, behaviours, and professionalism expected across the organisation.
* Complete all mandatory training and operate in accordance with OUP policies and guidelines.

  

### **Impact**

This role plays an important part in ensuring the successful promotion and growth of Oxford University Press's academic products and platforms. By delivering effective marketing campaigns, supporting product launches, analysing performance data, and contributing to strategic marketing objectives, you will help increase product awareness, customer engagement, and commercial success.

Your work will directly support Product Marketers, Sales teams, Product teams, and wider business stakeholders, ensuring OUP continues to deliver high-quality products and services to the global academic community.

  

**About You**
-------------

### **Essential Criteria**

* Marketing experience, including creating marketing plans and implementing digital marketing activities.
* Ability to work independently while operating within agreed frameworks, processes, and objectives.
* Excellent organisational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong collaboration and relationship-building abilities across functions and stakeholder groups.
* Ability to adapt effectively to change and uncertainty while supporting colleagues and stakeholders.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to use data and insights to improve campaign outcomes.

### **Desirable Criteria**

* Experience within academic publishing or an understanding of the institutional research landscape.
* Experience managing digital marketing activity across channels such as Google Ads, Facebook, LinkedIn, and email marketing platforms.
* Experience using digital analytics tools, including Google Analytics.
* Ability to interpret campaign performance data and apply insights to future marketing activity.
* Experience working with product marketing, brand marketing, or go-to-market campaigns.

title: Digital Marketing Executive
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a creative and result-oriented Digital Marketing Executive to manage and grow the LinkedIn presence of ProweSolution and its product, FieldTrix.

The role will primarily focus on B2B content marketing, LinkedIn management, brand awareness, and lead generation. The ideal candidate should have strong writing skills, a good understanding of social media content, and the ability to turn product updates, customer stories, and industry insights into engaging content.

You will work closely with the sales and management teams to create relevant content, connect with industry decision-makers, and generate potential business opportunities through LinkedIn.

Key Responsibilities. LinkedIn Content & Social Media Management

* Plan and publish 3 LinkedIn posts per week across the FieldTrix and ProweSolution company pages.
* Create different content formats, including text posts, carousels, infographics, and short product videos.
* Manage the content calendar and maintain consistency in posting.
* Create 1–2 LinkedIn posts per week for the founder's personal profile based on inputs from the sales team and management.
* Take content approval before publishing during the initial phase. Once the process is established, manage routine content independently within agreed guidelines.

2. Content Creation & Design

* Write engaging and original content around product features, customer challenges, industry trends, business insights, and company updates.
* Convert product updates, client results, and sales team inputs into meaningful marketing content.
* Design festival creatives, company announcements, and promotional creatives for LinkedIn and WhatsApp status.
* Create short product demonstration videos and feature highlights using basic video editing tools.
* Use Canva, Gamma, Adobe or similar tools to create professional marketing creatives.

3. Industry Research & LinkedIn Engagement

* Research the Pharma and FMCG industries to understand their business challenges, sales processes, and distribution operations.
* Identify relevant LinkedIn groups, communities, and industry discussions.
* Engage with relevant posts and discussions through meaningful comments and content sharing.
* Build connections with industry professionals and potential customers.

4. Lead Generation & Network Building

* Identify and build a database of decision-makers at target companies, including Sales Heads, National Sales Managers (NSMs), Zonal Sales Managers (ZSMs), Regional Sales Managers, and Founders.
* Grow the LinkedIn network of the founder and company pages with relevant industry professionals.
* Identify potential prospects and business opportunities through LinkedIn.
* Share interested leads and relevant prospect information with the sales team every week.
* Coordinate with the sales team to understand lead quality and improve lead generation efforts.

5. Performance Tracking & Reporting

* Track LinkedIn performance and prepare weekly/monthly reports.
* Monitor engagement, relevant follower growth, profile reach, and lead generation.
* Track demo requests and qualified leads generated through LinkedIn.
* Evaluate content performance and suggest improvements based on results.

Skills & Qualifications

* 1–3 years of experience in digital marketing, B2B content marketing, or LinkedIn marketing.
* Experience in SaaS, IT services, FMCG, Pharma, or other B2B industries will be preferred.
* Strong written English and the ability to communicate business ideas clearly.
* Good understanding of LinkedIn as a B2B marketing and lead generation platform.
* Basic video editing skills for short product videos and promotional clips.
* Working knowledge of Canva, Gamma, Adobe Creative Suite, or similar design tools.
* Ability to research industry topics and create original, engaging content.
* Basic understanding of social media analytics and performance reporting.
* Good communication, coordination, and time management skills.
* Willingness to learn about field sales operations, Sales Force Automation (SFA), and Distributor Management Systems (DMS), particularly in Pharma and FMCG.

Content Quality Expectations

* Content must be original, relevant, and specific to FieldTrix, ProweSolution, and their target industries.
* AI tools can be used for brainstorming, research assistance, and initial drafts. However, the final content must be properly researched, edited, and refined by the candidate.
* Content should be simple, informative, engaging, and focused on the audience's business challenges.
* Avoid generic promotional posts and repetitive AI-generated content.
* All product claims, client results, and business-related announcements must be verified and approved before publication.

Performance Measurement (KPIs)

Performance will be evaluated based on:

* **Lead Generation:** Demo requests and qualified business leads generated through LinkedIn.
* **Relevant Audience Growth:** Growth in followers and connections from target industries, particularly Pharma and FMCG decision-makers.
* **Content Engagement:** Meaningful engagement, including comments, shares, and interactions from relevant audiences.
* **Content Consistency:** Timely execution of the agreed content calendar and publishing schedule.
* **Network Development:** Growth of relevant industry connections across company and founder profiles.
* **Content Quality:** Originality, relevance, accuracy, and effectiveness of published content.

**Incentive Structure**

An additional performance-based incentive will be applicable for leads independently generated by the candidate that successfully convert into paying clients.

The incentive structure and eligibility criteria will be communicated separately.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who can do more than just create social media posts. We want someone who understands the audience, researches the industry, communicates product value effectively, and contributes to building a strong B2B presence and generating real business opportunities through digital marketing.

title: SEO Executive
description:
**Job Summary:**

We are looking for a **SEO Executive** under the business domain Global Surf Digital Media LLC (https ://www.globalsurf.ae/) to support the planning and execution of search engine optimization strategies across multiple platforms. In this role, you will work closely with the digital marketing team to improve website visibility, increase organic traffic, and enhance search rankings. The role will also focus on optimizing content for AI-driven search experiences (AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity) and ensuring visibility across emerging search interfaces beyond traditional SERPs. The ideal candidate will have a solid understanding of SEO best practices, keyword research, content optimization, and performance tracking. You will be responsible for monitoring search trends, identifying content gaps, and ensuring all SEO efforts align with broader marketing goals. Additionally, you will contribute to improving content discoverability in AI-generated answers and zero click search environments.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. Technical & On-Page SEO**

* Run technical SEO audits — crawlability, indexation, site architecture, Core Web Vitals, structured data — and translate findings into a prioritized action list.
* Execute on-page optimization across client sites: metadata, internal linking, content structure, and schema markup, aligned to each client's industry and search intent.
* Coordinate technical SEO fixes with the Development team where changes require code or CMS-level implementation.

**2. SEO Strategy Execution**

* Execute the SEO strategy and roadmap set by the SEO Team Lead for each assigned account — keyword targeting, content briefs, and link-building priorities.
* Conduct keyword research and competitive analysis for B2B, high-consideration search categories (construction, engineering, industrial, real estate).
* Flag strategy or scope risks on assigned accounts to the SEO Team Lead early, rather than absorbing them silently.

**3. Client & Account Support**

* Support client-facing SEO updates and monthly reporting calls for overseas (GCC) B2B accounts, under the SEO Team Lead's oversight.
* Produce clear, accurate written updates — client-facing English communication is a working requirement, not a nice-to-have, given the overseas client base.
* Understand each client's sales cycle and search behavior well enough to prioritize SEO work by commercial impact, not just technical severity.

**4. Reporting & Analytics**

* Track and report monthly SEO performance — rankings, organic traffic, indexation health, and lead-quality signals — using Google Search Console, GA4, Microsoft clarity, Ahref, and SEMrush.
* Maintain accurate, current documentation of SEO work completed per client, in line with GS Digital's reporting standards.
* Distinguish B2B-relevant SEO outcomes (qualified organic enquiries, ranking for buyer-intent terms) from vanity metrics (raw traffic, impressions).

**5. AI-Assisted Delivery**

* Adopt and maintain agency AI workflow standards for SEO research, content briefing, and reporting as they evolve.
* Log AI tool usage against client deliverables as required by delivery protocols.

**Requirements**

* 1.5 to 3.5 years of hands-on SEO experience, agency-side preferred, with direct exposure to B2B and/or overseas (GCC, UK, US) clients.
* Working proficiency with Ahrefs or SEMrush, Google Search Console, Google Analytics (GA4), GTM, Microsoft clarity and Screaming Frog
* Solid grasp of technical SEO fundamentals — crawl budget, indexation, site structure, structured data, Core Web Vitals.
* Experience with content-led SEO for long B2B sales cycles: service pages, technical blogs, case studies.

Pay: Up to ₹35,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

As Global Project Lead, you will make sure the expert conversations that shape Novo’s medical strategy are well planned and flawlessly delivered. You will lead advisory board meetings from first scope to final closure, working with Global Medical Affairs teams and leading external experts. Experience and understanding of Medical Affairs.

This role will serve as the single point of contact (SPOC) between customers, internal engineering teams, foundries, EDA vendors, and IP suppliers, ensuring seamless execution, effective communication, timely issue resolution, and successful silicon delivery.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead end-to-end semiconductor program execution from specification to silicon delivery.
* Ensure effective communication, establish project governance and reporting, tracking and review mechanisms, evolve early risk assessment and mitigation plans, budget management, and drive change requests between internal and external teams.
* Ensure on-time availability and maintenance of IP licenses, EDA vendor collaboration, smooth engagement with Foundries for TO, MPW’s and drive logistics for sample release and production.
* Implement project tracking and collaboration using smart project tracking tools and methodolodgies (e.g., Jira, Smartsheet, MS Project, etc).

**You are best equipped for this role if you have:**

* 12+ years of total semiconductor experience, including at least 5+ years managing SoC development programs(spec-to-silicon).
* Strong understanding of semiconductor end to end design flows, manufacturing, package and test flows, handled logistics and coordination of materials between different teams and finally to the customer.
* Worked in similar capacity delivering design services and/or turnkey SOC programs.
* Experience coordinating directly or with teams engaged with foundries, EDA vendors, and IP suppliers.
* SPOC to drive changes, strong interface between customer and internal management to ensure timely issue resolution and also to pave the way for future engagements.

**Program Management and Interpersonal Skills:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical / Electronics / Computer Engineering or related field.
* PMP or equivalent project management certification.
* Strong leader with good interpersonal and organisational skills.
* Technically able to coordinate and drive ASIC turnkey and/or design services projects reading the customer’s pulse.
* Expertise in using Project Management tools, methodologies, and tracking mechanisms
* Worked in a Matrixed organisation and has delivered multiple projects in ASIC turnkey and/or design services model.
* Go-getter and team builder
* Excellent customer communication and stakeholder management experience in a global environment.
* Able to work under aggressive customer expectations and schedules while maintaining relationships between internal and external stakeholders.
* Out of the box thinker able to manage cross functional and global teams.

title: Delivery Lead (Suite)
description:
TITLE
  
  
Delivery Lead
  
  
**Who We Are**
Duck Creek Technologies is the intelligent solutions provider defining the future of the property and casualty (P&C) insurance industry. Our modern SaaS platform enables insurers to run agile, cloud-based operations and deliver better customer experiences.
  
  
Duck Creek is a flexible-first company, offering employees autonomy in how they manage their work. As part of our Flying Together approach, we are thoughtfully increasing opportunities for in-person collaboration by focusing on hiring in designated locations. This role is aligned to a specific location, and you’ll partner with your leader to participate in meaningful in-person moments that support team connection and collaboration.
  
  
**About Vista**
Duck Creek Technologies is a portfolio company of Vista Equity Partners, a global investment firm that partners with mission-critical enterprise software and technology-enabled businesses to drive growth and operational excellence. As part of a Vista portfolio company, you’ll work in an environment backed by deep expertise, long-term investment, and a strong commitment to building market-leading businesses and meaningful careers.
  
  
**Position Overview**
The Delivery Lead is responsible for leading teams to deliver project(s) for clients, and manages schedules, financials, and project change requests to ensure successful and on-time project delivery. The Delivery Lead identifies and addresses potential issues and risks that may impact project deliverables, and serves as the point of escalation for project related activities, and is the escalation point for the Customer. The role may be expected to work across multiple complex projects simultaneously.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Responsible for leading teams to deliver project(s) for clients,
* Manages the day-to-day project activities and deliverables, including schedules, financials, and project change requests
* Provides on-site leadership for project team by building and motivating team members to meet project goals, adhering to their responsibilities and project milestones
* Identifies and develops trusted adviser relationship with project and program stakeholders, sponsors and university stakeholders
* Serves as the point of escalation for project related activities, and for the Customer
* Reports on project results, metrics, test and deployment management activities
* Prepares estimates and detailed project plan for all phases of the project
* Provides status reporting regarding project milestones, deliverable, dependencies, risks and issues, communicating across leadership
* Understands interdependencies between technology, operations and business needs
* Manages project scope and changes
* Supports formal/informal schedules to manage the engagement contract
* Assists management in defining the Statement of Work
* Sets and continually manages project and program expectations while delegating and managing deliverable with team members and stakeholders
* Develops and delivers progress reports, proposals, requirements documentation and presentations to various audiences, including project team, sponsors, CIO and key stakeholders
* Mentors project team members
* May work across multiple complex projects simultaneously.
* Performs other related duties and activities as required
* Leads governance and AI-enabled initiatives across project lifecycle in multiple complex projects
* Experience in using approved AI tools, Co-pilots, agents and automations to improve project planning, scheduling, status reporting, risk sensing, forecasting, resource optimization, requirements analysis and decision support.
* Evaluates whether a business or delivery need is best addressed through AI, conventional automation or process improvement by assessing business value, feasibility, risk and adoption requirements.
* Establishes baselines and measures AI-enabled delivery outcomes, including cycle-time reduction, productivity, forecast accuracy, quality, adoption, risk reduction and business value.
* Applies responsible AI practices covering privacy, security, intellectual property, explainability, auditability, human accountability and approved-tool usage.

**What You’ve Done**
Education and Work Experience:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree or higher or equivalent additional years of experience; applicable functional experience in the discipline or a closely related function.
* Practical experience in Services Project Management or a closely related function.
* Demonstrated ability to deliver work of moderate to high complexity in a global software, SaaS, technology, insurance technology, or comparable business environment.
* Experience working independently with limited day-to-day instruction and collaborating across teams is required

**Preferred Education And Experience**

* Advanced degree, professional certification, or specialized training relevant to Services Project Management.
* Experience improving processes, tools, reporting, controls, or operating practices within the function.
* Experience partnering with distributed teams and stakeholders across regions, business units, or functional areas

**Skills, Knowledge, Abilities, And Behaviors**

* Applied knowledge of Services Project Management practices, processes, tools, and operating standards.
* Sound analytical judgment and structured problem-solving capability.
* Ability to plan, prioritize, and deliver work against agreed timelines.
* Clear written and verbal communication for technical and business audiences.
* Stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration.
* Attention to detail and commitment to high-quality work products.
* Ability to interpret data, identify trends, and convert findings into action.
* Process improvement mindset with practical change management awareness.
* Understanding of governance, risk, controls, and policy compliance.
* Customer, partner, or internal service orientation appropriate to the function.
* Adaptability in a dynamic global software company environment.
* Ownership mindset, accountability, and reliable follow-through.
* Professional discretion when handling confidential or sensitive information.
* Ability to learn new systems, tools, methods, and business processes quickly.
* Inclusive behaviors that support collaboration, trust, and constructive feedback.
* Practical AI literacy as relevant to project delivery and management.
* Hands-on experience with approved AI-enabled project-management tools
* Experience governing AI-enabled delivery across a portfolio or multiple complex projects, including value
* prioritization, responsible-AI controls, adoption metrics and executive reporting.

CORE COMPETENCIES
  
  
Our team is built on strong core values that guide how we work and grow together. We prioritize clear and thoughtful communication, fostering open collaboration across diverse perspectives to achieve shared goals.
  
  
We approach challenges with curiosity and critical thinking, seeking creative solutions while remaining adaptable in a fast-changing environment.
  
  
We take accountability for our work and outcomes, holding ourselves to high standards of integrity and professionalism. Above all, we are committed to doing the right thing—treating others with respect, embracing continuous learning, and engaging inclusively across cultures and backgrounds.
  
  
LEARN MORE
  
  

* Company Website – Transforming Insurance with Duck Creek's SaaS Solutions
* Life at Duck Creek – Life at Duck Creek - Duck Creek
* Benefits & Rewards – Wellbeing & Rewards - Duck Creek

LOCATION & WAYS OF WORKING
  
  
Duck Creek is a flexible-first company, offering employees autonomy in how they manage their day-to-day work. As part of our Flying Together approach, we are thoughtfully increasing opportunities for in-person collaboration by focusing on hiring in designated locations.
  
  
This role is aligned to a specific location, and you are expected to reside within reasonable proximity to that location. You will partner with your leader to participate in meaningful in-person moments that support team connection, collaboration, and business priorities.
  
  
At the start of your employment, your work may be performed remotely, subject to business needs and company guidelines. As our Flying Together approach continues to evolve, you may be expected to transition to a hybrid work arrangement, including working from a designated office location on a schedule determined by your leader and organizational needs.
  
  
The Company reserves the right to modify your work arrangement, including location expectations and in-person requirements, based on business needs, organizational policy, or regulatory considerations.
  
  
**What We Stand For**
Our global team values the unique perspectives each employee brings. Our success is driven by an inclusive culture where everyone can learn from one another, regardless of role or background. This collaborative approach helps us continuously improve our products, services, and systems.
  
  
Duck Creek is committed to equal opportunity for all employees and applicants, with decisions based on skills, experience, and achievements—without regard to any protected status.
  
  
We strive to lead by example in inclusion, diversity, and equity, creating an environment where employees can be their authentic selves. Our values guide us: We Prioritize Respect, We Listen, We Care, We Add Value, and We Lead.
  
  
To learn more: https://www.duckcreek.com/life-at-duck-creek/

title: Strategic Program Manager
description:
**About MISUMI Americas**
MISUMI Americas, a division of MISUMI Group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions. By integrating a vast catalog of components with a world-class digital manufacturing platform, MISUMI Americas empowers engineers and procurement teams to accelerate innovation across the entire product lifecycle. With operations in the San Francisco Bay Area and Chicago, the company serves as a vital partner for the most innovative companies in the Americas.
  
  

* This position will be based on-site in our Bangalore office, working overnight IST hours to support the US Pacific Standard Time zone.\*\*

**Impact In This Role**
As a Strategic Program Manager (SPM) at Fictiv, you will collaborate with some of the world’s leading enterprises and innovative startups to accelerate product launches while maintaining the highest quality standards. Serving as a trusted advisor, you will leverage your expertise in engineering, operations, quality, and logistics to guide customers through every phase of the product lifecycle—from New Product Development (NPD) and New Product Introduction (NPI) to mass production.
  
  
You will play a critical role in ensuring customers’ products are launched on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards. Working closely with cross-functional teams across Sales, Solutions Engineering, and Fulfillment, you will scope, plan, and execute customer programs, consistently delivering exceptional service and tangible value throughout the product lifecycle.
  
  
With a focus on continuous improvement, you will help refine internal processes and drive operational enhancements that improve the customer experience. You will also mentor and guide Associate Strategic Program Managers (ASPMs), sharing knowledge and best practices to strengthen program execution and support the team’s overall success.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Champion the customer experience: Act as the primary customer advocate, building trusted relationships and delivering exceptional experiences that foster long-term customer loyalty.
* Lead cross-functional program execution: Collaborate with pre- and post-sales teams, including Sales, Solutions Engineering, and Fulfillment, to scope, plan, and execute customer programs, ensuring on-time delivery while proactively managing risks and changes throughout the program lifecycle.
* Apply technical and program management expertise: Leverage your knowledge of engineering and manufacturing processes, combined with strong program management skills, to identify risks early, develop mitigation strategies, and manage changes to keep programs on track.
* Serve as a trusted subject matter expert: Provide technical and operational insights to customers and internal stakeholders, ensuring alignment on requirements, manufacturing feasibility, quality expectations, and program objectives.
* Drive program performance and accountability: Track and report on program milestones, timelines, deliverables, and key performance indicators, making necessary adjustments to maintain progress and meet customer expectations and quality standards.
* Drive continuous improvement: Identify opportunities to improve processes, strengthen operational efficiency, and enhance the overall customer experience in collaboration with cross- functional teams.
* Facilitate effective program communication: Lead regular status meetings with customers and internal stakeholders to communicate requirements, timelines, deliverables, and quality standards, maintain alignment, and proactively resolve blockers.
* Mentor and support Associate Strategic Program Managers (ASPMs): Share expertise, provide guidance, and reinforce program management best practices to strengthen execution capabilities and support the team's overall success.
* Support quality management: Adhere to and contribute to Fictiv's Quality Management System (QMS), supporting compliance with established quality standards and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Desired Traits**

* Education: Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Manufacturing, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Program management experience: 5+ years of experience managing complex projects or programs in fast-paced engineering or manufacturing environments.
* NPD and NPI expertise: Hands-on experience supporting New Product Development (NPD), New Product Introduction (NPI), and transitions into high-volume manufacturing.
* Manufacturing process knowledge: Expertise in one or more manufacturing processes, such as CNC machining, 3D printing, injection molding, sheet metal fabrication, die casting, or assembly.
* Customer-facing leadership: Experience leading complex, consultative customer engagements, using technical and operational expertise to align stakeholders, solve problems, and deliver successful outcomes.
* Program and risk management: Strong program planning, risk management, organizational, and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize competing demands and consistently meet deadlines.
* Tools and systems proficiency: Proficiency with program management tools and software for tracking milestones, managing deliverables, communicating updates, and reporting progress across distributed teams.
* Business and customer orientation: A self-starter with strong business acumen and a customer-first mindset, capable of solving complex problems and building meaningful relationships with customers and internal stakeholders.
* Continuous improvement mindset: A demonstrated commitment to process optimization, operational excellence, service enhancement, and customer success.
* Mentorship and collaboration: A willingness to share knowledge, mentor colleagues, and promote best practices while working effectively across cross-functional teams.
* Growth mindset: A passion for continuous learning, developing innovative solutions, and tackling challenging problems in dynamic environments.
* Communication skills: Outstanding verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across multicultural, cross-functional, and geographically distributed teams.
* Strong program management, risk management, and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize and meet deadlines within a structured framework.
* Proficiency in standard program management tools and software used for tracking, communication, and reporting across distributed teams.
* Self-starter, with strong business acumen and a customer-first mindset, capable of solving problems and building deep, meaningful relationships with customers and internal stakeholders.
* Demonstrates a focus on process optimization, service enhancement, and driving customer success.
* Passionate about learning, building solutions, and tackling challenges.
* Outstanding verbal and written communication skills, with experience working across multi-cultural, cross-functional teams.

**Interested in learning more? We look forward to hearing from you soon.**
We’re actively seeking teammates who:
  
  

* Bring diverse perspectives and experience to our culture and company.
* Excel at being part of a strong, empathetic team.
* Thrive in an environment emphasizing respect, honesty, collaboration, and growth.
* Have an ‘always learning’ mindset that celebrates learning, not just wins.
* Help us continue to build a world-class organization that values the contributions of all of our teammates

We encourage applications from members of underrepresented groups, including but not limited to women, members of the LGBTQ community, people of color, people with disabilities, and veterans.

title: Senior Program Manager
description:
**About the role**

Refyne helps India's workforce access the salary they have already earned. The PMO team is where that promise is kept. We own the client integrations that connect employers' payroll systems to our platform, the delivery cadence of our product and engineering PODs, the programs that run across departments, and the response when something breaks in production.

We are looking for a Senior Program Manager who can hold all of it: a portfolio of client integrations, owning the scrum cadence for more than one team, managing programs that span departments, and the incident process behind both the platform and its integrations.

**Key responsibilities**

**Client integrations -**
You sit with the client's HR, payroll and IT teams, work out how their system should talk to ours, write the specification and drive the build with engineering through UAT and cutover. After go-live it stays yours.

* Scope and solution new integrations across APIs, SFTP and file-based exchanges, and write the technical integration document the client builds from.
* Own client configuration end to end: eligibility rules, limits, and translating business logic into technical implementation.
* Monitor integrations in production, triage failures and downtime, conduct RCA and escalate with a clear read on client impact.

**Act as client's technical counterpart -**
Solution calls, demos, business rule questions, infosec questionnaires, due diligence reviews. You are the person on our side who answers without a handoff.

* Act as the primary contact for client technical and project stakeholders through the integration lifecycle.
* Run demos and user journey walkthroughs for stakeholders.
* Collate and close out integration-related infosec and due diligence questionnaires with our security and compliance teams.

**Program planning and tracking-**
Much of what you own cuts across product, engineering, operations, risk and business teams, and leadership is watching the dates.

* Build the plan: scope, milestones, dependencies, owners and a critical path that holds up.
* Track delivery across departments, chase the dependencies nobody has claimed, and hold one honest view of status, risks and blockers.
* Give leadership the overview they need through weekly delivery reporting, program dashboards and the PMO section of the monthly business metrics report.

**Scrum and delivery cadence -**
You run the cadence for several product and engineering PODs and keep them moving.

* Run planning, grooming, standups, retrospectives and release coordination across your PODs.
* Co-ordinate with product and engineering to break requirements into epics and stories with acceptance criteria that hold up, and keep the backlog healthy.
* Clear blockers, protect the sprint from mid-flight scope, and keep velocity and release readiness visible in Jira.

**Incident management -**
When something breaks in production, you run the response and the follow-through.

* Run the incident process end to end: detection, triage, the severity call, bridge coordination and client communication while it is still live.
* Monitor integration and platform health — API failures, sync breaks, downtime — and escalate with a clear read on employee and client impact.
* Close the loop with root cause analysis, preventive actions, and the service and escalation workflows that stop a repeat.

**Documentation and governance -**
Author and maintain the Client Integration Wiki for every client, to our standard template.

* Own the SOPs that govern how configurations are raised, reviewed and changed.
* Mentor juniors and interns, delegating real initiatives with clear ownership and checkpoints.

**Requirements**

* **6-10 years**
  in program and project management, implementation or technical account management, with at least 3 years running client-facing technical delivery.
* **Programs you have run end to end.**
  Planning, dependencies, stakeholders across several functions, leadership reporting, and the hard conversations about timelines.
* **Scrum mastery in practice, not theory.**
  You have run the cadence for more than one team at a time and kept the backlog, the velocity and the release train honest, in Jira or its equivalent.
* **Integrations you have personally shipped.**
  You have written the specification, worked it through with engineering, run the testing and seen a cutover through.
* **Technical fluency.**
  A working understanding of system design, the software development lifecycle, and how a release moves from requirement to production. On the integration side: REST APIs, authentication patterns, webhooks, SFTP and file-based exchanges. You can read an API contract, question a data model and spot what will break in production.
* **Incident experience.**
  You have owned a production issue from detection to resolution, managed the client through it, and written the root cause analysis afterwards.
* **Writing that holds up.**
  You turn a messy requirements call into a document a client's engineer can build from, and an auditor can read a year later.
* **Stakeholder management.**
  You can explain a production issue, push back on a timeline and keep the room calm.
* A bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science or a related field, or the equivalent in practice.

**Good to have**

* A project or agile certification such as PMP, CSM, PSM or SAFe.
* Fintech, lending experience.
* ITIL-aligned incident and problem management, and experience standing up a service desk such as Jira Service Management.
* Well versed in using AI to take the grind out of routine and repetitive tasks.

title: Customer Project Manager
description:
**Job Description**
Customer Project Management (CPM) ensures customer projects/programes are delivered within agreed scope, budget, schedule, and quality. Contains projects throughout all phases, starting from delivery approach identification to completion / care / operation. Comprises management of customer (and all stakeholder) relationships and expectations during the contract fulfilment as well as project team members / resources. Contains project risk management, and driving of improvement actions to secure project gross margin and upselling and cross-selling.
  
  
**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**

* Manage customer programme (collection of projects managed together for business benefits) or project for a defined product and / or service scope for a medium / large and / or complex customer contract with medium / high risk probability.
* Collect CIQ inputs from the customer for the 4G/5G network configuration, integration and acceptance testing of the network, and handover the project to Care
* Contract might be defined as key project by BG / market. Delivers the operational and project single/multiple BG / BUs scope to the customer.
* Ensure all project and operational management is in full alignment with Nokia Mode of Operation (MoO), BG / BL guidelines and the PM@Nokia methodology.
* Plan customer project and keeps plan updated to reflect and anticipate changes by coordinating change management on all aspects affecting cost, scope, schedule and quality (CSSQ).
* Participate in pre-sales and sales process activities, determine delivery approach alternatives and manages the selection of the final recommended approach to delivery.
* Define the customisation of any global operational processes together with relevant point of contacts to meet project requirements (for example, network operations, supply chain, logistics, and acceptance).
* Manage the customer relationship during delivery and serves as the primary interface towards the customer in all activities-related to the own scope of the contract, including customer complaints, corrective actions, and changing requirements.
* Actively apply appropriate best practices and lessons learned throughout the life of the project. Monitor, control and report KPIs defined in customer contract, seek to define new opportunities to expand and renew contracts with the customer, lead the project team and may perform some line manager responsibilities.
* Complete the project closure and / or handover as required (for example, complete contractual requirements, post calculation, lessons learned). (The term customer project refers generally to all forms of Nokia customer contracts, projects with a definitive start and end, and programmes as collections of projects managed together for business benefits which may contain an ongoing operations business).

**Key Skills And Experience**
**You have:**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, Computer Science, or a related field with 10+ years of industry experience in leading & managing projects in Telecommunication.
* Leadership ability to manage large & complex projects, Negotiation Skills & Conflict Management, and strong Radio, Core and IP knowledge for 4G/5G
* Ability to understand the customer technical requirements and translate these into CIQ for the network bring up
* Troubleshooting skills for 4G/5G networks, escalation Management & Decision Making

* PMP certification

The length of the recruitment process may vary depending on the specific role's requirements. We strive to ensure a smooth and inclusive experience for all candidates. Discover more about the recruitment process at Nokia .

title: Medical Project Owner
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
  
  
**Organization Background**
Scientific data and information are core assets of Eli Lilly and Company (“Lilly”). Providing balanced, objective, and accurate information to regulators, the scientific community, healthcare professionals (HCPs), payers, and patients across the drug development lifecycle is fundamental to Lilly’s mission.
  
  
Global Content Hub (GCH) is a part of Global Commercial Capabilities and Innovation organisation and houses plethora of capabilities that help deliver impactful, scalable content that empowers informed decision making across the healthcare spectrum dedicated to crafting top-tier promotional/non-promotional materials for healthcare professionals (HCPs), patients, and payers.
  
  
**Position Description**
The Medical Project Owner (MedPO) is responsible for coordinating and tracking the end-to-end execution of medical and scientific content projects within Eli Lilly’s Global Content Hub. Operating at the intersection of project execution, workflow coordination, and operational visibility, this role ensures that projects move efficiently through initiation, development, review readiness, approval milestones, and closure.
  
  
The MedPO serves as the execution lead after project kickoff, working closely with Functional PMs, content teams, DRM, MCA teams, and other stakeholders to maintain progress, resolve blockers, and improve milestone visibility. The role holder coordinates deliverable movement through Medical-Legal-Regulatory-Operational (MLRO) review workflows in Veeva and across Adobe Workfront, ensuring that dependencies are tracked, handoffs are clean, and cycle times are minimized.
  
  
This role strengthens execution discipline so that Functional PMs can focus on planning, stakeholder engagement, and strategic alignment. The role is introduced as part of an evolving operating model and will continue to be refined based on pilot learnings.
  
  
**Key Objectives/Deliverables**
**Execution Tracking & Lifecycle Coordination**

* Drive execution tracking across the full project lifecycle after kickoff — from initiation through development, review readiness, approval, and closure — ensuring every stage is documented and progressing within agreed SLAs
* Monitor milestone progression for both end-to-end and mid-way projects depending on business needs, maintaining real-time visibility into deliverable status, scope, and stage transitions
* Identify delays, dormant projects, and emerging risks early; drive timely follow-ups and corrective actions to keep projects on track and minimize cycle-time delays
* Maintain the MCA Internal Tracker, daily planner, and supporting logs with up-to-date status, assignment data, and milestone updates — targeting 100% accuracy in project records
* Track deliverable turnaround against defined SLAs and surface bottlenecks that could impact downstream review or approval timelines

**Workflow Coordination & Handoff Management**

* Coordinate workflow movement across Adobe Workfront, Veeva Vault, and supporting tools — ensuring smooth transitions between development, review, and approval stages
* Facilitate handoffs between writers, designers, DRM, MCA, QMR, Content Editors, and other stakeholders, ensuring each party has the inputs and context needed to proceed without delays
* Route deliverables through Veeva for parallel MLRO review where applicable, minimizing sequential bottlenecks and supporting efficient processing
* Ensure alignment on timelines, dependencies, and next steps across all involved teams; proactively flag misalignments or unclear scope before they impact execution
* Assign and allocate deliverables to appropriate stakeholders during daily standups based on bandwidth, priority, and scope — ensuring prompt allocation within 24 hours

**Project Setup & System Readiness**

* Create and manage project structures in Adobe Workfront, ensuring all projects are initiated with the required metadata, workflow templates, and system readiness for execution
* Support Veeva placeholder creation as part of execution setup, in alignment with the evolving operating model and compliance requirements
* Maintain trackers, logs, and status dashboards with high accuracy to provide a single source of truth for project visibility across the team and leadership
* Ensure project setup reflects accurate scope, deliverable type, business unit alignment, and expected timelines — enabling downstream reporting and KPI measurement

**Stakeholder Coordination**

* Work closely with Functional PMs, BU leads, content owners, GCH teams, DRM, and MCA teams to ensure alignment on execution priorities, deliverable timelines, and quality expectations
* Support alignment across GCH, TPO, and affiliate workflows where applicable — bridging operational gaps and ensuring cross-team dependencies are surfaced early
* Surface missing inputs, unclear scope, and dependency gaps proactively; collaborate with Deliverable Owners and Operations teams to resolve issues promptly
* Participate in standups, planning sessions, and working meetings to maintain execution flow, provide status updates, and coordinate next steps across distributed teams
* Provide subject matter guidance to assigned business units on execution workflows, tool usage, and lifecycle processes

**Visibility, Escalation & Reporting**

* Maintain clear, real-time visibility of project status, risks, and bottlenecks through structured tracking, dashboards, and regular status updates
* Escalate delays, missing dependencies, or workflow issues through defined channels to Functional PMs, BU leads, and leadership — ensuring no critical blocker goes unaddressed
* Provide regular execution updates to stakeholders and leadership, including progress against milestones, risk summaries, and forecasting trends
* Support pilot reporting through structured tracking and actionable insights — translating execution data into recommendations for process and operating model refinement
* Drive KPI reporting discipline across assigned scope, pulling and presenting metrics on a weekly/monthly cadence to support evidence-based decision-making

**Continuous Improvement & Pilot Evolution**

* Identify workflow inefficiencies, duplication risks, and execution bottlenecks; recommend and implement targeted process improvement initiatives to enhance throughput and reduce rework
* Capture structured learnings on where the MedPO role adds the most value and where adjustments are required — feeding insights back into the operating model evolution
* Support refinement of the operating model based on pilot outcomes, stakeholder feedback, and performance data
* Contribute to playbooks, best practices, SOPs, and standardization efforts that codify execution excellence and enable scalable onboarding of new team members
* Drive a continuous improvement mindset across the team by facilitating knowledge-sharing sessions, lessons-learned reviews, and cross-BU benchmarking discussions

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* Strong execution tracking and project coordination across multiple concurrent projects, dependencies, and stakeholders
* Hands-on experience with Adobe Workfront and Veeva Vault workflows (project setup, deliverable routing, milestone tracking, and reporting)
* Understanding of the medical content lifecycle and review workflows, including MLR/MCA context, MLRO parallel review, and DRM/approval stage dependencies
* Familiarity with medical affairs content types (scientific publications, medical education, presentations, digital collateral) and relevant pharmaceutical regulatory/CIQ standards
* Demonstrated prioritization, follow-through, and escalation discipline; SLA management and turnaround-time optimization
* Risk identification and mitigation within compliance-driven delivery workflows; comfortable operating in evolving and pilot environments
* Strong cross-functional communication with Functional PMs, content owners, operations teams, DRM, MCA, and BU leadership
* Ability to manage expectations, surface issues diplomatically, and influence outcomes without overstepping role boundaries
* Proficiency with reporting tools (Excel, Power BI, dashboards) and ability to translate execution data into actionable insights
* Continuous improvement mindset with the ability to drive process enhancements, contribute to playbooks, and support team capability development

**Minimum Qualification Requirements**

* Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience in Content Operations, Project Management, Process Management, and Agile methodologies
* High degree of proficiency with tools and software associated with Content Operations and Project Management
* Demonstrated initiative and ability to influence, challenge, and work with cross-functional teams, and ability to drive decisions within scope of responsibility

**Additional Preferences**

* Experience with Agile methodologies, Veeva Vault, Wrike, and Adobe Systems
* Knowledge of data visualization tools such as Power BI and Tableau
* Knowledge of data processing tools such as KNIME, Alteryx, and MS Excel
* Experience in building SOPs and process flows
* Project Management certifications equivalent to PMP, ACP, CSM, CAPM, or Lean Six Sigma

**Education Requirements**

* Minimum: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent
* Preferred: Master’s degree or equivalent, preferably in Business Management, Operations, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or Health Care

title: Project Manager – Risk (L09)
description:
**Role Title: Project Manager – Risk (L09)**
**Company Overview**
Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as #3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the #1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
  
  
**Organizational Overview**
Synchrony's Risk Team is a dynamic and innovative team dedicated to providing oversight as 2nd Line of Defense. Our Risk organization consists of 4 pillars: Compliance, Credit & Financial Risk, Enterprise Risk and Operational Risk. Each of the pillars plays a vital role in managing Risk and supports the business in anticipating and addressing risks, issues, and challenge. This role is aligned to the Risk India team, requiring cross-functional effectiveness, and contribute to Enterprise, Compliance, Credit, Operational and Supervisory Affairs Risk pillar.
  
  
Position Overview: We are looking for a proactive and resourceful Mid-Level Project Manager to partner with the Risk India Leader and manage key projects that enhance operational efficiency and stakeholder engagement. This role involves driving initiatives such as Learning & Development programs, senior leadership visits, offsite events, and process digitization efforts. The ideal candidate will have prior experience working as a Business Analyst or Project Manager in process digitization and be skilled in data visualization and presentation tools.
  
  
**Role Summary/Purpose**
We are seeking a proactive and resourceful mid-level Project Manager to partner closely with the Risk India Leader to deliver a balanced portfolio of initiatives across
**Risk Engagement Strategy**
and
**AI Strategy for Risk**
. The role will execute end-to-end delivery of stakeholder engagement programs—Learning & Development, senior leadership visits, offsites, communications, and rhythm-of-business routines—ensuring strong planning, logistics, stakeholder coordination, and measurable outcomes, while also driving delivery of Risk’s AI initiatives by coordinating intake and prioritization of AI use cases, managing project plans and dependencies with Risk,
  
  
Data/Analytics, Technology, and governance teams, supporting process automation and Gen AI adoption, and tracking milestones, risks, and value realization through dashboards and executive-ready reporting.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Deliver Risk Engagement Strategy programs including Learning & Development initiatives, offsites, leadership visits, communications, and rhythm-of-business routines—owning end-to-end planning, logistics, stakeholder coordination, and post-event follow-through.
* Deliver AI Strategy for Risk initiatives by coordinating AI/GenAI and automation use-case intake, supporting prioritization, and driving execution in partnership with Risk, Data/Analytics, Technology, and governance teams.
* By / through (indicative but nor exhaustive)
* Building and managing integrated project plans (scope, timelines, milestones, dependencies, resources), ensuring on-time delivery across multiple concurrent workstreams.
* Running project governance and operating cadence (workstream meetings, action tracking, decision logs), escalate blockers, and ensure timely resolution of issues and dependencies.
* Tracking and reporting delivery progress, risks, and issues; develop mitigation plans and ensure appropriate escalation to the Risk India Leader and stakeholders.
* Creating executive-ready communications including crisp PowerPoint updates, status summaries, decision papers, and leadership readouts that highlight progress, risks, adoption, and outcomes.
* Developing and maintaining dashboards and reporting (e.g., Tableau and/or other tools) to provide transparency into milestones, adoption, and value realization for engagement and AI initiatives.
* Supporting process digitization/automation delivery by documenting requirements, coordinating testing/UAT, managing implementation readiness, and partnering with Business Analysts and technical teams to drive deployment.
* Ensuring governance-ready documentation for AI initiatives (e.g., use-case documentation, assumptions, controls/approvals tracking, change management and adoption plans) in line with Risk and enterprise standards.
* Serving as a primary liaison between the Risk India Leader and internal partners, ensuring consistent stakeholder communication, alignment, and execution across initiatives.

**Required Skills/Knowledge**

* Bachelor's degree in business, Finance, Information Technology, Data/Analytics, or related discipline with 3–5 years of project/program delivery experience preferably within financial services, risk, analytics, or technology transformation or in lieu of a degree 5-7 years of project/program delivery experience preferably within financial services, risk, analytics, or technology transformation
* Minimum 3 to 5 years of progressive project management experience, preferably within financial services, risk management, or a regulated environment. Demonstrated experience working as a Business Analyst or in process digitization/automation projects is strongly preferred. Proven track record of managing complex projects with multiple stakeholders and cross-functional teams.
* Demonstrated experience delivering process automation and AI-enabled solutions (Machine Learning, AI, GenAI), — with the ability to assess business ideas, translate them into solution requirements, and recommend an appropriate technology approach/use-case mapping in partnership with Analytics and Technology teams.
* Experience supporting delivery of AI/GenAI or advanced analytics initiatives (e.g., use-case intake, execution tracking, adoption/change support), working with Data/Analytics and Technology partners.
* Strong ability to work with senior leaders, manage multiple priorities, and drive execution across cross-functional teams with clear governance and follow-through.
* Advanced PowerPoint skills for executive storytelling (status, decisions needed, risks/issues, outcomes/value).
* Expert knowledge of building Tableau dashboards and delivery/value tracking; comfortable working with data and defining metrics.
* Proficiency with project management and Agile delivery tools (e.g., Jira/Confluence, MS Project/Smartsheet) and familiarity with Agile ways of working.
* Excellent organization, communication, and stakeholder management skills; able to influence without authority and keep teams aligned.
* Proven ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with discretion and sound judgment.
* Experience delivering stakeholder engagement initiatives such as Learning & Development, events, leadership visits/offsites, or communications cadence (as applicable to role scope).

**Desired Characteristics**

* Exposure to Risk governance and controls relevant to AI/GenAI (e.g., model risk concepts, validation/approvals, documentation standards), without needing to be a deep technical expert.
* Experience with process automation / workflow tooling such as Microsoft Power Platform (Power Automate/Power Apps).
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to define success metrics, track adoption/value realization, and synthesize insights for leadership.
* Experience operating in a highly regulated environment with compliance/audit considerations and evidence-based delivery.
