title: Trust & Privacy Program Mgr., Devices & Services Trust, Privacy, and Accessibility (TPA)
description:
**Description**
Devices & Services Trust, Privacy and Accessibility (DSTPA) is responsible for maintaining and raising the trust bar for Amazon customers across a diverse set of 30+ Devices and Services. We offer horizontal services for builders to ensure trust, privacy, and accessibility is built into our products and services. We also build customer-facing capabilities that provide customers with control and transparency while reducing trust risks, and enable partner teams to innovate with appropriate guardrails for privacy, safety and appropriateness, creative content, fairness, veracity, security, and accessibility.
  
  
The DSTPA team is seeking a Program Manager to join our Trust Review & Incident Management team. In this role, you will own high-impact, cross-functional programs that advance trust, privacy, and enablement across our products and services. You will build and manage the program plan, map dependencies across teams, surface risks early, and keep stakeholders aligned on a shared bar and timeline. You will use data to drive insights and decisions, and you will partner across the organization to turn ambiguous problems into clear, executable plans. This is a high-impact, high-visibility position that directly contributes to maintaining customer trust and regulatory compliance.
  
  
A successful candidate will have an established background driving a complex program portfolio with considerable impact, excellent program-management, problem-solving, and communication skills, and be comfortable interacting with technical and non-technical stakeholders at all levels. The candidate should have a history of driving deep insights from complex data, possess business judgment including the acumen to quickly assess the viability of key decisions, the ability to write compelling business documents, and drive outcomes for senior leadership. The ability to influence cross-functionally and across the organization, at all levels, will be absolutely critical to success in this role.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Own and drive end-to-end, high-impact programs: define scope, milestones, and success metrics, and translate goals into an executable roadmap with clear owners
* Map and manage cross-team dependencies, identify risks and blockers early, and drive them to resolution before they affect delivery
* Collaborate with Engineering, Product, Operations, Legal, and Privacy teams to ensure timely deliverables for key projects and initiatives
* Analyze data and dive deep into processes to derive business-critical insights for improving systems and workflows
* Write compelling business documents (narratives, status reports, escalation briefs) and drive outcomes for senior leadership
* Keep stakeholders aligned through clear written status and decision documents, and hold partner teams accountable to shared commitments
* Identify process improvements and opportunities to scale and automate, building a data-oriented culture within the team
* Communicate program status, risks, and blockers clearly and escalate as needed to keep delivery on track

A day in the life
  
  
As a Program Manager on the Trust Review & Incident Management team, you will work on high-impact, high-visibility programs that directly impact our customers. You will ideate, analyze data, generate insights, develop proofs of concept, write compelling business cases, and gain agreement from leaders across levels and functions to implement solutions. You will collaborate with leaders from cross-functional teams — including trust, privacy, accessibility, security, engineering, legal, and product — to drive programs from ideation to implementation effectively.
  
  
**About The Team**
Trust Review & Incident Management (TRIM) is a horizontal organization within Devices & Services Trust, Privacy, and Accessibility (TPA) responsible for building the technologies, programs, and services at Amazon scale that instill and grow customer trust, create mechanisms to attain ever-evolving regulatory objectives, and ensure our partners can meet their trust obligations without disruption. We value collaboration, continuous learning, and operational excellence, and we support new members across a broad mix of experience levels and tenures in an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 2+ years of program or project management experience
* 3+ years of Computerized Maintenance Management System program experience
* 3+ years of maintenance planner/scheduler in industrial maintenance, manufacturing, or distribution industries experience
* 3+ years of advanced Microsoft Word and Excel experience
* Bachelor's degree in relevant field, or 2+ years of Amazon RME (BB/3P) full time experience
* Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Knowledge of Lean principles and DMAIC methodology
* Experience in MS Access and SQL
* Experience in requirement gathering and ability to write clear and detailed requirement document
* Experience using Microsoft Projects software
* Experience with material handling systems (MHS) installation, operation and maintenance
* Experience working in an analytical environment with cross-functional teams

description:
**About AbleCredit**
AbleCredit has built a foundational AI platform to help BFSI enterprises reduce OPEX by up to 70% by powering workflows for onboarding, claims, credit, and collections. Our GenAI model achieves over 95% accuracy in understanding Indian dialects and excels in financial analysis.
  
  
The company was founded in June 2023 by Utkarsh Apoorva (IIT Delhi, built Reshamandi, Guitarstreet, Edulabs); Harshad Saykhedkar (IIT Bombay, ex-AI Lead at Slack); and Ashwini Prabhu (IIML, co-founder of Mythiksha, ex-Product Head at Reshamandi, HandyTrain).
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for an Implementation Manager to lead end to end onboarding and deployment for our customers. The role will own requirement gathering, solution configuration, stakeholder coordination, UAT, go live, and implementation success.
  
  
**What You Will Do?**

* Own end to end implementation and onboarding for enterprise customers.
* Understand customer workflows, business requirements, operational challenges, and success criteria.
* Lead requirement workshops, solution walkthroughs, implementation planning, and stakeholder alignment.
* Configure workflows, questionnaires, user journeys, roles, rules, and customer specific setups.
* Coordinate integrations, UAT, pilot launches, production rollout, and post go live stabilisation.
* Work closely with Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and technology teams.
* Manage project plans, dependencies, risks, blockers, timelines, and delivery milestones.
* Troubleshoot functional issues, identify root causes, and coordinate timely resolution.
* Provide structured project updates, trackers, meeting notes, and escalation communication.
* Conduct customer training and ensure a smooth handover to Customer Success after go-live.

**What You Need to Succeed?**

* 4-7 years of experience in SaaS implementation, product implementation, solution consulting, technical account management, or enterprise onboarding.
* Experience working with banks, NBFCs, HFCs, fintech companies, or enterprise SaaS customers.
* Strong understanding of lending workflows, onboarding journeys, credit processes, or financial services operations.
* Basic understanding of APIs, JSON, webhooks, integrations, data flows, and SaaS configurations.
* Ability to translate business requirements into clear implementation and technical actions.
* Strong project management, stakeholder management, problem solving, and escalation management skills.
* Structured written and verbal communication.
* Comfortable managing multiple complex implementations in a fast paced environment.
* Willingness to travel for customer workshops, launches, or go live when required.

Skills:- Onboarding, Planning, Project coordination, Product configuration, System integration, Stakeholder management, Saas implementation, API, JSON, Webhooks, Workflow configuration, BFSI, Fintech, NBFC, Implementation, product implementation and implementation planning

**Job Description:**
**The Future Begins Here:**
At Takeda, we are leading digital evolution and global transformation. By building innovative solutions and future-ready capabilities, we are meeting the need of patients, our people, and the planet.
  
  
Bengaluru, the city, which is India’s epicenter of Innovation, has been selected to be home to Takeda’s recently launched Innovation Capability Center. We invite you to join our digital transformation journey. In this role, you will have the opportunity to boost your skills and become the heart of an innovative engine that is contributing to global impact and improvement.
  
  
**At Takeda’s GCC we Unite in Diversity:**
Takeda is committed to creating an inclusive and collaborative workplace, where individuals are recognized for their backgrounds and abilities they bring to our company. We are continuously improving our collaborators journey in Takeda, and we welcome applications from all qualified candidates. Here, you will feel welcomed, respected, and valued as an important contributor to our diverse team
**About the Role :**
Drive integrated planning and delivery for prioritized initiatives supporting the MedEx transformation portfolio.
  
  
Translate priorities into executable roadmap, coordinated workplans and transparent governance.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities:**
**Program delivery and governance:**

* Own the integrated roadmap, milestones, critical path, dependencies, RAID log, decisions and benefits plan across the MedEx portfolio.
* Run planning, governance and portfolio review cadences with clear decision requirements, quorum and documented outcomes.
* Coordinate delivery across GCM, Global Medical, Digital, Finance, HR, Procurement and external partners.
* Operate scope and change control so baseline changes to scope, schedule or cost are assessed, approved and traceable.

**Execution discipline and performance:**

* Convert strategic priorities into scoped initiatives with owners, resource plans, acceptance criteria and measurable outcomes.
* Track delivery health against schedule, cost and quality baselines; resolve cross-workstream issues and escalate material risks early.
* Manage resource demand, capacity and vendor performance; maintain stakeholder and communication plans for each release.
* Maintain clear documentation, status reporting and audit-ready traceability for leadership and governance forums.

**Value, benefits and improvement:**

* Support business cases, investment tracking and benefit realization against agreed KPIs and value targets.
* Standardize program templates, tooling and metrics; embed data- and AI-enabled delivery practices.
* Run retrospectives, capture lessons learned and continuously simplify portfolio execution.
* Apply data- and AI-enabled delivery practices within enterprise data, privacy and AI-governance requirements.

**Dimensions and Aspects:**

* **Technical expertise:**
  Applies program-management practices to manage roadmaps, milestones, dependencies, risks, resources, benefits, and change control.
* **Leadership:**
  Coordinates global, cross-functional teams and drives delivery through clear communication, governance, and follow-up.
* **Decision-making:**
  Recommends actions within agreed scope, resolves delivery issues, and escalates material risks and decisions requiring leadership input.
* **Interaction:**
  Partners with Medical, GCM, Digital, Finance, HR, Procurement, regional teams, and external vendors.
* **Innovation:**
  Improves portfolio visibility and execution through practical templates, tools, reporting, data, and AI-enabled practices.
* **Complexity:**
  Manages multiple interdependent workstreams, changing priorities, cross-geography teams, resource constraints, and competing delivery requirements.
* **Impact:**
  Enables timely, transparent, and disciplined delivery of the GCM transformation portfolio, supporting benefits realization and business continuity.
* **Scope:**
  Global portfolio scope; no direct reports; coordinates assigned resources, vendors, and budgets within approved authority.

**Qualifications :**

* **Experience:**
  6-8 years leading programs or transformation delivery, including 2+ years running a multi-workstream portfolio in a global, matrixed or capability-center environment; Medical Affairs or life-sciences experience preferred.
* **Education:**
  Degree in business, life sciences, engineering or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
* **Certifications:**
  PMP, PRINCE2, PgMP or equivalent program certification preferred; Agile/SAFe and Lean Six Sigma exposure aplus.
* **Technical skills:**
  Integrated roadmap and dependency planning, RAID and change control, resource and capacity planning,benefits tracking, executive reporting; proficient with enterprise PPM and collaboration tooling.
* **Governance:**
  Ability to advance AI-enabled and agentic ways of working within scientific, quality and compliance controls.

**BENEFITS:**
It is our priority to provide competitive compensation and a benefit package that bridges your personal life with your professional career. Amongst our benefits are
  
  

* Competitive Salary + Performance Annual Bonus
* Flexible work environment, including hybrid working
* Comprehensive Healthcare Insurance Plans for self, spouse, and children
* Group Term Life Insurance and Group Accident Insurance programs
* Employee Assistance Program
* Broad Variety of learning platforms
* Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Programs
* Reimbursements – Home Internet & Mobile Phone
* Employee Referral Program
* Leaves – Paternity Leave (4 Weeks) , Maternity Leave (up to 26 weeks), Bereavement Leave (5 calendar days)

* Takeda is leading a digital revolution. We’re not just transforming our company; we’re improving the lives of millions of patients who rely on our medicines every day.
* As an organization, we are committed to our cloud-driven business transformation and believe the GCCs are the catalysts of change for our global organization.

title: Hardware Program Manager, Sr
description:
**Company**
Qualcomm India Private Limited
  
  
**Job Area**
Engineering Services Group, Engineering Services Group > Program Management
  
  
**General Summary**
Develops, defines, and executes plans of record, including: schedules, budgets, resources, deliverables, and risks. Monitors and drives the program from initiation through delivery, interfacing with internal and external stakeholders across functions on technical matters, as needed. Monitors budget/spending, on-time delivery, and achievement of program milestones. Represents the program and drives alignment across stakeholders.
  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
* 5+ years of Program Management or related work experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
* PMP Certification.
* 10+ years of Program Management or related work experience.
* 5+ years of work experience in a role requiring interaction with senior leadership (e.g., Director level and above).
* 3+ years of experience working in a large matrixed organization.
* 2+ years of experience with program management tools such as dashboards, Gantt charts, etc.

**Principal Duties And Responsibilities**

* Collaborates with key stakeholders and program sponsors to develop program goals, set the prioritization of deliverables, discuss involvement of business processes (e.g., program change management, communication) and drives decisions necessary for on time delivery.
* Manages and takes responsibility for multiple medium sized programs/technology with moderate complexity by applying up-to-date program management knowledge to meet deadlines.
* Develops and manages the execution of the program Plan of Record (e.g., on time, on budget, within scope) for multiple medium sized programs which include schedule and resource forecasting, stakeholders identification, method and frequency of communication, scope, and prioritization.
* Establishes key program metrics and manages team to take action outside their comfort zone to ensure program success when metrics deviate from Plan of Record.
* Identifies and secures resources to ensure alignment of team with program/technology demand for multiple medium sized programs with moderate complexity.
* Drives teams to identify program issues/risks, and create a risk mitigation plan for multiple medium sized or a single complex program(s). Maintains and updates the risk tracker.
* Promotes program vision and objectives within the team, ensures program objectives are met or exceeded, presents program vision to management, and gains buy-in from stakeholders.
* Promotes adoption of processes by applying best practices and identifying and executing process improvement initiatives across the Program Management team.

**Level Of Responsibility**

* Working independently with little supervision.
* Making decisions that are significant in impact; errors are not readily apparent due to the complexity of work process/product or time between decisions and results; errors typically result in significant expenditure of time, resources, and funds to correct.
* Using verbal and written communication skills to convey complex and/or detailed information to multiple individuals/audiences with differing knowledge levels. May require strong negotiation and influence, communication to large groups or high-level constituents.
* Having a moderate amount of influence over key organizational decisions (e.g., is consulted by senior leadership to provide input on key decisions).
* Completing tasks that require multiple steps that can be performed in various orders; tasks require simultaneously executing multiple cognitive abilities and maintaining information in short- or long-term memory.
* Exercising exceptional creativity to innovate new ideas and develop innovative products/processes without established objectives or known parameters.
* Using deductive and inductive problem solving; multiple approaches may be taken/necessary to solve the problem; often information is missing or conflicting; advanced data analysis and interpretation skills are required.
* Occasionally participates in strategic planning within own area affecting immediate operations.

**The Responsibilities Of This Role Do Not Include**

* Financial accountability (e.g., does not involve budgeting responsibility).

title: SAP PMO - Senior Associate
description:
The Opportunity
  
  
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
  
  
As a SAP PMO - Senior Associate, you will play a pivotal role in overseeing and managing large-scale SAP implementation projects, working closely with business leaders, project managers, and technical teams to define objectives, develop plans, allocate resources, and monitor progress. Within our Digital Core Modernisation practice, you will coordinate multiple projects and stakeholders to enable successful delivery of SAP solutions, helping clients optimize operational efficiency and achieve strategic objectives.
  
  
As a Senior Associate, you will focus on building meaningful client connections and learning how to manage and inspire others. You will navigate increasingly complex situations, growing your personal brand and deepening your technical skills. You are expected to anticipate the needs of your teams and clients, delivering quality work while embracing increased ambiguity. In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will utilize a broad range of tools and methodologies to generate new ideas and solve problems, interpret data to inform insights, and uphold professional and technical standards. This position offers a unique opportunity to develop a deeper understanding of the business context and how it is evolving.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Overseeing large-scale SAP implementation projects to align with strategic objectives
* Collaborating with business leaders and technical teams to define project goals and develop comprehensive plans
* Allocating resources effectively to support seamless integration and utilization of SAP solutions
* Monitoring project progress and mitigating risks to validate successful delivery
* Coordinating multiple projects and stakeholders to achieve program milestones
* Utilizing analytical thinking and program management skills to optimize operational efficiency
* Implementing continuous process improvement methodologies to enhance project outcomes
* Leveraging tools like Microsoft Project and Jira Software for efficient project tracking and reporting
* Facilitating cross-functional team coordination to drive project success
* Developing business cases and managing project budgets to support financial objectives

What You Must Have
  
  

* At least a Bachelor's degree
* At least 2 years of experience
* Oral and written proficiency in English required

What Sets You Apart
  
  

* Utilizing Agile Methodology for efficient project management
* Excelling in Business Case Development and Benefits Realization Management
* Demonstrating proficiency in SAP Project Management and Program Planning
* Leveraging Jira Software and Microsoft Project for project tracking
* Coordinating cross-functional teams to achieve project goals
* Engaging stakeholders through effective communication strategies
* Embracing change and fostering a culture of continuous improvement

title: Project Manager
description:
Job Title: Project Manager – Civil, MEP & Interior Fit-Outs

**Experience:** 8–10 Years

**Reporting To:** Director

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Function:** Project Management & Site Execution

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Project Manager with 8 to 10 years of hands-on experience in civil construction, complemented by strong execution knowledge across MEP (Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing) services and commercial/corporate interior fit-outs. **Reporting directly to the Director**, this role owns end-to-end project planning, scheduling (using MS Project and Primavera P6), site coordination, vendor/contractor management, and timely project handover while ensuring strict adherence to quality, safety, and budget baselines.

Key Responsibilities1. Project Planning, Scheduling & Management Reporting (MSP & Primavera P6)

* Develop, baseline, and maintain detailed Master Construction Schedules, micro-schedules, and look-ahead plans using **MS Project (MSP)** and **Primavera P6**.
* Define Work Breakdown Structures (WBS), critical paths, dependencies, resource loading, and milestone trackers across civil, MEP, and fit-out phases.
* Conduct regular schedule variance analysis, identify delays early, and present recovery/catch-up plans and weekly executive MIS dashboards **to the Director**.

2. Site Execution & Multi-Disciplinary Coordination

* Lead end-to-end site execution for core civil works, MEP installations (HVAC, electrical, firefighting, plumbing, BMS), and interior fit-outs (partitions, ceilings, flooring, joinery, finishes).
* Ensure seamless sequencing and clash resolution between civil, MEP, and interior finishing contractors to prevent rework and bottlenecks.
* Interpret architectural, structural, and MEP shop drawings, raising RFIs (Requests for Information) and coordinating design clarifications with consultants and clients.

3. Cost, BOQ & Contractor Management

* Review Bills of Quantities (BOQs), technical specifications, and vendor/contractor bids to ensure scope completeness, **submitting cost comparisons and recommendations to the Director for approval**.
* Track project budgets, validate contractor RA (Running Account) bills, monitor material reconciliation, and control extra items/variations.
* Drive subcontractor performance, enforce SLAs, and conduct weekly site progress reviews with documented Minutes of Meeting (MoMs).

4. Quality Assurance, EHS & Handover

* Implement Quality Assurance/Quality Control (QA/QC) checklists, material inspections, and testing & commissioning protocols for MEP and fit-out systems.
* Enforce Environmental, Health, and Safety (EHS) compliance across all site teams and subcontractors.
* Manage snagging/de-snagging, as-built documentation, statutory approvals, and smooth client handover.

Qualifications & Skills Required

* **Education:** B.E. / B.Tech or Diploma in Civil Engineering (PMP or NICMAR certification is an added advantage).
* **Experience:** 8–10 years in civil construction with proven execution experience in commercial/office interior fit-outs and MEP coordination.
* **Technical Tools:** Hands-on proficiency in **MS Project (MSP)**, **Primavera P6**, AutoCAD (drawing review), and MS Excel.
* **Core Competencies:** Strong command of construction sequencing, billing/BOQ verification, executive reporting, vendor negotiation, and site risk management.

Languages to be known:

Telugu,Hindi, English & Tamil

Pay: ₹700,000.00 - ₹1,000,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

**SAP PMO Manager**

• Employment: Full-time, permanent

**Communication first:**
You will be the delivery voice for US clients every day, on status calls, escalations and steering updates. We screen for clear, confident spoken and written English at every interview stage, and we hire only when it is excellent.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

Stellite Works delivers SAP programs for US clients from our Hyderabad center. As PMO Manager, you run the machinery behind that delivery: the people, the timelines and the governance. You lead the India team onsite, keep every project on its plan, run the PMO routines, and act as the day-to-day delivery contact for US clients during their business hours.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**People**

• Lead the India delivery team onsite: allocation across projects, utilization, performance conversations, coaching and backfills.

• Run daily stand-ups and regular one-to-ones, and clear blockers before they reach the client.

• Work with recruiting on requirements, interviews and onboarding when the team needs to grow.

**Timelines and Delivery**

• Build and maintain project plans with milestones, dependencies and named owners, and track progress against them daily.

• Flag slippage early with a recovery plan; escalate with facts and options, never surprises.

• Track effort against approved budgets and raise a change request for anything outside scope.

**PMO Activities**

• Run the PMO toolkit for each engagement: RAID log, decision log, resource plan, deliverable tracker and formal change control.

• Produce weekly status reports and monthly steering packs that leadership can send onward without rework.

• Keep SAP delivery stages on schedule: quality gates, test cycles, cutover planning and go-live readiness.

**US Client Management**

• Be the delivery point of contact for US clients: weekly status calls, escalation calls and steering updates, with crisp minutes and reliable follow-through.

title: Technical Program Manager, GDO Tooling
description:
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in program management.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in technical program management, software engineering, or technical operations.
* Demonstrated experience building, working with, and deploying AI agents and LLM-based technologies (e.g., ADK, Jetski, etc.).
* Experience managing tooling security, access controls, and governance (including WTPs, MDB groups, and access management platforms).
* Experience leading cross-functional projects and managing relationships across Engineering, Operations, and global Program Management teams.

**About The Job**
A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.
  
  
The Geo Data Operations (GDO) Tools team is focused on building the next generation of operational tooling to scale Google Maps and Geo data production. We are looking for a highly technical, AI-forward Technical Program Manager (TPM) to drive our transition toward machine-led operations and agentic workflows, while ensuring our systems maintain the highest standards of security and access governance.
  
  
In this role, you will sit at the intersection of AI innovation, security, and operational excellence. You will not only manage complex, cross-functional programs but will also be technically in designing and implementing AI agents to solve operational pain points. Additionally, you will own critical aspects of our tooling security, ensuring that access controls, and automation, and data governance scale securely alongside our AI investments.
  
  
The Geo team is focused on building the most accurate, comprehensive, and useful maps for our users, through products like Maps, Earth, Street View, Google Maps Platform, and more. Every month, more than a billion people rely on Maps services to explore the world and navigate their daily lives.
  
  
The Geo team also enables developers to use the power of Google Maps platforms to enhance their apps and websites. As they plot a course for the future of mapping, they are solving complex computer science problems, designing beautiful and intuitive product experiences, and improving our understanding of the real world.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Work with the global Program Manager (PgM) team to develop and deliver AI Automation projects from conception to implementation, and seamlessly manage relationships across engineering and operations.
* Be direct with AI technologies (including Jetski, ADK, Gemini, and custom agents) to actively build solutions that solve complex operational pain points and automate manual workflows.
* Lead tooling security initiatives, bringing a deep understanding of access governance, including the management, auditing, and implementation of Workflow Team Policies (WTPs) and MDB groups.
* Act as the connective tissue between Operations, global PgMs, and Engineering. Translate operational bottlenecks into technical requirements and agentic workflows.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

title: Project Manager - Project Controls
description:
**Company Overview**
Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. Milestone is focused on building an employee-first, performance-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. Milestone culture is built to provide a collaborative, inclusive environment that supports employees and empowers them to reach their full potential.
  
  
Our seasoned professionals deliver services based on Milestone’s best practices and service delivery framework. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short-term and long-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.
  
  
**Job Overview**
**Project Manager - Project Controls**
**Required 5 Days Onsite Hyderabad Covering US Hours**
Milestone is seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Project Controls Business Analyst / Project Manager to support the financial, operational, and governance activities across a portfolio of Information Systems (IS) projects and programs. This role serves as a critical liaison between Project Managers, Portfolio Managers, Technology Leadership, Finance, Procurement, and external vendors to ensure accurate financial forecasting, project reporting, budget management, and portfolio governance.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines strong project controls expertise with business analysis, financial management, and PMO support capabilities. The role requires hands-on ownership of project financials, purchase order management, forecasting, vendor tracking, status reporting, and project governance activities while helping ensure alignment between project execution and broader organizational financial objectives.
  
  
This is a tactical execution-focused position that works directly with project and program teams to maintain financial discipline, reporting accuracy, and operational excellence across a diverse technology portfolio.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Project Financial Management & Controls**

* Develop and maintain project budgets, forecasts, and cost estimates for IS initiatives.
* Build and manage quarterly and ad hoc project financial forecasts.
* Monitor project expenditures and ensure spend aligns with approved budgets and forecasts.
* Track and manage Capital Expenditures (CapEx) and Operational Expenditures (OpEx).
* Maintain project balance sheets and assist with financial reconciliation activities.
* Support monthly and quarterly financial close processes.
* Create and maintain cost tracking models and financial dashboards.
* Analyze project financial performance and identify budget variances, risks, and cost-saving opportunities.
* Prepare and present financial reports for project teams, leadership, and portfolio stakeholders.
* Support Long-Range Estimates (LEs) and financial planning activities.
* Prepare and maintain Total Cost Management (TCM) reports and related financial controls documentation.
* Understand and communicate how project financials impact departmental budgets and overall P&L performance.

**Procurement, Vendor & Invoice Management**

* Create, submit, and track Purchase Orders (POs) throughout the procurement lifecycle.
* Partner with Procurement, Accounts Payable, and vendors to ensure timely PO processing and invoice payments.
* Review Statements of Work (SOWs), change orders, contract amendments, and vendor funding requests.
* Monitor vendor invoices for accuracy and alignment to contractual agreements.
* Investigate and resolve invoice discrepancies and payment issues.
* Conduct monthly vendor spend reviews and validate vendor cost reporting across multiple suppliers.
* Track committed costs versus actual expenditures and identify financial risks.
* Support vendor onboarding and purchasing processes using established company policies and procedures.

**Project Controls & Portfolio Governance**

* Establish and maintain project financial controls and governance processes.
* Monitor project performance metrics, budget adherence, resource allocations, and financial health indicators.
* Ensure project data, documentation, and reporting artifacts remain current and audit-ready.
* Maintain project repositories, PMO documentation, governance records, and portfolio data.
* Support project intake, funding approvals, and investment lifecycle management (ILM) activities.
* Ensure compliance with enterprise project management standards, processes, and controls.

**PMO & Program Support**

* Facilitate weekly and bi-weekly meetings with Project Managers, Program Managers, Portfolio Managers, and IS Leadership.
* Support program governance activities, reviews, and steering committee preparation.
* Coordinate status collection, reporting cycles, action items, decisions, and risk tracking.
* Review, maintain, and enhance project dashboards and portfolio reporting.
* Assist in the preparation and delivery of executive-level presentations and status communications.
* Manage project documentation repositories, PMO vaults, and project records.
* Support resource planning, project prioritization, and portfolio visibility initiatives.

**Reporting & Analytics**

* Prepare monthly project and portfolio dashboards highlighting budget, forecast, risks, milestones, and overall health.
* Create executive reporting packages and management presentations.
* Develop financial analyses that support strategic decision-making.
* Produce recurring and ad hoc reports related to project performance, vendor performance, financial trends, and portfolio metrics.
* Analyze complex data sets and present findings in a clear, business-focused format.
* Recommend process improvements to increase reporting accuracy and operational efficiency.

**Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Partner closely with IS Leaders, Finance teams, Project Managers, Portfolio Managers, Procurement, and vendor partners.
* Build strong relationships with business and technical stakeholders.
* Facilitate discussions regarding budgets, forecasts, funding requests, prioritization, and project performance.
* Communicate project financial risks, assumptions, and recommendations to leadership.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, Project Management, or related field, or equivalent work experience.
* 12+ years of experience supporting IT/IS projects in a Financial Analyst, Project Controls Analyst, Project Coordinator, Project Manager, PMO Analyst, or Business Analyst capacity.
* Experience managing project budgets, forecasting, financial reporting, and procurement processes.
* Working knowledge of project management methodologies, including Agile and Waterfall.
* Strong understanding of project financial controls, budgeting, CapEx, OpEx, and cost management practices.
* Experience with vendor management, purchase orders, invoices, contracts, and SOW administration.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookups, financial modeling, and reporting automation.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* PMP, CAPM, PMI-PBA, Agile, Scrum, or related certifications.
* Experience supporting enterprise technology portfolios or PMO organizations.
* Experience with financial planning, portfolio management, and investment governance processes.
* Knowledge of IT financial management and technology investment practices.
* Experience working within large-scale infrastructure, digital transformation, ERP, cloud, or application development programs.

**Required Tools & Technologies**

* Microsoft Excel (Advanced)
* Microsoft Office Suite (Word, PowerPoint, Outlook)
* Microsoft 365 / O365
* SAP
* Ariba
* Annaplan
* Smartsheet
* Microsoft Teams
* Power BI (preferred)
* SharePoint
* Project and Portfolio Management (PPM) tools

**Compensation**
Estimated Pay Range:
  
  
Exact compensation and offers of employment are dependent on circumstances of each case and will be determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, licenses or certifications, and location.

title: Salesforce-Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.

Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.

The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.

We are looking for an experienced Salesforce Manager who can lead end-to-end solution delivery across the Salesforce ecosystem. The ideal candidate will guide development teams, work closely with business stakeholders, and ensure scalable, secure, and high-performing Salesforce implementations across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and custom applications.

* translate requirements into technical solutions.

* change management processes.
* Manage project risks, dependencies, budget, stakeholders, and release
* timelines.

**Team Leadership & Mentorship**

* Conduct technical capability assessments and drive continuous learning in areas like Apex, LWC, integrations, and Salesforce certifications.
* Guide junior team members on troubleshooting, performance tuning, design decisions, and platform best practices.

**Business & Stakeholder Management**

* Act as the technical liaison between business teams and the engineering team.
* Run design workshops, solution walkthroughs, and architecture discussions with customers/stakeholders.
* Support pre-sales, effort estimation, solution demonstrations, and project scoping.

**Operational Excellence**

* Ensure high-quality documentation for architecture, integrations, data flows, and technical builds.
* Drive improvement initiatives around DevOps, CI/CD, testing automation, and org optimization.
* Troubleshoot and resolve production issues, performance bottlenecks, and integration failures.
* Maintain compliance with Salesforce security, data governance, and architectural guidelines.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* 8–15 years of overall IT experience with a minimum of 5+ years leading
* Salesforce projects.

**Deep technical expertise in:**

* Apex, Triggers, SOQL/SOSL
* Lightning Web Components (LWC) & Aura
* Flows, Process Builder (retirement-ready), and declarative tools
* Salesforce APIs (REST/SOAP), Platform Events, Integration Patterns
* Data modeling, large datasets, and performance optimization
* Strong understanding of Salesforce architecture, multi-org strategy, governor
* limits, sharing/security model, and deployment processes.
* Hands-on experience with Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and
* ideally field service or CPQ.
* Strong experience with Agile/Scrum, backlog management, user stories, and sprint planning.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, documentation, and leadership skills.

**Preferred Certifications**

* Salesforce Certified Platform Developer I
* Salesforce Certified Platform Developer II
* Salesforce Certified Application Architect or System Architect (highly preferred)
* Salesforce Administrator / Advanced Administrator
* Project management certifications (PMP, CSM, SAFe) are an added advantage.

**Nice-to-Have**

* Experience with CI/CD tools (Copado, Gearset, Azure DevOps, Git).
* Experience working with integration platforms such as MuleSoft, Boomi, or Kafka.
* Experience managing multi-cloud Salesforce implementations.
* Exposure to enterprise integration patterns, security standards, SSO, OAuth, and Identity.
* Experience guiding org consolidation, technical debt remediation, and modernization initiatives.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment:**

Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
Professional Development: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.

Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.

title: Government Partnerships Manager Hyderabad, Telangana
description:
**About the job Government Partnerships Manager Hyderabad, Telangana**
**Role: Government Partnerships Manager Hyderabad, Telangana
  
  
Experience: 5-8 years
  
  
Salary band: upto 12 LPA
  
  
Location: Hyderabad, Telangana
  
  
**Note: Female candidates who are Telugu-speaking are preferred for this role.****
**About The Role**
Telangana has made significant progress in expanding access to higher education for young women, and female enrolment now exceeds male enrolment in the state. The challenge has increasingly shifted from access to livelihood outcomes: an estimated 52% of women graduates in Telangana remain unemployed after graduating, compared to 37% nationally. As Government Partnerships Manager, you will build and lead the State-level Girls' Education, Employment & Livelihood Cell within the Commissionerate of Collegiate Education (CCE), Government of Telangana. Your mandate is to turn policy into measurable placement, apprenticeship, and economic outcomes for young women across Government Degree Colleges, and to build an institutional model that CCE will fully own and run within five years.
  
  
**Role And Responsibilities**

* Governance & Institutional Set-up
* Serve as the primary day-to-day point of contact between our organization and CCE, including the Commissioner's office and designated Nodal Officer.
* Manage day-to-day Cell operations and CCE departmental requests, using routine administrative deliverables to build institutional credibility while keeping the Cell anchored on student livelihood outcomes.
* Establish clear escalation pathways and operational protocols across Government Degree Colleges to ensure seamless execution of Cell initiatives.
* Planning & Programme Management
* Lead development of the Annual Girls' Action Plan in collaboration with CCE.
* Drive the Programme Convergence Framework to align CCE's existing partners and initiatives.
* Manage the PMU's work plan and team against the agreed implementation roadmap.
* Oversee early programme piloting in the initial cohort of colleges.
* Partnerships & Ecosystem Development
* Build and maintain the Partnership Ecosystem Map of CCE's existing girls-focused interventions.
* Fulfil CCE's partnership mandates while steering employer engagement beyond MoUs and events toward committed, trackable internship, apprenticeship, and placement outcomes for women graduates.
* Organise partner convenings and networking forums across government, industry, and civil-society stakeholders.
* Monitoring, Data & Reporting
* Define the Cell's output/outcome measurement framework along with the Operations Director and CCE leadership and lead the thematic, geographic, and student-level gap assessment.
* Own the design and rollout of the State-level Monitoring Dashboard. Manage CCE reporting and dashboard requirements, framing field-level gaps and college performance data as actionable risk-mitigation insights for senior leadership.
* Set up baseline data collection and the periodic reporting cadence to CCE and the Principal Secretary.
* Translate findings into policy and programme recommendations, feeding them continuously into planning and capacity-building decisions and submit them formally for CCE's review.
* Capacity Building & Government Ownership Transition
* Lead Gender-Focused Capacity Building for principals, Women's Empowerment Cell Convenors, and faculty.
* Document lessons from early pilots to inform subsequent-year planning.
* Build CCE's internal capacity to progressively assume ownership of the Cell over the engagement period.

**Role**
**What This Role Really Involves**
You will sit physically inside CCE while holding our outcome standards. That means navigating real administrative dynamics:
  
  

* Dual expectations: You will deliver on CCE's operational priorities while keeping focus on our structural metrics: livelihood outcomes, system embedding, and sustainability.
* Influence without authority: You will drive change across colleges without line authority over principals or department staff. Success depends on relationship building, strategic positioning, and aligning mutual incentives.
* Diplomatic reporting: You will surface operational gaps, such as underperforming colleges or disengaged faculty, and communicate them in ways that drive improvement without damaging key relationships.
* Institutional continuity: Government leadership rotates. You will build mechanisms, such as SOPs, automated dashboards, and embedded routines, that last through official transfers and structural change.

**Relevant Experience and Qualifications: You have/are...**

* 5–8 years of experience in program/project management, with a significant portion managing a government PMU or leading large-scale public-sector implementation.
* Experience working directly with senior state-level government officials on policy, planning, or strategic decision-making.
* A proven track record of driving policy or behavioural adoption within state-level public systems, measured by impact (such as employment rates) rather than outputs (such as the number of trainings held).
* Strong lateral leadership: the ability to influence principals, Nodal Officers, and senior officials without direct line authority.
* Skilled at turning field data into compelling briefs that help senior IAS officers make policy decisions.
* A strong background in the education, skilling, gender, or livelihood sector.
* Experience building and managing multi-stakeholder partnerships across government, industry, and civil society.
* Skilled in designing M&E frameworks, dashboards, and data-driven reporting.
* Comfortable with project management tools and digital systems.
* Strong communication in English and Telugu; Hindi is a plus.
* Willingness to travel regularly across Telangana.
* Deep alignment with our mission and a commitment to gender equity, women's economic participation, and strengthening public education systems.

**Benefits**

* A front-row seat to systems change in action with high ownership, high learning, high impact in a values-driven culture with a small but mighty team
* Generous leave package and parental leave
* Professional and personal development with the leadership team
* Written and verbal references will be provided
* A fun, passionate, high-caliber team that gives you the freedom to be brilliant
* The ability to put your talents towards a deeply meaningful mission and the opportunity to work on high-impact programs that will define the future of work for girls around the world

title: People Service Lead, Employee Success Operations - APAC
description:
**Description**
**The Experience**
The Agentic People Experience & Automation Hub (APEX) is the regional engine of Salesforce’s Global People Services & Operations, delivering an end-to-end hire-to-retire employee experience. Operating under Salesforce’s “Customer Zero” model, APEX leverages cutting-edge technology and AI agents to automate routine inquiries, empowering our team to focus on high-impact, complex resolution and high-touch support.
  
  
As an Agentic People Service Lead, Employee Success Operations - APAC, you sit at the strategic intersection of Tier 2 (T2) operational execution—spanning Benefits, Leave of Absence, Time Tracking, and Employee Relations—and regional project management. Beyond core case management, you will lead critical regional initiatives, incident responses, and compliance communications, collaborating closely with Benefits, Legal, Employee Success Business Partners, Employee Relations, and DET. Based in Hyderabad (hybrid), you will support ANZ, ASEAN and India, with working-hours overlap across APAC time zones and occasional regional travel as needed.
  
  
This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports. You’ll lead through influence, coaching peers, owning projects and acting as a delegate for the Manager.
  
  
The ideal candidate brings an AI-first mindset, exceptional organizational and communication skills, and an eagerness to lead in a fast-paced environment. You are a trusted partner capable of building cross-functional relationships at all levels, managing highly confidential HR matters with complete discretion, and driving continuous operational innovation across the region.
  
  
**What You'll Actually Be Doing**

* ES Business Operations
* Oversee daily case and inquiry handling for APAC region, covering queue health, SLAs, escalations and quality.
* Mentor and guide People Specialists on complex cases, share best practices and help maintain case quality, without formal line management
* Partner with the Manager to run team rhythms (huddles, workload allocation, coverage planning, handoffs) and act as delegate when the Manager is out of office.
* Identify trends in cases and recommend knowledge-article, process or tooling improvements.
* Act as the first point of escalation for complex T2 cases, make decisions within defined policy, and escalate high-risk or precedent-setting matters to the Manager.
* Provide regular coaching and feedback to People Specialists, and review case quality against SLA and CSAT targets.
* Use AI agents and automation to deflect routine inquiries, and feed case trends back into agent and knowledge improvements
* Project and program management (ES Business Operations)
* Plan and deliver ES initiatives end to end: scope, timelines, risks, stakeholder updates and post-launch reviews.
* Manage the APAC project pipeline and prioritization, and report status to ES leadership.
* Drive process standardization and operational readiness for new programs and policy changes.
* Act as the subject-matter reference for process and project questions within the team.
* Own delivery of assigned APAC initiatives against agreed milestones, and report progress, risks and outcomes to ES leadership
* ES compliance for ASEAN
* Support ASEAN ES compliance, including data privacy requirements, record-keeping and policy attestations, in line with local legal requirements
* Help maintain documentation, SOPs and controls so they meet local legal and company requirements.
* Run periodic quality and compliance checks, track remediation actions to closure, and work with Legal, Privacy and local HR/ER partners.
* Act as a key partner to the Global ES Compliance team, owning ASEAN inputs for audits and attestations through to closure

**You’re Our Person If...**

* 8+ years in HR operations, shared services or People Operations, including leading projects or mentoring peers with/without formal authority
* Prior experience with Workday, Peopleforce, Google Workspace and any similar HRIS is highly desirable
* Working knowledge of APAC employment practices, HR generalist and business operations, and HR compliance
* AI-First and human/agent collaboration experience and mindset
* Proven project management skills
* Sound judgment in applying HR policy to varied situations across APAC
* Strong problem-solving skills with data analysis and reporting; scripting (Google Apps Script, Python) is a plus.
* Excellent communication skills
* Proven ability to influence and align stakeholders across regions
* Ability to work in a diverse work environment with ambiguity and multiple priorities
* Ability to handle confidential matters with discretion and manage multiple priorities independently

**Even Better If...**

* Experience with Salesforce Service Cloud and Slack, plus reporting or analytics tools.
* Working knowledge of ASEAN employment and data privacy regulations (e.g. PDPA)
* You hold Certification in project management (e.g. PMP, PRINCE2)
* You hold Certification in process improvement (e.g. Six Sigma, Lean, Kaizen)

**How We’ll Measure Success**

* SLA and CSAT performance for APAC T2 cases.
* On-time delivery of regional projects.
* Timely closure of ASEAN compliance actions.
* Stakeholder feedback.

* 5+ years of people management experience
* Significant experience leading Agile business value delivery in complex, matrixed organizations

* Expert in agile metrics and utilization of metrics for continuous improvement

* Proven track record of identifying and improving Agile execution on a team

**Preferred Qualifications**

title: Senior Technical Program Manager
description:
**About Us:**
Seismic is the Go-To-Market Performance company, driving how organizations turn their strategy into revenue. Seismic brings together signals from customer conversations, buyer engagement, governed content, coaching and seller behavior to turn intelligence into winning action. Through its AI revenue execution platform, the company equips customer-facing teams with the insights, governance, and contextual guidance they need to execute with confidence and deliver measurable business outcomes. Trusted by 2,500 organizations and over 3.5 million users around the globe, Seismic is headquartered in San Diego with offices across North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific. Learn more at seismic.com.
  
  
Seismic is committed to building an inclusive workplace that ignites growth for our employees and creates a culture of belonging that allows all employees to be seen and valued for who they are. Learn more about DEI at Seismic here.
  
  
**Overview:**
**About The Role**
We're hiring a Senior Technical Program Manager for our Product & Engineering organization. You'll own two areas:
  
  

* Product delivery and release readiness for Seismic software (including Highspot by Seismic): making sure features ship on time, at quality, with go-to-market teams ready on day one.
* Technical programs that span teams, such as localization workflows, architecture upgrades, and other technical initiatives.

You'll work across Engineering, Product, Design, Product Marketing and customer-facing teams. You'll turn ambitious goals into clear plans, make tradeoffs visible, and keep programs moving without needing formal authority.
  
  
**Who you are:**
**Required**

* 5+ years as a Technical Program Manager or in a similar role in B2B SaaS, leading complex cross-functional programs.
* Experience managing the full software development lifecycle and go-to-market readiness for product launches. Critically, you have delivered not only internal projects, but you have overseen feature/product delivery to external customers.
* Deep experience with agile/scrum, and judgment about when to adapt process for a large, complex organization.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills; able to explain technical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Data-driven: you use metrics to make decisions, surface risks and measure success. You're comfortable getting data yourself with tools like Amplitude, SQL and Snowflake.
* Hands-on use of AI tools to automate workflows, speed up delivery and remove manual work. Please share examples in your application.
* Flexibility working across time zones, in particular coordinating across North America and sometimes China.

**Nice to have**

* Experience leading change management or new technology adoption across an organization.
* Experience with Jira/Confluence, LaunchDarkly, Salesforce, and sales enablement products.
* PMP, CSM, SAFe or similar certification.

**What you’ll be doing:**
**Product delivery & release readiness**

* Own end-to-end program management for a core product feature area across multiple engineering teams in different geos, keeping a predictable delivery cadence.
* Run the release readiness process: drive sign-off from Engineering, QE, Security and other functions, and make sure features are high quality and well documented.
* Partner with Product Marketing, Sales, Support and Technical Account Managers so customer-facing teams are enabled and customers are set up for success at launch.

**Technical programs**

* Lead internal and/or customer-facing technical programs from definition through delivery: set scope, build the plan, line up owners and drive adoption.
* Lead change management for new processes and tools, including stakeholder alignment, communication, training and measuring adoption.

**Across both**

* Define and track program metrics and business KPIs, and give stakeholders and leadership clear, concise status.
* Spot risks and dependencies early, raise them with options, and drive them to resolution.
* Find manual, repetitive program work and automate it, including with AI tools.

**What Success Looks Like**

* First 90 days: Own the release calendar for a major product area (to be determined), establish relationships across functions and run at least one release end to end.
* First year: Releases are predictable and GTM teams are consistently ready at launch. At least one technical program is delivered with measurable adoption.

**What we have for you:**
At Seismic, we’re committed to providing benefits and perks for the whole self. To explore our benefits available in each country, please visit the Global Benefits page.

The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Engagement Manager to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you will lead delivery quality and velocity for programs spanning several concurrent workstreams, orchestrating 50+ person teams of AWS builders, partners, and customers to deliver transformational AI, data, and enterprise modernization outcomes for the world's leading HCLS organizations.
  
  
Your objective will be to deliver distinctive customer business outcomes and experience. In doing so, you will lead the implementation of AWS delivery innovations with customers, including re-designing software development processes to become AI-native end-to-end (“AI-DLC”). This is an opportunity to shape the future of the industry directly through hands-on transformation leadership.

We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.

title: Project Manager
description:
**Overview**
Cactus Life Sciences partners with the global biopharma industry to drive innovation and elevate patient outcomes through agile, science-driven medical communications. We transform complex data into actionable insights, bridging the critical gaps between research, decision-making, and real-world healthcare impact. As a growing scientific communications agency, we are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive Project Manager to manage the successful execution of internal projects and coordination with external collaborators. This role is critical in ensuring timely delivery, budget adherence, and compliance across all project stages.
  
  
Please Note: We are a remote-first organization, and we embrace an "accelerate from
  
  
anywhere culture". You may be required to travel to our Mumbai office based on business requirements or for company/team events.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Manage end-to-end execution of projects ensuring on-time, on-budget, and high-quality delivery using project plans, timelines, and tools like SharePoint.
* Monitor and control project performance by tracking milestones, consultant costs, invoicing, cash flow, and time investment.
* Maintain project documentation and ensure compliance with internal policies and audit requirements through accurate archiving and reporting.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders and external collaborators (e.g., freelancers) to ensure efficient project execution and service delivery.
* Having experience and looking into drafting, reviewing and assisting Statement of work and project proposal in alignment with the client and project requirements.
* Ensure SLA adherence and operational excellence by managing internal service level agreements, change requests, and resource capacity.
* Oversee financial processes including timely invoicing, PO utilization, and monthly KPI reporting in line with internal controls.
* Communicate project updates and status effectively through structured email communication and MIS dashboards.

**Qualifications And Prerequisites**

* Minimum 5 years of experience managing projects in Pharma, Life Sciences, Healthcare or Medical Device companies
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree is required; a background in Life Sciences or Pharma is preferred.
* Strong project planning and coordination skills, with knowledge of project/account management principles.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and ability to work with project management tools
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Keen attention to detail with strong organizational and documentation capabilities.
* PMP certification preferred (not mandatory but an advantage).

Application Process
  
  
Before applying, please ensure you meet the role requirements listed above and have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is advertised. Our selection process typically involves an initial screening by a recruiter, a technical assessment, and two to three interview rounds. For this role, there will be one interview round with the reporting manager, a Technical round, followed by the HR round. All interviews will be conducted virtually via MS Teams.
  
  
**AI at Cactus Life Sciences**
The life sciences industry is undergoing a fundamental shift in how scientific knowledge is created, communicated, and delivered. We are building our work around it.
  
  
AI is embedded meaningfully across everything we do, through proprietary platforms purpose-built for life sciences and generative tools that deliver measurable value to our clients. It is core to how we operate, and an expected way of working for everyone who joins us.
  
  
We believe in Human-Anchored AI™: whatever your discipline - science, communications, strategy, or operations, you will work in an environment where AI augments your expertise rather than replaces it.
  
  
You will build skills that are in genuine demand and still taking shape across the industry. If you are curious and focused on building capabilities for the world where human intelligence meets artificial intelligence, this is where you belong.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity**
Our hiring practices reflect our commitment to providing equal opportunities and creating an environment where everyone can thrive, develop, and succeed. We celebrate the uniqueness of our team members and prohibit discrimination of any kind, based on race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or any other protected characteristic.
  
  
**About CACTUS**
At Cactus Life Sciences (cactuslifesciences.com), we believe the future of medical communications lies at the intersection of science, technology, and human connection. Headquartered in Princeton, New Jersey, with teams in Switzerland, the United Kingdom, India, and Japan, we help biopharmaceutical organizations redefine scientific exchange—leveraging AI, automation, and innovation while keeping patients at the heart of everything we do.
  
  
Our expertise spans medical strategy, scientific content development, and medical education across therapeutic areas and the product lifecycle. By blending scientific rigor, agile operational models, and future-ready technologies, we partner with medical affairs teams to catalyze their transformation, adapt to a changing landscape, and drive meaningful outcomes for healthcare communities worldwide.

title: Sr. Project Manager, India Construction Management
description:
**Description**
The Data Center Construction Manager (CM) of Amazon Data Services India Private Limited (ADSIPL), the local data center entity in India, is responsible for managing some of the most technical, cost efficient, and fast paced construction project schedules achievable. Amazon Construction Managers are constantly challenged to drive continuous improvement and deliver the highest quality, most technically efficient data centers in the world.
  
  
As a Data Center CM of ADSIPL you will be a part of highly creative, efficient team tasked with tackling the most fascinating and challenging problems in building Amazon data facilities in India. Amazon CM's are always at the forefront of the construction industry in terms of innovation, and maintain a focus to deliver the most innovative products to our customers.
  
  
Our data centers are industry leading facilities in terms of energy efficiency and cost effectiveness. The Data Center CM of ADSIPL is ultimately responsible for the day to day construction oversight and management of the contractors in India. The CM will also be utilized as a leader in their specific discipline (construction management, building services, architectural, electrical or mechanical engineering) and be responsible as a team member of ADSIPL for delivering construction of some of the most sophisticated electrical and mechanical systems in the world.
  
  
At Amazon we leverage unique opportunities presented to us by owning everything from the substation, to the server, and back to the cooling towers. We are diverse, upbeat, creative, team-oriented construction professionals working on a daily basis to develop data centers that are changing the face of data facilities.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Responsibilities of the Data Center CM of ADSIPL
  
  
At Amazon we are a team responsible for the design and operation of industry leading, geographically diverse, large scale critical facilities. Each team member is a highly motivated individual with demonstrated construction management and analytical expertise in the areas of complex, mission critical facilities. Daily responsibilities of CM will include all aspects of the entire data center lifecycle construction starting with the site feasibility, through the procurement of the design teams and design review, daily construction oversight, and commissioning of completed facilities in India.
  
  
The Data Center CM of ADSIPL will be responsible for:
  
  
Project management and oversight of construction related activities for new builds or general capital projects in India. This will include the ownership of the project scope, timeline, and budget.
  
  
Manage a team of high performing Construction managers and build talent, establish ways of working, and help raise the team's bar on delivery.
  
  
Drive costs down and schedules shorter while maintaining quality.
  
  
Provide Construction Management for specific initiatives aimed at improving safety, quality, and timelines for our DC builds
  
  
Review of constructability of electrical and mechanical system and building designs associated with the construction of new data centers or the optimization of existing data centers in India.
  
  
Creation of project scope and equipment requirements, assist with request for proposals, and capital requests.
  
  
Be accountable for the end to end construction life cycle of the builds and deliver through the team.
  
  
Issue/Manage the Request for Information process during construction and coordinate construction administration with engineers
  
  
Record and report key metrics to team members and management.
  
  
Concurrently manage multiple projects including new data center building and capital improvement projects associated with existing data centers in India.
  
  
Be a leader within the group as well as within internal and external teams that support the data center.
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
AWS Construction Managers lead the delivery of our Data Center projects. They work closely with Internal Stakeholders and Contractors, resolving project issues, managing RFIs, Change Orders and other key delivery functions. Our CMs spend the majority of the week on site working closely with our vendors to drive project outcomes.
  
  
**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Architecture, Structural, Civil, Mechanical or Electrical Engineering
* 10+ years of design, construction or program management in mission critical facilities experience
* Experience with large scale mechanical and power systems
* Experience in electrical or mechanical engineering

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with vendor and contractor/subcontractor negotiation and management skills associated with construction and project execution
* Experience directly related to the design or construction of large data center facilities, either colocation or client owned/operated
* Experience in construction of data center delivery (design, commissioning and construction), mission critical facilities, or equivalent industrial/manufacturing facility builds
