title: Program Manager I, INTL Physical Security Innovation Solutions
description:
**Description**
Amazon's Worldwide Physical Security team is looking for a Program Manager to help deliver physical security projects across our international network. Working within the team, you will own the day-to-day delivery of assigned projects end-to-end. Coordinating with site security teams, vendors and stakeholders to plan work, manage funding and approvals, track delivery and keep projects on time, on budget and to standard. It is a hands-on delivery role for someone early in their program-management career who enjoys turning plans into delivered outcomes in a fast-paced, multi-site environment.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Own the end-to-end delivery of physical security projects across assigned sites and programs — from intake and funding preparation through deployment and handover.
* Support the team's senior program managers on their larger, more complex initiatives — tracking actions, chasing dependencies and helping keep delivery moving.
* Prepare and maintain project documentation, including statements of work, responsibility matrices and requirements.
* Support capital funding requests and manage the approvals workflow through to sign-off, tracking spend against approved funding, flagging variances and keeping stakeholders informed.
* Work directly with vendors and installers to schedule works, monitor progress and confirm delivery meets the agreed scope, standards and quality bar.
* Coordinate with site security teams and cross-functional partners to align on requirements, dependencies and timelines, escalating issues appropriately.
* Track project milestones and risks, driving early resolution or ensuring a clean hand-off to the right owner, and report accurate status and metrics into regular business reviews.
* Support proof-of-concept and pilot activity for new physical security technologies, gathering data and documenting outcomes.
* Ensure solutions are delivered in line with Amazon physical security standards and relevant regulatory, legal and safety requirements.
* Contribute to team process improvements — optimising the templates, trackers and workflows the team relies on to deliver.

A day in the life
  
  
You start your morning reviewing progress across your program and catching up with partners on solutions being validated across the worldwide network. Mid-morning you join a working session with field security teams and stakeholders to define the problem behind an upcoming initiative and shape the requirements for a pilot, working through how a solution will integrate into live operations without slowing throughput. After lunch, you prepare a capital funding request for a program, pull together data from a recent proof-of-concept to strengthen the business case, and update your senior PM on key risks. Later you coordinate with a partner on a deployment timeline and capture the lessons from a completed pilot to inform the next rollout. **About Salesforce**

* Global Synchronisation & Timezone Flexibility: Maintain the structural timezone flexibility required to ensure seamless synchronisation, seamless governance, and executive support across global delivery regions (AMER/EMEA/APAC).

**You're Our Person If...**

* 15+ years of total experience in the IT consulting/services industry, with 8+ years of dedicated experience leading complex, enterprise-scale Salesforce implementations.

* Advanced Project / Scaled Agile Management Certification (at least one):PMP, PMI-ACP, SAFe Practice Consultant (SPC), SAFe Agilist, PRINCE2 Practitioner, or Senior Scrum Master credentials (CSM, PSM II).
* Expert-level command over modern enterprise project management, portfolio tracking, and collaboration platforms such as JIRA, Azure DevOps (ADO), MS Project, Smart sheet, and Google Workspace.
* Flexibility and willingness to travel internationally or domestically on a need basis.

**Even Better If...**

* Extensive experience delivering localised or global Salesforce transformations within highly regulated sectors: Healthcare and Life Sciences (HLS), Financial Services (Fins), or Consumer Goods / Retail Cloud.
* Strong functional awareness of data streaming and mid-tier enterprise connectivity strategies, including MuleSoft, Salesforce Data Cloud, and real-time, event-driven architectures.

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
*be your best*

**About Rusk Media**

Rusk Media is a full-stack, mobile-first digital entertainment company focused on creating and distributing engaging entertainment content for audiences aged 12–34. With a portfolio of original IPs and digital entertainment brands, we operate across OTT, digital video and emerging content formats.

As we expand our AI and Animation production capabilities, we are looking for an experienced
**Executive Producer – AI & Animation**
to lead project execution, studio partnerships and commercial delivery across our production slate.

**Role Overview**

The Executive Producer will be responsible for translating creative concepts and production requirements into commercially viable, executable and scalable production plans.

This is a senior production leadership role involving end-to-end ownership of project budgets, schedules, production pipelines, external studio partnerships, team management and client delivery.

The individual will work closely with internal leadership, creative teams, production partners and clients to ensure projects are delivered within agreed budgets, timelines and quality standards.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. End-to-End Production & Delivery**

* Own end-to-end commercial and operational delivery of projects, from initial bidding and production planning through final client acceptance.
* Translate creative treatments, scripts and briefs into executable budgets, production schedules, staffing plans, pipelines and delivery milestones.
* Build and manage production teams, including project delivery managers, line producers and outsourced studios.
* Oversee production timelines, milestones, deliverables and quality standards.

**2. Studio & Production Partnerships**

* Identify, evaluate, onboard and manage external animation, VFX, AI production, post-production and specialist creative studios.
* Lead studio and vendor selection processes and present recommendations for consensus approval from relevant business leadership.
* Build and maintain a reliable network of production partners to support current and future projects.
* Manage multi-vendor production pipelines and ensure effective coordination across internal and external teams.

**3. Commercial & Financial Management**

* Own project-level P&Ls, production budgets and cash requirements.
* Monitor cost-to-complete forecasts, project profitability and budget utilisation.
* Establish and manage project risk registers, change control processes and recovery plans.
* Identify opportunities to improve production efficiency while maintaining creative quality and delivery commitments.

**4. Client & Stakeholder Management**

* Represent the production function in client kick-offs, weekly reviews, escalations and delivery sign-offs.
* Build strong working relationships with broadcasters, OTT platforms, film studios, advertisers and international content partners.
* Manage client expectations, production changes and delivery-related escalations.
* Collaborate with internal creative, business and central production teams to ensure alignment throughout the project lifecycle.

**5. Production Strategy & AI Workflows**

* Build a scalable studio roster and production playbook to support business growth without creating a large fixed-cost structure.
* Explore practical applications of AI to improve production throughput, efficiency and cost optimisation.
* Evaluate AI-related production risks concerning quality, intellectual property rights, security and creative continuity.
* Drive continuous improvements across production processes, workflows and delivery standards.

**Desired Candidate Profile**

* 10–15 years of experience in animation, VFX, premium episodic content, feature-film production or studio operations.
* Proven track record of independently delivering at least two substantial long-form or multi-episode projects with clear budget, schedule and client accountability.
* Strong experience managing external production studios, multiple vendors and complex production pipelines.
* Demonstrated understanding of project economics, production budgeting, cost-to-complete forecasting and change control.
* Established industry relationships across broadcasters, OTT platforms, film studios, advertisers or international content partners.
* Practical understanding of AI-enabled production workflows and their applications in animation and content production.
* Strong commercial acumen, operational ownership, negotiation and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Ability to lead teams, manage production challenges and drive projects from planning through final delivery.

**What We're Looking For**

We are looking for a commercially strong and execution-oriented production leader who understands both the creative and business sides of production.

The ideal candidate should be capable of independently owning project delivery, managing external studio relationships, driving production economics and building scalable delivery capabilities across Rusk Media's AI and Animation slate.

title: Program Manager - Pharma & Healthcare
description:
**About The Job**
We are looking for a strategic Program Manager to lead high-impact initiatives across pharmaceutical operations, global regulatory lifecycles, and digital transformation. Acting as the bridge between core business functions (Regulatory / CMC/ Manufacturing/ Quality) and IT/Data teams, you will drive end-to-end program governance, accelerate AI and process excellence adoption, and ensure predictable global delivery.

* Experience: 5-8 years of overall experience, with mandatory hands-on Program or Project Management experience within the Pharma, Biotech, or Healthcare industry.

* Digital & Process Expertise: Working knowledge of enterprise data/integration programs, Lean/Six Sigma methodologies, and business applications of AI/GenAI.
* Stakeholder & Executive Communication: Consultative communicator skilled at aligning cross-functional teams and translating technical or regulatory dependencies into clear business decisions.
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Pharmacy, Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Engineering, or Information Technology.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting biosimilars or biologics portfolios across global and MOW markets.
* Familiarity with process mining platforms (such as Celonis) and BI/PMO reporting dashboards.
* PMP, Agile, or Lean Six Sigma certification.

description:

AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector
  
  
The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Engagement Manager to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you will lead delivery quality and velocity for programs spanning several concurrent workstreams, orchestrating 50+ person teams of AWS builders, partners, and customers to deliver transformational AI, data, and enterprise modernization outcomes for the world's leading HCLS organizations.
  
  
Your objective will be to deliver distinctive customer business outcomes and experience. In doing so, you will lead the implementation of AWS delivery innovations with customers, including re-designing software development processes to become AI-native end-to-end (“AI-DLC”). You will bring exceptional stakeholder orchestration and relationship-building skills, intrinsic problem-solving ability to proactively shape program direction, anticipate and mitigate risks, and actively manage interdependencies, and the backbone to influence customers and partners when program success demands it. This is an opportunity to shape the future of the industry directly through hands-on transformation leadership.
  
  
The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using AWS services. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing and AI transformation initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
  
  
10044
  
  
221100
  
  
Key job responsibilities

* Influence human builder and agent builder teams effectively, establishing clear operating models and responsible AI guardrails as delivery increasingly incorporates AI-augmented development workflows and agentic automation

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

title: Commercial Project Manager
description:
A Snapshot of Your Day

Lead end-to-end execution of 220 kV GIS/AIS substation projects, ensuring safe, profitable and on-time delivery in compliance with customer, contractual, quality and EHS requirements.

How You'll Make an Impact

1. Project Financial Planning & Controlling

Take financial and commercial ownership of assigned projects following handover from the Order Acquisition team through project completion and final cash recovery.

Prepare and maintain monthly Project Review Templates, analyzing Order Entry Cost (OEC), planned revenue, current carrying cost, and project profitability.

Periodically update Cost to Complete (CTC) and revised project cost estimates based on actual costs, open commitments, procurement status, and latest execution developments.

Validate material cost assumptions using updated commodity prices, purchase order rates, and actual procurement costs.

Monitor project margins, identify deviations from original estimates, and report risks and opportunities to management.

2. Cost Variance & Profitability Analysis

Perform detailed cost variance analysis covering material price, consumption, product mix, volume, manufacturing overheads, and execution-related costs.

Analyze Order Entry Cost versus revised project cost, identifying margin movements and their underlying drivers.

Review cost booking accuracy, material commitments, accruals, and potential cost overruns.

Collaborate with Procurement, Engineering, Planning, and Manufacturing teams to validate cost estimates and identify optimization opportunities.

Develop financial bridges and analytical reports explaining changes in project profitability.

3. Revenue Recognition & Financial Forecasting

Prepare monthly and quarterly revenue forecasts based on project progress and Percentage of Completion (POC) methodology, where applicable.

Ensure accurate revenue recognition in accordance with applicable accounting standards, including Ind AS 115, and company guidelines.

Analyze revenue deviations arising from project milestones, scope changes, price variations, and delivery schedules.

Manage project financial closing activities, including accruals, revenue recognition, and margin reporting.

Maintain accurate project-level financial forecasts and highlight potential reporting impacts.

4. Commercial Project Execution & Milestone Management

Work closely with Technical Project Managers to monitor contractual milestones, execution progress, and commercial obligations.

Coordinate with Planning, Manufacturing, Engineering, and Logistics teams to understand delays and assess their financial implications.

Manage commercial evaluation of scope changes, customer variations, claims, and potential liquidated damages.

Prepare and validate contractual Price Variation (PV) calculations and ensure timely submission of claims.

Review dispatch-related commercial documentation, invoices, payment conditions, and Incoterms to ensure contractual compliance.

5. Cash Flow & Working Capital Management

Prepare and maintain project-level cash flow forecasts, including milestone billing and expected customer collections.

Monitor billing milestones, outstanding receivables, advances, and retention amounts.

Coordinate with relevant stakeholders to ensure timely invoicing and cash recovery.

Identify potential collection delays and working capital risks and recommend corrective actions.

6. Business Analytics & Process Improvement

Develop project dashboards, cost variance models, and profitability reports to improve financial visibility and decision-making.

Identify opportunities to automate financial analysis, project reporting, and commercial controlling processes.

Drive continuous improvement in project controlling, forecasting accuracy, and financial reporting.

What You Bring

* MBA (Finance) from a reputed business school with 9–15 years of relevant professional experience in Project Finance, Commercial Project Management, Operations Finance, Cost Controlling, or Manufacturing Finance.
* Strong understanding of project costing methodologies, cost-to-complete forecasting, profitability analysis, and financial reporting.
* Sound knowledge of revenue recognition principles, particularly POC accounting and Ind AS 115.
* Excellent analytical capabilities in material cost variance, price, mix, volume, and manufacturing cost analysis.
* Excellent proficiency in Advanced Excel and Power BI, including financial modelling, cost analysis, interactive dashboards, and management reporting.
* Working knowledge of SAP or similar ERP systems.
* Strong communication, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience in manufacturing, capital goods, energy, engineering, or project-driven businesses will be preferred.

About the team

Our product portfolio includes AIS (upto 800 kV), GIS (upto 420 kV), Power Transformers (upto 765 kV, 500 MVA), Reactors (upto 765 kV), Traction Transformers (upto 33 kV, 10 MVA). We provide EPC for high and extra high voltage projects pertinent to AIS/GIS, Flexible Alternating Current Transmission System (FACTS) devices and High Voltage Direct Current Voltage Source Converter (HVDC VSC) technology. Further, we oﬀ er an extensive range of services for the complete lifecycle of the High Voltage /Extra High Voltage asset and projects including bay extension, substation modernisation, product retroﬁtting and overhauling, emergency services, breakdown services, Long Term Service Agreements (LTSAs), maintenance contracts, O&M contracts and spares.

Who is Siemens Energy India?

Siemens Energy India Limited (SEIL) has been a strategic partner in India for more than 100 years and is focused on being the most-valued energy technology company. Our large footprint spread across the entire region (India, Sri Lanka, Bhutan, Nepal, Maldives) with state-of-the-art facilities and customers installations positively impacts the lives of hundreds of millions of people, helping the countries navigate their energy transition and achieve its net zero targets.

SEIL is a pure play energy technology company, oﬀering a comprehensive portfolio of products, solutions, and services designed to support our customers along the entire energy value chain to go through their energy transition journey and achieve their net zero targets. Our portfolio oﬀering includes low to zero emissions power generation, power transmission and storage, and decarbonization of the industry. More information on: www.siemens-energy-india.com

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by #TeamPurpleIndia. Siemens Energy celebrates character - no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Rewards / Benefits

All employees are automatically covered under Medical Insurance. Company-paid family floater cover extends to employee, spouses, and 2 dependent children up to 25 years of age.

title: Sr. Project Manager, India Construction Management
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

The Data Center Construction Manager (CM) of Amazon Data Services India Private Limited (ADSIPL), the local data center entity in India, is responsible for managing some of the most technical, cost efficient, and fast paced construction project schedules achievable. Amazon Construction Managers are constantly challenged to drive continuous improvement and deliver the highest quality, most technically efficient data centers in the world.  
  
As a Data Center CM of ADSIPL you will be a part of highly creative, efficient team tasked with tackling the most fascinating and challenging problems in building Amazon data facilities in India. Amazon CM's are always at the forefront of the construction industry in terms of innovation, and maintain a focus to deliver the most innovative products to our customers.  
  
Our data centers are industry leading facilities in terms of energy efficiency and cost effectiveness. The Data Center CM of ADSIPL is ultimately responsible for the day to day construction oversight and management of the contractors in India. The CM will also be utilized as a leader in their specific discipline (construction management, building services, architectural, electrical or mechanical engineering) and be responsible as a team member of ADSIPL for delivering construction of some of the most sophisticated electrical and mechanical systems in the world.  
  
At Amazon we leverage unique opportunities presented to us by owning everything from the substation, to the server, and back to the cooling towers. We are diverse, upbeat, creative, team-oriented construction professionals working on a daily basis to develop data centers that are changing the face of data facilities.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Responsibilities of the Data Center CM of ADSIPL  
  
At Amazon we are a team responsible for the design and operation of industry leading, geographically diverse, large scale critical facilities. Each team member is a highly motivated individual with demonstrated construction management and analytical expertise in the areas of complex, mission critical facilities. Daily responsibilities of CM will include all aspects of the entire data center lifecycle construction starting with the site feasibility, through the procurement of the design teams and design review, daily construction oversight, and commissioning of completed facilities in India.  
The Data Center CM of ADSIPL will be responsible for:  
  
Project management and oversight of construction related activities for new builds or general capital projects in India. This will include the ownership of the project scope, timeline, and budget.  
  
Manage a team of high performing Construction managers and build talent, establish ways of working, and help raise the team's bar on delivery.
  
  
Drive costs down and schedules shorter while maintaining quality.  
  
Provide Construction Management for specific initiatives aimed at improving safety, quality, and timelines for our DC builds  
  
Review of constructability of electrical and mechanical system and building designs associated with the construction of new data centers or the optimization of existing data centers in India.  
  
Creation of project scope and equipment requirements, assist with request for proposals, and capital requests.  
  
Be accountable for the end to end construction life cycle of the builds and deliver through the team.  
  
Issue/Manage the Request for Information process during construction and coordinate construction administration with engineers  
  
Record and report key metrics to team members and management.  
  
Concurrently manage multiple projects including new data center building and capital improvement projects associated with existing data centers in India.  
  
Be a leader within the group as well as within internal and external teams that support the data center.  
  
A day in the life  
AWS Construction Managers lead the delivery of our Data Center projects. They work closely with Internal Stakeholders and Contractors, resolving project issues, managing RFIs, Change Orders and other key delivery functions. Our CMs spend the majority of the week on site working closely with our vendors to drive project outcomes.  
  
About the team  
Diverse Experiences  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  
  
Why AWS  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  
  
Work/Life Balance  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.  
  
Inclusive Team Culture  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Architecture, Structural, Civil, Mechanical or Electrical Engineering
* 10+ years of design, construction or program management in mission critical facilities experience
* Experience with large scale mechanical and power systems
* Experience in electrical or mechanical engineering

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with vendor and contractor/subcontractor negotiation and management skills associated with construction and project execution
* Experience directly related to the design or construction of large data center facilities, either colocation or client owned/operated
* Experience in construction of data center delivery (design, commissioning and construction), mission critical facilities, or equivalent industrial/manufacturing facility builds

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

description:

Proactively identify project risks and implement corrective and preventive measures to minimise impact and ensure regulatory compliance throughout the project lifecycle.

  

Plan and manage organisational initiatives such as sports events, employee engagement programmes, leadership meetings, and VIP visits enhancing workplace culture and stakeholder relationships.

  

Ensure rigorous adherence to safety protocols, quality standards, and statutory regulations during all phases of project execution, promoting a zero-incident culture.

Utilise advanced software tools like ArchiCAD, BIM, MEP, and MS Project for civil and utility design as well as project management to enhance precision and efficiency.

In this role, you will be pivotal in shaping and delivering world-class infrastructure that supports manufacturing excellence and sustainable growth.

**Experience**

The ideal candidate will have between 5 and 7 years of proven experience in infrastructure project management with a strong background in the Gas or Chemical Industries. Hands-on experience is critical, demonstrating the ability to manage complex projects involving chemical and mechanical systems.

Experience should include a robust understanding of industrial processes related to gas production, product testing, and quality manufacturing systems. Candidates will have a track record of effectively leading diverse teams, with strong communication skills to align technical and commercial aspects of operations.

Operational experience on the factory floor is highly desirable, emphasising practical problem-solving skills and collaborative leadership. The candidate should be adept at navigating regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements specific to the chemical and gas sectors.

* Gas and Chemical Manufacturing Plants

**Qualifications**
------------------

The successful candidate will hold a recognised engineering degree, ideally in:

* Mechanical Engineering
* Production Engineering

Additional professional certifications related to project management (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2) or design software proficiency (e.g., BIM certification) would be advantageous.

Candidates must demonstrate comprehensive technical knowledge concerning infrastructure development in industrial/manufacturing environments, encompassing civil, electrical, and mechanical disciplines.

Strong capability in financial oversight for CAPEX and OPEX budgets is essential, alongside excellent analytical and communication skills to articulate project status and risks to senior stakeholders.

**General Requirements**
------------------------

**General Requirements**

* Strong leadership qualities with excellent interpersonal and communication skills to effectively engage cross-functional teams and senior management.
* Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining high standards of quality and safety.
* Demonstrable commitment to compliance with legal, safety, environmental, and company policies.
* Resilience and flexibility in a dynamic manufacturing environment, with a pragmatic, solution-oriented approach.
* Proficiency in using project management and design software tools such as MS Project, ArchiCAD, BIM, and MEP software.

title: Project Controller (Supplier-Led Delivery)
description:
**Project Controller (Supplier-Led Delivery)**
==============================================

Location:
Noida, UP, IN, 201306

Salary: NIL

Division: English Language Teaching

Department: Content\_Overseas\_Asia

**Job Title**
=============

* **Title:** Project Controller (Supplier-Led Delivery)
* **Department:** ELT Product | Publishing / Content | Publishing General | Support
* **Location:** Noida Sector 62, India

  

**About the Role**
------------------

### **Introduction**

Oxford University Press is looking for a highly organised and detail-oriented Project Controller to join our Supplier-Led Delivery (SLD) team. This is an exciting opportunity to play a central role in supporting the operational delivery of educational publishing projects that reach learners and educators around the world.

As part of the ELT Product division, you will contribute to the successful delivery of print and digital learning products by providing project coordination, asset management, publishing support, and operational oversight. You will work closely with Supplier Delivery Leads, Content Commissioning Leads, Project Managers, and specialist teams to ensure projects are delivered efficiently, accurately, and at scale.

This role offers exposure to a broad range of publishing processes, digital products, content delivery systems, and supplier-led workflows, making it an excellent opportunity for someone looking to develop their career within educational publishing, project operations, and content delivery.

### **Opportunity**

As a Project Controller, you will provide operational, administrative, and coordination support that enables efficient and scalable delivery across Supplier-Led Delivery projects. You will ensure project data, assets, documentation, and workflows are managed accurately while supporting publishing and production activities throughout the product lifecycle.

Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:

#### **Product Data, IP and Contract Support**

* Create Letters of Agreement under the direction of the Contracts and IP Lead.
* Create and process New Publication Forms.
* Maintain author and series royalty trackers.
* Manage Salesforce archiving for packager Letters of Agreement.
* Maintain the ClickUp IP tracker, including ISBN processing through SAP and updating associated IP information.
* Support product data administration activities across publishing systems.

  

#### **Product Data and Systems Support**

* Add and maintain product data within Biblio following approved processes.
* Generate VPIM spreadsheets.
* Add internal teams to Digital Asset Management (DAM) folders when ISBNs are created.
* Create Teams sites for new projects.
* Create multi-access codes for internal self-service access.
* Set up products within EPS to enable digital access code creation.
* Maintain SAP records including series, ISBNs, specifications, and product updates.
* Support product transitions between frontlist and backlist teams and update associated metadata and publishing records.
* Manage the ELT Digital Content Request Process, supplying content to internal and external customers through approved channels.

  

#### **Project Administration and Delivery Coordination**

* Support project setup activities, including folder structures, naming conventions, workflow templates, and delivery schedules.
* Maintain access permissions across Teams, DAM, shared drives, and business systems.
* Assist with briefing preparation by collating technical specifications, delivery instructions, and operational information.
* Provide ongoing administrative support for assigned projects.
* Update dashboards and project reporting tools to support visibility of project status and deliverables.
* Support version control processes to ensure accurate and up-to-date project files are available to stakeholders and suppliers.

  

#### **Content Asset and Archive Management**

* Retrieve archive materials, native print files, final PDFs, reference files, and approved media assets.
* Identify the correct product components, ISBNs, and associated assets when sourcing materials.
* Organise, collate, and upload assets to publishing platforms including EPS and Hub.
* Coordinate asset storage and retrieval through the Digital Asset Management (DAM) system.
* Manage the archiving of project materials upon project completion.
* Support the identification and reuse of audio, video, image, and creative assets across projects.

  

#### **Production and Manufacturing Support**

* Prepare and maintain print pack sheets, production schedules, file inventories, and manufacturing handover documentation.
* Complete designated quality checks and escalate exceptions when required.
* Collate final supplier deliverables including press PDFs, native files, approved covers, and sign-off documentation.
* Coordinate supplier corrections, file requests, and handover activities.
* Track dependencies and escalate delivery blockers to Delivery Leads.
* Support cover-bank submissions and QR permalink administration activities following approved processes and training.

  

#### **Digital Publishing and Content Delivery Support**

* Coordinate the receipt, processing, management, and distribution of text, image, audio, video, animation, gaming, and digital assets.
* Prepare, validate, optimise, and organise content in line with publishing standards and metadata requirements.
* Prepare publishing assets, including anonymising Word documents, securing PDFs, validating VTT files, and maintaining simple Product Data Management records.
* Support content packaging, validation, upload, deployment, and maintenance across publishing platforms.
* Verify metadata, component mappings, asset paths, links, product configurations, and publishing assets against approved specifications.
* Manage content uploads to test and production environments.
* Investigate and coordinate the resolution of publishing, upload, and platform issues.
* Support publishing activities relating to CPT, OLP Learning Objectives, evaluation pack game builds, and other production workflows.
* Provide administrative and technical support throughout the product build and delivery lifecycle.

  

### **Impact**

This role is critical to ensuring Supplier-Led Delivery projects run smoothly and efficiently. By maintaining high-quality project data, managing assets and documentation, supporting publishing activities, and coordinating delivery operations, you will help ensure educational products are delivered accurately, on time, and to agreed quality standards.

Your contribution will directly support scalable delivery operations, effective supplier collaboration, and successful product publication across Oxford University Press.

**About You**
-------------

### **Essential Criteria**

* Experience supporting operational, project coordination, publishing, or production workflows within a fast-paced environment.
* Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and delivery activities simultaneously.
* Excellent attention to detail and accuracy when managing assets, metadata, documentation, and system records.
* Experience working with digital asset management, content publishing, workflow, or project management systems.
* Effective communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to collaborate across teams, suppliers, and business functions.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and confidence working across multiple business systems and platforms.

title: Technical Project Coordinator
description:
We are looking for an organized, proactive and technically aware Technical Project Coordinator to support our Software Development divisions. The candidate will coordinate multiple ongoing custom software development projects and in-house product development activities. The primary responsibility will be to monitor project progress, coordinate with developers and QA teams, track deliverables, maintain project documentation and provide consolidated progress reports directly to the senior management.

***Important:*** **This is a coordination and reporting-oriented position, not a software developer or technical team leader position.**

This role is focused on project coordination, execution tracking and reporting. It does not involve technical team leadership, architecture decisions or independent allocation of development resources.

***1. Required Skills & Qualifications:***

**Educational Background:**

● **Graduate in any discipline.**

● B.Tech, B.E., BCA, MCA, BBA or MBA (IT) preferred.

● Relevant IT project coordination experience will be given higher preference than educational qualification alone.

**Professional Experience:**

● **Min 2 years of experience in IT project coordination, software project management, Scrum coordination or related roles.**

● Experience working with software development teams or product teams.

● Practical understanding of software development life cycle (SDLC).

● Experience coordinating multiple projects simultaneously.

**Technical Knowledge**

● Understanding of frontend and backend development processes.

● Basic knowledge of APIs, databases and application development.

● Understanding of software testing and deployment processes.

● Familiarity with Git, version control and CI/CD concepts.

● Knowledge of Agile, Scrum and Kanban methodologies.

**Tools & Applications**

● Jira / Click Up / Trello or similar project management tools.

● Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets.

● Confluence or similar documentation platforms.

● Basic knowledge of project dashboards and reporting.

**Soft Skills**

● Excellent verbal and written communication.

● Strong organizational and coordination skills.

● Good follow-up and task-tracking abilities.

● Attention to detail.

● Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.

● Proactive problem identification and escalation.

● Professional communication with technical teams.

***2. Key Responsibilities:***

**A. Project Planning & Tracking**

● Maintain a centralized record of all ongoing custom development projects and products.

● Track project timelines, milestones, deliverables and deadlines.

● Monitor project progress against planned schedules.

● Maintain project task boards and ensure regular status updates.

● Identify delays, dependencies and potential delivery risks.

● Follow up with relevant team members to ensure timely completion of assigned tasks.

**B. Developer & Team Coordination**

● Coordinate with developers, technical leads, QA engineers and other relevant team members.

● Collect regular progress updates from individual developers.

● Track assigned, completed, pending and blocked tasks.

● Monitor developer availability and workload.

● Identify resource dependencies and coordination gaps.

● Facilitate communication between different development teams.

**C. Agile & Sprint Coordination**

● Coordinate sprint planning, daily stand-ups and sprint review meetings.

● Maintain sprint backlogs and task boards.

● Track sprint commitments against actual completion.

● Monitor unresolved tasks and sprint carryovers.

● Coordinate sprint retrospectives and document action items.

● Ensure the team follows agreed project management processes.

**D. Custom Software Project Coordination**

● Track client project requirements, scope, milestones and delivery commitments.

● Maintain project schedules and requirement documentation.

● Coordinate development, testing, UAT and deployment activities.

● Track client feedback, change requests and pending approvals.

● Highlight scope changes and potential timeline impacts to the senior management.

● Maintain project-wise delivery status.

**E. Product Development Coordination**

● Maintain individual product development plans and roadmaps.

● Track feature development, enhancements and bug fixes.

● Coordinate product release schedules.

● Monitor pending product improvements and technical dependencies.

● Maintain release documentation and feature status.

● Track product development progress against planned milestones.

**F. QA & Release Coordination**

● Coordinate with QA teams to track testing activities.

● Monitor open bugs and their resolution status.

● Track critical issues and pending fixes.

● Ensure testing and approval milestones are completed before release.

● Maintain deployment and release checklists.

● Coordinate release readiness updates with technical leads.

**G. Reporting & Documentation**

● Prepare consolidated weekly project status reports for the senior management.

● Maintain project-wise progress dashboards.

● Prepare developer task and workload reports.

● Highlight delayed activities, bottlenecks and delivery risks.

● Maintain meeting minutes and action-item trackers.

● Ensure project documentation is updated and accessible.

***3. Authority & Reporting Structure***

● Reports directly to the Chief Technology Officer.

● Coordinates with existing developers, technical leads and QA teams.

● Responsible for tracking and reporting project execution.

● Does not independently assign technical tasks or change project priorities.

● Does not make architecture, technology or development decisions.

● Escalates project delays, resource conflicts and operational bottlenecks to the senior management.

***4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)***

Performance will be evaluated based on:

* Accuracy and timeliness of project status reporting.
* Timely identification and escalation of project delays.
* Effectiveness of sprint and task tracking.
* Completeness of project documentation.
* Visibility into developer workload and project dependencies.
* Timely follow-up on pending tasks and action items.
* Quality of coordination between development and QA teams.
* Accuracy of project milestone and delivery tracking.

***5. Preferred Candidate Profile***

We are particularly interested in candidates who:

● Have worked in an IT services or software development company.

● Have experience coordinating developers across multiple projects.

● Understand the practical challenges of software development.

● Prefer project management and coordination over hands-on programming.

● Are interested in building a long-term career in IT project management and delivery operations.

Pay: ₹240,000.00 - ₹300,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Education:

* Bachelor's (Required)

Experience:

* IT project coordination/software project management: 2 years (Required)

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Baranagar, Kolkata, West Bengal

**Job Description**
-------------------

**Senior Manager – Global PMO**
===============================

### **Role Purpose**

The **Senior Manager – Global PMO** will act as a trusted transformation partner to senior leadership, translating strategic priorities into structured, executable programs with clear outcomes, governance, accountability, and measurable business value.

This role will lead complex, enterprise-scale transformation and business change initiatives across functions and geographies. The successful candidate will bring a strong combination of **strategy, transformation, program leadership and consulting mindset** , with the ability to navigate ambiguity, influence senior stakeholders, and drive initiatives from concept and business case through implementation, stabilization, and value realization.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Transformation & Strategic Program Leadership**

* Partner with senior leadership to translate strategic priorities into **structured transformation programs, roadmaps, milestones and measurable outcomes** .
* Lead enterprise-scale **transformation, transition, capability-building and business expansion initiatives** spanning multiple functions and geographies.
* Structure ambiguous business problems, identify critical issues and dependencies, and mobilize cross-functional teams to move initiatives from **concept and business case through execution and value realization** .
* Apply structured transformation methodologies across **operating-model design, process improvement, organizational change, technology enablement and transition to BAU** .

### **Program Governance & Delivery**

* Own end-to-end program governance covering **scope, timelines, financials, resources, risks, dependencies, change impacts, KPIs and benefits realization** .
* Establish effective governance forums, including executive reviews and **Steering Committee/SteerCo** meetings, ensuring clear ownership, accountability and timely decision-making.
* Identify potential delivery risks early, develop mitigation plans and escalate critical issues requiring leadership intervention.
* Coordinate interdependent workstreams and ensure program commitments remain aligned with strategic business objectives.

### **Executive Stakeholder Management**

* Serve as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders, bringing structure and clarity to complex transformation challenges.
* Develop **concise, data-driven executive narratives, business cases and recommendations** that enable leadership to make informed decisions.
* Facilitate senior leadership and SteerCo discussions, clearly highlighting progress, risks, trade-offs, decisions required and recommended interventions.
* Influence across functions and geographies without relying solely on formal authority.

### **Cross-functional & Partner Management**

title: Associate Program Manager
description:
**Associate Program Manager - JEE/NEET Operations**

**THE ROLE**

You are the operational backbone and academic leader for 3-4 assigned schools. You drive measurable student outcomes through rigorous curriculum tracking, teacher development, and data-driven interventions. You build trust with school leadership, parents, and students while maintaining operational excellence across all school visits.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **Academic Operations:**
  Monitor curriculum completion weekly; ensure chapter tests within timelines; track & remediate student performance gaps (target: 60% minimum in high-weightage chapters).
* **Teacher Development:**
  Conduct 2 classroom observations per teacher per visit; provide actionable feedback; ensure mandatory chapter revisions before assessments.
* **Student Outcomes:**
  Analyze test data to identify toppers & at-risk students; conduct mentoring sessions on focus, time management & exam strategy; track gender parity in performance.
* **School Leadership:**
  Lead principal reviews on syllabus status, exam performance & infrastructure; secure alignment on scheduling & special initiatives; document all commitments.
* **Data & Documentation:**
  Maintain school-wise issue logs (resolve critical issues within 48 hours); prepare monthly syllabus & exam reports; track all conversations & action items.
* **Team Management:**
  Oversee facilitator performance; track completion of assigned work against weekly schedules; provide status updates on team requests and pending items.
* **Strategic Planning:**
  Plan 3-4 day school visits; coordinate parent meetings quarterly; manage operational budgets and procurement 3+ months in advance.
* **Field Execution:**
  Conduct classroom observations, meet with teachers & students, review data with principal, and plan next steps; review previous commitments and verify syllabus completion versus plan.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

**Must-Haves**

* B.E./B.Tech or M.Sc. in Physics, Chemistry, or Mathematics; strong grasp of Grade 11-12 STEM curriculum.
* 3-6 years in Education Operations, Test Prep, or Academic Coordination (JEE/NEET exposure is a strong plus).
* Track record managing multi-site operations and remote teams.
* Data-driven mindset: ability to interpret test scores, identify patterns, and make decisions.
* Strong communicator with confidence in engaging school principals and senior staff.
* Meticulous documentation and process discipline; able to track details across multiple priorities.
* Empathy and mentorship capability; comfortable conducting 1-on-1 sessions with students and teachers.
* Willingness to travel 10-15 days/month to rural schools; flexibility for urgent school needs.

**WHAT PROBABLY WONT WORK**

* Unwillingness to spend extensive time on-ground in rural locations.
* Difficulty with relationship management or conflict resolution.
* Aversion to detail-oriented documentation and tracking.
* Limited understanding of competitive exam patterns and academic operations.
* Preference for strategic work over hands-on implementation.
* Impatience with government school bureaucracy or systems.

**WHAT'S HARD ABOUT THIS JOB**

•
**Complex Coordination:**
Balancing multiple priorities—curriculum, teacher performance, student outcomes, principal relationships—across 3-4 schools simultaneously

•
**High Travel Intensity:**
Frequent overnight stays in rural areas; managing fatigue while maintaining high performance standards

•
**Stakeholder Navigation:**
Building trust with government school systems while driving change that may face initial resistance

•
**Data Discipline:**
Maintaining meticulous documentation and follow-up on dozens of action items across multiple stakeholders

•
**Urgency vs. Long-term:**
Responding to immediate operational crises while building sustainable systems for scale

**WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS**

• You directly impact hundreds of students' preparation for India's most competitive exams (JEE/NEET) • Your work determines college enrollment outcomes and career trajectories for rural, underserved students

• You lead the effort to bring gender equity to STEM—supporting girls to pursue engineering and medical careers

• You build operational systems that scale across schools and transform education at regional level

• You're the bridge between Avanti's vision and ground-level execution; your presence builds trust and accountability

**COMPENSATION & LOGISTICS**

•
**Package:**
Competitive with development sector; based on experience and performance

•
**Location:**
Field-based; flexible across India with accommodation support during school visits

•
**Travel:**
10-15 days/month; organization covers all travel and accommodation expenses

•
**Support:**
Regular 1-on-1s with Senior Manager; annual professional development opportunities

**Job Summary**

The Operations Manager is responsible for overseeing and managing the day-to-day operations of the yard, including Production, Logistics, Maintenance, Safety, Resource Management, and overall project execution. The role ensures that operational activities are carried out safely, efficiently, within budget, and in accordance with required quality standards and project timelines.

The Operations Manager will work closely with Engineering, Procurement, Production/Construction, Quality Control, and other departments to ensure smooth workflow and effective utilization of manpower, materials, equipment, and other resources. The role also focuses on continuous improvement, cost optimization, operational performance, and timely delivery of projects.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Yard Operations: Oversee and manage the day-to-day activities of the yard, including production, logistics, maintenance, material movement, and other operational activities.
* Safety Management: Implement and enforce safety procedures, policies, and applicable regulations across yard operations. Conduct or coordinate risk assessments and promote a strong safety-conscious work culture.
* Resource Management: Plan and manage manpower, materials, machinery, tools, and equipment to ensure optimum utilization and availability for project requirements.
* Interdepartmental Coordination: Coordinate closely with Engineering, Procurement, Production/Construction, Quality Control, and other departments to ensure smooth workflow and efficient project execution.
* Budget & Cost Management: Develop and manage operational budgets, monitor expenditure, control operational costs, and identify opportunities for cost optimization without compromising safety or quality.
* Performance Monitoring: Define and track operational KPIs, analyze performance and productivity data, identify operational gaps, and implement corrective and improvement measures.
* Project Management: Oversee operational aspects of projects and ensure completion within agreed timelines, budgets, technical requirements, and quality standards.
* Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve operational processes, procedures, layouts, resource utilization, and workflows. Implement initiatives to enhance productivity and operational efficiency.
* Quality Control & Assurance: Coordinate with the Quality team to implement and monitor quality control procedures and ensure that vessels meet required specifications, standards, and customer requirements.
* Stakeholder Management: Liaise and maintain effective working relationships with suppliers, subcontractors, service providers, regulatory agencies, and other external stakeholders as required.
* Staffing & Training: Participate in manpower planning, recruitment, onboarding, training, performance monitoring, and development of operational and project personnel.
* Strategic Planning: Develop and support long-term operational strategies and plans aligned with organizational objectives, production requirements, and future projects.
* Inventory & Material Management: Oversee the availability and utilization of materials, consumables, tools, and equipment. Coordinate with relevant departments to maintain adequate stock levels and minimize shortages and operational delays.
* Maintenance Management: Ensure preventive and corrective maintenance of yard machinery, equipment, tools, utilities, and infrastructure to minimize downtime and ensure operational readiness.
* Customer Coordination: Maintain professional relationships with clients, support project-related customer interactions, and coordinate the timely resolution of operational or service-related concerns.
* Compliance & Documentation: Ensure operational activities comply with applicable statutory, regulatory, safety, environmental, and organizational requirements. Maintain appropriate operational records, reports, and documentation.
* Reporting: Prepare and present periodic reports on production progress, operational performance, resource utilization, project status, costs, safety, quality, and other key operational indicators to management.

**Job Requirements**

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering

**Experience**

* Relevant managerial experience in Operations, Production, Yard Management, Project Management, or a similar function.
* Experience in shipbuilding, boat manufacturing, marine, heavy engineering, fabrication, manufacturing, or a related industry is preferred.
* Demonstrated experience in managing multidisciplinary teams and coordinating multiple projects/activities simultaneously.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Strong knowledge of production and yard operations.
* Strong project planning and execution skills.
* Knowledge of safety practices, risk management, and regulatory compliance.
* Effective manpower and resource planning skills.
* Budgeting, cost control, and cost optimization capabilities.
* Strong leadership and team management skills.
* Excellent interdepartmental coordination and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.
* Knowledge of quality management and continuous improvement practices.
* Ability to monitor KPIs and prepare management reports.
* Strong inventory, logistics, and material management skills.
* Good communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work effectively under pressure and manage multiple priorities and project deadlines.
* Proficiency in MS Office and relevant ERP/project management systems.

description:

Whether you’re driving innovation in digital banking or streamlining client onboarding, you’ll be part of a culture recognized for excellence and investment in people. At CIBC India, people and progress are at the center of what we do: you’ll develop skills, collaborate with industry leaders, and see your ideas realized in a culture that values progress and belonging. We provide cutting-edge resources, ongoing learning, and a supportive environment where people come first. If you’re ready to create meaningful change and build your future, CIBC India is where your ambition meets opportunity.

**What CIBC India Offers:**

At CIBC India, your goals are a priority. We start with your strengths and ambitions and strive to create opportunities to tap into your potential. We aspire to give you a career that goes well beyond your compensation.

We work to recognize you in meaningful, personalized ways including competitive fixed pay, performance-based incentive programs, a family-first benefits program, employer contributions for your retirement, attractive time off and leave offerings, wellbeing support, and MomentMakers, our social, points-based recognition program.

Our spaces and technological toolkit will make it simple to bring together great minds to create innovative solutions that make a difference for our clients worldwide

We cultivate a culture where you can express your ambition through initiatives like Purpose Day, a paid day off dedicated for you to use to invest in your growth and development.

**What You’ll Be Doing (position summary):**

The QE Manager is accountable for leading and managing quality engineering and software testing activities across multiple projects, programs, or workstreams. This role ensures the delivery of high-quality solutions by developing and executing comprehensive test strategies, plans, and automation scripts, while driving continuous improvement in QA/QE processes and standards. The incumbent plays a key role in technical evaluation, solution design feedback, and implementation of emerging automation and AI-based testing approaches to expedite delivery, improve quality, and reduce costs.

At CIBC India we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. Details on your work arrangement (including on-site and remote work) will be discussed at the time of your interview.

**How You’ll Succeed (responsibilities):**

**Operational Excellence:**

* Develop, publish, manage, and execute test strategies, test plans, test cases, traceability matrices, automation scripts, status reports, defect logs, and exit reports
* Identify and obtain required test data and test environments to support testing activities
* Develop, publish, and execute testing estimates and manage financials related to testing

**Project & Team Leadership:**

* Manage and lead the testing activities for a workstream, program, or multiple projects/initiatives
* Lead a team of test analysts, including capacity management, performance management, productivity, quality assurance, and compliance with project requirements
* Ensure adherence to QA/QE standards and drive the implementation of new standards

**Continuous Improvement**
:

* Recognize and identify areas for improvement in policies, processes, procedures, and tools/methodologies; implement continuous improvements
* Track and report QA/QE metrics and KPIs such as velocity and defect slippage
* Identify, manage, and remediate noncompliance items and deviations

**Technical Evaluation & Quality Engineering:**

* Provide input, feedback, and challenge technical designs, assess impacts to testing based on technical details, and develop QA automation solutions
* Identify and implement automation, AI, or emerging solutions to expedite testing, improve quality, and reduce costs

**Quality Assurance:**

* Apply extensive knowledge of software quality assurance activities, tasks, tools, and techniques to evaluate new or enhanced systems and software tools for adherence to functionality and quality requirements

**Quality Management & Problem Solving:**

* Utilize quality management methods, tools, and techniques to create and support an environment that meets organizational needs
* Apply problem-solving approaches, tools, and techniques to recognize, anticipate, and resolve organizational, operational, or process problems

**People Management:**

* Set appropriate context when assigning work to ensure that individuals’ roles support the achievement of the business unit’s priorities and CIBC’s overall goals
* Build team and individual capabilities by providing development opportunities such as job shadowing, special projects, and training
* Manage performance by providing fair and accurate formal and informal feedback, identifying and removing obstacles to performance, and explaining how performance expectations align with business priorities
* Create a positive work environment and act as an effective role model by championing CIBC’s mission, vision, and values
* Ensure compliance with policies, standards, guidelines, and controls by applying the policies and controls fairly and consistently so employees understand what to expect
* Hire the right people in the right jobs to align individual capabilities with job requirements and business unit goals

**Experience: 10**
+ years of experience

* 10+ years of industry and job experience in software quality engineering, quality assurance, and test management. 2-3 yrs of management experience
* Extensive experience in evaluating systems, software packages, and tools for functionality and quality requirements
* Strong understanding of quality management methods, tools, and techniques
* Robot Framework, Appium, and Selenium scripting
* GitHub CoPilot or other Gen AI-based tools
* Proficient with Jira, Confluence, and/or other similar Agile, development, and QA tools
* Proficient with RestAPI, Parasoft, or other API testing and virtualization tools for API QA

title: Designer - Brand & Identity
description:
**About the role**

We have just moved through a rebrand - a global, editorial, vibrant, and confidently minimal identity where old-school graphic-design craft meets clean modern layout. We're looking for a mid-level designer with real depth to help us build on it: someone who understands the fundamentals, reads brand strategy fluently, and has the judgment to understand and evaluate a design process - not just follow it. You'll work closely with the design lead and alongside our junior designer, taking identity work a long way on your own while knowing when to bring it back for direction.

**What you'll do**

* Support end-to-end identity projects, translating brand strategy into visual identity systems - logos, typography, colour palettes, iconography, brand assets, and scalable design frameworks aligned with our objectives.
* Develop, document, and maintain comprehensive brand guidelines and toolkits, keeping implementation consistent across digital platforms, external communications, presentations, environmental graphics, publications, social media, and internal communications.
* Collaborate with strategy, content, and cross-functional teams to deliver integrated brand solutions - presenting creative concepts, articulating design rationale, and incorporating feedback effectively.
* Support the ongoing implementation, evolution, and governance of the brand system, while staying current with branding trends, emerging technologies, and AI-driven workflows - contributing to innovation, knowledge sharing, and a high standard of design excellence.
* Help raise the studio's craft bar and support the junior designer.

**The fundamentals we expect**

* A strong grasp of design principles - visual weight, hierarchy, balance - and the ability to use negative space to your advantage and create visuals with real depth.
* An understanding of brand strategy, with the ability to read and expand on brand guidelines rather than just apply them.

title: Instrumentation Technical Writer
description:
**Job Requirements**  

At Quest Global, it’s not just what we do but how and why we do it that makes us different. With over 25 years as an engineering services provider, we believe in the power of doing things differently to make the impossible possible. Our people are driven by the desire to make the world a better place—to make a positive difference that contributes to a brighter future. We bring together technologies and industries, alongside the contributions of diverse individuals who are empowered by an intentional workplace culture, to solve problems better and faster.

**Job Summary:**

* Provide technical writing and documentation support I&E Reliability Engineering, with primary focus on the **development, review, revision, and standardization of instrumentation maintenance procedures and work instructions (ICs/MWIs)** to support safe, consistent, and effective field maintenance execution.
* Develop, review, revise, and standardize **instrumentation maintenance procedures, instructions and work instructions (ICs/MWIs)** in accordance with approved ABU documentation requirements and templates.
* Convert **engineering requirements, OEM manuals and recommendations, existing maintenance practices, and field experience** into clear, technically accurate, and executable maintenance procedures and work instructions.
* Work closely with I&E Reliability Engineers, site engineers, maintenance personnel, technicians, and relevant SMEs to **capture practical field knowledge, maintenance steps, precautions, acceptance criteria, and equipment-specific requirements** for incorporation into ICs/MWIs.
* Develop and update maintenance instructions covering applicable activities such as **inspection, calibration, testing, troubleshooting, adjustment, repair, replacement, and functional verification** of instrumentation equipment.
* Review existing ICs/MWIs to identify opportunities to improve **technical accuracy, clarity, sequencing of work steps, usability, consistency, and completeness**.
* Develop and review maintenance procedures and work instructions for common instrumentation equipment, including **pressure, temperature, flow and level instruments; control valves; actuators; positioners; switches; analyzers; and associated field instrumentation**.
* Incorporate applicable **OEM information, engineering standards, approved company practices, safety requirements, and site-specific requirements** into maintenance procedures and work instructions, where relevant.
* Verify equipment and technical information against available **equipment data, drawings, datasheets, OEM manuals, existing maintenance documentation, and other approved source documents** before incorporation into ICs/MWIs.
* Ensure consistency in **technical terminology, equipment and tag references, units, document structure, formatting, references, revision information, and traceability of source information**.
* Support the review and incorporation of comments received from engineers, maintenance personnel, technicians, and SMEs and **update ICs/MWIs through the applicable review and approval cycle**.

**Skill Requirement:**

* **Strong hands-on/site experience with industrial instrumentation**, including transmitters, control valves, actuators, switches, analyzers, field instruments, junction boxes, and associated control and safety systems.
* **Practical understanding of instrumentation maintenance and testing**, including calibration, inspection, preventive/corrective maintenance, equipment replacement, loop checking, functional testing, commissioning, troubleshooting, and maintenance execution.
* **Ability to develop and review technically accurate and field-executable maintenance documentation**, including MWIs, maintenance procedures, work instructions and job plans, with clear steps, precautions, acceptance criteria, references, and restoration requirements.
* **Proficient in interpreting instrumentation and functional safety documentation**, including P&IDs, instrument loop diagrams, wiring/termination drawings, hook-up drawings, cause-and-effect diagrams, instrument datasheets, logic narratives, vendor/OEM manuals and Safety Requirements Specifications (SRS).
* **Strong working knowledge of SIS/SIF and functional safety principles**, including the application of **AS/IEC 61511**, Safety Integrity Level (SIL) concepts, SIS lifecycle requirements, sensors, logic solvers and final elements, sufficient to develop and validate maintenance and testing documentation. IEC 61511 establishes the SIS lifecycle and SIL framework and addresses the complete SIF from sensor through to final element.
* **Ability to interpret Safety Requirements Specifications (SRS) and translate applicable SIF requirements into clear maintenance and testing instructions**, including functional/proof-testing steps, acceptance criteria, set points, tolerances, test intervals and restoration requirements. IEC 61511 defines the SRS as containing the functional requirements for SIFs and their associated SILs.
* **Ability to maintain technical traceability and consistency** between ICs/MWIs, SRS requirements, engineering drawings, cause-and-effect documentation, OEM information and other approved source documents. Internal functional-safety guidance specifically identifies the ability to check traceability and consistency between documents and assess them against the SRS as an important competency.
* **Ability to interpret and appropriately incorporate applicable engineering standards**, OEM recommendations, company engineering practices, functional safety requirements and site-specific requirements into technical documents.
* **Strong attention to detail and document quality**, with the ability to verify equipment information, tag details, drawings, specifications, test requirements, acceptance criteria and technical references before issuing documentation.
* **Formal training in AS/IEC 61511 / Functional Safety is highly desirable**, with practical experience in development or review of SIS/SIF maintenance and testing procedures preferred. Internal functional-safety documentation similarly identifies formal functional-safety training/certification as desirable

**Work Location:**

Role Mandate

A hands-on, India-based GTM Engineer who combines strong Python and web development skills with solution architecture understanding and commercial awareness. The role supports sales and platform leadership by building compelling demos, shaping AI/media solutions, developing high-quality proposals and sales assets, scouting partners, and influencing qualified pipeline for Platform offerings and point solutions.

This is a technical GTM enablement role, not a primary sales quota-carrying position.

1. Build functional demos and prototypes Independently code, integrate, test and present client-specific demos, proof-of-concepts and lightweight web-based experiences using Python, APIs and modern web frameworks.

2. Support solution building and technical discovery Translate client needs into use cases, solution options, workflows, integration patterns, high-level architectures, effort assumptions and pilot scopes; work closely with engineering and product teams.

3. Create proposals and pursuit documentation Develop technical proposals, RFI/RFP responses, statements of work inputs, solution descriptions, POC plans, success criteria and estimates in collaboration with commercial and delivery teams.

6. Influence pipeline across platform and point solutions Partner with sales and account teams to identify opportunities, tailor demos and solutions to buying needs, improve technical qualification, strengthen pursuits and help move opportunities toward pilots or commercial closure.

7. Support platform and point-solution commercialization Package and position platform capabilities alongside focused accelerators, demonstrators and partner-powered point solutions; explain deployment and integration approaches clearly.

8. Maintain reusable GTM assets and feedback loops Build a reusable library of demo components, code, templates, solution patterns and reference architectures; convert client feedback into improvements to demos, collateral and product priorities.

Required Skills & Experience

Strong hands-on Python coding, REST API integration, debugging and automation; capable of building working demos rather than only presenting them.

Practical web development experience (e.g., JavaScript/TypeScript, React or comparable frameworks) to create lightweight demo front ends and interactive workflows.

Working understanding of AI/GenAI, LLM APIs, agents, computer vision/video intelligence, cloud services and media workflows; ability to interpret architecture and discuss technical trade-offs.

Experience in technical presales, solutions engineering, GTM engineering, AI/SaaS platforms or enterprise technology solutioning.

Excellent PowerPoint/storytelling, proposal writing and communication skills; comfortable engaging with sales, product, engineering and client stakeholders.

Ability to work independently, manage multiple pursuits, and combine engineering execution with commercial responsiveness.

Success Measures

Demo and prototype quality/speed; proposal and sales-deck quality; reusable solution assets; partner opportunities evaluated; technical support to qualified opportunities; and demonstrable contribution to platform and point-solution pipeline progression.

We are looking for an experienced and customer-focused Presales Lead to drive technical solutioning, customer engagement and sales support for enterprise customers. **Why Join Accops?**

Opportunity to work with cutting-edge cybersecurity and digital workspace solutions. Exposure to enterprise and strategic customer engagements. Collaborative and growth-oriented work environment. Opportunity to influence solution strategy and customer transformation journeys.

description:

+ Work with CoE teams to position AI-enabled use cases relevant to customer sector challenges.

+ Excellent communication, presentation, and demonstration skills.
+ Ability to simplify complex SAP concepts for business and technical stakeholders.

+ SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition certification.
+ Familiarity with SAP BTP, SAC, integrations, workflow, and extensibility.
+ Exposure to industry-specific S/4HANA Cloud scope items and scenarios.
+ Experience running PoVs, PoCs, or demo environments.

**Why This Role Matters in NDBS India**
This GTM role shapes customer perception, influences deal outcomes, and showcases NDBS India’s SAP Cloud leadership. You play a central role in customer-facing conversations, differentiating our offering, and accelerating SAP Public Cloud adoption for strategic accounts.
