title: Solutions Architect
description:
We are looking for passionate technologists to join our Pre-Sales organization to ensure that our growth is grounded and guided by strong technical alignment with our platform and the needs of our customers.
  
  
MongoDB Pre-Sales Solution Architects are responsible for guiding our customers and users to design and build reliable, scalable systems using our data platform. Our team is made up of seasoned technical sales professionals, software architects, entrepreneurs, and developers who take direct responsibility for customer success, including the design of their software, deployment, and operations. You'll work closely with our sales executives, helping customers solve business problems by leveraging our solutions, playing a key role in winning deals and driving the business forward. You'll be a trusted advisor to a wide range of users from startups to the world's largest enterprise IT organizations.
  
  
We are looking for candidates based in Bengaluru, Gurugram and Mumbai to work in the Hybrid work model.
  
  
As an ideal candidate, you will have:
  
  

* 8 to 11 years of related industry experience, ideally 5-7 years of experience in a customer facing role
* Minimum of 3 years experience with modern scripting languages (e.g. Python, Node.js, SQL) and/or popular programming languages (e.g. C/C++, Java, C#) in a professional capacity
* Experience implementing scalable and highly available distributed systems in the cloud and on-prem
* Demonstrated ability to work with customers to review complex architecture of existing applications, providing guidance on how to improve by leveraging technology
* Excellent presentation, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to convey complex technical and business concepts in a clear and compelling manner to technology and business leadership
* Ability to work with a cross functional sales team to formulate and execute an end to end deal cycle
* A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience

You may also have:
  
  

* Experience developing, deploying, or supporting applications with any of the major cloud providers
* Experience working in a technical pre-sales capacity
* Experience with database programming and data models
* Experience in data engineering or AI/ML projects
* Understanding of popular sales methodologies/ frameworks such as MEDDPICC/ Command of the Message
* A MongoDB Certification
* A Cloud Provider Certification

What you do at MongoDB:
  
  
In this role, you will work on complex opportunities where analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of various factors. You will:
  
  

* Design and Architect: Design scalable and performant applications, systems and infrastructure for large software projects leveraging MongoDB
* Customer Advising and Value Articulation: Guide customers on architecture patterns and optimisation strategies for MongoDB, while clearly communicating its business value to the relevant stakeholders
* Sales Partnership: Collaborate with the sales team to drive account success through account planning, opportunity prioritization/qualification and pipeline generation strategy, while taking ownership of the technical aspects (including but not limited to technical discovery, demos, proof of value, presentations, sizing and documentation)
* Demand Generation: Proactively generate demand within the sales territory through self-driven technical initiatives, participation in events such as industry trade shows and account-based marketing events
* Customer Success: Foster strong customer relationships, build champions and ensure customer success and satisfaction
* Innovation and Improvement: Continuously seek opportunities to innovate and improve MongoDB solutions and processes (e.g. by relaying field feedback to the product team), as well as proactively mentor other Solutions Consulting team members
* Personal Training and Development: Engage in ongoing training and professional development to stay abreast of MongoDB product suite as well as industry trends

What you will learn:
  
  
MongoDB Product Suite Mastery:
  
  

* Core Database Server: Master the fundamentals and advanced features of MongoDB's core database
* Atlas and Advanced Services: Gain expertise in Atlas (fully managed cloud database service), Atlas Stream Processing, Atlas Data Lake, Atlas Full-Text Search, Atlas Vector Search, and Charts
* Relational Migrator: Learn to migrate from relational databases seamlessly

Market-Relevant Technologies:
  
  

* Hyperscaler Ecosystem: Gain expertise in designing complex systems utilizing cloud services on hyperscaler platforms
* Complementary Technologies: Enhance your skills with partner and complementary technologies such as Apache Kafka and Kubernetes

Modern Architecture Design:
  
  

* Design Patterns and Methodologies: Embrace best practices in microservices, DevOps, cloud, and security
* Cutting Edge RAG and AI Architectures: Help customers on their generative AI journey and working with industry leading partners in the space

Sales Techniques and Soft Skills:
  
  

* Effective Communication: Master presentations, demonstrations, and whiteboarding
* Client Interaction: Develop strategies for discovery and objection handling

Industry Insights:
  
  

* Diverse Market Verticals: Gain exposure to a broad spectrum of interesting use cases across various industries

**About MongoDB**
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
  
  
With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
  
  
Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
  
  
To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!
  
  
MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.
  
  
MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

title: Platform Solution Sales - Partner (Tech Presales skills needed)
description:

.

Share expertise and thought leadership in Decisioning, Analytics, & Optimization within Financial Services with the goal of helping our clients leapfrog the competition leveraging FICO’s cutting-edge Platform.

title: Digital Marketing Consultant
description:
Company:- Digital Dhairya (digitaldhairya.com)

Role

Junior Community Coach (member coaching and account management)

Location

In office, Modipuram, Meerut, UP - 250001

Type

Full time, Monday to Saturday

Reports to

Agrim Mittal, Senior Community Coach

Languages

Hindi and English. Calls are in Hinglish, written replies in clear English

Pay

Fixed salary plus commission on member renewals and agency projects

About Digital Dhairya

Digital Dhairya is Dhairya's coaching business, with about 1 million followers on YouTube and 400,000 on Instagram. We help coaches, trainers, consultants, experts and agency owners sell their programs online through a video-led sales funnel: ads, a page with a short video, a paid application and a sales call.

Members join our 6-month Mastermind. It is consulting: we review and guide, and the member or their team builds. For members who want us to build for them, our agency team does the scripting, shoot, editing, pages and ads as a separate service.

Our members are healers, health and fitness coaches, business coaches, doctors, numerologists, corporate trainers and more. Most are one-person businesses or small teams. Some are new to marketing and need simple, patient guidance. Others are experienced and want a sharp second opinion. A good coach can tell which one they are talking to.

What you'll do

**1. Own your members**

* Take a set of members as their coach, from their first week to the end of their 6 months.
* Onboard each new member: welcome, what the program covers, what they do first.
* Know every member's buyer, offer, price and where they are in their funnel.

**2. Review and guide their work**

* Review offer documents, ad scripts, video scripts, landing pages and application forms against Digital Dhairya's standards.
* Send written feedback that names the problem clearly and gives the member at most three things to do next.
* Get on a one-to-one video call when writing can't settle it.
* Help run the weekly expert sessions on offer creation and funnel copywriting.

**3. Track their numbers**

* Collect each member's funnel numbers (ad spend, page visits, applications, calls held, sales) in our standard format.
* Keep member records current in our CRM (GoHighLevel).
* Record member wins as case studies.

**4. Flag problems early**

* Log complaints and stuck members the same day and route them to the senior team.
* Join the senior coach's call with your member and carry the follow-through after it.

**5. Renewals**

* Before a member's 6 months end, review their progress with them and agree the plan for the next 6.
* Hold the renewal conversation and follow it through to payment.

**6. Agency projects**

* Spot members who need hands-on execution and are ready for it, and introduce our agency services.
* On projects from your members: write the scripts (short sales video, pre-call video, ads) with a senior coach's review, and manage the member's checklist, approvals and delays until the funnel is live.

**7. Community and events**

* Answer members in the community WhatsApp group and keep it useful.
* Support our quarterly offline events: invitations, registrations and hosting members on the day.

How we coach

These are the rules every coach here works by.

* **The member's result is the job.** A reply sent is not the result. A member's first paying clients are.
* **Know where they stand before you advise.** A beginner and an experienced business owner need different answers to the same question.
* **Only the necessary.** A member leaves every reply knowing the next one to three things to do. Nothing more.
* **Writing first, call when needed.** A clear written answer comes first. A call happens when writing can't settle it.
* **Numbers before opinions.** We find the problem in the member's own numbers, then fix one thing at a time.
* **Honest, always.** No invented proof, no income promises, and we say so plainly when something is outside what we do.
* **Raise it early.** A complaint or a stuck member is logged and passed up the same day, never argued with or left in DMs.

Who we're looking for

**Must have**

* 1 to 3 years in customer success, account management, coaching support, digital marketing or sales.
* Clear written and spoken **English**. You can explain a problem in five simple lines.
* Comfortable on Hinglish video calls with business owners who are often older and more experienced than you.
* Basic understanding of how online selling works (ads, landing page, sales call), or proof that you learn fast.
* Comfortable with numbers.
* Organised: you can follow 30-40 members at once without anyone slipping.
* Patient with beginners, and firm enough to tell a member what they don't want to hear.

**Good to have**

* Copywriting or script writing for ads and videos.
* Experience with any CRM (GoHighLevel is a plus).
* Worked with coaches, consultants or an online education business before.
* Sales or renewal experience.
* Everyday use of AI tools such as Claude or Gemini for drafting and review.

How success is measured

Targets for each measure are set with you in your first 30 days.

Measure

What we look at

Member results

How many of your members get paying clients from their offer during their 6 months

Renewals

How many of your members renew when their 6 months end

Numbers on file

How many of your members have current funnel numbers recorded in our format

Clear replies

Members act on your feedback without coming back confused

Early flags

Complaints and stuck members logged and passed up the same day

Agency projects

Projects from your members go live on time, with delays logged

Case studies

Member wins recorded with real numbers

Pay

Your pay has a fixed part and a part you earn from how your members do.

Part

What it is

When it's paid

Fixed salary

Based on current package

Monthly

Renewal commission

₹10000 for every member of yours who renews

When the renewal payment is received in full

Agency commission

Commissions for every agency project taken by a member of yours

When the project goes live

The commission has no upper limit. A coach whose members get results earns the most, because those are the members who renew and who are ready for agency work.

Your first 90 days

Days

What happens

1 to 30

Learn our standards for offers, videos, ads and funnel numbers. Sit in on member calls and expert sessions with the senior coaches

31 to 60

Take your first 10 members. A senior coach reviews your written replies before they go out

61 to 90

Own your full set of members, hold your first renewal conversations and support your first agency project

Where this role goes

Coaches whose members get results move up to Senior Community Coach, with a larger set of members, their own agency projects and new coaches to train.

How to apply

Send these to agrim@digitaldhairya.com :

* Your CV.
* Your current and expected monthly salary.
* A written reply, in under 150 words, to this message from a member: *"I've spent* ₹*30,000 on ads in three weeks. People are visiting my page but nobody is booking a call. What should I do?"*

We read the reply first. Shortlisted candidates get a 20-minute video call, then in person interview at the office.

Members' businesses and Digital Dhairya's methods are confidential. Every coach signs a confidentiality agreement on joining.

title: Bid Manager
description:
**Position Objective**

The
**Sr. Executive / Manager – Bids & Proposals**
will own Cabcon India's end-to-end tendering and bid management function for Government, PSU and utility business, including smart metering (AMI) and ICT projects. The role covers identifying opportunities, bid/no-bid qualification, costing and BOQ preparation, techno-commercial compliance, vendor negotiation and timely e-tender submission, and supports post-bid activities through to contract finalization. The aim is to improve the company's win ratio and bid margins while keeping every submission accurate, compliant and on time.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Tender Identification & Bid Qualification

* Track tender portals (GeM, CPPP, State e-procurement portals, PSU and utility portals) daily; identify opportunities of interest for bidding or market intelligence, attend pre bid queries and track any extension.
* Maintain and prepare MIS report of pipeline tenders for management review.
* Drive the bid/no-bid decision process by assessing eligibility criteria, risk and commercial viability.
* Develop bid strategy and win plans for strategic and high-value pursuits (RFP / RFQ / EOI / NIT).

2. Costing, BOQ & Pricing

* Prepare detailed cost estimates, BOQ analysis and pricing strategies, covering project cash flow, taxes and price justification.
* Engage with OEMs, system integrators, service providers, vendors and subcontractors to obtain competitive quotations and ensure compliant proposals.
* Participate in e-tender portals and reverse auctions, applying disciplined pricing and vendor negotiation to secure competitive L1 / L2 positions.
* Develop the vendor base: identify, evaluate and onboard new OEMs, vendors and subcontractors, benchmark their rates and track vendor performance to improve price competitiveness.

3. Techno-Commercial & Compliance Management

* Review RFP / tender documents for technical specifications, commercial terms, risk and contractual conditions.
* Prepare compliance matrices and ensure adherence to Make in India / Public Procurement preference policies, BIS / statutory certifications and eligibility documents.
* Coordinate technical and commercial inputs across Sales, Technical, Finance, Legal and Operations to ensure consistent, timely submissions.
* Raise and manage pre-bid queries and client clarifications.

4. Submission, Post-Bid & Contract Support

* Manage the complete tender life cycle, from documentation and authorization to submission well ahead of deadlines.
* Support post-bid activities including price negotiations, LOA / PO review, contract finalization and handover to the project execution / supply team.
* Maintain a centralized repository of proposal templates, technical documents, certifications, credentials and past-performance records.
* Conduct post-bid analysis of every won and lost bid (price gap vs. L1, technical / commercial rejection reasons, competitor pricing) and feed the findings into future bid strategy and pricing and prepare a MIS report / dashboard for management review.

5. Market Intelligence, Reporting & Process Improvement

* Conduct competitor analysis and benchmarking of pricing, win/loss trends and market intelligence to improve win probability.
* Track and report bid performance metrics: win rate, turnaround time, margin improvement and compliance accuracy.
* Prepare periodic MIS reports and dashboards (pipeline, win/loss, margin, turnaround, vendor performance) for the Directors and organise bid strategy meetings with action-point tracking.
* Standardize documentation and compliance processes to reduce submission turnaround time.
* Apply data analytics to tender, win/loss, pricing and vendor data to spot trends, improve bid selection and support pricing decisions; use AI-driven tools to speed up tender screening, document review and report preparation.

Ideal Candidate Profile

**Experience & Target Background**

* **Tendering Experience:**
  Proven record of managing 100+ Government / PSU tenders across GeM, CPPP and State e-procurement portals.
* **Industry Exposure:**
  Background in AMI / smart metering, ICT, electrical, solar, railway / metro telecom or smart infrastructure bids; cable & wire or EPC background also considered. Exposure to PSU / utility (discom) procurement is an advantage.
* **Commercial Acumen:**
  Experience handling bids of significant value, with demonstrated contribution to improved win ratios and margins.

**Skills & Competencies**

* **Tendering & Procurement Portals:**
  Strong working knowledge of GeM, CPPP, State portals and reverse auction handling.
* **Costing & BOQ:**
  Expertise in cost estimation, BOQ preparation, price justification and vendor / OEM / system integrator coordination and negotiation.
* **Compliance & Risk:**
  Sound understanding of Make in India policy, eligibility criteria, contract terms and risk management frameworks.
* **Documentation & Coordination:**
  High accuracy and attention to detail; able to coordinate across cross-functional teams under tight deadlines.
* **Tools:**
  Advanced MS Excel / MS Office; data analytics and dashboard tools (e.g. Power BI) for MIS; working knowledge of AI-driven tools for tender analysis, document drafting and compliance checks.
* **Language & Mobility:**
  Fluency in English, Hindi and Bengali. Willingness to travel occasionally (up to 10–15%) for pre-bid meetings, client visits and vendor interactions.
* **Analytics & AI:**
  Skilled in post-bid analysis, data analytics and MIS reporting, with hands-on use of AI-driven tools in bid work.
* **Vendor Development:**
  Ability to build, evaluate and negotiate with a reliable OEM / vendor / subcontractor base.

**Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Number of tenders identified, qualified and submitted on time (target vs. actual).
* Bid win ratio and value of orders secured.
* Bid margin achieved versus estimated margin.
* Submission turnaround time and compliance accuracy (rejection rate due to technical / documentation lapses).
* Reverse auction performance (L1 / L2 positions secured).
* Timeliness and quality of MIS, pipeline and competitor reports.
* Post-bid analysis completed for every won / lost bid, and new vendors developed with rate savings achieved.

title: Job Description – Sales & Marketing Executive (B2B Media Space Selling)

The Sales & Marketing Executive will be responsible for selling advertising space and integrated media solutions (print, digital, events and sponsorships) to B2B clients. **Travel & Events**

* Travel for client meetings within the city and across India as required
* Represent the company at trade shows, exhibitions, conferences and industry events

**Reporting**

* Submit weekly and monthly sales reports and forecasts

**Requirements**

**Experience**

* 1-3 years of proven experience in space selling for B2B magazines or media platforms
* Experience selling to industrial, engineering, manufacturing or technical sectors is preferred

**Skills**

* Strong understanding of advertising sales, client acquisition and relationship management
* Ability to identify business opportunities and develop new client networks
* Good knowledge of digital marketing trends and platforms (social media, websites, emailers, webinars, programmatic and content marketing)
* Excellent communication, negotiation and presentation skills
* Target-driven, self-motivated and able to work independently
* Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) and familiarity with CRM tools

**Other**

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to work with a leading B2B industrial media platform
* Exposure to diverse industries and senior business professionals

* Attractive incentives on achieving sales targets

title: Senior Finance Associate / General Manager – Finance & Accounts .
company: Nutrifresh Farm Tech India Pvt ltd
description:
Key responsibilities1. Accounting, books and month-end close (Zoho Books)

* Own the general ledger in Zoho Books: chart of accounts, branch/location and project/cost-centre tagging, and clean master data for items, customers and vendors.

* Deliver a monthly close within 12 working days: accruals, prepaid and provisions, fixed-asset register and depreciation, inter-unit entries, and a reviewed trial balance.

* Operate and maintain the Zoho workflows that keep the books current: bank feeds and reconciliation, recurring entries, purchase and expense approval routes, and standard reports and MIS views.

* Prepare monthly balance-sheet schedules with ageing and a named owner for every open item such as bank, GST, TDS, advances, deposits, inter-unit, payroll, provisions and clear ageing balances.

* Maintain a documented closing checklist and accounting manual, so the close does not depend on one person.

* Support costing, valuation and other FinOps analyses, including financial sanity checks.

2. Inventory, costing and asset control

* Own the inventory valuation policy for produce, inputs (seeds, nutrients, growing media, packaging) and standing crop, and apply it consistently at every close.

* Fixed assets and CWIP: capitalisation policy for polyhouses, irrigation, climate control and cold-chain assets; asset tagging, physical verification, transfers, disposals and insurance cover.

* Review purchase price variances, yield and conversion losses against standards.

3. Internal financial controls and process governance

* Govern vendor and customer masters: onboarding, GST/PAN and bank-detail validation, duplicate checks, and contracted rates versus invoiced rates.

* Operate three-way match (PO–GRN–invoice) with exception reporting on price, quantity and off-contract purchases.

* Control credit and commercial leakage: credit limits and terms, and approval of discounts, credit notes, claims and write-offs within the delegation matrix.

* Revenue assurance: reconcile platform and modern-trade settlements, validate commissions and deductions, pursue claims, and track unbilled and uncollected revenue.

* Maintain the related-party register with supporting documentation and arm's-length pricing support on file.

* Review vendor, lease, customer and platform contracts from a finance and tax standpoint before signature.

* Manage cash-handling controls, petty-cash limits and surprise checks at farm locations.

* Keep insurance cover – crop, assets, stock-in-transit, liability – reviewed for adequacy, and see claims through.

* Track audit and control observations to closure, with owners and dates.

4. Tax and statutory compliance

* GST: monthly/quarterly returns (GSTR-1, GSTR-3B), annual returns (GSTR-9/9C), e-invoicing and e-way bills from Zoho. Handle a mixed portfolio of exempt fresh produce and taxable supplies (packaged/branded goods, services, scrap), including correct classification and proportionate ITC reversal.

* Reconcile GST TCS and income-tax TDS (e.g. Sec. 194-O) deducted by e-commerce operators and B2B customers against Form 26AS/AIS and GSTR-2B.

* TDS/TCS deduction, deposit and quarterly returns; Form 16/16A; advance tax and income-tax return filing, including the agricultural versus business income position.

* Labour-law compliance support: PF, ESIC, Professional Tax, LWF, Bonus and Gratuity, and contract-labour records – working closely with HR.

* Companies Act and ROC compliance support to the Company Secretary: board/AGM documentation, annual filings (AOC-4, MGT-7), share allotments and ESOP accounting.

* Maintain a compliance calendar across entities and locations, with due dates, owners and filing evidence.

5. Audit and financial reporting

* Prepare annual financial statements under the Ind AS where the thresholds apply – and coordinate statutory, tax and internal audits end to end, closing them on schedule with minimal adjustments.

* Maintain audit-ready documentation across the business for statutory and internal audit, including capex, grants and subsidies.

* Maintain statutory records and a retention policy for vouchers, contracts, registers and filings.

6. FP&A, costing and unit economics

* Support and maintain the annual budget, rolling forecasts and a 5-year operating model aligned to the Group's expansion plan.

* Develop crop-wise and SKU-wise costing (cost per kg and per sq. ft. under cultivation), covering seeds, nutrients, energy, labour, packaging, logistics and wastage.

* Publish the monthly MIS pack with variance analysis against budget

* Evaluate capex proposals for new farm phases (ROI, payback, lease versus buy).

7. Treasury, working capital and banking

* Run a 12-week rolling cash-flow forecast and manage daily cash, vendor payment runs and collections.

* Review the uploaded payments (within approved terms and the delegation matrix), with supporting documentation on file.

* Manage banking relationships, working-capital and term-loan facilities, covenant compliance, and any agri-linked or MSME schemes we can access.

8. Team, stakeholders and support

* Review the work of accounts executives and farm accountants; build review checklists and train the team on Zoho and compliance basics.

* Manage external consultants, tax advisors and auditors day to day.

* Partner with Operations, Supply Chain, Sales and HR as the finance point of contact on commercial and process questions.

* Give the Head of Finance & Accounts the schedules, reconciliations and analysis needed for board, investor and lender reporting, due diligence and fundraising.

* Contribute to finance-systems and automation initiatives as a user: requirements, testing and sign-off on outputs.

RequirementsMust-have

* Qualified Chartered Accountant (ICAI) with 4–5 years of post-qualification experience.

* At least 2 years of hands-on experience in Zoho Books – setting up and running books, not just viewing reports – including GST filing and reconciliation, and bank reconciliation.

* Strong working knowledge of GST (including exempt versus taxable supplies and ITC reversal), TDS, income tax and Companies Act compliance.

* Experience owning month-end close, MIS and statutory audits for a company with multiple locations or business lines.

* Experience designing or operating internal financial controls: approval matrices, reconciliations, physical verification and closure of audit observations.

* Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills for financial modelling, budgeting and analysis.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills, attention to detail and the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams.

* Willing to travel regularly to the farm and packhouse near Pune for stock counts, asset verification and site reviews.

Good to have

* Experience in agri-tech, FMCG, fresh produce, food processing, D2C/e-commerce or quick-commerce supply businesses.

* Exposure to inventory and cost accounting for perishables, yield and wastage tracking.

* Experience with venture-funded startups: investor reporting, due diligence, cap tables, ESOPs and FEMA filings.

* Familiarity with the wider Zoho suite.

* Knowledge of agricultural subsidies, government grants and their accounting.

* Working knowledge of Marathi and/or Hindi for dealing with farm, vendor and field teams.

* Prior experience leading an accounts and finance.

title: Practice Consultant
description:
**Practice Consultant – Regional Commercial Operations**

**What Makes Us a Great Place to Work**

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work. We are currently the #1 ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor's Best Places to Work list and have maintained a spot in the top four on Glassdoor's list since its founding in 2009.

Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don't happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

**Who You'll Work With**

Over the past two decades, Bain has formalized industry and capability areas, internally known as "Practices", integral to how Bain wins and delivers results to its clients. Practice is considered a business unit of Bain. The primary role of Practice is to drive growth for Bain in a particular industry or capability, together with offices, and boosting Bain's expertise and commercial excellence.

The APAC Applied Tech & AI Practice is Bain's regional practice supporting affiliates and case teams across the region on selling and serving of work involving tech and AI strategy and transformation, domain-specific solutions/builds, and tech and AI foundations. It draws capabilities across Product Management and Innovation, Data Science and Machine Learning Engineering, Application Engineering, Design and Research, Architecture, Process Excellence and Tech Delivery to customize the right solution for clients. We partner closely with global leadership, industry practices, other capability practices, and Bain's technology ecosystem (cloud solution providers, AI providers, systems integrators) to keep the region's offering current and commercially competitive.

This role will sit at the center of the day-to-day running of the practice owing the strategy, planning, and operations backbone and supporting the Practice Director on commercial, content, and senior stakeholder relationships.

**What You'll Do**

**Strategy and Planning**

* Regional practice plan and budget: Support the RCL and Practice Director in developing the regional practice plan and budget; coordinate with global team to ensure consistency of elements and approach
* Regional practice priorities and KPI tracking: Support the RCL and Practice Director in defining the Applied Tech & AI priorities and goals. Track progress monthly and proactively flag trends and risks
* Regional meetings: Own regional meeting planning including agenda and facilitators, working closely with RCL as well as other industry and capability practices to incorporate the best results stories and expertise from Applied Tech & AI
* Leadership reporting: Prepare and coordinate ongoing reporting into leadership forums on the progress and performance of the Applied Tech & AI Practice
* Practice team management: Coach and mentor team members; support knowledge team in receiving opportunities to build skills in content development. Help KM team decide what content to codify to meet commercial needs of the region (along with solution teams)

**Affiliate Management and Staffing**

* Affiliate engagement through regional calls, training/information sharing: Work with the RCL and Practice Director to set agendas for regional calls and trainings and coordinate with facilitators on specific topics
* Affiliate career development, HLAs and ratings: Provide input to RCL and Practice Director on affiliate contributions tracked during the HLA process; gather and coordinate input from solution teams
* Quarterback alignment and enablement: Support alignment of Applied Tech & AI quarterbacks to Bain priority accounts. Ensure quarterback assignments reflect in affiliate HLAs. Plan and run training on effective quarterback role
* Staffing and expert deployment in region; utilization management: Support RCL and Practice Director as needed on coordinating with offices on affiliate staffing, making suggestions to manage utilization and skill development for individuals

**Solution Deployment & Commercialization**

* Regional go-to-market strategy including win/loss learning & feedback: Support RCL / Practice Director on debrief calls with pitch teams and case teams; ask probing questions based on client context; develop an informed perspective on insights and patterns; feed learnings back to Solution teams and to affiliates for improved go-to-market
* Interlock execution in region with interlock champions: Measure interlock progress, including content creation and commercialization; support interlock content creation as needed, in coordination with the industry and other capability practices
* Manage and run quarterly business review (QBR) process with APAC regional managing director, Applied Tech & AI RCL, Industry RPLs and Interlock Leaders to ensure progress of interlocks and resolve roadblocks
* Direct proposal support: Work with interlock leaders, quarterbacks, and industry practices to prioritize must-wins in the region; Provide direct solution support on occasional opportunities where appropriate
* Central orchestrator of Bain Solution SKU in region, aligned with global standards, across Bain ecosystem: Provide in-region support for Solution ecosystems and deployment
* Client and case-team advisory and support: Support case teams with commercial requests in region, providing more detailed recommendations to rapid response requests

**Marketing and Brand Building**

* Regional external meetings/forums: Work with hosts and content facilitators to prepare for events, with limited RCL / Practice Director support; pre-wire calls, dry runs on content and discussions
* Regional marketing collateral: Create videos, blogs, briefs and other sales collateral with the Marketing team, specific to the region and to meet regional commercial goals; track ROI/impact

**About You**

**Education & Experience**

* 5–8 years' professional services + undergrad
* 4–5 years' experience with MBA/Master's

**Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* Analytical and problem-solving skills and expertise to push insights to conclusive recommendations
* Able to effectively drive pieces of work end-to-end with limited direction
* Able to prioritize, or work with supervisor to proactively prioritize when there are competing pieces of work
* Perform complex, accurate analysis independently; clearly communicate insights and implications of work
* Proficient Excel and PowerPoint based analysis and reporting; as well as comfort building and using dashboards and other reporting tools
* Continuously learn from one experience to another and make thoughtful recommendations on improvements
* Put together first draft of an executive summary or storyline; structure and design impactful slides and updates for senior audiences
* Steer and direct highly effective meetings; participate in meetings with more senior stakeholders and appropriately share opinions
* Able to understand clients’ core business needs and provide initial views/suggestions on the best of Bain’s solutions and capabilities to solve those needs
* Track record of inspiring, motivating and apprenticing junior team members

**Additional Requirements**

* Comfort operating in a fast-changing technology and AI space, and willing to learn and experiment with technology and new tools
* Flexibility with hours needed to work with global team
* In-office requirements as per local office and PPK guidelines
* Language requirements: Fluent English spoken and written

**A. Land Acquisition & Property Due Diligence**

* Conduct legal due diligence and title verification for land parcels identified for solar power projects, project offices, warehouses, and other company facilities.
* Examine ownership documents, title deeds, sale deeds, lease deeds, agreements to sell, revenue records, mutation entries, and encumbrance records.
* Verify the chain of title, ownership status, land classification, existing charges, litigation, and potential legal disputes.
* Identify title defects, ownership discrepancies, access issues, and other legal risks before acquisition or leasing.
* Prepare legal due diligence reports and provide recommendations to the management.

**B. Land Leasing & Documentation**

* Draft, review, and vet land lease agreements, agreements to sell, sale deeds, memoranda of understanding, possession letters, indemnities, affidavits, and other property-related documents.
* Coordinate negotiations and documentation with landowners, developers, intermediaries, and other stakeholders.
* Verify lease tenure, renewal provisions, rent escalation, access rights, termination clauses, and permitted land use.
* Ensure proper execution, stamping, registration, and record-keeping of property documents.
* Maintain a database of land parcels, landowners, lease terms, registration details, and contractual obligations.

**C. Solar Project Land & Regulatory Compliance**

* Assist in verifying land-use permissions, conversion approvals, access rights, right-of-way requirements, and other land-related permissions for solar projects, as applicable.
* Coordinate with relevant revenue, registration, municipal, industrial development, and other government authorities.
* Support the legal documentation required for project-site development, land possession, and site handover.
* Assist the project and business development teams in identifying legal restrictions affecting the proposed use of land for solar installations.
* Coordinate with internal teams and external legal counsel to address land-related objections, notices, disputes, and litigation.

**D. Government Liaison & Registration**

* Coordinate with Sub-Registrar Offices, revenue authorities, land-record departments, and other relevant authorities in Delhi and project locations.
* Facilitate property registration, mutation, record verification, certified copies, and other land-related documentation.
* Track applications, approvals, registrations, and pending legal formalities.
* Ensure compliance with applicable central and state laws, local land regulations, and registration requirements.

**E. Legal Risk Management & Reporting**

* Maintain an updated repository of property documents, title reports, agreements, approvals, and legal correspondence.
* Monitor lease expiry dates, renewal obligations, contractual milestones, and other time-sensitive requirements.
* Coordinate with external advocates on land disputes, property litigation, notices, and legal opinions.
* Prepare periodic reports on land acquisition status, due diligence findings, documentation gaps, and outstanding approvals.
* Work closely with the Projects, Business Development, Finance, Administration, and other relevant teams to support business requirements.

**3. Educational Qualification & Experience**

* LL.B. degree from a recognized university.
* 2–5 years of experience in land and property law, real estate, infrastructure, renewable energy, or project development.
* Experience in land acquisition, property title verification, lease documentation, and registration procedures.
* Experience handling land documentation for solar, power, infrastructure, or industrial projects will be an added advantage.

**4. Required Knowledge & Skills**

* Strong knowledge of property documentation, title searches, land records, and lease agreements.
* Familiarity with the Transfer of Property Act, Registration Act, applicable stamp laws, and relevant state land and revenue laws.
* Understanding of land-use permissions and regulatory requirements relevant to solar and infrastructure projects.
* Good legal drafting, negotiation, analytical, and documentation skills.
* Strong coordination skills for dealing with landowners, government authorities, external advocates, and internal departments.
* Proficiency in MS Office and legal document management systems.
* Willingness to travel to project sites and government offices as required.

**5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Timely execution and registration of lease deeds and other legal instruments.

As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.

In management at Crowe, you play a pivotal role in leading teams, guiding project execution, and deepening client relationships. You are expected to contribute to account planning, identify opportunities to add value, and ensure high-quality delivery. As your responsibilities expand, you take on broader account ownership, balancing project leadership with growing involvement in client strategy and solution development.

Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.

**Role Overview**

We are hiring a **Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations – Supply Chain Management Manager** to join our Customer Success team. This role is crucial in ensuring the stability and effectiveness of our D365 F&O system in the supply chain domain. You will collaborate with clients, functional teams, technical teams and developers to provide expert support, drive solutions and improve process outcomes. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in inventory management, procurement and sourcing, sales and marketing, warehouse management and asset management functions within D365 F&O, helping clients streamline operations and achieve operational excellence.

***Working hours: 1st Shift (12:00 PM - 9:00 PM)***

**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide expert support and consulting for D365 F&O Supply Chain modules (Inventory Management, Procurement and Sourcing, Sales and Marketing, Warehouse Management, Asset Management).
* Provide priority support for high severity cases identifying options to get past the initial issue and deliver the necessary long-term solution. Collaborate with internal teams and clients as needed for deliver root cause analysis for these cases.

* Monitor and respond to incidents and service requests within defined SLAs.
* Evaluate reported issues to identify where they stem from and work with the necessary team to resolve. This includes but is not limited to customer specific code, Crowe Metals Accelerator (CMA) and Microsoft functionalities.
* Prepare/maintain support documentation, configuration guides and process documentation.
* Support implementation of enhancements through the full software development life cycle, hotfixes and service updates.
* Support period-end/year-end business activities.
* Guide clients on best practices for configuration/processes and internal controls within D365 F&O.
* Continuous self-learning of new features/functionality/technologies as well as guiding younger team members on their cases/career.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Supply Chain, Business, Information Technology, or related field.
* Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience with D365 F&O
* Strong functional knowledge of D365 F&O SCM modules (Inventory, Procurement, Product Information Management, Warehouse Management).
* Microsoft certifications for Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management (preferred).
* Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, meticulous attention to detail and collaborative teamwork abilities.

* Clear, confident English communication – comfortable engaging directly with U.S. counterparts during the alternate shift.
* Ability to manage multiple client expectations and work in a fast-paced environment.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

* Experience supporting integrations between D365 SCM and 3PL, shipping carriers, or EDI platforms.
* Familiarity with manufacturing and distribution best practices.
* Experience with multi-entity or global deployments.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience managing business transformation and debottlenecking projects.
* Exposure to Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps).
* Good functional knowledge of D365 F&O SCM Asset Management

title: Electrical Site Engineer
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION – SOLAR SITE ENGINEER

**Company:** Solar4Ever Private Limited  
**Base Location:** Howrah Maidan, West Bengal  
**Work Location:** Project sites across West Bengal  
**Department:** Engineering & Project Execution  
**Employment Type:** Full-time  
**Experience:** 1–4 years  
**Qualification:** B.Tech / B.E. / Diploma in Electrical, Mechanical or Renewable Energy Engineering  
**Reporting To:** Project Manager / Head of Engineering  
**Salary:** As per qualifications, experience and technical competency

**Candidate must be willing to travel to any location in West Bengal. Accommodation will be provided by the company.**

1. About the Company

Solar4Ever Private Limited is a growing Solar EPC and Distribution company committed to delivering sustainable, reliable and innovative solar energy solutions across residential, commercial, industrial, institutional, government and railway sectors.

We are looking for a technically competent, proactive and result-oriented Solar Site Engineer to manage end-to-end solar project execution, including technical site surveys, system design, installation, testing, commissioning, quality assurance and site safety.

The ideal candidate should demonstrate strong technical knowledge, leadership capabilities, problem-solving skills and the ability to independently manage multiple project sites and installation teams.

2. Key Roles & ResponsibilitiesTechnical Site Survey & Feasibility Assessment

* Conduct detailed technical site surveys for residential, commercial and industrial solar projects.
* Assess rooftop dimensions, orientation, shading conditions and available installation area.
* Coordinate structural suitability assessments with qualified structural engineers.
* Analyze customer electricity consumption, sanctioned load and system capacity requirements.
* Assess existing electrical infrastructure, earthing systems and grid connectivity.
* Identify suitable locations for solar modules, inverters, electrical panels and cable routing.
* Identify technical constraints, installation challenges and potential safety hazards.
* Prepare detailed site survey reports with measurements, photographs and technical recommendations.

Solar System Design & Engineering

* Prepare solar PV system layouts and technical design proposals.
* Perform solar module and inverter sizing, string configuration and DC/AC ratio calculations.
* Prepare Single Line Diagrams (SLDs), cable routing plans and equipment layouts.
* Conduct shading analysis and energy generation simulations.
* Prepare Bill of Materials (BOM) and Bill of Quantities (BOQ).
* Perform cable sizing, voltage drop and electrical protection calculations.
* Coordinate mounting structure design, wind-load considerations and structural approvals.
* Optimize system design for maximum energy generation, reliability and cost efficiency.
* Ensure compliance with applicable MNRE, CEA, BIS, IEC and DISCOM requirements.
* Coordinate with Tata Power engineering teams for technical design validation and approvals, as applicable.

Project Planning & Execution

* Take ownership of assigned solar projects from technical survey to final commissioning.
* Prepare project execution plans, installation schedules and manpower requirements.
* Coordinate material availability with procurement and warehouse teams.
* Ensure site readiness before mobilizing installation teams.
* Allocate responsibilities to Site Supervisors, Solar Site Technicians and subcontractors.
* Monitor daily installation progress against approved project schedules.
* Identify project risks, dependencies and operational bottlenecks.
* Manage multiple project sites and ensure timely completion.
* Escalate technical, commercial and operational issues to management.
* Ensure projects are executed within approved budgets and quality standards.

Mechanical & Electrical Installation Supervision

* Supervise installation of solar module mounting structures on RCC rooftops, metal sheds and ground-mounted sites.
* Ensure correct module orientation, tilt, alignment and fastening.
* Supervise installation of solar modules, inverters, ACDB, DCDB and associated electrical equipment.
* Ensure proper DC and AC cable routing, termination and protection.
* Supervise earthing, lightning protection and surge protection system installation.
* Ensure installation activities comply with approved engineering drawings and manufacturer guidelines.
* Verify equipment ratings, cable specifications and electrical protection arrangements.
* Prevent unauthorized modifications to approved system designs.
* Ensure electrical works are performed by appropriately qualified and authorized personnel.

Testing, Commissioning & Net Metering

* Conduct or supervise pre-commissioning mechanical and electrical inspections.
* Verify string voltage, polarity, continuity, insulation resistance and earthing resistance.
* Supervise inverter configuration, protection settings and system commissioning.
* Configure remote monitoring systems and solar generation monitoring applications.
* Coordinate with WBSEDCL and other applicable DISCOMs for technical inspections and net-metering activities.
* Ensure all commissioning activities follow approved electrical safety procedures.
* Prepare testing reports, commissioning certificates and project completion documentation.
* Conduct final system demonstrations and technical handover to customers.

Quality Assurance & Quality Control

* Establish and implement site-level quality control procedures.
* Inspect incoming solar modules, inverters, mounting structures and electrical components.
* Verify installation quality against approved drawings, specifications and manufacturer guidelines.
* Conduct periodic quality inspections throughout project execution.
* Identify non-conformities and ensure timely corrective actions.
* Maintain installation quality checklists and inspection records.
* Ensure first-time-right installation and minimize rework.
* Verify equipment serial numbers and warranty documentation.
* Ensure compliance with company quality management procedures and ISO 9001-aligned practices.

Occupational Health, Safety & Environment (HSE)

* Take responsibility for implementing site-level occupational health and safety requirements.
* Ensure compliance with company HSE policies and ISO 45001-aligned procedures.
* Conduct site-specific Hazard Identification and Risk Assessment (HIRA).
* Prepare Job Safety Analysis (JSA) before critical installation activities.
* Conduct safety inductions and daily toolbox talks.
* Ensure appropriate PPE usage by employees, technicians and subcontractors.
* Implement approved working-at-height, fall protection and rescue arrangements.
* Ensure compliance with electrical isolation, Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) and applicable Permit to Work procedures.
* Monitor safe lifting, material handling and equipment usage.
* Investigate incidents, near misses and unsafe conditions.
* Maintain site safety records, working hours and incident reports.
* Exercise stop-work authority whenever unsafe working conditions are identified.
* Ensure productivity targets never compromise occupational health and safety.

Manpower Management & Leadership

* Lead and supervise Solar Site Technicians, Site Supervisors and subcontractor teams.
* Allocate manpower based on individual skills, technical competency and project requirements.
* Monitor team productivity, attendance, discipline and quality of workmanship.
* Provide hands-on technical guidance and mentoring to junior technicians.
* Conduct periodic technical training and skill development sessions.
* Develop standardized installation practices across project teams.
* Identify potential team leaders and support their professional development.
* Promote teamwork, accountability and a performance-driven working culture.

Material & Project Cost Management

* Prepare project-wise material requirements and coordinate procurement.
* Verify materials received at project sites against approved BOMs.
* Monitor material consumption and installation expenses.
* Minimize material wastage, equipment damage and unnecessary expenditure.
* Maintain records of tools, testing instruments and installation equipment.
* Monitor project expenditure against approved budgets.
* Identify opportunities for cost optimization without compromising quality or safety.
* Coordinate the return of unused and defective materials to the warehouse.
* Support project-wise profitability analysis.

Operation, Maintenance & Troubleshooting

* Supervise preventive and corrective maintenance of installed solar PV systems.
* Analyze system generation, inverter performance and operational efficiency.
* Investigate underperformance, inverter faults and electrical system failures.
* Conduct root cause analysis of recurring technical issues.
* Develop corrective and preventive action plans.
* Coordinate warranty claims and equipment replacements with manufacturers.
* Attend technical customer complaints and service escalations.
* Maintain service records and system performance reports.
* Ensure timely resolution of technical issues and customer satisfaction.

Customer & Stakeholder Management

* Provide technical consultation to prospective and existing customers.
* Support sales teams during technical discussions and commercial proposal preparation.
* Explain system design, installation methodology and expected energy generation.
* Coordinate with customers, contractors, consultants, vendors and DISCOM officials.
* Maintain professional communication throughout project execution.
* Manage customer expectations regarding technical deliverables and project timelines.
* Conduct final customer handover and provide system operation and maintenance guidance.

Documentation, MIS & Reporting

* Maintain detailed site survey reports, engineering drawings and project documentation.
* Prepare daily progress reports (DPR) and weekly project status reports.
* Maintain project-wise manpower, material consumption and expenditure records.
* Prepare installation, quality inspection and commissioning checklists.
* Maintain safety documentation, incident reports and corrective action records.
* Prepare as-built drawings and final project handover documentation.
* Update project status in the company's CRM and project management systems.
* Provide regular MIS reports to management highlighting progress, risks and pending activities.

3. Required Qualifications & Skills

* B.Tech, B.E. or Diploma in Electrical, Mechanical or Renewable Energy Engineering.
* 1–4 years of relevant experience in solar EPC, electrical installation or project execution.
* Strong understanding of on-grid, off-grid and hybrid solar PV systems.
* Knowledge of solar modules, inverters, mounting structures and electrical protection systems.
* Understanding of electrical load calculations, cable sizing, earthing and protection systems.
* Ability to interpret engineering drawings, SLDs and technical specifications.
* Proficiency in AutoCAD and Microsoft Excel.
* Familiarity with solar design tools such as PVsyst, HelioScope, SketchUp or equivalent applications.
* Knowledge of electrical testing instruments and commissioning procedures.
* Strong project planning, analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent leadership and team management capabilities.
* Good communication skills in Bengali, Hindi and English.
* Ability to manage multiple projects independently.
* Willingness to travel extensively and relocate anywhere within West Bengal as per business requirements.
* Medical suitability for assigned site activities and willingness to work at heights following appropriate safety training.

4. Preferred Candidate Profile

* Prior experience in residential, commercial or industrial rooftop solar EPC projects.
* Experience in independently managing solar project execution.
* Knowledge of Tata Power solar products and installation practices.
* Familiarity with PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana and DISCOM technical requirements.
* Experience in industrial, institutional or railway solar projects.
* Knowledge of electrical safety, working-at-height procedures and ISO management systems.
* Experience in managing technicians, contractors and installation teams.
* Familiarity with project costing, resource planning and inventory management.
* Electrical Supervisor Licence or other relevant electrical competency certification will be an added advantage.
* Candidates with a two-wheeler and valid driving licence will be preferred.
* Immediate joiners will be preferred.

Fresh engineering graduates with strong technical knowledge, leadership potential and willingness to learn may be considered for a Trainee Solar Site Engineer position.

5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Timely project completion and commissioning.
* Monthly installed and commissioned solar capacity (kWp).
* Accuracy of technical site surveys and engineering designs.
* First-time-right installation quality.
* Project execution within approved budgets.
* Material consumption and wastage control.
* Installation team productivity and resource utilization.
* Occupational health and safety compliance.
* Lost Time Injury Frequency Rate (LTIFR).
* Lost Time Injury Severity Rate (LTISR).
* Timely closure of technical issues and non-conformities.
* Customer satisfaction and service resolution.
* Accuracy and completeness of project documentation.
* Timely submission of project MIS reports.
* Technical training and development of installation teams.

6. What We Offer

* Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience.
* Performance-based growth opportunities.
* Exposure to residential, commercial, industrial and large-scale solar EPC projects.
* Advanced technical and engineering training.
* Occupational health and safety training.
* Opportunities to work with leading solar technology manufacturers.
* Leadership opportunities within an expanding engineering organization.
* Long-term career progression in the renewable energy sector.

7. How to Apply

Interested candidates are requested to share their updated resume with the subject line **"Application for Solar Site Engineer – Solar4Ever"**.

**Email:** HR@solar4ever.in  
**Contact:** +91 9836393935  
**Website:** www.solar4ever.in

**Office Address:**  
Solar4Ever Private Limited  
357/5, Belilious Road, Howrah Maidan  
Howrah, West Bengal – 711101

**Solar4Ever**  
*Infinite Energy. Endless Possibilities.*

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹25,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Food provided
* Life insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person
